syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Hia goweli kanoheha tsunetlvtanvsv Tsisa Galonedv, Dewi uwetsi, Equahami uwetsi.
english: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᏏᎩᏃ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᏧᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Equahami Esigi udenelei; Esigino Tsegaqui udenelei, Tsegaquino Tsuda ale nasgi anadanvtli gvwadenelei;
english: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏃ ᏇᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏎᎳ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᏖᎹ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏇᎵᏏᏃ ᎢᏏᎳᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᏏᎳᎻᏃ ᎡᎵᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Tsudano Quelisi ale Sela gvwadenelei Tema dunanugowisei; Quelisino Isilami udenelei; Isilamino Elimi udenelei;
english: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎵᎻᏃ ᎡᎻᏂᏓᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎻᏂᏓᏈᏃ ᎾᏐᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎾᏐᏂᏃ ᏌᎵᎹ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Elimino Eminidaqui udenelei; Eminidaquino Nasoni udenelei; Nasonino Salima udenelei;
english: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᎵᎹᏃ ᏉᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᎾᎸᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏉᏏᏃ ᎣᏇᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᎷᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᎣᏇᏗᏃ ᏤᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Salimano Quosi udenelei Lehawi unalvgowisei; Quosino Oquedi udenelei Lusi unanugowisei; Oquedino Tsesi udenelei;
english: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᏏᏃ ᏕᏫ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏕᏫᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ ᏳᎳᏯ ᎤᏓᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Tsesino Dewi ugvwiyuhi udenelei; Dewino ugvwiyuhi Solimanv udenelei Yulaya udayvdv unanugowisei;
english: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎵᎹᏅᏃ ᎶᏉᎹ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎶᏉᎹᏃ ᎡᏆᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᏆᏯᏃ ᎡᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Solimanvno Loquoma udenelei; Loquomano Equaya udenelei; Equayano Esi udenelei;
english: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏏᏃ ᏦᏏᏆ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ.  ᏦᏏᏆᏃ ᏦᎳᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏦᎳᎻᏃ ᎣᏌᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Esino Tsosiqua udenelei.  Tsosiquano Tsolami udenelei; Tsolamino Osaya udenelei;
english: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏌᏯᏃ ᏦᏓᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏦᏓᎻᏃ ᎡᎭᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎭᏏᏃ ᎮᏏᎦᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Osayano Tsodami udenelei; Tsodamino Ehasi udenelei; Ehasino Hesigaya udenelei;
english: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎮᏏᎦᏯᏃ ᎹᎾᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎹᎾᏏᏃ ᎠᎼᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎼᏂᏃ ᏦᏌᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Hesigayano Manasi udenelei; Manasino Amoni udenelei; Amonino Tsosaya udenelei;
english: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏌᏯᏃ ᏤᎪᎾᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᏗᎶᏂ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Tsosayano Tsegonaya ale anadanvtli gvwadenelei; nahiyu Dadiloni tsiwidigegatinvstanei;
english: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏃᎸ ᏤᎪᎾᏯ ᏌᎳᏓᏱᎵ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏌᎳᏓᏱᎵᏃ ᏥᎳᏇᎵ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Dadilonino widigegatinolv Tsegonaya Saladayili udenelei; Saladayilino Tsilaqueli udenelei;
english: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎳᏇᎵᏃ ᎠᏆᏯᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᏆᏯᏗᏃ ᎢᎳᏯᎩᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᎳᏯᎩᎻᏃ ᎡᏐ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Tsilaquelino Aquayadi udenelei, Aquayadino Ilayagimi udenelei; Ilayagimino Eso udenelei;
english: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏐᏃ ᏎᏙᎩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᏎᏙᎩᏃ ᎡᎩᎻ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎡᎩᎻᏃ ᎢᎳᏯᏗ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Esono Sedogi udenelei; Sedogino Egimi udenelei; Egimino Ilayadi udenelei;
english: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᏯᏗᏃ ᎢᎵᎡᏌ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎢᎵᎡᏌᏃ ᎹᏓᏂ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ; ᎹᏓᏂᏃ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Ilayadino Iliesa udenelei; Iliesano Madani udenelei; Madanino Tsegaqui udenelei;
english: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏕᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᎭᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Tsegaquino Tsowa udenelei, nasgi Meli uyehi nasgi tsunanugowise Tsisa Galonedv tsanohahoi.
english: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏤᎮ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏫᏃ ᏤᎮ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ; ᏕᏫᏃ ᏤᎮ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᎵᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ; ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏕᏁ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᏛᏍᏘ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏄᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigadv nunadanetliyvsv Equahami tsehe nahiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv Dewino tsehe nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei; Dewino tsehe nahiyu nvligvwadalenvdv Dadilonino tsiwidigegatinvstane nahiyu nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei; Dadilonino nahiyu tsiwidigegatinvstane udayudalenvdv Tsisano tsudene nahiyu nvdvsti nigadu nunadanetliyvsei.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎴ ᎤᏕᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏥ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏂᏓᎾᏤᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nulistanidole udenv Tsisa Galonedv.  Nasgi Meli Tsisa utsi Tsowa udayvsdi, asiquo nidanatsegvna gesei, unelitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanvtelvhi.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏮᏓᏥᏯᎧᏂ, ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsowa nasgi na tsunatsvsdi udanvtiyu gesv iyusdi, ale nudulisgvna gesv iyusdi gvnigesv udehohisdodiyi, udelidvquo iyvdv wvdatsiyakani, uwelisei.
english: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏦᏩ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸ ᎯᏯᏅᏗᏱ ᎺᎵ ᏣᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᏥᎦᏁᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Aseno asiquo hia nasgi nusdeadanvtesgei, gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi Yihowa unvsidv gvnigesv nudvnele asgidasgvi, hia nigawesgei; Tsowa, Dewi uwetsi, tlesdi tsasgalv hiyanvdiyi Meli tsadayvsdi, nasgiyeno na tsiganeli Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanvtelvhi;
english: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎯᏲᎥᎭ, ᏧᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᏙᏓᎫᏓᎴᏏ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dagananugowisi atsutsa, nasgino TsiSa dehiyovha, tsutseliyeno yvwi dodvsdelvhi dodagudalesi unisganvtsvi.
english: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgino hia nigadiyu nulistanidole udohiyudiyi ayelvsvi hia tsinuwese Yihowa adolehosgi agvdisgvi;
english: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏛ ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎹᏄᎡᎵ ᎠᏃᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo adv natsiyehvna ganelidv gesesdi, ale dagananugowisi atsutsa, nasgino Imanueli anosehesdi, nasgi anetlvtanvhi gesv hia nusdi gadvga, Unelanvhi igeladidoha.
english: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩᏃ ᎤᏰᏨ ᎤᎸᏅᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᏯᏅᎨᏉ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsowano uyetsv ulvnvi dikahnawadidohi Yihowa nvdayunvsidv nuweselv nudvnelei, uyanvgequo udayvsdi.
english: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏙᎥᏎᎢ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᏑᏬᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Ale vtla yugadovsei gvni unanugowisv igvyi ehi uwetsi atsutsa, Tsisano suwoei.
english: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏤᎮ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᏅᏙ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᎶᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano udenv Gaduyi gaduhv Tsudiyi, nahiyu tsehe Elodv ugvwiyuhi, gvniyuquo unilutse Tsilusilimi anigatahnai nvdo dikalvgv iditlv tsunilosei,
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎭᏢ Ꮎ ᏧᏕᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎣᎩᎪᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; hatlv na tsudenv Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga, ogigohvyeno utseli noquisi dikalvgv iditlv, ale otsadadolisdaneliga.
english: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Elodvno ugvwiyuhi udvganv nasgi, uwelihisdi udanvdadei, ale nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi.
english: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎳᏫᏛᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏃᏪᎳᏁᎯ, ᏚᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏕᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Dulawidvno nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi, ale yvwi dinowelanehi, dudvdvnei, nahna udedi gesv Galonedv.
english: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏧᏗᏱ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏩᏅ ᎤᏬᏪᎳ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei; Tsudiyi Gaduyi gaduhvi; hiayeno nuwanv uwowela adolehosgi;
english: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᎶᏓᏑᏯ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᏣᏄᎪᏥ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵ-ᏗᎧᏁᏤᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nihi Gaduyi gaduhv Tsudiyi, vtlasgini tsasdikani yigi, tsilodasuya nunigvwiyusv Tsudiyi, nihiyeno datsanugotsi diquatseli yvwi Isilidikanetsehi.
english: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏛᏘᏌᏁ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Elodv udelidv widuyanvhv nasgi anigatahnai, osdv dudvtisane iyuquo nasgi noquisi unanugotsvi.
english: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, inquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᎦᏚᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏤᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏪᏥᏲᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏥᏩᏛᎲᎭ, ᎢᏍᎩᏃᏁᎵᎸᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ale dunvse Gaduyi, hia nuwesei; Itsena osdv wetsiyoga nasgi usdi ayoli, iyuno etsiwadvhvha, isginonelilvha, ayvno nasquo witsilutsvha, ale tsiyadadolisdanelvha.
english: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏃᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏁᏅᎡᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏭᎷᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᎵ ᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unadvganonelvno ugvwiyuhi unanigisei, gvniyuquono noquisi, nasgi unigohvhi dikalvgv iditlv, igvyi unenvelei, gvni wulutsilv ale ulewistanv galvladitlv nahna atsili ehvi.
english: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎤᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Unigohvno nasgi noquisi, ulotanvhi unalihelitsei.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᏲᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎺᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎳᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᎸᏁ ᏅᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎠᏜᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎻᎳ.
phonetic: Adanelvno uniyvlv unigohe ayotla ale utsi Meli, ale eladi dunadanvnei, unadadolisdanelei, ale tsugvwalodi unilanvdv dunisduisv uninelvne nvnalisgolvtanvhi, adelvdalonidv, ale uganasdv gawasvgi adla, ale mila.
english: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎡᎶᏛᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Anasgidasgvno Unelanvhi dunetselv Elodvyi wunilohisdiyi nigesvna, unanigisv utsatiniquo iditlv wunilose iunenv unatseligohi.
english: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏘᏄᎦ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏘ, ᎢᏥᏈ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏪᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᏫᎬᏁᏤᎸᎭ, ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏲᎵ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unanigisvno gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi unvsidv Yihowa gvnigesv nudvnele Tsowa asgidasgvi, hia nuweselei; Talehvga, ale tatinuga ayoli ale utsi ale haliti, Itsiqui wilohi, nahnano wehesdi gvni wigvnetselvha, Elodvyeno ase dvyoli usdi ayoli uhisdiyi.
english: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᏒᏃᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏛᏱ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dulenv utinvse ayoli ale utsi svnoyi, ale Itsidvyi wulosei.
english: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏪᎮ ᎬᏂ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏮᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏫᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏇᏥ.
phonetic: Ale nahna wehe gvni Elodv uyohusv; udohiyune Unelanvhi unetsvi, adolehosgi tsuwvtanei, hia tsinuwesei; Itsiquiyi witsiyanvhv aquetsi.
english: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎬᏩᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᏫᏚᏂᎰᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᎾᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏩᏍᏘ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏓᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏥᏓᏛᏛᎮᎸᎥᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Elodv udolehosv anigatahnai gvwalidastanvi, utsatanvhi utalawosei, ale udanvse widunihone nigadv diniyoli gaduyi anehi, ale nigadv nigvnadv nahnani, tali iyunadetiyvdv wasti, nahiyu nvdayudalenvdv tsidalisinahisdanehe tsidadvdvhelvvsge anigatahnai.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Hnaquono udohiyune Tselimaya adolehosgi unetsvhi, ale tsinuwesei;
english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎴᎹᏱ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎢ; ᎴᏥᎵ ᏓᏍᎪᏂᎲ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Lemayi kanegv unadvganvgi, daniyvgvi, ale danatloyihvi, ale utsati unelugvi; letsili dasgonihv tsuwetsi, ale nudulisgvna gesv unuwohisdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv nanehvnaquo gesvi.
english: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Elodv uyohusv, gvniyuquo dikahnawadidohi Yihowa utseliga gvnigesv nudvnele Tsowa asgidasgv Itsiquiyi,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏘᏄᎦ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᎾ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎬᏅ ᏧᏂᏲᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nuweselei; Talehvga ale hatinuga ayoli ale utsi, ale hena Isiliyi, hnaquoyeno duniyohusv ayoli gvnv tsuniyohvgi.
english: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Dulenvno utinvse ayoli ale utsi, ale Isiliyi wulutsei.
english: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏯᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎪᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno udvganv Atsila ugvwiyuhi gesv Tsudiyi udoda Elodv udanetliyvsdanelvi, usgale nahna wulohisdiyi; aseno Unelanvhi uweyatanvhi gesv asgidasgvi, Gelili wugolvstanei;
english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎮᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏁᏤᎢ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏧᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gaduhvno Naselidi tsudoidv wulutsv nahna ehei.  Nasgino udohiyune anadolehosgi tsuninetsei, Naselidi ehi agosehesdi, tsunadvnei.
english: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏧᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Nahiyu ulutse Tsani Didawosgi alitsidohvsge inage Tsudiyi,
english: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nigawesgei; Ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, hnaquoyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
english: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏅᏅ ᏗᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia na tsikaneisdisge adolehosgi Isaya, hia tsinigawesgei; Uweluga gilo inagei, hia nigaweha; Osdv nitsvga Yihowa ulohisdiyi, dunvnv ditsitsinohisda.
english: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏄᏪ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᏅᎯ, ᎦᏃᏥᏃ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏕᎢ, ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏃ ᎥᎴ ᎨᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᏃ ᎡᎯ ᏩᏚᎵᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia Tsani unuwe gemili ustiyenvhi, ganotsino udatlosdei, ulisdayvdino vle gese inageno ehi wadulisi.
english: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏉᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏅᎾᏛ ᏦᏓᏂ,
phonetic: Naquono wigvwalutsele Tsilusilimi ale nigadv Tsudiyi, ale nigadv nanvnadv Tsodani,
english: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏓᏂᏃ ᏕᎤᏬᎡᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsodanino deuwoei, aninohvsge unisganvtsvi.
english: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎠᏂᎷᎬ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎴᎢ; Ᏺ! ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ! ᎦᎪ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᏨᏣᎢ?
phonetic: Aseno dugohv unitsati Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi anilugv dadawosgvi, hia niduwehalei; Yo! inadv tsunetsi nihi! Gago itseyatanv etsaliediyi utalawohisdi tsvtsai?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏩᏲᎪ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Itsinanugowayogo adolehohisdodi detsinetliyvsv detsadanvdvi;
english: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏲᏥᏪᏏ ᎢᏤᎵᏒᎩ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ; ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎬᏓ ᏱᏕᎪᏢᎾ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Ale tlasdi hia nvdayotsiwesi itselisvgi doditsadanvdvi; Equahami ogidoda; itsvyoseyeno Unelanvhi yeliquo hia nvya yidegvda yidegotlvna Equahami tsuwetsi.
english: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎦᎷᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎭ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo gayula galuyasdi aha duhnasdetlv detlugvi; nasgino nigadv detlugv anosdv nanadadvsgvna digaleyvsdodi ale atsilvyi widadinvdi gesesdi.
english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏕᏨᏯᏬᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏂ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᏧᎳᏑᎶ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏗᎩᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏙᏓᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ayv udohiyuhi ama detsvyawosdiha ditsinetliyvsdiyi detsadanvdv ugvwali; aseno nasgi na oni tsvdayai utlihiyu ulinigidiyu esgaquo ayv, tsulasulo vtla yeli yinigoi diginidasdiyi; nasgisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale atsilv dodatsawostani.
english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎳᏐᏫᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎦᎳᏐᏫᏏ, ᎤᏤᎵᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᏛᏂ ᎠᏓᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏘᏴᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏛᎪᎲᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi galasowisdi utseliga ayeha, ale nigadv dagalasowisi, utselino ugatatanvhi dagatlisani dvni adananvdiyi utiyvhisgini dvgohvstani nigvtlosgvna atsilvyi.
english: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏧᎶᏎᎢ, ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏣᏂ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa Gelili tsulosei, Tsodani ulutse Tsani edohvi agawosdiyi uyelvsei.
english: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏢᏫᏎᎴᏉ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏍᏆᏬᎥ; ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᎷᏤᎭ?
phonetic: Aseno Tsani dutlvwiselequo, hia nuwesei; Ayvsgini yisquawov; tsigono isgilutseha?
english: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎮᎳ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎩᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎩᎳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano tsunetsv hia nuweselei; Unelagi hela gohi gesvi, osiyuyeno nasgi iginadvnediyi ginisquadisdiyi nigav duyugodv gesvi.  Gila unelagi uweliselei.
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏬᎥ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏎᎢ, ᎠᎹᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏣᏥᏍᏚᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎪᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏧᏛᎿᎭᏗᏎ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎵᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano agawov, gilaquo iyvdv uhnalusei, amayi udanvsei, ale gvniyuquo galvladi tsatsisdugielei, ale wugohe Unelanvhi Udanvdo eladi nvtsudvhnadise guledisgonihi ditselidv; ale uweyalvtsei.
english: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏥᏰᎸᎠ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo hia nvtsuwese galvladi; Hia tsigeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu tsitsiyelva.
english: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Adanvdo inage wutinvstane Tsisa, asgina ugoliyediyi ayelvsei.
english: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎤᏩᏅ ᎩᎳ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏁᎢ
phonetic: Nvgasgohino tsudodaquadv ale nvgasgohi tsusvhidv amatli uwanv gila uyosisanei
english: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᎦᏚ ᎤᎾᏙᏢᏗᏱ ᎯᏁᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ugoliyesgi ulutselv hia nuwesei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, hia nvya gadu unadotlvdiyi hinegi.
english: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏚᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎬᎿᎭᏗᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno unetsv, hia nuwesei; Hia nigvnv gowela, yvwi vtla gaduquo uwasv yigvhnadisdi, nigavsgini kanohedv Unelanvhi aholi nvdayunanugotsvhi.
english: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎩᎸᏔᏁ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Hnaquono asgina galvquodiyu digaduhv wutinvstanei, ale wugilvtane usgoli udvnvdigalawiisdiyi;
english: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎶᎥᏓ ᏨᏒ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏎ ᏙᏓᎧᏁᏤᎵ ᎫᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᏌ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᎨᏣᏌᎳᏙᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏣᎾᏍᏆᎶᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, hadalovda tsvsv; hiayeno nigvnv igowela; Ase dodakanetseli gutseli dinikahnawadidohi nisa gesv ugvwali, ale tsunoyeni getsasaladodesdi nasgi ilvhiyu nvyohi tsanasqualosdodiyi nigesvna.
english: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselei; Hia nasquo nigvnv igowela; Tlesdi higoliyevgi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi.
english: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏆᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏅ-ᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏫᎤᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏎᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏬᏚᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hnaquale asgina utsati invigati odalv wiutinvstanei, ale dusehele nigav ayeli degotlvwadisv elanigvi, ale nasgi niduwodusvi;
english: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuweselei; Hia nigadv yidegvyohisi, iyuno yitsadanvnv, ale yisquadadolisdanelv.
english: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᏎᏓᏂ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏎ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏕᎯᏯᏁᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselei; Utli wilohi, Sedani, hiayeno nigvnv igowela; ase hiyadadolisdanehesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi, ale nasgiquo uwasvhiyu dehiyanelodesdi.
english: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gilano asgina udanvelei, gvniyuquono dinikahnawadidohi unilutsei, ale gvwasdelvhidolei.
english: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏣᏂ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎲᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvganv Tsani atsisduhvi, Gelili wulosei.
english: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏎᎵᏗᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎨᎷᏤ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏕᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ, ᏤᏆᎳᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏁᏩᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ,
phonetic: Naselidino udanvsv gequani gelutse nahna wudenei, nasgi vdali amayulodi tsigaduha, Tsequalani ale Newatali unatseligohi,
english: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Udohiyudiyi adolehosgi Isaya tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᏆᎳᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏩᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎢᏓᎵ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Tsequalani unatseligohi, ale Newatali unatseligohi, idali iditlv, Tsodani udiditlv, Gelili Tsunadalenvdv yvwi daninelvi,
english: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎾᏃ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ, ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Yvwi ulisigv tsaninvgi utsati igagati unigohv, nano ayohuhisdiyi gesv utseligohi ale udawadisgv tsaninvgi, igagati uninanugotselv.
english: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Tsisa ulenvhe alitsidohvsgei, hia nigawesgei; ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, hnaquoyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
english: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎨᎢ-ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano aisv Gelili vdalulodi dugohe anitali analinvtli, Sawani Quida tsanosehoi unvtlino Enidi, vdali anigayaluvsgeianigayaluvsgiyeno gesei.
english: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᎢᏍᏗᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏍᏛᏴᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Sginisdawaduga, yvwino isdigayaluvsgi nvdasdvyvneli.
english: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏗᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose digayaludi ale gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎤᏪᏅ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏚᎪᎮᎢ, ᏥᎻ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᏣᏂ, ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎡᎢ, ᏓᏃᏢᎯᏏᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ; ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᏃ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiuwenv, anitali nvwanadale analinvtli dugohei, Tsimi Tsequidi uwetsi unvtlino Tsani, tsequidi unidoda tsiyuhi unatsaei, danotlvhisisge tsunigayaludi; widuyanvheno.
english: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏥᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose tsiyu ale unidoda, ale gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎨ ᏧᎵᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano nigvnadv Gelili edohei dadeyohvsge tsunilawiisdiyi, ale alitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgei, ale dekanvwisge tsulilenvdv dunitlvgvi, ale tsudalenvdv vyugi yvwi unehvi.
english: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎤᏰᎵᏎᎢ; ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᏃᏘᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩ; ᏚᏅᏩᏁᏃ.
phonetic: Deganotsalvno nigvnadv Siliyi uyelisei; degvwatinoheleno nigadv tsunitlvgi, tsudalenvdv vyugi ale ehisdi uniyilidohi, ale nasquo anisgina digvwaniyai, ale nasquo tsunilvnotisgi, ale nasquo tsuninawisgi; dunvwaneno.
english: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ-ᎦᏚᎩᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino yvwi gvwasdawadvsei nvdayunilosvhi gelili, AsgohinoGadugiyi, ale Tsilusilimi, ale Tsudiyi, ale Tsodani sgoniditlv.
english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏫᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏎᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino widugohv usahilv uhnalusei, uwenvno gvwasdawadidohi gvwalutselei.
english: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎰᎵᏃ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Aholino usduisv duweyone hia nuwesei;
english: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo iyunadvhnadegi dunadanvdvi; unatseliyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᏛᎨᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏂᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo unadanvtawadegi, dvgetsinuwohistaniyeno.
english: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unadanvti, gadohiyeno unatseli iyulisdodi.
english: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᏛᎨᏥᎧᎵᎵᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uniyosisgi ale unitadegisgi unadanvti iyunalisdodiyi; dvgetsikaliliyeno.
english: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ, ᏛᎨᏥᏙᎵᏥᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unadadolitsati, dvgetsidolitsiyeno.
english: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ;
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi tsudanvgalvdv tsuninawi, Unelanvhiyeno unigowadvdi;
english: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏛᎨᎪᏎᎵ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi anohisdisgi, Unelanvhiyeno tsuwetsi dvgegoseli.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᎾᏕᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi uyo igegvnadegi duyugodv gesv unisdvdisgi, unatseliyeno galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎨᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Osiyu itsalisdanedi iyuno yvwi usonv nigetsiwesehesdi ale uyo nigetsvnehesdi, ale nigav tsudalenvdv usonv gayegogi getsinohesgesdi ayv gesv itsisdvdisgesdi.
english: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏥ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᏂᎨᏤᏅᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Itsaliheligesdi ale utsatanvhi osdv itsadanvtesdi, utsatiyeno etsaguyvedi galvladi; nasgiyayeno utsi nidunvnelvgi anadolehosgi igvyi tsinigetsenvelv.
english: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹ ᏳᏥᏍᎪᎸ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏙᏢᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ, ᎠᏗᏅᏗᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗ.
phonetic: Nihi ama elohi utseliga; iyusgini ama yutsisgolv gado yigalisdoda ama yadotlvna; vtla hnaquo gohusdi gvdodi yigagi, adinvdiquo uwasv, ale yvwiquo unalasdaedi.
english: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᏥᎦᎧᎰᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏰᎬᏍᎦᎸᎦ.
phonetic: Nihi iga itsatisdisgi elohi.  Gaduhv usahilv tsigakahoi vtla yeli yvgayegvsgalvga.
english: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏯᏄᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎦᏃ ᎤᎾᏘᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yvwi anitsvsdvga atsvsdodi atlilosdi yanutlvdisgoi, gagodiyisgini anikahvsgoi, igano unatisdaneho nigadv galitsode aniyai.
english: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏘᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Iga itsatisdisgv dunilvsadadehesdi yvwi, nasgino osdv detsilvwisdanehv anigowatisgesdi, ale anilvquodisgesdi Itsidoda galvladi ehi.
english: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏲᏍᏔᏂᎸ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏓᎩᏲᏍᏔᏂᎸ, ᏓᎩᎧᎵᎵᎸᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Tlesdi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi duyostanilv yisgiyelisehesdi; vtlasgini yidagiyostanilv, dagikalililvsgini.
english: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfill.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏭᏍᏗᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎶᎯ ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᎧᎵᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, gvni galvloi ale elohi anilosonvha saquo usdi ale saquo wusdigv dikahnawadvsdi vtla yvgalohi gvni nigadiyu akalitsvha.
english: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo ayosdisgesdi saquo hia usdikani ulinetsvi, ale nasgi nusdesdi yvwi degeyohvsgesdi, nasgi usdikani agosehesdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; gilosgini dakahnawadegesdi, ale nasgi nusdesdi dadeyohvsgesdi, galvquodiyu agosehesdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏨᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᏥᏴᎭ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha, itsvno nasgi itsadanvti gesv niditsigonadvtanvna igesesdi dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi, vtla galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv yvgetsiyvha.
english: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsadalvgi; ale gilo adahihesdi gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi dinugodisgiyi.
english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎢᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏣᏁᎫ ᎢᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo dinadanvtli asgagesdi gohusdi nusdvdisgvna igesesdi, gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi dinugodisgiyi; gilono dinadanvtli Nitsadanvdvna igosehesdi, degalawiv gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi; gilono Tsanegu igosehesdi, gvwasdvdisdi gesesdi tsvsgino atsilvyi.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎢᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏤᎵᏎᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsilvgelasdiyi hiyohihesdi tsadanedi, nahnano ihanvdadisgesdi disdadanvtli gohusdi tselisehvi,
english: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎯᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏅᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᎩᎳᏃ ᎯᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Nahna atsilvgelasdiyi hihiyasgesdi tsadanedi ale hadanvsgesdi, igvyi osdv nisdvnehesdi disdadanvtli; gilano hilugesdi halisgolvdisgesdi tsadanedi.
english: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎳᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏛ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱᎾᏏ ᏫᏱᏣᎧᎲᎦ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏱ ᏫᏱᏣᎧᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏱᏪᏣᏴᏓ.
phonetic: Nulaquo osdv nisdv tsayilidohi, asiquo isdaisvi, digugodisgiyinasi wiyitsakahvga tsayilidohi, digugodisgino didaniyisgiyi wiyitsakahvga, ale didasdudiyi yiwetsayvda.
english: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎦᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᏰᎵᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎭᎫᏴᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Vtla yvdvgahinugoi, gvni ulisqualvdi ayeliiyadanvtedi haguyvhvha.
english: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi.
english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏓᎧᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏓᏲᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo ageyv dakanisgesdi tsunanisidiyi udulisgesdi, gayula udayonelvhi gesesdi tsudanvdvi.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏣᎵᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏱᏣᏲᎱᏎᎭ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎯᏰᎸ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno higadoli higatisi detsodesdisgesdi, hadagatedoisgesdi, ale tsadegesdi; osiyuyeno itsalisdanedi saquoquo tsaligvhalvdv yitsayohuseha, ano unosdv hiyelv tsvsgino wiyetsadaineha.
english: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏣᎵᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏱᏣᏲᎱᏎᎭ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎯᏰᎸ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno tsoyeni higatisi detsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi, ale tsadegesdi; osiyuyeno itsalisdanedi saquoquo tsaligvhalvdv yitsayohuseha, ano unosdv hiyelv tsvsgino wiyetsadaineha.
english: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut if off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎦᎴᏅᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hia igawedv igi; Gilo udalii igakahvsgesdi, ganvnehesdi goweli nasgi dunagalenvhvi.
english: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏂᏏᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏓᏲᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎬᏂᏌᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Gilo udalii igakahvsgesdi, tsunisinvhisgininonv igesesdi, udayonediyiquo nigvnisanehesdi; gilono atsikanvhi adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏘ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏲᏍᏔᏅ ᏣᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏯᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale itsadvganvhi igi hia tsinigetsiwesele eti tsanehei; Tlesdi tsayostanv tsaselitanvi, yihowasgini niyadvnehesdi nusdv tsanetsvi.
english: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏎᎵᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Tlesdi yitsaselitanesdi yitsaneistanesdi gohusdi, tlesdi galvladi yitsaneistanesdi, Unelanvhiyeno uwediyi nasgi;
english: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏧᎳᏏᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Tlesdi ale elohi, tsulasidiyiyeno nasgi; ale Tsilusilimi, nasgiyeno atsilvquodi Ugvwiyuhi utseli gaduhvi;
english: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎪᎵ ᏱᏣᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎩᏢ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎿᎭᎨ ᏱᏅᎦᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdi ale hisgoli yitsaneistanesdi, tlayeno yeli saquo gitlv unegv ale gvhnage yinvgahvga.
english: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎥᎥ, ᎥᎥ; ᎥᏝ, ᎥᏝ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎦᎣ ᎤᏲᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Itsinegvsgini hia nusdesdi, Vv, Vv; Vtla, Vtla; utliyeno tsinigao uyoquo gesv didalenisgoi.
english: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᎦᏔᏉ ᏓᎬᏩᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎧᏳᎦᏃ ᎧᏳᎦᏉ ᏓᎬᏩᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvhi igi hia igawedv gesvi, Agata agataquo dagvwalvsgesdi, kayugano kayugaquo dagvwalvsgesdi.
english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏎᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏣᎪᏇᎷᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsaweseha; Tlesdi yitsatlegesdi usonv netsvnelvi; gilosgini higatisi tsagoqueluhvsgesdi, soi nasquo hiyalisgolvdanehesdi.
english: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᎡᏗᏱ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏣᏄᏬ, ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono udulisgesdi tsayilidasdiyi, ale tsanaediyi hawini tsanuwo, udvnohi nasquo hinvnehesdi.
english: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono sutlilodv isdenvsdiyi nitsvnehesdi, tali iyutlilodv isdegesdi.
english: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏔᏲᏎᎯ ᎯᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏣᏙᎸᎡᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎯᏯᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsatayosehi hinehesdi, tsadolvediyino udulisgi tlesdi iyvdv ihiyadvnelvgi.
english: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ, ᎯᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏣᏍᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvhi igi hia igawedv gesvi; Higeyusesdi nav idisdadala, hisgagesdino tsasgagi.
english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsvweseha; Detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi; osdv detsinetsehesdi getsisginvdisgi, osdv nidetsadvnehesdi getsiniquatihi, ale osdv iyunalisdanediyi itsadadolisdisgesdi gayegogi getsinohesgi ale uyo igetsvnehi.
english: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏅᏙ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎰ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏅᏓᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino galvladi ehi Itsidoda tsuwetsi nitsalisdisgesdi; nasgiyeno utseli nvdo degananugowiseho uniyo ale anosdv, ale daganvdaneho unadanvti ale uninegutsidv.
english: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏰᏣᎫᏴᏓᏏ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno yiditsigeyuha getsigeyuhi, gado yetsaguyvdasi?  Tlasgo nasgi yinanadvneho ayeliadelv anigisidohi?
english: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᏗᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᏕᏥᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ?
phonetic: Iyu ale itsadanvtliquo unvsv yiditsiyoliha, gado itsadvnehv detsigonadvdi anisoi?  Tlasgo nasgi yinanadvneho ayeliadelv anigisidohi?
english: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nihisgini nitsisganvna gesesdi nasgiya Itsidoda galvladi ehi nasganvna tsigi.
english: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱᏉ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi tlesdi yitsadanehesdi anigatahv yvwi getsigowadvdiyiquo yitsiyelvsgesdi, iyuyeno nasgiquo yinusdi vtla yvgetsaguyvsi Itsidoda galvladi ehi.
english: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎭᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᏱᏃᏴᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏧᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎾᎢᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᏐᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno hadanehesdi tlesdi atselugi igvyi wiyinoyvlisdisgesdi nasgi tsinanadvneho unatlonasdi tsulawiisdiyi ale enaidasdiyi degalanvdvi, yvwiquo gvwanilvquododiyi tsuniyelvsoi; udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, gegaguyvelv.
english: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎭᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini hadanehesdi tlesdi tsoyeni higasgani udolehosv higatisi tsoyeni nadvnehvi.
english: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎭᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hadanehv udelisv gesesdi, Tsadodano udelisv agowatisgi uwasv ase tsaguyvedi gesesdi gvnigesvi.
english: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎭ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏐ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏐ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎴᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏏᏯᏅ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎡᎾᎢᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Iyu ale hadadolisdisgesdi, aha tlesdi nunasdv unatlonasdi yinitsasdesdi; nasgiyeno oso uniyelvso unadadolisdodiyi unalediyi digalawiisdiyi ale dunvsiyanv degalanvdv enaidasdiyi, yvwiquo gvwanigowadvdiyi unadulisgoi.  Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, gegaguyvelv.
english: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᏎᏍᏗ ᏫᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᏍᏚᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᏣᏙᎵᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini iyuno tadadolistanisesdi wiyvhihesdi kanvsulvi, hnaquono tsasdunesdi galohisdiyi, hiyadadolisdanehesdi tsadoda udelisv ehi, tsadolino udelisv agowatisgi ase tsaguyvedi gesesdi gvnigesvi.
english: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏨᎫᏘᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᏁᎬ ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏓᏲᎦᏛᎦᏁᎵ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno itsadadolisdisgesdi tlesdi asequo yitsvgutilosgesdi nasgi tsinanadvneho tsunadalenvdv yvwi; utsatiyeno otsinegv udagalisdotani dayogadvganeli anelisgoi.
english: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᎬ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏁᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini tlesdi nasgi nunasdv yinitsasdesdi, Itsidodayeno agataho iyusdi itsinigvgv asiquo netsitayoselvna tsigesoi.
english: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎨᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini itsadadolisdisgv hia nusdesdi; Ogidoda galvladi gehi, galvquodiyu gesesdi detsadovi.
english: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ.  ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi gesv wigananugoi.  Ani elohi winigalisda hadanvtesgvi, nasgiya galvladi tsinigalisdiha.
english: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏍᎩᎥᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Nidadodaquisv ogalisdayvdi sgivsi gohi iga.
english: Give us this day our daily bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉᏃ ᏕᏍᎩᏚᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᎰ ᏦᏥᏚᎩ.
phonetic: Digesgivsiquono desgidugvi, nasgiya tsidigayotsineho tsotsidugi.
english: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏗᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏍᎩᏳᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏣᏤᎵᎦᏰᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi udagoliyediyi gesv widisgiyatinvstanvgi, sgiyudalesgesdiquosgini utsi gesvi.  Tsatseligayeno tsagvwiyuhi gesvi, ale tsalinigidiyi gesvi, ale etsalvquodiyu gesv nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yvwi getsisganvtsehv yidigetsineha, nasquo itsidoda galvladi ehi itsidolisdi gesesdi.
english: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᎲᏏ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgini nidigetsinehvna yigi yvwi getsisganvtsehvi, nasquo Itsidoda vtla yidogetsihvsi itsisganvtsvi.
english: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎢᏨᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ, ᏂᏓᏤᎸᎾᏰᏃ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎰ ᏚᎾᎧᏛᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo amatli itsvsgesdi, tlesdi nvnatlonasdi nunasdv yinitsasdesdi, unadadolisdi tsigeso dikanodiyi, nidatselvnayeno nidanvneho dunakadvi, yvwiquo unadolehohisdiyi unadulisgo amatli anvsgvi.  Udohiyuhiya nitsvweseha gegaguyvelv.
english: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏠᏁᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᎬᏍᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nihisgini amatli hvsgesdi, hatlonesgesdi, ale hagvsquosgesdi,
english: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏱᏣᏰᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏨᏒᎢ, ᏣᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tlesdi yvwiquo getsadolehohisediyi yitsayelisesdi amatli tsvsvi, Tsadodasgini udelisv ehi, Tsadodano udelisv agowatisgi, ase tsaguyvedi gvnigesvi.
english: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏍᏜᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Tlesdi tsugvwalodi elohi yitsitlisisgesdi, tsisgoyv ale ayasdladisgi uniyosdodiyi ale aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi ale uninosgisdiyi;
english: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎠᏯᏍᏜᏓᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galvladisgini witsitlisisgesdi tsugvwalodi, nahnani tsisgoyv ayasdladisgino uniyosdodiyi nigesvna gesvi, ale aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi ale uninosgisdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏫᏥᎲᎢ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏓᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Nahnayeno tsugvwalodi witsihvi ase nasquo widahesdi ditsadanvdo.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Agata ayelv iga gatisdisgi, iyusgini higadoli gohusdi nusdvna gesesdi, nigv hiyelvi ukalitsonvhi gesesdi igagati.
english: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏤᎲ ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏂᎦ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ!
phonetic: Iyusgini higadoli uyo igesesdi, nigv hiyelvi ukalitsonvhi gesesdi ulisigi.  Iyusginino igagati hawini tsehv ulisigiquo igesesdi, nasgi ulisigi niga equohiyu!
english: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ, ᏱᎠᏍᎦᎦᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏱᏅᎨᏳᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏙᎤᏂᏴᎭ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎹᎹᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏱᏙᎨᏣᏛᏂᏏ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo yeli anitali gvwanatlai gohusdi yidogvdvnisi, yiasgagayeno saquo yinvgeyuhano soi, ale yidouniyvha saquo yiganiquatihano soi.  Tlasgini yeli Unelanvhi ale Mamani gohusdiyidogetsadvnisi.
english: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᎬᏅ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᏄᏬ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi yitselihisgesdi detsvnvi, iyusdi itsigisdiyi ale iyusdi itsaditasdiyi, tlesdi ale ditsiyelvi yitselihisgesdi iyusdi ditsanuwosdiyi.  Tlasgo agvnv utlihiyu yigi esgaquo alisdayvdi?  Ale tlasgo ayelvi esgaquo dinuwo?
english: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏂᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ Ꮭ ᏯᏂᏁᏣᎢᏍᎪᎢ, Ꮭ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏯᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏙᎨᎶᎰᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏁᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Ditsakanvga tsisqua galvloi anehi, tlayeno yaniwisgoi, ale tla yaninetsaisgoi, tla ale dadanelv yanitlisisgoi, aseno Itsidoda galvladi ehi dogelohoi.  Tlasgo nihi utli yinetsilvquodi esgaquo nasgi?
english: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᎬᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏱᎧᏁᏉᏣ ᎬᏅᎢ?
phonetic: Gagono nihi tsinitsadvnv udasuya uwelihisgvquo yeli saquo iyutlilodv yikanequotsa gvnvi?
english: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏙᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪᎢ?  ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᏧᏥᎸᎯ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏤᎯ ᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᏍᏙᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gadono dinuwo dotselihisgoi?  Ditsadanvdvli tsutsilvhi tlogesi tsehi dadvsgvi.  Vtla yidunilvwisdanehoi, ale vtla yanisdohoi.
english: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏬᏚᏒᎢ Ꮭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᏚᏄᏮᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha, nasquo solimanv nigav nuwodusvi tla nasgi yinusde dunuwvi saquo hia nusdvi.
english: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏱᎦᏄᏬᎭ ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎡᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏤᎭ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᏙᎨᏥᏄᏬᏣ, ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi yinigvneha yiganuwoha kanesga tlogesi ehi, gohi iga tseha, ugitsvnvno digadudiyi wunadinvdi tsigi, tlasgo utlihiyu yinidogetsinuwotsa, usdi itsohiyuhi?
english: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏄᏬᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitselihisgesdi hia yinitsiwesgesdi; gado dayotsigi, ale gado dayotsaditahi, ale gado dayotsanuwoi?
english: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏲᎰ ᏧᎾᏖᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.  ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvyeno nasgi hia uniyoho Tsunatelenvdv yvwi.  Galvladiyeno ehi Itsidoda agataha nasgi hia nigadv itsinigvsehvi.
english: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏲᎦ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᏉᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Igvyisgini itsiyoga galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ale utseli duyugodvi, hiano nigadiyu dayetsinequoeli.
english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏫᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏛᏕᎵᎯᏍᏔᏂ.  ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi ugitsvnv iyvdv yiwitselihisgesdi, ugitsvnvyeno uwasv tsudalenvdv dvdelihistani.  Yeliquo uyo iga uwehvi.
english: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tlesdi tsitsadalawiseli nasgino nihi tlesdi etsilawiselvgi.
english: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏛᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᏒᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏛᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nusdv itsadalawiselv ase nasquo dvetsilawiseli, ale nusdv itsadatlilosvlv nasquo dvetsatliloeli.
english: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏐ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gadono ihigowatisgo utlvdalvdv ugasuhvi disdadanvtli, nelisgvnano igeso unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi.
english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏏ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎬᎸᏏ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎭ.
phonetic: Ale gado yigalisdoda hia yiniwesi disdadanvtli, Gvlvsi utlvdalvdv tsagasuhvi, gvniyuquono unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuha.
english: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᎸ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsatlonasdi!  igvyi hilv unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi, hnaquono gvnigesviyu tsagowadvdiyi gesesdi hilvediyi utlvdalvdv disdadanvtli ugasuhvi.
english: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎩᎵ ᏗᏥᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏏᏆ ᏫᏗᏣᏗᏁᎸᎩ, ᏱᏓᎾᎳᏍᏓᎥᎵᏉᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏴᎨᏥᏓᎦᎸᎥᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gohusdi galvquodi gili ditsinelvgi, tlesdi ale dagvnaiyunasdi ditsatseliga siqua widitsadinelvgi, yidanalasdavliquoyeno, ale yanagatahvna yvgetsidagalvvga.
english: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ; ᎢᏥᏲᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎢᏨᏂᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Itsitayoha, ase dayetsineli; itsiyoga, ase datsiwadvhi; itsvniga, ase dayetsisduieli.
english: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏣᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᎠᏥᏁᎰᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏲᎰ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏥᏫᎬᏂᎰ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno tsatayohiho atsinehoi, gilono tsuyoho awatisgoi, gilono tsiwigvniho atsisduiehoi.
english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᎨ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏚ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏅᏯᏉ ᏯᎲᏏ?
phonetic: Gagoge asgaya hia tsinitsadvnv, iyuno uwetsi gadu yutayoseha, nvyaquo yahvsi?
english: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏯᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎾᏛᏉ ᏴᎦᏅᎥᏏ?
phonetic: Ale atsadi yatayohiha, tsigo inadvquo yvganvvsi?
english: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏲᎢ ᏱᏥᏏᎾᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎯ.
phonetic: Iyuno nihi itsiyoi yitsisinahi osdv gesv ditsinediyi ditsetsi, utlihiyu udohiyuhiya Itsidoda galvladi ehi osdv danehesdi gvwatayosehi.
english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nigav gohusdi itsadulisgv yvwi igetsadvnediyi, nasgiya nasquo nidetsadvnehesdi; nasgiyeno hia nusdi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi
english: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏯᏙᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏓ ᎠᏯᏖᏂᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏖᏂ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂ ᏣᏔᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᎶᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ayadoli galohisdiyi itsiyvsda Ayateniyeno galohisdiyi ale ayateni nvnohi ayohuhisdiyi wigananugogvi, uni tsatano nahna anilosga.
english: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎠᏂᏩᏘᎭ.
phonetic: Ayadoliyuyeno galohisdiyi ale ayadoliyu nvnohi gvnidv wigananugogvi, ale anigayoliyu aniwatiha.
english: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎦᏁᎦ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᏥᎨᏥᎷᏤᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏯ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Detseyadotsehesdi unatlonasdi anadolehosgi, awi uninodena ganega tsunanuwai tsigetsilutsehoi; aseno hawini gesv waya unigvvsgi gesoi.
english: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.   ᏥᎪ ᏴᏫ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪ ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗᎯ?  ᎠᎴ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎪᏥᏥᎯ ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Nusdv anadadvsgvi dodatsolistani.   Tsigo yvwi telvladi danadesgo tsisdunigisdihi?  Ale svgataiyunasdi tsigotsitsihi danadesgoi?
english: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini nusdi nigav osdv tlugv osdv adadvsgoi, uyono tlugv uyo adadvsgoi.
english: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏲ ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Osdv tlugv vtla yeli uyo yvgvdadvga, ale uyo tlugv vtla yeli osdv yvgvdadvga.
english: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ, ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ.
phonetic: Nigavsgini detlugv osdv nanadadvsgvna, digaleyvsdodi gesesdi, ale atsilvyi widadinvdi.
english: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dodatsolistani nusdv anadadvsgvi.
english: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏉᏎᎯ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno naniv, Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, gvquosehi, galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv wuninanugoisdi yigi, nasgisgini na Edoda galvladi ehi adanvtesgv tsunilvwisdanehi.
english: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᎩᏪᎭᎵ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᏲᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏙᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ?
phonetic: Nahiyu iga gesesdi unitsatisdi hia nvdagvgiwehali; Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge yotsadolehosgei?  Ale tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge anisgina yidotsinugowisgei?  Ale tlasgo detsadov yotsvdisge utsati usquanigodi yidogilvwisdanehei?
english: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏪᏎᎵ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏨᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvdagatsiweseli; vtla ilvhiyu yitsvgatahei; utli witsilohi uyo ditsilvwisdanehi.
english: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi naniv gilo hia tsinitsiwea anadvgisgesdi, ale nasgi nanadvnehesdi, agatahnai asgaya dodagatsiyatlilostani, nasgi nvyohi tsunesgehei;
english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏁᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏚᏱᎶᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᏤᎢ, ᏅᏥᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎧᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsugahnanei, ale tsidunohuganei, ale tsunolvnei, nahna adanelv tsiduyilolei; aseno vtla yuyotsei, nvtsihiyeno gakahei.
english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎫ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏳᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivno gilo hia tsinitsiwea anadvgisgesdi, nasgino nanadvnehvna igesesdi, unegu asgaya digegatlilosdodi gesesdi nasgi noyuhi tsunesgehei.
english: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏁᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏚᏱᎶᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏲᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗᏳ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏲᏨ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsugahnanei, ale tsidunohuganei, ale tsunolvnei, nahna adanelv tsiduyilolei, ale tsuyotsei, ale usgasediyu tsinulistane uyotsv.
english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi Tsisa usquadv nasgi nigawesgvi, unisquanigose dadeyohvsgvi.
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏰᏃ ᏥᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏉ ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Utseligayeno tsidadeyohvsgo iyusdi gesei, vtlano dinowelisgiquo tsidanadeyohvsgo iyusdi yigesei.
english: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᏐᎠᏒ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsugasoasv usahilvi, unitsati gvwasdawadvsei.
english: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏍᎩᏅᎦᎸ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo adayesgi utlvgi ulutse udadolisdanelei, hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno yitsadanvtelv yeliquo yisginvgalv.
english: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎦᏓᏅᏛᎵ, ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano udoyanvhidv usvnilei, gadanvdvli, tsadanvgalvdv gesesdi, uwoselei; gilaquono iyvdv adayesgi utlvgv udanvgalvhei.
english: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; Ꭷ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᎯᏃᏁᎵ, ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᏫᏣᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏫᎲᎦ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano Tsisa nuweselei; Ka tlesdi gilo tsihinoneli, henaquosgini, witsagowadv atsilvgelohi, ale alisgolvdodi wihvga Mosi unetsv alisgolvdodi nasgi unadolehohisdodi.
english: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎨᏆᏂ ᏫᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᎫᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa Gequani wiulutsv, ulutsele asgohiguqui aniyawisgi ditinidohi, usdiyetanei,
english: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᎦ ᏗᏇᏅᏒ ᎤᏢᎦ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎦ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎦ.
phonetic: Hia nuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsinvsidasdi ganvga diquenvsv utlvga ulvdalvvsga utsatanvhi agiliyoga.
english: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏓᎨᏏ ᏓᏥᏅᏩᏁᏏ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei; Dagesi datsinvwanesi.
english: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏗᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏥᏁᎸ ᏣᏴᏍᏗᏱ; ᎯᏁᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᏳᏗᏩᏏ.
phonetic: Asgohitsuquino ditinidohi diunetsv hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tlayeli yinigoi tsinelv tsayvsdiyi; hinegiquosgini uwasv, tsinvsidasdino dayudiwasi.
english: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᏁᎶᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎧᎭ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏆᏁᎶᏙᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎡᎪᎢ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎡᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᏗᎡᎪᎢ; ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᎿᎭᏛᎦ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno diquadanelodiquo, ale dagikaha aniyawisgi nasgi degvquanelodoi, gilono Hena tsiyosi, egoi; nvwadaleno Ehena tsiyosi, diegoi; tsinvsidasdino, hia hnadvga tsiyosi, nasgi nadvnehoi.
english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎩᏩᏛᎲ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvganv usquanigosei, ale hia niduwesele Nvdagvwasdawadvdv, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla nasquo Isili dudov nasgi igai gohiyudi gesv yagiwadvhv.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏕᎵᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏗᏂᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᏅᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ale hia nitsvweseha; Unitsati dikalvgv ale wudeligv iditlv dinilosgesdi, ale itsulaha ananvvsgesdi Equahami, ale Esigi, ale Tsegaqui, galvladi ehi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi,
english: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament
