syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᎡ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏓᎨᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᏫᏙᏓᎨᎦᏓᎡᏏ ᏧᎵᏏᎬ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Galvladisgini ehi nahna ugvwiyuhi gee anehi dagetsinugowisi widodagegadaesi tsulisigv doyiditlv, nahna daniyvgesdi, ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏏ.  ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎤᏗᏩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesele asgohitsuqui ditinidohi; Hena, ale nusdv tsohiyunv nasgi winitsalisdasi.  Unvsidasdino nahiyuquo udiwasei.
english: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᎪᎮ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏥ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano Quida ganelv ulutsv, ugohe Quida udalii utsi ganvge udilehvsgei.
english: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏂᎴᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ, ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏗᏩᎭᎢ.  ᏚᎴᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Usvnileno uwoyeni, udilehvsgvno udiwahai.  Duleneno ale dusdelvhidolei.
english: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ; ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎧᏁᎬᏉ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv, unitsate anisgina digvwaniyai degvwatinohelei; dunugowiseno anisgina kanegvquo gvdisgei, ale nigadv tsunitlvgi dunvwanei.
english: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᎩᎩᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏕᎩᏢᎬᏃ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Udohiyudiyi ayelvsvgi Isaya adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei; Uwasv igigisdanelvgi didiwanagalahiyu gesvi, degitlvgvno tsutseli niduwanelvgi.
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏜᏓᏫᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎢᏍᎪᏅ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano dugohv unitsati yvwi gvwadlawisdisgvi, unetse isgonv wunilohisdiyi.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎮᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi digowelisgi ulutsei, hia nuweselei; Tadeyohvsgi dagvsdawadidoli nigav hedohvi.
english: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏧᎳ ᏚᏂᏔᎴᏐᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᎾᏁᏍᏓᏝᎰᎢ, ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei; Tsula dunitalesoi, tsisquano galvlo anehi dunanesdatlahoi, yvwisgini Uwetsi vtla ilvhitlv asgoli udiyi yigi.
english: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎾ ᏥᏂᏌᏄᎦ ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno usdawadidohi hia nuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, igvyi gena tsinisanuga edoda.
english: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᎭᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᏂᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwehalei; Sgisdawaduga, unanelagino tsuniyohusvhi daninisisgesdi tsunatseli tsuniyohusvhi.
english: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsiyuhi wutsanv gvwasdawadidohi gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏱᎶᎴ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎢᏓᎵ; ᏥᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎹ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎤᏭᏢᎥᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦᎵᎮᏉ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono utsati uyilole unole idali; tsiyuyeno ama dalisdilanegv uwutlvvsgei; aseno igalihequo.
english: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎬᏩᏰᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ, ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏒᏂᏉ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutsele gvwayestanei, hia nigvwaweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, sgisdelv, dayotsadisvniquo.
english: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎢᎭ?  ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ!  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏚᏍᎦᏤ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ, ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏓᏥᎾᏍᏛᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gadono itsisgaiha?  Usdi itsohiyuhi!  Hnaquono dulenv dusgatse unole ale vdali, utsatino udatsinasdvhi nulistanei.
english: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎢᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Anisgayano unisquanigosei, hia nuniwesei; Gado usdi hia asgaya, nasquoyeno unole ale vdali igvwohiyuhvsga.
english: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎦᎩᏏᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏎᎢ, ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Isgoniditlvno wulutsv Gagisini unatseligohi, anitali anisgina digvwaniyai degvwatlosei, dadanisahv tsuninugotsei, utsatanvhi unihnalvhiyu gesei, nasgi vtla gilo nahna gvwalohisdi yigesei.
english: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏓᏛᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂ ᏣᎷᏥᎸ ᏍᎩᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ?
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo unelunei, hia nuniwesei; vtla gohusdi digadadvdodi yigi nihi, Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi, tsigo ani tsalutsilv sginigiliyoisdodiyiquo asiquo nasqualisgvna?
english: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎯᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏁᏙᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Gehino iyvdv dinedohe unitsati sunadatlugi siqua analisdayvnidohei.
english: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᎭ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎵᏎᎸᎭ ᏏᏆ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᎪᏍᏗᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Anisginano gvwatayoselei, hia nigvwaweselei; iyuno sgininugowisvha, unanelagi sgineliselvha siqua sunadatlugi wigosdiyvsdiyi.
english: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᏕᎾ.  ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ, ᏏᏆ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏴᎴᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎠᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ, ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ ᎦᏁᏡᎩ ᎬᏒᎢ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏚᏂᎵᏬᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Sdena.  Uninugotsvno, siqua sunadatlugi widuniyvlei.  Ale gvniyuquo nigadv sunadatlugi siqua ayanuliyu unalisei, wunigasoase ganetlugi gvsvi, vdali wunalitadinvsei, ale amayi duniliwotsei.
english: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Dinigatiyano unalisei, digaduhv wunilosei, nigadv wuninohelei, ale anisgina gvwaniyai nunalisdanelvi.
english: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏏᎴᎢ; ᎬᏩᎪᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono nigadiyu sgadugi tsuninugotsei, tsisa degvwatlosilei; gvwagohvno gvwatayosele udanvsdiyiquo unatseligohi gesvi.
english: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏅ, ᏚᏪᏐᏤᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏪᏚᎲ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Tsiyuhino utsanv, duwesotsei, uwasvno uweduhv wulutsei.
english: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳᏉ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono gvwatinohele asgaya utlvgi ulvdalvvsgi ganvge atsesdogihi; Tsisano udolehosv anohiyuhvsgvi, hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi; Aquetsi, ugalisdiyuquo hadanvdada, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
english: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono igadv dinowelisgi hia nuniwese dunadanvdvi; hia asgaya Galvladi ehi asotlvisdiha.
english: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ?
phonetic: Tsisano agatahe nusdv anadanvtesgvi, hiano niduweselei; Gadono uyo itsadanvteha ditsinawiyi?
english: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏥᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ?  ᎯᎠᎨ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏓ?
phonetic: Gadoge usdi utli ahidiyu kaneisdiyi, tsigo hia yinagawea, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi?  Hiage yinagawea, talehvga ale geda?
english: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎮᎾ.
phonetic: Adina itsadolehohisdiyi yvwi Uwetsi asganvtsv gvwadadolisdi gesv ani elohi, hnaquo hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi; Talehvga, tsatsesdo hinagi, ale ditsenvsv hena.
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Dulenvno tsuwenvsv wulosei.
english: And he arose, and departed to his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Unitsatino unigohv, unisquanigosei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi nasgi tsulisgolvdanelvhi nasgi iyusdi tsunilvwisdanediyi yvwi.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎹᏚ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏬᎸᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗᏱ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano nahna udanvsv, ugohvgi asgaya Madu tsudoidv, uwolvgi ayeli aguyvdiyi.  Hiano nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.  Dulenvno usdawadvsvgi.
english: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᏅᎬ [ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ] ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᏓᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, ganvgv [alisdayvhvsgv] galitsode, gvniyuquo unitsadvgi adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana unilutsv unanitlvnvgi aninvdlav Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi.
english: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚ ᏂᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Aniqualisino unadolehosv, hia nidu niweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Gadono Ditseyohvsgi adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana itsulaha ianalisdayvhvsga?
english: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᏚᏂᏢᎬᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvganv hia niduweselvgi; Nidunitlvgvna vtla udulvdi yinunalisdaneho didanvwisgi, tsunitlvgisgini.
english: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᎾᏍᎩᏂ, ᏫᏣᏕᎶᏆ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏅᎯᎸ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Itsenasgini, witsadeloqua gadvgv hia nasgi tsinigaweha; adadolisdi gesv aquaduliha, vtlano atsilvgelasdiyi gesvi.  Vtlayeno nanisganvna yiditsiyanvhilv, anisganasgini tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi.
english: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ [ᏥᏌ] ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᏯᏃ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏦᏨᏍᎦ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎾᏅᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsani gvwasdawadidohi [Tsisa] gvwalutselvgi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono ayv Aniqualisino yano amatli tsotsvsga, nihino getsasdawadidohi amatli nanvsgvna tsigi?
english: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᏓᎾᏠᏱᎦ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏛᎵᏱᎶᎵ ᏓᎨᏥᏯᏅᎡᎵ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ, ᎩᎳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏛᏅᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo yeli degegatsvsdisgv anigatahi yidanatloyiga asiquo udesvnilvhi uneladidohvi?  Aseno iga dvliyiloli dagetsiyanveli udesvnilvhi, gila hnaquo amatli dvnvni.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤ ᏱᎦᎳᏍᏢᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎠᏄᏬᎩᎯ, ᎦᎳᏍᏢᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᎦᏣᎦᎸᏓ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᎤᏓᏣᎦᎸᎲᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo itse yigalastlvdisgo uweti anuwogihi, galastlvdvyeno yvgatsagalvda anuwo, udatsagalvhvno utli equohiyu yinigalisda.
english: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏘ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏱᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᏓᏣᎦᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏯᏤᏬᎩ, ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏃ ᏱᏓᏲᎩ.  ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏗᏤ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale itse gigageaditasdi tsuweti disutlvdv yidanitlisdisgoi; disutlvdvyeno yidadatsagalv, ale gigageaditasdi yatsewogi, disutlvdvno yidayogi.  Itsesgini gigageaditasdi ditse disutlvdv danitlisdisgoi, itsulano dunisquanigodoi.
english: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ.  ᎠᏗᎾ ᎮᎾ, ᎯᏯᏒᏂᎸᎭ, ᎠᎭ ᏛᎠᏛᏂᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Asiquo nasgi nidegawesehvgi, gvniyuquo gilo iyusdi nugvwiyusadegi ulutsv udadolisdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Aquetsi ageyutsa gayula uyohusidena.  Adina hena, hiyasvnilvha, aha dvadvnidiquo.
english: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano dulenv usdawadvsvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
english: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᏒᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono ageyv utlvgi gigv uwenvehi taladu tsudetiyvda igvwalistanvhi, oniditlv uluhisdanelvgi, gadaluyadv unuwav usvnelvgi.
english: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏄᏩᎥᏉ ᏯᏆᏒᏂᎸ, ᎠᏎ ᏯᏆᏗᏫ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nuwese udanvdvi; iyuno unuwavquo yaquasvnilv, ase yaquadiwi.
english: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ.  ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ.  ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugatahvsv ale ugohv, hia nuwesvgi; Aquetsi, ugalisdiquo hadanvdada.  Tsohiyusv tsadiwisda.  Ageyvno nahiyuquo udiwasvgi.
english: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᏗᏂᏤᎷᎯᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano nugvwiyusadegi ganelv ulutsv, ale dugohv dinitseluhisgi, ale yvwi daniyvgvi,
english: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎾ, ᎾᎪᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ; ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.  ᎥᎬᏩᏰᏣᏍᏔᏅᏉᏃ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; Itsadanvna, nagono uyohusvhi yigi ageyutsa; galihaquosgini.  Vgvwayetsastanvquono.
english: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎠᎨᏳᏣᏃ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Getsinugowisvno yvwi, uyvlvgi uwoyeni uniyvhvgi, ageyutsano dulenvgi.
english: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏥᏙᎸᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia dunotsalotsidolvi nahna nigvnadv duyelisidolvgi.
english: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Tsisano nahna udanvsv, anitali dinigewi anisgaya gvwasdawadvsvgi, unelugvgi hia naniwesgvgi, sginidoligi nihi Dewi Uwetsi.
english: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ ᎤᏴᎸ, ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Galitsodeno uyvlv, dinigewi gvwalutselvgi, tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Isdohiyuhvsgasgo yeli nasgi igvquadvnedi gesvi?  Hia nigvwaweselvgi; Vv, Tsagvwiyuhi.
english: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏒᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dusvnelv dinigadoli, hia nuwesvgi; Nusdv isdohiyuhvsgv nasgiya nisdalisdasi.
english: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎩᏒᎩ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Dinigadolino dulisdugisvgi.  Tsisano dunvsdadelvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Tlesdi gilo udolehosvgi.
english: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᏉ ᏚᏂᏃᏣᎳᏅᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unadanvsvquo duninotsalanvgi nahna nigvnadvi.
english: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono aninugogvi gvniyuquo gilo gvwatinohelvgi asgaya uwagewi, asgina uyai.
english: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ.
phonetic: Asginano atsinugowisv uwagewi uwonisvgi.  Unitsatino unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; vtla ilvhiyu nasgi iyusdi agohvhi yigi isiliyi.
english: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏥᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno Aniqualisi hia nuniwesvgi; Anisgina unatseli ugvwiyuhi gvdiha tsideganugowisga anisgina.
english: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano nigav tsudvna degaduhv ale tsusdi degaduhv uwedolvgi, dadeyohvsgvgi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale alitsidohvsgvgi osdv kanohedv galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgvgi, ale dekanvwisgv nigav dunitlvgv ale nigav vyugi yvwi uniyilidehvi.
english: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏩᎾᏉ ᏓᏂᎶᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏂᎦᏘᏯ.
phonetic: Dugohvno unitsati yvwi, duwedolitsvgi, udagalisdodisgvgi wanaquo danilogvi, ale unadigaleyotsvhi gesvi, nasgiya awi uninodena nehvna tsigeso unigatiya.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquo hia niduwehalv gvwasdawadidohi; Equohiyu tlogesi ugadvnatsvhi, aseno anigayoliyu tsunilvwisdanehi.
english: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏏ ᎤᎶᎨᏛ ᏧᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi etsitayosi ulogedv tsunvsdiyi tsunilvwisdanehi ugadvnatselvi.
english: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎥᏳᎩ.
phonetic: Widuyanvhvno taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, dunelv anisgina tsuninugowisdiyi, ale tsunadanvwodiyi nigav dunitlvgv, ale nigav vyugi.
english: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.  ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ, ᎡᏂᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏅᏟ, ᏥᎻᏃ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nusdi dunadov taladu iyanidv getsinvsidv.  Igvyiyi Sawani Quida tsanosehoi, Enidino nasgiquo unvtli, Tsimino Tsequidi uwetsi, Tsanino nasgiquo unvtli.
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏃ, ᏩᏓᎳᎻᏃ, ᏓᎻᏃ, ᎹᏚᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ, ᏥᎻᏃ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎴᏈᏯᏃ ᏓᏗᏯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ,
phonetic: Quiligino, Wadalamino, Damino, Maduno adelv agisidohi, Tsimino Eliqui uwetsi, Lequiyano Dadiya tsanosehoi,
english: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎠᎨᎾᏂᏗ, ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Sawanino Agenanidi, Tsudasino Isgaladi nasgi Tsisa tsulonuhelvgi.
english: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏫᏥᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏚᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᎸᎩ
phonetic: Nasgi hia taladu iyanidv Tsisa dunvsvgi dunetselvno hia niduweselvgi; Tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv iditlv tlesdi witsilosvgi, ale Sameli anehi duniduhv tlesdi itsiyvlvgi
english: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᎯᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏩᏛᎱᎦ.
phonetic: Awisgini unalenahidv Isili sidanelv gesv ditsiwadvhuga.
english: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎢᏒᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Itsaisvno itsalitsidohvsgesdi, hia nitsiwesgesdi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai.
english: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᏣᎴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏎᏉ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᏎᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunitlvgi detsinvwisgesdi, adayesgi tsunitlvgi detsinvgalisgesdi, tsuniyohusvhi detsaledisgesdi, anisgina detsinugowisgesdi.  Asequo etsinelvhi, asequo itsadanehesdi.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎲ ᏱᏣᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ,
phonetic: Tlesdi detsadatlohv yitsadanelesdi dalonige adelv ale unegv adelv ale vtsayi,
english: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏣᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ; ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Ale degalodi, ale tali ditsanuwo, ale dilasulo, ale didolanvsdi; tsulvwisdanehiyeno uwadvdi geso ulisdayvdi.
english: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎤᏛᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎥᏣᏂᎩ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno udvna gaduhv ale usdi gaduhv itsilugesdi, itsadadvdvhvsgesdi gilo ehv udanvti, nahnano itsinesdi gvni vtsanigi.
english: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎢᏥᏴᎭ ᎢᏥᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Adanelvno itsiyvha itsiyolihesdi.
english: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏁᎳ ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno nahna aninela uwadohiyadv digvwanadanilvisdi igesesdi, nasgi uwadohiyadv itsatseli unilutsedi gesesdi; iyuno digvwanadanilvisdi nigesvna igesesdi, nasgi nvwadohiyadv itsvsvquo itsilutsedi igesesdi.
english: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏁᎬ ᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎩ, ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo niditsadanilvgvna igesesdi, ale itsinegv nadvgisgvna igesesdi, nahna galitsode ale gaduhv itsinugogi, detsinvgovdisgesdi gada ditsalasideni.
english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏳᏪᏎᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvyuweseha, esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Sodami ale Gomali, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nasgi na gaduhvi.
english: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏣᏁᎳᏗᏙᎰ ᏩᏲᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎢᎨᏥᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎨᏌᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎢᎨᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo itsvnvli awi uninodena tsaneladidoho wayohi nasgiyai; nasgi iyusdi inadv igetsisinasani gesasdi, ale guledinisgonihi igetsadanvti gesesdi.
english: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏴᏫ, ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏣᏘᏃᎵ, ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ.
phonetic: Detseyadotsehesdi adina yvwi, degalawivyeno dodagetsatinoli, tsunilawiisdiyino dodagetsilivnili.
english: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏃᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ale ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi nunigvwiyusadegi ale unigvwiyuhi dunolv igvyiditlv detsatinohihesdi, nasgi unvsv ale Tsunadalenvdv yvwi unadolehohisdodi.
english: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᎨᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo degetsatinohihesdi tlesdi yitselihisgesdi iyusdi itsineisdiyi ale itsiwesdiyi; nahiyuquoyeno etsinedi gesesdi itsiwesdiyi.
english: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno nihi yitsinegoi, Itsidodasgini Udanvdo kanegoi nihi itsvdisgoi.
english: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᏧᎾᏛᏒᎯ ᏙᏛᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Asgayano dodayuyosi uyohuhisdiyi dinadanvtli, agayvligeno uwetsi dodayuyosi, ale oni tsunadvsvhi dodvnatlutani tsunigayvligei, ale nasgi nvdvnvnisani digetsiisdi gesesdi.
english: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nanivquo yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi; aseno nasgi gvlisquadisgi atlinigvnehi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎨᏨᎿᎭᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎢᎶᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᎵᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᏥᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᏕᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏱᎨᏤᏙᏁᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo uyo nigetsvhnadegesdi ilvhitlv gaduhvi, ilolisgesdi nvwalile digaduhv witsilosgesdi.  Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, Vtla Isiliyi degaduhvi yigetsedonesdi hnaquo yvwi Uwetsi dagalutsi.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙᎢ ᏒᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Dideloquasgi vtla utli yinatsilvquodoi esgaquo tsuweyohvsgi, ale atsinvsidasdi vtla utli yinatsilvquodoi svsgaquo unvsidohi.
english: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏰᎵᏉᏰᏃ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᏘᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏳᏃᏎᎸ, ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᏂᏪᏎᏗᏱ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Yeliquoyeno dideloquasgi tsuweyohvsgi itsulahaquo yigi, ale atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi itsulahaquo yigi.  Iyuyeno tsudatihnai adanelv Quelitsiqua yunoselv, utli ahidiyu nasgi itsuniwesediyi dudatihnavi.
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi.  Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna gesvi, vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi adolehohisdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎢᏥ ᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎡᏣᏙᏅᎡᎸᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ulisigv itsvnetselvi igagadv itsi negesdi; etsadonvelvno gesv gasanali itsalitsidohvsgesdi.
english: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᏂᎯᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi ayelvi anihihi, aseno adanvdo gvwanihisdi nigesvna tsigi.  Ugvwiyusesdisgini etsisgaihesdi nasgi digvwahisdi tsigi ayelvi ale adanvdo itsula tsvsginoi.
english: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Tlasgo anitali tsisquaya saquo iyadanvtedi tsunagvwalodi yigi, aseno vtla saquo eladi unvisdi yigi Itsidoda udanvtelvhi nigesvna.
english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏘᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasquosgini itsistiyegv itsisgoli nigadiyu diselvhi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; utliyeno nigav ditsagvwalodi nihi esgaquo unitsati tsisquaya.
english: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno gvnigesv naquvnehesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasquo ayv nasgi gvnigesv udatsiyvneli Edoda galvladi ehi agatahvi.
english: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎠᏆᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏱᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini iaquadayihesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasquo ayv nasgi datsiyadayili Edoda galvladi ehi agatahvi.
english: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏯᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᎸ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Tlesdi dohiyi unanugowisilv elohi, yisgiyelisehesdi; vtlasgini dohiyi yaginanugowisilv, ayelasdisgini ganvhidv.
english: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᏗᎾᏓᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏙᏓᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏥᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ ᎤᏦᎯᏃ;
phonetic: Ayvyeno agilutsilv, dinadasgagi iyulisdodiyi asgaya udodano, ale aganvgi ageyv utsino, ale udatsohiya utsohino;
english: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono uwasvquo dudatihnav gvwasgagi gesesdi.
english: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᎩᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᎩᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono utli nugeyusesdi udoda ale utsi esgaquo ayv nagigeyusesdi, vtla yeli nasgi ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.  Gilono utli nugeyusesdi uwetsi asgaya ale uwetsi ageyv esgaquo ayv nagigeyusesdi, vtla yeli nasgi ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.
english: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏱᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo nayisgvna igesesdi utseli tsudahnawadv ale nagisdawadegvna igesesdi, vtla yeli ayv aquatseli igvwalisdodi yigesesdi.
english: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎢᎠᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono gvnv iawatisgesdi, nasgi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono iuyohusehesdi gvnv ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi uwadvdi gesesdi.
english: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏒᎯ
phonetic: Gilono detsadanilvgesdi, nasgi ayv daquadanilvgesdi; gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, nasgi dadanilvgesdi nvdvginvsvhi
english: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙ ᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono dadanilvgesdi adolehosgi adolehosgi gesv udigalisdodigesdi, adolehosgi agaguyvdanedi gesv nasgi agaguyvdanehesdi; gilono dadanilvgesdi udanvti asgaya udanvti gesv udigalisdo disgesdi, udanvti asgaya agaguyvdanedi gesv nasgi agaguyvdanehesdi.
english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏉ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏴᏜᏓᎠᎹ ᎠᎱᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono saquo hia tsunasdi gesvi ulisquidiquo akalii uyvdla ama ahuvsgesdi agisdawadidohi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, udohiyuhiya nitsvweseha, vtla nasgi uyohusedi yigesesdi agaguyvedi gesvi.
english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎲ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᏚᏕᏲᎤᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏚᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi; Tsisa usquadv dekanetsehv taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, unigisvgi nahnani, dudeyousvgi ale ulitsidonvsvgi duniduhnavi.
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏣᏥᏍᏚᎲ ᏧᏛᎦᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏙᏧᏅᏎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsani tsatsisduhv tsudvganv nusdv dulvwisdanehv Galonedv, dotsunvse anitali gvwasdawadidohi,
english: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ Ꮎ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Hia nvdayuweselvgi; Nihisgo na uluhisdi tsigi, tsigoge nvwadale otsigatenohesdi?
english: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏍᏕᎾ ᏣᏂ ᏫᎡᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏗᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ:
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; tsisdena Tsani wiesdinohvsi nigav isdadvgisgvi ale isdigowatisgvi:
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎦ, ᏧᏂᎵᎡᎾᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᎭ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏕᎨᎦᎴᏗᎭ ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Dinigewi anigowatiha, diniyoulino anedoha, adayesgi tsunitlvgi dunadiwasga, tsunilienano anadvgiha, tsuniyohusvhino degegalediha uyono iyunadvhnadegi osdv kanohedv igegalitsidoneha.
english: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎩᎶᏂᏗᏥᏲᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi giloniditsiyodesdisgvna igesesdi.
english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎤᏁᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏃᎮᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ?  ᏩᏐᎾᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏖᎸᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Iunenvno Tsisa ulenvhvgi hia niduweselvgi unitsati Tsani dunohedanelvgi; Gado itsagatanvse inagei?  Wasonasgo unole utelvhesgvi?
english: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎪ ᏗᏩᎾᎨ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᏩᎾᎨ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎠᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Asgayasgo diwanage tsunuwai?  Gvniyuquo diwanage tsunanuwai unigvwiyuhi daninelv anehoi.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎪ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Adolehosgisgo?  Vv, itsvyoseha, ale utlihiyu esgaquo adolehosgi.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎨᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸᏍᎬ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia na gegowelv hia atsinohelvsgv tsinigvnv; Gvniyuquo, tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Anigeyv gvwaninanugowisvhi tsigi vtla gilo yunanugotsv gvwadalinehidedi Tsani didawosgi; aseno usdikani galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo tsani.
english: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᎡᎭ, ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏓᏂᏂᏱᎭ.
phonetic: Tsanino didawosgi unanugotsv nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ananelugieha, ananelugisgino gvsgaisdagi daniniyiha.
english: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno anadolehosgi ale dikahnawadvsdi anadolehosgvgi Tsani unanugotsilv iyasti.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno digetsadanilvisdi gesesdi, nasgi hia Ilaya uluhisdi tsigesvgi.
english: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi nasgi advgisgesdi.
english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏃᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏓᏂᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Gadoge dodagatsiyatlilostani hia gohi tsaneha?  Diniyoliquo nasgiya ganododiyi tsaninoi ale tsiwidaniyanisgo unedasdi;
english: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏓᏂᏪᏎᎰᎢ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎣᎬᏔᏅ ᏕᏨᏃᎩᎡᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎩᏒ; ᏙᏥᏴᎬᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸ.
phonetic: Ale hia tsinidaniwesehoi; atselugi ogvtanv detsvnogielv, aseno vtla yitsalisgisv; dotsiyvgvgi itsadvgodi, aseno vtla yiditsatloyilv.
english: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno ulutsvgi vtla yalisdayvhvsgei ale vtla yaditasgei, aseno nianiweha; Asgina uyaa.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎦ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏕᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Yvwi uwetsi ulutsv alisdayvhvsga ale aditasga, hiano nianiweha; Gvniyuquo asgaya ugvvsgi alisdayvdi ale gigageaditasdi, adelv anigisidohi ale anisdena unalii.  Aseno agatahnai tsuwetsi osiyu igvwayelvha.
english: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎩ ᏚᏂᏚᎲᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏂᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ulenvhvgi dugvsgolvnvgi duniduhvi nahna utli igai usquanigodi dulvwisdanelvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi dunadanvdv niduninetliyvsvna gesvi.
english: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎪᎴᏏᏂ, ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏇᏣᏱᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏱᏙᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ, ᎪᎯᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏧᏏᏕᎾ ᏱᏚᎾᏄᏬᎡ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏳᎾᏓᏅᎵᏰᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Golesini, uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Quetsayidi; iyuyeno usquanigodi degalvwisdanelv nihi itsehv yidogalvwisdanele Taya ale Sadoni, gohigi digvwaninetliyvdv yigese dunadanvdvi, tsusidena yidunanuwoe ale gosdu yunadanvliyeei.
english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Taya ale Sadoni, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nihi.
english: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏤᏣᏌᎳᏓ, ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏮᏓᏰᎶᎥᏔᏂ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏱᏙᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏐᏓᎻᏱ, ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏕᏉ.
phonetic: Nihino Gequani galvladi iyvdv tsetsasalada, tsvsginoi wvdayelovtani; iyuyeno usquanigodi degalvwisdanelv nihi itsehv yidogalvwisdanele Sodamiyi, asi gohi gesv yinigvwasdequo.
english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎵᎻ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; Esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Solimi digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nihi.
english: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏕᎲᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏃ ᏥᏕᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Tsisa unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gvyalielitseha Edoda, Tsagvwiyuhi galvladi ale elohi, nasgi hia tsidehvsgalanelv anisinasani ale aneyatahi, diniyolino tsidehinanugowiselv.
english: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Vv, Edoda, nasgiyeno osiyu tsayelvnvhi.
english: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᏓᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎡᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nigav gohusdi dagiyohiselv Edoda, ale vtla gilo yagataha Uwetsi Udodaquo uwasv; vtla ale gilo yagataha agayvligei Uwetsi uwasv, gilono nasgi tsinanugowisi ela Uwetsi.
english: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏤᎾ, ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎷᏥ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏗᏣᎵᏎᎯ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏨᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Etsena, ayv sgilutsi, nigadiyu agiliya ditsilvwisdanehi, ale gagedv ditsalisehi, ayvno datsvyawesolvstani.
english: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏴ ᎠᏆᎩᎳᎾᎶ ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᏏ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsiyv aquagilanalo ale sgiyadeloquasi, aquadanvtiyuyeno ale aquadadolisdiyu aginawiyi, datsiwadvhino ditsadanvdo tsuyawesolvsdiyi.
english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎩᎳᎾᎶᏰᏃ ᏄᎯᏐᏛᎾ, ᎦᎵᏎᎲᏃ ᎤᏓᏌᎧᎯᏳ.
phonetic: Aquagilanaloyeno nuhisodvna, galisehvno udasakahiyu.
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ ᎠᏫᏒ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᎪᏄ ᏚᏂᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏒᎩ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏗᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Tsisa aisvgi awisv utsalesdi unadodaquasgv iga; gvwasdawadidohino agonu duniyosisgvgi, ale unalenvhvgi unisgudesvgi utsalesdi ale unisdigvgi.
english: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎾᏛᏁ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno Aniqualisi unadolehosv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gvniyuquo igvdvnedi nigesvna unadodaquasgv iga nanadvne getsasdawadidohi.
english: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᏕᏫ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ,
phonetic: Aseno hia niduweselvgi; Tlasgo yitsigoliyeo Dewi nudvnelv agonu tsuyosisge, ale nasgi anehi,
english: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎨᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᏥᎸᏍᎩᏂ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ?
phonetic: Unelanvhi utseli adanelv tsuyvlei, ale agadodi gadu tsugei, yeli gvwagisdi nigesvna tsigesei, ale nasgi anehi, atsilvsginianelohi unvsv?
english: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo nasquo yitsigoliyeo dikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi unadodaquasgv iga udvna digatawiisdiyi atsilvanelohi unadodaquasgv aniyosdisgv, ale unisganvtsvhi nigesvna gesvi?
english: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo udvna digalawiisdiyi.
english: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎠ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᏰᎸᏁ ᏄᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ.
phonetic: Yitsigadovsesgini gadvgv hia nasgi tsinigawea, adadolisdi gesv aquaduliha, vtlano atsilvgelasdiyi gesvi, vtla unisganvtsvhi yidogetsiyelvne nunisganvtsvna.
english: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno Uwetsi Ugvwiyuhi nasquo unadodaquasgv iga.
english: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎢᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano iudanvsv, tsunilawiisdiyi wuyvlvgi.
english: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono edohvgi asgaya uwoyeni uwaiselvhi.  Gvwadvdvnvgino hia nuniwesvgi; tsigo yeliquo gvdanvwodi unadodaquasgvi; gvwayilidasdiyi unadulisgvgi.
english: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᏳᎾᏝᎠ, ᎠᏔᎴᏒᏃ ᏳᎸᏨ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏭᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Tsigo asgaya udasuya itsehvi, iyuno saquo awi unodena yunatlaa, atalesvno yulvtsv unadodaquasgvi, nasgi wuniyvdi ale wulesdi nigesvna?
english: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Nigavsgini utlihiyu atsilvquodiyu yvwi esgaquo awi unodena.  Nasgisgini iyusdi yeliquo osdv digalvwisdanedi unadodaquasgv iga.
english: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏓ; ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛᎩᏃ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏐᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nuweselv asgaya; Hadoyanvhida; udoyanvhidvgino.  Ale udiwasvgi, nasgiya soi nusdv nulistanvgi.
english: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Aniqualisi uninugotsv uninohelv iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi.
english: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa udolehosv nahna udanvsvgi; unitsatino gvwasdawadvsvgi; ale nigadv dunvwanvgi,
english: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale dunvsdadelv gvnigesv igvwanediyi.
english: And charged them that they should not make him known:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Udohiyudiyi ayelvsvgi Isaya adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ; ᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo tsinvsidasdi tsiyasuyedv tsigeyui diquadanvdv iyvdv osdv tsiyelvi; datsineli aquadanvdo, ale Tsunadalenvdv yvwi duyugodv tsunanugowisedi gesesdi.
english: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏧᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla tsutiyosdi ale uweludi yigesesdi, vtla ale gilo udvganedi yigesesdi kanegv degalanvdvi.
english: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏩᏐᎾ ᎤᏰᏓᏬᏨᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏍᏆᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏜᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏓᎵᏁᎯᏙᏅᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Wasona uyedawotsvhi vtla tsusqualisdi yigesesdi, ale doledv tsugasvsdi vtla uwadladisdi yigesesdi, gvni adalinehidonvha duyugodv gesv dayelihisdisgvi.
english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale dudov Tsunadalenvdv yvwi analisgasdodisgesdi.
english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono agatinohelvgi asgina uyai digewi ale uwagewi, ale unvwanvgi; nasgino digewi ale uwagewi uwonisvgi ale ugohvgi.
english: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia Dewi Uwetsi yigi?
english: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏧᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno Aniqualisi unadvganv, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia vtla anisgina yidiganugowisga gvni tsusdelisgo Quelitsiqua ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎪᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏙᏉ.
phonetic: Ale tsisa agatahv nusdv anadanvtesgvi, hia niduweselvgi; Nigav ayeli gotlvsvi tali tsinadadisgo uwasvquo tsadatludisgo ayogoquo; ale nigav gaduhv ale adanelv tali tsinadadisgo uwasvquo tsadatludisgo vtla yinigvwasdoquo.
english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᏔᎵ ᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ?
phonetic: Iyu ale Sedani Sedani yiganugowisga, tali nadadisgoi uwasvquo adatludisgoi; gadono yigalisdoda yinigvwasdiquo utseligohi?
english: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏯᎩᏍᏕᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏥᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno ayv Quelitsiqua yagisdeli anisgina yiditsinugowisga, gago unisdelisgo ditsetsi tsidaninugowisgoi?  Nasgisgini digetsugodanehi gesesdi.
english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎬᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏗᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎿᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Iyusgini ayv Unelanvhi Udanvdo yigvdi anisgina yiditsinugowisga, hnaquosgini galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv itsilutselv.
english: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᏛᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏯᏴᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎭᎥ ᏯᏬᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏄᎸᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?  ᎩᎳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏯᏬᏅ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gado yadvga gilo ulinigidv asgaya ganelv yayvha ale uhnav yawonv, iyuno igvyi nulvlvna yigi nasgi ulinigidv asgaya?  Gila hnaquo yawonv ganelvi uhnavi.
english: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏆᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᎭ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏃᏍᏗᏟᏏᏍᎬᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Gilo naqualigonehvna, nasgi aquatludiha; gilono nosditlisisgvna, nasgi yadigaleyasga.
english: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha; nigav nudalesv asganvisdi gesv ale asotlvdodi gesv getsidolisdiquo gesesdi yvwi; Galvquodiyusgini Adanvdo asotlvdodi gesv vtla getsidolisdi yigesesdi yvwi.
english: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gilo gawonisgv atludisgesdi yvwi Uwetsi, atsidolisdiquo gesesdi; gilosgini gawonisgv atludisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, vtla atsidolisdi yigesesdi gohi gesv ale nasquo soiyi digesvi.
english: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᎤᏛᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᏨᎦ ᎤᏛᏃ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ; ᏡᎬᏰᏃ ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Tlugv osdv nitsvga udvno osdv, ale tlugv usonv nitsvga udvno usonvi; tlugvyeno golisdodi geso nusdv udvi.
english: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ᏺ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ!  ᏥᏂᏥᏲᎢᏴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏥᏬᏂᎯ?  ᎤᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏪᎲᎢ ᎥᎰᎵ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Yo inadv tsunetsi nihi!  Tsinitsiyoiyv gado yigalisdoda osdv yitsiwonihi?  Utsadvyeno onawiyi owehvi vholi gawonisgoi.
english: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎤᏲᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Osdv yvwi, osdv usquanigodv unawiyi, osdv gananugowisgoi.  Uyono yvwi, uyo usquanigodv uyo gananugowisgoi.
english: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nitsvweseha; Nigav uyo aniwonisgv yvwi, uninohedi gesesdi digugododiyi iga gesvi.
english: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏁᎬᏰᏃ ᏣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏁᎬ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏗᏣᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hinegvyeno tsadudalesdodi gesesdi, ale hinegv tsasganvtsv ditsadugodanedi gesesdi.
english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎣᎦᏚᎵ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᎡᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi uninetsv, hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, uyelvdv ogaduli itsvgowadvediyi.
english: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Gohi tsaneha uniyo ale dinadayonehi uyelvdv uniyohoi; aseno uyelvdv vtla getsinedi yigesesdi, Tsona adolehosgi utseliga uyelvdv uwasv.
english: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎾᏰᏃ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎡᏆ ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱ ᏣᏯᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsonayeno tsoi iga ale tsoi svnoyi atsadi equa usquoliyi tsayaei, nasquosgini yvwi Uwetsi tsoi iga ale tsoi svnoyi gadohi hawini ayaesdi.
english: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᏂᏂᏫ ᏣᏁᎲᎩ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏓᎬᏩᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏅᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎩ ᏦᎾ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏦᎾ.
phonetic: Yvwi Niniwi tsanehvgi dodvnaleni dagvwanatlutani gohi tsaneha, digugododiyi iga gesvi, ale unisganvtsv gvnigesv udvnvneli; nasgiyeno dunadanvdv duninetliyvsvgi Tsona alitsidohvsgv nuwanisanvgi, gvniyuquono ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Tsona.
english: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏤᎮᎢ ᏙᏛᎴᏂ ᏓᏳᎾᏡᏔᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᏪᏅᏎ ᎤᏛᎦᏂᎴ ᏐᎵᎼᏅ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎵᎼᏅ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi ageyv tsuganawv tsehei dodvleni dayunatlutani gohi tsaneha digugododiyi iga gesvi, ale unisganvtsv gvnigesv nvdagvneli; nasgiyeno gadohi wasdv iyvdv tsuwenvse udvganile Solimonv agatahnaiyu gesvi, gvniyuquono ani edoha utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Solimonv.
english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏴᏫᎯ ᎦᏄᎪᎢ, ᎤᎧᏲᏛᎯ ᎡᏙᎰᎢ ᎤᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gadaha adanvdo yvwihi ganugoi, ukayodvhi edohoi uyawesolvsdiyi uyohoi, aseno vtla yawatisgoi.
english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᎸ ᏗᎩᏄᎪᏨ ᏴᏛᏥᎶᏏ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏏᏩ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏃᏌᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nigawesgoi; ditsinelv diginugotsv yvdvtsilosi.  Hnaquono wigalugi awatisgo usiwa geso ale gvnosadvhi ale goduisdoi.
english: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎡᎪᎢ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎾᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono iegoi widayanisgo uwanadale galiquogi anisgina utli iyuninegutsidv esgaquo uwasv, nahnano aniyvhihoi ale ananeladisgoi, onino nusdv na asgaya utli uyoiyu gesoi esgaquo igvyiyi.  Nasgisgini nunasdesdi gohi uninegutsidv tsaneha.
english: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Asiquo degawonedisgv yvwi, gvniyuquo utsi ale analinvtli doyitlv anidonavgi, unadulisgvgi gvwalinohedodiyi.
english: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎠ, ᎨᏣᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Gilono hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo tsatsi ale itsalinvtli doyi anidonaa, getsalinohedodiyi unaduliha.
english: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎤᏃᏁᎸᎯ; ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuweselv unonelvhi; Gago etsi?  Ale gago otsalinvtli?
english: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏐᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Widusonvno gvwasdawadidohi hia nuwesvgi; Gvniyuquo etsi ale otsalinvtli.
english: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥ.
phonetic: Giloyeno nadvnehesdi nusdv udulisgv Edoda galvladi ehi, nasgi vginvtli ale vgido ale etsi.
english: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyu iga Tsisa unugotsvgi adanelvi, ale vdalulodi uwenvgi.
english: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ.  ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Unitsatino yvwi gvwadatluwistanvgi, nasgi iyusdi tsiyuhi utsanvgi, ale uwenvgi.  Nigadiyuno nasgi unitsati amayulodi anidonavgi.
english: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Deuwonetanvno utsati tsudalenvdv dutlilosdanelvgi; hia nuwesvgi; Gvniyuquo, awisgi uwisvsei.
english: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏫᏒᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏘᏐᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Uwisvno igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei, tsisquano unilutse ale unutisonei.
english: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎦᏲᎵ ᎦᏓ ᎦᎳᎨᏴᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏌᎨᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ.
phonetic: Igadvno nvyohi gesv ulageyadvtsei, gayoli gada galageyvi, gilaquono iyvdv uliyenei, nvdigalisdodisge sageiyu gesv gada.
english: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙ ᏧᎧᎸᏨ ᎤᎴᏴᏎᎢ, ᏂᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᎾᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᎭᏍᎬᏤᏉ.
phonetic: Aseno nvdo tsukalvtsv uleyvsei, niduhnasdetlvnano gesv iyusdi uhnasgvtsequo.
english: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᏧᏛᏒ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei, anugalvno tsudvsv unenulastanei.
english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvsgini osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, nasgino ugatatanei, igadv asgohitsuqui unequotsei, igadvno sudalasgohi unequotsei, igadvno tsoasgohi unequotsei.
english: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Gilo degalugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
english: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏕᎭᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselv hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono dehiwonedisgv tsidehatlilosdaneha?
english: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬ ᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Nvdigalisdodisgini nihi etsinelvhi gesv itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv galvladi ehi ugv wiyuhi gesvi, nasgini vtla gegalisgolvdanelvhi yigi.
english: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno uhesdi atsinedi gesesdi, utsatino uhesdi; gilosgini nuhvna gesesdi atsigiediquo gesesdi nasgi nasquo uhvi.
english: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏕᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᏛᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏃᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha tsidegatsiyatlilosdaneha, anigowatisgvyeno vtla yinadvgiha ale vtla yinoliga.
english: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏅ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏧᏙᎴᎰᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale anehv udohiyunv Isaya tsudolehosei, hia tsinuwesei; Itsadvgisgv itsadvgisgesdi, aseno vtla yitsoligesdi; ale itsigowatisgv itsigowatisgesdi, aseno vtla yitsadolehosgesdi.
english: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᎵᏦᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᏓᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏗᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiayeno yvwi tsuninawi dulitsohvsv, ale danililugv gayoliyu dadvgiha, ale dinigadoli dunisdunv; nasgi dinigadoli digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale danililugv digvwanadvgododinigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale tsuninawi digvwanolisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, ale digvwanadanetliyvedi nigesvna dunadanvdv, ale digagatsinvwodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎵᎷᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᏛᎩᎭ;
phonetic: Nihisgini ditsigadoli digalvquotanvhi, nasgiyeno dagowatiha, ale detsililugvi, nasgiyeno dadvgiha;
english: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏛ ᎤᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, unitsati anadolehosgi ale unadanvti unadulvdv utsigowadvdiyi hia nasgi tsitsigowatiha, aseno vtla unigohvhi yigi; ale unadvgodiyi hia nasgi tsitsadvgiha, aseno vtla unadvganvhi yigi.
english: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi itsadvgvga datlilosdv awisgi.
english: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎬᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᎾᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾᏃ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎡᎰ ᎠᏫᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo advgvga kanohedv galvladi ehi ugvnayuhi gesv ugvwali, nigoligvnano tsigesoi, hnaquo unegutsidv galugoi ale ugieho awisv unawiyi.  Nasgi hia unohulodi tsawisei.
english: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nvyohi tsawisei; nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv, ale gilaquo iyvdv ulihelitsvhi tsidadanilvgoi;
english: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᎦᏉ ᏥᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎠᎩᎵᏴᏰᏃ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏓ ᎠᎦᏕᏯᏙᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno niduhnasdetlvnaquo gesoi, ale tlegaquo tsidakahnawadegoi; agiliyvyeno gananugoi ale kanohedv dvliyeilvsda agadeyadoda, gilaquo iyvdv duwodehihoi.
english: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎦᏔᏛᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasquo anugalvhi tsawisei, nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv, elohino uwelihisdi gesv ale genvisdi gesv udalidasdv aninenulasdisgo kanohedv, nasgino nagatadvsgvnaquo gesoi.
english: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏣᏫᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪᎵᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᎦᏔᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na osv gadohi tsawisei; nasgi tsadvgisgo kanohedv ale tsigoligoi, ale nasquo tsagatadvsgoi, ale tsigananugowisgoi, igadv asgohitsuqui unequotsvhi, igadvno sudalasgohi, igadvno tsoasgohi.
english: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo asgaya osdv ugata ulogesv tsuwisei.
english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨ, ᎤᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏫᏎ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏒ ᎤᏑᏴᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎ.
phonetic: Aseno yvwi unilinvtsv, usgaya ulutse uyo ugata uwise utsalesdi awisv usuyvnei; ale iuwenvse.
english: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono uliyenv ale ugatatanv nasquo uyo unanugotsei.
english: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏱᏣᏫᏎ ᏣᎶᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏰᎦ?
phonetic: Hnaquono asgaya ganela tsunvsidasdi gvwalutselei, hia nigvwaweselei; sginvsidasdi, Tlasgo osdv ugata yitsawise tsalogesvi?  Gado digalisdodaha uyo tsuyega?
english: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ.  ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᎣᎩᏰᎯᏒᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Gilo agisgagi nasgi nudvnelv.  Tsunvsidasdi hia nigvwaselei; Tsadulisgono ogiyehisvsdiyi?
english: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ, ᎢᏥᏰᎯᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ, ᏱᏕᏥᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᏓ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nuwesei; vtla, itsiyehisgvyeno uyo, yidetsihnasdetlvda nasquo utsalesdi.
