english: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᎫᎳᎭ ᏫᏓᏛᎯ ᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᏨᎭ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩ; ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏥᏟᏌ ᎤᏲ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏦᏛᏣ ᏗᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏟᏌ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelagi igulaha widadvhi gvni agadvnatsvha; hnaquono agadvnatsv hia nvdagatsiweseli anisgudesgi; Igvyi itsitlisa uyo, ale ditsodvtsa digohvsdodi, utsalesdisgini itsitlisa agisquanigododiyi.
english: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᎦᏔ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏫᏎ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo atsilv ugata, asgaya tsugise ale tsuwise ulogesvi.
english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᏬᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎦᏔ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏛᎯ ᏥᏬᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏛᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏡᎬ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ ᏣᏂᎷᎪᎢ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏣᎾᎭᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi udohiyusv tsiwodagonadvdi usdigiyu gesv nigav ugata, aseno advhi tsiwodagonadvdi udvniyu gesv nigav uyehnavi, ale tlugv tsinigalisdiha, nasgino tsisqua tsanilugoi, duwanigalv tsanahadisgoi.
english: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏬᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏑᏴᏁ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏒ ᎦᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎪᏐᏅ.
phonetic: Nvwadale dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwosvgi; Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo agododi, nasgi ageyv tsugise ale tsusuyvne tsoi iyutlilodv isv galvi, gvni nigadv ugosonv.
english: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏂᏓᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nigadiyu Tsisa duwonetanvgi unitsati dutlilosdanelvgi, nidatlilosdanehvnano gesv vtla yiduwonetanei.
english: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏓᏥᏍᏚᎢᏏ ᏥᎣᎵ ᏕᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Udohiyudiyi ayelvsvgi adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei; datsisduisi tsioli degatlilosdisgvi, datsineistani udelidv asquanigodv elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏍᎩᏲᏏᏌᏏ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏧᎵᏰᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa duyelihistanv unitsati, adanelv wuyvlvgi; gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Disgiyosisasi datlilosdv uyo tsuliyene tlogesi.
english: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; nasgi na Osdv ugata tsuwisei nasgi yvwi Uwetsi;
english: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏠᎨᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎤᏲᏃ ᏧᎵᏰᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Tlogesino nasgi elanigvi; osdv ugata nasgi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv anehi; uyono tsuliyene nasgi unegutsidv tsuwetsi;
english: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏫᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ; ᎤᎦᏛᎾᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Agasgino nasgi tsuwisei, nasgi asgina; ugadvnaisdiyino gesv nasgi alisquadvha elohi; anisgudesgino nasgi dinikahnawadidohi.
english: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏣᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino uyo tsanitlisisgo ale tsanagohvsdisgo atsilvyi, nasgiyasgini nasquo nusdesdi alisquadvha hia elohi.
english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏙᏛᏃᏣᎴᏏ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Yvwi Uwetsi dodaganvsi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi, ale nasgi utseligohi dodvnotsalesi nigadv dinadadodesdisgi ale nigadv anisganvgi,
english: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎪᏢᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᏓᎡᏏ; ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Digotlvsvno atsilvyi widodvnadaesi; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏩᏂᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unadanvti gvwanitalugisgi gesesdi Unidoda utseligohi, nvdo nasgiyai.  Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
english: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏣᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏩᏛ, ᏣᏕᎸᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏘ ᏤᎪᎢ ᏥᏫᎦᎾᏕᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏭᏩᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo tsugvwalodi udelidv tlogesi tsahoi, nasgi iyu asgaya awadv, tsadelvsgoi, aliheligvno iyusti tsegoi tsiwiganadego nigadv usquanigodvi, ale tsiwuwasgo nasgi tlogesi.
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎦᏃᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏲᎮ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo ganodisgi tsiduyohe tsuwoduhi dagvnaiyunasdi.
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏓᎬᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo uwadvhv saquo utsati tsugvwalodi dagvna iyusdi uwenvse wunadinvse nigadv usquanigodvi, nasgino uwasei.
english: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏥᏭᎾᏓᎢᏅᏎ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ;
phonetic: Ale nasquo Galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo agayaludi tsiwunadainvse amequohi, ale tsiduniniyvhe naniv tsunadalenvdv;
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎧᎵᏨ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᏏᏃᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᏃᏍᏛᏃ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᏚᏂᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo ukalitsv amayulodi uninasinolei, ale unanvnei, anosdvno ditelido dunilvtanei, uniyono dunadainvsei.
english: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ; ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏛᏂᎷᏥ, ᏙᏛᎾᎦᎴᏅᏔᏂ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Nasgisgini nusdesdi elohi alisquadvha; dinikahnawadidohi dvnilutsi, dodvnagalenvtani uninegutsidv ale unadanvti;
english: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛᏃ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᏓᎡᏏ ᏗᎪᏢᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Uninegutsidvno widodvnadaesi digotlvsv atsilvyi, nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏦᎵᎩᏧ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ?  ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; itsoligitsu nigadv hia?  vv, tsagvwiyuhi, vgvwoselvgi.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏥᏙᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏘ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduweselvgi; Nasgi iyusdi gilo digowelisgi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali ageyonvhi tsigesoi, nasgiyaquo asgaya ganela tsidodigananugowisgo tsugvwalodi usquanigodv tsudalenvdv ditse ale tsuweti.
english: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, hnaquo Tsisa usquadv hia nasgi datlilosdisgvi, unigisvgi.
english: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏪᏲᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏣᎦᏔ ᎿᎭᎠ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono uwasv utseligohi ulutsv tsunilawiisdiyi duweyonvgi; nasgi iyusdi unisquanigosvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Gado ulisdotanv hia nasgi asgaya tsagata hnaa ale usquanigodi tsidulvwisdaneha?
english: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᎧᏂ ᏗᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎺᎵᎧᏂ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴᎧᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ?
phonetic: Hiakani dinesgesgi uwetsi, Melikani utsi, alekani analinvtli Tsimi, ale Tsosi ale Sawani ale Tsudasi?
english: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᎧᏂ ᏧᏙ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏂ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᎭ?
phonetic: Alekani tsudo nigadv esgani tsaneha?  Gadono ulisdotanv hia nigadv tsuweha?
english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎸᎩᏃ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vgvwagonelohiselvgino; aseno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Adolehosgi vtla natsilvquodvna yigesoi, uwasvsgininonv utseligohi ale uwasv ganelvi.
english: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᏳᏣᏖ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Vtlano yutsate usquanigodi nahna yidulvwisdanelei, nanohiyuhvsgena gesv nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
english: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏁᏳ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏍᏓᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Naneyu Elodv nvgi igadugi gesv sdadugi atsigatidisdi udvgane deganotsalv Tsisa.
english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏪᏍᎩ; ᏙᎤᎴᏅ ᏧᏲᎱᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele tsunvsidasdi; Hia nasgi Tsani Didawesgi; doulenv tsuyohusvgi, ale nasgi iyusdi usquanigodiyu tsidulvwisdaneha.
english: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎮ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎴᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏚᏁ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ,  ᏈᎵᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvyeno uniyvhe Tsani ale ulvlei ale usdune didasdudiyi,  Quiligi Elodv dinadanvtli udalii Elodisi tsudoidv usdvdisgei.
english: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏰᎭ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno hia nuwesele Elodv; vtla duyugodv yigi nasgi tsadayeha.
english: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Ale udulisge uhisdiyi, aseno dasgaihe yvwi, adolehosgiyeno uniyelvse Tsani.
english: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ, ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏎ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎡᎶᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo Elodv udenv iyu iga dunilawitsv, Elodisi uwetsi adv unalisgielei, ale ose uyelvne Elodv.
english: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᎤᏔᏲᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi uselitane uduisdanele unediyi nusdvquo utayolvi.
english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono utsi uweyonvhi nigesei hia nuwesei; Ani sgiyohelvha Tsani Didawosgi usgo atelido galodesdi.
english: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino uyoiyu uyelvnei, aseno uselitanvi, ale nasquo nasgi analisdayvhvsgi nvtsulisdotanei, unetse atsinediyi.
english: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᏭᏂᏍᎫᏕᏎ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Udanvseno wunisgudese Tsani didasdudiyi.
english: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎴ ᎠᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏥ ᏭᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Usgono uniyole atelidogihi, ale uninele adv, nasgino utsi wunelei.
english: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏎ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᏭᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unilutse ale uninese ayelvi, ale uninisanei, ale unenvse wuninonele Tsisa.
english: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏦᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎤᏓᏰᎵᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᎡᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏙᏓᏳᏁᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvganv, tsiyu utsotanvgi nahna unigisvgi udayelilv inage wulosvgi.  Hnaquono yvwi unadvganv, eladi gvwasdawadvegi degaduhv dodayunenvsvgi.
english: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᏧᏂᏢᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano utsaisv dugohvgi unitsati yvwi, ale duwedolitsvgi, ale dunvwanvtsunitlvgi.
english: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎶᏐᏂᏗ, ᏥᏤᎾᏉᏃ ᎩᏲᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎠᏂᎶᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv gvwasdawadohi gvwalutselvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Ani inagequo, ale iga ulosonidi, tsitsenaquono giyosi hia unitsati yvwi, ale dodigaduhv wianilohi, nahna unvsv unalisdayvdi uniwasvha.
english: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᎥᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯᏉ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla ase vunenvsdi yigi, nihiquo ditselasda.
english: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᏚ ᏙᎩᎭ, ᏔᎵᏉᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Ani hisgiquo gadu dogiha, taliquono atsadi.
english: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂ ᏗᏍᎩᏲᎯᏏ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Ani disgiyohisi.
english: He said, Bring them hither to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎧᏁᏍᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ, ᏚᎩᏒᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏒ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏚᎧᎾᏅ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᏚᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Dunetselvno unitsati kanesgohi gesv unanvdiyi, dugisvno hisgi gadu ale tali atsadi dunesv, galvladino widukananv ulihelitsvgi, ale dugvhaluyv dunelvgi gadu gvwasdawadidohi, nasgino gvwasdawadidohi unitsati widuninelvgi.
english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏘᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unalisdayvnvgi ale dunolvsvgi, ale unutisvgi uligvhaluyvhi utiyvhi taladu iyakalii talutsa.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯᏃ ᎯᏍᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᏂᏓᏁᏢᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ.
phonetic: Unalisdayvnvhino hisgiha iyagayvli anisgaya nanivgi, nidanetlvdvna anigeyv ale diniyoli.
english: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏦᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᏚᏂᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏏ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv Tsisa dunvwistanvgi gvwasdawadidohi tsiyuhi unatsodiyi, ale igvyi nidunisohisdiyi asi dayelihisdisgv unitsati.
english: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono duyelihistanv unitsati odalv uhnalusvgi uwasv gesvi, udadolistanvsvgi.  Usvno nulistanv nahna uwasvquo gesvgi.
english: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏩᏂᏂᏒᎩ ᎤᏝᏗᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᎹ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏃᎴᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏓᏳᎦᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Tsiyuno hnaquo ayeli vdali waninisvgi utladistanidohv ama dalisdilanegvi, unoleyeno igvyitlv dayugadvgi.
english: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᎩᏁ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᏌ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nvgine iyunadanetliyvdv gesv aniyawisgi svnoyi Tsisa widulutselvgi vdali gadui aisvgi.
english: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎩ; ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏰᎯ ᎯᎠ.  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwagohv vdali gadugi; aisvi unadanvtetanvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Nayehi hia.  Anisgaihvno iyusdi unalistanvgi.
english: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ, ᎠᏴᏉᏰᏃ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno gilaquo iyvdv Tsisa dunetselvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Ugalisdiquo itsadanvdada, ayvquoyeno, tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
english: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏁᏥ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno nihi gesesdi, sginetsi wigvlutsediyi amayi gadui.
english: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎮᎾ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏩᎦᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Ehena, udvnvgi.  Hnaquono Quida tsiyuhi utsaisv amayi gadui aisvgi Tsisa tsedohv wagadvgi.
english: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᎦᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎲ ᎦᏃᏴᎬ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno nvdolehosv asdayiyu ganolvvsgv usgalvgi, ale ulenvhv ganoyvgv uwelunvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi sgisdelv, udvnvgi.
english: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ ᏭᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏍᏗ ᏦᎯᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᎯ ᎥᏣᏜᏓᏏᏛᏏ?
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv Tsisa wudoyanvhidv wuniyvhvgi, hia nuweselvgi; usdi tsohiyuhi, gadohi vtsadlasidvsi?
english: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎢᎤᎾᏣᏅ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Tsiyuhino iunatsanv ganolvvsgv usuligotsvgi.
english: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsiyuhi unatsai unilutsv gvwadadolisdanelvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi.
english: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᏐᏨ ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunisotsv Genisiladi unilutsvgi.
english: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏬᎵᏨ, ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏏᏙᎸᎩ, ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano anehi anisgaya gvwolitsv, gvwaduwidv dunadanvsidolvgi, degvwatinohelvgi nigadv tsunitlvgi.
english: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᎾᏒᏁᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gvwatayoselvgino gadaluyadvquo nasquo unuwav unasvnediyi, nigadvno unasvnilvhi dunadiwasvgi.
english: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa gvwalutselvgi dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi Tsilusilimi anehi, hia nuniwesvgi;
english: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎡᏘ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ?  ᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᏃᏑᎴᏍᎪ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏨᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono getsasdawadidohi aniyosdisgo eti anehi uninohelvhi?  Tlayeno yidanosulesgo tsunoyeni tsvdinalisdayvnisoi.
english: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏘ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ?
phonetic: Aseno unetsv hia niduweselvgi; gadono nasquo nihi eti anehi uninohelvhi itsvdisgo itsiyosdisgo Unelanvhi unetsvhi?
english: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎩᎶ ᏓᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno unetse hia nuwesei; Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi; ale nasquo hia; Gilo dasginvdisgesdi udoda ale utsi ase uyohuhisdi gesesdi.
english: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ,
phonetic: Aseno nihi hia nitsiwesgoi; Iyuno gilo hia nigawesehesdi udoda, ale utsi, Aqualisgolvtanvhi yeli getsalisdelvdodi gesvi nitsadvnehv,
english: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, [ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ,] ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎡᏘ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎢᏨᏔᏅ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Nigalvquodisgvnano igesesdi udoda, ale utsi, [vtla usganvtsvhi yigesesdi,] itsadisgoi.  Nasgi hia eti anehi uninohelvhi itsvtanv asequo nitsvnelv Unelanvhi unetsvhi.
english: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏧᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᏥᏥᏛᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Itsatlonasdi, yeliquo Isaya tsudolehose tsitsidvgei, hia tsinuwesei;
english: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎥ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎭ ᎠᏂᎰᎵ ᎠᏅᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᏓᏅᏗ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏄᏅᏅ.
phonetic: Hia yvwi nav gvgilutseha aniholi anvdiha, ale dunihanegalv danvdi gvgilvquodiha, aseno uninawi invhiyu nunvnv.
english: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ ᎬᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Asequosgini nanadvneha gvquadadolisdaneha, tsidanadeyohvsga danadeyohvsgv yvwiquo uninetsvhi.
english: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Widuyahvno unitsati hia niduweselvgi; Itsadvgvga ale itsoligi.
english: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏭᏴᎸᎯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎰᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Vtlasgini nasgi na aholi wuyvlvhi gadaha yinuwaneho yvwi, aholisgini nvdayunugotsvhi nasgi gadaha nuwaneho yvwi.
english: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎦᏔᎭᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᏨᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi unilutsv hia nigvwaselvgi; Higatahasgo Aniqualisi unihnalvtsvi unadvganv nasgi hia nitsawesvi.
english: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏰᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno unetsvgi hia nuwesvgi; nigav duyegv Edoda tsuwisvhi nigesvna diyehisdi gesesdi.
english: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ, ᏗᏂᎨᏫᏉ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᏗᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏯᏘᏂ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unanelagi, dinigewiquo dinigewi dinatinidohi; iyuno digewi yatini digewi itsula atalesv tsunilvisdi.
english: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏍᎩᏲᏏᏌᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano unetsv hia nuweselvgi; disgiyosisasi hia nasgi datlilosdvi.
english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾᏉ ᎢᎩ?
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Asisgo nasquo nihi nitsoligvnaquo igi?
english: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏏ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎥᎰᎵ ᎤᏴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏉᎵᏱ ᏫᎦᎷᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᏉ?
phonetic: Tlasgo asi yitsoliga nasgi nigav gohusdi vholi uyvstanvhi gesv osquoliyi wigalugvi, nasgino wigalohisdisgvquo?
english: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgini vholi nvdayunugotsvhi onawiyi didalehvsgoi, nasgino gadaha nuwaneho yvwi.
english: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎾᏫᏱᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎪ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎪᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᏓᏱᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Onawiyiyeno didalehvsgo usonv adanvtedi gesvi, ale adahisdiyi gesvi, ale adayonediyi gesvi, ale udelidv dinisidiyi gesvi, ale ganosgisdiyi gesvi, ale atsigodiyi danadayilidohvi, ale asotlvisdodiyi gesvi.
english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᏴᏫ; ᏂᏓᏑᎴᎲᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia gadaha iyuwanehi yvwi; nidasulehvnasgini alisdayvdiyi vtla gadaha yinuwaneho yvwi.
english: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᎩᏒ ᏔᏲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂᏱ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano nahna unigisv Tayoi ale Sadoniyi wulosvgi.
english: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎨᎾᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎥ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono Genani ehi ageyv nahna nav nvdayulosvhi uwelunvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Sgidoligi, Tsagvwiyuhi Dewi uwetsi, aquetsi ageyv utsatanvhi udeyadodiha asgina.
english: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏁᏤᎸᎾᏉ ᎥᎨᏒᎩ.  ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏫᎡᎾ, ᎢᎩᏍᎪᏂᎭᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Aseno nunetselvnaquo vgesvgi.  Gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselvgi, gvwatayoselvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Wiena, igisgonihayeno.
english: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏴᎩᏁᏤᎸ, ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᎸᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuwesvgi; vtla gilo ditsiwadvdiyi yvginetselv, awi uninodena unalenalvhi unvsv Isili sidanelvhi gvsvi.
english: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ageyv ulutsv udadolisdanelvgi hia nuwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, sgisdelv.
english: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᏗᎩᎡᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᏚ, ᎩᎵᏃ ᏫᏓᏗᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuwesvgi; vtla yiduyugodi digiediyi diniyoli unatseli gadu, gilino widadinediyi.
english: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎵ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏅᎪᎣᏒᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᏚᏂᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ageyvno hia nuwesvgi; Udohiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, aseno gili analisdayvdisgo unvgoosvhi digvwaninatlai dunisgilvi.
english: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏦᎯᏳᎭ; ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏏ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏗᏩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv utsati tsohiyuha; nusdv tsadulisgv winitsalisdasi.  Nahiyuquono uwetsi udiwasei.
english: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᎩᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏒᏃ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏪᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano nahna unigisv Gelili vdalulodi ulutsvgi, uhnalusvno usahilv nahna uwenvgi.
english: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏓᎾᏘᏁᎲ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᏚᏂᏅᏅᎩ, ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Unitsatino yvwi gvwalutselvgi, danatinehv diniyouli, ale dinigewi, ale tsunvgewi, ale gohusdi usdv diniyelv tsuniyohuselvhi, ale unitsati nvwanadalei, ale Tsisa dulasgv nav duninvnvgi, dunvwanvgino.
english: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᏚᏂᎪᎲ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏲᎤᎵ, ᎬᏩᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏅᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi unitsati gesv unisquanigosvgi, dunigohv tsunvgewi aniwonisgoi, ale ahusdi usdv diniyelv tsuniyohuselvhi uninosdv nunalistanvi, ale didiyouli, gvwanedasdi nulistanvi ale dinigewi gvwanigowadvdi nulistanvi; unilvquotanvgino Unelanvhi Isili unatseliga.
english: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏦᎢᏰᏃ ᎾᏙᏓᏆ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᏰᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎢᏝ ᏯᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏙᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ, ᏩᎾᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᏂᏩᏂᎦᎶᎩ ᏩᎾᎢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano widuyanvhv gvwasdawadidohi, hia nuwesvgi; gatsiyadoliga hia unitsati gesvi, tsoiyeno nadodaqua ani gedohv anedoha, ale vtla yiniyeha unalisdayvdi.  Ale itla yaquaduliha dounenvsdiyi digvwaniyosisgi, wanayeno yidaniwanigalogi wanaisvi.
english: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏢᏃ ᏲᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏂᏣᏘ ᏰᎵ ᏧᏃᎸᎯᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hatlvno yotsigi nasgi igai alisdayvdi inagei, nasgi iyunitsati yeli tsunolvhisdi?
english: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Galiquogi, ilvsgino tsunasdi atsadi, unadvnvgi.
english: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unitsatino dunetselvgi gadohi unanvdiyi.
english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏒ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᏃ, ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏁᎸᎩ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Galiquogino gadu dugisvgi ale dunesv atsadi, ulihelitsvno, dugvhaluyvgi, ale gvwasdawadidohi widunelvgi, gvwasdawadidohino unitsati widuninelvgi.
english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏒᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏖᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
phonetic: Ale nigadv unalisdayvnvgi, ale dunolvsvgi.  Ale unutesvgi uligvhaluyvhi galiquogi iyakalii talutsa.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎯᏃ ᏅᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᏂᏓᏁᏢᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ.
phonetic: Unalisdayvhino nvgiha iyagayvli nanivgi anisgaya, nidanetlvdvna anigeyv ale diniyoli.
english: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᏭᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Ale unitsati duyelihistanvgi, ale tsiyuhi wutsanvgi, ale magideli wunanugotsvgi.
english: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino ale Anisadusi unilutsvgi, gvwagoliyesgvno gvwatayoselvgi tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.
english: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏒᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᎸᎦᎵᏱᏌᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᎶᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Usvnigalisda hia nitsiwesgoi; ulvgaliyisadv gesesdi, galvloyeno gigageiyu igi.
english: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏛᎦᎿᎭᏂ, ᎦᎸᎶᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎶᎩᎵᏰᎭ, ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎢᏳ ᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Sunaleno tsigesoi, Gohi iga tsigi dvgahnani, galvloyeno gigageiyu igi, ale igalogiliyeha, itsadisgoi.  Itsatlonasdi, yeliquo itsadolehosgo nusdv galvloi, tlasgono yeli getsadolehohisdi yigi uyelvdv iyu listanidasdi gesvi?
english: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏲᎰ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.  ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Uniyo ale uninegutsidv tsaneha uniyoho uyelvdvi, aseno vtla yvgagegalisgolvdasi uyelvdvi, Tsona adolehosgi utseli uyelvdv uwasv.  Dudanvelvno unigisvgi.
english: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏐᏨ ᎤᏅᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᏃᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino dunisotsv unvgewisvhi gesvgi unadenodiyi.
english: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi unatseliga.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎦᏕᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Uninohelvgino gesv unvsv, hia nuniwesvgi; Nigadenvna tsigi nvdigalisdodiha.
english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi udolehosv hia niduweselvgi; Usdi itsohiyuhi, gadono itsvsv gesv itsinoheha alisdayvdi nitsiyehvna gesvi?
english: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏏ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏅᏔ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo asi yitsoliga, ale tlasgo yitsanvta hisgi gadu ale hisgi iyagayvli tsinanivgi, ale iyakalii talutsa itsutesvi?
english: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎦᏚ ᏅᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎳᏣ ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Ale galiquogi gadu nvgino iyagayvli tsinanivgi, ale iyakalii talatsa itsutesvi?
english: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏏ ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚ ᏱᏥᏛᎦ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᏨᏲᏏ?
phonetic: Gado digalisdodi nitsoligvna tsigi, nasgi hia tsinitsvwesi tlasgini gadu yitsidvga, itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi Ale Anisadusi unatseliga, tsitsvyosi?
english: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏃᎵᏨᎩ ᏄᏂᏁᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏯᏙᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ, ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unolitsvgi nuninetsehvna gesv uneyadoisdiyi gadu agododi, danadeyohvsgvsgini Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi.
english: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏇᎵᎩᏱ, ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎪ ᎬᏉᏎᎰ ᏴᏫ?
phonetic: Tsisano ulutsv Sisaliyi Queligiyi, dudvdvnvgi gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselvgi; Ayv yvwi Uwetsi tsigi gago gvquoseho yvwi?
english: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ [ᎨᏦᏎᎰᎢ,] ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesvgi; Igadv Tsani didawosgi [getsosehoi,] igadvno Ilaya, anisoino Tselimaya ale gilo iyusdi anadolehosgi gesvi.
english: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᎾᏃ ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; nihinano gago sgiyoseha?
english: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎯ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Sawanino Quida unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Galonedv nihi, gvnidv Unelanvhi Uwetsi.
english: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ, ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Osiyu itsalisdanedi nihi Sawani Tsona uwetsi; vtlayeno uquedali ale gigv nasgi yitsananugowiselv, Edodasgini galvladi ehi.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏈᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏓᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎢ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayvno hia nigvweseha; Quida nihi ale nasgi ani hia nvyohi daganesgehi aquatseli tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, ale tsvsginoi dasduhvi esga iyunvnedi nigesvna gesesdi.
english: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏙᏓᎬᏕᎵ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎸᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎸᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎸᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
phonetic: Ale disduisdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv tsutseli dodagvdeli, nigavno gohusdi halvihesdi elohi, galvsdi gesesdi galvladi, nigavno gohusdi halvgisgesdi elohi galvgisdi gesesdi galvladi.
english: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunvsdadelvgi gvwasdawadidohi gilo uninonediyi nasgi uwasv Galonedv gesvi.
english: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎩᎵᏲᏤᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa ulenvhvgi dunonelvgi gvwasdawadidohi ase uwenvsdiyi gesv Tsilusilimi, Ale tsudalenvdv tsugiliyotsediyi dinilawigi ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi; ale atsiisdiyi, ale tsoine iga tsulediyi.
english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏭᏅᏍᏙᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida iyvdv wutinvstanv ulenvhvgi udanvsdadelvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Unelanvhi wunvsdohi, Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla nasgi yinvgetsalisdasi.
english: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏈᏓ; ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ, ᏎᏓᏂ, ᏗᏍᏉᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏓᏅᏕᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏴᏫᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎭᏓᏅᏕᎭ.
phonetic: Ugatahvsvno hia natsiweselv Quida; Aquasohadv halehvga, Sedani, disquodesdisgiquo nihi, vtlayeno yadanvdeha Unelanvhi utseliga, yvwiquosgini unatseli hadanvdeha.
english: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏚᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi gvwasdawadidohi; Iyuno gilo udulisgesdi agisduwadvsdiyi, adadayihesdi uwasv, ale tsudahnawadv ayisgesdi, ale agisdawadegesdi.
english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Giloyeno udulisgesdi usdelvdiyi gvnvi, uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono uyohusehesdi gvnvi, ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, uwadvdi gesesdi.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᏴᏫ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Gado yvwi yunequotsi iyuno elanigv utseli yinulistanv, udanvdono yuyohuselv; ale gado yahvga yvwi yiganetliyvsda udanvdo.
english: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏙᏛᎫᏴᎡᎵ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno Uwetsi dagalutsi Udoda utseli galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi, ale dinikahnawadidohi datinehesdi; hnaquono dodvguyveli naniv yvwi nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏓᏂᏙᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gilo ani danidoga vtla yvdvnadolehosi ayohuhisdi gesvi, gvni anigohvha yvwi Uwetsi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesv gananugotsilvha.
english: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎿᎭᎷᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Sudalino winusvlv Tsisa dutinvsvgi Quida, ale Tsimi ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli, ale duhnalutanvgi inv igati odalv unvsv gesvi,
english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᏅᏙ ᎢᏗᎬᏤᎵᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᏄᏁᎩᏰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udanetliyvse danikanvi, ale ukadv digvwalvsada nulistanei nvdo idigvtselidv, ale unuwav igagadv tsinunegiyv nunegiyei.
english: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo nahna gvnigesv nigvwanadvnele Mosi ale Ilaya gvwalinohedisgei.
english: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏕᏙᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ, ᎠᏂ ᏦᎢ ᏱᏙᏥᎵᏦᏛᎦ, ᏌᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Quidano unetsv hia nuwesele Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, osiyu ani tsidedoha, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv, ani tsoi yidotsilitsodvga, saquo nihi tsatseliga, soino Mosi utseliga, soino Ilaya utseliga.
english: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏍᎪᏍᏛ ᎤᎶᎩᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏩᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏇᏥ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Asiquono gawonisgei, gvniyuquo usgosdv ulogila unadawadistanei, ale gvniyuquo nahna ulogilv tsunetsei, Hia nvtsuwesei; hia nasgi Aquetsi tsigeyui, nasgi osiyu tsiyelvi, nasgi etsadvdasdanehesdi.
english: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏅᏤ ᏚᏂᏯᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganv duninvtse duniyasdusei, utsati unisgalei.
english: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏚᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano ulutse dusvnilei, hia nuwesei; Ditsalehvga, ale tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
english: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᎧᎾᏅᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᎪᎮ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Dunakananvno vtla gilo yunigohe Tsisa uwasv.
english: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏏᏗᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏥᏃᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎬᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunigasoasidisvno odalvi tsisa dunvsdadelei, hia nuwesei; Tlesdi gilo etsinonelvha nasgi tsitsigowadv gvni yvwi Uwetsi uyohusv dulenesdi.
english: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ, ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei; Gadono dinowelisgi, Ilaya igvyi dagalutsi, tsanadisgoi?
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏢᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei; Udohiyuhi Ilaya igvyi uluhisdi ale uwotlvhisodi nigav gohusdi.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᎳᏯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎵᏦᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸ.  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; Ilaya gayula ulutsv, ale vtla yigvwolitsoi, aseno nigav unadulisgvi nigvwanelv.  Nasquosgini yvwi Uwetsi nasgiya nvdagvwaneli.
english: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏃᎵᏤ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi unolitse Tsani Didawosgi kaneisdisgvi.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono unitsati anedohv unilutsv, ulutselvgi asgaya duliniquanvnelvgi hia nuwesvgi;
english: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎬᎵᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎯᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎬᏛᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎠᎬᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi, hiyadoligi atsutsa aquetsi, gvliyeno gvwahiha, ale utsati agiliyoga, yanogiyuyeno atsilvyi gvdvgoi ale amayi agvgoi.
english: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏯᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gatsiyatinohelvgino getsasdawadidohi, aseno uninulvnvgi uninvwodiyi.
english: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ?  ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Nitsohiyusvna ale itsagatahvdv gohi tsitseha, ilago nigohilesdi itsvyeladidohesdi?  Ilago nigohilesdi unanelagi itsvyelisehesdi?  Sgiyatinohisi.
english: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏍᎦᏨᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano asgina usgatsvgi; asginano unugotsvgi atsutsa, ale nahiyuquo udiwasvgi.
english: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏦᎩᏄᎸᏅᎩ ᎣᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi Tsisa gvwalutselvgi unvsv gesvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Gadono tsoginulvnvgi otsinugowisdiyi?
english: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᏉ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎢᎩᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎭᏓᏅᎾ ᎢᏢ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎠᎭ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏥᏄᎸᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; nvdigalisdodiha nitsohiyusvna gesvi.  Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno yitsohiyuha nasquo atsilvquo ugata igidv, hia yinitsiwesi hia tsodalv, hadanvna itlv wilohi, aha udanvsdi; vtla ale gohusdi yigetsinulvhvsga.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂ ᏴᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏯᎬᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Hiasgininonv iyusdi vtla unugoisdi yigi, gvni yvdadolisdiha ale amatli yagvsga.
english: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏃ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎵ,
phonetic: Asino Gelili anedohvi Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; yvwi Uwetsi yvwi dodagetsiyohiseli,
english: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ.  ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi dagvwali, ale tsoine iga dodvaleni.  Utsatanvhino uyo uniyelvnvgi.
english: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏆᏂᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏯᎫᏱᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Gequanino unilutsv ayeli adelv anigisidohi gvwalutsele Quida, hia nuniwesei; Tlasgo ditseyohvsgi ayeli yaguyisgoi?
english: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎮᎵᎭ, ᏌᏩᏂ; ᎦᎪ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᎫᏴᎡᎰ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎪ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎨ?
phonetic: Vv, udvnei.  Adanelvno ulutsv Tsisa uyosdodanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Gado heliha, Sawani; gago ayeli gvwanaguyveho unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi; tsunetsisgo, nvwanadalege?
english: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎩᏂᎨᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩᏉ.
phonetic: Nvwanadalei, udadoselvgi Quida.  Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Tsunetsisginigeno unanelagiquo.
english: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏂᎿᎭᎸᏙᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏑᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᏓᎡᏒᎭ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎯᏴᎩᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎯᏁᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᏘᏩᏛᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎩᏒᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎩᎾᎫᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno dinihnalvdosdiyi nigesvna, vdali hena, asudino witsadaesvha, igvyiyino hiyvgidv atsadi hinesvha, ale hisduisv aholi ayeliadelv tiwadvhi; nasgi higisvha ale dehinelvha ayv ginaguyvdi.
english: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎤᏟᎠ ᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Tsisa gvwalutselv gvwasdawadidohi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gago utlia tsilvquodiyu nahna galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Tsisano ayoli wuyanvhv ayeli aninv uwekanvgi, ale hia nuwesvgi;
english: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏥᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᏥᏴᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno nitsadanetliyvsvna igesesdi, ale diniyoli tsinunasdi nitsalistanvna igesesdi, vtla galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv yvgetsiyvha.
english: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo udadolisdi gesesdi nasgiya hia ayoli, nasgi utli atsilvquodiyu gesesdi nahna galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo dadanilvgesdi saquo nasgi hia iyusdi ayoli daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ayv daquadanilvgesdi.
english: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎪᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ ᏯᏥᏯᏝᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏛᎬ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏯᏥᎬᏴ.
phonetic: Gilosgini degodesdisgesdi saquo hia tsunasdiga gesv nasgi gvquohiyuhvsgi, utli osiyu asdosgi nvya yatsiyatlanv, ale asdvgv amequohi yatsigvyv.
english: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Uniiyu iyulisdanedi gesesdi elohi nvdigalisdodiha dinadadodesdisgi, aseyeno dinadadodesdisgi uninanugoisdi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya didadodesdisgi unanugowisvhi.
english: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏣᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏱᏘᏰᏌᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏅ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno tsoyeni ale tsalasideni detsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi ale witsadegesdi; utli osiyu itsalisdanedi tsoyeni ale tsalasideni tsayohuselvhi yigi gvnidv digesv wiyitsayvlv, ano itsula yitiyesada ale itsula ditsalasideni wiyetsadainv nigvtlosgvna gesv atsilvyi.
english: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎧᎿᎭᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏱᏘᎧᎿᎭᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏰᏣᏓᎢᏅ.
phonetic: Iyu ale higadoli detsodesdisgesdi, hadagatedoisgesdi ale witsadegesdi; utli osiyu itsalisdanedi saquo yikahna gvnidv digesv wiyitsayvlv, ano itsula yitikahna tsvsginoi atsilvyi wiyetsadainv.
english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏔᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏦᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi tsigayetsisotlvtani saquo hia tsunasdiga; hiayeno nitsvweseha; Galvladi tsosv tsunatseliga dinikahnawadidohi nigohilv anigowatisgo ukadv Edoda galvladi ehi.
english: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸ ᎤᎴᎾᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno Uwetsi ulutsv usdelvhilv ulenalvhi.
english: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏫ ᏱᏚᎾᏝᎠ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᏳᎴᏲᎡᎸ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏱᏗᎬᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎧᎾᎷᏏᏙᎰ ᎦᏚᏏ ᏳᏲᎰ ᎤᎴᏲᎡᎸᎯ?
phonetic: Gado itseliha; Iyuno gilo asgaya asgohitsuqui awi yidunatlaa, saquono yuleyoelv, tlasgo soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv yidigvdegoi, ale yidikanalusidoho gadusi yuyoho uleyoelvhi?
english: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎤᏟ ᏂᎦᎣ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏄᎾᎴᏲᎥᎾ.
phonetic: Iyuno awadv, udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, utli nigao aliheligo nasgi gesv iyusdi, esgaquo soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv nunaleyovna.
english: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎵ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎦ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo vtla yuduli Itsidoda galvladi ehi, saquo hia tsunasdiga gesv tsuniyohuhisdiyi.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎢᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎮᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏍᏛᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᏩᏛᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Iyuno disdadanvtli itsasganvtsehesdi, hegesdi hinonehesdi usganvtsv isdvsvquo gesvi; iyuno itsadvdasdanehesdi, hiwadvhesdi disdadanvtli.
english: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏕᎭᏘᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏣᏁᏨ ᎠᏍᏓᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusginino nitsadvdasdanehvnaquo igesesdi, asiyvwi ale anitali dehatinegesdi, nasgino aninohesgv anitali ale anitsoi anigatahi nigadv tsanetsv asdayosgesdi.
english: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᏃᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵᏉ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi nidadvdasdanehvnaquo igesesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv hinohvsgesdi; iyusginino tsunanelodi unadatlugv nidadvdasdanehvna igesesdi, nvwadalequo yvwi ale ayeliquoadelv agisidohi nasgiya hiyadanvtesgesdi.
english: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎸᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎸᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎸᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigav gohusdi itsalvihesdi elohi, galvsdi gesesdi galvladi; nigavno gohusdi itsalvgisgesdi elohi galvgisdi gesesdi galvladi.
english: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏤᏙᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᎪᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Alewo hia nitsvweseha; iyuno anitali nihi tsitsedoha analigohvsgesdi ani elohi nigavquo gohusdi anitayohihesdi, nasgi iyunadvnedi gesesdi Edoda galvladi ehi.
english: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᏥᏓᏂᎳᏫᎣ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏑᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvyeno anitali ale anitsoi tsidanilawio ayv daquadov tsinvdigalisdodisgoi, nahna ayeli aquadasuyoi.
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎾᎩᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏥᏯᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏍᎪ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida ulutselv hia nuwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, ilago nagisganvtsehesdi tsosdadanvtli, asiquo itsiyadoligesdi?  Galiquogisgo?
english: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏉ ᏱᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᎢᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Vtla galiquogiquo yigvyoseha, galiquasgohisgini galvquogi iyulosvhi.
english: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎬ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo gilo Ugvwiyuhi tsudanvtele osdv iyunvnediyi dudugv tsunvsidasdi.
english: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏆᏗᏅᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏚᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unalenvhv osdv nunvnelv, saquo agatinohele asgohi iyuquadinvdv adelv udugi.
english: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏥᎾᏗᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎠᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ.
phonetic: Aseno gohusdi udayvdodi nuhvna gesv iyusdi, unatlai unetse atsinadinvdiyi ale udalii ale tsuwetsi ale nigav gohusdi uhvi, adayvdiyino.
english: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi atsinvsidasdi eladi udanvnei, ale udadolisdanelei, hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, sgidoligi sgigatida, nigadvno dagvyaguyveli.
english: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino atsinvsidasdi unatlai uwedolitsei, ale uwekanei, ale udugv unelagi uweliselei.
english: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᎩᏴᎮᎢ; ᏍᏆᎫᏴᏏ ᏥᎬᏚᎦ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unugotsv, uwadvhe asiyvwi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi nasgi unetsvhi uguyvediyi asgohitsuqui agisi tsunagvwalodi; uniyvheno, ale uyvsgiyvhei; squaguyvsi tsigvduga, udvnei.
english: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Itsulahano getsinvsidasdi dulasgv eladi udanvne udadolisdanelei, hia nuwesei; Sgidoligi sgigatida, nigadvno dagvyaguyveli.
english: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏉ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏴᏔᏁ ᎤᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yuwohiyunei, didasdudiyiquo wulosei, ale nahna wuyvtane uguyvdiyi atsidugv igohidv.
english: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Naquono nasgi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi unadolehosv nulistanvi utsati uyo uniyelvnei, ale unilutse uninonele tsuninatlai nigadv nulistanidolvi.
english: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎬᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎬᏰᎵᏎᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎬᏚᎬᎩ, ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unatlai wuyanvhv hia nuweselei; tsanegutsidv gvnvsidasdi, unelagi gvyeliselvgi nigadv nihi tsigvdugvgi, sgitayoselv iyusdi.
english: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎯᏯᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᏍᏗᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏯᏙᎵᏨᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo nasquo nihi gahiyadolisdi yigese itsulaha esdinvsidasdi, nasgiya gvyadolitsvi?
english: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏔᎳᏭᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏍᏚᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎫᏴᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Utalawuseno unatlai, ale widuyohisele dinadasduhvsgi uguyvhohvsdiyi nigadv atsidugv igohidv.
english: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nvdatsvyvneli edoda galvladi ehi, iyuno ditsadanvdv iyvdv itsisiyvwiha gesv niditsidoligvna igesesdi itsadanvtli unisganvtsvi.
english: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏛ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎠᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, Tsisa usquadv nasgi hia nigawesgvi, Gelili udanvsvgi, Tsudiyi asdv wulutsvgi Tsodani asgoniditlv.
english: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Unitsatino gvwasdawadvsvgi, ale nahna dunvwanvgi.
english: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎲᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Aniqualisi nasquo gvwalutselv gvwagoliyesgvgi, hia nigvwawesehvgi; Duyugodisgo asgaya udainvdiyi udalii nigavquo gohusdi yvdiliyeilvsdiha?
english: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏧᏪᏢᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏚᏬᏢᏅᎢ?
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselvgi; Tlasgo yitsigoliyeo, nasgi didalenisgv tsuwetlvnvhi asgaya ale ageyv duwotlvnvi?
english: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏕᎬᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏜᏓᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Ale hia nuwesvi; Nasgi iyusdi asgaya degvdegesdi udoda ale utsi, ale adlawisdisgesdi udalii, ale nasgi anitali saquoquo uniquedalvi?
english: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏱᎩ; ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏚᎦᎴᏅᏔᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi vtla hnaquo anitali yigi; saquoquosgini uniquedalvi.  Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi tsuwudatanvhi gesv tlesdi yvwi yidugalenvtanesdi.
english: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᏏ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎦᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Gadono Yisi tsunetse goweli ganvnediyi digalenvdodi, ale agehidasdiyi?
english: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏓᏂᎨᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ, ᎢᏤᎵᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; disdayiyu gesv iyusdi ditsinawi Mosi unanelagi danigedohihesdi tsunadalii, itseliselvgi; didalenisgvsgini vtla nasgi yinusdei.
english: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎠᎨᎯᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏏᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎢᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏥᎨᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; Gilo udalii iagehidohesdi tsunisinvhisgininonv igesesdi, nvwadaleno iadayegesdi, adayonehesdi.  Gilono atsigehidolvhi adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
english: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏓᎾᏤᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselvgi; Iyuno nasgi yinusdi asgaya udalii danatsehvi, vtla osiyu yigi adesvhvsdiyi.
english: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥ Ꮻ ᏱᏙᎬᎾᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi, Vtla naniv hia tsinitsi wi yidogvnadanilvgi, gegalisgolvdanelvhi unvsv.
english: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏍᏙ ᏧᏂᏥ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᎵᏛᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎾᎵ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᎾᎵᏛᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anehayeno aninali nvwanasdo tsunitsi gvwaninanugowisv, ale aneha aninali yvwi gvwaninalidvhi, ale aneha aninali unvsv unadanalidvhi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv diliyeilvsdisgvi.  Gilo digvwadanilvisdi gesesdi nasgi dadanilvgesdi.
english: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dagatinohelvgi tsunasdi diniyoli nasgi tsusitadisdiyi ale udadolisdodiyi; gvwasdawadidohino duninvsdadelvgi.
english: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesvgi; Unanelagi ditselisi tsunasdi diniyoli, ale tlesdi ditsinvsdadelvgi gvgilutsediyi; nasgiyeno nunasdi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv.
english: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏏᏔᏛᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Dusitadvno nahna udanvsvgi.
english: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎰᏍᏛ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ?
phonetic: Gvniyuquono asiyvwi ulutselvgi hia nuweselvgi; Hosdv Tadeyohvsgi, gado usdi osdv gohusdi dagadvneli agiwadvdodi winasdvna gvnidv?
english: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎰᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏣᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏘᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselvgi; Gadono hosdv isquoseha?  Vtla gilo osdv yigi saquo uwasvhiyu, nasgi Unelanvhi.  Aseno tsadulisgesdi gvnidv digesv witsananugoisdiyi tisquanigoda dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᎡᎩ; ᎯᎠ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ; ᏓᎾᏓᏱᎵᏙᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Hia nuweselvgi; Gado usdi?  Tsisa hia nuweegi; Hia, Tlesdi tsadalvgi; Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi; Tlesdi tsanosgisvgi; danadayilidohv Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi;
english: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi; ale nasquo hia; Tsvsv nitsadageyusv nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.
english: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᏅ ᏥᏧᏣ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎦᏙ ᎠᏏ ᎠᎩᎷᎳ?
phonetic: Awinv hia nuweselvgi; Hia nasgi nigadv dagikahnawadenv tsitsutsa gesv nvdagvwadalenvdv, gado asi agilula?
english: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
author: Cherokee New Testament
