syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᏫᎾᏚᎦ ᏣᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᎲᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏖᏒ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsasquadisdiyi tsadulisgesdi, hena, winaduga tsahnavi, ale tihvsi uyo iyunadvhnadegi, galvladino witsahesdi tsugvwalodi; ale tesv sgisdawadesvha.
english: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno awinv nasgi udvganv udanvsvgi uyoiyu uyelvnvgi, utsatiyeno uwehnaiyu gesvgi.
english: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsisa hia niduweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; uwehnai yvwi asdayiyu wuyvsdiyi galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎩ ᎦᏏᏁᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Alewo hia nitsvweseha; utli ahidiyu gemili ugadvlehisdiyi yvgi gasinenadvdiyi esgaquo uwehnai yvwi wuyvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏥᏍᏕᎸ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganv utsatanvhi unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi Gagono yeli yatsisdelv?
english: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi dukahnanv hia niduweselvgi; Yvwi gesv vtla nasgi yinvgalisda, Unelanvhisgini gesv nigav gohusdi iyulisdodiquo.
english: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᎩᏲᏐᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏲᏥᏩᏛᎯ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo ayv nigadiyu dogiyosonv ale itsvsdawadenv; gadono ayv dayotsiwadvhi?
english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏅᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏕᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; adanetliyvsvi, Yvwi Uwetsi ganvha galvquodiyu uwesgilvi, nihi sgisdawadvdv nasquo itsinesdi taladu degasgilvi, detsugodanehesdi taladu nanilasdalv Isili.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏅᏕᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ.
phonetic: Ale naniv gilo tsunvdetsvhi daninelvi, ale analinvtli ale tsunido, ale tsunidoda, ale tsunitsi, ale tsunadalii, ale tsunetsi, ale gadohi, daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, uniwadvdi gesesdi asgohitsuqui unequotsvhi, ale unatseli iyulisdodi gesesdi gvnidv winasdvna.
english: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno unitsata igvyi tsigi oniyi gesesdi; oniyino tsigi igvyiigesesdi.
english: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ ᏧᏪᏅᏎ ᏥᏚᏅᏒᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Galvladiyeno utseligohi nasgiyaquo asgaya ganela, sunaleiyu tsuwenvse tsidunvsvse gohusdi anadvnehi telvladi duwisv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
english: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏧᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏏᎦ, ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏧᏫᏒ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi asgaya gohusdi anadvnehi dunugotanv agisi tsugvwalodi tsuguyvediyi siga, telvladi dotsuwisv dunvsei.
english: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᏐᎣᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᎲᎾ,
phonetic: Uwenvseno sooneline iyutlilodv kalawadisvi, ale dugohe nvwanadale ganododiyi anidonae gohusdi nanadvhvna,
english: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏤᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏗᏫᏒᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏨᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei; Itsena nasquo nihi telvladi dodiwisvi, duyugodvno gesv datsvyaguyveli.  Unenvseno.
english: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎤᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Taline iga iuwenvse ale nasquo tsoine iyutlilodv kalawadisv usvhiyeyi, nasgiya niudvnelei.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎠ ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ?
phonetic: Hisgineno iyutlilodv kalawadisv taline iuwenvsei, ale duwadvhe nvwanadale anidonae gohusdi nanadvnehvna, hiano niduweselei; Gadono ani itsidonaa udodaquadv gohusdi nitsadvnehvna?
english: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏰᎾ ᎩᎶ ᏲᎩᏅᏒ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎾ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏗᏫᏒᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏨᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Tlayena gilo yoginvsv, unadvnei.  Hiano niduweselei; Nihi nasquo itsena telvladi dodiwisvi; duyugodvno gesv datsvyaguyveli.
english: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᎦᏘᏕᎯ, ᏫᏘᏯᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎫᏴᏏ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏔᎴᏅᏓ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏘᏍᏆᎸᏓ
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv, telvladi dawisv utseliga hia nuwesele adelv ugatidehi, Witiyanv gohusdi anadvnehi ale taguyvsi dunilvwisdanelvi, oniyi getsinvsvhi talenvda igvyiyino getsinvsvhi tisqualvda
english: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hisgineno iyutlilodv kalawadisv getsinvsvhi unilutsv, anisiyvwiha agisi tsugvwalodi gegaguyvelei.
english: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏓᏲᎦᎫᏴᎡᎵ ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎩᏏᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyiyino getsinvsvhi unilutsv utli igai dayogaguyveli unelisei.  Aseno nasquo agisiquo tsugvwalodi anisiyvwiha igegaguyvelei.
english: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎴᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ,
phonetic: Gegaguyvelvno, unigonelohiselequo asgaya ganela,
english: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏍᎩᏴᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᎴᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; Hia oniyi unilutsvhi saquoquo iyutlilodv dunilvwisdasi, itsulahaquono nvsgiyvga ayv nasgi gagesv ale udilegv iga tsogilvwisdanelvhi.
english: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏂᎬᏴᏁᎭ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎣᏏ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏁ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Aseno asiyvwi unetsele hia nuweselei; Ginalii, vtla utsatini yinigvyvneha.  Tlasgo osi yitsayelvne agisi tsugvwalodi gvyaguyvediyi?
english: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎩ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎮᎾ.  ᎣᏏ ᎠᎩᏰᎸ ᏥᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎸ ᎢᎦᎢ.
phonetic: Higi tsatseliga ale tsihena.  Osi agiyelv tsiyaguyvediyi hia oniyi ulutsvhi nihi gvyaguyvelv igai.
english: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo duyugodv yigi nusdv gadanvtesgv iyaquvnediyi aquatseli gesvi?  Tsisa higadoli uyoiyu igi nvdigalisdodi ayv aquadanvtiyu gesvi?
english: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎣᏂᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᎲ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏒ.
phonetic: Howano oniyi tsigi igvyi gesesdi, igvyino tsigi oniyi gesesdi.  Unitsatayeno getsiyanvhv, aseno anigayoliyu gegasuyesv.
english: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Tsisano Tsilusilimi wagadvi, taladu iyanidv anadasdawadidohi unanelagi iyvdv widutinvstanvgi, ale hia niduweselvgi;
english: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏗᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᏰᏥᏲᏏ ᏙᏓᎨᏦᏲᎯᏎᎵ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᏛᏄᎪᎳᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Gvniyuquo Tsilusilimi widigati, ale yvwi Uwetsi dodayetsiyosi dodagetsoyohiseli nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi, nasgino dodvnugolani uyohuhisdiyi,
english: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎫᎾᏏᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ ᎤᏂᏪᏢᎾᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎨᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ.
phonetic: Ale gunasilenvdv yvwi dodvniyohiseli uniwetlvnanediyi, ale unilivnisdiyi, ale unadvdiyi tsudahnawadv gedvi; ale tsoine iga dodvaleni.
english: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏤᏈᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏂᏥ, ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ulutselvgi Tsequiti tsuwetsi unitsi, datinehvgi tsuwetsi aniwinv, eladi udanvnvgi, ale ahusdi utayosehvgi.
english: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵᎭ?  ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselvgi; Gado tsaduliha?  Hia nvdayuweselvgi; Halisgolvda hia anitali diquetsi tsunidiyi tsatseligohi gesvi, saquo higatisi iditlv, soino higasgani.
english: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ.  ᏥᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᎠᏴ ᏨᏓᎦᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏕᏣᏬᏍᏓ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏓᏴᏆᏬᏍᏔᏂ?  ᏰᎵᏉ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Tla yitsigataha nusdv itsitayohihvi.  Tsigo yeliquo getsaditasdi ulisquidi atlisdv ayv tsvdagaditahi, alesgo yeliquo yidetsawosda ayv nasgi tsvdayvquawostani?  Yeliquo, unadvnvgi.
english: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᏓᏣᏗᏔᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.  ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎨᏥᏁᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhi aquatseli ulisquidi atlisdv datsaditahi, ale ayv vquawosdodi gesv dodayetsawostani.  Tsigatisisgini ale tsigasgani gilo uwediyi vtla ayv aquadanedi yigi, getsinedisgininonv gesesdi nasgi Edoda tsudanelanelvhi.
english: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏂᏆᏘᎸ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Asgohino iyanidv unadvganv utsati unitalawosvgi duniniquatilv anitali dinadanvtli.
english: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎪ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᏥᏙᎲ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano widuyanvhv hia nuwesvgi; Itsigataha ayeli degotlvwadisv nunigvwiyusadegi aninego iyunadvnelidasdiyi yvwi, ale getsilvquodi aninetsidohv nanadvnehoi.
english: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihisgini tlesdi nasgi yinitsvnesdi; gilosgini atsilvquodi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi nasgi etsinvsidasdi gesesdi.
english: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo ugvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi nasgi etsinatlai gesesdi.
english: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏓᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏲᎵᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᎫᏴᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiyaquo yvwi Uwetsi udanvsidasdiyi nuyolilvna tsigi, atsinvsidasdiyiquosgini, ale gvnvi ulisgolvdodiyi unitsati diguyvdodi.
english: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎵᎪᏃ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tseligono unanigisv unitsati yvwi gvwasdawadvsvgi.
english: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎤᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᏚᏃᎸᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎶᏒᎢ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono anitali dinigewi unohulodi dunolvgi, unadvganvno tsisa ulosvi unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Sginidoligi, Tsagvwiyuhi Dewi uwetsi.
english: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎤᏅᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Unitsatino duninetselvgi elaweyi unvdiyi.  Aseno utliquo igai unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi, Sginidoligi, Tsagvwiyuhi Dewi uwetsi.
english: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏓᏚᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᏛᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Tsisano ulewistanv widuyanvhvgi, ale hia niduweselvgi; Gado isdaduli ayv isdvyadvnediyi?
english: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ:  ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏦᏍᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᎵᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesvgi:  Tsagvwiyuhi, tsosdigadoli tsulisduisdiyi oginaduliha.
english: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏒᏁᎸᎩ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano duwedolitsv dinigadoli dusvnelvgi, gilaquono iyvdv gvwanigowadvdi nulistanvgi; ale gvwasdawadvsvgi.
english: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᏒᎦᏙᎯ, ᎣᎵᏩ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏅᏒᎩ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsilusilimi nav unilutsv, Svgadohi, Oliwa usahilvi iyvdv, Tsisa anitali gvwasdawadidohi dunvsvgi,
english: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᎢᏢ Ꮎ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏰᏍᏗᏩᏛᎯ ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎨᎵᏌᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏍᎩᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; isdena itlv na tsvdigaduha, gilaquono iyvdv dayesdiwadvhi soquilidigalianvhidv gelisadesdi, ale agina atinehesdi, desdelisadesvha, ale desginatinohelvha.
english: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏍᏙᏎᎸᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏚᎵᎭ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo gohusdi isdoselvha, hia nesdiweselvha; Ugvwiyuhi duduliha; gilaquono iyvdv dodayuyosi.
english: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎢ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi hia nigadv nulistanvgi, udohiyudiyi ayelvsvi adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
english: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏁᏥᏪᏏ ᏌᏯᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏤᎵ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᏓᏣᎷᏤᎵ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎸᏕᏍᏗ ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Hia netsiwesi Sayani uwetsi ageyv; Gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi tsatseli dayai, datsalutseli udadolisdiyu, ale ugilvdesdi soquilidigalianvhidv gohusdi advnehi uwetsi agina.
english: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unenvsvgi, Tsisa nuniweselv nasgiya winunadvnelvgi;
english: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎸᎩ; ᏗᏂᏐᎯᏱᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏢᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᎩᎸᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Soquilidigalianvhidv ale agina dunatinolvgi; dinisohiyino tsunanuwo dunitlvnvgi, ale nahna unagilvtanvgi.
english: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏰᏍᏛᏅᎩ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ ᏧᏪᏲᏔ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏂᏲᏔᏅᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Utlino iyanii yvwi tsunanuwo duniyesdvnvgi nvnohi, igadvno dunvnigalvhvgi tsuweyota detlugvi, ale nvnohi duniyotanvnvgi.
english: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎰᏌᎾ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ!  ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ!  ᎰᏌᎾ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ!
phonetic: Unitsatino igvyi anegi, ale oni anegi unelugvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; Hosana Dewi Uwetsi!  atsilvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa deudov tsigaluhisdiha!  Hosana wasdv galvladiyu!
english: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏂᎬ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ?
phonetic: Tsilusilimino ulutsv nigv gaduhv unalitelvnvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; Gago hia?
english: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino hia nuniwesvgi; Hia Tsisa adolehosgi, Naselidi ehi Gelili gaduhvi.
english: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎷᏆᏗᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano wuyvlvgi udvnadigalawiisdiyi Unelanvhi utseliga, ale dunugowisvgi nigadv aninadegi ale uniwasgi nahna digalawiisdiyi, ale duluquadinvsvgi dunisgilv adelv dininetliyvsgi, ale gule dinisgonihi dininadegi unanvdiyi.
english: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎳ; ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏚᏙᎡᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Hia nigvnvgowela; Aquatseli galitsode adadolisdodiyi galitsode dudoesdi; aseno hia aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi nitsvnelv.
english: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎨᏫᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Dinigewino ale diniyouli gvwalutselvgi digalawiisdiyi, ale dunvwanvgi.
english: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏁᎷᎬ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎰᏌᎾ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ!  ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi unadolehosv usquanigodiyu dulvwisdanehvi, ale diniyoli unelugv udvnadigalawiisdiyi hia naniwesgvi, Hosana Dewi Uwetsi!  utsati unisonvtselvgi;
english: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᎭ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎸᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣᎢ; ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎠᏂᎰᎵ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏣᏩᏛᏙᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Ale hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hadvgisgo hia tsinaniweha?  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Vv, Tlasgo hilvhiyu hia yitsigoliyeoi; Tsunasdi diniyoli ale dinisdai aniholi unugotsvhi tsawadvdotanv etsalvquododiyi?
english: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏒᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Dudanvelvgino, ale gaduhv unugotsvgi, Quediniyi wulutsvgi, ale nahna usvlvgi.
english: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏮᎠᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Sunaleno digaduhv wvagadvi agonu uyosisanvgi.
english: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᏭᎷᏨᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᎳᏍᏚᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏣᏓᏔᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ugohvno svgataiyusdi tlugv nvnohulodi, nahna wulutsvgi; aseno vtla gohusdi yuwadvhei, ulasdusv uwasv; hiano nuweselvgi; Tlesdi ilvhiyu gohi iyudalenvdv yitsadatanesdi.  Gilaquono iyvdv svgataiyusdi tlugv uwayvsvgi.
english: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏞᎬᏉ ᎬᏴᎯ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ!
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unigohv unisquanigosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Natlegvquo gvyvhi svgataiyusdi tlugvi!
english: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏥᎾᎬᎦ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᏚᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; iyuno yitsohiyuha, ale nitsadlasidvehvna yigi, vtla hiaquo svgataiyusdi tlugv tsinagvga yinvgetsadvga, nasquosgini hia yinitsiweselv hia tsodalv, Hadanvna, ale amequohi wetsaduga, ase nasgi iyulisdodi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigavno gohusdi itsitayohihesdi, itsadadolisdisgvi, itsohiyuhvsgesdi, itsiwatisgesdi.
english: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᎾᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏣᏁᏤᎸᎯ?
phonetic: Udvnano digalawiisdiyi ulutsv, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi yvwi anehv gvwalutselvgi dadeyohvsgvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Gado tsalisgasdodi hia nasgi tsidetsalvwisdaneha?  Ale gago tsanetselvhi?
english: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏍᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; ayv nasgi sudalegi datsvyadvdvni, iyuno nasgi isginonelv nasgi ayv datsvnoneli iyusdi aqualisgasdodvi, hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ ᎭᏢ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ? ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎪ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ?  ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?  ᏲᎪᏏ.
phonetic: Tsani tsidadawosgvgi hatlv tsudalenei? Galvladisgo, yvwiquoge anehv tsudalenei?  Elaweyino unadanvtelvgi, hia naniwesgvgi; iyuno galvladi, yogadvnv, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?  Yogosi.
english: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᏙᏥᏍᎦᎢᎭᏉ ᏴᏫ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Iyuno yvwiquo anehv tsudalenei yogadvnv, dotsisgaihaquo yvwi; nigadvyeno adolehosgi uniyelvha Tsani.
english: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸ ᏥᏌ; ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᎨᏨᏃᎲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Uninetsvno hia nvgvwaweselv Tsisa; Vtla yotsigataha.  Hiano niduweselvgi; Vtla nasquo ayv yvgetsvnohvsi iyusdi aqualisgasdodvi hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
english: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎮᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏫᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᎩᏫᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno gado itseliha?  Gilo asgaya anitali tsuwetsi anisgaya anehei; asiyvwino igvyi wulutselv, hia nuweselei; Aquetsi, hena gohi widitsalvwisdasi telvladi dagiwisvi.
english: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᏨᏃ, ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunetsvno, vtla, udvnei; aseno oni unetliyvse udanvdvi, ale uwenvsei.
english: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎢᏃ ᏭᎷᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ.  ᏧᏁᏨᏃ, ᏓᎨᏏ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏪᏅᏒᎾᏉ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Soino wulutselv nasgiya nuweselei.  Tsunetsvno, dagesi, udvnei; aseno nuwenvsvnaquo igesei.
english: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ?  ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎭ ᏕᎨᏥᎪᏂᎭ.
phonetic: Gago hia anitali udoda unetsv nudvnelei?  Igvyi wulutselvhi, vgvwoselvgi.  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, adelv anigisidohi ale tsunatsesati anigeyv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv waniyvhiha degetsigoniha.
english: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ ᏥᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏂ ᏱᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno duyugodv dulvwisdanehv itsilutselvgi, ale vtla yetsoiyunei, adelvsgini anigisidohi ale anigeyv tsunatsesati tsigvwohiyunvgi; nihino itsadolehosv vtla oni yiditsinetliyvse detsadanvdv etsoiyudiyi.
english: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ; ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏐᏲᎴ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎮ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎢᏅᏃ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadale datlilosdv itsadvgvga; Ehe gilo asgaya ganela, nasgi telvladi duwisei, ale usoyole gvwaduwidv, ale usgose gigageaditasdi gotlvdiyi, ale unesgehe inv igati, ale dudolastane tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, invno wulosei.
english: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᏚᏂᏁᏒᏎ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono navniyu gese unvnisdiyi dunvse tsunvsidasdi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, duninesvse unadadvnvhi.
english: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏠᎨᏏᏃ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎸᏂᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏅᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Tlogesino tsunilvwisdanehi duniniyvhe tsunvsidasdi, asiyvwi unilvnilei, soino unilei, soino nvya dunvnistanei.
english: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏃ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno dunvse nvwanadale tsunvsidasdi utli iyanii; nasgiyaquono nidunvnelei.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏇᏥ.
phonetic: Oniyino uwetsi unvsei, hia nuwesei; Ase dvnilvquotani aquetsi.
english: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ; Ꭷ ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏗᏬᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unigohv uwetsi hia nidunadaweselei; Nasgi hia utseli iyulisdodi; ka ediluga, ale ediwonv utseli iyulisdodi tsigi.
english: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Uniniyvheno, ale uninugowise telvladi dawisvi, ale unilei.
english: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ?
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi telvladi dawisv utseliga galutsvha, gado dodagvneli na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi?
english: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᏙᏛᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏙᏛᏙᎳᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᎫᏴᏗ ᎾᏅᎾᏏᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; uyoiyu nidodagvneli dodvli nasgi na uniyoi, ale nvwanadale tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dodvdolastani, nasgi yeli gvwanaguyvdi nanvnasisvi.
english: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎠᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏅᏯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; tlasgo ilvhiyu yitsigoliyeo hia tsinigvnv tsigowela?  Ananesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nvya nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv; nasgi hia Yihowa nudvnelv, ale usquanigodiyu dedakanisgvi.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏓᏰᏥᎩᏒᎵ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏓᎨᏥᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha; Unelanvhi utseligohi dayetsigisvli, nvwanadaleno dagetsineli, nasgi yeli gvwaninanugowisdi udatanvhi.
english: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏢᏨᎭ ᏓᏳᏐᏅᏂ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏐᏅᎭ ᏓᏳᏪᏓᏬᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Gilono ani nvyohi atlvtsvha dayusonvni, gilono usonvha dayuwedawotani.
english: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniqualisi unadvganv datlilosdisgvi, unadolehosvgi unvsv getsidvgvi.
english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᏍᎦᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Uniniyvdiyino unadanvtelv, unitsati yvwi dunisgalvgi, nasgiyeno adolehosgi gvwayelvsvgi.
english: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv taline dutlilosdanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
english: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏫᏅ,
phonetic: Galvladi utseligohi nasgiyaquo gilo ugvwiyuhi tsudvnvistane tsagatsvsdodiyi uwetsi awinv,
english: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏯᏅᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎤᏂᏳᎸᏁᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale tsidunvse tsunvsidasdi tsuniyanvhvsdiyi wigetsiyanvdv degegatsvsdisgv uniluhisdiyi; aseno diuniyulvnequo nvdayunenvsdiyi.
english: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏗᏥᏪᏏ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏚᏂᎸ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᏅᎯ; ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno nvwanadale tsunvsidasdi dunvsei, hia niduweselei; Hia winiditsiwesi wigetsiyanvdv; Gvniyuquo aquadvnvisdi alisdayvdi, diquatseli waga ale digalitsotanvhi dunilv, nigadiyuno advnvistanonvhi; degegatsvsdisgv itsilugi.
english: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᏗᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏧᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎤᏃᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno nvlisaliquo diuniyelvnei, ale utsatiniquo wunilosei, asiyvwi tsulogesvi, soino unododiyi.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Anisoino duniniyvhe tsunvsidasdi, ale digvwanisotlvtanei, ale dunilei.
english: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏂᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ugvwiyuhi udvganv utalawosei, ale dunvse tsutseli aniyawisgi, ale widunile nasgi tsunadalvhi, ale wunagohvstane uniduhvi.
english: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎾᏃᏎ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduwesele tsunvsidasdi; digegatsvsdodiyi advnvisdi, aseno wigetsiyanvdv vtla yeli yinanose uniluhisyi.
english: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏅᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏕᏥᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂ ᏙᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏔᏂᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi deganvhnawadisv witsilohi, nanivno detsiwatisgesdi detsinetsehesdi uniluhisdiyi ani dodigegatsvstanisvi.
english: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏅᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏟᏌᏁ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎲ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏙᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏔᏂᏒ ᏰᎵ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Howano nasgi tsunvsidasdi deganvhnawadisv wunilosei, ale unitlisane naniv duniwadvhv uniyo ale anosdv; hnaquono dodigegatsvstanisv yeli nulistanile analisdayvhvsgi.
english: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏴᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎦᏔᏂᎸ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᎪᎮ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏄᏄᏩᎥᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏄᏬᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono uyvlv ugvwiyuhi dugatanilv analisdayvhvsgi, ugohe nahna asiyvwi nunuwavna gese degegatsvsdisgv anuwosdi.
english: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎥᎯᏴᎵᎦ ᏂᏣᏄᏩᎥᎾ ᎢᎩ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏄᏬᏍᏗ?  ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Ginalii, gadono ani vhiyvliga nitsanuwavna igi degegatsvsdisgv anuwosdi?  Elaweyiquono gesei.
english: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎡᏣᎸᏣ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎾᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᎵᏏᎬ ᏪᏣᏓᎤᎦ.  ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ugvwiyuhi hia niduwesele getsinvsidasdi; Etsalvtsa tsuwoyeni ale tsulasideni; ale etsinawidv, ale vdoyiditlv tsulisigv wetsadauga.  Nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎩᏲᎵᏳ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ.
phonetic: Unitsatiyeno getsiyanvdv, aseno anigiyoliyu gegasuyedv.
english: For many are called, but few are chosen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏌᏛᏗᏱ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Aniqualisi unenvsvgi wuninohelvgi iyunadvnediyi unisadvdiyi gawonisgvi.
english: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᏤᏙᎲ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎩᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏘᎾᏰᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᏉ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏘᎸᏉᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Duninvsvgino tsedohv gvwanisdawadidohi ale Elodv gvwasdelisgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, otsigataha udohiyugiya gesv nihi, ale Unelanvhi utseliga duyugodv dehadeyohvsgvi, vtla ale yvwi yitinayesga, vtlayeno nunasdvquo yvwi yitilvquodoi.
english: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎦᏙ ᎮᎵᎭ?  ᏥᏌ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᏏᏌ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏝᎨ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi sginohvsi, Gado heliha?  Tsisa duyugodi Sisa aguyvediyi ayeli aguyvdi gesvi; tlage?
english: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᏉ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᏌᏛᎥᏍᎦ, ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa udolehosvgi uyoquo anadanvtesgvi, ale hia niduweselvgi; Gadono isgisadvvsga, itsatlonasdi?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ.  ᎠᎩᏏᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎬᏩᏲᎮᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsigowadv adelv ayeli aguyvdodi.  Agisino tsugvwalodi gvwayohelvgi.
english: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?
phonetic: Hiano niduwehalvgi; Gago hia dagatlilosdi, ale Gago atsinoheha hia tsigowela?
english: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏏᏌ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏏᏌ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᏥᎲᏏ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Sisa, unadvnvgi.  Hiano niduweselvgi; Sisa adina etsihvsi Sisa utseliga, Unelanvhino Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Unadvganvno unisquanigosvgi, ale unadanvelvgi.
english: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Nahiyu iga Anisadusi dilehisodi gesv unadlasidvehi gvwalutselvgi, ale gvwadvdvnvgi,
english: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, Mosi unetse hia nuwesei; Iyuno asgaya ayohusgesdi tsuwetsi nanehvna gesesdi, dinadanvtli adayegesdi udayvdv, nasgino dadvhisdanehesdi diniyoli dinadanvtli.
english: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏤᎲ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ; ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏕᏒᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᏉ, ᏧᏪᏥᏃ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏪᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Nasgino ayv otsehv anehvgi galiquogi iyanidv anadanvtli; udaniligeno udesvnv uyohusvquo, tsuwetsino nanehvna gesv iyusdi udalii uwegodanelv unvtli.
english: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁᎢ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᏫᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo talinei, ale tsoinei, galiquogine wigvdisgi.
english: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino ageyv nasquo uyohusvgi.
english: And last of all the woman died also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo tsuniyohusvhi danalehisanvha, gago udalii gesesdi nasgi galiquogi iyanidv gesvi?
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Itsilidasdiha nitsigatavna gesv iyusdi nusdv gowelvi, ale nulinigvgv Unelanvhi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ; ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Tsuniyohusvhiyeno danalehisanvha, vtla yidanadesvhvsgoi, vtla ale yidigetsiyegoi; dinikahnawadidohisgini galvladi anehi Unelanvhi tsutseli nasgiya gesoi.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ?
phonetic: Tsuniyohusvhisgininonv unalehisodi gesv tsitsineisdiha, tlasgo yitsigoliyeo Unelanvhi itsinetselvhi, hia tsinigaweha?
english: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Ayv Unelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga.  Vtla Unelanvhi tsuniyohusvhi unatseli yigi, dinvnodvquosgini unvsv.
english: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino unadvganv unisquanigosvgi nusdv dadeyohvsgvi.
english: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᏚᏩᏅ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Aniqualisisgini unadvganv elaweyi duwanv Anisadusi, nasgi dunilawitsvgi.
english: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ, ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎤᏌᏛᎥᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Asiyvwino nahna udasuyvgi dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi, udvdvnvgi usadvvsgvi, hia nuwesvgi;
english: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Tadeyohvsgi, gado usdi utli galvquodiyu ulinetsv dikahnawadvsdi?
english: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Yihowa Tsanelanvhi higeyusesdi nigav tsanawi hvdisgesdi, ale nigav tsadanvdo, ale nigav tsadanvtediyi.
english: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia igvyiyi ale utsati galvquodi dikahnawadvsdi.
english: This is the first and great commandment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ; ᏨᏒ ᏥᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Talineno nasgiyaquo nasquo; tsvsv tsinitsadageyusv nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.
english: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎵᏁᏨ ᏚᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia tali nulinetsv dulisdayidisdi nigadiyu dikahnawadvsdi ale unadolehosvi.
english: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Asiquo danilawiv Aniqualisi, Tsisa dudvdvnvgi,
english: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵ ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᏕᏫ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; Gado itseli etsadanvtesgv Galonedv, Gago uwetsi?  Dewi, vgvwoselvgi.
english: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏕᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎪᏎᎭ?  ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ;
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; Gadono digalisdodiha, Dewi adanvdo uweyohvsgvi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tsigoseha?  Hia tsinigaweha;
english: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ;
phonetic: Yihowa hia nuweselvgi Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga; Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi, gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha;
english: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏕᏫ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏱᎪᏎᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno Dewi, Tsagvwiyuhi, yigoseha, Gado yigalisdoda uwetsi yigi?
english: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮭ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᏍᎦᏁᏨᎯ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; Ꮭ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tla hnaquo yeli gilo sganetsvhi gvwanetsedi yigesei; tla ale gilo nahiyu iyudalenvdv yeli gagvwadvdvdi yigesei.
english: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa duwonetanvgi unitsati ale gvwasdawadidohi,
english: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏂᎾ;
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi Mosi uwesgilv anina;
english: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏚᎦ ᎨᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏂᏁᎪᏰᏃ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hiyusdi nigav gohusdi ditsikahnawaduga getsosehesdi detsikahnawadegesdi ale nasgi nitsadvnehesdi; aseno nasgi nanadvnehvi tlesdi yinitsadvnehesdi; aninegoyeno aseno vtla nasgi yinanadvnehoi.
english: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎾᏓᎵᏢᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏛ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏃᎭᏝᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏂᏰᏌᏛ ᏴᎬᏅᏓ ᏱᏙᎬᏂᏖᎸᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Danadalitlvsgoyeno digagedv dilisvsdi ale udeyadodi dilisvsdiyi, nasgino yvwi daninohatlahvsgoi; aseno unvsv vtla saquo aniyesadv yvgvnvda yidogvnitelvhvga.
english: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏐᎢ.  ᏗᏯᏖᎾ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎰ ᏧᎾᎬᏓᏃᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏯᏛᎥᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ;
phonetic: Nigadiyusgini dunilvwisdanehv yvwiquo gvwanigowadvdiyi uniyelvsoi.  Diyatena nidanvneho tsunagvdanosdi, ale daniyadvvsdisgo degadaluyadv tsunanuwo;
english: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Ale unilvquodo nugvwiyusv tsunanitlvdiyi danalisdayvhvsgvi, ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi,
english: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏩᏃᏎᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Ale getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi, ale Tadeyohvsgi, Tadeyohvsgi, gvwanosediyi yvwi.
english: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟᏉ.
phonetic: Nihisgini tlesdi Tadeyohvsgi, yetsosehesdi; asiyvwiyeno Ditseyohvsgi, nasgi Galonedv; nigadvno nihi itsalinvtliquo.
english: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏦᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi gilo edoda etsoselvgi ani elohi; asiyvwiquoyeno Itsidoda, nasgi galvladi tsvtseha.
english: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi Squatinidohi yetsosehesdi nihi, asiyvwiquoyeno Ditsatinidohi, nasgi Galonedv.
english: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilosgini utli atsilvquodiyu gesesdi nihi itsehvi, nasgi etsinvsidasdi gesesdi.
english: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎢᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilono uwasvquo iadasaladisgesdi eladi iyagvnedi gesesdi; gilono uwasvquo eladi nadadvnehesdi atsisaladodi gesesdi.
english: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏁᎰᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏥᏴᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᏂᏴᎭ ᏱᏗᏤᎵᏎᎰ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎯ.
phonetic: Nihisgini uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsisdunehoyeno yvwi galvladi utseligohi; vtlayeno itsvsv yitsiyvhihoi, ale vtla unanelagi waniyvha yiditseliseho waniyvhihi.
english: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏕᏥᏒᏁᎰᏰᏃ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsisvnehoyeno tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale itsatlonasdv gohidiyu itsadadolisdisgoi.  Nasgi iyusdi utlihiyu igai itsigiliyoisdi gesesdi.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏕᏣᏕᏲᎰᏰᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎡᏥᏲᎰ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏨᎦ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏁᏨᏁᎰ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsadeyohoyeno amequohi ale gadohi etsiyoho asiyvwi nusdv itsohiyusv gohiyuhvsgi iyetsvnediyi, ale nasgi netsvga tali iyuwagudi utli tsvsginoi uwetsi netsvneho esgaquo itsvsv.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ!  ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎤᏚᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi, ditsigewi ditsadatinidohi!  hia itsiwesgi; Gilo iaselidvsgesdi ikaneisdisgesdi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, asequoquo nasgi; gilosgini ikaneisdisgesdi adelv dalonige udvnadigalawiisdiyi ahvi, nasgi asdayiyu ududala.
english: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ!  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎪ ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ, ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ?
phonetic: Itsinegu ale ditsigewi!  gado usdi utli galvquodiyu, adelvsgo dalonigei, udvnadigalawiisdiyige nasgi galvquodiyu tsinigvneha adelv dalonigei?
english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎤᏚᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Ale, gilo ikaneisdisgesdi atsilvgelasdiyi, asequoquo nasgi; gilosgini ikaneisdisgesdi alisgolvtanvhi nahna ahvi, nasgi asdayiyu ududala.
english: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ!  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯᏍᎪ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Itsinegu ale ditsigewi!  gado usdi utli galvquodiyu, alisgolvtanvhisgo, atsilvgegelasdiyi, nasgi galvquodiyu tsinigvneha alisgolvtanvhi?
english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo iaselidvsgesdi ikaneisdisgesdi atsilvgelasdiyi, kaneisdisgesdi nasgi ale nigav gohusdi nahna ahvi.
english: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏁᎳ.
phonetic: Ale gilo ikaneisdisgesdi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, kaneisdisgesdi nasgi ale nahna ganela.
english: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏬᎵ.
phonetic: Ale gilo ikaneisdisgesdi galvladi, kaneisdisgesdi Unelanvhi uwediyi ale nahna uwoli.
english: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎪ ᏒᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎻᏂ; ᏕᏥᏃᎯᏯᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏛᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᏂᏥᏃᎯᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  asgohineyeno itsaguyisgo svtli ale esv ale gamini; detsinohiyasgono utli ulisgedvya gesv dikahnawadvsdi, duyugodv gesvi, ale adadolisdiyi, ale gohiyudiyi.  Nasgisgini hia yinitsadvnelei, ale soi nitsinohiyvnaquo yigesei.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ!  ᏙᏒ ᎢᏥᎿᎭᏐᎸᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᎻᎵᏃ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ditsigewi ditsadatinidohi!  dosv itsihnasolvsdisgi gemilino itsigisgi.
english: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᎢᏦᏑᎴᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  itsosulesgoyeno gaduiditlv ulisquidi ale atelido, aseno awiniditlv ukalitsvhi geso asequo adagiedi gesvi ale duyugodv nigesvna.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏆᎵᏏ ᏘᎨᏫ!  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᏅᎦᎸ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ, ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiqualisi tigewi!  igvyi hinvgalv awiniditlv ulisquidi ale atelido, gaduiditlvno nasquo tsudanvgalvdv gesesdi.
english: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏧᏁᎬ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏧᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᏂᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  nasgiyaquoyeno nihi tsunegv idigvnelvhi datselisdvi, nasgi gaduiditlv udohiyuhi tsuwoduhiyu tsigesoi, aseno awiniditlv tsukalitsvhi tsigeso tsuniyohusvhi tsunigola ale nigav gadaha gesvi
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎨᏣᎧᏃᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyaquosgini nasquo nihi gaduiditlv itsadanvtiyu nvwasdoi yvwi digetsakanodiyi, aseno awiniditlv itsikalitsvhi geso itsatlonasdvi ale uyoi.
english: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏕᎦᏂᏌᎲ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏦᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi ale Itsiqualisi itsatlonasdi!  detsotlvhisisgoyeno deganisahv anadolehosgi, ale detsoduisdisgo datselisdv unadanvti;
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏲᏤᎮ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏦᎩᏙᏓ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏲᏣᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏚᎾᏤᏪᎸ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nitsiwesgoi; Iyuno ayv yotsehe nahiyu tsogidoda tsanehei, vtla yidogayotsaligonele gigv dunatsewelv anadolehosgi.
english: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᏛᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvsv gvnigesv nitsadadvne nasgi ditsidoda gesv anadolehosgi tsunilvhi.
english: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏣᎪᎦ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Itsikalitsagoga ditsidoda unatlilovi.
english: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎾᏛ ᏂᎯ!  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ!  ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏰᏣᏗᏫᏏ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ?
phonetic: Inadv nihi!  unisgasedi inadv tsunetsi nihi!  gadono yigalisdoda yetsadiwisi agiliyoisdi digesv tsvsginoi?
english: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏕᏥᏅᎵ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏤᎲ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏙᏓᏥᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏣᏛᏂ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏙᏓᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ ᏗᏥᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏙᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᏕᎦᏚᎿᎭᎥᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gvniyuquo detsinvli nahna ditsehv anadolehosgi ale anigatahnai ale dinowelisgi; igadvno dodatsili ale dodatsadvni dadahnawasdvi, igadvno dodatsilivnili ditsilawiisdiyi, ale uyo nidodatsvneli degaduhnavi;
english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏇᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏅᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎸ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏃ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsilutsediyi nigadv osdv gigv elohi utsewotsvhi, udanvti Equili ugigv nvdagvwadalenvdv, Tsegalaya ugigv Queligaya uwetsi nvdvsdi, nasgi tsetsilv udlanvdv udvnadigalawiisdiyi atsilvnogelasdiyi.
english: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᎾᎵᏱᎶᎮᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; hia nasgi nigadv dayunaliyiloheli hia gohi tsaneha.
english: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏘᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏅᏯ ᏛᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ!  ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏯᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏥᏕᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏛ ᏗᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimi!  Tsilusilimi!  anadolehosgi tihihi, ale getsalutsediyi getsinvsvhi nvya dvnisdisgi!  yanogiyu aquadulisgv gatsiyatlisodiyi ditsetsi, nasgiya tsataga tsidegatlisisgo tsuwetsi anidv dikanogeni hawiniditlv; aseno vtla yitsadulisgei.
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏅᏔ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo itsatseli galitsode nvta netsvnelv.
english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ; ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha; vtla yvgesgigowadv gohi iyudalenvdv, gvni hia nitsiwesvha; Atsilvquodiyu nasgi Yihowa deudov tsigaluhisdiha.
english: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏂᏚᏍᏛ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano unugotsvgi digalawiisdiyi udanvsvgi, gvwasdawadidohino gvwalutselv gvwanonelvgi nidusdv dadanelv udvnadigalawiisdiyi.
english: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏗᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏂ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Tlasgo nigadv hia yiditsigowatiha?  Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; vtla saquounv nvya ani yidudasatlahesdi nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
english: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎵᏩᏲᏃ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᎯᎳᎪ ᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Oliwayono usahilv uwolvi gvwasdawadidohi unvsv gesv gvwalutselvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Sginohvsi hilago iyu hia nasgi nvdagalistani; ale gado usdi uyelvdv gesesdi tsaluhisdiyi, ale gohi gesv ulisquadisdiyi?
english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎶᏄᎮᎵ;
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Itseyatahesdi tlesdi gilo tsitsilonuheli;
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏓᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadov aniluhisdisgesdi, ayv Galonedv, anadisgesdi; ale unitsadasdi danilonuhesgesdi.
english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲ ᏓᎿᎭᏯ; ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale itsadvgisgesdi dahnawa ale aninohelidohv dahnaya; itseyatahesdi tlesdi uwelihisdi yinitsalisdanelesdi; nasgiyeno nigadiyu ase iyulisdodi, aseno ulisquadisdiyi gesv asi gesesdi.
english: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏚᏃᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli dunotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani, ale dagonulosidohesdi, ale vyugihiyu nigalistanidohesdi, ale gadohi dalitelvnidohesdi.
english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nigadv alenisgv gesv agiliya gesvi.
english: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏫᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᏏ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nihi widodagetsiyosi itsigiliyoisdiyi, ale dodagetsili; ale nigadiyu nunadalesv yvwi getsisgagesdi ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏚᏃᏕᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unitsatesdi dunodehihesdi, ale danadatludisgesdi ale danadasgagesdi.
english: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale unitsatesdi unatlonasdi anadolehosgi aninanugogesdi, ale unitsatesdi danilonuhesgesdi.
english: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎲ ᏛᏴᏜᏓᏗ.
phonetic: Ale utsadv asganvisdi gesv ehv nasgi iyusdi unitsatesdi adageyudi gesv unehv dvyvdladi.
english: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi na gvlisquadisgi atlinigvnehi nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏛᎵᏍᏆᏗᎵ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi osdv kanohedv galvladi utseligohi elanigv unalitsidoninidasdi gesesdi unadolehohisdiyi naniv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, gilano hnaquo dvlisquadili.
english: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᎲᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᎬᏃᏌᏛᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏂᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, (ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᎨᏍᏗ,)
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo itsigohvha usgaisdiyu gvnosadvhi igvnehi, nasgi Denili adolehosgi tsuneistanei, gadogesdi galvquodiyu gesvi, (gilo agoliyesgesdi goligesdi,)
english: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᏙᏦᏓᎸ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquo Tsudiyi anini analisvha dotsodalv wanilosvha.
english: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏠᎠᏎᏍᏗ ᏳᎩᏐᎴᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Gilono gasanali ugilesdi tlesdi yvdiutloasesdi yugisolesdi gohusdi uhv ganelvi;
english: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏪᏙᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᏄᏬ ᏱᏚᏁᏐᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo tlogesi wedohi tlesdi yvdiutsvsesdi tsunuwo yidunesolesdi.
english: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi dininelidv ale tsunisdai nahiyu gesvi.
english: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale itsadadolisdisgesdi itsitayohihesdi gola ale unadodaquasgv itsalisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno utsatesdi agiliya, nasgi igai vtla ilvhiyu yinulistano elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti, vtla ale ilvhiyu nasgi iyulisdodi yigesesdi.
english: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏓᏍᏆᎳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏗᏍᏆᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ
phonetic: Ale nahiyu iga nidasqualanvna yigi, vtla uquedali gayetsisdelvdi yigagi; aseno gegasuyedv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi nahiyu iga disqualodi gesesdi
english: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏙᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᏂ
phonetic: Nahiyu gesv iyuno gilo hia nitsiwesehesdi, Gvniyuquo ani Galonedv edoha; ale ani; tlesdi tsitsohiyuni
english: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏱᏓᏂᎶᏄᎲᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ.
phonetic: Dvninanugotsiyeno unatlonasdi Galonedv ale unatlonasdi anadolehosgi, ale aninanugowisgesdi galvquodiyu uyelvdv ale usquanigodi; nasgi iyusdi iyuno yeli igvwalisdodi yigi yidanilonuhvli nasquo gegasuyedv.
english: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo nitsvnonelv.
english: Behold, I have told you before.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᏙᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏥᎶᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎠᏯᎠ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno hia nigetsiweselvha; Inage edoha; tlesdi nahna witsilosvgi; gvniyuquo udelisv kanvsulv ayaa; tlesdi tsitsohiyuni.
english: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᏨᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᎪᎢ, ᏭᏕᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏥᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Anagalisgiyeno dikalvgv tsvdigananugogoi, wudeligvno iyvdv tsiwidigalvsadadisgoi, nasgiya nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsilvha.
english: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎦᏃᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏬᎭᎵ ᎠᎾᏓᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvyeno gohusdi uliwotsvhi tsiganoi, nahna awohali anadatlisisgoi.
english: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏓᏉ ᎣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ, ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᏛᎵᏏᎲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎦ ᏳᏘᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏛᏂᏅᎪᎠᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
phonetic: Igvwenvdaquo oni nasgi nahiyu agiliya galosonvha, nvdo iga ehi dvlisihvsi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi vtla iga yutisdesdi, ale noquisi dvninvgoasi, ale unitsati galvloi tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
english: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono galvloi dagananugotsi yvwi uwetsi utseli uyelvdvi, ale hnaquo nigadv danilasdalv elohi dodvniyvlasi, ale dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi, ulinigidiyu gesv ale utsati galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi.
english: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏛᏂᏤᎷᎯᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᏟᏌᏂ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏙᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ, ᎦᎸᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dodaganvsi tsunvsidasdi, ale asdayiyu dvnitseluhisi, ale dodvnitlisani gegasuyedv nvgi nidodigalosgv unole, galvlo iyvdv widulistinilv.
english: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏗᏓᎨ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᎢ ᏥᎦᎳᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎪᎩ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ka, itsadeloqua datlilosdv svgataiyusdi tlugvi; Iyuyeno duwanigalv didage nidegalisda, ale gilai tsigalasduhvsgoi, itsigataho gogi navniyu gesvi.
english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎲᎭ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyasgini nasquo nihi, iyuno hnaquo hia nasgi tsudalenvdv itsigohvha, itsigatahesdi esganiyu gesvi, galohisdiyiquo gesvi.
english: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Hia gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni, gvni nigadv hia tsudalenvdv nigalistanvha.
english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
phonetic: Galvlo ale elohi dodagalosoni, ayvsgini aginetsvi vtla yvdagalosoni.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, Ꮭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ.
phonetic: Aseno nahiyu iga gesv ale iyutlilodv kalawadisv vtla gilo yagataha, tla nasquo dinikahnawadidohi galvladi anehi, Edodasgini uwasvhiyu.
english: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏃᏯ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno tsinusde nahiyu Noya tsehei, nasgiya nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha.
english: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᎡᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎦᏃᎱᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏃᏯ ᎤᏣᏅ ᏥᏳᎯ,
phonetic: Nahiyueno asi niganohugisgvna tsigesei, danalisdayvhvsgei, ale danaditasgei, ale danadesvhvsgei ale degetsiyegei, gvni nahiyu iga Noya utsanv tsiyuhi,
english: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏂᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎬᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
