phonetic: Ale nanelisgvna tsigesei, gvni unohuganilv, ale nigadv dunigvtsv, nasgiyaquosgini nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha.
english: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Hnaquono anitali tlogesi anedohesdi, asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi;
english: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩᏱ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anitali anigeyv anisdosgesdi asdosgiyi, asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
english: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, vtlayeno yitsigataha iyuquo uluhisdiyi itsatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏱᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏳᏯᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᎩᏴᏏ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏱᎬᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano itsanvtesdi, iyuno asgaya ganela yiagatahe iyuquo ganosgisgi uluhisdiyi, yuyawisei, ale vtla unelagi wagiyvsi galitsode yigvwelisei.
english: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾᏉᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi nasquo itsadvnvisdesdi, nitselisgvnaquoyeno gesv iyu yvwi uwetsi dagalutsi.
english: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᎨᏃ ᎠᎦᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gagogeno agaliya ale asinasani atsinvsidasdi, nasgi unvsidohi nugvwiyusv iyuwanelvhi ganelv dudatihnavi, nasgi unalisdayvdi tsunediyi unalisdayvdiyi nigalistanisvi?
english: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi galutsvha uwadvhvha nasgi nadvnehvi.
english: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ ᏛᎦᏘᏗᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigadv uhnavi dvgatidistani.
english: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎯᏗᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Iyusginino nasgi na unegutsidv atsinvsidasdi hia nigawesgesdi tsudanvdvi; Aginvsidohi gohidiha uluhisdiyi;
english: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᎦᎸᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Ale alenisgesdi dogalvnihesdi itsulaha getsinvsidasdi, ale itsulaha analisdayvhvsgesdi ale danaditasgesdi tsuniyvsdesgi,
english: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏓᎦᏖᏃᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi dagalutsi nahiyu iga nadagatenohvna gesvi, ale iyu nelisgvna gesvi,
english: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏳᎦᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏩᏁᎲ ᏮᏓᏳᏎᎮᎵ; ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dodayugalisi, ale unatlonasdi wanehv wvdayuseheli; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᎾᏠᏒᏎ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiya gesesdi asgohi iyanidv anadv, nasgi tsiduninvse ditsvsdodi ale tsidunatlosvse adesvhvsgi.
english: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ.
phonetic: Hisgino iyanidv anigatahnai gesei, hisgino uninegu.
english: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎢ ᏄᏂᏁᏨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Uninegu duninvse ditsvsdodi aseno goi nuninetsvsvna gesei,
english: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏧᏂᏨᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏎ ᏚᏂᏟᏍᏔᏁ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ.
phonetic: Anigatahnaisgini duninvse tsunitsvsdodi, ale nasquo goi uninetsvse dunitlistane ditelido.
english: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏃ ᎤᎪᏂᏲᎨ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎵᏅᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Asino ugoniyoge adesvhvsgi, nigadv anilinvgei, ale unilinvtsei.
english: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏒᏃᏱᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᏓᏯᎢ!  ᏫᏕᏣᏠᎢ!
phonetic: Svnoyino ayeli gilo asdaya unetsei, hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo adesvhvsgi dayai!  widetsatloi!
english: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎤᎾᏗᏓᏁᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏥᏃᏍᎦᎸᎮ ᏚᏂᏨᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv anadv unadidanesei, ale dunitsinosgalvhe dunitsvsdvi.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᎪᎢ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏍᎩᏁᎥᏏ, ᏙᎬᏠᎯᏎᎭᏰᏃ ᏙᎩᏨᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Unineguno hia niduniwesele anigatahnai; Igadv goi itsatseli sginevsi, dogvtlohisehayeno dogitsvsdvi.
english: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᎨ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏙᎨᎩᏰᎵᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᎢᏤᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᏃᏗᏍᎬ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏫᏥᏩᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno anigatahnai uninetsv hia nuniwesei; Tlage yeli yidogegiyeliga nigadv, itsenaquosgini dininodisgv, itsvsv witsiwahi.
english: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏩᏎᏅᏃ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᏁ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uniwasenvno adesvhvsgi ulutsei, unadvnvisdino nasgi itsulaha tsagatsvsdodiyi wuniyvlei, ale unisdune galohisdiyi.
english: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᏍᎩᏍᏚᎩ.
phonetic: Onino nasquo anisoi anadv unilutsei, hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, esgisdugi.
english: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno tsunetsv hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, vtla yitsvgataha.
english: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, vtlayeno yitsigataha nahiyu iga gesv ale iyutlilodv kalawadisv uluhisdiyi yvwi Uwetsi.
english: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏅᏥᏮᏗᎦᎶᏏᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyaquoyeno gilo asgaya invtsiwvdigalosisei, ale tsiwiduyanvhe tsunvsidasdi, ale tsiduyohisele uhnavi.
english: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ, ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino hisgi iyagayvli adelv dunelei, soino tali iyagayvli, soino saquo iyagayvli, anisiyvwiha nasgi yeli igvwanadvnedi gesvi.  Hnaquono unigisei.
english: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏭᏃᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hisgi iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvse wunotanei, hisgino iyagayvli unequotselei.
english: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquo ale na tali iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi nasquo tali iyagayvli unequotselei.
english: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏭᏍᎪᎭ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏩᏍᎦᎳᏁ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Saquosgini iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvsei, wusgoha gadohi, ale widuwasgalane unatlai tsutseli adelv.
english: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhiyuno iyvdv ulutse nasgi getsinvsidasdi uninatlai, osdvno nunvnelei.
english: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏲᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏕᏴᎵ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Hisgino iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsei, ale duyole nvwanadale hisgi iyagayvli adelv, hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, hisgi iyagayvli adelv desgiyohiselvgi; gvniyuquo nvwanadale hisgi iyadeyvli gvginequotselv.
english: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ!  ᎰᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᎵᏯ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ!  ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ; ᎯᏴᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Unatlaino hia nuweselei; Osiyu!  hosdv ale higaliya etsanvsidasdi!  duyugodv nitsadvnelv usdi tsudalenvdv detsalvwisdanelvi; utsati tsudalenvdv tsagvwiyusadegi nvdagvyvneli; hiyvha osdv adanvdadisdiyi tsanatlai utseligohi.
english: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Nasquono tali iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsv hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, tali iyagayvli adelv desgiyohiselvgi; gvniyuquo nvwanadale tali iyagayvli gvginequotselv.
english: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ!  ᎰᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᎵᏯ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ!  ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ; ᎯᏴᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Unatlai hia nuweselei; Osiyu!  hosdv ale higaliya etsanvsidasdi!  duyugodv nitsadvnelv usdi tsudalenvdv detsalvwisdanelvi; utsati tsudalenvdv tsagvwiyusadegi nvdagvyvneli; hiyvha osdv adanvdadisdiyi tsanatlai utseligohi.
english: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎬᎦᏔᎲᎩ, ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏣᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎱᏖᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏣᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono saquo iyagayvli tsatsinelvhi ulutsv hia nuwesei; Sginatlai, gvgatahvgi, hisdayiyu gesvi, ale hisgudesgvi nahna nitsawisvna gesvi, ale hutesgvi nahna nitsaleladvnvna gesvi.
english: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ, ᏫᏓᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale tsisgaihvi aquenvsvgi, widagvsgalanvgi gadohi adelv ditsatseliga; gvniyuquo ani nasgi ditsatseliga.
english: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ!  ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎩᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎩᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ!
phonetic: Unatlaino unetsv hia nuweselei; Tsanegutsidv ale tsadanulvdi etsanvsidasdi!  higatahvgi tsisgudesgv nahna nagiwisvna gesvi, ale gutesgv nahna nagileladvnvna gesvi!
english: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᏱᏫᏙᏣᏁ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏥᎷᎩ ᏱᏓᎩᎪᎮ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Adelv dinisquanigodisgiyi yiwidotsane adelv diquatseliga, nasgino gohi tsitsilugi yidagigohe diquatseli ale uninequotsvhi.
english: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏙᎡᏥᎩᏏᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᎯ ᏤᏥᎥᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tsidoetsigisiquo saquo iyagayvli adelv, asgohino iyagayvli tsuhi tsetsivsi.
english: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno uhesdi atsinedi gesesdi, utsatino usquanigodesdi; gilosgini nuhvna gesesdi atsigiediquo gesesdi nasgi nasquo uhvi.
english: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᎵᏏᎬ ᏪᏣᏓᎤᎦ; ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ganvsidasdi doyiditlv tsulisigv wetsadauga; nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi.
english: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏓᎦᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuno hnaquo yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha uwasv utseliga galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdesdi, ale nigadv getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi datinehesdi, hnaquo dagani galvquodiyu uwesgilvi;
english: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎳᏫᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᎦᎴᏅᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Igvyiditlvno dodagetsilawidi nigadiyu nunadalesv yvwi, ale dodvgalenvtani nasgiya awidigatiya tsidagalenvdisgo tsutseli awi uninodena ale awi dinihanulvhi.
english: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏙᏓᎦᎪᏔᏂ, ᎠᏫᏃ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ;
phonetic: Awino uninodena agatisi iditlv dodagagotani, awino dinihanulvhi agasgani iditlv;
english: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ; ᎡᏤᎾ, ᎡᏙᏓ ᎢᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Ugvwiyuhi hia nidodagaweseli agatisi iditlv anidonai; Etsena, Edoda Itsilvquotanvhi, itsatseli winigalisda utseligohi etsalisgolvdanelvhi elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏅᏃ; ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᎤᏅᏃ; ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏴᏔᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Agonuyeno agiyosisgvgi, vsgiyelastanvno; agitadegisgvgi, vsgiunvno; nvgigatahvna gesvgi, vsgiyvtanvgi;
english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏙᏍᎩᏄᏬᎥᎩᏃ; ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏯᎦᏔᏂᎸᎩᏃ; ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎥᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎸᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Agiyelvha gesvgi, dosginuwovgino; agitlvgvgi, vsgiyagatanilvgino; didasdudiyi vgisduhvgi, vsgiwadvhilvgino.
english: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏛᏂᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᏒ ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏨᎤᏁᏃ;
phonetic: Hnaquono unadanvti dvninetsi hia nvdagvwaweseli; Tsagvwiyuhi, ilagiyu itsvgosv tsayosisgei, itsvyelastaneno; ale tsatadegisgei, itsvuneno;
english: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ, ᎢᏨᏴᏔᏁᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏨᏄᏬᎡᏃ;
phonetic: Ilagiyu itsvgoe netsagatahvna, itsvyvtaneno; ale tsayelvha gesei, itsvnuwoeno;
english: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏣᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ, ᎢᏨᏯᎦᏔᏂᎴᏃ?
phonetic: Ale ilagiyu itsvgoe tsatlvgei, ale didasdudiyi etsasduhei, itsvyagatanileno?
english: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏓᎧᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino dakanetsi hia nidodagaweseli; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Nasgiyeno tsinetsadvnelv usdikani hia nasgi otsalinvtli, ayv nisgiyadvnelvgi.
english: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ, ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nasquo nidodagaweseli agasgani iditlv anidonai; Sgiyadanvsi, etsisgatsvhi, winasdvna atsilvyi digesv witsilohi, nasgi asgina ale tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi gegotlvnanelvhi.
english: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᎤᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Agonuyeno agiyosisgvgi, vtlano yisgiyelastanei; agitadegisgvgi, vtlano yisgiunei;
english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏴᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏄᏬᎡᎢ; ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nvgigatahvna gesvgi, vtlano yisgiyvtanei; agiyelvha gesvgi, vtlano yidisginuwoei; agitlvgvgi, ale didasdudiyi vgisduhvgi, vtlano yisgiwadvhilei.
english: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏂᏁᏥ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ, ᏂᏨᏍᏕᎸᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ?
phonetic: Nasquono nasgi dvninetsi, hia nvdagvwaweseli, Tsagvwiyuhi, ilagiyu itsvgoe tsayosisgei, ale tsatadegisgei, ale netsagatahvna gesei, ale tsayelvha gesei, ale tsatlvgei, ale didasdudiyi etsasduhei, nitsvsdelvhvnano gesei?
english: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᎧᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dakanetsi hia nidodagaweseli; udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, nasgiyeno netsadvnelvna gesv usdikani hia nasgi, ayv vtla yinisgiyadvnelei.
english: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏮᏛᏂᎶᏏ; ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi winasdvna agiliyoisdiyi digesv wvdvnilosi; unadanvtisgini winasdvna gvnidv digesvi.
english: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ;
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, nasgi Tsisa usquadv nigadv hia nasgi nigawesgvi, hia niduweselvgi gvwasdawadidohi;
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏒᎯ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎦᏡᏔᏂᏒ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsigataha tali iyusvhi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi gesvi, ale yvwi Uwetsi tsagatlutanisv agadvdiyi.
english: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ, ᎦᏁᎸ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎧᏯᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ;
phonetic: Hnaquono dunilawitse nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi ale dinilawigi anehv yvwi, ganelv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi Kayaqua tsudoidv;
english: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uninoheleno galonuhedv unvdodiyi uniniyvdiyi Tsisa, ale unihisdiyi.
english: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nuniwesei; Tlesdi dilisdayvdiyi gesvi, nahiyuyeno yigi utsati yanalitelvhvga yvwi.
english: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano Quediniyi edohvi, Sawani adayesgi utlvgi ganelvi,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏰᎲᎩ ᎫᎫ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎦᏅᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ulutselvgi ageyv ayehvgi gugu nvya unegv gotlvtanvhi atlisdvgi utsati tsugvwalodi atlonedi, ale ulonetanvgi asgoli ganvgv alisdayvhvsgvi.
english: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏤᏬᎩ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwagohv unitalawosvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Gadono hia tsatsewogi?
english: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏳᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏱᏚᎬᏩᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏗᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno atlonedi yunadinvse utsati yidugvwalanei, ale nasgi uyo iyunadvhnadegi dinedi yigesei.
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ?  ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᎾᏋᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano udolehosv, hia niduweselvgi; Gadono ietsadeyadodi ageyv?  Osiyuyeno dulvwisdasi tsinaquvga.
english: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏱᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Uyoyeno iyunadvhnadegi nigohilv getseladidoha, ayvsgini vtla nigohilv yitsvyeladidoha.
english: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏣᎩᎶᏁᏓ, ᎥᎩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hiayeno atlonedi tsiyelvi tsagiloneda, vginisodiyi aquadvnvisdiha.
english: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎸᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏥᎾᏛᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Analitsidonidolvha hia osdv kanohedv ilvhitlv elanigvi, nasquo hia ageyv tsinadvga uninohedi gesesdi, nasgi aganvdadisdodi.
english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono asiyvwi taladu iyanidv gesvi, Tsudasi Isgaladi tsudoidv, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi widulutselei,
english: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏓᏍᎩᏁᎵ ᎠᏴᏃ ᏙᏓᏨᏲᎯᏎᎵ?  ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᏕᎬᏩᏌᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hia winiduweselei; Gado dasgineli ayvno dodatsvyohiseli?  Tsoasgohino ayeliadelv degvwasasdanelei.
english: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏲᎸ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono ulenvhvgi uyolv iyudvnediyi ulonuhediyi.
english: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ.
phonetic: Igvyiyiquono iga nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi gesv gvwasdawadidohi gvwalutselv Tsisa, hia nigvwaweselvgi, Hatlv tsaduliha ogadvnvisdodiyi tsalisdayvdiyi kanohiyegi.
english: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏤᎾ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏤᎲ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎵᏗ, ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᏁᎸ ᏓᏲᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Itsena digaduhvi, nahna tsehv asgaya, hiano natsiweselvha; Dideyohvsgi hia nigaweha; Hnaquo agisqualvelidi, gvgisdawadidohi hinelv dayotsisquanigotani kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi gesvi.
english: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino nusdv Tsisa dunetselv nasgi nunadvnelvgi, ale osdv nunvnelvgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi.
english: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏅᎩ [ᏥᏌ] ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv unanitlvnvgi [Tsisa] taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi
english: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᏛᏆᏡᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Analisdayvhvsgvno hia nuwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; hia tsinitsadvnv saquo udasuya dvquatlutani.
english: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?
phonetic: Utsatino uyoiyu uniyelvnvgi, ale unalenvhvgi anisiyvwiha hia nigvwaweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsigo ayv?
english: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᏍᏓᏑᏫᏍᎦ ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏆᏡᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuwesvgi; itsulaha tsosdasuwisga atelidogihi nasgi dvquatlutani.
english: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏄᏕᏅᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwi Uwetsi ai nusdv goweli atsinohesgvi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi asgaya awi Uwetsi atludisgi.  Osiyu yigese nasgi asgaya nudenvnaquo yigesei.
english: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎠᏓᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Tsudasino adatludisgi unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, tsigo ayv?  Hia nuweselvgi; Yeli niwi.
english: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Analisdayvhvsgvno Tsisa gadu ugisvgi, ale ulihelitsvgi, ale ugvhaluyvgi, ale dunelv gvwasdawadidohi, hiano nuwesvgi; Itsigi, itsiga, hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi.
english: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏃ ᎤᎩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ ᏚᏁᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᏗᏔ;
phonetic: Ulisquidino ugisv ale ulihelitsv dunenelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Nitsiv itsadita;
english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᎨᎦᏤᏪᎸ, ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia agigigv itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, nasgi unitsati tsigegatsewelv, gagetsinediyi unisganvtsvi.
english: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ ᎯᎠ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤ ᎢᏓᏗᏔᎲᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha; vtla ilvhiyu gogi iyudalenvdv yvgagadita hia telvladi unanugowisvhi, gvni nahiyu iga itsulaha itse idaditahvha Edoda utseligohi.
english: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏒᏃ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎣᎵᏩᏲᎢ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Duninogisvno dikanogisdi uninugotsvgi, Oliwayoi usahilv wunilosvgi.
english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏙᏓᏦᏕᎵ ᎪᎯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᏓᏥᏴᏂᎵ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ, ᎠᏫᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏛᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏥ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; nihi nitsiv dodatsodeli gohi svnoyi tsigi, ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi.  Hiayeno nigvnv igowela, datsiyvnili Awidigatiya, awino unadatlugv dvnadigaleyotsi.
english: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏆᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno diqualenvhi gesesdi igvyi nvdatsvyenveli Gelili.
english: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏚᏃᏕᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎬᏉᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Quida unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Nasquo nigadv yidunodelv nihi yinvdigalisdodiha, ase ayv vtla yidogvquodega.
english: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎪᎯᏉ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Gohiquo svnoyi tsigi asi tsataga naniyvgvna gesesdi tsoi nvdasquadayili.
english: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᏱᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎬᏯᏓᏱᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Quidano hia nuweselvgi; nasquo itsulaha diyiniyohuhisdi yigi, ase vtla yvgagvyadayiga.  Nasgiya nasquo nigadv gvwasdawadidohi nasgi nuniwesvgi.
english: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎨᏏᎻᏂ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎢᏢ ᏫᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi unilutsvgi Gesimini dudovi, hiano niduweselv gvwasdawadidohi; Ani itsinesdi gvni itlv wigadadolistanvha.
english: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Dutinvsvgino Quida ale anitali Tsequidi tsuwetsi, ale ulenvhe ehisdi udanvdadei, ale utsati gagediyu nulisdanele udanvdvi.
english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᎢ.  ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduweselei; Aquadanvdv ukalitsvhi utsati ehisdi gesvi ayohuhisdi gesv igai.  Ani itsinesdi ale itsulaha idiyawisgesdi.
english: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎤᏗᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏯᏍᏚᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏩᎩᎶᎯᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Usdigidvno udiditlvsdodi iyvdv wulutsei, ale uliyasdunei, ale udadolistanei, hia nuwesei; Edoda, iyuno yeli igvwalisdodi gesesdi wagilohisiquo hia ulisquidi; vtlasgininonv ayv nusdv gadanvtesgvi, nihisgini.
english: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏗᎤᎷᏨ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏂᎵᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ; ᎦᏙᏉ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎨᏥᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino aninv diulutsv duwadvhe anilinei, hiano nuwesele Quida; Gadoquo, tlasgo tsiyawisgv saquo iyutlilodv igohidv getsiyawisdi yigi?
english: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ.
phonetic: Itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi nasgi udagoliyediyi gesv witsinanugoisdiyi nigesvna gesvi.  Adanvdo udohiyuhi udvnvisdi, uquedalvsgini wanagalahiyu.
english: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎬᎩᎶᎯᏎᏗᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂ ᏯᏆᏗᏔᎲ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Talineno uwenvsei, wudadolistanei, hia winuwesei; Edoda, iyuno hia ulisquidi gvgilohisediquo nigesvna yigi, gvni yaquaditahv, nusdv hadanvtesgv winigalisda.
english: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Diulutsvno duwadvhe taline anilinaei, dinigadoliyeno digagediyu gesei.
english: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏚᏮᏕᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno duwvdetse ale udanvsei, ale tsoine wudadolistanei, nasgiya winuwesei.
english: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏗᎤᎷᏨ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᎵᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏪᏐᎸᎦ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎦᏡᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸ.
phonetic: Hnaquono diulutsv gvwasdawadidohi aninvi, hia niduweselei; Hnaquo itsilinvgi ale itsiyawesolvga; gvniyuquo iyu gesv usqualvhidi, yvwino Uwetsi agatlutanv uninegutsidv yvwi degetsiyohiselv.
english: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ!  ᎢᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ!  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᏓᏯᎢ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ditsalehvga!  idaisesdi!  gvniyuquo aquo dayai aquatludisgi.
english: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏂᏁᎯ, ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Asiquono gawonisgvi gvniyuquo Tsudasi asiyvwi taladu iyanidv gesv ulutsvgi, ale datinehvgi unitsati yvwi, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada dininehi, nvdagvninvsidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi dinilawigi anehv yvwi.
english: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᏣᎳᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Utludisgino tsunonelvhi gese unadolehohisdodi hia iyuwesvhi gesei; gilo tsiyadutsalanvha nasgi gesesdi, asdaya detsiniyvhvha.
english: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏙᎯᏱ ᏕᎾᏓᎪᏩᏛ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏣᎳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ulisdiyuno Tsisa gadogv ulutsvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Dohiyi denadagowadv, Sginatlai; ale udutsalanvgi.
english: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᎯᎷᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏔᏛᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Ginalii, gadono vhilugi.  Hnaquono unilutsvgi ale degvwasitadvgi Tsisa, gvwaniyvhvgi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎤᎸᎲᎩ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo asiyvwi Tsisa anehi usaladanvgi kanogeni ulvhvgi ayelasdiganvhidv, ale uluyv ugvwiyuhi atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale ulisdestanvgi.
english: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎯᎳᏓ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Galadisdiyi tsihilada tsatseli ayelasdiganvhidv, nigadvyeno ayelasdiganvhidv aniyisgi ayelasdiganvhidv tsuniyohuhisdodi gesesdi.
english: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏔᎳᏚᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏙᎬᎩᎧᏏ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yadanvteha yeli gatsiyadadolisdanedi gesv Edoda, gilaquono iyvdv vtla taladuquo iyunadatlugi dinikahnawadidohi yidogvgikasi?
english: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏙᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Aseno gado yigalisdoda yadohiyuhvga nusdv gowelvi, ase nasgi iyulisdodi tsigi?
english: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᎯᎦ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏥᏁᎯ?  ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏅᎩ ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏂᏱᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno Tsisa hia niduweselvgi unitsati; Tsigo ganosgisgi tsitsiyoho nasgiya itsilugi sginiyvhiga, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada ditsinehi?  Nidugitsvnisv itsulaha idinvgi degadeyohvsgvgi udvnadigalawiisdiyi, vtlano yisginiyisgei.
english: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏕᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno nigadv nasgi hia nulistanvgi udohiyudiyi anadolehosgi unowelanvhi.  Hnaquono nigadv gvwasdawadidohi gvwadetsvgi ale unalisvgi.
english: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏛ ᎧᏯᏉᎢ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano uniniyvdv kayaquoi wunatinvstanvgi nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, nahna dinowelisgi ale dinilawigi danilawivi.
english: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᎢᏎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏁᎢ, ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano usdawadvse ge iyvdv tsaise nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelv gvdisgi, uyvlei, ale getsinvsidasdi itsulaha aninei, ugowadvdiyi uyelvse walisquadihihvi.
english: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi ale nigadv dinilawigi uniyole gayegogi uninohelvhi Tsisa utludisgi, nasgi unihisdiyi unadulisgei;
english: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ.  ᎣᏂᏱᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno unatlotsequo; unitsatesgininonv gayegogi aninohesgi uninanugotsei, aseno unatlotsequo.  Oniyisgininonv anitali gayegogi aninohesgi unilutsei, hia nuniwesei;
english: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏒᎩ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ [ᏔᎵᏁ] ᏴᎦᏁᏍᎬᎵ.
phonetic: Hia niduwesvgi; Yeliquo yitsiyosda Unelanvhi utseli udvnadigalawiisdiyi, tsoiquono tsudodaquadv [taline] yvganesgvli.
english: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏁᎦ?  ᎦᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᏥᎨᏣᏡᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dulenei, hia nuweselei; Tlasgo yinega?  Gado hia anigatahv tsaninoheha tsigetsatludiha?
english: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎬᎳᏲᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎯᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa elaweyiquo gesei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi iunetsv hia nuweselei; Gvlayosi Unelanvhi gvnidv hineisdodiyi, sginohvsi, tsigo nihi Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi?
english: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᏬᎴᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei; Yeli niwi.  Aseno hia nitsvweseha; ilvhiyu dayetsigoi yvwi Uwetsi agatisi iditlv ulinigvgv uwolesdi, ale tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi.
english: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏄᏩᎥ ᏚᏪᏣᎦᎸᎮᎢ; ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏓ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏯᏂᏃᎮᎭ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dunuwav duwetsagalvhei; Asotlvisda, udvnei; gadono asi anigatahi yaninoheha?  Gvniyuquo hnaquo itsadvgvga asotlvisdisgvi.
english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gado itseliha?  Uninetsvno hia nuniwesei; Yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi.
english: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏍᏇᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏈᏅ ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono ukadv dunalitsisquei, ale asquinv degvwanasdisgei ale anisoi tsunoyeni degvwanasdisgei,
english: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏙᎴᎣᎯᏏ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᎪ ᏥᏨᏂᎦ?
phonetic: Hia naniwesgei; Sgiyadoleohisi, Galonedv, Gago tsitsvniga?
english: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤᎴᏃ ᎠᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Quidano uwole udlanvdvi, ulutseleno adv hia nuwesei; Nihi nasquo sdedohvgi Tsisa Gelili ehi.
english: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nigadv anigatahv udayilei, hia nuwesei; Vtla yitsigataha niwesgvi.
english: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᏱᏢᏃ ᏭᎶᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎯ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Doyitlvno wulosv nvwadale ugohei, ale hia niduwesele nahna anedohi; Nasquo hia Tsisa Naselidi ehi danedohvgi.
english: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno udayilei, unelanvhi uneistanei; tla yitsigataha na asgaya, udvnei.
english: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎯ, ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Gohiyino iyvdv gvwalutsele nav anidonai, hia nigvwawesele Quida; Udohiyuhi nasquo nihi itsedolvhi, hiwonisgvyeno gvnigesv nitsvneha.
english: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏍᎩᏅᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; Ꮭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ulenvhe usginvdei, ale unelanvhi uneistanei; Tla yitsigataha na asgaya, udvnei; gilaquono iyvdv tsataga uyvlasei.
english: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.  ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano unvdade Tsisa unetsvhi, hia tsinuweselei; Asi tsataga naniyvgvna gesesdi tsoi nvdasquadayili.  Unugotsvno ehisdi widutloyilei.
english: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Sunaleno nulistanv, nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi anehv awi uninohele iyunadvnediyi Tsisa unihisdiyi.
english: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎸᎸ ᎤᏁᎵᏌᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᏆᏂᏛ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unalvlv unelisanawidvhei, Quanidv Qualedi ugvwiyuhi widuniyohiselei.
english: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᎸᎯ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏙᎤᏲᎮᎴ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsudasi nasgi ulonuhelvhi udolehosv dagugodanelvi unetliyvse udanvdvi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsunadvsonvhi douyohele tsoasgohi ayeliadelv tsunagvwalodi,
english: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎩᎬ ᏥᎦᏡᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎬᏙᏗ?  ᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei; tsisganvgi nusganvtsvna gigv tsigatluda.  Hiano nuniwesei; Gado nasgi ayv ogvdodi?  Tsvsv nasgi ditsalvwisdasi.
english: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏗᏅ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᏭᏓᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dudinv adelv nahna digalawiisdiyi, ale unugotsei, ale iyvdv wulosv, uwasv wudadvnei.
english: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᏱᏗᏗᎲᏍᎦ, ᎩᎬᏰᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi dunigisv adelv hia nuniwesei; vtla duyugodv yigagi adelvdidiyi yididihvsga, gigvyeno tsugvwalanvhi.
english: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᎥᏘ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᏂᏐᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uninohelvno, uniwahistane vti digotlvsgi ulogesvi nahna anedohi digetsinisodiyi.
english: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᏎᎭ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasgi tlogesi gigv ulogesv anoseha gohi tsigi.
english: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᏧᏁᏤ ᏤᎵᎹᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎬᏩᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᏂᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono udohiyune tsunetse Tselimaya adolehosgi, hia tsinuwesei; Ale dunigisvgi tsoasgohi ayeliadelv nasgi na tsugvwatanvhi, nasgi tsatsigvwalotanvhi, Isili tsuwetsi tsunigvwalotanvhi,
english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎥᏘ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎠᏇᏲᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uniwahistanvgi vti digotlvsgi ulogesvi, nasgiya Yihowa aqueyonvi.
english: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Tsisano gadoge igvyiditlv ugvwiyuhi uwolvi.  Ugvwiyuhino udvdvnei, hia nuwesei; nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Tsisano hia nuweselei; Yeliniwi.
english: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi gvwayilidolv vtla yunetsei.
english: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏛᎩᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselei; Tlasgo yadvgiha nigav gvnigesv nanvnehv anigatahi getsatludisgvi?
english: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏱᏄᏁᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla saquounv yinunetsei, nasgi iyusdi ugvwiyuhi utsati usquanigosei.
english: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Dilisdayvdiyino gesv iyui ugvwiyuhi tsuyohisedi geso saquo ayvgi, hiaquo anela yvwi.
english: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᏃᏣᎵ ᎠᏴᎩ ᎤᏂᎧᎮ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno diganotsali ayvgi unikahe Qualaqua tsudoidv.
english: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ?  ᏆᎳᏆᏍᎪ?  ᏥᏌᎨ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo dunilawitsv Qualedi hia niduweselei; Gago itsaduli ditsvyohisediyi?  Qualaquasgo?  Tsisage Galonedv tsanosehoi?
english: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎠᏅᏳᎬᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏂᏲᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Agataheyeno anvyugvquo nvdigalisdodisgv duniyosvi.
english: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎸᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Uwolvno digugododiyi gasgilvi udalii tsudanvsei, hia nvtsuweselei; Tlesdi nihi gohusdi na nasganvna asgaya ugvwali yiditsalvwisdanelesdi, utsatiyeno tsigiliyogi gohi iga gasgidasgvi nasgi nvdigalisdodisgvi.
english: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi dunisdiyetane unitsati gesv Qualaqua unitayosediyi, Tsisano unihisdiyi.
english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ?  ᏆᎳᏆ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino unetsv hia niduweselei; Gago hia anitali gesv itsaduli ditsvyohisediyi?  Qualaqua, unadvnei.
english: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᏥᏌ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ?  ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ, ᎬᏬᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ.
phonetic: Qualedi hia niduweselei; Gadono datsiyvneli Tsisa, Galonedv tsanosehoi?  Wagadvvga, gvwosele nigadv.
english: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Gadono, gado udvnelv usganvtsv?  Aseno utliquo nigae unelunei, wagadvvga, anadisgvi.
english: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏔᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎹ ᏬᏁᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏑᎴᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎩᎬ.  ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Qualedi udolehosv digvwasegogisdi nigesvna gesvi, ale unadasuyedv unalitalvnvgi, ama wonegisei, ale dusulehe unitsati anigatahvi, hia nuwesei; Ayv vtla agisganvtsvhi yigi hia nusganvtsvna yvwi ugigv.  Nihi itsagasayasda.
english: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᎩᎬ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎨᏥ ᎣᎩᏅᎦᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi uninetsei, hia nuniwesei; Ugigv ayv ale tsogetsi oginvgalesdi.
english: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏕᎤᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᎵᎥᏃᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏲᏎ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualaqua deuyohiselei; ulivnonvno Tsisa duyose agadvdiyi.
english: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏕᎬᏩᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono aniyawisgi ugvwiyuhi tsutseliga ugvwiyuhi ganelv uniyvtane Tsisa, ale nahna degvwaduwistane nigadv sunadatlugi aniyawisgi.
english: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏄᏪᏒᏃ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᎦᏌᎴᎾ ᎤᏂᏄᏬᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Duninuwesvno, gigage gasalena uninuwoei.
english: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᏅ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎾᏒᎦᎳᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏕᎰᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale unisdeyonv alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi, unisdulanei, ale ganasda agatisi iditlv unasvgaladistanei; ale danaliniquanvnehe ale anadehodisgei, hia naniwesgei; Itsvyoliga, Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga.
english: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏇᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᎡᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᎸᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Dunalitsiqueno ale uniyvele ganasda ale unisqualvnistanei.
english: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏔᏃᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᏪᏎ ᎦᏌᎴᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏄᏪ ᏚᏂᏄᏬᎡᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Unadehotanonvno uninuwese gasalena, ale uwasv tsunuwe duninuwoei; ale unadvdiyi wunatinvstanei.
english: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ.
phonetic: Uninugotsvno uniwadvhe asgaya Salini ehi Sawani tsudoidv; nasgi gvsgaisdagi nunvnele uwenvsdiyi tsudahnawadv.
english: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏂᎷᏨᏃ ᎪᎵᎦᏓ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪᎢ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ,
phonetic: Wunilutsvno Goligada dudovi, nasgi usqualugoi tsigadvga,
english: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎦ ᎠᏑᏱ ᎤᏂᏁᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎸᏔᏅᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎸᎮ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsunitsoyasdi uditasdi adaga asuyi uninenelei, unelvtanvno vtla yudulvhe uditasdiyi.
english: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎴ ᏧᏄᏬ ᎠᎾᏌᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏆᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏄᏬ ᎤᎾᏌᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Unadvneno ale duniyadole tsunuwo anasasdisgei; nasgino udohiyune adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei; Diquanuwo duniyadolvgi, ale aquanuwo unasastanvgi.
english: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏅᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏯᏫᏎ.
phonetic: Unanvneno ale uniyawise.
english: And sitting down they watched him there;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏯᎸᏁᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏛᎢ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏁ ᎪᏪᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠᏲ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Uniyalvneno galvladitlv ulisdadvi iyusdi gesv uliyilidehvi, hia nigvne gowelei; HiAYo TsiSa UGvWiYuHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
english: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏁ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Nasquono itsulaha degegadvne anitali aninosgisgi, saquo agatisi iditlv, soino agasgani iditlv.
english: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏛᏁᎮᎢ,
phonetic: Navno anilosgi gagvwasotlvdei, ale danalisdvnehei,
english: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎯᏰᎢᎵᏙᎯ ᎭᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ, ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ ᏨᏒ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎡᎭᏠᎠᎯ.
phonetic: Hia naniwesgei; udvnadigalawiisdiyi hiyosdisgi, tsoiquono iga hiyeilidohi hanesgesgi, halisdelv tsvsv; iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, dadahnawasdv ehatloahi.
english: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏰᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Nasquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi ale dinilawigi aniyelisgvi hia naniwesgei;
english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏍᏕᎸ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎡᎠᏠᎠᎯ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᏓᏰᏙᎢᏳᏂ.
phonetic: Anisoi dasdelisgvgi, uwasvsgini vtla yvgvlisdelv.  Iyuno Ugvwiyuhi Isili unatseli gesesdi, hnaquo dadahnawasdv eatloahi, gilano dayedoiyuni.
english: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᏭᏍᏕᎸ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi ulisgasdodvgi; hnaquo wusdelv iyuno ulvquodesdi; hiayeno tsinigawesgvgi, Unelanvhi Edoda.
english: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Aninosgisgino nasgi itsulaha digegadvnvhi nasquo gagvwasotlvdei.
english: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏒᎩ ᏂᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono iga udalenvdv tsoine iyutlilodv kalawadisv iyasti usvhiyeyi iditlv ulisihvsvgi nigv nasgi gadohi.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴ ᎧᏔᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᏱ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᎳ, ᎢᎳ, ᎳᎹ ᏌᏆᏓᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᏋᏕᏨᏉ?
phonetic: Tsoineno iyutlilodv iyv katawadisv usvhiyeyi iditlv Tsisa unetse asdaya, hia nuwesei; Ila, Ila, lama saquadani?  Nasgi hia nusdi gadvgvi, Unelanvhi aquatseliga, Unelanvhi aquatseliga, gadono isquvdetsvquo?
english: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏯᏂᎭ ᎯᎠ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno nahna anidonai nasgi unadvganv, Ilaya ayaniha hia, unadvnei.
english: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏁᏎ ᏚᏬᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᎾᏍᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᏆᏙᏔᏅ ᏭᏅᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv asiyvwi dusqualvtanei, ale wunese duwoli, ale tsunitsoyasdi ukaliistanei, ganasdohino uwequadotanv wunvnele nasgi uditasdi.
english: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏳᏍᏕᎸᎯᎵ.
phonetic: Igadvno hia nuniwesei; Unelagi, idadolehohi, tsigono Ilaya dagalutsi dayusdelvhili.
english: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Tsisano taline asdaya unetsv deuyose udanvdo.
english: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎵᏍᏡᏰᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎴᏅᎮ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏭᏍᏆᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏚᎾᎵᏍᏡᏰᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono anuwo ayedoladv udvnadigalawiisdiyi dulistluyei, galvladi tsulenvhe eladi wusquadistanei; ale gadohi ulitelvnei, ale nvya dunalistluyei.
english: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏗᏓᏁᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Datselisdvno dulisduisei, ale unitsati unadanvti unilinvtsvhi unadidanesei,
english: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale datselisdv duninugotse tsulenvhi nigesei, ale galvquodiyu gaduhv uniyvlei, ale unitsate gvnigesv nidunadvnelei.
english: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Hnaquono asgohitsuqui didatinidohi ale nasgi na itsulaha Tsisa gvwayawisgi, unadolehosv gadohi alitelvhvsgvi, ale nasgi nulistanidolvi, utsate unisgalei, hia nuniwesei; Udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi Uwetsi gese hia.
english: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏗᏂᎧᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸᎯ,
phonetic: Nahnano anidonae unitsate anigeyv ge iyvdv dodinikanei, nasgi Tsisa Gelili nvdagvwasdawadvdv gvwasdelvhidolvhi,
english: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏂᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏂᏥ.
phonetic: Nahna unadasuye Meli Magideli ehi, ale Meli Tsimi ale Tsosi unitsi, ale Tsequidi tsuwetsi unitsi.
english: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏦᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv ulutse uwehnai asgaya Alimadiyi ehi Tsowa tsudoidv, nasquo nasgi Tsisa usdawadidohi gesei;
english: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏭᏔᏲᎴᎢ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Qualediyi uwenvsei, Tsisa ayelvi wutayolei.  Hnaquono Qualedi unetse ayelvi tsuniyohisediyi.
english: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏁᏒ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎶᏔᏁ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏁᎬ;
phonetic: Tsowano ayelv unesv uwetsanulotane gadaha nigesvna anuwo unegv;
english: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏁ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎯ ᎤᏔᎴᏒᎢ; ᎡᏆᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏪᏌᏆᎴᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale unvne uwasv utseli itse didanisodiyi, nasgi uyohi utalesvi; equano nvya galohisdiyi atselisdv wuwesaqualelv udanvsei.
english: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏚᏃᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎺᎵ.
phonetic: Nahnano igvyiditlv didanisodiyi dunole Meli Magideli ehi ale soi Meli.
english: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ, ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᏤ ᏆᎴᏗ,
phonetic: Ale ugitsvdv, advnvisdodiyi iga ulosonvhi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniqualisi degvwalawitse Qualedi,
english: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᎦᏅᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᎬᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏦᎢᏁᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎦᎴᏂ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, oganvta nasgi na adalonuhesgi, asiquo tsigvnvgi, hia tsinuwesvgi; Tsoinequo iga dodvgaleni.
english: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏯᏂᎷᎩ ᏱᎬᏩᏃᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏱᏂᏓᏂᏪᏏ ᏴᏫ; ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏙᎤᎴᏅ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᏄᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hinegi asdaya iyunvnediyi atselisdvi tsoine iga igohidv, gvwasdawadidohiyeno svnoyi yanilugi yigvwanosgi, hiano yinidaniwesi yvwi; Tsuyohusv doulenv; oniyino unatlonuhelvi utli uyoiyu yigi esgaquo igvyiyi.
english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᎧᎭ, ᎢᏤᎾ ᎾᏍᏓᏴ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᎡ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ.
phonetic: Qualedi hia niduweselei; Aniyawisgi detsikaha, itsena nasdayv igetsvnedi gee winitsvga.
english: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏫᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏔᏁ ᏅᏲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Howano unenvse asdayiyu winunvnele atselisdvi, uniyelvtane nvyohi, ale dunikane anigatidisgi.
english: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏉᏅᎯᏃ, ᎩᎳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎺᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏂᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Unadodaquonvhino, gila iga nigalisdisgei alenisgv sunadodaquasdi gesv Meli Magideli ehi ale soi Meli unagatanile atselisdvi.
english: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᏠᎠᏎᎢ, ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏪᏌᏆᎴᎴ ᎤᎲᏎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎩᎳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo utsati gadohi ulitelvnei, Yihowayeno utseli dikahnawadidohi galvladi tsutloasei, ulutsvno nvya uwesaqualele uhvse galohisdiyi ahvi; ale usgilanei.
english: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏄᏩᎥᏃ ᎥᏃᏥ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᏄᏁᎩᏰᎢ.
phonetic: Dikanodiyi anagalisgi nasgiya gesei, unuwavno vnotsi tsinunegiyv nunegiyei.
english: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᏚᏂᎾᏪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Anigatiyano anisgaihv duninawei, ale tsuniyohusvhi nasgiya nunalistanei.
english: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏍᏗᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎡᏍᏗᏲᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino unetsv hia niduwesele anigeyv; Tlesdi nihi yisdisgaihesdi, tsigatahayeno Tsisa agadvnvhi esdiyohvi.
english: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᏘᎦᎾ, ᏚᎴᏅᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; ᎡᏍᏕᎾ ᎡᏍᏓᎦᏔ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ani tigana, dulenvyeno nasgiya nuwesvi; Esdena esdagata Ugvwiyuhi atsinvnvi.
english: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏗᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᏰᏏ, ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏍᏛᏃᎲᏏ.
phonetic: Ale ulisdiyu isdena widisdinohvsi gvwasdawadidohi deulenv uyohusvi; ale gvniyuquo igvyi Gelili nvdayesi, nahna dayetsigoi.  Gvniyuquo isdvnohvsi.
english: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ulisdiyuno atselisdv unadanvsei, anisgaihe ale utsati analiheligei, ale dunisqualvtane gvwasdawadidohi duninonelvsei.
english: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏓᏂᏃᏁᎵᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎾᏠᏎᎢ; ᏙᎯᏱ ᏕᏓᏓᎪᏩᏛ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎤᏂᎷᏨᏃ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎬᏩᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Anaisvno daninonelisv gvwasdawadidohi gvniyuquo Tsisa dunatlosei; Dohiyi dedadagowadv, udvnei.  Unilutsvno tsulasideni duniniyvhei, eladi nigvwadvnelei.
english: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᏗᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏗᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏓᎬᎩᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselei, Tlesdi yisdisgaihesdi; isdena widisdinohvsi otsalinvtli Gelili wunilohisdiyi, nahnano dagvgigohi.
english: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏯᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Anaisvno gvniyuquo igadv uniyawisvhi unilutse gaduhvi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi duninonele nigadv nulistanidolvi.
english: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏂᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgino ale dinilawigi dunilawitsv ale uninohelv, utsati adelv duninele aniyawisgi,
english: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎣᏥᎵᏅ ᎬᏩᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; Hia nitsiwesvha; Gvwasdawadidohi svnoyi unilutsvgi, otsilinv gvwanosgisvgi.
english: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᏲᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏨᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi advganv ugvwiyuhi, dayotsisdiyetani, ale datsvsdelvhi.
english: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ, ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎭ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
phonetic: Dunigisvno adelv, nigetsiweselv nunadvnelei.  Nasgino hia kanohedv asi aninohelidoha Anitsusi.
english: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᏦᏓᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᏎᎮᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono sadu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi Gelili unenvsvgi tsodalv Tsisa unasehelvi.
english: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎪᎲᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎬᏩᏛᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎸᏉ.
phonetic: Gvwagohvno eladi nigvwadvnelvgi.  Aseno igadv unadlasidvelvquo.
english: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᎩᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano ulutsv duwonetanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Vginelv nigav digilvwisdanediyi galvladi ale elohi.
english: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎾ ᏫᏗᏤᏲᎲᎦ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᏕᏣᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsena widitseyohvga nagadv nunadalesv yvwi, detsawosgesdi itsvdisgesdi dudov Agayvligei ale Uwetsi ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo,
english: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᏫᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Detseyohvsgesdi tsunikahnawadvsdiyi nigav itsvnetselvi; gvniyuquono nigohilv itsvyeladidoha wigvlisquadisgi elohi.  Emenv.
english: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Adalenisgv yisdv kanohedv, Tsisa Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi utseliga.
english: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏱ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela anadolehosgiyi; Gvniyuquo, tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
english: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎡᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏏ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏅᏅ ᏗᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Uweluga gilo inagei, hia nigaweha; Etsadvnvisdasi Yihowa ulohisdiyi, dunvnv ditsitsinohisda.
english: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎨ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᏗᏓᏪᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏴᏓᏘᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsani dadawosge inagei, ale alitsidohvsge kanohesge didawesdi gesv ganetliyvsdiyi odanvdv ugvwali nasgi gayvdatinediyi asganvtsvi.
english: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏬᎡ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale wigvwalutsele nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Tsilusilimi anehi, ale nigadv nasgi dunawoe Tsodani uweyvi, unisganvtsv aninohvsgei.
english: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏄᏪ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏅᎯ, ᎦᏃᏥᏃ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏕᎢ; ᎥᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏚᎵᏏ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
