phonetic: Tsanino unuwe gemili usdiyenvhi, ganotsino udatlosdei; vleno ale wadulisi inage ehi alisdayvdisgei.
english: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎳᏑᎶᎩᎯ ᏓᎧᏁᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏆᏗᏌᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Alitsidohvsgeno hia nigawesgei; Utli ulinigidiyu esgaquo ayv oni dayai, nasgi tsulasulogihi dakanesadv vtla yeli yinigoi aquadisadadisdiyi ale digikaneyvdiyi.
english: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏕᏨᏯᏬᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ayv udohiyuhi ama detsvyawostanv, nasgisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo dodatsawostani.
english: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᎶᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏓᏬᎡ ᏦᏓᏂ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno hia nulistanei, Tsisa Naselidi tsulose nasgi Gelili tsigaduha, ale Tsani udawoe Tsodani.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᎿᎭᎷᏒ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏧᏓᏅᏒ, ᎤᎪᎮ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎫᎴᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏧᏠᎠᏏᏗᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv tsuhnalusv amayi tsudanvsv, ugohe galvloi ulisduidv gesei, ale Adanvdo guledisgonihi nasgiyai, tsutloasidise nasgi uweyalvtsei.
english: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎬᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏰᎸᎢ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nvtsuwese galvladi, nihi gvgeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu gvyelvi tsigi.
english: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv Adanvdo inage wutinvstanei.
english: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᏙᎮ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎿᎭᎢ ᏕᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano inage edohe nvgasgohi tsusvhidv, Sedani ugoliyesgei; ale inage ehnai degeladidohei; ale dinikahnawadidohi gvwasdelvhidohei.
english: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎾᏥᏴᏔᏁᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
phonetic: Tsanino didasdudiyi natsiyvtanei, Tsisa Gelili ulutsei, alitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali,
english: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ; ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Ale hia nigawesgei, Hnaquo aliyiloga, ale Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv esganiyu dayai; ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, ale itsohiyuhvga osdv kanohedv.
english: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎵᎵᏃ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎤᎶᏗ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᏚᎪᎮ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gelilino vdali ulodi aisvi, dugohe Sawani ale Enidi nasgi dinadanvtli, vdali anigayaluvsgei; anigayaluvsgiyeno gesei.
english: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᏴᏫᏃ ᏗᏍᏗᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏍᏛᏴᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselei; Sginisdawaduga, yvwino disdigayaluvsgi nvdasdvyvneli.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏎ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv duniyose tsunigayaludi, ale gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ, ᏚᎪᎮ ᏥᎻ, ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏣᎡ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏓᏃᏢᎯᏏᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiuwenv usdigidv, dugohe Tsimi, Tsequidi uwetsi, Tsanino nasgi dinadanvtli, nasgino nasquo unatsae tsiyuhi danotlvhisisge tsunigayaludi.
english: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᎤᏅᏕᏨᏃ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᏧᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎥᎢ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv nasgi widuyanvhei; unvdetsvno unidoda Tsequidi gegaguyvehi tsuninvsidasdi itsulaha tsiyuhi unatsavi, gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏆᏂᏃ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Gequanino wuniyvlei; gilaquono iyvdv digalawiisdiyi wuyvlv dudeyone unadodaquasgv iga.
english: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏕᏲᏁᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏧᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unisquanigoseno nusdv dadeyohvsgvi, dudeyoneyeno ulinigidv tsuho nasgiyai, vtlano dinowelisgi danadeyohvsgv nasgiya yigesei.
english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᏯᎡ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏁ,
phonetic: Tsunilawiisdiyino ayae asgaya gadaha adanvdo uyai, ale uwelune,
english: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎣᎦᏁᎳᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᏓᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎯ, ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎮᎯ?  ᏥᎪ ᏍᎩᏛᏔᏂᎸ?  ᎬᎦᏔᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Oganelagi; gado digadadvdodi nihi, Tsisa, Naselidi hehi?  Tsigo sgidvtanilv?  Gvgataha, nihi nasgi gesvi; nasgi Atsilvquodi Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᎳᏪ ᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏄᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano usgatsei, hia nuwesei; Elawe hvna, ale hinugoi.
english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏓᎭᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎸᏕᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅ, ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Gadahano adanvdo ulvdestanv, ale asdaya uwelunv, unugotsei.
english: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎯᎠ?  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎲ ᎬᏗ ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎰ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unisquanigosei; ale unvsv gesv dunadadvdvnei, hia naniwesgei; Gado uyelvdi hia?  Gado usdi hia itse dideyodi gesvi?  Ulinigidvyeno uhv gvdi dekanetseho anigadaha didanvdo, ale gvwohiyuhvsgoi.
english: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸ ᏚᏰᎵᏎ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv nasgi deganotsalv duyelise Gelili nahna gvwaduwidv gesvi.
english: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏨ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᎸ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᏁᎮ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv digalawiisdiyi tsuninugotsv, Sawani ale Enidi aninelv wuniyvlei, anehe Tsimi ale Tsani.
english: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏥ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎤᏢᎨ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎨᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino udalii utsi ganvge utlvge udilehvsgei; gilaquono iyvdv gvwanonelei.
english: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ, ᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ; ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ulutsvno ale uwoyanesv, duletanei; udilehvsgvno gilaquo iyvdv udiwasei, ale dusdelvhidolei.
english: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏅᏙ ᏭᏕᎵᏨ, ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ;
phonetic: Usvno hnaquo nvdo wudelitsv, degvwatinohele nigadv tsunitlvgi, ale anisgina digvwaniyai;
english: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᎮ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nigadvno gaduhv anehi unadatlisahe galohisdiyi.
english: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏕᎤᏅᏩᏁ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎤᏁᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏩᏂᏁᎩ ᏱᏕᎵᏎᎮ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ, ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎬᏬᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino deunvwane tsunitlvgi tsudalenvdv vyugi unehi; ale unitsati anisgina dunugowisei; ale vtla waninegi yidelisehe anisgina, udigalisdodisge gvwoligvi.
english: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ, ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Sunaleno, asi gohidiyu gvwagitsvdi gesv udidvhe unugotsei, ale inage wulosei, ale nahna udadolistanei.
english: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino ale nasgi anehi, gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎬᏩᏩᏛᎲᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏣᏲᏎ.
phonetic: Wigvwawadvhvno, hia nigvwaweselei, nigadvquo yvwi getsayose.
english: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏐᎢ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᏗᎶᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎸᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Disoi dodigaduhv widilohi, nahna nasquo galitsidonidolvha; nasgiyeno iyusdi agilutsilv.
english: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎮᏃ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Alitsidonidoheno tsunilawiisdiyi nigvnadv Gelili, ale anisgina deganugowisgei.
english: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏍᎩᏅᎦᎸ.
phonetic: Adayesgino utlvgi ulutselei, udadolisdanele duliniquanvnelei, ale hia nuweselei, Iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv, yeliquo yisginvgalv.
english: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ, ᎦᏙᎵᎬ ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᏅ; ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano, gadoligv udoyanvhidei, ale usvnilei, ale hia nuweselei, Osiyu tsiyelvnv; tsadanvgalvdv gesesdi.
english: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬ ᎤᎵᏛᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unetsvquono gilaquo iyvdv adayesgi utlvgv ulidvtanei, ale udanvgalvdv gesei.
english: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᏤᎸ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ulinigidvno unetselv, gilaquo iyvdv unetsele udanvsdiyi;
english: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᎯᏃᏁᎵ; ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᏂᏯᏛᏂᏏ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓ ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎯᏳᎾᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuweselei, Heyatahesdi tlesdi gilo gohusdi tsihinoneli; henaquosgini, gvnigesv winiyadvnisi atsilvgelohi, ale walisgolvda tsadanvgalvhv ugvwali, nasgi Mosi unetsv alisgolvdodiyi, nasgi unadohiyunanediyi.
english: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᏣᎳᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ; ᏂᎬᎾᏛᏉᏃ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unugotsv, ulenvhe utsati duyelihistanei, ale dunotsalane nasgi, nasgino iyusdi Tsisa vtla hnaquo gvnigesv wigvwayvsdi yigese gaduhvi, doyiditlvquosgini inage degesadisv edohei; nigvnadvquono nidodayunilosvhi gvwalutsehei.
english: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎨᏆᏂ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏤᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno ilvsgi winusvlv Gequani wuyvlei; dunotsalotseno galitsode ayavi.
english: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏓᏅᏕ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ; ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏃ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv unitsati dunilawitsolei, nasgi iyusdi vtla yudlanvde, vtla nasquo galohisdiyulodi; kanohedvno dulitsidonelei.
english: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwalutseleno gilo iyusdi ulvdalvvsgi aninehei, nasgi nvgi iyanidv gvwanolei.
english: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᏅᏁᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏯᎥᎢ; ᎤᏅᏁᏒᏃ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᏤᏍᏙ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Uninulvnvno gadogv nav uniluhisdiyi aninenulv iyusdi, unvnese nahna ayavi; unvnesvno, eladi nunvnele atsesdo nahna ulvdalvvsgi ganvgvi.
english: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᏯᏥ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv unohiyusvi, hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi, Ayatsi, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
english: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno nahna anine gilo iyunasdi dinowelisgi, hia nusde anadanvtesge dotsunadanvdvi,
english: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎢᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Gadono hia asgaya hia nigaweha iasotlvisdiha?  Gago yeli asganvtsv gvwadadolisdi, saquoquo uwasv, nasgi Unelanvhi?
english: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv Tsisa tsudanvdv udolehosv nusdv anadanvtesgv dotsunadanvdvi, hia niduweselei; Gadono nasgi hia niusdi itsadanvteha doditsadanvdvi?
english: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ?  ᏥᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᏎ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ; ᎯᎠᎨ ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ?
phonetic: Gado usdi utli ahidiyu?  Tsigo hia yinagawese ulvdalvvsgi, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi; hiage yinagawea, Talehvga, ale hinagi tsatsesdo, ale heda?
english: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎲᎢ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ (ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ,)
phonetic: Aseno itsadolehohisdiyi yvwi Uwetsi uhvi gvwadadolisdi gesv asganvtsvi ani elohi (hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi,)
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᏫᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Gvyoseha, Talehvga, ale hinagi tsatsesdo, ale ditsenvsv wilohi.
english: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᏒᏃ ᎠᏤᏍᏙ, ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏲᎩᎪᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv dulenei, unesvno atsesdo, unugotse nigadv anigatahvi; nasgi iyusdi nigadv unisquanigosei, ale Unelanvhi unilvquotane hia nuniwesei; vtla ilvhiyu nasgi iyusdi yogigohoi.
english: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎤᎶᏗ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᏲᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno unugotse vdali ulodi uwedolei; ale nigadv unitsati wigvwalutselei, ale nasgi duweyonei.
english: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎢᏒᏃ, ᎵᏫ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aisvno, Liwi Eliqui uwetsi ugohe uwole ayeli adelv agisdiyi, ale hia nuweselei, Sgisdawaduga.  Dulenvno usdawadvsei.
english: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏥᏌ] ᎦᏅᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏓᏂᏅᎨ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi [Tsisa] ganvgv alisdayvhvsgv nasgi ganelvi, unitsate adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana itsulaha daninvge Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi; unitsateyeno, ale gvwasdawadidohei.
english: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᎾᏗᏔᏍᎦ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Dinowelisgino ale Aniqualisi gvwagohv itsulaha analisdayvhvsgv adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana, hia niduniwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Gadono itsulaha tsanalisdayvhvsga ale itsulaha tsanaditasga adelv anigisidohi ale anisganai.
english: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏂᏢᎬᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩᏍᎩᏂ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏅᎯᎸ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi udvganv hia niduweselei, Nasgi nidunitlvgvna vtla udulvdi yinunalisdaneho didanvwisgi, tsunitlvgisgini; vtla unadanvti yiditsiyanvhilv, anisganasgini dunadanvdv tsuninetliyvsdiyi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏣᏅᏍᎪᎢ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎾᏅᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ?
phonetic: Tsanino gvwasdawadidohi ale Aniqualisi gvwanisdawadidohi amatli anvsgi gesei; unilutseno ale hia nigvwaweselei, Gadono Tsani gvwasdawadidohi, ale Aniqualisi gvwanisdawadidohi amatli tsanvsgoi, nihino getsasdawadidohi amatli nanvsgvna tsigesoi?
english: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏯᏅᎾ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ?  ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏴᎬᏅᎾ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselei, Tsigo degegatsvsdisgv anigatahi yeli amatli yanvna adesvhvsgi uneladidohv igohidv?  Igohidv adesvhvsgi uneladidohv, vtla yeli amatli yvgvnvna.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏛᏅᏂ.
phonetic: Dvsqualvhisgini nahiyu getsiyanvediyi adesvhvsgi, nahiyuno hnaquo amatli dvnvni.
english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎢᏤ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏤᏰᏃ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎦᎳᏍᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏴᎦᏣᎦᎸᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏓᏣᏕᎸᎲ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo uweti anuwo itse agvhalvdv yigalistlvdisgoi, itseyeno agvhalvdv galastlvtanvhi yvgatsagalvdoda uweti, nasgino udatsadelvhv utli equohiyu yinvgalisda.
english: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏘ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏱᏓᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎢᏤᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏕᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎦᏣᎦᎸ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏯᏤᏬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏱᏓᏲᎩ; ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᏗᏤ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏗᏟᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo itse gigageaditasdi tsuweti disutlvdv yidatlisdisgoi; itseyeno gigageadetasdi yidogatsagalv disutlvdv, ale gigageaditasdi yatsewogi, ale disutlvdv yidayogi; itsesgini gigageaditasdi, ditse disutlvdv ditlisdodi gesoi.
english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᎶᏎ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᎾᎢᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᏔᏅᏎ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi tlogesi utsalesdi dawisv ulose unadodaquasgv iga; gvwasdawadidohino unalenvhe anaisv unisgudestanvse utsalesdi.
english: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino hia nigvwaweselei, Gvniyuquo, gadono unadodaquasgv iga niduyugodvna gesv nanadvneha.
english: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᏕᏫ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏧᏂᎬᏎᎮ ᎢᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, tlasgo yitsigoliyeo Dewi nudvnelv tsunigvsehe iyu, ale agonu tsuyosisgei, uwasv, ale nasgi tsanehei?
english: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏴᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏤᎮ ᎡᏆᏱᏓ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎨ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi utseli adanelv tsuyvle nahiyu tsehe Equayida nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, ale tsuge agadodi gadu, nasgi gvgisdi nigesvna tsigese atsilvanelohi unvsv, ale nasquo tsidunele nasgi anehi.
english: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎤᏙᏢᏁ ᏴᏫ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎨᎪᏢᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, unadodaquasgv udotlvne yvwi nvdigalisdodisgei; vtlano unadodaquasgv yinvdigalisdodisge yvwi yigegotlvnei.
english: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo yvwi Uwetsi unadodaquasgv Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎡᏙᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Talineno wuyvle digalawiisdiyi; nahnano edohe asgaya uwoyeni uwaiselvhi.
english: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏰᎢᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwayawiseno unadulisge unadolehohisdiyi gvwadanvwodi gesv unadodaquasgv iga, nasgi gvwayeilidasdiyi.
english: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ; ᎠᏰᎵ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele asgaya uwoyeni uwaiselvhi; Ayeli halehvga.
english: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ, ᎤᏲᎨ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎬᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏕᎸᎡᏗᏱ, ᎠᎯᏍᏗᏱᎨ?  ᎡᎳᏪᏉᏃ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Duyugodisgo osdv digalvwisdanediyi unadodaquasgv iga, uyoge digalvwisdanediyi?  Gvnv gilo asdelvediyi, ahisdiyige?  Elawequono unvsei.
english: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏐᏅᏤᎯᏃ ᏕᎤᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ, ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎲ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ.  ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏕᏃ, ᎤᏬᏰᏂᏃ ᎬᏩᏃᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏐᎢ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Usonvtsehino deukahnanv nasgi gvwaduwidv nunadvnv, udeyatanehv disdayiyu gesv tsuninawi, hia nuwesele asgaya; Hadoyanvhidv.  Udoyanvhideno, uwoyenino gvwanosdv nulistane nasgiya soi nusdvi.
english: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino uninugotsv, gilaquo iyvdv wunalinohele Elodv gvwasdelisgi gvwatludisgv, nasgi iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi.
english: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Tsisano udanvse dutinvse gvwasdawadidohi vdali wunilosei; unitsatino gvwasdawadvsei, nvdayunilosvhi Gelili, ale Tsudiyi,
english: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏙᎻᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎾᎥ ᏗᏁᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsilusilimi, ale Idomiyi, ale Tsodani isgoniditlv; ale Daya ale Sadoni nav dinehi, utsati anigodiyu, nasgi unadvganv nigav usquanigodi deulvwisdanelv, gvwalutselei.
english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏁᏄᎳᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Dunetseleno gvwasdawadidohi, nasgi tsiyu ugatidisdiyi, unitsati gesv iyusdi, nasgi gvwanenulasdodiyi nigesvna.
english: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᏚᏅᏩᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏃᏟᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Unitsateyeno dunvwanei; nasgi iyusdi gvwanenulasdisge gvwanotlisdodiyi unadulisgei, nigadv gohusdi dinalisdisgi.
english: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏁᎮ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎨ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Ale digadaha didanvdo, iyuno gvwagowadv, eladi gvwadanvnehe, ale aneluhvsge, hia naniwesgei, Unelanvhi Uwetsi nihi.
english: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvno dunetsele nasgi gvnigesv igvwanediyi nigesvna.
english: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏎᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᏯᏅᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Uhnaluseno odalvi, ale duyanvhe nasgi udulisgv tsuyanvdiyi; ale gvwalutsehei.
english: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏑᏰᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Ale dusuyese taladu iyanidv, nasgi gvwasdawadidasdiyi, ale nasgi tsunvsdiyi unalitsidonidasdiyi,
english: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᏧᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale tsulisgolvdanediyi dunitlvgv tsuninvwodiyi, ale anisgina tsuninugowisdiyi;
english: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino Quida duwoei.
english: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏤᏈᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎠᎾᏥ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴᏓᏆᎶᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎦᏛᎦ;
phonetic: Ale Tsimi Tsequidi uwetsi, ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli; ale nasgi Quoanatsi duwoei, nasgi ayvdaqualosgi tsuwetsi gadvga;
english: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᏙᎳᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎨᎾᏂᏗ,
phonetic: Ale Enidi, ale Quiligi, ale Quadolami, ale Madu, ale Dami, ale Tsimi Eliqui uwetsi, ale Dadiya, ale Sawani Agenanidi,
english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏉ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎴᎢ; ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsudasi Isgaladi, nasgi squo tsulonuhelei; adanelvno wunilosei.
english: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎤᏟᏍᏕ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unitsatino taline dunilawitsolei, sgi iyusdi nasquo niutlisde gadu unigisdiyi.
english: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎸᏃᏘᎭ.
phonetic: Gohusdino tsuwanv unadvganv, unenvse gvwaniyvhvsei; hiayeno naniwesgei, ulvnotiha.
english: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Dinowelisgino Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi, hia naniwesgei, Quelitsiqua uweha, ale ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga gvdiha deganugowisga anisgina.
english: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᎦᏄᎪᏩ ᏎᏓᏂ?
phonetic: Nasgino widuyanvhv, hia niduwesele dutlilosdanelei, Gado yigalisdoda Sedani yiganugowa Sedani?
english: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale ayeli gotlvsv tali yinudaa, uwasvquo yadatludiha, vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo nasgi ayeli gotlvsvi.
english: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Iyu ale sidanelv gesv tali yinudaa, uwasvquo yadatludiha, nasgi sidanelv gesv vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo.
english: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏱᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏚᏓᎦᏘᎴᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ, ᏱᏩᏍᏔᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale Sedani yidulenv uwasv yidudagatilenv, ale tali yinudaa, vtla yeli yinigvwasdiquo, yiwastaquosgini ehvi.
english: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏴᎬᏴᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᎬᏬᏅ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏳᎸᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎩᎳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏯᏬᏅ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo ulinigidv asgaya ganelv yvgvyvha, ale yvgvwonv uhnavi, gvni igvyi yulvlv nasgi ulinigidv asgaya; gila hnaquo yawonv ganelv uhnavi.
english: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎦᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, Nigav asganvisdi gesv, gagetsidolisdiquo gesesdi yvwi tsunetsi, ale asotlvisdodi gesv, nigav gvwanisotlvisdodi gesvi;
english: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᏰᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gilosgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo asotlvisdisgesdi, vtla ilvhiyu gayetsidolisdi yigesesdi, digayegugodanediquosgini winasdvna usdvdisdiyi;
english: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎠ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodisgei, gadaha adanvdo uyaa, unadvnvi.
english: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᏫᎬᏩᏯᏂᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwalutsele analinvtli, ale utsi, ale doyiditlv danidoge, unadanvse wigvwayanisgei.
english: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏂᏁ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏕᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏗᎨᏣᏲᎭ.
phonetic: Unitsatino anine gvwadatluwisdei; hiano nigvwaweselei, Gvniyuquo, tsatsi ale itsalinvtli doyiditlv digetsayoha.
english: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
phonetic: Dunetseleno hia nuwesei, Gago etsi, ale otsalinvtli?
english: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏂ ᏚᎧᎾᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
phonetic: Gvwaduwidvno dukahnanidolv uwolv nav anini dukananv hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo etsi, ale otsalinvtli?
english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥ.
phonetic: Giloyeno Unelanvhi udulisgv nadvnehesdi, nasgi tsosdadanvtli, ale vgido, ale etsi.
english: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏔᎸ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏙᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno ulenvhe dudeyone vdalulodi; unitsatino gvwadatluwistanei, nasgi iyusdi tsiyuhi utsanei, ale vdali atalv uwenei; nigadvno unitsati gesv vdalulodi doyi gesv anidonaei.
english: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Ale utsate tsudalenvdv duweyone dutlilosdanelei, ale hia niduwesele dadeyohvsgvi,
english: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Itsadvdasda; Gvniyuquo, awisgi uwisvsei;
english: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎢᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane awisgvi, nasgi igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei, tsisquano galvloi aninohiidohi unilutse ale unigonei.
english: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏲᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏌᎨᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓ;
phonetic: Igadvno nvyohi gesv ulageyadvtsei, nahna gayoliyu gesv gada; ale gilaquo iyvdv diuliyenei, nvdigalisdodisge sageiyu gesv gada;
english: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ-ᎡᎯ ᏧᎧᎸᏨ ᎤᎴᏴᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎿᎭᏍᎬᏤᏉ.
phonetic: Aseno nvdo igaehi tsukalvtsv uleyvsei; ale niduhnasdetlvna gesv iyusdi, uhnasgvtsequo.
english: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᏧᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎦᏔ.
phonetic: Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei; anugalvno tsudvsei, ale unenulastanei, ale nunanugowisvna gese ugata.
english: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ.
phonetic: Igadvno osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, ale uliyenei, ale advsgei, ale kanequogei, ale ugatatanei, igadv tsoasgohi iyuwagudi, igadvno sudalisgohi, igadvno asgohitsuqui.
english: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi, wadvgvga.
english: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uwasvno gesei, nasgi gvwasdawadidegi ale taladu iyanidv gvwadvdvne gadvgv nasgi datlilosdvi.
english: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ.  ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei.  Nihi etsinelv itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; nasgini doyiditlv anedohi hia nasgi nigadv degegatlilosdanehoi;
english: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi anigowadisgv unigowadvdiyi, ale gvwanadolehohisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi; ale anadvgisgv unadvgodiyi, ale gvwanolisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi; nasgi tsunadanetliyvediyi nigesvna dunadanvdv, ale unisganvtsv gagetsinediyi nigesvna.
english: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏕᏦᎵᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Tlasgo yitsoliga hia nasgi datlilosdvi?  Gadono yigalisdoda yidetsoligi nigadv datlilosdvi?
english: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi awisgi kanohedv awisgoi.
english: The sower soweth the word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎷᎪ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nvnohulodi nahna kanohedv tsigetsiwiselei; hnaquono anadvgvga, Asgina galugo gilaquo iyvdv, ale agisgo kanohedv tsuninawiyi awisvhi.
english: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nasquo nvyohi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi hnaquo kanohedv anadvgvga gilaquo iyvdv unalihelitsvhi danadanilvgoi;
english: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎿᎭᏍᏕᏠᎢ, ᏞᎦᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ, ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏓ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏃᏕᎯᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale vtla yidunihnasdetloi, tlegaquosgini danikahnawadegoi; hnaquono, agiliya ale udeyadodi aliyeiloga kanohedv dvliyeilvsda, gilaquo iyvdv dunodehihoi.
english: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ,
phonetic: Ale hia anugalvhi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi hia kanohedv tsanadvgisgoi,
english: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎲ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎦᏔᏛᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Uwelihisdino elohi ehi, ale genvisdi gesv udalidasdi gesvi, ale tsudalenvdv gohusdi adulvdi gesv, aniyvhihv aninenulasdisgo kanohedv, ale nasgi nagatadvsgvnaquo gesoi.
english: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏫᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᏛᏍᎩ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi osv gadohi tsigetsiwiselei; nasgi anadvgisgi kanohedv, ale dinadanilvgi, ale anigatadvsgi, igadv tsoasgohi iyuwagudi, igadvno sudalasgohi, igadvno asgohitsuqui.
english: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎰ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎦᎧᎲ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏂᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᏢᏫᏉ?  ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏗᏱ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎪᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Atsvsdodisgo aninohiho atlilosdi gakahv hawiniditlv unigodiyi, ale ganitlvwiquo?  Vtlano unigodiyi atsvsdodi gagodiyi?
english: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᏂᎬᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna; vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yinigvno, nasgi ase gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna.
english: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ; ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᏒᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏣᎵᎾᎶᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadvgisgvi; nusdv itsadatlilosvhv, nasgiya etsalinaloedi gesesdi; nihino itsadvgisgi etsinequoedi etsinedi gesesdi.
english: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᏒᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno uhesdi, nasgi atsinedi gesesdi; gilono nuhvna gesesdi, nasgi atsigisvdi gesesdi nasquo uhvi.
english: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏳᏫᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ;
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nasgiyaquo gilo asgaya ugata yuwisv gadohi;
english: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏳᎸᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᏗᏗᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏳᎵᏰᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏛᏒ, ᏄᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏄᏙᎴᎰᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale yulvnv, ale yadidiha digvwagitsvdi, ale ugata yuliyenv, ale yudvsv, nulisdotanv nudolehosvna.
english: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎦᎶᎬ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᎫᏓᏛᎢ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᏛ ᎤᏍᎫᏓᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gadohiyeno uwasvquo gananugowisgo ugatatanvhi; igvyiyi gesv ugalogv, hnaquono usgudadvi, onino ukalitsvhi ugatadv usgudadvi.
english: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᎾᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎶᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono agadvnagi gilaquo iyvdv asgudesgoi, asgudesdiyiyeno uliyeiloloi.
english: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᏓᏤᎳᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎦᏙᎨ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏙᏓᏓᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ?
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Gado dodadatselastani Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?  Gadoge datlilosdv dodadatlilostani?
english: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎤᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏣᏫᏐᎢ, ᏥᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎭᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Atsilvugata nasgiyai, nasgi gadohi tsawisoi, tsiwudagonadvdi usdigiyu esgaquo nigav ugata gadohi dahadvi.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏛᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏉᎯᏳ ᏓᏱᏢᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᎾᎭᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno awisvhi tsigesoi, didvsgoi, ale utli equohiyu nigalisdisgo esgaquo nigav uyehnavi, ale tsequohiyu dayitlvsgoi; ale tsisqua udlanvdv aninohilidohi yeliquo udawadisdv hawiniditlv anahadisgoi.
english: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nuwese utsate dutlilosdanelei, kanohedv dulitsidonelei, nasgi yeli gvwanadvgodi nigalisdisgvi.
english: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏓᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁᎢ; ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏬᏏᏌᏁᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nidatlilosdanehvnasgini vtla yiduwonetanei; unvsvno gesei, nigadv nasgi duwosisanele gvwasdawadidohi.
english: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ, ᎤᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏗᏐᎩ ᏍᎪᎾ ᏫᏗᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono iga, usv nulistanv, hia niduweselei, Didisogi sgona widilohi.
english: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏅᏩᏛᏁᏉ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᎥ ᎬᏩᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏗᎬᏩᏓᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏩᏗᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Duniyelihistanvno unitsati nvwadvnequo tsiyuhi utsav gvwatinawidvhei; ale nasquo nidigvwadale tsusdi tsiyu unaligowadisei.
english: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏱᎶᎴ ᎤᏃᎴ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎠᏟᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatino uyilole unole, ale dalisdilanegv tsiyuhi atligei, ale hnaquo akaliwohi gesei.
english: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏣᎡ ᎦᎵᎮᎢ, ᎠᎫᏍᏙ ᎤᎫᏍᏓᎡᎢ; ᎬᏩᏰᏍᏔᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᎭ ᏨᏓᏲᏣᏗᏒᏂ?
phonetic: Tsiyuhino oniditlv utsae galihei, agusdo ugusdaei; gvwayestaneno, ale hia nigvwaweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, tlasgo gohusdi yeliha tsvdayotsadisvni?
english: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏁᏃ, ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ, ᏙᏉ; ᎤᏓᏥᎾᏍᏛᎯ ᎿᎭᎵᏍᏓ.  ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏑᎵᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏥᎾᏍᏛᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Duleneno, unole usgatsei, ale hia nuwesele vdali, Doquo; udatsinasdvhi hnalisda.  Ganolvvsgvno usuligotsei, ale utsati udatsinasdvhi nulistanei.
english: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏒᎾ?  ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gadono nitsisgasvna?  Gado digalisdodi nitsohiyusvna igi?
english: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎢᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Utsatino unisgalei, ale hia nidunadaweselei, Gado usdi hia asgaya, nasquoyeno unole ale vdali igvwohiyuhvsga.
english: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢᏃ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᏂᎨᏕᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Isgoniditlvno vdali wunilutse Anigedeli unatseligohi.
english: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏠᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎢ,
phonetic: Tsiyuhino utsaisv gilaquo iyvdv dutlose asgaya dadanisahv nvdayulosvhi gadaha adanvdo uyai,
english: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲᏉ ᎡᎮᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᎸᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi dadanisahvquo ehei; vtla ale nasquo tsudadesvdv gvdi gilo gvwalvsdi yigesei.
english: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᏣᏥᏅᏠᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏣᎦᎸᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛᏃ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏅᏠᏍᏗ ᏓᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏘᏐᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Yanogiyuyeno tsatsinvtlolvhi gesei, ale tsudadesvdv tsagalvstanvhi gesei, tsudadesvdvno dagalisgei, ale diganvtlosdi dasqualisgei; vtla ale gilo gvwadanvtisodi yigesei.
english: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ, ᎦᏚᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲᎢ, ᎤᏪᎷᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏓᏰᎶᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigohilv, svnoyi ale iga, gadusi ale dadanisahvi, uwelugei, ale nvya gvdi adayelohei.
english: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏭᎪᎲ ᏥᏌ, ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno invhiyu wugohv Tsisa, dusqualvtane ale udadolisdanelei,
english: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎩᎾᏓᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᎬᏁᏤᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale asdaya uwelune hia nuwesei; Gado diginadadvdodi nihi Tsisa, wasdv galvladiyu ehi Unelanvhi Uwetsi?  Gvnetseha, Unelanvhi gvneisdaneha, nasgi sgigiliyoisdodiyi nigesvna.
english: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎡᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏂᎯ ᎯᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nuweselei, Ehinugoi nasgi na asgaya, nihi higadaha adanvdo.
english: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᏛᏁᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ?  ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ; ᎣᎩᏣᏔᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Udvdvneno, Gado detsadov?  Uwoselei.  Hiano nuweselei, Sunadatlugi daquadov; ogitsatayeno.
english: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎾᎿᎭᎨᏒ ᏧᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale utsati usdiyetane nahna gesv tsunugowisdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎣᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano odalulodi unitsati sunadatlugi siqua analisdayvnidohei.
english: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏏᏆ ᏗᏁᏙᎲ ᏬᏥᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏙᏥᏴᏏ.
phonetic: Nigadvno anisgina gvwasdiyetane hia naniwesgei, Unelagi siqua dinedohv wotsilohi, nasgi widotsiyvsi.
english: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴᎢ.  ᏗᎦᏓᎭᏃ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ, ᏏᏆ ᏫᏚᏂᏴᏎᎴᎢ; ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎷᎩᏎ ᎤᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ ᎦᏁᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᎢ, (ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡᎢ,) ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏚᏂᎬᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv Tsisa dulisgolvdanelei.  Digadahano didanvdo uninugotsv, siqua widuniyvselei; sunadatlugino unanelugise unigasoase ganetlugi gesv vdali wunalitadinvsei, (tali iyagayvli iyvdv naniei,) ale vdali dunigvtsei.
english: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᏃᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Dinigatiyano unalisei, ale gaduhv wuninonei, ale iyvdv danewadisvi.  Uninugotseno unagatanvse nasgi nulistanvi.
english: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ, ᎤᏬᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏄᏪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano gvwalutselei, ale gvwagohe nasgi anisgina gvwayvlvhi, nasgi sunadatlugi gvwayvlvhi, uwolei, ale dunuwei, ale dohi udanvtei; ale anisgaihei.
english: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ, ᎬᏩᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏏᏆ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino unigohvhi, gvwaninonele nulisdanelv anisgina gvwayvlvhi, ale nasquo siqua nunalisdanelvi.
english: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Ale unalenvhe gvwatayosele udanvsdiyi unatseligohi.
english: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsiyuhino utsanv nasgi anisgina gvwayvlvhi utayosele unelagi uwelisediyi usdawadidasdiyi.
english: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴᎢ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎮᎾ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᎾ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏙᎵᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yulisgolvdanelei Tsisa, hiaquosgini nuweselei, Tsihena ditsenvsv gohusdi ditsvna dinehvi, ale widinohvsi nigav usquanigodi Ugvwiyuhi nitsadvnelvi, ale tsadolitsvi.
english: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎩᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏃᏣᎳᏁ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ-ᎢᎦᏚᎩᏱ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unigiseno, ale ulenvhe dunotsalane Asgohiigadugiyi, nigav usquanigodi Tsisa nudvnelvi; ale nigadv yvwi unisquanigosei.
english: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏙᎤᏪᏐᏨ ᎢᏍᎪᎾ ᏫᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎤᎶᏗ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano taline tsiyuhi douwesotsv isgona wiulutsv, unitsati yvwi gvwadatluwistanei; ale vdali ulodi edohei.
english: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏤᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎤᎪᎲᏃ [ᏥᏌ] ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo ulutse gilo iyusdi nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi, Tsela tsudoidv; ugohvno [Tsisa] dulasgv udanvnei,
english: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎦ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏁᎾ, ᎯᏯᏏᏔᏛᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏁᏍᏗᏃ.
phonetic: Ale utsati usdiyetanei, hia nuwesei; Aquetsi ageyutsa hnaquo ayohusga; aseno inena, hiyasitadvha, nasgi udiwisdiyi, gvnesdino.
english: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unenvseno; ale unitsate yvwi gvwasdawadvsei, ale gvwanenulasdisgei.
english: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎮᎢ,
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi ageyv taladu tsudetiyvdv gvwadalenvdv gigv uwenvehei,
english: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᎦᎾᎦᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎩᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏒᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎫᏱᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎧᏁᏉᎨᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏢᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Ale anigodiyu aniganagati utsati gvwagilvnvhi gesei, ale gohusdi uhv nigadv usvnvhi gese aguyisgvi, aseno vtla osiyu yinulisdanehei, kanequogequosgini utlvgvi;
english: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏅᏘᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏔᏁ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏒᏂᎴ ᎤᏄᏮᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi udvganv Tsisa atsinohesgvi, oniditlv unvtidv nunadvnv uluhistane, ale usvnile unuwvi.
english: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏧᏄᏬᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏓᏆᏒᏂᎸ, ᏯᏆᏗᏫ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nuwesei, Tsunuwoquo nasquo yidaquasvnilv, yaquadiwi.
english: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎᏃ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏗᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv gigv uwenvehv uyohistanei; udolehoseno ayelv udiwasv nasgi utlvgvi.
english: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎢ, ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏅᏘᏛ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏓᏒᏂᎦ ᏗᏆᏄᏬ?
phonetic: Tsisano gilaquo iyvdv udolehosv uwasv gesv udanvwodi gesv unugotsvi, ugatahvse nahna unvtidv anidonavi, ale hia nuwesei, Gago dasvniga diquanuwo?
english: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏕᎩᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino hia nigvwaweselei, Degigowadiha unitsati getsanenulasdisgv, tsigono Gago aquasvniga ihadiha?
english: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏃ ᎤᎦᏖᏃᎴ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Gvwaduwidvno ugatenole ugowadvdiyi nasgi hia iyudvnelvhi.
english: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino ageyv asgaihe ale uwenawisgei, agatahe nulisdanelvi, ulutse ale eladi udanvnelei, ale nigadv duyugodv unonelei.
english: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏇᏥ, ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏣᏢᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei, Aquetsi, tsohiyusv tsadiwisda; nvwadohiyadv tsihena, ale tsadiwasvhi gesesdi tsatlvgvi.
english: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏤᏥ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᎯᏯᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Asiquo kanegei, nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi ganelv nvdayunadalenvhi unilutse hia nuniwesei, Uyohusv tsetsi; gadono asiquo ihiyadeyadodiha dideyohvsgi?
english: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Udvganvquono Tsisa nusdv uniwonisvi, hia nuwesele nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi, Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, tsohiyusesdiquo.
english: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo yulisgolvdanele gvwasdawadvsdiyi, Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani Tsimi dinadanvtli unvsv.
english: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎦᎮ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ulutseno ganelv nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi, ale dugahe unadasuyedv yvwi, ale utsati danatloyihv ale daniyvgvi.
english: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏰᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏣᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ, ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Uyelvno hia niduweselei, Gadono itsadanoyvlisdiha, ale dotsatloyiha?  Vtla yuyohusv ageyutsa, galihaquosgini.
english: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏩᏙᏢᏔᏁᏉᏃ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏐᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᏗᏐᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Igvwadotlvtanequono.  Nigadvno dunugowisonv, hia nasgi ageyutsa udoda ale utsi ale nasgi anehi dutinvse, ale wuyvle nahna ageyutsa disonvi.
english: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒᏃ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᎵᏓ ᎫᎻ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ; ᎯᎨᏳᏣ, ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Uwoyanesvno ageyutsa, hia nuweselei, Talida Gumi; nasgi anetlvtanvhi hia nusdi gadvga; Higeyutsa, gvyoseha, Talehvga.
english: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ; ᏔᎳᏚᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv ageyutsa dulenei, ale uwedolei; taladuyeno iyudetiyvdv gesei.  Utsatanvhino unisquanigosei.
english: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvno dunetsele dunvsdadele gilo udolehohisdiyi nasgi; ale unetsegohusdi ulisdayvdi uninediyi.
english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unugotseno nahnani, ale uwasv utseligohi wulutsei; gvwasdawadidohino gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᎵᏰᎶᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏕᏲᏁ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Unadodaquasgvno uliyelolv, ulenvhe dudeyone digalawiisdiyi; unitsatino gvwadvganelv unisquanigosei, hia naniwesgei, Hatlv agiha hia asgaya hia nasgi igvwadvnedi tsigi?  Ale gado usdi agadovhisdi nasgi atsinelvhi tsigi, nasgi iyusdi usquanigodi tsidulvwisdaneha?
english: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎺᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎨᎦᏓᏑᏯ?  ᎥᎬᏩᏐᏅᏤᎸᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Tlasgo nasgi hia dinesgesgi yigi, Meli uwetsi, Tsimi, ale Tsosi, ale Tsuda, ale Sawani analinvtli?  Ale tsudo tlasgo ani yigegadasuya?  Vgvwasonvtselvgino.
english: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselei; adolehosgi vtla natsilvquodvna yigesoi, utseligohisgininonv uwasv, ale tsuyvwi anehvi, ale uwasv ganelvi.
english: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nahna vtla gohusdi usquanigodi digvwalvwisdanedi yigesei, uwasvsgininonv ilvsgi iyanidv tsunitlvgi dusitadv ale dunvwanvi.
english: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale usquanigose nanohiyuhvsgvna gesvi.  Ale uwedole uduwidv degaduwadisvi dadeyohvsgei.
english: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏏᏙᎴ ᏔᎵᎭ ᏧᎵᎪᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ;
phonetic: Taladuno iyanidv widuyanvhei, ale dunvsidole taliha tsuligonvdv, ale dulisgolvdanele tsuninugowisdiyi digadaha didanvdo;
english: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏠᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ale dunetsele nasgi gohusdi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna unalisdelvdodi anedohvi, adolanvsdi uwasv; vtla degalodi, ale gadu, ale vtsayi dunadatlohvi;
english: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᎳᏑᎸᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunalasulvdiyisgini; ale tlesdi tali yiditsanuwosgesdi.
english: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏣᏅᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎥᏣᏂᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, adanelv ilvhitlv itsiyvhihesdi, nahnaquo itsanvvsgesdi gvni vtsanigi nahnani.
english: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᏓᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gilo niditsadanilvgvna ale nitsadvdasdanehvna igesesdi, hnaquo nahna itsanigisgesdi, ditsalasideni gosdu detsinvgovdisgesdi, nasgi gohiyudisgi unatludisgi.  Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Sodami, ale Gomali, digugododiyi iga gesesdi, utlihiyu nahna gaduhvi.
english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤᏃ, ᏭᎾᎵᏥᏙᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏎ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uninugotseno, wunalitsidone nasgi yvwi ase tsuninetliyvsdi gesv dunadanvdvi.
english: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎢ ᏚᏂᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino duninugowise anisgina, ale goi dunilonetane unitsati tsunitlvgi, ale duninvwanei.
english: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏤᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎡᎶᏛ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᏓᎴᎯᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Elodvno ugvwiyuhi udvgane nasgi atsinohesgvi; dunotsalotseyeno nasgi dudovi; ale hia nuwese Elodv, Tsani Didawosgi dalehisa uyohusvi, ale nasgi nvdigalisdodiha usquanigodi tsideulvwisdaneha.
english: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎯᎠ.  ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno hia naniwesgei, Ilaya hia.  Igadvno hia naniwesgei, adolehosgi hia, ale gilo anadolehosgi gesv nasgiyai.
english: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏂ ᎯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏥᏍᎫᏕᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvsgini udvganv, hia nuwesei; Tsani hia, nasgi ayv tsitsisgudesvgi; nasgi dulehisanv uyohusvi.
english: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏭᏂᏴᎲᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᎸᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ, ᎤᏅᏟ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvyeno uwasv udanvsvhi gese wuniyvhvhi gese Tsani, ale didasdudiyi ulvlvhi gesei, asdvdisdisge Elodisi, unvtli Quiligi udalii; nasgiyeno adayehei.
english: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎡᎶᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎡᏣᏅᏟ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏣᏓᏰᎭ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno hia iyuweselvhi gese Elodv, vtla yiduyugodi etsanvtli udalii tsadayeha.
english: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎠᏍᎦᎨ [ᏣᏂ] ᎠᎴ ᏳᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Elodisi asgage [Tsani] ale yulei; aseno vtla nasgi igvwadvnedi yigesei.
english: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ [ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ,] ᎤᏣᏖ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvyeno ulvquodiyu gese Tsani, agataheyeno udanvtiyu ale nasganvna gesv asgaya, ale ugasayasdiyu gesei; nasgino udvganv [alitsidohvsgv,] utsate dulvwisdanelei, ale ulihelitsvhi advdasdanehei.
english: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎯᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ,
phonetic: Ahidvno nasgi igvdvnedi gesv usqualvhv, nasgi Elodv udenv iyu iga udvnvistane gvwalisdayvnanediyi tsutseli unigvwiyuhi, ale anisgayegvsda, ale digeganelodi Gelili anehi,
english: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛ ᎤᏴᎵᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏂᏜᏓᎢ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏛ, ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏉ ᎮᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᎬᏁᎵᏃ.
phonetic: Nasgino Elodisi uwetsi adv uyvlilv, ale ulisgisv, ale Elodv ale nasgi itsulaha aninidlai osiyu uniyelvnv, ugvwiyuhi hia nuwesele adv, Sgitayosi iyusdiquo helisgvi, dagvnelino.
english: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏎᎵᏓᏁᎴᏃ [ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ,] ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏉ ᎮᎵᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏏ, ᏓᎬᏁᎵᏃ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Uselidaneleno [hia nuwesei,] Iyusdiquo helisgv sgitayosi, dagvnelino, nasquo ayeli iyvdv yigi nahna agigvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏥᏔᏲᎵ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
phonetic: Unugotsvno hia winuwesele utsi, gado datsitayoli?  Hiano nuweselei, Tsani Didawosgi asgoli.
english: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏉᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏴᎵᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏍᎩᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪ.
phonetic: Igvwenvdvquono ulisdi uyvlile ugvwiyuhi ayavi, ale utayole hia nuwesei, Aquaduli gilaquo iyvdv sginediyi, atelidogihi, Tsani didawosgi usgo.
english: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏂᏜᏓᏅᎯ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino utsati tlaquo uyelvnei; aseno uselitanvi, ale nasgi itsulaha unanidlanvhi nvtsulisdotane, vtla gvwageyudodi yigesei.
english: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏅᏎ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎤᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏍᎫᏕᏎ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ,
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv ugvwiyuhi unvse ayawisgi, ale unetse usgo uniyohisdiyi; uwenvseno, ale wusgudese didasdudiyi ayavi,
english: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎴ ᎤᏍᎪ ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ ᎦᎶᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛ ᎤᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᏛᏃ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uyole usgo atelidogihi galodei, ale adv unelei; advno utsi unelei.
english: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏎ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganv, unilutse ale uninese ayelvi, ale atselisdv uninvnei.
english: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎾᏕᏲᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno unadatlisane Tsisa edohvi, ale gvwanonele nigadv nunadvnelidolv, ale nasquo nusdv dunadeyonvi.
english: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏕᎾ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏗᎶᎯ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏣᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏓ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎷᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏁᎨᎢ, ᎥᏞᏃ ᏯᏜᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Idena itsvsvquo iyvdv widilohi inage digesvi, ale tlega itsatsawesolvsda; unitsateyeno aniluge ale danegei, vtleno yadlanvdadisge nasquo unalisdayvdiyi igohidv.
english: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏣᎡᎢ, ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏎ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ.
phonetic: Tsiyuhino unatsaei, unanigise inage wunilose udelidv.
english: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᎾᏂᎩᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎬᏬᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗᏉ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎩᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᏟᏌᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwino gvwanigohe ananigisgvi, ale unitsate gvwoligei, ale eladiquo dunisqualvtane nahna iditlv wunilose degaduwadisv nidodayunilosvhi, degvwanigiyeno, ale wigvwadatlisanelei.
english: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏣᎢᏒ, ᏚᎪᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏓᎾᏤᎳᎬ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏂᎦᏘᏯ; ᎤᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏪᏲᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano utsaisv, dugohe unitsati yvwi, ale duwedolitsei, nvdigalisdodisge awi uninodena danatselagv nehvna tsigeso unigatiya; ulenvheno utsati tsudalenvdv duweyonei.
