english: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏂᏕᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎢᎦ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎶᏐᏂᏗ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ulosonidena gese iga, gvwasdawadidohi gvwalutsele, hia nuniwesei, Ani inagei, ale hnaquo ulosonidi iga.
english: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏘᏰᎵᎯᏍᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏩᏂᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᎯ ᎦᏚ, ᎥᏞᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏂᏰ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Tiyelihisda, nasgi dadaneladisv gvwaduwidv wanilohi, ale degaduwadisvi, ale wuniwahi gadu, vtleyeno gohusdi yaniye unalisdayvdi.
english: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏓᏲᏤᏏ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏚ ᏮᏓᏲᎩᏩᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏲᏤᎳᏍᏔᏂ?
phonetic: Dunetseleno hia niduweselei, Nihi ditselasda.  Hiano nigvwaweselei, Tsigo dayotsesi talitsuqui anigisi tsugvwalodi gadu wvdayogiwasi, ale dodayotselastani?
english: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᏫᏣᎦᏔ.  ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᎯᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩ, ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Witsagata.  Unadolehosvno, hia nuhiwesei, Hisgi, talino atsadi.
english: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏁᏍᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Dunetseleno unanitlvdiyi nigadv itse kanesgohi gesv tsunadatlunvdv.
english: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏁᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᎿᎭᏁᎢ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Unanitlvneno osdv dunadanvhnanei asgohitsuqui, ale hisgasgohi tsunadatlunvdv.
english: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏒ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏰ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ; ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏯᏙᎮᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hisgino gadu dugisv ale tali atsadi dunesv, galvladi widukahnanei, ale ulihelitsei, ale dugvhaluye gadu, ale gvwasdawadidohi dunele tsuninediyi; talino atsadi nigadv duyadohelei.
english: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unalisdayvnei; ale dunolvsei.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏄᏖᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏗᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏣᏗ.
phonetic: Unuteseno uligvhaluyvhi taladu dikalii talutsa, ale nasquo atsadi.
english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᏧᏂᎬᎯ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Nasgino na gadu tsunigvhi hisgi iyagayvli iyvdv nanie anisgaya.
english: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏦᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᏂᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv dunvwistane gvwasdawadidohi tsiyuhi unatsodiyi, ale igvyi tsunisohisdiyi, Quetsayidi wuniluhisdiyi, asiquo uwasv dayelihisdisgv unitsati.
english: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᏃ, ᎣᏓᎸ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Duyelihistanvno, odalv wulose udadolistanvsei.
english: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏥᏳ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏂᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᏙᏱ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv tsiyu vdali ayeli aninisei, uwasvno doyi edohei.
english: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎪᎮᏃ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏪᎯᎲᎢ; ᏩᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎢᏗᏏ ᏗᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ.  ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dugoheno anigiliyogv anigawehihvi; wanigadvno idisi diganolvdisgei.  Nvgineno iyvdv aniyawisgv svnoyi dulutselei, vdali gadui aisei, ale yidulohiselei.
english: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎸᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno wigvwagohv vdali gadui aisvi, utselvnvhi unelisei, ale unelunei.
english: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ.)  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᎠᏴᏉ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: (Nigadvyeno gvwagohei, ale unadeyatanelei.)  Gilaquono iyvdv dulinohetanei, ale hia niduweselei, Ugalisdiquo itsadanvdada; ayvquo; tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᎳᏫᏎᏃ ᏫᏚᏣᏁᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ; ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏎᎵᎪᏤᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏁ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ugilawiseno widutsanele tsiyuhi; ganolvvsgvno useligotsei; ale ulosvstanvhi unadanvtetane dotsunadanvdvi, ale unisquanigosei.
english: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎦᏚ; ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏰᏃ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yidunadanvtele gadu; tsuninawiyeno disdayiyu gesei.
english: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏐᏨᏃ, ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Dunisotsvno, Genisiladi wunilutsei, ale unitaladei.
english: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏣᎢᏒ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏬᎵᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Tsiyuhino unatsaisv gilaquo iyvdv gvwolitsei.
english: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎤᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏚᏂᏂᏙᎴ ᏗᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᏚᏂᏢᏕ, ᏫᏓᏂᏃᎯᎮ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nahna gvwaduwidv unedolei, ale tsunitlvgi duninidole ditsesdogihi dunitlvde, widaninohihe anadvgvga nahna edohvi.
english: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ, ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏓᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᏓᏂᏅᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᎤᎾᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ, ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏄᏮᎢ; ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ilvhitlv wigalugi, tsusdi degaduhv, ale tsudvna degaduhv, ale iyvdv didanelohi gesvi, tsunitlvgi degalanvdv daninvvsgei, ale gvwatayosehe unasvnisdiyi, gadaluyadvquo nasquo unuwvi; nanivno nasgi gvwasvnilvhi dunadiwasgei.
english: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᏦᎴᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Degvwalawitsoleno Aniqualisi, ale gilo iyunasgi dinowelisgi, Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi.
english: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏂᎩᏍᎬ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᎬᏗ, (ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᎦᏛᎦ,) ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dunigohvno igadv gvwasdawadidohi gadu anigisgv digadaha tsunoyeni gvdi, (nasgi nidunasulehvna gadvga,) unisonvtselei.
english: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎪ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Aniqualisiyeno, ale nanivquo Anitsusi, iyuno osdv nidunasulehvna yigi, vtla yinalisdayvhvsgoi, danikahnawadego nuniwesv eti unadenvhi.
english: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏛᏂᎶᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏄᏓᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᏗᎫᎯᎶᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ganododiyi dvnilohi, iyuno nidunasulehvna yigi, vtla yvgvnalisdayvhvga.  Ale utsata nudale gohusdi tsunikahnawadvsdi nunvnelv, nasgi tsulisquidi diguhilovi ale ditelido, ale vtsayidigotlvtanvhi ditelido, ale dinitlvdiyi.
english: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᏑᎴᎲᎾᏉ ᏣᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Aniqualisi ale dinowelisgi igvwadvdvne hia nigvwaweselei; Gadono getsasdawadidohi vtla yidanikahnawadega eti unadenvhi uninetsvi, nasgi nidunasulehvnaquo tsanalisdayvhvsga?
english: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏌᏯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᏓᏅᏗᎭ, ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏂᏚᏅᎿᎭᏕᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Dunetselvno hia niduweselei, Isaya yeliquo nuwesv udolehosv nihi itsatlonasdi itsineisdisgvi, hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Hia nasgi yvwi gvgilvquodiha dunihanegalv danvdiha, tsuninawisgini invhiyu nidunvhnadega ayv naquadvnvi.
english: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno, asequoquo gvgilvquodiha tsidanadeyohvsga danadeyohvsgv yvwiquo uninetsvhi.
english: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏴᏛᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᏗᎫᎯᎶᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏄᏓᎴᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Iyvdvyeno nitsvne Unelanvhi unetsvhi, yvwi uninetsv dikahnawadvsdi nitsvneha, nasgi ditelido ale tsulisquidi diguhilovi; ale utsata nudaleha nasgiya utloyi detsilvwisdanehoi.
english: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎣᏏᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᏥᏥᏲᎢᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, osiquo nitsadvneha tsitsiyoiseha Unelanvhi unetsv, nasgi itsatseli dikahnawadvsdi itsisquanigododiyi.
english: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ; ᎠᎴ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᏎ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Mosiyeno hia nuwesei, Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi; ale, Gilo asgi nvdisgesdi udoda ale utsi, ase uyohuhisdi gesesdi.
english: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎪᏆᏂ, (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬ, ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ,) ᏂᎦᎥ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ; [ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.]
phonetic: Nihisgini hia nitsiweha, Iyuno gilo hia nigawesehesdi udoda ale utsi, Goquani, (nasgi gadvgv, aqualisgolvtanvhi,) nigav getsalisdelvdodi gesv ayv gvsdelisgvi; [nasgi ududaledv gesesdi.]
english: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏫᏓᏛᏂᏏ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᏰᏤᎵᏎᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Ale vtla hnaquo unelagi gohusdi widadvnisi udoda ale utsi yetselisehoi;
english: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᏨᏁᎰ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏨᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏓᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv asequo nitsvneho itsvdisgo nihi itsinetsvi; ale utsati iyudalegi nasgi iyusdidani nitsadvnehoi.
english: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏯᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎵᎩ;
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi widuyanvhv, hia niduweselei, Sgiyadvdasdasi nitsivi, ale itsoligi;
english: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᏫᎯ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᏴᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Vtlano gohusdi yvwihi doyiditlv ehi, uyvha, nasgi gadaha yinuwanehoi; nasgini nvdayunugotsvhi, nasgi gadaha nuwaneho yvwi.
english: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi, nasgi wadvgvga.
english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ ᏭᏴᎸ ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸ ᏴᏫ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Galitsodeno wuyvlv dudanvelv yvwi, gvwasdawadidohi gvwadvdvne datlilosdv ugvwali.
english: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎩ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏳᏴᎯᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Nasquosgo nihi nasgi igai nitsoligvna igi?  Tlasgo yitsigowatiha, nasgi gohusdi doyiditlv ehi nasgi yuyvhiha yvwi gadaha igvwanedi nigesvna gesvi;
english: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᏫᎾᏴᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ?
phonetic: Nasgi unawiyi winayvhihvna gesv iyusdi, usquoliyiquosgini, ale wigalohisdisgvquo, nasgino ganvgalisgv nigav alisdayvdi?
english: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫᎯ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Nasgi na yvwihi unugotsvhi nasgi gadaha nuwaneho yvwi.
english: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏫᏂᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Hawiniyeno nvdayudalenvhi, yvwi unawiyi, didalehvsga uyo adanvtedi gesvi, adayonedi gesvi, udelidv dinisidi gesvi, adahisdi gesvi,
english: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏢᏉᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎿᎭᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ganosgidv gesvi, tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, uyo iyadvnedi gesvi, galonuhedv gesvi, alisotlvisdodi gesvi, advyugedi gesvi, adasotlvisdodiyi, atlvquododiyi, alisgahnawisdi gesvi.
english: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nigadv uyoi hawini didalehvsgoi, ale gadaha nuwaneho yvwi.
english: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ, ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎠᏍᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏗᏍᎦᎶᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano dulenv, Taya ale Sadoni asdv wulutsei, ale adanelv wuyvlv, vtla yudulisge gilo udolehohisdiyi; aseno vtla gvwadisgalodi yigesei.
english: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛᏄᏣ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎢ, ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ:
phonetic: Giloyeno iyusdi ageyv nasgi uwetsi advnutsa gadaha adanvdo uyai, udvganv atsinohesgvi, ulutse ale dulasgv udanvnei:
english: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎪᎢ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏌᎶᏈᏂᏏ ᎨᏎᎢ;) ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏛᏄᏣ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: (Nasgi na ageyv Agoi gesei, Asaloquinisi gesei;) ale nasgi usdiyetane nasgi uwetsi advnutsa asgina unugowisediyi.
english: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏫᏓᏃᎸᎯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᏚ ᏗᎩᎡᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎵ ᏫᏓᏗᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa hia niuweselei, Igvyi diniyoli widanolvhi; vtlayeno osiyu yigi, diniyoli tsunatseli gadu digiediyi, ale gili widadinediyi.
english: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎵ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏂᏅᎪᎠᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino unetse hia nuweselei, Udohiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi; aseno gili gasgilv hawiniditlv diniyoli uninvgoahiselvhi gadu analisdayvdisgoi.
english: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏫ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᏥᎮᎾ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏤᏥᏱ ᎠᏯᎥ ᎤᏄᎪᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei, Nasgi hia tsiniwi winigalisdoda, tsihena; asgina tsetsiyi ayav unugogi.
english: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎢ, ᎤᏪᏥᏃ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsuwenvsv wiulutsv, udolehose asgina unugotsvi, uwetsino atsesdogihi ganvgvi.
english: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎠᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎩᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎶᏎ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ-ᏗᎦᏚᎩᏱ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale taline Taya ale Sadoni asdv unigisv Gelili vdalv wulutsei, ayeli ulose Asgohidigadugiyi sgadugi gesvi.
english: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏧᎵᎡᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᎳ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Igvwatinoheleno gilo tsuliena, ale ganila gawonisgi; ale igvwasdiyetane nasgi usitadisdiyi.
english: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏴᏛᏃ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏓᏰᎵᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᏕᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᏗᎦᎴᏂ ᏚᏐᎾᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏥᏍᏇᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎪ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Iyvdvno wutinvstanv udayelilv unitsati anedohvi, degayesadv digaleni dusonadei, ale dulitsisquei, ale ganogo usvnilei;
english: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎤᎵᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎡᏇᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎭᎵᏍᏚᎢ.
phonetic: Galvladino widukahnanv uliyetanei, ale hia nuweselei, Equeda, nasgi gadvgv halisdui.
english: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎦᎴᏂ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎪ ᎤᎸᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏚᎵᎧᏁᏴᎮ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv digaleni dulisduisei, ale ganogo ulvsdanelvhi dulikaneyvhe, ale osdv uwonisei.
english: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏕᎦᏅᏍᏓᏗᏏ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏓᏂᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Dunvsdadeleno gilo uninonediyi; aseno deganvsdadisi utliquo igai daniyelihisdisgei;
english: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ; ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏂᏕᎬᏁ ᏧᏂᎵᎡᎾ, ᏧᏅᎨᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ulosvstanvhi unisquanigosei, hia naniwesgei, Nigadv osiyu deulvwisdasi; unadvgodiyi nidegvne tsuniliena, tsunvgewino uniwonihisdiyi.
english: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏈᏯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᏥᏌ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Nahiyuno unitsati gesv yvwi tsuquiya gesv iyusdi, ale nunihvna gesv unalisdayvdi, Tsisa widuyanvhv gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei;
english: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ;
phonetic: Gatsiyadoliga unitsati gesvi, nvdigalisdodi hnaquo tsoi iga itsulaha ogedolvi ale nunihvna gesv unalisdayvdi;
english: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᏂᎩᏍᏗᎭ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏯᏁᎦ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎾ, ᏩᎾᎢᏒᏉ ᏱᏓᏂᏩᎾᎦᎶᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏙᏧᏁᏅ.
phonetic: Iyuno yigatsiyanigisdiha dotsunenvsv yanega nunalisdayvnvna, wanaisvquo yidaniwanagalogi; igadvyeno invhiyu dotsunenv.
english: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏱᏓᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏂ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᏛᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino hia nigvwaweselei, Hatlv yidagi gilo nasgi igai gadu ani inagei, hia nasgi yeli gvwanidvdanedi.
english: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᎳᎪ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᏰᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩ.
phonetic: Dudvdvneno hia nuwesei; Ilago gadu detsiyeha?  Hiano nuniwesei, Galiquogi.
english: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ; ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ; ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Dunetseleno unitsati gadohi unanitlvdiyi; galiquogino gadu dugisv, ale ulihelitsv, dugvhaluyei, ale gvwasdawadidohi dunele nasgi igvyiditlv tsuninediyi; igvyiditlvno duninele unitsati yvwi.
english: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏓᏂᏁᎮᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏧᏂᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ilvsgi tsunasdi atsadi daninehei, ulihelitsvno unetse nasgi nasquo igvyiditlv tsuninvdiyi.
english: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ; ᎤᏄᏖᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
phonetic: Unalisdayvneno, ale dunolvsei; unuteseno uligvhaluyvhi utiyvhi galiquogi iyakalii talutsa.
english: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡᎢ; ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏁᏃ.
phonetic: Unalisdayvnvhino nvgi iyagayvli iyvdv naniei; duyelihistaneno.
english: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏁ ᎠᏁᎮ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎵᎻᏄᏓ ᎠᏍᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Igvwenvdvno tsiyuhi utsane anehe gvwasdawadidohi, ale Daliminuda asdv wulutsei.
english: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎮᎸᏁᎢ, ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino unilutse ale unalenvhe gvwadvdvhelvnei, gvwatayosele tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi, gvwagoliyesgei.
english: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯᏃ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎤᎵᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Udanvdogihino hawini uliyetanei, ale hia nuwesei, Gadono gohi hia tsaneha uyelvdv uniyoha?  udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla gvnigesv igegvnedi yigesesdi uyelvdv hia gohi tsaneha.
english: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏅ, ᎠᏍᎪᎾ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Dudanvelvno, ale taline tsiyuhi utsanv, asgona wulosei.
english: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ] ᎤᏅᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎾᏕᏅᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎶᏒᏍᏕ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏂᎸ ᏥᏳᎯ.
phonetic: [Gvwasdawadidohino] unvgewisvhi gese gadu tsunadenvdiyi, vtla ale yulosvsde saquo gadu unilv tsiyuhi.
english: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Dunetseleno hia nuwesei, Itsiyawisgesdi, Aniqualisi unatseli agododi itseyadotsehesdi, ale elodi utseli agododi.
english: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᏚ ᏂᏗᏗᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unvsvno gesv unalinohele, hia nuniwesei, Nvdigalisdodiha gadu nididiyehvna gesvi.
english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏃᎮᎭ ᎦᏚ ᏂᏗᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎩ?  ᎠᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ?
phonetic: Tsisano udolehosv hia niduweselei, Gadono itsalinoheha gadu niditsiyehvna gesv iyusdi?  Asiquosgo nitsadolehosgvna igi, ale nitsoligvna igi?  Asiquosgo asdaya nidetsvnv ditsinawi?
english: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎧᏅᏍᎪ, ᏂᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ?  ᏕᏥᎵᎷᎦᏍᎪ, ᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎾᏍᎪ ᎢᎩ?
phonetic: Detsikanvsgo, nitsigowatisgvnano igi?  Detsililugasgo, nitsadvgisgvnano igi?  Ale nitsanvdadisgvnasgo igi?
english: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᏓᎩᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎢᏧᏖᏎᎢ?  ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᎬᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hisgi gadu dagigvhaluyv hisgi iyagayvli detsinelv, ilago iyakalii talutsa uligvhaluyvhi itsutesei?  Taladu igvwoselei.
english: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ [ᎦᏚ] ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎢᏧᏖᏎᎢ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Galiquogino [gadu] nvgi iyagayvli detsinelv, ilago iyakalii talutsa uligvhaluyvhi itsutesei?  Galiquogi unadvnei.
english: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gado galisdodiha nitsoligvna tsigi?
english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏇᏣᏱᏗᏃ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ; ᏗᎨᏫᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Quetsayidino wulutsei; digewino asgaya gvwatinohelei, ale unitayosele nasgi usvnisdiyi.
english: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎨᏫᏃ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ; ᏗᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏥᏍᏋ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎯᎪᏩᏛᏗᎭ?  ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Digewino uwoyanesv, gaduhv unugowisei; digadolino dulitsisquv, ale dusitadv, gohusdisgo higowadvdiha?  Uwoselei.
english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᏁᎩᎭ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Dukahnanvno, hia nuwesei, Yvwi gatsigowatiha anegiha detlugv nasgiyai.
english: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏏᏔᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏓᎪᏩᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline digadoli dusitadei, ale tsukanodiyi nuwanelei; ale udiwasei, ale naniv osiyu dagowadisgei.
english: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᏣᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ ᎯᏃᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ale unetsele tsuwenvsv wulohisdiyi, hia nuwesei, Tlesdi digaduhv witsayvlvgi, ale tlesdi gilo gaduhv ehi hinonelvgi.
english: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ; ᏩᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏚᏛᏛᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎬᏉᏎᎰ ᏴᏫ?
phonetic: Tsisano unugotse ale nasgi gvwasdawadidohi, Sisaliyi Quiligi degaduhv wunilosei; wanaisvno dudvdvne gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Gago gvquoseho yvwi?
english: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎳᏯ [ᎠᎾᏗᎭ;] ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei, Tsani Didawosgi; igadvsgini Ilaya [anadiha;] igadvno, Gilo iyusdi anadolehosgi.
english: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᎾᏃ ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ?  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Nihinano gago sgiyoseha?  Quidano unetsv hia nuweselei, Galonedv nihi.
english: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Dunetseleno nasgi gilo uninonediyi nigesvna.
english: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᏪᏲᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩ ᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏲᎢᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ulenvheno duweyonei, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi utsati tsudalenvdv ugi liyoisdiyi; ale gvwayoisedi gesv dinilawigi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi, ale atsiisdiyi gesvi, tsoineno iga tsulehisodi gesvi.
english: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᎲ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia gvnigesv nuwesei.  Quidano uyanvhv ulenvhe ugvsgolvnei.
english: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ ᏎᏓᏂ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᎭ, ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno ugatahvsv, ale gvwasdawadidohi dukahnanv, Quida ugvsgolvnei, hia nuwesei, Aquasohadv halehvga Sedani; vtlayeno Unelanvhi utseli gesv osiyu yitsayelvha, yvwisgini unatseli gesvi.
english: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎾᏩᏛ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Widuyanvhvno yvwi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Gilo udulisgesdi agisdawadvsdiyi, uwasv adadayihesdi, ale uwasv utseli tsudanawadv ayisgesdi, ale agisdawadegesdi.
english: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Giloyeno udulisgesdi gvnv usdelvdiyi, nasgi uyohusehesdi; gilosgini gvnv uyohusehesdi ayv ale osdv kanohedv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ?
phonetic: Gadoyeno yunequotsi yvwi, iyuno nigvnadv elohi utseli yinulistanv, uwasvno udanvdo yuyohuselv?
english: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ?
phonetic: Ale gado yahvga yvwi yiganetliyvsda udanvdo?
english: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏓᏑᏴ ᎠᏂ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Giloyeno aquadehosgesdi ayv, ale ayv tsinegvi, udasuyv ani dinadayonehi ale anisgana anehvi, nasgi nasquo yvwi Uwetsi udehohisdi gesesdi, galutsvha unuwosdesdi galvquodiyu gesv Udoda utseliga, anehesdi getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi.
english: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏓᏂᏙᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, nasgi gilo ani tsidanidoga, vtla yvdvnadolehosi ayohuhisdi gesvi, gvni unigohvhi gesesdi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ulinigidiyu gesv galutsvha.
english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎢᏅᏃ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏚᎿᎭᎷᏔᏁ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Sudalino winusvlv Tsisa dutinvse Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani, invno igati odalv duhnalutane iyvdv unvsv gesvi; ale udanetliyvse anigatahvi.
english: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏄᏬᏃ ᏚᏔᎷᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏁᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏃᏥ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᎩᎶᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᏁᎬ ᏱᏂᏙᎦᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Tsunuwono dutalugisgei, utsati tsunegiyu gesei vnotsi tsinunegiyv nasgiyai; nasgi vtla gilo digvgilosgi ani elohi ehi nasgi itsunegv yinidogagvga.
english: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎴ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnigesvno nigvwanadvnele Ilaya ale Mosi; Tsisano gvwalinohedisgei.
english: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏕᏙᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏫᏙᏥᎵᏦᏛᎦ; ᏌᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Quidano unetsv hia nuwesele Tsisa, Tadeyohvsgi, osiyu ani tsidedoha; ale tsoi widotsilitsodvga; saquo nihi tsatseliga, saquono Mosi utseliga, saquono Ilaya utseliga.
english: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yagatahe iyuwesdiyi; utsatiyeno anisgaihei.
english: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎶᎩᎸᏃ ᎤᏄᏢᏔᏁᎢ; ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Ulogilvno unutlvtanei; kanegvno ulogilv tsunanugotsei, hia nigawesgei, Hia nasgi tsigeyui Aquetsi; nasgi etsadvdasdasi.
english: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎾᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv dunakahnanidolv, vtla hnaquo gilo yunigohei, Tsisa uwasv, ale unvsv.
english: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏏᏗᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunigasoasidisvno odalvi, dunetsele nasgi gilo uninonediyi nigesvna nusdv unigohvi, gvni yvwi Uwetsi uyohusv tsulehisanvhi gesesdi duwoselei.
english: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv unagasayastanei, danadadvdvhvsge gadvgv ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi.
english: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, gadono dinowelisgi Ilaya igvyi dagalutsi tsanadisgoi?
english: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᎯᏐᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏓᏰᏥᏰᎸᏂ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselei, Ilaya udohiyuhi igvyi uluhisdi, ale nigadv uwotlvhisodi; ale nasquo hia nigvnvgowela yvwi Uwetsi atsinohesgvi, nasgi utsati tsudalenvdv ugiliyoisdi gesesdi, ale asequo dayetsiyelvni.
english: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha, Ilaya udohiyuhi ulutsv, ale nusdv unadulisgv nigvwanelv, nasgiya nigvnv gowelv nasgi atsinohesgvi.
english: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏡᏫᏍᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏛᎮᎸᎢᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino anedohv ulutsv, unitsati dugohe gvwanadatluwisdei, ale dinowelisgi gvwanadvdvhelvisgei.
english: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎬᏩᎪᎲ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏩᏗᏝᎣᎮᎸᏃ ᎬᏩᏲᎵᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv nigadv yvwi, gvwagohv, utsati unisquanigosei; gvwaditlaohelvno gvwayolilei.
english: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏕᏣᏛᏛᎮᎸᎥᏍᎦ ᏚᏬᏎᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Dudvdvneno dinowelisgi, gado detsadvdvhelvvsga duwoselei?
english: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᎢ;
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi unitsati gesv gela unetsv hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvyatinohisi aquetsi, uwagewi adanvdo uwei;
english: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎤᏱᎶᎯᏏ ᎤᎩᎸᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᎭᏬᎢᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎸᏓᎩᏍᎪ ᏕᎦᏄᏙᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏕᎯᎰᎢ; ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎦᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᏉ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno uyilohisi ugilvsgoi; ale dahawoihoi, ale degalvdagisgo deganudogvi, ale ulvdehihoi; getsasdawadidohino gatsitayoselv uninugowisdiyi; aseno uninulvnvquo.
english: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏤᎸᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, Ᏺ!  ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ!  ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏂ ᎯᏯᏘᏃᎦ.
phonetic: Unetselvno, hia nuwesei, Yo!  nitsohiyusvna gohi tsitseha!  ilago igohidv itsvyeladidohesdi?  Ilago igohidv unelagi itsvyelisehesdi?  Ani hiyatinoga.
english: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎮᎴᏃ; ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎩᎸᏁᎢ; ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎤᏅᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎭᏬᎢᎲ ᎠᎵᏗᏒᏂᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Unatinoheleno; ugohvno gilaquo iyvdv adanvdo ugilvnei; eladino unvtsei, ale dahawoihv alidisvnihei.
english: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ?  ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏲᎵᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Udvdvneno udoda, Ilago nigohigi nasgi hia igvwalisdanelvhi?  Uwoselei.  Ayoliquo gesvi, udvnei;
english: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏑᏱ ᎤᏓᎡᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏍᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Yanogiyuno atsilvyi ale asuyi udaegoi, nasgi uhisdiyi; iyusgininonv gohusdi getsadvnedi gesesdi, sgisdoligi, ale sgisdelv.
english: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏰᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Iyuno getsohiyudi gesesdi, nigadiyu gohusdi igayegadvnedi gohiyuhvsgi.
english: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ; ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᏏ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv ayoli udoda uwelunei, ale digvgasawoihi hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, goiyuhvsga; sgisdelvsi naquohiyusvna gesvi.
english: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎬ ᎠᎾᏓᏟᏏᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᏤ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏨᎨᏩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᎡᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎬᏁᏤᎭ, ᎡᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎯᏴᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv nasgi unitsati ananelugisgv anadatlisisgvi, usgatse gadaha adanvdo, hia nuweselei, Tsvgewa ale ditsaliena adanvdo, gvnetseha, ehinugoi, ale tlesdi hnaquo ilvhiyu tsihiyvli.
english: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ] ᎤᏪᎷᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎩᎸᏅ, ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: [Adanvdono] uwelunv, ale utsati ugilvnv, unugotsei; ale uyohusvhiquo nasgiya gesei; nasgi iyusdi unitsate, ayohuhi, anadisgei.
english: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ, ᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno tsisa uwoyanesv, duletanei, ale dulenei.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ ᏫᎤᏴᎸ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏲᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ?  ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Galitsodeno wiuyvlv, gvwasdawadidohi unvsv gesv gvwadvdvnei, Gadono ayv vtla gayotsinugowisdi yigesei?  Unadvnei.
english: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏰᎦᏄᎪᏩ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Hia nasgi iyusdi vtla yvgayeganugowa, gvni adadolistanvhi ale amatli gvnvhi tsigesoi.
english: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unanigisvno nahnani, Gelili ayeli unilosei; vtlano yudulisge gilo udolehohisdiyi.
english: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏪᏲᏁᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᏥᏲᎯ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᎯᏏ ᏴᏫ. ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏙᏛᎠᎴᎯᏌᏂ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Duweyoneyeno gvwasdawadidohi, ale hia niduweselei, yvwi Uwetsi datsiyohi degetsiyohisi yvwi. ale dagvwali; ale oni hnaquo atsilvhi gesesdi, dodvalehisani tsoine iga.
english: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎤᎾᏛᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi nuwesv ale anisgaihe unadvdvdiyi.
english: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏆᏂᏃ ᎤᎷᏥᎴᎢ; ᎦᎵᏦᎦᏃ ᎠᏯᎥ ᏚᏛᏛᏁ, ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ Ꭰ ᏗᏓᎢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gequanino ulutsilei; galitsogano ayav dudvdvne, Gado nasgi tsitsinohesgv itsvsv gesv a didaisvi.
english: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ; ᏗᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno elaweyiquo unvsei; dinaisvno aninohesge unvsv gesv nasgi utli atsilvquodiyu gesvi.
english: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏅᏃ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎠᎦᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Uwenvno, taladu iyanidv widuyanvhei, ale hia niduweselei, iyuno gilo igvyi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi, nasgi oniyi agaledodi gesesdi nanivi, ale naniv gvwanvsidohi gesesdi.
english: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎵᏃ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ, ᎠᏂᏅ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ; ᎤᏄᎶᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Ayolino wuyanvhv, aninv ayeli uwekanei; unulolvno hia niduweselei,
english: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo asiyvwi hia iyunasdi diniyoli dadanilvgesdi ayv ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ayv daquadanilvgesdi; gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, vtla ayv yidaquadanilvgesdi, nvdvginvsidvsgini dadanilvgesdi.
english: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎩ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎭ; ᎣᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩᏃ ᏂᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsanino unetselei, hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigohvgi asiyvwi anisgina deganugowisgvgi detsadov gvdisgvgi; vtlano yigisdawadidoha; otsinvsdadelvgino nigisdawadegvna gesv iyusdi.
english: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎭ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎬᎩᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno tsisa hia nuwesei, Tlesdi etsinvsdadelvgi; vtlayeno yeha gilo daquadov gvdisgi usquanigodi tsulvwisdanehi, nasgi igvwenvdv usonv gvgineisdodi.
english: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᎪᏁᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno nasgi nigatludisgvna tsigeso, nasgi igaligonehi gesoi.
english: For he that is not against us is on our part.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᎹ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᏁᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno ama ulisquidi akalii itsaditasdi itsinenehi ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, Galonedv etsatseli gesv iyusdi, udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, vtla uyohusedi yigesesdi agaguyvedi gesvi.
english: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏙᎪᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ ᏯᏥᏯᏝᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏱᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅ.
phonetic: Ale gilo asiyvwi hia tsunasdi gesv nasgi tsigvquohiyuhvsga dogodesdisgesdi, utli osiyu iyulisdanedi asdosgi nvya yatsiyatlanv, ale amequohi yiwagadainv.
english: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏰᏂ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏣᎪᎳᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏱᏫᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᎨᎰᏯᏗ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏱᏫᏣᏴᎸ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎦᎬᏜᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Iyu ale tsoyeni detsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi; utli osiyu itsalisdanedi tsagolani gvnidv digesv yiwitsayvlv, ano itsula digehoyadi tsvsgino yiwitsayvlv, nahna atsilvyi gagvdladisdi nigesvna;
english: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᏂᎦᎵᏬᎬᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahna unatseli tsisgoyv nigaliwogvna digesvi, ale atsilv nigvtlosgvna digesvi.
english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏙᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎯᏲᎤᎵ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏱᏫᏣᏴᎸ, ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᎨᏣᎳᏍᎩ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏱᏪᏣᏓᎢᏅ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎦᎬ ᏜᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Iyu ale tsalasideni dotsodesdisgesdi, hisqualisgesdi; utliyeno osiyu itsalisdanedi hiyouli gvnidv digesv yiwitsayvlv, ano itsula digetsalasgi tsvsgino yiwetsadainv, nahna atsilvyi gagv dladisdi nigesvna;
english: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᏂᎦᎵᏬᎬᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Nahna unatseli tsisgoyv nigaliwogvna digesvi, ale atsilv nigvtlosgvna.
english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᏙᏦᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏱᎧᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏱᏫᏣᏴᎸ ᎠᏃ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏱᏘᎧᏅ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏱᏪᏣᏓᎢᏅ;
phonetic: Iyu ale higadoli dotsodesdisgesdi, hadagatedoisgesdi; utliyeno osiyu itsalisdanedi saquoquo yikanv Unelanvhi utseligohi yiwitsayvlv ano itsula yitikanv tsvsgino atsilvyi yiwetsadainv;
english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᏂᎦᎵᏬᎬᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahna unatseli tsisgoyv nigaliwogvna digesvi, ale atsilv nigvtlosgvna digesvi.
english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏗ ~ᎠᎹ ᎨᏥᏅᏝᏰᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ~ᎠᎹ ᎦᏅᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno atsilv gvdi ~ama getsinvtlayedi gesesdi, ale nigav atsilvgelasdi ~ama ganvliyedi gesesdi.
english: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎹ ᎣᏏᏳ; ᎠᏎᏃ ~ᎠᎹ ᏳᏥᏍᎪᎸ ᎦᏙ ᏱᏨᎦ ᏄᏥᏍᎪᎸᎾ ᏱᏂᏨᎦ?  ~ᎠᎹ ᎢᏥᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ama osiyu; aseno ~ama yutsisgolv gado yitsvga nutsisgolvna yinitsvga?  ~Ama itsilotsvhi gesesdi, ale dohiyi nitsvnesdi itsehvi.
english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲᎢ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᏦᏓᏂ ᎠᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ ᏧᎶᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏟᏌᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏪᏲᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano dulenv, Tsudiyi gada ahvi ulutsei, Tsodani asgoniditlv tsulohistanei; ale unitsati yvwi taline igvwadatlisanelei; ale iyudvnedi gesv nudvnelei, taline duweyonei.
english: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ?  ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino gvwalutselv gvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei, Duyugodisgo asgaya udainvdiyi udalii?  Gvwagoliyesgei.
english: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕ ᎢᏥᏁᏤᎴ ᎼᏏ?
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nisuweselei, Gado usde itsinetsele Mosi?
english: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎼᏏ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁ ᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᏙᎦᎴᏅᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei, Mosi ulisgolvtane gowelodiyi dogalenvhvi, ale adainvdiyi.
english: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᏪᎳᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv, hia niduweselei, Disdayiyu gesv iyusdi ditsinawi hia nasgi dikahnawadvsdi itsowelanelei;
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏢᏅᏅᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏚᏬᏢᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Didalenisgvsgini uwetlvnvnvi, Unelanvhi asgaya ale ageyv duwotlvnei.
english: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏕᎬᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᏜᏓᏩᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi asgaya degvdegesdi udoda ale utsi, ale udalii adlawasdisgesdi;
english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino anitali saquoquo gesesdi uniquedalvi; nasgino vtla hnaquo anitali yigi, saquoquosgini uniquedalvi.
english: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎦᎴᏅᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi tsuwudatanvhi tlesdi yvwi tsugalenvtanvgi.
english: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᎥ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Galitsodeno aniyav gvwasdawadidohi taline igvwadvdvne nasgi ugvwali.
english: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᏓᎡᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gilo udalii adaegesdi, ale nvwadale adayegesdi, nasgi adayonehesdi asganvtsehesdi nasgi.
english: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎠᏓᎡᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏓᎾᏤᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyu ale ageyv uyehi adaegesdi, ale nvwadale danatsegesdi, nasgi adayonehesdi.
english: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏍᏗᏃ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ; ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏘᏃᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Tsunasdino diniyoli degvwatinohelei, nasgi tsusvnisdiyi; gvwasdawadidohino dunigvsgolvne nasgi tsunatinolvhi.
english: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏒᏍᎦ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏕᏤᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisasgini ugohv utsati svsga uyelvnei, ale hia niduweselei, Unelagi detselisehesdi tsunasdi diniyoli gvgilutsediyi, ale tlesdi yiditsinvsdadehesdi; nasgiyeno nunasdi Unelanvhi utseligohi.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᎿᎭᏱᏮᎬᏴᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, iyuno gilo Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nidadanilvgvna igesesdi nasgiya ayoli tsidadanilvgoi, vtla nahna yiwvgvyvha.
english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏒᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dunesvno ale dusitadv, osdv dunetselei.
english: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎦᏅᏅ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏗᏠᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Unigisvno ganvnv wulutsv, gilo iyusdi uditloelvgi, ale duliniquanvnelvgi, udvdvne hia nuweselei, Hosdv Tadeyohvsgi, gado dagadvneli ulisquadisdi nigesvna gvnidv aquatseli iyulisdodiyi?
english: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎰᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ ᎠᏴ?  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Gadono hosdv isquoseha ayv?  Vtla gilo osdv yigi, saquo uwasvhiyu, nasgi Unelanvhi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ, ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ ᏕᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dehigataha dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi, Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi, Tlesdi tsadalvgi, Tlesdi tsanosgisvgi, Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi, Tlesdi tsadalonuhelvgi, Tsadoda ale tsatsi dehilvquodesdi.
english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᏥᏧᏣ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, hia nasgi nigadv dagisquanigotanv tsitsutsa gesv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏣᎷᎳ; ᎮᎾ ᏫᎾᏚᎦ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏣᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎩᏁᎸᎭ, ᏦᏒᏃ ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏖᏒᎭ, ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎯᏴᎲᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano dukahnanv, ugeyuhiyu nulistanei, ale hia nuweselei, Sudalegi tsalula; hena winaduga nigav gohusdi tsanavi, ale uyo iyunadvhnadegi ginelvha, tsosvno witsahesdi tsugvwalodi; ale tesvha, tsudahnawadv hiyvhvha, ale sgisdawadesvha.
english: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᎿᎭᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Uyono uyelvne nasgi natsiweselv, ale ehisdi gvwadanvti udanvsei; utsatiyeno uhnaei.
english: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᏓᏯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᎲᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano uduwidv dukahnanidolv, hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Nasdaya tsugvwalodi unihi Unelahvhi utseligohi wuniyvsdiyi.
english: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏥᏲᎵ.  ᎾᏍᏓᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwasquanigosele nasgi nuwesvi.  Aseno Tsisa taline iunetsv, hia niduweselei, Ditsiyoli.  nasdaya nasgi genvisdi gesv analisgasdodisgi, Unelanvhi utseligohi wuniyvsdiyi.
english: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᎻᎵ ᏴᎩ ᎦᏌᏁᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utli ahidiyu gemili yvgi gasanenadvdiyi ugadvlehisdiyi, ano uwehnai yvwi Unelanvhi utseligohi wuyvsdiyi.
english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎦᎪᎨ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ?
phonetic: Ulosvstanvhino unisquanigosgei, hia nidanadawesehei, Gagoge yeli gayetsisdelvdi?
english: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi dukahnanv, hia nuwesei, Yvwi gesv nasgi igvdvnedi nigesvna, Unelanvhisgini gesv vtla; Unelanvhiyeno gesv nigav gohusdi igvdvnedi.
english: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎣᎬᏕᏦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida ulenvhe hia nuweselei, Gvniyuquo ayv nigadiyu ogvdetsonv, ale nihi itsvsdawadenv.
english: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏮᏕᏨᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla gilo yeha nasgi uwvdetsvhi igesesdi adanelvi, ale analinvtli, ale tsudo, ale udoda, ale utsi, ale udalii, ale tsuwetsi, ale dulogesvi, ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ale osdv kanohedv nvdigalisdodisgesdi,
english: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗ; ᏐᎢᏱᏃ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi gohi gesv atsinedi nigesvna gesv asgohitsuqui iyuwagudi ulosvsdi dadanelvi, ale analinvtli, ale tsudo, ale tsutsi, ale tsuwetsi, ale degalogesvi, agiliyoisdi gesv tali udvdi; soiyino digesv ulisquadisdi nigesvna gvnidv.
english: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎣᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno unitsata nasgi igvyi tsigi, oni gesesdi; onino tsigi, igvyi gesesdi.
english: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏅᏅᏃ ᎠᎾᎢᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏣᏂᎦᏖᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏚᏪᏅᎡᎴᎢ; ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ.  ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏃᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ganvnvno anaise Tsilusilimi tsanigatei; tsisano igvyi duwenvelei; unisquanigoseno; nasgino analisdawadisv anisgaihei.  Talineno duyanvhv taladu iyanidv, ulenvhe dunonele nasgi iyulisdanelidasdi gesvi.
english: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ;] ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏗᎦᏘ; ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏙᏓᏰᏥᏲᏏ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎵ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ;
phonetic: [Hia nigawesgei;] Gvniyuquo Tsilusilimi widigati; ale yvwi Uwetsi dodayetsiyosi nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi ale dinowelisgi dodagetsiyohiseli; ale dodagvwugodaneli uyohuhisdiyi, ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi widodvniyohiseli;
english: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎬᏩᎵᏥᏍᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵ; ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ.
phonetic: Ale dagvwasotlvistani, ale dagvwalivnili, ale dodagvwalitsisqui, ale dagvwali; tsoineno iga taline dodvaleni.
english: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎻᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏍᎩᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏍᎩᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏛᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsimino ale Tsani, Tsequidi tsuwetsi gvwalutselei, hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, sginaduliha isginadvnediyi nusdv isdvtayosedi gesvi.
english: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᏓᏚᎵ ᎢᏍᏛᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gadono isdaduli isdvyadvnediyi?
english: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎩᏂᏗᏱ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂᏗᏢ, ᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei, Sginalisgolvdasi, nasgi tsoginidiyi, asiyvwi higatisiditlv, soino higasganiditlv, tsatseli galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏗᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ.  ᏥᏌ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏍᏓᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏰᏍᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa hia niduweselei, vtla yisdigataha nusdv isditayohihvi.  Tsisa yeliquo gesdaditasdi ulisquidi nasgi aquaditasdi tsigi?  Ale digayesdawosdi nasgi didawosdi gesv nasgi vquawosdodi tsigi?
english: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏓᏍᏓᏗᏔᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᏰᏍᏓᏬᏍᏔᏂ;
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei, yeliquo.  Tsisano hia niduweselei, Udohiyuhi dasdaditahi ulisquidi nasgi ayv aquaditasdi tsigi, ale didawosdi gesv ayv vquawosdodi tsigi, nasgi dodayesdawostani;
english: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏉᎸ ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ
phonetic: Uwediyisgini aquolv tsigatisi iditlv, ale tsigasgani iditlv, vtla ayv aquadanedi yigi; unvsvsgini nasgi gegadvnvisdanelvhi tsigi
english: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏚᏂᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Asgohino iyanidv unadvganv, unalenvhe utsati esga duniyelvnanele Tsimi ale Tsani.
english: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏅᏁᎰᎢ; ᏧᏂᎸᏉᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno tsisa widuyanvhv hia niduweselei; Itsigataha nasgi unigvwiyuhi getsiyelvi gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, digvwananelododiyi nanvnehoi; tsunilvquodino gesv gvwanadalinehidehoi.
english: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihisgini itsehv vtlesdi nasgi yinitsvnesdi; gilosgini atsilvquodi iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi, nasgi etsinvsidasdi gesesdi.
english: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo nihi nitsadvnv nugvwiyusv iyulisdodiyi udulisgesdi, nasgi nigadv gvwanvsidohi gesesdi.
english: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎷᏨ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏅ ᏧᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎫᏴᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Nasquoyeno yvwi Uwetsi vtla yulutsv gohusdi agadvnediyi, gohusdisgini udadvnediyi, ale gvnv tsuyohisdiyi tsuguyvdodiyi unitsati.
english: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎵᎪᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎵᎪ ᎢᎤᏄᎪᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᏗᎨᏫ ᏆᏗᎻᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎻᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎠᏚᎳᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tseligono unilutsei, ale nasgi Tseligo iunugotsv ale nasgi gvwasdawadidohi, ale unitsati yvwi, digewi Quadimiya, nasgi Dimiya uwetsi, uwole nvnohulodi aduladisgei.
english: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏪᎷᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᏌ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Udvganvno nasgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi gesvi, ulenvhe uwelune, hia nuwesei, Dewi Uwetsi, Tsisa, sgidoligi.
english: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᎬᏩᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎴ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎤᏮᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsateno gvwagvsgolvne gvwanetsele elaweyi uwvdiyi; aseno utliquo igai uwelunei, Dewi Uwetsi sgidoligi, adisgei.
english: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᏤ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᏗᎨᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ; ᏗᏣᏯᏂᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano ulewistanv unetse watsiyanvdiyi.  Uniyanvheno digewi, hia nuniweselei, Ugalisdiquo hadanvdada; talehvga; ditsayaniha.
english: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏓᎢᏅ ᎤᏄᏬ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏭᎷᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino udainv unuwo dulenei, ale Tsisa wulutselei.
english: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵ ᎬᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᏗᎨᏫᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ [ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ.]
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Gado tsaduli gvyadvnediyi?  Digewino hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, vagigowadvdiyi [aquaduliha.]
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎮᎾᏉᏃ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏍᏕᎸ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Henaquono; tsohiyusv tsasdelv.  Gilaquono iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nulistanei, ale usdawadvse Tsisa aisvi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎾᎥ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏒᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎣᎵᏩᏲᎯ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Tsilusilimino nav wunilutsv nasgi Svgadohi ale Quediniyi iyvdv, Oliwayohi usahilvi, anitali gvwasdawadidohi dunvsei,
english: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏍᏕᎾ Ꮎ ᏕᏍᏗᏙᎬ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ ᏫᏍᏗᏣᎯ; ᏫᏍᏗᏴᎸᏉᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᏓᏰᏍᏗᏩᏛᎯ ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎨᎵᏌᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕᏒᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏍᏓᏘᏁᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Isdena na desdidogv tsuyugodi tsvdigaduha wisditsahi; wisdiyvlvquono nahnani, dayesdiwadvhi digalianvhidv agina gelisadesdi, nasgi vtla gilo yvwi ugilvtanvhi yigi; esdelisadesvha ale tsesdatinesvha.
english: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏍᏓᏛᏁᎭ ᎢᏍᏙᏎᎸᎭ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᎭ, ᎢᏍᏓᏛᏅᎭ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏍᏓᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo Gadono nasgi nisdadvneha isdoselvha?  Ugvwiyuhi uduliha, isdadvnvha; gilaquono iyvdv dodayuyosi ani esdatinohisdiyi.
english: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎨᎵᏌᏕ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᏓᏠᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏁᎵᏌᏕᏎᏃ.
phonetic: Unenvseno, ale wuniwadvhe agina gelisade galohisdiyulodi doyiditlv, nahna deganvnv datlosgvi; unelisadeseno.
english: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏂᏙᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕ ᎠᎩᏫ?
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi nahna dinidogi hia niduniweselei, Gadono iesdelisade agiwi?
english: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ:  ᏚᏂᏲᏎᏃ.
phonetic: Ale nasgiyaquo Tsisa nuwesv unetsv niduniweselei:  duniyoseno.
english: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎾᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏢᏁᎴᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aginano Tsisa unatinohelei, ale tsunanuwo dunitlvnelei; Tsisano ugilvtanei.
english: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏄᏰᏍᏛᏁᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᏡᎬ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏃᎯ ᏚᏂᎳᎨᏯᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsateno tsunanuwo nvnohi dunuyesdvnei; igadvno detlugv dunvnigalvhei, ale nvnohi dunilageyadvnei.
english: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᎢ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎠᏁᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎰᏌᎾ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᏓ.
phonetic: Igvyii anegi, ale oni anegi, unelugei, hia naniwesgei, Hosana, Galvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa deudosdv tsigaluhisdida.
english: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏫ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏚᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ; ᎰᏌᎾ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyu gesesdi Dewi igidoda utseli ugvwiyuhi gesvi, nasgi Yihowa dudosdv tsigaluhisdiha; Hosana wasdv galvladiyu.
english: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏒᎯᏴᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎠᏁᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Tsisano Tsilusilimi wuyvlei, ale utanvdigalawiisdiyi wuyvlei; hnaquono gvwaduwidv dukahnanidolv nigadv tsudalenvdv dukahnanv, ale hnaquo usvhiyvyi gesei, unugotse Quediniyi wulose anehe taladu iyanidv.
english: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᏧᏂᎶᏒ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno Quediniyi tsunilosv agonu uyosisgei;
english: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᎪᎮᏃ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᏡᎨ ᏒᎦᎳᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᏯᏎᎦᎩ ᏱᏥᏩᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏔ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎢ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᏒᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏳᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᏒᎦᏔᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Wugoheno ge iyvdv ditluge svgalaiyusdi, ulisdusei, wulutsei, yasegagi yitsiwadv gohusdi yuta uwelisei; nahnano wulutsv vtla gohusdi yuwadvhe ulisdusvquo uwasv; vtlayeno asi yusqualvhe svgataiyunasdi unvnisdiyi.
english: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎠᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ.  ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Tlesdi gilo ilvhiyu tsiagi nihi tsadatanvhi gohi iyudalenvdv.  Gvwasdawadidohino unadvganei.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏔᏅ-ᏗᎦᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᎡᎥᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏔᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎷᏆᏗᏅᏎ ᏚᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏟᏴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ;
phonetic: Tsilusilimino unilutsei; Tsisano utanvdigatawiisdiyi wuyvlv, ulenvhe dunugowise aninadegi ale uniwaevsgi nahna utanvdigalawiisdiyi, ale duluquadinvse dunisgilv adelv dinitliyvsgi, ale unanvdiyi guledinisgonihi dininadegi;
