english: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏴᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale vtla unelagi yuwelisele gilo gohusdi usdi atelido uyvdodiyi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.
english: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏕᏲᏁᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏅ ᏱᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎡᏍᏗ?  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏓᎦᎸ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Dudeyoneno, hia niduweselei, tlasgo hia yinigvnv yigowela, aquatseli adanelv nigadiyu tsunadalenvdv yvwi unadadolisdodiyi dudoesdi?  Nihisgini aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi usdagalv nitsvnelv.
english: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎬᏩᎾᏰᏍᎨᏰᏃ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎬ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Dinowelisgino ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi unadvganei, ale uniyole iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi; gvwanayesgeyeno, nvdigalisdodisge nigadv yvwi unisquanigosgv nusdv dadeyohvsgvi.
english: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv unugotse gaduhvi.
english: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎡᎦᏔᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Sunaleno anaisvi, unigohe egataiyusdi tlugv uwayvsvhi gese duhnasdetlv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎡᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏥᏍᎦᏨᎩ ᎤᏩᏴᏐᏅ.
phonetic: Quidano unvdadv hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvniyuquo, egataiyusdi tlugv tsisgatsvgi uwayvsonv.
english: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv, hia niduweselei, Unelanvhi etsoiyusesdi.
english: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᏪᏣᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᏚᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyayeno hia nitsvweseha, Gilo hia nigawesehesdi hia tsodalv, Wetsahvna, ale amequohi wetsaduga; ale nudlasidvehvna igesesdi unawiyi, gohiyuhvsgesdiquosgini nasgi nigawesgv ase iyulisdodi gesvi; nasgi uhesdi nigav nuwesvi.
english: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏥᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Nigav gohusdi itsitayoha itsadadolisda, itsohiyuhvsgesdi etsinei gesvi, ale ase itsihesdi.
english: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎶᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᏔᏗ ᏤᎭ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno itsalehvsgesdi itsadadolisdisgesdi, getsadanehesdi etsisganvtselvi, iyuno gohusdi etselisehesdi giloi; nasgi nasquo Itsidoda galvtadi tseha gagetsinediyi hia itsisganvtsvi.
english: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏣᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏴᎨᏥᏙᎵᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgini nitsadanehvna igesesdi etsisganvtselvi, vtla nasquo Itsidoda galvladi ehi yvgetsidoligi itsisganvtsvi.
english: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ; ᎤᏛᏅᏃ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ,
phonetic: Tsilusilimino taline unilutsei; udvnvnodigalawiisdiyi edohei, gvwalutsele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinowelisgi, ale dinilawigi,
english: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎿᎭᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏣᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Ale hia nigvwaweselei, Gado tsalisgasdodi hia nasgi tsihnadvneha?  Ale gago tsanele nasgi hia itsadvnediyi?
english: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏛᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Ayv nasgi sudalegi dvtsvyadvdvni, ale sginohvsi, ayvno datsvnoneli nusdv aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsinigadvneha.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏍᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ?  ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ.
phonetic: Tsani tsidadawosgvgi, galvlasgo tsudalenei, yvwiquoge anehvi?  Sginohvsi.
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᏛᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏫ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Unvsvno gesv unalinohelei, hia nuniwesei, Iyuno galvladi nvdayudalenvhi yigadvnv, hia yinigawi, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?
english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏱᎦᏛᏅ,^ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᏴᏫ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Iyuno yvwiquo anehv yigadvnv,^nasgi danisgaihe yvwi; nigadvyeno yvwi adolehosgi udohiyuhi gvwayelvha Tsani.
english: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Uninetsvno hia nuniwesele Tsisa, Vtla yotsigataha.  Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Vtla nasquo ayv yvdatsvnoneli iyusdi aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsinigadvneha.
english: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏐᏱᎴ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎮ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ulenvheno duwonetane datlilosdisgvi.  Gilo iyusdi telvladi duwisei, ale usoyile gvwaduwidv, ale usgose gigageaditasdi gotlvdiyi, ale unesgehe inv igati, ale dudolastane tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale inv wulosei.
english: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎤᏅᏎ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unvnisdiyino gesv iyui, unvse unvsidasdi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, nasgi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi nvdagvwanediyi unequotsvhi telvladi dawisvi.
english: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏒᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏂᎩᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igvwaniyvheno, ale igvwalivnilei, ale asvha igvwanigistanei.
english: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏎ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏯᏉ ᏙᎬᏩᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏐᏅᏁ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏂᎩᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Talineno nvwadale unvsidasdi unvse dinehvi; nasgino nvyaquo dogvwanistanei, ale igvwasonvne asgoli, ale igvwanigistane udehohisdi igvwanelvhi.
english: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎵᎥᏂᎮᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᏂᎯᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno nvwadale unvsei; ale nasgi unilei; ale unitsate nvwanadalei; igadv danilivnihei, igadvno danihihei.
english: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏎ ᎣᏂᏱ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏇᏥ.
phonetic: Asino saquo uwetsi ehei, ugeyuhi, nasgi nasquo unvse oniyi dinehvi, hia nuwesei, Ase dvnilvquotani aquetsi.
english: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏭᏘᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;  Ꭷ, ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗᏃ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, hia nidunadaweselei, Hia nasgi tsugvwalodi wutiyelihisdi gesvi;  ka, ediluga, tsugvwalodino utiyedi igatseliga gesesdi.
english: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwaniyvhvno gvwalei, ale telvladi dawisv doyiditlv wigvwadainvsei.
english: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏙᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono nasgi dvdvneli telvladi dawisv utseliga?  Dagalutsi ale dodvdvtani nasgi tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale nvwanadale dodvneli telvladi dawisvi.
english: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ, ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ;
phonetic: Tlasgono yitsigoliyeo hia nasgi tsinigvnv tsigowela?  Nasgi nvya, dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv;
english: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Yihowa nudvnelv, ale usquanigodiyu dedakanisgvi.
english: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏅᎡᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unanelotaneno gvwaniyvdiyi, aseno unitsati yvwi danisgaihei; anigataheyeno unvsv getsidvgv nasgi dutlilostanvi; igvwadanveleno ale dunenvsei.
english: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏅᏎᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏌᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Duninvseno wigvwalutsediyi gilo iyunasdi Aniqualisi ale Elodv gvwasdelisgi, unisadvdiyi unadulisge gawonisgvi.
english: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎷᏨᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏖᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏖᎸᏉᏙᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎾᎫᏱᏍᎬ ᏏᏌ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ, ᏝᎨ?
phonetic: Unilutsvno, hia nigvwaweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigataha duyugodv hiwonisgv gesvi, ale gilo nitenayesgvna gesvi; vtlayeno nunasdv yvwi yitelvquodoi, Unelanvhisgini unvnv udohiyusv dehadeyohvsgoi; duyugodisgo ayeli anaguyisgv Sisa aguyvediyi, tlage?
english: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏲᏥᏂᏧ, ᏝᎨ ᏴᏓᏲᏥᏂ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᎵᏰᎭ?  ᎡᏍᎩᎥᏏ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Dayotsinitsu, tlage yvdayotsini?  Aseno agatahe unatlonasdvi, hia niduweselei, Gadono isgigoliyeha?  Esgivsi agisi tsugvwalodi nasgi agigowadvdiyi.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏲᎴᏃ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎦᏪᎳ?  ᏏᏌ, ᎢᎬᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Uniyoleno.  Hiano niduweselei, Gago hia dagatlilosdi, ale gago atsinoheha hia tsigawela?  Sisa, igvwoselei.
english: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏟ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏏᏌ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎴᏃ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetli hia nisuweselei, Sisa etsaguyvsi Sisa utseliga, Unelanvhino Unelanvhi utseliga.  Igvwasquanigoseleno.
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏃᏆᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎢᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Noquale Anisadusi igvwalutselei, nasgi ayohusv vtla dilehisodi yigi anadisgi; ale igvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei.
english: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ ᎣᎪᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎦᎧᎯᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏪᏥᏃ ᏂᏗᎦᎧᎯᏯᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tadeyohvsgi, Mosi ogowelanelvgi hia nogiweselvgi, Analinvtli gilo ayohusgesdi, ale udalii igakahiyasgesdi, tsuwetsino nidigakahiyasgvna igesesdi, analinvtli ayanisgesdi udalii, ale nasgi analinvtli tsuwetsi dadvhisdanehesdi.
english: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ;  ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏕᏒᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgino galiquogi analinvtli anehvgi;  igvyino ehi udesvnvgi, ale uyohusvgi tsuwetsi nanehvna.
english: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᏚᏪᎧᎯᏰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏪᎯ.
phonetic: Talineno wehi nasgi udayvsvgi, ale uyohusvgi; nasquono nasgi vtla tsuwetsi yiduwekahiyei; ale nasgiya nasquo tsoine wehi.
english: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎯᎧᎯᏰ ᏧᏁᏥ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi galiquogi iyanidv unadayvsvgi, ale vtla yidunihikahiye tsunetsi; oniyino ageyv nasquo uyohusei.
english: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ?  ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏰᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Tsuniyohusvhino tsunalehisodi gesvi, nahiyu nasgi hia danalehisanvha, gago udalii gesesdi nasgi hia?  Galiquogiyeno iyanidv anadayehvgi.
english: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ, ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselvgi, Tlasgo yitsilidasdiha, yinvdigalisdodiha nitsoligvna gesv Goweli, ale Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesvi?
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ;  ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno tsunalehisodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi, vtla yidanadesvhvsgoi, vtla ale yidigetsiyegoi;  galvladisgini anehi getsinvsidasdi nunasdv nasgiya nunasdi.
english: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Tsuniyohusvhino nasgi tsunalehisodi gesvi; tlasgo yitsigoliyeo Mosi utseli gowelihi, nasgi uweyodadv Unelanvhi ulinohetanvi, hia nuweselvi, Ayv Aquanelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Aquanelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Aquanelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga.
english: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Vtla tsuniyohusvhi unatseli Unelanvhi yigi, dinvnodvsgini unatseli Unelanvhi; nasgi iyusdi utsati itsilidasdiha.
english: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ, ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎢ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Dinowelisgino gesv asiyvwi ulutselv, udvganv analinohesgvi, ale udolehosv osiyu nuwesv dunetselvi, udvdvnei, Gado usdi utli galvquodiyu nigadv dikahnawadvsdi gesvi?  Udvnei.
english: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎭᏛᎬᎦ ᎢᏏᎵ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏌᏉᎯᏳ ᏱᎰᏩ;
phonetic: Tsisa unetsele hia nuweselei, Utli galvquodi nigadv dikahnawadvsdi gesv hia nasgi; Hadvgvga Isili; Yihowa Iganelanvhi saquohiyu Yihowa;
english: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎬ ᏣᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale higeyusesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi hvdisgesdi nigv tsanawi, ale nigvtsadanvdo, ale nigv tsadanvtediyi, ale nigav tsalinigvgvi.  Hia nasgi wudagonadvdv galvquodi dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.  ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏯᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno gesvi, nasgiyaquo, hia nasgi nusdi, tsvsv nitsadageyusv nasgiya nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.  Vtla nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi yaha utli igalvquodi esgaquo nasgi.
english: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; Ꭷ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏫ; ᏌᏉᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ;
phonetic: Digowelisgino hia nuweselei; Ka, Tadeyohvsgi, duyugodv niwi; saquoquoyeno eha Unelanvhi; vtla ale nvwadale yeha nasgi uwasvhiyu;
english: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎬ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏃᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎨᏳᏗᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino ageyudiyi gvdodiyi nigv onawiyi, ale nigv adanvtediyi, ale nigv adanvdo, ale nigav nolinigvgvi, ale nav iyunadala uwasv udageyusv nasgiya ugeyudiyi, utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nigadv digvwanosdv atsilv digelasdodi, ale alisgolvdodi.
english: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv agatahnai iyuwesdi nuwesv unetsvi, hia nuweselei, Vtla invhiyu yinitsadvhnadega Unelanvhi utseligohi gesvi.  Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv vtla gilo gohusdi gvwadvdvdi yigesei.
english: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏣᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv dadeyohvsgv udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, hia nuwesei; Gadono dinowelisgi Galonedv Dewi uwetsi, tsanadisgoi?
english: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Dewiyeno uwasv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uweyohvsgv hia nuwesei, Yihowa hia nuwesele aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi, Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha.
english: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎪᏎᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎴᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᎩ?  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dewiyeno uwasv Ugvwiyuhi igoseha; gadono digalesdodiha uwetsi igi?  Unitsatino yvwi unalihelitsvhi gvwadvdanelei.
english: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele dadeyohvsgvi, Detseyadotsehesdi dinowelisgi osiyu tsuniyelv diganvhidv tsunanuwai unedasdiyi, ale getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi,
english: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏧᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale nugvwiyusv tsunanitlvdiyi danalisdayvhvgvi;
english: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏒᏁᎰ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏣᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsidanisvneho tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale unatlonasdv gohidiyu tsanadadolisdisgoi; hia nasgi utli igai unigiliyoisdi digegugodanedi gesesdi.
english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano uwole adelvdidiyi tsuyugodi, ale ugohe nanadvnehv yvwi adelv danihvsgv adelvdidiyi; unitsatino tsunehnai utsati danihvsgei.
english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏔᎵ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎤᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi ulutsv, tali aginudvdi iyadanvtedi unei, nasgi ayeli iyadanvtedi igai tsigi.
english: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎲᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Widuyanvhvno gvwasdawadidohi, hia niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Hia nasgi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi utli igai ahvga esgaquo nigadv nasgi adelvdidiyi tsanihvga.
english: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎤᏃᏣᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᎲᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ-ᎤᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎲᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvyeno utsati unihv unotsaledv anihvga; nasgisginiunigidv gesv ahvga nigadv uhvi, nigadv ulisdelvdodi uhvi.
english: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏄᎪᎮᏃ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ Ꮎ ᏂᏕᎤᏍᏗ ᏅᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏕᎤᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏁ-ᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Ganugoheno udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, asiyvwi nasgi gvwasdawadidohi hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvniyuquo na nideusdi nvya ale nideusdi dadanelvi?
english: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏕᎯᎪᏩᏗᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏆ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᏅᏯ ᎧᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Dehigowadisgo hia nasgi tsequa dadanelvi?  Vtla saquo nvya kanohiyvhi yigesesdi yidudasatlahesdi, nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎵᏩᏲᏃ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Oliwayono usahilv uwolvi, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi adanelv tsuyugodi, Quida, ale Tsimi, ale Tsani, ale Enidi, unvsv gesv gvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei,
english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Sginohvsi, ilagiyu nasgi hia nvdagalistani?  Ale gado uyelvdv gesesdi nahiyu hia nasgi nigadv uliyeilohisdi gesvi?
english: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎶᏄᎮᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano dunetselv, ulenvhe hia nuwesei, Itseyatahesdi, tlesdi gilo tsitsilonuheli.
english: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadosdv aniluhisdisgesdi, hia naniwesgesdi, ayv nasgi; ale unitsatesdi danilonuhesgesdi.
english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᏅᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲ ᏓᏅᏩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ; ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsadvgisgesdino danvwa, ale aninohelidohv danvwa, tlesdi yitsadeyatanehesdi; nasgiyeno ase iyulisdodi; ulisquadisdiyisgini gesv asi gesesdi.
english: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ.
phonetic: Tsunadaledvyeno yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli degotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani; ale gadohi dalitelvnidohesdi, ale dagonulosidohesdi ale udeyadodi nigalistanidohesdi; hia nasgi adalenisgv agiliya.
english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏧᏂᏔᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏕᏥᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏤᏣᏖᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ.
phonetic: Adina itseyatahesdi; danilawivyeno degetsiyosgesdi; tsunitawiisdiyino detsilivnihesdi; ale nunigvwiyusadegi ale unigvwiyuhi aninv tsetsatenohisdi gesesdi ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi gohiyudisgi tsunigatilegi.
english: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Osdvno kanohedv igvyi nigvnadv tsunewadisv yvwi alitsidodi gesesdi.
english: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᏣᏘᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏄᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏁᎪᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo detsatinegesdi, ale detsiyosgesdi, tlesdi igvyi gayehi yitselihisgesdi itsiwesdiyi itsineisdiyi, ale tlesdi igvyi gayehi yitsadanvtesgesdi; nusdvsgini wihiyu gesv etsinelv nasgi itsinegesdi; vtlayeno nihi yitsanegoi, Galvquodiyusgini Adanvdo.
english: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏅᎩ ᏓᎾᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏓᎾᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏅᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Analinvtlino duyosgesdi analinvtli uyohuhihisdiyi; asgayano uwetsi duyosgesdi; ale digeganvgi danalehvsgesdi tsunigayvlige danatludisgesdi, ale nasgi nanvnisisgesdi degetsiihesdi.
english: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏧᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nigadiyu yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi ayv tsuquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi; gilosgini gvlisquadisgi dikahnawadegi, nasgi atsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏕᏂᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎴᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, (ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᎨᏍᏗ,) ᎿᎭᏉ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᏙᏦᏓᎸ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Itsigowatisgesdisgini usgaisdi advdisgi Denili adolehosgi uneistanvhi, gadogesdi nahna gvwaledi nigesvna, (gilo agoliyesgesdi goligesdi,) hnaquo Tsudiyi anini analisvha dotsodalv wanilosvha.
english: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᏠᎠᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏫᏯᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏯᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏭᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᎭᎥ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gilo gasanali ugilesdi, tlesdi yvditloasgesdi adanelv wiyayvhihesdi, ale tlesdi nahna wiyayvhihesdi wugisdiyi gohusdi uhnav ganelvi.
english: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎡᏙᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᏬ ᏳᏁᏐᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo tlogesi edohi tlesdi yvdiutsvsesdi unuwo yunesolesdi.
english: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi dininelidv, ale tsunisdai nahiyu gesesdi.
english: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᎳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale itsadadolisdisgesdi itsitayohihesdi gola itsalisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏢᏅᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏢᏁ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏳᏕᏃᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno gesesdi agiliya ehesdi, nasgi gotlvnvi nasgi Unelanvhi tsuwotlvne nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasdi vtla nasgi iyusdi yudenoi, vtla ale udedi yigesesdi.
english: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏚᎪᎳᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏱᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ; ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᎳᏛ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi nidugoladvna yigese nahiyu iga, vtla uquedali yigayetsisdelvhei; gegasuyedvsgini nvdigalisdodiha, nasgi tsusuyedv gesvi, nasgi dugoladv nahiyu iga.
english: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎢᏳᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono iyu gilo hia nitsiweselvha, Gvniyuquo ani Galonedv; ale gvniyuquo nahnani; tlesdi itsoiyunvgi;
english: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno unatselvhi ale anadolehosgi unatselvhi dvninanugotsi, ale aninanugowisgesdi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi, nasgi tsunilonuhediyi, iyuno yeli yigi, nasquo gegasuyedv.
english: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Nihisgini itseyatahesdi; gvniyuquo nigadv nitsvnonelv.
english: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎶᏐᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ, ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᏛᎵᏏᎲᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎦ ᏳᏖᏍᏕᏗ;
phonetic: Nahiyusgini gesesdi, ulosonesdi nasgi agiliya, nvdo iga ehi dvlisihvsi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi vtla iga yutesdedi;
english: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎠᏂᎧᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏂᏅᎪᎠᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
phonetic: Ale noquisi anikalv galvloi aninvgoasgesdi, ale unitsate galvlo tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
english: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilvi, unuwosdesdi utsati ulinigidiyu gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᏙᏛᏯᏅᎯ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏙᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᏭᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎦᎸᎶᏃ ᏭᎵᏍᏘᏂᎸ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dodaganvsi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi, ale dodagatlisani gegasuyedv tsutseliga widodvyanvhi nvgi nidodigalosgv unole, elohi wulistinilv nvdayudalenvdv galvlono wulistinilv wigalugi.
english: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᏃ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ;  ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏓᎨ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎵᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎪᎩ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Itsadeloquano svgataiyusdi tlugv datlilosdvi;  Uwanigalv hnaquo udage nigalisda, ale tsigalisduhvsgoi, itsigataho gogi navniyu gesvi;
english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi, hnaquo itsigowatisgesdi hia nasgi nigalistanidohvi, itsigatahesdi navniyu gesvi, galohisdiyiquo gesvi.
english: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎮ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvwesehe, hia nasgi gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni gvni hia nasgi nigadiyu nigalistanvha.
english: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
phonetic: Galvlo ale elohi dvnilosoni; ayvsgini aginetsv vtla yvdagalosoni.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ, Ꮭ ᎾᏉᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Nahiyusgini iga gesv ale iyu kalawadisv vtla gilo yagataha, vtla nasquo dinikahnawadidohi galvladi anehi, tla naquono Uwetsi, agayvligesgini uwasv.
english: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi, itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi; vtlayeno yitsigataha iyu gesvi.
english: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ] ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏣᏂᎩᏍᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏤᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏕᎪ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏧᏂ ᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᏥᎧᏁᏤᎰ ᎤᏯᏫᏗᏱ.
phonetic: [Yvwiyeno Uwetsi] nasgiyaquo asgaya tsanigisgo ilvhitlv tsegoi, nasgi tsigvdego ganelvi, ale anigatiya tsinidegvneho tsunvsidasdi, ale anisiyvwiha tsuni lvwisdanedi tsidanehoi, ale galohisdiyi agatiya tsikanetseho uyawidiyi.
english: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎤᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎠᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi; vtlayeno yitsigataha iyuquo uluhisdiyi ganela, usvi, ale svnoyi ayeli, ale tsataga aniyvgvi, ale sunalei;
english: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎦᎷᎩᏰᏃ ᏯᏰᎶᎢᏍᏓ, ᏴᏥᏩᏛᏓ ᎢᏥᎵᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Yigalugiyeno yayeloisda, yvtsiwadvda itsilinavi.
english: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ-ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nihi tsinitsvweseha, nasgi nigadvquo nigatsiwesehaItsiyawisgesdi.
english: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎧᏃᎯᏴᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Talino winusvlv kanohiyvgi dilisdayvdiyi ale nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi usqualvdi gesei, nunigvwisvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi uniyole iyunadvnediyi galonuhedv unvdodiyi uniniyvdiyi, ale unihisdiyi.
english: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏯᎾᎵᏕᎸᎲᎦᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno vtlesdi dilisdayvdiyi iyu iga gesvi, yanalidelvhvgayeno yvwi, unadvnei.
english: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏇᏗᏂᏱᏃ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎠᏩᏂ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᏨᎯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎦᏅᎨᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᏰᎮ ᎫᎫ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᏍᏕ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎾᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒ ᎫᎫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
phonetic: Quediniyino edohei, Aawani adayesgi utlvtsvhi ganelvi, ganvgeno alisdayvhvsgei, ageyv ulutse ayehe gugu nvya unegv gotlvtanvhi atlisde atlonedi nada tsudoidv, utsati tsugvwalodi; ale ulosv gugu, ale ulonetane asgoli.
english: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᎤᏅᏳᏤ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏤᏬᎩ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ?
phonetic: Gilono unadasuye unvyutse dotsunadanvdvi, ale hia nuniwesei, Gadono hia atsewogi atlonedi?
english: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏳᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏦᎢᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎵᎬᏩᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Yuninadinvseyeno nasgi hia atlonedi tsoitsuqui anigisi tsunagvwalodi ulosvsdi yiduligvwalanei, ale uyo iyunadvhnadegi digvnedi yigesei.  Ale gvwagonelohiselei.
english: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ?  ᎣᏏᏳ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᎾᏋᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesei, Unelagi; gadono ietsadeyadodiha?  Osiyu deulvwisdasi tsinaquvga.
english: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏕᏣᏛᏂᏏ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏱᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Uyoyeno iyunadvhnadegi nigohilv getseladidoha, ale iyuquo itselisgvi osdv yinidetsadvnisi; ayvsgini vtla nigohilv yitsvyeladidoha.
english: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏛᎦ; ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎦᎷᎩ ᎤᎶᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏰᎴ ᎥᎩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nigav igvwadvnedi gesv nadvga; igvyi gayehi galugi ulonediyi tsiyele vginisodiyi ugvwali.
english: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Ilvhitlv hia nasgi osdv kanohedv alitsidodi nigalisdisgesdi elohi nigvnadvi, hia nasgi tsinadvga nasquo uninohedi gesesdi nasgi aganvdadisdodi.
english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᎳᏗ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏗᏂᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsudasino Iyagaladi, asiyvwi nasgi taladu iyanidv gesvi, uwenvse nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi dininvi, nasgi tsuyohisediyi.
english: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏲᎴᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unadvganvno osiyu uniyelvnei, ale uniduisdanele adelv tsuninediyi.  Uyoleno osdv udlanvdadediyi tsuyohisediyi.
english: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᎸ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏚᎵ ᏬᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Igvyiyino iga nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi, nahiyu unilv kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi, gvwasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselei, Hatlv tsaduli wogadvnvisdodiyi, kanohiyegi tsalisdayvdiyi?
english: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ, ᏙᏓᏣᏠᏏᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏟᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎡᏍᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Dunvseno anitali gvwasdawadidohi, ale hia niduweselei, Digaduhv isdena, dodatsatlosino asgaya ayehesdi atelido ama atlisdesdi; esdisdawadesvha.
english: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᏩᏴᎸᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno wayvlvha, hia nesdiweselvha asgaya ganela, Dideyohvsgi hia nigaweha, Hatlv anedohi uniyvsdiyi, nahna kanohiyegi itsulaha ogalisdayvdiyi gvgisdawadidohi.
english: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏍᏓᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎤᏛᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᎿᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ; ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎩᏯᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Dasdasehelino udvnv galvladi kanvsulvi, gayula gvhnai, ale advnvistanvhi; nahna sgiyadvnvisdanelvha.
english: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unenvse ale digaduhv wunilutsei, ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya niduweselvi; unadvnvistaneno kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi.
english: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏓᏖᏁᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv ulutse datenehe taladu iyanidv.
english: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᏓᎡᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ, ᏛᏆᏡᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgino aninvdlaei ale analisdayvhvsgei, tsisa hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, asiyvwi hia tsinitsadvnv itsulaha tsosdalisdayvhvsga, dvquatlutani.
english: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᎬᏪᏒᏛ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?  ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ?  ᎠᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unalenvheno uyo uniyelvnei, ale hia nigvwaweselei, saquo gvwesvdv, Tsigo ayv?  Nvwadaleno, Tsigo ayv?  Adisgei.
english: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏥᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏖᎵᏙᎩᎯ ᏦᏍᏓᏑᏩᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselei, Asiyvwi taladu itsidv gesv nasgi itsulaha atelidogihi tsosdasuwasga.
english: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ!  ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏄᏕᏅᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwi Uwetsi udohiyuhi uwenvsdi nasgiya nigvnv gowelv atsinohesgvi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi asgaya yvwi Uwetsi atludisgi!  osiyu yigese iyuno nasgi asgaya nudenvnaquo yigesei.
english: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Analisdayvhvsgvno Tsisa gadu ugisv, ale ulihelitsv, ugvhaluyei, ale dunelei, ale hia nuwesei, Itsigi, itsiga; hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi.
english: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ulisquidi ugisv, ale ulihelitsv, nasgi dunelei; nigadvno nasgi unaditahei.
english: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎢᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᎨᎦᏤᏪᎸ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, hia nasgi ayv agigigv itsv kanohedv datlohisdvi, nasgi unitsati tsigegatsewelv.
english: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏤ ᎦᏗᏔᎲᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, vtla hnaquo ilvhiyu yvgagadita telvladi unanugowisvhi, gvni nahiyu iga itse gaditahvha Unelanvhi utseligohi.
english: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏒᏃ, ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᎣᎵᏩᏲ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Duninogisvno, uninugotse Oliwayo odalv wunilosei.
english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᏂᎯ ᏙᏓᏦᏕᎵ ᎪᎯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏫ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏓᏥᏴᏂᎵ, ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾᏃ ᏛᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏥ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselei, nitsiv nihi dodatsodeli gohi svnoyi tsigi, ayv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi; hiayeno nigvnvigowela, Awi digatiya datsiyvnili, uninodenano dvnadigaleyotsi.
english: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏆᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᏨᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo diqualenvhi gesesdi, igvyi datsvyenveli Gelili iyvdv.
english: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᏚᏃᏕᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida hia nuweselei, Nasquo nigadv yidunodestanv, ayv ase vtla.
english: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏉ ᏒᏃᏱ, ᎠᏏ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ ᏣᏔᎦ, ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Nasgi gohi iga, ale gohiquo svnoyi, asi taline naniyvgvna tsataga, tsoi nvdasquadayili.
english: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎬᏯᏓᏱᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno utli ulinigidv unetse hia nuwesei, Iyuno nasquo itsulaha diginiyohuhisdi yigi, ase vtla yvgagvyadayiga.  Nasgiya nasquo nuniwese nigadv.
english: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏎᎻᏂᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Geseminino dudov unilutsei; hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Ani itsinesdi, wigadadolisdisgv igohidv.
english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏖᏅᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ;
phonetic: Dutenvseno Quida ale Tsimi ale Tsani, ale ulenvhe utsati udeyatanelei, ale utsati ehisdi udanvdadei;
english: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Aquadanvdo utsati udeyataneha ayohuhisdi nasgiyai; ani itsinesdi, ale itsiyawisgesdi.
english: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎤᏪᏅ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ, ᎤᏔᏲᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᎯᏎᏗᏱᏉ.
phonetic: Usdigidvno iyvdv iuwenv, eladi udanvnei, ale udadolistane, utayolei, nasgi yeli igvwalisdodi yigi, nahiyu gesv ulohisediyiquo.
english: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏂᎯ, ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᎦᏯᏉ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ; ᏍᎩᎲᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuwesei, Aqua, Edoda, nihi, gesv yeligayaquo igetsadvnedi nigavi; sgihvsiquo hia nasgi ulisquidi; vtlasgininonv ayv aquadulisgvi, nihisgini tsadulisgvi.
english: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎯᎵᎭᏉᏧ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏣᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ?
phonetic: Iulutseno ale duwadvhe anilinaei, ale hia nuwesele Quida, Sawani, hilihaquotsu?  Tlasgo sutlilodvquo igohidv nasquo getsayawisdi yigesei?
english: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ.
phonetic: Itsiyawisgesdi ale itsadadolisdisgesdi nasgi tlesdi udalenasdiyi witsinanugotsvgi; Adanvdo udohiyuhi udvnvisdi, uquedalvsgini awanagalahiyu.
english: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏄᏪᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno iyvdv wulosv, udadolistanei, nuwesv nasgiya winuwesei.
english: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎡᎢ, ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Diulutsvno duwadvhe taline anilinaei, dinigadoliyeno digagediyu gesei, vtla ale yinigatahe iyuniwesdiyi uninetsediyi.
english: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎨᏥᎵᏁᏍᏗᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏓ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎶᏐᎾ-ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᎯᏏ.
phonetic: Tsoineno widulutselei, ale hia niduweselei, getsilinesdiquo hnaquo, ale itsatsawesolvsda; Hnaquo galosonahnaquo asqualv nahiyu gesvi; gvniyuquo yvwi Uwetsi anisgana degetsiyohisi.
english: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎢᏕᎾ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsalehvga, idena; gvniyuquo aquatludisgi esganiyu dayai.
english: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏪᏂᏍᎨᎢ, ᏧᎾᎸᎪᏤ, ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᏓᏘᏁᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏗᏂᏁᎯ, ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv asiquo gawenisgei, tsunalvgotse, Tsudasi, asiyvwi taladu iyanidv gesv, datinehe unitsati, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada dininehi, nvdagvwaninvsidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinowelisgi, ale dinilawigi.
english: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᏣᎳᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏒᏥᏂᏴᎲᎭ, ᎡᏣᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎭ ᎬᏩᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏁᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Utludisgino gvnigesv itsuwanelvhi gese unadolehohisdodi, hia iyuwesvhi gesei, Gilo tsiyadutsalanvha, nasgi gesesdi, svtsiniyvhvha, etsatinawidvhvha gvwadudalesdi nigesvna netsvnesdi.
english: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏨᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏣᎳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ulutsvquono gilaquo iyvdv wulutselei, ale hia nuwesei, Disqueyohvsgi, Disqueyohvsgi; ale udutsalanei.
english: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏔᏕᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Degvwasitadeno, ale gvwaniyvhei.
english: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎿᎭᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᏰ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nav anidohnai, ayelasdiganvhidv ulvhei, ale nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi uluye ale ulisdestanei.
english: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏨᏤᏥᏂᏴᎯᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᎩ, ᏗᏥᏁᎯ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᎰᎦ?
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Tsigo ganosgisgi tsvtsetsiniyvhiso nasgiya itsilugi, ditsinehi ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada ayv sginiyvhoga?
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏂᏴᎮᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nidugitsvnisv itsvyeladidohvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, degadeyohvsgvgi, ale vtla yisginiyvhei; udohiyudisgininonv nigvnv Gowelvi.
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᏕᏦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadiyuno gvwadetsonei, ale unalisei.
english: And they all forsook him, and fled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏓᏇᏅᏕ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi awinv usdawadvsei, doledv anuwo udaquenvde uyelvha gesvi; aniwinvno gvwaniyvhei.
english: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᎴᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᏚᎵᏘᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Doledvno anuwo uniyei, ale uyelvha dulitielei.
english: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏕᎬᏩᎳᏫᎡ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsuwolv wunatinvstanei; nasgino degvwalawie nigadv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinilawigi, ale dinowelisgi.
english: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎤᏬᎴᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏛ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano ge iyvdv usdawadisei, nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelv wuyvlei, uwoleno getsinvsidasdi aninvi, ale godv uganawosgei.
english: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎤᏂᏲᎮ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏃ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale nigadv danilawiv uniyohe uninohelvhi Tsisa utludisgi, nasgi unihisdiyi, unatlotseno.
english: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsateyeno gayegogi aninohesgi gvwatludisgei, aseno aninohesgv vtla utloyi yigesei.
english: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᎴᏁᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Dunaleneno gilo iyunasdi ale gayegogi uninohele gvwatludisgvi, hia naniwesgei;
english: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎧᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏓᏥᏲᏍᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏛᏥᏱᎵᏙᎵ ᏛᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ogadvganvgi hia nikawesgvgi, Datsiyostani hia udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, nasgi digoyi digvtanvhi gotlvnvhi, tsoiquono tsusvhidv dvtsiyilidoli dvganesgehi nvwadale digoyi digvtanvhi nigesvna.
english: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nasquo nasgi uninohelvhi vtla utloyi yigesei.
english: But neither so did their witness agree together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᎭ?  ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi ayeli ulenv, udvdvne Tsisa, hia newesei, Tlasgo gohusdi yadiha?  Gado nasgi hia tsaninoheha getsatludisgvi?
english: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏛᏁ ᏨᏁᏤᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ?
phonetic: Aseno elawequo uwasei, ale vtla gohusdi yudvne tsvnetsei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi taline udvdvne, ale hia nuweselei, Nihisgo Galonedv, Atsilvquodi Uwetsi?
english: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏬᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesei, Ayv nasgi; ale dayetsigoi yvwi Uwetsi uwolesdi agatisi iditlv ulinigidv gesvi, ale tsaisesdi ulogilv galvloi.
english: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏄᏩᎥ ᏚᏪᏣᎦᎸᎮᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏱᏗᎦᏚᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dunuwav duwetsagalvhei, hia nuwesei, Gadono asi yidigaduli aninohesgi?
english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsadvgvga asotlvisdisgvi; gado itseliha?  nigadvno degvwugodanele yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi gesvi.
english: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᏕᎬᏩᎵᏥᏍᏆᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎬᏭᏢᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏈᏅ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno unalenvhe degvwalitsisquasgei, ale ukadv gvwutlvnehei, ale asquinv degvwanidisgei, ale hia nigvwawesehei, Hadolehohi; ale getsinvsidasdi degvwanihei.
english: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎡᎳᏗᏢ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Quidano eladitlv nahna adanelv edohei, ulutse asiyvwi ageyv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi.
english: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino ugohv Quida uganawosgvi, dukahnanei, ale hia nuwesei, Nihi nasquo tsisdedohvgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi.
english: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎪᎵᎦ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏩᏲᏓᏝᎲ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ; ᏣᏔᎦᏃ ᎤᏴᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno udayilei, hia nuwesei, Vtla yitsigataha, vtla ale yigoliga niwesgvi.  Unugotseno doyiditlv wayodatlahv wulosei; tsatagano uyvlisei.
english: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏛᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎨᎳ.
phonetic: Advno taline ugohei, ale ulenvhe hia niduwesele nav anidonai, hia nasgi nahna gela.
english: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ.  ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎮᎳ; ᎨᎵᎵᏰᏃ ᎮᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno udayilei.  Nigohilvnano oni nasgi nav anidonai taline hia nuniwesele Quida, Udohiyuhi nihi nahna hela; Geliliyeno hehi, ale gowonisgv utloyi igi.
english: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏍᎩᏅᏕ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏁᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏃᎮᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno ulenvhe usginvde ale uselitane hia newesei, Vtla yitsigataha na asgaya nasgi tsetsinoheha.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏴᎵᏎ ᏣᏔᎦ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏏ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏴᎳᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno uyvlise tsataga.  Quidano unvdade Tsisa nuwesvi, hia tsinuweselei, Asi tsataga tali nuyvlasvna gesesdi, tsoi nvdasquadayili.  Nasgino udanvtelv dutloyilei.
english: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎩᏨᏅ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎸ ᎤᎾᎸᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ  ᎤᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv wugitsvnv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale tsunadvsonvhi, ale dinowelisgi, ale nigadv dinilawigi unalinohelv unalvle Tsisa, ale  unatinawidvhei, ale Qualedi widuniyohiselei.
english: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Qualedino udvdvne hia nuweselei, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Unetsvno hia nuweselei, Yeliquo niwi.
english: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi utsate tsudalenvdv gvwuhisdisgei.
english: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Qualedino taline udvdvne hia nuwesei; Tlasgo gohusdi yadiha?  Gvniyuquo utsati tsudalenvdv aninoheha getsatludiha.
english: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏏ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa asi vtla gohusdi yadisgei; nasgi iyusdi Qualedi usquanigosei.
english: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᏳᎢ ᏓᏲᎯᏎᎮ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎭ.
phonetic: Danalisdayvhvsgvno iyui dayohisehe asiyvwi ayvgi, nasgiquo anitayoha.
english: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎡᎮ ᏆᎳᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᎡ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino ehe Qualaqua tsudoidv nasgi itsulaha degegalve gvwaligonelvhi unadasuyedv unalitelvnvhi, nasgi unadalvhi gese nahiyu unadasuyedv unalitelvnvi.
english: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎢ, ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎢᏧᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unitsatino asdaya unalisdei, unalenvhe unitayole nasgiya nidudvnelv tsuwagutanvsv itsudvnediyi.
english: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᏳᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Qualedino dunetsele hia nuwesei, Itsadulisgo Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga diyuyohisediyi.
english: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏅᏳᏤᎲᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎬᏩᏲᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Agataheyeno nasgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi anvyutsehvquo nvdigalisdodisgv degvwayosvi.
english: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno nunigvyusv atsilvanelohi nunvnisane unitsati yvwi, nasgi Qualaqua unitayosdiyi tsuyohisediyi.
english: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏤᏦᏎᎭ?
phonetic: Qualedino taline unetsv, hia niduweselei, Gadono itsaduli tsiyvnediyi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga tsetsoseha?
english: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Talineno unelunei hiyadvvga unadvnei.
english: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᏯᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Qualedino hia niduweselei, Gadono, gado usdi uyo dulvwisdanelv?  Aseno utliquo iyasdaya unelunei, hiyadvvga, unadvnei.
english: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏆᎳᏆ, ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᏚᏲᏎ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Qualedino osiyu uyelvse osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi unitsati, duyohisele Qualaqua, Tsisano ulivnilv duyose agadvdiyi.
english: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏥᎳᏫᏤᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Aniyawisgino gvwatinawidvhe wigvwayvtane ugvwiyuhiyi adanelvi nasgi ugvwiyuhi tsatsilawitsediyi, nigadvno sunadatlugi widuniyanvhei.
english: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎦᎨᏃ ᎬᏩᏄᏪᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎶᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gigageno gvwanuweei, ale alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi unisdeyonv, nasgi unisdulotanei.
english: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᏂᏲᎵᎮᎢ, ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale unalenvhe aniyolihei, itsvyoliga, Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga, anadisgei.
english: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᎵᏥᏍᏆᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᎥᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Asgolino degvwanihe ganasda gvdi, ale degvwalitsisquasgei, ale danaliniquanvvsge gvwadadolisdanehei.
english: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏔᏃᏅᏃ, ᎬᏩᏄᏪᏎ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏄᏬ ᏕᎬᏩᏄᏬᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unadehotanonvno, gvwanuwese gigagei, ale uwasv tsunuwo degvwanuwoei, ale wigvwatinvstane gvwadvdiyi.
english: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎢᏎᎢ, ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎷᏆᏏ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi Sawani tsudoidv Salini ehi aisei, dodigalogesv nvdayulosvhi, nasgi Eligi ale Luquasi unidoda, nasgi utseli tsudahnawadv uwenvsdiyi nunvnelei.
english: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎵᎦᏓᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Goligadano dudov wigvwatinvtanei, nasgi anetlvtanvhi gesv usqualugo gadvga.
english: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏁᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎻᎳ ᎠᏑᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᎩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwaneneleno uditasdi gigageaditasdi mila asuli; aseno vtla yunegisei.
english: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏅ ᎤᏂᏯᏙᎴ ᏧᏄᏬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏎᏒᎮ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏧᏂᏁᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dadahnawasdv gvwadvnv uniyadole tsunuwoi, unasesvhe unadolehohisdiyi nasgi anisiyvwiha tsuninesvsdi gesvi.
english: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Soonelano iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesei, ale gvwadvnei.
english: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢᏃ ᎪᏪᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏁᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Galvladitlvno gowele nusdv aguisdvi, hia nigvnei, UGvWiYuHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
english: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏁ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Itsulahano degegadvne anitali dinadanasahvsgi; asiyvwi agatisiditlv, soino agasgani iditlv.
english: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᏪᎸᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᎦᏎᎸ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Gowelvno udohiyunei, hia tsinigaweha, unisganvtsvhi gegaselv agatloyastanvgi.
english: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏛᏂᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, Ᏺ, ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏉᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎯᏱᎵᏙᎯ ᎭᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Anilosgino gagvwasotlvdisgei, ale danalisdvnihe hia naniwesgei, Yo, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi hiyosdisgi, ale tsoiquoquo iga hiyilidohi hanesgesgi,
english: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎭᏠᎠᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Tsvsv halisdelv, ale ehatloahi dadahnawasdvi.
english: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏗᏍᎬ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᎤᏩᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi ale dinowelisgi gvwadehodisgv, hia nidanadawesehei, Nvwanadale dasdelisgvgi; uwasv vtla yvgvlisdelv.
english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏩᏠᎠᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi Isili unatseliga hnaquo watloahi dadahnawasdvi, nasgi ogigowadvdiyi ale ogohiyudiyi.  Ale nasgi itsulaha digegadvnvhi gagvwasotlvdei.
english: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏎ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏙᎯ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Taladuno iyutlilodv uliyeilolv ulisihvse nigvnadv nahna gadohi, tsoi iyutlilodv iyasti.
english: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᎶᎢ, ᎢᎶᎢ, ᎳᎹ ᏌᏆᏓᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᏍᏋᏕᎩ?
phonetic: Tsoine iyutlilodv uliyeilolv Tsisa asdaya uwelunei, hia nuwesei, Iloi, Iloi, lama saquadani?  Nasgi anetlvtanvhi hia nusdi gadvga, Aquanelanvhi, Aquanelanvhi, gadono vsquvdegi?
english: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏯᏂᎭ.
phonetic: Igadvno nav anidonai unadvganv, hia nuniwesei, Gvniyuquo, Ilaya ayaniha.
english: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏴᏫᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᎵ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᏭᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏍᏙᎯ ᎤᏪᏆᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᏁᎸ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏳᏠᎥᏔᏂᎵ.
phonetic: Aseyvwino dusqualvtanv, ale duwoli tsunitsoyasdi wukaliistanv, ale ganasdohi uwequatanv, unenelv uditasdi; hia nuwesei, Unelagi, idadolehohi, tsigono Ilaya dagalutsi dayutlovtanili.
english: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano asdaya uwelunv, ulisquadelei.
english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏛ ᎤᏓᏣᎦᎸᎮ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏓᏕᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏩᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayedoladvdino udvnvdigalawiisdiyi gadv udatsagalvhe tali nudadei, galvladi nvdayudalenvdv eladi wasdi.
english: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᎦᏙᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎸᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Asgohitsuquino ditinidohi aiditlv tsuyugodi gadogi, udolehosv nasgi uwelunvi, ale ulisquadelvi, hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhi hia asgaya Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesei.
english: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꭸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᏗᏂᎧᏁᎢ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏁᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏑᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏂᏥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎶᎻ.
phonetic: Anigeyvno nasquo ge iyvdv dodinikanei; nahnano anele Meli Sugideli ehi, ale Meli Tsimi usdi ale Tsosi unitsii, ale Salomi.
english: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏤᏙᎮ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏙᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo Gelili tsedohe gvwasdawadidohe ale gvwasdelvhidohei; ale unitsate nvwanadale anigeyv Tsilusilimi nvdagvwasdawadolvhi.
english: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏈᏕᎾ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
