phonetic: Hnaquono usv nulistanv, nasgi advnvisdodiyi gesv iyusdi, nasgi unadodaquidena iga gesvi.
english: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩ ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏆᎴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsowa Alimadiyi ehi atsilvquodi digalawigi, nasgi nasquo agatiye Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv uluhisdiyi, nasgi ulutsei, ale nasgaihvna wuyvle Qualediyi, ale utayole Tsisa ayelvi.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, and honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏏᎪᏎ ᎤᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎮ ᎾᏞᎬ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ; ᏭᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᏰᎵᏍᎪ ᎪᎯᎩ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Qualedino usquasigose udlasidvehe natlegv uyohusvi; wuyanvhvno asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, udvdvne, yelisgo gohigi gvwayohusvhi, udvnei.
english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏃ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᏦᏩ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnigesvno nuwanelv asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, Tsowa duyohisele ayelvi.
english: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏒ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏄᏬᎩᎯ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎳᏅ, ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏅᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏍᎪᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏪᏌᏆᎴᎴᎢ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Uwasvno usidoli doledv anuwo, ale udesv ayelvi, ale anuwogihi doledv uwetsanulanv, atselisdv unvne nasgi nvyohi asgosvi, ale nvya uwesaqualelei atselisdv galohisdiyi unei.
english: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Melino Magideli ehi, ale Meli Tsosi utsi unigohe nahna uninvnvi.
english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎶᎻ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎶᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unadodaquasgvno ulosonv, Meli Magideli ehi, ale Meli Tsimi utsi ale Salomi uniwasvhi gese uganasdv gawasvgi, uniluhisdiyi uniyelvse ale gvwalonediyi.
english: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏨᏗᎧᎸᎪᏉ.
phonetic: Sunaleiyuno igvyiyi iga sunadodaquasdi gesvi, unilutse atselisdv tsvdikalvgoquo.
english: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏓᎩᎲᎡᎵ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎲᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano nidunadaweselei, Gago dagihveli nvya atselisdv galohisdiyi ahvi?
english: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᎾᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᏅᏯ ᎠᎲᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Widunakahnanvno unigohe nvya ahvdv gesvi, utsatiyeno equohiyu gesei.
english: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏂᏴᎸᏃ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᏫᏴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏬᎴᎢ, ᎤᏄᏪ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᏄᏬ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏃ.
phonetic: Wuniyvlvno atselisdvi, unigohe awiyv agatisiditlv uwolei, unuwe ganvhidv unegv anuwo; anisgaiheno.
english: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎡᏥᏲᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏛᎥᏍᎬᎩ; ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎦᏅ; ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ Ꭰ  ᎤᏂᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; Tsisa Naselidi ehi etsiyoha, nasgi tsagadvvsgvgi; dulehisanv; vtla ani yiganv; ditsakanvga a  uninvnvi.
english: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏤᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏗᏥᏃᎲᏏ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᏚᎶᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎨᎵᎵ; ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno tsitsena, ale widitsinohvsi gvwasdawadidohi ale Quida nasgi igvyi widulohisediyi Gelili; nahna dayetsigoi, nasgiya nitsiweselvi.
english: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ ᏚᎾᎵᏖᏎ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ; ᏚᏂᎾᏫᏍᎨᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏃᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Ulisdino uninugotsv dunalitese atselisdvi; duninawisgeyeno ale unisquanigosgei; vtla ale gilo gohusdi yunoselei; anisgaiheyeno.
english: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano dulehisanv sunaleiyu igvyiyi iga sunadodaquasdi gesvi, igvyi gvnigesv nudvnele Meli Magideli ehi, nasgi galiquogi anisgina tsidunugowiselei.
english: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎯ ᏫᏚᏃᏁᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino uwenv unedolvhi widunonele uyo dunadanvdvi ale danatloyihvi.
english: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv gvnvi, ale nasgi ugohvi, vtla yunohiyunei.
english: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎳ ᎠᎾᎢᏎᎢ, ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏩᏂᎦᏖᎢ.
phonetic: Onino nvwadale nusde gvnigesv nidudvnele anitali nahna anela anaisei, dodigalogesv wanigatei.
english: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᏅ ᏫᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏃᎯᏳᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino unenv widuninonele anisoi; nasquo vtla yidunohiyune nasgi.
english: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎴ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ, ᏂᏚᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᎲᎯ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Onino gvnigesv nidudvnele sadu iyanidv analisdayvhvsgvi, ale dugvsgolvne nigalisdodisge nunohiyusvna gesv ale disdayiyu gesv tsuninawi, nidunohiyunvna gesv iyusdi nasgi gvwagohvhi tsulehisanvhi nigesei.
english: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᏙᎾ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏗᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᎪᏢᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Itsedona elohi nigvnadvi, ale widitsalitsidohvsi osdv kanohedv naniv gegotlvnvhi.
english: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi ale agawosgesdi atsisdelvdi gesesdi; nigohiyuhvsgvnasgini tsagugodanedi gesesdi.
english: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏗᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏚᏛᏗᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Hiano nasgi uyelvdv digolisdodi tali dudvdidegesdi anohiyuhvsgi; ayv daquadov anvdisgesdi anisgina daninugowisgesdi; nvwanadale tsuniwonihisdi daniwonisgesdi;
english: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎾᏛ ᏓᏂᏁᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏳᎾᏗᏔᎲ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏓᎾᏏᏔᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Inadv daninesgesdi; iyu ale gohusdi adahihi yunaditahv, vtla gohusdi yunvnehesdi; tsunitlvgi danasitadisgesdi, ale dunadiwasgesdi.
english: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏙᏣᏕᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino Ugvwiyuhi duwonetanv, galvladi dotsadedanilvtsei, ale agatisi iditlv Unelanvhi uwolv uwenei.
english: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎴᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎨ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Unenvseno ale nigvnadv unalitsidonidolei, Ugvwiyuhi tali udvdidege dunilvwisdanehvi, ale aninegv asdayidisdisge uyelvdv ulitloyasdidegvi.  Emenv.
english: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎲᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏦᎪᎯᏳᎭ,
phonetic: Nasgino anigodiyu tsunanelotanv gvnigesv iyunvnediyi kanohvsgi tsudalenvdv nulistanidolv nasgi udohiyuhiya tsogohiyuha,
english: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎪᎩᏪᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏂᎪᎯᏙᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ^
phonetic: Nasgiya nigogiweselv nasgi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv unvsv unigohidolvhi, ale kanohedv unalitsidonvhi gesvi^
english: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅ ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎣᏈᎵ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᏰᏛᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ,
phonetic: Nasquo ayv osiyu agiyelvnv wigvyowelanediyi osdv agiyeilvsdiyi, nihi etsalvquodi Dioquili, agisquaniyedvyeno nigadv hia tsudalenvdv didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv,
english: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsagadovhisdiyi udohiyuhiya gesv nasgi nahna tsudalenvdv etseyonvi.
english: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎮ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᏯ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏔᏅ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏃ ᎡᎳᏂ ᏧᏪᏥᏛᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎵᏏ ᏚᏙᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Elodv ugvwiyuhi gese Tsudiyi, gilo iyusdi ehe atsilvgelohi Tsegalaya tsudoidv, nasgi Equaya agatinvtanv gela gesei, udaliino Elani tsuwetsidvhi gesv nvdayudalenvhi gesei, ale Lisi dudoei.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏅᎢ, ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᎨᏥᎳᎾᏎᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Ale itsula duyugodv tsunilvwisdanehi gese Unelanvhi dodikanvi, danikahnawadise nigadv dikahnawadvsdi ale ulinetsv iyadvnelidasdi gesv Yihowa tsutseliga, usonv nigetsilanasehvna.
english: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᏥ, ᎵᏏᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎷᎸᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nehvna gese unetsi, Lisiyeno vtla yidalulvvsgei, ale itsula hnaquo anigayvlige gesei.
english: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎤᎮᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎸ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᎨᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi atsilvgelohi tsulvwisdanedi gesv dulvwisdanehe Uhelanvhi agatahvi, nahiyu uliyilolv tsunilvwisdanediyi nahna gelvi,
english: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏜᏓᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏩᏴᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyunadvnedi gesv atsilvanelohi, nasgi uwadodi nigalisdisge adla gawasvgi nahiyu wayvha Yihowa utseli udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.
english: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏜᏓᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ.
phonetic: Unitsatino yvwi doyiditlv anadadolisdisge nahiyu adla gawasvgi gvdodiyi usqualvhv.
english: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Yihowano utseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv nudvnele gadoge agatisiditlv gawasvgi gvdodiyi gotlvsvi.
english: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᎳᏯᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsegalayano ugohv, udeyatanele ale usgalei.
english: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸᎩ; ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᎵᎢ ᎵᏏ ᏓᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏤᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᏣᏂᏃ ᏕᎯᏲᎥᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno dikahnawadidohi hia nuweselei; Tsegalaya tlesdi tsasgalvgi; hadadolisdisgvyeno etsadvganelv; ale tsadalii Lisi datsananugowiseli tsetsi atsutsa, Tsanino dehiyovha.
english: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏣᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale haliheligesdi ale osdv tsayelvsesdi; ale unitsati analiheligesdi udenv iyusdi.
english: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏗᎧᏅᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎤᏥ ᎤᎾᏅᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Ale atsilvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa dodikanvi, vtla ale uditasdi yigesesdi gigageaditasdi ale adayvsdesdisgi; ale ukalitsvhi gesesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, utsi unanvgowisv udagvwadalenvdv.
english: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏙᏛᎪᎸᏏ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏙᏛᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ale unitsati Isili tsuwetsi dodvgolvsi Yihowa Unanelanvhi iditlv dodvgatahvstani.
english: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᏳᏪᏅᎡᎵ [ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ] ᎢᎳᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏚᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏧᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏚᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale igvyi dayuwenveli [Ugvwiyuhi] Ilaya nasgiya gesesdi udanvdogi ale ulinigidiyu gesvi, tsugatahvsdiyi tsuninawi anigayvligei diniyoli iditlv widugatahvsdodiyi, ale nunohiyusvna tsugatahvsdiyi unadanvti anigatahnav iditlv widugatahvsdodiyi; tsudvnvisdodiyi yvwi, Ugvwiyuhi tsudvnvisdanediyi.
english: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᎳᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ?  ᎠᏆᏛᏐᏅᎯᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᎵᎢ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsegalayano hia nuwesele dikahnawadidohi, Gadono aquadolehohisdodi gesesdi nasgi hia?  Aquadvsonvhiyeno, ale aquadalii hnaquo agayvligei.
english: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎨᏈᎵ, ᏥᏥᏙᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏨᎩᏅᏒ ᎬᏯᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino unetsv hia nuweselei; Ayv Gequili, tsitsidogo Unelanvhi agatahvi; ale tsvginvsv gvyalinohedodiyi, ale gvnanugowisediyi hia nasgi osdv kanohedv.
english: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏨᎨᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo tsvgewi gesesdi, ale getsaneisdi nigesvna gesesdi gvni nahiyu iga nasgi hia nigalistanvha, nvdigalisdodiha nitsohiyunvna gesv tsinegvi, nasgi ase iyulisdodi tsigi iyulisdodiyi asqualvhvha.
english: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏰ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏩᏯᎥ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Yvwino gvwagatiye Tsegalaya, ale unisquanigosge gohidiyu wayav udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.
english: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸ ᏩᏯᎥ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᏓᏁᎶᏓᏁᎮᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᏉ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunugotsvno vtla digvwalinohedodi yigesei; unadolehoseno unelawiselv wayav udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.  Danelodaneheno ale nvwasdequo uwagewi gesei.
english: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏧᏪᏅᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nulistanei, nasgi hnaquo usquadv aselvhi gesv igohidv tsulvwisdanediyi, uwenvse tsuwenvsvi.
english: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎵᏏ ᎤᏁᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏍᎦᎳᏁ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Onino iyvdv udalii Lisi unelitsei, ale udisgalane hisgi iyanvdo, hia nuwesei,
english: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏕᎠᏆᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᎠᎩᎲᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎥᏆᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi naquadvnelv Yihowa nahiyu iga deaquakahnanv, agihvediyi udehohisdi vquadanvtediyi yvwi anehvi.
english: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎵᏁᏃ ᎧᎸᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏈᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ,
phonetic: Sudalineno kalvi dikahnawadidohi Gequili Unelanvhi nvdayunvsidv ulutse gaduhv Gelili Naselidi tsudoidv,
english: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏛ ᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ulutsele adv nasgi Tsowa tsudoidv asgaya udayvsdi, nasgi Dewi unetlvtanvdv nvdayudalenvhi gesei; nasgino adv Meli tsudoidv gesei.
english: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏲᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᏫᏗᏣᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏓ; ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino ulutselv hia nuwesei; Gvyoliga nihi etsalvquotanvhi, Yihowa widitsakahnawadida; anigeyv anehv nihi wudagonadvdi osiyu itsalisdanedi.
english: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎵᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ugohvno udeyatanele nasgi nuweselvi, ale udanvtele nusdv uyelvdv hia nasgi uyolilvi.
english: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎺᎵ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏣᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏩᏛᎲ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino hia nuweselei; Meli tlesdi tsasgalvgi; Unelanvhiyeno osdv tsayelvdi gesv tsawadvhv.
english: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏘᏁᎵᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏙᏘᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo tinelitsi, ale tinanugowisi atsutsa, ale Tsisa dotiyoi.
english: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᏱᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏳᏁᎵ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Atsilvquodiyu gesesdi nasgi, ale wasdv Galvladiyu ehi Uwetsi agosehesdi; Yihowano Unelanvhi dayuneli udoda dewi uwesgilvi.
english: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale winasdvna ugvwiyuhi gesesdi Tsegaqui unetlvtanvdv gesv anehvi; ale nasgi ugvwiyuhi gesv wusditsihisdi nigesvna gesesdi.
english: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
phonetic: Melino hia nuwesele dikahnawadidohi; Gado yigalisdoda nasgi yinigalisda, nitsigatahvnano tsigi asgaya?
english: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏣᎷᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏣᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏔᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏨᏓᏣᏕᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino unetsv hia nuweselei; Galvquodiyu Adanvdo datsalutseli ale ulinigidiyu gesv wasdv Galvladiyu ehi datsadawadisdotani; nasgi iyusdi nasquo nasgi galvquodiyu tsvdatsadeneli Unelanvhi Uwetsi agosehesdi.
english: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏍᏗᏠᏱ ᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎤᏁᎵᏨ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏑᏓᎵᏁ ᎧᎳ ᎬᏩᏁᎵᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo isditloyi Lisi nasquo atsutsa unelitsv hnaquo agayvlige gesvi; ale gohi tsigi hnaquo sudaline kala gvwanelitsvhi nasgi dilulvvsgi nigesvna tsagosehvgi.
english: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla gohusdi unulvdi yigesesdi.
english: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᏫᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏏ.  ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Melino hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo aquo unvsidasdi ageyv; Yihowa nasgiya nitsawesv winaqualisdasi.  Dikahnawadidohino udanvelei.
english: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎤᏩᏅᏤ ᎣᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ;
phonetic: Melino nahiyu dulenei, uwanvtse odali gesv wulosei, Tsudiyi gaduhv wulutsei;
english: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎵᎴ ᎵᏏ
phonetic: Ale wuyvle Tsegalaya ganelvi, ale uyolile Lisi
english: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎵᏏ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏲᎵᎲᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎦᏁᎵᏒ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎵᏏ ᎤᎧᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ,
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi Lisi udvganv Meli uyolihvi, ayoli ganelisv ulitelvnei; ale Lisi ukalitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo,
english: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏨᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ.
phonetic: Ale asdaya unetsei, hia nuwesei; Anigeyv anehv nihi wudagonadvdi etsalvquodiyu; ale galvquodiyu nasgi nihi tsvtinanugowisi.
english: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏥ ᏣᎩᎷᏥᏏ?
phonetic: Gadono dagalisdoda ayv nasgi tsinaqualisdasi, nasgi aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi utsi tsagilutsisi?
english: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᏉ ᎯᏁᎬ ᏍᎩᏲᎵᎲᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏁᎵᏒ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquoyeno aquadvganvquo hinegv sgiyolihvi, ayoli tsinelisv ulitelvnv aliheligvi.
english: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎸ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi uwohiyunvhi; nasgiyeno nvtsuweselv Yihowa nasgi ase nvdagalistani.
english: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ,
phonetic: Melino hia nuwesei, Aquadanvdo utsati galvquodiha Yihowa,
english: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale aquadanvdo ulihelitselv Unelanvhi Agisdelisgi.
english: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᎧᎿᎭᏅᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏏᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎬᏉᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Deukahnanvyeno uyo nudvhnadegv ageyv unvsidasdi; gvniyuquoyeno gohi iyudalenvdv nanadanetliyvsisv yvwi galvquodiyu gvquosehesdi.
english: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvyeno tsigi nasgi usquanigodiyu naquadvnelv; ale galvquodiyu nasgi deudovi.
english: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎭ ᎬᏩᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏏᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udadolisdi gesv degananugowiseha gvwanayesgi nanadanetliyvsisvi.
english: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Kanogeni uwvtanv unanugowisv ulinigidv gesvi; unatlvquodi dotsunadanvdv dudigaleyastanv.
english: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᏪᎧᎲᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅ.
phonetic: Tsunalinigidv duwekahvsv unanvdiyi, ale uyo iyunadvhnadegi dusaladanv.
english: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏂᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢᏃ ᎠᏒᎭ ᏙᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Agonu tsuniyosisgi osdv gesv dukaliistanv, tsunehnaino asvha dounenvsdiyi niduwanelvgi.
english: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᎠᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Isili unvsidasdi usdelvhv anvdadisgv udadolitsadvi,
english: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya niduweselv digigayvligei, Equahami, ale nasgi tsunetlvtanvdv gesv nigohilvi.
english: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᏕᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᎤᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Melino tsoi iyanvdo iyvdv Lisiyi udenei, gilano uwasv tsuwenvsv wiulosei.
english: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎵᏏᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎴ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎠᏧᏣ.
phonetic: Lisino hnaquo usqualvele udediyi ayoli, ale unanugowise atsutsa.
english: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎿᎭᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Navno iyunadala ale gohusdi tsuwahna unadvgane Unelanvhi utsati uwedolitsvi, ale itsulaha unalihelitsei.
english: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎤᏙᏓ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏚᏃᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi tsuneline iga unihusdeselvha ayoli, ale Tsegalaya dunoei, udoda dudov dunostanei.
english: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏥᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏞᏍᏗ; ᏣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Utsino unetsv hia nuwesei; Vtlesdi; Tsanisgini agosehesdi.
english: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᏠᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏙᎥ.
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei; Vtla gilo itsitloyi gesv nasgi yinusdi yidudov.
english: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᏓᏃ ᏓᎾᏁᎶᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏛᏛᏁ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏣᎪᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Udodano dananelodanehv unadvdvne nusdv udulisgv tsagosdiyi.
english: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏔᏲᎴᏃ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏣᏂ ᏚᏙᎥ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Utayoleno digowelodiyi ale uwowelane hia nigawesgei; Tsani dudov.  Nigadvno unisquanigosei.
english: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎱᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎦᏃᎪᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏌᏕᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏂᏎ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv ahuli ulisduisei, ganogono udelisadesei, ale uwonise ulvquotane Unelanvhi.
english: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏗᏂᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏤ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎣᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahnano gvwaduwidv dininelv nigadv uninayesei; ale nigadv nasgi hia nulistanidolv dunotsalotse nigvnadv odali gesv Tsudiyi.
english: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ?  ᏱᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivno nasgi unadvganvhi tsuninawiyi unisquanigotanei, hia naniwesgei; Gado usdesdi hia ayoli?  Yihowano usdelvhidohei.
english: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᏓᏃ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Udodano Tsegalaya ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale udolehose hia nuwesei;
english: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ; ᏚᏩᏛᎰᎸᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎫᏴᎲ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyu gesesdi Yihowa Unelanvhi Isili unatseliga; duwadvholvyeno ale duguyvhv tsutseliga yvwi.
english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎤᏲᏅ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ;
phonetic: Ale iginanugowiselv uyonv igalisdelvdodi, Dewi unvsidasdi unetlvtanvdv gesv anehv unanugotsv;
english: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgiya nuwesv degvdisgv tsutseli getsilvquodi anadolehosgi unadenvhi tsigi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv;
english: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎨᎩᏍᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏂᎨᎬᏅ ᏗᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎨᎩᏂᏆᏘᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi didadudalaediyi gegisgagi, ale asdaya nigegvnv didadudalaediyi nigadiyu geginiquatihi;
english: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Iyudvnediyi duduisdanelv digigayvlige tsuwedolisdiyi, ale unvdadisdiyi utseli galvquodiyu kanohedv datlohisdvi,
english: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎢᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ,
phonetic: Nasgi tsuselitane tsuduisdanele igigayvlige Equahami,
english: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Nasgi gedadudalaelvhi gesv gegisgagi igalisgolvdanediyi nidinayesgvna edadadolisdanediyi,
english: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nidisganvna ale duyugodv igedasdiyi agatahv nigohilv idalenidohvi.
english: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎯᏲᎵ, ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏘᏰᏅᎡᎵ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎯᏯᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nihino hiyoli, wasdv Galvladiyu ehi utseli adolehosgi etsosehesdi, nihiyeno igvyi tiyenveli Yihowa, hiyadvnvisdanediyi ulohisdiyi;
english: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ,
phonetic: Gvnigesv itsuwanediyi tsutseli yvwi nasgi unalisdelvdodi gesvi, gagetsinehv unisganvtsvi,
english: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏗᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᎯᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Yihowa udadolitsatiyu gesv Iganelanvhi, nasgi tsinigalisdodiha igagati diyelihisdisgi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi igiwadvhilvhi tsigi,
english: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦ ᏧᏘᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᏣᏂᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏖᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Iga tsutisdanediyi ulisigv ale ayohuhisdi gesv udawadisdodv tsanina, ale digatenvsdiyi nvwadohiyadv ganvnvi.
english: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎵᏃ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎨ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ ᎡᎮᎢ ᎬᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
phonetic: Ayolino advsgei ale kanequoge ulinigosgv udanvdvi, ale inagequo ehei gvni gvnigesv nidudvnelv Isili.
english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏌ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno hia nulistanei, nasgi Sisa Ogasda unetsvhi unanugotse nigvnadv elohi gegasesdiyi.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏎᎵᏙᎴ ᎠᏏ ᏌᎵᏂ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia unaselidole asi Salini Siliyi ugvwiyuhi nigesvna nigesei.
english: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigadv unenvse gegasesdiyi anisiyvwiha gesv dodaniduhvi.
english: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏂᎩᏎᎢ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏭᎷᏤ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᏕᏫ ᏧᏪᏚᎲᎢ, ᎦᏚᏱ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏫ,
phonetic: Ale Tsowa nasquo Gelili unigisei unugotse Naselidi gaduhvi, wulutse Tsudiyi, Dewi tsuweduhvi, gaduyi tsudoidv, Dewiyeno unetlvtanvdv gesv nvdayudalenvhi gesei ugayvlige gesei ale Dewi,
english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gegasesdiyi uyelvse uwasv ale Meli udayvsdi, nasgi ganelidv gesei.
english: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi asi nahna anedohei, usqualvhe ayoli unanugowisdiyi.
english: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎸᏁᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏜᏓᏅᏕ ᏧᏂᏒᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Unanugowiseno igvyi ehi uwetsi atsutsa, ale uwetsanulanei, ale soquili unalisdayvdiyi ulvnei; vtlayeno yudlanvde tsunisvsdiyi adanelvi.
english: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎾᎥᎢ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏫ ᏓᏂᎦᏘᏰ ᏒᏃᏱ.
phonetic: Nahnano navi awidinigatiya anedohe udlanvdvi, awi danigatiye svnoyi.
english: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono dikahnawadidohi Yihowa utseliga unilutselei, ale galvquodiyu dulvsadv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga dunaduwistanei ale utsatanvhi unisgalei.
english: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏲᎯᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino hia niduweselei; Tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi, gvniyuquoyeno itsvyohisi osdv kanohedv utsati alihelisdi, naniv yvwi unadvgodi.
english: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏣᏕᏁᎸ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏚᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Gohiyeno iga itsadenelv Dewi uweduhvi, Itsisdelisgi nasgi Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi.
english: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏙᎯᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏓᏰᏥᏩᏛᎯ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᏣᏄᎴᏍᏗ, ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi itsadohihohisdodi gesesdi; Dayetsiwadvhi ayoli atsitsanulesdi, soquili unalisdayvdiyi ganvgesdi.
english: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv unitsati galvladi anehi gvwaligonele dikahnawadidohi, Unelanvhi anilvquodisgei, hia naniwesgei;
english: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᏙᎯᎣ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyu gesesdi Unelanvhi wasdv galvladiyu, elohino dohio gesesdi, osdv gegadanvtesgesdi yvwi.
english: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ; Ꭷ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎢᏕᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏂᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nulistanei, nasgi dinikahnawadidohi gvwanadanvelv, galvladi wiunilosv, hia nidunadawesele awidinigatiya; Ka, hnaquo gaduyi idena, ale widadolehohi nasgi hia nulistanvi, nasgi Yihowa gvnigesv tsinigvnisi.
english: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎺᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ulisdiyuno wunilutsei, ale duniwadvhe Meli ale Tsowa, ale ayoli soquili unalisdayvdiyi ganvgei.
english: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unigohvno uninohelidole nusdv getsinohehelv nasgi ayoli atsineisdisgvi.
english: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unadvganvhi unisquanigose nusdv gvwaninohehelv awidinigatiya.
english: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎯᎶᎡ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Melisgini nasgi hia nigadv usquanigotanei, ale nasgi udanvtehiloe tsudanvdvi.
english: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫᏃ-ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Awinodinigatiya iunatsvsei, anilvquodisge ale analihelitsehe unelanvhi nvdigalisdodisge nigav unadvganv ale unigohvi, nasgi nusdv getsinonelvi.
english: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏂᏚᏬᎡ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏥᏁᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunelineno iga usqualvhv nasgi ahusdesedi gesv ayoli, TsiSa dunoei, nasgi dikahnawadidohi niduwoe asiquo natsineligvna gesei.
english: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏂᏃᎴ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏂᎧᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Hnaquono usqualvhv unadanvgalvdiyi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi Mosi uwowelanvhi, Tsilusilimi uninole Yihowa unikanediyi;
english: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᎰᏩ ᏣᏥᎵᎦ; ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgiya nigvnv gowelv dikahnawadvsdiyi Mohowa tsatsiliga; Naniv igvyi unadenvhi anisgaya Yihowa Tsatsiyohiselvhi gegosehesdi;
english: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᎴᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏛ ᏬᏱ.
phonetic: Ale atsilvgelasdi unalisgolvdodiyi nasgiya hia nigawesgv dikahnawadvsdi Yihowa utseliga; Anitali tsuledinisgonihi, ale anitali anidv woyi.
english: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎡᎮ ᏏᎻᏯᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎦᏘᏰ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo gilo iyusdi asgaya Tsilusilimi ehe Simiyani tsudoidv; ale nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi ale Unelanvhi dikahnawadegi gesei, agatiye Isili getsinuwohisdodiyi; Galvquodiyuno Adanvdo tali udvdidegei.
english: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ
phonetic: Ale gvnigesv iyuwanelvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdi nigesvna gesv gvni Yihowa utseli Galonedv ugohvhi yigi
english: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎮᎸᎯ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Ale adanvdo udanvtehelvhi wulutse udvnadigalawiisdiyi; tsugayvligeno uniyvtanilv ayoli Tsisa nasgi nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi iyunadvnediyi,
english: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Hnaquo nasgi unesei, ale ulvquotane Unelanvhi, hia nuwesei;
english: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᎯᏲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ;
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi, hnaquo hinvsidasdi nvwadohiyadv dehiyosga, nasgiya nitsawesv tsanetsvi;
english: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏰᏃ ᎬᏗ ᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ditsigaliyeno gvdi tsigowadv tsatseli alisdelvdodi.
english: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi tsadanelanvhi tsigi naniv yvwi anigatahvi,
english: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᏧᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Igagati tsunilvsadadedi Tsunadalenvdv yvwi, ale galvquodiyu gesv ditsatseli yvwi Isili unatseliga.
english: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tsowano ale ayoli utsi anisquanigosge nusdv atsineisdisgv nasgi.
english: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎻᎻᏯᏂᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏥ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏥᎧᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᎾᏡᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Mimiyanino osdv dunetselei, ale hia nuwesele Meli ayoli utsi, Gvniyuquo hia nasgi ayoli atsikanv nasgi Isili anehi unitsati tsuninvisdiyi ale tsunalehisododiyi; ale uyelvdv unatludodi aniwonisgvi.
english: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ: ᎥᎥ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏣᏘᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi unitsati nusdv danadanvtesgv tsuninawiyi gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi: Vv, ayelasdiganvhidv nasquo tsvsv tsadanvdo datsatili.
english: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏄᎡᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎡᏌ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎤᏠᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏛᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏛᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏨᏛ;
phonetic: Ale gilo iyusdi ageyv Eni tsudoidv adolehosgi ehei, nasgi Quanueli uwetsi gesei, Esa anilasdalv utloyi, nasgi utsati agayvlige gesei, ale galiquogi itsudetiyvdv unaneladvhi gese asgaya advquo gesv tsunatsvdv;
english: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏅᏍᎨ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏎᎢ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᎵᏏᏂᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uwosulotsvhi gese nelasgohi nvgigali iyvdv iyudetiyvdv, nasgi vtla yidanvsge udvnadigalawiisdiyi, Unelanvhiquo dakahnawadisei amatli gvsgv ale adadolisdisgv nidulisinisv ale nidugitsvnisvi.
english: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎴ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎧᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino nasquo nahiyuquo ulutse ulihelitsele Yihowa, ale nasgi dekaneisdanehe nanivquo Tsilusilimi anehi anigatenohi aguyvdodi gesv unanugoisdiyi.
english: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᏚᎲ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Unisquadvno nigadv iyadvnelidasdi gesv nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi Yihowa utseliga, iunatsvse Gelili wunilose, unvsv tsuniduhv Naselidi wunilutsei.
english: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎵᏃ ᎠᏛᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎵᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ayolino advsgei ale udanvdv alinigosgei, ukalitsvhi gese agadovhisdi gesvi; ale Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesv dukahnawadidohei.
english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎨ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Tsugayvligeno Tsilusilimi anege nidadetiyvhisv kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi asqualisgv iyui.
english: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏁᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Taladuno iyudetiyvdv gese Tsilusilimi unenvha nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv danalisdayvhvsgv iyui.
english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏚᎵᏒᏍᏛᎢ, ᎥᎤᎾᏨᏏᏗᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏌ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏗᎤᏗᎩᏰᎢ, ᏦᏩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unisquadvno igohidv dulisvsdvi, vunatsvsidisv ayoli Tsisa Tsilusilimi diudigiyei, Tsowano ale utsi vtla yinelisgei.
english: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᎾᎢᏒ ᎨᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬ ᏏᎦ ᎡᏅᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏁᏅᏎᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏅᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎦᏔᎯ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᏂᏲᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino sunadatlugi anaisv geladi anelisgv siga envsdi iyvdv unenvsei; gohusdino tsunvnv ale dinadagatahi aninv uniyolei.
english: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏠᏨᏃ ᎢᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏂᎶᏎ ᎬᏩᏲᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwatlotsvno iunatsvsei Tsilusilimi wunilose gvwayohei.
english: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏓᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏛᏛᎮᎸᎥᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi tsoine iga uniwadvhe udvnohi digalawiisdiyi, uwole ayeli aninv dinadeyohvsgi dadvdasdanehe ale dadvdvhelvvsgei.
english: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏃᏒ ᎪᎵᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᏕᎦᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno gvwadvganelvhi unisquanigose nosv goligvi, ale gvwadvdvhvsgv degawohiliyvsdanehvi.
english: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏥᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏅᏍᎩᎾᏛᏂᏏᏉ?  ᏣᏙᏓ ᎢᏍᏛᏲᎲᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎩᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Tsugayvligeno gvwagohv unisquanigosei; utsino hia nuweselei Aquetsi, gadono nvsginadvnisiquo?  Tsadoda isdvyohvgi uwelihisdi oginadanvtawadegvgi.
english: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᏂᏲᎮᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏍᏗᎦᏔᎮ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏇᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Gadono isginiyohei?  Tlasgo yisdigatahe Edodoyi ase aquedasdi gesvi?
english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi niduweselvi.
english: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏁᎶᏕᎢ.  ᎤᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ.
phonetic: Dusdawadvseno, ale Naselidi wulutsei, ale deunelodei.  Utsisgini hia nasgi nigadv usquanigotane unawiyi.
english: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎧᏁᏉᏥᏎ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsisa kanequotsise agatahnaiyu gesv ale advsgvi ale Unelanvhi ale yvwi gvwageyuhiyu gesvi.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒ ᏓᏈᎵᏯ ᏏᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏋᏗᏯ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎢᏚᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏝᎪᏂᏗ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎵᏌᏂᏯᏃ ᎠᏈᎵᏂ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Hisgigadusineno udetiyvsadisv Daquiliya Sisa ugvwiyuhi gesvi, Quvdiya Qualedi Tsudiyi tsaganelodi gesei, ale Elodv gelili sgadugi gesv atsigatidisdi gesei, unvtlino Quiligi Iduli ale Tlagonidi atsigatidisdi gesei, Lisaniyano Aquilini atsigatidisdi gesei;
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎾᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏱᏆ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎯ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Enano ale Gayiqua nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi gesei, Unelanvhi uwonisvhi inage ulutsele Tsani Tsegalaya uwetsi.
english: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏴᏓᏘᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi ulutse uwedole Tsodani navnige gesvi, alitsidohvsge kanohesge didawosdi gesv ganetliyvdv gesv odanvdvi, nasgi gayvdatinediyi osganvtsvi;
english: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏂᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎡᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏏ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏅᏅ ᏗᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nigvnv gowelv gowelihi Isaya adolehosgi uwenisvhi, hia tsinigaweha; Uweluga gilo inagei, hia nigaweha; Etsadvnvisdasi Yihowa ulohisdiyi, dunvnv ditsitsinohisda.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎨᏓᎵᏴᏅ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏙᏓᎸᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎯᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎡᎳᏗᎭ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏧᏓᏥᏃᏍᏈᏗᏰᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏥᏃᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᎬᎾᏕᏍᎩ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dugedaliyvnv nigadiyu dikaliisdi gesesdi, dodalvno ale dusahilv nigadiyu eladiha idigvnedi gesesdi, tsudatsinosquidiyedvno gesv digatsinohisdodi gesesdi, uyono deganvnv gvnadesgi idigvnedi gesesdi.
english: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏛᎪᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno uquedali dvgohi Unelanvhi udasdelvdodi gesvi.
english: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎸᏐᎸᎯ; Ᏺ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏂᎯ!  ᎦᎪ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduwesele unitsati nasgi digegawosdiyi unilvsolvhi; Yo inadv tsunetsi nihi!  gago itseyatanv etsaliediyi utalawohisdi uluhisdi gesvi?
english: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ; ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎬᏓ ᏱᏕᎪᏢᎾ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsinanugowa adolehohisdodi detsinetliyvsv detsadanvdvi; ale tlesdi itsalenvhv hia itsiwesv detsadanvdvi; Equahami ogidoda ayv; itsvyoseyeno Unelanvhi yeliquo hia nvya yidegvda yidegotlvna Equahami tsuwetsi.
english: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎦᎷᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏅᎯ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo gayula galuyasdi anvhi duhnasdetlv detlugvi; nasgi iyusdi nigadiyu detlugv osdv nadadvsgvna igesesdi digaleyvsdodi ale atsilvyi widadinvdi gesesdi.
english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏛᏁᎵ?
phonetic: Unitsatino gvwadvdvne hia nigvwaweselei; Gado dayotsadvneli?
english: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏔᎵ ᏗᎦᏌᎴᎾ ᏚᎾᎡᏍᏗ, ᏄᎾᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unetsv hia niduweselei; Gilo tali digasalena dunaesdi, nunavna gesv ganvnehesdi; gilono alisdayvdi uhesdi, nasgiya nadvnehesdi.
english: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎸᏐᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏛᏁᎵ?
phonetic: Nasquono adelvanigisidohi unilvsole digegawosdiyi, ale hia nigvwaweselei; Tadeyohvsgi, gado dayotsadvneli?
english: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎡᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᎢᏥᎩᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Tlesdi yitsilosvsdisgesdi igai etsinetselv itsigisidasdiyi.
english: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏃ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏛᏁᎵ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏱᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aniyawisgino nasquo igvwadvdvne, hia nuniwesei; ayv nano gado dayotsadvneli?  Hiano niduweselei; Tlesdi gilo gvsgaisdagi iyetsvnelvgi, ale tlesdi gayegogi yitsadalawisehesdi; ale yeliquo itsiyelvsesdi etsaguyvehvi.
english: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎠᏫ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᏣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Unitsatino anigatenohei, ale nigadvquo awi dotsunadanvdv gvwadanvtesge Tsani, nasgi Galonedv gesv, ale galonedv nigesvna gesvi;
english: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏕᏨᏯᏬᏍᏗᎭ; ᏓᏯᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎧᏁᏌᏛ ᏧᎳᏑᎶᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏙᏓᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ;
phonetic: Tsani unetse hia niduwesele nigadv, Ayv udohiyuhi ama detsvyawosdiha; dayaisgini utli ulinigidiyu esgaquo ayv, nasgi dakanesadv tsulasulogi vtla yeli yinigoi digikaneyvdiyi; nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale atsilv dodatsawostani;
english: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎳᏐᏫᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎦᎳᏐᏫᏏ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᎦᏟᏌᏂ ᏛᏂ ᎤᏗᏱ; ᎤᏬᎭᏄᎶᏔᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏛᎪᎲᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏂᎬᏠᏍᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi ulasowisdi ayeha, ale nigadv dagalasowisi ayodatlahvi, utsalesdino dagatlisani dvni udiyi; uwohanulotanvhisgini dvgohvstani atsilvyi nigvtlosgvna.
english: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Ale utsate tsudalenvdv degawonedisgv dulitsidonele yvwi.
english: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎡᎶᏗᏏ ᎤᏅᏟ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎤᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎡᎶᏛ,
phonetic: Elodvsgini sgadugi atsigatidisdi gesvi, Tsani ugvsgolvne diliyeilvsdisge Elodisi unvtli Quiligi udalei, ale nasquo nigadv utsatini nudvnelv Elodv,
english: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏚᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Asi wudagonadv hia nasgi nudvnelei, Tsani didasdudiyi usdunei.
english: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏬᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nulistanei, nigadv yvwi degegawov Tsisa nasquo agawoei, ale udadolistanv galvladi ulisduisei,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏠᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᏧᎴ-ᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏙᏢᏒᎢ; ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎶᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎯ ᎬᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎣᏏᏳ  ᎬᏰᎸᎢ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo tsutloase nasgi uweyalvtsei, ayelv tsuledisgonihi nasgiya gese udotlvsvi; kanegvno galvladi tsulose hia nvtsuwesei; Hihi gvgeyui Aquetsi; osiyu  gvyelvi nihi.
english: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎳᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano hnaquo ase tsoasgohi iyudetiyvdv gesei, nasgi Tsowa uwetsi uniyelvsei, nasgi Hilayi uwetsi gesei,
english: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏓᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎵᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵᎦᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Madadi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Liwi uwetsi gesei, nasgi meligayi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsana uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsowa uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏗᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎼᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᎠᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏏᎳ, ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Madidaya uwetsi gesei, nasgi Emosi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Neami uwetsi gesei, nasgi Esila, uwetsi gesei, nasgi Nagi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎠᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏗᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᎻᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Meadi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Madidaya uwetsi gesei, nasgi Simiya uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsowa uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsuda uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎠᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎵᏌ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎳᏇᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᎳᏓᏱᎵ  ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᎳᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Tsoana uwetsi gesei, nasgi Lisa uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsilaqueli uwetsi gesei, nasgi Saladayili  uwetsi gesei, nasgi Silayi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵᎦᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏌᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎵᎼᏓᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Meligayi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Adayi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Gosami uwetsi gesei, nasgi Elimodami uwetsi gesei, nasgi Vli uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎵᎡᏌ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏓᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎵᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Tsosi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Iliesa uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsolimi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Madadi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Liwi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᎻᏯᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎾᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎳᏱᎩᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Simiyani uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsuda uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsowa uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsonani uwetsi gesei, nasgi Ilayigimi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎻᎵᎠ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎻᎾᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏓᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏓᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Milia uwetsi gesei, nasgi Minani uwetsi gesei, nasgi Madada uwetsi gesei, nasgi Nedani uwetsi gesei, nasgi Dewi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏆᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᎵᎹ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏐᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Tsisi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Oquadi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Quosi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Salima uwetsi gesei, nasgi Nasoni uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎻᏂᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎳᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏇᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Eminida uwetsi gesei, nasgi Elimi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Isilami uwetsi gesei, nasgi Quelisi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tsuda uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᎰ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Tsegaqui uwetsi gesei, nasgi Esigi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Equahami uwetsi gesei, nasgi Dela uwetsi gesei, nasgi Neho uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎴᎪ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏇᎵᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏆ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Selagi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Lego uwetsi gesei, nasgi Queligi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Hiqua uwetsi gesei, nasgi Sela uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏱᏅ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏣ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎴᎻᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Kayinv uwetsi gesei, nasgi Aquatsa uwetsi gesei, nasgi Semi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Noya uwetsi gesei, nasgi Lemigi uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎻᏚᏏᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏃᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎳᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᎵᎵᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏱᏅ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Midusila uwetsi gesei, nasgi Inogi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Tseladi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Malilili uwetsi gesei, nasgi Kayinv uwetsi gesei,
english: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏃᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Inosi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Sedi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Adawi uwetsi gesei, nasgi Unelanvhi uwetsi gesei.
english: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏗᎤᏨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo Tsodani diutsvsei, ale adanvdo inage wutinvstanei,
english: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛ ᎩᎳ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nvgasgohi tsusvhidv ugoliyesge asgina.  Nasgino igohidv vtla gohusdi yusei Nasgino ulisquadv gila uyosisanei.
english: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎯᏁᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᎦᏚ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Asginano hia nuweselei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, hinegi hia nvya gadu iyulisdodiyi.
english: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ; ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏚᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎬᎿᎭᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsele hia nuwesei; Hia nigvnv gowela; Yvwi vtla gaduquo uwasv yigvhnadisdesdi, nigavsgini Unelanvhi unetsvi.
english: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏔᏁ ᎢᏅᎢᎦᏘ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏎᎮᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Asginano utinvse uhnalutane invigati odalvi, ale dusehele gilaquo iyvdv igohidv nigav ayeli degotlvwadisv elohi.
english: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏛᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏥᎥᏏ ᎨᎳ ᏥᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale asgina hia nuweselei; Hia nasgi nigadv ulinigidiyu gesv yidegvyohisi, ale nasgi galvquodiyu gesvi; ayvyeno dvgiyohiselv, ale gilo tsivsi gela tsinehoi.
english: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏍᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: nasgi iyusdi iyuno yisquadadolisdanelv, nigadiyu nihi tsatseli gesesdi.
english: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᏓ ᏎᏓᏂ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏕᎯᏯᏁᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetse ale hia nuweselei; Aquasohadv haleda Sedani; hiayeno nigvnv gowela; Yihowa Tsanelanvhi hiyadadolisdanehesdi, ale nasgi uwasvhiyu dehiyanelodesdi.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏘᏃᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᎶᎥᏓ ᎠᏂ;
phonetic: Ale tsilusilimi utinolei, ale udvnadigalawiisdiyi usgoli ugilvtanei, ale hia nuweselei; Iyuno nihi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesesdi, tsvsv hadalovda ani;
english: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ; ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏙᏓᎧᏁᏤᎵ ᏗᎨᏣᎧᎾᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv igowela; tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi dodakanetseli digetsakanawadidasdiyi getsasquanigododiyi;
english: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᎨᏣᏌᎳᏙᏗᏕᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏣᎾᏍᏆᎶᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale tsunoyeni getsasaladodidegesdi, nasgi ilvhiyu nvyohi tsanasqualosdodiyi nigesvna.
english: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano tsunetsv hia nuweselei; Hia igawedv igi; Tlesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi higoliyevgi.
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Asginano usquadv nigadv ugoliyesgvi, udanvele ilvsgi igohidv.
english: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏘᏂᏙᎲ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎢᎤᎷᏤᎢ; ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano Adanvdo utinidohv Gelili iulutsei; deganotsalvno nahna gvwaduwidv duyelisidolei.
english: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dadeyohvsge tsunilawiisdiyi, nanivno gvwalvquodiyu gesei.
english: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏎᎵᏗᏃ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎦᏛᎯᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᏁ ᏧᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎵ.
phonetic: Naselidino ulutse nahna agadvhistanvi; iyudvnedino gesv nudvnele wuyvle digalawiisdiyi unadodaquasgv iga, ale dulene tsugoliyediyi goweli.
english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᏅᏁᎴᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Atsinvneleno goweli Isaya adolehosgi uwowelanvhi.  Usduisvno goweli uwadvhe hia nigvnv gowelvi;
english: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏆᏛᏓᏁᎵᏕᎦ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏣᎩᎶᏁᎥ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ; ᏗᎩᏅᏒ ᏗᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᎦᏥᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᏥᏂᏆᎶᏔᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Adanvdo Yihowa utseli tali aquadvdanelidega nvdigalisdodi tsagilonev gatsiyalitsidonediyi osdv kanohedv uyo iyunadvhnadegi; diginvsv digatsinvwodiyi uyo unadanvtawadegi, gatsinonediyi aniyvgi gvwanadudalesdi gesvi, ale dinigewi gvwanigowadvdi gesvi, ale digatsiyagodiyi digetsiniqualotanvhi,
english: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏕᏘᏱᏍᎬ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aginohelidasdiyi adetiyisgv Yihowa tsudanilvisdi gesvi.
english: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏚᏁᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎤᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Usduneno goweli ale wiunvnele atsinvsidasdi, ale uwenei.  Nigadvno digalawiisdiyi aniyai uyanvsvhi degvwakahnanei.
english: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏙᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ulenvhe hia niduweselei; gohi iga tsigi hia nasgi gowelv adohiyuhvga itsadvgisgvi.
english: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏒ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Nigadiyuno gvwalvquodisgei ale anisquanigosge nasgi nosv uwonisvi.  Hiano nuniwesei, tlasgo hia nasgi Tsowa uwetsi yigi?
english: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᏓᏍᎩᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᏔᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ, ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᏅᏮᎦ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏆᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎿᎭᏛᎦ ᎠᏂ ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; ase dasgineisdaneli hia igawesdi tsigi; Tadanvwisgi, tsvsv hadanvwvga; nigav nusdv ogadvganv detsalvwisdanelv Gequani, nasgi nasquo hnadvga ani tsatseligohi.
english: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎦᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Adolehosgi vtla yidagadanilvgo uwasv utseligohi.
english: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏧᎵᏍᏚᎯ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏚᎪᏄᎶᎭ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; unitsate tsunosulotsvhi Isiliyi nahiyu Ilaya tsehei, galvloi tsulisduhi tsoi tsudetiyvdv sudalino iyanvdo, nahiyu utsati tsidugonuloha nigvnadvi.
english: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏯᏥᏅᏎ ᎩᎶ ᏭᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᏌᎴᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎦᏁᎳ.
