phonetic: Aseno vtla Ilaya yatsinvse gilo wulutsediyi, ageyv uwosulotsvhi uwasv, Saleda nasgi Sadoni gaduhv ganela.
english: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏁᎮ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎳᏏᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏤᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏥᏅᎦᎸᎡ, ᏁᎹᏂ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Ale unitsate anehe adayesgi tsunitlvgi Isiliyi nahiyu Ilasiya adolehosgi tsehei; aseno vtla gilo yatsinvgalve, Nemani Siliyi ehi uwasv.
english: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno digalawiisdiyi aniyai nasgi hia unadvganv unikalitse unitalawosgvi.
english: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᎴᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏩᏝᎥ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏚᎲ ᎦᎧᎲᎢ, ᏗᎬᏩᎶᎥᏔᏂᏎᎢ
phonetic: Dunaleneno ale gvwanugowise gaduhvi, ale wuwatlav usahilv wigvwatinvsta nahna uniduhv gakahvi, digvwalovtanisei
english: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᏎ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏍᏔᏁᏉ;
phonetic: Aseno ugadvlese ayeli anidonav igvwenvstanequo;
english: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎨᏆᏂ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏍᏆᎸᎮᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Gequani wulutse nasgi Gelili gaduhvi, ale degeyohvsge unadodaquasgv iga dasqualvhegvi.
english: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unisquanigoseno nusdv dadeyohvsgvi, ulinigidiyuyeno kanegei.
english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᏯᎡ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏇ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyino ayae gilo iyusdi asgaya gadaha adanvdo asgina uyai, ale asdaque uwelunei,
english: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎣᎦᏁᎳᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᏓᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎮᎯ?  ᏍᎩᏛᏔᏂᏄᏧ?  ᎬᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ-ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ
phonetic: Hia nigawesgei, Oganelagi; gado digadadvdodi nihi Tsisa Naselidi hehi?  Sgidvtaninutsu?  Gvgataha nihi nasgi gesviGalvquodiyu Unelanvhi utseliga gesvi
english: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᎳᏪ ᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᎠᏍᎦᏲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏩᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano usgatsei, hia nuwesei, Elawe hvna, ale hinugoi Asginano aninv ayeli ustlvnistanv unugotse asgayohi, ale vtla gohusdi yuwanelei.
english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ?  ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎬᏗᎭ ᏕᎧᏁᏤ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᎦ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unisquanigosei, ale unalinohele unvsv gesv hia nidunadaweselei; Gado usdi kaneisdi hia?  Utseligayayeno ale ulinigidv gesv degvdiha dekanetse anigadaha didanvdo, ale aninugoga.
english: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Deganotsalvno nahna nigvnadv duyelisidolei.
english: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏤ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ.  ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎨᎢ; ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴᏃ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Dulenvno unugotse digalawiisdiyi, sawanino ganelv wuyvlei.  Sawanino udalii utsi utsati udilehvsgei; gvwatayoseleno usdelvdiyi.
english: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏅᎬᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎴᏁ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏤ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏙᎣᎴᏃ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎪᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ganvgvno nav ulene, ale usgatse udilehvsgvi, udooleno udilehvsgvi, gilaquono iyvdv udidvhe, ale dusdelvgodolei.
english: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏭᏕᎵᎨ ᏅᏙ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏧᏁᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏚᏏᏔᏕ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏁᎢ
phonetic: Ale hnaquo wudelige nvdo nigadv tsudalenvdv tsunitlvgi tsunehi degvwatinohelei, ale anisiyvwiha dusitade ale dunvwanei
english: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏂᏄᎪᎨ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᎢ, ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.  ᏚᏍᎦᏤᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale anisgina nasquo gvwaninugoge unitsatei, aneluhvsge hia naniwesgei; Nihi Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi.  Dusgatseno dunvsdadele unineisdiyi; anigataheyeno nasgi Galonedv gesvi.
english: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᎤᏂᎨᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎬᏩᏲᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏗᎩᏯᏍᎨᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ ᎬᏬᏎᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo ugitsvnv unigese ale inage wulosei; unitsatino gvwayolei, ale gvwalutselei, ale gvwadigiyasgei, tlesdi sgiyadanvelvgi gvwosehei.
english: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏐᎢ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏨᎩᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Ase nasquo disoi degaduwadisv gatsiyalitsidonedi aginohedi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; nasgiyeno iyaquadvnediyi tsvginvsv.
english: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᎵᎵ.
phonetic: Ale alitsidohvsge digalawiisdiyi dadanelv Gelili.
english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏜᏓᏫᏍᏗᏕᎨ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᎦᏙᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi, unitsati gvwadlawisdidege unadvgodiyi kanohedv Unalanvhi utseliga, Genisiladi vdalulodi gadogei.
english: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏚᎪᎮ ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ ᏓᏔᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᎦᏯᎷᎥᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏣᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏅᎩᎶᏍᎨ ᎫᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
phonetic: Tsiyuno tali dugohe vdalulodi datalei; anigayaluvsgisgini unatsaidv gesei, ale danvgilosge gunigayaludi.
english: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏃ ᎠᏔᎸ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏣᏁᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎧᏙᏯᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏪᏁᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏳᎢ ᎬᏩᏣᎢ.
phonetic: Saquono atalv tsiyu utsanei nasgi Sawani utseliga gesei, ale utayosele usdigidv iyvdv wukadoyasdiyi.  Uweneno ale duweyone unitsati tsiyui gvwatsai.
english: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏗᏍᏛᎬ ᏫᏅᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏗᏨᎦ ᏗᏥᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏗᏥᏂᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono uyohistanv gawonisgv hia nuwesele Sawani, disdvgv winvsdv ale eladi niditsvga ditsigayaludi ditsiniyvdiyi.
english: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏨᏓᏆᏛ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏲᏥᏂᏴ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᏨ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ.
phonetic: Sawanino unetse hia nuweselei; Tadeyohvsgi ulitsvdaquadv dogilvwisdasi vtlano gohusdi yotsiniyv; aseno nihi tsanetsv iyusdi dagvni agayaludi.
english: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎠᏣᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᏚᎾᎵᎦᎵᏎᎴᎢ
phonetic: Nasgino nunadvnelv unitsati duniniyvhe atsadi; ale unigayaludi dunaligaliselei
english: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏁᎶᏥᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏂᏍᏕᎸᎲᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏥᏳ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᎦᏃᏴᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Dunanelotsineleno unaligohi soiyi tsiyuhi unatsai nvdagvwanisdelvhvsdiyi.  Unilutseno, ale itsula tsiyu dunikalilei, nasgino hnaquo deganoyvgei.
english: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏃᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎧᏂᎨᏂ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏍᏆᏓᏅᏏ, ᏥᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Sanonino Quida ugohv udanvne Tsisa dikanigeni navi, hia nigawesgei; Tsagvwiyuhi squadanvsi, tsisganahiyuyeno ayv.
english: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Usquanigoseyeno ale nigadv anehi unisquanigose nvdigalisdodisge naniv atsadi duniniyvhvi;
english: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏌᏩᏂ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᎦᎸᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏘᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Tsimi ale Tsani Tsequidi tsuwetsi nasgi unaligohi tsigese Sawani.  Tsisano hia nuwesele Sawani; Tlesdi tsasgalvgi; gohi iyudalenvdv yvwi tiniyisgi gesesdi.
english: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏝᎥᏃ ᏚᏂᏔᎳᏗᎸ ᏥᏳ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᏲᏐᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Uwatlavno dunitaladilv tsiyu, nigadv duniyosone ale gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏯᏍᏚᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏍᎩᏅᎦᎸ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane ilvhitlv gaduhv edohvi, gvniyuquo asgaya nigv adayesgi utlvgi nahna edohei; nasgi Tsisaugohv uyasdusei, ale utayosele hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv yeliquo yisginvgalv.
english: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛᏃ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎾ; ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Udoyanvhidvno usvnilei, hia nuwesei; Osiyu tsiyelvna; tsadanvgalvdv gesesdi.  Gilaquono iyvdv adayesgi utlvgv udanvelei.
english: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ, [ᎤᏬᏎᎴᎢ,] ᏫᏯᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏫᎲᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Unetseleno gilo unonediyi nigesvna; henaquosgini, [uwoselei,] wiyadananugowisi atsilvgelohi, ale Mosi unetsv tsadanvgalvhv alisgolvdodi wihvga, nasgi unadolehohisdodi.
english: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏚᏰᎵᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno utliquo igai duyelise nasgi deganotsalvi.  Unitsatino dunilawitsole unadulisge unadvgodiyi ale tsunvwodiyi dunitlvgvi.
english: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏬᎶᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Udanvseno inage wolose ale adadolisdisgei.
english: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏁ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᏩᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᏚᎾᏗᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhiyuno hia nulistanei, nahiyu dadeyohvsgei, nahna anine Aniqualisi ale dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi degaduwadisv Gelili nvdawanilosvhi, ale Tsudiyi, ale Tsilusilimi; Ugvwiyuhino ulinigvgv dunadiwisdisgei.
english: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏃᎴ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᎦᏅᎨ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ; ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ [ᏥᏌ] ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo gilo iyunasdi anisgaya uninole atsesdogihi ganvge asgaya ulvdalvvsgi; unanelotaneno uniyvtanihisdiyi, ale [Tsisa] igvyitlv uninvnediyi.
english: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎾᎩᎳᏫᏎᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏧᏂᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏠᎥᏔᏂᎴ ᎤᏤᏍᏙ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Unatlotsvno iyunadvnediyi uniyvtanihisdiyi unitsati gesv iyusdi, gasanali unagilawisei, nahnano tsunigadvlehistane unatlovtanile utsesdo gvwatloyasdi unadatlugv ayeli, Tsisa igvyitlv uninvnelei.
english: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Unohiyusvno udolehosv, hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
english: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ?
phonetic: Dinowelisgino ale Aniqualisi unadanvtele hia nuniwesei; Gago hia nasgi tsasotlvisdiha?  Gago gvwadadolisdi asganvtsvi?  Tlasgo unelanvhi uwasv?
english: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᏙᏗᎶᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa udolehosv nusdv danadanvtesgvi, unetse hia niduweselei; Gado itsadanvteha dodilodanvdvi?
english: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗᏱ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ?
phonetic: Gado usdi utli ahidiyu kaneisdiyi, Tsasganvtsv etsadoligi advdiyi; ale hia igawesdiyi, Talehvga ale heda?
english: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, (ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ;) ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎮᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno itsadolehohisdiyi Yvwi Uwetsi yeliquo ani elohi gvwadadolisdi gesv osganvtsvi, (hia nuwesele ulvdalvvsgi;) hia nigvweseha; Talehvga, tsatsesdo hinagi, ale ditsenvsv hena.
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏎ ᎤᏤᏍᏙᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv udidvhe danikanvi, ale unese utsesdogi, ale tsuwenvsv wulosei, galvquodisge Unelanvhi.
english: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Nigadiyuno utsatanvhi unisquanigosei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, ale ukalitsvhi unayehisdi unadanvdadei, hia naniwesgei; Usquanigodiyu idigowadv gohi iga.
english: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎵᏫ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎫᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nulistanidolv unugotsei, ale ugohe adelv agisidohi Liwi tsudoidv, uwole ayeli ehi adelv aguyvdiyi; ale hia nuweselei, Sgisdawaduga.
english: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏮᏕᏦᏁ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᏁ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno uwvdetsone ale dulene usdawadvsei.
english: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎵᏫᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᏓᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Liwino utsati tsagalisdayvnanediyi udvnvisdanele uwasv ganelvi; ale unitsate adelv anigisidohi ale nvwanadale itsulaha aninvdlaei.
english: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏚᏂᏔᎳᏬᎯᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎦ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ?
phonetic: Dinowelisgisgini tsunatseli ale Aniqualisi dunitalawohisele gvwasdawadidohi, hia nuniwesei; Gadono itsulaha itsalisdayvhvsga ale itsaditasga adelv anigisidohi ale anisganai?
english: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᏴ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᏚᏂᏢᎬᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ, ᏧᏂᏢᎩᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hiyv nisuweselei; Nidunitlvgvna vtla udulvdi yinunalisdaneho didanvwisgi, tsunitlvgisgini.
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏅᎯᎸ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla unadanvti yiditsiyanvhilv, anisganasgini tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi.
english: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏗᏔᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei; gadono Tsani gvwasdawadidohi yanogiyu amatli anvsgoi ale anadadolisdisgoi, ale nasquo Aniqualisi gvwanisdawadidohi; nihisgini getsasdawadidohi analisdayvhvsgo ale anaditasgoi.
english: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏥᎪ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎤᏅᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᏕᏨᏂᏏ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Tsigo degegatsvsdisgv anigatahi amatli unvdiyi yinidetsvnisi asiquo uneladidohv udesvnilvhi?
english: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎵᏰᎢᎶᎵ ᎢᎦ ᏓᎨᏥᏯᏅᎡᎵ ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ, ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno diliyeiloli iga dagetsiyanveli udesvnilvhi, nahiyuno hnaquo amatli anvsgesdi.
english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ [ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;] ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏪᏘᎯ ᏱᎦᎳᏍᏢᎥᏍᎪᎢ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏛᏁᎸ, ᎢᏤ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎦᏣᎦᎵᏍᎪ ᎤᏪᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏙᎵᎪ ᎤᏪᏘ.
phonetic: Dutlilosdaneleno nasquo [hia nuwesei;] vtla gilo itse anuwo uwetihi yigalastlvvsgoi; iyuyeno nasgi yinudvnelv, itse anuwo gatsagalisgo uweti, ale nasquo itse agvhalvdv vtla yidanadoligo uweti.
english: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏘ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏱᏓᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ;  ᎢᏤᏰᏃ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎦᏣᎦᎸ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏤᏬᎩ, ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏃ ᏱᏓᏲᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo gigageaditasdi tsuweti disutlvdv yidatlisdisgoi;  itseyeno gigageaditasdi yidogatsagalv disutlvdv ale yatsewogi, disutlvdvno yidayogi.
english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏃ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᏗᏤ ᏗᏑᏢᏛ ᏗᏟᏍᏙᏗ; ᎩᎳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏂᏗᎬᏩᏍᏙᎢ
phonetic: Itsesgino gigageaditasdi ase ditse disutlvdv ditlisdodi; gila hnaquo itsula nidigvwasdoi
english: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩᏛ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ ᎢᏤ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏪᏘ ᎤᏟ ᏃᎯ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo uweti gigageaditasdi udugidv tsigeso igvwenvdv itse yudulisgoi; hiayeno nigawesgoi, Uweti utli nohi.
english: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏄᎵᏐᏃᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᎶᏎᎢ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᎫᏕᏎ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏗᎨ ᎠᎾᏍᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane taline unadodaquasgv igvyiyi nulisonoi, nasgi tlogesi utsalesdi dawisv ulosei, gvwasdawadidohino dunisgudese utsalesdi, ale unisdige anasgoliyesge tsunoyeni.
english: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi aniqualisi hia nigvwaniweselei, Gadono nihi nitsadvneha nasgi igvdvnedi nigesvna gesv unadodaquasgv iga.
english: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏫ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎪᏄ ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisano dunetselv hia nuwesei; Tlasgo nasquo hia nasgi yitsigoliyeoi, nasgi Dewi nudvnelvi, agonu tsuyosisge uwasv ale nasgi tsanehei?
english: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏴᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎨ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsuyvle Unelanvhi utseli adanelvi, ale tsugise ale tsuge gadu agadodi, ale nasquo tsidunele nasgi tsanehei; nasgi niduyugodvna tsigi gilo ugisdiyi atsilvanelohi unvsv.
english: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei; Nasquo unadodaquasgv Yvwi Uwetsi utseliga.
english: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ Ꮕ-ᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏕᏲᏁᎢ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎡᏙᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ
phonetic: Hiano nasquo nulistane nvwadale unadodaquasgvi, nasgi wuyvle digalawiisdiyi ale dudeyonei; nahnano edohe asgaya agatisiditlv uwoyeni uwaiselvhi
english: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏬᏗᏉ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Dinowelisgino ale Aniqualisi gvwayawisgei, tsigo gvwadanvwodiquo unadodaquasgv iga anelisgei, nasgi gohusdi gvwanuhisdodi uniyohei.
english: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎭᎴᏂᎦ.  ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᎴᏂᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno agatahe nusdv danadanvtesgvi, ale hia nuwesele asgaya uwaiselvhi uwoyeni; Talehvga, ale ayeli haleniga.  Dulenvno ulenilei.
english: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ; ᎦᏙ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎪ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏲᎨ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎬᏅ ᎠᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᎯᏍᏗᏱᎨ?
phonetic: Hnaquono tsisa hia niduweselei; sudalegi datsvyadvdvni; Gado duyugodi unadodaquasgvi?  Osdvsgo digalvwisdanediyi, uyoge digalvwisdanediyi?  Gvnv asdelvdiyi, adahisdiyige?
english: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸᏃ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ; ᎤᏬᏰᏂᏃ ᎤᏗᏩᏎ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏐᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Dukahnanidolvno gvwaduwidv nigadv nunadvnvi, hia nuwesele asgaya; Hadoyanvhidv.  Nasgino nudvnelei; uwoyenino udiwase nasgiya soi nusdv nulistanei.
english: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤᏃ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ; ᏚᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Unikalitseno unitalawosgvi; dunalinoheleno unvsv iyunvnediyi Tsisa.
english: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏭᎶᎭ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏨᏓᏇ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nahiyui, nasgi odalv wuloha udadolistanvsei, ale utsvdaque Unelanvhi adadolisdanehvi.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏚᏑᏰᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ^
phonetic: Hnaquono iga nulistanv gvwasdawadidohi widuyanvhei; nasgino gvwasdawadidohi gesv taladu iyanidv dusuyesei, ale getsinvsidv duwoei^
english: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᏓ ᏚᏬᎡᎢ, ᎡᏂᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏅᏟ.  ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏙᎳᎻ,
phonetic: Sawani, nasgi nasquo Quida duwoei, Enidino nasgiquo unvtli.  Tsimi ale Tsani, Quiligi ale Quadolami,
english: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ, ᏥᎻ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏫᏥ, ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏏᎶᏗ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ,
phonetic: Madu ale Dami, Tsimi Eliqui uwitsi, Sawanino Silodi tsanosehoi,
english: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Tsudasino Tsimi dinadanvtli, ale Tsudasi Isgaladi nasgi adalonuhesgi tsinulistanei.
english: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏒ ᎤᏬᏓᎸ ᎤᎴᏁᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎶᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎷᏤ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino itsulaha tsunigasoasv uwodalv ulenei.  Ale unitsati gvwasdawadidohi, ale unitsuquisdi yvwi nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi, ale Taya ale Sadoni amequohi ulodi nvdayunilosvhi, nasgi tsunilutse gvwadvganediyi, ale digetsinvwodiyi dunitlvgvi.
english: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏕᎩ [ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ]; ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale anigadaha didanvdo gvwanadeyadodidegi [unilutsei]; ale degetsinvwanei.
english: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎬᏩᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏗᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unitsati gesv anatlinigvnehe gvwasvnisdiyi.  Nasgiyeno gesv didalehvsge udanvwodi gesv ale dunadiwisdisge nanivi.
english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁᏃ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎧᎾᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ; ᎢᏣᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dusaladaneno digadoli dukanane gvwasdawadidohi, hia nuwesei; Osiyu itsalisdanedi uyo itsadvhnadegi; itsatseliyeno Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏥᏲᏏᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏙᏓᏦᎸᏏᏰᏃ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏛᏥᏰᏥᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Osiyu itsalisdanedi ditsiyosisgi gohi gesvi; dodatsolvsiyeno.  Osiyu itsalisdanedi ditsatloyihi gohi gesvi; dvtsiyetsiyeno.
english: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Osiyu itsalisdanedi iyuno yvwi getsiniquatihesdi, ale getsadadaledisgesdi, ale gagetsisotlvdesdi, ale anisgagiyu gesesdi detsadov gohusdi uyo nasgiyai, Yvwi Uwetsi nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎵᏔᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Itsaliheligesdi nahiyu iga, ale detsalitadegesdi itsaliheligvi; gvniyuquoyeno utsati etsaguyvedi galvladi; nasgiyayeno tsunidoda nidunvnele anadolehosgi.
english: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏤᎾᎢ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ!  ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nihisgini ditsenai tsigi, uyo itsalisdanedi!  gayulayeno itsiha itsigalisdadisgi.
english: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᎸᏒᎯ!  ᏙᏛᏥᏲᏏᏌᏂᏰᏃ.  ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏥᏰᏣᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ!  ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi ditsolvsvhi!  dodvtsiyosisaniyeno.  Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi itsiyetsasgi tsigi gohi!  uyoyeno itsadanvtawadegesdi ale detsatloyihesdi.
english: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ!  ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏂᏚᏂᎸᏉᏕ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi nahiyu nigadiyu yvwi osiyu getsinohesgesdi!  nasgiyayeno tsunigayvlige nidunilvquode unatlonasdi anadolehosgi.
english: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎭ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ,
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha nihi tsisgiyadvganeha; Detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi, osdv nidetsadvnehesdi getsiniquatihi,
english: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Osdv detsinetsehesdi getsisginvdisgi, ale itsadadolisdisgesdi getsidolisdiyi gagetsisotlvdisgi.
english: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎯᎪᏆᎵᎢ ᎢᏨᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᏣᎾᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏣᏄᏬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎨᏳᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono higoqualii itsvnihesdi soiyi nasquo hiyalisgolvdanehesdi; gilono udvnohi tsanaehesdi, nasquo hawini tsanuwo tlesdi higeyutanvgi.
english: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᏣᏔᏲᏎᎯ ᏕᎯᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏣᎾᎥ ᏣᎩᎡᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Naniv getsatayosehi dehinehesdi; gohusdino tsanav tsagiehi tlesdi hitayoselvgi.
english: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiyano nusdv itsadulisgv igetsadvnediyi yvwi, nasgiya nasquo nidetsadvnehesdi.
english: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎯᏉ [ᎤᏅᏒ] ᏱᏗᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏂᎨᏳᏐ ᎬᏩᏂᎨᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno getsigeyuhiquo [unvsv] yiditsigeyuha, gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo dunigeyuso gvwanigeyuhi.
english: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏗᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale osdv yiniditsadvneha osdv igetsadvnehi, gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo nasgiya nanadvnehoi.
english: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏛᎪᎩᏁᎵ ᏗᏤᎵᏎᎯ ᏱᏗᏣᏙᎳᏍᏗᎭ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏓᎾᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎥᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyu ale dvgogineli ditselisehi yiditsadolasdiha; gado itsiha gayetsalielitsedi gesvi?  Anisganayeno nasquo anisgana danadolasdisgoi, nasgi igai taline vgetsinediyi.
english: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏂᏨᏒᎾ ᎥᎡᏥᏂᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏩᏍᏛᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎰ ᏄᎾᎵᎮᎵᏣᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini detsigeyusesdi getsisgagi, ale osdv detsilvwisdaehesdi, ale itsadadolasdisgesdi udugi nitsvsvna vetsinidiyi gohusdi; utsatino etsaguyvedi gesesdi, wasdvno Galvladiyu ehi tsuwetsi gesesdi nihi; nasgiyeno osdv nidadvneho nunalihelitsadvna ale uniyoi.
english: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsadadolitsatiyu gesesdi, nasgiya Itsidoda nasquo udadolitsadiyu tsigi.
english: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏰᏥᎳᏫᏏ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏰᏧᎪᏓᏏ; ᏕᏥᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎯ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Tlesdi itsadalawiselvgi, nihino vtla yvgayetsilawisi; tlesdi ditsadadugodanelvgi, nihino vtla yidogayetsugodasi; detsidoligesdi getsisganvtsehi, nihino ase etsidolisdi gesesdi;
english: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏟᎶᏛ, ᎠᏍᏓᏲᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎸᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏤᏬᎩ, ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎲᎢ.  ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Itsadanehesdi, nihino ase etsinedi gesesdi; osdv atlilodv, asdayotanvhi, ale atelvnvhi, ale gvtsewogi, getsinedi gesesdi yvwi detsadatlohvi.  Nusdvyeno itsadatliloelv nasgiya nasquo etsatliloedi gesesdi;
english: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᏥᎪᏗᎨᏫ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏯᏘᏄᎦ ᏗᎨᏫ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᏱᏙᎬᏂᎸᎩ?
phonetic: Hiano nuwese dutlilosdanelei; Tsigodigewi yeliquo yatinuga digewi?  tlasgo itsula atalesv yidogvnilvgi?
english: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏱᎾᏥᎸᏉᏙ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏧᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏂᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᏧᏁᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dideloquasgi vtla utli yinatsilvquodo esgaquo tsuweyohvsgi; nanivsgini unisquadvhi tsuneyohvsgi nusdv nasgiya gesesdi.
english: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏐ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gadono ihigowatisgo utlvdalvdv ugasuhvi disdadanvtli, nelisgvnano igeso unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi?
english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏏ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᎸᏏ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᏨᏒᏃ ᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ?  ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎯᎸ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gado yigalisdoda hia yiniwesi disdadanvtli; Dinadanvtli gvlvsi utlvdalvdv tsagasuhvi, tsvsvno nigowatisgvna unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi?  Tsatlonasdi!  igvyi hilv unosdv ada tsvsv tsagasuhvi, hnaquono gvnigesviyu tsagowadvdiyi gesesdi hilvediyi utlvdalvdv disdadanvtli ugasuhvi.
english: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏡᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏯᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Osdvyeno tlugv vtla uyo yadadvsgoi; ale uyo tlugv vtla osdv yadadvsgoi.
english: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏡᎬᏰᏃ  ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ; ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tlugvyeno  golisdodi geso nusdv uwasv adadvsgvi; tsisdunigisdihiyeno vtla svgataiyunasdi yidanadesgo yvwi, ale anugalvhi vtla telvladi yidanadesgoi.
english: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᏲᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎤᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎤᏪᎲ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Osdv yvwi osdv usquanigodv unawiyi osdv gesv gananugowisgoi; uyono yvwi uyo usquanigodv unawiyi uyo gesv gananugowisgoi; utsadvyeno unawi uwehv aholi kanegoi.
english: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏍᎩᏲᏎᎰᎢ, ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏐᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gadono Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, isgiyosehoi, nitsiwesgvno nitsadvnehvna igesoi?
english: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᏓᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Gilo agilutsehesdi, ale advgisgesdi nitsiwesgvi, ale nasgi nadvnehesdi, datsvnanugowiseli datselv nasgi;
english: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏧᏍᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᏝᏁᎢ; ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏅᏃ ᎡᏉᏂ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎬᏂᎵᎯᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏖᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᏅᏲᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎧᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Asgaya datselv nasgi na tsunesgehei, ale hawini tsusgosei, ale gagusdvdi nvyohi tsutlanei; unohuganvno equoni nahna adanelv asdayiyu gvnilihihei, ale vtla gvwatelvdi yigesei; nvyohiyeno gakahei.
english: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᏂᏚᎫᏍᏓᎥᎾ ᎦᏙᎯᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ; ᎡᏉᏂᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎵᎯᎮᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏪᏇᏴᏎᎢ; ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗᏳᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏲᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na udvganvhi, nudvnelvnano, nasgi asgaya datselv nidugusdavna gadohiquo adanelv tsunesgehei; equonino nahna ulinigidiyu gvnilihihei, gilaquono iyvdv uwequeyvsei; usgasediyuno nulistane uyotsv nasgi adanelvi.
english: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎨᏆᏂ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono usquadv nigadv gawonisgv anadvgisgv yvwi, Gequani wuyvlei.
english: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎤᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgohitsuqui aniyawisgi ditenidohi unvsidasdi, osdv uyelvhi, utlvgei, ale uyohusidena gesei.
english: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏚᏅᏎ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏭᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏏᏗᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano atsinohesgv udvganv, dunvse tsedohv dinilawigi Anitsusi tsunatseliga, wutayosehe nvdayuwenvsdiyi unvwodiyi unvsidisdi.
english: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᏍᏗ ᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏅᏘᏯᏛᏁᎵ;
phonetic: Tsisano gvwalutselv, utsati gvwasdi yetanei, hia naniwesgei; Udanvtiyu nasgi hia tsinvtiyadvneli;
english: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎩᏠᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏁᏍᎨᎸ ᏗᎩᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ugeyuhiyuyeno igitloyi gesv yvwi, ale iganesgelv digilawiisdiyi.
english: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎥᏉ ᎤᎷᎴ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏙᏧᏅᏎ ᏧᎵᎢ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏩᏠᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎯ ᏣᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏁᎸᎢ ᏥᎾᏆᏍᏗᏉ;
phonetic: Tsisano dusdawadvsei.  Hnaquono navquo ulule didanelv, asgohitsuqui aniyawisgi ditinidohi dotsunvse tsulii nidodagvwatlohisdiyi, hia nvtsuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tlesdi tsvsv tsadadeyadotanvgi; vtlayeno yeli yinigohi tsayvsdiyi tsinelvi tsinaquasdiquo;
english: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎪᎢ ᏱᏇᎵᏎ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎯᏁᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᏳᏗᏩᏏ.
phonetic: Vtla ale nasquo yeli nigoi yiquelise wigvlutsediyi; hinegiquosgini, tsinvsidasdino tsuyudiwasi.
english: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏆᏓᏁᎶᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎧᎭ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎬᏆᏁᎶᏙᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎡᎪᎢ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎡᎮᎾ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᏗᎡᎪᎢ; ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎿᎭᏛᎦ ᏥᏲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno nasquo diquadanelodiquo, ale digikaha aniyawisgi ale ayv degvquanelodoi, gilono Hena tsiyosi, egoi; nvwadaleno Ehena tsiyosi, diegoi; tsinvsidasdino Hia hnadvga tsiyosi, nasgi nadvnehoi.
english: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎩᏩᏛᎲ.
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi hia udvganv, usquanigoselei, ale ugatahvsei, ale hia niduweseli yvwi nasgi nvdagvwasdawadvdv; hia nitsvweseha; Vtla nasquo Isili anehv nasgi igai gohiyudi gesv yagiwadvhv.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᏫᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ, ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏢᏨᎯ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino na nvdagetsinvsidv, wiunilutsv didanelv, atsinvsidasdi utlvtsvhi uniwadvhe udiwasvhi igesei.
english: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏱᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane ugitsvdv, nasgi digaduhv Nayini tsudoidv wuyvlei; yelino anigodiyu gvwasdawadidohi gvwasdawadvsei, ale unitsati yvwi.
english: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏂᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono galohisdiyi gotlvsv gaduhv nav ulutsv, gvniyuquo asgaya uyohusvhi aninugowisge aninisei, uwasvhiyu uwetsi gese utsi, ale nasgi uwosulotsvhi gesei; unitsateno yvwi gaduhv anehi gvwasdawadisei.
english: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino ugohv uwedolitsei, ale hia nuweselei; Tlesdi ditsatloyilvgi.
english: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎤᏏᏔᏕ ᎠᏥᏢᏛᎢ, ᎬᏩᏁᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏫᏅ, ᎭᏗᏛ, ᎬᏲᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Ulutsvno usitade atsitlvdvi, gvwanegino unalenawistanei.  Hiano nuwesei; Hiwinv, Hadidv, gvyoseha.
english: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏬᏂᏎᎢ; ᎤᏥᏃ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Uyohusvhino udidvhe uwenei, ale ulenvhe uwonisei; utsino uwekanelei.
english: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎩ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏩᏛᎯᎦ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nigadvno uninayesei; ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, hia naniwesgei; Atsilvquodi adolehosgi gananugogi idehvi; ale hia; Unelanvhi dawadvhiga tsutseli yvwi.
english: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia atsinohesgv Tsudiyi nigvnadv duyelisidolei, ale nahna gvwaduwidv gesvi.
english: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsanino gvwasdawadidohi nasgi hia nigadv gvwanonelei.
english: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏥᏌ ᏤᏙᎲ ᏚᏅᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏕᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Tsanino anitali gvwasdawadidohi widuyanvhe Tsisa tsedohv dunvse hia winuwesei; Nihisgo uluhisdi tsigi?  Tsigoge nvwadale otsigadenohesdi?
english: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᏦᎩᏂᏅᏒ ᎢᏍᏛᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᏪᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Anisgayano gvwalutselv, hia nuniwesei; Tsani Didawosgi tsogininvsv isdvlutsediyi, hia nvdigaweha; Nihisgo uluhisdi tsigesvgi?  Tsigoge nvwadale otsigatenohesdi?
english: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᏚᏅᏩᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏚᏂᏱᎵᏙᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᏱᎵᏙᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono dunvwane unitsati dunitlvgv ale vyugi duniyilidohv, ale uniyodidanvdo gvwaniyilidohvi; ale unitsati dinigewi gvwanigowadvdi nuwanelei.
english: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏥᏍᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᏪᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏗᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᎦᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᏂᎵᎡᏅ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᎨᎦᎴᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselei; Tsisdena ale Tsani wesdinohvsi nusdv isdigohv ale nusdv isdadvganvi; nasgi dinigewi anigowatisgvi, diniyouli anedohvi, adayesgi tsunitlvgi getsinvgalisgvi, tsunilienv anadvgisgvi, tsuniyohusvhi degegaledisgvi, uyono iyunadvhnadegi osdv kanohedv gegalitsidonehvi.
english: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᏥᏲᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale osiyu iyulisdanedi gilo ayv niditsiyodesdisgvna igesesdi.
english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᏂ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏣᏂ ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ?  ᏩᏐᎾᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏖᎸᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsani nidodayunvsidv iunenv, ulenvhe Tsani duneisdanele yvwi; Gado itsagatanvse inagei?  Wasonasgo unole utelvhesgvi?
english: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎪ ᏗᏬᏍᎩᎵ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎠᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Asgayasgo diwosgili tsunuwai?  Gvniyuquo tsuwoduhi tsunanuwai ale osdv dinalisdayvhvsgi unigvwiyuhi daninelv anehoi.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎪ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gadoge itsagatanvsei?  Adolehosgisgo?  Vv, itsvyoseha, ale utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo adolehosgi.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᎧᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia atsinohesgv hia tsinigvnv tsigowela; Gvniyuquo tsinvli tsinvsidasdi tsakadv igvyiditlv, nasgi datsadvnvisdaneli tsalohisdiyi igvyiditlv.
english: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏓᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎷᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᎳ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha; Anigeyv gvwaninanugowisvhi tsigi vtla yudlasdi gilo adolehosgi utli iyatsiluquodi esgaquo Tsani Didawosgi; aseno usdikani Unelanvhi utseligohi gela utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo Tsani.
english: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ, ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᎨᎦᎧᏍᏔᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏎ ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi unadvganvhi, ale adelv anigisidohi, unilvquotane Unelanvhi, digegakastanvhiyeno gese Tsani tsudawosdodi gesvi.
english: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏓᏅᏖᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᏔᏁᎢ, ᏂᏗᎨᎦᏬᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aniqualisisgini ale dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi Unelanvhi dudanvtehelvi uniyoisele unvsv unadatlutanei, nidigegawovna gesvi.
english: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᎨᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏓᎾᏤᎸ?
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Gadogedodagatsiyatlilostani yvwi gohi tsaneha?  Ale gado danatselv?
english: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏃᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᏓᎾᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏫᎾᏂᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎣᎬᏔᏅ ᏕᏨᏃᎩᎡᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎩᏎᎢ; ᏙᏥᏴᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏱᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Diniyoliquo nasgiya ganododiyi tsaninoi, ale tsiwidanadayanisgoi, hia tsiwinaniwesgoi; Atselugi ogvtanv detsvnogielv, aseno vtla yitsalisgisei; dotsiyvgv itsadvgodi, aseno vtla yiditsatloyilei.
english: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏚ ᏯᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᏎ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno Didawosgi ulutsvgi vtla gadu yagisgei, vtla ale gigageaditasdi yaditasgei; hiano nitsiwese; Asgina uyaa.
english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎦ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwi Uwetsi ulutsv alisdayvhvsga ale aditasga; hiano nitsiweha; Gvniyuquo asgaya ugvvsgi alisdayvdi ale gigageaditasdi aditasgi, adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana unalii.
english: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏰᎸᎭ
phonetic: Aseno agatanai tsuwetsi nigadv osiyu igvwayelvha
english: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎴᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎩᏳᏍᏓᏅᏁ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi Aqualisi utayosele ulisdayvnanediyi Wuyvleno Aqualisi ganelvi, ale uligiyusdanvne alisdayvdiyi.
english: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎦᏅᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲᎴ ᎫᎫ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᏍᏕ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ,
phonetic: Gvniyuquono ageyv nahna gaduhv ehi, asganai, udolehosv Tsisa Aqualisi ganelv ganvgv alisdayvhvsgvi, uyole gugu nvya unegv gotlvtanvhi atlisde atlonedi,
english: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏁ ᏚᏜᏓᏌᏛ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏓᏠᏱᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᏔᏁ ᏧᎦᏌᏬᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎧᏲᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏚᏣᎳᏁ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Ale ulene dudlasadv oniditlv datloyihei, ale ulenvhe tsulasideni duwosuletane tsugasawolvhi, ale dukayodotane usdiyegvi, ale dudutsalane tsulasideni, ale dulonetane atlonedi.
english: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏯᏅᏛ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏳᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏟᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Aqualisino nasgi wuyanvdv ugohv, unetse tsudanvdv hia nigawesgei; Hia asgaya iyuno adolehosgi yigese yudolehose nasgi gesv ale iyusdiquo gesv hia ageyv tsunotlisdiha, asganayeno.
english: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎠᎩᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏲᏎᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᏫᎪᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei; Sawani, agiha gohusdi gvyosedi.  Hiano nuwesei; Tadeyohvsgi, niwigoga.
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎮ ᏧᏓᏚᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏚᎩ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ; ᏏᏴᏫ ᎯᏍᎩᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏥᏚᎨᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Gilo iyusdi ehe tsudadugi, nasgi anitali tsudugi anehei; siyvwi hisgitsuqui anigisi tsunagvwalodi atsidugei, soino hisgasgohi.
english: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᏚᏲᏎᏉ ᎢᏧᎳ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᏄᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Gohusdino nunihvna gesv unaguyvdodi, duyosequo itsula.  Nasgino sginohvsi, gago nasgi utli nudageyusesdi?
english: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᎨᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏕᎱᎪᏓ.
phonetic: Sawani tsunetsv hia nuwesei; Asegeli nasgi na utli igai digvwayohiselvhi.  Hiano nuweselei; Duyugodv dehugoda.
english: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ; ᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ?  ᎯᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎹ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏁᏁᎴ ᏗᏉᏑᎴᏗ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᏉᏑᎵᏏ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏧᎦᏌᏬᎸᎯ ᎬᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎧᏲᏙᏓᏏ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ageyvno gadogv iditlv wugatahvstanv hia natsiwesele Sawani; Higowatisgo hia ageyv?  Hinelv agiyvlvgi, ama vtla yisginenele diquosuledi diqualasideni; nasgisgini na daquosulisi diqualasideni tsugasawolvhi gvda, ale dagikayododasi ustiyegvi.
english: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᏆᏔᏪᏙᏁᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎩᏴᎵᎸ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏑᎵᎪᏨ ᏓᏆᏚᏣᎳᏁᎲ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
phonetic: Vtla yisquatawedonei; hiasgini ageyv, agiyvlilv nvdagvwadalenvdv, vtla yusuligotsv daquadutsalanehv diqualasideni.
english: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏚᎶᏁᏔᏅ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisgoli vtla yisgilonetane goi; hiasgini ageyv atlonedi dulonetanv diqualasideni.
english: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏈᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᏙᎵᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏎᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nigvweseha; Usganvtsv, nasgi tsuquiya tsigi, atsidoligi, utsatiyeno udageyusei; gilosgini usdi atsidolitsvhi, nasgi usdi udageyusoi.
english: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele ageyv; Tsasganvtsv etsadoligi.
english: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏂᏜᏓᎢ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᎦᏙᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Nasgino na itsulaha aninidlai analisdayvhvsgv unalenvhe dotsunadanvdv hia nuniwesei; Gago nasgi hia, asganvtsv nasquo tsidegadoliga?
english: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏍᏕᎸ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele ageyv, Tsohiyusv tsasdelv; nvwadohiyadv tsihena.
english: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏙᏁᎢ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏩᏕᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Onino iyvdv hia nulistanei, nasgi degaduwadisv tsudvna ale tsusdi uwedonei, alitsidohvsge ale gvnigesv nigvnehe osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv kanohesgi, taladuno iyanidv unaligowadegei;
english: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎦᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏤᎸᎯ,
phonetic: Ale gilo iyunasdi anigeyv digetsinvwanvhi uniyo didanvdo gvwanadeyadodisgv ale dunitlvgvi, nasgi Meli Magadeli ehi tsanosehoi, nasgi galiquogi anisgina gvwanugotselvhi,
english: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsoine udalii Tsusa nasgi Elodv utseli tsugvwalodi ugasayasdidegi, ale Susani, ale anigodiyu nvwanadale nasgi tsigvwasdelvdodisge gohusdi unihnavi.
english: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏂᏄᎪᏨᎯ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Anigodiyuno yvwi dunilawitsolv nasgi gvwalutselv degaduwadisv nidodayuninugotsvhi, unetse dutlilosdanelei;
english: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏫᏒᏎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎦᏔ; ᎤᏫᏒᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Awisgi uwisvse utseli ugata; uwisvno igadv nvnohulodi ulageyadvtsei; unalasdaeleno ale tsisqua galanvdv aninohilidohi unigonei.
english: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᏧᎵᏰᏅᏉᏃ ᎤᎿᎭᏍᎬᏤ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᏬᏕᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno nvyohi ulageyadvtsei; tsuliyenvquono uhnasgvtse nvdigalisdodisge nuwodewisvna gesvi.
english: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ; ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎤᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno anugalvhi ulageyadvtsei; anugalvno itsulaha diudvsei, ale unenulastanei.
english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏤ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ
phonetic: Igadvno osv gadohi ulageyadvtsei, ale tsudvsei, ale ugatatanei unequotse asgohitsuqui iyuwagudi.  Nasgino hia nuwesv, ulistanei, hia nuwesei, Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga
english: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwadvdvne hia nigvwaweselei; Gado gadvga hia datlilosdvi.
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᎦᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Nihi etsinelvhi itsolisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; anisoisgini digegatlilosdanedi; nasgi anigowatisgv gvwanigowadvdi nigesvna, ale anadvgisgv gvwanolisdi nigesvna.
english: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ; ᎤᎦᏔ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Datlilosdvno hia nasgi nusdi; Ugata kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli gadvga.
english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗᏃ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᎪ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nvnohulodino tsulageyadvtsei nasgi anadvgisgi getsidvga; hnaquono asgina galugoi, ale agisgo ganugowisgo kanohedv tsuninawiyi, gagvwanohiyudi ale gagetsisdelvdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ, ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎿᎭᏍᏕᏠᎢ; ᏞᎦ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎠᏂᏑᎵᎪᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nano nvyohi tsulageyadvtsei, getsidvga nasgi anadvgvga ulihelisdiyu tsidanadanilvgo kanohedv; ale vtla yidunihnasdetloi; tlega anohiyuhvsgoi; ale getsigoliya anisuligogoi.
english: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ. ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏥᏩᏂᎶᏍᎪᎢ, ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Nano anugalvhi tsulageyadvtsei getsidvga nasgi anadvgvga. ilvhitlv tsiwanilosgoi, elohino ehi uwelihisdi ale genvisdi gesv, ale osdv ayelvdi gesv aninenulasdisgoi, ale vtla yaninanugowisgo ugadvnatsvhi.
english: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎣᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏧᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nano osv gadohi tsulageyadvtsei getsidvga nasgi nutlonasdvna ale osdv gesv uninawi gvdi anadvgvga kanohedv, anisquanigodisgoi, ale aninanugowisgo ugatatanvhi anvnidiyu gesoi.
english: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏱᎫᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᏢᏩ ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo atsvsdvga atsvsdodi atelido yigutlvdisgoi, ale ganitlvwa yigakahvsgoi; gagodiyisgini gakahvsgoi, nasgi aniyvhihi unigowadvdiyi igagadvi.
english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna; vtla ale gohusdi yigvsgalv nasgi agadovhisdi ale gvnigesv igvnedi nigesvna.
english: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ, ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎰ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadvgisgvi, giloyeno uhesdi, nasgi atsinedi gesesdi; gilono nuhvna gesesdi, nasgi atsigiedi gesesdi nasgi na tsuho tsinvwasdoi.
english: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᎥ ᏫᎦᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwalutsele utsi ale analinvtli, ale vtla nav wigagvwanilutsedi yigese nvdigalisdodisge yvwi unitsadvi.
english: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᏂᏙᎦ ᎤᎾᏚᎵ ᎨᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwanoneleno hia nuniwesei; Tsatsi ale itsalinvtli doyiditlv danidoga unaduli getsagowadvdiyi.
english: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎾᏛᎩᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselei; Etsi ale otsalinvtli hia nasgi tsanadvgia kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale nasgi nigawesgv iyanadvnehi.
english: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏁ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎯᎠᏙ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏗᏐᎩ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏍᎪᎾ ᏫᏗᎶᎯ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᏫᏛᎮ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane ilvhiyu iyvdv, nasgi utsane tsiyuhi unaligose gvwasdawadidohi; hiado niduweselei, Didisogi vdalv sgona widilohi.  Ale uniyvwidvhe.
english: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏂᏒᏃ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎸᏁᎢ; ᎤᏃᎴᏃ ᎤᏱᎶᎴ ᎥᏓᎸᎢ; ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤᎴᏃ ᎠᎹ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Aninisvno tsiyu ulvnei; unoleno uyilole vdalvi; unikalitseleno ama, ale unayehisdi nunalisdanelei.
english: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏰᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏒᏂ!  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᎦᏤ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎠᎹ; ᎤᏂᏑᎵᎪᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏥᎾᏍᏛᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwalutseleno ale gvwayestanei, hia naniwesgei; Tadeyohvsgi, Tadeyohvsgi, dayotsadisvni!  Hnaquono udidvhe ale dusgatse ganolvvsgv ale dalisdilanegv ama; unisuligotseno ale udatsinasdvhi nulistanei.
english: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏝ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?  ᏕᎧᏁᏤᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Hatla itsohiyusvi?  Nasgino anisgaihv unisquanigosei, hia nidunadaweselei; Gado usdi hia asgaya?  Dekanetseyeno unole ale ama, ale igvwohiyuhvsga.
english: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏕᎳᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Anigedelano unatseligohi wunilutse, nasgi Gelili tsuyugodi sgoniditlv tsigi.
english: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏣᎢᏒᏃ, ᏚᏠᏎ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏯᎢ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᏄᏬᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏯᏕᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Wutsaisvno, dutlose gilo iyusdi asgaya gaduhv nvdayunugotsvhi, gohidiyu anisgina gvwayai nigesei, ale vtla yidanuwosgei, vtla ale, adanelv yadehvsgei, datselisdvquosgini.
english: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎩᎾᏓ-ᏛᏙᏗ, ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᎩᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ugohvno Tsisa, uwelunei, ale udanvne gadogv igvyiditlv, ale asdaya hia nuwesei; Gado diginadadvdodi, Tsisa, Unelanvhi wasdv galvladiyu ehi Uwetsi?  Gvtayoseha tlesdi sgigilvnvgi.
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏁᏤᎶᏰᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.  ᏯᏃᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏱᏍᎨᎢ; ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏰᏌᎾᎶ ᏓᎦᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᏓᎦᎵᏍᎨᏃ ᏚᏓᎸᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏱᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nunetseloyeno gadaha adanvdo unugoisdiyi asgaya.  Yanoquoyeno uniyisgei; tsudadesvdvno ale diliyesanalo dagalvsdisgei; dagalisgeno dudalvsdvi, ale asgina inage wuyilvsdisgei.
english: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏗᎤᏪᏎᎢ; ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvdvne hia nuweselei; Gado detsadov?  Hiano nvdiuwesei; Sunadatlugi; unitsateyeno anisgina gvwayvlvhi gesei.
english: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴᏃ ᏧᏁᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏍᏛᎬ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwatayoseleno tsunetsediyi nigesvna disdvgv wunilohisdiyi.
english: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏙᎮ ᎦᏚᏏ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏏᏆ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏧᏪᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏃ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ
phonetic: Nahnano analisdayvnidohe gadusi unitsati sunadatlugi siqua; nasgino gvwatayosele unelagi tsuwelisediyi nasgi widuniyvsdiyi; unelagino duweliselei
english: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏤ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᏆ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᎴᎢ; ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩᏃ ᎠᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏎ ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ ᎦᏁᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎬᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono anisgina gvwanugotse asgaya, ale siqua wigvwaniyvlei; sunadatlugino ayanuliyu unalise wunigasoase ganetlugi gesv vdalv wunilutse ale dunigvtsei.
english: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᎶᎸᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᏚᎾᎵᏘᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᏭᏂᏃᏁ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏩᎫᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunelolvhino unigohv nulistanvi dunalitisei, ale unenvse wuninone digaduhv ale iyvdv wuwagudvi.
english: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏅᏎ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏨᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ, ᎤᏬᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎳᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏄᏩᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᏃ.
phonetic: Unenvseno unagatanvse nulistanvi; Tsisano wunilutselei, ale uniwadvhe asgaya, nasgi gvwanuhitsvhi anisgina, uwole Tsisa dulasgvi, dunuwaei, ale udanvtisanvhi gesei; unisgaleno.
english: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏯᎢ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Unigohvhino nasquo duninonele nulisdotanv anisgina gvwayai atsinvwanvi.
english: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎨᏕᎳ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᏓᏅᎡᏗᏱ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ; ᏥᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏣᏅ ᎢᎤᏨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadiyu unitsati Anigedela unatseligohi nigvnadv dinehi gvwatayosele tsudanvediyi; utsatiyeno anisgaihei; tsiyuhino utsanv iutsvsei.
english: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏤᎸᎯ, ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino asgaya anisgina gvwanugotselvhi, usdiyetane ulisgolvdanediyi usdawadidasdiyi; aseno Tsisa unetsele udanvsdiyi hia nuweselei,
english: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎮᎾ ᏗᏤᏅᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᏅᎦ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ,  ᎠᎴ  ᏭᏃᎮᎵᏙᎴ ᏂᎬᎢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Tsihena ditsenvsvi, ale gvnigesv winvga nigav usquanigodi nitsadvnelv Unelanvhi.  Uwenvseno,  ale  wunohelidole nigvi gaduhv nigav usquanigodi nudvnelv Tsisa.
english: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ ᏫᎤᎷᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏰᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane Tsisa wiulutsv, nasgi yvwi degvwadanilvtsei; nigadvyeno gvwagatiyei.
english: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏤᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏴᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gvniyuquono ulutsele asgaya Tsela tsudoidv nugvwiyusadegi digalawiisdiyi; Tsisano dulasgv udanvnei, ale utayosele ganelv uyvsdiyi;
english: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎡᎮ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᎢ.  ᎠᎢᏒᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏩᏍᏗᏕᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Saquohiyuyeno ehe uwetsi ageyutsa taladu iyvdv iyudetiyvdv, ale nasgi ayohusgei.  Aisvno unitsati yvwi gvwadatluwasdidegei.
english: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᏢᎨ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎮ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᎡᎸᎯ, ᎤᏒᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏓᎫᏴᎡᎲ ᎠᏂᎦᎾᎦᏘ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏅᏬᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Ageyvno utlvge gigv uwenvehe taladu tsudetiyvdv gvwadalenvelvhi, usvnvhi gese nigadv ulisdelvdodi daguyvehv aniganagati, aseno vtla gilo gvwanvwodi yigesei,
english: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᏒᏂᎴᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
