phonetic: Nasgi oniditlv uluhisdanei, ale gadaluyadv unuwav usvnilei; gilaquono iyvdv gigv uwenvehv uyohistanei.
english: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏱᎸ, ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏓᏡᏫᏍᏗᏕᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏁᏄᎳᏍᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesei; Gago aquasvniga?  Nigadvno unadayilv, Quida ale nasgi anehi hia nuniwesei; Tadeyohvsgi, unitsati getsadatluwisdidega ale getsanenulasdiha, tsigono Gago aquasvniga ihadiha?
english: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏆᏒᏂᎦ; ᎦᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏄᎪᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesei, Gilo aquasvniga; gadolehosgayeno aquadanvwodi gesv aginugotselvi.
english: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏗᏍᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏃᏁᎴ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎤᏒᏂᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ageyeno udolehosv nudisgalvna gesvi, ulutse uwenawisgei, ale igvyitlv udanvnelei, nigadvno yvwi anigatahv unonele nvtsulisdotanv usvnilvi, ale nasgi gilaquo iyvdv udiwasvi.
english: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him and how she was healed immediately.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᎮᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Aquetsi, ugalisdi hadanvdada; tsohiyusv tsadiwisda; nvwadohiyadv tsihena.
english: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎷᏤ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏤᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᏯᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Asiquo gawonisge gilo ulutse digalawiisdiyi ugvwiyusadegi ganelv nvdayulosvhi, hia nuweselei, Tsetsi uyohusv, tlesdi hiyadeyadotanv Dideyohvsgi.
english: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗᏉ, ᏓᏳᏗᏩᏏᏃ.
phonetic: Aseno tsisa udvganv unetsele hia nuwesei; Tlesdi yisgaihesdi; tsohiyusesdiquo, dayudiwasino.
english: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎤᏴᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ.
phonetic: Adanelvno uyvlv, vtla gilo yulisgolvdanele uyvsdiyi, Quida ale Tsimi ale Tsani unvsv, ale ageyutsa udoda ale utsi.
english: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎪᏂᎮᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ, ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Nigadvno danatloyihe ale anisgonihei.  Aseno hia nuwesei; Tlesdi ditsatloyilvgi; vtla yuyohusv, galihaquosgini.
english: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏩᏙᏢᏔᏁᏃ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igvwadotlvtaneno, anigataheyeno uyohusvhi gesvi.
english: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ ᎤᏯᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎨᏳᏣ, ᎭᏗᏛ.
phonetic: Nigadvno dunugowisv ale uwoyanesv uyanvhe hia nuwesei; Higeyutsa, hadidv.
english: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎤᎷᏥᏌᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏗᏛᎮᎢ; ᎤᏁᏤᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Udanvdono ulutsisanelei, ale gilaquo iyvdv udidvhei; unetseno ulisdayvdi uninediyi.
english: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Tsugayvligeno unisquanigosei; aseno dunetsele gilo uninonediyi nigesvna nasgi nulistanvi.
english: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᎲᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏁᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏢᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Widuyahvno taladu iyanidv gvwasdawadidohi, dunele naniv anisgina gvwanohiyudiyi, ale dunitlvgv tsunadanvwodiyi.
english: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏧᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ
phonetic: Dunvseno unalitsidonvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali, ale tsunitlvgi tsuninvwodiyi
english: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏣᎢᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏣᏄᏬ ᏱᏗᏥᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Tlesdi gohusdi itsadanelanvgi itsalisdelvdodi itsaisvi, tlesdi didolanvsdi, ale degalodi, ale gadu, ale adelv; ale itsisiyvwiha tlesdi tali ditsanuwo yiditsinehesdi.
english: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno adanelv itsiyvhihesdi nahaquo itsinesdi, ale nahna itsanigisgesdi.
english: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏚᏅᎦᎸ ᏕᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono niditsadanilvgvna igesesdi, nahna gaduhv itsinugogesdi, ditsalasideni gosdu dunvgalv detsinvgovdisgesdi nasgi kanohesgi gesesdi unatludisgi.
english: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᏙᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏫᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unanigisvno degaduwadisv unedole analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv, ale danadanvwisge nigav anedohvi.
english: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Elodvno nvgi igadugi gesv sgadugi atsigatidisdi udvgane nigadv deulvwisdanehvi; ale udeyatanelei, nvdigalisdodisge gilo Tsani uyohusv deulehisanv anadisgvi;
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏣᏁᎮ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono Ilaya gananugogi anadisgvi; igadvno gilo iyusdi ilvhiyu tsanehe anadolehosgi dulehisanv anadisgvi.
english: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏥᏯᏛᎩᎭ?  ᎤᏟᏂᎬᏁᎴᏃ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Elodvno hia nuwesei, Tsani tsisgudesvgi; hiasgini gago, nasgi hia tsinusdi tsitsiyadvgiha?  Utlinigvneleno ugowadvdiyi.
english: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎢᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏚᏘᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᏇᏣᏰᏗ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno iunilutsv, gvwanonele nigadv nunadvnelvi.  Dutinvseno ale unvsv gesv inage wulose gaduhv nav Quetsayedi tsanosehoi.
english: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏩᏁ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Yvwino unadolehosv gvwasdawadvsei; ale dudanilvtsei, duneisdanele Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali, ale dunvwane udulvdi iyunalisdanehi digetsinvwodiyi.
english: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎬᏩᎷᏎᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏤᎴᎢ, ᏘᏰᎵᎯᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏩᏁᎾ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏫᏚᏂᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎢᎾᎨᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏕᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Igano hnaquo galosohvsgei gvwalusele taladu iyanidv ale hia nigvwawetselei, Tiyelihisda unitsati, nasgi wanena dodigaduhv ale dodigalogesv ani gvwaduwidv widunisvsdiyi, ale unalisdayvdi wuniwadvdiyi; aniyeno inagequo gesv idedoha.
english: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᏚ ᏙᏥᏰᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏔᎵᏉᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏲᎩᏩᏎᏅ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno hia niduweselei; Nihi ditselasda.  Hiano nuniwesei, Hisgiquo gadu dotsiyeha ale atsadi taliquoi; iyusgininonv yogiwasenv nigadv hia nasgi yvwi unalisdayvdi.
english: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎡ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏩᎾᏅᎥᎦ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎫᏂᏨᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hisgiyeno iyagayvli iyvdv nanie anisgaya.  Hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Wananvvga hisgasgohi igunitsvdv gesesdi.
english: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏅᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nunadvnelei, ale nigadv unanvdiyi nidunvlei.
english: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏁᏎᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏂᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Hisgino gadu dugisei, ale tali atsadi dunesei; galvladino widukahnanv ulihelitsei, ale ugvhaluyei, ale dunele gvwasdawadidohi tsuninediyi unitsati.
english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏃᎸᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏖᏎ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᎾᏘᏰᎸᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ ᏔᎷᏣ.
phonetic: Unalisdayvneno, ale nigadv dunolvsei; ale unutese uligvhaluyvhi unatiyelvhi taladu iyakalii talutsa.
english: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ; ᏚᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎬᏉᏎᎰ ᏴᏫ?
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei nasgi uwasv gesv adadolisdisgv gvwasdawadidohi anehei; dudvdvneno hia niduweselei, Gago gvquoseho yvwi?
english: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎳᏯ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ [ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎪᎢ.]
phonetic: Uninetsvno hia nuniwesei, Tsani didawosgi; igadvsgini Ilaya; anisoino, gilo iyusdi ilvhiyu unadenvhi anadolehosgi dulehisanv [anadisgoi.]
english: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᎾᏃ ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ?  ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Nihinano gago sgiyoseha?  Quida unetsv hia nuwesei, Galonedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Ulinigidvno dunvsdadele dunetsele gilo uninonediyi nigesvna nasgi,
english: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎩᎵᏳᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏣᎦᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nigawesgei, yvwi Uwetsi ase utsati tsudalenvdv tsugiliyutsedi gesesdi, ale digvwayohisdi gesesdi dinilawigi ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi, ale atsiisdi gesesdi, ale tsoine iga tsagaledodi gesesdi.
english: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele nigadv, iyuno gilo udulisgesdi agisdawadvsdiyi uwasv adadayihesdi, ale ayisgesdi nidugitsvnisv utseli tsudahnawadv, ale agisdawadegesdi.
english: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Giloyeno udulisgesdi usdelvdiyi gvnvi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilosgini gvnv uyohusehesdi ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi, nasgi usdelvdi gesesdi.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎦᏓᎢᏅ.
phonetic: Gadoyeno yunequotsi yvwi iyuno nigv elohi utseli yinulistanv, uwasvno yuyohusv ale yagadainv.
english: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Giloyeno aquadehosgesdi ayv ale aginetsvi, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi udehohisdi gesesdi nahiyu galutsvha unuwosdesdi galvquodiyu gesv uwasv utseliga, ale Udoda utseliga, ale getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi unatseliga.
english: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏓᏂᏙᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno udohiyuhiya itsvnoneha, gilo ani danidoga vtla yvdvnadolehosi ayohuhisdi gesv gvni Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv anigohvha.
english: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᎳᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏐᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏚᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏎ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunelano iyvdv winusvlv nasgi hia nuwesoi, hia nulistanei, nasgi Quida ale Tsani ale Tsimi dutinvse ale uhnaluse odalv udadolistanvsei.
english: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎨᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᏁᎩᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏥᏍᏓᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Adadolisdigeno nusdv ukadv udanetliyvsei, ale dunuwav unegiyu ale gvwatsisdalugisgi nulistanei.
english: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏯᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo gvwalinohetane anitali anisgaya, nasgi Mosi ale Ilayagesei,
english: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᏬᏍᏕ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Nasgi galvquodiyu gesv unanuwosde gvnigesv nunadvnelei; ale unineistane ulisquadediyi gesv Tsilusilimi.
english: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏂᎸᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏂᏰᏨᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏙᎬ ᏗᏂᏙᎩ.
phonetic: Quidasgini ale nasgi na anehi utsati danilvsgei; uniyetsvno unigohe utseli galvquodiyu gesvi, ale nasgi anitali anisgaya gadogv dinidogi.
english: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᎡᎮᎢ, ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏕᏙᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏫᏙᏥᎵᏦᏛᎦ; ᏌᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi hnaquo gvwadanvehei, Quida hia nuwesele Tsisa, Tadeyohvsgi, osiyu ani tsidedoha; ale tsoi widotsilitsodvga; saquo nihi tsatseliga, saquono Mosi utseliga, saquono Ilaya utseliga, vtla yagatahe nigawesgvi.
english: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ ᎤᎶᎩᎳᏕᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏢᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴ ᎤᏂᏄᏴᎸ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asiquo nasgi nigawesgei ulogiladei ale unutlvtanei; ale unisgale uninuyvlv ulogilvi.
english: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎶᎩᎸᏃ ᏧᎶᏎ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ulogilvno tsulose kanegv hia nigawesgei, Hia nasgi tsigeyui Aquetsi, nasgi etsadvdasdanehesdi.
english: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏥᏩᏛᎮ ᏥᏌ.  ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉᏃ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Kanegv ulosonv uwasvquo atsiwadvhe Tsisa.  Elaweyiquono unvsei, ale vtla gilo yuninonele nahiyu gesv nusdv unigohvi.
english: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏒ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nasgi ugitsvdv tsunigasoasv odalvi, unitsati yvwi degvwatlosei.
english: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏘᏯᎦᏃᏗᏱ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo asgaya nahna unadatlugv uwelunei hia nigawesgei, Tadeyohvsgi, gvsdiyediha tiyaganodiyi aquetsi; uwasvhiyuyeno aquetsi nasgi;
english: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏱᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎨᎷᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏕᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎭᏬᎢᎰᎢ, ᎤᏂᏆᎶᏛᏃ ᎦᏂᎳ ᎤᏓᏅᎡᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo, adanvdo uniyisgoi, ale gilaquo iyvdv geluhvsgoi, ale ulvdesdisgoi ale dahawoihoi, uniqualodvno ganila udanvehoi.
english: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Gatsitayoselvno getsasdawadidohi uninugowisdiyi; aseno uninulvnvgi.
english: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; Ᏺ, ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ!  ᎢᎳᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ?  ᎡᎯᏯᏘᏄᎦ ᏤᏥ.
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Yo, nitsohiyusvna ale itsagatahvdv gohi tsitseha!  ilago nigohilesdi itsvyeladidohesdi, ale unanelagi itsvyelisehesdi?  Ehiyatinuga tsetsi.
english: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏣᎢᏎᎢ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏕᏍᏔᏁᎢ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏤ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏩᏁ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏪᎧᏁᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Asiquono tsaisei asgina ustlvnistanei, ale ulvdestanei.  Tsisano usgatse gadaha adanvdo ale unvwane ayoli, ale taline iuwekanele udoda.
english: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ;
phonetic: Nigadvno unisquanigose utsati ulinigidiyu gesv Unelanvhi.  Nigadvno unisquanigosv nigav tsisa nudvnelvi, hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi;
english: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᏩᏴᎭ ᏗᏥᎴᏂ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi tsinitsiweha wayvha ditsileni; yvwiyeno Uwetsi yvwi digetsiyohisedi gesesdi.
english: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎪᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi niduweselvi, ale gegvsgalanelei, nasgi nunigohvna gesei; ale anisgaihe gvwadvdvdiyi nasgi nuwesvi.
english: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono uninohele unvsv gesvi, nasgi na unadatlugv utli atsilvquodiyu gesvi.
english: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᏭᏯᏅᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano udolehosv nusdv danadanvtesgv dotsunadanvdvi, ayoli wuyanvhe ale uwolv nav uwekanei,
english: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Gilo dadanilvgesdi hia ayoli ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi, ayv daquadanilvgesdi; gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, dadanilvgesdi nvdvginvsidv, nasgiyeno usdikani nihi nigadv nitsadvnvi, nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesesdi.
english: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎩ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsanino unetse hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigovgi asiyvwi anisgina deganugowisgvgi detsadov gvdisgvgi; otsinvsdadelvgino nvdagalisdodisgvgi nigisdawadegvna gesvi.
english: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᎪᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi, Tlesdi etsinvsdadelvgi; giloyeno nigatludisgvna yigi nasgi igaligonehi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎨ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane hnaquo asqualisge galvladi tsagadanilvisdiyi, ulinigidiyu udanvte Tsilusilimi wulohisdiyi.
english: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏅᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏁᎩ; ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Dunvseno igvyi anegi; unenvseno, ale Sameli anehi uniduhv wuniyvlei, nasgi gvwadvnvisdanediyi.
english: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏩᎦᏙ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlano yidigvwadanilvtsei, nvdigalisdodisge Tsilusilimi tsiwagado nvwasdei.
english: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎣᏏᏉᏍᎪ ᏱᏰᎸᎾ ᏲᎩᏂᏁᏨ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎳᏯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino Tsimi ale Tsani nasgi unigohv, hia nuniwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, osiquosgo yiyelvna yogininetsv atsilv galvladi nvdayulohisdiyi ale unagohvsdodiyi nasgiya Ilaya nudvnelvi?
english: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᏚᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno ugatahvsv dugvsgolvne hia nuwesei, Vtla yisdigataha nusdv adanvdo isdihvi.
english: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᎷᏥᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏅᏅ ᏱᏚᏛᏔᏂᎸ, ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸᏉᏍᎩᏂ.  ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno Uwetsi tsulutsilv vtla yvwi danvnv yidudvtanilv, dusdelvhilvquosgini.  Nvwadaleno digaduhv wunilosei.
english: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎮᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Anaisvno nvnohi hia nulistanei, gilo iyusdi hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, dagvsdawadidoli nigav hedohvi.
english: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᎳ ᏚᏂᏔᎴᏐᎢ, ᏥᏍᏆᏃ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ Ꭰ-ᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᏁᏍᏓᏝᎰᎢ; ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏠᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Tsula dunitalesoi, tsisquano galanvdv aninohilidohi dunanesdatlahoi; yvwisgini Uwetsi vtla ilvhitlv asgoli utlodiyi yigi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Uwadaleno hia nuweselei, Sgisdawaduga.  Aseno hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, squalisgolvdasi igvyi aquenvsdiyi witsinisodiyi edoda.
english: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᏂᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎮᎾ ᏩᎵᏥᏙᎲᎦ ᏫᏃᎲᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselei, Tsuniyohusvhi daninisisgesdi digvwaniyohuhiselvhi; nihisgini hena walitsidohvga winohvli Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎾ ᏫᎦᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᏅᏛᏂᏂ ᏗᏇᏅᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno nasquo hia nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, dagvsdawadidoli; aseno igvyi gena wigatsiyoliga nvdvnini diquenvsvi.
english: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᏧᏏᏔᏛᎯ ᎦᏓᎷᎪᏗ ᏱᎠᎦᏔᎲᏃ, ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Vtla giloi, tsusitadvhi gadalugodi yiagatahvno, yeli Unelanvhi Ugvwiyuhi gesv wigvwayvsdi yigi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏑᏰᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏎ ᏔᎵ ᏧᎾᎵᎪᏅᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏄᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏩᏒ ᏭᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv, Ugvwiyuhi nvwanadale galiquasgohi iyanidv nasquo dusuyesei ale dunvse tali tsunaligonvdv igvyi nunenvsdiyi nigadv degaduwadisv ale nigvnadv, nahna uwasv wuluhisdi gesvi.
english: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏔ, ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎦᏛᎾᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia niduweselei, Ugadvnatsvhi udohiyuhi utsata, tsunilvwisdanehisgini anigayoliyu; nasgi iyusdi etsadadolisdasi Ugvwiyuhi ugadvnatsvhi utseliga, nidodayunvsdiyi tsunilvwisdanehi nahna ugadvnatselvi.
english: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᎾ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᏩᏲᎯ ᏥᏩᏂᎶᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Itsena; gvniyuquo itsvnvli uninodena anigina wayohi tsiwanilosgo nasgiyai.
english: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎩ ᎢᏣᎢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi ditsinvsvgi adelv digalodi, ale degalodi, ale dilasulo; ale tlesdi gilo etsiyolilvgi itsaisvi.
english: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᎬᏱ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno adanelv itsiyvhihesdi, igvyi, Nvwadohiyadv ehesdi ani adanelvi, itsadisgesdi.
english: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎢᏥᎷᏥᏌᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno nvwadohiyadv uwetsi nahna ehesdi, nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga ulutsedi gesesdi; iyuno nahna nehvna igesesdi itsvsvquo itsilutsisanedi gesesdi.
english: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᎲᎢ; ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒ ᏱᏤᏙᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ
phonetic: Ale nahnaquo adanelv itsinesdi, itsalisdayvdisgesdi ale itsaditasgesdi nusdv etsinehvi; tsulvwisdanehiyeno duyugodi aguyvediyi dulvwisdanelvi.  Tlesdi dadaneladisv yitsedolidohesdi
english: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale ilvhitlv gaduhv itsilugesdi, ale degetsadanilvgesdi, nusdv getselasdisgv itsalisdayvdisgesdi.
english: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Ale detsinvwisgesdi tsunitlvgi nahna anehvi, ale hia nidetsiwesehesdi, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu itsilutselv.
english: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏴᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᏂᏗᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏫᏥᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Ilvhitlvsgini gaduhv itsiyvhihesdi, nidigetsadanilvgvnano igesesdi, itsinugogesdi degalanvdv nahnani witsilosgesdi, hia nitsiwesgesdi,
english: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏍᏚᏉ ᎢᏥᏚᎲ ᎦᎳᎨᏴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏯᎸᎬᎢ ᎣᏥᏅᎪᎥᏗ ᎢᏨᎢᏰᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquo gosduquo itsiduhv galageyvi, nasgi ogiyalvgvi otsinvgovdi itsviyeha; aseno hia nusdesdi itsigatahesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu itsilutselvi.
english: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nitsvweseha, esgaquo igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi Sodami nahiyu iga gesesdi utlihiyu nasgi gaduhvi.
english: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏂᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎴᏏᏂ!  ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏇᏣᏱᏗ!  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏙᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎪᎯᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏧᏏᏕᎾ ᏱᏚᎾᏄᏩᎡ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏚᎯ ᏳᎾᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Uyoniyu itsalisdanedi nihi Golesini!  uyoiyu itsalisdanedi nihi Quetsayidi!  iyuyeno usquanigodi yidogalvwisdanele Taya ale Sadoni nihi itsehv degalvwisdanelvi, gohigi digvwaninetliyvdv yigese dunadanvdvi, tsusidena yidunanuwae ale gosduhi yunanvnei.
english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎡᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏔᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno utli osiyu iyunalisdanedi gesesdi Taya ale Sadoni ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi esgaquo nihi.
english: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏤᏣᏌᎳᏓ, ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏮᏓᏰᏣᎶᎥᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ale nihi Gequani galvladi iyvdv tsetsasalada, tsvsgino iyvdv wvdayetsalovtani.
english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Gilo nihi itsadvdasdanehesdi ayv aquadvdasdanehesdi; gilono itsiniquatihesdi, ayv aginiquatihesdi; gilono ayv aginiquatihesdi ganiquatihesdi nvdvginvsidv.
english: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏚᏁᏓᏅᏖᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎪᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎯ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Galiquasgohino iyanidv taline unilutse ulihelisdi dunedanvtei, hia naniwesgei, Tsagvwiyuhi, anisgina nasquo igogohiyuhvsga nihi detsadov nvdigalisdodiha.
english: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᎦᏙᎠᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏳᏙᎠᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Sedani tsigovgi anagalisgi galvladi tsvdigadoasgo nasgiya dayudoasvgi.
english: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᏗᏣᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗᏱ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏙᎬ ᏗᎾᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏍᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo itsvyalisgolvdasi ditsalasdaediyi inadv ale dinidogv dinadatsvyasdisgi, ale itsadalinehidediyi nigav ulinigidiyu gesv agasgi; vtla ale gohusdi yeli uyo igetsvnedi yigesesdi.
english: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ; ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏦᏒ ᏫᏗᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv hia nasgi vtlasdi yitsalihelisdisgesdi, nasgi didanvdo getsohiyusvi; itsaliheligesdisgini nvdigalisdodisgesdi detsadov galvladi tsosv widigowelvi.
english: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤ ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏕᎲᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏃ ᏥᏕᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ; ᎥᎥ, ᎡᏙᏓ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Tsisa ulihelitse udanvdogihi, hia nuwesei, gvyalielitseha Edoda Tsagvwiyuhi galvladi ale elohi, nasgi hia tsidehvsgalanelv anisinasani ale aneyatahi, diniyolino tsidehinanugowiselv; vv, Edoda; nasgiyeno osiyu tsayelvnvhi.
english: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎡᏙᏓ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎡᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nigav gohusdi dagiyohiselv Edoda; vtla ale gilo yagataha nasgi gesv Uwetsi, agayvlige uwasv; ale nasgi agayvlige gesv Uwetsi uwasv, ale gilo tsinanugowisi ela Uwetsi.
english: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ;
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino iditlv wugatahvstanv hia niduwesele Unvsv gesvi, digalvquotanvhi digadoli nasgi tsidagowatiha nihi tsitsigowatiha;
english: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ
phonetic: Itsvyoseyeno unitsadvgi Anadolehosgi ale unigvwiyuhi unadulvhvgi nihi tsitsigowati unigowadvdiyi, aseno vtla yunigohei; ale unadvgodiyi nasgi nihi tsitsadvgiha, aseno vtla yunadvganei
english: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏯᏆᏛᏁᎸ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
phonetic: Gvniyuquono, gilo iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi dulenei, ale ugoliyesgv hia nuwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, gado yaquadvnelv aquatseli yinigalisda gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna?
english: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ?  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏙ ᎯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano natsiweselei, Gado gvnv gowela dikahnawadvsdiyi?  Gado usdo higoliyesgoi?
english: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎾᏫ ᏣᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᎥᏃ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunetsvno hia nuwesei, Higeyusesdi Yihowa Tsanelanvhi, hvdisgesdi nigav tsanawi tsalvi, ale nigav tsadanvdogi, ale nigav tsalinigvgvi, ale nigav tsadanvtedi gesvi; navno idisdadala tsvsv nitsadageyusv nasgiya nigeyusesdi.
english: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏂᏫ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎲᏁᏍᏗᏃ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei, yeliquo niwi; nasgi hia hnadvnehesdi, hvnesdino.
english: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎦᎪᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏦᎩᎾᏓᎳ?
phonetic: Aseno udulisgv ududalesdiyi hia nuwesele Tsisa, Gagono nav itsoginadala?
english: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏂᎩᏎ ᏤᎵᎪ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏩᏛᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏩᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏄᏩᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᏕᏤ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano tsunetsv hia nuweselei, Gilo iyusdi Tsilusilimi unigise Tseligo uwenvsei, dinadanasahvsgino dunadawadvtanei, nasgi degvwanuwese dunuwavi, ale gvwalivnilei, ale unadanvse gvwadetse ayeli iyvdv uyohusvhi gesei.
english: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᏄᏮᏔᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎦᏅᏅ ᏗᎤᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᎠᏂᏗᏢᏉ ᏄᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ayelino nuwvtane gilo iyusdi atsilvgelohi nahna niganvnv diulosei; ugohvno aniditlvquo nulosei.
english: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎵᏫ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎲ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᎦᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏗᏢᏉ ᏄᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Aliwi nahna edohv, ulutse ugatanei, ale aniditlvquo nulosei.
english: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᎷᏤ ᎦᏅᎢ; ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ;
phonetic: Gilosgini iyusdi Sameliyi ehi aisvi, ulutse ganvi; ugohvno uwedolitsei;
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎸᎡᎴ ᏓᏥᏐᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎢ ᎩᎦᎨᏃ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏓᏍᏚᏞᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᏧᏂᏒᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏘᏃᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale wulutse ale dulvele datsisonvnvi, ale goi gigagenoaditasdi dasdutlehei, ale uwasv ugilvdodi ugilvtanei, tsunisvsdiyino adanelv utinolei, ale usquanigotanei.
english: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᎩᏒ, ᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏑᎴᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᎦᎢᏃ ᏫᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏣᎫᏴᎯᏙᎸᎢ, ᎢᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno hnaquo unigisv, tali anigisi tsunagvwalodi sulesei, ale dunele ganela, ale hia nuweselei, Hisquanigodesdi, igaino wigalosvsdisgv tsaguyvhidolvi, itsilutsvha igvyaguyvelvha.
english: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᏂᎯ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᎳ ᏅᏩᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎾᏓᏩᏛᏔᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano nasgi tsoi iyanidv gesv, nihi hadanvtesgv, gago nav itsunadala nvwasdi nasgi dinadanasahvsgi tsidunadawadvtanei?
english: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎯ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏫᎾᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Nasgi na uwedolitsvhi.  Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselei, Hena, ale nihi nasgiya winadvga.
english: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎹᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane anaisvi, nasgi ilvhitlv gaduhv ulutsei; gilono iyusdi ageyv Madi tsudoidv dudanilvtse ganelvi.
english: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎸᏃ ᎡᎮ ᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏬᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎳᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏕ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ulvno ehe Meli tsudoidv, nasgi nasquo uwole Tsisa dulasgvi, ale udvdasde gawonisgvi.
english: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᎭ ᎥᎩᎸ ᏣᏋᏕᏨ ᏣᎩᎯᏯᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏘᏁᏥ ᏓᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Madisgini uwelihisdisge utsati dulvwisdanehvi, ale ulutsele hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlasgo gohusdi yeliha vgilv tsaquvdetsv tsagihiyasdanelv aquvsvquo gohusdi itsvyadvnediyi?  Nasgi iyusdi tinetsi dagisdelvdiyi.
english: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎹᏗ, ᎹᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛ ᏤᎵᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuweselei, Madi, Madi, utsati tsudalenvdv tsagasayasdv tselihisdiha ale tsadeyadodiha;
english: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏉ ᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎤᏑᏰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏥᎩᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Sudalegiquo sgini udulvdi; ale Meli usuyesv nasgi osani gesvi, nasgi gayetsigiedi nigesvna tsigi.
english: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ, ᎤᏑᎵᎪᏨ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏰᏲᎲᎦ ᎣᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏥᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi adadolisdisgv ilvhitlv, usuligotsv, asiyvwi usdawadidohi hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, sgiyeyohvga ogadadolisdodiyi, nasgi Tsani tsinudvnele tsiduweyone gvwasdawadidohi.
english: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎮᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ; ᏨᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢ; ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, itsadadolisdisgesdi hia nitsiwesgesdi, Ogidoda galvladi hehi, Galvquodiyu gesesdi detsadovi; Tsvgvwiyuhi gesv wigananugoi; Hadanvtesgv winigalisda elohi nasgiya galvladi tsinigalisdiha.
english: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ogalisdayvdi sginehesdi nidugitsvnisvi.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉ ᎣᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏦᏥᏚᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᏫᏗᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏍᎩᏳᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale digesgivsiquo ogisganvtsvi; ayvyeno nasquo digayotsineho nigadv tsotsidugi; ale tlesdi udagoliyediyi widisgiyatinvstanvgi; sgiyudalesgesdiquosgini uyo gesvi.
english: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᎵᎢ ᏰᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏱᏭᎷᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏄᏪᏎᎸ, ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᏦᎢ ᎦᏚ ᏗᏍᏆᏙᎳᏍᏓ;
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gago hia tsinitsadvnv ulii yeha, ale enoyi ayeli yiwulutselv, ale hia yinuweselv, Ginalii, tsoi gadu disquadolasda;
english: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎠᎩᎷᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᎭ ᏥᏰᎳᏍᏙᏗ;
phonetic: Oginaliiyeno aisv agilutsi, vtla ale gohusdi yagiha tsiyelasdodi;
english: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏯᎥ ᏴᏓᎧᏁᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᏫ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᏍᏚᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏃ ᏗᏇᏥ ᎣᏥᏂᏝᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏛ ᏱᏙᎦᎬᎥᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino diyav yvdakanegi hia yinvdagawi, Tlesdi squadeyadotanvgi; galohisdiyi gayula asduha, diniyolino diquetsi otsinitlaa, vtla yeli yvgagadidv yidogagvvsi.
english: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎬᏩᏗᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎾᎵᎢᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏯᏗᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏕᎠᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyoseha gvwadidvdi nigesvna ale digvwanedi nigesvna yigi, unaliiquo gesv iyusdi, nasuligogvnasgini gesv iyusdi yadidv ale yideahvsi nigav dudulisgvi.
english: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ; ᎢᏥᏲᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎢᏨᏂᎦ, ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎵ;
phonetic: Ale hia nitsvweseha, Itsitayoha, ase dayetsineli; itsiyoga, ase datsiwadvhi; itsvniga, ase dayetsisduieli;
english: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏂᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᎨᏥᏁᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏲᎰ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏥᏫᎬᏂᎰ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivquoyeno gilo tsanitayohiho getsinehoi; gilono tsuyoho awatisgoi; gilono tsiwigvniho atsisduiehoi.
english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏚ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏥᏌ ᏅᏯᏉ ᏯᎲᏏ?  ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎤᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎾᏛᏉ ᏱᎦᏅᎥᏏ?
phonetic: Iyu ale gilo hia tsinitsadvnv itsigayvlige gesv uwetsi gadu yutayoseha, tsisa nvyaquo yahvsi?  Iyu ale atsadi yutayoseha, tsigo atsadi unvnedi gesv inadvquo yiganvvsi?
english: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎸ, ᏥᎪ ᎦᏙᎬ-ᎠᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎦᏅᎥᏏ.
phonetic: Iyu ale uwetsi yutayoselv, tsigo gadogvadatsvyasdisgi yiganvvsi.
english: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏲᎢ, ᏱᏥᏏᎾᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎯ!
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno nihi itsiyoi, yitsisinahi osdv gesv ditsinediyi ditsetsi, utlihiyu nudvnvisdi Itsidoda galvladi ehi tsunediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo gvwatayosehi!
english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎯᎠ Ꮓ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᎤᏬᏂᏎᎢ; ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Asginano ganugowisgei, ale uwagewi gesei.  Hia no nulistanei, nasgi asgina unugotsv uwagewi uwonisei; yvwino unisquanigosei.
english: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎤᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Igadvsgini hia nuniwesei, Anisgina deganugowisga usdeliha Quelitsiqua ugvwiyuhi anisgina unatseliga.
english: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬ, ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Anisoino gvwagoliyesgv, gvwatayosele tsunanugowisediyi uyelvdv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.
english: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏲᎪᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᏔᎵ ᏥᏄᏓᎣ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno agatahe nusdv danadanvtesgv hia niduweselei, Nigav ayeli degotlvsvi tali tsinadadisgo uwasv tsadatludisgoi, ayogoquo; ale sidanelv tali tsinudao uwasv tsadatludisgo ayogoi.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏔᎵ ᏱᏄᏓᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏯᏓᏡᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᎤᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏥᏍᎩᏲᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Iyu ale Sedani tali yinudaa uwasv yadatludiha, gado yigalisdoda yinigvwasdiquo utseligohi?  Nvdigalisdodiha Quelitsiqua usdeliha anisgina tsideganugowisga tsisgiyoseha.
english: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏇᎵᏥᏆ ᏯᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏗᏤᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno Quelitsiqua yagisdeliha anisgina detsinugowisgvi, gago unisdeliha ditsetsi nasgi daninugowisgvi?  Nasgi iyusdi nasgi digetsugodanehi gesesdi.
english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᏱᎬᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏓᏏᏛᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgini ayv anisgina detsinugowisgv Unelanvhi gayesadv yigvdiha, vtla yudlasidvha Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv itsilutselvi.
english: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎬᏰᎯ ᏯᎦᏘᏯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno ulinigidv asgaya ulisgasdodi gvyehi yagatiya ganelvi nvwadohiyadv nusdv uhnavi.
english: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏳᏃᎵᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏎᎪᎩᏒ, ᎤᎩᎡᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎰ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏬᏅᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Utlisgini iyulinigidv yunolilv ale yusegogisv, ugieho nigadv ulisgasdodi ulisgasdotanvi, ale ayadohiho tsugvwalodi udawonvhvi.
english: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏆᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎪᏉ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏃᏍᏗᏟᏏᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎪᏉ.
phonetic: Gilo naqualigonehvna tsigeso aquatludisgoquo; gilono nosditlisisgvna tsigeso adigaleyasgoquo.
english: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏄᎪᎩ, ᎡᏙᎰ ᎤᎧᏲᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲᎰ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᏠᎩᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᏛᎦᏨᏏ ᏗᏇᏅᏒ ᏗᎩᏄᎪᏨ ᏮᏛᏥᎶᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuno gadaha adanvdo yvwi unugogi, edoho ukayodvhi gesvi, uyoho atsawesolvsdodiyi; utlogino, hia nigawesgoi, Dvgatsvsi diquenvsv diginugotsv wvdvtsilosi.
english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎦᎷᎩᏃ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎬᏃᏌᎲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Wigalugino awatisgo gvnosahvhi ale goduistanvhi gesoi.
english: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎰ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono egoi, ale widayanisgo galiquogi didanvdo nvwanadale utli iyuninegutsidv esgaquo uwasv; nasgino aniyvhiho ale nahna ananeladisgoi; oniyino nusdv na asgaya utli uyoiyu gesoi esgaquo igvyiyi.
english: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎨᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏛᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, asiquo nasgi hia nigawesgei, gilo iyusdi ageyv gela unadatlugv usaladane kanegv ale hia nuweselei; Osiyu iyulisdanedi nihi tsananugowisvhi ale nasgi tsasdvnvhi.
english: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nuwesei, Vv, utlihiyusgini osdv iyunalisdanedi anadvgisgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga ale nasgi anisquanigodisgi.
english: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏁᏄᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏂᏲ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ; ᎤᏂᏲᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᏦᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Hnaquono yvwi ganenuli unadatlisanv, ulenvhe hia nuwesei; Uniyo gohi tsaneha; uniyoha uyelvdvi; aseno vtla getsinanugowisedi yigesesdi uyelvdvi, Tsona adolehosgi utseli uyelvdv uwasv.
english: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴ ᏂᏂᏫ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏅᏓᎨᎬᏁᎵ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Tsonayeno uyelvdv tsinigegvnele Niniwi anehi, nasgiya nasquo yvwi Uwetsi uyelvdv nvdagegvneli gohi tsaneha.
english: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏤᎮᎢ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏛᎦᏂᎴ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi ageyv tsuganawv tsehei dodvnaleni gohi tsaneha digugododiyi gesesdi, ale tsunadugodanediyi nidodagvneli; nasgiyeno wasdv iyvdv gadohi tsunvse udvganile Solimanv agatanavi; gvniyuquono ani edoha utli iyatsilvquodi esgaquo Solimanv.
english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᏂᏂᏫ ᏣᏁᎮ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ; ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏎᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏦᎾ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏦᎾ.
phonetic: Yvwi Niniwi tsanehe dodvnaleni gohi tsaneha digugodiyi gesesdi, ale tsunadugodanediyi nvdvnvneli; duninetliyvseyeno dunadanvdv Tsona dulitsidonelv; gvniyuquono ani edoha utli iyatsilvquodi esgaquo Tsona.
english: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏨᏍᏛᎦ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏱᎫᏢᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎪᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo atsvsdvga atsvsdodi udelisv yigakahvsgoi, vtla ale atlilosdi yigutlvdisgoi, gagodiyisgini gagodisgoi, nasgi nvdvniyvhihi unigowadvdiyi iga gadvi.
english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏔ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ, ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ.
phonetic: Agata ayelv iga atisdanehi; nasgi iyusdi, iyuno gohusdi nusdvna gesesdi higadoli, nigv hiyelv nasquo kaliwohi gesesdi iga gati; iyusgini higadoli uyo gesesdi nigv hiyelv nasquo kaliwohi gesesdi ulisigi.
english: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏤᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi heyatahesdi nasgi iga gati hawini tsehv tlesdi ulisigi yigesesdi.
english: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬ ᎯᏰᎸ ᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ, ᏂᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏣᏘᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno nigv hiyelv kaliwohi gesesdi iga gati, ilvhitlv nudadalvna ulisigi, nigv ukalitsvhi gesesdi iga gati, nasgiya atsvsdodi osdv adaweligisgv iga tsitsatisdanehoi.
english: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏴᎴᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎩᏳᏍᏓᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Asiquono gawonisge gilo iyusdi Aqualisi utayosele ulisdayvnanediyi; uyvleno, ale uligiyusdanvnei.
english: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏂᏚᏬᏑᎴᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎾ.
phonetic: Aqualisino ugohv usquanigose niduwosulevna gesv asiquo nulisdayvnvna.
english: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᏕᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ; ᎭᏫᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuweselei, Nihi Itsiqualisi ulisquidi ale atelido gaduiditlv detsinvgalisgoi; hawinisgini gesv itsikalitsvhi geso asequo adagiedi gesv ale asganai.
english: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎫ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᏳᏬᏢᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Itsinegu, tlasgo nasgi gaduiditlv ehi uwotlvnvhi nasquo hawiniditlv ehi yuwotlvnei?
english: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyusesdisgini itsadanehesdi nusdv itsihvi; gvniyuquono nigadiyu itsadanvgalvelvhi gesesdi.
english: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ!  ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏰᏃ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎪ ᏒᏟ ᎠᏟ ᎷᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎢᏥᏃᎯᏯᏍᎪᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᏂᏥᏃᎯᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini Itsiqualisi uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  Asgohineyeno gotsaledv itsaguyisgo svtli atli luwi ale nigav Uyehnavi, itsinohiyasgono duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ale Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi; nasgisgini yinitsadvnelei, ale soi nitsinohiyvnaquo yigesei.
english: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ!  ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏙᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi Itsiqualisi!  detsilvquodoyeno nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale etsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi.
english: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏲᎢᏳᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ, ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲ ᏕᏣᏤᎸ ᏄᏪᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Oyoiyuitsalisdanedi ditsowelisgi, ale Itsiqualisi, itsatlonasdi!  nihiyeno dadanisahv detsatselv nuwelisdvna tsigesoi, ale yvwi gadui anilosgi vtla yinadolehosgoi.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏪᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏍᎩᏐᏢᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono asiyvwi dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi unetse hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, nasgi hia tsiniweha ayv nasquo gesgisotlvdiha.
english: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏦᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ!  ᏕᏥᏐᏈᎸᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗᏱ, ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᏃᏟᏍᏓ ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏨᏓ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᏌᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Nihi nasquo dikahnawadvsdi ditsosisisgi uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  detsisoquilvsgoyeno yvwi dilisvsdi udeyadodi dilisvsdiyi, itsvsvsgini vtla yvgetsinotlisda dilisvsdi yvgetsvda saquo itsiyesadvi.
english: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ!  ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏌᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏙᏓ ᏕᎤᏂᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi!  detsotlvhisisgoyeno anadolehosgi degetsinisahvi, ale ditsidoda deunilvgi.
english: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏚᏂᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏕᏦᏢᎯᏏᎭ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya gvnigesv nitsvneha nasgi osiyu itsiyelvsv nusdv dunilvwisdanelv ditsigayvligei; nasgiyeno udohiyuhi dunilvgi, nihino detsotlvhisiha degetsinisehvi.
english: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ, ᏓᎦᏥᏅᏏ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏙᏛᏂᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᎨᎯᏙᎵ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo hia nuwesv Unelanvhi agatanavi, Dagatsinvsi wigvwanilutsediyi anadolehosgi, ale getsinvsidv, nasgino igadv dodvnili ale dodvnigehidoli,
english: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᏨᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ;
phonetic: Nasgi nigadv anadolehosgi unigigv atsvnvhi gesv elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv getsitayosediyi gohi tsaneha;
english: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏅᏛᎴᏅᏛ, ᏤᎩᎳᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏩᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅᏃ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎨᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Equili ugigv nvdvlenvdv, Tsegilaya ugigv wasdi, nasgi tsulisquadele ayeli atsilvgelasdiyi udvnvnodigalawiisdiyi; udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, getsitayosedi gesesdi gohi tsaneha.
english: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏦᏏᏏᏍᎩ!  ᎢᏥᏴᏫᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏥᏴᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi nihi dikahnawadvsdi ditsosisisgi!  itsiyvwidvhvyeno asduisdi agadovhisdi gesvi; vtlayeno itsvsv yitsiyvlv, ale nasgi na aniyvhihi detsiyosdodanelv.
english: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎮᎢ, ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏩᏅᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᎳᏕᎮ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgino hia nidegawesehei, dinowelisgi ale Aniqualisi ulinigidv gvwanvwisdisgei, ale gvwaniladehe ugodidi tsudalenvdv unohediyi;
english: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎮ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎡᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏩᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwayawisgei, ale uniyohe uniwadvediyi gohusdi gagvwalawisedi gesvi.
english: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᏕᎠᏂᎳᏫᎡ ᎤᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎠᎾᏓᎳᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏴ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono deanilawie unitsuquisdi yvwi, nasgi iyusdi deanadalasdvdisgei, nasgi ulenvhe hia igvyv niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Itseyatahesdi agododi Aniqualisi unatseliga, nasgi atlonasdi tsigi.
english: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎦᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gohusdi yigvsgala nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodi nigesvna gesvi, vtla ale gohusdi udelidv yigi nasgi agadovhisdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏥᏁᏨ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛ ᎠᏛᎪᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏙᏅᎸᎢ ᏕᎧᏅᏑᎸ, ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nagav gohusdi ulisigv itsinetsv iga gadv advgodi gesesdi; nasgino na itsadonvlvi dekanvsulv, gasanali gvnigesv igvnedi gesesdi.
english: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏂᎯᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎪᎱᏏᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale itsvyoseha nihi igalii, Tlesdi yiditsisgaihesdi ayelv anihihi, hnaquono gohusidi utli iyvdv wigvwanadvnedi nigesvna tsigi.
english: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏨᏰᏯᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏳᏓᎸ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᏓᎢᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᎥ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno datsvyeyatani nasgi etsinayesdi gesvi; Etsinayesgesdi nasgi na yudalv, yeliquo tsvsgino wigvwadadainvdi gesvi; vv, itsvyoseha Etsinayesgesdi nasgi.
english: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᎵᎬᏩᎸᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎥᏝᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tlasgo hisgi tsisquaya tali iyadanvtedi yidanaligvwalvsgoi?  Vtlano saquo nasgi agvgewisvhi yigi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᏂᎦ-ᏗᏳ ᏗᏎᎸᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏆᏯ.
phonetic: Nasquosgini itsisdiyegv itsisgoli nigadiyu diselvhi.  Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; nihi utli igai ditsagvwalodi esgaquo unitsati tsisquaya.
english: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasquo itsvyoseha, Gilo gvnigesv naquvnehesdi yvwi anigatahvi, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi gvnigesv nasquo nvdayuwaneli anigatahv dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga.
english: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎦᏓᏱᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Gilosgini aquadayihesdi yvwi anigatahvi, agadayisdi gesesdi anigatahv dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga.
english: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo gawonisgv atludisgesdi yvwi Uwetsi, gayetsidolisdiquo gesesdi; gilosgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo asotlvisdisgesdi vtla gayetsidolisdi yigesesdi.
english: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale digalawiisdiyi detsatinohihesdi, ale nunigvwiyusadegiyi, ale unigvwiyuhiyi, tlesdi yitselihisgesdi nusdv ale iyusdi gesv itsadanetsediyi, ale itsiwesdiyi;
english: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏤᏲᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyuyeno Adanvdo datseyoni nahiyu gesv itsiwesdiyi.
english: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᏁᏥ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏲᎩᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi unadatlugv hia nuweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, hinetsi tsosdadanvtli tali iyoginidisdiyi tsugvwalodi utiyvhi.
english: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᎪ ᏗᏍᏛᏳᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏛᏯᏙᎮᎯ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ?
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei, Hisgaya, gago disdvyugodanehi ale isdvyadohehi naquvnelv?
english: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎿᎭᎥ ᏳᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselei, Itseyadotsehesdi tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi; yvwiyeno gvnv vtla utsati uhnav yulisdelvdodi.
english: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎶᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏛᏒᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Dutlilosdaneleno hia niduweselei, Gilo iyusdi uwehnai asgaya ulogesv utsati udvsvnelei;
english: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏳᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏛᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Udanvteleno uwasv tsudanvdvi, hia nuwesei, Gado dagadvneli, vtlayeno yeli yudlanvdv agidiyi aquadvhiselvhi.
english: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ; ᏙᏓᏥᏲᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᎩᏅᏗᏱ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏧᏛᏂᏗᏃ ᏓᏓᎦᏁᏍᎨᎯ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏓᏥᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏆᏛᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Hia nvdagadvneli; dodatsiyostani aginvdiyi dadanelvi, tsudvnidino dadaganesgehi; nahnano datsini nigadv aquadvhiselvhi ale aginavi.
english: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ; ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩ, ᎤᏣᏔ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎭᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏓ, ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nvdatsiweseli aquadanvdo; Aquadanvdogi, utsata tsasquanigodi tsugvwalodi utsati itsudetiyvdi tsalisdelvdodi; hatsawesolvsda, halisdayvhvsgesdi, haditasgesdi, haliheligesdi.
english: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏘᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ, ᎪᎯᏉ ᎤᏒᎢ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏰᏣᏯᏅᏒᎵ; ᎦᎪᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏓᏁᎳᏅ.
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi hia nuweselei; Titsadanvdvna, gohiquo usvi tsadanvdo dayetsayanvsvli; gagono utseli gesesdi nasgi tsitsadanelanv.
english: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏓᏓᏟᏌᏁᎰ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏄᏪᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi gilo tsadadatlisaneho tsugvwalodi uwasv utseliga, Unelanvhiyino iditlv nuwehnavna tsigesoi.
english: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele Gvwasdawadidohi, nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi yitselihisgesdi detsvnvi, iyusdi itsalisdayvdiyi; ale ditsiyelvi, iyusdi ditsanuwosdiyi.
english: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎬᏅ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᏄᏬ.
phonetic: Agvnv utlihiyu esgaquo alisdayvdi, ale ayelv utlihiyu esgaquo dinuwo.
english: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎳᏅ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏂᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏂᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎾᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏅᏗᏱ ᏱᏓᏓᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎨᎶᎰᎢ.  ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏟ ᏁᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏥᏍᏆ.
phonetic: Golanv ditsadanvdvli; vtlayeno yaniwisgoi, vtla ale yanisgudesgoi; vtla ale tsunadananvdiyi ale uninvdiyi yidadanelv; ale Unelanvhi degelohoi.  Nigav utli netsilvquodi nihi esgaquo tsisqua.
english: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᎬᏉ ᏖᎵ ᏱᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎬᏅᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ.
phonetic: Gagono hia tsinitsadvnv uwelihisgvquo teli yiganvhida gvnvi saquo iyagiyusquidv.
english: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏫᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi usdikani gesv yeli igetsadvnedi nigesvna yigi, gadono asi nvwadale witselihisgoi?
english: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᏧᏥᎸᎯ ᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏂᏍᏙᎰᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᏚᏄᏩᎥᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsadanvdvli tsutsilvhi dadvsgvi; Vtla yidunilvwisdanehoi, vtla ale yanisdohoi; aseno hia nitsvweseha, nasquo Solimanv nigav uwoduhiyu gesv vtla nasgi yinusde dunuwavi hia nasgi saquo nusdvi.
english: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏱᎦᏄᏬᎭ ᎧᏁᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏤᎭ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᏗᏱ ᏬᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏙᏓᏥᏄᏬᎢ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ!
phonetic: Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi yinigvneha yiganuwoha kanesga, nasgi gohi iga tlogesi tseha, ugitsvnvno digadudiyi wonadinvdi tsigi, utlihiyusgini nihi nidodatsinuwoi usdi itsohiyuhi!
english: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏢᏫᏛ ᏱᏂᏚᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi nihi yitsiyohesdi iyusdi itsalisdayvdiyi, ale iyusdi itsaditasdiyi, ale tlesdi tsutlvwidv yinidusdesdi detsadanvdvi.
english: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ; ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nigadv hia tsunadalenvdv yvwi elohi danewadisv uniyohoi; Itsidodano agataho nasgi hia tsudalenvdv itsinigvgvi.
english: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᏣᏠᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsiyohesdisgini Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi; nasgino hia nigadv tsudalenvdv etsatloyasdanedi gesesdi.
english: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏲᎵ ᎠᏫ; ᎢᏥᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi itsigayoli awi; Itsidodayeno osiyu uyelvha itsinediyi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎾᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎿᎭᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ ᏂᏚᏪᏔᎬᎾ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᎿᎭᏫᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎪᏯ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
