phonetic: Itsinadegesdi itsihnavi ale itsadanelvvsgesdi; itsadanelesdi degalodi niduwetagvna, tsugvwalodi galvladi witsitlisisgesdi adisvhvsgi nigesvna, nahna wigvwaluhisdi nigesvna ganosgisgi, ale tsisgoya wigvwayosdodi nigesvna.
english: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏫᏥᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏓᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Nahnayeno witsihv tsugvwalodi, nahna nasquo widahesdi ditsinawi.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏨᏍᏛᏃ ᏓᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Detsadatlohesdi, detsitsvsdvno dadaweligisgesdi.
english: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒᏃ ᏕᏣᏤᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᎦᏘᏲ ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏭᏪᏙᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏳᎷᏨ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏩᏂᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᏍᏚᎢᎡᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsvsvno detsatselesdi anisgaya nasgi tsanigatiyo uninvsidohi, iyuquo uluhisdiyi degegatsvsdisgv wuwedolvhi; nasgino yulutsv ale yuwanilv, nasgi gilaquo iyvdv wigvwasduiediyi.
english: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᏓᏩᏛᎲᎭ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏣᏲᏎᎭ ᏛᏓᏠᎵ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎧᏁᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ [ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ,] ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏙᏛᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi getsinvsidasdi, uninvsidohi galutsvha dawadvhvha aniyawisgvi; udohiyuhiya itsayoseha dvdatloli uwasv, ale dodakanetseli unanitlvdiyi [unalisdayvdiyi,] ale dagalutsi dodvsdelvhi.
english: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno taline ayawisdiyi gesv yulutsv, ale tsoine ayawisdiyi gesv yulutsv, ale yiduwadvhv nasgi nanadvnehvi, osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi getsinvsidasdi.
english: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏗᎦᎷᏥᏒ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᏳᏯᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏩᎩᏴᏏ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᎬᏪᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi itsigatahesdi, nasgi iyu ganela yagatahe iyutlilodv aliyeilisv digalutsisv ganosgisgi, yuyawisei, ale vtla wagiyvsi adanelv yigvwelisei.
english: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi nasquo itsadvnvisdesdi; yvwiyeno Uwetsi dagalutsi iyuquo aliyeilisv nitselisgvna gesvi.
english: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏴᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏍᎩᏯᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛᏉᎨ?
phonetic: Quidano hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, ayvsgo hia nasgi desgiyatlilosdaneha, nigadvquoge?
english: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᏓᏍᏆᎸᎯᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Gagono nasgi na osdv ale agatanai adanelv atsigatidisdi, nasgi unvsidohi nugvwiyusadegi nvdayuwaneli ganelvi, nasgi tsunediyi unalisdayvdi nidasqualvhisvi?
english: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na atsinvsidasdi, nasgi unvsidohi galutsvha uwadvhv nasgi nadvnehvi.
english: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏩᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, nasgi ugvwiyusadegi nvdayuwaneli nigav uhnavi.
english: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎯᏗᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏅᎲᎭ ᏙᎦᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Iyusgini nasgi na atsinvsidasdi hia nigawesv unawiyi, Aginvsidohi gohidiha uluhisdiyi; ale alenvhvha dogalivnihesdi anisgaya ale anigeyv getsinvsidasdi, ale alisdayvhvsgesdi ale aditasgesdi, ale uyvsdesgesdi;
english: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏓᎦᏖᏃᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏳᎦᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏮᏓᏳᏎᎮᎵ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na atsinvsidasdi unvsidohi dagalutsi iyuquo iga nadagatenohvna gesvi, ale iyuquo aliyeilisv nelisgvna gesvi, ale dodayugalisi, ale wvdayuseheli nunohiyusvna dinehvi.
english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᎬᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino na atsinvsidasdi agatahi nusdv udulisgv unvsidohi, ale nudvnvistanvna igesesdi, ale nasgiya nusdv udulisgv nudvnelvna igesesdi, utsati iyagvnisdi gesesdi.
english: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᏰᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᎢᏯᎬᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᏱᎶᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgini nagatahvna gesv ale yeliquo gayetsilivnisdi iyudvnelvhi gesesdi nasgi gayoliquo iyagvnisdi gesesdi.  Yilono utsati atsinelvhi, utsati atsitayosedi gesesdi; ale gilo utsati digvwayohiselvhi yvwi, nasgi utli igai gvwatayosedi gesesdi.
english: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᏆᏚᎳ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏳᏥᏍᏝ?
phonetic: Agilutsilv nasgi iyaquvnisodiyi atsilv gadohi uluhisdiyi; ale gado yaquadula iyuno gayula yutsistla?
english: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I if it be already kindled?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔ ᎬᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏛᎭ!
phonetic: Aseno agiha adawosdi gesv vquawosdodi; ale nigav uwelihisdi aquadanvta gvni alisquadvha!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏚᏁᎵᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏔᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Tsisa nvwadohiyadv dunelilv elohi sgiyeliseha?  Vtla itsvyoseha; taliquosgini iyunadadisdiyi;
english: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏚᎾᏡᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏚᎾᏡᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gohiyeno iyudalenvdv sidanelvhi gesv hisgi iyanidv tali nunadaesdi, tsoi iyanidv unaligosesdi anitali dunatludesdi, ale anitali unaligosesdi tsoi dunatludesdi.
english: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏥ; ᎤᏦᎯᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏦᎯᏯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏦᎯ.
phonetic: Agayvligei tali nunadaesdi asgaya uwetsi, aganvgino asgaya tali nunadaesdi udoda; ale ageyv tali nunadaesdi ageyv uwetsi, ale aganvgi ageyv tali nunadaesdi utsi; utsohino tali nunadaesdi udatsohiya, ale udatsohiya tali nunadaesdi utsohi.
english: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᏅᏙ ᏭᏕᎵᎬ ᏓᎦᎶᎯ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎹ ᏛᏰᎢᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo hia niduwesele yvwi, Ulogilv itsigowadv nvdo wudeligv dagalohi, gilaquo iyvdv hia nitsiwesgoi, ama dvyeili; nasgino nigalisdisgoi.
english: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏗᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏗᎴᎩᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ale itsadolehohi tsuganawv diganolvdisgvi, hia nitsiwesgoi, Udilegiyu gesesdi; ale nasgi nigalisdisgoi.
english: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Itsatlonasdi!  yeliquo itsadolehosgo nusdv galvladi, ale elohi; gadono digalisdodiha nitsadolehosgvna tsigi gohi gesvi?
english: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gadono itsvsv gesv digetsugododi nigesvna igi duyugodv gesvi?
english: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏱᎵᏙᎯ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᏍᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏫᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎯᏯᏚᎵᎳᎡᏗᏱ; ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ ᎾᏏ ᏫᏱᏣᏘᏃᎦ, ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏱ ᏫᏱᏕᏣᏲᎯ, ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏫᏱᏣᏴᏓ.
phonetic: Iyuno tsayilidohi digugodisgiyi sdaisesdi, asiquo wisdaisvi, hatlinigvnelvha hiyadulilaediyi; digugodisgiyi nasi wiyitsatinoga, digugodisgino didaniyisgiyi wiyidetsayohi, didaniyisgino didasdudiyi wiyitsayvda.
english: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᎿᎭᏴᏛᎦᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏣᎫᏴᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ.
phonetic: Gvyoseha, vtla nahna yvdvgahinugoi, gvni tsaguyvhesdi ulisqualvdi aginudvdi iyadanvtedi.
english: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏩᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏇᎴᏗ ᏚᏑᏰᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino anedohe gilo gvwanonelvhi gvwaneisdanelvhi Gelili anehi, nasgi unigigv Queledi dusuyedanelv atsilvanelohvi.
english: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏧᏂᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisano dunetsele hia niduweselei, Itsadanvtesgvsgo hia nasgi Gelili anehi tsunigonadvtanvhi gese anisganahiyu gesv nigadv Gelili anehi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgi tsinunalisdanelei?
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏣᏗᏒᏂ.
phonetic: Vtla itsvyoseha; nihisgini niditsinetliyvsvna igesesdi detsadanvdvi, nigadv nasgiya datsadisvni.
english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏁᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏌᎶᎻ ᎢᏅᎢᎦᏘ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏐᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏂᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ?
phonetic: Ale na neladu iyanidv Salomi invigati adanelv tsunasonei, ale tsidunilei, tsigo itsadanvtesgv tsunigonadvtanvhi gese anisganahiyu gesv nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi?
english: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏩᏗᏒᏂ.
phonetic: Vtla itsvyoseha; nihisgini niditsinetliyvsvna igesesdi detsadanvdvi, nigadv nasgiya dawadisvni.
english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᎤᏫᏎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒᎢ; ᎤᎷᏤᏃ ᎤᏲᎴ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasquo nuwese dutlilosdanelei; Gilo iyusdi, egataiyusdi tlugv uwise telvladi duwisvi; ulutseno uyole udatanvhi, ale vtla yuwadvhei.
english: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏦᎢ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᏥᎷᎬᎩ ᎠᎩᏲᎲᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ; ᎯᎴᏴᏍᏓ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎤᎨᏗ ᎦᏙᎯ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nuwesele osdv iyuwahnadegi telvladi duwisvi, Gvniyuquo, hnaquo tsoi nadetiyv tsilugvgi agiyohvgi udatanvhi hia nasgi egataiyusdi tlugvi, ale vtla yitsiwatiha; hileyvsda; gadono iugedi gadohi?
english: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎮᎳ ᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᏍᎪᏏᏙᎸᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏓ ᏥᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, unelagi hela gohi nasquo tsudetiyvsadi, gvni gasgosidolvha, ale osdv gada tsinvha.
english: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎠᏓᏔᏅᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏄᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎩᎳ ᎣᏂ ᎯᎴᏴᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno iadatanvha, unelagiquo gesesdi; iyuno nutanvna yigi, gila oni hileyvstanvha.
english: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Dadeyohvsgeno ilvhitlv adanelv digalawiisdiyi unadodaquasgvi;
english: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎮ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏁᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏗᏌᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏥᏃᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono nahna edohe ageyv adanvdo vyugi gotlvsgi uyai neladu iyudetiyvdv igvwalistanvhi gesei, ale udisadei, ale gvwatlisdv ulitsinohisdodiyi gesei.
english: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏭᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏣᏢᎬ ᎡᏧᏓᎳᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv wuyanvhei, ale hia nuweselei, Higeyv, tsatlvgv etsudalagi.
english: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏏᏔᏕᏃ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Dusitadeno; ale gilaquo iyvdv gatsinosdv nulistanei, ale ulvquotane Unelanvhi.
english: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏓᏅᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ; ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏅᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyino nugvwiyusadegi uhnalvhi unetsei, nvdigalisdodisge Tsisa udanvwanv unadodaquasgv iga; ale hia niduwesele yvwi, Sudali iga duyugodi tsunilvwisdanediyi yvwi; nahiyusgini itsilugesdi ale detsinvwisgesdi, tlesdino unadodaquasgv iga.
english: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ!  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏰᏤᎵᏌᏕᏍᎪ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᏣᏘᏁᎪ ᎠᎹ ᏰᏣᏗᏔᏍᏔᏁᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hnaquo unetsele hia nuweselei, Tsatlonasdi!  tlasgo nihi itsisiyvwiha gesv unadodaquasgv yetselisadesgo digelasdiyi itsatseli waga ale soquilidigalianvhidv, ale yetsatinego ama yetsaditastanegoi?
english: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏂᏳ ᏁᎳᏚ ᏧᏕᏗᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎸᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏕ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᎸᏒᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎸᏍᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano ageyv Equahami uwetsi tsigi, nasgi Sedani hnaquo gvniyu neladu tsudediyvdv gvwalvlvhi tsigi, tlasgo yiduyugode unadodaquasgv agalvsvdiyi hia nasgi udalvsdvi?
english: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎦᏗᎴᎩ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᏎᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuwesv, nigadv digvwagadilegi unadehosei; nigadvno yvwi analihelige nvdigalisdodisge nigadv galvquodiyu nasgi deulvwisdanehvi.
english: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏤᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nuwesei, Gado datselv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?  Ale gado dodagatlilostani?
english: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎤᎦᏔ ᏓᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᏥᏭᏗᏅᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏡᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎤᎾᎭᏓᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Atsilvugata datselv, nasgi asgaya tsugise ale uwisvdiyi tsiwudinvsei; ale udvsei, ale equohiyu nulistane tlugvi; ale tsisqua galvlo aninohilidohi duwanigalv unahadadei.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Alewo hia nuwesei, gado dodagatlilostani Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi?
english: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᎩᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏑᏴᏁ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏒ ᎦᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏬᏘᏐᏅ.
phonetic: Agododi nasgiyai, nasgi ageyv tsugise ale tsusuyvne tsoi iyutlilodv isv galvi, gvni nigadv uwotisonv.
english: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎦᏛᎴᏏᏙᎴᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᏧᏛᎾ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏖᎢ.
phonetic: Ugadvlesidoleno uwedole tsudvna degaduhv ale tsusdi degaduhvi, dadeyohvsgei, ale Tsilusilimi wagatei.
english: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Asiyvwino hia nuweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, anigayoliquosgo getsisdelvdi gesesdi?  Hiano niduweselei,
english: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏯᏙᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᏓᏳᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsatlinigvnehesdi itsiyvsdiyi ayadoli galohisdiyi; unitsatiyeno, itsvyoseha, dayuniyoli uniyvsdiyi, ale vtla yeli wigvwaniyvsdi yigesesdi.
english: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ ᏓᎴᏅᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏚᏅᎭ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏤᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᏍᎩᏍᏚᎢᏏ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuno hnaquo Asgaya ganela dalenvha ale asdunvha galohisdiyi, nihino itsalenvhv doyiditlv itsidonavi, ale itsvnihesdi galohisdiyi hia nitsewesgesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsagvwiyuhi, esgisduisi; ale dikanetsv hia nvditsiweselvha, vtla yitsigataha ditsadalenvi;
english: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏓᏣᎴᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏏ, ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏗᏔᎲᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏕᏲᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏚᎲ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo datsalenvhi hia nvdatsiwesi, Ogalisdayvnvgi ale ogaditahvgi higatahvi, ale detsadeyonvgi ogiduhv edasdiyi degalanvdvi.
english: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏏ, ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nvdagawesi, itsvyoseha, vtla yitsigataha ditsadalenvi; sgiyadanvsi, nitsiv uyo ditsilvwisdanehi.
english: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏕᏥᎪᎲᎭ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᏒᏃ ᎡᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahna daniyvgesdi ale danilvdagisgesdi daninudogvi, nahiyu detsigohvha Equahami ale Esigi ale Tsegaqui ale nigadv anadolehosgi, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nahna aniyaesdi, itsvsvno etsinugowisvhi gesesdi.
english: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎸᎬᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏗᏂᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏕᎵᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏴᏢᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᎾᏮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏅᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dikalvgvno iditlv dinilosgesdi, ale wudeligvi, ale tsuyvtlvi, ale tsuganawvi, ale ananvvsgesdi Unelanvhi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎣᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏂ ᎨᏎᏏᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo aneha oni tsigi, nasgi igvyi gesesdi, ale aneha igvyi tsigi, nasgi oni gesesidi.
english: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏄᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏅᎾ ᎠᏂ; ᎡᎶᏛ ᎾᏏ ᎤᏚᎵ ᏣᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono iga gilo iyunasdi aniqualisi unilutse hia nigvwaweselei, Hinugoi, ale hadanvna ani; Elodv nasi uduli tsahisdiyi.
english: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏁᏥᏪᏏ Ꮎ ᎫᎳ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏓᏅᏫᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏅᎢ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Itsena, ale hia winetsiwesi na gula, Gvniyuquo anisgina detsinugowisga, ale degadanvwiha gohi iga ale ugitsvnvi, tsoineno iga agisquadvhi gesesdi.
english: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏇᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏰᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv aquedasdi nigalisdiha gohi iga, ale ugitsvnvi, ale ugitsvdv; vtlayeno adolehosgi yeli ilvhitlv gayetsiisdi yigi, Tsilusilimi uwasv.
english: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏘᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏛᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏯᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏥᏕᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏛ ᎠᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏗᎧᏃᎨᏂ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ!
phonetic: Tsilusilimi!  Tsilusilimi!  anadolehosgi tihihi, ale nvya dvnisdisgi getsalutsediyi getsinvsvhi; yanogiyu aquadulisgv gatsiyatlisodiyi ditsetsi, nasgiya tsataga tsidegatlisisgo tsuwetsi anidv awiniditlv dikanogeni, aseno vtla yitsadulisgei!
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᎸ ᏅᏔ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ, ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᏅᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo itsinelv nvta netsvnelv; ale hia nitsvweseha, Vtla yvgesgigowadv gohi iyudalenvdv gvni hia itsiwesdiyi asqualvhvha, Atsilvquodiyu nasgi na Yihowa denvdov tsigaluhisdiha.
english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏴᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi uyvlv gilo iyusdi tsaganelodi Aqualisi ganelv ulisdayvdiyi unadodaquasgv iga, nasgi gvwagasayasdei.
english: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏄᏛᏁ ᎤᏢᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏓᏁᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono gilo iyusdi asgaya igvyiditlv nudvne utlvgi ama udanenehi.
english: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᏗᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ?
phonetic: Tsisano unetse hia niduwesele dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi ale Aniqualisi; Duyugodisgo didanvwodiyi unadodaquasgv iga?
english: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏃ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᎤᏅᏩᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏲᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Elaweyino unvnei.  Uniyvhvno unvwanei, ale duyosei;
english: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ ᏳᎸᏤᎸ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏮᎦᎳᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ?
phonetic: Dunetseleno hia niduweselei, Gago hia tsinitsadvnv soquilidigalianvhidv ale waga yulvtselv atalesv vtla gilaquo iyvdv yiwvgalagi unadodaquasgv iga?
english: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Vtlano yeli nvdagvwawohiliyvsdanedi yigese nasgi hia.
english: And they could not answer him again to these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ, ᏚᎪᎲ ᏓᎾᏑᏰᏍᎬ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Ale dutlilostanele nasgi na wigetsiyanvdv, dugohv danasuyesgv nugvwiyusv dinitlvdiyi, hia niduweselei,
english: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏯᏅᎲᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏏᏅᎩ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ;
phonetic: Iyuno gilo degegatsvsdisgv tsenvsdiyi tsayanvhvha, tlesdi nugvwiyusv dinitlvdiyi tsanisinvgi; utliyeno iyatsilvquodi esgaquo nihi watsiyanvdv yinigagi;
english: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏍᏗᏯᏅᏛᏃ ᏱᎦᎷᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏣᏪᏏ, ᎯᏯᏜᏓᏅᏓᏗᏏ ᎯᎠ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᏕᎰᏒᎯ ᏯᎴᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏫᏱᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Wisdiyanvdvno yigalugi hia yinitsawesi, Hiyadlanvdadisi hia; hnaquono tsadehosvhi yalenv eladi gesv dinitlvdiyi wiyilohi.
english: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ, ᎮᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂᏏᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᏢᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏣᏯᏅᏛ ᎦᎷᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏣᏪᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎩᎾᎵᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᏫᎶᎯ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏥᏂᏜᏓᎢ [ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.]
phonetic: Etsayanisgesdisgini, hegesdi ale tsanisihvsgesdi eladi gesv dinitlvdiyi; nasgino witsayanvdv galugesdi, hia iyutsawesedi yigi, Ginalii, galvladitlvsdodi wilohi; hnaquo etsalvquodiyu gesesdi anigatahv itsulaha itsinidlai [dilisdayvdiyi.]
english: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Giloyeno uwasv adasaladisgesdi eladi iyagvnedi gesesdi; gilono uwasv eladi nadadvnehesdi nasgi atsisaladodi gesesdi.
english: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏭᏯᏅᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᎭᏕᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏫᏘᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎾᎢ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏣᏓᎳ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏮᎨᏣᏯᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏴᎨᏣᎫᏴᏏ.
phonetic: Hiano nasquo nuwesele wuyanvdv, Iyuno dehadelasdisgesdi iga ehi ale usv ehi, tlesdi yiwitiyanisgesdi ditsalii, ale itsalinvtli, ale gohusdi ditsvnv, ale tsunenai nav itsadala; nasquoyeno nihi yiwvgetsayanv ale yvgetsaguyvsi.
english: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎭᏕᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏫᏘᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎤᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᏗᏂᏲᏅᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ;
phonetic: Iyusgini dehadelasdisgesdi, witiyanisgesdi uyo iyunadvhnadegi, gohusdi usdv diniyelv uniyohuselvhi, diniyonvli, ale dinigewi;
english: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏴᎦᎨᏣᎫᏴᏏ; ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Osiyuno itsalisdanedi gesesdi; vtlayeno yvgagetsaguyvsi; etsaguyvediyeno gesesdi danalehisanv unadanvti.
english: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi itsulaha unalisdayvnvhi nasgi udvganv, hia nuweselei, Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nahna gvwalisdayvdi nigalisdanvha.
english: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ [ᏥᏌ] ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᏕᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ;
phonetic: Ale [Tsisa] hia nuweselei, Gilo iyusdi asgaya utsati dudelastanei, ale unitsati widuyanvhei;
english: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᎤᏅᏎ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᏗᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ; ᎡᏤᎾ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Alisdayvdiyino gesv usqualvhvunvse unvsidasdi hia winiduwesediyi wigetsiyanvdv; Etsena, nigadiyuyeno hnaquo advnvisdi.
english: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏧᎾᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏂᏲᎴᎢ.  ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᎩᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎦᏔᏅᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎬᏔᏲᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nigadvno utloyi tsunatlvwisdodi unalenvhe uniyolei.  Igvyiyi hia nuweselei, tlogesi agiwasv, ale ase aquenvsdi ale aquagatanvsdi nigalisdiha; gvtayose unelagi squelisediyi.
english: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎩᎳᎾᎳ ᏩᎦ ᏓᎩᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏁᎶᏔᏂ; ᎬᏔᏲᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno hia nuwesei, hisgi iyunagilanala waga dagiwasv, ale deganelotani; gvtayose unelagi squelisediyi.
english: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏆᏕᏒᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏫᎬᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno hia nuwesei, aquadesvnv, nasgino iyusdi vtla yeli wigvgiluhisdi yigi.
english: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.  ᎦᏁᎳᏃ ᎤᎾᎸᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ ᏄᎳ ᏫᏴᎲ ᎡᎾᎢᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛᎢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏘᏃᎸᎭ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏛ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎤᏂᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgino na atsinvsidasdi iulutsv unanugowisele unvsidohi nasgi hia nulistanidolvi.  Ganelano unalvhiyu gesv hia nuwesele unvsidasdi, Hena nula wiyvhv enaidasdiyi ale tsusdi degalanvdvi gaduhvi, ale dehatinolvha uyo iyunadvhnadegi, ale gohusdi usdv diniyelv uniyohuselvhi, ale diniyouli, ale dinigewi.
english: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛᎦ, ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Atsinvsidasdino hia nuwesei, sginvsidohi, nitsawesv nasgiya nigadvga, asiquono udlanvdv.
english: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᏕᎦᏅᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏐᏴᎢ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎩᏴᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Unvsidohino hia nuwesele unvsidasdi, Hinugoi deganvhnawadisv ale dasoyvi wilohi, ale ase uniyvsdiyi nigiyvnelvha nasgi ukaliisdiyi tsinelvi.
english: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏛᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏔᏂ ᏓᏆᏕᎳᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha, vtla gilo nasgi na wigetsiyanvdv gesv yvdvnalisdayvtani daquadelastanvi.
english: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Unitsatino yvwi gvwasdawadvsei; ugatahvsvno hia niduweselei,
english: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᎦᏂᏆᏘᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏙ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Gilo ayv agilutsehesdi nidiganiquatihvnano igesesdi udoda, ale utsi, ale udalii, ale tsuwetsi, ale analinvtli, ale tsudo, vv, ale uwasv nasquo gvnvi, vtla yeli agisdawadidohi yinvgalisda.
english: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎾᏱᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Ale gilo utseli tsudahnawadv nayisgvna ale nagisdawadegvna igesesdi, vtla yeli agisdawadidohi yinvgalisda.
english: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᏯᏓᏅᏖ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎦᎲᏍᎪ ᏯᏎᎯᎰ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gagoyeno hia tsinitsadvnv, yadanvte inv igati unesgediyi, vtla igvyi yigahvsgo yasehiho igai tsugvwatanihisdi gesvi, udolehohisdiyi yeli gvwasquadisdodi igai uhvi.
english: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏧᏛᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏯᎾᎴᏅ ᏱᎬᏩᏕᎰᏛ,
phonetic: Iyuyeno gagusdvdi tsudvhi yigi, ale gvwasquadisdi nigesvna yigi, nigadv anigowatisgi yanalenv yigvwadehodv,
english: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏱᎾᏂᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hia yinaniwi, hia asgaya ulenvhvgi anesgesgvi, ale vtla yeli gvwasquadisdi yigesei.
english: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᏱᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎦᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏓᏘᏁᎲ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏟᏴᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏔᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gago iyusdi ugvwiyuhi, dahnawa yinvdvnvneli nvwadale ugvwiyuhi, vtla igvyi yigahvsgo ale yadanvtesgo yeliquo asgohi iyagayvli datinehv digvwanatliyvdi gesv tsugatilegi talasgohi iyagayvli datinehvi.
english: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏏ ᏐᎢ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏨᏣᎢᏐᎢ, ᏕᎦᏅᏍᎪ ᏧᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎰ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuno yeli nigesvna yigi, asi soi invhiyu tsvtsaisoi, deganvsgo tsunvsidv atayohiho dohiyi iyunvnediyi.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏚᏲᏐᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi, iyuno gilo niduyosohvsgvna igesesdi nigadv utseli gesvi, vtla yeli agisdawadegi yinvgalisda.
english: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ~ᎠᎹ ᎣᏏᏳ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ~ᎠᎹ ᏳᏥᏍᎪᎸ, ᎦᏙ ᏘᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ~ᎠᎹ ᏯᏙᏢᎾ.
phonetic: ~Ama osiyu; iyusgini ~ama yutsisgolv, gado tigalisdoda ~ama yadotlvna.
english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎦᎳᎨᏯᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏓ ᎦᏡᎬ ᎬᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᏭᎾᏕᎪᏉ.  ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Vtla hnaquo tlogesi galageyadvdi ale osdv gada gatlugv gvdi yigesoi; wunadegoquo.  Gilo degalilugesdi udvgodiyi wadvgvga.
english: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nav gvwalutsele nigadv adelv anigisidohi ale anisgana gvwadvdasdanediyi.
english: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino ale dinuwelisgi unisonvtsele hia nuniwesei, hia asgaya dadanilvgo anisganai, ale itsulaha analisdayvhvsgoi.
english: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏁᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Hiano nuwese dutlilostanelei,
english: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏱᏚᎾᏝᎠ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎬᏕᎪ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏲᎴᎪ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏩᏛ?
phonetic: Gago hia tsinitsadvnv, asgohitsuqui yidunatlaa uninodena, iyuno saquo yuyohuselv, vtla yidigvdego inage anedohv soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv, ale yuyolego uyohuselvhi, gvni awadv?
english: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ ᎠᏃᎭᏢᎥᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno awadv anohatlvvsgoi aliheligoi.
english: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎦᎷᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᏧᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎰᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ; ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᏣᎩᏲᎱᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Vgalugino uwenvsv widayanisgo tsulii ale nav iyunadala, hia nidegawesehoi, Itsulaha idaliheligi; itsiwadvhvyeno unodena tsagiyohusehvgi.
english: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎾᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏦᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyoseha, nasquosgini utlihiyu nanaliheligesdi galvladi tsosv saquo asgana ganetliyvsgesdi udanvdvi, esgaquo iyvdv soonelasgohi soonelagali iyanidv unadanvti anisgaya tsuninetliyvsdi nunalisdanehvna dunadanvdvi.
english: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏱᏚᎭ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᏨᏍᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎬᏃᏌᏍᎪ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᏳᏲᎰ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏩᏛ?
phonetic: Ale gago iyusdi ageyv asgohi yiduha agisi tsunagvwalodi, iyuno saquo yuyohuselv, vtla yatsvsdvsgo atsvsdodi ale yigvnosasgo galitsode, ale ulisinahisdi yuyoho gvni awadv?
english: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏩᏛ ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᏧᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ; ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲᏰᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏣᎩᏲᎱᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno awadv widayanisgo tsulii ale nav iyunadala, hia nigawesgoi, Itsulaha idaliheligi; agiwadvhvyeno adelv tsagiyohusehvgi.
english: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquosgini itsvyoseha analiheligo dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga saquo asgana ganetliyvna udanvdvi.
english: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Gilo iyusdi asgaya anitali tsuwetsi anisgaya anehei.
english: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏣᎲᎢ ᏍᎩᎲᏏ.  ᏔᎵᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏕᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Onino ehi hia nuwesele udoda, Edoda, aquatseli iyulisdodi gesv tsugvwalodi tsahvi sgihvsi.  Talino niduwedele nigav tsugvwalodi uhvi.
english: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏉᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎣᏂ ᎡᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏪᏟᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎩᏎ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏄᏁᎸᎾ ᎡᎲᎢ ᏭᏤᏫᏙᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgiquono winusvlv uwetsi oni ehi nigadv uwetlisanei, ale unigise inv wulosei, nahnano nunelvna ehvi wutsewidole tsugvwalodi uhvi.
english: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏤᏬᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎪᏄᎶᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigadv utsewonv utsati dugonulose nahnani, hnaquono ulenvhe udulvhvnei.
english: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᎤᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᏙᏧᎶᎨᏒᏃ ᏏᏆ ᏗᎨᎶᎸ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Uwenvseno uligonele nahna ehi asgaya; dotsulogesvno siqua digelolv unvsei.
english: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏧᏪᏰᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᎵᏎᏥ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ ᏏᏆ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏚᏅᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udulisge tsuweyesdiyi kalisetsi unadadvnvhi siqua unalisdayvdi, aseno vtla gilo yidunvnehei.
english: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏌᏅᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏄᏂᏣᏔ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎪᏄᏉ ᎠᎩᎯᎭ!
phonetic: Udanvtisanvno hia nuwesei; Nunitsata gegaguyvehi getsinvsidasdi edoda tsutseliga ulosvstanvhi uniha unalisdayvdi, ayvno agonuquo agihiha!
english: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᏓᎦᎴᏂ, ᎡᏙᏓ ᏮᏓᏥᎷᏤᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏅᏓᏥᏪᏎᎵ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dodagaleni, edoda wvdatsilutseli, hia winvdatsiweseli; Edoda, Galvladi tsisganvtselv, ale nihi higatahvi.
english: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏍᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᏘᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏉ ᏔᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏍᏋᎦ.
phonetic: Ale vtla hnaquo yeli aquetsi gesquosedi yigi; tinvsidasdiquo taguyvehi nunasdv nasgiya nisquvga.
english: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᏁ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏭᎷᏤᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏣᎢᏎᎢ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏭᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎵᎨᏂ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏪᏙᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dulene udoda wulutselei.  Aseno asi invhiyu tsaisei udoda wugohei, ale uwedolitsei, ale dusqualvtanei, ale agiligeni uweyalvtsei, ale utawedonei.
english: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏥᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ Ꮭ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏍᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Uwetsino hia nuweselei; Edoda, Galvladi tsisganvtselv, ale nihi higatahvi; ale tla hnaquo aquetsi gesquosedi yigi.
english: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎣᏌᏂ ᎠᏄᏬ ᏫᏥᎾᎩ, ᎡᏥᏄᏬᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏰᏑᏍᏙᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏣᎳᏑᎸᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno udoda hia niduwesele tsunvsidasdi; Osani anuwo witsinagi, etsinuwotsa, ale etsiyesusdoga, ale tsetsalasulvga.
english: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏫᏥᏯᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎷᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏓᏓ.
phonetic: Ale galitsotanvhi waga agina witsiyanv, ale etsiluga; ale idalisdayvhvga, osdv idadanvdada.
english: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏓᏠᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎠᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ; ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno aquetsi uyohusvhi gesvgi, talineno ieha, ale edatlotsvhi gesvgi, iatsiwadvhvno; unalenvheno osdv unadanvdadei.
english: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏪᏙᎮᎢ; ᏗᎤᏪᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏓᏂᏃᎩᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎩᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏁᎢ
phonetic: Udaniligeno uwetsi tlogesi wedohei; diuwenvno ale adanelv nav ulutsv, daninogisgv ale analisgisgv udvganei
english: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Wuyanvheno asiyvwi atsinvsidasdi, ale udvdvne uyelvdv nasgi nanadvnehvi.
english: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏣᏅᏟ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏣᏙᏓᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᎸ, ᏙᎯᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuweselei; Etsanvtli ulutsv, tsadodano galitsotanvhi waga agina ulv, dohiyi unanugotsilv iyusdi.
english: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏄᏴᎸᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏧᏄᎪᏤ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Utalawoseno, ale winuyvlvnaquo gesei; nasgi iyusdi udoda tsunugotse usdiyetanei.
english: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᎬᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓ, ᎠᎴᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏣᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏫ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᏎᏄᎸᎯ ᏱᏍᎩᎧᏁᎶᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏆᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia nuwesele udoda; Gvniyuquo utsata nadetiyv gvsdelvhida, alevtla ilvhiyu naquohiyunvna yigi tsanetsvi, aseno vtla ilvhiyu awiagina asenulvhi yisgikaneloi, osdv ogadanvdadisdodi diqualii.
english: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏥ ᎤᎷᏦᏅᎯᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏒᏁᎸᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏙᎸᎢ, ᎢᎯᎡᎸ ᎦᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Hiasgini tsetsi ulutsonvhiquo, nasgi tsasvnelvhi tsugvwalodi anigeyvhi uninegutsidv uweladidolvi, ihielv galitsotanvhi waga agina.
english: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏂᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏤᎵᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Aquetsi, nigohilvquo itsulaha ininelv, ale tsatseliquo nigav aginavi.
english: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎡᏣᏅᏟ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏓᏠᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎠᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ.
phonetic: Duyugodvgi osdv igadanvdadisdiyi, ale igilihelisdiyi; hiayeno etsanvtli uyohusvhi gesvgi, talineno ieha, ale edatlotsvhi gesvi, iatsiwadvhvno.
english: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎮ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎧᎮ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎤᎿᎭᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏤᏪᎸ ᎠᏥᏃᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, Gilo iyusdi ehe uwehnai asgaya nasgi uwekahe ugasayasdidegi uhnavi; ale nasgi atsilawisehv tsugvwalodi udatsewelv atsinonelei.
english: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᎬᏯᏛᎩᎭ?  ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Wuyanvheno hia nuweselei, Gado digalisdodiha tsinusdi tsigvyadvgiha?  Gvnigesv nvga nusdv detsalvwisdanelv tsagasayasdidegi gesvi; gohiyeno iyudalenvdv vtla hnaquo tsagasayasdidegi yigesesdi.
english: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎩᎡᎭ ᎠᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏆᏍᎪᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏆᏚᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎢᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ugasayasdidegino hia nuwese uwasv tsudanvdvi, Gado dagadvneli, aginvsidohiyeno agigieha aquagasayasdidegi gesvi?  Tlano yeli gvquasgosdi yigi; aquaduladidasdiyino igadeosga.
english: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎫᎪᏓ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏌᏕᏒ ᎠᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎬᏆᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Degugoda iyaquadvnediyi, nasgi vgisadesv aquagasayasdidegi gesv digagvquadanilvisdi iyulisdodiyi daninelvi.
english: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏧᏚᎩ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏣᏚᎦ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Howano widuyanvhe nigadv unvsidohi tsudugi, igvyiyino hia nuweselei, Ilago igai tsaduga aginvsidohi.
english: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎪᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎡᏣᏚᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎳ ᎯᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᎰᏪᎸᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Asgohitsuqui iyutlilodv goi.  Hiano nuwesei, hinagi goweli etsadugvi, ale nula hihvga, ale hisgisgohi howelvga.
english: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯᎾ ᎢᎳᎪ ᎡᏣᏚᎦ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎡᏣᏚᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎰᏪᎸᎦ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno hia nuweselei, nihina ilago etsaduga?  Hiano nuwesei, asgohitsuqui iyutlilodv utsalesdi.  Hiano nuweselei, Hinagi goweli etsadugvi, ale nelasgohi howelvga.
english: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏜᏓᎢᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏛᎾᎯ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏍᎨ ᎤᏏᎾᏌᏅᏨᎢ; ᎡᎶᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎾᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Unadlaino ulvquotane niduyugodvna iyadvnahi ugasayasdidegi, udigalisdosge usinasanvtsvi; elohiyeno tsuwetsi unvsv anehvi, utli nanisinasanv esgaquo igagati tsuwetsi.
english: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏣᎵᎢᏓ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏩᏕᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale itsvyoseha, itsaliida udalidasdi genvisdi gesvi; nasgi esga nitsalisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna wadediyi gesv gagetsadanilvisdi gesesdi.
english: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏃ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎤᎪᏗᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo duyugodv iyadvnehi gayoli gesvi, nasquo duyugodv nadvneho ugodidi gesvi; niduyugodvnano iyadvnehi usdi gesv, nasquo niduyugodvna nadvneho ugodidi gesvi.
english: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏓ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno duyugodv nitsadvnehvna igesesdi udalidasdi genvisdi gesv gohusdi itsvdisgvi, gago yitsigatidisda nudalidasdvna genvisdi gesvi?
english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Iyuno duyugodv nitsadvnelvna yigi nvwadale utseliga gesvi, gago datsineli itsvsv itsatseli gesvi?
english: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ; ᏱᎠᏍᎦᎦᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎤᎨᏳᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ; ᏱᏙᎤᏂᏴᏆᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭᏃ ᏐᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎹᎹᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎨᏣᏛᏂᏏ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo atsinvsidasdi yeli anitali gvwanvsidohi gohusdi yidogvdvnisi; yiasgagayeno saquo yiugeyuhano soi; yidouniyvquale saquo yiganiquatihano soi.  Tlasgini yeli Unelanvhi ale mamani gohusdi yidogetsadvnisi.
english: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino nasquo, nasgi adelv unigvvsgi tsigesei, nasgi hia nigadv unadvganei; ale gvwadehotanei.
english: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎧᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᏐ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Nihi kani duyugodv itsadvnehi nvwasdoi yvwi anigatahvi; Unelanvhisgini dagataha ditsinawi; nasgiyeno galvquodiyu tsuniyelvso yvwi, uniquatisdiyu Unelanvhi dakanisgvi.
english: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᏤᎲᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ; ᎾᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎭ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi detsehvgi Tsani unanugotsilv iyasdi; nahiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv aninoheha analitsidohvsga, ale naniv yvwi ananelugi aniyvhiha.
english: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale utli ahidiyu galvloi ale elohi unilosohvsdiyi, ano saquo usdikani dikahnawadvsdi esga iyulisdodiyi.
english: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎢᎠᏓᎡᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᎦᏓᎢᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo udalii iadaegesdi, ale nvwadale adayegesdi, adayonehesdi; gilono agadainvdv adayegesdi adayonehesdi.
english: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏓᏄᏬᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo iyusdi asgaya uwehnai ehei, gigage ale usidoli doledv dinuwo danuwosgei, ale nidadodaquisv osdv dalisdayvhvsgei.
english: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎳᏏᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏏᏁ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᏥᏓᎳ ᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nasquo ehe gilo iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi Lasila tsudoidv, nasgi atsinisine uwehnai utseli galohisdiyi, tsutsidala gesei,
english: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎠᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᎪᎣᏒᎯ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎵ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᏚᏂᎦᎾᏕ ᏚᏥᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udulisge agelasdodiyi unvgoosvhi uwehnai uwesgilvi; ale nasquo gili unilutse duniganade dutsidalvi.
english: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏅᏎ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ ᏫᎬᏪᎧᏁᎢ.  ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei; nasgi uyo iyudvhnadegi uyohusei, ale dinikahnawadidohi gvwanvse Equahami ganetsii wigvwekanei.  Uwehnaino nasquo uyohusei ale atsinisanei.
english: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏅ ᏭᎪᎮ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsvsginoi dusaladane digadoli agiliyogei, ale nahna inv wugohe Equahami, ale Lasila Equahami ganetsii.
english: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏅᎵ ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ ᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᎠᎼᎯ ᏩᎱᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎩᏙᎣᎸᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᏃᎪᎢ; ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦᏰᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uwelune hia nuwesei; Edoda Equahami, sgidoligi, ale ehinvli Lasila, ale nasgi usgoli gayesadv amohi wahuda, ale wagidoolvsdasi tsinogoi; tsigiliyogayeno ani adaweligisgvi.
english: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎭᏅᏓᏓ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᏏ ᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎩ ᎯᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏲᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏥᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎯᎩᎵᏲᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno Equahami hia nuwesei; Aquetsi, hanvdada, nihi asi tsalenidohvgi hiwatisgv tsatseliga osdv, ale Lasila nasquo awatisgvgi utseliga uyoi.  Aseno hnaquo atsinuwohistanv, nihino ihigiliyoga.
english: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏤᎲ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎪᏢᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎤᎾᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏅᎬᎾᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏤᎲᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᎷᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Aleno nasquo ayv otsehv nihino itsehv nahna ayeli gesv equohiyu udlanvdvi gotlvha, nasgi iyusdi gilo yunaduliha ani unadalesdiyi ditsehv wunilohisdiyi, vtla yeli yinvgvnadvga, ale nasquo ani otsehvi vtla yvgvnilugi nahna nvdayunilohisdiyi yunaduliha.
english: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎦᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; adina edoda, gvtayoseha, hinvsdiyi edoda diganelvi;
english: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏱᏫᏕᎧᏃᎲᏏ ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏂᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Hisgiyeno naniv otsalinvtli aneha; nasgino yiwidekanohvsi nasquoyeno ani agiliyoisdiyi gesv yanilugi.
english: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Equahami hia nuweselei; Mosi ale anadolehosgi duneha; nasgi widanadvdasdasi.
english: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᏭᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏓᏂᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Tlesdi edoda Equahami, iyusgini gilo uyohusvhi yiwunilutselv ase yidaninetliyvna danadanvdvi.
english: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᎬᏃᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᏚᎴᏅ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nuweselei; iyuno nidanadvdasdanehvna yigi Mosi ale anadolehosgi, vtla nasquo yvgvnohiyuhvga, nasquo gilo uyohusvhi yidulenv.
english: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏎ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ!
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, ase didadodesdisgi unanugoisdi; aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na unanugowisvhi!
english: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏯᏥᏯᏝᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏱᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏬᏕᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utli osiyu iyulisdanedi yigese nvya asdosgi yatsiyatlanei, ale amequohi yiwagadainvsei, ano hia asiyvwi tsunasdi gesv tsuwodesdiyi.
english: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎢᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏰᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsvsv itsadayawisgesdi.  Iyuno disdadanvtli itsasganvtsehesdi, higvsgolvvsgesdi; iyuno uyo iyayelvsgesdi, hiyadoligesdi.
english: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏂᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏏᎦ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏂᏣᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏏᎦ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Iyu ale galiquogi nitsasganvtsehesdi siga gesv, ale galiquogi nitsalutsehesdi siga gesv, hia nitsawesehesdi, uyo agiyelvha, ase hiyadoligesdiquo.
english: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏁᏉᏏ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno hia nuniwesele Ugvwiyuhi, Sginequosi ogohiyusvi.
english: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎤᎦᏔ ᏥᏂᎬ ᎢᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎫᏩ-ᏧᏁᎬ ᏥᏡᎦ, ᏫᏕᏣᎾᏍᏕᏢᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏪᏣᎧᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Iyuno atsilvugata tsinigv igidv gohiyudi gesv yitsiha, hia yinitsiwesi hia guwatsunegv tsitluga, Widetsanasdetlvda, ale amequohi wetsakahvga, ale yitsohiyuhvga.
english: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏓᎷᎩᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᎶᎸᎥᏍᎦ, ᏠᎨᏏ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏏ, ᎮᎾ ᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ?
phonetic: Aseno gago hia tsinitsadvnv, etsinvsidasdi yigadalugiha, ale yigelolvvsga, tlogesi nvdayulosonvhi, gilaquo iyvdv hia yinetsiwesi, Hena walisdayvhvga?
english: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎬᏩᎬᏫᏳ ᏱᏅᎦᏰᏥᏪᏏ, ᎭᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏠᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓ ᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏗᏔᏍᎬ ᎢᎬᎯᏛ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏗᏔᎲᎭ?
phonetic: Tlasgo hia yigvwagvwiyu yinvgayetsiwesi, Hadvnvisda aqualisdayvdiyi, ale hadatloga, ale sgisdelvhida galisdayvhvsgv ale gaditasgv igvhidv; onino tsvsv halisdayvnvha ale haditahvha?
english: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Agalielitsehosgo nasgi atsinvsidasdi natsiweselv nudvnelvi?  Vtla agiyelvha.
english: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᏅᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏃᎦᏛᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi, hnaquo nigadv nutsiweselv nitsadvnehonvha, hia nitsiwesvha, Gohusdi ogvdodi nigesvna oginvsidasdi; iyogadvnediquo gesv nogadvnelv.
english: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏖᎢ, ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nasgi Tsilusilimi wagatei, Sameliyi ale Gelili ayeli ulosei.
english: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏩᏴᎯᎲᎢ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏎᎢ, ᎢᏅ ᏧᎾᎴᏅᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Ilvhitlvno gaduhv wayvhihvi asgohi iyanidv anisgaya adayesgi tsunitlvgi degvwatlosei, inv tsunalenvnei;
english: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏍᎩᏯᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Ale unisaladane aninegv hia nuniwesei, Tsisa Tadeyohvsgi, sgiyadoligi.
english: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎪᎲᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏤᎾ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏫᏂᏗᏣᏛᏂᏏ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Dugohvno, hia niduweselei, Itsena atsilvanelohi gvnigesv winiditsadvnisi.  Hiano nulistanei, anaisvquo dunadanvgalvhei.
english: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎢ, ᏗᎤᏨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Asiyvwino, udolehosv atsinvwanvi, diutsvsei, ale asdaya unetse ulvquotane Unelanvhi,
english: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎤᎵᏯᏍᏚᏁ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎮᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udanvne uliyasdune dulasgv navi, alihelitsehei.  Ale Sameliyi ehi gesei.
english: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏱᎨᏥᏅᎦᎸᎡᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᎣᏁᎳ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎭᏢ?
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesei, Tlasgo asgohi yigetsinvgalvei?  Aseno soonela iyanidv hatlv?
english: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏥᏩᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏨᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Vtla yigetsiwadv nvdayunatsvdv Unelanvhi anilvquodisgi, hia nvwadale yvwi uwasv.
english: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎮᎾ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele nasgi, Talehvga, ale tsihena; tsohiyusv tsadiwisda.
english: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅ ᎢᏳᏉ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Aniqualisino gvwadvdvnv iyuquo uluhisdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv, dunetselei, hia nuwesei, Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv vtla gvgowadvdi yigesesdi galutsvha.
english: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ!  ᎠᎴ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ!  ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Vtla ale hia yinigvniwesgesdi, Gvniyuquo ani!  ale, Gvniyuquo nahnani!  gvniyuquoyeno Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv itseladidoha.
english: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᎪᏩᏛ.
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi, dvsqualvhi nahiyu gesv itsadulisgesdi itsigowadvdiyi saquo iga yvwi Uwetsi utseliga, ale vtla yvgetsigowadv.
english: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nigetsiwesehesdi, Gvniyuquo ani; ale Gvniyuquo nahnani; tlesdi itsenvsvgi, ale tlesdi ditsisdawadvsvgi.
english: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏨᏗᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgiyayeno anagalisgi saquo iditlv galvloi tsvdigalisgoi, utsatinino iditlv galvloi tsiwidigalvsadadisgoi; nasgi nasquo nusdesdi yvwi Uwetsi utseli iga aliyilolvha.
english: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno igvyi utsati tsudalenvdv ugiliyoisdi, ale digvwayohisdi gesesdi gohi tsaneha.
english: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏃᏯ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ale nasgiya tsinusde nahiyu Noya tsehei, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi nahiyu yvwi Uwetsi utseli iga aliyilolvha.
english: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏃᏯ ᎤᏣᏅ ᏥᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎱᎦᏂᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎬᏦᏅ.
phonetic: Danalisdayvhvsgei, danaditasgei, danadesvhvsgei, degetsiyegei, gvni nahiyu iga Noya utsanv tsiyuhi, ale unohuganilv ale nigadv dunigvtsonv.
english: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎶᏛ ᏤᎮᎢ; ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏂᏩᎡᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᏂᏫᏒᎥᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo tsinusde nahiyu Lodv tsehei; danalisdayvhvsgei danaditasgei, uniwaevsgei, aninotanvvsgei, daniwisvvsgei, dananesgesgei;
english: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎶᏛ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎦᎿᎭᏁ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᏚᏂᎰᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nahiyuquo iga Lodv Sodami unugotsv, galvladi tsugahnane atsilv ale sagonige adawelagisgi, nigadiyuno dunihonei.
english: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏂᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nusdesdi nahiyu iga yvwi Uwetsi gananugonilvha.
english: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᎩᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᎿᎭᎥᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎠᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ ᎤᏫᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏫᎡᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyu iga gilo gasanali ugilesdi, uhnavno galitsode ahesdi, tlesdi nvdayutloasvgi uwidvdiyi; ale gilo tlogesi wiedohesdi, tlesdi nasquo nvdayutsvsvgi.
english: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᎶᏛ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Etsanvdada Lodv udalii.
english: Remember Lot's wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏅ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo uwasv gvnv usdelvdiyi uyohesdi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono uyohusehesdi, nasgi usdelvdi gesesdi.
english: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ ᏓᏂᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itseyoseha, nahiyu svnoyi gesesdi anitali saquo atsesdogihi daninvgesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
english: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anitali anigeyv itsulaha anisdosgesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
english: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏥᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anitali tlogesi anedohesdi; asiyvwi atsiyanvdi gesesdi, soino atsikahiyasdi gesesdi.
english: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎦᏃᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏬᎭᎵ ᎠᎾᏓᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Uninetsvno hia nigvwaweselei, Hatlv, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano niduweselei, Ilvhitlv gohusdi uliwotsvhi tsiganoi, nahna awohali anadatlisisgoi.
english: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Dutlilosdaneleno, hia nusde ugvwalei, nasgi yvwi nigohilv unadadolisdodiyi, ale tsuniyaweisdi nigesvna;
english: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᎮ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏂᏚᏁᎶᏛᎾ;
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Ehe digugodisgi ilvhitlv gaduhvi, nasgi Unelanvhi niganayesgvna, ale yvwi nidunelodvna;
english: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏍᎩᎾᏛᏂᏏ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏱᎵᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Ale uwosulotsvhi nahna gaduhv ehei; nasgino ulutselei, hia nigawesgei, Duyugodv nisginadvnisi tsosdadayilidohi.
english: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏉᏌᏁ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏱᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏁᎶᏗ ᏴᏫ;
phonetic: Aseno uquosane ilvsgi igohidv; onisgini hia niuwese uwasv tsudanvdvi, Tlasgininonv yitsinayesga Unelanvhi, ale vtla yiditsiyanelodi yvwi;
english: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏣᏆᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᏥᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏰᏃ ᎦᎷᎬ ᏱᏓᎩᏯᏪᎢᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno hia uwosulotsvhi tsaquadeyadodiha nvdagalisdotani duyugodv nvdatsiyadvneli, nigohilvyeno galugv yidagiyaweisda.
english: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Itsagasayasda niduyugodvna iyadvnehi digugodisgi nigawesgvi.
english: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᎦᏑᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ ᏥᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏱᏓᏙᎯᏕᎭ?
phonetic: Tlasgono Unelanvhi duyugodv yinidogvdvnisi uwasv tsutseli gegasuyvdv, nasgi digvwagitsvdi tsigvwadadolisdaneha, nasquo gohidiyu yidadohideha?
english: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏙᏓᎫᎴᏏ.  ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏒ ᏛᏩᏛᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ?
phonetic: Itsvyoseha tlegiyu dodagulesi.  Aseno, yvwi Uwetsi galutsvha, gohiyudisgo gesv dvwadvhi elohi?
english: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎸᎯ, ᎤᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏗᏂᏰᎸᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano dutlilosdanele gilo iyunasdi unvsv anadalvquodisgi, nanisganvna unatselvhi, uwanadaleno nvlisali diniyelvsgi.
english: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Anitali anisgaya udvnadigalawiisdiyi unadadolistanvsei, asiyvwi Aqualisi gesei, soino adelvagisidohi.
english: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
author: Cherokee New Testament
