syllabary: ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎴᏁ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᎾᏓᎩᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aqualisi ulene uwasv gesvi udadolistane hia nuwesei; Tsanelanvhi gvyalielitseha anisoi yvwi nunasdvi nasgi naquasdvna tsigi, nasgi asequo anadagiehi tsigi, ale niduyugodvna iyanadvnehi, ale dinadayonehi, ale nasquo hia adelvagisidohi nasgi nusdv naquasdvna tsigi.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎠᎹᏟ ᏂᎬᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᎾᎥ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏥᎥᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Sunadodaquasdi gesv tali amatli nigvsgoi; ale nigav aginav asgohine gotsaledv tsivsgoi.
english: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏕᎸᏃ-ᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏅ ᏧᎴᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏗᎬᏩᎧᏃᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎦᏁᏥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏂᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Adelvnoagisidohi inv tsulenei, vtla yeli galvladi widigvwakanodi yigesei, ganetsiquosgini uwanilei, hia nuwesei; Tsanelanvhi, sgidoligi tsisganai.
english: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎥᏝ.  ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎠᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsvyoseha, hia nasgi asgaya ududaledv tsuwenvsv wulosei, soino vtla.  Giloyeno uwasv iadasaladisgesdi eladi iyagvnedi gesesdi, gilono uwasv eladi niadadvnehesdi atsisaladodi gesesdi.
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏚᏂᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo degvwatinohele tsunasdi diniyoli, nasgi tsusitadisdiyi; aseno gvwasdawadidohi unadolehosv dunigvsgolvnei.
english: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano widuyanvhv hia nuwesei, Unanelagi ditselisi diniyoli gvgilutsediyi, ale tlesdi ditsinvsdadelvgi; nasgiyeno nunasdi nahna unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏥᏓᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gilo Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv nidadanilvgvna igesesdi nasgiya ayoli tsidadanilvgoi, vtla nahna uyvsdi yigesesdi.
english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏯᏆᏛᏁᎸ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏱᏥᏩᏛ?
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi nugvwiyusadegi udvdvne, hia nuwesei, Hosdv Tadeyohvsgi, gado yaquadvnelv winasdvna gvnidv yitsiwadv?
english: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎰᏍᏛ ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Gadono hosdv isquoseha?  Vtla gilo osdv yigi saquo uwasvhiyu, nasgi Unelanvhi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎯᎦᏔᎭᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᏕᎩᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ.
phonetic: Dehigatahaquo dikahnawadvsdi, Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi, Tlesdi tsadalvgi, tlesdi tsanosgisvgi, Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi, Degilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi.
english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᎩᎧᎾᏩᏕᏅ ᏥᏧᏣ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴ ᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Hia nasgi nigadv dagikanawadenv tsitsutsa gesv nvdagvwadale nvdv.
english: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏏ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏣᎷᎳ; ᎯᎾᏚᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏣᎾᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᏯᏙᎯᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᏖᏒᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano nasgi hia udvganv, hia nuweselei, Asi sudalegi tsalula; hinaduga nigadv tsanavi, ale tiyadohisi uyo iyunadvhnadegi, galvladino witsahesdi tsugvwalodi; tesvno sgisdawadesvha.
english: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia udvganv utsati uyo uyelvnei; utsatiyeno uwehnaiyu gesei.
english: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ!
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv utsati uyo uyelvsvi, hia nuwesei, Nigav asdayiyu tsunehnai Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi digesv wuniyvsdiyi!
english: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᎻᎵ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎩ ᎦᏌᏁᎾᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utliyeno ahidiyu gemili ugadvlehisdiyi yvgi gasanenadvdiyi ano uwehnai yvwi wuyvsdiyi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi digesvi.
english: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏥᏍᏕᎸ?
phonetic: Unadvganvhino hia nuniwesei, Gagono yeli yatsisdelv?
english: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Nasgi yvwi yeli igvwanadvnedi nigesvna tsigi, yeliquo igvwadvnedi Unelanvhi.
english: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᎩᏲᏐᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida hia niuwesei, Gvniyuquo ayv nigadiyu dogiyosonv, ale itsvsdawadenv.
english: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏮᏕᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Vtla gilo tsuwvdetsvhi yigi ganelvi, ale tsugayvligei, ale analinvtli, ale udalii, ale tsuwetsi, nvdayulisdotanvhi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi,
english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏐᎢᏱᏃ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi atsinedi nigesvna gesv utsati iyuwagudi gohi gesvi, soiyino digesv gvnidv winasdvna.
english: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏗᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏃᏪᎸ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taladu iyanidv iyvdv widutinvstanei, ale hia niduweselei, Gvniyuquo Tsilusilimi widigati, ale nigav dunowelv anadolehosgi yvwi Uwetsi atsinohesgv nasgi iyulisdodi gesesdi.
english: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏰᎦᏕᎰᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏰᎦᎵᏥᏍᏈ,
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dodagetsiyohiseli, ale dayegadehotani, ale dagayetsisotlvtani, ale dodayegalitsisqui,
english: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵ; ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᎯᏌᏂ.
phonetic: Ale dagvwalivnili, ale dagvwali; tsoineno iga dodvalehisani.
english: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎨᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nasgi vtla yunolitsei; ale nasgi hia nuwesv gegvsgalanelei, ale vtla yanigatahe iyusdi gadvgv nasgi unetsvi.
english: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎵᎪ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎠᏚᎳᏗᏍᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Ale hia nulistanei, nasgi Tseligo nav ulutsv, gilo iyusdi digewi nvnohulodi uwole aduladisgei;
english: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Udvganvno unitsati anilosgv udvdvne nasgi uyelvdvi.
english: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎴᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎶᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwanoneleno nasgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi galosgvi.
english: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᎷᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏥᏌ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Uweluneno hia nuwesei, Tsisa, Dewi uwetsi, sgidoligi.
english: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎬᏩᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ, ᎡᎳᏪ ᎲᎾ ᎬᏬᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ; ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ, ᎠᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyino anegi gvwagvsgolvnei, elawe hvna gvwoselei; aseno utliquo igai uwelunei; Dewi Uwetsi sgidoligi, adisgei.
english: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᏗᏱ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisano ulewistanv unetse agatinohediyi; hnaquono nav ulutsv udvdvnei,
english: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵ ᎬᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Gado tsaduli gvyadvnediyi?  Hiano nuwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, vagigowadvdiyi aquaduliha.
english: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎨᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Getsagowadvdi winigalisda; tsohiyusv tsasdelv.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nulistanei, ale usdawadvse galvquodisge Unelanvhi; nigadvno yvwi unigohv unilvquotane Unelanvhi.
english: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏴᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏎ ᏤᎵᎪ.
phonetic: Tsisano uyvle ale ulose Tseligo.
english: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᎮ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏌᎩᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏕᎸᎠᎩᏏᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo ehe asgaya Sagiya tsudoidv, nasgi nugvwiyusv gese adelvagisidohi, ale uwehnaiyu gesei.
english: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏄᎸᏁ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uyole Tsisa ugowadvdiyi, nasgi nusdvi; aseno unulvne nvdigalisdodisge unitsati gesvi, usdigiyuyeno gesei.
english: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᏭᏗᏢᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎸᏎ ᎫᏩᏧᏁᎬ ᏡᎬ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyino wuditlvstanv ulvse guwatsunegv tlugv ugowadvdiyi udulisgei; nahnayeno iditlv wulohisdi gesei.
english: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎷᏨ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏌᎩᏯ, ᏞᎩᏳ ᎡᎭᏠᎠᎯ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏘᏁᎸ ᏫᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano nahna ulutsv, galvladi widukahnanei, ale ugohei, ale hia nuweselei, Sagiya, tlegiyu ehatloahi; gohiyeno iga tsigi tinelv wigedohesdi.
english: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏅᏤᏃ ᏗᎤᏠᎠᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Uwanvtseno diutloasei, ale ulihelitsvhi dudanilvtsei.
english: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏩᏴᏢ ᏮᏛᏒᏎᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Unigohvno nasgi nigadv unisonvtselei, hia nuniwesei, Wayvtlv wvdvsvseli asgaya asganai.
english: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᎩᏯᏃ ᎤᎴᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎩᎲ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏕᏥᎥᏏ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎩᎡᎸ, ᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏥᎥᏏ.
phonetic: Sagiyano ulene hia nuwesele Ugvwiyuhi, Gvniyuquo, Tsagvwiyuhi, ayeli igai tsugvwalodi agihv uyo iyunadvhnadegi detsivsi; iyu ale gayegogi aquvtanvhi yigi gilo gohusdi yitsigielv, nvgi iyuwagudi igai tsivsi.
english: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎷᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Gohi iga alisdelvdodi gesv galugi ani adanelvi, nvdigalisdodi nasgi nasquo Equahami uwetsi gesvi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏚᏲᎵᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno Uwetsi duyolilv ale dusdelvhilv unalenalvhi tsigesvgi.
english: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏁᏉᎡ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏥᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia unadvganv unequoe dutlilosdanelei, nvdigalisdodisge Tsilusilimi nav ulutsidisvi, ale nvdigalisdodisge Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv igvwenvdv dagananugotsi anelisgvi.
english: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎤᎸᏒᏎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nuwesei, Gilo iyusdi asgayegvsda ilvhitlv inv wulosei, ulvsvse ugvwiyuhi iyagvnediyi ale vuluhisdiyi.
english: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ [ᎠᏕᎸ,] ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎢᏥᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Widuyanvheno asgohi iyanidv tsunvsidasdi, ale deuyohisele asgohi iyudagedv [adelv,] hia niduweselei, Gohusdi detsvdisgesdi gvni itsilutsvha.
english: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎬᏩᏂᏆᏘᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᎬᏩᎨᎮᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᎦᏚᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno tsutseli yvwi igvwaniquatilei, ale duninvse gvwagehegi, hia winaniwesgei, Vtla yogaduli hia asgaya ugvwiyuhi ogatseli iyulisdodiyi.
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎢᎤᎷᏥᎸ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎨᏅᏛᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏤᎸ ᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, iulutsilv, ugvwiyuhi iyagvnelvhi gesei, unetse nasgi getsinvsidasdi wigetsiyanvdiyi gvwalutsediyi, nasgi na adelv tsugenvdvhi, nasgi udolehohisdiyi igai anisiyvwi uninequotselv aninodisgvi.
english: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏣᏤᎵ ᏑᏓᎨᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᎤᏁᏉᏨ.
phonetic: Igvyino ulutsvhi, hia nuwesei, Sginatlai, tsatseli sudagedv asgohi iyudagedv unequotsv.
english: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᎤᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏕᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuweselei, Osiyu, hosdv etsanvsidasdi; usdi gesv osiyu nitsadvnelv; tsagvwiyusadegi gesesdi asgohi degaduhvi.
english: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏣᏤᎵ ᏑᏓᎨᏛ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᎤᏁᏉᏨ.
phonetic: Talineno ulutsvhi, hia nuwesei, Sginatlai, tsatseli sudagedv hisgi iyudagedv unequotsv.
english: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino nasquo hia nuweselei, nihi nasquo hisgi igadugi tsagvwiyusadegi gesesdi.
english: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂ ᏣᏤᎵ ᏑᏓᎨᏛ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎩ ᎠᎩᏣᏄᎸᎩ ᎠᏯᏠᎩᎯ;
phonetic: Nvwadaleno ulutsei, hia nuwesei, Sginatlai, gvniyuquo ani tsatseli sudagedv, agisquanigodvgi agitsanulvgi ayatlogihi;
english: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎾᏰᏍᎬᏰᏃ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᎦᏯ; ᎯᎩᏍᎪᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏫᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnayesgvyeno, nvdagalisdodisgvgi hisdayiyu gesv hisgaya; higisgoyeno nasgi nitsanvna gesvi, ale hisgudesgo nasgi nitsawisvna gesvi.
english: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏪᏒ ᏓᎬᏔᏂ ᏙᏓᎬᏳᎪᏓᏁᎵ ᏣᏲ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᏥᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᎩᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei, Tsvsv nitsawesv dagvtani dodagvyugodaneli tsayo etsanvsidasdi.  Higatahvgi tsisdayiyu gesvi, tsigisgv nasgi aginvhi nigesvna gesvi, ale tsisgudesgv nasgi agiwisvhi nigesvna gesvi;
english: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᏫᏙᏣᏁ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏕᏄ, ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸᏃ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᏱᏓᎩᎩᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono tla disquanigododiyi yiwidotsane diquatseli adenu, agilutsilvno diquatseli ale uninequotsvhi yidagigisei.
english: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎡᏥᎩᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏑᏓᎨᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᏧᎯ ᎡᏥᎥᏏ^
phonetic: Hiano niduwesele nav anidonai, Etsigisi nasgi na sudagedv, ale asgohi iyudagedv tsuhi etsivsi^
english: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏗᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᏕᎤᎭ^
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei, Disginatlai, asgohi iyudagedv deuha^
english: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎯ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏄᏂᎲᎾᏃ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎨᏥᎩᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha, Nasgi naniv unihi getsinedi gesesdi; nunihvnano tsigi, nasgi nasquo unihv getsigiedi gesesdi.
english: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎬᎩᏍᎦᎩ, ᏄᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎡᏗᏣᏘᏄᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎷᎦ ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ
phonetic: Nano gvgisgagi, nunadulisgvna tsigesv agigvwiyuhi iyaqualisdodiyi anehvi, editsatinuga, ale ditsiluga tsigatahvi
english: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᏥᏌᏃ] ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏪᏅᎭ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏩᎦᏖᎢ.
phonetic: [Tsisano] nasgi nuwesv, igvyi uwenvha uhnaluse Tsilusilimi wagatei.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎸᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏒᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎵᏩᏲᎯ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᏥᏚᏙᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Hiano lvlistane nav ulutsv Svgadohi ale Quediniyi, nahna Oliwayohi usahilv tsidudoa, nasgi anitali gvwasdawadidohi dunvsei,
english: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᎢᏢ Ꮎ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᏍᏗᎷᏨᎭ ᏓᏰᏍᏗᏩᏛᎯ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎨᎵᏌᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎩᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕᏒᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏍᏓᏘᏁᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Isdena itlv na tsvdigaduha, nahnano wisdilutsvha dayesdiwadvhi agina gelisadesdi, nasgi vtla asi gilo ugilvtanvhi yigi; esdelisadesvha ale tsesdatinesvha.
english: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏍᏓᏛᏛᏅ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕᎭ?  ᎢᏍᏙᏎᎸᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᎾ ᎤᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo isdadvdvnv Gadono iesdelisadeha?  Isdoselvha, hia nesdiweselvha; Ugvwiyuhiyena uduliha.
english: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Getsinvsvhino unenvse ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya niduweselvi.
english: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏁᎵᏌᏕᏍᎨᏃ ᎠᎩᎾ, ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏍᏕᎵᏌᏕ ᎠᎩᎾ?
phonetic: Anelisadesgeno agina, uninatlai hia nigvwaniweselei, Gadono iesdelisade agina?
english: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei, Ugvwiyuhi uduliha.
english: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ; ᏧᎾᏄᏬᏃ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎦᏐᎯ ᏚᏂᏢᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᎩᎸᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Tsisano unatinohelei; tsunanuwono agina gasohi dunitlvnei, ale nahna unagilvtane Tsisa.
english: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎢᏒᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᏚᏂᏰᏍᏛᏁ ᏅᏃᎯ.
phonetic: Aisvno tsunanuwo duniyesdvne nvnohi.
english: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎦᏐᎠᏍᎬ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᎵᏩᏲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏂᏁᎨᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Navno wulutsv, nahna agasoasgv iyvdv Oliwayo usahilvi, nigadv unitsati gesv anadasdawadidohi unalenvhe analihelige ale anilvquodisge Unelanvhi asdaya aninegei, nvdigalisdodisge nigadv usquanigodi degalvwisdanelv unigohvi;
english: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ. ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏚᏙᏍᏛ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ!
phonetic: Hia naniwesgei. Galvquodiyu gesesdi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Yihowa dudosdv tsigaluhisdiha; Galvladi nvwadohiyadv gesesdi, ale galvquodiyu gesesdi wasdv galvladiyu gesvi!
english: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏘᏅᏍᏓᏗᏏ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Igadvno Aniqualisi nahna unitsati nunadvnv hia nvdigvwaweselei, Tadeyohvsgi, tinvsdadisi getsasdawadidohi.
english: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᏳᏅᏅ, ᏅᏯ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏯᏁᎷᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselei, hia nitsvweseha, Iyuno hia elaweyi yunvnv, nvya gilaquo iyvdv yaneluhvga.
english: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎤᏍᎪᏂᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Navno ulutsv, dukahnanv gaduhvi, usgonilei,
english: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎯᎦᏔᎮᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏣᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ!  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏨᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, iyuno nihi yihigatahei, vv, nihi, gohi nasquo nasgi hia tsatseli iga gesvi, nasgi nvwadohiyadv tsanehi gesvi!  aseno hnaquo etsvsgalanelv.
english: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏣᎵᏰᎢᎶᎮᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏛᏁᎵᏍᎦᎸᎯ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎨᏣᏚᏫᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏘᏓᏂ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏚᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno gesv datsaliyeiloheli, nasgi getsasgagi gesv dodvnelisgalvhi gvwaduwidv, ale dodagetsaduwistani, ale nvgatidani getsalisdudesdi.
english: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᎨᏣᏡᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏥ ᎬᏂᏯᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏣᎯᏰᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᏳ ᎡᏣᏩᏛᎯᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gadohi dagetsatluni, ale ditsetsi gvniyai gesesdi; ale vtla getsahiyedi yigesesdi saquo nvya yidudasatlahesdi; nvdigalisdodiha nigatahvna tsigesv iyu etsawadvhihisdi gesvi.
english: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏴᎸᏃ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᎥᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Wuyvlvno udvnadigalawiisdiyi, ulenvhe dunugowise nahna aninodisgi, ale uniwasvvsgi;
english: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᏥᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏚᏙᎠ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏓᎦᎸ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselei, Hia nigvnv gowela, Tsinelv adadolisdodiyi adanelv dudoa, aseno nihi aninosgisgi uniyvsdiyi usdagalv nitsvnelv.
english: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᏃ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏫ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nidugitsvnisvno dadeyohvsge udvnadigalawiisdiyi.  Aseno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi ale nunigvwiyusv awi unanelotane gvwahisdiyi.
english: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᏤ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ; ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏝᏫᏍᏗᏕᎨ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale unatlotse iyunadvnediyi; nigadvyeno yvwi gvwatlawisdidege gvwadvdasdanediyi.
english: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏃᎴᎢ, ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏎ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ,
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, nasgi saquo iga nahiyu gesv, degeyohvsge yvwi udvnadigalawiisdiyi, osdv kanohedv alitsidohvsgei, nasgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale dinowelisgi gvwanolei, unaligose dinilawigi,
english: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Ale gvwalinohetane, hia nuniwesei, Sginohvsi, gado tsalisgasdodi hia nasgi tsinusdi tsidetsalvwisdaneha?  Ale gago nasgi na tsanelvhi nasgi itsadvnediyi?
english: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ;
phonetic: Unetsvno hia niduweselei, Ayv nasquo sudalegi datsvyadvdvni; ale sginohvsi;
english: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉᎨ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsani tsudawosdi gesvi, galvladisgo tsudalenei, yvwiquoge anehvi.
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏃᎩᏪᏏ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Dotsunadanvdvno unadanvtele hia naniwesgei, Iyuno galvladi, yogadvnv, hia yinogiwesi, Gadono tla yietsoiyunei?
english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏲᎦᏛᏅ, ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏴᏫ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎪᎬᏂᏍᏓ; ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏁᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno Yvwiquo anehvi, yogadvnv, nigadvquo yvwi nvya yidegogvnisda; Tsaniyeno adolehosgi gesvgi, aneliha.
english: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Uninetsvno, Vtla yotsigataha tsudalenvi, unadvnei.
english: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏴᎨᏨᏃᎲᏏ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselei, Vtla nasquo ayv yvgetsvnohvsi iyusdi gesv aqualisgasdodv hia nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏫᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎳᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏭᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎪᎯᏛ ᏭᏪᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo ulenvhe nasgi hia dutlilosdanele yvwi; Gilo iyusdi asgaya telvladi duwisei, ale dudolastane tlogesi wunilvwisdanehi, ale inv wulose gohidv wuwedolei.
english: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎤᏅᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏅᎯ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᎠᏒᎭ ᎤᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno unvnisdiyi gesv unvsidasdi unvse tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi dinehvi, nasgi nidodagvwanvnediyi unadadvnvhi telvladi dawisvi; aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unilivnilv asvha unigehidolei.
english: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏎ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏅ, ᎠᏒᎭ ᎤᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale taline nvwadale unvse unvsidasdi gagvwanisotlvtanv, asvha unigehidolei.
english: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᏅᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏅ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Alewo tsoine unvsei; nasgino nasquo unisonvnv uninugowisei.
english: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ?  ᎠᏇᏥ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏓᏥᏅᏏ; ᏯᏂᎸᏉᏓ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono telvladi dawisv utseliga, hia nuwesei, Gado dagadvneli?  Aquetsi tsigeyui datsinvsi; yanilvquoda yigi nasgi anigohvha.
english: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, Ꭷ, ᎡᏗᎷᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi unigohv, unvsv gesv unalinohele hia nidunadaweselei, Hia nasgi utiyedi tsigi tsugvwalodi, Ka, ediluga, nasgino tsugvwalodi utiyasdanedi gesv igatseli yinigalisda.
english: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Howano uninugowisv telvladi dawisvi, unilei.  Nasgi iyusdi nasgi na telvladi dawisv utseliga gado dodagvneli nasgi?
english: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏏ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏙᏛᏁᎵ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏫᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Dagalutsi ale dodvdvtani nasgi na tlogesi tsunilvwisdanehi, ale nvwanadale dodvneli telvladi dawisvi.  Nasgino unadvganelv, Vtlesdi, unadvnei.
english: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ?
phonetic: Dukahnanvno, hia nuwesei, Gadono nasgi hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nvya nasgi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nulistanv?
english: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏢᏨᎭ ᏓᏳᏐᏅᏂ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅᎭ ᏓᏳᏪᏓᏬᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Gilo nasgi nahna nvyohi atlvtsvha dayusonvni; gilono nasgi usonvha dayuwedawotani.
english: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᎦᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏥᏛᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi nahiyuquo unanelotane uniniyvdiyi, aseno dunisgale yvwi; unadolehoseyeno nasgi hia dutlilostanv unvsv getsidvgvi.
english: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏧᏂᏅᏎ ᎠᎾᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏣᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎢᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Gvwagasayasdeno, ale dotsuninvse anadagasayasdisgi, nasgi unadanvti unatsalvdiyi nasgi gvwagonelohisediyi gawonisgvi, nasgino widuniyohisediyi uyeilidasdiyi ugvwiyuhi.
english: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏘᎸᏉᏙᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, otsigataha hiwonisgv ale dehadeyohvsgv duyugodv gesei, ale nitilvquododvna gesv nunasdv yvwi, Unelanvhisgini utseli ganvnv udohiyuhiya dehadeyohvsgvi;
english: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᏏᏌ ᎡᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏝᎨ?
phonetic: Duyugodisgo Sisa edaguyvediyi ayeli aguyvdi gesvi, tlage?
english: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏎ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏍᎩᏌᏛᎥᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Aseno udolehose anisinasanvgvi, ale hia niduweselei, Gadono isgisadvvsga?
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ.  ᎦᎪ ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ?  ᎤᏂᏁᏤᏃ, ᏏᏌ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Tsigowadv agisi tsugvwalodi.  Gago dagatlilosdi, ale gago atsinoheha hia tsigowela?  Uninetseno, Sisa, unadvnei.
english: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎵᎢ, ᏏᏌ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselii, Sisa adina etsaguyvsi Sisa utseliga, Unelanvhino Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Kanegvno vtla yeli gagvwanigonelohisedi yigese yvwi anigatahvi; unisquanigoseno nuwesv unetsvi, ale elaweyi unvnei.
english: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎾᏓᏱᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi Anisadusi, nasgi tsanadayiha ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi, gvwalutselv gvwadvdvnei,
english: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ,  ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ ᎣᎪᏪᏁᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei,  Tadeyohvsgi, Mosi ogowenelvgi hia nogiweselvgi, Gilo dinadanvtli ayohusgesdi udalii uwekahesdi, ale tsuwetsi nanehvna ayohusgesdi, nasgi dinadanvtli adayegesdi udayvdv, ale dadvhisdanehesdi tsuwetsi dinadanvtli.
english: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ; ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᏕᏒᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgino anehvgi galiquogi iyanidv analinvtli; udaniligeno udesvnvgi, ale uyohusv tsuwetsi nanehvna.
english: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Ale taline wehi nasgi udayvsvgi, ale uyohusv tsuwetsi nanehvna.
english: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏪᎯ ᎤᏓᏴᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale tsoine wehi udayvsvgi; ale nasgiya nasquo galiquogi iyanidv; ale tsunetsi nanehvna duniyohusvgi.
english: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Oniyino ageyv nasquo uyohusvgi.
english: Last of all the woman died also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎸᎭ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏴᏛ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo dilehisodi nigalistanilvha, gago udalii gesesdi nasgi, galiquogiyeno iyanidv unadayvdv igi.
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia niduweselei, Ani elohi anehi danadesvhvsgoi ale degetsiyegoi;
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏐᎢᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini soiyi digesv ale ayohusv dilehisodi gesv yeliquo gvwanateladisdi getsiyelvhi, vtla yidanadesvhvsgoi, vtla ale yidigetsiyegoi.
english: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla ale hnaquo digvwaniyohuhisdi yigesesdi; dinikahnawadidohisgini galvladi anehi nunasdv nasgiya nunasdesdi; ale Unelanvhi tsuwetsi nasgi, ayohusv dilehisodi gesv tsuwetsi gesv iyusdi.
english: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏱᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏧᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nano tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi gesv, Yisi gvnigesv nuwanele uweyodadvi, nahiyu Yihowa Unelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga, tsuwoselei.
english: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏍᎩᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla tsuniyohusvhi unatseliga yigi, dinvnodvsgini; nasgiyeno adanvtesgv nigadiyu dinvnodv.
english: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gilo iyunasdi dinowelisgi uninetse hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, yeligaya niwi.
english: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv anisgaihe gohusdi gvwadvdvdiyi.
english: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎾᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, gado digalisdodiha Galonedv Dewi uwetsi tsanadiha?
english: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Dewino uwasv hia nigaweha Dikanogisdiyi goweli, Yihowa hia nuwesele Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga, Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi,
english: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha.
english: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᏎᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᎩ?
phonetic: Dewiyeno Tsagvwiyuhi goseha; gadono digalisdodiha uwetsi igi?
english: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv yvwi unadvdasdv, hia niduwesele gvwasdawadidohi,
english: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎾᏢᏗᏱ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Detseyadotsehesdi dinowelisgi, nasgi tsunadulisgo diganvhidv tsunanuwai unedasdiyi, ale osiyu tsuniyelvha getsiyolisdiyi diganododiyi, ale nugvwiyusv degasgilv digalawiisdiyi, ale nugvwiyusv dinatlvdiyi danalisdayvhvsgvi;
english: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏒᏁᎰ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᏣᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsidanisvneho tsunosulotsvhi daninelvi, ale unatlonasdv gohidiyu tsanadadolisdisgoi; nasgi utlihiyu igai unigiliyoisdi gesesdi.
english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏂᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Dukahnanvno dugohe tsunehnai anihvsge adelvdidiyi unalisgolvtanvhi.
english: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎪᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎲᏍᎨ ᏔᎵ ᎠᎩᏄᏛᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏅᏖᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo ugohe gilo iyusdi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi nahna ahvsge tali aginudvdi iyadanvtedi.
english: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎲᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya itsvyoseha, hia nasgi uyo iyudvhnadegi uwosulotsvhi utli igai ahvga esgaquo nigadv anisoi.
english: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎤᏃᏣᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎲᎠᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigadv utsati unihv unotsaledv anihvga Unelanvhi alisgolvdanedi gesvi; hiasgini uyo iyudvhnadegi gesv nigadiyu ulisdelvdodi uhvahvga.
english: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᏅᏯ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Igadvno unineistanv udvnadigalawiisdiyi, nigav goduisdv gvtanvnvya tsuwoduhi ale dilisgolvtanvhi, hia nuwesei;
english: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏚᏓᏌᏝᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎲᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi tsidetsigowadiha, dvsqualvhi, nasgi vtla saquounv nvya yidudasatlahesdi nasgi nigohvtanvna yigesesdi.
english: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎢᎳᎪᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ?
phonetic: Gvwadvdvneno hia nuniwesei, Tadeyohvsgi, ilagono iyu hia nasgi nvdagalistani?  Ale gado usdi uyelvdv gesesdi nahiyu hia nasgi tsudalenvdv aliyeilolvha?
english: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᎡᏥᎶᎾᏍᏔᏂ; ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei, Itseyatahesdi tlesdi tsietsilonastani; unitsatesdiyeno ayv daquadov aniluhisdisgesdi, Ayv [Galonedv] anadisgesdi, ale hnaquo usqualvhidi; nasgi iyusdi tlesdi ditsisdawadvsvgi.
english: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏅᏩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦ-ᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno itsadvgisgesdi danvwa ale tsudalenvdv nigalistanidohvi, tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi; hiayeno nasgi ase igvyi iyulisdodi, vtlasgini igvwenvdvquo ulisquadisdi yigesesdi.
english: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏚᏙᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᏙᏛᎾᏓᏡᏔᏂ;
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Tsunadalenvdv yvwi dodvnaleni dodvnadatlutani, ale ayeli dudotlvwadisv dodvnadatlutani;
english: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎵᏖᎸᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᏄᎶᏏᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏳᎩᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gadohi utsati dalitelvnidohesdi, ale dagonulosidohesdi; ale vyugihiyu nigalistanidohesdi; ale unayehisdiyu ale usquanigodi uyelvdv gananugogesdi galvloi.
english: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏂᏴᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ, ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏗᏃᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏚᏃᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno asi nasgi hia nigadv nulistanvna gesesdi dodagetsiniyvhi ale uyo nvdagetsvneli, degetsiyosgesdi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale didasdudiyi, ale detsadinohihesdi unigvwiyuhi ale nunigvwiyusadegi dunolv igvyiditlv ayv daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕ ᎸᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi kanohesgi itsalisde lvdodi nigalisdisgesdi.
english: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏧᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏓᎷᎴᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎯᏐᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi niditsugodesdi detsadanvdvi asiquo udalulesdi, itsadanvtehisodiyi nigesvna itsiwesdiyi itsalisdelisgvi.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᏈᏗᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏎᎷᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno datsvneli itsiwesdiyi ale agadovhisdi gesv nasgi nigadv getsaquidisgi yeli digvwanigatilvsdi ale gvwaniselugisdi nigesvna gesesdi.
english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏛᎿᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale degetsiyosgesdi ditsigayvligei, ale itsalinvtli, ale gohusdi ditsadadvhna, ale ditsalii; ale nasgi nvdvnvnisani gilo nihi tsetsiisdi gesesdi.
english: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nigadiyu yvwi getsisgagi gesesdi yvwi daquadov nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᎢᏥᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla saquounv itsisdiyegv itsisgoli uyohuhisdi yigesesdi.
english: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
phonetic: Ditsvnidiyu gesv detsisdelvdodisgesdi ditsadanvdogi.
english: In your patience possess ye your souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimino itsigowatisgesdi aniyawisgi hnaquo dunaduwisdesdi, itsigatahesdi nasgi uyoisdi gesv usqualvhidisvi.
english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏒᎭ ᎣᏓᎵ ᏩᏂᎶᏒᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏄᎪᏨᎭ; ᎢᏴᏛᏃ ᏭᏩᎫᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏳᏂᏴᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquo nasgi Tsudiyi anehi analisvha odali wanilosvha; ale nasgi ayeli gesv anedohi aninugotsvha; iyvdvno wuwagudv dinehi tlesdi nahna yuniyvlesdi.
english: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏞᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utlegiyeno nahiyu gesv uliyilohisdi gesesdi, nasgi nigadiyu gowelanvhi gesv nasgi iyulisdodiyi.
english: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᏁᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᎢ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ!  ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Dininelidvsgini ale tsunisdai uyoiyu iyunalisdanedi gesesdi nahiyu gesvi!  utsatiyeno agiliya ehesdi ani gadohi, ale utalawohisdi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi hia yvwi.
english: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏃ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᏘᏅᏍᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏍᏆᏛᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎦᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayelasdinoganvhidv tsuninvisdodi gesesdi, ale digetsiyvginvhi Tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisv widigegatinvsdvdi gesesdi; Tsilusilimino Tsunadalenvdv yvwi unalasdaedi gesesdi, gvni asquadvha tsunadalenvdv yvwi gegadanelanelvhi gesvi.
english: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏰᎸᏛᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎧᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎧᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎠᏂᎧᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ; ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎤᏍᏆᏃᏴᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Uyelvdvno agowadvdi gesesdi nvdo iga ehi kalvi, ale nvdo svnoyi ehi kalvi, ale noquisi anikalvi; ale elohi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv uwelihisdi, ale udeyadodi nvdayunalisdaneli; amequohi ale ama dalisdilanegv usquanoyvgesdi;
english: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᎸᏕᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏖᏃᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏛᎾᎵᏖᎸᏂ.
phonetic: Yvwi dunadanvdv dulvdehihesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi aninayesgv ale anigatenohv nasgi tsudalenvdv elanigv unanugoisdi gesvi; unitsatiyeno galvlo tsanikala dvnalitelvni.
english: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏅᏧᏛᎿᎭᏗᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dvnigohi yvwi Uwetsi tsaisesdi ulogilvi ulinigidv ale utsati galvquodi nvtsudvhnadisesdi.
english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴᏅᎲᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏗᏣᎧᎾᏅᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ ᏗᏥᏍᎪᎵ; ᎡᏧᏓᎴᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsudalenvdv alenvhvha nasgi nigalisdisgesdi, hnaquo galvladi widitsakananvha, ale detsisaladanvha ditsisgoli; etsudalesdiyeno gesv navniyu tsaisesdi.
english: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏤᏃ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ; ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᎡᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Unetseno dutlilosdanelei; Ditsakanvga egataiyusdi tlugvi, ale nigav detlugvi;
english: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎩᎳ ᏥᎦᎳᏍᏚᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎢᏨᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎰᎪᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo gila tsigalasduhvsgoi, nasgi itsigowadv itsvsvquo gesv itsigatahogogi hnaquo navniyu gesvi.
english: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv nigalisdisgv itsigowatisgesdi, itsigatahesdi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv navniyu gesvi.
english: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ ᎬᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Gohi tsaneha vtla yvdvnilosoni gvni nasgi hia nigadiyu nigalistanvha.
english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᏂᎶᏐᏂ; ᎠᎩᏁᏨᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
phonetic: Galvloi ale elohi dvnilosoni; aginetsvsgini vtla yvdagalosoni.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏤᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale itsadagasayasdesdi itsvsv gesvi, tlesdi ilvhiyu detsadanvdv gagedv yinitsalisdanehesdi yinvdigalisdodisgesdi itsilosvsdisgv itsalisdayvhvsgvi, ale detsiyvsdesgvi, ale elohi adanvtedi gesvi, nasgino nahiyu iga nitselisgvna itsilutsediyi.
english: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏌᏙᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᏂᎷᏤᎵ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Tsasadoyeno igagadv dayunilutseli nigvnadv dinehi.
english: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏗᏫᏎᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏤ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎬᏩᎾᎴᏗ ᎦᏰᏤᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi nigohilvi, itsadadolisdisgesdi, nasgino yeliquo hia nigadv tsudalenvdv uliyeilohisdi tsigi gvwanadiwisedi, ale yvwi Uwetse uwolv igvyiditlv gvwanaledi gayetselisedi yinigalisda.
english: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏛᎾᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏒᏃ ᎦᏄᎪᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎵᏩᏲᎯ ᏣᏃᏎᎰ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏒᎯᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Igano gesv dadeyohvsge udvnadigalawiisdiyi; usvno ganugogei, ale Oliwayohi tsanoseho odalv usvhihei.
english: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi sunaleiyu gvwalutsehe udvnadigalawiisdiyi gvwadvdasdanediyi.
english: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾᏃ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏙᎠ.
phonetic: Nagotanvnano gadu agisdiyi usqualvhidisei, nasgi Kanohiyeno dilisdayvdiyi tsidudoa.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎴ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi uniyole iyunvnediyi unihisdiyi; danisgaiheyeno yvwi.
english: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏴᏎᎴ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sedani uyvsele Tsudasi Isgaladi tsudoidv, nasgi gela gese taladu iyanidv gesvi.
english: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏅᏎᏃ ᏫᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ [ᏥᏌ] ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uwenvseno widulinohetane nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinadaniyisgi, iyuwanediyi [Tsisa] tsuyohisediyi.
english: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unalihelitseno, ale gvwanetsele adelv digvwanediyi.
english: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎴ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Uduistaneno, ale uyole tsuyohisediyi, nahiyu unigonelv unitsati.
english: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎮ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono usqualvhe nagotanvna gesv gadu agisdiyi, nasgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi ahisdi gesvi.
english: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᏥᏌᏃ] ᏚᏅᏎ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏍᏕᎾ ᏫᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: [Tsisano] dunvse Quida ale Tsani, hia nuwesei, Isdena wisdadvnvisda kanohiyegi, nasgi igalisdayvdiyi.
english: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎩᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei, Hatlv tsaduliha oginadvnvisdodiyi?
english: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏍᏗᏴᎸᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏙᏓᏣᏠᏏ, ᎠᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏟᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎡᏍᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏭᏴᎸᎢ ᏫᏍᏗᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gvniyuquo, gaduhv isdiyvlvha, asgaya dodatsatlosi, ayehesdi atelido ama atlisdesdi; esdisdawadesvha adanelv wuyvlvi wisdilutsvha.
english: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᏣᏪᏎᎭ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?
phonetic: Hiano nesdiweselvha asgaya ganela, Dideyohvsgi hia nvditsaweseha, Hatlv anedohi uniyvsdiyi nahna kanohiyegi itsulaha ogalisdayvdiyi gvgisdawadidohi?
english: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏍᏓᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎤᏛᎾ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ; ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Dasdasehelino udvna galvladi kanvsulv osdv igvnelvhi; nahna isdadvnvistanvha.
english: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unenvseno ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya niduweselvi; unadvnvistaneno kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi.
english: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏏᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Usqualvhvno nahiyu gesvi, unisinei, ale nasquo taladu iyanidv getsinvsidv.
english: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᎩᎩᎵᏲᏨᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Utsati aquadulisgvgi hia kanohiyegi itsulaha igalisdayvdiyi asiquo nagigiliyotsvna.
english: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᎦᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏓ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyoseyeno vtla hnaquo hia nasgi yvgagalisdayvda gvni ulisquadvhi gesesdi unelanvhi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏒᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏙᎦ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ugisvno ulisquidi, ale ulihelitsv, hia nuwesei; Hia itsigi ale itsiyadoga itsvsv gesvi.
english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏁᏅᎯ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha, Vtla yvgagadita telvladi unenvhi gvni Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv aliyeilolvha.
english: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏚᏃ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gaduno ugisei, ale ulihelitsv, ugvhaluyei, ale dunelei, hia nuwesei, Hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi, nasgi nihi etsaguyvtanvhi tsigi, hia nasgi nitsadvnehesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi.
english: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ [ᏅᎩᏎ] ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᏬᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo ulisquidi [nvgise] unalisdayvnonv, hia nuwesei, hia nasgi ulisquidi itse kanohedv datlohisdvi ayv agigigvhi, nasgi nihi itsatsewotselvhi tsigi.
english: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno gvniyuquo nasgi uwoyeni aquatludisgi oginatequaloha ani gasgilvi.
english: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᏰᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ
phonetic: Ale udohiyuhiya ayv Uwetsi dayesi nasgiya dudugotanvi, aseno uyoiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya utludisgi
english: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏛᏛᏁ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᏛᏁᎵᏒ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Unalenvheno dunadadvdvne unvsv gesv, nasgi nvdidvnelisv hia.
english: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ
phonetic: Ale nasquo anadisvhihe nasgi na unvsv gesv utli atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodi gesvi
english: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏁᎶᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏅᏁᎰ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏗᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, unigvwiyuhi tsunadalenvdv yvwi tsunatseliga, digvwananelodvdiyi nanvneho yvwi; ale nasgi digvwananelododi iyanvnehi osdv idinadvnehi gegosehoi.
english: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫᎾᎨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ Ꮎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihisgini vtlesdi nasgi yinitsvnesdi; nasgisgini na nihi nitsadvnv utli iyatsilvquodi; nasgi awinage nasgiya gesesdi; nasgiya na nugvwiyusadegi disdelvhidohi nasgiya gesesdi.
english: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏃ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Gagoyeno utli atsilvquodiyu, alisdayvhvsgi ano adasdelvhidohi?  Tlasgo nasgi na alisdayvhvsgi?  Ayvsgini itsvyeladidoha adasdelvhidohi nasgiyai.
english: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏙᎸᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nihisgini nasgi nitsisuligogvna igedolvhi uyo naqualisdanelidohvi;
english: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ;
phonetic: Ale itsvyalisgolvdaneha itsigvwiyuhi itsalisdodiyi, nasgiya Edoda ayv tsaqualisgolvdanelv;
english: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎩᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsalisdayvdiyi ale itsaditasdiyi agisgilv nahna agigvwiyuhi gesvi, ale itsanvdiyi unigvwiyuhi tsunidiyi degasgilvi, ditsugodanediyi taladu nanilasdalv Isili.
english: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏔᏲᎸ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᎫᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᏣᏅᎫᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei, Sawani, Sawani, gvniyuquo, Sedani utayolv agalisgolvdanediyi itsvgusdodiyi utsalesdi tsanvgusdisgo nasgiyai.
english: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Aseno aquadadolistanv etsasdelvdiyi, nasgi tsohiyusv udalidvdodiyi nigesvna; tsagatahvdvno gesesdi dehalinigohistanvha itsalinvtli.
english: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎬᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Tsagvwiyuhi, aquadvnvisdi gvsdawadvsdiyi nasquo didasdudiyi ale ayohuhisdi gesvi.
english: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ ᎬᏲᏎᎭ ᏈᏓ, ᏣᏔᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏴᎳᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏣᏓᏱᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei gvyoseha Quida, tsataga vtla yvdvyvlasi gohi iga gvni tsoi itsadayilvhi gesesdi ayv sgigatahvi.
english: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᏨᏅᏒᎩ ᏂᏗᏥᏁᎲᎾ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎮᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Tsitsvnvsvgi niditsinehvna adelvdigalodi, ale degalodi, ale dilasulo, gohusdisgo itsinigvsehei?  Vtla gohusdi, unadvnei.
english: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᎦᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᎡᏍᏗ, ᎦᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏄᏩᏴᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎾᏚᎦ ᎤᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏩᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Gohisgini tsigi, gilo adelvdigalodi unaesdi, ganegesdi, ale nasquo degalodi; gilono ayelasdi ganvhidv nuwayvna gesesdi, wiganaduga unuwo ale wuwahi.
english: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭᏰᏃ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏏ ᏛᏙᎯᏳᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏌᏂ; "ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᎦᏎᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ;" ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Itsvyosehayeno, hia nasgi tsigowela ase asi dvdohiyuni ayv nvdagvnisani; "Ale anisgana gegaselvi nasgi agatloyastanvgi;" ayvyeno aginohesgv ase nasgi nvdagalistani.
english: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏂ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei, Tsagvwiyuhi, gvniyuquo, ani tali ayelasdidiganvhidv; hiano nisuweselei, Yeliquo nasgi.
english: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᎣᎵᏩᏲ ᎤᏌᎯᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsunugotsv, uwenvse Oliwayo usahilvi nasgi iyudvnedi gesvi; ale gvwasdawadidohi nasquo gvwasdawadvsei.
english: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏭᎷᏧ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano wulutsu, hia niduweselei, Itsadadolisda udalenasdiyi gesv witsiyvsdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎴᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏫᎬᏗᏅᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏁ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Dudanveleno nvya wigvdinvdi iyvdv ale duliniquane udadolistanei,
english: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏍᎩᎲᏏᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Edoda, iyuno osiyu yitsayelvnv sgihvsiquo hia ulisquidi; aseno vtlesdi ayv gadanvtesgvi, nihisgini hadanvtesgv winigalisda.
english: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnigesvno nudvnele dikahnawadidohi galvladi nvdayulosvhi, ulinigohisdisgei.
english: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵ ᎤᎯᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎩᎬ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᏫᏗᎦᏬᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatino ehisdi udanvte utli iyulinigidv udadolistanei; ale ali uhihv nasgiya gese gigv equohiyu gadohi tsiwidigawogoi.
english: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏙᎤᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎵᎮ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dulenvno adadolisdisgv ale widoulutselv gvwasdawadidohi, duwadvhe danilihe uyo uniyelvsv iyusdi.
english: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏥᎵᎾᎠ?  ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gadono itsilinaa?  Ditsalehvga itsadadolisdi, nasgi udalenasdiyi gesv witsiyvsdiyi nigesvna.
english: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᎾᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏣᎪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎢᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏤᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏔᏪᏙᏂᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Asiquono kanegei, gvniyuquo unitsati, nano Tsudasi tsagosehei, nasgi taladu iyanidv gesv gela, igvyi aise, ale nav ulutsele Tsisa tsutawedonisei,
english: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎯᏯᏔᏬᏙᎲᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᎯᎶᏄᎡᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ?
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Tsudasi, hiyatawodohvsgvsgo hilonuediha yvwi Uwetsi?
english: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᎬᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏙᏓᏲᏥᎷᏯᏍᏔᏂ?
phonetic: Navno anedohi unadolehosv nusdv wigvwaliyeilohisdi gesv, hia nigvwaweselei, Tsagvwiyuhi, ayelasdisgoganvhidv dodayotsiluyastani?
english: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᎷᏰ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎦᎴᏂ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino uluye nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale ulisdestane agatisi galeni.
english: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ  ᎤᏒᏁᎴᏃ ᎦᎴᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏩᏁᎢ
phonetic: Tsisano unetsv hia nuwesei, Unanelagi, nasgiquo igai  Usvneleno galeni ale unvwanei
english: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎯᎸᎯ, ᎢᏥᎷᎩᏍᎪ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓ ᏥᏕᏥᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduwesele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale osdv iyunvhnadegi udvnadigalawiisdiyi, ale dinilawigi, nasgi gvwaniyvhilvhi, Itsilugisgo adanasahvsgi tsetsiyoho nasgiyai, ayelasdidiganvhidv ale ada tsidetsineha?
english: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏑᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᏍᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nisugitsvnisv itsvyeladidohv udvnadigalawiisdiyi, vtla yitsanelotane sginiyvdiyi; aseno itsatseliga gohi tsigi, ale ulisigi ulinigvgvi.
english: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸᎢ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎢᏅ ᎣᏂ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwaniyvhei, ale gvwatinvse ale wigvwayvtane nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi diganelvi.  Quidano inv oni dilisdawadisei.
english: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏅᏅ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᏪᏁ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono udlanvdv ayeli unotanv, ale itsulaha unanvnv, Quida uwene aninvi.
english: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏳᎶᏗ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi adv ugohv atsilvyulodi uwolvi, ale uyanvsvhi dukahnanv, hia nuwesei, Hia asgaya nasquo danedohvgi nasgi.
english: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏓᏱᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno udayile hia nuwesei, Higeyv, vtla yitsigataha nasgi.
english: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏱᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎮᎸ ᎢᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎾᎿᎭᎨᎸ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Gohiyino iyvdv nvwadale ugohv, hia nuwesei, Nihi nasquo nahna helv igi.  Quidano hia nuwesei, Hisgaya, vtla ayv nahna gelv yigi.
english: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏕᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ; ᎨᎵᎵᏰᏃ ᏕᎯ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Onino sutlilodv iyvdv igohidv, nvwadale nasgi udohiyuhi gesv usdayidei, hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhi hia nasquo danedohvgi; Geliliyeno dehi igi.
