english: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎪᎵᎦ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎧᏁᎨᎢ, ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano hia nuwesei; Hisgaya, vtla yigoliga niwesgvi.  Gilaquono iyvdv, asiquo kanegei, tsataga uyvlasei.
english: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁ ᏈᏓ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏅᏓᏕ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᏄᏴᎳᏒᎾ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏦᎢ ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino ugatahvsv dukahnane Quida.  Quidano unvdade unetsv Ugvwiyuhi, hia tsinuweselei; Asiquo nuyvlasvna tsataga tsoi nvdasquadayili.
english: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ
phonetic: Unugotseno Quida, ale ehisdi dutloyilei
english: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏴᎯ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Anisgayano Tsisa digvwaniyvhi gagvwasotlvde ale degvwanihei.
english: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎬᏩᎦᏚᏢᏅᏃ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎮᎢ, ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏥᏨᏂᎦ?
phonetic: Degvwagadutlvnvno ukadv degvwanihei, gvwadvdvhvsge hia naniwesgei, Hadolehohi, gago tsitsvniga?
english: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏎᎮ ᎬᏩᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale utsati asi iyudalegi gohusdi gvwosehe gvwasotlvisdisgvi.
english: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏉᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Igaquono nulistanv dinilawigi yvwi anehv ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi dunilawitsei, ale danilawiv gvwatinole hia nuniwesei;
english: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ?  ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ;
phonetic: Nihisgo galonedv?  Sginohvsi.  Hiano niduweselei, Iyuno yitsvnonelv vtla yvgetsohiyuhvga;
english: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏨᏯᏛᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏍᎩᏲᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo yitsvyadvdvnv vtla yvgesginetsi, ale vtla yidogesgiyohi.
english: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᏂ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhiyu dvsqualvhi yvwi Uwetsi dagani agatisiditlv ulinigidv Unelanvhi uwolvi.
english: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᏂᏥᏫ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nuniwese nigadv, Nihisgo Unelanvhi Uwetsi?  Hiano niduweselei, Yeli nitsiwi, ayvyeno nasgi.
english: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎬᏙᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ?  ᎢᎬᏒᏰᏃ ᎡᏓᏛᎦᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei, Gadono igvdodi asi gohiyudisgi?  Igvsvyeno edadvgasi uwasv kanegvi.
english: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno nasgi unitsati gesv dunalenv Qualedi wigvwatinohelei.
english: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏕᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏍᏓᏕᎲᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏏᏌ ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎧᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Ale unalenvhe gvwuhisdisge hia naniwesgei, Hia nasgi dotsiwadvhvgi dedalenasdisgvgi yvwi, ale dekanvsdadehvgi ayeli adelv Sisa aguyvediyi, hia nikawesgvgi, ayv agigvwiyuhi, Galonedv.
english: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Qualedino udvdvne, hia nuwesei, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?  Unetseleno hia nuwesei, nasgi niwi.
english: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Qualedino hia nigawesele nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale yvwi, Vtla yitsiwati usganvtsv hia asgaya.
english: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏱᏕ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏓᏖᎸᎲᏍᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ, ᏓᏕᏲᏂᏙᎭ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Aseno unisdayide hia naniwesgei, Datelvhvsga hia yvwi, dadeyonidoha Tsudiyi nigvnadvi, Gelili nvdagvwadalenvdv ani iyasti.
english: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏛᏁ, ᎨᎵᎵᏍᎪ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Qualedino udvganv Gelili anineisdisgv udvdvne, Gelilisgo ehi hia asgaya, udvnei.
english: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎶᏛ ᏭᏪᎧᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎡᏙᎮ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Udolehosvquono Elodv ugvwiyuhi gesv nahna edi gesvi, Elodv wuwekanelei, nasgi Elodv uwasv Tsilusilimi edohe nahiyui.
english: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏎ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎪᎯᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏎ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvno ugohv Tsisa, utsati ose uyelvnei; gohidiyuyeno nvwadulisge ugowadvdiyi, nvdigalisdidodisge utsati tsudalenvdv atsinohesgv udvganvi, ale udugi uwase ugowadvdiyi gohusdi usquanigodi dulvwisdanehvi.
english: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᏛᎮᎸᏁᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Udvdvhelvneno utsati tsudalenvdv, aseno vtla yunetselei.
english: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale dinowelisgi danidoge ulinigidv gvwuhisdisgei.
english: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏄᏬᎥ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᏂᎧᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvno ale tsutseli aniyawisgi gagvwasotlvtanei, ale gvwadehotanei, ale digvwalvsadv anuwo uninuwov Qualedi taline wunikanelei.
english: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎢᏕᎢ; ᏗᎾᏓᏍᎦᎩᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno iga Qualedi ale Elodv unaliidei; dinadasgagiyuyeno iyulistanvhi gese nahiyu iyasti.
english: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏚᎳᏫᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ,
phonetic: Qualedino dulawidv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, ale nunigvwiyusadegi, ale unitsati gesv yvwi,
english: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏃᎮᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏩᏘ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏧᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Hia niduweselei, Sgiyatinohelv hia asgaya yvwi dunadanvdv dilenasdisgi nasgiyai; gvniyuquono tsigoliyevhi tsigi itsigatahvi, vtla gohusdi yitsiwati usganvtsv hia asgaya nasgi nusdv etsuisdisgvi;
english: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ; ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᏛᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Elodv ale nasquo vtla; nahnayeno itsenvsdiyi itsvnetselvgi; gvniyuquono vtla gohusdi yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesv yinudvnelv.
english: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎵᎥᏂᎸᎭ ᏓᏥᏯᎧᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tsilivnilvha datsiyakani.
english: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Aseyeno saquo tsuyohisedi geso dilisdayvdiyi gesv iyui.
english: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎷᏁᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏆᎳᏆᏃ ᏗᏍᎩᏲᎯᏏ.
phonetic: Uneluneno saquo igagadv, hia nuniwesei, Hiluga hia asgaya, Qualaquano disgiyohisi.
english: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏁ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Qualaqua udasuyedv unalitelvnv nahna gaduhv ale udalvi atsisdvdistane didasdudiyi atsiyvtanvhi gesei.
english: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Qualedino udulisgv Tsisa uwegodiyi nvtsulisdotane taline dunetselei.
english: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎯᏍᏛᎥᎦ, ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno unelune hia nuniwesei, Hisdvvga, hiyadvvga.
english: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ?  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏥᎵᎥᏂᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᏏ.
phonetic: Tsoineno hia niduweselei, Gadono, gado usdi uyo dulvwisdanelv?  Vtla yitsiwadveha gohusdi yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesvi;  nasgi iyusdi datsilivnili ale dodatsiyosi.
english: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮ ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unatlinigvnele asdaya aninegvi, anitayohihe agadvdiyi.  Nasgino na ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi aninegv ugvwiyutsei.
english: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏁᏤ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Qualedino unetse nusdv unadulisgv iyulisdodiyi.
english: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏔᏲᎴᎢ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏧᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎸᎢ; ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale duwekanele nasgi tsunitayolei, didasdudiyi atsiyvtanvhi tsigesei tsusdvdisge udasuyedv unalitelvnv ale udalvi; Tsisasgini duyohisele unadulisgv iyunvnediyi.
english: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏘᏂᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ, ᏙᏗᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏃᏝᏗᏍᏔᏁ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvwatiniseno uniniyvhe gilo iyusdi Sawani tsudoidv, Salini ehi, dodigalogesv nvdayulosvhi, nasgino unanotladistane tsudahnawadv, nasgi Tsisa aisv oniditlv uwenvsdiyi.
english: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏂᏴᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadiseno unitsati yvwi, ale anigeyv, nasgi nasquo daniyvge ale gvwasgonihei.
english: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎦᏔᎲᎡᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎨᏴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᎪᏂᎸᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏓᏍᎪᏂᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏗᏥᏍᎪᏂᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisano dugatahvelv hia nuwesei, Itsigeyv Tsilusilimi tsuwetsi, tlesdi ayv sgisgonilvgi, itsvsvsgini ditsadasgoniga, ale ditsetsi ditsisgoniga.
english: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏰᏃ ᏛᎵᏰᎢᎶᎵ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏂᏪᏏ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᎾᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏍᏛᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gvniyuyeno dvliyeiloli iga, nahiyu hia nvdvniwesi, Osiyu iyunalisdanedi dinalulvvsgi nigesvna, ale tsunadananugowisvhi nigesvna, ale tsunadasdvnvhi nigesvna.
english: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏛᎾᎴᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏛᏂᏪᏎᎵ ᏙᏓᎸᎢ, ᏍᎩᏯᏐᎥᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎯᎸᎢ, ᏍᎩᏳᏢᎥᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dvnalenvhi hia nidodvniweseli dodalvi, Sgiyasovga; ale dusahilvi, Sgiyutlvvga.
english: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏤ ᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ, ᎦᏙ ᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎧᏲᏛ ᏡᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno itse tlugv nasgi yinvdvnvneli, gado gvnedi gesesdi ukayodv tlugvi?
english: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᏘᏅᏎ ᏗᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo anitali nvwanadale uyo tsunilvwisdanehi itsulaha degegatinvse digetsiisdiyi.
english: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏂᎷᏨᏃ ᎧᏫᎵ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏛᏁ ᎤᏲᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Wunilutsvno Kawili dudovi, nahna dadahnawasdv gvwadvnei, ale dunadvne uyotsunilvwisdanehi, asiyvwi agatisiditlv, soino agasgani iditlv.
english: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏘᏙᎵᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏯᏙᎴᏃ ᎤᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏎᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuwesei, Edoda, tidoligi; vtlayeno yanigataha nanadvnehvi.  Uniyadoleno unuwo ale anasesdisgei.
english: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᏫᏍᏕ ᏚᎾᎦᏙᏍᏕᎢ.  ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᎢᎬᏩᏕᎰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᎤᏩᏒ ᏩᎵᏍᏕᎸ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Yvwino unalenawisde dunagadosdei.  Nunigvwiyusadegino nasquo dunaligonele igvwadehotanei, hia naniwesgei, Anisoi dasdelisgvgi; uwasv walisdelv iyuno Galonedv Unelanvhi usuyedv gesesdi.
english: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏍᏉ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ, ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏁᏁᎮ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Ale aniyawisgi hnasquo gagvwasotlvdei, gvwalutsehe ale gvwanenehe tsunitsoyasdi,
english: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Ale hia naniwesgei, Iyuno nihi Anitsusi unatseli Ugvwiyuhi gesesdi, tsvsv halisdelv.
english: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏪᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏁᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo gowele ulisdadv galvladitlv Anigoi uniwonihisdi, ale Anilomi uniwonihisdi, ale Aniquilu uniwonihisdi gowele hia nigvnei; HiA UGvWiYuHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
english: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏕᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎸ ᏨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏂᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi uyo tsunilvwisdanehi nasgi digegadvnvhi gagvwasotlvdei, hia nigawesgei, Iyuno nihi Galonedv gesesdi, halisdelv tsvsv ale ayv sginisdelv.
english: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏁᏨ ᎤᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏕᏣᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Soisgini tsunetsv ugvsgolvnei, hia nuwesei, Tlasgo Unelanvhi yinayesga utloyiquo detsadugodanelv tsigi?
english: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏕᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎩᏂᏍᏛᏗᎭ, ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini udohiyuhi duyugodvi; ayvyeno deginilvwisdanelv duyugodv ginisdvdiha, hiasgini vtla gohusdi utsatini iyudvnelvhi yigi.
english: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᏆᏅᏓᏛᎭ ᏫᎷᏨᎭ ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele Tsisa, Tsagvwiyuhi, squanvdadvha wilutsvha tsatseligohi.
english: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎬᏲᏎᎭ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏫᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselei, Udohiyuhiya gvyoseha, Gohi iga tsigi winedohesdi nvwadohiyadv digesvi.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏎ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Taladuno iyvdv iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesei, ale nigvnadv ani gadohi ulisihvse tsoine iyutlilodv iyasti.
english: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏏᎲᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏚᎵᏍᏡᏰᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nvdo ulisihvsei, ale anuwo ayedoladv udvnadigalawiisdiyi ayeli dulistluyei.
english: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏂᎯ ᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano asdaya unetsv hia nuwesei, Edoda, nihi degvyohisi aquadanvdogi; nasgino nuwesv ulisquadelei.
english: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏓᏖᏁᎯ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Asgohitsuquino didatenehi ugohv nulistanidolvi ulvquotane Unelanvhi hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya udanvdi asgaya gese hia.
english: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏔᏂᎸᎯ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏚᏅᏂᎴ ᏗᏂᏁᏥᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi nahna agowadvdi gesv unagadostanilvhi, unigohv nulistanidolv dunvnile dininetsiyi, ale unatsvsei.
english: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎢᏅ ᏧᎾᎴᏅᏁᎢ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Nigadvno gvwagatahi gesv ale anigeyv Gelili nvdagvwasdawadvdv inv tsunalenvnei anigowatisge nasgi hia.
english: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏦᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎩ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ,
phonetic: Gvniyuquono asgaya Tsowa tsudoidv, digalawigi, udanvti asgaya, ale duyugodv iyadvnehi,
english: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counseller; and he was a good man, and a just:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ,) ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏘᏰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,^
phonetic: (Nasgi vtla osiyu yuyelvne nasgi nusdv dunugotanv ale nunadvnelvi,) Alimadiyi ehi gesei, nasgi Anitsusi uniduhvi, nasgi nasquo agatiye Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi,^
english: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏭᎷᏤᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi asgaya Qualedi wulutsele ale utayosele Tsisa ayelvi.
english: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏒ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎶᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏅᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏔᎴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏥᏅᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udesv doledv anuwo uwetsanulotanei, ale atselisdv unvne nasgi nvyohi ataledv, nasgi nahna ilvhiyu gilo natsinvnvna gesvi.
english: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎩᏥᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno iga advnvisdodiyi gesei, unadodaquasgvno hnaquo ugitsisgei.
english: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ, ᎣᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Anigeyvno nasquo Gelili nvdagvwasdawadvdv, oni analisdawadisei, ale unigohe atselisdvi, ale nigvnv uninvnv ayelvi.
english: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏨᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᎳᏁ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏯᏪᏐᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unatsvseno ale unadanelane gawasvgi ale atlonedi; ale uniyawesole unadodaquasgv nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᏚᏂᏲᎴ ᏗᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyiyino iga sunadodaquasdi gesv gila iga tsinigalisdisgoi, unilutse atselisdvi, duniyole digawasvgi nasgi tsunadanelanvhi, ale gilo iyunasdi anehei.
english: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎦᏌᏆᎴᎸᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uniwadvheno nvya iyvdv wigasaqualelvstanvhi gese atselisdvi.
english: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏴᎸᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎾᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Uniyvlvno vtla yuninawadvhe ayelv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa.
english: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎡᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᎥ ᏚᎾᎴᏂᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ;
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei nasgi utsati unadeyatanehe nasgi nvdigalisdodisgei, eniyuquo anitali anisgaya nav dunalenile digvwatalugisgi tsunanuwai;
english: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏚᏅᏁ ᏚᎾᎧᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᎡᏥᏲᎭ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ?
phonetic: Anisgaiheno ale eladi nidunvne dunakadvi, nasgi hia nigvwaniweselei, Gadono gvnodv ietsiyoha tsuniyohusvhi nunadvnvi?
english: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎦᎾ, ᏚᎴᏅᏰᏃ; ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏤᏙᎲᎩ,
phonetic: Vtla ani yigana, dulenvyeno; Itsanvdada nitsiweselvi asiquo Gelili tsedohvgi,
english: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏎ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏛᏗ ᏓᏓᎾᏩᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ.
phonetic: Hia tsinigawesgvgi, yvwi Uwetsi ase yvwi anisgana digetsiyohisedi gesesdi, ale agadvdi dadanawasdvi, ale tsoine iga tsulehisodi.
english: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏕᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ,
phonetic: Unanvdadeno unetsvi,
english: And they remembered his words,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏗᎤᎾᏨᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Ale atselisdv diunatsvsei nasgi hia nigadv nulistanidolv duninonele sadu iyanidv, ale nigadv anisoi.
english: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎠᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᎬᏩᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Meli Magideli ehi, ale Tsoana, ale Meli Tsimi utsi, ale nvwanadale anigeyv anehi, nasgi tsiwigvwaninonele getsinvsidv.
english: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯᏃ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎪᎢᏳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Uninohelvhino asequoquo nvwasdei, ale vtla yigegoiyunei.
english: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ, ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ; ᎤᏗᏍᏚᏅᏃ ᏚᎪᎮ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏙᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano dulenv, dusqualvtane atselisdv wulosei; udisdunvno dugohe doledv dinuwo unelagi iyvdv doganei, udanvseno asquanigosge nasgi nulistanidolvi.
english: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎸᎯ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎺᏯᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏩᏂᎦᏖᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎳ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏂᏚᏓᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo, nahiyuquo iga anitali unadasdawadidolvhi digaduhv Emeyasi tsudoidv wanigatei, nasgi tsunela iyvdv iyutlilodv nidudale Tsilusilimi.
english: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Analinohesgvno aninohesge nigadv nasgi nulistanidolvi.
english: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎾᎵᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nasgi asiquo analinohesge ale danadadvdvhvsgei, Tsisa uwasv nav ulutsv nasgi unenvstanei.
english: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏴᎡᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏬᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno dinigadoli degetsiniyvele nasgi gvwolisdiyi nigesvna.
english: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏑᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᏃᎮᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏍᏓᎵᏃᎮᎭ ᎢᏍᏓᎢᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᏓᏓᏅᏔ?
phonetic: Hiano nisuweselei, Gado isdinoheha hia nasgi tsisdalinoheha isdaisvi ale uyoquo tsinvwasdi tsisdadanvta?
english: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏟᎣᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎮᏙᎯᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi Tlioqua tsudoidv unetsv hia nuweselei, Tsigo hedohiquo nihi Tsilusilimi, ale nigatahvnaquo nasgi nahna nulistanidolv gohi tsigi?
english: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass therein these days?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏤᎲᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Gado usdi?  Hiano nigvwaweselei, Tsisa Naselidi tsehvgi nulisdanelvi, nasgi adolehosgi tsigesvgi, ulinigidv dulvwisdanelv ale dadeyohvsgv tsigese Unelanvhi agatahv ale nigadv yvwi anigatahvi.
english: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎦᏤᎵ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᏕᎬᏩᏲᏎ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale tsogatseli nunigvwiyusadegi tsidegvwayose tsagugodanediyi uyohuhisdiyi, ale tsigvwadvnvgi.
english: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏗᏓᏱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᎩᏥᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Aseno udugi ogvsvgi nasgi Isili didayisgi gesvi.  Ale nasquo gohi iga tsigi tsoine ugitsiha nasgi hia igvwalistanvhi;
english: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎣᎦᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎳ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎳ ᏧᎩᏥᏍᎪ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏁᏙᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Vv, ale nasquo gilo iyunasdi anigeyv ogadatlugv anela usquanigodi gogadanvdadistanvgi, nasgi gila tsugitsisgo atselisdv wunedolvhi;
english: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏅ ᎪᎪᏏ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Wunatlotsvno ayelvi, unilutsei, hia nuniwesei, dinikahnawadidohi nasquo dotsigowadv nasgi gvnv gogosi, unadvnei.
english: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏤᎯ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎪᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gilo iyusdi nasgi otsehi unenvsvgi atselisdvi, ale wuniwadvhe nasgiya nusde anigeyv nuniwesvi; nasgisgini na vtla yunigohei.
english: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᏥᏁᎫᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ!
phonetic: Hnaquono hia niduweselei, Itsinegutsi, ale itsadanvdv itsisganoliyu itsohiyudiyi nigav nuniwesv anadolehosgi!
english: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlasgo hia nasgi iyusdi ase ugiliyoisdi yigese Galonedv, ale wuyvsdi yigese galvquodiyu utseli digesvi.
english: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎴᏅᏔᏅᏃ ᎼᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᏚᏬᏏᏌᏁᎴ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ulenvtanvno Mosi, ale nigadv anadolehosgi, duwosisanele nagav gowelv nasgi uwasv unohesgvi.
english: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎿᎭᏩᏂᎦᏛᎢ; ᎤᏟᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏮᏗᎦᎶᏏᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Navno unilutse gaduhv nahna wanigadvi; utlino iyvdv tsiwvdigalosiso iyusdi nudvnelei.
english: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏂᏒᏏ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏒᎯᏰᎯᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗᏳ ᏫᎧᎳ.  ᎤᏴᎴᏃ ᏙᏗᏒᏎᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno igvwasdiyetanei, hia nuniwesei, Ayv sginisvsi, hnaquoyeno usvhiyehiyu, ale eladiyu wikala.  Uyvleno dodisvselisei.
english: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎨᎢ ᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏎᎢ, ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᏚᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nasgi ganvgei dinalisdayvnisei, gadu ugisv ulihelitsei, ale ugvhaluyv dunelei.
english: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏬᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏛᏔᏁ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Dinigadolino dulisduisei, ale igvwolitsei, ale ulidvtane danikanvi.
english: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᎩᏂᎾᏫ ᏧᏗᎴᎩᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏥᎩᎾᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏓᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎩᏃᏏᏌᏁᎲ ᎪᏪᎵ?
phonetic: Hiano nidunadaweselei, Tlasgo digininawi tsudilegiyu yigese hawini tsiginalinohedisgv didaisvi, ale tsideginosisanehv goweli?
english: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏚᎾᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎡ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏡᏩᏍᏗᏕᎩ,
phonetic: Nahiyuquono aliyeilisv dunalenei, ale Tsilusilimi taline wiunilosei, ale duniwadvhe danilawie sadu iyanidv, ale nasgi gvwanadatluwasdidegi,
english: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Hia naniwesgei, Ugvwiyuhi dulenv udohiyuhi, ale Sawani gvnigesv nudvnelv.
english: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uninohele nulistanidolv anaisvi, ale nasgi unolistanv gadu agvhaluyasgvi.
english: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎴᏂᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Asiquono nasgi naniwesgei, Tsisa uwasv ulenile ayeli aninvi, ale hia niduweselei, Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
english: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno uninayesei, ale unisgalei, adanvdo otsigowadv anelisgei.
english: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᏧᏢᏫᏛ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, gadono itsadeyataneha?  Ale gadono tsutlvwidv nitsalisdane doditsadanvdvi?
english: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏆᏛᏅ; ᏍᎩᏯᏒᏂᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏇᏓᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏧᎪᎳ ᏱᏚᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏓᏋᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsakanvga diquoyeni ale diqualasideni, aquvsvquo hia tsinaquadvnv; sgiyasvniga ale itsadolehohi; adanvdoyeno vtla yuquedala, ale vtla tsugola yidulv nasgiya tsitsigowatiha ayv nidaquvnvi.
english: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv dunanugowisele tsuwoyeni ale tsulasideni.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏥᎭ?
phonetic: Asiquono nanohiyuhvsgvna gese nvdigalisdodisge analiheligvi, ale unisquanigosgei, hia niduweselei, Alisdayvdisgo ani itsiha?
english: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏅᏁᎴᏃ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎠᏒᎾᏘᎶᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏩᏚᎵᏏ.
phonetic: Gvwanvneleno agvhalvdv atsadi asvnatilodv, ale agvhalvdv wadulisi.
english: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏁᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Suneseno, ale ulisdayvne anigatahvi.
english: And he took it, and did eat before them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏴ ᎬᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, Hia nasgi tsinitsvweselvgi, asiquo tsitsvyeladidohvgi, nasgi nigav nasgi ase iyulisdodi gesvi gowelanvhi gesv dikahnawadvsdiyi Mosi utseliga, ale anadolehosgi dunowelvi, ale dikanogisdiyi, ayv gvginohesgvi.
english: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᎡᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎵ;
phonetic: Hnaquono dusduiele dunadanvdvi, nasgi tsunolisdiyi goweli;
english: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ;
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei, nasgi hia nigvnv gowela, ale nasgi ase ugiliyoisdi gesvgi Galonedv, ale tsulehisodi gesv uyohusv tsoine iga;
english: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎥᏓᏗᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino dudov unvdodiyi ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv ale asganvtsv vdadidolisdi gesv gegalitsidonediyi nigadv tsunadalenvdv danewadisvi, Tsilusilimi unalenvdiyi.
english: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎯᏃ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Hihino itsinohesgi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv.
english: And ye are witnesses of these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎦᏓᏅᎵ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo, gadanvli itsilutsediyi Edoda uduistanvhi gesvi; aseno Tsilusilimi gaduhv itsinesdi gvni itsanuwosdesdi ulinigidv gesv galvladi nvdayudalenvhi.
english: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏘᏅᏎᏃ ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ; ᏧᏬᏰᏂᏃ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dutinvseno Quediniyi iyvdv; tsuwoyenino dusaladanv osdv dunetselei.
english: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎮᎢ ᎠᎦᏓᏓᎴᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏩᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei asiquo osdv dekanetsehei agadadaletane anidonavi, galvladino wagatinvstanei.
english: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Unadadolisdanelvno Tsilusilimi taline wiunilose utsati analiheligei;
english: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏯᎡᎢ, ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎮ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale nigohilvquo udvnadigalawiisdiyi aniyaei, analihelitsehe ale anilvquodisge Unelanvhi.  Emenv.
english: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Didalenisgv Kanohedv ehei, ale nasgi Kanohedv Unelanvhi itsulaha anehei, ale nasgi Kanohedv Unelanvhi gesei.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Didalenisgvi nasgi Unelanvhi itsulaha anehei.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏬᏢᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nigav gohusdi nasgi uwotlvnei, ale nigav gotlvnvhi tsigi vtla gohusdi nasgi nuwotlvnvna yigi.
english: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎧᏃᎮᏛ] ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏪᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎾᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi [Kanohedv] gvnidv uwehei; ale nasgi gvnidv yvwi iga unatisdanehi gesei.
english: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏚᎸᏌᏕᎢ, ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi igagatisdisgi ulisigv dulvsadei, ulisigino vtla yidudanilvtsei.
english: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎲᎩ ᏣᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gilo iyusdi asgaya ehvgi Tsani tsudoidv Unelanvhi nvdayunvsidv gesvgi.
english: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi ulutsvgi kanohesgi gesvgi, nasgi Igagati unohediyi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi naniv unohiyudiyi.
english: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Vtla nasgi na Igagati yigesei, kanohesgiquosgini gesvgi nasgi Igagati.
english: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎷᏨ, ᎢᎦ ᏥᏕᎠᏘᏍᏓᏁ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na kanohedv udohiyusv Igagati gesvgi; nasgi elohi tsulutsv, iga tsideatisdane naniv yvwi.
english: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎵᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi elohi ehvgi, ale nasgi elohi uwotlvnvhi gesvgi, ale elohi vtla yuwolitsei.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Utseligohi ulutsvgi, aseno tsutseli vtla yidigvwadanilvtsei.
english: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏕᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅ Ꭿ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nanivsgini digvwadanilvtsvhi deulisgolvdanelvgi Unelanv hi tsuwetsi iyunalisdodiyi; nasgi deudov anohiyuhvsgi;
english: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎬ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi gigv tsunanugowisvhi nigesvna, ale uquedali adanvtesgv tsunanugowisvhi nigesvna, ale yvwi adanvtesgv tsunanugowisvhi nigesvna, Unelanvhisgini tsunanugowisvhi.
english: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏕᎲ ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎸᎩ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Kanohedv uquedali nulistanvgi, ale idehv ulenidolvgi, ukalitsvhi gesvgi udadolitsadv ale duyugodvi; ale idigowatisgvgi utseliga galvquodiyu gesvi, nasgi galvquodiyu gesv Agayvlige uwasvhiyu udenelvhi utseliga nasgiya gesvgi.
english: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎧᏃᎮᏛ,] ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎣᏂ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎦᎴᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsani kanohesgvgi nasgi [Kanohedv,] ale uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi; Hia nasgi tsitsinohesgvgi, hia tsinitsiwesgvgi, oni tsvdayai igvyi agaledi, nasgiyeno ehvgi asi nigevna tsigesvgi.
english: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏏᎶᏛ ᎡᎩᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ukalitsvhi gesv nidiv eginelvhi, gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv ulosilodv eginelv.
english: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno Mosi gvnigesv iyuwanelvhi gesvgi, udadolitsadvsgini ale duyugodvi Tsisa Galonedv nidodayulisgolvtanvhi.
english: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎬᏩᎪᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo ilvhiyu yigvwagoho Unelanvhi; uwasvhiyu udenelvhi Uwetsi, Agayvlige ganetsii ehi, nasgi gvnigesv nuwanelv.
english: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏙᏧᏂᏅᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎵᏫ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ?
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia Tsani unohelvhi, nahiyu Anitsusi Tsilusilimi dotsuninvsv atsilvanelohi ale Aniliwi gvwadvdvdiyi, hia iyuniwesdiyi; Gago nihi?
english: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ Ꭴ'ᏃᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏓᏱᎴᎢ, Ꭴ'ᏃᏅᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale u'nonvgi, ale vtla yudayilei, u'nonvquosgini hia nuwesvgi; Vtla ayv Galonedv yigi.
english: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪᎨ?  ᎢᎳᏯᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ.  ᏥᎪᎨ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale vgvwadvdvnvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Gagoge?  Ilayasgo nihi?  Hiano nuwesvgi; Vtla.  Tsigoge na adolehosgi nihi?  Vtla, udvnvgi.
english: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᏫᏙᏥᏃᏁᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᎪᎩᏅᏒᎯ; ᎦᏙ ᎭᏗᎭ ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gago nihi?  Widotsinonediyiyeno nvdagoginvsvhi; Gado hadiha tsvsv hadanohesgvi?
english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᎷᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ; ᎢᏥᏥᏃᎯᏍᏓ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; Ayv nasgi na uwelugi hia tsinigawe inagei; Itsitsinohisda nvnohi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga; nasgi nuwesv Isaya adolehosgi.
english: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino na nvdagetsinvsidv Aniqualisiyi unaligohi gesvgi.
english: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏕᎭᏓᏬᏍᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Gvwadvdvnvgino hia nigvwaweselvgi; Gadono tsidehadawosga, iyuno nihi nasgi na Galonedv ale Ilaya ale nasgi na adolehosgi nigesvna yigi?
english: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ;
phonetic: Tsani dunetselvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Ayv ama degadawosdiha; aseno gadoga gilo itsidonav udasuya nasgi netsigatahvna;
english: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏂ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏣᎦᎴᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎳᏑᎶ ᏕᎪᎸᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏂᎪᎢ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na oni tsvdayai, igvyi tsagaledi; nasgi tsulasulo degolvsadv vtla yeli yinigoi disgikaneyvdiyi.
english: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᎦᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ ᎾᎿᎭᏣᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nulistanidolvgi Digasohisdiyi Tsodani sgoniditlv nahna Tsani dadawosgvi.
english: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏣᏂ ᏭᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏛᎦᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏤᏣᎦᏅᎦ ᎠᏫ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ugitsvdv Tsani wugohvgi Tsisa gadogv iditlv dvgadvgi, ale hia nuwesvgi; Tsetsaganvga Awiagina Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi ahvsgi elohi unisganvtsvi.
english: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᏥᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏂ ᏓᏯᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎦᎴᏗ ᏥᎦᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia na tsitsineisdisgvgi; Oni dayai igvyi agaledi tsigadisgvgi, nasgiyeno ehvgi asi nigevna tsigesvi.
english: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᎷᏨ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ale ayv vtla yitsigatahei; aseno nasgi Isili getsinanugowisediyi nvtsulisdotanv agilutsv ama degadawosdiha.
english: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏳᏁᏡᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎩᎸᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Tsani unohelvgi hia nuwesvgi; Agigohvgi Adanvdo guledisgonihi nasgiya dayunetlunvgi galvladi, ale nasgi dugilvtsvgi.
english: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎹ ᏗᏆᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎯᎪᎥᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏁᏡᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏚᎩᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ayv vtla yitsigatahei; aseno nasgi na nvdvginvsidv ama diquadawosdodiyi nasgi hia nagiweselvgi; Gilo higovha Adanvdo anetluhvsgvi dugilvtsvha, nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo didawosdisgi.
english: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Agigohvgino ale aginohelvgi nasgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi.
english: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏣᏂ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᏙᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Alewo ugitsvdv Tsani gadogvgi, ale anitali gvwasdawadidohi danidogvgi.
english: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏤᏣᎦᏅᎦ ᎠᏫ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Dukahnanvno Tsisa aisvi hia nuwesvgi; Tsetsaganvga Awiagina Unelanvhi utseliga;
english: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Nasgino na anitali gvwasdawadidohi unadvganvgi unetsv; ale nasgi unisdawadvsvgi Tsisa.
english: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏍᏗᏲᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏈ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏛᎦ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ-ᎭᏢ ᏗᏤᏅ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugatahvsv, ale gvwasdawadisv dugohv, hia niduweselvgi; Gado isdiyoha?  Hiano nigvwaweselvgi; Taquinasgi anetlvtanvhi gadvga Tadeyohvsgihatlv ditsenv.
english: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏕᎾ, ᏫᏍᏓᎦᏔ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎦᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ; ᏅᎩᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; Idena, wisdagata.  Unenvsvgino ale unagatanvgi ganelvi, ale itsulaha unedolvhi nahiyu iga; nvgineyeno iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesvgi.
english: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏣᏂ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ [ᏥᏌ] ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Asiyvwi nasgi na anitali Tsani unadvganelvhi, ale [Tsisa] unisdawadvdv, nasgi Enidi gesvgi, Sawani Quida dinadanvtli.
english: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎵ ᏌᏩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᏩᏛᎲ ᎺᏌᏯ; (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᏛᎦ.)
phonetic: Igvyi uwadvhvgi utseli unili Sawani, ale hia nuweselvgi; Otsiwadvhv Mesaya; (nasgi anetlvtanvhi Galonedv gadvga.)
english: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ ᏂᎯ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏏᏆᏏ ᏕᏣᏙᎡᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi utinolvgi Tsisa edohvi.  Tsisano dukahnanv hia nuwesvgi; Sawani nihi, Tsona uwetsi, Siquasi detsadoesdi; nasgi anetlvtanvhi Quida gadvga.
english: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdv Tsisa udulisgvgi Gelili uwenvsdiyi; Quiligino uwadvhvgi, ale nasgi hia nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.
english: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩ ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎡᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Quiligi Quetsayidi ehi gesvgi, Enidi ale Quida uniduhvi.
english: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎫᏬᏪᎳ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Quilino uwadvhvgi Nedanili, ale hia nuweselvgi; Otsiwadvhv nasgi Mosi guwowela tsikanoheha dikahnawadvsdi gowelihi, ale anadolehosgi tsaninoheha, nasgi Tsisa Naselidi ehi Tsowa uwetsi.
english: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏁᏓᏂᎵᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏰᎵᏍᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ?  ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏁᎾ, ᏩᎦᏔ.
phonetic: Nedanilino hia nuweselvgi; Yelisgo gohusdi osdv nvdagvwananugoisdi Naselidi?  Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Inena, wagata.
english: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏭᎪᎲᎩ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ, ᎦᏙᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏛᎦᏛᎩ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ.
phonetic: Tsisa wugohvgi Nedanili, gadogv iditlv dvgadvgi; hiano nuwesvgi, nasgi uneistanvgi; Gvniyuquo udohiyuhiya Isili uwetsi, nasgi galonuhedv nudasuyvna.
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏁᏓᏂᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏍᎩᎦᏔᎭ?  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏫᏂᏣᏯᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎡᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏦᎸᎩ, ᏫᎬᎪᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Nedanili hia nuweselvgi; Gado digalisdodi isgigataha?  Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Asiquo quiligi winitsayanisgvna tsigesvgi, egataiyusdi Tlugvi hawiniditlv tsitsolvgi, wigvgovgi.
english: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏁᏓᏂᎵ ᎤᏅᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᏂᎯ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nedanili unvtsv hia nuwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, nihi Unelanvhi uwetsi; nihi Tsagvwiyuhi Isili unatseliga.
english: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏪᏏ, ᎬᎪᎥᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ?  ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Tsigo hia tsinigvwesi, gvgovgi hawiniditlv svgataiyusdi tlugvi, nasgi nvdigalisdodiha hohiyuhvsga?  Utli iyusquanigodi higowatisgesdi, esgaquo nasgi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎾᎵᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Alewo hia nuweselvgi; Udohiyuhiwa udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Gohi iyudalenvdv itsigowatisgesdi galvladi ulisduidv gesesdi, ale detsigowatisgesdi dinikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga analisaladisgesdi ale eladi nanadvnehesdi gvwalutsehesdi yvwi Uwetsi.
english: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎨᏂ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᏥᏌ ᎤᏥ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoineno iga degegatsvsdisgvgi Gelili Geni gaduhvi; Tsisa utsi nahna edohvgi.
english: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano watsiyanvhvgi ale gvwasdawadidohi degegatsvsdisgv uniluhisdiyi.
english: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎦᎨᏃ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏗᏒᏅ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᏁᎭ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gigagenoaditasdi udisvnv, Tsisa utsi hia nuweselvgi; Vtla yunineha gigageaditasdi.
english: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᎾᏓᏛᏙᏗ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏴ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv gado ayv diginadadvdodi?  Vtla asi ayv yagisqualvelv.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏥᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Utsino hia niduweselvgi getsinvsidasdi; Nigav nitsiwesehv nasgi nitsadvnelvha.
english: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏕᎦᎧᎲᎩ ᏑᏓᎵ ᎠᎹ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ ᏅᏯ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏂᏕᎤᏅᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏅᎩ, ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏗᏟᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ
phonetic: Nahnano degakahvgi sudali ama ditlisdi nvya digotlvtanvhi Anitsusi tsinideunvno unadanvgalvdiyi tsinidegvnvgi, tsoasgohi iyvdv iyutlilodv ditlisdodi gesvgi
english: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᎹ ᏗᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏓ ᎠᎹ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Ama ditsikaliisda ama ditlisdi.  Nasgino akalii dunikalilvgi.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏥᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏪᏥᏁᎥᏏ.  ᏭᏂᏁᏁᎸᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Hnaquo ditsitlv ale analisdayvhvsgv ugvwiyusadegi wetsinevsi.  Wuninenelvgino.
english: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᏚᎩᏒ ᎠᎹ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏧᎶᏒᎢ, ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏂᏢᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏭᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyusadegi udugisv ama gigageaditasdi iyulistanvhi, ale nagatahvna gese tsulosvi, getsinvsidasdisgini ama unitlvdv anigatahvgi, ugvwiyusadegi wuyanvhvgi asgaya tsagatsvsdisgi,
english: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎾᎴᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏝᎲᏍᎪ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎩᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᎩᎳ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᏂᏝᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuweselvgi; Naniv yvwi analenvdisgo anitlahvsgo osani gigageaditasdi, hnaquono utsati unaditahvhi tsigesoi gila usonv anitlahvsgoi; nihisgini tsasquanigode osdv gigageaditasdi gohi iyasdi.
english: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎴᏅᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎨᏂ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia ulenvtanvgi Tsisa usquanigodi dulvwisdanelvgi Gelili Geni gaduhvi, ale gvnigesv nuwanelvgi atsilvquodiyu gesvi.  Gvwasdawadidohino gvwohiyunvgi.
english: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎨᏆᏂ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎸᏍᎩᏉ ᏄᏂᏒᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv Gequani wulosvgi, uwasv, ale utsi, ale analinvtli ale gvwasdawadidohi; ale nahna ilvsgiquo nunisvlvgi.
english: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎩ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Kanohiyegino dilisdayvdiyi Anitsusi unatseliga usqualvhidisvgi; Tsisano Tsilusilimi wulosvgi.
english: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᏅᏃ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Udvnvnodigalawiisdiyi duwadvhvgi aninvgi dininadegi waga ale awi ale guledinisgonihi, ale adelv dininetliyvsgi.
english: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏩᏍᏛᏂᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᏬᏢᏅ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ; ᏚᏤᏮᎩᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏂᎲ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎷᏆᏗᏅᏒᎩ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gawasdvnisdino uwotlvnv, nigadv udvnadigalawiisdiyi dunugowisvgi, ale nasquo awi, ale waga; dutsewvgino adelv dunihv adelv dininetliyvsgi, ale duluquadinvsvgi degasgilvi.
english: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎫᎴ-ᏗᏂᏍᎪᏂᎯ ᏗᏂᎾᏕᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏗᏥᎧᎲᎾ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏨᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia niduweselvgi guledinisgonihi dininadegi; hia ditsikahvna, Tlesdi Edoda ganelv ganododiyi adanelv itsvnelvi.
english: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; "ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏓᏇᎷᎬ ᎠᎩᏯᎣᏅ."
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino unanvdadvgi hia nigvnv gowelvi; "Tsatseli adanelv daquelugv agiyaonv."
english: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏴᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Anitsusino uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gado adolehohisdodi gvnigesv nvdasgiyvneli, nasgi tsinusdi tsidetsalvwisdaneha?
english: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᏲᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏦᎢᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏥᏱᎵᏙᎵ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏛᎦᏁᏍᎨᎰᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi hia niduweselvgi; Itsiyosda hia udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, tsoiquono iga datsiyilidoli hnaquo dvganesgehoni.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏑᏓᎵᎦᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎸᎯ ᎠᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᏥᎪᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏦᎢᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏛᎯᏱᎵᏙᎵ ᏛᎭᏁᏍᎨᎰᏂ?
phonetic: Anitsusino hia nuniwesvgi; Nvgasgohi sudaligali tsudetiyvdv uniyilidolvhi ananesgesgv hia udvnvdigalawiisdiyi; tsigono nihi tsoiquo iga dvhiyilidoli dvhanesgehoni?
english: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ.
phonetic: Aseno uwasv ayelv adanelv kaneisdisgvgi nasgi nuwesv.
english: But he spake of the temple of his body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Howano hnaquo uyohusv deulenv gvwasdawadidohi unanvdadvgi nasgi niduweselvi; ale unohiyunvgi goweli ale nasgi Tsisa unetsvi.
english: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimino edohv kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi iyu gesvi, unitsadvgi unohiyunv dudovi, unigohv usquanigodi dulvwisdanelvi.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏚᏓᏲᏎᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏓᎦᏔᎲᎩ,
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa vtla uwasv yidudayosei, nanivyeno dagatahvgi,
english: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎤᏪᎲ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Vtla ale udulvdi yinulisdanehe gilo gvnigesv iyuwanediyi nusdv yvwi, agatahvgiyeno nusdv hawini uwehv yvwi.
english: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎲᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Asgaya ehvgi Nigadimasi tsudoidv, Aniqualisiyi utseligohi, Anitsusi digvwanelodi gesvgi.
english: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ:  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎲᎾᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi Tsisa ulutselvgi svnoyi hia nuweselvgi; Disqueyohvsgi, otsigataha tadeyohvsgi gesv Unelanvhi nvdatsanvsidv gesvi:  vtlayeno gilo nasgi hia usquanigodi tsidetsalvwisdaneha yidogvwalvwisdasi, Unelanvhi nidukahnawadidohvnayigi.
english: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙ ᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎪᏩᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫ ᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Udo hiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Gilo taline udenvhi nigesvna igesesdi vtla yvgvgowadv nahna Unelanvhi ugvwi yuhi gesvi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏴᏫ ᏯᏕᎲᎦ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏱᎩ?  ᏥᎪ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏥᏏᏱ ᏫᏯᏴᎭ, ᏯᏕᎲᎦ?
phonetic: Nigadimasino hia nuweselvgi; Gado yigalisdoda yvwi yadehvga hnaquo agayvlige yigi?  Tsigo taline utsisiyi wiyayvha, yadehvga?
english: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏴᎭ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi; Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha, Gilo ama ale Adanvdo gvwananugowisvhi nigesvna igesesdi, vtla yvgvyvha nahna Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na uquedali unanugowisvhi uquedaliquo gesoi; nasgi na adanvdo unanugowisvhi Adanvdo gesoi.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏕᏗ, ᏥᎬᏲᏏ.
phonetic: Tlesdi tsasquanigosvgi ase taline itsadedi, tsigvyosi.
english: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎢᏘᏢ ᏫᎦᏃᎸᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᎭᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏔᎰ ᏗᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Unole udulisdvquo ititlv wiganolvdisgoi, ale unoyvgv hadvgisgoi, aseno vtla yigataho digadvi ale wagadvi; nasgiyasgini nusdi naniv gilo nasgi Adanvdo tsunanugowisvhi.
english: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Nigadimasi unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Gado yigalisdoda nasgi yinusdi?
english: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Tsigo tadeyohvsgi Isili anehvi, nigatahvnano igi nasgi hia.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎣᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Onigatahv otsinegoi, ale ogigohvhi otsinohesgoi, aseno vtla yiditsadanilvgo otsinohesgvi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᏱᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ?
phonetic: Iyuno elohi nigalistanidohv itsvnohehelv nitsohiyuhvsgvna yigi, gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga, galvladi nigalistanidohv yitsvnohehelv?
english: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏳᎶᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gilo galvladi wiyulosoi, galvladi nvdayulosvhi uwasv, yvwi Uwetsi, nasgi galvladi tseha.
english: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᏰᏥᏌᎳᏗᏂ,
phonetic: Ale Mosi inadv tsusaladane inagei, nasgiya nasquo yvwi Uwetsi dayetsisaladini,
english: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi, uyohuhisdiyi nigesvna, gvnidvsgini uwadvdi.
english: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᏒᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nigavgi Unelanvhi ugeyusvgi elohi, deuyosvgi utseliga Uwetsi nasgi uwasvhiyu udenelvhi, gilo nasgi yigohiyuhvsga uyohuhisdiyi nigesvna, gvnidvquosgini uwadvdi.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᏭᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla elohi uluhisdiyi yvtsunvsv Uwetsi tsuwudanediyi elohi, nasgisgini iyuwanisodiyi elohi atsisdelvdiyi.
english: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Gilo nasgi na tsigohiyuhvsgoi, vtla usganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi yigesoi, nasgisgini na nigohiyuhvsgvna nasgi gayula usganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi gesoi, nvdigalisdodisgo nuwohiyunvna gesv Unelanvhi Uwetsi deudov nasgi uwasvhiyu udenelvhi.
english: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏚᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ, ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nvdigalisdodiha unisganvtsv tsidunadugodaneha, nasgi igagati elohi unanugotsilv, ale yvwi utli uniyelvnv ulisigi esgaquo igagati, dunilvwisdanehvyeno uyoiyu gesvgi.
english: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎪ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎷᎪ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Uyoyeno tsulvwisdanehi asgago igagati, ale vtla yigalugo igagadvi, nvdigalisdodisgo nudulisgvna gesv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nusdv dulvwisdanehvi.
english: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Duyugodvsgini tsulvwisdanehi igagadv galugoi, udulisgo gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi dulvwisdanehvi.
english: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏬᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa ale gvwasdawadidohi Tsudiyi wunilosvgi, nahnano unedolvgi, ale dudawovgi.
english: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏃᏂ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ, ᏎᎵᎻ ᎾᎥᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎹ.  ᎠᏂᎷᎬᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Tsanino nasquo Inoni dadawosgvgi, Selimi navi, nahnayeno utsadvgi ama.  Anilugvgino ale degegawosgvgi.
english: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏯᏥᏴᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno vtla asi didasdudiyi yatsiyvdisgei.
english: For John was not yet cast into prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏣᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono kanohedi nunalisdanelvgi Tsani gvwasdawadidohi Anitsusino adanvgalvdiyi ugvwali.
english: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᏂᎵᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏬᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Tsanino unilitselvgi, hia nuniweselvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, nasgi natsisdedohvgi Tsodani sgoniditlv, nasgi tsinohesgvgi, gvniyuquo nasgi dadawoa, ale nigadvquo gvwalutseha.
english: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎬᏩᏛ ᎬᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsani unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Yvwi vtla gohusdi yvgvwadv gvni galvladi nvdayetsinelvhi yigi.
english: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏥᏰᏅᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Nihi itsvsv itsigatahi hia tsinitsiwesgvgi; Ayv vtla Galonedv yigi, vginvsidvquosgini igvyi tsiyenvehi.
english: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎧᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏙᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ, ᎤᏣᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨ.
phonetic: Udayvsdi uwekahi nasgi adesvhvsgi; aseno adesvhvsgi unalii, nasgi tsigadogo ale tsudvganehoi, utsalanvhi aliheligo nvdigalisdodisgo adesvhvsgi kanegvi.  Nasgisgini ayv galieligv ukalitsv.
english: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏛᏃᏏ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏥᏲᎶᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgi na ase dvdvnosi, ayvsgini ase datsiyolotsi.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Galvladi nvdayulosvhi utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo nanivi.  Elohi unanugotsvhi elohiquo ehi gesoi, ale gawonisgv elohiquo ehi gesoi, galvladisgini nvdayulosvhi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nanivi.
english: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏓᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ugohvi udvganvnasgi kanoheha, aseno vtla gilo yidadanilvga nasgi unohelvi.
english: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na tsudanilvtsvhisgini unohelvi nasgi usdayidv Unelanvhi gvwatsigodi nigesvna gesvi.
english: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟᎶᏛᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno Unelanvhi unvsidv, Unelanvhi uwonihisdi gesv gawoniha; Unelanvhiyeno vtla utlilodvquo Adanvdo yuneha.
