english: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸ.
phonetic: Agayvlige ugeyuhiyu Uwetsi, ale nigadiyu gohusdi duyohiselv.
english: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏁᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏰᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi, nasgi gvnidv alisquadisgi negesvna utseliga, nasgisgini Uwetsi gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna vtla gvnidv ugowadvdi yigi; Unelanvhiquosgini utalawohisdi gesv ulinohiyeha.
english: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino udvganv Aniqualisi unadvganv Tsisa utli iyanii gvwasdawadegi nidegvnehv ale degawosgvi, esgaquo Tsani,
english: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏓᏓᏬᏍᎨᎢ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ,)
phonetic: (Vtlasgininonv Tsisa uwasv yidadawosgei, gvwasdawadidohiquosgini,)
english: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏮᎤᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsudiyi unigisvgi ale taline Gelili wvulosvgi.
english: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Sameliyi ase ulohisdi gesvgi.
english: And he must needs go through Samaria.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏌᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᏥᎦᏚᎭ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ ᏤᎦᏈ ᏧᏁᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏦᏩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sameliyi gaduhv ulutsvgi Saga tsudoidv nasgi nav tsigaduha gada ahv Tsegaqui tsunele uwetsi Tsowa.
english: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎩ ᎠᎹ ᏧᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏯᏪᏨ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ; ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano atalesvgi ama tsunitlvdiyi Tsegaqui utseliga; Tsisano duyawetsv aisv uwenvgi atalesvi; taladuno iyvdv iyutlilodv kalawadisv gesvgi.
english: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎷᏤ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏢᎯᎴᎢ; ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ.
phonetic: Nahna ulutse ageyv Sameliyi ehi ama utlvhilei; Tsisa hia nuweselei; Aquaditasdi sginehvsi.
english: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏩᏁᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏒᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohiyeno digaduhv wanedohvgi alisdayvdi uniwasvsvgi.
english: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎯᏧᏏ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏍᎩᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏥᎨᏴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎨᎢ.  (ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ.)
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi ageyv Sameliyi ehi hia nuweselei; Gado digalisdodiha nihi Hitsusi aditasdi isgitayoseha tsigeyv Sameliyi gei.  (Anitsusiyeno ale Sameliyi anehi vtla yidunadagasayasdoi.)
english: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎯᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎯᎦᏔᎮ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏣᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏆᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ; ᏨᏒ ᏱᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏣᏁᏁᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎹ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsei hia nuweselei; Iyuno yihigatahe Unelanvhi udanedi tsigi, ale yihigatahe hia nasgi tsinitsaweseha, Aquaditasdi sginehvsi; tsvsv yitayoselei, ale yitsanenele gvnidv ama.
english: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏰᎭ ᎠᏢᏗ, ᎭᏫᏂᏳᏃ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢᏃ ᏣᏁᎩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎹ?
phonetic: Ageyv hia nuweselei, Hisgaya, vtla gohusdi yiyeha atlvdi, hawiniyuno atalesvi, hatlvno tsanegisv nasgi gvnidv ama?
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᎯ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏗᏔᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏗᏔᎲᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏝᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa utli etsalvquodiyu nihi, esgaquo igidoda Tsegaqui nasgi iginelvhi hia atalesvi, ale nahna uwasv uditahvi ale dunaditahvi tsuwetsi ale unatlanavi.
english: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏳᏗᏔᎲ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎹ ᏔᎵᏁᏉ ᎤᏔᏕᎪᏗ;
phonetic: Tsisa unetsei hia nuweselei; Gilo yuditahv hia ama talinequo utadegodi;
english: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏗᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏔᏕᎪᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎹ, ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini yuditahv nasgi ama ayv tsinenedi tsigi vtla iyuhiyu utadegodi yigi, ayvsgini tsinenedi tsigi ama, hawini ayelv ama ganugogv gesesdi, wigananugogesdi gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna digesvi.
english: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᏍᎩᏁᎲᏏ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎦᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎠᎩᏢᎯᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ageyv hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, hia nasgi ama sginehvsi, tlesdino agitadeganvgi, ale tlesdi ani agitlvhilvgi.
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏰᎯ ᏫᏯᏅ, ᎠᏂᏃ ᎢᏍᏗᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselei; Tsayehi wiyanv, anino isdilutsvha.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ ᎠᎩᏰᎯ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ ᎠᎩᏰᎯ, ᏣᏛ;
phonetic: Ageyvno unetsei hia nuweselei; Vtla yeha agiyehi.  Tsisa hia nuweselei; Yeli niwi, vtla yeha agiyehi, tsadv;
english: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ ᎨᏣᏰᎯ, ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᏣᎧᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏣᏰᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏫ.
phonetic: Hisgiyeno nanivgi getsayehi, gohino tsitsakaha vtla tsayehi yigi; nasgi tsiniwi duyugodv niwi.
english: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎭᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ageyv hia nuweselei; Hisgaya, gadoleosga hadolehosgi gesvi.
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ; ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsogigayvlige anadadolisdisgvgi ani odalvi, aseno nihi hia nitsiwesgoi; Tsilusilimisgini nahna ugvwiyuha adadolisdodiyi.
english: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏍᏉᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏱᎦᏰᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselei; Higeyv, squohiyuhvga, dvsqualvhi nahiyu vtla ani odalvi, ale nasquo Tsilusilimi, yigayetsadadolisdanehesdi Agayvligei.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihi itsadadolisdaneha gohusdi nasgi nitsigatahvna; ayvsgini otsigataha iyusdi otsadadolisdanehvi; Anitsusiyeno anehv alisdelvdodi gesv nvdayunanugoisdi.
english: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏛᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏙᏛᏅᏔᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏚᏲᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno dvsqualvhi, ale hnaquo usqualvhv, nasgi udohiyusv anadadolisdisgi dvnadadolisdaneli Agayvlige dodvnvtani tsunadanvdo ale duyugodvi; Agayvligeyeno duyoho nasgi iyunasdi gvwadadolisdanehi.
english: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏅᏙᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi Adanvdo; nasgino na anadadolisdanehi tsunadanvdo ale duyugodv tsunvdodi unadadolisdanedi.
english: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎺᏌᏯ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᏓᎩᏃᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ageyv hia nuweselei; Tsigataha uluhisdi gesv Mesayanasgi Galonedv tsanosehoinasgi galutsvha, daginoneli nigav gohusdi.
english: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᎬᏬᏁᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎺᏌᏯ.]
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselei; Ayv tsigvwonediha nasgi [Mesaya.]
english: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᏲᎭ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎯᏯᎵᏃᎮᏍᏗ?  ᏳᏬᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi unilutsvgi, ale unisquanigosvgi ageyv alinohedisgvi.  Aseno vtla giloi, Gado tsayoha?  Ale Gadono ihiyalinohesdi?  yuwoselei.
english: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎯᏴᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏢᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏴᏫ;
phonetic: Hnaquono ageyv uhiyvgi ama utlvdi, ale digaduhv wulosvgi, hia winiduweselvgi yvwi;
english: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏕᎾ, ᏪᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎩᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Idena, wetsigowadv asgaya aginonelvhi nigav naquadvnelidolvi.  Tlasgo nasgi Galonedv yigi?
english: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Howano gaduhv uninugotsvgi, ale vgvwalutselvgi.
english: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏪᏙᎲᎩ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎩ, ᏗᏍᎩᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Asiquono gaduhv wedohvgi, gvwasdawadidohi gvwasdiyetanvgi, Disgiyeyohvsgi, halisdayvhvga, anadisgvgi.
english: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno hia niduweselvgi; Agiha aqualisdayvdi nihi nitsigatahvna.
english: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎮᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ?
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi gvwasdawadidohi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Tsigo gilo uyohelv ulisdayvdi?
english: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi, Nusdv adanvtesgv aginvsidv iyaquadvnediyi, ale nasgi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv agisquadisdiyi, nasgi ayv aqualisdayvdi.
english: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎨᏥᏪᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏏ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎩᎳ ᏛᎦᏛᎾᏥ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᏥᏌᎳᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᏧᏁᎩᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tlasgo hia igetsiwesdi yigi; Asi nvgi iyanvdo gila dvgadvnatsi?  Gvniyuquo hia nitsvweseha; ditsigadoli ditsisaladvga, ale degalogesv ditsakanvga, hnaquoyeno tsunegiyu, ale usqualvhv asgudesdiyi.
english: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᏫᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎾᏃ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale asgudesgi agaguyvehoi, ale usgudesvhi wigatlisisgo gvnidv digesvi, nasgi itsula unalihelisdiyi nigalisdisgo awisgi nano asgudesgi.
english: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᏫᏍᎪᎢ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ani udohiyuhi nigalisdiha hia igawedv tsigi; Gilo awisgoi nvwadaleno asgudesgoi.
english: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏅᏒᎩ ᏫᏥᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎯ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏗᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏥᏴᎸ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvnvsvgi witsisgudesdiyi nahna nihi ditsilvwisdanelvhi nigesvna gesvi; nvwanadale dinilvwisdanelvgi, nihino itsiyvlv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏌᎺᎵ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏃᎮᎸ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎩᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale unitsadvgi Anisameli nahna gaduhv anehi gvwohiyunvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi unohelv ageyv hia tsinuwesei; Aginonelvgi nigav naquadvnelidolvi.
english: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᎺᎵ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᏪᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏔᎵ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Anisameli gvwalutselv gvwatayoselvgi tsuweladidasdiyi, ale Nahna tali tsusvhidv uwedolvgi.
english: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Ale asi unitsadvgi unohiyunvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi uwasv kanegvi;
english: And many more believed because of his own word;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯᏉ ᏣᏁᏨ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᎭ ᏦᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎣᎬᏒᏰᏃ ᎣᏣᏛᎦᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuniweselvgi ageyv; Hnaquo otsohiyuhvsga vtla nihiquo tsanetsv yinvdigalisdoha tsotsohiyuhvsga, ogvsvyeno otsadvgasi, ale otsigataha nasgi hia udohiyuhiya Galonedv gesv elohi Asdelisgi.
english: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino tali winusvlv nahna unigisvgi, ale Gelili wulosvgi.
english: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisayeno uwasv hia nuwesvgi; adolehosgi vtla atsilvquodiyu yigeso uwasv utseligohi.
english: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Gelili wulutsv, Gelili anehi degvwadanilvtsvgi, unigohvhiyeno gesvgi nasgi nigadv dulvwisdanelv Tsilusilimi nahiyu danalisdayvhvsgvi; nasquoyeno unenvsvgi dodinalisdayvhvsgvi.
english: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎨᏂ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᎨᎵᎵᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏬᏢᏔᏅᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎡᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ ᎨᏆᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisano taline ulutsvgi Geni gaduhvi Geliliyi, nahna gigageaditasdi ama uwotlvtanvi.  Ale gilo iyusdi ugvwiyuhi asdelisgi ehvgi, nasgi uwetsi utlvgvgi Gequani.
english: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏧᎶᏒ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎷᏥᎸᎢ, ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi na udvganv Tsisa Tsudiyi tsulosv Gelili ulutsilvi, uwadvhvsvgi, ale utayoselvgi uwenvsdiyi wunvwodiyi uwetsi, uyohusidenayeno gesvgi.
english: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎬᏂ ᏱᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Vtla yvgetsohiyuhvga, gvni yitsigowatiha uyelvdvi ale usquanigodi.
english: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎮᎾ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏲᎱᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᏇᏥ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi asdelisgi hia nuweselvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, hena asiquo nayohusgvna aquetsi.
english: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎮᎾ, ᏤᏥ ᎬᏅ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsihena, tsetsi gvnv.  Ale nasgi asgaya uwohiyunvgi Tsisa nuweselvi, ale uwenvsvgi.
english: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎥᎠᎢᏒᎩ, ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᏁᎸᎩ, ᏤᏥ ᎬᏅ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono vaisvgi, tsunvsidasdi degvwatlosvgi ale gvwanonelvgi, Tsetsi gvnv, vgvwoselvgi.
english: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎤᎴᏅᎲ ᏏᏲᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎤᏒᎯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᏄᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dudvdvnvgi iyui ulenvhv siyosdv nulisdanelvi.  Usvhi saquo iyutlilodv kalawadisv nudilehvsgvna nulistanvgi, vgvwoselvgi.
english: Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ; ᏤᏥ ᎬᏅ.  ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino udoda udolehosvgi nahiyu gesv Tsisa hia nuweselvi; Tsetsi gvnv.  Uwasvno uwohiyunvgi ale nasquo nigadv tsutseli sidanelvhi gesvi.
english: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎷᏦᏅᎯ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia taline usquanigodi dulvwisdanelv Tsisa Gelili ulutsonvhi, Tsudiyi nvdayulosvhi.
english: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv, usqualvhvgi Anitsusi tsunalisdayvdiyi; ale Tsisa Tsilusilimi uwenvsvgi.
english: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏂ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏡᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ; ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏓᏲᏓᏝᎭ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimini awi uniyvsdiyi nav adawosdiyi gotlvha nasgi Aniquilu uniwonihisdi gesv Tludesdi deudov; nahnani hisgi dayodatlaha.
english: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏂᏜᏓᎥᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᎢᏒᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎹ.
phonetic: Nahna aninidlavgi unitsati tsunitlvgi, ale dinigewi, ale diniyouli, ale unvisvhi, anigatiyvgi ulitelvdiyi ama.
english: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏥᎯᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎹ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᏅᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏖᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᎹ, ᎤᏗᏩᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎤᏱᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyvdvhayeno dikahnawadidohi galutsihihvgi adawosdiyi, ale atelvhvsgvgi ama, gilono nasgi tsudalenvtanvhi udunvhi hnaquo atelvnvhi tsigeso ama, udiwasgvgi nigav gohusdi vyugi uyilidohvi.
english: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏅᎬᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏁᎳᎦᎵ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏢᏨᎯ ᏄᏗᏩᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nahna ganvgvgi gilo iyusdi asgaya, tsoasgohi nelagali iyudetiyvdv gvwatlvtsvhi nudiwasgvna gesvgi.
english: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎡᏣᏅᏬᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Tsisano ugohvgi nasgi asgaya ganvgvi, ale udolehosv gesvgi, gohidiyu igvwalistanvhi gesvi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsadulisgo etsanvwodiyi?
english: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏢᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᏙᎰ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎵᏖᎸᎲᎦ, ᎠᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏩᎩᎧᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᏥᏫᎦᎢᏐᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏓᎩᎪᏂᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏩᏠᎠᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Utlvgi unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Hisgaya, vtla gilo yedoho ama alitelvhvga, adawosdiyi wagikahvsgi; asiquoyeno tsiwigaisoi, gilo dagigonisgoi igvyi watloasgoi.
english: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Talehvga, hinagi tsatsesdo, ale heda.
english: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv nasgi asgaya udiwasvgi, ale unesvgi utsesdo, ale uwedolvgi.  Ale unadodaquasgv gesvgi nahiyu iga.
english: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ; ᎪᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᏣᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi hia nuniwesele atsinvwanvhi; Gohi unadodaquasgvi, vtla duyugodv yigi tsatsesdo tsanidasdiyi.
english: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᎩᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎾᎩ ᏣᏤᏍᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselei; Aginvwanvhi hia nagiweselvgi; Hinagi tsatsesdo, ale heda.
english: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏣᏤᏍᏙ ᎯᎾᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ, ᏦᏎᎸᎯ?
phonetic: Hnaquono unadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei; Gago iyusdi nasgi asgaya, Tsatsesdo hinagi ale heda, tsoselvhi?
english: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi atsinvwanvhi vtla yagatahe nasgi gesvi; Tsisayeno udelidv udanvsvgi; unitsadvyeno nahna anedohvgi.
english: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏣᏅᏩᏅ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᏍᏗ, ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏲ ᏱᏣᎷᏥᏏ.
phonetic: Onino Tsisa nasgi uwadvhvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale hia nuweselvgi; Gvniyuquo etsanvwanv; tlesdi hnaquo ilvhiyu yitsasganvtsesdi, utliyeno iyuyo yitsalutsisi.
english: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi asgaya udanvsvgi, ale widunonelvgi Anitsusi, Tsisa unvwanvhi gesvi.
english: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi unadeyadotanvgi Tsisa, ale uniyolvgi unihisdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi nudvnelv unadodaquasgv iga.
english: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ [ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ,] ᎡᏙᏓ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Tsisa dunetselvgi [hia niduweselvgi,] Edoda gohi iyasti dulvwisdanehoi, ayvno nasquo dagilvwisdanehoi.
english: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏛᏅᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Anitsusi utli igai unadulvhvgi unihisdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi vtla unadodaquasgvquo uwasv uyostanvi, nasquosgini Unelanvhi Udoda udvnvi, itsulaha Unelanvhi nadadvnehvi.
english: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᏪᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi vtla yeliga gohusdi uwasv gesv yidogvwalvwisdasi, agowatisgvsgini Udoda dulvwisdanehvi; nasgiyeno nusdv dulvwisdanehvi nasgi nasquo Uwetsi dulvwisdanehoi.
english: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎰ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Agayvligeyeno ugeyuhiyu Uwetsi, ale gananugowiseho nigadv uwasv dulvwisdanehvi; ale utli igai digalvwisdanedi dagananugowiseli esgaquo hia; nasgi itsisquanigohisdiyi.
english: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏥᏓᎴᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎡᎳ.
phonetic: Agayvligeyeno tsidaledisgo tsuniyohusvhi, ale dinvnodv tsinidegvnehoi, nasgiyasgini Uwetsi dinvnodv nidegvneho naniv nasgiquo ela.
english: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Agayvligeyeno nasquo vtla gilo yidigugodanehoi, duyohiselvsgini Uwetsi nagadv digugododi gesvi,
english: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᏂᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigadv unilvquododiyi Uwetsi, nasgiya tsinanilvquodiha Agayvligei.  Gilo nigalvquodisgvna tsigeso Unelanvhi Uwetsi, vtla yigalvquodisgo Agayvlige nasgi nvdayunvsidv.
english: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎭ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏚᎪᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᎶᏒ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Advgisgi tsinegvi, ale gohiyuhvsgi nvdvginvsidv nasgi uha gvnidv nalisquadisgvna, ale nasgi vtla tsudugododi yigi usganvtsvi, ayohuhisdisgini gesv udanvsv, gvnidv digesv wulosv.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Dvsqualvhi ale hnaquo usqualvhv tsuniyohusvhi unadvgodiyi Unelanvhi Uwetsi kanegvi, ale unadvganvhi unadvnidisdi gesesdi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Agayvligeyeno gvnidv utseliga tsigi, nasgiya nasquo unelv Uwetsi gvnidv utseliga iyulisdodiyi.
english: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎸ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo unelv tsuwugododiyi, nvtsulisdotanv yvwi Uwetsi gesvi.
english: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Tlesdi nasgi hia itsisquanigosvgi, dvsqualvhiyeno nahiyu datselisdv aniyai nigadv dvnadvgani kanegvi,
english: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᎴᏔᏂ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏙᏛᎾᎴᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ale dvninanugotsi, nasgi na osdv tsunilvwisdanelvhi gvnidv gesv widodvnaletani, uyono tsunilvwisdanelvhi udasdvdisdi gesv widodvnaletani.
english: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏙᎬᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ; ᎦᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏉᎪᏔᏅ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᎩᏲᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎩᏲᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Vtla gohusdi aquvsv gesv yeli yidogvgilvwisdasi; gadvgisgv nasgiya degugodisgoi, ale daquogotanv duyugodv gesoi; nvdigalisdodisgo nagiyohvna gesv aquvsv gadanvtesgvi, agiyohvsgini adanvtesgv Edoda nasgi nvdvginvsidv.
english: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏱᎦᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᏙᎯᏳᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno aquvsv yigadanoheha, tsinohesgv vtla yigvwadohiyuha.
english: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadale eha ayv aginohesgi, ale tsigataha udohiyuhi gesv nasgi kanohesgvi, ayv aginohesgvi.
english: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsani tsuwolv itsadanvsvgi, ale nasgi duyugodv unohelvgi.
english: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv vtla yidigadanilvga yvwi aginohesgvi, aseno nasgi hia nitsiwea etsisdelvdiyi.
english: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎸᏌᏓ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᏞᎦ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi adaweligisgi ale tsulvsada atsvsdodi gesvgi; nihino tlega osiyu itsiyelvsvgi itsalihelisdiyi nasgi iga utisdvi.
english: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎠᏇᎭ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏣᏂ; ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno utli galvquodiyu aginohesgi aqueha esgaquo Tsani; digalvwisdanediyeno Agayvlige aginelvhi agisquadisdiyi, nasgi tsidagilvwisdaneha, aginohesgo ayv Agayvligei nvdvginvsidv gesvi;
english: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎸ.  ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏣᏛᎦᏃ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᎪᎰ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Agayvlige nvdvginvsidv nasgi aginohelv.  Vtla ilvhiyu yigetsadvgano kanegvi, ale yigetsigoho nusdvi.
english: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi unetsvi vtla yitsiyaa, nasgiyeno na nvdayunvsidv vtla yetsoiyuhvsga.
english: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏥᎭ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ditsigoliya goweli, nahnayeno nalisquadisgvna gvnidv itsiha itsiyelvha, ale nasgi na goweli ayv aginohesgi.
english: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᏍᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yitsaduliha sgilutsediyi gvnidv itsatseliga iyulisdodiyi.
english: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ;
phonetic: Yvwi gvgilvquodisgv vtla yidigadanilvga;
english: I receive not honour from men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎦᏔᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno itsvgataha, Unelanvhi etsigeyuiyu nigesvna gesvi.
english: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎠᎩᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏕᏅᏙᎥ ᏳᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv Edoda deudov agiluhistanv, vtlano yidisgiyadanilvga.  Iyuno nvwadale uwasv denvdov yuluhistanv, nasgi ase yidetsadanilvgi.
english: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎦ, ᏂᏥᏲᎲᎾᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏓᏗᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga, itsvsv detsadalvquodisgv tsidetsadanilvga, nitsiyohvnano tsigi vdadilvquododi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi uwasvhiyu nvdayulisgolvdodi tsigi?
english: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏓᎧᏃᏁᎵ ᏓᏲᎫᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎭ ᎢᏧᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎼᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Tlesdi Agayvligei dakanoneli dayoguhistani yisgiyelisehesdi; asiyvwi eha itsuhisdisgi, Mosi, nasgi tsetsanelodi tsigi.
english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno Mosi yietsoiyuhvsgei ayv yisgiyoiyunei, nasgiyeno ayv aginohesgvi uwowelanvgi.
english: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Aseno nitsohiyuhvsgvna yigi nasgi uwowelanvhi, gado yigalisdoda yitsohiyuhvga ayv tsinegvi?
english: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᏪᏐᏨᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎥᏓᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏈᎵᏯ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa duwesotsvgi gelili vdalvi, nasgi Daquiliya vdalv tsidudov.
english: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᎫᏂᏢᎩ.
phonetic: Ale unitsatanvhi gvwasdawadvsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi anigowatisgv nasgi unisquanigodi nidadvnehv gunitlvgi.
english: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏒᎩ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏪᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisano uhnalusvgi odalvi, ale nahna uwenvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
english: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏕᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Kanohiyegino dilisdayvdiyi Anitsusi unatseliga usqualvhidena gesvgi.
english: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏗᎬᏩᎷᏤᎵᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᏓᎩᏩᏏ ᎦᏚ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano dusaladanv digadoli, ale dugohv unitsati digvwalutselisvi, hia nuweselvgi Quiligi; Hatlv dagiwasi gadu hia unigisdi.
english: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nuwesvgi atsigoliyesgvgi, uwasvyeno agatahvgi iyudvnediyi.
english: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏚ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎦᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Talitsuqui anigisi tsunagvwalodi tsugvwalodi gadu vtla yeli yigagi, nasgi anisiyvwiha usdi unigisvsdiyi.
english: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ, ᎡᏂᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohi gesv asiyvwi, Enidi tsudoidv, Sawani Quida dinadanvtli, hia nuweselvgi;
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏫᏄᏣ ᎠᏂ ᎡᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᎭ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏕᎦᏁᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏎᏉᎧᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏥᏄᏂᏣᏔ?
phonetic: Asiyvwi awinutsa ani edoha, nasgi dayeha hisgi utsalesdiiyusdi gadu, ale tali tsunasdi atsadi deganeha; aseno asequokani nasgi, hiano tsinunitsata?
english: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏩᎾᏅᎥᎦ ᏴᏫ.  ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎦᏄᎸᏒᎩ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; wananvvga yvwi.  Nahnano utsadvgi ganulvsvgi.  Howano unanvnvgi anisgaya hisgiha iyagayvli iyvdv iyanii.
english: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏚ ᏚᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ ᏚᏯᏙᎮᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎮᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Tsisa gadu dugisvgi, ale ulihelitsv duyadohelvgi gvwasdawadidohi, gvwasdawadidohino duniyadohelvgi unanvnvhi, ale nasquo atsadi nigav dunadulisgvi.
english: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏃᎸᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎢᏥᏟᏌ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏤᏬᏤᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dunolvsvno hia niduweselvgi gvwasdawadidohi; Itsitlisa uligvhaluyvhi utiyvhi, tlesdi gohusdi yutsewotsesdi.
english: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏂᏟᏌᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏔᎷᏣ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ ᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏚ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏘᏰᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Howano unitlisanvgi, ale taladu talutsa dunikalistanvgi uligvhaluyvhi hisgi utsalesdiiyusdi gadu nasgi unalisdayvnvhi unatiyelvhi.
english: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino na anisgaya, unigohv usquanigodi Tsisa dulvwisdanelvi, Hia nuniwesvgi; hia udohiyuhiya nasgi na Adolehosgi elohi uluhisdi tsigesvgi.
english: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏗᏂᎷᏥᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏗᏝᎥᏔᏂᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏗᎬᏩᏁᎵᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏦᏓᎸ ᏭᏣᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa udolehosv dinilutsisvgi ale digvwaditlavtanisv ugvwiyuhi nvdigvwanelisvi, udanvsvgi taline tsodalv wutsasvgi uwasv gesvi.
english: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏒᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Usvno nulistanv, gvwasdawadidohi vdalv wunilosvgi;
english: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᏅᎩ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏚᏂᏐᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎷᏤᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsiyuhi unatsanvgi Gequani iditlv widunisohistanvgi.  Ale Hnaquo ulisigvgi, ale Tsisa vtla yunilutsehei.
english: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏃᎸᏅ, ᎥᏓᎵ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Utsatino unolvnv, vdali dalisdilanegvgi.
english: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᎭᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩᎭ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᏂᎦᏪᎸ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏥᏗᏒᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoihano ale nvgiha iyutlilodv unigawelv, unigohvgi Tsisa vdali gadui aisvgi, ale tsiyuhi nav ulutsidisvgi.  Ale anisgaihvgi.
english: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴᏉ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno hia niduweselvgi; Ayvquo, tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi.
english: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏳ ᏭᏔᎳᏗᏨᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏅᏔᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsiyuhi degvwadanilvtsvgi; gilaquono iyvdv tsiyu wutaladitsvgi nahna unanvtawadisvi.
english: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎢᏍᎪᎾ ᏅᏛᏂᏙᎾᎢ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎵ ᏥᏳ ᎾᏔᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏦᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏂᏚᎵᎪᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎢ;^
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno unitsati vdali isgona nvdvnidonai, unadolehosv nvwadali tsiyu natalvna gesvi, nasgi na uwasv gvwasdawadidohi unatsotanvhi, ale Tsisa niduligonelvna gesv gvwasdawadidohi tsiyuhi unatsanv, ale gvwasdawadidohi unvsv unanigisvi;^
english: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏂᏗᎬᏩᏓᎴ ᏥᏳ ᏓᏈᎵᏯ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏂᏅᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᎸᎩ ᎾᎥᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎢ^
phonetic: Udohiyuhisgininonv nidigvwadale tsiyu Daquiliya nidodayuninvstanvhi duninolvgi navi nahna Ugvwiyuhi ulihelitsvi ale unalisdayvnvi^
english: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎾᎿᎭᏁᏙᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᎰᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏚᎾᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏆᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᏂᏲᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo unitsati unadolehosv Tsisa nahna nedohvna gesvi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadihohi, nasgi nasquo tsiyuhi dunatsanvgi, ale Gequani unilutsvgi, aniyohvgi Tsisa.
english: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎥᏓᎵ ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᎳᎪ ᎢᏳ ᎠᏂ ᏣᎷᏤᎢ?
phonetic: Gvwawadvhvno vdali isgoniditlv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, hilago iyu ani tsalutsei?
english: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏍᎩᏲᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏥᎪᎲᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏚ ᏕᏥᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏦᎸᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa dunetselv hia nuwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Sgiyoha vtla yinvdigalisdodiha usquanigodi digalvwisdanedi itsigohvi, nvdigalisdodiquosgini gadu detsigvi, ale detsolvsvi.
english: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ ᎢᎬᏂᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏛ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yiditsilvwisdanehesdi itsiwadvdiyi alisdayvdi ayoli, nasgisgini na alisdayvdi alisquadisgi nigesvna digesvi igvnidv tsigi, nasgi yvwi Uwetsi itsinedi tsigi, nasgiyeno Unelanvhi Agayvlige usdayidv.
english: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏛᏁᎵ ᏙᏓᏲᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gado dayotsadvneli dodayogilvwisdaneli Unelanvhi utseliga digalvwisdanedi gesvi?
english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Hia nasgi na digalvwisdanedi Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi etsoiyudiyi nasgi na nvdayunvsidv.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᏗᏱ?  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gadono usdi uyelvdv hinanugowisga, nasgi ogigowadvdiyi ale itsvyoiyudiyi?  Gado usdi detsalvwisdaneha?
english: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎹᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ; "ᏕᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ."
phonetic: Digigayvligei mana analisdayvdisgvgi inagei, nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela; "Deanehvgi gadu unigisdi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi."
english: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎼᏏ ᏱᏥᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏁᎭ ᎦᏚ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Vtla Mosi yitsinele nasgi na gadu galvladi nvdayudalenvhi; Edodasgini itsineha gadu udohiyuhiya galvladi nvdayudalenvhi.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᏚ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ Ꭰ'ᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno utseliga gadu nasgi hia galvladi nvdayulosvhi tsigi, ale gvnidv a'nehi tsigi elohi.
english: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏍᎩᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, nigohilv sginehesdi nasgi hia gadu.
english: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ.  ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲᏏᏐᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏔᏕᎪᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Ayv nasgi na advnidisdodi gadu.  Gilo agilutsehesdi vtla uyosisodi yigesesdi, ale gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi vtla utadegodi yigesesdi.
english: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛᎲ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ale hia nitsvweselvgi; Sgigowadvhv aseno vtla yitsohiyuhvsga.
english: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎬᎩᎷᏤᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nigadv Edoda digikanelvhi ase dagvgilutseli; ale nasgi na agilutselvhi ase vtla tsinugowisdi yigi.
english: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏠᎣᏒ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Galvladiyeno diquatloosv, vtla aquvsv gadanvtesgv digilvwisdanediyi, adanvtesgvisgini nasgi na nvdvginvsidv.
english: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏗᎦᎴᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nusdi adanvtesgv Agayvligei nasgi nvdvginvsidv, nasgi nigadv digiyohiselvhi gesvi, gohusdi agiyohusedi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, digaledodiyisgini ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nusdi adanvtesgv Agayvlige nvdvginvsidv, nasgi gilo agowatisgi Uwetsi, ale nasgi gohiyuhvsgi, nalisquadisgvna gvnidv utseliga iyulisdodiyi; ale nasgi ayv dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏛᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwagonelohiselvgi nvdagalisdodisgvgi hia nuwesvi, ayv nasgi na gadu galvladi nvdadvlosvhi.
english: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᏱᎩ, ᏦᏩ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᏗᏗᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᎩ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏛᏆᏠᎠᏒᎯ, ᏣᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia nasgi na Tsisa yigi, Tsowa uwetsi, nasgi udoda ale utsi didigatahi tsigi?  Gadono ulisdotanv, galvladi nvdvquatloasvhi, tsadiha?
english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎪᏁᎶᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa unetsvgi hia niduweselvgi; Tlesdi yitsigonelosgesdi.
english: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎬᎩᎷᏥᏏ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏎᏒᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo yeli yvgvgilutsisi, gvni Agayvligei nvdvginvsidv usesvdv yigi; ale ayv nasgi dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏱ; "ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ."  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nigvnv gowela anadolehosgiyi; "Ale nigadv Unelanvhi tsuweyonvhi gesesdi."  Nasgi iyusdi nigadv unadvganelvhi ale unadeloquaelvhi Agayvligei, gvgilutsehoi.
english: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv gilo Agayvligei ugohvhi yigi, na uwasv Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi; nasgi ugohvhi Agayvligei.
english: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Aquohiyuhvsgi uha alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ayv nasgi na gadu advnidisdodi.
english: I am that bread of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎹᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ;
phonetic: Ditsigayvligei mana analisdayvdisgvgi inagei, ale duniyohusv;
english: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏲᎱᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nusdi gadu galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nasgi gilo yugv vtla yvgvyohuhi.
english: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᏨᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏫᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏙᏛᎩᏲᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ayv nasgi na gadu gvnidv galvladi nvdayulosvhi.  Iyuno gilo agisgesdi nasgi hia gadu, alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnesdi.  Ale nasgi na gadu tsvdatsineli nasgi ayv agiwiya, nasgi tsidodvgiyosi elohi udvnidisdodi.
english: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏚᎾᏘᏲᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᎩᎲᏏ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏫᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi unvsvquo dunatiyolvgi, hia nuniwesvgi, Gado yigalisdoda hia asgaya yigihvsi uwasv uwiya igalisdayvdodi?
english: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪ ᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏥᎬᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏫᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᎲ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvwe seha; Iyuno nitsigvna yvwi Uwetsi uwiya, ale ugigv itsaditahv yigi, vtla gvnidv yitsiyaa.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏓᏥᏯᎴᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Agiwiya agisgi, ale agigigv aditasgi, gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna utseliga, ale nasgi ayv dodatsiyaletani ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏫᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Agiwiyayeno udohiyusv alisdayvdi, ale agigigv udohiyusv aditasdi.
english: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Agiwiya agisgi, ale agigigv aditasgi, nasgi agiyaa, ayv ale nasgi tsiyaa.
english: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎬᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiyai gvnidv Agayvligei aginvsidv tsigi, ale Agayvlige tsinvdigalisdodiha ayv tsigvnv, nasgiyai ayv aqualisdayvdisgi nasgi ayv nvdigalisdodisgesdi gvnesdi.
english: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎦᏚ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎹᎾ ᏣᏂᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia na gadu galvladi nvdayulosvhi; vtla nasgiya ditsigayvligei mana tsanigisgei, ale nasgi tsuniyohusvhi tsigi; hia gadu agisgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnesdi.
english: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎨᏆᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi digalawiisdiyi, dadeyohvsgv Gequani.
english: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎦᎪ ᏰᎵ ᏯᏛᎬᎦ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi unitsadvgi gvwasdawadidohi unadvganv, hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia asdayiyu kanohedv; gago yeli yadvgvga?
english: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏦᏕᏍᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa tsudanvdv udolehosv gvwasdawadidohi unigonelosgvi, hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo nasgi hia detsodesdiha?
english: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᎾᏃ ᏰᏥᎪᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏳᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏓᎴᏅ ᏱᏬᎶᏒ?
phonetic: Iyunano yetsigov yvwi Uwetsi yulisaladanv nahna tsudalenv yiwolosv?
english: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Adanvdosgini adadvnidisgi; uquedali vtla gvwadasdelvdi yigi.  Kanohedv ayv tsitsvwonediha nasgi adanvdo, ale nasgi gvnidv.
english: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ.  ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno itsadasuya nitsohiyuhvsgvna.  Tsisayeno didalenisgv nidagataho nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna, ale nagatahoi nasgi na utludisgi iyulisdodi.
english: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎬᎩᎷᏥ, ᎬᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nasquo nuwesvgi; Nasgi iyusdi hia tsinitsvweselvgi; vtla gilo yvgvgilutsi, gvni Edoda unelvhi yigi.
english: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏁᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nahiyu iyudalenvdv unitsadv gvwasdawadidohi unatsvsvgi, ale vtla hnaquo ilvhiyu yunedolei.
english: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏛᏣᏓᏅᏏ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselv taladu iyanidv; Tsigo nasquo nihi dvtsadanvsi?
english: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏮᏓᏲᏥᎶᏏ?  ᏂᎯ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago tsuwolv wvdayotsilosi?  Nihi tsasquanigodi kanohedv alisquadisgi nigesvna advnidisdodi.
english: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Ale otsohiyuhvsga, ale otsigataha nihi nasgi Galonedv gesvi, gvnidv Unelanvhi Uwetsi.
english: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏥᏛ ᏱᏨᏯᏑᏰᏎᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi.  Tlasgo nihi taladu itsidv yitsvyasuyesei?  Aseno asiyvwi udasuya asgina igi.
english: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᏛᎬᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎨᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi nuwesv Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi atsidvgvgi; nasgiyeno utludisgi iyulisdodi gesvgi, taladu iyanidv gesv nahna gela gesvgi.
english: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎾᏁᎶᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv Tsisa Gelili uwedolvgi; Vtlayeno yudulisge Tsudiyi uwedasdiyi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi Anitsusi ananelodisgv gvwahisdiyi.
english: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ-ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Anitsusi degalitsodvitsunalisdayvdiyi usqualvhidisvgi.
english: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏫᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Analinvtlino hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hadanvna, ale Tsudiyi wilohi, nasgino getsasdawadidohi nasquo anigohvha nusdv detsalvwisdanehvi.
english: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏯᏛᏂᏏ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gilo atsigatahi iyulisdodiyi tsudulisgoi udelidv yidulvwisdanehoi.  Iyuno nasgi hia hnadvnehesdi, elohi gvnigesv niyadvnisi.
english: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Analinvtliyeno nasquo vtla yigvwohiyuhvsgei.
english: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᎸᎡᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla asi yagisqualveha; nihisgini nigohilvquo itsisqualvehoi.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is always ready.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎦ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Elohi vtla itsisgagi yinvgalisda; ayvsgini agisgaga, nvdigalisdodiha tsitsinoheha nasgi dulvwisdanehv uyoiyu gesvi.
english: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏤᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎠᏴ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏓᎨᏏ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Nihi dodinalisdayvhvsgv itsena; vtla asi ayv dodinalisdayvhvsgv yvdagesi; vtlayeno asi yagisqualvelv.
english: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ ᎨᎵᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia niduweselv, asiquo uwedolvgi Gelili.
english: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᏅᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏗᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno analinvtli unenvdv nigesoi, hnaquo nasquo dodinalisdayvhvsgv uwenvsvgi, vtla gvnigesvi, udelidvquosgini iyusdi.
english: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏲᎸᎩ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwayolvgi danalisdayvhvsgvi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Hatlv nasgi edoha?
english: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏛᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏓᎾᎵᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎥᏝ, ᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᏉ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Utsadvno udelidv danalinohelidohvgi yvwi nasgi gvwanohesgvi; igadvyeno hia naniwesgvgi; Osiyu asgaya; igadvno, vtla, degalonuhequo yvwi, anadisgvgi.
english: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏳᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla gilo gvnigesv yunohesgei, udagalisdodisgvgi daninayesgv Anitsusi.
english: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎵᏒ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏕᏲᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ayeli iyvdv aliyeilisv danalisdayvhvsgvi Tsisa udvnvdigalawiisdiyi uyvlvgi, ale dudeyonvgi.
english: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏗᏏᎾᏏᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᏧᏕᎶᏆᎥᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
phonetic: Anitsusino unisquanigosvgi, ale nuniwesvgi; Gado ulisdotanv hia asgaya goweli disinasiyu tsigi, tsudeloquavhino nigesvna?
english: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Tsisa dunetselvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Tsidegadeyohvsga, vtla aquatseliga yigi, utseligasgini nvdvginvsidv.
english: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo udulisgesdi nasgi nusdv udulisgv tsulvwisdanediyi, ase udolehohisdi nasgi hia tsidegadeyohvsga Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesesdi, ale tsiwonisgv aquvsvquo aquadanvtelvhi igesesdi.
english: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏥᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏲᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏓᏑᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo uwasv udanvtedv tsigawonisgoi, uwasvquo atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi uyohoi; gilosgini nvdayunvsidv atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi tsuyohoi, nasgi duyugodv gesoi, ale vtla atlonasdi gesv yudasuyoi.
english: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎼᏏ ᏱᏥᏁᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎭ.  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Tlasgo Mosi yitsinele dikahnawadvsdi?  Aseno vtla gilo yudasuya dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yinadvneha.  Gadono itsaduli sgiisdiyi?
english: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎠ; ᎦᎪ ᎤᏚᎵ ᏣᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Unitsati uninetsvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Asgina tsayaa; gago uduli tsahisdiyi?
english: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᏂᏥᎥᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Sudalegi dagilvwisdanelv, nitsivno itsisquanigosga.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏁᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᎡᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎰ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Mosi ahusdesdi gesv itsinelvgi; vtlasgininonv Mosi unanugowisvhi yigi, anigayvligesgini uninanugowisvhi; nihino unadodaquasgvno ietsiusdeseho asgaya.
english: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᏯᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎭ, ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᏍᎩᏍᎦᎦ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏥᏥᏅᏩᏅ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ?
phonetic: Iyuno asgaya unadodaquasgv iga yatsiusdeseha, yinvdigalisdodiha dikahnawadvsdi Mosi utseli uyoisdi nigesvna gesvi, tsigo isgisgaga nvdigalisdodiha asgaya nigv ayelv tsitsinvwanv unadodaquasgv iga?
english: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᎧᏂᏍᎬᏉ ᏱᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi detsakanisgvquo yiditsugodisgesdi, duyugodvsgini detsugodisgesdi.
english: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎵ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Hnaquono igadv Tsilusilimi anehi hia nuniwesvgi, Tlasgo nasgi na hia yigi tsunaduli unihisdiyi?
english: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏃᏎᎭ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gvniyuquono nasgaihvna gawoniha, ale vtla gohusdi yanoseha.  Tsisa unigvwiyuhi udohiyuhi anigataha nasgi udohiyuhiya Galonedv gesvi?
english: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎬᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno idigataha hia asgaya tsudalenvi, Galonedvsgini galutsvha vtla gilo yigvgatahesdi tsudalenvi.
english: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏍᎩᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏯᎩᎷᏨ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa uwelunvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi dadeyohvsgvi, hia nuwesvgi; Sgigataha, ale nasquo itsigataha diquadalenvi; ale vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv yagilutsv, nvdvginvsidvsgini duyugodvi, nasgi netsigatahvna tsigi.
english: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini tsigataha, nahnayeno nvdvquadalenvhi, ale nasgi diginvsv.
english: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗᏱ:  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏏᏔᏕᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏄᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unadanvtelvgi gvwaniyvdiyi:  aseno vtla gilo yusitadei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi asi nusqualvelvna gesvi.
english: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏙᏓᏳᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ?
phonetic: Ale unitsadvgi gvwohiyunvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Galonedv galutsvha, tsigo utli igai usquanigodi dodayulvwisdaneli, esgaquo hia nasgi tsidulvwisdanelv?
english: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏓᎾᎵᏃᎮᎵᏙᎲᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᏅᏒᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aniqualisi unadvganvgi unitsati nasgi gvwanohesgv udelidv danalinohelidohvi.  Ale Aniqualisi nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi duninvsvgi dinadaniyisgi nasgi wuniniyvdiyi.
english: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏮᏛᏥᎶᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Asi tlega itsvyeladidoha, hnaquono nvdvginvsidv tsuwolv wvdvtsilosi.
english: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏍᎩᏯᏠᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᏫᎨᎥ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Sgiyohesdi, aseno dasgiyatlotsi; ale wigev vtla yeli wiyvgetsilugi.
english: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᏮᏓᎦᎶᏏ, ᎦᏰᏗᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ?  ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏍᎪ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᏙᏛᏩᏛᎮᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏙᏓᎨᏲᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nidunadaweselvgi, Hatlv wvdagalosi, gayediwadvdi nigesvna igesesdi?  tsunadalenvdvsgo yvwi danewadisv unadigaleyotsvhi dodvwadvhesi, ale widodageyoni tsunadalenvdv yvwi?
english: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒ; ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏍᎩᏯᏠᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎨᎥᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ?
phonetic: Gado gadvga hia tsinuwesv; Sgiyohesdi aseno dasgiyatlotsi, ale wigevi vtla wiyvgetsilugi?
english: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏩᎩᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏗᏔ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino iga, nasgi galvquodi iga gesv danalisdayvhvsgvi, Tsisa dulenvgi ale uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi; Iyuno gilo utadegisgesdi, ayv wagilutsi, ale wadita.
english: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏉᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎨᏰᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎪᏪᎵ.
phonetic: Gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi, usquoliyi degananugogesdi equoni gvnidv ama degeyesdi; nasgiya tsinigawe Goweli.
english: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᏪᏛᏨᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesv, uwedvtsvgi Adanvdo, nasgi gvwohiyuhvsgi getsinedi gesvi; tlayeno asi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo yigananugogei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi Tsisa asi natsilvquodisgvna gesvi.
english: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi unitsadv yvwi nasgi hia unadvganv, hia nuniwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya hia nasgi na Adolehosgi.
english: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᎵᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Hia nasgi Galonedv.  Aseno igadv hia nuniwesvgi; tsigo Galonedv Gelili nvdayunanugoisdi?
english: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪᎭ?  ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᏱ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo Goweli hia yinigaweha?  Galonedv Dewi unetlvtanvdv gesv unanugoisdi, ale Gaduyi gaduhvi Dewi udenvi?
english: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tali nunadadvgi yvwi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi gvwasdvdisgvi.
english: So there was a division among the people because of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏏᏔᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Ale igadv unadasuyvgi unadulisgvgi gvwaniyvdiyi; aseno vtla gilo yusitadei.
english: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏴᎡᏣᏘᏃᎦ?
phonetic: Hnaquono dinadaniyisgi gvwanilutselvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniqualisi.  Hiano niduniweselvgi; Gadono tla yvetsatinoga?
english: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎬᏩᏬᏂᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Dinadaniyisgi uninetsv hia nuniwesvgi; Vtla ilvhiyu gilo yigvwawoniso nasgiya hia nigawesgv gawonisgvi.
english: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Aniqualisi uninetsv hia niduniweselvgi; Tsigo nihi nasquo etsilonuelv?
english: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅ?
phonetic: Tsigo gilo nunigvwiyusv ale Aniqualisi gvwohiyunv?
english: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ.
phonetic: Hiasgini yvwi dikahnawadvsdi nanigatahvna tsigi getsisginvdvhi.
english: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ,^ᏥᏌ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎸᎩ,^ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Nigadimasi,^Tsisa svnoyi ulutselvhi, nasgi gelvgi,^nasgi hia niduweselvgi;
english: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏗᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎰ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎦᏛᎦᏁᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigo digikahnawadvsdi duwugodaneho gilo asi nagadvganelvna tsigesoi, ale dulvwisdanehv adolehosvhi nigesvna tsigesoi?
english: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎮᎯ?  ᏣᏲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsigo nasquo nihi Gelili hehi?  Tsayoga ale hagasayasda, tlayeno Gelili unanugoisdi yigi adolehosgi.
english: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏫᏙᎤᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nigadvno dotsunenvsv widounilosvgi.
