english: And every man went unto his own house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎵᏩᏲᎢ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏬᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano uliwayoi odalv wolosvgi.
english: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎥᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ; ᎤᏪᏅᏃ ᏑᏪᏲᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Sunalequono taline udvnvdigalawiisdiyi ulutsvgi; ale nigadv yvwi vgvwalutselvgi; uwenvno suweyonvgi.
english: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎲ ᎠᏥᏂᏴᏛ; ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏂᎧᏅ,
phonetic: Dinowelisgino ale Aniqualisi gvwatinohelvgi ageyv adayonehv atsiniyvdv; ayelino unikanv,
english: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎲ ᏕᎦᏅᎬᎢ ᎠᏥᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nigvwaweselvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, hia ageyv adayonehv deganvgvi atsiniyvhvgi.
english: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎼᏏ ᎣᎩᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏅᏯ ᏗᎨᎬᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎦᏙ ᎭᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Ka, Mosi oginetselvgi dikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi iyunasdi nvya digegvnisdodiyi; aseno nihi gado hadiha?
english: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᏌᏛᎥᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏄᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛᎩ, ᎦᏰᏌᏛᏃ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuniwesvgi anisadvvsgvgi, unuhisdodiyiquo uniyelvsvgi.  Aseno Tsisa udisadadvgi, gayesadvno uwatanvgi uwowelanvgi gadohi.
english: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏱᎵᏒ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏥᏃᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᏓᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᏅᏯ ᏫᎬᏂᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Asiquono aniyilisv gvwadvdvhvsgv udatsinohistanvgi hia niduweselvgi; Gilo udasuyesdi usganvtsvhi nigesvna nasgi igvyi widadalenvda nvya wigvnisda.
english: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛ, ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno udisadadv, gadohi uwowelanvgi.
english: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏛᏂᏛ ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨ ᏚᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎩ, ᎣᏂᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv, ale tsunadanvdo gvwanuhistanv, uninugotsvgi saquo udvnidv udanilige dudalenvtanvgi, oniyi wigvwadvnvgi; Tsisano uwasv nulistanvgi, ageyvno ayeli gadogvgi.
english: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏓᏥᏃᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎭᏢ Ꮎ ᎨᏧᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᏱᏕᎫᎪᏓ?
phonetic: Tsisano udatsinohistanv, ale ageyvquo uwasv ugohv, hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv, hatlv na getsuhisdisgi?  Tlasgo gilo tsasganvtsvi yidegugoda?
english: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ.  ᏥᎮᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏱᏣᏍᎦᏅᏤᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; Vtla gilo, Tsagvwiyuhi.  Tsisano hia nuweselvgi; Vtla nasquo ayv tsasganvtsv yidigugodiha.  Tsihena, ale tlesdi ilvhiyu hnaquo yitsasganvtsesdi.
english: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᏥᏐ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏯᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏱᎦᏰᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Alewo Tsiso duwonetanvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Ayv elohi iga tsiyatisdanehi; gilo agisdawadegesdi vtla ulisigv yigayedohesdi; advnidisdodisgini iga utseliga gesesdi.
english: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏨᏒᏉ ᎭᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏙᎯᏳᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Aniqualisi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsvsvquo hadanoheha, hinohesgv vtla yudohiyuha.
english: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᎦᏓᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᏎ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Aquvsvquo nasquo yigadanoheha, ase tsinohesgv udohiyuha; tsigatahayeno diquadalenvi ale witsigadvi.  Nihisgini vtla yitsigataha diquadalenvi ale witsigadvi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᏧᏬᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nihi detsugodisgo uquedaliquo tsuwogododi gesvi; ayv vtla gilo yiditsiyugodanehoi.
english: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ, ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏑᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno nasquo yidigugodiha, daquegotanv suyugodv yigi.  Vtlayeno aquvsvquo yigi, Agayvligeyeno nvdvginvsidv oginaligoha.
english: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo gowela ditsikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi anitali uninohelvhi gesv udohiyuhiya gesvi.
english: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᏓᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏃᎮᎭ.
phonetic: Ayv aquvsv gadanohesgi, Agayvligeno nvdvginvsidv nasquo ayv aginoheha.
english: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏙᏓ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎮ ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Hnaquo hia nvgvwaweselvgi, Hatlv Tsadoda?  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla ayv yisgigataha, ale vtla yetsigataha Edoda.  Iyuno ayv yisgigatahei, nasquo yetsigatahe Edoda.
english: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏱ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎤ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏳᏍᏆᎸᎡᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi Tsisa adelv disquanigodiyi, nahiyu dadeyohvsgv udvudigalawiisdiyi; ale vtla gilo yuniyvhei, vtlayeno asi yusqualvehei.
english: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏓᎦᏓᏅᏏ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa taline hia niduweselvgi; Dagadanvsi, nihino sgiyohesdi, ale ase asgani gesv dodatsiyohusi, ale witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilugi.
english: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏛᏓᎵ?  ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nuniwesvgi, Tsigo uwasv dvdali?  Hia tsinigaweha; Witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilugi.
english: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎠᏴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ.  ᏂᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Nihi eladi itsadalenvhi; ayv galvladi nvdvquadalenvhi.  Nihi ani elohi itsadalenvhi; ayv vtla ani elohi aquadalenvhi yigi.
english: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏏ; ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏂᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvwesi; ase getsisganiquo gesv dodatsiyohusi; iyuyeno nitsohiyuhvsgvna igesesdi ayv nasgi gesvi, ase getsisgani gesv dodatsiyohusi.
english: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪᏂᎯ?  ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎰᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gagonihi?  Tsisano hia niduweselvgi; Nasgiquo tsitsvyosehoi, udohiyuhiya nasgiquo.
english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᏃᎮᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Utsati gohusdi agiha itsvyosedi, ale ditsvyugodanedi; aseno nvdvginvsidv duyugodvi; ayvno elohi tsinoheheha nasgi nusdv tsiyadvganelvi.
english: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla yunolitse Agayvlige gadvgv nasgi degawonedisgvi.
english: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏓᏣᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏙᏓᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏇᏲᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Yvwi Uwetsi etsisaladanvha, hnaquo datsadolehosi ayv nasgi gesvi, ale aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv gohusdi nidagilvwisdanehvna gesvi, Edodaquosgini aqueyonv nasgi tsinohesgvi.
english: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏋᏕᏨ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ.
phonetic: Nvdvginvsidv oginaligoha; Agayvlige vtla yaquvdetsv, nigohilvyeno dagilvwisdaneho osdv uyelvdi.
english: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Asiquo nasgi hia nigawesgvgi, unitsadv gvwohiyunvgi.
english: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquo Tsisa hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi gvwohiyuhvsgi; Iyuno detsikahnawadisesdi aginetsvi, udohiyuhiya sgisdawadidohi gesesdi.
english: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎦᏙᎥᏏ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏃ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Ale datsigadovsi duyugodvi, duyugodvno nidetsinatlavna nvdatsvneli.
english: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏙᎩᎾᏢᏃᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏅᏓᏰᏨᏁᎵ, ᏣᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Gvwanetselv hia nigvwaweselvgi; Ayv Equahami unetlvtanvdv, ale vtla ilvhiyu gilo yidoginatlvnoi, gadono nidetsinatlavna nvdayetsvneli, tsadiha?
english: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa dunetselv hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Gilo tsasganvgoi asgani unatlai gesoi.
english: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᎦᏅᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Atsinatlaino vtla adanelv nigohilv ehi yigesoi; Aganvgisgini nigohilv ehoi.
english: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno Aganvgi nidetsinatlavna yinitsvnelv udohiyusv nidetsinatlavna yigi.
english: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏫᎾᏴᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsigataha nihi Equahami unetlvtanvdv gesvi; aseno itsaduli sgiisdiyi, nvdigalisdodiha tsinegv detsadanvdv winayvhihvna gesvi.
english: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏁᎪᎢ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎲ ᎢᏥᏙᏙᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nusdv agigohv Edodoyi nasgi tsinegoi; nihino nusdv itsigohv itsidodoyi nasgi nitsadvnehoi.
english: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Equahami ogidoda.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno nihi Equahami tsuwetsi yigi, Equahami tsulvwisdanedi gesv yiditsilvwisdaneha.
english: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ.
phonetic: Aseno itsaduli sgiisdiyi ayv duyugodv itsvnonelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi tsiyadvganelvhi gesvi; vtla nasgi yinadvnehe Equahami.
english: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᎡᎭ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Itsidoda tsulvwisdanedi gesv detsilvwisdanehoi.  Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; vtla udelidv dinisinvhi oginanugotsvhi yigi; saquo eha Ogidodanasgi Unelanvhi.
english: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᏱᎩ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱᏰᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛᏯᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᏗᎩᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno Unelanvhi Itsidoda yigi, sgigeyuiyu yigi; Unelanvhiyiyeno diquadalenv agilutsilv; ale vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedvyagilutsilv, diginvsvsgini.
english: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᏦᎵᎦ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏛᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono tla yitsoliga tsiwonisgvi?  Nvdigalisdodisgini tsinegv yeli getsadvgodi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎯᎯ ᏂᎨᏐ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏪᎭ.  ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏉ ᎧᏁᎪᎢ; ᎦᏰᎪᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsidoda asgina nvdatsadalenvhi nihi, ale itsidoda uyo dulvwisdanehv itsadvnediyi itsaduliha.  Nasgi yvwi dihihi nigeso didalenisgvi, ale udohiyuhi gesv vtla yidukahnawadvsei, vtlayeno udohiyuhi gesv yuweha.  Gayegogi kanegi utseligaquo kanegoi; gayegogiyeno nasgi, ale ugayvlige gayegogi gesvi.
english: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏁᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno duyugodv tsinegv nvdigalisdodiha vtla yisgiyoiyuhvsga.
english: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ Ꮭ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Gago udasuya hia tsinitsadvnv gvnigesv igvwanedi agisganvtsvhi gesvi?  Iyuno duyugodv yitsinega, gadono tla yisgiyoiyuhvsga?
english: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesv nasgi advgisgo Unelanvhi kanegvi; nihi nitsadvgisgvna tsigi nvdigalisdodi Unelanvhi nvdatsadalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏲᏥᏁᎦ, ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎮᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎢ, ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎭ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi Uninetsvgi, hia nuniweselvgi; Tlasgo duyugodv yotsinega, Sameliyi hehi ale asgina tsayai, tsitsvyoseha?
english: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏯᎩᏯᎠ, ᏥᎸᏉᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏍᎩᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla asgina yagiyaa, tsilvquodiquosgini Edoda; nihino ayv gesgisotlvisdiha.
english: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᏲᎭ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏱ; ᎡᎭ ᎤᏲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yagiyoha aquvsv vgilvquodiyi; eha uyohi ale digugodisgi.
english: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Iyuno gilo asquanigodisgesdi tsinegvi, nasgi vtla ilvhiyu ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdi yigesesdi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏯᎥᎢ.  ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯᏪᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono anitsusi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hnaquo otsadolehohi asgina tsayavi.  Equahami uyohusv, ale anadolehosgi, nihino hia nihiweha; Iyuno gilo asquanigodisgesdi tsinegvi, nasgi vtla ilvhiyu ayohuhisdi gesv udolehosdi yigesesdi.
english: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎣᎩᏙᏓ, ᏧᏲᎱᏒ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ.  ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎭᏤᎸᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Tsigo nihi utli etsalvquodiyu esgaquo Equahami ogidoda, tsuyohusv?  Ale nasquo anadolehosgi duniyohusv.  Gago nihi hatselvsga?
english: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏱᎦᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏣᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno aquvsv yigadalvquodiha, vgilvquodiyu asequoquo yigi; Edodasgini agilvquodisgi, nasgi ayv Oganelanvhi tsitsadiha.
english: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏱᏚᏗᎭ ᏥᏰᎪᎩᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏣᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla yetsigataha, ayvsgini tsigataha; iyuno vtla yitsigataha yidudiha tsiyegogiquo yigi, nihi tsinitsasdi nasgiyai; aseno tsigataha, ale unetsv agisquanigodi.
english: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Itsidoda Equahami alihelisdi udugi uwasv ugowadvdiyi gohi gesv ayv gevi, ale ugohvgi ale osiyu udanvdadvgi.
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏣᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎪᎥᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nvgvweselvgi; vtla asi hisgisgohi itsadetiyvdv yigi; Tsisano higovhi igi Equahami?
english: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᎨᎣᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Asiquo Equahami nehvna tsigesvgi, Ayv nigeoi.
english: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏗᏍᎦᎳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᎦᏛᎴᏒᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nvya dunigisvgi, digvwanisdodi, aseno Tsisa udisgalanvgi, ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi unugotsvgi, ayeli anidonav ugadvlesvstanvgi, ale ulosonvgi.
english: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᏥᏌᏃ] ᎤᎶᏒ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏂᎨᏎ ᎤᏕᏅ.
phonetic: [Tsisano] ulosv ugohvgi asgaya, nasgi digewi nigese udenv.
english: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠᏍᎪ, ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᎨ, ᏗᎨᏫ ᏧᏕᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino gvwadvdvnvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, gago usganvtsei, hiasgo, tsugayvligeige, digewi tsudenei?
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Vtla hia yusganvtsv, vtla ale tsugayvligei; Unelanvhiquosgini tsulvwisdanedi gesv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nasgi agvdisgvi.
english: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ; ᏒᏃᏱ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ase digilvwisdanedi nvdvginvsidv tsulvwisdanedi gesv asiquo iga tsigi; svnoyi dayai, nahiyu yeli gilo digvwalvwisdanedi nigesvna.
english: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏥᏯᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nigohilv elohi gedohvi, ayv elohi iga gatsiyatisdanehi.
english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏥᏍᏋᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏥᏍᏋᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏝᏬᏔ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ,
phonetic: Nasgi nuwesv gadohi ulitsisquvgi, ale nasgi tlawota uwotlvtanvgi ulitsisquvhi, ale nasgi tlawota dunvliyedanelvgi digewi digadoli,
english: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎮᎾ ᏩᏙᏑᎵ ᏌᎶᎻ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ,^ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᏛᎦ.  ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏙᏑᎴᎥᎩ, ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuweselvgi; Hena wadosuli Salomi tsvdalvi,^nasgi anetlvtanvhi Atsinvsidv gadvga.  Uwenvsvgino ale wudosulevgi, ulutsvno agowatisgvgi.
english: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᏗᏂᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏚᎳᏗᏍᎬᎩ?
phonetic: Hnaquono na nav dininela, ale unigohidolvhi digewi gesvi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia nasgi yigi na tsuwolv ale tsaduladisgvgi?
english: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᏓᎾᏤᎸ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Igadv, nasgi, unadvnvgi; igadvno, danatselv unadvnvgi.  Uwasvsgini, Ayv nasgi, udvnvgi.
english: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi, Gado ulisdotane tigadoli dulisduisei?
english: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᎥ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᎶᎻ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ ᎮᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏙᏑᎵ; ᎠᏇᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏩᏆᏙᏑᎴᎢ ᏰᎵ ᎬᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Asgaya Tsisa tsidudov tlawota uwotlvnvgi, ale dunvliyev ditsigadoli; hiano nagiweselvgi; Salomi tsvdalvi hena ale wadosuli; aquenvno ale waquadosulei yeli gvgigowadvdi nulistanvgi.
english: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎡᏙᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏅᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Hatlv edoha?  Vtla yitsigataha, nvdvnvgi.
english: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Aniqualisi dunatinohelv nasgi digewi iyulistanvhi.
english: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏝᏬᏔ ᎤᏬᏢᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏒ.
phonetic: Unadodaquasgvno iga gesvgi Tsisa tlawota uwotlvnv ale digadoli dusduisv.
english: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏝᏬᏔ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᎥᎩ, ᎠᏆᏙᏑᎴᎥᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo Aniqualisi nasquo vgvwadvdvnvgi nulisdotanv gvwagowadvdi nulistanvi.  Hiano niduweselvgi; Ditsigadoli tlawota dunvliyevgi, aquadosulevgino ale itsigowatiha.
english: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎭ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ?  ᏔᎵᏃ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono igadv Aniqualisi hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia asgaya vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, tlayeno yasquanigodiha unadodaquasgvi.  Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Gado yigalisdoda yvwi asganai nasgi iyusdi usquanigodi yidulvwisdasi?  Talino nunadadvgi.
english: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ; ᎦᏙ ᏂᎯ ᎭᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ ᏥᏕᏣᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ?  ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno hia nuniweselvgi digewi; Gado nihi hadiha nasgi hinohesgvi tsidetsasduielv tigadoli?  Adolehosgi, udvnvgi.
english: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi vtla yanohiyuhvsge digewi iyulistanvhi gesv ale gvwagowadvdi nulistanvi, gvni widuniyanvhv tsugayvlige nasgi na gvwagowadvdi iyulisdanelvhi.
english: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏍᏕᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎩ ᏥᏍᏓᏗᎭ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎪᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᎭ?
phonetic: Dunadvdvnvgino, nasgi hia nuniwesvgi; Hiasgo nihi isdetsi, nasgi digewi udenvgi tsisdadiha?  Gadono ulisdotanv gohi tsagowatiha?
english: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎣᎩᏁᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎢ;
phonetic: Tsugayvlige duninetselv hia niduniweselvgi; Osdigataha hia oginetsi gesvi, ale digewi udenvi;
english: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ ᎪᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏍᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ.  ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏗᏃᎾ ᎤᏛᎾ, ᎡᏣᏛᏛᎲᎦ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎧᏃᎮᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno nvtsulisdotanvi gohi tsagowatiha vtla yosdigataha; ale ayv vtla yosdigataha nasgi na tsusduielvhi gesv digadoli.  Hnaquo adinona udvna, etsadvdvhvga, uwasv dakanoheli.
english: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏄᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi nuniwesvgi tsugayvligei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi danisgaihv Anitsusi; gayulayeno anitsusi tsunugotanvhi gesvgi, nasgi iyu gilo yunetsv nasgi galonedv gesv atsinugowisdiyi digalawiisdiyi.
english: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏛᎾ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᏣᏛᏛᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi tsugayvlige hia nuniwesv; Hnaquo udvna, uwasv etsadvdvhvga.
english: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline wuniyanvhvgi asgaya digewi iyulistanvhi; hiano nuniweselvgi; Hilvquoda Unelanvhi, ayv otsigataha nasgi hia asgaya asgana gesvi.
english: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unetsvgi hia nuwesvgi; Iyuno asgana yigi vtla yitsigataha; sudalegi tsigataha; ditsigewi tsigesvgi hnaquo itsigowatiha.
english: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᏨᏁᎴ ᏕᏣᏍᏚᎢᎡᎴ ᏘᎦᏙᎵ?
phonetic: Hnaquono taline hia nuniweselvgi; Gado tsvnele detsasduiele tigadoli?
english: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏛᏓᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unetsv hia niduweselvgi; gayula itsvnonelv, aseno vtla yitsadvdastanei; gadono itsaduli taline itsadvgodiyi?  Nasquosgo nihi itsaduliha etsisdawadidohi itsalisdodiyi.
english: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎼᏏ ᎣᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gagvwanisotlvtanvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Nihi nasgi hisdawadidohi, ayvsgini Mosi otsisdawadidohi.
english: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Otsigataha Unelanvhi Mosi uwonetanvi; nasgini hia vtla yotsigatahatsudalenvi.
english: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; Ꮀ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᏥᏓᎩᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏗᏥᎦᏙᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi asgaya unetsv hia niduweselvgi; Ho usquanigodiyu nasgi, nitsigatahvna tsigi tsudalenvi, ano tsidagisduielv ditsigadoli.
english: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏓᏛᎦᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Idigatahayeno Unelanvhi nidadvganehvna gesv anisganai, iyusgini gilo Unelanvhi adadolisdanehi yigi, ale nasgi adanvtesgv iyadvnehi yigi, nasgi advganehoi.
english: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎦᏛᎦᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎨᏫ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv vtla yigegadvgano gilo dusduielv digadoli digewi udenvhi.
english: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuno hia nasgi asgaya Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna yigi, vtla yeli gohusdi yidogvwalvwisdasi.
english: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᎲᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏕᏅᎩ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᎩᏰᏲᎲᏍᎦ?  ᎥᎬᏩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; nvhvi asgani gesv tsadenvgi, Tsigono ayv isgiyeyohvsga?  Vgvwanugowisvgino.
english: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎢ; ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ?
phonetic: Tsisa udvganvgi gvwanugowisvi; uwadvhvno hia nuweselvgi; Hiyoiyuhvsgasgo Unelanvhi Uwetsi?
english: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Nasgi unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gago nasgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, nasgi tsiyoiyudiyi?
english: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎪᎥᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏣᎵᏃᎮᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Higovhi, ale nasgi na tsitsalinohediha.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩᏃ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Goiyuhvsga, Tsagvwiyuhi; udadolisdanelvgino.
english: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏬᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano hia nuwesvgi; Diwogododiyi agiyelvha elohi agilutsilv, nasgi na nanigowatisgvna unigowadvdiyi, ale nasgi na anigowatisgi dinigewi iyunalisdodiyi.
english: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏥᎨᏫ?
phonetic: Aniqualisino edohv anedohi nasgi unadvganvgi, ale hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsigo nasquo ayv tsotsigewi?
english: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏥᎨᏫ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎢᏣᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏃᎯᏯᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Iyuno ditsigewi yigesei vtla yigetsisganvgei, aseno otsigowatiha itsadiha; nasgi nvdigalisdodiha itsisganahiyu gesv alinohiyasga.
english: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nasgi na galohisdiyi ayvsdisgi nigesvna awi uninodena uniyvsdiyi, utsatiniquosgini galvsdisgi, nasgi ganosgisgi ale adanasahvsgi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na galohisdiyi ayvsdisgi nasgi awi uninodena digatiya.
english: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᎡᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ ᎠᏫ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏘᏂᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi galohisdiyi agatiya usduiehoi, ale awi anadvgisgo kanegvi, ale dunadov dayanisgo awi tsutseliga, ale datinisvsgini deganugowisgoi.
english: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏩᏃ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏫ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏓᎴᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪᎢ; ᎠᏃᎵᎪᏰᏃ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Deganugowano tsutseliga awi, igvyi dalenehoi, ale awi gvwasdawadegoi; anoligoyeno kanegvi;
english: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ, ᎠᎾᎵᎡᎰᏉ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏃᎵᎪ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadalesgini vtla yvgvnisdawaduga, analiehoquo, vtlayeno yanoligo nvwanadale aninegvi.
english: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia datlilosdv Tsisa duwonetanvgi; aseno vtla yunolitse nasgi nusdv duwonetanvi.
english: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha, Ayv galohisdiyi awi unatseliga.
english: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏫ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᎾᏛᎦᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadv igvyi unilutsvhi ayv oni, nasgi aninosgisgi ale anadanasahvsgi.  Aseno awi vtla yigvwanadvganelei.
english: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏴᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ  ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᏄᎸᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galohisdiyi ayv; Iyuno gilo ayv agiyvsdisgesdi, ase  atsisdelvdi gesesdi, ale uyvsdi ale unugoisdi gesesdi, ale uwadvdi gesesdi ganulvsvi.
english: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏐᎢ:  ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ganosgisgi galugoi, unosgisdiyiquo ale udahisdiyiquo uyelvsoi:  Ayv agilutsilv, gvnidv unatseliga iyulisdodiyi, ale utsatanvhi unatseliga itsvlisdodiyi.
english: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ.  ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏁᎰ ᎠᏫ.
phonetic: Ayv aquadanvti awiditsigatiya.  Udanvti awidigatiya gvnvi eladi daneho awi.
english: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏩᏯ ᏣᎢᏒᎢ ᏩᎪᏩᏛ, ᏕᎬᏕᎪ ᎠᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏩᏯᏃ ᏕᎦᏂᏱᏍᎪ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᎪ ᎠᏫ.
phonetic: Atsinvsidvsgini, awidigatiya nigesvna, ale awi tsutseliga nigesvna, waya tsaisvi wagowadv, degvdego awi ale alitisgoi; wayano deganiyisgo ale dadigaleyasgo awi.
english: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎵᏘᏍᎪᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Atsinvsidv alitisgoi nvdigalisdodisgo atsinvsidvquo gesvi.
english: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎭ,
phonetic: Ayv aquadanvti awiditsigatiya; ale detsigataha diquatseliga, ale diquatseliga gvgigataha,
english: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏣᎩᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᎭ ᎠᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgiya Agayvlige tsagigataha, ale ayv Agayvlige tsitsigataha.  Ale gvnv eladi detsineha awi.
english: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏓᎩᎧᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏯᏂᏯᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏙᏓᎦᏘᏃᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᏅᏛᎾᎵᏍᏔᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ.
phonetic: Ale nunadale awi dagikaha, nasgi vtla hia uniyvsdiyi yaniyaa; nasgi nasquo ase dodagatinoli, ale dvnadvgani tsinegvi; ale sunadatlugi nvdvnalistani; ale saquo gesesdi awidigatiya.
english: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎳᏗ ᏥᏥᎥᏍᎦ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᎩᎩᏏᏐᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎭ.
phonetic: Eladi tsitsivsga gvnvi nasgi taline agigisisodi tsigi nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Agayvlige agigeyuha.
english: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᏛᎩᎩᎡᎵ, ᎠᏋᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏥᏂ.  ᎠᎩᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎬᎩᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᎩᎩᏏᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo yvdvgigieli, aquvsvquosgini aquadanvtedv eladi datsini.  Agiha yeliquo eladi gvgidi gesvi, ale agiha yeliquo gvgigisisodi gesvi.  Nasgi hia nusdi Edoda aginetselv.
english: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline tali nunadadvgi Anitsusi nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi nuwesvi.
english: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᏃᏘᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Unitsadvgino unadasuyvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Asgina uyaa, ale ulvnotiha; gadono ietsadvdasdaneha?
english: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᏥᎧᏁᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏯᎢ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏓᏍᏚᎢᏏ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ.
phonetic: Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Nasgi hia tsinigawe tsikanega vtla asgina uyai uneisdi yigi; tsigo asgina yeli yidasduisi digewi digadoli.
english: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᎦᎸᎲ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyino uninvgalvhv danalisdayvhvsgvgi Tsilusilimi, ale gola gesvgi.
english: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano edohvgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, Solimanv utseliga ayodatlahvi.
english: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎳᎪ ᏅᏓᎪᎯᏥ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi gvwadatluwistanvgi, hia nigvwaweselvgi; Hilago nvdagohitsi sgiyeliisdisgesdi?  Iyuno nihi galonedv gesesdi, sginohvsi duyugodvi.
english: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ.  ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏚᏙᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi hia duniweselvgi; Itsvnonelvgi, aseno vtla yisgiyoiyunei.  Digalvwisdanedi tsidagilvwisdaneha Edoda dudosdvi, nasgi gvnigesv naquvneha.
english: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nihisgini vtla yitsohiyuhvsga, nvdigalisdodiha nihi awi diquatseliga nigesvna gesvi, nasgiya tsinitsvweselvgi.
english: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏫ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪᎢ,
phonetic: Awi diquatseliga anadvgisgo tsinegvi, ale ayv gatsigataha, ale gvnisdawadegoi,
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᏥᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᏆᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv gatsinehoi, vtlano ilvhiyu tsuniyohuhisdi yigi, ale vtla gilo diquasugalvdodi yigi.
english: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏗᎬᏩᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi na Edoda digikanelvhi utli ulinigidiyu Esgaquo nanivi, vtlano yeli gilo Edoda digvwasugalvdodi yigi.
english: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ.
phonetic: Ayv Edodano saquoquo.
english: I and my Father are one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi taline nvya dunigisvgi digvwanisdodi.
english: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏚᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎤᏣᏔ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏥᏕᏍᎩᏴᏂᏍᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi hia duniweselvgi, Utsata osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv edodoyi nvdayudalenvhi gvnigesv nitsvyvnelv; Gado usdi nasgi digalvwisdanedi agisdvdia nvya tsidesgiyvnisdiha?
english: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᏍᏛᏓ ᏅᏯ ᏱᏙᎨᏨᏴᏂᏍᏓ, ᎯᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ, ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏣᏤᎸᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Anitsusi uninetsv hia nvgvwaweselvgi; osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv vtla yvgetsasdvda nvya yidogetsvyvnisda, hisotlvisdisgvsgini, nihi yvwiquo tsigi Unelanvhi tsatselvsga.
english: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂ ᎬᏅ ᏱᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎩ?
phonetic: Tsisa dunetselvgi; tlasgo hia yini gvnv yigowela ditsikahnawadvsdiyi; nihi itsvnelanvhi, aquadvnvgi?
english: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ,
phonetic: Iyuno itsanelanvhi tsuwoselvhi yigi, kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga getsinetselvhi, ale goweli uyoisdi nigesvna yigi,
english: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎯᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎡᏦᏎᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ "ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ" ᏥᎦᏛ?
phonetic: Tsigo hisotlvisdiha ietsoseha Agayvligei ulvquotanvhi ale elohi uluhisdiyi unvsidv, nvdigalisdodiha "Ayv Unelanvhi Uwetsi" tsigadv?
english: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏅᎩ
phonetic: Iyuno Edoda utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv nidagilvwisdanehvna igesesdi, tlesdi sgiyoiyunvgi
english: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ
phonetic: Iyusgini nasgi utseli yidagilvwisdaneha, nasquo ayv nisgiyoiyuhvsgvna yigi, ase itsohiyuhvsgesdi nasgi na digalvwisdanedi gesvi; nasgino yeli getsadolehohisdi ale getsohiyudi yigi Agayvligei, agiyavi ale nasgi ayv tsiyavi
english: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏗᏫᏎᎸᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi taline unanelotanvgi gvwaniyvdiyi; aseno dudiwiselvgi,
english: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏦᏓᏂ ᏍᎪᎾ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᏣᏂ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏚᏓᏬᎥᎢ.  ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Tsodani sgona wulosvgi, nahna Tsani igvyiyi dudawovi.  Nahnano uwedolvgi.
english: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏂ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏃᎮᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsadvno gvwalutselvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Tsani vtla usquanigodi yidulvwisdanehei, aseno nigav Tsani nuwesv unohelv hia nasgi asgaya, udohiyuhiya gesei.
english: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ
phonetic: Nahnano unitsadv gvwohiyunvgi
english: And many believed on him there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ, ᎳᏏᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏇᏗᏂᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎺᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎹᏗ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgaya utlvgvgi, Lasila tsudoidv, Quediniyi ehi, Meli ale ulvi Madi uniduhvi.
english: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎺᎵ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᏧᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬ ᏧᏩᏔᏁ ᏥᏚᏅᎦᎸᎡᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏙ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi Meli atlonedi tsulonetane Ugvwiyuhi, ale ustiyegv tsuwatane tsidunvgalvele tsulasideni, nasgi nvdo Lasila utlvgvgi.
english: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᏙ ᏓᏳᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏛᎪᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏢᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsudo dayunadanvsvgi udvgodi, hia nvdayuniwesvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, gvniyuquo higeyui tsigi utlvga.
english: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏢᎦᎥᏝ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano udvganv hia nuwesvgi; Hia nasgi tsutlvgavtla uyohuhisdi yigi, atsilvquododiyiquosgini Unelanvhi, nasgino Unelanvhi Uwetsi atsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳᎨᏒᎩ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎳᏏᎳ.
phonetic: Tsisano tsugeyuhiyugesvgi Madi ale ulvi ale Lasila.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎤᏢᎬᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᏏ ᏔᎵ ᏅᎤᏙᏓᏋᎩ.
phonetic: Udvganvno utlvgvi, nahna edohvi asi tali nvudodaquvgi.
english: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏫᏗᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Onino hia niduweselvgi gvwasdawadidohi; Taline Tsudiyi widilohi.
english: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎪᎯᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ ᏅᏯ ᏗᎨᏨᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏔᎵᏁᏍᎪᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏮᏛᎯᎶᏏ?
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tadeyohvsgi, vtla yigohigi Anitsusi unanelotanvgi nvya digetsvnisdodiyi, talinesgono nahna wvdvhilosi?
english: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏏᎦ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi; Tlasgo taladu iyutlilodv yigi siga?  Iyuno gilo iga tsedohoi, vtla yiduwodehihoi, nvdigalisdodisgo agowatisgv iga ani elohi dulvsadvi.
english: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏃᏱ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏚᎸᏌᏓᏕᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini enoyi tsedohoi, duwodehihoi, nvdigalisdodisgo iga nidulvsadadehvna gesvi.
english: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᎦᎵᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᎨᏏ, ᏮᏓᏥᏰᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi; hnaquono hia nuduweselvgi; Lasila igalii galiha; aseno dagesi, wvdatsiyestani.
english: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᎭ ᏓᏳᏗᏩᏏᏉ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohino hia nuniwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno yigaliha dayudiwasiquo.
english: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎦᏛᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏥᏌ:  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᎦᎵᎲᏉ ᏦᏯᏪᏐᎵᎰ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno uyohusv gadvgvgi nasgi nuwesv Tsisa:  nasgisgini na agalihvquo tsoyawesoliho gadvga unelisvgi.
english: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ;
phonetic: Hnaquono gvnigesv Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Lasila uyohusv;
english: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏂᎨᏙᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏗᏩᏛᎱᎦ.
phonetic: Ale osiyu agiyelvha nahna winigedohvna tsigesvgi, nihi nvdigalisdodiha, itsohiyudiyi.  Aseno ediwadvhuga.
english: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᎻ, ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏕᎾ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒᎭ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Dami, Didima tsudoidv, hia niduweselvgi unaligohi anadasdawadidohi, Nasquo ayv idena, ayohusvha igatloyastanvha.
english: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏙᎴᎱᏒᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏅᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏉᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa ulutsv udolehusvgi gayula nvgi tsudodaquodv gvwaninvnvhi gesv atselisdvi.
english: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏇᏗᏂᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᎭᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi Quedinino gaduhv Tsilusilimi nav gesvgi, talihaquo iyutlilodv.
english: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᏄᏬᎯᏍᏔᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᏙ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale unitsadv Anitsusi gvwanilutselvgi Madi ale Meli gvwaninuwohistanilvgi unido uyohusv iyusdi.
english: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎹᏗ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏉ ᏥᏌ ᏣᎢᏒᎢ ᏫᏚᏠᏒᎩ.  ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏉ ᎬᏬᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Madi udvganvquo Tsisa tsaisvi widutlosvgi.  Melisgini galitsodequo gvwolvgi.
english: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎮᏙᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᏲᎱᏎ ᎥᎩᏙ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Madi ale nuweselvgi Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno ani yihedohei, vtla yigvwayohuse vgido.
english: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏣᏁᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno tsigataha nasquo gohi gesv nigav gohusdi yitayoselv Unelanvhi, tsanediquo gesv Unelanvhi.
english: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᏙ ᏙᏛᎠᎴᎯᏌᏂ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Etsado dodvalehisani.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏙᏗᎴᎯᏌᏂᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Madi hia nuweselvgi; Tsigataha dodilehisanisv dilehisodi gesv ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ.  ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Ayv dilehisodi gesv ale gvnidv.  Gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi, iyu nasquo uyohusvhi yigi, gvnesdi.
english: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ?
phonetic: Gilono gvnesdi ale aquohiyuhvsgesdi, vtla ilvhiyu uyohuhisdi yigesesdi.  Hohiyuhvsgasgo nasgi hia?
english: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nuweselvgi; Vv, Tsagvwiyuhi; goiyuhvsga nihi Galonedv gesvhi, Unelanvhi Uwetsi, nasgi elohi uluhisdi tsigesvgi.
english: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏭᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎺᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏯᏂᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv udanvsvgi, ale udelidv wuyanvhvgi ulvi Meli, hia nuwesvgi; Dideyohvsgi galugi ale ditsayaniha.
english: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᏱᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi udvganv yilaquo iyvdv dulenvgi, ale wulutselvgi.
english: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏱᎦᎷᎨ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎹᏗ ᏫᏚᏠᏒ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano vtla asi yigaluge gaduhvi, nahnaquosgini Madi widutlosv edohvgi.
english: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎤᏪᎸ ᎠᏂᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎺᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᎦᏂᏌᎲ ᏩᎦᏘ ᎾᎿᎭᏮᏛᏍᎪᏂᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi galitsode uwelv anini, ale gvwanuwohisdisgi, unigohv Meli ulisdiyu dulenv ale unugotsv gvwasdawadvsvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Diganisahv wagati nahna wvdvsgonili.
english: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂ ᏱᎮᏙᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᎩᏙ ᏱᎬᏩᏲᎱᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Melino ulutsv Tsisa edohvi, ale ugohv, dulasgv eladi udanvnvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, iyuno ani yihedohei, vtla vgido yigvwayohusei.
english: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏙᎸᎯ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv datloyihvi, ale dugohv Anitsusi nasgi unisdawadolvhi danatloyihvi, ehisdi udanvdadvgi, ale udeyadodi nulisdanelvgi.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎭᏢ ᎡᏥᏅᏁᎢ?  ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎡᎭᎦᏔ, ᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuwesvgi; Hatlv etsinvnei?  Tsagvwiyuhi, ehagata, gvwoselvgi.
english: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᏚᏠᏱᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa dutloyilvgi.
english: Jesus wept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nuniwesvgi; Gvniyuquo nigae ugeyuhiyu gesei.
english: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏂᏌᏁ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎾ ᏱᎦᎨᏎ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
phonetic: Igadvno unadasuyvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Tlasgo hia digewi digadoli tsusduielvhi, nasquo nasgi yinigvwanisane nuyohusvna yigagese hia asgaya?
english: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.  ᎤᏍᏓᎦᎸ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏚᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisano taline ehisdi udanvdadv atselisdv ulutsvgi.  Usdagalv gesvgi, ale nvya asdudvgi.
english: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᏅᏯ ᎢᏥᎲᎾ.  ᎹᏗ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏒᎦ, ᏅᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏒᎭ ᎦᏰᏥᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuwesvgi, Nvya itsihvna.  Madi uyohusvhi udo, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gohi ase asvga, nvgiyeno nusvha gayetsinisanvhi.
english: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎬᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo hia yinigvweselei; iyuno hohiyuhvsgesdi, tsagowadvdi gesesdi galvquodiyu gesv unelanvhi utseliga.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏂᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎦᏅᎢ.  ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎬᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏥᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nvya unihvsgi uyohusvhi ganvi.  Tsisano dusaladanvgi digadoli, hia nuwesvgi; Edoda, gvyalielitseha tsisquadvganelv.
english: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂ ᏣᏂᏙᎾᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᏫ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsigataha nigohilvi squadvganehvi; aseno yvwi ani tsanidonaa nvdagalisdoda nasgi tsinitsiwi, unohiyudiyi nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
english: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎡᎯᏄᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, asdaya uwelunvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Lasila, ehinugoi.
english: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏚᏓᎸᏍᏛᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏓᎸᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ, ᎤᎧᏛᏃ ᎠᏯᏠ ᎤᏓᎸᏍᏛᎩ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᎸᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏥᏲᎯ.
phonetic: Uyohusvhino dayunugotsvgi, tsuwoyeni ale tsulasideni dudalvsdvgi digalvdalvdv dinuwo, ukadvno ayatlo udalvsdvgi.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Etsalvsv ale tsetsiyohi.
english: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎺᎵ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale unitsadvgi unadasuyvgi Anitsusi Meli gvwalutselvhi, ale unigohvhi nasgi Tsisa nudvnelvi, gvwohiyunvgi.
english: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏗᏂᏅ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏂᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Igadvsgini Aniqualisi dininv wunilosvgi, ale widuninonelvgi Tsisa nudvnelvgi.
english: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏉᎵᏏ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏓᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniquolisi dunilawidvgi, ale hia nuniwesvgi; Gado idadvneha?  Hiayeno asgaya utsata usquanigodi dulvwisdaneha.
english: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏰᏕᎵᏎᎭ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏓᎬᏬᎯᏳᏂ, ᎠᏂᎶᎻᏃ ᏛᏂᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎨᎩᎩᎡᎵ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎨᎩᏯᏅᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi unelagi yedeliseha, nigadiyu dagvwohiyuni, Anilomino dvnilutsi ale dagegigieli igatseligohi ale digatseli yvwi dodagegiyanveli.
english: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏓᏑᏴᎩ, ᎧᏱᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ,
phonetic: Asiyvwino udasuyvgi, Kayiqua tsudoidv, nahiyu udetiyvsadisv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gesvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Vtla gohusdi yitsigataha,
english: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎨᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏓᏲᎱᎯᏎᎭ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏯᎾᏗᏒᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ale vtla yitsadanvteha utli osiyu igegalisdanedi gesvi, asiyvwi gilo yidayohuhiseha yvwi, ano unitsati unvsv yanadisvhvsga.
english: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏧᏲᎱᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ,
phonetic: Nasgi nuwesvgi, vtla uwasv udanvtedv yigesei; nahiyu atsilvgelohisgini gesv iyusdi udetiyvsadisv udolehosvgi Tsisa tsuyohuhisediyi nasgi sunadalegi gesv yvwi,
english: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏪᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Ale vtla nasgi na sunadalegi gesv unvsv, nasquosgini saquo itsuwanediyi tsuwetlisodiyi unadigaleyotsvhi Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
english: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nahiyu unalenvhvgi uninohelvgi unihisdiyi.
english: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏚᏪᎳᏗᏙᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎢᎾᎨ ᎾᎥ ᏭᎶᏅᎩ, ᎢᏆᎻ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏪᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa hnaquo vtla ilvhiyu gvnigesv yiduweladidole Anitsusi; nahnasgini unigisvgi, inage nav wulonvgi, Iquami dudov digaduhvi, ale nahna uwenvgi ale gvwasdawadidohi.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒᎩ; ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Anitsusino unatseliga kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi usqualvhidisvgi; unitsadvgino nahna unanigisvgi Tsilusilimi wunilosvgi asiquo nasqualisgvna kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi, unadanvgalvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
english: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏓᎦᎷᏥ?
phonetic: Tsisano uniyolvgi, ale udvnvdigalawisdiyi anidonav hia nidunadaweselvgi; Gado itseliha?  Tlasgo danalisdayvhvsgv yvdagalutsi?
english: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusvno atsilvanelohi ale nasquo Aniqualisi uninetsvhi gesvgi, iyuno gilo yagataha edohvi, gvnigesv iyuwanediyi, uniniyvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
english: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏃᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᏇᏗᏂ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎲ ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏚᎴᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono sudali iga dunosvgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi usqualvdiyi Tsisa Quedini wulutsvgi, nahna ehv Lasila, uyohusvhi tsigesvgi, nasgi uyohusv tsiduletanvgi.
english: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎹᏗ ᏚᏕᎳᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎳᏏᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᎸᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nahna gvwasdayvnvgi; ale Madi dudelastanvgi; Lasilasgini gelvgi analisdayvhvsgvi.
english: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎺᎵ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ ᏑᏓᎨᏛ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎾᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ ᏚᏅᎦᎸᎲᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ.  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎩ ᎦᏩᏒᎬ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Meli ugisvgi sudagedv atlonedi nada tsudoidv gohusdi nasuyvna, utsati tsugvwalodi, ale dunvliyevgi Tsisa tsulasideni, ale ustiyegv uwatanvgi dunvgalvhvgi tsulasideni.  Ale galitsode ukalitsvgi gawasvgv atlonedi.
english: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono asiyvwi Tsisa gvwasdawadidohi gesv Tsudasi Isgaladi tsudoidv, Sawani uwetsi, nasgi utludisgi iyulisdodi, hia nuwesvgi;
english: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏧᏈ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᏩᎶᏗ ᏱᏚᏂᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏚᏂᏁᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Gadono hia atlonedi vtla yuninadinvse ale tsoitsuqui agisi tsunawalodi yiduniwadvhei, ale vtla uyo iyunadvhnadegi nasgi yiduninelei?
english: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ ᎦᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi, vtla uyo iyunadvhnadegi osdv iyunalisdanediyi udulisgv yinvtsulisdotanei, ganosgisgisgini gesv nvdayulisdotanvgi, ale degalodi ganehvi ale nahna galanvhi ganosgisgvi.
english: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᎩ; ᎥᎩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Unelagi; vginisodiyi gesv iga gvdisgi usquanigotanv nasgi hia.
english: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏱᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Uyoyeno iyunadvhnadegi nigohilv getseladidoha; ayvsgini vtla nigohilv yitsvyeladidoha.
english: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Unitsadvgino Anitsusi unadvganvhi gesvgi nahna edohvi, ale unilutsvgi vtla Tsisa uwasv gesv yinvtsulisdotanei, nasquosgini Lasila unigowadvdiyi uniyelvsvgi, nasgi uyohusv tsuletanvhi.
english: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᎳᏏᎳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Aseno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi uninohelvgi Lasila nasquo unihisdiyi,
english: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏫᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nuwanisanvgi unitsadvgi Anitsusi unadanvsvgi, ale Tsisa wigvwohiyunvgi.
english: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏥᎷᏥᎵᎻ ᏗᎦᎷᏥᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ugitsvdv unitsadvgi yvwi dilisdayvdiyi unilutsvhi, unadvganv Tsilutsilimi digalutsisvi,
english: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏧᏪᏲᏔ ᏧᎦᏄᏓᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏚᎾᏠᏒᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎰᏌᎾ!  ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏚᏙᏍᏛ ᏨᏓᏯᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Duniyvhvgi tsuweyota tsuganudanvhidv ale uninugotsvgi dunatlosvsvgi, ale hia nuniwesv unelunvgi, Hosana!  Atsilvquodiyu winigalisda Yihowa dudosdv tsvdayai, Ugvwiyuhi Isili unatseliga.
english: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ, ᎤᎩᎸᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ;
phonetic: Tsisano uwadvhv agina soquilidigalianvhidv, ugilvnvgi, nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela;
english: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏌᏯᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏯᎢ, ᎠᎩᎾ ᏐᏈᎵ-ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎩᎸᏗ."
phonetic: "Tlesdi yisgaihesdi nihi Sayani uwetsi, gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi tsatseliga dayai, agina soquilidigalianvhidv uwetsi ugilvdi."
english: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏃᎵᏤ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ, ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvwasdawadidohi vtla nasgi tsanolitse igvyiyi, Tsisasgini atsilvquotanv hnaquo unanvdadvgi nasgi hia nigvnv gowelv atsinohesgvi, ale nasgi nigvwanelvi.
english: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎳᏏᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ, ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Itsulahano unedolvhi yvwi nahiyu atselisdv wuyanvhv Lasila, ale uyohusv deuletanv, uninohelvgi.
english: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏒᎩ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi nasquo yvwi degvwatlosvgi, unadvganvgiyeno nasgi usquanigodi dulvwisdanelvi.
english: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᏂᏣᎵᏰᎢᎴᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Aniqualisi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Itsadolehosgasgo nitsaliyeilegvna tsigi?  Gvniyuquo elohi usdawadenv.
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi anigoi anelvgi unalidolistanilvhi dilisdayvdiyi.
english: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᏇᏣᏱᏗ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi gvwalutselvgi Quiligi, Quetsayidi gaduhv Gelili ehi, ale gvwatayoselvgi hia nuniwesvgi, ogaduliha otsigowadvdiyi Tsisa.
english: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ ᏭᏃᏁᎸᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏂᏃᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Quiligi ulutsvgi ale Enidi wunonelvgi; hnaquono Enidi ale Quiligi Tsisa wuninonelvgi.
english: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisano dunetselvgi hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo usqualvhv yvwi Uwetsi atsilvquododiyi.
english: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏬᏨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎪᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎪᎯ ᎤᏣᏙ ᎧᏁᏉᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Iyuno saquo utsalesdi ugata eladi nuwotsvna ale nugosvna yigi, uwasvquo geso nigohilvi; iyusgini ugohi utsado kanequogoi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gilo ugeyusesdi gvnvi uyohusedi gesesdi; gilono asgagesdi gvnvi ani elohi gesvi, nasgi usquanigododi gesesdi gvnidv winasdvna digesv gvdisgi.
english: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎨᎥᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo tsinvsidasdi nigalisdisgesdi, nasgi agisdawadegesdi; gevno nahna nasquo tsinvsidasdi ehesdi.  Iyuno gilo tsinvsidasdi nigalisdisgesdi, nasgi Edoda ulvquododi gesesdi.
english: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎭ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᎦᏛᏂ?  [ᎯᎠᏍᎪ ᏅᏓᏥᏪᏏ,] ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏍᏊᏓᎳᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏣᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡ ᎪᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ.
phonetic: Hnaquo aquadanvdo udeyataneha; gadono dagadvni?  [Hiasgo nvdatsiwesi,] Edoda, squudalagi gohi gesvi?  Aseno nasgi iyusdi tsagisqualve gohi agisqualvediyi agilutsilv.
english: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏳᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏥᎸᏉᏔᏂ.
