phonetic: Edoda, hilvquoda detsadovi.  Hnaquono galvladi dayunetsvgi, hia nvdayuwesvgi; gayula agilvquotanv, ale taline dvtsilvquotani.
english: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᏴᏓᏆᎶᏣ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏳᏬᏁᏓ.
phonetic: Yvwino nav anidonai unadvganv, ayvdaqualotsa, unadvnvgi.  Igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Dikahnawadidohi dayuwoneda.
english: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᎯᎠ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎦ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv, hia nuwesvgi; Vtla ayv gesv yinvdagalisdoda, nihisgini gesv nvdagalisdoda, hia kanegv tsigananugotsiga.
english: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏙᏓᏰᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquo hia elohi dodayegugodaneli, hnaquo ugvwiyuhi hia elohi utseliga dayetsinugowisi.
english: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᎩᏌᎳᏓᏅᎭ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏙᏓᎦᏎᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno iyuno elohi vgisaladanvha, naniv yvwi dodagasesvhi.
english: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏛᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi, nasgi iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi gadvgvgi.
english: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎡᎲᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏰᏥᏌᎳᏓᏂ ᎢᎭᏗᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ?
phonetic: Yvwi uninetsv hia nigvwaweselvgi, Ayv ogadvganv dikahnawadvsdiyi nasgi Galonedv ulisquadisdi nigesvna ehvi; Gadono yvwi Uwetsi ase dayetsisaladani ihadiha?  Gago nasgi na yvwi Uwetsi?
english: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏏᏞᎦ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎢᏤᏙᎲᎢ; ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᎦ ᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏕᎲᎢ; ᎤᎵᏏᎩᎾᏏ ᏱᏧᏢᏓ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏤᏙᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Asitlega iga dulvsadv itsedohvi; itsedohesdi nigohilv iga detsilvsadadehvi; ulisiginasi yitsutlvda; giloyeno ulisigv tsedohoi, vtla yagataho wagadvi.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏕᎭ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏗᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Asi iga tsidetsilvsadadeha, itsohiyuhvga iga dulvsadvi, nasgino nihi iga dulvsadv tsuwetsi gesesdi.  Nasgi hia nuwesvgi Tsisa, ale udanvsvgi dudisgalanelvgi.
english: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Utsadisgininonv usquanigodi tsulvwisdanelvhi gesvgi anigatahvi, aseno vtla yigvwohiyunei.
english: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; "ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎸᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎧᏃᎨᏂ?"
phonetic: Nasgino udohiyunvgi unetsv Isaya adolehosgi, hia tsinuwesei; "Tsagvwiyuhi, gago uwohiyunv oginohelvi?  Ale gago atsinanugowiselv Ugvwiyuhi kanogeni?"
english: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᏔᎵᏁᏰᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusidi vtla yeli gvwanohiyudi yigesei; talineyeno Isaya hia nuwesei.
english: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᏚᏍᏚᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ; ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ."
phonetic: "Dusdunelv dinigadoli, ale dusdayidelv tsuninawi; digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna dinigadoli, ale gvwanolisdodi nigesvna uninawi, ale nasgi digvwanadanetliyvedi nigesvna, ale digagatsinvwodi nigesvna."
english: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎢᏌᏯ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏧᎪᎮ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᎮᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nuwese Isaya, nahiyu tsugohe galvquodiyu gesv utseliga, ale nasgi tsunohelei.
english: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏙᎩᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Unitsadvgisgininonv nasquo unigvwiyuhi gvwohiyunvgi; aseno Aniqualisi nvdagalisdodisgvgi vtla gvnigesv yinunvnelei, digalawiisdiyi yidoginugowa anelisgvgi.
english: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utliyeno uniyelvsvgi yvwi unadalvquododi gesv esgaquo Unelanvhi udalvquododi gesvi.
english: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏯᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisano uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi, Gilo aquohiyuhvsgi vtla ayv yaquohiyuhvsga, nvdvginvsidvsgini gohiyuhvsgoi.
english: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gilo ayv agigowatisgi nvdvginvsidv agowatisgoi.
english: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎤᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayv igagati elohi agilutsilv, nasgi gilo aquohiyuhvsgesdi vtla hnaquo ulisigv udedi yigesesdi.
english: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏗᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎵᎸ, ᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo advgisgesdi tsinegvi, nigohiyuhvsgvnano igesesdi, vtla ayv yiditsiyugodaneha; vtlayeno elohi yiditsiyugodanelilv, tsisdelvhilvsgini elohi.
english: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ ᏧᏬᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏪᎭ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Agisonvisdisgi ale didanilvgi nigesvna tsinegvi tsuwogodanehi uweha.  Kanohedv aginetsvhi nasgi tsuwogodanedi gesesdi ulisqualvdi iga gesesdi.
english: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv aginetsvhi yigi, Agayvligeisgini nvdvginvsidv, nasgi aginetselv iyagiwesdiyi agiwonihisdiyi.
english: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ.
phonetic: Ale tsigataha nasgi unetsvhi winasdvna gvnidv gesvi.  Nasgi iyusdi nigav tsinegvi, nasgiya Agayvligei nagiweselvi, nasgi nitsiwea.
english: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏃ ᎤᏃᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Asino unosvgi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi, Tsisa agatahiyu gesvgi usqualvelv ani elohi udanvsdiyi, Agayvligesdvyi wulohisdiyi, tsugeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi gesvgi tsutseliga elohi anehi, gvlisquadisgi tsugeyuhiyu gesvgi.
english: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅᏃ,
phonetic: asginano hnaquo ulanelvhi gesvgi unawiyi Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi nasgi ulonuhediyi, unalisdayvnonvno,
english: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏲᎯᏎᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Tsisa agatahiyu gesvgi Agayvligei nigav gohusdi deuyohiselvi; ale Unelanvhiyi nvdayudalenvhi gesvi, ale Unelanvhiyi wulohisdi gesvi,
english: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎢ ᏕᎤᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᎠᏄᏬ-ᏗᏑᎴᏗ, ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏔᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Ulisdayvnvi deulenvgi ale unuwesvgi, ale unesvgi anuwodisuledi, udatlostanvgi;
english: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏟᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎩ ᎠᏄᏬ-ᏗᏑᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono atelido ama utlistanvgi, ale ulenvhvgi duwosulelv gvwasdawadidohi tsunalasideni, ale dunvgalvelvgi anuwodisuledi nasgi udatlosdv uwatanvgi.
english: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏙᏓᏍᏉᏑᎴᎵ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Sawani Quida uwolv ulutsvgi.  Quidano hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsigo nihi dodasquosuleli diqualasideni?
english: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᏔᎭ, ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏘᎦᏙᎥᏏ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsv hia nuweselvgi; Hia tsinigadvneha vtla gohi gesv yigataha, onisgini tigadovsi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳᎯ ᏱᏙᏓᏍᏉᏑᎴᎵ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬᏲᏑᎴᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Quida hia nuweselvgi; Vtla ilvhiyuhi yidodasquosuleli diqualasideni.  Tsisa unetselvgi; Iyuno nigvyosulevna yigi vtla tsatseliga yudasuya aquatseliga gesvi.
english: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏕᏂᏉ ᏧᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᎪᎵ.
phonetic: Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla diqualasideniquo tsuwasv, nasquosgini diquoyeni ale tsisgoli.
english: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᏑᎵᏌᏛ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂᏉ ᏧᏩᏒ ᏧᏬᏑᎴᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᏂᎬᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Gilo udosulisadv tsigesoi tsulasideniquo tsuwasv tsuwosuledi gesoi; nigvno udanvgalvdv gesoi.  Ale nihi itsadanvgalvdv, aseno vtla nitsiv yigi.
english: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Agatahiyuyeno gesvgi nasgi na ulonuhesgi; nasgi iyusdi, Vtla nitsiv itsadanvgalvdv yigi, udvnvgi.
english: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎣᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎤᏄᏬᎥ; ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎤᏪᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏍᎪ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏨᏯᏛᏂᏏ?
phonetic: Hnaquono duwosuleonelv tsunalasideni, ale iunuwov; ale taline iuwenv, hia niduweselvgi; Itsigatahasgo hia nasgi tsinitsvyadvnisi?
english: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᏲᏎᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tadeyohvsgi, ale Tsagvwiyuhi, sgiyosehoi; ale duyugodv nitsiwesgoi, nasgiyeno nusdi.
english: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏱᏗᏨᏲᏑᎴᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏙᏑᎴᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno ayv Agigvwiyuhi itsatseliga ale Ditsvyeyohvsgi ditsalasideni yiditsvyosuleha, nasquosgini itsvsv itsalasideni yiditsadadosuleha.
english: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏨᏯᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsadeloquasdiyeno itsvvsi, nasgiya nitsvyadvnelv itsadvnediyi.
english: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Atsinatlai vtla utli atsilvquodiyu yigesoi, esgaquo unatlai; ale vtla atsinvsidv utli atsilvquodiyu yigesoi, esgaquo nvdayunvsidv.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏣᏓᏅᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi hia yitsigataha, Osiyu yitsadanvta nasgi yinitsadvneha.
english: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏱᏨᏯᏛᎦ; ᎦᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎦᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, "ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎦᏗᎨᏂ ᎠᏆᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ."
phonetic: Vtla nitsiv yitsvyadvga; gatsigataha gatsiyasuyedv gesvi; aseno udohiyudiyi gowelvi, "Itsulaha osdalisdayvhvsgi usaladanv gadigeni aquatludisgvi."
english: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo itsvnoneha, asiquo nasgi nulistanvna, nasgi hnaquo nigalistanvha itsohiyudiyi ayv nasgi gesvi.
english: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Gilo dadanilvgesdi tsinvsidv, ayv daquadanilvgesdi, gilono ayv daquadanilvgesdi, nvdvginvsidv dadanilvgesdi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᏛᎩᎶᏄᎮᎵ.
phonetic: Tsisa nasgi nuwesv udeyatanelv udanvdvi, ale gvnigesv nuwanelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiha hia nitsvweseha; hia tsinitsadvnv asiyvwi udasuya dvgilonuheli.
english: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᎧᎿᎭᏅᎩ ᎤᎾᏠᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏛᎦ ᎤᏁᎵᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi dunadakahnanvgi unatlogvgi nasgi atsidvga unelisdiyi.
english: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᏱ ᎦᏍᏛᎦᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino gvwasdawadidohi gesv Tsisa ganetsiyi gasdvgalvgi, nasgi Tsisa ugeyuhi.
english: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᎫᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏛᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino Quida nasgi ulisguwiselvgi udvdvdiyi nasgi gesvi gadvgvi.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᎢ ᎤᏍᏛᎦᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa ganetsii usdvgali hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago?
english: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏥᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏊᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏭᏅᏃ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎤᏁᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi; Nasgi gesesdi agvhalvdv tsinelvha nasgi aquunvhi gesesdi.  Uwunvno agvhalvdv unelvgi Tsudasi Isgaladi Sawani uwetsi.
english: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛᏃ ᎠᏥᏁᎸ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏴᏎᎸᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎳᏉ ᎿᎭᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Agvhalvdvno atsinelv Sedani uyvselvgi.  Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Nasgi itsadvnedi gesv nulaquo hnadvga.
english: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏅᏜᏓᎢ ᏳᏬᎵᏤ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlano gilo aninvdlai yuwolitse nusdv gadvgv nasgi nuweselvi.
english: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏰᏃ ᏕᎦᎶᏗ ᎦᏁᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᏂᎦᏪᏏ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏣᏩᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏙᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏘᎲᏏ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ.
phonetic: Tsudasiyeno degalodi ganehv nvdayulisdotanvgi igadv, hia Tsisa nigawesi unelisvgi; Gohusdi tsawahi dilisdayvdiyi gesv iyu gohusdi igvdodi; ale hia yigi; gohusdi tihvsi uyo iyunadvhnadegi.
english: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᎤᎩᏒ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi, agvhalvdv ugisv, gilaquo iyvdv unugotsvgi, ale svnoyi gesvgi.
english: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎬᏂᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgino unugotsv, Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo yvwi uwetsi atsilvquoda, nasgino nigvnisa Unelanvhi atsilvquoda.
english: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏂᏌᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏳᎸᏉᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏳᎸᏉᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi yinuwanisanv Unelanvhi yatsilvquotanv, Unelanvhi uwasv nvdagvnisani nasgi dayulvquotani, ale gilaquo iyvdv dayulvquotani.
english: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎠᏏ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ; ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ, "ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏫᏴᎨᏥᎶᎯ," ᏥᎦᏥᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli, asi tlega itsvyeladidoha; sgiyohesdi; ale nasgiya Anitsusi tsinigatsiweselvgi, "Witsigadv vtla wiyvgetsilohi," tsigatsiyoselvgi, nasgiya nasquo hnaquo nihi nitsvweseha.
english: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itse dikahnawadvsdi itsvvsi, ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi; Nasgiya itsvgeyuiyu nulistanvi, nasgi nasquo ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi naniv unadolehohisdodi gesesdi sgisdawadidohi gesvi, iyuno ditsadageyuhiyu yigi.
english: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎭᏢ ᎭᎢ?  ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏏ.
phonetic: Sawani Quida hia nuweselvgi, Tsagvwiyuhi, hatlv hai?  Tsisa unetselvgi; Witsigadv vtla hnaquo yvgesgisdawaduga; onisgini dasgisdawadesi.
english: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎬᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ?  ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏓᏥᏂ ᎬᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Quida hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gadono vtla yeli hnaquo gagvsdawadvsdi yigi?  Nihi nvdagalisdotani eladi datsini gvnvi.
english: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏘᏂ ᎲᏅᎢ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᏣᏔᎦᏨᏯᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏴᎳᏏ ᎬᏂ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏍᏆᏓᏱᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetselvgi; Tsisa ayv nvdagalisdotani eladi tini hvnvi?  Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Tsatagatsvyai vtla yvdvyvlasi gvni tsoi isquadayilvhi gesesdi.
english: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏕᏍᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdi itsadanvdo yudestanehesdi; etsoiyuhvga Unelanvhi, ale nasquo ayv sgiyoiyuhvga.
english: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Edoda ganelvi utsata dadanelv.  Iyuno nasgi nusdvna yigesei, yitsvnonelei.  Gadvnvistani itsiyvsdiyi.
english: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏯᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᏅ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏥᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᎸ ᏙᏓᏨᏯᏓᏂᎸᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuno yaquadvnvistanenv itsiyvsdiyi, taline dvtsilutsi ale aquvsv aquolv dodatsvyadanilvtsi, nasgi ayv gev nasquo nahna itsadediyi.
english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎦᏅᏅ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Ale ayv witsigadv itsigataha, ale wiganvnv itsigataha.
english: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏫᎦᏛᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏫᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Dami hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, vtla yotsigataha wigadvi; gadono yigalisdoda yotsigataha wiganvnvi.
english: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ.  ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏱᎦᎷᏤᎰᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎶᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Ayv nasgi nvnohi, ale duyugodvi, ale gvnidv.  Vtla gilo Agayvligei yigalutsehoi, gvni ayv agilohiselvhi tsigesoi.
english: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏔᎮᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏰᏥᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎪᏩᏛᎲ.
phonetic: Iyuno ayv yisgigatahei nasquo Edoda yetsigatahei; Gohino iyudalenvdv etsigataha ale etsigowadvhv.
english: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏍᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏰᎵᎦ ᏓᏲᏥᏰᎸᏂ.
phonetic: Quiligi hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, sginanugowisi Agayvligei, hnaquono yeliga dayotsiyelvni.
english: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᏂᎪᎯᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏁᏓ, ᎠᏏᏍᎪᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎦᏙᎥᏍᎦ, ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯᏪᎠ; ᏍᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsisa nigohigi itsulaha ineda, asisgono vtla yisgigadovsga, Quiligi; gilo ayv agigohvhi tsigesoi, ugohvhi geso Agayvligei; gadono hia nihiwea; Sginanugowisi Agayvligei?
english: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏲᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ?  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏨᏃᎮᎮᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏱᏥᏁᎪᎢ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Tlasgo yohiyuhvsga ayv Agayvligei tsiyavi, ale Agayvlige ayv agiyavi?  Kanohedv tsitsvnohehehoi, vtla aquvsvquo aquadanvtedv yitsinegoi, Agayvligeisgini tsagiyaa nasgi dulvwisdanehoi.
english: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏉ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Sgiyoiyuhvga ayv Agayvligei tsiyavi, ale Agayvligei ayv agiyavi, iyuno nisgiyoiyuhvsgvna igesesdi, dagilvwisdanehvquo winigalisdoda sgiyoiyuhvga.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᏉᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏓᏳᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏙᏓᏳᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎡᏙᏙᏱᏰᏃ ᎦᎢ,
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Aquohiyuhvsgi, ayv tsidagilvwisdaneha nasquonasgi dodayulvwisdaneli, ale utli usquanigodiyu dodayulvwisdaneli esgaquo hia; Edodoyiyeno gai,
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏉᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigavno gohusdi daquodov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi iyaquadvnedi gesesdi, Agayvligei atsilvquododiyi Uwetsi iyuwanisanvhi gesvi.
english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gohusdi daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi ase iyaquadvnedi.
english: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Iyuno sgigeyuiyu gesesdi, itsisquanigoda aquatseli dikahnawadvsdi;
english: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏥᏔᏲᏎᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎵ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᏥᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎯ,
phonetic: Ale Agayvlige ayv datsitayoseli, nasgino datsalisgolvdaneli nvwadale Itsinvwohisdisgi, nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna itseladidohi,
english: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏳᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏔᎭ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi na gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo, nasgi elohi digvwadanilvisdi nigesvna tsigi, nasgi yugowatiha ale vtla yugataha; nihisgini etsigataha, itseladidohayeno, ale nasgi itsiyaesdi.
english: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏓᏂᏯᏛ ᏴᏓᏨᏴᏕᏥ; ᏛᏨᎷᏤᎵ.
phonetic: Vtla itsadaniyadv yvdatsvyvdetsi; dvtsvlutseli.
english: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏ ᏞᎦ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎬᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Asi tlega, hnaquo elohi vtla yagigowatisgesdi, nihisgini sgigowatisgesdi, ayvyeno gvnv, ale nihi nasquo detsvnesdi.
english: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏓᏣᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyu datsadolehosi ayv Edoda tsiyavi, ale nihi sgiyavi, ale ayv itsvyavi.
english: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏥᏯᏛᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi na dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga usquanigodi ale dikahnawadegi, nasgi ayv agigeyuhi, ale ayv agigeyuhi ugeyuhi gesesdi Edoda, ale ayv tsigeyuiyu gesesdi, ale gvnigesv nvdatsiyadvneli.
english: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏛᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ?
phonetic: Tsudasi, vtla Isgaladi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gado dagalisdotani gvnigesv ayv nvdvsgiyadvneli, vtlano elohi?
english: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ; ᎡᏙᏓᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏲᏍᏗᎷᏤᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏓᏲᏍᏓᏁᎳᏗ.
phonetic: Tsisa unetsvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno gilo agigeyuhi yigi, nasgi tsukahnawadvsdi aginetsvi; Edodano ugeyuhi iyulisdodi, ale dayosdilutseli, ale ganelvi dayosdaneladi.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎪ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ.  ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏃ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Agigeyuhi nigesvna vtla yidakahnawadego aginetsvi.  Kanohedvno tsitsadvgia, vtla ayv aquatseliga yigi, agayvligesgini nvdvginvsidv utseliga.
english: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsvnohehelv asi tsitsvyeladidoha.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏓᏆᏙᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏤᏲᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Adanvwohisdisgisgini, galvquodiyu Adanvdo, nasgi Agayvligei nvdayunvsdi tsigi daquadosdvi, nasgi nigadv datseyoni, ale datsanvdadistani nigav itsvnetselvi.
english: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᎢᏯᏏ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎥᏏ.  ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏓᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᎥᏏ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏳᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nvwadohiyadv itsviyasi; nvwadohiyadv aquatseliga itsvvsi.  Vtla elohi tsadaneho nasgi iyusdi yitsvvsi; tlesdi itsadanvdo yudeyatanehesdi, ale tlesdi yasgaihesdi.
english: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏛᎨᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏛᏨᎷᏤᎵ, ᏥᏨᏲᏎᎸᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏱᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ ᏣᏆᏛᏅᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvhi, dvgesi ale dvtsvlutseli, tsitsvyoselvgi.  Iyuno sgigeyuiyu yigi, yitsaliheliga yinvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigati tsaquadvnvgi; Edodayeno utli atsilvquodiyu esgaquo ayv.
english: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏃᎲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono asiquo nasqualisgvna gesv itsvnohvsi, nasgi asqualvhvha itsohiyudiyi.
english: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏴᎨᏨᏯᎵᏃᎮᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏯᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏯᏇᎭ.
phonetic: Gohi iyudalenvdv vtla utsati yvgetsvyalinoheda; ugvwiyuhiyeno hia elohi utseliga dayai; vtlano gohusdi utseli yaqueha.
english: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏗᏣᎴᎲᎦ, ᎢᏕᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno elohi udolehohisdiyi Agayvligei tsigeyuiyu gesvi, ale Agayvligei aginetselvi nasgi nigadvnehvi.  Ditsalehvga, idena.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏖᎸᎳᏗᏯ ᎠᏴ, ᎡᏙᏓᏃ ᏗᎦᎶᎩᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Telvladiya ayv, Edodano digalogisgi.
english: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᏓᏋᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏕᎬᏂᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏂᎦᎷᏬᏍᎪᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nigav daquvnigalvi nanadadvvsgvna tsigeso degvnigalisgoi; nigadvno anadadvvsgi degvnigaluwosgoi utli igai unadadvdiyi uyelvsoi.
english: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquo nihi itsadanvgalvtanv kanohedv nasgi itsvnetselvhi tsigi.
english: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏯᎡᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏓᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏖᎸᎳᏛ ᏧᏩᏂᎦᎶᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏍᎩᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Sgiyaesdi, aseno itsvyaesdi.  Nasgiya uwanigalvi uwasv yeli gvwadadvdi nigesvna tsigeso gvni utelvladv tsuwanigaloi, nasquosgini nihi vtla yeliga gvni ayv yisgiyaa.
english: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏖᎸᎳᏛᎢ ᎠᏴ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᏂᎯ.  ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏙ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᎥᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏣᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Utelvladvi ayv, duwanigalvi nihi.  Ayv agiyai, ayvno tsiyai, nasgi utsado anadadvvsgoi.  Vtlayeno ayv vtla yeli gohusdi yvgetsadvga.
english: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎩᏯᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎦᏓᎡᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏂᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎡᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏴᏍᎪᎢ; ᏴᏫᏃ ᏓᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᏱᏃ ᏫᏚᎾᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎪᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nagiyavna tsigesoi, agadaegoi nasgiya uwanigalanvhi tsunadaegoi, ale gvyvsgoi; yvwino danitlisisgoi, atsilvyino widunadegoi, ale dagohvsgoi.
english: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏰᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno nihi sgiyaesdi, ale aginetsv itsiyaesdi, nigav itsadulisgv itsitayohihesdi, ale nasgi ase iyetsadvnedi gesesdi.
english: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏛᎥᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏓᏰᏥᎸᏉᏔᏂ; ᎰᏩᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Utsadv itsadadvvsgv nasgi nvdagalisdotani Edoda dayetsilvquotani; howano sgisdawadidohi gesesdi.
english: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏂᎯ.  ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Edoda agigeyuhiyu tsigi, nasgiya nasquo itsvgeyuiyu nihi.  Nvwasdidisesdiquo itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
english: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno yitsisquanigodi dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga, yinvwasdidiquo itsvgeyuiyu gesvi; nasgiya tsagisquanigotanv dikahnawadvsdi Edoda utseliga, ale tsinvwasdidiquo agigeyuhiyu gesvi.
english: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅ, ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᎬ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvwonetanv, nvwasdidisesdiquo gatsiyalieligv aquelisv, ale analiheligv ukalitsvhi gesesdi aquelisv.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdi aquatseliga hia nusdi, Ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya itsvgeyuiyu nulistanvi.
english: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎬᎪᎾᏛᏓ ᎤᎵᎢ ᏗᏲᎱᎯᏎᎯ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo udageyuhiyu gesv yvgvgonadvda ulii diyohuhisehi.
english: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nihi ayv igalii, iyuno nigav itsvnetsehv yinitsadvneha.
english: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᎾᏞᎢ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
phonetic: Gohi iyudalenvdv vtla itsvnvsidasdi yitsvyoseha; atsinvsidasdiyeno vtla yagataho unatlei nadvnehvi.  Nihisgini igalii itsvyoseha; nigavyeno gohusdi Edoda tsiyadvganelvi nasgi itsvnanugowiselv.
english: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏯᏑᏰᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏨᏯᎧᏅ ᎢᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᎥᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla nihi ayv sgiyasuyedv yigi, ayvsgini nihi itsvyasuyedv, ale detsvyakanv itsenvsdiyi unequotsvhi itsinanugowisdiyi, ale unequotsvhi itsatseliga galosohvsgi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, nigavno gohusdi etsitayosehesdi Agayvligei, ayv daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi, nasgi itsinediyi.
english: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnetseha ditsadageyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏂ.
phonetic: Iyuno elohi itsisgagiyu yigi, itsigataha ayv igvyi agisgagiyu nulistanv nihi oni.
english: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏨᏯᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuno elohi itsaligohi yigesei, elohi tsugeyuhiyu yigese tsutseliga.  Aseno elohi itsaligohi nigesvna tsigi, itsvyasuyedvsgini elohi tsigi, nasgi nvdigalisdodiha elohi itsisgaga.
english: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎬᎩᏐᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎨᏥᏐᏢᏔᏂ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏁᏨ ᏛᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Itsanvtesdi hia tsinitsvweselvgi; Atsinatlai vtla utli atsilvquodiyu yigeso esgaquo unatlai.  Iyuno ayv gvgisotlvtanvhi yigi, nihi nasquo dagetsisotlvtani.  Iyuno ayv aginetsv unisquanigotanvhi yigi, nihi nasquo itsinetsv dvnisquanigotani.
english: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎡᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏆᏙᎥᎢ, ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi hia nigadv tsudalenvdv nvdagetsvneli nvdigalisdodisgesdi daquadovi, nigvwagatahvna gesv iyusdi nvdvginvsidv.
english: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᎩᎷᏨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎮᎢ; ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᎭ ᎤᏄᏢᏙᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno nagilutsvna ale nigatsiwonetanvna yigesei, vtla asgani yigvwanehei; gohisgini vtla yuneha unutlvdodi unisganvtsvi.
english: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgi na agisgagi ayv, nasquo asgagiyu geso Edoda.
english: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎩᎶ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎪᎩᏂᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎩᏂᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᏓᏃ.
phonetic: Iyuno anehv nidagilvwisdanehvna yigesei gilo tsulvwisdanelvhi nigesvna tsigi, vtla asgani yigvwanehei; aseno hnaquo itsula goginigohv ale goginisgagiyu nulistanv itsula ayv Edodano.
english: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ [ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ] ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; "ᎠᏎᏉ ᎬᎩᏍᎦᎬᎩ."
phonetic: Aseno [nasgi nulistanvgi] udohiyudiyi ayelvsv ulinetsv hia tsinigvnv tsigowela tsunikahnawadvsdiyi; "Asequo gvgisgagvgi."
english: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏓᏥᏅᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᎩᏃᎮᎵ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏋᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno adanvwohisdisgi galutsvha, nasgi Agayvligesdvyi nvdatsinvsdi tsigi nihi itsilutsediyi, gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo agayvligesdvyi nvdvdalehvsgi, nasgi dvginoheli gvnigesv nvdvquvneli.
english: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏰᏃ ᎢᏕᏓ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Nihino nasquo itsinohesgi gesesdi, itsulahayeno ideda didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ, ᏗᏦᏕᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohehelv, ditsodesdiyi nigesvna.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ; ᎥᎥ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏥᏯᏛᏁᎭ, ᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyi dayetsinugowisi; vv, dvsqualvhi, gilo itsihihesdi, Unelanvhi nitsiyadvneha, elisgesdi.
english: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎬᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nanadvnehesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi nanigatahvna gesv Agayvligei, ale ayv nigvgigatahvna gesvi.
english: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎲᏏ, ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉ ᏱᏨᏃᏁᎴᎢ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏕᏙᎲ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohvsi, asqualvhv itsanvdadisdiyi nasgi itsvnonelvi.  Ale vtla nasgi igvyiyiquo yitsvnonelei, itsulaha idedohv nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
english: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏯᏆᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪ; ᎭᏢ ᏫᎦᏘ?
phonetic: Hnaquono nvdvginvsidv tsuwolv witsigati, vtlano gilo nihi nitsadvnv yudasuya yaquadvdvhvsga, hia yinigawe; Hatlv wigati?
english: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᎸ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi nitsvweselv nvdigalisdodiha, uyo adanvdadisdi gesv ukalilv itsinawi.
english: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏨᏓᎨᏏ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏇᏅᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏥᎷᏥᏏ; ᏯᏇᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏥᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno udohiyuhiya itsvnoneha; osiyu itsalisdanedi tsvdagesi; iyuyeno naquenvsvna yigi, adanvwohisdisgi vtla yvgetsilutsisi; yaquenvsgini nvdatsinvsdi gesesdi itsilutsediyi.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino galutsvha gvnigesv nvdagvneli elohi asgani gesvi, ale duyugodv gesvi, ale digugododi gesvi.
english: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Asgani gesvi, nigvquohiyuhvsgvna gesv iyusdi;
english: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Duyugodv gesvi, Edodoyi witsigadvi, ale hnaquo nisgigowatisgvna gesv iyusdi;
english: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Digugododi gesvi, ugvwiyuhi hia elohi utseliga tsagugodanedi gesv iyusdi.
english: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎠᎩᎷᎳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏛᎪᏗ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Asi utsata agilula gohusdi itsvnonedi, aseno gohi gesv vtla yeli nasgi getsadvgodi yigi;
english: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎷᏨᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᏣᏘᏂᏙᎵ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏱᎧᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galutsvhasgini nasgi na gayegogi nigesvna Adanvdo, nigav udohiyuhi gesv dodatsatinidoli, vtlayeno uwasvquo udanvtedv yikanegesdi, nigavsgini advgisgesdi nasgi kanegesdi; Ale datsinanugowiseli tsudalenvdv oni iyulistanidasdi gesvi.
english: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᎩᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎩᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi dvgilvquotani ayv, aquatseliyeno gesv dvgisi ale datsinanugowiseli.
english: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎲ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏫ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎩᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ.
phonetic: Nigav Agayvlige uhv aquatseliga, nasgi iyusdi hia tsinitsiwi, aquatseliga gesv dvgisi ale datsinanugowiseli.
english: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi; ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi; nvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigadvi.
english: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎩᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ?  ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono igadv gvwasdawadidohi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Gado gadvga hia tsinigiweseha; Nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi, ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi?  ale Nvdigalisdodiha Agayvligesdvyi witsigadvi?
english: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏣᏗᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᏲᏦᎵᎦ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nuniwesvgi, Gado gadvga Nigohilvnaquo tsadiha?  Vtla yotsoliga nusdv gadvgvi.
english: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪᏕᏣᏓᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏍᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Tsisano agatahvgi unadulisgv gvwadvdvdiyi, Hiano niduweselvgi; tsigodetsadadvdvhvsga gadvgvi hia tsinagiwesvgi; nigohilvnaquo hnaquo vtla yisgigowatisgesdi, ale hnaquo taline nigohilvnaquo isgigowatisgesdi?
english: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎯ ᏕᏥᏴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᎪᏂᎮᏍᏗ, ᎡᎶᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏮᏛᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; nihi detsiyvgesdi ale itsisgonihesdi, elohisgini aliheligesdi; nihino uyo itsadanvtesdi, aseno uyo itsadanvdv ulihelisdi wvdvdanetliyvstani.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏣᏕᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎡᎸ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏲᎵ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏒᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Ageyv uyo udanvdo tsadehvsgo ayoli, usqualvelv nvdigalisdodisgoi; aseno hnaquo gananugowa ayoli, vtla hnaquo yanvdadisgo ehisdi udanvdadvi, nvdigalisdodisgo aliheligv yvwi unanugowisv svlohi.
english: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏨᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ ᏛᎵᎮᎵᏥ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎨᏥᎩᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi gohi gesv uyo itsadanvta; aseno taline dvtsvgoi, ale itsinawi dvlihelitsi, itsaliheligvno vtla gilo yvgetsigisi.
english: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎩᏯᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏥᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno iga vtla gohusdi yisgiyadvdvhvsgesdi.  Udohiyuhiya udohiyuhiya hia nitsvweseha; Nigav gohusdi Agayvlige etsitayosehesdi, daquadov itsvdisgesdi, ase etsinedi gesesdi.
english: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏔᏲᏍᏔᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏉᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵᏃ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gohi iyasdi vtla gohusdi yitsitayostano ayv daquodovi.  Itsitayoha dayetsinelino, itsaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
english: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏋᏔᏅ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᏯᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏗ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvnohehelv utsosdi golisdiyi aquvtanv; aseno dvsqualvhi hnaquo vtla yitsvyalinohedisgesdi utsosdi golisdiyi gvdi, gvnigesviyusgini datsvnanugowiseli Agayvligei.
english: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎭ;
phonetic: Nahiyu iga daquadov itsitayosdisgesdi; vtlano Agayvlige datsiyadadolisdaneli nihi itsisdelvdiyi yitsvyoseha;
english: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Agayvligeyeno uwasv itsigeyuha, nvdigalisdodiha sgigeyuiyu gesvi, ale itsohiyunv Unelanvhiyi nvdvquadalenvhi gesvi.
english: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏗᏆᏓᎴᏅ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᎸ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏛᎦᏓᏅᏏ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏮᏛᏥᎶᏏ.
phonetic: Agayvligesdvyi diquadalenv, elohi agilutsilv; taline elohi dvgadanvsi, Agayvligesdvyi wvdvtsilosi.
english: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎯᏁᎦ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏦᏍᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏁᎦ.
phonetic: Gvwasdawadidohi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Gvniyuquo hnaquo gvnigesviyu hinega, vtlano utsosdi golisdiyi yinega.
english: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏨᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo otsigataha nigav gohusdi higatahiyu gesvi, ale asequoquo gesv gilo yitsvdvdvhvsga.  Nasgi udigalisdodiha otsohiyuhvsga Unelanvhiyi nvdatsadalenvhi gesvi.
english: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Tsigo hnaquo itsohiyuhvsga?
english: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎥᎥ, ᎿᎭᏉᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏙᏗᏤᏅᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᎩᏴᏕᏥ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏋᎡ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏅᏛᏗᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo dvsqualvhi, vv, hnaquousqualvhv, itsadigaleyoisdiyi, nitsiv itsisiyvwiha doditsenvsv iditlv, ale dasgiyvdetsi aquvsvquo gesesdi; vtlasgininonv aquve yigi, Agayvligeyeno tali nvdvdidega.
english: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi nusdi hia itsvnohehelv ayv nvwadohiyadv itsvyadanvdadisdodiyi.  Elohi udeyadodi datsiwadvhi; aseno ugalisdiquo itsadanvtesdi; ayv tsisegogisv elohi.
english: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ; ᎯᎸᏉᏓ ᏤᏥ, ᏤᏥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nuwesvgi Tsisa, ale dusaladanvgi digadoli galvladi widukahnanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Edoda, hnaquo usqualvhv; hilvquoda Tsetsi, Tsetsi nasquo nihi tsalvquododiyi.
english: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏖᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiyalisgolvdanelvyeno nigav uquedali, tsunediyi nalisquadisgvna gvnidv naniv tekanelvhi gesvi.
english: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏨᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nusdi gvnidv nalisquadisgvnanasgi getsagadovhisdiyi nihi tsvsvhiyu udohiyusv Tsanelanvhi, ale unigadovhisdiyi Tsisa Galonedv nasgi na hinvsidv tsigi.
english: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎸᏉᏔᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvlvquotanv elohi; agisquadv digalvwisdanedi sginelvhi tsigi digilvwisdanediyi.
english: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏓ ᏨᏒ ᏗᏦᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᏗᏦᎸ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono, nihi Edoda, sgilvquoda tsvsv ditsolvi, nasgiya vgilvquodiyu tsigesvgi ditsolv asiquo nigvnadv nadalenisgvna tsigesvgi.
english: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏔᏑᏰᏛ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Detsadov gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelv anisgaya elohi tasuyedv disgikanelvhi tsigi.  Ditsatseliga gesvgi, ale desgikanelvgi; ale unisquanigotanv kanohedv tsatseliga.
english: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono anigatahiyu nulistanv, nigav gohusdi sginelvhi tsigi, nihi nvdayudalehvhi gesvi.
english: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏁᎸᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏖᎲ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Detsinelvyeno kanohedv nasgi sginelvhi tsigi; ale nasgi dunadanilvtsv, ale unigadovsv udohiyusv nihi tehv nvdvquadalenvhi gesvi; ale unohiyunv nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
english: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi gatsiyadadolisdaneha; vtla elohi yitsiyadadolisdaneha, nasgiquosgini na disgikanelvhi tsigi; nihiyeno ditsatseliga.
english: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nigadvno aquatseliga nihi tsatseliga, nihino tsatseliga ayv aquatseliga; ale nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vgilvquodiha.
english: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᎨᎠ, ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏗᏦᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ.  ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᏨᏒ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ayv vtla elohi yigea, hiasgini elohi aneha, ayvno ditsolv witsigati.  Etsalvquodiyu Edoda, tsvsv detsadov hvdisgesdi dehisquanigodesdi disgikanelvhi, saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi ayvno saquoquo tsigi.
english: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎦᏥᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏕᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏛᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏳᏲᎱᏒ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asi elohi tsigatsiyeladidohvgi, detsadov detsisquanigododvgi; nasgi disgikanelvhi gatsisquanigotanv, ale vtla asiyvwi yuyohusv na uwasv ayohuhisdi uwetsi, udohiyudiyi gowelvi.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏗᏦᎸ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎬᏉᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ditsolv witsigati, nasgino hia nitsiwea ani elohi, gvquoliheligv unikaliisdiyi unadanvdvi.
english: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏁᎸ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ; ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᏗᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Detsinelv kanohedv tsatseliga; elohino disgagiyu nulistanv, elohi anehi nigesvna gesv iyusdi, nasgiya ayv elohi gei nigesvna tsigi.
english: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎧᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏥᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᏘᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla elohi dikahvsdiyi yitsitayohiha, tiyosdodanediyiquosgini uyo gesvi.
english: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla elohi anehi yigi, nasgiya ayv elohi gei nigesvna tsigi.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏖᏅᎦᎸᏓ; ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gayegogi nigesvna tsatseliga tenvgalvda; kanohedv tsatseliga nasgi gayegogi nigesvna.
english: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᏥᏅᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nihi elohi agiluhisdiyi sginvsidv tsigi, nasgiya nasquo ayv elohi gatsinvli nasgi.
english: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᏓᏅᎦᎵᎠ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᎿᎭᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia gesv nvdigalisdodiha gadanvgalia, nasquo unvsv gayegogi nigesvna unahnanvgalvdodiyi.
english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ Ꮎ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ;
phonetic: Ale vtla hiaquo na unvsv yigatsiyadadolisdaneha, nasquosgini na analitsidohvsgv gvquohiyuhvsgi iyulisdodi tsigi gatsiyadadolisdaneha;
english: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏍᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎬᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigadv saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi Edoda tsisgiyaa, ale ayv tsigvyaa, nasgi nasquo saquoquo igalisdodiyi; nasgino elohi uwohiyudiyi nihi nvdasginvsidv gesvi.
english: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏁᎸ, ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi vgilvquododi gesv nihi sginelvhi tsigi, nasgi gatsinelv, saquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgiya nihi ayvno saquoquo tsigi;
english: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏳᎪᏗᏯ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv nasgi gatsiyavi, ale nihi ayv sgiyavi, nasgi tsuyugodiya saquoquo iyunalisdodiyi, nasgino elohi ugadovhisdiyi nvdasginvsidv gesvi, ale nasgi tigeyuhiyu gesvi, nasgiya sgigeyuiyu tsigi.
english: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎨᎥᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᏕᏗᏱ, -ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᎸᏉᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Edoda, aquaduli nasquo disgikanelvhi ayv gevi nasgi itsulaha ogadediyi, nasgino unigowadvdiyi vgilvquodvi, nasgi sginelvhi tsigi; sgigeyuhiyuyeno gesvgi asi elohi nadalenisgvna tsigesvgi.
english: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏣᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᏔᎯᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏍᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsadanvti Edoda, elohi vtla tsagatahi yigi, ayvsgini gvwatahiyu, ale hia anigatahiyu sginvsidv gesvi.
english: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎦᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ, ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ayvno detsadov gatsinanugowiselv, ale ase dagatsinanugowiseli, uneladisdodiyi ayv sgigeyuhiyu gesvi, ale ayv nasgi gatsiyai iyulisdodiyi.
english: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏘᏅᏒᎩ, ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏚᏪᏐᏨᎩ ᎩᏠᏂ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Tsisa nuwesv, gvwasdawadidohi dutinvsvgi, unugotsvgi duwesotsvgi Gitloni uweyvi, nahna awisvdiyi gotlvsvgi, nahna uyvlvgi, ale nasquo gvwasdawadidohi.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᎳᏫᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Tsudasino utludisgi nasquo agatahiyu gesvgi nahnani, Tsisayeno ale gvwasdawadidohi yanogiyu nahna danilawigvgi.
english: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏚᏘᏁᏅ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏉᎵᏏ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᏓᏂᏁᎲᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsudasi dutinenv sunadatlugi aniyawisgi, ale dinadaniyisgi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale Aniquolisi nvdayunadalenvhi, nahna ulutsvgi, daninehvgi ditsvsdodi ale dilisgasdodoi.
english: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥᏲᎭ?
phonetic: Tsisano agatahiyu gesv nigav iyulisdanedi gesvi, uwenvsvgi hia winiduweselvgi; Gago etsiyoha?
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ.  ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Tsisa Naselidi ehi.  Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Ayv nasgi.  Tsudasino nasgi utludisgi nasquo gadogvgi anidonavi.
english: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏚᏬᏎᎸ, ᎤᎾᏏᏅᏒᎩ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᏂᏅᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono, Ayv nasgi, duwoselv, unasinvsvgi, eladi widuninvtsvgi.
english: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏙᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥᏲᎭ?  ᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline doudvdvnvgi, Gago etsiyoha?  Duweselvgi hiano nuniwesvgi; Tsisa Naselidi ehi.
english: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏩᎾᏓᏅᎾ;
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi, Gayula itsvnonelv ayv nasgi gesvi.  Iyuno ayv sgiyohesdi, hia unanelagi wanadanvna;
english: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ; "ᏗᏍᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏍᎩᏲᎱᏎᎸ."
phonetic: Udohiyudiyi unetsv hia nuwesvi; "Disgikanelvhi vtla asiyvwi sgiyohuselv."
english: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎦᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᎸᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏴᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎦᎴᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎹᎵᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sawani Quida ayelasdiganvhidv ganehvi, ulvhvgi, ale uluyvgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi unvsidasdi, ale nasgi agatisi galeni ulisdestanvgi.  Nasgi atsinvsidasdi Maliga tsudoidv gesvgi.
english: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ; ᏥᎯᎳᏓ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎦᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏴᏓᎦᏗᏔᎯ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia nuweselvgi Quida; Tsihilada tsatseli ayelasdiganvhidv galadisdiyi; ulisquidi edoda aginelvhi, tlasgo Yvdagaditahi?
english: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎸᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono sunadatlugi, ale aniyawisgi ditinidohi, ale dinadaniyisgi Anitsusi tsuninetselvhi, gvwaniyvhvgi Tsisa, ale gvwalvlvgi.
english: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᎾ ᏧᏬᎸᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎧᏱᏆ ᎤᎿᎭᏥᏴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Ena tsuwolvi igvyi wigvwatinvstanvgi, nasgiyeno Kayiqua uhnatsiyvgi, ale nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gesvgi nahiyu udetiyvsadisvi.
english: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏱᏆ ᏥᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏱᏚᏲᎱᎯᎭᎸ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Kayiqua tsidunetsele Anitsusi, hia tsiniduweselei; utli osiyu igalisdanedi asiyvwi yiduyohuhihalv yvwi.
english: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino Quida usdawadvsvgi Tsisa, ale nasquo nvwadale adasdawadidohi.  Nasgi adasdawadidohi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ugatahi gesvgi; itsulahano Tsisa uniyvlvgi udlanvdvi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ganelvi.
english: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏉ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᎯ, ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏭᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᏈᏓ.
phonetic: Quidasgini doyiditlvquo galohisdiyi ulenvgi.  Hnaquono nasgi na soi adasdawadidohi, nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ugatahi, unugotsvgi, wulinohetanvgi adv galohisdiyi agatiya, ale uyvtanvgi Quida.
english: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᏈᏓ; ᏂᎯᎧ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi adv, galohisdiyi agatiya, hia nuweselv Quida; Nihika nasquo hia asgaya hisdawadidohi?  Vtla, udvnvgi.
english: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎾᏙᎾᎥᎩ, ᎧᏃᏍᎦ ᎤᏃᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, -ᎤᏴᏢᎩᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.  ᏈᏓᏃ ᎨᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidasdino ale dinadaniyisgi nahna anadonavgi, kanosga unodotanvhi gesvgi, uyvtlvgiyeno, ale uniganawosgvgi.  Quidano gelvgi gadogvgi ale uganawosgvgi.
english: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi udvdvnvgi Tsisa, gvwasdawadidohi ale nusdv dadeyohvsgv ugvwali.
english: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᏦᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Gvnigesv gatsiwonedisgvgi elohi; yanogiyu degadeyohvsgv digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisvi, ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, nahna Anitsusi nigohilv tsunilawitsohisdiyi tsigi, udelidvno vtla gohusdi aquadvnvhi yigi.
english: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏍᏆᏛᏛᎲᏍᎦ?  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏔᏛᏛᎲᎦ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono ayv isquadvdvhvsga?  Nasgi na tadvdvhvga unadvganvhi nasgi nigatsiweselvi.  Gvniyuquo anigataha nagiwesvi.
english: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏗᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎩ ᎤᏏᏛᏂᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᏂᏪᏎ ᎯᏁᏤᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ?
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, asiyvwi didaniyisgi nav gadogi usidvnilvgi Tsisa, hia nuwesvgi; Nasgisgo niwese hinetseha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi?
english: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎯ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᏍᏗ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏍᏋᏂᎭ?
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno usonv aginetsesdi, nasgi higatahi winigalisda usonv aginetsvi; iyusgini osiyu aginetsesdi, gadono tsisquvniha?
english: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏱᏆ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏪᏅᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Enayeno unetsvhi gesvgi agalvidv agatinvsdiyi Kayiqua nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsuwenvsvi.
english: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎤᎦᎾᏬᏍᎬᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯᎧ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ?  ᎤᏓᏱᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Sawanino Quida gadogvgi uganawosgvgi.  Hnaquono hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Nihika nasquo hia hisdawadidohi?  Udayilvgi, Vtla, udvnvgi.
english: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᎾ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏒᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᎬᎪᎡ ᏥᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Asiyvwi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsunvsidasdi, gohusdi uwana Quida ulisdesvhi, hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo yigvgoe tsisdedohvgi awisvdiyi?
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏓᏱᎸᎩ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᏔᎦ ᎤᏴᎳᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Quidano taline udayilvgi.  Gilaquono iyvdv tsataga uyvlasvgi.
english: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎧᏱᏆ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎨᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏳᏁᏅᏎᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᏱᏃᏣᎵᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquo Kayiqua ganelv unatihnawidvhvgi Tsisa, digugododiyi wunatinvstanvgi; ale sunale gesvgi.  Unvsvsgini vtla digugododiyi yunenvsei, gadaha yinotsalisda anelisgvgi, kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi tsunalisdayvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
english: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎡᏧᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ?
phonetic: Qualedino dayunugotsvgi anidonav ulutsvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Gado etsuisdiha hia asgaya?
english: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏨᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Uninetsvgi hia ugvwaweselvgi; Iyuno usganvtsvhi nigesvna yigesei vtla yidogetsvyohiselei.
english: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏓ ᎡᏥᏱᎵᏓ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎣᏥᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Etsatihnawidv, itsvsv ditsikahnawadvsdi itsvda etsiyilida.  Hnaquono Anitsusi hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Vtla ulinetsvhi yigi yvwi otsihisdiyi.
english: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ] ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎦᏛᎬ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: [Nasgi nulistanvgi] udohiyudiyi Tsisa unetsvi, gadvgv iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi.
english: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏭᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎪ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi taline digugodiyi uyvlvgi, ale Tsisa wuyanvhvgi, hia nuweselvgi, Nihisgo Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?
english: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏪᎠ, ᎩᎶᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏃᎮᎮᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsigo tsvsv tsadanvtedv nasgi tsiniwea, giloge nasgi getsanohehelei?
english: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ?  ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏕᎨᏣᏲᏒ ᎦᏙ ᏣᏛᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Qualedi hia nuwesvgi; Tsigo ayv Tsitsusi?  Ditsatseliga yvwi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi degetsayosv gado tsadvnelv.
