english: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᏚᎾᏟᏴᎮᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᏳᏁᎵᏎᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Agigvwiyuhi gesv vtla ani elohi ehi yigi.  Iyuno agigvwiyuhi gesv ani elohi ehi yigesei, diquatseliga yidunatliyvhei, tlesdi Anitsusi digetsiyohiselvgi, yunelisei.  Aseno vtla ani udalenvhi yigi agigvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᎧᏂ?  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏰᎵ ᏂᏫ, ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ.  ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎩ.  ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎪ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhiyekani?  Tsisa hia nuwesvgi; Yeli niwi, agigvwiyuhiyeno ayv.  Tsinohesgi udohiyusv iyaqualisdodiyi, nasgi iyusdi aquadenvgi, ale nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi elohi aginanugotsilvgi.  Naniv udohiyusv unigeyuhi anadvgisgo tsinegvi.
english: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Gado usdi udohiyusv gesvi?  Nasgino hia nuwesv, taline unugotsvgi Anitsusi anidonav wulosvgi, ale hia winiduweselvgi; Vtla yitsiwatiha usganvtsvi.
english: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎭ, ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏗᏨᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Aseno dikahnawadvsdi itsiha, ditsvyohisediyi asiyvwi kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi asqualisgv iyui.  Nasgi iyusdi itsadulisgo ditsvyosediyi Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga?
english: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏆᎳᏆᏍᎩᏂ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᎳᏆ ᎠᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv taline unelunvgi, Hia nuniwesvgi; vtlasdi hia asgaya, Qualaquasgini.  Nasgi Qualaqua adanasahvsgi gesvgi.
english: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi uniyvhvgi Tsisa ale ulivnilvgi.
english: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᎸ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎤᏃᏢᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏚᎳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎬᏩᏄᏬᎥᎩ,
phonetic: Aniyawisgino unisdeyolv tsutsayosdi alisdulo unotlvnvgi ale gvwasdulanvgi, ale gigage anuwo gvwanuwovgi,
english: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏛᏂᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ale hia nuniwesvgi; Itsvyoliga Tsagvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga.  Ale degvwasidvnilvgi.
english: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ, ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎾᎩᏩᏛᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi taline unugotsvgi, hia winiduweselvgi; Gvniyuquo itsvnanugowisi, itsadolehohisdiyi usganvtsv nagiwadvhvna gesvi.
english: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏮᎩ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏄᏬ.  ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Tsisano dayunanugotsvgi, ulisdulvgi alisdulo tsutsayosdi gotlvtanvhi, ale unuwvgi gigage anuwo.  Qualedino hia niduweselvgi; Gvniyuquo hia nasgi asgaya.
english: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ, ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ!  ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ! ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏗᎿᎭᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏛᎥᎦ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinadaniyisgi gvwagohv, unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hiyadvvga!  hiyadvvga! Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Nihi etsadihnawidv, ale etsadvvga; ayvyeno vtla yitsiwatiha usganvtsvi.
english: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᎩᎭ, ᏦᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Anitsusi hia winvgvwaweselvgi; Dikahnawadvsdi ogiha, tsogikahnawadvsdino nigvnv yeliquo gvwayohuhisdi, Unelanvhiyeno Uwetsi utselvnvgi.
english: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᎦᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi nasgi udvganv utli igai usgalvgi;
english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᎭᏢ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ?  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale taline uyvlvgi digugododiyi, hia winuweselvgi Tsisa; Hatlv nvdatsadalenvhi?  Aseno Tsisa vtla yunetselei.
english: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏍᎩᏁᏤᎭ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᎦᏔᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᎬᏯᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎦᎬᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Qualedi hia nuweselvgi; Tlasgo yisginetseha?  Tlasgo yigataha yeliquo gagvyadvdi gesvi, ale yeliquo digagvyohisdi gesvi?
english: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏣᎭ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏍᏋᏁᏗᏱ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᏲᏒᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Vtla yigetsaha yeli ayv gohusdi squvnediyi, galvladi nvdayetsalisgolvdanelvhi nigesvna yigi.  Nasgi iyusdi, ayv digiyosvhi nihi ditsayohiselvhi utli equohiyu usganvtsv.
english: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏲᎸᎩ ᎥᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎯᏯᎧᏅᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏏᏌ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᎢ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎩ, ᎧᏁᎬ ᏏᏌ ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno iyudalenvdv Qualedi uyolvgi vuwegodiyi.  Aseno Anitsusi unelunvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Iyuno hia asgaya ihiyakanvha vtla Sisa isdalii yigagesesdi.  Gilo ugvwiyuhi atselvsgi, kanegv Sisa atludisgoi.
english: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᏅᏯ-ᎠᏰᏍᏓᎥ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏆᏓ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Qualedi nasgi udvganv unugowisvgi Tsisa, ale uwenvgi digugododiyi gasgilvi, Nvyaayesdav deudovi, Anitsusisgini uniwonihisdi gesv Gequada deudov.
english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩᏃ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ!
phonetic: Kanohiyegino dilisdayvdiyi advnvisdodiyi iga gesvgi, ale taladu iyutlilodv iyvdv kalawadisv gesvgi, Qualedino hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi; Gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi itsatseliga!
english: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎷᎦ!  ᎯᎷᎦ!  ᎯᏯᏛᎥᎦ!  ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏓᏥᏯᏛᏂᏍᎪ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᎧᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏏᏌ ᎤᏩᏒ!
phonetic: Aseno unelunvquo hia nuniwesvgi; Hiluga!  hiluga!  hiyadvvga!  Qualedi hia niduweselvgi; Datsiyadvnisgo itsatseliga Ugvwiyuhi?  Nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi hia nuniweselvgi; Vtla yogikaha ugvwiyuhi, Sisa uwasv!
english: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priest answered, We have no king but Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏛᎩᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono duyohiselvgi unadvdiyi.  Uniniyvdvgino Tsisa ale unatinawidvhvgi.
english: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᎦᏓ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Tsisano tsudahnawadv ganehvgi unugotsvgi, usqualugo dudov ulutsvgi, nasgi Goligada dudov Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gesv anvdisgvi;
english: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏥᏌᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ.
phonetic: Nahnani gvwadvnvgi, ale anitali nvwanadale itsulaha degegadvnvgi itsula iditlv Tsisano ayeli.
english: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏅᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ; ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏩᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Qualedino uwowelanvgi agoliyedi, ale dadahnawasdv uweyalvnvgi; hia nigvnv gowelvgi; TsiSa NaSeLiDi EHi, UGvWiWaHi ANiTsuSi UNaTseLiGa.
english: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᏥᏌᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi agoliyedi unitsadv Anitsusi anigoliyesgvgi, Tsisayeno agadvnv gaduhv nav gesvgi, Anitsusino, ale Anigoi, ale Anilomi tsuniwonihisdi gesv gowelvgi.
english: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏁᎸ ᏦᏪᎳᏅᎩ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi Anitsusi tsunatseliga hia nuniweselvgi Qualedi; Tlesdi hia itsvnelv tsowelanvgi; Ugvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga; hiasgini; Agigvwiyuhi Anitsusi unatseliga adisgvgi.
english: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᏣᏉᏪᎳᏅ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅ.
phonetic: Qualedi hia nuwesvgi; Tsinaquvnelv tsaquowelanv, hnaquo ase aquowelanv.
english: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏛᏅ, ᏚᏂᏁᏒᎩ ᏧᏄᏬ, ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏂᏛᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᏛᎯ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏄᏅᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎤᏄᏬᎥᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏫᏛ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏂᎬ ᎬᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono aniyawisgi, Tsisa gvwadvnv, duninesvgi tsunuwo, nvgi nidunidvgi, saquo igadvhi asiyvwi ayawisgi utseliga nunvnelvgi; ale nasquo hawini unuwovhi.  Nasgi hawini anuwo vtla gayewidv yigesei, nigv gvnvhi gesvgi.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏣᎦᎸᎢᏒᎩ, ᎢᏓᏎᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᏆᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏄᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏌᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nidunadaweselvgi; Tlesdi igitsagalvisvgi, idasehiquosgini idadolehohi utseliga iyulisdodi gesvi; udohiyudiyi gowelv hia tsinigvnv; Duniyadolvgi diquanuwo, ale aquanuwosdi unasastanvgi.  Hia nasgi aniyawisgi nunadvnelvgi.
english: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏛᎢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ ᎤᏥ, ᎤᏂᏃ ᎤᎸᎢ ᎺᎵ ᏟᎣᏆ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎺᎵᏃ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Navno dadahnawasdv Tsisa gadvi anidonavgi utsi, unino ulvi Meli Tlioqua udalii, Melino Magideli ehi.
english: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏥ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏤᏥ.
phonetic: Tsisano ugohv utsi, ale ugohv nav gadogv usdawadidohi ugeyuhi, hia nuweselvgi utsi; Higeyv, Gvniyuquo tsetsi.
english: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎤᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏣᏥᎢ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nvuweselvgi usdawadidohi; Gvniyuquo tsatsii.  Nahiyuquono nasgi usdawadidohi tsuwenvsv wutinvstanvgi.
english: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛᎢ, ᎪᏪᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᎭ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa agatahiyu gesv nigav hnaquo ulisquadvi, gowelv udohiyudiyi, Agitadegiha, udvnvgi.
english: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎥᎦᎧᎲᎩ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ; ᏚᏬᎢᎵᏃ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏏᏈ ᎤᏂᏆᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎰᎵ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏂᏩᏌᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano vgakahvgi atelido tsunitsoyasdi akaliwohi; duwoilino tsunitsoyasdi unikaliistanvgi, ale nasgi hisiqui uniquadotanvgi, aholi nav uniwasatanvgi.
english: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏃ ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏓ; ᎤᎵᏍᎫᏫᏒᏃ ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Tsisano tsunitsoyasdi unegisv hia nuwesvgi; Hnaquo alisquada; ulisguwisvno deuyosvgi udanvdo.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ ᏗᏂᏅᏍᎨᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏆᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏁᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᏱᏗᎦᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Anitsusino unitayoselvgi Qualedi dininvsgeni digetsisqualisediyi ale digetsinesdiyi, nvdayulisdotanvgi advnvisdodiyi iga gesvi, tlesdi unadodaquasgv yidigadesdi anelisgvgi, nasgiyeno unadodaquasgv iga galvquodiyu gesvgi.
english: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎵᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᏅᏍᎨᏂ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏌ ᏗᎨᎦᏛᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi aniyawisgi unilutsvgi, dunisqualisvgi diganvsgeni igvyiyi gadi ale soi itsulaha Tsisa digegadvnvhi.
english: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏛ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᏍᏆᎵᏎ ᏗᎦᏅᏍᎨᏂ;
phonetic: Tsisasgini gadv wunilutsv, ale unadolehosv gayula uyohusvhi gesvi, vtla yidunisqualise diganvsgeni;
english: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏗᏓᏘᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏘᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏉᎨᏂ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏳᏨᏨᎩ ᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ.
phonetic: Asiyvwisgini ayawisgi, didatisdi uwetistanvgi asquogeni, gilaquono iyvdv nahna dayutsvtsvgi gigv ale ama.
english: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino na ugohvhi unohelvgi, kanohesgvno udohiyuha, ale agataha udohiyuhi kanohesgvi, nasgi getsohiyudi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ; "ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎤᎪᎳ ᏧᎵᏍᏆᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ."
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia nulistanvgi udohiyudiyi gowelv hia tsinigvnv; "Vtla saquo ugola tsulisqualisdi yigesesdi."
english: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏩᎭ; "ᏙᏓᎬᏩᎧᎾᏂ ᏗᎬᏪᏘᎸᎯ."
phonetic: Alewo nvwadale gowelv hia nigawaha; "Dodagvwakanani digvwetilvhi."
english: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎣᏂ ᏦᏩ ᎠᎵᎹᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏩ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎤᏁᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.  ᏆᎴᏗᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv oni Tsowa Alimadiyi ehi, Tsisa asdawadidohi gesvgi, aseno udelidvquo Anitsusi dasgaihvi nvdagalisdodisgvgi, nasgi Tsowa utayoselvgi Qualedi unesdiyi Tsisa ayelvi.  Qualedino ulisgolvdanelvgi.  Howano ulutsvgi unesvgi Tsisa ayelvi.
english: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎥᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᎹᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏃᏱ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᎤᏲᎸᎩ ᏗᏜᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎻᎳ ᎡᎳᏫᏃ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ.
phonetic: Nasquono vulutsvgi Nigadimasi, nasgi igvyiyi Tsisa enoyi ulutselvhi, uyolvgi didlastanvhi mila elawino, asgohitsuqui iyvdv iyudagedv.
english: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏁᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏂᏣᏄᎶᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᏚᏂᏣᏄᎳᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᎾᏓᏂᏌ.
phonetic: Hnaquono uninesvgi Tsisa ayelvi ale doledv anuwo unitsanulotanvgi, ale nasquo digawasvgi dunitsanulanvgi, nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv Anitsusi danadanisa.
english: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎠᏫᎡᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nahnano agadvnv awiediyi gotlvsvgi; nahnano awisvdiyi itse didanisodiyi gotlvsvgi gilo atsinisanv asi nigesvna.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᏅᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎾᎥᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano uninvnvgi Tsisa nvdagalisdodisgvgi Anitsusi unatseliga advnvisdodiyi iga gesvi; didanisodiyiyeno navquo gesvgi.
english: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏑᎾᎴᎢᏳ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᎩ, ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏅᏯ ᎠᎲᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: alenisgvino iga sunadodaquasdi gesvi, Meli Magideli ehi sunaleiyu, asiquo ulisigvgi, ulutsvgi atselisdvi, ale ugohvgi nvya ahvdv gesvgi atselisdvi.
english: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎩ, ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏂᏁᏒ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭᏭᏂᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dusqualvtanvgi, Sawani Quida wulutselvgi, ale nasquo soi adasdawadidohi, nasgi tsisa ugeyuhi, hia winiduweselvgi; Uninesv uninugowisv Ugvwiyuhi atselisdvi, ale vtla yotsigatahawuninvnvi.
english: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Quida unugotsvgi, ale soi adasdawadidohi, ale atselisdv unilutsvgi.
english: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏚᏂᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎩ; ᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏓᎩᏴᎩ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi anitali itsulaha dunisqualvtanvgi; soino adasdawadidohi dudagiyvgi, igvyi atselisdv ulutsvgi.
english: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏴᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino udisadadv dugohvgi doledv dinuwo deganvgi; aseno vtla yuyvlei.
english: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎣᏂᏉ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sawani Quida oniquo ulutsvgi, ale atselisdv wuyvlvgi, ale dugohvgi doledv dinuwo deganvi.
english: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏯᏠᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏕᎦᏅ ᏱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎦᏇᏅᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᎦᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ayatlono unisdulotanvhi vtla doledv dinuwo deganv yiganei, unelagi gaquenvhi iyvdv wiganvgi.
english: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᎢ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ, ᎤᏴᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasquo soi adasdawadidohi, igvyi ulutsvhi atselisdv, uyvlvgi; ale ugohvgi ale uwohiyunvgi.
english: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏯᏃᎵᎨ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlayeno asi yanolige gadvgv gowelvi, nasgi uyohusv tsulehisodi gesvi.
english: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono anadasdawadidohi unadanvsvgi, taline dotsunenvsv wunilosvgi.
english: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎩ; ᏓᏠᏱᎲᎩ ᎤᏗᏌᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏫᏚᎧᎾᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Melisgini atselisdv doyiditlv galohisdiyi gadogvgi, datloyihvgi; datloyihvgi udisadadvgi, atselisdv hawini widukananvgi,
english: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᎪᎲᎩ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏚᎾᏣᏅᏛᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏃᎸᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏘᏅᎢ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏜᏓᏌᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale widugohvgi unegv dunatsanvdvgi anitali dinikahnawadidohi dunolvgi, saquo ulistinvi, soino dudlasatanvi.
english: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎭᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏁᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Higeyv, gadono dohatloyiha?  Hiano niduweselvgi; Nvdigalisdodiha uninesv Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga, ale uninvnv nitsigatahvna gesvi.
english: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎵᏤ ᏥᏌ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv ugatahvsvgi; ale ugohvgi Tsisa gadogvgi, ale vtla yuwolitse Tsisa gesvi.
english: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᎨᏴ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎭᏠᏱᎭ?  ᎦᎪ ᎯᏲᎭ?  ᎠᏫᏒᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎾᏫᏛᎮᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ ᏫᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏥᎾᏫᏛᎯ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Higeyv, gadono dohatloyiha?  gago hiyoha?  Awisvdiyi osdv iyuwahnadegi uwelisvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Hisgaya, iyuno nihi hinawidvhesdi, sginohvsi winvnvi, ayvno datsinawidvhi.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎺᎵ.  ᎺᎵ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎳᏉᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᏗᏍᏇᏲᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Meli.  Meli ugatahvsv hia nuweselvgi; Laquoni, nasgi gadvgvi, Disqueyohvsgi.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏒᏂᎸᎩ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᏫᏯᏆᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ; ᎮᎾᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᏂᏅᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏫᏂᎩᏪᏏ; ᎡᏙᏙᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏓᏂᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᏙᏱ; ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tlesdi squasvnilvgi, tlayeno asi edodoyi wiyaqualisaladanv; henaquosgini otsalinvtli dininvi, hiano winigiwesi; Edodoyi aqualisaladanidi ale nihi Itsidodoyi; Aquatseliga Unelanvhiyi, ale itsatseliga Unelanvhiyi.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Meli Magideli ehi ulutsvgi ale dunonelvgi anadasdawadidohi ugohv Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi nuwesv ulinohetanvi.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nahiyu iga usvi, alenisgv sunadodaquasdi gesvi, galohisdiyi dasduhvgi anadasdawadidohi danilawivi, nvdagalisdodisgv danisgaihv Anitsusi, ulutsvgi Tsisa, ayeli ulenvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
english: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᎨᏂ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, dunanugowiselvgi tsuwoyeni ale asquageni.  Hnaquono gvwasdawadidohi osdv unadanvdadvgi unigohv Ugvwiyuhi.
english: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎡᏙᏓ ᎠᎩᏅᏒᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏅᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taline Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.  Edoda aginvsvi nasgiya itsvnvli.
english: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᏦᏔᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, dutsotahvgi, hia niduweselvgi; Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ditsadanilvgi.
english: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏲᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏕᏥᏂᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏂᏴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo usganvtsv detsiyosgesdi diyosvhi gesesdi, gilono usganvtsv detsiniyisgesdi diganiyvdi gesesdi.
english: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᎻ, ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᎳ, ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨ.
phonetic: Aseno Dami, taladu iyanidv gela, didima tsudoidv, vtla yigele Tsisa ulutsv.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎣᏥᎪᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎪᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎬᏂ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏴᎩ ᏚᏰᎸᏒ ᏱᏓᎩᎪᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏰᏌᏛ ᏯᏋᏔᏅ ᏯᎩᏃᏟᏍᏔᏅ ᏴᎩ ᏚᏰᎸᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᎨᏂ ᏯᏆᏐᎾᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi anisoi anadasdawadidohi hia nigvwaweselvgi; Otsigov Ugvwiyuhi.  Aseno hia niduweselvgi; Vtla yvgagoiyuhvga gvni tsuwoyeni yvgi duyelvsv yidagigohv, ale tsiyesadv yaquvtanv yaginotlistanv yvgi duyelvsvi, ale asquageni yaquasonadv.
english: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏯᎥᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ ᎨᎸᎩ.  ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᏗᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunelineno iga taline gvwasdawadidohi aniyavgi galitsode, ale Dami gelvgi.  Tsisa ulutsvgi, digalohisdiyi dasduhvgi, ayeli ulenvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Nvwadohiyadv itsatseliga gesesdi.
english: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏓᎻ; ᎡᏍᎦ ᎡᏅᎦ ᎯᏰᏌᏛᎢ, ᏘᎪᎵᏯ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎡᏅᎦ ᏦᏰᏂ ᏥᏍᏆᎨᏂ ᏩᏐᎾᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nuweselvgi Dami; Esga envga hiyesadvi, tigoliya diquoyeni, ale esga envga tsoyeni tsisquageni wasonada, ale tlesdi nohiyuhvsgvna yigesesdi, hohiyuhvsgisgini gesesdi.
english: Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎻ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ!
phonetic: Dami unetsvgi, hia nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi aquatseliga, ale Tsanelanvhi aquatseliga!
english: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎬᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎬᏉᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Tsisgigowadv nvdagalisdoda hohiyuhvsga; osiyu iyunalisdanedi gvgigohvhi nigesvna aseno tsigvquohiyuhvsgoi.
english: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏂᎪᏪᎸᎾ;
phonetic: Ale utsadvgi utli igai usquanigodi dulvwisdanelv Tsisa gvwasdawadidohi anigatahvi, ani gowelihi nigowelvna;
english: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiasgini gowela itsohiyudiyi Tsisa Galonedv gesvi, ale nasgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi, itsohiyuhvsgvno gvnidv itsatseli iyulisdodiyi, nasgi dudov nvdayuliyeilvsdodiyi.
english: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏥᏌ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏔᏈᎵᏯ ᎥᏓᎸᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv, Tsisa taline gvnigesv nidudvnelvgi gvwasdawadidohi Taquiliya vdalvi.  Hiano nulistanidolvgi gvnigesv nudvnelvgi.
english: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏅᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ ᏗᏗᎹ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏓᏂᎵ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏂ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Itsulaha aninvgi Sawani Quida, ale Dami Didima tsudoidv, ale Nedanili Gelili ehi Geni gaduhvi, ale Tsequidi tsuwetsi, ale anitali nvwanadale gvwasdawadidohi.
english: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᎦᏯᎷᏂ.  ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏕᏏ.  ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᏅᎩ; ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᏂᏴᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Sawani Quida hia niduweselvgi; Tsigayaluni.  Hia nvgvwaweselvgi; Ayv nasquo dadesi.  Unenvsvgi, gilaquono iyvdv tsiyuhi unatsanvgi; nahiyuno svnoyi vtla gohusdi yuniniyvhei.
english: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏥᏌ ᎤᏩᏝᎥ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᏥᏌ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Sunaleno nulistanv, Tsisa uwatlav gadogvgi; aseno gvwasdawadidohi vtla yanigatahe Tsisa gesvi.
english: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎢᏥᏂᏌᎠᏧ?  ᎥᏝ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Ditsiyoli, itsinisaatsu?  vtla, unadvnvgi.
english: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏥᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎢᏥᎦᏯᎷᎥᎦ, ᏙᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯᏃ.  ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏂᎦᏯᎷᏅᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏎᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Tsiyuhi agatisiditlv itsigayaluvga, dodatsiwadvhino.  Howano unigayalunvgi, hnaquono vtla yeli gvwanasehisdi yigesei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi unitsadv atsadi.
english: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏚᎢ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᏚᏄᏩᎥᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᎵ ᏭᎵᏔᏗᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi adasdawadidohi Tsisa ugeyuhi hia nuweselvgi Quida; Ugvwiyuhi nasgi.  Hnaquono Sawani Quida udvganv nasgi Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, gadui unuwosdi udatlostanvgi, nidunuwavnayeno gesvgi, ale vdali wulitadinvsvgi.
english: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎾᏦᏛᎩ, ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏙᏱ, ᏔᎵᏧᏈᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏍᏛᎩ, ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏂᎾᏏᏁᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Anisoino anadasdawadidohi tsiyu unatsodvgi, unilutsvgi, vtlayeno invhiyu yigese doyi, talitsuquiquo iyaligiyusquidv iyvdv nvwasdvgi, agayaludi atsadi akaliwohi aninasinehvgi.
english: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏚᎩᏒᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎭ ᎪᏛᎩ, ᎠᏣᏗᏃ ᎥᎬᏓᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᏓᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Unadugisvno unigohvgi atsilvha godvgi, atsadino vgvdavgi, ale gadu dahvgi.
english: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏗᏥᏄᎦ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎩᎳᏉ ᏥᏕᏥᏂᏴ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Editsinuga igadv atsadi gilaquo tsidetsiniyv.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏱ ᏭᎾᏏᏃᎸᎩ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᏣᏁᏆ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᏦᎢᎦᎵ ᎤᏂᎥᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏒᎦᏃ ᎾᏂᎥᎽ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎦᏯᎷᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Sawani Quida wutsanvgi, ale doyi wunasinolvgi agayaludi akaliwohi tsanequa atsadi, sgohitsuqui hisgisgohi tsoigali univgi.  Nasgisvgano nanivmu aseno agayaludi vtla yuyotsei.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏄᎦ.  ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᎬᏬᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia niduweselvgi; Etsalisdayvnuga.  Vtlano gilo anadasdawadidohi, Gago nihi, gvwosedi yigesei, anigatahvgiyeno Ugvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsisa ulutsvgi ugisvgi gadu ale dunelvgi, ale nasquo atsadi dunvnelvgi.
english: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia hnaquo tsoine Tsisa gvnigesv nidudvnelv gvwasdawadidohi uyohusv dulenv nvdayudalenvdv.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ, ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎯᎠ?  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unalisdayvnonv, Tsisa hia nuweselvgi Sawani Quida; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, nihi utli nisgigeyuha esgaquo hia?  Hia nuweselvgi; Vv, Tsagvwiyuhi, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena anigina.
english: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᎾ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎤᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ?  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᎥ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ.
phonetic: Talina hia nvuweselvgi; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, sgigeyuhatsu?  Hia nuweselvgi; Vv Tsagvwiyuhi, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena.
english: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏌᏩᏂ, ᏦᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ?  ᏈᏓ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎭᏧ ᎤᏬᏎᎸᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᎬᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏕᎮᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ.
phonetic: Tsoine hia nuweselvgi; Sawani, Tsona uwetsi, sgigeyuhatsu?  Quida uyoiyu udanvdadvgi nvdayulisdotanvgi tsoine sgigeyuhatsu uwoselvi.  Hiano nuweselvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi nigav gohusdi higataha, higataha gvgeyuiyu gesvi.  Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Dehelohesdi diquatseliga uninodena.
english: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᏫᏅ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᏨᏒ ᎭᏓᏠᎯᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎮᏙᎲᎩ; ᏣᏛᏐᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏙᏔᏐᎸᏔᏂ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏓᏣᏠᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏮᏓᏣᏘᏅᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya, udohiyuhiya hia nigvweseha; Hiwinv tsigesvgi tsvsv hadatlohihvgi, ale tsadulisgv hedohvgi; tsadvsonvhisgini gesesdi dotasolvtani, nvwadaleno datsatloli, ale nitsadulisgvna gesv wvdatsatinvstani.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ ᎤᏪᏛᏨᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏁᏪᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi nuwesvgi uwedvtsvgi iyulisdanediyi uyohuhisdiyi gesvi, nasgino ulvquododiyi Unelanvhi.  Nasgino newesv, hia nuweselvgi; Sgisdawaduga.
english: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏛᎦᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏁᏥᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Quidano ugatahvsv ugohvgi adasdawadisvgi Tsisa ugeyuhi adasdawadidohi, nasgi usdvgalvnvhi Tsisa ganetsiyi analisdayvhvsgvi, ale hia iyuwedv tsigi; Tsagvwiyuhi, gago nasgi tsatludisgi.
english: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏥᏌ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎯᎠᎾᏃ ᎦᏙᎢ?
phonetic: Quida nasgi ugohv, hia nuweselvgi Tsisa; Tsagvwiyuhi, hianano gadoi?
english: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᏯᏇᎵᏒ, ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏙᏗ?  ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦᏉ.
phonetic: Tsisa hia nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsilutsvha gvdisgi ehesdi yaquelisv, gado nasgi tsvdodi?  Sgisdawadugaquo.
english: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏰᎵᏒᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏛᏲᎱᏏ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏲᎱᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᏯᏇᎵᏒ, ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi anadanvtli anehv uyelisvgi hia naniwesgvi, nasgi adasdawadidohi vtla advyohusi.  Aseno Tsisa vtla yvdvyohusi vtla yuwoselei, hiaquosgini nuweselvgi; Iyuno tsilutsvha gvdisgi ehesdi yaquelisv, gado nasgi tsvdodi.
english: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia na adasdawadidohi hia tsikanoheha, ale nasgi hia uwowelanvhi tsigi, ale idigataha nasgi kanohesgv udohiyuhiya gesvi.
english: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏣᏔ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏱᎪᏪᏔᏅ, ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎧᎵᎩᏉ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale asi utsata Tsisa tsulvwisdanelvhi, nasgi iyuno nigadv yigowetanv, gadanvtesgv elohi nasquo yakaligiquo goweli nasgi digowelanvhi.  Emenv.
english: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᏗᎣᏈᎵ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏣᏉᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏕᏲᏅᎢ,
phonetic: Ka Dioquili, igvyiyi tsaquowelanvgi kanohesgvgi nigadv Tsisa ulenvhv dulvwisdanelv ale dudeyonvi,
english: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏎ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ.
phonetic: Gvni nahiyu iga atsisaladanv, gayula Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uwatanvhi tsunetselvhi nigese getsinvsidv nasgi tsusuyedv.
english: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo gvnodv gvnigesv nidudvnelei, ugiliyotsvhi nigesei, utsati nudlasidvsvna adolehohisdodi gvdisgvi, nvgasgohi tsusvhidv gvwagohvi, ale Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ugvwali unohelvhi nigesei.
english: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨᏃ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏂᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, [ᏚᏬᏎᎴᎢ.]
phonetic: Dunilawitsvno dunetsele Tsilusilimi uninugoisdiyi nigesvna, unigatidisdiyisgini Agayvlige uduistanvi, nasgi sgiyadvganelvhi tsigi, [duwoselei.]
english: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᏳᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Tsaniyeno udohiyuhi ama dadawosdisgvgi; nihisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo dodayetsawostani ilvsgiquo iyusvhi.
english: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅ ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒ ᏙᏛᎯᏁᎵ ᎢᏏᎵ?
phonetic: Hnaquono unadatlisanv gvwadvdvnei, hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, hnaquosgo ayeli gotlvsv dodvhineli Isili?
english: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏩᏅ.
phonetic: Aseno hia niduweselei; Vtla nihi itsigadovhisdi yigi iyu ale nahiyu degesadisvi, nasgi Agayvlige uwasv itsuwanelidasdi tsinuwanv.
english: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏰᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno dayetsalinigohistani Galvquodiyu Adanvdo itsilutselvha, ale sginohesgi gesesdi Tsilusilimi ale nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Sameliyi ale nigvnadv elohi.
english: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏕ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏁᎢ, ᎤᎶᎩᎸᏃ ᏭᏕᎵᏤ ᏓᏂᎧᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuwesv, asiquo unagadosde atsisaladanei, ulogilvno wudelitse danikanvi.
english: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏭᎶᏒ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏫᏓᏂᎧᏁ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏁᎬ ᏧᎾᏄᏫ ᎤᎶᏗᏢ ᏚᎾᎴᏂᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Asiquono wulosv uyanvsvhi widanikane galvladi, gvniyuquo anitali anisgaya tsunegv tsunanuwi uloditlv dunalenilei;
english: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ;  ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᎾᎠ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏙᏥᎧᎿᎭ  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᏤᏥᏯᏅᏏ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏫᎦᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏤᏥᎪᏩᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏫᎦᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuniwesei;  Itsisgaya Gelili itsehi, gadono itsidonaa galvladi widotsikahna?  Nasgi hia Tsisa tsetsiyanvsi galvladi tsiwigalohi nasgiya nvdvdvneli dagalutsi tsetsigowadv galvladi tsiwigalohi.
english: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏌᎯᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᎥ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏅᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Tsilusilimi wiunilosei Oliwa tsudoidv usahilv unadanvsei, nasgi Tsilusilimi nav tsigi unadodaquasgv iga envsdi iyvdv tsigi.
english: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏴᎸᏃ, ᎤᎾᎩᎳᏫᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏂᏁ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏂᏗ, ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎻ, ᏆᏓᎳᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎹᏚ, ᏥᎻᏃ ᎡᎵᏈ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎠᏏᎶᏗ, ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᏥᎻ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Uniyvlvno, unagilawise galvladi kanvsulv wuniyvlei, nahnano anine Quida ale Tsimi ale Tsani ale Enidi, Quiligino ale Dami, Quadalami ale Madu, Tsimino Eliqui uwetsi ale Sawani Asilodi, Tsudasino Tsimi dinadanvtli.
english: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎾᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nigadv saquo igagadv naniyohisdisgvna anadadolisdisgei ale anitayohihei, ale nasquo anigeyv, ale Meli Tsisa utsi, ale Tsisa analinvtli.
english: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎴᏁ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏔᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Nahiyuno Quida ulene ayeli aninv anohiyuhvsgi, nasgi naniv dunadov asgohitsuqui talasgohi iyvdv gesei, hiano nuwesei;
english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏫ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏧᏩᏔᏁ ᏧᏁᏤ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏘᏂᏙᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏥᎬᏩᏂᏱᏍᎬᎩ;
phonetic: Itsisgaya didadanvtli, hia gowelv ase udohiyudi gesvgi, nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo Dewi aholi tsuwatane tsunetse Tsudasi atsinohesgvi, nasgi tsutinidolvhi Tsisa tsigvwaniyisgvgi;
english: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎦᎵᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᎳᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno ayv egaligotanvhi tsigesvgi, ale ageladistanvhi tsigesv hia digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎤᏩᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᏠᎨᏏ, ᎤᏙᎠᏒᏃ ᏧᏣᎷᏘᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎵᎩᏏ ᏥᏚᏄᎪᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino usganvtsvi tsugvwalanvhi tsiuwahistane tlogesi, udoasvno tsutsalutisei, ale nigadv tsuligisi tsidunugotsei.
english: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏎᎵᏓᎹ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎬᏱ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi unadvganvgi, nasgiyeno tlogesi unatseligaya uniwonihisdi gesv anvdisgv Aselidama deudov, nasgi Gigvyi gadvga.
english: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, "ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏅᏔ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎿᎭᏳᏁᎳᏕᏍᏗ;" ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ, "ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏩᎩᏍᏓ."
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv gowela Dikanogisdi gowelihi, "Ganelvi nvta winigalisda, ale tlesdi gilo nahna yuneladesdi;" ale nasquo hia nigvnv, "Tsulvwisdanedi gesv nvwadale wagisda."
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎨᏙᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎨᎳᏗᏙᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nasgi anisgaya igedolvhi tsigi nigohilv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa igeladidolvi,
english: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂ ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏣᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᏤᎩᏯᏅᎡᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏎ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏑᏰᏍᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎢᏗᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsani tsidadawosgvi nvdagvwadalenvdv, gvni nahiyu iga tsatsisaladanv tsegiyanvelvgi, nasgi hia anisgaya ase saquo asuyessdi, nasgi igeladidasdiyi unohediyi Tsisa deulehisanv idinohesgvi.
english: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏔᎵᏃ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ, ᏦᏩ ᏆᏏᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏣᏍᏓ ᏣᎪᏎᎰᎢ, ᎹᏓᏯᏃ.
phonetic: Anitalino dunikanei, Tsowa Quasiqua tsudoidv, Tsasda tsagosehoi, Madayano.
english: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏘᎦᏔᎯ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏯᏑᏰᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Unadadolistaneno hia nuniwesei; Nihi Tsagvwiyuhi, nigadv tsuninawi tigatahi, gvnigesv nvga nasgi hia anitali gesv nasgi hiyasuyesvi,
english: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏥᏚᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uweladidasdiyi hia digalvwisdanedi ale adanvsidv gesvi, nasgi Tsudasi tsiduyosvgi uwasv utseligohi wulohisdiyi.
english: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᎾᏎᏒᎮᎢ; ᎹᏓᏯᏃ ᎠᎦᏑᏰᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᎳᏕ ᏌᏚ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunasesvhei; madayano agasuyesei; ale agelade sadu naniv getsinvsidv unadatlugvi.
english: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Hisgasgohine iga usqualvhv, nigadv saquo igagadv unadatlugei.
english: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏃᏴᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏧᎶᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏃᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏣᏱᎵᏐᎢ, ᎤᎧᎵᎣᏁᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Uyeloistaneno usquanoyvgv galvladi tsulosei nasgiya unole utsati tsayilisoi, ukalioneno adanelv nahna aninvi.
english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎪᎮᏃ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏧᏓᎢ ᏗᎦᏃᎦ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏯᎸᏤ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dunigoheno tali itsudai diganoga atsilv nasgiyai, ale nasgi duniyalvtse anisiyvwiha gesvi.
english: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᏬᏂᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏄᏅᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Nigadvno dunikalitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale unalenvhe nvwanadale tsuniwonihisdi duniwonisei, nasgi gvwanineisdi nunvnehv Adanvdo.
english: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimino anedohe Anitsusi Unelanvhi aninayesgi nvdayunilosvhi nunadalesv anehv yvwi galvlo hawiniditlv.
english: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎵᏙᎸ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᎾᏛᎦᏁᎲ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏗᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi uninohelidolv unitsati dunilawitsei ale unadeyatanelei, nvdigalisdodisge danadvganehv daniwonisgv dinisiyvwiha tsuniwonihisdi gesvi.
english: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ; Ᏺ!  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏣᏂᏬᏂᎭ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Ale nigadv utsatanvhi unisquanigosei, hia nidunadaweselei; Yo!  tlasgo nigadv hia tsaniwoniha Gelili anehi yigi?
english: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏕᏓᏛᎩᎠ ᏗᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏕᎦᏛᏒ ᏗᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Gadono digalisdodiha tsidedadvgia didisiyvwiha degadvsv digiwonihisdi?
english: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᏗᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎻᏗᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᎻᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎺᏌᏆᏕᎻ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏆᏙᏏ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᏋᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ,
phonetic: Quadiyi idehi ale Midiyi idehi ale Ilamiyi idehi ale Mesaquademi idehi, Tsudiyi ale Gequadosi idehi, Quvdiyino ale Esiyi idehi,
english: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏥᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎢᏈᎵᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᎢᏥᏈᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎵᏈᏱ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᎢᏕᏙᎯᏃ ᎶᎻ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᎢᏗᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏗᏓᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ,
phonetic: Quitsiyino ale Quaiquiliyi idehi, Itsiquino ale Liquiyi Salini uduwidv idehi, idedohino Lomi idehi, Iditsusi ale Anitsusi didaligonelvhi,
english: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎵᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏈᏱ ᎢᏕᎯ, ᎢᏓᏛᎩᎭ ᏗᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilidino ale Alequiyi idehi, idadvgiha digiwonihisdi gesv aniwonisgvi, usquanigodiyu Unelanvhi dulvwisdanelv aninohesgvi.
english: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏛᎦ?
phonetic: Nigadvno unisquanigosei ale unadanvtetanei, hia nidunadaweselei, Gado hia gadvga?
english: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎾᏕᎰᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏤ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᏨ.
phonetic: Igadvno danadehodisgv hia nuniwesei; Itse gigageaditasdi dunikalitsv.
english: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏌᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎬᎢ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏥᏧᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida sadu iyanidv anidonav gadogvi, asdaya unetse hia niduweselei; Itsisgaya itsitsusi, ale nigadv Tsilusilimi itsehi, hia nasgi itsanvtesdi, ale itsadvdasda tsinegvi.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏚᏂᏴᏍᏕᎭ ᏚᏂᏴᏍᏕᎭ ᏥᏤᎵᎭ, ᎠᏏᏰᏃ ᏐᎣᏁᎳᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno hia yiduniyvsdeha duniyvsdeha tsitseliha, asiyeno soonelaquo iyutlilodv kalawadisvi.
english: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏦᎢᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia Tsoili adolehosgi tsunetsei, hia tsinuwesei;
english: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏥᏯᏐᏅᏰᎵ, ᏗᏤᏥᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏥ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏫᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯᏃ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏒᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: "Hiano nvdagalistani ulisqualvdi gesesdi adiha Unelanvhi, nigav uquedali gesv aquadanvdo datsiyasonvyeli, ditsetsino anisgaya ale ditsetsi anigeyv anadolehosgesdi, aniwinvno ditsatseli unanelawisehesdi, tsunadvsonvhino ditsatseli anasgidasvvsgesdi;
english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᎦᏥᏯᏐᏅᏰᎵ ᎦᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏃ.
phonetic: Ale nahiyu aquadanvdo dagatsiyasonvyeli gatsinvsidasdi anisgaya ale anigeyv, anadolehosgesdino.
english: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎳᏗ, ᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale usquanigodi galvlo galvladi datsinanugowisi ale uyelvdv elohi eladi, gigv ale atsilv ale tsugasvsdi.
english: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏳ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ, ᏅᏙᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎩᎬ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ, ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏕᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nvdo iga ehi ulisigiyu nvdagalistani, nvdono svnoyi ehi gigv nvdagalistani, usqualvhidena gesesdi nahiyu iga galvquodiyu ale usquanigodiyu Yihowa utseliga.
english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ."
phonetic: Hiano nigalisdisgesdi, nanivquo gilo anadadolisdisgesdi Ugvwiyuhi dudov anvdisgesdi anitayohihesdi getsisdelvdi gesesdi."
english: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ.  ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᎴᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ,
phonetic: Itsisgaya Isili tsuwetsi itsadvdasda hia tsinegvi.  Tsisa Naselidi ehi tsigesvgi Unelanvhi gvnigesv iyuwanelvhi itsehvi, nasgi uwadisgv udalehi ale usquanigodi ale uyelvdvi tsidulvwisdanelvgi itsehvi, nasgi nihi nasquo tsitsigataha,
english: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᏩᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᏂᎨᏎᎢ ᏥᏚᏲᏎᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏂᏴᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᎦᎾ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᏕᏨᏔᏅ ᎡᏣᏛᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgi, Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi ale gayula gvwagohvhi tsinigesei tsiduyosei, nihi etsiniyvhv ale disgana ditsoyeni detsvtanv etsadvnv ale etsilv.
english: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ, ᏕᎤᎦᎵᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏴᎵ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi deuletanv, deugalisv ayohuhisdi gesv ehisdi uwehvi, vtlayeno yvli nigohilv nasgi gvwaniyvdi yigesei.
english: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; "ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎠᏆᎧᏛᎢ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢᏰᏃ ᎦᏙᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Dewiyeno hia nigawe nasgi kanohesgvi; "Nigohilv tsigowatisgvgi Yihowa igvyitlv aquakadvi, tsigatisiditlvyeno gadoga, nasgi vgitelvdiyi nigesvna.
english: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ, ᏥᏃᎦᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏓᏳᏯᏪᏐᎵ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi aginawi osiyu udanvdadvgi, tsinogano aliheligvgi, nasquono agiquedalv dayuyawesoli udugi gvdi gesvi;
english: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᏫᏱᏙᎦᎯᏲᎯ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏭᎪᎯ ᎦᎯᏰᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno aquadanvdo wiyidogahiyohi tsuniyohusvhi unatseligohi, vtla ale nasganvna tsatseli unelagi wugohi gahiyelisedi yigi.
english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏛ ᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᏕᏍᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ, ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏍᎩᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᏣᎧᏛ ᏛᏔᏂ."
phonetic: Gvnidv deganvnv desginanugowiselv, alihelisdi gesv dasgikaliistani tsakadv dvtani."
english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏕᏫ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵᏃ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏓᏑᏴᎢ.
phonetic: Itsisgaya idadanvtli nitsisgaihvna agayvlige Dewi itsvnohehisi, nasgi uyohusvi ale atsinisanvi, utselino atselisdv asi gohi tsigi igadasuyvi.
english: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎢ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Adolehosgisgini gesv iyusdi, ale agatahiyu gesv Unelanvhi uselitanv unetselvi, ayeli uquedali gesv unanugowisdiyi Galonedv, nasgi uwenv uwediyi,
english: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎢ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏫᏂᏓᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏄᎪᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia adolehosgvi nvtsulisdotanei, Galonedv tsulehisodi gesv unohelei, nasgi udanvdo winidatsiyohiselvna gesv tsuniyohusvhi unatseligohi, ale nasgi uquedali nugosvna gesvi.
english: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Tsisa Unelanvhi deuletanv, ale nasgi ayv nigadv otsinohesgi.
english: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi agatisi uwoyeni uwatanvhi usaladanvhi gesvi, ale Agayvlige uduisdanelvhi gesv tsunediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uwesonvyv hia gohi tsitsigowatiha ale tsitsadvgiha.
english: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏳᎶᏒ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪ ᎤᏩᏒ; "ᏱᎰᏩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᏥᎦᏘᏏ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Dewiyeno vtla yulisaladanv galvladi wiyulosv, hiayeno nigawe uwasv; "Yihowa hia nuweselv Ugvwiyuhi aquatseliga; Tsigatisi iditlv tsolesdi,
english: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂ ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ."
phonetic: Gvni getsasgagi ditsalasidiyi gasgilo nigatsiyvnelvha."
english: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᏏᎢ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi naniv Isii sidanelvhi gesv udohiyusv wanadolehohi, Unelanvhi Ugvwiyuhi ale Galonedv nuwanelv nasgi Tsisa nihi tsetsadvnvgi.
english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏚᏂᏣᏲᎴᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏲᏣᏛᏁᎵ?
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi unadvganv tsuninawiyi dunitsayolei; hiano niduniwesele Quida ale anisoi getsinvsidv; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, gado dayotsadvneli?
english: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏂᏥᎥ ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏕᏣᏬᏣ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛᎢ, ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Quidano hia niduweselei; Nitsiv ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, ale widetsawotsa, Tsisa Galonedv deudosdvi, etsidolisdiyi itsisganvtsvi; Galvquodiyuno Adanvdo dayetsineli.
english: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏤᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᏅ ᏗᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏧᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno etsiduisdanelvhi ale ditsetsi ale naniv inv dinehi, nasgi naniv Ugvwiyuhi Unelanvhi igatseli tsuyanvdi gesvi.
english: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏁᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏣᎵᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Ale utsate utli igai ikanetsvhi duwonetanei hia nuwesei; Ditsalisi hia niduyugodvna iyanadvnehi tsaneha.
english: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᏤᎯ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᎡᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏤ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unetsv ulihelitsvhi digvwadanilvtsehi degegawoei, nahiyuno iga uninequotse tsoi iyagayvli iyvdv.
english: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏂᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino ulinigidiyu dunilvwisdanehe getsinvsidv danadeyohvsgvi, ale unaligosvi, ale gadu anigvhaluyasgvi, ale anadadolisdisgvi.
english: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ, ᎤᏣᏖᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Nanivno yvwi unayehisdiyu unadanvdadei, utsateno tsudalenvdv usquanigodi ale uyelvdv dunilvwisdanehe getsinvsidv.
english: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵᏉ ᏄᏅᏁ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nanivno anohiyuhvsgi unadatlugei, ale ayeliquo nunvne nigav tsugvwalodi unihvi;
english: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎾᏕᎨ ᏚᏂᎶᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏯᏙᎮᎮ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale daninadege dunilogesv ale tsugvwalodi unihvi, ale daniyadohehe naniv nasgiya uninigvsehvi.
english: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᎠᏂᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᎨ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒᎢ, ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ,
phonetic: Nidugitsvnisvno saquo igagadv anedohe udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale gadu anigvhaluyasge dadaneladisvi, danalisdayvhvsge analihelige ale utlonasdi nudasuyvna gese tsuninawiyi,
english: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏂᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏫᏂᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᏕᎠᎵᎪᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Anilvquodisge Unilanvhi, ale naniv yvwi gvwinigeyuhiyu gesei.  Ugvwiyuhino nidugitsvnisv unaligosv dealigodisge nasgi getsisdelvdi gesvi.
english: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᏅᎭ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano ale Tsani itsulaha unenvha udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, adadolisdodiyi gesv iyui, tsoine iyutlilodv kalawadisvi.
english: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᏂᎨᏎ ᎤᏕᏅ-ᎠᏥᏁᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏂᎧᎲᏍᎨ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᏥᏕᎤᏙᎥ, ᏧᏚᎳᏕᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎ ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎯ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgaya ayouli nigese udenvatsinegei, nasgi nidugitsvnisv anikahvsge galohisdiyulodi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi nasgi galohisdiyi Uwoduhi tsideudov, tsuduladediyi uniyelvse aniyvhihi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.
english: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᎪᎲ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏂᏴᎵᏎ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏚᎳᏕᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi deugohv Quida ale Tsani hnaquo diniyvlise udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, duduladelei.
english: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᏂ; ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏗᏍᎩᎾᎦᏅᎦ.
phonetic: Quidano uyanvsvhi dukahnanei, ale nasquo Tsani; Quidano hia nuwesei, Disginaganvga.
english: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁᏃ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎬᎩᏁᎵ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Deuwohiyuneno, gohusdi dagvgineli elisgei.
english: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏓᎩᎭ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎩᎲ ᎬᎥᏏ; ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏤᎲ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎮᏓ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida hia nuwesei; Adelv uninegv ale adelv dalonige vtla yidagiha, iyusdisgininonv agihv gvvsi; Tsisa Galonedv Naselidi tsehv deudosdv talehvga ale heda.
english: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏃ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏆᎵᎢ ᏧᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏂᏚᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Agatisino uwoyanesv deuletanei; gilaquono iyvdv tsulasideni ale didaqualii tsulinigidiyu nidulistanei.
english: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎤᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏭᏂᏴᎴ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎡᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎵᏔᏕᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino dulitadinvsei, ulenei, ale uwedolei, ale itsulaha wuniyvle udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, edohei, ale dalitadegei, ale galvquodisge Unelanvhi.
english: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎪᎮ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nigadvno yvwi gvwagohe edohvi ale galvquodisgv Unelanvhi.
english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏬᎵᏤᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏰᎸᏎ ᏥᎦᎲᏍᎨ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwolitseno nasgi gesv uduladisdiyi tsuyelvse tsigahvsge uwoduhi galohisdiyi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi.  Utsatanvhino unisquanigose nvdigalisdodisge nasgi nulisdanelvi.
english: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᏕᎤᏂᏴᏎ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏔᏫᏤ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏥᏕᎤᏙᎥ, ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Asiquono atsinvwanvhi ayouli deuniyvse Quida ale Tsani, nigadv yvwi degvwanitawitse ayodatlahvi Solimanv utseli tsideudov, utsatanvhi unisquanigosgei.
english: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎦ ᎯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏙᏍᎩᎾᎦᏂᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᎩᏅᏒ ᏙᎩᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏙᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏦᎩᏅᏔᏃᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏪᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏃᏍᏛᏁᎶᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano udolehosv hia niduwesele yvwi; Itsisgaya Isili tsuwetsi, gadono itsisquanigosga hia, ale gadono uyanvsvhi dosginaganiha, nasgiya oginvsv doginalinigvgv ale osdosiyu gesv tsoginvtanoi hia gvwedasdi tsinosdvneloi.
english: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏅ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏕᏥᏲᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏣᏓᏱᎸᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏆᎴᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ ᏧᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Esigi utseliga, ale Tsegaqui utseliga, Unelanvhi digigayvlige unatseliga, ulvquotanv uwetsi Tsisa, nasgi nihi tsidetsiyosvgi ale tsetsadayilvgi agatahv Qualedi, nasgi uwegodiyi tsuyelvsvgi.
english: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏓᏱᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ, ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎸᎩᏃ ᎤᏓᎸᎯ ᎡᏥᎧᏁᏗᏱ
phonetic: Aseno nihi etsadayilvgi nasgi nasganvna ale udanvti, itsitayolvgino udalvhi etsikanediyi
english: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎡᏥᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏍᏗᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi gvnidv adanehi etsilvgi, nasgi Unelanvhi deuletanv uyohusvi, nasgino ayv osdinohesgi.
english: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎢ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏤᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎥᎥ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏃᏍᏛᏯ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎦᏛ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi dudov gohiyudi gesv nvtsulisdotanv nasgi dudoi ulinigohistanv hia asgaya, nasgi tsetsigowatiha ale tsetsigataha; vv, gohiyudi gesv nasgi utseliga hia unosdvya nuwanelv itsigatahv nigadv.
english: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Ka idadanvtli tsigataha nitsigatahvna gesv nvtsulisdotanv nasgi nitsadvnelvi, ale nasquo ditsatseli unigvwiyuhi.
english: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎧᎵᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏥᏕᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia tsinulistanv Unelanvhi ukalilv nasgi gayula gvnigesv iyuwanelvhi tsigesei Galonedv ugiliyoisdiyi, nigadv tsutseli anadolehosgi diniholi tsidegvdisgei.
english: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ, ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ditsinetliyvna detsadanvdvi, ale itsagatahvna, udanvgalvdiyi itsisganvtsvi, nasgi osdv adanvdadisdi gesv unanugoisdiyi Ugvwiyuhiyi nvdayudalenvhi.
english: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᏳᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎡᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Ale nvdayunvsdiyi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi gayula etsalitsidonelvhi tsigi;
english: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏭᏕᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎵᎰᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏧᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅᎢ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi galvladi wudedi tsigi gvni nahiyu aliyilolvha udanetliyvsdi gesv nigavi, nasgi Unelanvhi unetsvhi tsigi tsutseli getsilvquodi anadolihosgi diniholi tsuwatanvhi tsigi, elohi tsudotlvnvi nvdagvwadalenvdv.
