english: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎤᏪᏎᎴ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ; "ᏱᎰᏩ ᎢᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᏁᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Mosiyeno hia nideuwesele digidoda; "Yihowa itsanelanvhi datsinanugowiseli adolehosgi itsalinvtli gesv dagananugotsi, ayv nasgiyai; nasgi dayetsadvdasdaneli nigav itsinetsedi gesvi.
english: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎠᎨᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏑᏴ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ."
phonetic: Hiano nvdagalistani nasgi gilo nigohiyuhvsgvna igesesdi nasgi adolehosgi, atsidvdodi ageladisdi gesesdi udasuyv yvwi anehvi."
english: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏌᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏂ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo nigadv anadolehosgi Sami nvdayudalenvdv, nasgi oni uninanugotsvhi, naniv uniwonisvhi, nasquo unineistanv gohi gesvi.
english: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏚᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ; "ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ."
phonetic: Nihi anadolehosgi tsunetsi, ale nasquo tsuwetsi aduisdvi, nasgi Unelanvhi digigayvlige duduisdanelvi, hia tsinuwesele Equahami; "Ale nihi tsanetlvtanvhi gesv nvdagalisdotani nunadalesv yvwi elohi anehi osiyu iyunalisdanedi gesesdi."
english: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏅᏒᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎲᏍᎬ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi, unanugowisv uwetsi Tsisa, nihi itsehv igvyi unvsvgi osdv itsadvnediyi detsigatahvsgv ditsiyohisdiyi nitsvnehv nitsiv itsisganvtsvi.
english: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏓᏂᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᏚᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Asiquono daniwonedisge yvwi, atsilvanelohi ale osdv iyuwahnadegi udvnvdidulawiisdiyi ale Anisadusi gvwaninolei;
english: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏥᏐᏅᏤᎮ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᏁᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utsisonvtsehe nvdigalisdodisge daneyohvsgv yvwi, ale Tsisa anvdisgv analitsidohvsgv ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi.
english: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏂᏴᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏍᏚᏁ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏒᎢ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale degvwaniniyvge ale degvwanisdune ugitsvdv igohidv, hnaquoyeno usvi gesei.
english: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᎩᎭ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎾᏂᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unitsate kanohedv unadvganvhi unohiyunei, nasgino anisgaya hisgiha iyagayvli naniei.
english: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Hiano nulistane ugitsvdv, nasgi unigvwiyuhi tsunatseli ale dinilawigi ale dinowelisgi,
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᎾ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏱᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᏅ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Ale Ena nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, ale Kayiqua ale Tsani ale Eligi ale nigadv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gohusdi tsuwanv dunilawitse Tsilusilimi.
english: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᏚᏂᎧᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎ ᏚᎾᏛᏛᏁᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎦᏙᎥ ᎢᏍᏛᏔᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏍᏓᏛᏁᎸ?
phonetic: Ayelino dunikanv hia nuniwese dunadvdvnei; Gago ulinigvgvi ale gago gadov isdvtanv, hia nisdadvnelv?
english: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏗᏥᎳᏫᏤᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, hia niduweselei; Itsigvwiyuhi yvwi tsunatseliga ale Isili ditsilawitsehi,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏃᏍᏓᏛᏁᎸᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎣᎩᎾᎵᏱᎵᏕᎮᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Iyuno osdv nosdadvnelvi hia ayouli asgaya, iyusdi gvtanvhi gesv atsinvwanvi nvdigalisdodisgesdi gohi iga ioginaliyilidehesdi,
english: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᏥᎦᏙᎦ ᏕᏥᎧᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigatahesdi nigadv, ale nigadv Isili anehi anigatahesdi nasgi deudov Tsisa Galonedv Naselidi tsehvgi, nasgi dadahnawasdv tsetsadvnvgi, Unelanvhi tsideuletanv uyohusvi, nasgi nuwanisanv hia asgaya udiwasvhi tsigadoga detsikanvi.
english: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏯ ᏥᏥᏲᎢᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᏣᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini hia nvya tsitsiyoiselvgi ditsanesgesgi; nasgi unvsiyv nugvwiyusv adi tsinulistanv.
english: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎩᎶᎢ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎭ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla ale nvwadale giloi alisdelvdodi gesv yuha, vtlayeno nvwadale deudov galvlo hawiniditlv yvwi anehv alisgolvtanvhi yigi igalisdelvdodi.
english: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎾᏂᏯᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏂᏓᏂᏏᎾᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unadolehosvno Quida ale Tsani naniyagaihvna gesvi, ale unadanvtelv goweli nidanisinasvna ale nanigatahnavna gesvi, unisquanigosei, ale dunolitse nasgi Tsisa unedolvhi gesvi.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏫᎬᏩᎾᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Anigowatisgeno asgaya atsinvwanvhi itsulaha anidonaei, vtlano gohusdi wigvwanadvdi yigesei.
english: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᏥᎸ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno duninetsilv uninugoisdiyi danilawivi unvsv gesv unalinohelei,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏙᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎨᏓᏓᏱᎦ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; Gado dodadvneli hia anisgaya, nudlasidvsvnayeno usquanigodi dunilvwisdanelv gvnigesv nunalisdanelv nigadv Tsilusilimi anehi, ale vtla yeli yvgedadayiga.
english: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᏃᏣᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯ ᏗᏗᏍᎦᎩ ᏗᏗᏁᏥ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno utli igai tsunotsaloisdiyi nigesvna yvwi anehvi, ulinigidvya didisgagi didinetsi, gohi iyudalenvdv hia nasgi dudov anineisdisgv gilo uniwonedodiyi nigesvna.
english: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Widuniyanvhvno duninetsele Tsisa dudov unvdodiyi unineisdiyi ale tsunadeyodiyi nigesvna.
english: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᏧᎪᏓ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida ale Tsani uninetsv hia niduniweselei; Iyuno duyugodesdi Unelanvhi dodikanisgvi nihi utli igai itsvyadvdasdanediyi esgaquo Unelanvhi, ditsugoda nihi.
english: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎦᏲᎩᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎣᎩᏂᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᎩᏂᎪᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎾᏛᎦᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno unelagi gayoginiyelvdi yigi, oginineisdodiyi nusdv oginigohvi, ale oginadvganvi.
english: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏃ ᏙᎤᏂᏍᎦᏨ, ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ, ᎤᎾᏠᏤ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Asino dounisgatsv, dunikanei, unatlotse gohusdi gvwanisdvdisdi gesvi, nvdigalisdodisge unitsati yvwi, nigadvyeno anilvquodisge Unelanvhi, nvdigalisdodisge nasgi nulistanvi.
english: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏩᏅᎯ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏱᎰᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Asgayayeno nasgi usquanigodi iyagvnelvhi atsinvwanvhi ulosvsdi nvgasgohi iyudetiyvdv yihosei.
english: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎨᏥᎧᏅᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏅᎯ ᏗᏂᏅ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎸ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ.
phonetic: Degetsikanvno unaligonvhi dininv wunilosei, ale wuninohele nigav nigvwaniweselv nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi.
english: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᏦᏢᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv saquo igagadv Unelanvhi unisaladanele aninegvi, hia nuniwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, nihi Tsanelanvhi, ditsotlvnvhi galvloi ale elohi ale amequohi ale nigadv nahna anehi;
english: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᏫ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏨᏔᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏣᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ; "ᎦᏙᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hinvsidasdi Dewi aholi tsvtanvhi hia itsawedv tsigi; "Gadono tsunadalenvdv yvwi unitalawosei, ale yvwi unadanvtele iyunadvnediyi nasgi igvwalisdodi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᎾᎴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨᎩ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ."
phonetic: Unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi dunalenvgi, ale ayeli tsunilvwisdanehi dunilawitsvgi anatludisgv Ugvwiyuhi ale anatludisgv utseli Galonedv."
english: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏤᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨᎩ,
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyayeno anatludisgv nasganvna tsetsi Tsisa nasgi hilonedv itsula Elodv ale Quanidi Qualedi ale yvwi tsunadalenvdv ale Isili yvwi dunilawitsvgi,
english: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏦᏰᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᏧᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyunadvnediyi nigav tsoyeni ale hadanvtesgv gayula ditsugotanvhi tsigese nasgi iyulisdodiyi.
english: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ, ᏔᎧᏅᎦ ᎪᎩᏍᎦᎬ ᏣᏂᏁᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ ᏘᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏣᏁᏨ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Ka Tsagvwiyuhi, hnaquo, takanvga gogisgagv tsaninega, ale talisgolvdasi tinvsidasdi usdiunv nanisgaihvna iyulisdodiyi tsanetsv aninohesgvi,
english: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏙᏯᎯᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎯᏅᏫᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏤᏥ.
phonetic: Hadoyahidisgv dehinvwisgvi ale uyelvdvi ale usquanigodi dunilvwisdanehv anvdisgv deudov Tsisa nasganvna tsetsi.
english: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏚᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Unadadolistanvno ulitelvne nahna danilawivi, nigadvno dunikalitse Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale nanisgaihvna uninohele kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏄᏅᏁ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏯᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎠᏰᎵᏉᏰᏃ ᏄᏅᏁᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unitsati gesv unohiyunvhi saquoquo nunvne tsuninawi ale tsunadanvdo; vtla ale gilo aquvsv aquatseli yadisge gohusdi uhvi, ayeliquoyeno nunvnei nigav gohusdi.
english: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨ ᎨᏥᏪᏍᎨ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ ᏕᏅᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ulinigidiyuno naniwesge getsiwesge getsinvsidv gvnigesv nanvnehv denvlehisanv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa; nigadvno utsati osiyu gegadanvtesgei.
english: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏓᏑᏰ ᏳᏂᎬᎨᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏂᎯ ᏚᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏗᏅᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏲᎴᎢ,
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo yudasuye yunigvgei, nanivyeno gada ale dadanelv tsunihi duninadinvsei, nasgino uninadinvdv tsugvwalanvhi uniyolei,
english: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎨᏥᏯᏙᎮᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Ale unine getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi, nanivno nasgiya uninigvsehv getsiyadohehei.
english: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏏᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏥᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎵᏫ ᏌᏈ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Tsosino getsinvsidv Quaniqua tsidunoei, nasgi gadvgv osdv adanvdadisdi uwetsi, Aliwi Saqui udenvhi,
english: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏓ ᎤᎮᎢ, ᎤᎾᏗᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏲᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Gada uhei, unadinvsei, ale adelv duyolei, ale nasgi deune getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi.
english: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏃ ᏌᏉᎵ ᎤᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgaya Eninaya tsudoidv, udaliino Saquoli uninadinvse gohusdi unihvi,
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎯᏰ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎤᏲᎴᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uhiye igadv tsugvwalanvhi, ale udalii nasquo agatahei; uyoleno igadv, ale getsinvsidv tsunalasidenulodi unei.
english: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎡᏂᎾᏯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎢᏣᎧᎵᎡᎸ, ᎯᏯᏥᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓ ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Quidano hia nuwesei; Eninaya, gadono Sedani tsanawi itsakalielv, hiyatsigonediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale tsahiyasdiyi igadv nasgi gada tsugvwalanvhi.
english: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏛᏉ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏣᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ?  ᏣᎾᏗᏅᏃ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᎮ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᏢᏅ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ?  ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏱᎩᏯᏥᎪᏁᎸ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏯᏥᎪᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Tsinvwasdvquo tlasgo tsatseligaya yigesei?  Tsanadinvno tlasgo yitsahe hadanvtesgvquo itsvnediyi?  Gadono hia nasgi niusdi itsotlvnv tsanawiyi?  Vtlasgini yvwiquo yigiyatsigonelv, Unelanvhisgini hiyatsigonelv.
english: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏅᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.  ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Eninayano nasgi udvganv unvtse ale ulisquadelei.  Nanivno nasgi nulistanvi unadvganvhi utsatanvhi uninayesei.
english: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᏚᎾᎴᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏄᎳᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᎾᏫᏛᎲᏃ ᏭᏂᏂᏌᏁᎢ.
phonetic: aniwinvno dunalene ale unitsanulanei, uninawidvhvno wuninisanei.
english: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᎭᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏂ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎤᏴᎵᎴᎢ, ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ,
phonetic: Tsoihano iyutlilodv iyvdv oni udalii uyvlilei, nagatahvna gese nulistanvi,
english: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏅᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏕᏍᏓᎬᏩᎳᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᎥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano hia ninvweselei; Sginohvsi, tsigo nasgiquo igai desdagvwalanele nasgi gadohi?  Hiano nuwesei; Vv, nasgiquo igai.
english: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᏥᏍᏓᎵᎪᏅ ᎡᏍᏗᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏉ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏣᏰᎯ ᎬᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏛᎨᏣᎾᏫᏛᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida hia nuweselei; Gadono tsisdaligonv esdigoliyediyi Ugvwiyuhi utseli Adanvdo?  Gvniyuquo aquo galohisdiyi tsunalasideni tsayehi gvwanisanvhi, nasgino nihi dvgetsanawidvhi.
english: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏄᎶᏗ ᎤᏅᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏕᎴᎢ.  ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏂᎾᏫᏛᎲᏃ ᏭᏂᏂᏌᏁ ᎤᏰᎯ ᏫᎦᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv tsulasidenulodi unvtsei, ale ulisquadelei.  Aniwinvno uniyvlv uniwadvhe uyohusvhi igesei, uninawidvhvno wuninisane uyehi wiganvi.
english: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nigadvno tsunanelodi unadatlugv utsatanvhi uninayesei, ale nasquo nigadv hia nasgi nulistanv anadvgisgi.
english: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏁ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏲᏓᏝᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno utsate uyelvdv ale usquanigodi dunilvwisdanehe yvwi anehvi.  Nigadvno saquo igagadv anine Solimanv utseli ayodatlahvi.
english: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎬᏩᎾᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Anisoino anisgaihe gvwanaligonediyi; unitsatisgini yvwi gvwanilvquodiyu gesei.
english: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏟ ᏂᎦᎡ ᎬᏩᏁᏉᏤᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
phonetic: Anohiyuhvsgino utli nigae gvwanequotsele Ugvwiyuhi, unitsatanvhi gese anisgaya ale anigeyv.
english: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏜᏓᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᏂᏃᎯᎮ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᏗᏤᏍᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏂᏟ ᏓᏂᏢᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏄᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Dudlanvdvyeno daninohihe tsunitlvgi, ditsesdo ale diganitli danitlvdisgei nasgi udawadisdvquo nasquo Quida aisvi igadv unutlvdodiyi.
english: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏂᎷᎨᎢ, ᏓᎾᏖᏃᎯᎮ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎬᏩᏂᏱᎵᏙᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquono unitsate degaduwadisv nvdayunilosvhi Tsilusilimi anilugei, danatenohihe tsunitlvgi ale anisgina gvwaniyilidohi; nigadvno degetsinvwanei.
english: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᎴᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dulenv ale nigadv gvwaligonehi, nasgi Anisadusi tsunadoidv tsigi, unikalitse unitalawosgvi;
english: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale duniniyvhe getsinvsidv ale didasdudiyi duniyvtanei.
english: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏎ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno dikahnawadidohi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga svnoyi dusduise didasdudiyi galohisdiyi, dunugowisvno hia nuwesei;
english: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᎾ, ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏫᏣᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏗᏥᏬᏁᏓ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏗᏥᏃᎲᏏ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Itsena, udvnvdigalawiisdiyi witsalehvga ale widitsiwoneda yvwi widitsinohvsi nigadv kanohedv hia nasgi gvnidv ugvwali.
english: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎩᎳ ᏧᎩᏥᏍᎪᎢ ᏭᏂᏴᎴ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏕᏲᏁᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎯ, ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏁ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏯᏅᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv gila tsugitsisgoi wuniyvle udvnvdigalawiisdiyi ale dunadeyonei.  Aseno nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ulutsv, ale nasgi gvwaligonehi, dunitlisane dinilawigi, ale nigadv nunigvwiyusadegi Isili tsuwetsi tsunatseliga, ale widayanvhv unadanvse didasdudiyi.
english: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᏫᏚᎾᏠᏤ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᏗᎤᎾᏨᏒᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno dinadaniyisgi wunilutsv widunatlotse didasdudiyi, diunatsvsvno uninonei,
english: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎩᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᏩᏛᎮ ᏱᏯᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesei; Didasdudiyi udohiyuhi ogiwadvhv ulinigidiyu asduhvgi, ale anigatiya anidonav doyiditlv galohisdiyulodi, aseno ogisduisv vtla gilo yotsiwadvhe yiyaei.
english: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏁᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏮᏛᏍᏗᏥ ᎯᎠ, ᎤᏁᎵᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono atsilvgelohi ale osdv iyuwahnadegi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi, nasgi hia nuniwesv unadvganv, nasgi unadanvtetanei, Hatlv wvdvsditsi hia, unelisei.
english: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎷᏤ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏥᏕᏥᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᎠ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏁᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gilo ulutse uninonele hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo nasgi anisgaya didasdudiyi tsidetsiyvtanvgi aniyaa udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, anidonaa, ale daneyohvsga yvwi.
english: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎾ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏅᏯ ᏱᏕᎪᎬᏂᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono osdv iyuwahnadegi ale dinadaniyisgi gvsgaisdagi nidunvnelvna widuniyanvhei; danisgaiheyeno unitsati, nvya yidegogvnisda anelisgei.
english: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏘᏃᎸᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏑᏂᎧᏁᎢ.  ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏛᏛᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Dunatinolvno degalawiv igvyiditlv sunikanei.  Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi dudvdvnei,
english: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯ ᏱᏨᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᏗᏣᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ?  ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏕᏣᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei; Tlasgo ulinigidvya yitsvnvsdadele ditsadeyodiyi hia nasgi deudov itsvdodiyi?  Gvniyuquono detsadeyohvsgv Tsilusilimi itsikaliistanv, ale nasgi asgaya ugigv ogisdvdisdiyi, itsiyelvha.
english: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᏗ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Quidano ale getsinvsidv uninetsv hia nuniwesei; Unelanvhi otsohiyudi, vtlano yvwi.
english: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎸᎩ ᎨᏛ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi digidoda unatseliga deuletanv Tsisa, nasgi tsetsilvgi gedv tsetsadvnvgi.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎠᎦᏘᏏ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi usaladanv agatisi uwoyeni uwatanv, Ugvwiyuhi ale Adasdelisgi iyulisdodiyi, Isili tsunediyi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale gagetsinediyi unisganvtsvi.
english: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvno tsutseli otsinohesgi nasgi hia nusdvi, ale nasquo Galvquodiyu Adanvdo nasgi Unelanvhi tsunelvhi tsigi gvwohiyuhvsgi.
english: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏘᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏱᎵᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv dunitile tsuninawiyi, ale tsunihisdiyi uniyilidolei.
english: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᎴᏁ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎨᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏞᎦ ᏧᏂᎧᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono degalawivi gilo iyusdi dulene Aqualisi Gemeli tsudoidv dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi naniv yvwi gvwalvquodi, ale unetse getsinvsidv tlega tsunikahvsdiyi.
english: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏗᏳᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselei; Itsisgaya Isili tsuwetsi itseyatahesdi nusdv itsadanvtesgv idiyunediyi hia anisgaya.
english: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏚᏓᏏ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏤᎸᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏤ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏫᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎴᏉ.
phonetic: Ilvhiyuyeno tsunanugotse Dudasi gilo tsutselvsei, anisgaya nvgitsuqui iyvdv iyanidv tsigvwaligonelei, nasgi tsatsilei, ale nigadv nasgi gvwohiyunvhi tsunadigaleyotse ale tsiwigvwaniyotsidolequo.
english: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎡᎯ ᏣᎾᏎᎵᏙᎮ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏚᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Onino tsunanugotse Tsudasi Gelili ehi tsanaselidohe iyui, ale unitsati yvwi tsidutihnawidvhei, nasgino nasquo tsiuyohusei ale nigadv naniv gvwohiyunvhi tsunadigaleyotsei.
english: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᎵᏌᎳᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏤᎵᏏ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗᏉ;
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nitsvweseha, Tlesdi ditsalisalanelv hia anisgaya, unanelagi ditselisi, iyuyeno hia anadanvtesgv ale dunilvwisdanehv yvwiquo nvdayudalenvhi igesesdi, uyotsidasdiquo;
english: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎨᏥᏲᏍᏓ; ᏯᎵᎦᏚᏓᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏤᏣᏟᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini nvdayudalenvhi igesesdi, vtla yeli yvgetsiyosda; yaligadudagiyeno Unelanvhiquo tsetsatliyvehi gesvi.
english: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ; ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ, ᏚᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino gvwohiyunei; widuniyanvhvno getsinvsidv ale dunilivnilv, duninvsdadele Tsisa dudov unineisdodiyi, ale dunikanei.
english: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Uninugotseno degalawivi analihelige yeli udehohisdi igvwanalisdanedi gesv nasgi deudov nvdigalisdosgvi.
english: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᏃ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒ ᎾᏂᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎨᏎ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nidugitsvnisvno udvnvdigalawiisdiyi ale dadaneladisv nanisuligogvna gese danadeyohvsge ale analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv Tsisa Galonedv ugvwali.
english: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᏃᏎᎮ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᎨᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno anohiyuhvsgi unitsatanv, Anigoi uniwonihisdi aniwonisgi gohusdi danosehe Aniquilu, nvdigalisdodisge nigegagasayasdvna gesv tsunatseli anigeyv tsunosulotsvhi nidugitsvnisv aniyadohihvi.
english: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᏲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono taladu iyanidv unitsati anohiyuhvsgi widuniyanvhv hia nuniwesei; Vtla duyugodv yigagi iyuno yidogiyosga Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv degasgilvno yidogilvwisdaneha.
english: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏣᏑᏯᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᏁᏤᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, idadanvtli, itsvsv itsadatlugv ditsasuyagi galiquogi iyanidv anisgaya osdv getsinohesgi unikalitsvhi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale anigatanai, nasgi hia tsunilvwisdanediyi digayotsinetsedi.
english: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎯᎸ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᏲᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini nigahilv adadolisdodi gesv ale kanohedv dodayogilvwisdanedi.
english: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎢ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏑᏰᏎ ᏍᏗᏫ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎪᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎨᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎹᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎻᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎩ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgino nuniwesvi osiyu uniyelvne nigadv unitsati gesvi; ale unasuyese Sdiwi, asgaya ukalitsvhi uwohiyusv ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale Quiligi ale Quogola ale Nagena ale Tamani ale Quamina ale Nigi Vtiogi ehi Anitsusi tsuligonelvhi;
english: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ; [ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ] ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏚᎾᏏᏔᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino getsinvsidv aninv igvyiditlv dunikanei; [getsinvsidvno] unadadolistanv dunasitadei.
english: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎨ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Kanohedvno Unelanvhi utseli kanequogei, nanivno anohiyuhvsgi utsati aninequoge Tsilusilimi, unitsatino atsilvanelohi unohiyune gohiyudi gesvi.
english: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᏗᏫᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ  ᎤᏣᏖ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Sdiwino ukalitsvhi uwohiyusv ale ulinigvgv  utsate usquanigodi ale uyelvdv dulvwisdanehe yvwi anehvi.
english: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᎾᎴᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎳ ᎠᏂᎵᏆᏗᏂ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎠᏂᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᏱᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᏔᏁ ᏍᏗᏫ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunalene gilo iyunasdi digalawiisdiyi anela Aniliquadini tsunilawiisdiyi tsidudov, ale Salini anihi, ale Eliyigi anehi, ale Silisiyi anehi, ale Ediyi anehi, unalinohetane Sdiwi.
english: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎭᎷᎩᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlano yeli gvwanihalugisdi yigese asinasanv ale adanvdo degvdisgv gawonisgvi.
english: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ; ᎣᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎼᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono duninvse anisgaya nasgi hia iyaniwesgi; otsadvganelv nasgi kanegvi asotlvisdisgv Mosi ale Unelanvhi.
english: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏁᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏃᎴᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dunitelvneno unitsati yvwi ale dinilawigi ale dinowelisgi, uninoleno ale uniniyvhe ale degalawiv unatinolei.
english: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏰᎪᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ Ꮭ ᏯᏑᎵᎪᎦ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gayegogino aninohesgi dunikanei, nasgi hia iyaniwesgi; Hia asgaya tla yasuligoga kanegv asotlvisdisgv hia nasgi galvquodiyu gesv ale dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎧᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏤᎲᎩ ᏛᏲᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏁᏟᏴᏏ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Ogadvganvyeno hia nikawesgvgi; Nasgi hia Tsisa Naselidi tsehvgi dvyostani ani, ale daganetliyvsi iyadvnelidasdi nasgi Mosi iginelvhi.
english: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏓᏂᎧᏅ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno degalawiv anini uyanvsvhi danikanv unigohe ukadv dikahnawadidohi ukadv nasgiya gesei.
english: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᏄᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi hia nuwesei; Nasgisgo unohiyuhi nusdi?
english: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᏍᏗᏫᏃ] ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ, ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ.  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎺᏌᏆᏕᎻ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎨᎳᏂ ᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: [Sdiwino] hia nuwesei; Itsisgaya idadanvtli ale digidoda, itsadvdasda.  Unelanvhi atsilvquodi gvnigesv nudvnele igidoda Equahami nasgi nahiyu Mesaquademi tsehei, asiquo Gelani naneladisgvna tsigesei;
english: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᎿᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏙᎯ ᎬᏯᏎᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nuweselei; Tsatseligohi hinugoi ale gohusdi ditsvhna, ale nahna gadohi gvyasehedi gesv wilugi.
english: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏗ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎨᎳᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏕᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏗᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎡᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Hnaquono udanvse Anigalidi unatseligohi, Gelanino uneladei, nahnano diudanvsv, udoda uyohusv, esgani ulutselei nasgi ani gohi tsitseha.
english: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏓ ᎠᏂ ᏳᏁᎴᎢ ᏂᎤᏟᏍᏕ ᏏᎳᏏᏅᎯᏉ ᎢᎩᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale vtla gada ani yunelei niutlisde silasinvhiquo igidv, aseno uduisdanele nasgi utseli iyuwanediyi ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv asiquo uwetsi nehvna gesei.
english: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; "ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏤ-ᎵᎪᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᏙᏓᎬᏩᏂᎾᏢᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏅᏁᎵ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Unelanvhino hia nuwesei; "Tsanetlvtanvdv anedohi gesesdi nahna unatseligohi nigesvna gesvi, ale nahna anehi dodagvwaninatlvni ale uyo nvdagvwanvneli nvgitsuqui tsudetiyvdv.
english: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏢᏅᎯ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎵ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ," ᎤᏛᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino sunadalegi yvwi digvwaninatlvnvhi dodagatsiyugodaneli, onino uninanugoisdi gesesdi ale ani gohusdi gvquadvnedi gesesdi," udvne Unelanvhi.
english: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᏁᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ; ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏃ ᎤᏕᏁᎴ ᎡᏏᎩ, ᎤᎱᏍᏕᏎᎴᏃ ᏧᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ, ᎡᏏᎩᏃ ᏤᎦᏈ, ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdino unele ahusdesdi gesv ugvwali; Equahamino udenele Esigi, uhusdeseleno tsuneline iga, Esigino Tsegaqui, Tsegaquino taladu iyanidv digigayvligei.
english: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎠᏅᏳᏤᎲ ᏅᏗᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᏦᏩ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏩᎦᏘᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᎢ,
phonetic: Digigayvligeno anvyutsehv nvdiulisdotane uninadinvse Tsowa Itsiquiyi wagatinvsdodiyi; aseno Unelanvhi dukahnawadidohei,
english: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏭᏓᎴᏍᎨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎦᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏇᎵᏲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uwudalesge nigadv uyo nulisdanelidegvi, ale unele osiyu agadanvtediyi ale agatahnaiyu gesv agatahv Queliyo ugvwiyuhi Itsiquiyi, ale nugvwiyusadegi nuwanele Itsiquiyi, ale nigadv ganelvi.
english: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎬᎾᏛᏃ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎾᏂ ᏚᎪᏄᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎨ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Nigvnadvno Itsiquiyi ale Genani dugonulosei, ale utsati agiliya nulistanei, digigayvligeno unatloge unalisdayvdi.
english: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎡᎲ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ, ᏕᎤᏅᏎ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎩᎳ ᎾᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsegaquino udvganv utsalesdi ehv Itsiquiyi, deunvse digigayvlige gila nagesei.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏦᏩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎬᏬᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏇᎵᏲ ᏕᎤᎦᏙᎥᏎ ᏦᏩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎿᎭ
phonetic: Talineno Tsowa analinvtli gvwolitsei, ale Queliyo deugadovse Tsowa gohusdi tsuwahna.
english: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏩᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏎ ᏭᏯᏅᎮ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎿᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᎯᏍᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ.
phonetic: Tsowano udanvse wuyanvhe udoda Tsegaqui ale nigadv uwasv gohusdi tsuwahna, nasgi galiquasgohi hisgigali iyanii.
english: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᏈᏃ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tsegaquino Itsiquiyi wulosei, uyohuseno, ale nasquo digigayvligei.
english: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᎩᎻᏃ ᏫᏗᎨᏥᏅᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᏌᏁ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎫᏴᏔᏁ ᏥᏚᏩᏎᎴ ᎡᎹ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᎩᎻ ᎤᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Sagimino widigetsinvstanei ale degetsinisane atselisdv nasgi Equahami adelv tsuguyvtane tsiduwasele Ema tsuwetsi, nasgi Sagimi udoda.
english: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᏤᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ.
phonetic: Aduisdvno usqualvhidisei, nasgi Unelanvhi uselitanvhi tsunetsele Equahami, nasgi uninequotse yvwi ale unitsatanvhi nunalistane Itsiquiyi.
english: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏦᏩ.
phonetic: Gvni nvwadale ugvwiyuhi unanugotsv nasgi nugatahvna Tsowa.
english: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏏᎾᏌᏅᏤᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᎿᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi dasinasanvtsehe gohusdi digvhna, ale uyo niduwanele digigayvligei, nasgi digegadainvdiyi tsunasdi tsunetsi, digvwanadvhisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏕᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Nahiyu Mosi udenei, ale uwatanvhi uwoduhiyu gesei, ale atsisquanigotane udoda ganelvi tsoi iyanvdo.
english: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏓᎢᏅᏃ ᏇᎵᏲ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Agadainvno Queliyo uwetsi ageyv unesei, ale usquanigotanei uwasv uwetsi uyelvnei.
english: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᏏᏃ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Yisino ageyonvhi gese nigav anigatahnaiyu gesv Itsiquiyi anehi, ale ulinigidiyu gese uneisdiyi ale tsulvwisdanediyi.
english: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᏧᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nvgasgohino iyudetiyvdv nulistanv, udanvtele tsuwadvhvsdiyi analinvtli Isili tsuwetsi.
english: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎪᎲᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏛᎢ, ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏞᏤᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Ugohvno asiyvwi gayetsisotlvdvi, usdelvhei, ale utletsele uyo iyagvnelvhi, ale ule Itsiquiyi ehi.
english: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᏛᏃᎵᏥ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᏗᎬᏔᏂᏒ ᏙᏗᏍᏕᎸᎯᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nelisgei, dvnolitsi otsalinvtli Unelanvhi ayv aquoyeni digvtanisv dodisdelvhisvi; aseno vtla yunolitsei.
english: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏤᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; "ᎢᏍᏗᏍᎦᏯ, ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟᏉ; ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏙᏍᏓᏓᏛᏁᎭ?"
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno dunanugotsele analihvi, ale gagohisdanehe hia nuwesei; "Isdisgaya, disdadanvtliquo; gadono uyo nidosdadadvneha?"
english: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᎳ ᏗᎤᏪᏌᏙᏰᏉ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᎩᏳᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏣᎧᏅ ᏂᎯ?
phonetic: Aseno utsatini iyudvnelvhi nav itsunadala diuwesadoyequo, hia nuwesei; Gago nitsagvwiyusadegi ale disgiyugodanehi itsakanv nihi?
english: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᏚᎵ ᏍᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏒᎯ ᏥᎸᎩ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎡᎯ?
phonetic: Tsigo ayv nasquo tsaduli sgihisdiyi nasgiya usvhi tsilvgi Itsiquiyi ehi?
english: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎵᏘᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎻᏗᏂ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ ᎡᏙᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏩᏕᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv Mosi ulitisei, ale Midini gada ahv edohi nulistanei, nahnano anitali anisgaya tsuwetsi gvwadenelei.
english: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏌᎾᏱ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nvgasgohino nudetiyvhv dikahnawadidohi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga gvnigesv nudvnele inage sanayi odalv uweyodadv adaweligisgvi.
english: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎾᎥ ᏭᎷᏨ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᏎᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ;]
phonetic: Mosino ugohv usquanigose nusdv agowatisgvi.  Ugoliyediyino uyelvnv nav wulutsv digoliyesei, Ugvwiyuhi kanegv udvgane [hia nigawesgei;]
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏣᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᏅᏤᎵᎦ."  ᎣᏏᏃ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᏪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᎴ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ.
phonetic: "Ayv Unelanvhi ditsagayvlige unatseliga, Unelanvhi Equahami utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Esigi utseliga, ale Unelanvhi Tsegaqui nvtseliga."  Osino uwehnawei, ale usgale ugoliyediyi.
english: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; "ᏔᎳᏑᎳᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏥᏙᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuweselei; "Talasulagi, nahnayeno tsidoga galvquodiyu gadohi.
english: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏣᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᎵᏰᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏠᎣᏏᎸ ᏕᎫᏓᎴᏏᎸ; Ꭷ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏓᎬᏅᏏ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ."
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya agigohv uyo nunalisdanelidegv yvwi diquatseli Itsiquiyi tsaneha, ale aquadvganv duniliyedisgvi, ale aquatloosilv degudalesilv; ka hnaquo dagvnvsi Itsiquiyi."
english: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎼᏏ ᏧᏂᏲᎢᏎᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᏂᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏣᎧᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏲᏓᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia Mosi tsuniyoisele hia tsinuniwesei, Gago nitsagvwiyusadegi ale dugodisgi tsakanv, nasgi Unelanvhi unvse nugvwiyusadegi ale unudalesgi nuwanele uwatane dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv iyudvnelvhi uweyodadvi.
english: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎮᎢ ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎶ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ-ᎩᎦᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi dutihnawidvhei nidulvwisdanelo usquanigodi ale uyelvdv Itsiquiyi ale Amagigagesdvyi ale inage nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv.
english: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᏣᏛᎦᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi Mosi nasgi hia tsiniduwesele Isili tsuwetsi; Ugvwiyuhi Itsanelanvhi datsinanugowiseli adolehosgi itsalinvtli gesv dagananugotsi ayv nasgiyai; nasgi dayetsadvganeli.
english: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᏩᏕᎬ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᏧᏛᏗᏕᎨ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏤᎴ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏌᎾᏱ, ᏥᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏓᏥᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi na tsigeladidohe unadatluwadegv inagei, tali tsudvdidege dikahnawadidohi nasgi tsunetsele odalv Sanayi, tsigeladidohe anedohv digigayvligei, nasgi nasquo tsidatsiyohisele advnidisdodi kanohedv ayv iginedi.
english: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎢᏴᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏅᏁᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏈᏱᏉ ᏫᏂᏚᏅᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi digigayvlige vtla yunadulisge unohiyudiyi, iyvdvquosgini nunvnetanei, ale dunadanvdv Itsiquiyiquo winidunvnei,
english: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎴ ᎡᎳᏂ; ᏗᏍᎩᏲᏢᎾᏏ ᏦᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎪᎦᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎼᏏ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᏲᎦᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesele Elani; Disgiyotlvnasi tsoganelanvhi digogatinidohi, hiayeno Mosi Itsiquiyi nidodayogatinvstanvhi vtla yotsigataha nulisdanelvi.
english: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎤᏃᏢᏁ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᎮᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏧᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᏢᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno unotlvne waga agina, nasgino ditlilostanvhi atsilvgelasdi uniyohelei, ale unalihelitsele unvsv tsunoyeni tsunvtanvhi unotlvnvhi.
english: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏫᏓᏂᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ; "ᏂᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏕᏍᎩᏃᎮᎸ ᏗᎸᎯ ᎦᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏥᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Unelanvhi ugatahvsei, ale unanelagi widanilvquoda unitsati galvlo anehi duweliselei, nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela anadolehosgi tsunowelanvhi; "Nihi Isili sidanelvhi gesvi, tsigo desginohelv dilvhi ganatlai ale atsilvgelasdi nvgasgohi tsinadetiyv inagei?
english: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎲᏒᏰᏃ ᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗ ᎼᎳᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎴᎻᏈᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏦᏢᏅᎯ ᏗᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ; ᏓᏗᎶᏂᏃ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ ᏫᏙᏓᏨᏯᎧᏂ."
phonetic: Itsihvsvyeno galitsododi Molagi utseliga ale unelanvhi itsiyelvhi lemiquini utseliga noquisi, ditlilostanvhi nasgi ditsotlvnvhi ditsadadolisdanedi; Dadilonino udiditlv widodatsvyakani."
english: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎤᏂᎮ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ ᎼᏏ ᏧᏁᏤᎴ ᎤᏬᏢᏗᏱ ᏧᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Digigayvlige inage unihe galitsodv adolehohisdodi, nasgiya unetsvi Mosi tsunetsele uwotlvdiyi tsutlilosdodiyi nusdv ugohvi.
english: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏦᏑᏩ ᏧᎾᏖᏉᎶᏎ ᏧᏂᏲᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏚᎨᎯᏕᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏕᏫ ᏤᎮ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo digigayvlige digetsiyohiselvhi gesv Tsosuwa tsunatequolose tsuniyole tsunadalenvdv yvwi unatseligohi nasgi Unelanvhi tsidugehidele digigayvlige Dewi tsehe iyasdi.
english: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏔᏲᎴ ᎤᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi osiyu udanvtesgi nulistanei, ale nasgi utayole uwadvdiyi uneladisdiyi Unelanvhi Tsegaqui utseliga.
english: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᎵᎹᏅ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Solimanv unesgelei.
english: But Solomon built him an house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏱᎦᏁᎸ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏧᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎠ;
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv wasdv galvladiyu ehi yiganelv dadanelv gilo tsunoyeni tsunvtanvhi tsunanesgehvhi, nasgiya adolehosgi hia tsinigawea;
english: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎩᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯᏃ ᏗᏆᎳᏏᏗᏱ.  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏓᏍᎩᏯᏁᏍᎨᎵ?  ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎭᏢ ᎠᏆᎵᏙᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: "Galvladi agidiyi elohino diqualasidiyi.  Gado usdesdi galitsode dasgiyanesgeli?  adiha Ugvwiyuhi; ale hatlv aqualidohisdodiyi;
english: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏉᏢᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᏄᏍᏗᏓᎾ?"
phonetic: Tlasgo aquoyeni aquvtanvhi aquotlvnvhi yigi hia nigadv tsinusdidana?"
english: Hath not my hand made all these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏩᏗᏔᏯ ᏗᏥᎩᎵᎨᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏕᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎵᎷᎬᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᏣᏡᏗᏍᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Tsuwaditaya ditsigiligeni, ale nidetsiusdeselvna ditsinawi ale detsililugvi, nigohilv etsatludisgo Galvquodiyu Adanvdo; ditsigayvlige nunadvnelv nasgiya nihi nitsadvnehoi.
english: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏂᎸ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸᎯ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ;
phonetic: Gado usdi nasgi na anadolehosgi gesv ditsigayvlige vtla uyo iyunvnelvhi yigi?  Ale deunilv unadolehosvhi gvnigesv iyunvnelvhi uluhisdiyi nasganvna nasgi nihi etsilonuelvhi ale etsilvhi tsinulistanv;
english: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsetsiyohiselvgi dikahnawadvsdi dinikahnawadidohi osdv nunvhnadegvi aseno vtla itsisquanigotanvhi yigi.
english: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏘᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏄᏙᎬ ᏕᎬᏩᏄᏓᎨᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv dunitile tsuninawiyi, ale dininudogv degvwanudagelei.
english: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎪᎮ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ;
phonetic: Aseno ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uyanvsvhi galvladi widukahnanei, ale wugohe galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale Tsisa gadoge Unelanvhi agatisiditlv;
english: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᏙᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Gvniyuquo galvladi ulisduidv tsigowatiha, ale Yvwi Uwetsi gadoga Unelanvhi agatisiditlv.
english: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᏓᏯᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅ ᏗᏏᎴᏂ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎴᏃᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎷᎩᎡᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Asdayano unelunv disileni dunisdunei, ale ulenonvhi unanelugielei;
english: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏅᏯ ᏚᏅᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ.  ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏃ ᏧᎾᏅᏬ ᏚᏂᏅᏁ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏫᏅ ᏐᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Gaduhvno uninugowisv nvya dunvnistanei.  Anigatahino tsunanvwo duninvne dulasgv nav awinv Sola tsudoidv.
english: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏯᏃ ᏚᏅᏂᏍᏔᏁ ᏍᏗᏫ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᏌ, ᏔᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
phonetic: Nvyano dunvnistane Sdiwi adadolisdisgei, hia nigawesgei; Tsagvwiyuhi, Tsisa, tadanilvgi aquadanvdogi.
english: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏅᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᎦᎯᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᎸᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Duliniquanvnvno asdaya uwelunei, hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tlesdi hia unisganvtsv yigahistanesdi.  Nasgino nuwesv ulvnei.
english: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎨ ᎠᏥᎸᎢ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎤᎶᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎨᎬᎾᏕᎨ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏈᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏤ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ, ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ.
phonetic: Solano osiyu ayelvsge atsilvi.  Nahiyuno uloti uyo nigegvnadege tsunanelodi unadaquigv Tsilusilimi; ale nigadv unadigaleyotse nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Sameliyi, getsinvsidv unvsv.
english: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᏍᏗᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎪᏂᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Anisgayano Unelanvhi aninayesgi uninawidvhe Sdiwi, ale utsatanvhi unisgonilei.
english: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎮ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏈᎬᎢ, ᏓᏴᎵᏙᎮ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒᎢ, ᏕᎦᎾᏌᏁᏏᏙᎮ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Solasgini utsati uyo nidegvnehe tsunanelodi unadaquigvi, dayvlidohe dadaneladisvi, deganasanesidohe anisgaya ale anigeyv, ale didasdudiyi dayvdisgei.
english: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎮ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Unadigaleyotsvhino anedohe analitsidonidohe osdv kanohedv.
english: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Quiligino digaduhv Sameliyi wulosei, ale dulitsidonele dunohehele Galonedv.
english: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsatino saquo igagadv unagasayastane Quiligi kanohesgvi, unadvganv ale unigohv usquanigodi dulvwisdanehvi.
english: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎨ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏄᎪᎨ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏤᏖ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Anigadahayeno didanvdo asdaya aneluhvsge degvwaninugoge unitsate gvwaniyai, ale unitsete tsuninawisgi ale diniyouli dunadiwasgei.
english: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatanvhino analihelige nahna gaduhvi.
english: And there was great joy in that city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎮ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgininonv iyusdi asgaya nahna ehe Sawani tsudoidv nasgi nahna gaduhv adonvdi tsulvwisdanelvhi gesei, ale usquanigodi tsudanvdadistanvhi gese Sameliyi anehi, gilo iyusdi atsilvquodi atselvsgei.
english: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino gvwohiyuhvsge naniv getsilvquodi ale getsilvquodi nigesvna, hia naniwesgei; Utsati ulinigidiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga hia asgaya uweha.
english: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino gvwohiyuhvsgei, gohidiyuyeno gvwalenvdv gese usquanigodi dadanvdadisdisge adonisgvi.
english: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
phonetic: Aseno unohiyunv Quiligi alitsidohvsgv osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesv ale deudov Tsisa Galonedv ugvwali, degegawosge anisgaya ale anigeyv.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎦᏬᎥᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎠᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Sawanino nasquo uwohiyunei, agawovno usdawadidole Quiligi; agowadisgvno usquanigodi ale uyelvdv dulvwisdanehvi, asquanigosgei.
english: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᏕᎤᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏈᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno Tsilusilimi anini unadvganv Sameliyi deunadanilvtsv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, duninvse Quida ale Tsani nasgi tsuniwadvhvsdiyi.
english: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Nasgino wunilutsv unadadolistane gegalisgolvdanediyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏳᏓᏑᏰ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎯ, ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏎ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno asi yudasuye gilo nasgi ulutselvhi, digegawostanvhiquo uwasv gese deudov Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa.
english: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᎾᏏᏔᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunasitadei, ale nasgi getsinele Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏥᏁᎲᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᎾᏏᏔᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ,
phonetic: Sawanino udolehosv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo getsinehvi nvdigalisdodisgv danasitadisgv getsinvsidv, nasgi deulisgolvdanele adelv,
english: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᎩᏂᎥᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏏᏔᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei; Ayv nasquo sginivsi hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi, nasgi gilo tsiyasitadisgesdi atsinedi gesesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏫᏓᎵᏗᏛᏓ ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏤᎳ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida hia nuweselei; Adelv ditsatseli widalididvda tsvsv halidvdisgvi, nvdagalisdoda Unelanvhi udanedi gesv yeliquo adelv gvwahisdodi tsela.
english: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏣᏤᎵ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla gohusdi tsatseli yudasuya hia ani, tlayeno duyugodv yigi tsanawi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎯᏰᎸᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏯᏙᏓᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏰᏣᏙᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi uyo hiyelvna hia nasgi tsisganvgi, ale hiyadodalisdasi Unelanvhi, gayetsadolisdiquo yinigagi nusdv tsanawiyi tsadanvtelvi.
english: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᏣᏚᎲ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎪᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏣᏓᎸᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gadoleosgayeno tsaduhv uyvsdi adagohi, ale asgani tsadalvsdvi.
english: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎡᏍᏗᏔᏲᏏ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏍᏗᏁᎩ ᏯᎩᎷᏤᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Sawanino unetsv hia nuwesei; Nihi esditayosi Ugvwiyuhi agidolisdiyi, nasgino tlesdi saquounv hia tsisdinegi yagilutselesdi.
english: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎾᏨᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏖ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏁ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino uninohelv ale unalitsidonv kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga unatsvse Tsilusilimi wunilosei, ale utsate Sameliyi anehi duniduhv unalitsidone osdv kanohedv.
english: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᎶᎯ ᏂᎦᏅᏅᎢ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎨᏏᏃ, ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎾᎨ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino Ugvwiyuhi utseli unetsele Quiligi, hia nuwesei; Talehvga tsuganawv iditlv wilohi niganvnvi Tsilusilimi Gesino, nahna inage tsigi.
english: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏘᏱᏈ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏳᎾᎦ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎬᏗᏏ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏗᎣᏈ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᎦᏘᏕᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ,
phonetic: Dulenvno uwenvsei; gvniyuquono asgaya Itiyiqui ehi ayunaga atsilvquodi unetselvhi Gvdisi ageyv ugvwiyuhi Idioqui anehi unatseliga, nasgi nigadv adelv ugatidehi, nasgi udadolistanilvhi gese Tsilusilimi,
english: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏨᏏᏗᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏆᎴᎷᎯ ᎤᏣᎡᎢ, ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono utsvsidisei, ale daqualeluhi utsaei, agoliyesge Isaya adolehosgi.
english: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎾᎥ ᏫᎷᎩ ᏫᏯᎵᎪᎲᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏓᏆᎴᎷ.
phonetic: Adanvdono hia nuwesele Quiligi; Nav wilugi wiyaligohvsi nasgi na daqualelu.
english: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏗᏠᎸ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎰᎵᎦᎨᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᎵᏰᎭ?
phonetic: Quiligino nahna wuditlolv udvgane adolehosgi Isaya agoliyesgvi, hiano nuwesei; Holigageli nasgi tsigoliyeha?
english: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏆᏎᎮᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᎤᏔᏲᎴᏃ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎤᏦᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuwesei; Gado yigalisdoda, iyuno gilo naquasehehvna yigi?  Utayoleno Quiligi utsodiyi ale itsulaha tsunidiyi.
english: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ; "ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᎠᏫ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᏫ ᎡᎳᏪ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎬᏩᏍᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏍᏚᎢᏎ ᎠᎰᎵ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi gowelv agoliyesgei; "Agatinolvgi awi unodena nasgiya dihisdiyi, ale nasgiya agina awi elawe tsigeso gvwasyesgi anigatahvi, nasgiya vtla yusduise aholi.
english: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏄᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ ᎠᏥᎩᎡᎸᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏙᏓᎧᏃᎮᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏤᎮ ᎠᏁᎯ?  ᎬᏅᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ."
phonetic: Uyo nudvhnadegvi atsigielvgi utseli gesv duyugodvi; ale gago dodakanoheli yvwi nahiyu tsehe anehi?  gvnvyeno unigisvgi elohi."
english: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏳᎾᎦᏃ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏈᎵᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏎ?  ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎪ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎨ ᎩᎶᎢ?
phonetic: Ayunagano unetsv hia nuwesele Quiligi; Gago kanoheha adolehosgi hia nasgi tsinigawese?  Uwasvsgo, nvwadalege giloi?
english: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎠᎰᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎪᏪᎸ ᎤᎴᏅᎮᎢ ᎤᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Quiligino usduisv aholi, nasgi nahna gowelv ulenvhei unohehele osdv kanohedv Tsisa ugvwali.
english: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎢᏒᏃ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᎠᎹᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ.  ᎠᏳᎾᎦᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂ ᎠᎹ, ᎦᏙ ᎠᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁ ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Anaisvno nvnohi, amayi unilutsei.  Ayunagano hia nuwesei; Ani ama, gado agiyosdodane vquawosdiyi?
english: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎾᏫ ᏴᏗᎭ ᏲᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.  ᎤᏁᏨᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Quiligino hia nuwesei; yeliquo iyuno nigav tsanawi yvdiha yohiyuhvsga.  Unetsvno hia nuwesei; Goiyuhvsga Tsisa Galonedv Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi.
english: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏤᏃ ᏓᏆᎴᎷ ᎤᎴᏫᏍᏙᏗᏱ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏏᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏳᎾᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎦᏬᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Unetseno daqualelu ulewisdodiyi.  Hnaquono wunigasoasile amayi itsula Quiligi ale ayunaga, nasgino agawoei.
english: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎹᏱᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᎿᎭᎷᏒ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎮ ᏈᎵᎩ, ᎠᏳᎾᎦᏃ Ᏺ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏂ ᏳᎪᎮᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Amayino tsunadanvsv tsunihnalusv, Ugvwiyuhi Udanvdo utihnawidvhe Quiligi, ayunagano yo hnaquo oni yugohei, uwasvyeno wagadvi wulose aliheligei.
english: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏦᏓ; ᎠᎢᏒᏃ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎬᏂ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᎷᏨ.
phonetic: Quiligisgini atsiwadvhe Atsoda; aisvno alitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv nigadv degaduhv gvni Sisaliyi wulutsv.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎬᏬᎳᏕᏍᎨ ᏕᎦᎾᏰᏓᏁᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏁᎨ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏧᏬᎸ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Solano asiquo gvwoladesge deganayedanehe ale tsuhisdiyi kanege Ugvwiyuhi gvwasdawadidohi, nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsuwolv wulosei,
english: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏧᏅᏍᏗ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᏱᏚᏩᏛᎲ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᏧᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Ale dutayosele goweli tsunvsdi Demasga digaduhv digalawiisdiyi, nasgino iyu yiduwadvhv gilo nasgi iyusdi dinikahnawadegi, anisgaya ale anigeyv, nasgi digegalvidv tsutinohisdiyi Tsilusilimi.
english: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎢᏒᏃ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎾᎥ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᏚᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Aisvno Demasga nav wulutsei, uyeloistaneno igagati galvladi nvdayulosvhi duduwistanei.
english: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎤᏅᏨ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎲᎢ; ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Eladino unvtsv udvgane gilo kanegvi hia nuwesehvi; Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?
english: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ:  ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᎲᏖᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏯ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesei; Gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesei; Ayv Tsisa uyo tsiniyvneha:  udeyadodiyu ditsahvtesdiyi digosdaya.
english: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
author: Cherokee New Testament
