syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᎾᏪ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏣᏚᎵ ᎠᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎮᎾ, ᏓᏰᏣᏃᏁᎵᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino uwenawe ale usquanigose hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, gado tsaduli aquadvnediyi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nuweselei; Talehvga, digaduhv hena, dayetsanonelino itsadvnediyi.
english: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏁᎯᏃ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏂᏙᎨᎢ, ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Anehino aniwinv tsunvgewi nasgiya danidogei, anadvgisge kanegvi, aseno vtla gilo yanigowatisgei.
english: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏃ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎦᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎪᎮᎢ, ᎬᏬᏱᏅᏎᏃ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Solano deulenv eladi ganvi, ale digadoli dulisduisv vtla gilo yugohei, gvwoyinvseno Demasga wigvwayvtanei.
english: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎾᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏗᏔᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsoino tsusvhidv nagowadisgvna gesei, ale nalisdayvhvsgvna ale naditasgvna gesei.
english: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎡᎮ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ, ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎡᏂᎾᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᏂ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi tsunelodi ehe Demasga, Eninaya tsudoidv; nasgino unelawisehv Ugvwiyuhi hia nuweselei; Eninaya.  Hiano nuwesei; Ani, Tsagvwiyuhi.
english: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎮᎾ ᏗᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ, ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏫᏲᎦ ᏐᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏓᏌ ᎡᎯ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ,
phonetic: Hiano nuwesele Ugvwiyuhi; Talehvga, hena digalanvdv Gatsinosdv tsidudov, Tsudasino ganelv wiyoga Sola tsudoidv Dasa ehi.  Gvniyuyeno adadolisdiha,
english: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎲ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏴᎵᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏔᏛ ᎥᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale unelawisehv ugohv asgaya Eninaya tsudoidv uyvlilv ale usitadv vugowadvdiyi.
english: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎬᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Eninayano hia nuwesei; Tsagvwiyuhi, tsiyadvganelv hia asgaya unitsata gvginonelv utsati uyo niduwanelv ditsatseli unadanvti Tsilusilimi.
english: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏃ ᎤᎭ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏧᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Anino uha gvwanetselvhi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi tsulvsdiyi nigadv detsadov anineisdisgi.
english: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎮᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᎠᏱᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Aseno Ugvwiyuhi hia nuweselei; Hena, nasgiyeno tsiyasuyedv atelido aquatseliga daquadov ayidohi anigatahv tsunadalenvdv yvwi ale unigvwiyuhi ale Isili tsuwetsi.
english: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᏄᏣᏛ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnigesvyeno nvdatsiyvneli nutsadv ase ugiliyoisdiyi daquadov nvdigalisdodisgvi.
english: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏴᎴᎢ, ᏚᏏᏔᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏐᎳ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴ ᏔᎢᏒᎢ ᏗᎩᏅᏒ ᎥᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Eninayano uwenvsei, ale adanelv uyvlei, dusitadvno hia nuwesei; Sola vginvtli, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi gvnigesv tsinitsadvnele taisvi diginvsv vtsagowadvdiyi ale tsakaliisdiyi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎦᏔᏅᎪᎠᏎ ᎤᏩᏥᏍᎦᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎠᎦᏬᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv dugatanvgoase uwatsisgalv iyusdi, ale gilaquo iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nulistanei; dulenvno agawoei.
english: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏎᎢ.  ᏐᎳᏃ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏚᏪᎳᏗᏙᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Ulisdayvnvno ulinigosei.  Solano ilvsgi tsusvhidv duweladidole anohiyuhvsgi Demasga anehi.
english: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏁᎢ, ᎤᏃᎮᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igvwenvdvno digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisv ulitsidonei, unohele Galonedv nasgi Unelanvhi uwetsi gesvi.
english: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᎩ ᏥᏓᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏅᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎸᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᏘᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nigadvno unadvganvhi unisquanigosei, ale hia nuniwesei; tlasgo nasgi hia yigi tsidagiliyoisdodisgv Tsilusilimi hia denvdov anineisdisgi?  Ale nasgi iyusdi ani ulutsvgi, nasgi tsulvsdi widutinohediyi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi.
english: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᎳ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᏉ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏚᎪᎾᏛᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Sola kanequogequo ulinigosgvi, ale aniwonisgv dugonadvtane Anitsusi Demasga anehi, gvnigesv nigvnehe nasgi hia Galonedv gesvi.
english: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Yelino uwohitsv Anitsusi uninohele unihisdiyi.
english: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏐᎳ.  ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏗᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎭᎷᏁ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi dunugotanvi udvgane Sola.  Nigohilvno iga ale svnoyi digalohisdiyi dunihalune unihisdiyi.
english: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎮ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᏣ ᎤᏂᏲᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏠᎥᏔᏁ ᎠᏐᏴᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno tsunanelodi uniyanvhe svnoyi ale talutsa uniyotane unatlovtane asoyvi.
english: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏧᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏁᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎢᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Solano Tsilusilimi ulutsv tsunanelodi tsuligonediyi uyelvnei.  Nigadvno gvwasgaihei, ale vtla yanohiyuhvsge tsunelodi gesvi.
english: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᏚᏘᏃᎮᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏃᏁᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno Quaniqua wuyanvhv dutinohele getsinvsidv, ale dunonele Ugvwiyuhi ugohvi aisvi, ale nasgi uwonetanvi, ale nasgaihvna Tsisa deudov uneistanvi Demasga.
english: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ.
phonetic: Nasgino itsulaha anedohe Tsilusilimi.
english: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾᏃ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎮ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏁ ᎬᏩᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgaihvnano kaneisdisge deudov Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale Anigoi uniwonisdi aniwonisgi anadisvhihe aniwonisgvi.  Aseno unanelotane gvwahisdiyi.
english: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᎾᏘᏃᎴᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᏌ ᏭᏂᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Analinvtlisgini nasgi unadvganv, Sisaliyi wunatinolei, hnaquono Dasa wuninvsei.
english: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡ Ꭼ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎢᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsunanelodi unadatlu gv nvwadohiyadv nunalisdanele nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale Gelili ale Sameliyi, ale gegalinigohistanei, ale anaise nahna ganayehisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, ale osdv unigalisdadisgv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, aninequogei.
english: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏈᏓ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎵᏓ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, Quida nigvnadv uwedolv nasquo widulutsele unadanvti Lida anehi.
english: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏂᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏧᏁᎳ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏏᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᏂᏟ ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano uwadvhe gilo iyusdi asgaya Iniya tsudoidv, tsunela itsudetiyvdv gvwanisinvhi gese ganitli ulvdalvvsgei.
english: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎢᏂᏯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏣᏅᏮᎦ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏰᏍᏛᎢᏌ ᏣᏂᏏᏗᏱ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano hia nuwesele nasgi; Iniya, Tsisa Galonedv tsanvwvga; talehvga, ale hiyesdvisa tsanisidiyi.  Gilaquono iyvdv dulenei.
english: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎵᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏎᎶᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvno Lida ale Seloni anehi gvwagohei, ale Ugvwiyuhi iditlv wunagatahvstanei.
english: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏈᏃ ᎡᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ, ᏓᏈᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᎩ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsoquino ehe gilo iyusdi ageyv tsunelodi, Daquidi tsudoidv, nasgi anetlvtanvhi Dagi gadvga, nasgi hia ukalitsvhi gese osdv dulvwisdanehvi ale adanelvvsgvi.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏢᏨ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏬᎥ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane nahiyui, nasgi utlvtsv uyohusei, nasgino unawov galvladi kanvsulv uninvnei.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎵᏓᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏈ ᎾᎥ ᏂᏚᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏈᏓ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎵᏓ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏭᏂᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Lidano ale Tsoqui nav nidudalei, anohiyuhvsgino unadvganv Quida edohv Lida, anitali anisgaya duninvse wunitayosediyi udohidisdiyi nigesvna nidodayuwadvhvsdiyi.
english: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏚᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎤᎷᏨᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎧᏅᏑᎸ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏔᏁᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎩ ᏧᏪᏰᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano dulenv dusdawadvsei; ulutsvno galvladi kanvsulv wigvwayvtanei; nigadvno anigeyv tsunosulotsvhi gadogv nav anidonae daniyvgei, ale daninanugowisge hawini dinuwo ale tsudalenvdv dinuwo nasgi Dagi tsuweyewisvhi asi uneladidohei.
english: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏕᏛᏅᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ, ᏓᏈᏗ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᏚᏍᏚᎢᏎᏃ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ, ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᎪᎲ, ᎤᏗᏛᎮ ᎤᏪᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Quidano nigadv dunugowisv duliniquanvne ale udadolistanei, dedvnvno iditlv wugatahvstanv, Daquidi talehvga, udvnei.  Dusduiseno digadoli, Quidano ugohv, udidvhe uwenei.
english: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒᏃ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ; ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᏕᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴ ᎬᏃᏛ.
phonetic: Uwoyanesvno deuletanei; widuyanvhvno unadanvti ale tsunosulotsvhi, deunanugowisele gvnodv.
english: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏈᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Tsoquino nigvnadv unadvganei, ale unitsate unohiyune Ugvwiyuhi.
english: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎤᏬᎯᏤ ᎤᏕᏁ ᏦᏈ, ᏗᏑᏫᏍᎩ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanei, yeli uwohitse udene Tsoqui, disuwisgi Sawani tsudoidv ganelvi.
english: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᎮ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ, ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎨᎳ ᎢᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgaya ehe Sisaliyi, Kaniliya tsudoidv, asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, gela Idali tsunadoidv unadatlugv.
english: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᎮ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏁᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Udanvti ale Unelanvhi ganayesgi, ale nasquo nigadv ganelv anihe, utsati dinelvvsgi yvwi, ale Unelanvhi nigohilv adadolisdanehi.
english: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᎭ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎤᎪᎮ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎧᏂᎵᏯ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsoiha iyutlilodv kalawadisv gvnigesviyu ugohe dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseli ulutselei, ale hia nuweselei; Kaniliya.
english: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᏙᎢ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᏚᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ ᎠᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dukahnanvno ale usgalv hia nuwesei; Gadoi, Tsagvwiyuhi.  Hiano nuweselei; Hadadolisdisgv ale hadanelvvsgv dulisaladanv anvdadisdodi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᏦᏈ ᏘᏅᎵ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᏫᏯᏅ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ,
phonetic: Ka, Tsoqui tinvli aniwinv, wiyanv Sawani Quida tsudoidv,
english: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎳ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏗᏑᏫᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ ᏥᎦᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi uwola gilo iyusdi ganelv Sawani tsudoidv, disuwisgi, nasgi amayulodi tsiganelv, nasgi datsanoneli itsadvnediyi.
english: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino udanvsv nasgi Kaniliya uwonetanvhi, anitali widuyanvhe adanelv tsunvsidasdi ale saquo ayawisgi Unelanvhi adadolisdanehi nigohilv gvwagatidisgi gesv gela.
english: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎸ, ᏦᏈ ᏚᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigadv dunohehelv, Tsoqui dunvsei.
english: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᎢᏎ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᎤᏂᎷᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏈᏓ ᎤᎩᎳᏫᏎ ᎦᏌᎾᎵ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno anaise ale hnaquo navnige unilule digaduhvi, Quida ugilawise gasanali udadolistanvse taladu iyutlilodv iyvdv kalawadisvi.
english: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏣᎦᎵᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatino uyosisanei, ale udulisge ulisdayvdiyi, aseno asiquo anadvnvisdisge tsagaliho nasgiya nulisdanelei.
english: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎪᎮᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏧᏍᏗᏗᏎ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏆ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᏅᎩ ᏚᏅᏏᏴ ᏥᏕᎦᎸᎣᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Ugoheno galvladi ulisduidv gesei, ale gohusdi iyusdi atelido eladi nvtsusdidise, nasgiya equa anuwo, nvgi dunvsiyv tsidegalvoi, nasgino eladi igvnelvhi tsigeso elohi iyvdv.
english: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᎡ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nahnano aniyae nigadv tsunadalenvdv nvgi dininvsadi elohi anehi, ale inage anehi, ale anadanasinidohi, ale galvlo aninohilidohi.
english: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎠᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏈᏓ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎪᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Atsinetseleno hia nvdiatsiweselei; Quida, talehvga, hiluga ale halisdayvhvga, agoselei.
english: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏞᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏯᎩᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎦᎸᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Quidano hia nuwesei; Tlesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tleyeno ilvhiyu yagigo gohusdi gadaha ale niganvgalvhvna.
english: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎠᏥᏪᏎᎵᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Talineno hia nvdiatsiweselii; Unelanvhi unvgalvdv nasgi tlesdi gadaha yosehesdi.
english: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏦᎢ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᎤᎵᏌᎳᏓᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia tsoi nulistanei, hnaquono atelido taline galvladi wiulisaladanei.
english: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏛᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏌᏩᏂ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎡ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ;
phonetic: Asiquono Quida adanvtesge nusdv gadvgv nasgi unelawiselvi, gvniyuquo aniwinv nasgi Kaniliya nidodayunvsvhi unadadvdvnvhi gese Sawani ganelvi, ale anidonae galohisdiyulodi;
english: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏛᏁᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏬᎳ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Wunalistanvno unadadvdvnei; Anisgo uwola Sawani Quida tsudoidv, unadvnei.
english: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎨᏣᏲᎭ.
phonetic: Asiquono Quida adanvtesge unelawiselvi, Adanvdo hia nuweselei, gvniyuquo anitsoi aniwinv getsayoha.
english: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎭᏠᎠᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏢᏫᏎᎲᎾ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏗᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Ka, talehvga, hatloahi, ale tisdawaduga gohusdi niditsatlvwisehvna, ayvyeno ditsinvsidv.
english: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏠᎠᏒ ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏧᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᏩᏯᏅᎯᎸᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏲᎭ.  ᎦᏙ ᏧᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏥᎷᎩ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida utloasv widulutselv aniwinv Kaniliya tsunvsidv gvwayanvhilvhi, hia nuwesei; Gvniyuquo ayv nasgi tsetsiyoha.  Gado tsuliyeilvstanv hia tsitsilugi?
english: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᏚᏳᎯᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᏫᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei; Kaniliya asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, duyuhidv iyadvnehi asgaya ale Unelanvhi ganayesgi, ale osdv gvwanohesgi naniv sunadalegi gesv Anitsusi, unetselvgi galvquodi dikahnawadidohi, udanvsdiyi tsuwenvsv witsaluhisdiyi ale hiwonisgv udvgodiyi.
english: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎸᏃ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁᎢ.  ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏕᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏦᏈ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dutayoselvno uniyvsdiyi, ale dusquanigotanei.  Ugitsvdvno Quida deusdawadvsei, ale gilo iyunasdi analinvtli tsoqui anehi gvwaligonelei.
english: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎴᎢ.  ᎧᏂᎵᏯᏃ ᎤᏂᎦᏘᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏟᏌᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Wiugitsvnvno Sisaliyi wuniyvlei.  Kaniliyano unigatiyei, ale tsuwetlisanvhi gese gohusdi tsuwani ale tsulii.
english: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏗᏴᎵᏎ ᎧᏂᎵᏯ ᏕᎤᏠᏎᎢ, ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎤᏅᏨ ᏈᏓ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quida diyvlise Kaniliya deutlosei, eladino unvtsv Quida dulasgv udadolisdanelei.
english: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫᏉ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida deuletane hia nuwesei; Talehvga, ayv nasquo yvwiquo.
english: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏉᏃ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨ, ᏭᏴᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏛᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎡᎢ.
phonetic: Asequono alinohedisge, wuyvlei; ale duwadvhe unitsate danilawiei.
english: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏙᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᎠᏴ ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᏅᎦᎸᎥᎾ ᏥᏲᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia niduweselei; Itsigatahaquo udanvsdosvhi gesv gilo Atsusi unedasdiyi ale uwadvdiyi gilo nvwadale yvwi; aseno Unelanvhi gvnigesv naquvnelv ayv gilo yvwi gadaha ale natsinvgalvvna tsiyosedi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎪᏁᎶᏍᎬᎾ ᏛᏇᏅᏒᎩ ᏮᎩᏯᏅᎰᎸᏉ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏛᎲᎦ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏫᏍᎩᏯᏅᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi gohusdi nasgonelosgvna dvquenvsvgi wvgiyanvholvquo.  Nasgino iyusdi itsvyadvdvhvga nvtsulisdotanv wisgiyanvhvi.
english: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏂᎵᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏅᎩ ᏄᏒᎭ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ, ᏦᎢᏃ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏁᎸᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᏧᏄᏫ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎠᏆᎴᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Kaniliyano hia nuwesei; Nvgi nusvha amatli gvsgvgi hia iyu kalawadisv iyasdi, tsoino iyutlilodv kalawadisv gadadolisdisgv tsinelvi, gvniyuquono asgaya digvwalvsada tsunuwi igvyitlv aqualenelvgi.
english: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎧᏂᎵᏯ, ᎭᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏓᏁᎸᎢᏍᎬ ᎠᏅᏔ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Kaniliya, hadadolisdisgv etsadvganelv ale hadanelvisgv anvta Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᏦᏈ ᎭᏓᏅᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏯᏅ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎳ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏗᏑᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᏓᏣᏬᏁᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ka, Tsoqui hadanvli, ale wiyanv Sawani Quida tsudoidv; nasgi uwola Sawani disuwisgi ganelvi amayulodi, nasgi galutsvha datsawonetani.
english: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏪᏣᏯᏅᏗᏱ; ᎣᏏᏳᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᎩ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏤᏙᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏣᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Howano gilaquo iyvdv aquadanvsvgi wetsayanvdiyi; osiyuno nitsadvnelv tsilugi.  Hnaquono nigadv ani otsedoha Unelanvhi agatahvi, ogadvnvisdi ogadvgodiyi nigav Unelanvhi tsanetselvhi gesvi.
english: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎠᎰᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎩᎶ ᏧᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Quidano usduisv aholi, hia nuwesei; Udohiyuhiya gadoleosga Unelanvhi gilo tsulvquododi nigesvna gesvi;
english: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏳᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎦᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivquosgini tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi gilo nasgi yunayesga ale duyugodv yidulvwisdaneha nasgi dagadanilvgoi.
english: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏎ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ,
phonetic: Kanohedv tsudanvse Isili tsuwetsi unadvgodi tsikanohesge osdv kanohedv nvwadohiyadv ugvwali Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv nasgi Ugvwiyuhi naniv unatseliga,
english: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏨᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏄᎵᏥᏙᏃ ᏣᏂ^
phonetic: Nasgi kanohedv itsigataha, gvnigesv tsinulistanv nigvnadv Tsudiyi, Gelili tsvdayudalenvhv didawosdi gesv ugvwali nulitsidono Tsani^
english: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏚᎶᏁᏔᏁ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏙᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎧᏅᏫᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏅᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale ulinigidv gesv tsidulonetane Tsisa Naselidi ehi, nasgi tsedohv osdv dulvwisdanehvi, ale dekanvwisgv nigadv uyo iyunvhnadegi asgina; Unelanvhiyeno dukahnawadidohvgi.
english: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᎩ ᎨᏛ ᏧᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvno otsinohesgi nasgi nigadv nudvnelidolv Anitsusi unatseligohi ale Tsilusilimi; nasgi tsunilvgi gedv tsunadvnvgi.
english: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi tsoine iga deuletanvgi ale gvnigesv niduwanelvgi,
english: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᎬᏩᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎦᏗᏔᎲᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏥᏂᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla nigadv yvwi, aninohesgiquosgini unvsv Unelanvhi gayula digvwasuyedv tsigesvgi, nasgi ayv itsulaha ogalisdayvnvhi ale tsogaditahvhi nasgi uyohusv tsulehisanvhi tsinigesei.
english: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏦᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᎧᏅ ᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Ale oginetselvgi yvwi tsotsalitsidonediyi, ale oginohediyi nasgi Unelanvhi uwekanv digugodanehi nuwanelv dinvnodv ale tsuniyohusvhi.
english: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ, ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigadv anadolehosgi gvwanoheha, hia naniweha; nasgi Gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi nasgi deudovi, atsidolisdi gesesdi usganvtsvi.
english: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Asiquono Quida hia nasgi nigawesgei, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo eladi nudvnele unilutsele nigadv anadvgisgi kanohedv.
english: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏈᏓ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᏰᎸ ᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Digetsiusdeselvhino anohiyuhvsgi nigadv Quida nvdagvwasdawadvdv utsati unisquanigosei, nvdigalisdodisge tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasquo getsisonvyelv getsinelv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏛᎦᏁᎴᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Dunadvganeleyeno tsudalenvdv daniwonisgv ale anilvquodisgv Unelanvhi.  Hnaquono Quida unetse hia nuwesei;
english: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏅᏍᏙᎯ ᎠᎹ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigo gilo yunvsdohi ama hia nasgi digegawosdiyi nasgi nasquo Galvquodiyu Adanvdo tsigetsinelv nasgiya ayv eginelvi?
english: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Deunetseleno digegawosdiyi deudosdv Ugvwiyuhi.  Hnaquono gvwatayosele ilvsgi tsusvhidv uwediyi.
english: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidvno ale analinvtli Tsudiyi anehi unadvgane nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasquo dunadanilvtsv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎷᏨ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᎦᏘᎸᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Quidano Tsilusilimi wulutsv digetsiusdeselvhi degvwagatilvsei,
english: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᎡᎢ; ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᏕᎯᏴᏎᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuniweei; nidigetsiusdeselvna dehiyvselei, ale nasgi itsulaha itsalisdayvnei.
english: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno Quida ulenvhe dunohehele nigadv osdv uyilvsei, hia nuwesei;
english: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᏈ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏙᎲᎩ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᏣᎦᎵᎰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏍᏗᏗᏒᎩ, ᎡᏆ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏅᏏᏴ ᏥᏚᏂᏂᏴᏐᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoqui gaduhv gedohvgi gadadolisdisgvgi; tsagalihono nasgiya naqualisdanelv aquanelawiselvgi, atelido agigohvgi eladi nvdayusdidisvgi, equa anuwo nasgiyai galvladi nvdayudalenvhi, nvgi nidunvsiyv tsiduniniyvsoi; ale ayv agilutselvgi.
english: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino aquagadostanv aquadanvtelvgi ale detsigovgi nvgi dininvsadi elohi anehi ale inage anehi ale anadanasinidohi ale galvlo aninohilidohi.
english: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᏈᏓ, ᎯᎷᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ.
phonetic: Kanegvno aquadvganvgi hia nagiweselvgi; Talehvga Quida, hiluga ale halisdayvhvga.
english: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎦᎸᎲᎾ ᏳᏴᎶ ᏥᎣᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nagiwesvgi; Tlesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi, tlayeno ilvhiyu gohusdi gadaha ale niganvgalvhvna yuyvlo tsioli.
english: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᎠᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᎤᎶᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno kanegv taline hia nvdvagiweselvgi galvladi dvulosvgi; Unelanvhi unvgalvdv nasgi tlesdi gadaha yosehesdi.
english: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏭᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoino nasgi hia nulistanvgi, nigadvno galvladi taline wulisaladanvgi.
english: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏉᎸᎢ, ᎬᎩᏯᏅᎰᎸᎯ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono gilaquo iyvdv tsoi iyanidv anisgaya anidonav adanelv nahna aquolvi, gvgiyanvholvhi Sisaliyi nvdagetsinvsvhi.
english: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏢᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᏘᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.  ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏆᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᏬᎩᏴᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Adanvdono hia nagiweselvgi; gohusdi niditsatlvwisehvna tisdawaduga.  Nasquono hia nasgi sudali iyanidv idadanvtli gvqualigonelvgi, ale nasgi asgaya diganelv wogiyvlvgi.
english: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎣᎩᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏙᎨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏦᏈ ᏘᏅᎵ ᎠᏂᏫᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏯᏅ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgino oginonelvgi ugohvi dikahnawadidohi uwasv ganelvi nasgi gadoge hia nuweselei; Tsoqui tinvli aniwinv, ale wiyanv Sawani Quida tsudoidv;
english: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏣᏃᏁᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi datsanoneli itsadvnediyi tsalisdelvdiyi nihi ale nigadv ditsatseli sidanelvi.
english: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎴᏅᎲᏃ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aqualenvhvno agiwonisv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo eladi nudvnelvgi, unilutsegi, nasgiya ayv tsigilutselv didalenisgvi.
english: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎹ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Hnaquono aquanvdadvgi Ugvwiyuhi unetsvi, hia tsinuwesvgi; Tsani udohiyuhi ama dadawosdisgvgi, nihisgini Galvquodiyu Adanvdo dodayetsawostani.
english: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᏙ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏎ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Iyuno Unelanvhi tsunelvhi yigi udanedi gesv nasgiya tsiginelvgi ayv nasgi edoiyunvhi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, gado ayv gese yeli gatsiyosdodanedi gese Unelanvhi.
english: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ:  ᎾᏍᏉᎧᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎤᏁᎸ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᎯ.
phonetic: Unadvganvno nasgi elawe unvnei, ale unilvquotane Unelanvhi, hia nuniwesei:  nasquokani Unelanvhi tsunadalenvdv yvwi deunelv dunadanvdv tsuninetliyvsdiyi gvnidv waliyilohihi.
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ, ᏨᏧᏓᎴᏅᎮ ᏍᏗᏫ, ᏈᏂᏏ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᎮᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Unadigaleyotsvhino nahiyu uyo tsinunalisdanele, tsvtsudalenvhe Sdiwi, Quinisi iyvdv wunedolei, ale Saqui, ale Vtiogi, Anitsusiquo unvsv kanohedv daninohehehei.
english: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏌᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᏚᏂᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgino igadv Saqui ale Salini anehi gesei, nasgi Vtiogi wunilutsv duniwonetane Anigoi, aninohesge osdv kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa ugvwali.
english: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎨᎢ, ᎤᏂᏤᏖᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino uwoyeni tali udvdidegei, unitseteno unohiyunei, Ugvwiyuhino iditlv wunagatahvstanei.
english: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎤᏂᏅᏎᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodino unadatlugv Tsilusilimi anehi nasgi hia unadvganei, uninvseno Quaniqua Vteogi iyvdv wuwedasdiyi.
english: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi wulutsv ale ugohv Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesvi, ulihelitsei, ale dutayosele nigadv ulinigidv unadanvdadisdiyi tsuniniyvdiyi Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏰᏃ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏁᏉᏤᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Udanvtiyeno gese asgaya, ale ukalitsvhi gese Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ale gohiyudi gesvi.  Unitsateno yvwi gvwanequotsele Ugvwiyuhi.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᏓᏌ ᏭᎶᏎ ᎤᏲᎸᏎ ᏐᎳ;
phonetic: Hnaquono Quaniqua Dasa wulose uyolvse Sola;
english: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ ᎤᏘᏃᎴᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏁᏲᏁᎢ.  ᎥᏖᎣᎩᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᏂᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᎪᏎᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Uwadvhvno Vteogi utinolei.  Hiano nulistanei, nasgi sudetiyvdv nahna tsunanelodi unadatlugv danilawigei, ale unitsate yvwi duneyonei.  Vteogino igvyiyi Anigalonedv gegosele anohiyuhvsgi.
english: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎥᏖᎣᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno Tsilusilimi nvdayunilosvhi anadolehosgi unilutse Vteogi.
english: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏕᎤᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎪᏄᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎶᏗ ᏏᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi Egiwa tsudoidv deulenei, adanvdo uwatane gvnigesv nuwanele utsati ugonulohisdiyi nigvnadvi; nasgino nulistanvgi nahiyu Galodi Sisa ugvwiyuhi tsigesvgi.
english: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏁ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Anohiyuhvsgino anisiyvwiha yeli igvwanadvnedi gesv dunugotane unadanvsdiyi unalisdelvdodi analinvtli Tsudiyi anehi.
english: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎳ ᏚᎾᎨᏅᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nunadvnelei, widuninele digeganelodi Quaniqua ale Sola dunagenvdei.
english: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏕᏯᏙᏔᏁ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno Elodv ugvwiyuhi ulenvhe dudeyadotane igadv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi.
english: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏃ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎤᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏣᏂ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Ayelasdino ganvhidv uwatane ule Tsimi Tsani dinadanvtli.
english: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂᏰᎸᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏴᎮᎢ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Udolehosvno osiyu aniyelvsgv Anitsusi, Quida nasquo uniyvhei.  Nahiyuno nagotanvna gadu agisdiyi gesei.
english: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎤᏴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏗᏂᎢᏛ ᏅᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ, ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Uniyvhvno didasdudiyi uyvtanei, ale duyohisele nvgi idiniidv nvgi nunadatlugv aniyawisgi gvwagatidisgi, kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi ulosonvhi yvwi tsunanugowisediyi uyelvsei.
english: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎮᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Quidano atsisduhei; aseno tsunanelodi unadatlugv ulinigidiyu unadanvte anadadolisdanehe Unelanvhi nasgi atsisdelvdiyi.
english: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᏗᏎᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏈᏓ ᎦᎵᎮ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏓᏂᏅᎬᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏓᎦᎸᏍᏕᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏂ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎨ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno Elodv unanugowisidisei, nahiyu svnoyi Quida galihe ayeli anitali aniyawisgi daninvgvi, tali tsudadesvdv dagalvsdei, anigatiyano galohisdiyulodi anini aniyawisge didasdudiyi.
english: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎴᏂᎴ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ, ᎢᎦᏃ ᎤᏙᏤ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ; ᎤᏩᏂᎸᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏍᏆᎨᏂ, ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᏞᎩᏳ.  ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛᏃ ᏚᏙᎠᏎ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquono dikahnawadidohi Ugvwiyuhi utseli ulenile ganvgvi, igano udotse didasdudiyi; uwanilvno Quida asquageni, deuletanei, hia nuwesei; Talehvga tlegiyu.  Tsudadesvdvno dudoase tsuwoyeni.
english: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎭᏓᏠᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎳᏑᎸᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎭᏄᏬᏣ ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino hia nuweselei; Hadatloga, ale talasulvga.  Nasgino nudvnelei.  Hiano nuweselei; Hanuwotsa ale sgisdawaduga.
english: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏫᏎᏉ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unugotsvno usdawadvsei; ale vtla yagatahe udohiyuhi gesv dikahnawadidohi nudvnelvi, aquanelawisequo elisgei.
english: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ, ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎶᏒ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏚᏛ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏚᎢᎡᎴᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏓᏓᎴᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyiyino ale taline, aniyawisgv unilosv wunilutse talugisgi disdudv digaduhv wigananugoisdisgvi, nasgi uwasvquo unalisduielei.  Uninugotsvno saquo galanvdv unilosei, gilaquono iyvdv dikahnawadidohi udadaletanei.
english: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏓᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏌᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏇᏓᎴᏒ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏥᏓᎩᏂᏴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
phonetic: Quidano udanvtisanv hia nuwesei; Hnaquo gadoleohi udohiyuhi Ugvwiyuhi tsunvsv utseli dikahnawadidohi, ale aquedalesv Elodv tsidaginiyvsvi, ale nigav udugi tsunvsv Anitsusi.
english: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᏃ ᏭᎷᏤ ᏗᎦᏁᎸ ᎺᎵ, ᏣᏂ ᎹᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᏥ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎡ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Udanvtelvno wulutse diganelv Meli, Tsani Maga tsudoidv utsi, nahna unitsate danilawie anadadolisdisgei.
english: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᏗᏃ ᏭᏩᏂᎸ ᎠᏍᏚᎲ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏛ ᎶᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏧᏛᏓᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Quidino wuwanilv asduhv galohisdiyi, adv Lodi tsudoidv tsudvdastanvsei;
english: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏬᎵᏨ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎣᏒ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᏅᏓᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᏄᏍᏚᎢᏒᎾᏉ ᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏁᏉ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏭᏃᏁ ᏈᏓ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino uwolitsv Quida gawonisgvi osv uyelvsv nvdalisdotane nusduisvnaquo gese galohisdiyi, dusqualvtanequo wuyvlei ale wunone Quida gadogv galohisdiyulodi.
english: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏣᎸᏃᏘᏉ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏕᏉ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏉ.
phonetic: Hiano nigvwaweselei, Tsalvnotiquo.  Aseno usdayidequo kanegvi, Udohiyuhi nasgi nusdi, udvnei.  Hiano nuniwesei; dakahnawadidohiquo.
english: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏗᎬᏂᎮᎢ; ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᏃ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida asiquo digvnihei; unisduisvno gvwagohei ale unisquanigosei.
english: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏖᎸᏅ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏗᏱ, ᏚᏃᏁᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ.  ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏗᏥᏃᎲᏏ ᏥᎻ ᎠᎴ ᏦᏣᏓᏅᏟ.  ᎤᏄᎪᏤᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno uwoyeni utelvnv elawe unvdiyi, dunonele nulistanv Ugvwiyuhi unugowisv didasdudiyi.  Ale hia nuwesei; Hia nasgi widitsinohvsi Tsimi ale tsotsadanvtli.  Unugotseno ilvhitlv wulosei.
english: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᏳᎾᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏈᏓ ᏫᏄᏛᏁᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Igano nulistanv vtla usdiquo yunadeyatanele aniyawisgi nasgi Quida winudvnetanvi.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᎤᏲᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏨ ᏚᎪᎵᏰᎡ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏤ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ.  ᏧᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᏕᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Elodvno uyolv ale utlotsv dugoliyee gvwagatidvhi ale unetse tsuniyohuhisdiyi.  Tsudiyino udanvsv, Sisaliyi wudenei.
english: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏛᏃ ᏚᏔᎳᏬᎯᏎᎴ ᏓᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴᎢ, ᎤᎾᎵᎢᏛᏃ ᏆᎳᏍᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᏏᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ; ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏕ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Elodvno dutalawohisele Daya ale Sadoni anehi; aseno saquo igagadv gvwalutselei, unaliidvno Qualasda ugvwiyuhi unisidiyi atsigatidisdi, dohiyi iyunvnediyi unitayoselei; unatseligohiyeno ulisdelvdode ugvwiyuhi utseligohi.
english: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏒᏍᏛᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏄᏬᎥ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᏬᏍᏗ, ᎤᏪᏁ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Dasvsdvno usqualvhv Elodv unuwov unigvwiyuhi unanuwosdi, uwene inv igati gasgilvi, ale dulitsidonelei.
english: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎧᏁᎦ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Yvwino unelanei, hia nuniwesei; Galvladi ehi kanega, vtlano yvwi.
english: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏩᏂᎴᎢ, ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᎸᏉᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏥᏍᎪᏴᏃ ᎬᏩᏯᎥ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gilaquono iyvdv dikahnawadidohi Ugvwiyuhi utseli uwanilei, nvtsulisdotane Unelanvhi nulvquotanvna gesvi.  Tsisgoyvno gvwayav uyohusei.
english: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏛᏃᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Kanohedvsgini Unelanvhi utseli advnosgei ale kanequogei.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᏂᏉᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎳ ᏭᏂᏍᏆᏛ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏗᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎤᎾᏘᏃᎴᏃ ᏣᏂ ᎹᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: quaniquono ale sola wunisquadv getsinetselvi, unilutse tsilusilimi diunilosei, unatinoleno tsani maga tsudoidv.
english: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᎻᏂ ᎾᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎷᏏᏯ ᏌᎵᏂ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᏁᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᎾᏛᏒᎯ ᎡᎶᏛ ᏅᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᎳ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodino Vtiogi tsunadatlugv anehvgi gilo iyunasdi anadolehosgi ale dinadeyohvsgi, nasgi Quaniqua, ale Simini Naga tsudoidv, ale Lusiya Salini ehi, ale Maneni nasgi itsulaha tsunadvsvhi Elodv nvgi igadugi gesv sgadugi atsigatidisdi, ale Sola.
english: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏓᎴᏓᏏ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎳ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏥᏯᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Anadadolisdanehvno Ugvwiyuhi ale amatli anvsgvi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo hia nuwesei; Disgiyadadaledasi Quaniqua ale Sola tsunilvwisdanediyi gatsiyasuyesv ugvwali.
english: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎤᏅᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏏᏔᏛ, ᏚᏂᏅᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono amatli unvnv ale unadadolistanv ale dunasitadv, duninvsei.
english: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏅᏒ, ᏏᎷᏏᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎤᏁᏅ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏫᎤᎾᏣᏁ ᏌᏈ ᏫᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uninvsv, Silusiyi wunilosei, nahnano wiunenv tsiyuhi wiunatsane Saqui wiunilutsei.
english: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᎳᎻᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎾᏘᏁᎮᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Salamino anedohvi uninohele Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, anatineheno nasquo Tsani unisdelvhidohi.
english: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅᏃ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎨᏆ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏆᏥᏌ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Unilosonvno nigvnadv amayeli gesvi Gequa iyvdv, nahna uniwadvhe gilo iyusdi Atsusi Quatsisa tsudoidv, adonisgi, utlonasdi adolehosgi,
english: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᏌᏥᏯ ᏉᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏐᎳ ᎤᏔᏲᎴ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi anedohe nahna gada ahv atsigatidisdi Satsiya Quola tsudoidv agatahnai asgaya, nasgi widuyanvhe Quaniqua ale Sola utayole udvgodiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᎵᏑ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎤᏂᎭᎷᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Elisu adonisgi, nasgiyeno nusdi deudov anetlvtanvhi, unihalugisgei, udulisge atsigatidisdi ugatahvediyi uwohiyusvi.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᎳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Solano nasgi nasquo Quola tsidudov, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ukalitsvhi gese nasgi uyanvsvhi dukahnanei,
english: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏣᎧᎵᏨᎯ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎭᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏴᏘᏑᎵᎪᏥ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏕᎲᏁᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Hia nuwesei; Galonuhedv ale unegutsidv tsakalitsvhi, Asgina uwetsi, hatludisgi nigav duyugodv gesvi, tlasgo yvtisuligotsi utsatini nidehvnehv duyugodv nvnohi Unelanvhi tsutseliga?
english: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏏᏔᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏘᎨᏩᏥ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.  ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎤᏭᏢᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏙᎮ ᏚᏲᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏬᏱᏂᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Ka gvniyuquo Ugvwiyuhi tsasitada, ale dotigewatsi vtla yigowatisgesdi nvdo ilvsgi igohidv.  Gilaquono iyvdv ulisigi uwutlvnei, ale edohe duyohe gilo gvwoyinidohi.
english: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᎪᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono atsigatidisdi ugohv nasgi nulistanvi, uwohiyunei, asquanigosge nusdv danadeyohvsgv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga.
english: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏆ ᏫᎤᎾᏣᏅ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᏆᎩ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ.  ᏣᏂᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᎤᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola ale nasgi anehi Gequa wiunatsanv wunilutse Quagi gaduhv Quamiquiliyi.  Tsanino unadadaledanelv Tsilusilimi wiulosei.
english: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏆᎩ ᏫᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏆᏏᏗᏱ; ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎸ ᎤᎾᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino Quagi wiunanigisv wunilutse Vtiogi gaduhv Quasidiyi; unadodaquasgvno iga digalawiisdiyi wuniyvlv unanvnei.
english: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎪᎵᏰᎥᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏎ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏚᏂᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎨᏥᏬᏁᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᏥᏁᎩ.
phonetic: Dunigoliyevno dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgi, digalawiisdiyi getsigatidisdi unadanvse hia winiduniweselei; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, iyuno digetsiwonedodi gesesdi yvwi, itsinegi.
english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᏚᎴᏅ, ᎤᏬᏰᏂᏃ ᎤᏖᎸᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ, ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Quolano dulenv, uwoyenino utelvnv, hia nuwesei; Itsisgaya Isili tsuwetsi ale Unelanvhi itsinayesgi, itsadvdasda.
english: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏚᏑᏰᏎ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᏙᎯᏉ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎤᏌᎳᏛ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎾᎿᎭᏙᏧᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi hia yvwi Isili unatseliga dusuyese digigayvligei, ale dusaladane hia yvwi anedohiquo tsigese Itsiquiyi, ale kanogeni usaladv uwatane nahna dotsunugowisei.
english: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nvgasgohino tsudetiyvdv igohidv unelagi uwelise nunadvnelidolv inagei.
english: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏒᏅᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎾᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏚᏯᏙᎮᎴ ᏓᎾᏎᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Dusvnvno galiquogi iyunadalegi yvwi Genani anehi, nasgi unatseli gadohi duyadohele danasesgvi.
english: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎴ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᎯᏍᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᏌᎻ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏤᎮ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ.
phonetic: Onino duwekanele dinugodisgi nvgitsuqui hisgisgohi tsudetiyvdv iyvdv igohidv, Sami adolehosgi tsehe iyasti.
english: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎴ ᏐᎳ ᎩᏌ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏇᏂ ᏧᏴᏫ, ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unitayole ugvwiyuhi; Unelanvhino duwekanele Sola Gisa uwetsi Queni tsuyvwi, nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv igohidv.
english: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᎧᎲᏒ, ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎴ ᏕᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏥᏩᏛᎲ ᏕᏫ ᏤᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino uwekahvsv, dunanugowisele Dewi unatseli ugvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi; nasgi nasquo tsuneistane hia tsinuwesei; Tsiwadvhv Dewi Tsesi uwetsi, asgaya osdv tsiyelvi, nasgi nvdvdvneli nigav gadanvtesgvi.
english: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfill all my will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ;
phonetic: Nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv Unelanvhi nasgiya uduisdvi dunanugowiselv Isili unisdelisgi, nasgi Tsisa;
english: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᎷᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᏧᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏏᎵ, ᏧᏃᎮᎮᎸᎯ ᎨᏎ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Asiquono nigalugvna tsigesei, Tsani tsulitsidonelvhi gese naniv yvwi Isili, tsunohehelvhi gese didawosdi gesv ganetliyvsdi odanvdv ugvwali.
english: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏂᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎮ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎪ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎭ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎣᏂ ᏓᏯᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎳᏑᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᎩᎧᏁᏴᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsanino hnaquo akaliihe tsulvwisdanedi gesvi, hia nuwesei; Gago sgiyeliseha?  Vtla ayv nasgi yigi, aseno gvniyuquo oni dayai nasgi dulasulv vtla ayv yeli digvgikaneyvdi yigi.
english: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ ᎡᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Itsisgaya idadanvtli, Equahami nvdayunetlvtanvdv, ale gilo itsadasuyesdi etsinayesgi Unelanvhi, nihi itsadvgodi etsiyelvnanelv kanohedv nasgi hia alisdelvdodi gesv kanohesgi.
english: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏙᏓᏈᏒ ᏥᏓᏂᎪᎵᏰᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏃᎯᏳᏔᏅ ᏥᏚᏄᎪᏓᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimiyeno anehi, ale tsunatseli unigvwiyusadegi, nasgi nigvwagatahvna gesv iyusdi ale nasquo nanigatahvna gesv iyusdi aninegv anadolehosgi nunadodaquisv tsidanigoliyea, nasgi dunohiyutanv tsidunugodanelei.
english: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᏩᏛᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏎ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nuniwadvhvnano gese yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesvi, aseno unitayosele Qualedi nasgi atsiisdiyi.
english: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᏕᏎ ᎠᏓ ᎨᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Unisquadvno nigav gowelv nasgi atsinohesgvi, unadese ada gedvi, ale atselisdv uninvnei.
english: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᎴᏔᏁ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi duletane uyohusvi.
english: But God raised him from the dead:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏤ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨ ᎨᎵᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale uwohitse gvwagowatisge Gelili nasgi nvdagvwasdawadvdv itsulaha Tsilusilimi unilutsvhi; nasgi tsutseli gvwanohesgi yvwi anigatahvi.
english: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno nihi itsvnoheheha osdv kanohedv nasgi tsigetsiduisdanele digigayvligei,
english: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ; "ᎠᏇᏥ ᏂᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏍᏆᏕᏁᎸ."
phonetic: Nasgi unelanvhi udohiyuhi nigvnelv ayv nasgi tsunetsi, nasgi Tsisa deuletanvi; nasgiya nasquo hia tsinigvnv tsigowela Dikanogisdiyi talinei; "Aquetsi nihi, gohi iga squadenelv."
english: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎪᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎᎢ; "ᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏕᏫ."
phonetic: Nano deuletanvi uyohusvi hnaquo ugohisdi nigesvna gesvi, hia niuwesei; "Datsvneli uyoisdi nigesvna osdv iyulisdanedi Dewi."
english: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎠ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; "ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏭᎪᎯ ᎦᎯᏰᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ."
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo hia nigawea nvwadale gowelvi; "Nasganvna tsatseli vtla unelagi wugohi gahiyelisedi yigi."
english: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏫᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᏛᏁᎸ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏓᏂᎾᎥ ᎠᏥᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Dewiyeno gohusdi dudvnelv nahiyu unadenvhi Unelanvhi adanvtesgv nasgiyai, ulvnei, ale tsugayvlige daninav atsinvnei, ale ugosei.
english: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎪᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgini Unelanvhi tsuletanvhi gesv vtla yugosei.
english: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ [ᎠᏍᎦᏯ] ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᏥᏃᏁᎭ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsanvtesdi itsisgaya didadanvtli, nasgi hia [asgaya] iyuwanisadv etsinoneha gayetsidolisdi gesv itsisganvtsvi.
english: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏚᏓᎴᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi nvdigalisdodiha nigadv anohiyuhvsgi anadudaleha nigav tsudalenvdv, nasgi getsadudalaedi nigesvna tsigesv Mosi utseli dikahnawadvsdi detsikahnawadisv iyusdi.
english: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itseyatahesdi tlesdi itsilutselvgi hia tsinaniwe anadolehosgi;
english: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ, ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏒᏅ; ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᏁᎮᎮᎸ."
phonetic: "Ditsakanvga, itsiniquatihi, ale itsisquanigohi ale itsadisvnv; ayvyeno gohi itsehv dagilvwisdane digalvwisdanedi, nasgi digalvwisdanedi vtla yvgetsohiyuhvga nasquo ase gilo yitsinehehelv."
english: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᎮᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Anitsusino uninugotsv digalawiisdiyi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi unitayole nasgi hia getsinohehediyi taline unadodaquasgvi.
english: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᏃ ᏚᏂᏰᎵᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᎵᎪᏁᎸᎯ ᏚᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᏚᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Danilawivno duniyelisv unitsate Anitsusi ale Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi Anitsusi tsunaligonelvhi dunisdawadvse Quola ale Quaniqua, nasgino duniwonetane dunitayosele tsuniyohisdiyi nigesvna Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesvi.
english: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏫᎤᎾᏙᏓᏋ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏂᏚᏂᏔᏫᏤ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏔᏂᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Talineno wiunadodaquv alequo nigadv gaduhv nidunitawitse unadvdastanile kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᎪᎲ, ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎨ ᏉᎳ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi, unitsati dunigohv, unikalitse advyugedi gesvi, ale aniwonisgv anatludisge Quola nigawesgv gawonisgvi, unigonelosgei ale anisotlvisdisgei.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎧᏁᏉᎨ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏎ ᎡᏥᏃᎮᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏢᏉ ᏥᏂᏨᏁᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏰᏥᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᏥᏰᎸ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏬᏍᏓᎦᏔᎲᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Naquono Quola ale Quaniqua kanequoge nanisgaihvna gesvi, hia nuniwesei; Nihi igvyi ase etsinohehedi gesvgi Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv; aseno itlvquo tsinitsvneha ale itsvsv itsadanvtesgv yeli gayetsinedi nigesvna tsitsiyelv gvnidv, gvniyuquo tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv wosdagatahvsda.
english: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎩᏂᏁᏤᎸ, [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ;] "ᎬᏯᎧᏅ ᎢᎦ ᏔᏘᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ."
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nusdi Ugvwiyuhi ogininetselv, [hia nigaweha;] "Gvyakanv iga tatisdanediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, ulisdelvdodi itsalisdodiyi elohi nigvnadvi."
english: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvno yvwi nasgi unadvganv unalihelitsei, ale unilvquotane Ugvwiyuhi utseli kanohedv, ale unohiyune naniv gvnidv uniwadvdi igegvnelvhi.
english: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino utseli kanohedv duyelise nahna nigvnadvi.
english: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏁ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎨᎯᏙᎴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi dunitelvne getsilvquodi anigeyv Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale nahna gaduhv digeganelodi anisgaya, ale nasgi nunvnisane gagetsisotlvdodiyi Quola ale Quaniqua, ale dunigehidole unatseligohi gesvi.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᎪᎥᏓᏁᎴᏉ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᎵᏰᎥᎢ, ᎢᎪᏂᏯᏃ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno duninvgovdanelequo gosdu tsunalasideni udanvliyevi, Igoniyano wunilutsei.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Anohiyuhvsgino unikalitsvhi gese analiheligvi ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏭᏂᏴᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistane Igoniya, nasgi itsulaha wuniyvle Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi, ale nusdv aniwonisgv nvtsulisdotane unitsati Anitsusi ale nasquo Anigoi unohiyunei.
english: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏁ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏅᏂᏌᏁ ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Aseno nunohiyusvna Anitsusi dunitelvne tsunadalenvdv yvwi dunadanvdvi, nasgino nunvnisane dinisgagi nulistane analinvtli.
english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎯᏤᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᏙᎴᎢ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᏓᏁᎮ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏧᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uwohitseno nahna unedolei, nanisgaihvna aniwonisge nvdigalisdodisge unalisgasdodv Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi asdayidisge kanohedv uwasv udadolitsadv kanohesgi, danehe tsunoyeni tsunvdodiyi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi tsunilvwisdanediyi.
english: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏕᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏁᎴᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ.
phonetic: Unitsatino nahna gaduhv anehi tali nunadadei; igadv Anitsusi dunaligonelei, igadvno getsinvsidv.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎨ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏧᏅᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvno yvwi ale Anitsusi ale digeganelodi ananelugisge digvwanisotlvdodiyi ale nvya tsunvnisdodiyi,
english: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏘᏎᎢ, ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏈ ᎵᎨᎣᏂᏯ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi unadvganei, ale dunalitisei, Lisdi ale Daqui Ligeoniya degaduhv wunilosei, ale nahna gvwaduwidv gesvi.
english: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎮ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Nahnano anedohe analitsidohvsge osdv kanohedv.
english: And there they preached the gospel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏬᎴ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎾᏲᎤᎴ ᎤᏕᏅ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi asgaya uwole Lisdi ayouli tsulasideni, nayoule udenv, ilvhiyu uwedolvhi nigesvna.
english: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏉᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᎲ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏬᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi udvgane gawonisgv Quola, nasgi uyanvsvhi dukahnanv ale udolehosv uhv gohiyudi gesv anvwodi,
english: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ; ᎦᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ.  ᏚᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuwese asdaya; Gatsinosdv halehvga.  Dulitadinvseno ale uwedolei.
english: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏁ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎵᎨᎣᏂᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᏠᎠᏏᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unitsatino unigohv nudvnelv Quola unisaladane aninegvi, Ligeoniya anehi uniwonihisdi unvtane hia nuniwesei; Galvladi anehi anatloasiga yvwi nunasdv nasgiya iyunasdi.
english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᏧᏈᏓ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᏉᎳᏃ ᎹᎫᎵ ᏚᏃᎡᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Quaniquano Tsuquida dunoei, Quolano Maguli dunoei, nasgiyeno nugvwiyusv alitsidohvsgi gesei.
english: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᏎᎯ ᏧᏈᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏳᎶᏗ ᏚᏘᏃᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏛᎢᏛ ᎤᏂᏥᎸᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏃᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎤᏁᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono atsilvgelosehi Tsuquida nasgi gaduhv igvyiditlv gotlvsvi, galohisdiyulodi dutinole waga ale digodvidv unitsilvnvhi deunolei, nasgi uwasv ale unitsati gesv atsilvunelasdiyi uyelvsei.
