english: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏚᏂᏣᎦᎸᎮ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᏙᎲ ᏫᏚᎾᏗᏢᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno getsinvsidv Quaniqua ale Quola unadvganv dunitsagalvhe tsunanuwo, unitsatino yvwi dinedohv widunaditlvstanei, unelunei,
english: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏲᎩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏫᏣᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Hia naniwesgei; Itsisgaya, gadono nasgi hia nitsadvneha?  Ayv nasquo yvwiquo nasgiya nitsalisdanehv iyoginalisdanehi, ale itsvyalitsidoneha ditsiyohisdiyi hia asequoquo nitsadvnehvi, witsagatahvsdiyino gvnidv Unelanvhi iditlv, nasgi uwotlvnvhi tsigi galvloi ale gadohi ale amequohi ale naniv nahna anehi;
english: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᏂᏅᏅ ᏩᏂᎶᎯ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ;
phonetic: Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesvgi unanelagi unvsv duninvnv wanilohi duwelisele nigadv nunadalesv yvwi;
english: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏩᎩᏂᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎦᏃᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒᎢ, ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏓᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv waginigohi gvnigesv iyaquvnehi yuwelisei, nasgi osdv dulvwisdanehvi, ale igiganodanehvi galvladi digalosgvi, ale igalisgolvdanehv utsati gohusdi udvhisdiyi nidadetiyvhisvi, diginawi dakaliisdisgv alisdayvdi ale ulihelisdi.
english: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ ᎦᏂᎳ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎬᏩᏁᎴᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino naniwesgvi ganila duniyosdodanele unitsati atsilvgvwanelediyi anadanvtesgvi.
english: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏉᎳᏃ ᏅᏯ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏍᏔᏅ ᎬᏩᎾᏌᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏎᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unilutse Anitsusi Vtiogi ale Igoniya nvdayunilosvhi, nasgi dunitayosele unitsati, Quolano nvya degvwanistanv gvwanasanawidvhe gaduhv gvwanuhisei, uyohusv anelisgei.
english: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏕᎬᏩᏚᏫᏍᏕᎢ ᏚᎴᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ.  ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏎᎢ, ᏓᏈ ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno unaligohi degvwaduwisdei dulenei, ale digaduhv wuyvlei.  Ugitsvdvno Quaniqua unanigisei, Daqui wunilosei.
english: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏔᏅ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏫᎤᏂᎶᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Unalitsidonelvno osdv kanohedv nasgi gaduhvi, ale anigodiyu dunaligotanv, taline Lisdi ale Igoniya ale Vtiogi wiunilosei,
english: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏓᏂᏔᏲᏎᎮ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏃᏁᎮ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎵᏴ ᎢᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Danalinigohisdisge dunadanvdv anohiyuhvsgi, danitayosehe tsuniyohisdiyi nigesvna gohiyudi gesvi, ale daninonehe utsati agiliyv igilohisdi gesv Unelanvhi utseligohi wigiyvsdiyi.
english: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᎧᏅᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏘ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎠᏅᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Dunikanvno digeganeloti tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, ale unadadolistanv amatli anvsgvi, duniyohisele Ugvwiyuhi nasgi Ugvwiyuhi unohiyunvhi.
english: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᏏᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Quasidiyino unilosonv Quamiquiliyi wunilutsei.
english: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᎩᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏅ ᎠᏔᏓᏯ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Quagino kanohedv unalitsidonv Atadaya wunilutsei.
english: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᎾᏣᏅ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎨᏥᏲᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano tsiyuhi wunatsanv Vtiogi wunilutsei, nahna digetsiyosvhi tsigese Unelanvhi unidolisdiyi, nasgi tsunilvwisdanediyi nasgi hnaquo unisquadvhi tsigesei.
english: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎷᏥᎸᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏚᎢᎡᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unilutsilvno ale dunilawidv tsunanelodi unadatlugv uninohele nigav Unelanvhi nunadvnelvi, ale dusduielv tsunadalenvdv yvwi gohiyudi gesv galohisdiyi.
english: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏕᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano anohiyuhvsgi anehv gohidiyu unadenei.
english: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᏚᏁᏲᏁ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎼᏏ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏰᏥᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi Tsudiyi nvdayunilosvhi duneyone anadanvtli hia nuniwesei; Iyuno tsetsiusdeselvhi nigesvna igesesdi, nasgi Mosi nigawesgvi, vtla yvgayetsisdelv.
english: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎸ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏁ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏛᏛᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏱᎵᏙᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Quolano ale Quaniqua utsati uniyotlohiselv ale unadisvlv aniwonisgv nasgi, dunugotane Quola ale Quaniqua ale gilo iyunasdi nvwanadale Tsilusilimi unenvsdiyi tsunadvdvnvsdiyi getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi nasgi hia aniyilidohv ugvwali.
english: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏗᎬᏩᏂᎧᏅ ᎤᏂᎶᏎ ᏈᏂᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎺᎵᏱ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨ ᎠᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ; ᎤᏩᏘᏃ ᏚᎾᎵᎨᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodino unadatlugv iyvdv widigvwanikanv unilose Quinisi ale Sameliyi aninohesge anagatahvsgv tsunadalenvdv yvwi; uwatino dunaligelistane nigadv anadanvtli.
english: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎦᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimino unilutsv gagvwanadanilvtse tsunanelodi unadatlugv ale getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi; uninoheleno nigav Unelanvhi nudvnelv unisdelvhidolvi.
english: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᎾᎴᏁ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᎠᏁᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏁᏤᏗ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno dunalene gilo iyunasdi Aniqualisi unaligosv anela nasgi unohiyunvhi, hia nuniwesei, Ase digetsiusdesedi, ale dikanetsedi tsunikahnawadvsdiyi Mosi unetsvhi.
english: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo uninohediyi dunilawitse getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi.
english: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᏒ ᏈᏓ ᏕᎤᎴᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎯᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏒ ᎢᎦᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utsatino uniwonisv Quida deulenei, hia niduweselei; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, nihi itsigataha hnaquo yeli gohigi Unelanvhi ayv aquasuyesv igadatlugv tsunadalenvdv yvwi ayv gvquadvganediyi osdv kanohedv, nasgino unohiyudiyi.
english: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏗᎦᏔᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ ᏕᎨᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎢ, ᏕᎠᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhino tsuninawi digatahi gvnigesv nuwanelvgi degegadanilvtsvi, deanehv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ayv nasgiya tsiginelvgi.
english: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎦᏅᎦᎸᏓᏁᎲ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Ale vtla digadalehnai yinigvnele nasgi, gohiyudi gesv deganvgalvdanehv tsuninawi.
english: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎡᏥᎪᎵᏰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏕᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎨᎦᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ka gadono ietsigoliye Unelanvhi, detsigilanaladisgv anohiyuhvsgi, nasgi digigayvlige ale nasquo igvsv yeli gegagilanaladisdi nigesvna tsigesvgi.
english: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏴ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno idohiyuhvsga nasgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdigalisdodisgv ayv egisdelvdi gesvi, nasgiya nasgi getsisdelvdi tsigi.
english: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv unitsati gesv elawe unvnei, ale dunadvdasdanele Quaniqua ale Quola aninohesgv nigav uyelvdv ale usquanigodi Unelanvhi nasgi unvdisgv dulvwisdanelv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi.
english: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅ, ᏥᎻ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᏓᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino elawe unvnv, Tsimi unetse hia nuwesei; Itsisgaya idadanvtli ayv sgiyadvdasdasi.
english: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏩᏂ ᎤᏃᎮᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏚᏩᏛᎲᎢ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏪᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏗᎨᎪᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Sawani unohelv Unelanvhi igvyiyi duwadvhvi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nahna tsuwelesdiyi yvwi nasgi dudov digegosdodiyi.
english: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ;
phonetic: Nasgino hia nasgiya nidegalisdiha anadolehosgi uninetsvi, hia tsinigvnv tsigowela;
english: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᏛᏥᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏛᏥᎵᏦᏘᏌᏂ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏪᏡᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᏥᎵᏦᏘᏌᏂ ᎤᎵᏦᏙᎠᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᏥᎧᎯᏌᏂ.
phonetic: "Nasgino nulistanesdi dvtsilutsi ale dvtsilitsotisani Dewi utseli galitsodvi, nasgi eladi uwetlusvhi tsigi, ale dvtsilitsotisani ulitsodoasvi, ale dvtsikahisani.
english: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏂᏯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏗᎨᎪᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ."
phonetic: Nasgi nunadale yvwi gvwaniyasdi iyulisdodiyi Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasquo nigadv tsunadalenvdv yvwi daquadov digegostanvhi tsigi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi hia nigadv tsulvwisdanehi tsigi."
english: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi agatahiyu nvtsudalenvhvna nigadv dulvwisdanehvi.
english: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᏯᏙᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᏖᎴᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayv gadanvtesgv hia nusdi, nasgi didadeyadododiyiquo nigesvna tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv unateledv Unelanvhi iditlv wunagatahvstanvhi tsigi;
english: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏙᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ.
phonetic: Didowelanediyiquosgini tsuniyohisdiyi gadaha itsulistanvhi nasgi dilisgolvdanelvhi Unelanvhi diyelvhi, ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi, ale gohusdi gvwostanvhi, ale gigv.
english: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎡᏘ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᏕᎤᏪᎭ ᎬᏩᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ, ᏓᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᎾᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Mosiyeno eti nvdagvwadalenvdv degaduwadisv deuweha gvwalitsidohvsgi, datsigoliyesgvi digalawiisdiyi nunadodaquisvi.
english: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᏂᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᎾᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏆᏏᏆ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏢᎢ, ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏘᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Hnaquono osiyu uniyelvne getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi ale nigadv tsunanelodi unadatlugv tsuninvsdiyi anisgaya tsunasuyedv unvsv unadatlugvi, nasgi Tsudasi Quasiqua tsudoidv ale Sayila getsilvquodi anadanvtlvi, Quola ale Quaniqua itsulaha unenvsdiyi Vtisgi,
english: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏗ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ; ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎥᏘᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino uninvsdi unowelane hia nunvnelei; Oginvsidv ale tsoganelodi ale otsadanvtli witsvyoliga itsadanvtli ditsadalenvdv yvwi Vtisgi ale Siliyi ale Silisiyi itsehi.
english: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎬᏛᎦᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎪᎦᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎢ ᏕᎨᏥᎦᏔᎲᎡᎲ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏎ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏦᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Ogvdvganv gilo iyunasdi gogadasuyedv aniwonisgv getsadeyadotanvi degetsigatahvehv ditsadanvdo, hia naniwesgvi; Ase tsetsiusdesedi ale dikahnawadvsdi itsisquanigododi; nasgi iyusdi tsotsinetselvhi nigesvna;
english: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏅ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ, ᏗᏤᎲ ᏦᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏦᏥᎨᏳᎯ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ,
phonetic: Nasgi nvtsulisdotanv osiyu ogiyelvnv nigadv saquo igagadv, ditsehv tsotsinvsdiyi tsotsasuyedv anisgaya tsunisdawadvsdiyi tsotsigeyuhi Quaniqua ale Quola,
english: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏅᏅ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi anisgaya danvnv tsunalisgolvtanvhi, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv deudov nvdigalisdidodisgvi.
english: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏙᏥᏅᎵ ᏧᏓᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏓᎨᏥᏃᎮᎮᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dotsinvli Tsudasi ale Sayila, nasgi nasquo aninegvi utloyi dagetsinoheheli.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏍᎩᏰᎸᏅ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏯᏰᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Osiyuyeno uyelvnv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale ayv osiyu sgiyelvnv, gohusdi ditsvyayenvdodiyi nigesvna, hia uwasv nasgi ase iyadvnedi tsigi;
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏗᏤᏯᏙᏤᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ.  ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi ditsiyohisdiyi alisdayvdi Unelanvhi diyelvhi dilisgolvdanelvhi, ale gigv, ale gohusdi gvwostanvhi, ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi.  Iyuno nasgi yiditseyadotselv osiyu yinitsadvga.  Dohiyi nitsadvhnadegesdi.
english: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᏲᏒ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᏂᎷᏤᎢ, ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏚᏂᏅᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgino degetsiyosv Vtiogi wunilutsei, dunilawidvno unitsati duninvnele nasgi goweli.
english: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ
phonetic: Nasgino unigoliyev, unalihelitse nvdigalisdodisge nasgi adagalisdadisgi gesvi
english: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᏏᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎤᏣᏖ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᏚᏂᏬᏁᏔᏁ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsudasino ale Sayila, utsate ikanetsvhi duniwonetane anadanvtli ale dunalinigohistanei, nasquoyeno unvsv anadolehosgi gesei.
english: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᏁᏙᎸ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᏲᏎ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino nuwohitsv unedolv, nvwadohiyadv degvwaniyose anadanvtli getsinvsidv dinehv wunilohisdiyi.
english: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏗᎩᏯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno Sayila osiyu uyelvne nahnaquo udigiyasdiyi.
english: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏁᏙᎮ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏖ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Quolano ale Quaniqua nasquo gvnedohe Vtiogi danadeyohvsgei, ale analitsidohvsge kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, ale nasquo unitsate nvwanadalei.
english: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏆᏂᏆ; Ꭷ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏙᏂᏩᏛᎱᎦ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎩᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎸ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏫᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino winusvlv Quola hia nuweselvgi Quaniqua; Ka taline tsidoniwadvhuga idadanvtli nigav degaduwadisv nahna ginalitsidonidolv kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, winadolehohi nunadvhnadegvi.
english: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏂ ᎹᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Quaniquano udulisgvgi unatinvsdiyi Tsani Maga tsudoidv.
english: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏁ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᎴ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᎵᎪᏁᎴ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Quola vtla osiyu yuyelvne unatinvsdiyi, nasgiyeno unadadaledanele Quamiquiliyi, ale vtla yunaligonele dunilvwisdanelidohvi.
english: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏫᏕᎬᏩᎾᎦᎴᏅᎲᎩ; ᏆᏂᏆᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎹᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅ ᏌᏈ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale utsati uniyotlohiselvgi, nasgi iyusdi widegvwanagalenvhvgi; Quaniquano utinvsvgi Maga, ale tsiyuhi wutsanv Saqui wulosvgi.
english: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏑᏰᏒ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏕᎬᏩᏲᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Quolano usuyesv Sayila, unigisvgi, anadanvtli degvwayosv Unelanvhi uwedolisdiyi.
english: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏏᎵᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎤᎶᏒᎩ, ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Siliyino ale Silisiyi ulosvgi, dalinigohisdisgvgi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.
english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏈᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎵᏍᏗ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎲᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏗᎹᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎪᎢ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Daquino ale Lisdi wulutsvgi, gvniyuquono nahna ehvgi gilo igesdi gohiyuhvsgi, Dimadi tsudoidv, Atsusi, ageyv gohiyuhvsgi utsi gesvgi, udodasgini Agoi gesvgi.
english: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᏂᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi osiyu gvwanohesgi gesvgi anadanvtli Lisdi ale Igoniya anehi.
english: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎪᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Quola udulvhvgi utinvsdiyi; uhusdeselvgino nvdayulisdotanvgi Anitsusi nahna danewadisvi, nigadvyeno anigatahvgi udoda Agoi gesvi.
english: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᏃ ᎠᏂᎶᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏂᏲᎯᏎᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏄᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Degaduwadisvno anilosgvi, daniyohisehvgi unisquanigododi dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi tsunugotanvhi getsinvsidv ale digeganelodi Tsilusilimi anehi.
english: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᏃ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎪᏒᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏂᎪᏙᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodino dunadatluwadisv dunalinigosvgi gohiyudi gesvi, ale nidugitsvnisv anigodosgvgi.
english: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅᏃ ᏈᏥᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ,
phonetic: Unilosonvno Quitsiyi ale Gelesiyi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo uninvsdadelv unalitsidodiyi kanohedv Esiyi,
english: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎻᏏᏱ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᏈᏗᏂᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏚᏪᎵᏎᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Misiyi wunilutsv, unadanvtelvgi Quidiniyi wunilohisdiyi, aseno vtla unanelagi yiduwelisele Adanvdo.
english: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎻᏏᏱᏃ ᎤᏂᎶᏒ, ᏠᎠᏏ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Misiyino unilosv, Tloasi wunilutsvgi.
english: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎦᏙᎨᎢ, ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎮᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎮᎢ; ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏫᎷᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Quolano unelawiselvgi svnoyi; gilo iyusdi asgaya Masidoni ehi gadogei, utayosehei, hia nuwesehei; Masidoni wilugi, ale wisgisdelv.
english: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᎦᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏬᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎣᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎩᏯᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Unelawiselvno gilaquo iyvdv oganelotanvgi Masidoni wogilohisdiyi, otsadolehosgvgi Ugvwiyuhi ogiyanisgvi nasgi tsotsalitsidonediyi osdv kanohedv.
english: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavored to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏎᎹᏞᏏ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏂᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino Tloasi tsiyuhi ogatsanv tsuyugodi woginvstanvgi, Sematlesi woginolvgi; ugitsvdvno Niaqualisi woginolvgi.
english: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎣᎦᏣᏅ, ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᏬᎩᏃᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏗᏢ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏚᎲ ᏥᎩ.  ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiogatsanv, Quiligiyi woginolvgi, nasgi nugvwiyusv gaduhv nahna iditlv Masidoni, ale nasgi unadanvdv uniduhv tsigi.  Nahnano gaduhv ilvsgi tsusvhidv ogedolvgi.
english: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎣᎩᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎡᏉᏄᎶᏗ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎣᎦᏅᏅᏃ ᏙᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Unadodaquasgvno gaduhv oginugotsvgi, equonulodi wogilosvgi adadolisdodiyi gesvi; oganvnvno dotsiwonetanv anigeyv nahna unadatlisanvhi.
english: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎩᎦᎨ ᏗᏄᏬ ᎦᏃᏗᏍᎩ, ᏓᏱᏓᎵ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎯ, ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ, ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi ageyv Lidi tsudoidv, gigage dinuwo ganodisgi, Dayidali gaduhv ehi, Unelanvhi adadolistanehi, udvdastanvgi.  Nasgi unawiyi Ugvwiyuhi usduisvgi, udvdasdodiyi Quola kanegvi.
english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏬᎥᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ, ᎣᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏴᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏥᏁᏍᏗ.  ᎣᎩᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᏃ ᎣᎩᏎᎪᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Agawovno uwasv ale nasgi dudatinavi, ogitayoselvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Iyuno udohiyusv Ugvwiyuhi gohiyuhvsgi sgiyelisehesdi, tsinelv itsiyvha ale nahna itsinesdi.  Ogisdiyedisgvno ogisegogisvgi.
english: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᎨᏅ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎢ, ᏙᎦᏠᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏓᏩᏛᎡᎲᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᏙᏂᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, adadolisdodiyi ogenv, gilo iyusdi adv, adanvdo adonisgi uyai, dogatlosvgi, nasgi utsadv tsugvwalodi dawadvehvgi gvwanatlai adonisgv gvdisgi.
english: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ, ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᎯ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi ogisdawadisv Quola ale ayv, uwelunvgi hia nuwesvgi; Hia anisgaya Unelanvhi wasdv galvladiyu ehi tsunvsidasdi, nasgi gvnigesv tsinigegvneha nvnohi alisdelvdodi gesvi.
english: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏄᏒᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎬᏁᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᎪᏤᏗᏱ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Ale utsadv nusvlvgi nasgi nadvnehvgi; aseno Quola udeyatanelv ugatahvsvgi, hia nuweselvgi nasgi adanvdo; Gvnetsi Tsisa Galonedv deudov gvdiha, nasgi gohugotsediyi.  Nahiyuquono unugotsvgi.
english: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏲᏨᎢ, ᏗᏂᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Gvwanatlaino unadolehosv udugi unvsv tsugvwalodi uniwadvdiyi uyotsvi, dininiyvhvgi Quola ale Sayila, ale nasgi ganododiyi widunatinohelvgi digeganelodi.
english: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎠᏧᏏ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᎩᏚᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Ale dinugodisgi widunatinohelvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia anisgaya Aatsusi utsatanvhi anadeyadodiha igiduhvi,
english: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎨᎩᏂᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏗᎶᎻ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gvnigesv nanvneha dikahnawadvsdi nasgi yeli digeginiyvdi ale digegikahnawadvsdi nigesvna, Idilomi gesv iyusdi.
english: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎬᏩᏂᎦᏘᎸᏒᎩ; ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏄᏪᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unitsatino gesv degvwanigatilvsvgi; dinugodisgino duninuwesv uninetsvgi digetsilivnisdiyi.
english: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᏂᏚᏅᏂᎸ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utsatino nidunvnilv, didasdudiyi duniyvtanvgi, uninetselvgi nasgi atsigatidisdi osdv tsugatidisdiyi.
english: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᎠᏥᏁᏤᎸ, ᏫᏚᏴᏔᏅᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎭᏫᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏚᏅᏎᏙᏅ ᎠᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino natsiweselv atsinetselv, widuyvtanvgi didasdudiyi gotlvsv galitsode hawini, ale asdaya dunvsedonv adohi.
english: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏒᏃᏱᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎢ.
phonetic: svnoyino ayeli Quola ale Sayila unadadolistanei, ale Unelanvhi duninogistanei; digetsisduhino nasgi unadvganei.
english: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏁᏃ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏘᏱ ᏚᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏛ ᏚᎵᏖᎸᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏍᏚᎲ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᎾᏓᎸᏍᏛ ᏚᏢᏒᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Uyeloistaneno gadohi ulitelvnei; ale didasdutiyi dulisdayidisdv dulitelvnei, gilaquono iyvdv nigadv dasduhv dulisduisei, ale naniv dunadalvsdv dutlvsvhei.
english: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᎤᏰᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏧᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎸᎮ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᏓᎵᏎᎢ, ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏒ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Didasdudiyino agatiya, uyetsv ale udolehosv galohisdiyi didasdudiyi tsulisduidv gesvi, ulvhe ayelasdi ganvhidv, ale uwasv didalisei, digetsisduhi unalisv elisgei.
english: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏥᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Aseno Quola asdaya ulistanei, hia nuwesei; Tlesdi tsvsv gohusdi uyo itsadadvnelvgi, aniyeno nigadv otsiyaa.
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗᏃ ᎤᏔᏲᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᏭᏴᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᎷᏤ ᎤᏪᎾᏫᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏂᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᏚᏃᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Atsvsdodino utayolv ulisdi wuyvlei, ale wulutse uwenawisgei, udanvnile igvyitlv Quola ale Sayila dunolvi.
english: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏍᏗᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Dunugowisvno hia nuwesei; Isdisgaya, gado dagadvneli vgisdelvdiyi?
english: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᏲᎢᏳᎲᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏓᏰᏣᏍᏕᎸᎯᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuniwesei; Hiyoiyuhvga Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, dayetsasdelvhino, nihi ale detsadatinavi.
english: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎮᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᏂᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino utseli kanohedv uninohehele nasgi, ale nigadv nasgi ganelvi aniyai.
english: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᏑᎴᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᏬᎡ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono svnoyi duyanvhei, ale duwosulele degetsilivnilvi; ale gilaquo iyvdv agawoe uwasv ale nigadv tsutseliga.
english: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏁᎸᏃ ᏚᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᏚᏪᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ganelvno duyvtanilv duwelastanei, ale gohiyuhvsgv Unelanvhi ulihelitsei, ale nasquo nigadv ganelvi.
english: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ; ᏘᎧᎲᎦ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ.
phonetic: Sunaleno nulistanv dinugodisgi duninvse dinadaniyisgi, hia winuniwesdiyi; Tikahvga na anisgaya.
english: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏃ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᏃᏁᎴ ᏉᎳ; ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏛᎾᏓᏅᎵ ᏗᏍᏛᏯᎪᏗᏱ; Ꭷ, ᏍᏗᏄᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏩᏛ ᎢᏍᏕᎾ.
phonetic: Didasdudiyino agatiya nasgi nvtsuniwesv unonele Quola; Dinugodisgi dvnadanvli disdvyagodiyi; ka, sdinugoi ale nvwadohiwadv isdena.
english: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏕᎪᎩᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎣᏍᏗᎶᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᎩᏂᏴᏔᏅ, ᏥᎪᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎢᎪᎩᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ?  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ, ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᏂᎷᎩ ᏫᎪᎩᏂᏄᎪᏩ.
phonetic: Aseno quola hia niduweselei, gvnigesv degoginilivnilv tsudugotanvhi nigesvna oginisganvtsvi, Osdilomi, ale didasdudiyi degoginiyvtanv, tsigono hnaquo udelidv igogininugowisga?  Udohiyuhi vtla, unvsvsgini wanilugi wigogininugowa.
english: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎾᏓᏂᏱᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᏚᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏗᏄᎪᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎴᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dinadaniyisgino nasgi hia nuniwesv duninonele dinugodisgi.  Unisgaleno unadvganv Anilomi gesvi.
english: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁᎢ; ᏚᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ ᏚᏂᏔᏲᏎᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unilutseno ale dunisdiyetanei; duninugowisvno dunitayosele nahna gaduhv unadanvsdiyi.
english: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎵᏗ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ; ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Uninugotsvno didasdudiyi Lidi ganelv wuniyvlvgi; dunigohvno anadanvtli, dunigalisdadvgi, ale unanigisvgi.
english: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏈᎪᎵᏱᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎶᏂᏯ ᎤᏁᏙᏅ, ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Vquigoliyino ale Aqualoniya unedonv, Desiloniga wunilutsvgi, nahna Anitsusi danilawiisdiyi adanelvgi.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ, ᏚᏴᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏄᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ,
phonetic: Quolano, nasgi iyudvnedi gesv nudvnelvgi, duyvselvgi, ale tsoi nunadodaquasgv goweli gvdisgv degawonedisgvgi,
english: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎪᏏᏏᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎵᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: degosisisgvgi ale gvnigesv nigvnehvgi Galonedv ase ugiliyoisdi gesvi, ale uyohusv tsulihisodi gesvi; ale hia nasgi Tsisa ayv tsitsvyalitsidoneha nasgi Galonedv, adisgvgi.
english: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
phonetic: Igadvno unadasuyv unohiyunvgi, ale dunaligonelvgi Quola ale Sayila, ale unitsatanvhi Anigoi Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale anigayoliquo nigesvna nunigvwiyusv anigeyv.
english: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᏅᏳᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᏫᏚᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎤᏁᏙᎯ, ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏅᏃ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᏚᏂᎦᏘᎴᏅᏃ ᏤᏌᏂ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi nunohiyusvna, anvyugv nvdayulisdotanvgi, widuniyanvhvgi gilo iyunasdi uninegutsidv unedohi, dunitlisanvno unitelvnvgi gaduhvi; dunigatilenvno Tsesani ganelvi, yvwi tsuninugowisediyi unanelotanvgi.
english: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᎾᏠᏨᏃ ᏫᏚᏂᎾᏌᏁᏒᎩ ᏤᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏂᎷᏆᏗᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ ᎢᎤᏂᎷᏨ;
phonetic: Widunatlotsvno widuninasanesvgi Tsesani ale gilo iyunasdi anadanvtli, gaduhv getsigatidisdi widunatinohelvgi, unelugvgi hia naniwesgvgi; hia elohi tsuniluquadinvdv, nasquo ani iunilutsv;
english: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏌᏂ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᎾᏡᏗᎭ ᏏᏌ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᎭ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Nasgi Tsesani dudanilvtsv; ale nasgi nigadv dunilvwisdanehv anatludiha Sisa unetsvi, hia naniweha; Nvwadale ugvwiyuhi eha, nasgi Tsisa.
english: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ.
phonetic: Dunadeyadotanvgino yvwi ale gaduhv getsigatidisdi, nasgi hia unadvganv.
english: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᏌᏂᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎲ ᏙᎨᏥᎧᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsesanino ale anisoi tali gvwanadvdanehi duniwadvhv dogetsikanvgi.
english: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᎾᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᏈᎵᏯ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏫᏚᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Analinvtlino gilaquo iyvdv dunatinawidvhvgi Quola ale Sayila, Quiliya svnoyi widunatinvstanvgi.  Nasgino nahna wunilutsv, Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi wuniyvlvgi.
english: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏃᏏᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᏓᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia utli anosiyu gesvgi esgaquo Desiloniga anehi, dunadanilvtsvgiyeno kanohedv ale nidugitsvnisv danigoliyesgvgi goweli, nasgi nusdv ale nasgi nusdvna gesv unadolehohisdiyi.
english: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi unitsadvgi nasgi unohiyunvgi, ale getsilvquodi Anigoi anigeyv, ale anisgaya anigayoliquo nigesvna.
english: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᎵᏯ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏭᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi Desiloniga anehi, unadvganv Quola nasquo Quiliya alitsidohvsgv Unelanvhi utseliga kanohedv, nahna nasquo wunilutsvgi, yvwi dunitelvnvgi.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎬᏩᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᏌᏱᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎾᏗᎩᏴᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gilaquo iyvdv anadanvtli gvwatihnawidvhvgi Quola, amequohi iditlv wigvwatinvstanvgi.  Sayilasgini ale Dimadi nahnaquo unadigiyvgi.
english: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᏛ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᏫᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᏌᏱᎳ ᏗᎹᏗᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗ, ᏄᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Quolano gvwatihnawidvdv Ediniyi wigvwatinolvgi; ale nasgi getsinetselv Sayila Dimadino unadvgodi, nulisdvquo gvwalutsediyi, unanigisvgi.
english: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ, ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Asiquono Quola nasgi dagatiyvgi Ediniyi, tsudanvdv utsati udeyatanelvgi, udolehosv gaduhv Unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanehi gesvi.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎦᏃᏗᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏩᏛᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi degawonedisgvgi digalawiisdiyi Anitsusi ale Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehi, ale nidugitsvnisv ganodidiyi degawonedisgvgi nahna tsuwadvtanvhi.
english: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏂᏈᎫᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏙᎢᎦ ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏚᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏰᎸᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎯᎠ; ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏍᏗ; ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi anigatahnai Aniquigula ale Anisdoiga gvwalinohetanvgi; igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Gado uduli udvdiyi hia nuyelvdvna gawonisgi; anisoino hia; Nvwanadale yvwi tsunatseli galvladi anehi digananugowisgi nvwasdi; nvdagalisdodisgvgi dalitsidonehvi Tsisa ale dilehisodi gesv ugvwali.
english: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎬᏩᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎡᎵᎣᏈᎦ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᎪᏗᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏤ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᎭ?
phonetic: Wigvwayanvhvno Elioquiga gvwatinolvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Tsigo gayogadvgodiquo nusdv nasgi hia itse dideyodi gesv nasgi tsinoheha?
english: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎯᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎭ ᏦᏥᎴᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎦᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gohusdiyeno usquanigodi dehinanugowiseha tsotsileni; nasgi iyusdi ogaduliha ogadolehohisdiyi nasgi nusdv gadvgvi.
english: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏗᏁᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadvyeno Ediniyi anehi ale ilvhitlv dinehi nahna anedohi vtla gohusdi yidunilvwisdanehei, aninohesgv uwasv ale anadvgisgv gohusdi itsei.
english: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏕᎤᎴᏅ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎵᎣᏈᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola deulenv ayeli Elioquiga, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya Ediniyi itsehi, gadoleosga itsikalitsvhi gesv detsinayesgv galvladi anehi.
english: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎢᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎪᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎯ, ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏅᎬᏅ ᎥᎪᏪᎸᎩ; "ᎾᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ."  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏤᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Gaisvyeno ale dagigohv galvquodiyu ditsiyelvhi, agiwadvhvgi nasquo atsilvgelasdiyi hia nvgvnv vgowelvgi; "NaTsiGaTaHvNa GaLvLaDi EHi UTseLiGa."  Nasgino howa netsigatahvna tsetsadadolisdaneha nasgi gvnigesv nitsvyvneha.
english: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏁᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏱ ᏧᏮᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi uwotlvnvhi tsigi elanigvi ale nigadv nahna anehi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi galvladi ale elohi unatseliga, vtla yiganelv digalawiisdiyi gilo tsuwoyi tsuwvtanvhi tsunesgehvhi.
english: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏱᏚᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗ, ᏧᏂᎬᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏕᎠᏁᎮᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏅᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏅᏬᎳᏕᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla ale nasgi ayv tsunoyeni yidulisdelvdi, tsunigvgo gohusdi nasgiyai, deaneheyeno nigadv danvnvi ale danvwoladesgv ale nigav gohusdi.
english: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏬᏢᏔᏅ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎤᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏍᏖᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale saquo gigv duwotlvtanv naniv nunadalesv yvwi nasgi tsunaneladisdiyi nigvnadv gaduiditlv elohi, ale deuwugotanv iyulistanidasdiyi, ale widustenv nahna degesadisv tsunaneladisdiyi.
english: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏒᏂᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏂᎦᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏱᏄᏛᎿᎭᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi uniyasdiyi Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi gvwanasvnisdi ale gvwaniwadvdi iyulisdodiyi, vtlasgininonv idisiyvwiha nigadvhnadegvi invhiyu yinudvhnadega.
english: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏩᏅ ᏥᏕᏛᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ; "ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ."
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nuwanv tsidedvnv, ale tsidalitelvhvsga, ale tsideha; nasgi nasquo gilo iyunasdi dikanogisdi dinowelisgi ditsatseliga hia nuniwesv; "Ayvyeno nasquo nasgi tsuwetsi."
english: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏱᏂᎨᏕᎵᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ, ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi, ayv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi tsigi, vtla hiaquo yinigedeliha; Unelanvhi nasgiyaquo adelv dalonige ale adelv unegv ale nvya, yvwi anisinasanv ale unadanvtelvhi gvtanvhi gotlvnvhi.
english: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾ ᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Nahiyuno nasgi hia nanigatahvna tsigesei Unelanvhi unelagi uwelisei; aseno hnaquo dekanetseha naniv yvwi nigvnadvi tsuninetliyvsdiyi duna danvdvi;
english: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏒᏍᏔᏅᏰᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎯ, ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Deusvstanvyeno iga nahiyu elohi duyugodv tsuwugodanediyi, gvdisgv asgaya nasgi uwekanvhi, nudlasidvsvna niduwanelv naniv yvwi nasgi deuletanvi uyohusvi.
english: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎵᎥᎩ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏛᏨᏯᏛᎦᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Unadvganvno ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi, igadv uniyelivgi, igadvno hia nuniwesvgi; Taline hia dvtsvyadvganeli.
english: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola udanvsvgi aninvi.
english: So Paul departed from among them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᎨᎸᎩ ᏓᏲᏂᏏᏯ ᎡᎵᎣᏈᎦ ᎦᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏘᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏕᎺᎵ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ.
phonetic: Gilosgininonv iyunasdi gvwaligonelvgi ale unohiyunvgi; nahna gelvgi Dayonisiya Elioquiga gahvsgi digugotisgi ale ageyv Demeli tsudoidv, ale nvwanadale nasquo.
english: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏉᎳ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv Quola Ediniyi udanvsvgi Golinidiyi wulutsvgi.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎡᏈᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏋᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ, ᎩᎳᎢ ᎤᎷᏦᏅᎯ ᎢᏓᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏈᏏᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏠᏗᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎶᎻ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏩᏛᎯᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Uwadvhvno gilo iyusdi Atsusi Equila tsudoidv, Quvdiyi udenvhi, gilai ulutsonvhi Idali nvdayulosvhi, ale nasquo udalii Quisila tsudoidv, nvdagalisdodisgv Tlodiya unetsv nigadv Anitsusi Lomi unadanvsdiyi, nasgi duwadvhilvgi.
english: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏠᏱᏃ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᎸ ᎤᏪᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗ ᏗᏃᏢᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utloyino tsulvwisdanehi gesvi, nasgi iyusdi aninelv uwenvgi, ale dulvwisdanelvgi; dunilvwisdanehvyeno digalitsododi dinotlvsgi gesvi.
english: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎾᏙᏓᏈᏒᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nunadodaquisvno Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi gawonisgvgi, ale dasdiyedisgvgi Anitsusi ale Anigoi.
english: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏧᏂᎶᏒ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Sayila ale Dimadi unilutsv, Masidoni tsunilosv, Quola udanvdv uyilvsvgi, ale nasgi gvnigesv niduwanelvgi Anitsusi Tsisa nasgi Galonedv gesvi.
english: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏄᏬ ᎤᏩᏣᎬᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᎩᎬ ᏗᏥᏍᎪᎵ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᎵᏰᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᎵᏰᎥ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏮᏓᏥᎶᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino uniyosdotanv ale unisotlvistanv, unuwo uwatsagvnvgi hia niduweselvgi; Itsigigv ditsisgoli itsvsv detsadanvliyeesdi, ayv vtla yaquadanvliyev; hnaquo gohi iyudalenvdv tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv wvdatsilosi.
english: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏂᎩᏒ, ᏭᏴᎸᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏣᏍᏓ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏚᏓᏯᎸᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahnano unigisv, wuyvlvgi gilo iyusdi ganelv tsasda tsudoidv, Unelanvhi adadolisdanehi, nasgi ganelv dudayalvgi digalawiisdiyi.
english: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏟᏍᏆᏃ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Tlisquano digalawiisdiyi nugvwiyusv atsigatidisdi uwohiyunvgi Ugvwiyuhi, ale nigadv dudatinavi, unitsatino golinidiyi anehi unadvganv unohiyunvgi; ale degegawovgi.
english: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴ ᏉᎳ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᏂᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏪ ᏨᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino hia nuwesele Quola svnoyi unelawisehvi; Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, hinigesdiquosgini ale tlesdi elawe tsvnvgi,
english: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏕᎬᎦᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏙᎨᏣᏘᎷᎦ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏨᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏓᎩᎧᎭ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno degvgahnawadidoha, ale vtla gilo yidogetsatiluga usonv gohusdi tsvnediyi, unitsatayeno yvwi ani gaduhv dagikaha.
english: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ, ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano sudetiyvdv sudalino iyanvdo uwedolvgi, dadeyohvsgvgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga nahna anehvi.
english: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎵᏲᏃ ᏂᎯᏳ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᎷᎩᎡᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Geliyono nihiyu Ekaya atsigatidisdvi, Anitsusi saquo igagadv gvwanelugielvgi Quola, ale gvwatinolv digugododiyi gasgilvi,
english: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesvgi; hia nasgi dasdiyediha yvwi Unelanvhi anadadolisdanehv dikahnawadvsdi uniyosdodiyi.
english: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏛᏍᏚᎢᏏᏒᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ, ᎨᎵᏲ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏥᏧᏏ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola dvsduisisvgi aholi, Geliyo hia niduweselvgi Anitsusi; Iyuno uyo iyudvnelvhi yigi, ale usganvtsvhi yigi, Itsitsusi, duyugodv yigi itsvyadvdasdanediyi.
english: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏙᎦᎫᎪᏓ.
phonetic: Iyusgini kanetsvhi ale gohusdi dudov ale dikahnawadvsdi itsatseliga kanohedi yigi, itsvsv ditsilvwisdasi, vtlayeno nasgi iyusdi ayv yidogagugoda.
english: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎨᎯᏙᎸᎩᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Dugehidolvgino digugododiyi gasgilvi.
english: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎲ ᏐᏍᏗᏂ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ.  ᎨᎵᏲᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv Anigoi uniniyvhv Sosdini Anitsusi tsunilawiisdiyi nugvwiyusv atsigatidisdi, unilivnilvgi igvyitlv digugododiyi gasgilvi.  Geliyono vtla yugasayastane nasgi nusdidegvi.
english: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎩ ᎤᏪᏙᎸᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏲᎵᎸ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ ᏏᎵᏱ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏰᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏒᏟᏯ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Quolano asi uwohitsvgi uwedolvgi; hnaquono duyolilv anadanvtli, tsiyuhi wutsanvgi Siliyi wulosvgi; ale nasquo Quisila ale Equila gvwasdawadvsvgi, ulisdoyehvhi gesvgi Svtliya iyvdv, Unelanvhiyeno uduisdanelvhi gesvgi.
english: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏈᏌᏃ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏚᏩᏕᎲᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
phonetic: Equisano wulutsvgi ale nahna duwadehvgi, uwasvsgini digalawiisdiyi wuyvlvgi ale duwonetanvgi Anitsusi.
english: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏪᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Gvwatayoselvno uwohiisdiyi tsuweladidasdiyi vtla yuwohiyunei;
english: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏲᎵᎸᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏎ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏨᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᏨᏩᏛᎯᎵ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ.  ᎡᏈᏌᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏭᏣᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Duyolilvquosgini hia nuwesvgi; Ase agisquanigododi Tsilusilimi hia dilisdayvdiyi tsvdvsqualvhi.  Aseno taline dvtsvwadvhili, iyuno Unelanvhi usiyu yuyelvnv.  Equisano tsiyuhi wutsanvgi.
english: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏏᏌᎵᏱᏃ ᎤᏚᎩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏫᏚᏲᎵᎸ, ᎥᏘᎣᎩ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Sisaliyino udugisv, ale tsunanelodi unadatlugv widuyolilv, Vtiogi wulosvgi.
english: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏥᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏪᏐᎸᎩ, ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ
phonetic: Yelino uwohitsv uwedolv, unigisvgi, ale Gelesiyi ale Quitsiyi osdv uyilvsvgi uwesolvgi, dalinigohisdisgvgi nigadv anohiyuhvsgi
english: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎠᏉᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎤᏛᏒᎯ, ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏗᏏᎾᏍᏛ, ᎡᏈᏌ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi Atsusi Aquola tsudoidv, Eligiyi udvsvhi, asinasdv uwonihisdiyi, ale digalvquodi goweli disinasdv, Equisa ulutsvgi.
english: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏣᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia ageyonvhi gesvgi Ugvwiyuhi unvnvi, ale ulinigidv gesv udanvdvi, kanohesgvgi ale dadeyohvsgvgi nasuligogvna Ugvwiyuhi utseli ugvwali gesvi, Tsani utseli didawosdi uwasv agatahvgi.
english: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᏈᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᏚᏃᏏᏌᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi ulenvhvgi nasgaihvna uwonisvgi digalawiisdiyi.  Nasgino Equila ale Quisila unadvganelv uniyanvhvgi, ale utli iyosdv dunosisanelvgi Unelanvhi utseli ganvnvi.
english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏃ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Udulvhvno Ekaya uwenvsdiyi, anadanvtli unowelanvgi dinitayoselvgi anohiyuhvsgi digvwadanilvisdiyi; nasgino wulutsv, utsati dusdelvhvgi Unelanvhi udadolitsadv iyuwanisadv unohiyunvhi.
english: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯᏰᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ, ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvyayeno gawonisgv gvdisgv unohiyudiyi nuwanelvgi Anitsusi degalawivi, digalvquodi goweli degvdisgvi gvnigesv nigvnehv Tsisa nasgi Galonedv gesvi.
english: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᎡᏙᎲᎩ, ᏉᎳ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏒ, ᎡᏈᏌ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏚᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, nahiyu Aquola golinidiyi edohvgi, Quola ayeli gesv ulosv, Equisa wulutsvgi.  Duwadvhvno gilo iyunasdi anohiyuhvsgi,
english: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎡᏥᏁᎸᏍᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᏅᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯᎤᏅ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; Etsinelvsgo galvquodiyu adanvdo getsohiyunvhi?  Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; vtla ogadvganvhiunv yigi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ehvi.
english: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏬᏍᏔᏁᎢ?  ᏣᏂ ᏧᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano niduweselvgi; Gado usdi didawosdodi gesv detsawostanei?  Tsani tsudawosdodi gesv, unadvnvgi.
english: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎲ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎣᏂ ᏅᏓᏰᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Tsani udohiyuhi dadawosdisgvgi didawosdodi ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv ugvwali, dekanetsehv yvwi, unohiyudiyi oni nvdayegi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa degosehvgi.
english: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa dudov degegawostanvgi.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ, ᏚᏂᏬᏂᏒᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola dusitadv, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo unilutselvgi, duniwonisvgino tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesvi, ale unadolehosvgi.
english: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino anisgaya nigadv taladu iyvdv nanivgi.
english: And all the men were about twelve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏭᏴᎸ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎯᏛ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyino wuyvlv nasgaihvna gawonisgvgi, tsoi iyanvdo igahidv degawonedisgvgi ale dasdiyedisgvgi unohiyudiyi Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali.
english: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏲᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏐᏅᏉ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎳᎾ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi unisdayosv ale nunohiyunvna nulistanv, ale osonvquo uninohelv nasgi ganvnv ugvwali unitsati anigatahvi, dudanvelvgi, ale dudadaletanvgi anohiyuhvsgi degawonedisgvgi nidugitsvnisv gilo iyusdi Dalana tsudoidv tsudeyodiyi.
english: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nudvnelvgi tali tsudetiyvdv igohidv, nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi nigadv Esiyi anehi Anitsusi ale Anigoi unadvganvgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa utseliga.
english: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ;
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi yano iyulisdodi nigesvna usquanigodi dulvwisdanehvgi Quola agvdisgvgi;
english: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏗᏯᏠ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏞᏌᏙ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᎲᎩ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ, ᎥᏳᎩᏃ ᎠᎵᏛᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏩᏂᏄᎪᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Ayelvyeno tsudalenvhi diyatlo ale ditlesado daninohehvgi tsunitlvgi, vyugino alidvdisgvgi, uniyono didanvdo gvwaninugogvgi.
english: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏅᏁᏙᎯ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏧᏂᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏂᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏓᏏ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎦᏃᎮᎭ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi Anitsusi nvnedohi, anisgina dininugowisgi, unadanvtele Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa deudov tsunineisdanediyi uniyo didanvdo tsuniyai, hia nuniwesei; Itsvneisdasi Tsisa, nasgi Quola alitsidohvsgv tsiganoheha.
english: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏁᎮᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏏᏫ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᎡ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Aneheno galiquogi iyanidv Siwi tsudoidv tsuwetsi Atsusi nugvwiyue atsilvgelohi nasgi nanadvnehei.
english: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏥᏌ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Uyono adanvdo unetsv hia nuwesei; Tsisa tsigataha, ale Quola tsigataha, nihisgini gago itsasdi?
english: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏯᎢ ᏚᏁᎷᎩᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏎᎪᎩᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏤ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎢᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᏐᏅᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Asgayano uyo adanvdo uyai dunelugielei, ale esga niduwanelei, ale dusegogisei, nasgi iyusdi unalise nahna adanelv uninugotse tsuniyelviha ale digetsisonvnvhi.
english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia unadvganvgi nigadv Anitsusi ale Anigoi Equisa anehi; nigadvno uninayesvgi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa dudov galvquodiyu nulistanvgi.
english: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Unitsadvgino unohiyunvhi unilutsvgi, aninohvsgv ale gvnigesv nanvnehvdunilvwisdanelvi.
english: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎵᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᎤᎾᏎᎸᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗᎯ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ.
phonetic: Nasquo unitsadvgi usquanigodi anadvnelisgi dunitlisanvgi goweli, ale dunagohvstanvgi nigadv anigatahvi.  Unaselvno tsugvwalodihi unadolehosvgi hisgasgohi iyagayvli gesv uninegv adelv.
english: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏂᎬᎬᎩ ᎤᏛᏃᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎵᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsulinigvgvgi udvnosvgi ale uyelisvgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎯ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏇᏙᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎶᎻ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏥᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nulistanidolv, Quola udanvtelvgi udanvdvi, hnaquo Masidoni ale Ekaya ulosonvhi, Tsilusilimi wulohisdiyi, hia nuwesvgi; nahna gvquedonvhi gesesdi Lomi nasquo ase dvtsigoi.
english: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏕᎤᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎯ, ᏗᎹᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎳᏍᏓ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏗᎩᏴᎩ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Howano Masidoni deunvsvgi anitali gvwasdelvhidohi, Dimadi ale Ilasda, uwasvsgini udigiyvgi Esiyi ilvsgi igohidv.
english: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno vtla usdiquo udeyadodi yinulistanei, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi ganvnv ugvwali.
english: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎻᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᏕᎪᏢᎾᏁᎲ ᏓᏰᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏱᏓᏩᏛᎡᎮ ᎠᏃᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Giloyeno iyusdi Dimitliya tsudoidv, adelv atlvnvvsgi, adelv digotlvtanvhi dadanelv degotlvnanehv Dayeni, vtla usdiquo tsugvwalodi yidawadvehe anotlvnvvsgi.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏗᏩᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi duwetlisanv ale nvwanadale nasgi iyusdi tsunilvwisdanehi duwetlisanv hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya, itsigataha hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv tsugvwalodi idiwadvdisgvi.
english: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏈᏌᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏉᎳ ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᎦᏔᎲᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂᏉ ᏧᏬᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale itsigowatiha ale itsadvgiha, vtla Equisaquo uwasv, nasquosgini alequo nigvnadv Esiyi, hia Quola dasdiyedisgv dugatahvsv unitsati yvwi, hia nidegawesehvi, vtla galvladi anehi yigi gilo tsuwoyeniquo tsuwotlvtanvhi tsigi.
english: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᏲᏥᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ale vtla hiaquo digilvwisdanedi gesv uwasv unelagi wigvwayotsidasdi yigi; nasquosgini adanelv galvquodiyu galvladi ehi Dayeni utseliga asequoquo igvwalistanidasdi, ale nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesv wigvwayotsidasdi, nasgi nigadv Esiyi ale nigvnadv elohi tsigvwalvquodiha.
english: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino unadvganv unitalawosgvi unikalitsvgi, ale unelunvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Galvquodiyu Dayeni Equisa anehi unatseliga.
english: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎬᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎲᏃ ᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᏍᏔᎦ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᎴᏃᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎷᎩᏒᎩ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nigvno gaduhv unadasuyedvquo nulistanvgi, duniniyvhvno Gaya ale Elistaga Masidoni anehi, Quola unaligohi anedohvi, ulenonvhi unanelugisvgi wuniyvlvgi unadvnelvdiyi.
english: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᏫᏚᏴᏎᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Quolano widuyvsediyi yvwi udanvtelv, anohiyuhvsgi gvwanvsdadelvgi.
english: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏉᎳ ᏧᎵᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᏭᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilono iyunasdi digeganelodi Esiyi anehi, Quola tsulii, unadanvsvgi wigvwatayoselvgi, wuyvsdiyi nigesvna unadvnelvdiyi.
english: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏉ ᏂᏚᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Unelunvhi tsudalenvdvquo niduniwesvgi; danilawivyeno unadasuyedvquo gesvgi, ale utli iyanidv vtla yanigatahe nvdigalisdodisgv unadatlisanvi.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏭᏃᏯᏁᏒᎩᏃ ᎡᎵᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᏅᏫᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎡᎵᎩᏃ ᎤᏕᎸᏅ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Wunoyanesvgino Eligi unitsati anidonavi, nasgi Anitsusi aninvwisdisgvgi; Eligino udelvnv uwoyeni udulisgvgi uwasv alisdelisgvi tsuwonedodiyi yvwi.
english: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏥᎧᏁᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ, ᏔᎵᎭ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᏰᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno unadolehosv Atsusi gesvi, saquo tsikanego nasgiya nigadv unelunvgi, taliha iyutlilodv igohidv hia naniwesgvgi; Galvquodiyu Dayeni Equisa anehi unatseliga.
english: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸ ᏴᏫ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᎭ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏓᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏉᏙ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎣᏒᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Digowelisgino duyosdodanelv yvwi, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya Equisa itsehi, gago eha nagatahvna gaduhv Equisa nasgi edadadolisdanehi gesv galvquodiyu galvladi ehi Dayeni, ale Tsuquodo nvdayuloosvhi ditlilostanvhi?
english: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏙᎯᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏁᎳᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi hia nudlasidvedi nigesvna tsigi, dohiyiquosgini yinitsadvnv, ale gohusdi gvnelagi nitsadvnelvna yigi.
english: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎦᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏕᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Detsatinogayeno hia na anisgaya, nasgi galvquodi degesv aninosgisgi nigesvna, ale itsatseli galvladi ehi anisotlvisdisgi nigesvna.
english: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
author: Cherokee New Testament
