syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎻᏟᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎠᏃᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᏓᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎭ; ᏫᏓᎾᏓᏱᎵᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno Dimitliya ale nasgi tsaneha anotlvnvvsgi anuhisdisgesdi giloi, udlanvdv didayilidasdiyi, ale getsigatidisdi aneha; widanadayilida.
english: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᏥᏱᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᏓᏚᎪᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gohusdi nvwadale itsiyilidohesdi, ulinetsvhi degalawiv dadugotanvha.
english: But if ye inquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎦᎵᏱᎵᏕᏗᏰᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᏓᎵᏖᎸᎲᎦ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎭ ᎨᎩᏃᎮᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏓᏓᎶᏌ.
phonetic: Gegaliyilidediyeno gohi iga udasuyedv tsidalitelvhvga, vtlayeno gohusdi yaha geginohedi nvdigalisdodisgv hia gohi tsidadalosa.
english: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv duyelihistanvgi danilawivi.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᎵᏙᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᏉᎳ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏚᏲᎵᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏑᏏᏙᏂ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Udasuyedvno analitelvhvsgv ulidohistanv, Quola widuyanvhvgi anohiyuhvsgi, duyolilvno, unigisvgi Susidoni uwenvsdiyi uyelvnvgi.
english: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᏪᏙᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᏪᏁᏔᏅ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano uwedonv ale utsati duwenetanv, Anigoi unatseligohi wulutsvgi.
english: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏄᎪᏔᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ, ᏏᎵᏱ ᏓᏰᏏᏒᎩ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏛᏣᏂᏒᎩ, ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᏛᎤᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᏏᏙᏂ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahnano tsoi iyanvdo uwedolv, ale Anitsusi tsunugotanv gohusdi gvwanediyi, Siliyi dayesisvgi tsiyuhi dvtsanisvgi, udanvtelvgi dvutsvsdiyi Mosidoni wulohisdiyi.
english: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏏᏱᏃ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᏐᏇᏓ ᏈᎵᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎬᏓ, ᎦᏯᏃ ᏓᏈ ᎡᎯ, ᏗᎹᏗᏃ, ᎡᏏᏱᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᎩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏠᏆᎹ.
phonetic: Esiyino gvdisgi gvwasdawadvsvgi Soqueda Quiliyi ehi, Desilonigano anehi Elisdaga ale Sigvda, Gayano Daqui ehi, Dimadino, Esiyino anehi digiga ale Tloquama.
english: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏄᏁᏅᏒᎩ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏓᎪᎩᏚᏘᏴᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia igvyi nunenvsvgi Tloasi dagogidutiyvgi.
english: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾᏃ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ, ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏫᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nagotanvnano gadu agisdiyi gesv ulosonv, Quiligiyi tsiyuhi ogatsanvgi, hisgino winusvlv Tloasi widotsiwadvhvgi; nahnano galiquogi tsusvhidv ogedolvgi.
english: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅ, ᏉᎳ ᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏉ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏫᎬᏩᏛᏅᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Igvyiyino iga sunadodaquasdi gesvi gadu agvhaluyasdiyi ugvwali anohiyuhvsgi unadatlisanv, Quola dulitsidonelvgi, ugitsvdvquo uwenvsdi gesvi; ale enoyi ayeli wigvwadvnvgi gawonisgvgi.
english: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᏓᏨᏍᏛᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale utsadvgi datsvsdvgi galvladi nahna danilawivi.
english: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏫᏄᏣ ᏳᏘᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎠᏦᎳᏅ ᎤᏬᎸᎩ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎦᎵᎲᎩ; ᏉᎳᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎦᎵᎲ ᎤᏪᏇᏴᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᏗᏲᏓᏝᎲ ᏓᏳᏙᎣᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏁᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi awinutsa Yutiga tsudoidv atsolanv uwolvgi, asdaya galihvgi; Quolano gohidiyu alitsidohvsgv iyusdi, galihv uwequeyvsvgi ale tsoine diyodatlahv dayudoosvgi, ale atsinesvgi uyohusvhi gesvgi.
english: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏠᎣᏒ ᎤᎵᏢᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᎶᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎬᏅᏰᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Quolano utloosv ulitlvnvgi, ale unulolv hia nuwesvgi; tlesdi yitsadeyatanelesdi, gvnvyeno asiquo ayaa.
english: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᎤᎩᎳᏫᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᏒ, ᎤᎩᏨᏕᏱ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno iugilawisv, ale ugvhaluyv gadu, ale ugv, ale gohidv uwonisv, ugitsvdeyi gvdisgi, hnaquo unigisvgi.
english: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎲᎩᏃ ᎠᏫᏄᏣ ᎬᏃᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏳᎾᏓᏅᏓᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Unatihnawidvhvgino awinutsa gvnodv, ale vtla usdiquo osdv yunadanvdadei.
english: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏃᎨᏅᏒᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᏔᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏣᏅ, ᎡᏐᏏ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏉᎳ ᎣᏥᏲᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎳᏗᏉ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ayv igvyi nogenvsvgi tsiyu ditalvi, ale ogatsanv, Esosi wogilosvgi; nahna Quola otsiyodiyi ogiyelvsvgi, nasgiyeno iyuwedv gesvgi, uwasv eladiquo wulohisdiyi uyelvsvgi.
english: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏐᏏᏃ ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎣᏥᏴᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎻᏗᎵᏂ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ;
phonetic: Esosino ogiwadvhv otsiyvtanvgi, ale Midilini wogilutsvgi;
english: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᏱᎦᏣᏅ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎦᏲᏏ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᎣᏥᏂᏒᎩ.  ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏎᎼᏏ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ; ᏠᏥᎵᏯᏃ ᎣᎩᏒᎸ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎹᎵᏔ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiyigatsanv ugitsvdv Gayosi tsuyugodi otsinisvgi.  Ugitsvdvno Semosi wogilutsvgi; Tlotsiliyano ogisvlv ugitsvdv Malita wogilutsvgi.
english: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏰᏃ ᏧᏭᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎡᏈᏌ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏩᏅᎬᎩᏰᏃ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Quolayeno tsuwugotanvhi gesvgi ulohisdiyiquo Equisa, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nudulisgvna gesv Esiyi uwedasdiyi; uwanvgvgiyeno, iyuno yeli nasgi igvwadvnedi yigi, Tsilusilimi wuluhisdiyi hisgasgohine iga asqualisgvi.
english: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᎵᏔᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎡᏈᏌ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Malitano udanvsvgi Equisa widuyanvhvgi digeganelodi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi.
english: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏏᏱ ᏣᎩᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎩ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᏙᎸ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwalutselvno hia niduweselvgi; Itsigataha igvyiyi iga Esiyi tsaginanugotsilvgi nvdagvwadalenvdv, nusdv aqualinidolv itsehv nigohilvi.
english: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᎡᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᎵᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏋᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Detsikahnawadvehv Ugvwiyuhi nigav gohusdi naqualisgasdvna gesvi, ale detsigasawoihvi, ale agigoliyesgi aqualiwadvehvi, nvdigalisdodisgv Anitsusi gohusdi gvquvnediyi dunugotanvi.
english: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ] ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏋᏍᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏨᏰᏲᏅ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒᎢ,
phonetic: [Ale itsigataha] gohusdi itsalisdelvdodi aquvsgalanvhi nigesvna gesvi, itsvnanugowiselvquosgini ale detsvyeyonv degalawivi ale dadaneladisvi,
english: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvnigesv nigatsiyvnehv Anitsusi ale nasquo Anigoi nasgi Unelanvhi ganetliyvedi gesv odanvdvi, ale gohiyudi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏫᏥᎦᏘ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏅᏗᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ,
phonetic: Hnaquono gvniyuquo aquadanvdv galvidv Tsilusilimi witsigati, nitsigatahvna nvdiqualisdanelisv nahnani,
english: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᏘᏴ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyusgininonv Adanvdo gvnigesv nigvneha degaduwadisvi, nasgi gvgigatiyv vqualvsdi gesv ale uyo iyaqualisdanedi gesvi.
english: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᏖᎸᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎸᏉᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏔ ᏯᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi hia tsudalenvdv vtla gohusdi yagitelvhvsga, ale nasquo gvnv vtla utsati yagilvquodi, iyuno ulihelisdi yaquadanvta yagisquadv galenidohvi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa aginelvhi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, gvnigesv nigvnehv osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv kanohesgi.
english: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ, ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvniyuquo tsigataha nihi nitsivi, itsvyeladidolvhi galitsidohvsgv tsinohesgv Unelanvhi utseligohi, aquakadv hnaquo itsigowadvdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᏨᏴᎦ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎾᏆᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi gohi iga itsigatahi nitsvyvga, gilo unigigv naquadanvgalvna gesvi.
english: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno agisgalvhi yigi gvnigesv itsvyvnediyi nigav Unelanvhi udanvtelvi.
english: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏧᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsadagasayasdesdi itsvsv, ale detsigasayasdesdi nigadv sunadatlugi gesvi, nasgi ditsigatiya itsvnelvhi tsigi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ditselasdiyi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga, nasgi uwasv ugigv tsuguyvtanvhi tsigi.
english: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎩᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏩᏯ ᏓᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴᏂ, ᏂᏓᏂᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi tsigataha, hnaquo aginelesdi, unigvvsgi waya dagetsadasuyvni, nidanidoligvna gesesdi sunadatlugi gesvi.
english: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏛᏂᎾᏄᎪᏥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo itsvsv itsadatlugv dvninanugotsi anisgaya utsatini naniwesgesdi aniwonisgesdi, anohiyuhvsgi tsunatihnawidvdiyi uniyelvsesdi.
english: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏂᏥᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᏗᎦᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᏨᏰᏯᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsiyawisgesdi, ale itsanvtesdi tsoi tsudetiyvdv nitsisuligogvna svnoyi ale iga digatsigasawoihi itsisiyvwiha itsvyeyatanvi.
english: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᏨᏲᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏁᏍᎨᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ka, idadanvtli, hnaquo detsvyohi Unelanvhi itsidolisdiyi, uwvdodiyi, kanohedv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv kanohesgi, nasgi yeli getsanesgedi tsigi, ale itsatseli yeli igetsvnedi tsigi nasgi nigadv unadanvti igegvnelvhi unatseli iyulisdodi gesvi.
english: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏯᏚᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᏬ.
phonetic: Vtla gilo tsiyadulvelvhi yigi adelv unegv ale adelv dalonige ale dinuwo.
english: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏉᏰᏂ ᏓᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏤᎯ.
phonetic: Itsvsvyeno itsigataha hia nasgi diquoyeni daquvtanvhi agiwadvhv aginigvsehv aquvsv ale nasquo otsehi.
english: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ, "ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏴᏓᏁᎭ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏓᏗᏁᎭ."
phonetic: Nigadv gvnigesv nitsvyvnelv nasgi itsadvnediyi detsilvwisdanehv ditsisdelvdiyi diniwanagalai, ale itsanvdadisdiyi tsunetse Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, hia tsinuwesei, "Utli osiyu adanvdadisdi yvdaneha, esgaquo yvdadineha."
english: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nuwesv, duliniquanvnvgi ale nigadv anigatahv udadolistanvgi.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎾᏠᏱᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎩᎵᎨᏂ ᎤᏂᏯᎸᏨ ᎬᏩᏔᏪᏙᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nagadvno utsati dunatloyilvgi, ale Quola agiligeni uniyalvtsv gvwatawedonvgi.
english: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᏛ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏥᏳᏃ ᏗᏔᎸᎢ ᏫᎬᏪᎧᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Uyo uniyelvsvgi ho ugvwiyusv nvdagalisdodisgv unetsv nasgi ukadv hnaquo unigowadvdi nigesvna gesvi.  Tsiyuno ditalvi wigvwekanvgi.
english: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᎦᎦᎴᏅᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅ, ᏧᏳᎪᏗ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᎣᏏ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎶᏗᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎣᎨᏅ ᏆᏖᎵ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino dogagalenvhv ale tsiyuhi ogatsanv, tsuyugodi woginvstanvgi Goosi wogilutsvgi, ugitsvdvno Lodiyi, nahnano wiogenv Quateli wogilutsvgi.
english: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᏴᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᏥᏳ ᏈᏂᏏ ᎠᏂᏂᏒᎢ, ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏴᏫᏛᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ogiyvwadvhvno tsiyu Quinisi aninisvi, ogatsanvgi ogiyvwidvhvgi.
english: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎣᎩᎪᎲ ᏌᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᎶᏒ, ᏏᎵᏱ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᏯᏃ ᎣᎦᏣᎢᏒᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎸ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ogigohv Saqui, ale agatisiditlv ogilosv, Siliyi woginvstanvgi, Dayano ogatsaisvgi; nahnayeno tsiyu ulinesalv ulinesalesdi gesvgi.
english: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎦᏅᏅᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Dotsiwadvhvno anohiyuhvsgi nahna oganvnvgi galiquogi tsudodaquadv; nasgi Quola hia nigvwaweselvgi adanvdo iyuwanisadv; tlesdi Tsilusilimi tsenvsvgi.
english: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᏬᏥᎦᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏗᎬᎾᏘᏁᎯ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᏫᏕᎪᎩᎧᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗᏃ ᏙᎦᎵᏂᏆᏅᏅ ᎣᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino galiquogi tsudodaquadv ulosonv, oganigisvgi, wotsigadv iditlv wogilosvgi; nigadvno nasgi, ale tsunadalii ale tsunetsi digvnatinehi gaduhv wigananugogv widegogikanvgi.  Amayulodino dogaliniquanvnv ogadadolistanvgi.
english: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᎦᏓᏲᎵᎸᏃ, ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᏮᎤᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Dogadayolilvno, tsiyuhi ogatsanvgi; nasgino dotsunenvsv wvunilosvgi.
english: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᏍᏆᏛᏃ ᎣᎦᏅᏔᏩᏗᏒ ᏓᏯ ᏦᎦᏂᎩᏒᎢ ᏙᎵᎹᏱ ᎣᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏲᎵᎸ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᎿᎭᏑᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎣᎨᏙᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Ogisquadvno oganvtawadisv daya tsoganigisvi dolimayi ogilutsvgi, ale dotsiyolilv anadanvtli, nahna sudodaquadv ogedolvgi.
english: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎣᎦᎵᎪᎯ ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏬᎩᏴᎸᏃ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏈᎵᎩ ᎠᎵ ᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎦᎵᎪᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎦᏅᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno Quola ogaligohi oganigisvgi Sisaliyi wogilutsvgi.  Wogiyvlvno ganelv Quiligi ali tsidonidohi, nasgi galvquogi iyanidv agaligotanvhi, nahna oganvnvgi.
english: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎾᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsuwetsi nvgi iyanidv anehvgi anadv anadolehosgi.
english: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎦᏅᏅ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎡᎩᏩ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᏧᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Uwohitsvno nahna oganvnv, gilo iyusdi adolehosgi ulutsvgi, Egiwa tsudoidv, Tsudiyi nvdayulosvhi.
english: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎣᏤᏙᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏓᏠᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎸᎸ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏛᎾᎸᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏓᏠᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏫᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgino ulutsv otsedohv, ale unesv Quola udatlosdi, ale dulvlv uwasv tsuwoyeni, ale tsulasideni, hia nuwesvgi; Hia nigawea Galvquodiyu Adanvdo; nasgi hia nvdvnvneli Anitsusi Tsilusilimi dvnalvli asgaya hia adatlosdi utseliga, ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi widodvniyohiseli.
english: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᎣᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia ogadvganv, ayv ale nahna anehi otsisdiyetanvgi Tsilusilimi uwenvsdiyi nigesvna.
english: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏗ, ᏥᏕᏥᏴᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏥᏓᏬᏗᎭ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ; ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏰᏃ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Aseno Quola unetsv hia nuwesvgi; Gado itsiyelvdi, tsidetsiyvga ale tsitsidawodiha aginawi; aquadvnvisdiyeno, vtla vqualvsdiyiquo uwasv, nasquosgini agiyohuhisdiyi Tsilusilimi, nvdigalisdodisgv dudov Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa.
english: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᎣᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᎩᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏃᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Oninulvnvno otsisdiyedisgvi, ogisuligotsvgi, hia nogiwesvgi; Ugvwiyuhi adanvtesgv winigalisda.
english: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎣᎩᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᎣᎩᏱᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno gesv ulosonv, ogitlisanvgi ogiyidasdi, ale Tsilusilimi wogilosvgi.
english: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎥᎪᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏁᏌᏂ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏌᏈ ᎡᎯ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎣᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasquono vgogisdawadvsvgi ilvsgi iyanidv anohiyuhvsgi Sisaliyi anehi, ale unatinvsvgi gilo iyusdi Nesani tsudoidv Saqui ehi, ilvhiyu gvwohiyunvhi, nasgi ganelv oganvdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
english: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimino wogilutsv, anadanvtli ulihelitsvhi degogadanilvtsvgi.
english: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏥᎻ ᏧᏬᎸ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎨᏅᏒᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ogitsvdvno Quola Tsimi tsuwolv itsulaha ogenvsvgi, nigadvno digeganelodi anigatahvgi.
english: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏲᎵᎸᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏱᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Deuyolilvno osdv uyilvsvgi unohelvgi nusdv Unelanvhi deulvwisdanelv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, nasgi Quola agvdisgvi.
english: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.  ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎭᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unadvganvno nasgi, unilvquotanvgi Ugvwiyuhi.  Hia nigvwaweselvgi; Idalinvtli, hadolehosga nunitsuquisdv Anitsusi unohiyunvhi; nigadvno utsati unilvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᏕᎮᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎠᏂᏧᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏑᏯ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎼᏏ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎱᏍᏕᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale getsadvganelv deheyohvsgvi nigadv Ianitsusi, nasgi tsunadasuya tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, tsuniyohisdiyi Mosi, hia niwesgvi; Tlesdi yiditsihusdesehesdi diniyoli, ale tlesdi dikahnawadvsdi yitsisdawadegesdi.
english: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏛᏁᏗ?  ᎠᏎ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏐᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ, ᏛᎾᏛᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᏣᎷᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono advnedi?  Ase unadatlisodi unitsati, dvnadvganiyeno tsalutsvi.
english: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎲ ᎿᎭᏛᎦ.  ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎪᎨᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᎾᏚᎵᏄᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nitsvwesehv hnadvga.  Nvgi iyanidv anisgaya gogeladidoha Unelanvhi nunadulinunelv.
english: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᏘᏄᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎫᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏂᏍᎪᎵ ᏕᎠᎾᎵᏍᏙᏰᎲᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎭᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tatinuga, ale itsulaha itsadanvgalv, ale itsulaha itsaguyv, nasgino dinisgoli deanalisdoyehvha; ale nigadv anadolehosvha nusdv getsadvganelvi asequoquo gesvi, ale anadolehosvha tsvsv nasquo duyugodv halenidohvi, dikahnawadvsdi hisdawadegvi.
english: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏙᏦᏪᎳᏁᎸ ᏙᎫᎪᏔᏅ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᏯᏙᏤᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvsgini yvwi unohiyunvhi tsigi, dotsowelanelv dogugotanv unisquanigododiyi nigesvna gohusdi nasgi iyusdi tsuneyadotsediquosgini uwasv Unelanvhi diyelvhi dilisgolvdanelvhi, ale gigv ale gohusdi gvwostanvhi ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi.
english: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎲᎩ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᏂᏴᎸᎩ, ᎧᏃᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono quola duyanvhvgi anisgaya, ugitsvdvno itsulaha unadanvgalvhvgi, digalawiisdiyi wuniyvlvgi, kanohvsgvgi ulisquadv igohidv adanvgalvdi gesvi, nasgi alisquadisgvi adanedi gesv anisiyvwiha unalisgolvdodi gesvi.
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎵᏍᏆᏗᏗᏒᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎡᏏᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎲ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᏂᏖᎸᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ,
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi galiquogi iga dulisquadidisvgi, Anitsusi Esiyi nvdayunilosvhi gvwagohv digalawiisdiyi, dunitelvnvgi nigadv yvwi, ale gvwaniyvhvgi,
english: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ!  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ, ᏥᏓᏡᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelunvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Itsisgaya, Isili tsuwetsi, sgisdelv!  Hia nasgi asgaya nasgi tsidegeyohvsga naniv yvwi nigvnadvi, tsidatludiha hia yvwi ale dikahnawadvsdi ale ani gesvi, ale nasquo digalawiisdiyi tsiduyvtanilv Anigoi, ale gadaha tsinuwanelv ani galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏠᏆᎹ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏁᏙᎲ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏴᏔᏂᎸ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Gayulayeno unigohvhi gesvgi Tloquama Equisa ehi, nasgi Quola anedohv gaduhvi, nasgi Quola uyvtanilv digalawiisdiyi anelisgvgi.
english: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏂᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏌᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ; ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nigadvno gaduhv unalitelvnvgi, ale yvwi unadatlisanvgi, ale Quola uniniyvhvgi uninasanawidvhvgi digalawiisdiyi uninugowisvgi; gilaquono iyvdv galohisdiyi dunisdunvgi.
english: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎩ, ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᏗ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Asiquono unihisdiyi anadanvtesgvgi, sunadatlugi gesv aniyawisdi ditinidohi udvganvgi nigadv Tsilusilimi analitelvhvsgvi;
english: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏁᏙᎲ ᏭᏗᏢᏍᏔᏅᎩ.  ᏚᏂᎪᎲᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏂᎸᏂᎲ ᏉᎳ.
phonetic: Nasgi na gilaquo iyvdv widuyanvhv aniyawisgi ale asgohitsuqui dinatinidohi, ale dinedohv wuditlvstanvgi.  Dunigohvno nugvwiyusv didatinidohi ale aniyawisgi, unisuligotsvgi anilvnihv Quola.
english: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏣᎦᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv didatinidohi nav ulutsv, uniyvhvgi, ale unetsvgi tali tsudadesvdv tsagalvsdodiyi, ale udvdvnvgi iyusdi gesv, asgaya, ale nudvnelvi.
english: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏉ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏩᎦᏘᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unitsatino unelunvgi tsudalenvdvquo nuniwesvgi.  Unulvnvno duyugodv udolehohisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv udasuyedv analitelvhvsgvi, unetsvgi disoyv wagatinvsdodiyi.
english: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎠᎩᎳᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏅᏒᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Quolano agilawisdiyi ulutsv aniyawisgi gvwanvsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi gvsgaisdagi nanadvnehv unitsati.
english: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎷᎦ.
phonetic: Unitsatiyeno yvwi gvwasdawadvsvgi, aneluhvsgvgi hia naniwesgvgi; hiluga.
english: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏮᏓᏰᏥᏴᏔᏂᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏥᏌ ᏰᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏲᏎᏗ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola disoyv wvdayetsiyvtanisvi, hia nuweselvgi nugvwiyusv didatinidohi; Tsisa yeli gohusdi gagvyosedi?  Nasgino hia nuwesvgi; Tsigo Anigoi uniwonihisdi gesv yeli getsawonihisdi?
english: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏥᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ?
phonetic: Tlasgo nihi yigi na Itsiquiyi tsehvgi, ilvhiyu udasuyedv unalitelvdiyi tsinuwanelvgi, ale tsidutihnawidvhvgi inage tsiwidutinvstanvgi nvgi iyagayvli iyanidv anisgaya yvwi dinihihi?
english: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎨᎢ ᏓᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎤᏬᎭᏛ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᎨᎢ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Ayv Tsitsusi Silisiyi gei Dasa gaduhvi, vtla esgaquo uwohadv gaduhvi gei yigi; ale gvtayoseha unelagi squelisediyi ditsiwonedodiyi yvwi.
english: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏃ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᎳᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏖᎸᎾᏁᎸᎩ; ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅ, ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏮᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Unelagino uweliselv, Quola ulenvgi agilawisdiyi, uwoyeni yvwi dutelvnanelvgi; utsatino elawe unvnv, duwonetanvgi Anitsusi uniwonihisdi uwvtanvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
english: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ, ᎢᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏨᏓᏥᏬᏂᏏ.
phonetic: Itsisgaya idadanvtli ale digidoda, itsadvdasda hia aqualisdelvdodi hnaquo tsvdatsiwonisi.
english: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅᎩ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Unadvganvno Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gesv gvdisgv uniwonedisgvi, utli igai elawe unvnvgi; hiano nuwesvgi;
english: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏥᏧᏏ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎯ ᏓᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏆᏛᏒᎯ, ᎨᎺᎵ ᏚᎳᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏇᏲᏅᎯ ᏭᏂᎫᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᏓᏅᏔ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv Tsitsusi Silisiyi aquadenvhi Dasa gaduhvi, aseno ani gaduhv aquadvsvhi, Gemeli dulasgvi vqueyonvhi wunigudv dikahnawadvsdi gesv digigayvlige geginelvhi, ulinigidiyuno aquadanvdvgi detsigahnawadisv Unelanvhi nasgiya nitsiv nihi tsinusdi tsitsadanvta gohi iga tsigi.
english: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏅᏅ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ, ᏕᎦᏥᏯᎸᎢᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏕᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyohusgi gatsiyadeyadodisgvgi hia ganvnv dinikahnawadegi, degatsiyalvihvgi ale didasdudiyi degatsiyvdisgvgi anisgaya ale anigeyv.
english: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎬᎩᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᏕᏥᏯᏅᎲᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno atsilvgelohi nasquo gvnigesv naquvneha, ale nigadv digeganelodi gesvi, nasgi nasquo goweli degvginvnelvgi idalinvtli tsunigowadvdi, ale Demasga wagilosvgi, detsiyanvhvsv nahna anehi digegalvidv digatsiyatinohisdiyi Tsilusilimi, getsigiliyoisdodiyi.
english: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᎢᏒᎢ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎾᎥ ᏩᎩᎷᏨ, 'ᎢᎦ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎸᏌᏓᏛᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᏓᏆᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia naqualisdanelvgi gaisvi, Demasga nav wagilutsv, 'iga ayeli iyvdv, uyeloistanvgi utsati dulvsadadvgi galvladi nvdayulosvhi daquaduwistanvgi.
english: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎳᏗᏃ ᎠᎩᏅᏨᎩ, ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Eladino aginvtsvgi, kanegvno aquadvganvgi, hia nagiweselvgi; Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?
english: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏘ ᏤᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Ayvno aginetsv hia nagiwesvgi; gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano nagiweselvgi, ayv Tsisa Naseliti tsesgi, nasgi uyo tsiniyvneha.
english: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏤᎯᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏁ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᎩᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Otsehino udohiyuhi anigowatisgvgi iga gadvi, ale anisgaihvgi, aseno vtla yunadvgane kanegv agiwonedisgi.
english: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎮᎾ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏓᏰᏣᏆᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiwesvgi, Gado dagadvneli, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Ugvwiyuhino hia nagiweselvgi; Talehvga, Demasga hena, nahnano dayetsaquaneli nigav dudugotanv itsadvnediyi.
english: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏄᎸᏅᏃ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏛᎢ, ᎣᏤᎯ ᎬᏉᏱᏁᏅ, ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏩᎩᏴᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Aginulvnvno agigowadvdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv digvwalvsada nasgi iga gadvi, otsehi gvquoyinenv, Demasga wagiyvlvgi.
english: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Gilono iyusdi Eninaya tsudoidv, udanvti dikahnawadvsdi asdawadegi, nigadv Anitsusi nahna anehi osdv gvwanohesgi,
english: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᎤᎴᏂᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏐᎳ, ᏥᎯᎪᏩᏛ.  ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᏙᏥᏯᎦᎿᎭᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Agilutselv ulenilvgi, hia nagiweselvgi; dinadanvtli Sola, tsihigowadv.  Nahiyuquono dotsiyagahnanvgi.
english: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏣᏑᏰᏒ, ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Unelanvhi digigayvlige unatseliga tsasuyesv, tsagadovhisdiyi nusdv adanvtesgvi, ale higowadvdiyi nasgi na nasganvna, ale aholi gananugogv kanegv tsadvgodiyi.
english: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᎪᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏛᎦᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hinohesgiyeno gesesdi naniv yvwi anehvi nusdv tsagohvi ale tsadvganvi.
english: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎭᏙᎯᏗᎭ?  ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏪᏣᏬᏣ, ᎠᎴ ᎰᏑᎵ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎯᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Ka, gadono ihadohidiha?  Talehvga, ale wetsawotsa, ale hosuli tsasganvtsvi, hitayohihesdi hvdisgesdi deudov Ugvwiyuhi.
english: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎢᎠᎩᎷᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᏣᎦᎵᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Hiano naqualisdanelv Tsilusilimi iagilutsv, nasgi gadadolisdisgv udvnv digalawiisdiyi, tsagaliho iyusdi naqualisdanelvgi;
english: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎲᎩ; ᎾᏞᎬᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎯᏄᎪᎢ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᏛᏂᏂᏴᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsigovgi hia nagiwesehvgi; natlegvquo iyvdv hinugoi Tsilusilimi; vtlayeno yidodvniniyvhi ayv sginohesgvi.
english: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏂᏙᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏂᎵᏙᎸᎢ ᎨᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nagiwesvgi; Tsagvwiyuhi, anigataha detsisdunidolvi ale detsilvnilidolvi getsohiyuhvsgi digalawiisdiyi degotlvwadisvi.
english: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏣᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏍᏗᏫ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎤᏤᏬᏨ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎥ ᏥᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏴᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎯᎯ.
phonetic: Ale tsanohesgi Sdiwi ugigv utsewotsv ayv nasquo nav tsidogvgi ale osiyu agiyelvsvgi uyohusvi, ale detsigatiyvgi tsunanuwo nasgi gvwahihi.
english: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎭᏓᏅᎾ, ᏓᎬᏅᏏᏰᏃ ᎢᏅ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi; Hadanvna, dagvnvsiyeno inv tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehvi.
english: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩᏃ ᎬᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᎶᎯ ᏩᎦᏘᎿᎭᏫᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Gvwadvdasdanehvgino gvni nasgi hia nuwesv, hnaquono unisaladanvgi aninegv hia nuniwesvgi; elohi wagatihnawidv nasgiquo iyusdi yvwi; vtlayeno yeli gvnesdi gayelisdi yigi.
english: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᎡᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᏬ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏚ ᎤᎾᏕᏏᏙᎲᎩ;
phonetic: Asiquono unelugvgi ale dunadaegvgi tsunanuwo ale gosdu unadesidohvgi;
english: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏗᏐᏴ ᏩᏥᏴᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎵᎥᏂᎲ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏁᎷᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nugvwiyusv didatinidohi unetsvgi disoyv watsiyvdodiyi, ale atsilivnihv atsigoliyediyi, udulisgvgi udolehohisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv nigav aneluhvsgv gvwatludisgvi.
english: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎸ, ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏰᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎦᏰᏥᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎶᎻ, ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Gvwalivnisdiyino gvwatinolv, Quola hia nuweselvgi nav gadogi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi; Yeliquosgo dikanawadvsdi nigvnv gayetsilivnisdi asgaya Alomi, usganvtsv tsudugotanvhi nigesvna yigi?
english: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈᏃ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᏭᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏅᏔᏛᏁᎵ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎶᎻ.
phonetic: Asgohitsuquino ditinidohi, nasgi udvganv, wunonelvgi nugvwiyusv didatinidohi, hia winuwesvgi; Heyatahesdi hia tsinvtadvneli; hiayeno asgaya Alomi.
english: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᎯᎶᎻᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv didatinidohi ulutsv, hia nuweselvgi; Sginohvsi, Hilomisgo nihi?  Vv, udvnvgi.
english: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏤᏘ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎠᏆᏕᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno didatinidohi hia nuwesvgi; utseti aquaguyvdv hia nasgi aquadatseligaya gesvi.  Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Ayvsgini aquadatseligaya aquadenvgi.
english: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏴᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎲᎩ, ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᎶᎻ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎸᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gilaquo iyvdv gvwadanvelvgi gvwagoliyesgi; nasquono nugvwiyvsv didatinidohi asgaihvgi, udolehosv Alomi gesvi, ale nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi ulvlvi.
english: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎸᏒᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏐᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᏂᏅᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno udulisgv iyusdi duyugodv udolehohisdiyi nvdagalisdodisgv Anitsusi gvwuhisdisgvi, ulvsvhvgi, ale unetsvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale nigadv dinilawigi, unadatlisodiyi, ale utinolvgi Quola, aninvigvyitlv uwekanvgi.
english: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᏒᎯ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏆᏎᎮᎲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Quolano uyanvsvhi dukahnanv dinilawigi, hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, gohi iga iyasdi, aquadanvdo aquasehehv dagilvwisdanehvgi nigav duyugodv gesv Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏂᎾᏯᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏚᏂᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Eninayano nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi dunitselvgi gadogv nav anidonai aholi gvwanisdiyi.
english: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᏨᏂᎵ ᏂᎯ, ᎠᏐᏱ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ; ᏦᎳᏰᏃ ᎨᎵ ᏗᏍᏇᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ?  ᏥᎪᏃ ᎢᎯᏁᎦ ᎥᏋᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᎦᏘᎴᎦ?
phonetic: Quolano hia nuweselvgi; Unelanvhi datsvnili nihi, asoyi unegv igvnelvhi; tsolayeno geli disquegodanediyi nasgiwo dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi?  Tsigono ihinega vquvnisdiyi dikahnawadvsdi dohigatilega?
english: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᏥᎪ ᎦᎯᏐᏢᏗᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Navno anidonai hia nuniwesvgi; tsigo gahisotlvdiha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi Unelanvhi utseliga?
english: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎵᏍᎨ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ; "ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ."
phonetic: Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Idadanvtli, vtla yigelisge nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi gesvi; hiayeno tsinigvnv tsigowela; "Tlesdi usonv yinetsehesdi tsaganelodi ditsatseli yvwi unatseliga."
english: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ, ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᏥᏆᎵᏏ, ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏆᎵᏱᎵᏕᎭ.
phonetic: Quolano udolehosv igadv Anisadusi gesvi, igadvno Aniqualisi, uwelunvgi degalawivi hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, ayv Tsiqualisi, Aqualisi uwetsi; udugi gvdi gesv ale ayohusv dilehisodi gesv nvdigalisdodiha aqualiyilideha.
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎾᏓᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, uniyotlohiselvgi Aniqualisi ale Anisadusi, unitsatino gesv tali nunadadvgi.
english: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏎᎪᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Anisadusiyeno hia naniwesegoi; Vtla dilehisodi yigi, vtla ale yeha dikahnawadidohi ale adanvdo; Aniqualisisgini itsula anohiyuhvsga.
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ; ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏲᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᏓᏟᏴᎡᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Utsatino unelunvgi; dinowelisgino Aniqualisi unaligosv unaligohi dunalenv unadisvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Vtla gohusdi uyo yotsiwadveha hia asgaya, iyusgini adanvdo ale dikahnawadidohi unetselvhi gesesdi, tlesdi Unelanvhi tsedatliyvelvgi.
english: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎤᏂᏲᏠᎯᏎᎸ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ ᏉᎳ ᏱᎬᏪᏓᎦᎸᎥᎦ ᎡᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᎾᏑᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏐᏴᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatino uniyotlohiselv, nugvwiyusv didatinidohi asgaihvi Quola yigvwedagalvvga elisgvi, dunetselvgi aniyawisgi unenvsdiyi ale widunasugalvdodiyi, ale uniyvtanihisdiyi disoyvi.
english: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏫᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎴᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᏉᎳ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᏍᏋᏁᎸ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏍᏋᏁᎵ ᏣᏂ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno svnoyi winulistanv, Ugvwiyuhi nav ulenelei, hia nuwesei; Ugalisdi tsadanvtesdi, Quola, gvnigesvyeno tsinisquvnelv Tsilusilimi, nasquo gvnigesv nvdasquvneli Tsani.
english: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᎾᎴᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏁᎢ, ᎤᎾᏎᎵᏔᏁ ᏚᎾᏓᏁᏤᎴ ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏗᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏴᎨᏓᏗᏔ, ᎬᏂ ᏉᎳ ᎡᏗᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Sunaleno nulistanv gilo iyunasdi Anitsusi unaligonei, unaselitane dunadanetsele getsisginvdisdiyi, hia nuniwesei; Vtla gohusdi yvgediga ale yvgedadita, gvni Quola edilvhi gesesdi.
english: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nvgasgohino uditlvsdodi nanivgi nasgi itsunadaweselvhi.
english: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᏚᏂᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎣᎦᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᏙᎦᏓᏁᏤᎸ ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏅᏍᎦᎶᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂ ᏉᎳ ᎣᏥᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino nunigvwiyusv atsilv anelohi ale dinilawigi, dunilutselvgi hia nuniwesvgi; Ogaselitanv dogadanetselv ogisdvdisdiyi, gohusdi oganvsgalodiyi ale ogadugisdiyi nigesvna gvni Quola otsilvhi gesesdi.
english: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎲᎦ, ᎡᏥᏔᏂᏲᏏ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᎢᏣᏘᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏛᏗᏱ ᏥᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᎥ ᏂᎦᎷᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ka nasgi iyusdi nihi ale dinilawigi itsaligohvga, etsitaniyosi nugvwiyusv didatinidohi, ugitsvnv itsatinohediyi, utli igai gohusdi itsadvdvdiyi tsitsadulisgo nasgiyai hia nasgi aguisdisgvi, ayvno asiquo nav nigalugvna gesesdi, ogadvnvisdi otsiisdiyi.
english: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would inquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏙ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏂᎭᎷᎬᎢ, ᎤᏬᏅᏒᎩ, ᏗᏐᏴ ᏭᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ.
phonetic: Quolano udo uwetsi udvganv unihalugvi, uwonvsvgi, disoyv wuyvlvgi, ale wunonelvgi Quola.
english: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏫᏅ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏄᏬᎸ ᏫᏯᏘᏅᏍᏓ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᎭ ᎤᏃᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Quolano wuyanvhv asiyvwi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, hia nuwesvgi; Hia awinv nugvwiyusv didatinidohi nuwolv wiyatinvsda, gohusdiyeno uha unonedi.
english: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏯᏅᎲ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏭᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏉᎳ ᎠᏴᎩ ᏩᎩᏯᏅᎲᎩ, ᎠᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎬᏯᏘᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎭ ᏣᏃᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Howano uyanvhv, nugvwiyusv didatinidohi wutinohelvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Quola ayvgi wagiyanvhvgi, agitayoselvgi hia awinv gvyatinohediyi, nasgi gohusdi uha tsanonedi.
english: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏬᏯᏁᏒ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏕᎵᏒ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏍᎩᏃᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno didatinidohi uwoyanesv, iyvdv udelisv wutinvstanvgi, udvdvnvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Gado nasgi na sginonedi tsigi?
english: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎨᏣᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᏫᏯᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏨᏗᎾᏛᏛᏂᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; Anitsusi unadanvtelv getsatayosediyi ugitsvnv degalawiv wiyatinohisdiyi Quola, nasgiya gohusdi utli igai tsvdinadvdvnisoi.
english: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would inquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᏳᏅᎩ; ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏩᎭᎷᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᏁᏤᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏂᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏣᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno tlesdi dohiyunvgi; nvgasgohiyeno uditlvsdodi iyanidv anisgaya gvwahaluga, nasgi unaselitanvhi dunadanetselv unalisdayvdiyi ale unaditasdiyi nigesvna, gvni unilvhi gesesdi; hnaquono unadvnvisdi anigatiyv unadvgodiyi tsaduistanvi.
english: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ ᎠᏫᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎯᏃᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nugvwiyusv didatinidohi uwekanvgi awinv ale anetselvgi hia nuweselvgi; Tlesdi gilo hinonelv nasgi hia gvnigesv nisquvnelvi.
english: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᎾᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏗᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏘᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏂᏙᎯ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎠᏁᏒᎭ ᏐᎣᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏒᏃᏱ;
phonetic: Widuyanvhvno anitali asgohitsuqui dinadatinidohi, hia nuwesvgi; Disdadvnvisda talitsuqui aniyawisgi, ale galiquasgohi tsunagilvdi, ale didatisdi dininidohi talitsuqui, Sisaliyi anesvha sooneline iyutlilodv svnoyi;
english: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎸᏙᏗ ᏗᏍᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎾᎩᎸᏔᏅᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏩᎾᏘᏃᎮᎸᎭ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Ale digilvdodi disdadvnvisda nasgi Quola anagilvtanvha, ale nvwadohiyadv wanatinohelvha Quilisi ugvwiyuhi.
english: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᏪᎳᏅᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Uwowelanvgino hia winuweselvgi;
english: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎠᏴ ᏠᏗᏯ-ᎵᏏᏯ ᏫᎬᏲᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎰᏍᏛ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏈᎵᏏ.
phonetic: "Ayv TlodiyaLisiya wigvyoliga utsati hosdv tsagvwiyuhi Quilisi.
english: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᏩᎵᏒᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏘᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ, ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎶᎻ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hia asgaya Anitsusi gvwaniyvhvgi, ale dagvwalisvgi, hnaquo aniyawisgi degatinvsvgi, ale tsisdelvhvgi, aquadvganvhi gesv Alomi gesvi.
english: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏚᎸᎲᏃ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏥᏯᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Aquadulvhvno aquadolehohisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv gvwohisdisgvi, tsiyatinolvgi danilawivi.
english: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aquadolehosvno nasgi tsunikahnawadvsdiquo kanohedi gesv nvdigalisdodisgv aguisdisgvi gvwayohuhisdino ale gayegalvsdi gesv gohusdi naguisdvna gesvi.
english: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᎭᎷᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏒ ᏗᏦᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎨᏍᏗ."
phonetic: Ale vginonelv anitsusi unihalugv nasgi asgaya, gilaquo iyvdv aquadanvsv ditsolvi, ale nasquo gatsinetselv gvwuhisdisgi higatahv uninohediyi nvdigalisdodisgv anuhisdisgvi.  Dohiyi nitsadvhnadegesdi."
english: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ, ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ, ᎤᏂᏯᏅᎲᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏭᏂᎶᏒ, ᎥᏗᏇᏗ ᏭᎾᏘᏃᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Aniyawisgino, nigetsiweselv getsinetselv nunadvnelv, uniyanvhvgi Quola, ale svnoyi wunilosv, Vdiquedi wunatinolvgi.
english: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ ᎤᎾᏘᏅᏍᏗ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ, ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏨᏒᎩ, ᏗᏐᏴ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno tsunagilvdi unatinvsdi nunvnelv, aniyawisgi unatsvsvgi, disoyv wunilosvgi.
english: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏂᏅᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsunagilvdi Sisaliyi wunilutsv, ale ugvwiyuhi goweli uninvnelv, nasquo Quola duniyohiselvgi.
english: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino ugoliyev, udvdvnvgi nahna sgadugi ehi gesvi, udvganvno Silisiyi ehi gesvi,
english: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏓᎬᏯᏛᎦᏁᎵ ᎨᏧᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ.  ᎤᏁᏨᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; Dagvyadvganeli getsuhisdisgi nasquo anilutsvha.  Unetsvgino atsigatidisdiyi Elodv utseli digugododiyi adanelvi.
english: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎳ ᎡᏂᎾᏯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᏁᎲ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏘᏲᎯᎯ, ᏔᏓᎳ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏉᎳ.
phonetic: Hisgino winusvla Eninaya nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ulutsvgi, anehv digeganelodi, ale gilo iyusdi ditiyohihi, Tadala tsudoidv, nasgi uninonelvgi ugvwiyuhi, anuhisdisgv Quola.
english: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏩᏥᏯᏅᎲᏃ ᏔᏓᎳ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏬᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; "ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏦᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ,
phonetic: Watsiyanvhvno Tadala ulenvhvgi uwohistanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; "Nihi itsanisanvhi utsati nvwadohiyadv tsotseha, ale osdv tsinunalisdaneha yvwi ogatseligohi tsagasayasdiyu gesv tsinvdigalisdodiha,
english: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏈᎵᏏ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏣᏓᏂᎸᎪᎢ.
phonetic: nasgi iyusdi, hosdv quilisi, nigohilv ale nigvnadv nigav alihelisdi gesv otsadanilvgoi.
english: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏂᏗᎬᏯᏪᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾ, ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno asi utli igai nidigvyaweistanvna, gvtayoseha tsadanvtiyu gesv tsvdodiyi sgiyadvganediyi ilvsgi ikanetsvhi.
english: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏙᎴᎰᏒᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏂᎳᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᎾᏎᎵᏂ ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Ogadolehosvyeno hia nasgi asgaya utsatanvhi udeyadodi gesvi, ale ganiladisgi tsudalenvdv nigadv Anitsusi anehv nigvnadv elohi, ale nugvwiyusv didatinidohi unaligosv Naselini tsunadoidv.
english: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏦᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏥᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo udvnv digalawiisdiyi usotlvisdodiyi uyelvnvgi.  Nasgi otsiniyvhvgi ale ogadulisgvgi tsogikahnawadvsdi ogvdodiyi otsiyilidasdiyi.
english: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎵᏏᏯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩᏯ ᏙᎦᏑᎦᎸᏔᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Aseno Lisiya nugvwiyusv didatinidohi ulutsv utsati gvsgaisdagiya dogasugalvtanvgi,
english: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ ᏨᏒ ᎨᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏦᏧᎢᏍᏗᎭ."
phonetic: Ale dunetselvgi gvwuhisdisgi getsalutsediyi; nasgino higoliyesgvi tsvsv getsagadovhisdi yinigalisda hia nigadv tsotsuisdiha."
english: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏱᏛᎩ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Anitsusino nasquo unisdayidvgi, udohiyuhi nasgi nusdi, unadvnvgi.
english: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎫᏫᏎᎸ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; "ᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎦᏓᏅᏓᏓ, ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quola, ugvwiyuhi ulisguwiselv uneisdiyi ulisgolvdanelv, hia nuwesvgi; "Tsigatahiyu tsigi ilvsgi tsudetiyvdv dugodanehi igvwalistanvhi gesv hia sunadalegi yvwi, nasgi nvdagalisdoda utli ugalisdiyu gadanvdada, aquvsv galisdelisgv gvgineisdi tsinigalisda.
english: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏔᎳᏚᏉ ᏄᏒᎭ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎬᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Getsagadovhisdiyeno nigalisdiha nasgi asiquo taladuquo nusvha Tsilusilimi gvquadadolistanvsvhi.
english: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᎩᏩᏛᎮ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏍᏓᏗᏒᎯᎮ ᎣᏍᏗᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏥᏖᎸᎲᏍᎨ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale vtla yigvgiwadvhe gilo yosdadisvhihe osdiwonisgvi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, ale vtla yiditsitelvhvsge dunadanvdv yvwi digalawiisdiyi degesadisvi ale ilvhitlv gaduhvi.
english: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏥᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yeli gvwanohiyudodi yigi hia nasgi hnaquo tsigvquehisdiha.
english: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎬᏃᎲᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏥᏓᏃᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᏪᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Hiasgininonv gvnohvsi, nasgi unadatselidv unaligohi tsidanoseha, nasgi gatsisdawadisv tsiyadadolisdanehv Unelanvhi digigayvlige unatseliga, goiyuhvsgvi nigadv gowelv dikahnawadvsdiyi ale anadolehosgi dunowelvi;
english: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏥᏴᎠ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᎭ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo udugi tsiyva Unelanvhi, tsunalehisodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi unadanvti ale uninegutsidv, nasgi nasquo unvsv tsunohiyuha.
english: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ ᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎰ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎠᏆᏎᎮᎲᎢ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nigadvnehoi gatlinigvneho aquadanvdogi aquasehehvi nigohilv nitsisganvtsehvna Unelanvhi ale nigatsisganvtsehvna yvwi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏥᏲᎮᎸᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏲᎸᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino winudetiyvhv diquatseliga yvwi detsiyohelvgi getsinelvhi, ale agiyolvgi atsilvgelasdi.
english: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲᎢ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᎦᎵᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏥᏯᎥᎩ ᎤᏛᏅᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgino nigadvnehvi gilo iyunasdi Anitsusi Esiyi anehi gvgiwadvhvgi aquadanvgalisadv gesvgi tsiyavgi udvnvdigalawiisdiyi, vtla yigeladidohe unitsati anedohvi, ale unadasuyedv gesvi;
english: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂ ᏦᎸᎢ ᏱᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎴᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini ani tsolvi yianedohei, ale yuninohelei, iyuno gohusdi yigvquehisdiha.
english: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎸ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏛ ᏱᎩ ᏕᎦᎳᏫᎥ ᏥᏙᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Ale hiaquo nasquo unvsv yuninohelv, iyuno uyo dagilvwisdanelv uniwadvdv yigi degalawiv tsidogvi,
english: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒ ᎠᏇᎷᏅ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏥᏙᎬᎢ; ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏍᎩᏱᎵᏙᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ."
phonetic: Hia sgininonv sudalegi uwasv aginetsvi, hia nagiwesv aquelunv anigatahv tsidogvi; Dilehisodi gesv ayohusv nvdigalisdodi sgiyilidoha gohi iga tsigi."
english: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏈᎵᏏᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᏚᏬᎯᏕᎸᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎵᏏᏯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᏓᎦᏛᎦᏃᏂ ᏥᏥᏱᎵᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Quilisino nasgi udvganv, ale utli igai ugadovsv nasgi ganvnvi, duwohidelvgi hia nuwesvgi; Lisiya nugvwiyusv didatinidohi galutsvha dagadvganoni tsitsiyilidoha.
english: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏛ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏧᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏪᏓ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏅᏍᏙᏒᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏛᎯᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unetselvgino asgohitsudv ditinidohi tsukahnawadidasdiyi Quola, ale unelagi weda uwelisediyi, ale hia nuweselvgi; tlesdi tsanvsdosvgi gilo iyusdi unalii usdelvhidasdiyi ale uwadvhihisdiyi.
english: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ, ᎤᏘᏃᎸᎩ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏚᏏᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏧᏏ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ; ᎤᏛᎦᏁᎸᎩᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino winusvlv Quilisi ulutsvgi, utinolvgi udalii Dusili, nasgi Atsusi gesvgi, udanvsvgi watsiyanvdiyi Quola; udvganelvgino Galonedv gohiyudi gesv ugvwali.
english: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᎾᏮᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎭᏓᏅᎾ ᎪᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᏫᎬᏯᏅᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Asiquono kanohesgv duyugodv gesvi, ale alisinahisdodi gesvi, ale Unelanvhi tsuwugododiyi uliyilohisdi gesvi, Quilisi uwenawvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Hadanvna gohi, iyuno yeli igvquadvnedi nigalistanvha wigvyanvhvha.
english: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎬᎩ ᏩᏯᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo udugi uwasvgi Quola adelv tsunediyi, nasgino tsuyohisdiyi; nasgi iyusdi utli yanogiyu adanvsgvgi wayanisgvgi, ale alinohedisgvgi.
english: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏃ ᏫᏄᏕᎢᏴᎲ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᏅᎢ ᏉᏏᏯ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏪᏔᏅᎩ; ᏈᎵᏏᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏪᎧᎯᏴᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎦᎸᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Talino winudeiyvhv Quilisi uwenvi Quosiya Quesda uwetanvgi; Quilisino udulisgvi Anitsusi osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi, uwekahiyvgi Quola agalvidv.
english: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎦᏚᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏛ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᏦᎢ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quesda nahna sgadugi atsigatidisdv ulutsv, tsoi winusvlv, Sisaliyi unigisvgi Tsilusilimi wulosvgi.
english: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎦ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Hnaquono nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi ale unigvwiyuhi Anitsusi tsunatsega gvwanohehelvgi anuhisdisgv Quola ale gvwasdiyetanvgi,
english: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎮᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏭᏂᎭᎷᎨᏰᏃ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwatayoselvgi tsudanvtehediyi nasgi anuhisdisgvi, nasgi udanvsdiyi Tsilusilimi agatinohisdiyi; wunihalugeyeno nvnohi unihisdiyi uniyelvsei.
english: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno Quesda unetsvgi Quola agatidisdiyi Sisaliyi, ale uwasv nigohilvnaquo nahna wulohisdiyi.
english: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᏒᎭ ᏪᏥᏱᎵᏙᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nuwesvgi; nasgi iyusdi nihi yitsadasuya yeli igetsadvnedi gesesdi idesvha wetsiyilidolvha nasgi na asgaya, iyuno usganvtsvhi gesesdi.
english: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᏄᏒᎸ ᏚᏪᎳᏗᏙᎸ, ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᏉᎳ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Asgohino uditlvsdodi nusvlv duweladidolv, Sisaliyi wulosvgi; ugitsvdvno digugododiyi gasgilv uwolvi unetsvgi Quola watsiyanvdiyi.
english: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎷᏨᏃ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ulutsvno, Anitsusi Tsilusilimi nvdayulosvhi gvwaduwidv unalenvnvgi, ale utsadvgi ale gagedv anuhisdisgvgi Quola, nasgi udohiyusv gvnigesv igvwanvnedi nigesvna gesvgi.
english: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏏᏌ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Uwasvno alisdelisgv unetsvgi hia nuwesvgi; Vtla usdiunv agisganvtsvhi yigi Anitsusi tsunikahnawadvsdi unihvi, vtla ale udvnvdigalawiisdiyi tsisganvtselvhi yigi, vtla ale Sisa gohusdi tsisganvtselvhi yigi.
english: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Aseno Quesda udulisgvi Anitsusi osdv tsudanvdadisdodiyi nvdayulisdotanv, unetselvgi Quola hia nuweselvgi; Tsadulisgo Tsilusilimi tsenvsdiyi ale nahna hia nasgi digvyugodanediyi?
english: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏏᏌ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏙᎦ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏆᎵᏰᎢᎵᏕᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Sisa uwesgilv digugododiyi tsidoga, nahna aqualiyeilidediyi.  Anitsusi vtla gohusdi gatsisganvtselvhi yigi, nasgi osiyu nihi tsigataha.
english: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎬᏆᏢᏫᏏ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏙᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏴ.  ᏏᏐᎢ ᏫᏥᎥᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno tsisgana yigi, ale gvgiyohuhisdi igai agisganvtsvhi yigi, vtla yidogvquatlvwisi agiyohuhisdiyi; iyusgini nudohiyusvna yigi hia nasgi tsigvquehisdiha, vtla gilo yeli digvwaniyohisedi yigi ayv.  Sisoi witsivsda.
english: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏇᏍᏓ ᏚᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏏᏐᎢᏧ ᏫᎲᏍᏓ?  ᏏᏐᎢ ᏖᏏ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Quesda dulinohetanv dinilawigi, hia nuwesvgi; Sisoitsu wihvsda?  Sisoi tesi.
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᏏᏌᎵᏱ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎤᏂᏲᎵᎵᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino winusvlv Sisaliyi unilutsvgi ugvwiyuhi Egiliqui ale Quanisi, uniyolililvgi Quesda.
english: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᏙᎸ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏉᎳ ᎤᎵᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏴᎩ ᎠᏥᎧᎭ ᏈᎵᏏ ᎤᏪᎧᎯᏴᎯ.
phonetic: Ilvsgino nuwohitsv nahna unedolv, Quesda unohehelvgi ugvwiyuhi nusdv Quola uliyilidehvi, hia nuwesvgi; Gilo iyusdi asgaya ayvgi atsikaha Quilisi uwekahiyvhi.
english: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏫᎨᏙᎲᎩ, ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎲᎩ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᏚᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvginohehelvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi ale dinilawigi Anitsusi tsunatseliga, Tsilusilimi tsiwigedohvgi, anitayohihvgi usganvtsv tsudugododiyi.
english: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏂᎶᎻ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏅᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎧᏛ ᏧᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nigatsiweselvgi; Anilomi vtla nasgi yinunvnv, nasgi tsuniyohisdiyi gilo uyohuhisdiyi, gvni aguisdisgi gvwuhisdisgi dunakadv tsugohvhi tsigeso ale agalisgolvdanelvhi tsigeso uwasv alisdelisgv uneisdiyi unohediyi usganvtsv aguisdisgv ugvwali.
english: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᏥᎸ, ᏄᎵᏍᏛᏉ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎠᎩᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᏗᏱ.
