phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ani unilutsilv, nulisdvquo ugitsvdv digugododiyi gasgilv aginvgi, ale aginetsvgi nasgi asgaya watsiyanvdiyi.
english: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏭᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᎴᏅ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏂᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvwuhisdisgi dunalenv, vtla gohusdi yuninanugowise nasgi yaninanugowa aquelisv nasgi anuhisdisgvi.
english: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏗᏍᎨ ᎨᎵ ᏉᎳ.
phonetic: Anuhisdisgvsgini gohusdiquo usdi nasgi kanohedi gesv unvsvquo unatselidv Unelanvhi tsunikahnawadvsdi gesvi, ale gilo iyusdi Tsisa, uyohusvhi, nasgi eha adisge geli Quola.
english: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏆᏢᏫᏎᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ [ᏉᎳ]; ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏤᏧᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi kanohedv gesv daquatlvwisehvi nvdayulisdotanvgi, hia nvtsiweselvgi [Quola]; tsadulisgo Tsilusilimi tsenvsdiyi nahnano hia nasgi nigadv tsetsugodanediyi.
english: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏁᏨᎩ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏏᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Quola unetsv atsigatidisdiyi, ale Ogasda tsuwugodanediyi, aginetsvgi atsigatidisdiyi, gvni gvquadanvsdi yinulistanv, Sisoi.
english: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏅ ᏘᏯᏛᎦᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quesda; ayv nasquo aquvsv aquaduliha tsiyadvganediyi nasgi asgaya.  Hiano nuwesvgi; ugitsvnv tiyadvganeli.
english: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏣᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏓᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏴᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎾᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᏨ, ᏉᎳ ᏩᏥᏯᏅᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Howano ugitsvdv utsati unatsanvhi unilutsv Egiliqui ale Quanisi, nasgino didayilidasdiyi uniyvlv, ale nunigvwiyusv dinadatinidohi, ale getsilvquodi nahna gaduhv anehi, Quesda unetsv, Quola watsiyanvhvgi.
english: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏇᏍᏓᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏗᎾ; ᎡᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᎬᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏱᎬᏅ.
phonetic: Quesdano hia nuwesvgi; tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, ale nasquo nigadv itsisgaya ani tsidina; etsigowadiha hia asgaya, nasgi; anuhisdisgv nigadv unitsati Anitsusi tsigvgilutselvgi Tsilusilimi, ale nasquo ani, hia tsinaniwesgvgi; vtla osiyu yigagi asiquo yigvnv.
english: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᏒᏃ ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᎦᏍᏙᎢ ᏭᎲᏍᏔᏅ, ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aquadolehosvno nusganvtsvna gesv yeli gvwayohuhisdi gesvi, ale uwasv Ogasdoi wuhvstanv, daquegotanv agatinvsdiyi.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏯᎩᎭ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎯᏏ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᏗᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏉᏪᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsinohesgvi, vtla gohusdi usquanigodi yagiha gatsiyowelanedi ugvwiyuhi; nasgi iyusdi itsvyatinohisi, ale nihi ho ugvwiyuha gvwatinohisi, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, nasgino edigoliyevhi gesesdi, gohusdi yeli gvquowelodi gesesdi.
english: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᎨᎵᎠ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎦᏓᏅᏍᎦ ᎠᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᎾᎩᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎫᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yidogvwayugodi gelia, iyuno yigadanvsga agatinvsdiyi ayvgi, nagineistanvnano yigi nusdv aguisdisgvi.
english: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ; ᏨᏒ ᎭᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quola; Tsvsv halisdelisgv getsaneisdi nigalisda.  Hnaquono Quola udoyanvhidv uwasv alisdelisgv uwonisvgi, hia nuwesvgi;
english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏉ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎲ ᎦᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᏨᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ.
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi Egiliquo, galieliga gohi iga tsigi higatahv galisdelisgv tsvdatsineistani nigav gvquehisdisgvi Anitsusi.
english: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏥᏚᏁᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᏗᏣᏯᏪᎬᎾ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ho ugvwiyuha nvdigalisdodiha higatahiyu tsigi nigadv dikahnawadvsdi ale kanohedi gesv Anitsusi tsiduneha.  Nasgino iyusdi gvtayoseha niditsayawegvna squadvganediyi.
english: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᏥᏫᏄᏣ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏥᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎩ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭ,
phonetic: Nusdv aqualenidolv tsiwinutsa nvtsulistanv nvdagvwadalenvdv, nasgi igvyiyi gatsiyeladidolvgi diquatseli yvwi Tsilusilimi, nigadv Anitsusi anigataha,
english: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎸ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏏ ᎤᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᏕᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᏭᏂᎫᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏦᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvgigatahvgi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv, iyuno yuninohelv, anigatahiyuyeno Aqualisi ulenidasdi aqualenidolvi, detsisdawadisv unadatselidv unaligohi wunigudv dinikahnawadegi ogatseli Unelanvhi tsotsikahnawadvsdi gesvi.
english: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᏥᏙᎦ ᎢᎬᎩᏱᎵᏙᎭ, ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᎭ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏚᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᏦᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Gohino itsidoga igvgiyilidoha, agisdvdiha udugi gvdi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi tsiduduisdanele tsogigayvligei;
english: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᎭ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏃᏥᎳᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᏇᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi getsiduisdanelv unaliyilohisdiyi udugi unvha taladu notsilasdalvi, ulinigidiyu tsidanikahnawadi Unelanvhi digvwagitsvdi.  Nasgi udugi gvdi gesv nvdigalisdodiha, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, Anitsusi gvquehisdiha.
english: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?
phonetic: Gadono gagohiyudi nigesvna itsiyelvso Unelanvhi tsuledodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi?
english: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏎᎵᏘ ᏤᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv udohiyuhi hia nigelisgvgi; duyugodv yinigadvneha utsati gohusdi yidagilvwisdane gatludisgv deudov Tsisa Naseliti tsehvgi.
english: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏅᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ; ᏕᎨᏥᎷᎦᏃ ᏥᏁᎬᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Howano nasgi naquadvnelvgi Tsilusilimi; ale unitsadvgi unadanvti detsisdunvgi didasdudiyi, gvginetselvhi gesvgi nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi; degetsilugano tsinegvgi gatsiyatludisgvi.
english: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲᎩ; ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎦᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲ ᎾᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎲ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᏫᎦᏥᎨᎰᎢᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ale yanogiyu uyo nigatsiyvnehv digalawiisdiyi degesadisvi, ale unisotlvisdodiyi nigatsiyvnehvgi; utsatanvhino gatsiniquatihv nadagalisdodisgvgi uyo nigatsiyvnehv nvwadale dodigaduhv wigatsigehoihvgi.
english: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎹᏍᎦᏃ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Demasgano witsigadvi, nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi gvginetselvi,
english: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᏒᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏙ, ᏓᏆᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏤᎯ.
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi, gaisv iga ayeli agigohvgi igagadvi, galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nasgi usgosvi utli gesvgi esgaquo nvdo, daquaduwistanvgi ayv ale nasquo otsehi.
english: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏙᎩᏅᏨ, ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ ᏐᎳ, ᏐᎳ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎭ?  ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᎲᏖᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏯ.
phonetic: Nigadvno eladi doginvtsv, kanegv aquadvganvgi aginetsehvgi, Anitsusi uniwonihisdi gvdisgvgi; hia nigawesgvgi Sola, Sola, gadono uyo nisquvneha?  Udeyadodiyu ditsahvtesdiyi digosdaya.
english: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎠᏏ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᏴᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiwesvgi; Gago nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi?  Hiano nuwesvgi; Asi Tsisa nasgi uyo tsiniyvneha.
english: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏖᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏯᏛᏂᏏ, ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᏩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎬᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno talehvga, ale halehvga, hiayeno nvdigalisdoteha gvnigesv tsinigvyadvnisi, halitsidohvsgi igvyvnediyi ale hinohesgi hia nasgi tsigowadv, ale asi gvnanugowisedi tsigi.
english: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏁᎲ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏅᎵ,
phonetic: Gvwadalesgesdi getsatludisgv hia yvwi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi dinehv hnaquo gvnvli,
english: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏘᏍᏚᎢᎡᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏘᎪᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏘᎪᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏙᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏘᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏉᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tisduiediyi dinigadoli, ale ulisigv nunadvnv tigolvsdiyi igagadv iditlv witigatahvsdiyi, ale Sedani utseligohi nunadvnv tigolvsdiyi dotigatahvsdiyi Unelanvhi iditlv witigatahvsdodiyi; nasgi digagetsinediyi unisganvtsvi, ale gvwaniwadvdi iyulisdodiyi unatseliga iyulisdodi gesv getsinvgalvdv nvdigalisdodisgv vquohiyudi gesvi.
english: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusidi, tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, vtla naquohiyunvna yigese galvladi nvdayulosvhi agigohvi.
english: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏃᏁᎸᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gatsinonelvgiyeno igvyi Demasga anehi, ale tsilusilimi anehi, ale nigvnadv Tsudiyi ale nasquo tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale Unelanvhi iditlv wunagatahvsdodiyi, ale tsunilvwisdanediyi adolehohisdodi gesv duninetliyvsv dunadanvdvi.
english: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎬᎩᏂᏴᎲᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi Anitsusi gvginiyvhvgi udvnv digalawiisdiyi, gvgihisdiyi uniyelvsvgi.
english: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎲᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏏ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎭ ᏂᎨᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎾ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Unelanvhino agisdelvhvi nvdigalisdodiha asi galenidoha gohi iga tsigi, gvnigesv nigatsiyvneha nigetsilvquodvna ale nasquo getsilvquodi, gohusdi nitsinohesgvna na uwasv anadolehosgi ale Mosi unanugoisdi unadvnvhi tsigi;
english: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏐᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi Galonedv ugiliyoisdiyi, ale nasgi igvyi uyohusv tsulehisodiyi, ale igagati tsunanugowisediyi hia yvwi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
english: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏇᏍᏓ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏣᎸᏃᏘᎭ ᏉᎳ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏘᏏᎾᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎸᏃᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Asiquono nasgi nigawesgvgi, uwasv alisdelisgvi, Quesda hia asdaya nuwesvgi; tsalvnotiha Quola, utsati goweli tisinasiyu gesv nasgi tsalvnododiha.
english: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏯᎩᎸᏃᏘᎭ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᏇᏍᏓ, ᏥᏁᎦᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏃᎸᏃᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nuwesvgi; vtla yagilvnotiha, hosdv Quesda, tsinegaquosgini duyugodv gesvi ale nolvnotisgvna kaneisdi gesvi.
english: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏛᏓᏍᏛ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏥᏥᏁᎦ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhiyeno nasgi hia agataha, nasgi nasquo udvdasdv nitsisgaihvna tsitsinega; tsigatahayeno hia nasgi gohusdi agvsgalanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, tleyeno unvsiyv hia digalvwisdanelvhi yigi.
english: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ, ᏕᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ?  ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏕᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsagvwiyuhi Egiliqui, dehohiyuhvsgasgo anadolehosgi?  Tsigataha dehohiyuhvsgvi.
english: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎩᎵᏈ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ; ᎠᎴᏉ ᏂᏍᎩᏎᎪᎩᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Egiliqui hia nuweselvgi Quola; alequo nisgisegogia Galonedv tsiyoiyuhvsgi iyaqualisdodiyi.
english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᏚᎸᎡᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯᏉ ᏨᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᎭ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴᏉ ᎾᏆᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏆᎸᎥ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Quolano hia nuwesvgi; Unelanvhi tsiyadulveha, vtla nihiquo tsvsv, nasquosgini nigadv tsigvquadvganeha gohi iga tsigi, nasgi, vtla alequo naquasdvi, nasgiyasgini naquasdv itsalisdodiyi, hia nasgi tsvqualvv uwasv.
english: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, ugvwiyuhi dulenvgi, ale atsigatidisdi ugvwiyuhi, ale Quanisi, ale nasgi unanvnvhi,
english: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏴᏛᏃ ᏭᏂᎶᏒ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyvdvno wunilosv, unvsv gesv unalinohelvgi, hia nuniwesvgi; Hia asgaya vtla gohusdi yidulvwisdaneha gvwayohuhisdi ale gayegalvsdi gesvi.
english: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎩᎵᏈᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏇᏍᏓ; ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎦᏰᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏏᏐᎢ ᏫᏄᎲᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Egiliquino hia nuweselvgi Quesda; hia asgaya digayetsiyohisdiquo yigesei, iyuno Sisoi winuhvstanvna yigesei.
english: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅ ᎢᏓᎵ ᏭᎩᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏳ, ᏚᏂᏲᏒᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᏧᎵᏯᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎨᎳ ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎦᏍᏓ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dudugotanv Idali wuginvsdodiyi tsiyu, duniyosvgi Quola ale gilo iyunasdi nvwanadale aniyvgi, nasgi duniyohiselv gilo iyusdi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi, Tsuliyasi tsudoidv, gela sunadatlugi gesv Ogasda tsutseliga.
english: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏣᏅᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎡᏟᎻᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎣᎩᎧᏙᏴᎩ, ᎡᏏᏱ ᎤᎶᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏕᏌᎶᏂᎦ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎣᏤᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ogatsanvno tsiyuhi Etlimidi ehi ogikadoyvgi, Esiyi uloditlv oginvsdodiyi ogiyelvsvgi, gilo iyusdi, Elisdaga tsudoidv, Masidoni Desaloniga gaduhv ehi, otsehvgi.
english: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏌᏙᏂ ᎣᎩᏃᏠᏨᎩ.  ᏧᎵᏯᏏᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎩ ᏉᎳ, ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩᏰᏃ ᏧᎵᎢ ᏧᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ugitsvdvno Sadoni oginotlotsvgi.  Tsuliyasino osdv nudvnelvgi Quola, ulisgolvdanelvgiyeno tsulii tsuwadvhvsdiyi, ale nasgi gvwasquanigododiyi.
english: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎣᎩᎧᏙᏴ ᏌᏈ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᏳᎦᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiogikadoyv Saqui hawiniditlv oginvstanvgi, ganolvvsgvyeno igvyiditlv dayugadvgi.
english: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᎶᏐᏅᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ, ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎻᏈᎵᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎵᏏᏱ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ, ᎹᎵ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ogilosonvno amequohi, Silisiyi ale Quamiquiliyi tsuyugodi, Lisiyi wogilutsvgi, Mali deudov gaduhvi.
english: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏴᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᏥᏳ ᎢᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᏂᏒᎩ, ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏙᎩᏯᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano asgohitsuqui ditinidohi uyvwadvhvgi tsiyu Idali aninisvgi, Eligiyi ehi, nahnano dogiyanvgi.
english: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᎦᏂᎳ ᎣᎩᏁᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏃᎩᎶᏐᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏓ, ᏟᏗ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏌᎳᎼᏂ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ, ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎣᎩᏲᏍᏙ ᏓᏁᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Uwohitsvno ganila oginenv, ale asiquo nogilosonvna gesv Nada, Tlidi hawiniditlv woginvstanvgi, Salamoni tsuyugodi, ganolvvsgvyeno ogiyosdo danehvgi.
english: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎩᎶᏐᏅ, ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ, ᎾᎥ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎴᏏᏱ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Usegatsvhino nahna ogilosonv, wogilutsvgi osdv Ditaladisdiyi dudovi, nav gaduhv Lesiyi tsudoidv.
english: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏥᏳ ᎦᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎢ, ᏉᎳ ᏚᏪᏯᏔᏅᎩ,
phonetic: Uwohitsvno, ale unayehisdiyu nulistanv tsiyu ganidasdiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv amatli gvdi gesv ulosonvi, Quola duweyatanvgi,
english: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎦ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏥᏗᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏛ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏎᎵᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏁᏌᎸᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Hia niduweselvgi; Itsisgaya, gadoleosga hia nasgi tsiyu tsidini gohusdi digalisdanelisvi, ale utsadv digiyohuselisvi, vtla alinesalvquo ale tsiyu uwasv, nasquosgini dedvnvi.
english: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏚᏬᎯᏳᏒᎩ ᎧᏁᏥᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏁᎬᎢ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏉᎳ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno asgohitsuqui ditinidohi utli niduwohiyusvgi kanetsidohi ale utseliga tsiyu aninegvi, esgaquo Quola nigawesgvi.
english: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏃᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᎢ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏴᏫᏛᏗᏱ, ᏰᎵ ᏈᏂᏏ ᏫᎦᏲᎩᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎦᏲᎦᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏟᏗ ᏗᏔᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏕᎵᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Ditaladisdiyino nosvna gesv nahna ugoladiyvdiyi, utli iyanii uninetsvgi nasquo nahna uniyvwidvdiyi, yeli Quinisi wigayoginohisdi ale wigayogagoladiyvdi yigi anelisgvgi, nasgi nahna Tlidi ditaladisdiyi, ale nasgi wudeligv iditlv wugati.
english: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎵᏒ, ᎤᏂᎧᏙᏴᎩ, ᏟᏗ ᎾᎥᎢ ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsuganawv iditlv tsunolvtanv, nasgi igadulisgv nigalisda unelisv, unikadoyvgi, Tlidi navi uninvstanvgi.
english: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏄᏬᎯᏨᎾᏉ ᎣᏂ, ᎤᏱᎶᎸᎩ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏳᎶᏟᏛ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno nuwohitsvnaquo oni, uyilolvgi unole Yulotlidv tsudoidv.
english: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏴᎲ ᏥᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᎸᏅ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᎦᏛ ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎧᏄᎯᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᎨᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ganolvvsgv uniyvhv tsiyu, ale nasgi unulvnv unole tsugadv wulohisdiyi unelagi kanuhisesdi ogelisvgi.
english: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢᏃ ᎣᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲ, ᏠᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ, ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏉ ᏗᎦᏲᎩᏂᏴᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ.
phonetic: Hawiniditlvno oginvstanv gohusdi usdi amayeli uwekahv, Tlodi tsudoidv, usegatsvhiquo digayoginiyvdi nulistanvgi usdi tsiyu.
english: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏂᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᏗᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏚᏅᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᎾᎸᎸᎩ ᏥᏳ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᎾᎸ ᎤᏂᏃᏠᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎸᎩ ᏓᏰᏙᎳᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᏄᎯᏒᏉᏃ.
phonetic: Nasgino unisaladanv, dilisdelvdodi dunvtanvgi, unalvlvgi tsiyu; anisgaihvno usdanalv uninotlohisdiyi nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi eladi nidunvnelvgi dayedoladvi, uninuhisvquono.
english: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏃᎴᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎩᏝᏗᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᎩᏨᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏁᏌᎴᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Unoleno utsati ogitladistanidolv, ugitsvdv unalinesalesvgi.
english: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏦᎪᏰᏂ ᏙᎬᏔᏅᎩ, ᎣᎦᏘᏅᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᎵᏁᏌᎸ ᏥᏳ.
phonetic: Tsoineno iga ogvsv tsogoyeni dogvtanvgi, ogatinvsvgi utseligaya ulinesalv tsiyu.
english: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᎯᏨᏃ ᎾᏂᎾᏄᎪᎬᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏲᎵᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎩᏃᎸᏅ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎤᎵᏛᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Uwohitsvno naninanugogvna nulistanv nvdo ale noquisi, ale gayoliquo nigesvna oginolvnv, hnaquo gayogadvnidisdi gesv udugi ogvsv ulidvtanvgi.
english: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᏲᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏉᎳ ᏚᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎾᏣᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏱᏍᎩᏲᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᏥᎧᏙᏴᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏟᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏂᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᎪᎶᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gohidiyu gayogalisdayvnvhi nulistanv Quola dulenvgi ayeli unatsavi, ale hia nuwesvgi; Itsisgaya, yisgiyoiyunei, ale nvditsikadoyvnaquo yigese Tlidi, vtla nasgi hia usonv yinigetsalisdanele ale yigetsigolohiselei.
english: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏉᏃ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶᎬᏅ ᏴᎬᏩᏲᎱᏏ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎩᏲᎱᏎᎵ.
phonetic: naquono itsvtayoseha ugalisdi itsadanvdadisdiyi; hiayeno tsinitsadvnv vtla gilogvnv yvgvwayohusi, tsiyu uwasv dagiyohuseli.
english: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᎶᏗᏢ ᎠᏆᎴᏁᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ,
phonetic: Gohiyeno svnoyi tsigesvgi uloditlv aqualenelv dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Unelanvhi ayv aginatlai tsigi ale nasgi tsidetsigahnawadega,
english: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᏉᎳ, ᏏᏌ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᏎ ᏔᎴᏂ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏣᎧᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏥᏣᏣᎠ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesvgi; Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, Quola, Sisa uwolv igvyiditlv ase taleni; gvniyuquono Unelanvhi gatsakanelv nigadv tsiyuhi tsitsatsaa.
english: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ; ᏥᏲᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsisgaya, ugalisdi itsadanvdada; tsiyoiyuhvsgayeno Unelanvhi, nagiweselv nasgiya iyulisdodiyi.
english: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲ ᏓᎩᏝᏗᏤᎵ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv gohusdi usdi amayeli uwekahv dagitladitseli.
english: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᎤᎵᏏᏅ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎡᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᎣᎩᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏂᏙᎯ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᎣᏥᏂ ᎤᏁᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nigadusineno ulisinv, amequohi Etliya tsudoidv oginolvtanidohvi, svnoyi ayeli tsiyu aninidohi ilvhitlv gadohi navnige otsini unelisvgi.
english: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏛᎬᏃ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᏔᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎪᎷᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏃ ᎤᏗᏢᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎤᏁᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏟᎶᎥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᎪᎷᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasdvgvno unatlilov unadolehosvgi talasgohi igolunvdi gesvi; usdigidvno uditlvsdodi iunenv taline unatlilovgi, unadolehosvgi hisgigaduquo igolunvdi gesvi.
english: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎸ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎤᏂᏝᏗᏤᏗᏱ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏫᏚᎾᏗᏅᏒᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᎲᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unisgalv nvyohi unitladitsediyi, oniditlv widunadinvsvgi nvgi talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi, ale unadulvhvgi iga iyulisdodiyi.
english: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏂᏔᎳᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏴᏗᏢ ᏥᏫᏙᏧᎾᏕᏏᏐ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsiyuno aninidohi unalisdiyi uniyelvnv, ale hnaquo usdi tsiyu anitaladisgvi, anatlonasdisgv talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi igvyvditlv tsiwidotsunadesiso utloyi nanadvnehvi.
english: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏳᎯ ᏄᎾᏣᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏣᏛᏂᏓ.
phonetic: Quola hia niduweselvgi asgohitsuqui ditinidohi ale aniyawisgi; Iyuno hia nasgi tsiyuhi nunatsavna yigi vtla yvgetsadvnida.
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏒᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᏱᏛ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎦᏙᏌᏗᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎰᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono aniyawisgi dunigalisvgi asdeyidv usdi tsiyu gadosadisdvi, ale nasgi uwohosvgi.
english: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎩ, ᏉᎳ ᏚᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᏚᏏᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏥᏥᎦᏘᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏍᎬᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎩᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Igano nvdagalistanisvgi, Quola dutayoselvgi nigadv unalisdayvdiyi, hia nuwesvgi; Gohi hnaquo nigadusine iga tsitsigatiyv ale nitsalisdayvsgvna gohusdi nitsigisgvna tsigi.
english: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏌᏉᎤᏅ ᎤᏍᏘᏰᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᎦᏙᎠᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha itsalisdayvdiyi, nasgiyeno hia itsalisdelvdodi; hiayeno tsinitsadvnv vtla gilo saquounv ustiyenvhi adagadoasi.
english: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏴᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, gadu ugisvgi ale ulihelitselvgi Unelanvhi nigadv anigatahvi, ugvhaluyvno ulenvhvgi ulisdayvnvgi.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadv ugalisdiyu unadanvdadvgi, ale nasquo unalisdayvnvgi.
english: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏣᎢ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎦᎵᏆᏍᎪᎯ ᏑᏓᎵᎦᎵ ᏃᏥᎥᎩ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nigadvno tsiyuhi ogatsai talitsuqui galiquasgohi sudaligali notsivgi yvwi.
english: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅ, ᎤᎾᏓᏌᎧᎲᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᏳ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono yeli unalisdayvnv, unadasakahvstanvgi tsiyu, utsalesdi amequohi wunadinvsvgi.
english: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎵᏤ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏙᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏭᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎬᏚᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏂᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono iga nulistanv vtla yunolitse nahna gadohi; aseno unigohv amequohi wuwanigalvi, yeli gvdugisdi gesvi, nahna wuninvsdodiyi tsiyu uniyelvnvgi, iyuno yeli yigi.
english: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᎦᎵᏒ ᏕᎦᏙᏌᏗᏍᏛ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏗᎦᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁᏴᎲᎩ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏂᏰᏙᎳᏛᏅᎩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛᏗ; ᏙᏱᏃ ᏫᏚᏄᎪᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dunigalisv degadosadisdv talugisgi tsiyu diganahisdodi, amequohi duniyohiselvgi, ale dunikaneyvhvgi gasadvsdi degalvsdvi, ale ganolvvsgvi uniyedoladvnvgi usdi ayedoladvdi; doyino widunugotanvgi.
english: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏃ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏕᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᎵᏱᎶᎸ, ᏥᏳ ᎤᏂᏝᏗᏤᎸᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎵᏖᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎣᏂᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᏨᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ.
phonetic: Talino amequohi degesv wunaliyilolv, tsiyu unitladitselvgi gadohi; igvyiditlvno asdayiyu nulistanv, vtla yeli gvwalitelvdi yigesei, oniditlvsgini uyotsvgi nvdayulisdotanvgi ulinigidiyu dalisdilanegv amequohi.
english: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏯᏴᎢᏄᎦ ᏯᏚᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎵᏗ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Aniyawisgino tsunihisdiyi unadanvtelvgi aniyvgi; giloyeno yayvinuga yadugi ale yalidi anelisgvgi.
english: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏚᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎾᏴᎢᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏭᎾᏚᎩᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Aseno asgohitsuqui ditinidohi duyosdodanelvgi nusdv anadanvtesgv nvdayulisdotanvgi udulisgv usdelvdiyi Quola, ale dunetselvgi yeli gvwanayvinvsdi gesv, igvyi unalitadinvdiyi ale wunadugisdiyi,
english: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏧᏯᏕᎾ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏳ ᏧᎵᏢᎸᏛ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎩᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Anisoino igadv tsuyadena tsunagilvdodiyi, igadvno tsiyu tsulitlvlvdv.  Ale nasgi nulistanvgi, nigadv unadvnidvgi unadugisvgi.
english: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᏃ ᎩᎳ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎻᎳᏗ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ,
phonetic: Unadvnidvno gila unadolehosvgi nasgi amayeli Miladi dudovi,
english: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎪᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎩ; ᎤᏃᏔᏅᏰᏃ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎦᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏢᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwanadaleno yvwi nahna anehi utsati osiyu gogisquanigotanvgi; unotanvyeno degogadanilvtsvgi nigadv, nvdagalisdodisgvgi agasgvi ale uyvtlvi.
english: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᏫᏚᏭᏕᏒ ᏏᏄᎩᏝᏅᎯ ᎠᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎲᏔᏅ, ᎢᎾᏛ ᎤᏗᎴᎬ ᏓᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏪᏖᎳᏛᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Quolano widuwudesv sinugitlanvhi ada, ale duhvtanv, inadv udilegv dayunanugotsvgi uwoyeni uweteladvtsvgi.
english: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎦᏖᎳᏛ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏝᏏᏛᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎯᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏗᏫᏏ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏞᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏁᏍᏗ ᏳᏪᎵᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino nvwanadale yvwi unigohv inadv gateladv uwoyeni, hia nidunadaweselvgi; vtla yutlasidvha hia asgaya yvwi dihihi gesvi; udohiyuhisgininonv nasgi amequohi adiwisi, aseno utlegi vtla gvnesdi yuweliseha.
english: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸᏱᏃ ᏭᏙᎥᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Atsilvyino wudovtanvgi inadv, ale vtla gohusdi yulistanei.
english: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᎪᏘᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏓᎦᏅᏥ ᏛᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏨ ᎤᎾᎦᏙᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏒᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno unagadostanvgi, dagotisi ale uyohusvhi daganvtsi dvyeloistani, anelisgvgi; aseno uwohitsv unagadostanv, ale unadolehosv gohusdi nulisdanelvna gesvi, uninetliyvsvgi nusdv anadanvtesgvi, ale galvladi ehi, unadvnvgi.
english: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎾᎥ ᏚᎶᎨᏒᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎤᏪᎧᎲᎢ, ᏆᏟᏯ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎤᏙᎵᏍᏙᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnano nav dulogesvgi nugvwiyusv asgaya nahna amayeli uwekahvi, Quatliya tsudoidv; nasgi dogadanilvtsvgi, ale tsoi tsusvhidv udolisdosiyu ogisquanigotanvgi ganelvi.
english: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏟᏯ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎦᏅᎬᎩ ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏩᎫᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏉᎳ ᎤᏴᎸᎩ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏏᏔᏛ ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hiano nulistanvgi, nasgi Quatliya udoda ganvgvgi udilehvsgvgi ale gigv duwagusgvgi, nasgi Quola uyvlvgi ganvgvi, udadolistanvno ale dusitadv unvwanvgi.
english: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanv, nvwanadale nasquo tsunitlvgi nahna amayeli anehi unilutsvgi, ale degetsinvwanvgi;
english: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎪᎩᏁᎸᏅᎩ; ᎢᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᏃ ᎪᎦᎵᏁᏌᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᎳᏅᏛ ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo gogilvquodisgvi utsadvgi goginelvnvgi; ioganigisvno gogalinesalanelvgi tsudalelanvdv ogalisdelvdodi.
english: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏒᎩ, ᎣᎦᏣᏅᎩ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎡᎵᎩᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏏᎪᎳᏗᏱᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏛᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎧᏍᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏉᎳᏥ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoino iyanvdo ulosonv oganigisvgi, ogatsanvgi tsiyuhi Eligiyi ehi, nahna amayeli sigoladiyisgi unitaladvhi, nasgi golisdodi Kasda ale Quolatsi gowelvgi.
english: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᎴᎫᏏᏃ ᎣᎦᏚᎩᏒ, ᎾᎿᎭᏦᎢ ᏃᎩᏒᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Salegusino ogadugisv, nahna tsoi nogisvlvgi.
english: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᏫᎣᎨᏅ ᎠᎪᎸᏛ ᏬᎩᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎵᏥᏯ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.  ᏑᏙᏓᏆᏛᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏓᏳᏃᎸᏔᏅᎩ; ᎤᎩᏨᏛᏃ ᏇᏗᎣᎵ ᏬᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano wiogenv agolvdv woginvstanvgi, Litsiya wogilutsvgi.  Sudodaquadvno ulosonv tsuganawv iditlv dayunolvtanvgi; ugitsvdvno Quedioli wogilutsvgi.
english: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏙᏥᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎣᎦᏅᏗᏱ.  ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎶᎻ ᏫᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahna dotsiwadvhvgi otsadanvtli, ale gogitayoselvgi galvquogi tsusvhidv daninelv oganvdiyi.  Hnaquono Lomi widuyugodv wogilosvgi.
english: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏗᎪᎦᏛᎦᏅ, ᎡᏈᏲᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ-ᎢᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏕᎪᎦᏠᏏᎸᎩ; ᏉᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᎲ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Nahnano anadanvtli digogadvganv, Equiyoi iyvdv ale TsoiIdilisdayvdiyi degogatlosilvgi; Quola nasgi dugohv ulihelitselvgi Unelanvhi, ale ugalisdi udanvdadvgi.
english: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎶᎻᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ; ᏉᎳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Lomino wogilutsv, asgohitsuqui ditinidohi aniyvgi duyohiselvgi ugvwiyuhianigatiya ditinidohi; Quolasgini agalisgolvnelvgi unelagi uwasv udediyi, ale ayawisgi ugatidisdiyi.
english: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᎸ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏉᎳ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ; ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎦᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᎩᏁᎸᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏥᏴᎩ ᏓᎬᏆᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏕᎬᎩᏲᏒᎩ ᎠᏂᎶᎻᏱ.
phonetic: Tsoino winusvlv hia nulistanvgi; Quola duwetlisanvgi nunigvwiyusv Anitsusi; unadatlisanvno hia niduweselvgi; Itsisgaya idadanvtli, ayv vtla gohusdi gatsisganvtselvhi yigi digatseli yvwi, vtla ale agiyostanvhi yigi dikahnawadvsdi digigayvlige geginelvhi; aseno Tsilusilimi tsiyvgi dagvquatinawidvhvgi degvgiyosvgi Anilomiyi.
english: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᏱᏗᎬᎩᏲᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎬᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᎩᏩᏛᎡᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvgigoliyev, yidigvgiyosei, vtlayeno gohusdi ayohuhisdi gvgisdvdisdi yigvgiwadvelei.
english: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏐᏅᏤᎸ, ᎠᏎ ᏏᏐᎢ ᏩᎩᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᎮᎢ ᎦᏥᏳᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Aseno Anitsusi aninegv nasgi unisonvtselv, ase Sisoi wagihvsdodi naqualisdanelvgi; vtlasgininonv gohusdi yagihei gatsiyuisdodi diquatseliga yvwi.
english: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏥᏫᏨᏯᏅ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎵᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎢᏏᎵᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᏒᎢ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏨᏆᎸᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdagalisdoda tsiwitsvyanv itsvgowadvdiyi ale igalinohediyi, Isiliyeno udugi unvsvi nvtsulisdotanv hia tsudadesvdv tsvqualvsdi.
english: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᏙᎩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᎿᎭᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎨᏨᏁᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᎨᏣᏃᎮᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nvgvwaweselvgi; Vtla nihi etsanohesgv goweli Tsudiyi nidodayunowelanvhi yidoginoheha, vtla ale gilo idadanvtli nahna nvdayunilosvhi gvnigesv yinigetsvnelei, vtla ale usonv yigetsanohelei.
english: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒᎢ, ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎨᎦᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno ogaduliha itsvyadvganediyi nusdv hadanvtesgvi, hiayeno unadatselidv unaligosvi, otsigataha nigvnadv getsinohesgv gegatludisgvi.
english: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎬᏩᏒᏍᏓᏁᎸᏃ, ᎤᏂᏣᏛ ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ, ᏚᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏑᎾᎴ ᎤᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏒᎢ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᏓᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Degvwasvsdanelvno, unitsadv gvwalutselvgi uwediyi; nasgi gvnigesv niduwanelvgi, dunohehelvgi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi, sunale ulenvdv usvi gvdisgi, dasdiyedisgv Tsisa kanohesgvi; degvdisgv dikahnawadvsdi Mosi utseliga ale anadolehosgi.
english: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎯᏳᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Igadvno unohiyunvgi nasgi uwonisvi, igadvno vtla yunohiyunei.
english: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᎦᎴᏅᎲᏃ ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ ᏙᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ, ᏉᎳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏏ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎢᏌᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏩᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Dunagalenvhvno danadanvtesgvi dounenvsvgi, Quolasgininonv asi saquo ikanetsvhi unetsvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Yeliquo Galvquodiyu Adanvdo tsidunetsele digigayvligei, Isaya adolehosgi tsuwatanei,
english: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ; "ᎯᎠ ᏴᏫ ᏘᏩᏛᎱᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏫᏂᏫ; ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏦᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia tsinuwesei; "Hia yvwi tiwadvhuga, ale hia winiwi; itsadvgisgvi itsadvgisgesdi, aseno vtla yitsoligesdi, ale itsigowatisgvi itsigowatisgesdi aseno vtla yitsadolehosgesdi.
english: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ ᎤᎵᏦᎲᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᎦᏂᎵᏳ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎵᎷᎬ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎾᏫ ᎬᏩᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏧᏏᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎦᏥᏅᏬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ."
phonetic: Hiayeno yvwi uninawi ulitsohvsv, ale danililugv ganiliyu anadvgia, ale dinigadoli dunisduha; nasgi dinigadoli digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna, ale danililugv digvwanadvgododi nigesvna, ale uninawi gvwanolisdodi nigesvna, ale dunadanvdv tsusinetliyvsdiyi nigesvna ale digagatsinvwodi nigesvna."
english: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᎾᏛᏓᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsanvtesdi, hia nasgi alisdelvdodi Unelanvhi utseliga tsunadalenvdv yvwi getsinelvhi, ale nasgi dvnadvdastani.
english: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏒᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᏭᎾᎵᏃᎮᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino nuwesv, Anitsusi unadanvsvgi, unvsv gesv utsadvgi wunalinohelvgi.
english: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳᏃ ᎤᏃᏍᏛ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏛᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏙᎳᏒᎯ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏩᏘᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Quolano unosdv tali tsudetiyvdv uneladvgi utseliga udolasvhi adanelvi, ale dadanilvgvgi nigadv gvwawatisgi,
english: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏅᏍᏓᏕᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Alitsidohvsgvgi kanohesgvgi Unelanvhi ugvwiyuhi gesvi, ale dadeyohvsgvgi kanohesgvgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, usdiunv nasgaihvna, ale gilo nunvsdadehvna.
english: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᏴᏋᏁᎸᎯ, ᎥᏆᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidasdi, vginvsidv iyvquvnelvhi, vquadadaletanvhi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli aqualitsidodiyi,
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏂᎨᏎ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ,
phonetic: Nasgi uduistanvhi tsinigese anadolehosgi degvdisgv nahna galvquodiyu gowelihi,
english: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏕᏁᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi Uwetsi Ugvwali, nasgi Dewi unetlvtanvdv gesv tsudenei nasgi uquedali gesvi;
english: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ,
phonetic: Galvquodiyusgini Udanvdo gesv utsati ulinigidv gvnigesv tsinagvnele Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi, nasgi nahna uyohusv dulehisanvi; nasgi Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga,
english: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi oginelvhi tsigi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale oginvsidv gesvi, nasgi tsunadanilvisdiyi gohiyudi gesv naniv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi dudov nvdigalisdodisgvi;
english: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏂᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Nahna nasquo itsadasuya nihi, Tsisa Galonedv itsiyanvdv tsigi;
english: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥ ᎶᎻ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Nitsiv Lomi, Unelanvhi itsigeyuhi, etsiyanvdv itsadanvti; Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv getseladidohesdi, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyiyi gesvi, tsiyalielitseha Aquanelanvhi gvdiha dudov Tsisa Galonedv, nitsiv nihi gesv iyusdi, nvdigalisdodiha itsohiyusv nigvnadv elohi aninohesgvi.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏥᏯᏛᏁᎭ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎬᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno aquohiyudanehi, nasgi gohusdi tsitsiyadvneha aquadanvdo tsigvdiha nasgi osdv kanohedv Uwetsi utseliga gvnigesv nigvnehvi, nasgi nitsiyohisdisgvna itsvneisdisgvi, nigohilv gadadolisdisgv.
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎢᏒ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsitayohihvi, nasgi iyuno yeli yigi gohi hnaquo osdv iyaqualisdanelvsdiyi gaisv witsvlutsediyi, Unelanvhi osiyu ayelvsgv nvdayulisdodiyi.
english: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏭᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Utsatiyeno aquaduli itsvgowadvdiyi, nasgi ditsvyohisediyi gohusdi usdi adanvdo ulisdelvdodi gesvi, nasgi ditsalinigohisdiyi wuliyilohisdiyi;
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎩᎧᎵᏍᏙᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi, nasgi ayv itsulaha igikalisdohisdiyi gvtanvhi ayv nihino utloyi igohiyusvi.
english: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏄᎴᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino idalinvtli vtla nanigatahvnaquo gesesdi yitsvyeliseha, nasgi utsati iyuwagudi daquegotanv witsvlutsediyi, nasgi gohusdi ugatatanvhi nihi nasquo itsehv agigowadvdiyi agiyelvsvgi, nasgiya nusdv anisoi tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi; aseno gohi iyasdi aquadanuleha.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎩᏚᎦ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gvgiduga itsula Anigoi ale nvwanadale yvwi, anigatanai ale anigatanai nigesvna.
english: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᎢ, ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ ᎶᎻ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏤᎯ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi igvquadvnedi gesv igai, aquadvnvisdiquo osdv kanohedv itsvyalitsidonediyi Lomi nasquo itsehi nihi.
english: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yigadeosga osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga; nasgiyeno Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv gvnigesv igvnehi, nasgi nahna analisdelvdodisgv naniv anohiyuhvsgi; Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi.
english: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahnayeno gvnigesv igvnelvhi nusdv udadudalesdodi gesv Unelanvhi, gohiyudi gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, ale gohiyudi gesv wasquadisdisgi; nasgiya nigvnvgowelvi, Duyugodvsgini iyadvnehi gohiyudi gesv udvnidisdesdi.
english: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏓᎦᏘᎴᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏣᏂᎾᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Unalanvhiyeno utalawohisdi gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi galvloi tsvdidalehvsga tsidagatilega nudalesv Unelanvhi nunilvquodvna gesv, ale niduyugodvna iyunadvnedi gesv yvwi, nasgi duyugodv tsaninahisdiha uyo dunilvwisdanehvi;
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎬᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ.
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi na Unelanvhi yeli gvgadovhisdodi gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi anehvi; Unelanvhiyeno dunanugowiselv.
english: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏗᎦᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎭ ᏧᎾᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgiyeno digvgowadvdi nigesvna gesv tsutseliga gvnigesviyu digvgowadvdi igi elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv, digagolisdodi igi tsudalenvdv digotlvnvhi gesvi, nasgi nvtsudalenvhvna ulinigidiyu gesvi, ale Unelanvhi gesvi; nasgi iyusdi vtla yuniha tsunatlvwisdodi;
english: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏂᎸᏉᏙᏔᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎾᎵᎮᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎫ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᎵᏏᎲᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Unigadovsvyeno Unelanvhi, vtla Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv yunilvquodotanei, vtla ale yanaliheligei, anadanvtesgvsgini asequoquo nulistanei, ale tsunegu tsuninawi dulisihvsei;
english: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᎾᏤᎸᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Anigatanai anatselvsgvi, uninegu nunalistanei;
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Ale uninetliyvse galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi ayohusgi nigesvna utseliga, ayohusgi yvwi ditlilostanvhi nasgiya nunvnelei, ale tsisqua, ale nvgi dininvsadi, ale anadanasinidohi.
english: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎤᎾᏑᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi nasquo deuyose gadaha tsunilvwisdanediyi unvdodiyi unvsv tsuninawiyi unasulvnvdi gesvi, tsunisotlvisdodiyi diniyelv unvsvquo nidanadadvnehvi;
english: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎴ ᎠᎪᏢᏅᎯᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi udohiyusv Unelanvhi unohesgi uninetliyvstane gayegogi gesvi, ale utli igai unadadolisdanele ale gohusdi unadvnele agotlvnvhiquo gesv esgaquo igai uwotlvnvhi, nasgi galvquododi tsigi nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi deuyosvgi udehohisdi unadulvnvdiyi; nasquoyeno anigeyv tsunatseliga nasgi ahv iyunadvnedi gesv uninetliyvstane nasgi ahv iyunadvnedi nigesvna gesvi.
english: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᎨ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎾᏓᏕᎳᏲᏍᎨ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎾᏓᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏩᏛᎡᎮ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo anisgaya duniyosge iyunadvnedi gesv nasgi anigeyv geganelanvhi ugvwali gesvi, utsati danadadelayosge unvsvquo gesvi; anisgaya anisgayaquo gohusdi danadadvdisge dunilvwisdanehe nasgi udehohisdi gesvi, ale unvsv gesv unaliwadvehe duyugodv gegaguyvedi gesv nasgi unilidasdisgvi.
english: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏ ᏄᏂᏰᎸᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏲᏎ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi Osi nuniyelvsvna tsigese nusdv Unelanvhi unigadovsv unisquanigododiyi, Unelanvhi deuyose getsisonvistanvhi iyunalisdodiyi dunadanvdvi, nasgi igvdvnedi nigesvna gesv iyunadvnediyi;
english: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏛ, ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎾᏙᏅᎢᎯ,
phonetic: Unikalitsvhi gesv nudalesv niduyugodvna gesvi, udelidv dinisidi gesvi, uyo iyadadvnedi gesvi, tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, uniyo gesvi; unikalitsvhi advyugedi gesvi, didahisdi gesvi, ditiyosdi gesvi, atlonuhedv, uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi; anadonvihi,
english: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏗᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏐᏢᏗ; ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ, ᎤᎾᏢᏆᏌᏗ, ᎠᏃᎷᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᏂᏚᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ,
phonetic: Uyo dinadanohelidohi, Unelanvhi aniniquatihi, gvwanadasotlvdi; unatlvquodi, unatlvquasadi, anoluwatisgi tsudalenvdv uyoi, nidunohiyusvna tsunigayvligei,
english: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏃᎵᏣᏛᎾ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎾᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏅᎾ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ, ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏄᎾᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎾ;
phonetic: Nunolitsadvna, kanohedv dunatlohisdv aniyosdisgi, gohusdi tsunvna nidunigeyusvna, gvwanohisdi nigesvna, nunadadolitsadvna;
english: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsanigataha nusdv degugodisgv Unelanvhi, nasgi gilo nasgi iyusdi tsulvwisdanehi yeliquo digvwaniyohuhisdi gesvi, vtla nasgiquo nanadvnehv uwasv yigi, osiyusgini duniyelvha nasgi iyanadvnehi.
english: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏣᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏣᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫ ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎲ ᏨᏒ ᏕᎭᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎭᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi vtla ditsatlvwisdodi yitsaha, nihi yvwi nitsivquo ditsugodisgi; nahnayeno nvwadale dehiyugodanehv tsvsv dehadadugodaneha; nihiyeno dugodisgi nasgiya nihadvneha.
english: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno idigataha nasgi Unelanvhi degugodisgv duyugodv gesvi, nasgi degugodanehv nasgi iyanadvnehi.
english: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᏃ ᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎭᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏔᏚᏓᎳᎡᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigono hadanvtesgv nihi yvwi, nasgi dugodanehi tsigi nasgi iyanadvnehi, ale nasgiya ihadvnehi tsigi, tadudalaeli Unelanvhi tsuwugododi gesvi?
english: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎯᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᏄᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏒᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏘᏁᎬ ᏣᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigoge nvlisaliquo hiyelvsga nutsuquisdv udanvtiyu gesv ale gvnidiyu gesvi, ale gohidiyu unelagi svlisgvi, nigatahvnaquo gesv nasgi Unelanvhi udanvtiyu gesv tsatinegv tsanetliyvsdi gesv tsadanvdvi?
english: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏣᎾᏫ ᎯᏟᏏᎭ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸᎭ ᎤᏓᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎭ;
phonetic: Nasgiyasgini hisdayiyu gesv ale tsanetliyvdv nigesvna tsanawi hitlisiha utalawohisdi gesv tsatseli iyulisdodi nahiyu iga aliyilolvha udalawohisdi gesv ale Unelanvhi duyugodv tsuwugododi gesv gananugowisvha;
english: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi naniv tsuguyvedi tsigi nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi;
english: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎬᎾᎢᏒ ᏧᏂᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏧᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi osdv dunilvwisdanehv dinvnidiyu gvnaisv tsuniyasdiha digvwalvsadv ale galvquodiyu gesv ale ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesvi, alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv tsuguyvdanedi tsigi;
english: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ; ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgini [Unelanvhi] dinigatilegi tsigi, ale nanohiyuhvsgvna tsigi duyugodv gesvi, niduyugodvnasgini gesv anohiyuhvsgi tsigi; utalawohisdi ale uhnalvhi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi.
english: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Udeyadodi gesv ale uwelihisdi gesv unilutsedi gesesdi naniv anisiyvwiha gesvi, nasgi uyo iyanadvnehi, Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi;
english: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎢᎬᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Digvwalvsadvsgini ale galvquodiyu gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv unilutsedi gesesdi naniv anisiyvwiha gesv osdv iyanadvnehi, Anitsusi igvyi, ale nasquo Anigoi;
english: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla gilo digalvquodisgi yigi.
english: For there is no respect of persons with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏔᏅᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nanivyeno gilo unisganvtsvhi dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna nasquo dikahnawadvsdi nigvtanvna unigiliyoisdi; ale naniv gilo unisganvtsvhi dikahnawadvsdi unihi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi gegvdanedi digegugodanedi gesesdi,
english: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏓᎧᏅᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi anadvgisgi nanisganvna yigi Unelanvhi dakanvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nigawesgv iyanadvnehi nasgi unadudalesdi gesesdi.
english: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna tsigi, unvsv unadanvtedv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yinanadvneha, nasgi hia, dikahnawadvsdi nunihvna tsigi, unvsvquo gesv dikahnawadvsdi nanalisdiha;
english: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏓᎾᏓᏚᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv nanvneha dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyadvnedi gesv tsuninawiyi gowelvi, dunadanvdv nasquo gohiyudodisgvi, ale anadanvtesgv danadaduhisdisgv, ale danadadudalesgvi.
english: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎭ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Nahiyu iga Unelanvhi udelidv gesv yvwi unatseliga degugodanelvha, Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, nasgiya nigawesgv aquatseli osdv kanohedv.
english: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏧᏏ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏯᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Gvniyuquo, Atsusi detsadov, ale dikahnawadvsdi tsalisgasdodi, ale hiyatlvquasdodi Unelanvhi,
english: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale higataha nusdv osiyu uyelvdi gesvi, ale higowatiha tsudalenvdv tsudalehnai gesvi, etseyonvhi dikahnawadvsdiyi;
english: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎭ ᏨᏒ ᏔᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎨᏫ, ᎢᎦ ᏔᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎠᏂᏂ,
phonetic: Ale vtla yitsadlasidveha tsvsv tatinidohi gesv dinigewi, iga tatisdanehi gesv ulisigv anini,
english: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏖᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏖᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Teyohvsgi gesv nunadanvdvna, diniyoli teyohvsgi, nasgi tsasquanigodi agadovhisdi gesv ale duyugodv gesv ditlilostanvhi dikahnawadvsdiyi gowelvi.
english: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎯᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏨᏒ ᏯᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ?  ᏂᎯ ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎯᏃᏍᎩᎭ?
phonetic: Nasgino nihi nvwadale hiyeyohvsgi tsigi, tlasgo tsvsv yadadeyohvsga?  Nihi halitsidohvsgv tlesdi tsanosgisvgi tsadiha, tsigo ihinosgiha?
english: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎢᎭᏓᏲᏁᎭ?  ᏂᎯ, ᎤᏁᎴᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏥᏕᎯᏂᏆᏘᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎯᏐᏢᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Nihi, tlesdi tsadayonelvgi tsadiha, tsigo ihadayoneha?  nihi, Unelenvhi diyelvhi tsidehiniquatiha, tsigo nihi gohusdi galvquodi hisotlvdiha?
english: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏣᏢᏆᏙᏗᎭ, ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏐᏢᎯ ᏂᏴᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Nihi dikahnawadvsdi tsatlvquadodiha, hiyosdisgvsgo dikahnawadvsdi asotlvhi niyvne Unelanvhi?
english: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno dudov gvwanisotlvdi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi nihi itsvnisadv, nasgiya nigvnv gowelvi.
english: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏱᎿᎭᏛᏁᎭ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎡᏣᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ahusdesdiyeno gesv udohiyuhi tsasdeliha iyuno dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv yihnadvneha; iyusgini hiyosdisgi yigi dikahnawadvsdi, etsahusdeselvhi gesv etsahusdeselvhiquo nigesvna nigalisdiha.
english: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏯᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna yasquanigodiha dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnvi, tlasgo natsiusdeselvna gesv atsiusdeselvhi gesv atsiyelvnanedi yigagi?
english: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏅᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏙᎨᏧᎪᏓᏏ ᏂᎯ, ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Ale tlasgo atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna, nasgi udenvquo nusdv dikahnawadvsdi asquanigodisgi yidogetsugodasi nihi, goweli ale ahusdesdi gesv digvdi dikahnawadvsdi hiyosdisgi?
english: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfill the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏱᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏚᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏉ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Vtlayeno nasgi na Atsusi yigi, gaduquo iditlv Atsusi yigi; vtla ale nasgi na ahusdesdi gesv yigi, gaduquo iditlv uquedalvquo yigi;
english: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᏧᏏ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᏪᎵᏉ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na Atsusi, nasgi hawiniditlv Atsusi tsigi, ale nasgi na ahusdesdi gesv unawiyi ehi tsigi, udanvdogihi ehi, vtlano goweliquo nigawesgv dikahnawadegi; nasgi vtla yvwiquo gvwalvquododi yigi, Unelanvhisgini.
english: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᎤᏍᏛ ᎤᏟ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎠᏧᏏ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gadogeno usdv utli nudvnv Atsusi?  ale gado usdv gvwadasdelvdi ahusdesdi gesvi?
english: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᎢ; ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎦᎨᏅᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Utsati nigav nudalesvi; nugvwiyusv adina nvdigalisdodi nasgi gegagenvyv Unelanvhi unetsvi.
english: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᏥᎪ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏂᎬᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gadono iyu igadv nunohiyunvna yigi?  Tsigo nunohiyunvna gesv asequoquo yinigvga Unelanvhi gagohiyudi gesvi?
english: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᎱᎪᏔᏅᎭ.
phonetic: Gvwatlisdi; Vv, Unelanvhi duyugodv kanegi gesesdi, nanivno yvwi aniyegogi gesesdi; Nasgiya hia nigvnv gowelvi, nasgi nisganvna iyulisdodiyi hinegvi, ale tsadasegogisdiyi hnaquo dehugotanvha.
english: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏃᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎦᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᎭ?  (ᏴᏫᏉ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ).
phonetic: Aseno iyuno niduyugodvna nogadvnelv gvnigesv yinigvneha duyugodv iyadvnehi gesv Unelanvhi, gado dadadvni?  asganvgasgo Unelanvhi nasgi tsidasdvdisdodiha?  (yvwiquo iyuwesdi nitsiweha).
english: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᏕᎫᎪᏓᏏ?
phonetic: Gvwatlisdi; iyuyeno nasgi yinusdi gado yigalisdoda Unelanvhi elohi yidegugodasi?
english: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎧᏁᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏩᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏛᏊᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno duyugodv kanegi gesv Unelanvhi utli igai unequotsvhi yigi nasgi galvquodiyu nuwanehvi ayv gatsigohvsgv yinvdigalisdodiha, gadono ayv nasquo asiquo dvquugodaneha tsisgana nasgiyai?
english: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᎭ, (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏲᎩᏐᏢᏛ ᏥᎪᎩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᏪ ᏥᎪᎪᏎᎭ,) ᎤᏲ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Alesgo vtla nasgi hia yugvwiyuha, (nasgi gayogisotlvdv tsigoginoheha, ale gilo nasgi naniwe tsigogoseha,) Uyo degilvwisdanehesdi nasgi osdv gesv uliyeilvsdiyi?  nasgi unisganvtsv tsunadugodanediyi duyugodi.
english: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ?  ᎤᏟᏍᎪ ᏂᏙᎯ?  ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎤᏅ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᏕᎫᎪᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gadoge ugvwiyuha?  utlisgo nidohi?  Vtla usdigidv unv; gayulayeno degugotanv nasgi itsula Anitsusi ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nigadiyu asganvisdi gesv unadanuyvdvi.
english: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ, ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Vtla gilo osiyu iyadvnehi yigi, vtla, saquo unv.
english: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎵᎩ ᏱᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎯ ᏱᎩ.
