phonetic: Vtla gilo goligi yigi; vtla gilo Unelanvhi uyohi yigi.
english: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗᎭᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ.
phonetic: Nanivquo unatlesv ganvnvi, iyunasdihaquo gohusdi digvdodi nigesvna nunalistanv; vtla gilo osiyu iyadvnehi yigi, vtla saquo unv.
english: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᏗᏂᏃᎪᎢ ᎠᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᎾᏛ ᏚᏂᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏚᏂᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Unigisdiyi didanisodiyi ulisduidv tsigeso nasgiyai; dininogoi anadalonuhedisgoi, inadv duninehv adahihi dunihanegalv hawiniditlv dunineha.
english: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏓᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi diniholi dikaliwohi adasginvdisdi gesv ale uyvsdi gesvi.
english: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏗᏯᏄᎵᏳ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᏪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsunalasideni diyanuliyu gigv unadatsewediyi.
english: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎪ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Advdisgi gesv ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv tali udvdidego anedohvi.
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏃ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nvwadohiyadvno ganvnv vtla unigadovsvhi yigi.
english: And the way of peace have they not known:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv vtla igvyiditlv yinusdi dinikanvi.
english: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏄᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale idigataha nasgi nigav nigawesgv dikahnawadvsdi uninetseha nasgi dikahnawadvsdi getsinenuhi; nasgi naniv diniholi digetsisdunediyi, ale elanigv anehi unisganvtsvhi tsudugotanvhi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏄᏛᏁᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏴᎬᏚᏓᎴᏍᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nudvnehv vtla gilo uquedali yvgvdudalesda nasgi agatahvi; dikahnawadvsdiyeno asganvisdi gesv agadovhisdodi.
english: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬ ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini udadudalesdodi gesv, dikahnawadvsdi gvdodi nigesvna, gvnigesv igvnelvhi, gohiyudotanvhi dikahnawadvsdi ale anadolehosgv dunowelvi;
english: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎦᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi udagadalesdi gesvi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv gohiyudi tsvdidalehvsga, ale nasgi naniv anohiyuhvsgi unilutsedi ale nasgi naniv unatseli iyulisdodi tsigi; vtlayeno tsunadalehnai yigi;
english: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎤᏃᎭᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nigadiyuyeno unisganvtsvhi, ale esga unohasv Unelanvhi udalvquododi gesvi;
english: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎬᏩᎶᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Gegudaledv nidigetsigvwalodanelvna gvtanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi aguyvdoi gesv Galonedv Tsisa uwehvi;
english: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᎩᎬ; ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi [Tsisa Galonedv] Unelanvhi gvnigesv tsinuwanelv alisgolvtanvhi gohisdodi gesvi, nasgi gohiyudiyi ugigv; tsunanugowisediyi nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi gesvi, nasgi gayula asganvtsvhi gesv gagvwadanedi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi gvnidiyu gesv iyuwanisanvhi;
english: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Tsunanugowisediyi gohi gesv nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi gesvi; nasgi duyugodv iyadvnehi iyulisdodiyi, ale gudalesgi nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi Tsisa.
english: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏢᎨᏃ ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ.  ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ?  ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱᏍᎪ ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ?  ᎥᏝ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ.
phonetic: Hatlvgeno atlvquasdi gesvi?  Iyvdv igvnelvhi.  Gado usdi dikahnawadvsdi gvtanvhi?  digalvwisdanediyisgo adanetsehi?  Vtla; dikahnawadvsdisgini gvtanvhi gohiyudi gesv adanetsehi.
english: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏚᎪᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dedugodiha nasgi yvwi gohiyudi gesv adudalesdisgv dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv nudvnelvna.
english: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ?  ᎥᎥ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgo Anitsusiquo unvsv unatseliga?  tlasgo nasquo tsunadalenvdv yvwi unatseliga yigi?  Vv, tsunadalenvdv nasquo yvwi unatseliga.
english: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Saquohiyuyeno Unelanvhi nasgi gohiyudi gesv tsidegudalesdiha digetsiusdeselvhi, ale nidigetsiusdeselvna gohiyudi gesv tsidegudalesdiha.
english: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᏛᏁᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgisgono iyusdi asequoquo nidvneha dikahnawadvsdi gohiyudi gesv idvdiha?  Gvwatlisdi; idisdayidisgini dikahnawadvsdi.
english: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ?
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni Equahami igidoda uwadvhv uquedali gesv nvdayudalenvdv?
english: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎭ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ [ᏳᎭ,] ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno Equahami dulvwisdanehv ududalestanvhi yigi, uha utlvquisdodi; aseno vtla [yuha,] Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ?  ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gadoyeno adiha galvquodi goweli?  Equahami uwohiyune Unelanvhi, nasgino duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanelei.
english: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏯᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ, ᎤᏓᏚᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno tsulvwisdanehi agaguyvedi gesv vtla gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yinvdigalisdodisgo utseli yatsiyelvnanehoi, udadugvsgini nvdigalisdodisgo utseli atsiyelvnanehoi.
english: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ, ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgini nidulvwisdanehvna, gohiyuhvsgiquosgini nasgi na gudalesgi asganai, nasgi uwohiyusv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanehoi.
english: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏫ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏰᎸᎾᏁᎭ ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo Dewi tsikaneisdiha osdv iyulisdanedi gesv yvwi, nasgi na Unelanvhi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nasgiya uyelvnaneha nidulvwisdanelvna gesvi,
english: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ,] ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎨᎫᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ;
phonetic: [Hia tsinigaweha,] Osiyu iyunalisdanedi unisganvtsv gagetsinelvhi, ale uyo nunadvnelv gegutlvnanelvhi;
english: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏄᏭᎪᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Osi iyulisdanedi yvwi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi usganvtsv nuwugosdisgvna gesvi.
english: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏉᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?  ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᏓᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi osiyu iyudalisdanedi gesv digetsiusdeselvhiquosgo unilutseha, tsigoge nasquo digetsiusdeselvhi nigesvna?  Gohiyudiyeno gesv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanele Equahami idadiha.
english: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᎩᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?  ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ilagiyuno nasgi nusde atsiyelvnanelei?  tsigo atsiusdeselvhi tsigesei?  tsigoge atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna tsigesei?  Vtla atsiusdeselvhi tsigesei, atsiusdeselvhisgini nigesvna tsigesei.
english: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏁᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎲᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale atsinele ahusdesdi gesv uyelvdvi, asdayidisgi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanehvi nvdayudalenvhi uwohiyusv asi natsiusdeselvna tsigesei; nasgi unidoda iyulisdodiyi naniv anohiyuhvsgi, nidigetsiusdeselvna gesvi; nasgi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nasgi nasquo getsiyelvnanediyi;
english: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏚᎳᏏᏅᏒ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏎ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo digetsiusdeselvhi unidoda iyulisdodiyi, nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi uwasv nigesvna tsigi, nasquosgini anisdawadegi tsigi dulasinvsv igidoda Equahami, nasgi tsuwohiyuse atsiusdeselvhi asi nigesvna tsigesei.
english: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Tsatsiduisdaneleyeno utseli iyulisdodiyi elohi, vtla Equahami ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv dikahnawadvsdi nvdayudalenvhi yigesei, gohiyudisgini adudalesdodi gesv nvdayudalenvhi gesei.
english: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏱᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno dikahnawadvsdi analisgasdodisgi unatseli yinigegvneha, hnaquo asequo nigalisdiha gohiyudi gesvi, ale aduisdv gohusdi gvgodi nigesvna nigalisdiha.
english: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno utalawohisdi gesv waliyeilohiha; dikahnawadvsdiyeno nahna nahvna gesv, nahna dikahnawadvsdi ayosdodi gesv vtla yeha.
english: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gohiyudi gesv alisgasdodiha, nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalediyi; nasgi aduistanvhi gesv ulinigidiyu iyunalisdanediyi naniv unetlvtanvdv gesvi; vtla nasgi unvsv tsunetlvtanvdv gesv nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi nigvnvi, nasquosgini nasgi tsunetlvtanvdv gesv Equahami uwohiyusv nasgiya unohiyunvhi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Equahami nidiv igidoda tsigi,
english: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᏂᎬᏴᎦ,) ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏯᏂᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
phonetic: (Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, unitsati tsunadalenvdv yvwi unidoda nigvyvga,) agatahv Unelanvhi nasgi tsigohiyuhvsgei, nasgi digvnidisgi tsigi tsuniyohusvhi, ale diyanisgi tsigi tsunadalenvdv nasgi nanehvna gesvi, nasgi tsaneho nasgiyai;
english: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎦᎬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏂᏧᏈᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi udugi gagvdi nigesvna tsigesei udugi gvdi gesv tsuwohiyunei, nasgi unitsati tsunadalenvdv yvwi unidoda iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya hia igawedv tsigi, Nasgiya nunitsuquisdesdi tsanetlvtanvhi;
english: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏎᎵ ᏧᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale wanagala nigesvna gesv uwohiyusvi, vtla yudanvtele uwasv ayeli uliwotsvhi gesvi, hnaquo asgohitsuqui iyvdv iyudetiyvdv gesvi, vtla ale yudanvtele ulosvsdanelvhi gesv Seli tsudananugowisdiyi;
english: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏳᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎮ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Vtla yudlasidvehe Unelanvhi uduistanvi nuwohiyusvna gesv iyusdi; ulinigidiyusgini gese uwohiyusvi, galvquodisge Unelanvhi,
english: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ukalitsvhi uwohiyusei nasgi nusdv uduistanv yeliquo nasquo igvwadvnedi gesvi.
english: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv atsiyelvnanele nasgi.
english: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ] ᏣᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla ale uwasvquo gesv yinvdigalisdodisge gowelanvhi tsigi, nasgi [duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv] tsatsiyelvnanelei;
english: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ] ᎡᎩᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎡᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ;
phonetic: Ayvsgini gesv nasquo nvdigalisdodisgei, nasgi [duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv] egiyelvnanedi tsigi, edohiyuhvsgi nasgi tsuletanvhi uyohusv Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi;
english: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏥᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏔᏁ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsidatsiyose ayv igisganvtsv tsinvdigalisdodisgei, ale tsidagaletane ayv igadudalesdiyi.
english: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᎥᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gohiyudi gesv igadudalestanvhi tsigi, nvwadohiyadv nigvnv Unelavhi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv;
english: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏕᏗᏙᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo iyuwanisadv gohiyudi idvdisgv gegiluhisdi tsinulistanv hia nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nasgi nahna tsidedidoga, ale tsidaliheliga udugi igvsv galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseli eginediyi.
english: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎢᎩᎷᏤᎲ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ale vtla nasgiquo yinigav, nasquosgini agiliya igilutsehv idaliheligoi; nvdigalisdodisgo idigatahv agiliyoisdi gesv agvnidiyu nadadvnehvi;
english: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎣᏩᏒᏃ ᎣᏓᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Agvnidiyuno gesv owasv odagadovhisdi gesv nadadvnehvi; owasvno odagadovhisdi gesv udugi gvdi gesv adawadvehvi;
english: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏴᎬᏓᏩᏛᏏ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎩᏐᏅᏰᎸ ᏗᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino udugi gvdi gesv vtla adehohisdiyi yvgvdawadvsi; nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi ageyudi gesv egisonvyelv diginawiyi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv, nasgi eginelvhi tsigi.
english: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏗᎦᎵᏂᎬᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᎠᏎ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Nidigalinigvgvnayeno ase tsigesei, nahiyu aselvhi gesv Galonedv igiyohuhisele idisganai.
english: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏲᎱᎯᏏ; ᏯᏎᎦᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏎᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Usegatsvhiyeno udanvti asgaya gilo yayohuhisi; yasegagisgininonv osdv asgaya gilo gvwayohuhisedi yinigagi.
english: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini gananugowisga igigeyuhiyu gesvi, nasgi asi idisgana tsigesei Galonedv igiyohuhiselei.
english: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi, nasgi ugigv igadudalestanvhi tsigi, utlihi udohiyuhiya egisdelvdi gesesdi egudalesdi utalawohisdi gesv nasgi iyuwanisadv.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ, ᎠᏏ ᎡᏗᏍᎦᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎡᏙᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏟᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno, asi edisgagi tsigesvgi edoisdanelvhi yigi Unelanvhi gvtanvhi Uwetsi uyohusvi, hnaquo gohi edoisdanelvhi tsigi, utlihi udohiyuhiya egisdelvdi gesesdi nasgi gvnodv gesv iyusdi.
english: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏓᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale nasgiquo yinigav, Unelanvhisgini nasquo edalieliga, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, nasgi iyuwanisadv gohi gesv iginelvhi tsigi gohisdodi gesvi.
english: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ [ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ;] ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ^
phonetic: Nasgino, saquo asgaya iyuwanisadv asgani elohi tsunanugotsv, ale ayohuhisdi gesv [tsunanugotsv;] asgani iyuwanisadv ale nasgi tsinigalisdodiha ayohuhisdi gesv nigadiyu yvwi tsunilutselv, nigadiyuyeno unisganvtsv^
english: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏁᎰ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno ulinetsv asgani neho elohi; aseno vtla unisganvtsvhi getsiyelvdi yigi nahna dikahnawadvsdi nahvna gesvi.
english: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏫ ᏤᎮ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎼᏏᏃ ᏤᎮ ᏫᎬᏍᏘ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏄᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏓᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv ayohuhisdi gesv ehvgi Adawi tsehe nvdagvwadalenvdv Mosino tsehe wigvsti, nasgi nasquo anehv nunisganvtsvna gesv nasgiya nudvnelv usganvtsv Adawi, nasgi uluhisdi tsigesv tsagatlilosdodi tsigesei.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏕ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla nasgiya tsinusde asganvtsvi, nasgi nasquo yinusde gvwagatiya adanedi gesvi.  Iyuyeno asiyvwi usganvtsv unitsati tsuniyohuhistanvhi yigi; utlihiyu igai unitsati utsati unilutselv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi, ale udanedi gesv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi tsigi, nasgi asiyvwi asgaya iyuwanisadv, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ [ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ] ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᏰᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
phonetic: Ale vtla nasgiya asiyvwiquo usganvtsvhi iyuwanisadv [digegugodanedi tsinulistane] nasgiya yinusdi udanedi gesvi; Asganvtsvyeno digugododi gesv saquoquo iyasganvtsvhi nvdayudalenvhi; Gvwagatiyasgini udanedi gesv utsati iyasganvtsvhi adudalesdodi ugvwala.
english: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏌᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᏓᎷᎸᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno saquo yvwi usganvtsv yinvdigalisdodiha ayohuhisdi gesv yeha nasgi asiyvwi iyuwanisadv; utlihiyu nudalulvna nasgi utsati getsinelvhi tsigi udadolisdi gesv ale gvwagatiya adudalesdodi gesvi, nasgi gvnidv digesv unigvwiyuhi gesesdi asiyvwi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasgi asiyvwi usganvtsv iyuwanisadv asganvtsv digugododi gesv nigadiyu yvwi tsunilutselv; nasgiya nasquo asiyvwi duyugodv nudvnelv iyuwanisadv gvwagatiya udanedi gesv unilutselv nigadiyu yvwi gegudalesdiyi gvnidv uniwadvdiyi ugvwala.
english: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏅᏛᎾᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Asiyvwiyeno yvwi nuwohiyunvna gesv iyuwanisadv unitsati anisgana tsinunalistanv, nasgiya nasquo asiyvwi uwohiyunv nvdagalisdotani unitsati anisgana nigesvna nvdvnalistani.
english: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᏢᏁ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᏉᏥᏕᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎤᏁᏉᏥᏕᎬᎩ;
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdisgini udotlvne asganvisdi gesv unequoisdiyi.  Aseno nahna asganvisdi gesv unequotsidegv nahna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv utlihiyu unequotsidegvgi;
english: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎬᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino asgani tsugvwiyusadegvgi ayohuhisdi gesv gananugowisgvi, nasgiya nasquo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ugvwiyusadegi iyulisdodiyi gvnidv gananugowisgv gvtanvhi adudalesdodi gesv Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli iyuwanisadv.
english: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎨᏗᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gadogeno dadadvni?  Tsigo asiquo gedisganvgesdi nasgi iyuwanisodiyi unequoisdiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᏚᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᏴᏓᎴᏂᏓ?
phonetic: Gvwatlisdi.  Ayv digiyohusvhi asganvisdi gesv ugvwali, gado yidulisdoda yeli asi nahna yvdalenida?
english: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏓᏓᏲᎯᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏕᎦᏬᎥᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yitsigataha, nasgi nidiv tsegawovhi gesv Tsisa Galonedv dedadayohisehvi, nasgi uyohusv ugvwali degawovi?
english: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎩᏂᏌᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎢᏤ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasgi tsegawovhi tsigi, Galonedv itsulaha deginisanvgi, ale nasgi digiyohusvhi nulistanvgi; nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsidagaletanei Agayvlige galvquodiyu gesv gvtanvhi, nasgiya nasquo ayv idalenidohv itse yidalenidoha.
english: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏗᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi uyohusv didatselidv iyegvnelvhi gesesdi, nasquosgini dulehisanv didatselidv iyegvnedi gesesdi.
english: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi idigataha, nasgi igatseli uwetsi asgaya dadahnawasdv agadvnv itsulaha nasgi [galonedv] agadvnvi, nasgi asganvisdi gesv ayelv ehv uyohuhisdiyi, gohi iyudalenvdv asgani diginatlvdiyi nigesvna.
english: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎤᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na uyohusvhi ududalaelvhi geso asgani.
english: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno Galonedv itsulaha digiyohusvhi gesesdi, idohiyuhvsga itsulaha didvnodv iyulisdodiyi;
english: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Idigatahayeno nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsagaletanvhi gesvi, vtla taline uyohuhisdi yigi; ayohuhisdi gesv vtla hnaquo udalinehidehi yigi.
english: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎬᏃᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno uyohusvhi tsigi, asgani ugvwali saquo nuyohusvgi; asgini gvnodv tsigi, Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali gvnodv.
english: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi itsvsv gesv udohiyuhi ditsiyohusvhi gesv itsadadanvtesgesdi asgani ugvwali, Unelanvhisgini utseli ugvwali ditsvnodv gesv Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv.
english: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏲᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎠᏍᎦᏂ] ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭ[ᏗᏥᏰᎸ] ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi asgani yugvwiyusadegesdi diyogi ditsiyelvi, nasgi [asgani] itsohiyudiyi nahna [ditsiyelv] udulvnvvsgvi.
english: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏤᏣᏓᏲᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᎯ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Ale tlesdi asgani tsetsiyohiselvgi ditsiyelv ududadewisvi, nasgi ditsvdodiyi niduyugodvna ditsilvwisdanediyi; Unelanvhisgini itsvsv tsetsadayohisi, nasgi iyunadvnedi unadvnidvhi tsuniyohusvhi gesv ale ditsiyelv ududadewisv Unelanvhi detsiyohiselvgi nasgi ditsvdodiyi duyugodv ditsilvwisdanediyi,
english: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Asganiyeno vtla yigetsadalinehidehesdi; vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdiyi yitsadanuyvdi, gvwagatiyasgini udadolisdi gesv itsadanuyvdi.
english: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗᏍᎪ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gadono?  idisganvgesdisgo, nvdigalisdodisgesdi dikahnawadvsdiyi nigadanuyvdvna gesvi, gvwagatiyasgini udadolisdi gesv igadanuyvdvi?  gvwatlisdi.
english: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎲ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yitsigataha, nasgi gilo yidetsadayohiselv itsinvsidohv etsoiyudiyi, nasgi itsinatlai gesv etsoiyuhvsgi; nasquo asgani yigi ayohuhisdi gesv gvdisgi yigi, ale gohiyudi gesv yigi, adudalesdi gesv gvdisgi?
english: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎬᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adina Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi udohiyuhi asgani ditsinatlai tsigesvgi, aseno ditsinawi gvdi itsohiyunv nasgi nusdv dideyodi gesv nasgi tsetsiyohiselvhi gesvi.
english: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino asgani gesv niditsinatlavna tsinulistanv, duyugodv gesv ditsinatlai nulistanvgi.
english: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏥᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᏥᏕᏥᏲᏒᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎯ ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Yvwi iyuniwesdi nitsiweha, nvdigalisdodiha itsiquedalv wanagalahiyu gesvi; ditsiyelvyeno itsadudadewisv tsidetsiyosvgi gadaha ale uyo gesv uninatlai iyulisdodiyi, nasgi uyo ditsilvwisdanediyi; nasgiya nasquo gohi gesvi, ditsiyelv itsadudadewisv ditsiyohi uninatlai iyulisdodiyi, nasgi itsisgana nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno asgani ditsinatlai tsigesvgi, duyugodv gesv niditsinatlavna gesvgi.
english: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏕᎰᏍᎦ?  ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno tsigesvgi gado usdi itsinequotsehe nasgi gohi tsitsadehosga?  ayohuhisdiyeno gesv wuliyeilohisdi nasgi.
english: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎥᎯ ᎢᏥᎭ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ, ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᏃ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Gohisgini gesv asgani niditsinatlavna tsigi, ale Unelanvhi ditsinatlai tsinulistanv, itsinequovhi itsiha nitsisganvna itsvnehi, walisquadihihvno wusditsihisdi nigesvna gvnidv.
english: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Asganiyeno udaguyvedi gesv ayohuhisdi gesv igi; Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udanedi gesv gvnidv wusditsihisdi nigesvna, Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga iyuwanisadv.
english: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᏓᎵᏅᏟ, (ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᎭ,) ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏝᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎲᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yitsigataha, adalinvtli, (dikahnawadvsdiyeno anigatahi gatsiwonediha,) nasgi dikahnawadvsdi unatlav yvwi nigohilv ehvi?
english: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏓᏤᎰᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏙ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᏰᎯ; ᎤᏰᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ageyvyeno tsidatsehoi, dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdo uyehi unaneladisdiyi igohidv alenidohv uyehi; uyehisgini uyohusvhi yigi, ududaledv geso dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdv uyehi unaneladisdiyi.
english: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏰᎯ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᏚᎾᏤᏅ, ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏐ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏱᏓᎾᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno asiquo ehv uyehi, nvwadale asgaya yidunatsenv, adayonehi agosehesdi; iyusgini uyehi uyohusvhi yigi, ududaledv geso dikahnawadvsdi ududalvdvi; nasgino vtla adayonehi yigi, unelagi nvwadale asgaya yidanatseha.
english: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᏣᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli nihi nasquo ditsiyohusvhi nitsalistanv dikahnawadvsdi ugvwali, Galonedv ayelv iyuwanisadv; nasgi nvwadale ditsatsvsdiyi ayelvsvgi, nasgi ayohusv tsagaletanvhi gesvi, nasgi ugatatanvhi edinanugowisediyi Unelanvhi.
english: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏕᎲᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uquedalvquoyeno asi tsidehvi, asganvisdi gesv udulvnvvsgvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi iyuwanisadv gesvi, nasgi dulvwisdanehvgi didiyelv ududadewisvi ugatatanvhi ayohuhisdi gesv edinanugowisediyi.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎡᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏓᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᏪᎸᏉ ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohisgini gesv dikahnawadvsdi edadudalaelv, nvdigalisdodiha uyohusvhi gesv diginatlvnvhi gesvi; nasgi itse adanvdo igvdodiyi gohusdi edadvnediyi, vtlano gowelvquo igvdodiyi nasgiya nigadvnelv tsuwagutanvsvi.
english: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏉ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᎬᎩᎦᏙᎥᏎ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏥᎦᏔᎮ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏚᎸᎡᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Gadogeno dadadvni?  Tsigo dikahnawadvsdi asganiquo?  gvwatlisdi.  Vtlasgini asgani yigvgigadovse vtla dikahnawadvsdi; Vtlayeno yigatsigatahe uyo adulvnvdi gesvi, iyuno dikahnawadvsdi hia nuwesvna yigesei, Tlesdi tsadadulvelvgi.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᏅᏗᏱ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Asganisgini ulinetsv gvdisgvi nudalesv uyo aquadulvnvdiyi naquvnelvgi.  Vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi asgani uyohusvhi yigi.
english: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᏆᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎤᎵᏁᏨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎷᏨ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏛᏂᏛᎩ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ilvhiyuyeno tsigesv dikahnawadvsdi nidaquanelodvna gesv iyui gvnodv gesvgi; ulinetsvsgini ulutsv, asgani udvnidvgi, ayvno agiyohusvgi.
english: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎯᎯᏉ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ulinetsv gvnidv adanehi gesv adahihiquo naqualisdanelvgi ayv.
english: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Asganiyeno ulinetsv gvdisgv agilonuhelvgi, ale nasgi agihistanvgi.
english: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nasganvna; ale nasgi ulinetsv nasganvna, ale duyugodvi, ale osiyu.
english: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎯᎯᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ, ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsigono nasgi na osdv gesv agihihiquo nulistanei?  gvwatlisdi.  Asganisgini, nasgi gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi nasgi nusdv asgani, dulvwisdanehvgi agihisdiyi gvdisgvgi nasgi na osdv gesvi; nasgi asgani ulinetsv iyuwanisadv utsati asganahiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎥᎩᎾᏗᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Idigatahayeno nasgi dikahnawadvsdi adanvdo utloyi gesvi; ayvsgini uquedali aquatinidohi, vginadinvdv asgani aginatlvdiyi.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏄᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nusdvyeno dagilvwisdanehvi, vtla osiyu yagiyelvha; nusdvsgini aquadulisgvi vtla nasgi yinigadvnehoi; nasgisgini tsiniquatihvi, nasgi nigadvnehoi.
english: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyu naquadulisgvna gesv nasgi yinigadvneha, dikahnawadvsdi osiyu gesv goiyuhvsga.
english: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi vtla hnaquo ayv nasgi yinigadvneha, asganisgini nasgi tsagiyaa.
english: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒᎢ, (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏯᏛᏅ,) ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏚᎸᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ.
phonetic: Tsigatahayeno nasgi ayv gesvi, (nasgi agiquedalv yadvnv,) gohusdi osdv nulitloyasdvna gesvi; adulvdiyiyeno agiha; nasgisgini na osdv gesv iyadvnediyi vtla yitsiwatiha.
english: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Osdvyeno iyadvnediyi aquadulisgvi, vtla nasgi yinigadvnehoi; uyosgini nasgi naquadulisgvna gesvi, nasgi nigadvnehoi.
english: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᎦᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyuno ayv naquadulisgvna gesv nasgi yinigadvneha, vtla ayv hnaquo nasgi yinigagadvneha, asganisgini nasgi tsagiyaa.
english: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏉ ᏥᏩᏘᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎸ, ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino naquo tsiwatiha hia dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi osdv iyaquadvnediyi aquadulv, uyo gesv dagikahnawadidohoi.
english: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎭᏫᏂ ᎠᏇᎲ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Osiyuyeno agiyelvha dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseliga gvdiha hawini aquehv yvwi.
english: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᏊᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno itsigowatiha nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi tsiyelv aquadudadewisvi, nasgi digatilegi dikahnawadvsdi aquadanvdogihi ahvi, ale tsiyvgi iyaquvnehi aquudalvvsgi dikahnawadvsdiyi asgani utseliga, nasgi tsiyelv aquadudadewisv ahvi.
english: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ!  ᎦᎪ ᏛᏊᏓᎴᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uyosdvquo naquasdi ayv!  gago dvquudalesi hia nasgi tsiyelv adahihi aquadudalvdvi.
english: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎠᏴᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎦᎾᏩᏕᎦ, ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi tsiyalielitseha Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga iyuwanisadv.  Nasgino aquadanvtediyi gvdiha, ayvquo nasgi dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseli detsiganawadega, agiquedalvsgini gesv gvdi dikahnawadvsdi asgani utseli detsigahnawadega.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏩᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi vtla hnaquo waha digvwanadugodanedi gesv nasgi na Tsisa Galonedv gvwayai, nasgi uquedali gesv nanisdawadegvna tsigi, adanvdosgini tsanisdawadega.
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏊᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Adanvdoyeno gvnidv adanehi, nasgi gvnidv Galonedv Tsisa tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi Adanvdo utseli dikahnawadvsdi aquudalesv asgani ale ayohuhisdi gesv unatseli dikahnawadvsdiyi aquadudalvi.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ,^ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏎᎪᎩᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᏯᎥᎢ;
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno igvwadvnedi nigesvna gesvi, nvdigalisdodisgv awanagalahiyu gesv uquedali iyuwanisadv,^ Unelanvhi uwasv Uwetsi tsunvse nasgiya ditlilostanvhi asgana uquedali, ale asgani tsugvwalei, duwugodanele usegogise asganvisdi gesv uquedalv ayavi;
english: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdododiyi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nasgiya duyugodv igadvnehohvsdiyi, ayv uquedali gesv idisdawadegi nigesvna tsigi, Adanvdosgini idisdawadegi.
english: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno uquedali tsunatinidohi uquedaliquo utseli ugvwali unagasayasdoi, nasgisgini na Adanvdo tsunatinidohi Adanvdoquo utseli ugvwali unagasayasdoi.
english: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏕᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ.
phonetic: Uquedaliyeno agasayasdodiyi ayohuhisdi gesv waliyeilohiha; adanvdosgini adesayasdodiyi gvnidv ale nvwadohiyadv digesv waliyeilohiha.
english: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎩᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏅᎬᏛᎦ;
phonetic: Uquedaliyeno agasayasdodiyi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi digatilegi; vtlayeno dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi utseli dikahnawadegi yigi, vtla ale udogiyuhi nasgi yeli yinvgvdvga;
english: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᏅᎬᎾᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino uquedali tsunatinidohi gesv vtla Unelanvhi osdv uyelvdi yinvgvnadvga.
english: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᏥᏯᎠ.  ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎥᏝ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Nihisgini vtla uquedali ditsatinidohi yigi, Adanvdosgini ditsatinidohi, iyuno howa Unelanvhi Udanvdo yitsiyaa.  Ale iyu gilo Galonedv Udanvdo nuwehvna igesesdi, nasgi na vtla [Galonedv] utseli yigagi.
english: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyusgini Galonedv itsiyaesdi, ayelv udohiyuhi uyohusvhi asgani nvdigalisdodiha; Adanvdosgini gvnodv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
english: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏙᏓᎬᏃᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᏗᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏓᎬᏔᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Iyusgini Tsisa uyohusv tsuletanvhi Udanvdo itsiyaesdi, nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsuletanvhi nasquo dodagvnohistani diyohusgi ditsiyelvi dagvtani Udanvdo nasgi tsitsiyaa.
english: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᎩᏚᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏱᎩᏚᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎢᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli, egiduga, vtla uquedali yigiduga, nasgi uquedali igisdawadidasdiyi idehvi.
english: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno itsehv uquedali gesv itsisdawadidohesdi, dodatsiyohusi; iyusgini Adanvdo gvdi ayelv dulvwisdanehv itsihihesdi, detsvnesdi.
english: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno giloi Unelanvhi Udanvdo tsunatinidohi, nasgi Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎡᏥᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᏆ!  ᎡᏙᏓ!  ᏥᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno Adanvdo atsinatlai taline etsinelvhi yigi, nasgi itsinayehisdiyi; tsuwetsisgini igegvnelvhi unadanvdo etsinelv, nasgi idvdisgv, Aqua!  Edoda!  tsidadisgoi.
english: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏓᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᏗᎦᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adanvdoyeno uwasv daligoneha digadanvdo gvnigesv nanvnehv, nasgi ayv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gesvi.
english: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎦᏘᏰᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏱᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale iyu tsuwetsi yigi, hnaquo igatiyehi tsugvwalodi; igatiyedi tsugvwalodi Unelanvhi udanedi gesvi, ale Galonedv itsulaha igatiyedi; iyuno howa yigatloyasdiha agiliyogvi, nasquo igatloyasdodi gesesdi atsilvquodisgvi.
english: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎬᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadanvtesgvyeno hia nasgi gohi agiliyoisdi gesv vtla digvtlilosdodi yigi galvquodiyu gesv nasgi eginanugowisedi gesvi.
english: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvyeno udugi uwasv aganelanvhi gesv agatiya getsinanugowisv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
english: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏮᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ,
phonetic: Aganelanvhiyeno ayogi nagvnelei, vtla osiyu uyelvsv iyusdi, osiyusgini uyelvnv iyusdi nasgi na nasgi iyuwanelvhi, udugi uwvdiyi uyelvnv,
english: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏝᎥᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᏗᎨᏥᎪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi aganelanvhi uwasv nasquo ududalesdiyi ayogi gesv unatlavi, galvquodiyu nidigetsinatlavna gesv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi unatseliga widigetsigodiyi.
english: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏂᎵᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Idigatahayeno nasgi naniv geganelanvhi gesv itsulaha uniliyedisgv ale anigiliyogv gohi iyasdi.
english: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ, ᎢᎬᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ~ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎨᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏕᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᏧᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla ale unvsvquo, igvsvsgini nasquo nasgi igvyiyi unanugowisvhi ~adanvdo tsigeha, ayv nasquo igvsv gesv hawini degiliyediha, idigatiyv tsuwetsi igegvnedi, nasgi didiyelv tsuguyvdiyi tsuwudalesdiyi.
english: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏚᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᎭ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ; ᎤᏚᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏲᏩᏐᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏨᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎦᏲᏩᎭ?
phonetic: Udugiquoyeno igvha egisdelvdiyi; udugisgini owasv agohvhi tsigesoi vtla udugi yowasoi; Gohusdiyeno tsvgowatisgoi, gadono asi udugi yigayowaha?
english: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎬᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏲ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Iyusgini igigohvhi nigesvna gesv udugi yigvha, hnaquo didvnidiyu idigatiyo nasgi.
english: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏔᏲᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎭ ᎤᎵᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo Adanvdo igisdeliha didiwanagalahiyu gesvi; vtlayeno yidigataha iyusdi duyugodv gesv igitayosdiyi idadadolisdisgvi; Adanvdosgini uwasv igalisdiyedaneha uliyedisgv gvdiha nasgi ganeisdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏫ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi na digoliyesdi tsunawi agataha nusdv adanvtelidohv Adanvdo nvdigalisdodi unadanvti dalisdiyedanehv nasgiya Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
english: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏚᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᎾᏖᏆᎶᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale idigataha nasgi nigav nidulistanidohv unatequalosv osdv iyunalisdanediyi dunilvwisdanehv Unelanvhi unigeyuhi, nasgi na getsiyanvdv tsigi nasgiya udanvtelvi.
english: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏚᏑᏰᏐ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno gayula tsinidagatahoi, nasgi nasquo nidusuyeso Uwetsi nusdv nasgiya iyunalisdodiyi, nasgi igvyi ehi iyulisdodiyi unitsati analinvtli anehvi.
english: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏚᏑᏰᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏭᏓᎴᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino gayula tsinidusuyesoi nasgi nasquo duyanvhei; ale nasgi tsuyanvdv gesvi, nasgi nasquo duwudalesei; ale nasgi tsuwudaledv gesv, nasgi nasquo galvquodiyu niduwanelei.
english: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎦᎪ ᏱᎦᏡᏓ?
phonetic: Gadono dadadvni hia nasgi tsinusdi?  iyuno Unelanvhi yigisdeliha gago yigatluda?
english: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏥᏚᏲᏎᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᏲᎯᏎᎲ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎨᎩᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Nasgi na nugeyunvna tsigese uwasv Uwetsi, tsiduyosequosgini ayv nidiv igisdelisgvi, gado yigalisdoda nasgi degiyohisehv asequo digegiyohisedi nigesvna yinigalisda nigadiyu gohusdi?
english: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏙᏓᎫᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ?  ᏥᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᏓᎴᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Gago unisganvtsv dodaguhistani Unalenvhi tsusuyedv?  tsigo Unelanvhi, nasgi unudalesgi?
english: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᏧᏄᎪᏓᏁᎯ?  ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎱᏎᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏗᏏᏗᏢ ᏧᏬᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎦᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Gago tsunugodanehi?  Galonedvsgo, nasgi tsunihusei, vv, ale nasquo nasgi tsidulehisanv, nasgi nasquo Unelanvhi agadisiditlv tsuwola, nasgi nasquo tsigalisdiyedaneha?
english: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏥᎪ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏴᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎪᏄᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ?
phonetic: Gago iyvdv nvdagvneli Galonedv igigesvi?  tsigo agiliyoisdi gesvi, ale uwelihisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi, ale uyo iyvdadvnedi gesvi, ale udagonulohisdi gesvi, ale digiyelvha gesvi, ale unayehisdi gesvi, ale ayelasdiganvhidv?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏙᎩᎢᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾᏉ ᏗᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᎠ;
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha dogiiha nigohilvi; uninodenaquo dihisdi nasgiya ogiyelva;
english: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nasgi nigadv tsudalenvdv gesv idadasegogisgi ale utli igai, nasgi na igigeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi tsigi iyuwanisadv.
english: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Ulinigidvyeno aquohiyuha, nasgi vtla ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale advnidisdi gesvi, ale dinikahnawadidohi, ale nunigvwiyusadegi, ale getsilvquodi, ale gohusdi gohi tseha, ale gohusdi asi unanugoisdi tsigi,
english: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏫᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏰᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla ale galvladiyu gesvi, ale hawiniyu gesvi, vtla ale nvwadale anelanvhi gesvi, yeli iyvdv igvwanedi yigesesdi Unelanvhi igigeyusvi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi igatseli nvdayudalenvhi tsigi.
english: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ,
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya tsinega Galonedv agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga, aquadanvdv nasquo aquohiyudanehi nigalisdiha galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv,
english: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi utsati ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv ale nigohilv uyo agiyelvsv aginawiyi.
english: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏆᏚᎸᏗᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎥᏆᏓᏓᎴᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᎲᎢ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏟ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ Ꭰ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Gvquadulvdiquoyeno aquvsv gesv vgisgatsvhi iyulisdodiyi vquadadaledodiyi Galonedv ehvi gatsisdelisgv otsadanvtli, gohusdi diquvnv a uquedali gesvi;
english: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi Isili tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi; nasgi unatseliga tsigi [Unelanvhi] tsuwetsi igegvnedi gesvi, ale galvquodiyu gesvi, ale kanohedv datlohisdvi, ale dikahnawadvsdi getsinedi gesvi, ale Unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale aduisdodi gesvi;
english: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, Ꭰ ᎠᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎷᏤ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ.  ᎡᎹᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsunidoda tsigi anigayvligei, ale nasgi anehvi, a aquedali gesv tsulutse Galonedv, nasgi Unelanvhi tsigi, nudalesv ugvwiyusadegi, winasdvna galvquododi.  Emanv.
english: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᏱᏥᏁᎦ,] ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla adina Unelanvhi unetsv asequoquo tsinulistano nasgiya [yitsinega,] vtlayeno nigadv Isili yigi nasgi Isili tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi.
english: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ; ᎡᏏᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Vtla ale Equahami tsunetlvtanvdv tsigi nasgi yinvdigalisdodiha nigadv tsuwetsi yigi; Esigiquosgini dudov getsiyanvdisgesdi tsanetlvtanvhi.
english: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏧᏰᎸᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi yadvnv, Uquedali gesv unadetanvhi gesvi, nasgi hia vtla Unelanvhi tsuwetsi yigi; aduisdvsgini unadetanvhi gesv nasgi tsuwetsi tsuyelvdi.
english: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.  ᎯᎠᏉ ᎢᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᏎᎵ ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏧᏣ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nusdi ulinetsv aduisdvi.  Hiaquo iyu datsilutsi, ale Seli dagananugowisi atsutsa.
english: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ; ᎵᏇᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎵᏨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᏁᎵᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎡᏏᎩ;
phonetic: Vtla ale nasgiquo yinusdi; Liquegisgini nasquo unelitsv, nasgi asiyvwi atsinelitselv, nasgi igidoda Esigi;
english: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎾᏕᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏯᏂᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Diniyoliyeno asi nanadehvsgvna gesei, ale asi gohusdi osdv ale uyoi nanadvnehvna gesei, nasgi udanvtelv Unelanvhi nasgiya tsusuyesdi gesv uyoisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, vtla dunilvwisdanehv nvdigalisdodisgvi, nasgiyasgini diyanisgi udanvtelvi;
english: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨ ᏚᏁᎶᏕᏍᏗ ᎣᏂ ᎡᎯ;
phonetic: hia natsiweselei, Udanilige dunelodesdi oni ehi;
english: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏤᎦᏈ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᏅ, ᎢᏐᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᏆᏘᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Tsegaqui osiyu tsiyelvnv, Isosgini tsiniquatilv.
english: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᏥᎪ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni?  Tsigo niduyugodvna gesv uweha Unelanvhi?  Gvwatlisdi.
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎭ, ᏥᏯᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎨᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎨᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Osiyeno hia natsiweseha, tsiyadolisdi gesesdi nasgi na tsiyadoligi gelisgesdi, ale uwedolisdi tsiyadanvdadisdi gesesdi nasgi na uwedolisdi tsiyadanvdada gelisgesdi.
english: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎸᎲ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi vtla gilo udulvhv yinvdigalisdodiha, vtla ale dusqualvtanv yinvdigalisdodiha, Unalanvhisgini udanvtelvi nasgi digadoligi tsigi.
english: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᏪᎵᎯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎ ᏇᏓᏲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᎬᏯᎴᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎬᏴᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏙᎥ ᏧᏃᏣᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gowelihiyeno hia natsiwese Quedayo, nasgi hia nvdigalisdodiha degvyaletanv, Nasgi aginanugowisdiyi aqualinigidiyu gesv nihi gvyvdisgvi, ale nasgi ayv daquadov tsunotsaloisdiyi elohi nigvnadvi.
english: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏙᎵᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏯᏙᎵᎩ ᎡᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏍᏓᏱᏓ ᎡᎳ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gadoligo nasgi na tsiyadoligi ela, ale gilo tsisdayida ela asdayidisgoi.
english: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ Ꭷ ᎨᎵ ᏅᏛᏍᎩᏪᏎᎵ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎦ?  ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᏚᎦᏘᎴᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Hia ka geli nvdvsgiweseli, Gadono asiquo esga ayelvsga?  gagoyeno dugatilenv nusdv adanvtesgvi?
english: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎦᎪ ᎢᏣᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᏤᎭ ᏕᎯᎦᏘᎴᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ?  ᏥᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏢᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏍᏋᏁᎸ ᎢᏍᏉᏢᏅ?
phonetic: Aseno nihi yvwiquo gago itsasdi tsinetseha dehigatilegv Unelanvhi?  Tsigo gohusdi atlvnvhi hia nvdagaweseli nasgi uwotlvnvhi, Gadono nasgi hia nisquvnelv isquotlvnv?
english: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏩᎵ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᏳᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᏆᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎦᎾᏆᎸᏒ ᎠᎬᎭᎸᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏬᏢᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
phonetic: Tlasgo diwali digotlvsgi yuha adanvtesgv iyuwanelidasdiyi gadaquala, nasgiquo ganaqualvsv agvhalvdv saquo atelido uwotlvdiyi galvquododi, nvwadaleno galvquododi nigesvna?
english: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎦᏙᏃ ᏳᏍᏗ,] ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏚᏪᎵᏎᎸ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᏗᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᏛᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: [Gadono yusdi,] iyuno Unelanvhi udulisgv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi utalawohisdi gesvi, ale ulinigvgv unanugowisdiyi, gvnidiyu gesv gvdisgv gohidiyu unelagi yiduweliselv ditelido utalawohisdi gesv ditlisdi, didvnvistanvhi didvdodiyi;
english: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ] ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏂᎨᏎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᏕᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Ale nasgi [udulisgv] gvnigesv iyuwanediyi utseli utsatanvhi galvquodiyu gesv degvdisgv ditelido udadolisdi gesv ditlisdi, nasgi tsudvnvistanvhi tsinigese galvquodiyu digesv wunadediyi,
english: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi ayv, igiyanvdv tsigi, vtla Anitsusiquo unvsv anehvi, nasquosgini tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi;
english: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎰᏏᎠ ᎤᏬᏪᎸᎢ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ (ᏥᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ,) ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo hia tsinigawe Hosia uwowelvi; diquatseli yvwi gatsiyosehesdi nasgi na diquatseli yvwi nigesvna tsigesvgi; ale tsigeyui (tsiyosehesdi,) nasgi na tsigeyui nigesvna tsigesvgi.
english: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia nvdagalistani, nahnani hia nigetsiweselvi, Nihi vtla ayv diquatseli yvwi yigi; Nahnani gvnidv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gegosehesdi.
english: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏌᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏕᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏃᏳ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎦᎳᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᎾᏧᏈᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Isaya nasquo hia nigaweha Isili dekaneisdisgvi; Isili tsuwetsi nasquo noyu amequohi galageyv nasgiya yinunatsuquisdi, unalinohiyvhi ase getsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏛᏍᏆᏗᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ; ᎤᎵᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Dvsquadiyeno digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale duyugodv gvdi ulisdiyu nasgi nvdvdvneli; ulisdiyeno nvdvdvneli nusdv duwugotanv elohi.
english: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏐᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᏘᎾᎢ ᏂᎩᏃᎯᏰᎸᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ, ᏐᏓᎻᏉ ᏱᏗᏓᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏂᎦᏍᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgiya Isaya gayula hia tsinuwesoi, iyuno Yihowa unitsati tsudatinai niginohiyelvna yigese ulinohiyvhi, Sodamiquo yididatselei, ale Gomali nusdv nasgiya yinigasdei.
english: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏓᏓᏛᏂ?  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi gado dadadvni?  Nasgi na tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi adudalesdi gesv nunisdawadvsvna gesv, nasgi adudalesdi gesv uniwadvhv, nasgi gohiyudi gesv adudalesdodi tsigi.
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏏᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᏩᏛᎲ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Isilisgini unisdawadvdv dikahnawadvsdi adudalesdodi gesvi, nasgi vtla yuniwadvhv dikahnawadvsdi adudalesdodi gesvi.
english: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏅᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏔᏅᎢ; ᏚᏃᏕᏍᏔᏁᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᎯᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Gadono?  Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi gohiyudi gesv nunvtanvna gesvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nigawesgv iyadvnedi gesv unvtanvi; dunodestaneyeno nasgi na nvya didadodehihi gesvi;
english: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎦᏪᎳ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏌᏯᏂ ᏓᏥᏂ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏓᎿᎭᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigawela, Gvniyuquo Sayani datsini nvya didadodehihi, ale nvya adahnasqualosdisgi; ale gilo gohiyuhvsgesdi nasgi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
english: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, aginawiyi iyvdv aquaduliha, ale tsiyadadolisdaneha Unelanvhi Isili ugvwali, nasgi getsisdelvdiyi.
english: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏙᎮᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏅᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Gatsiyoiyudanehiyeno nasgi utsati unadulisgv Unelanvhi gohusdi unadvnediyi; aseno vtla agadohehisdi gesv yanvdiha.
english: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎾᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nanigatahvnayeno gesv nusdv Unelanvhi udadudalesdodi gesvi, ale anatlinigvnehv unisdayidisdiyi unvsv unatseli unadudalesdodi gesvi, vtla tsunadayohiselvhi yigi Unelanvhi udadudalesdodi gesvi.
english: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏩᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno ugvwale Galonedv unadudalesdodiyi naniv anohiyuhvsgi.
english: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏩᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Mosiyeno kanoheha nusdv udadudalesdodi gesv dikahnawadvsdi, hia tsinigaweha, Gilo yvwi nasgi nadvnehesdi gvnidv awadvdisgesdi.
english: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᎪ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᏰᏏ?  (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏠᎥᏙᏗᏱ;)
phonetic: Gohiyudisgini adudalesdodi gesv hia nigaweha, Tlesdi tsanawiyi hia yiniwesgesdi, Gago galvloi dayesi?  (nasgi Galonedv agatlovdodiyi;)
