english: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎠᏍᏛᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏮᏓᎦᎶᏏ?  (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᏙᏗᏱ;)
phonetic: Ale gago asdvgi gesv wvdagalosi?  (nasgi Galonedv uyohusv tsuledodiyi;)
english: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ?  ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎮᎲ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎰᎵᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᏫᏱᏉ ᎡᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ;
phonetic: Aseno gado adiha?  Kanohedv hehv navniyu nusdidega, nasgi hiholiquo, ale tsanawiyiquo eha; nasgi hia kanohedv gohiyudi gesv kanohesgi, nasgi ayv tsotsalitsidohvsga;
english: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎯᎰᎵ ᏱᏨᏔᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏦᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎡᏣᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyuno hiholi yitsvtanv gvnigesv yiniyvnelv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale tsanawiyi iyvdv yitsohiyunv Unelanvhi deuletanv uyohusvi, ase etsasdelvdi gesesdi.
english: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎾᏫᏰᏃ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪ ᎣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᎰᎵ ᎬᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎰ ᎥᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᎦ.
phonetic: Onawiyeno gvdi agohiyuhvsgo odudalesdi nigalistaniga; ale vholi gvdi gvnigesv nagvneho vdadisdelvdi nigalistaniga.
english: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᏪᎵᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Goweliyeno hia nigaweha, Gilo nasgi gohiyuhvsgesdi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
english: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎴᎾᎠ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yidunadalenaa Anitsusi ano Anigoi; nasgiquoyeno Ugvwiyuhi naniv unatseliga utsati uwehnaiyu tsusdelvdiyi naniv gvwadadolisdanehi.
english: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nanivquoyeno gilo anadadolisdisgesdi dudov Ugvwiyuhi anineisdisgesdi getsisdelvdi gesesdi.
english: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎲᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏃᎯᏳᎲᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎲᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᏛᎬᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Gadono yigalisdoda yanadadolisdasi gilo nunohiyusvna yigi ehvi?  ale gado yigalisdoda yanohiyuhvga gilo ehv nasgi unadvganvhi nigesvna yigi ehvi?  ale gado yigalisdoda yanadvgvga gilo alitsidohvsgi nunehvna yigi?
english: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎨᏥᏅᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏂᏚᏬᏚᎭ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gado yigalisdoda yanalitsidohvga iyuno nigetsinvsvna yigi?  nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, niduwoduha tsunalasideni nasgi na osdv kanohedv nvwadohiyadv adanehi analitsidohvsgi, Osdv kanohedv analitsidohvsgi nasgi osdv ugvwali gesvi.
english: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.  ᎢᏌᏯᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᏱᎰᏩ, ᎦᎪ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Aseno vtla naniv unohiyunvhi yigi osdv kanohedv.  Isayayeno hia nigaweha, Yihowa, gago uwohiyunv otsinohesgvi?
english: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᏛᎪᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsinusdi gohiyudi gesv advgodiyi didalehvsga, advgodiyino Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv didalehvsga.
english: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏳᎾᏛᎦᏅ?  ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎤᎾᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv hia nitsiweha, Tlasgo yunadvganv?  Vv, Udohiyuhi, unadanoyvlisdv duyelisv elanigvi, ale aniwonisgv elohi wasdv iyvdv duyelisv.
english: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎮ ᎢᏏᎵ?  ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎼᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎢᏣᏛᏳᎨᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᏓᎦᏥᏴᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏢᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏨᎾᎸᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Aseno ayv nitsiweha, Tlasgo yanigatahe Isili?  igvyi gesv Mosi hia nigaweha, itsadvyugediyi nvdatsvyvneli dagatsiyvtani nasgi na ayeli unotlvhi nigesvna gesvi, ale nunadanvdvna yvwi gatsiyvdisgv datsvnalvstani.
english: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎬᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎬᎩᏲᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏋᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎾᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Isaya niganayesgvna hia nigaweha, Gvgiwadvhvgi nasgi na nigvgiyolvna gesvi; gvnigesv nigvquvnelvgi anehv nasgi na nanadvdvhvsgvna gesv gevi.
english: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏏᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᏓᏆᏎᎵᏛᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏂᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏌᏘ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Isilisgini hia nidegaweseha, Udodaquadv daquaselidvgi gatsiyanisgv nunohiyusvna ale unigonelohisati yvwi.
english: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎢᏏᎵ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏇᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Tsigo Unelanvhi iyvdv niduwanelv tsutseli yvwi?  Gvwatlisdi.  Ayvyeno nasquo tsiisili, Equahami unetlvtanvdv nvdvquadalenvhi, Queni anilasdalv gela.
english: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏂᏓᎦᏔᎰᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎳᏯ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᏕᎠᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Unelanvhi vtla iyvdv yiniduwanelv tsutseli yvwi nasgi gayula tsinidagatahoi.  Tlasgo yitsigataha nigawesgv goweli nahna Ilaya atsinohesgvi?  nasgi atayohihv deatludisgv Isili hia nigawesgvi,
english: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏕᏅᏂᎸ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏚᏂᏲᏍᏔᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒᎯᏳ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎯᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎬᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ.
phonetic: Yihowa, denvnilv ditsatseli anadolehosgi, ale atsilv digelasdiyi ditsatseli duniyostanv; ale aquvsvhiyu aqualinohiyv, ale ayv gvgihisdiyi uniyoha.
english: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ?  ᎬᏆᎵᏃᎯᏰᏗᏱ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎾ ᏇᎠᎵ.
phonetic: Aseno gado adiha Unelanvhi uwohiliyvsdanehvi?  gvqualinohiyediyi naquvnelv galiquogi iyagayvli iyanidv anisgaya nasgi nidunaliniquanvnelvna Queali.
english: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᏚᏑᏰᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyano nasquo gohi gesvi unalinohiyvhi aneha nasgiya gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv uwatanv dusuyesvi.
english: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; hnaquo vtla digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; iyuno nasgi yinusdi, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vtla hnaquo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yigagi.  Iyusgini digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi, hnaquo vtla gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisanvhi yigi; iyuno nasgi yinusdi, digalvwisdanedi gesv vtla hnaquo digalvwisdanedi gesv yigagi.
english: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ [ᏫᎬᏛᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ?] ᎢᏏᎵ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏩᏛᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎲᎩ; ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏂᎫᏏᏲᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Gadono [wigvdvdi nigalisdiha?] Isili vtla yuwadvhv nasgi tsuyohvgi; gegasuyedvsgini gesv uniwadvhv, anisoino dunigusiyotsvgi.
english: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᎵᏔᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎴᏂ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Unelanvhi dunelv adalitadisgi adanvdo, ale dinigadoli digvwanigowadvdodi nigesvna, ale dinileni digvwanadvgododi nigesvna, gohi gesv iyasdi.
english: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᏫ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏁᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏌᏛᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏕᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏫᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏏ;
phonetic: Ale Dewi hia nigaweha, Alisdayvdiyi unisgilv unesgi, ale unisadvvsgi, ale tsunodehihi, ale unisdvdisdodi winunalisdasi;
english: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompence unto them:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏫᏗᎨᎦᎵᏏᎲᏍᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏚᎾᏗᏌᏓᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dinigadoli widigegalisihvsdasi, nasgi unigowadvdiyi nigesvna, ale nigohilv dunadisadadegesdi.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back always.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏥᎪ ᏚᏃᏕᎸ ᏰᎵ ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏎᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏂᏅᏨ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᏳᎨᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏐᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hia adina nitsiweha, Tsigo dunodelv yeli tsuninvisdiyi ayelvsei?  Gvwatlisdi; nasgisgini duninvtsv nuwanisanv alisdelvdodi gesv unilutselv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi unadvyugediyi iyunvnisodiyi.
english: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᏅᏨ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi duninvtsv unenvisdisgi yigi elohi, ale nasgi esga nunalisdanehv unenvisdisgi yigi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nigav ulosvsdesdi anikalitsvha.
english: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ, ᏥᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Nihiyeno itsvwonediha ditsadalenvdv yvwi, nvdigalisdodiha ayv vginvsidv gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalitsidonediyi, tsilvquodiha nusdv vquasvgalodvi;
english: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏋᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyuno yeli igvquadvnedi yigi, nasgi iyaquvnisodiyi unatlinigvnediyi ogitloyi gesvi, ale nasgi igadv gatsisdelvdiyi.
english: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᎨᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi getsisonvistanvi unohisdanehi yinigalisdi elohi, gado ulisdodi gesesdi degegadanilvtsvha, duniyohusvsgini dunalehisanv gesesdi.
english: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎬᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ [ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ;] ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno igvyiyi ugvdvnatsvhi galvquodiyu yigi, nigadv nasquo [galvquodiyu;] iyu ale duhnasdetlv galvquodiyu yigi, nasgiya nasquo duwanigalvi.
english: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏱᏗᎬᏂᎦᎴᏒ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ-ᎮᎯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᏱᏫᏰᏣᏱᏢᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎶᏛ ᏱᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏅ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuno duwanigalv igadv yidigvnigalesv, nihino inagehehi oliwa tlugv nahna yiwiyetsayitlvtanv, ale nasgiya unalisdelodv yitseladisdi yitsalisdelvdi duhnasdetlv ale galitsonv oliwa tlugvi;
english: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏔᏢᏈᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏯᏢᏈᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᏱᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitatlvquisehesdi duwanigalvi.  Iyusgini yatlvquisga, vtla nihi duhnasdetlv yitinanugowisga, duhnasdetlvsgini nihi getsananugowisga.
english: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎨᎵ ᏅᏛᎯᏪᏏ, ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏋᏱᏢᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ.
phonetic: Hia adina geli nvdvhiwesi, duwanigalv dunvnigalvhvgi, Nasgi ayv vquvyitlvdiyi nahnani.
english: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ; ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏕᎨᏥᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏙᎦ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᎭ.  ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏣᏤᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎯᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhi; Nunohiyusvna gesv nvdayulisdotanvgi degetsinigalvhvgi; ale nihi tsidoga tsohiyusv nigvnisiha.  Tlesdiquo utli yitsatselvsesdi, hinayesgesdisgini;
english: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏁᎯᏯ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏣᎨᏳᏅᎾᏉ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno Unelanvhi nidugeyunvna yigi nvnehiya duwanigalvi, nihi nasquo nitsageyunvnaquo yigi.
english: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏅᏨᎯ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎲᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗ ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏨᎾᎦᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hagasayasda udanvteyu gesv ale asdayiyu gesv Unelanvhi; asdayiyu nidegvnehv nasgi na tsuninvtsvhi; nihisgini udanvtiyu gesv tsananugowisehvi; iyuno yinvwasdidi detsaniyvsv udanvtiyu gesvi; Vtlayeno nasgi nihi nasquo etsvnagalesdi gesesdi.
english: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎬᏩᏱᏢᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi na nasquo, iyuno igvwasdihaquo nigesvna igesesdi nunohiyusvna gesvi, getsiyitlvdi gesesdi; Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo taline digvwayitlvdi.
english: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯᏯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᏨᏱᏢᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎮᎯᏯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᏰᏨᏱᏢᏅ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎯᏘᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nihi inage ehiya oliwa tlugv tsvyitlvnvhi yigi, ale nahna hehiya nigesvna gesv osdv oliwa tlugv yetsvyitlvnv, utlihiyusgini ahitiyu nasgi na nahna anehiya tsigi, getsiyitlvdi nahna unvsv unatseligaya oliwa tlugvi.
english: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, (ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢᏉᏰᏃ ᏱᏅᏣᎵᏍᏓ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ,) ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎫᏏᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎢᏏᎵ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Vtlayeno yaquaduli, idalinvtli, nitsigatahvnaquo iyulisdodiyi hia nasgi udelidv gesvi, (itsigatanaiquoyeno yinvtsalisda itsvsv itsadanvtesgvi,) nasgi agusiyoisdi gesv unilutselv igadv Isili, gvni unitsati gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi uniyvlvhi gesesdi,
english: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles be come in.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏌᏯᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏗᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏈ ᎤᏪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nvdagalistani nigadiyu Isili getsisdelvdi gesesdi; Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Sayani nvdayudalenvhi dagalutsi digudalesgi, ale iyvdv nvdagvneli Unelanvhi nunilvquodvna gesv igaqui uwehvi.
english: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᏥᎥᎡᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi nusdi kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelvi, nahiyu gatsivedi nigalistanvha unisganvtsvi.
english: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᏓᏑᏰᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Osdvno kanohedv ugvwali gesvi, getsisgagi nunalistanv nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha; dasuyesgvsgini ugvwali, getsigeyuha anigayvlige gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
english: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno udanedi gesv ale udayanvdi gesv tlaquo uyelvdi nigesvna gesoi.
english: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏁᏦᎢᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nihiyeno tsuwagutanvsv netsoiyusvna tsigesvgi Unelanvhi, aseno gohi etsidolitsvhi igi nvdigalisdodiha nasgi nunohiyusvna gesvi;
english: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏃᎯᏳᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nasgi hia gohi gesv vtla yunohiyunv, nasgi udadolisdi gesv itsatseli iyuwanisodiyi nasgi nasquo getsidolisdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno duwugotanv nigadiyu nunohiyusvna gesvi, nasgi nigadiyu tsuwedolisdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏎᏫᏂᏴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ!  ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎪᎷᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ!
phonetic: Nasewiniyv utsatanvhi agadosaniyu gesv ale agatanaiyu gesv Unelanvhi!  nigavquo gvgoliyedi nigesvna nusdv degugodisgvi, ale uwedasdiyi gesv gagoluwadvdi nigesvna!
english: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏐ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᎰᏩ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᎤᎾᏖᏆᎶᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎶᎢ?
phonetic: Gagoyeno ugadovso nusdv udanvdv Yihowa?  ale gago unatequalono unadanvteloi?
english: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏚᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏛᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᎵ?
phonetic: Ale gago dudalenvtanv unelv, ale taline dvagaguyveli?
english: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ; [ᎠᎴ] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno gesv nvdayudalenvhi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv, ale nasgi ugvwala; [ale] nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᏗᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ, ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, itsvsdiyediha Unelanvhi udadolitsatiyu gesv iyusdi, nasgi ditsiyelv ditsalisgolvdodiyi gvnodv atsilv gelasdi, gohusdi nusdvna, digvwadanilvisdi Unelanvhi, detsadanvdv gvdi gohusdi etsadvnehvi.
english: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏂᏨᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏤ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi elohi anehi nunasdv yinitsvsdesdi; ditsadanetliyvdvsgini gesesdi ditse idigvnelvhi gesv detsadanvdvi, nasgi getsigoliyedi iyulisdodiyi nusdv udulisgv Unelanvhi, nasgi osdv gesvi, ale digvwadanilvisdi gesvi, ale akalii gesvi.
english: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ; ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏯᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv gvdisgv, nasgi vginelvhi tsigi, hia nigatsiweseha nanivquo tsigetsadasuya; tlesdiquo yanilosvsdisgesdi anadanvtesgv nasgi tsiduyugodi unadanvtediyi, unalisinahisdisgini gesesdi anadanvtesgvi, nasgiya nusdv gohiyudi gesv Unelanvhi dutliloelv anisiyvwihai.
english: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᏥᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᏛ ᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Utsatiyeno tsidegahitlewisv saquo ayelv gesvi, ale nagadv degahitlewisv utloyi nigesvna tsigi gohusdi gvtanidasdi gesvi;
english: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᎩᏣᏘ ᏥᎩ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏂᏓᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo ayv, igitsati tsigi, saquoquo ayelv nidalisdiha Galonedv dedanelodvi, ale nidiv idisiyvwiha igadudadewisv.
english: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ ᎡᎩᏁᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ [ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ;]
phonetic: Nasgino tsudalehnai eginelvnvhi tsigi nasgiya gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iginelvi, iyuno adolehohisdi yigi, nasgiya gohiyudi gesv egatliloelv idvdisgesdi [idadolehosgesdi;]
english: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎲᏉ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏕᏲᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Iyu ale idiyadohihesdi, idiyadohihvquo degilvwisdanehesdi; ale gilo dadeyohvsgesdi, dideyodiquo gesv dulvwisdanehesdi;
english: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏙᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ, ᏄᎨᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎧᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gilo digawonedisgi gesesdi, digawonedodiquo gesv dulvwisdanehesdi; ale gilo dayadohehesdi, nugeyuhvsgvna nasgi nadvnehesdi; gilo tsaganelodi gesesdi, osdv ugasayasdi gesesdi; gilo adadoligesdi, ukalisdi udanvdv nasgi nadvnehesdi.
english: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adageyudi gesv nutlonasdvna gesesdi.  Itsiniquatihesdi na uyo gesvi; detsiniyvsesdi osdv gesvi.
english: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᎾᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᎬᏫᏳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Analinvtli tsunadageyudi gesv gvdi osdv detsadageyusesdi; didalvquododi gesv itsvdisgv detsadagvwiyudisgesdi.
english: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Detsilvwisdanehv tlesdi itsadanulvdi yigesesdi; ulinigidv detsadanvtesdi; gohusdi etsadvnehesdi Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ; ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Udugi itsvsv itsaliheligesdi; ditsvnidiyu gesesdi itsigiliyogvi; itsadadolisdisgesdi nigohilvi;
english: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᏕᏥᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unadanvti uninigvsehv detsiyadohehesdi; itsigaliyiyu gesesdi ditsadasquanigododiyi.
english: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᏨᎿᎭᏕᎩ; ᎣᏍᏛᏉ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Osdv detsinetsehesdi uyo igetsvhnadegi; osdvquo detsinetsehesdi, ale tlesdi yiditsisginvdisgesdi.
english: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎾᏠᏱᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi na analiheligi itsulaha itsaliheligesdi, ale nasgi na dinatloyihi itsulaha detsatloyihesdi.
english: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏠᏱᎭᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏕᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏱᏣᏓᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Utloyihaquo gesesdi detsadadanvtesgvi.  Tlesdi yitsagasayasdesdi gohusdi galvquodi gesvi, detseladidohesdisgini unadadolisdi.  Tlesdi itsigatanai yitsadayelvsesdi.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏐᏅ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏁᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎢᎬᏱ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Usonv nitsvnehesdi gilo tlesdi yitsatlegesdi usonv yinetsvnehesdi.  Igvyi nitsadanvtesgesdi osdv itsadvnelidasdi gesv nigadv anigatahvi.
english: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Iyuno yeli gesesdi nigav igetsadvnedi gesv itsatlinigvnehesdi dohiyi itsadediyi naniv yvwi.
english: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏞᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, tlesdi yitsatlegesdi, itsilanvdadehesdisgini utalawohisdi gesvi; hiayeno nigvnv gowela, Atleisdi gesv ayv aquatseliga; ayv dagaguyvhi, adiha Yihowa.
english: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏣᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᏰᎶᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎤᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲ ᏥᏃᏍᎦ ᏧᏥᏍᏟ ᏕᎯᏡᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno tsasgagi agonu uyosisgesdi, hiyelohesdi; iyuno utadegisgesdi, hiuvsgesdi; nasgiyeno hnadvnehv tsinosga tsutsistli dehitlusgesdi asgoli.
english: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ ᏱᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎴᏍᏗ, ᎤᏐᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ ᎯᏯᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi usonv netsvnelv yitsadalinehidelesdi, usonvsgini netsvnelv hiyadalinehidehesdi osdv hnadvnehvi.
english: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏚᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ.  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏳᏙᏢᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᏕᎪᏢᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nanivquo dunohiyusesdi ayeli degotlvwadisvi.  Vtlayeno ayeli yudotlvha Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna; ayeli tsidegotlvha Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi digotlvnvhi.
english: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ, ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏩᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo dagatilegesdi ayeli gotlvsvi, dagatilegesdi Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi gotlvnvhi gesvi; nasgino dinigatilegi tsunadugodanediyi aniwadvdisgesdi.
english: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ.  ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᏣᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎪᏢᏒᎢ?  ᎣᏍᏛ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nunigvwiyusadegiyeno vtla diganayehisdi yigi osdv yidolvwisdaneha, uyosgini yidolvwisdaneha.  Tsadulisgono tsanayehisdiyi nigesvna ayeli gotlvsvi?  osdv hnadvnehesdi, nasgino tsalvquododi gesesdi.
english: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ [ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ] ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏙᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏱᎦᏁᎭ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏞᎩ, ᎠᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno [nugvwiyusadegi] Unelanvhi unvsidasdi nihi osdv itsalisdanedi tsulvwisdanehi.  Iyusgini uyoquo dotsalvwisdanehesdi, hisgaihesdi; vtlayeno aseno yiganeha ayelasdiganvhidv; Unelanvhiyeno unvsidasdi nasgi, utlegi, asdvdisdisgi nasgi na uyo tsulvwisdanehi.
english: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏦᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏎᎮᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ase itsohiyudi gesesdi, vtla udasdvdisdiquo gesv iyusdi, tsodanvdvsgini nasquo osehehv iyusdi.
english: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodisgesdi ayeli aguyvdi gesv itsaguyisgesdi; Unelanvhiyeno tsunvsidasdi nasgi, dunilvwisdaneha nigohilv nasgi hia.
english: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᏃᏔᏅᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nigadiyu diguyvedi gesv detsaguyvehesdi; ayeli etsaguyvedi gesv ayeli etsaguyvehesdi; itsinotanvdiyi itsalisgolvdanelv etsaguyvedi gesv etsaguyvehesdi; nasgi etsinayeisdi gesv nasgi na etsinayesgesdi; nasgi etsilvquododi gesv nasgi na etsilvquodesdi.
english: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᏚᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎧᎵᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo yitsidugesdi gohusdi, ditsadageyudiyi uwasv; giloyeno nvwadale yugeyuha ukalilv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi.
english: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ,] ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎬᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏙᏣᎸᏍᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi [dikahnawadvsdi,] Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi, tlesdi tsadalvgi, Tlesdi tsanosgisvgi, Tlesdi gayegogi tsanohelvgi, Tlesdi gohusdi yitsagvvsgesdi, ale nigav nvwadale dikahnawadvsdi, hiaquo igawedv tsigi nahna adotsalvsga usquala kaneisdi gesvi, Tsvsv nitsadageyusv nasgiya nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala.
english: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Adageyudi gesv vtla uyo yinuwaneho nav iyunadala; nasgi iyusdi adageyudi gesv akaliiha dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgvi.
english: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᏥᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏰᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏗᎵᎲ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᎠᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎪᎯᏳᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi, tsidigataha iyvdv aliyilisvi, nasgi nahiyu ayeisdiyi idilihv hnaquo uliyeilolv; gohiyeno egisdelvdiyi gesv utli navniyu ano igvyiyi digohiyunvi.
english: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎶᎦ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎩᏨᏂᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏛᎦ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏄᏬᏍᏓ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Svnoyi asqualoga, hnaquo ugitsvnidi; nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nidvga ulisigv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale idanuwosda alisgasdodo igagadv ehi.
english: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ, ᎢᎦ ᏂᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎾᏩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏛᏳᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Duyugodv gesesdi idehvi, iga nigeso nasgiyai; vtlasdino alisganawasdi gesvi, ale udayvsdesdi gesvi, ale udelidv dinisidi gesvi, ale nolisinahisdvna alenidasdi gesvi, vtlesdino adisvsdi gesvi ale didadvyutsedi gesvi.
english: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᏄᏬᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhisgini Tsisa Galonedv etsanuwosda, ale tlesdi yitsadvnvisdanelesdi uquedali gesvi, nasgi ugvvsgv itsadvnediyi.
english: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfill the lusts thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏗᏧᎪᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏕᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo wanagala gesesdi uwohiyusvi detsadanilvgesdi, vtla adina ditsugododiyiquo nusdv adanvdesgvi.
english: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏐᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᏛᏒᎥᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Asiyvwi nigavquo gohusdi gvwalisdayvdodi gesv uwohiyusoi; gilono awanagala advsvvsgiquo alisdayvdisgoi.
english: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᏳᏰᎸᏁᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ.
phonetic: Tlesdi nasgi na alisdayvhvsgi nvlisaliquo yuyelvnesdi na nalisdayvhvsgvna; ale tlesdi nasgi na nalisdayvhvsgvna yiduwugodanelesdi na alisdayvhvsgi; Unelanvhiyeno dudanilvtsv.
english: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ?  ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏙᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏅᎬᎢ.  ᎥᎥ, ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎤᎴᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Gago nihi tsidehiyugodane nvwadale unvsidasdi?  uwasvquo unvsidohi ulisgasdodi gadogv ale ganvgvi.  Vv, atsiyosdodanedi gesesdi unvisdiyi; Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo ulediyi igvwanedi.
english: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎸᏉᏙ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᎦ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᎦ ᏚᎸᏉᏙᎢ.  ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo utli nulvquodo gohusdi usdi iga esgaquo nvwadale iga; gilono nigavquo iga dulvquodoi.  Naniv gilo akalii unohiyusesdi unvsv dotsunadanvdvi.
english: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏧᎸᏉᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏓᏁᎰᎢ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᎰᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo tsulvquodo iga Ugvwiyuhi galvquodanehoi; gilono nulvquodvna tsigeso iga, Ugvwiyuhi galvquodisgo nulvquodvna gesvi.  Gilo tsalisdayvhvsgoi, Ugvwiyuhi alisdayvnanehoi; Unelanvhiyeno alihelitsehoi; ale gilo nalisdayvhvsgvna tsigesoi, Ugvwiyuhi galvquododisgo nalisdayvhvsgvna gesvi, ale Unelanvhi alihelitsehoi.
english: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏕᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gilo iganelagiya yigi idehvi, vtla ale gilo unelagiya yigi ayohusgvi.
english: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏓᎴᏂᏕᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏗᏲᎱᎯᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yidalenidoha, Ugvwiyuhi edalenideha; ale iyu yididiyohusga, Ugvwiyuhi ediyohuhiseha; nasgino iyusdi iyuno yidalenidoha, ale yididiyohusga, Ugvwiyuhi edatseliga.
english: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᎴᎯᏌᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏩᏃᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia ugvwale Galonedv tsuyohusei, ale tsidulehisanei, ale tsuwanosei, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi iyulisdodiyi tsuniyohusvhi ale nasquo dinvnodv unatseliga.
english: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏙᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎢᎯᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎦᎴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nihi, gadono dohiyugodaneha isdalinvtli?  ale nihi nasquo, gadono nvlisaliquo ihiyelvsga isdalinvtli?  nigadiyuyeno igvyiditlv wigaledi gesesdi Galonedv tsuwugododiyi uwesgilvi.
english: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᎨᎥ ᏄᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏙᏓᎬᏆᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎵ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv gowela, Gev nudohiyusvi, adiha Yihowa, nigadiyu dodagvqualiniquanvneli ayv, ale nigadiyu gvnigesv nvdagvwaneli Unelanvhi.
english: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏰᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi nidiv idisiyvwiha gesv gvnigesv iyedvnedi gesesdi Unelanvhi nigadvnelidolvi.
english: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gohi iyudalenvdv yididadadugodanehesdi; hiasgini ugvwiyusesdi detsugodisgesdi, nasgi adadodesdisgi ale ustlvnisdisgi itsidiyi nigesvna itsalinvtli ulohisdiyi.
english: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏗ ᎾᏋᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Tsigataha, ale aquohiyudi naquvnelv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi gohusdi uwasvquo gesv gadaha nigesvna gesvi; gilosgini gohusdi gadaha ayelvsgi, nasgi gadaha nulisdanehoi.
english: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲᎢ.  ᏞᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᏛᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Iyusgini disdadanvtli alisdayvdi yinvdigalisdodiha ehisdi yiyadanvdadistanv, hnaquo vtla adageyudi gesv yvdiha nasgi hnadvnehvi.  Tlesdi halisdayvhvsgv hidvdotanvgi nasgi na Galonedv uyohuhiselvhi.
english: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino tlesdi osiyu nitsadvnehv usonv yuninohelesdi.
english: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎩ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno utseligohi vtla alisdayvdiquo ale aditasdiquo gesv yigi; duyugodvsgini gesvi, ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, ale alihelisdi gesvi galvquodiyu Adanvdo iyuwanisadv.
english: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏮᏗᏕᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎦᎬᏩᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Giloyeno nasgi hia uwvdidegv Galonedv gohusdi advnehesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi gesesdi, ale osiyu gagvwayelvdi gesesdi yvwi.
english: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎦᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idisdawadisesdi nasgi dohi igvnehi gesvi, ale nasgi digegadalinigohisdodi gesvi.
english: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏣᏲᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᏍᏗ.  ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᎪᏕᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tlesdi Unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv yitsayostanesdi alisdayvdiquo yinvtsulisdotanesdi.  Nudalesvyeno gohusdi udohiyuhi gadaha nigesvna; uyosgini nadvneho nasgi na yvwi alisdayvhvsgv gilo yidigodesdiha.
english: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟ ᎤᏏᏳ ᎭᏫᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏧᏬᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Utli usiyu hawiya agisdiyi nigesvna, ale gigageaditasdi aditasdiyi nigesvna, ale gohusdi advnediyi nigesvna, nasgi disdadanvtli tsuwodesdisgi, ale ustlvnisdisgi, ale awanagala iyuwanehi.
english: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏒ ᏤᎭ?  ᏣᏤᎵᏛ ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gohiyudisgo gesv tseha?  tsatselidv tsohiyusesdi Unelanvhi agatahvi.  Nvwadohisdv udanvtesdi gilo nusdv osiyu uyelvsv gvdisgv uwasv nidadadugodanehvna igesesdi.
english: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏢᏫᏎᎯ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏳᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini tsutlvwisehi degugodisgo usganvtsv iyuno yulisdayvnv, nvdigalisdodisgo nuwohiyusvna gesv alisdayvhvsgvi; nigavyeno gohusdi gohiyudi gesv nvdidalehvsgvna yigi asgani gesoi.
english: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏗᏕᎵᏎᎭ ᏓᏂᏩᎾᎦᎸ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏒᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᎨᏓᏛᏁᎵᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Ayvno digalinigidv tsigi unelagi yidideliseha daniwanagalv diniwanagalai, ale vtla igvsvquo osdv igiyelvdi yinigedadvnelidoha.
english: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎢᎦᏓᎳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nidiv idisiyvwiha gesv nav igadala osdv uyelvdi gesv nidadvnehesdi nasgi osdv gesv ulinigohisdiyi ugvwali.
english: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎮᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ,] ᎦᎬᏩᎾᏓᏐᏢᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎨᏣᏐᏢᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno nasquo vtla uwasvquo osiyu uyelvdi yinadvnehei; Hiasgini tsinigvnv tsigowela nasgiya [nulisdanelei,] gagvwanadasotlvdv nasgi na gagetsasotlvtanvi ayv agilutselvgi.
english: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏘ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸᏎ ᎪᏪᎳᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nudalesvyeno gohusdi eti gowelanvhi gesv ayv igadeloquasdi ayelvse gowelanei, nasgi didvnidiyu nigvnehv ale ugalisdi igadanvdadisdisgv goweli nasgi udugi igvhi iyulisdodiyi.
english: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgino Unelanvhi agvnidiyu ale ugalisdi iyadadvnehi itsinedi gesesdi utloyiquo itsadanvdadisdiyi, nasgiya Galonedv Tsisa adanvtesgvi;
english: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏥᎰᎵ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi saquo detsadanvdvi ale saquo itsiholi itsvdodiyi etsilvquododiyi Unelanvhi nasgi na Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
english: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi detsadadanilvgesdiquo, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv degadanilvtsv ayv, nasgi galvquodiyu iyagvnediyi Unelanvhi.
english: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏧᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nitsiweha, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv digetsiusdeselvhi uninvsidasdi nulistanvgi gvnigesv iyuwanediyi gayegogi nigesvna gesv Unelanvhi, tsusdayidisdiyi getsiduisdanelvhi gesv anigayvligei.
english: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᎬᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏥᏃᎩᏍᏔᏂ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi unilvquododiyi Unelanvhi udadolisdiyu gesv iyusdi; nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi iyusdi dagvneistani anehv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, ale dodatsinogistani detsadovi.
english: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᏗᏣᎵᎪᎲᏏ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Talineno hia nigaweha, Itsaliheligi ditsadalenvdv yvwi, ditsaligohvsi tsutseli yvwi.
english: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ ᏱᎰᏩ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ, ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Talineno, Etsilvquoda Yihowa, nigadiyu ditsadalenvdv yvwi; ale etsilvquoda, nitsivquo yvwi.
english: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎢᏌᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎤᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᏤᏏᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏙᏛᎴᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᎬᏩᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Talineno Isaya hia nigaweha; Uhnasdetlv gananugogesdi Tsesiyi, ale asiyvwi dodvleni ugvwiyusadegi iyulisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi; nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi dagvwalisgasdotani.
english: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino Unelanvhi udugi gvdi gesv adanehi itsikaliisdi gesesdi nudalesv ulihelisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv gesv itsohiyusv iyuwanisadv, nasgi utsatanvhi iyulisdodiyi udugi itsvsvi, galvquodiyu Adanvdo ulinigvgv iyuwanisadv.
english: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎥᎢ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale aquvsv nasquo aquohiyuha nihi itsvyadanvtesgvi, idalinvtli, nasgi nihi nasquo osdv gesv itsikalii gesvi, ale nudalesv agadovhisdigesv itsikalivi, yeliquo nasquo digetsadagvsgolvdi gesvi.
english: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno idalinvtli, utli igai nitsinayesgvna witsvyowelasi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi, nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi aginelv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi,
english: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Nasgi Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidohi iyaqualisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi, galvquodiyu dagilvwisdanehv osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga gvdisgvi, nasgi galisgolvdisgv tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalisgolvdisgvi tsudanilvisdi iyulisdodiyi, galvquodiyu iyuwanelvhi galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᏆᏢᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi agiha aquatlvquododi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, nasgi nahna Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali gesvi.
english: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Vtlayeno yeli yvgatsineisda nasgi Galonedv nudvnelvna gesv ayv aquvdisgvi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi gvwanohiyudi nidegvnehvi, kanohedv ale digalvwisdanedi gesv gvdisgvi,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎠᎴ] ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ ᎢᎵᎵᎦᎻ ᏩᏍᏗ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: [Ale] gvdisgv uyelvdvi ale usquanigodi, Unelanvhi Udanvdo ulinigidiyu gesv gvdisgvi; nasgi Tsilusilimi udalenvdv, ale uduwidv Ililigami wasdi, ukalitsvhi aqualitsidonv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga;
english: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎤᏅᎯ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᏆᏁᏍᎨᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Nasgino nusdvgi aquatlinigvnelvgi osdv kanohedv aqualitsidodiyi, vtla nahna Galonedv atsineistanvi, gilo unvhi gagusdvdi aquanesgesdiyi nigesvna;
english: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏂᎪᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏃᎵᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgiyasgini hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi getsineisdanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi dvnigohi; ale nasgi na unadvganvhi nigesvna gesv nasgi dvnolitsi.
english: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏏ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha utsati tsudalenvdv agiyosdodasi witsvlutsediyi;
english: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏄᏜᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏚᏫᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏅᏆᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gohisgini hnaquo ilvhitlv nudlanvdvna tsigi ani uduwidv, ale ilvsgi nadetiyv utsati tsinvquadulisgo witsvlutsediyi;
english: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏍᏆᏂᏱ ᎨᏒᎭ, ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏥᎦᏖᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏗᏢ ᏫᏍᎩᏯᎪᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎾᎩᏰᎸᏁᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno Squaniyi gesvha, witsvlutsedi gesesdi; udugiyeno aquvha itsvgowadvdiyi nahna witsigatesdi, ale nahna iditlv wisgiyagodiyi, iyuno igvyi alequo yeli nagiyelvnesdi itsvyeladidolvi.
english: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏇᏏᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Gohisgini tsigi aquesidi Tsilusilimi gatsisdelvhi unadanvti.
english: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏗᏱ ᏅᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Osiyuyeno uniyelvnv Masidoni ale Egaya anehi gohusdi unidiyi nvyo iyunadvhnadegi unadanvti Tsilusilimi anehi unalisdelvdodi.
english: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏚᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Osiyu uniyelvnv udohiyuhi; ale nasgi gvwaniduga.  Iyuyeno tsunadalenvdv yvwi uneladistanvhi yigi nasgi unatseli tsudalenvdv adanvdo ulisdelvdodi ugvwali, iyunadvnedi nasquo nunalisdanehvgi nasgi tsunisdelvdiyi uquedali ulisdelvdodi ugvwali.
english: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏍᏆᏛᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ, ᏫᏨᎶᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏂᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏖᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi hnaquo nasgi hia tsisquadvha, ale nudlasidvsvna nigatsiyvnelv unigowadvdiyi, hia nasgi udatanvhi, witsvloisdanedi gesesdi Squaniyi witsigatesdi.
english: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale tsigataha, nasgi hnaquo witsvlutselvha nigav osdv udanedi gesv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga tsiyehesdi witsvlutsedi gesesdi.
english: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎪᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
phonetic: Ale itsvsdiyediha idalinvtli, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nvdigalisdodiha, ale nvdigalisdodiha adageyudi gesv Adanvdo udanedi gesvi, nasgi sgiyaligonediyi Unelanvhi edadadolisdanehv ayv gesv ugvwali,
english: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏯᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏴᎡᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Nasgi gatsiyadudalaediyi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna Tsudiyi anehi; ale nasgi gatsiyvehv Tsilusilimi anehi, tsunadanilvisdiyiquo unadanvti;
english: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏗᎩᎦᎵᏍᏙᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ayv osiyu uyelvnvhi Unelanvhi, ulihelisdi aquadanvdv witsvlutsediyi, ale itsulaha nihi digigalisdohisdiyi.
english: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
phonetic: Unelanvhino nvwadohiyadv adanehi nitsiv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎣᎩᏙ ᏈᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎡᏟᏯ;
phonetic: Gvnigesv nitsvyvneha ogido Quigi, nasgi ayadohihi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Etliya;
english: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsetsadanilvisdiyi Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdayulisdodiyi, nasgiya tsiduyugodi iyunadvnediyi unadanvti, ale nasgi etsisdelvdiyi nigavquo gohusdi etsisdelvdiyi udulisgvi; nasgiyeno unitsati tsusdelvdv, ale ayv nasquo agisdelvdv.
english: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Detsiyolilvha Quisila ale Equila, itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Galonedv utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏅ ᎠᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏂᏴᏤᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᏂᏅᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi ayv gvnv anisdelisgvi, unvsv diniyvtseni eladi duninvnv; nasgi, vtla aquvsvquo yigatsiyalielitseha, nasquosgini nigadv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi;
english: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏈᏂᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨᎯ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo detsiyolilvha tsunanelodi unadatlugv nahna aninelvi.  Etsiyolilvha utsati tsigeyui Iquinida, nasgi igvyiyi ugadvnatsvhi tsinigalisdiha Egaya Galonedv alisgolvdanedi.
english: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎺᎵ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Meli etsiyolilvha, utsati tsulvwisdanelvhi tsigi ayv ogisdelisgvi.
english: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏠᏂᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏯ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ.
phonetic: Vtloniga ale Tsuniya detsiyolilvha, nasgi gohusdi diquvnv, ale itsulaha tsogiyvginvhi, nasgi getsilvquodi tsigi getsinvsidv anehvi; nasgi nasquo igvyi Galonedv tsunanelodi iyunalistanvhi ayv oni.
english: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎻᏟᏯ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Amitliya etsiyolilvha, nasgi tsigeyui itsulaha osdohiyuhvsgi Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏇᏂ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏍᏕᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Aqueni etsiyolilvha itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Galonedv utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi; ale Sdegi tsigeyui.
english: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏇᎵ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎡᎵᏍᏓᏊᎳ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Aqueli etsiyolilvha, tsagadanilvtsvhi Galonedv gohiyuhvsgi gesvi.  Elisdaquula dudatinav anela detsiyolilvha.
english: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᏓᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏅ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ. ᎾᏏᏌ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Elodani gohusdi aquvnv etsiyolilvha. Nasisa dudatinav nasgi Ugvwiyuhi anohiyuhvsgi gesv detsiyolilvha.
english: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏜᏓᏈᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏜᏓᏉᏏ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏆᏏ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Dlaquina ale Dlaquosi detsiyolilvha, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utseli tsunilvwisdanehi tsigi.  Etsiyolilvha atsigeyui Quasi, utsati tsulvwisdanelvhi tsigi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga.
english: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎷᏆ ᎡᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏂᏥ.
phonetic: Luqua etsiyolilvha, nasgi agasuyedv Ugvwiyuhi gohiyuhvsgi, ale nasgi oginitsi.
english: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎠᏏᏂᏟᏓ, ᏈᎵᎦᏂ, ᎭᎹᏏ, ᏆᏠᏆᏏ, ᎭᎻᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Detsiyolilvha Asinitlida, Quiligani, Hamasi, Quatloquasi, Hamisi, ale analinvtli nasgi itsulaha tsaneha.
english: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏆᎶᎳᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᎠ, ᏂᎵᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎵᎻᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Detsiyolilvha Qualolaga, ale Tsulia, Nilia, ale nasgi udo, ale Olimiqua, ale nanivquo unadanvti nasgi itsulaha tsaneha.
english: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Itsvsv gesv detsadayolihesdi itsvdisgesdi galvquodiyu didadowedovhisdi gesvi.  Tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Galonedv tsutseliga wigetsiyoliha.
english: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏗᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎿᎭᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᏗᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᎶᏆᎥᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Alewo idalinvtli, itsvsdiyediha ditsagasayasdodiyi digalenvdiyi ale udahnasqualosdiyi iyanvnehi, digatilvsdiyi dideyonvhi gesv nusdv itsadeloquavi; ale detsadanvehesdi.
english: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎪ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎾᏁᏯᏔᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyunasdi vtla Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv gohusdi yanadvneha, unvsvquosgini unisquoliyi; ale uwoduhi ale osdv gawonihisdi gesv anvdisgvi danilonuhesgo tsuninawi naneyatahvna.
english: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏨ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ.
phonetic: Itsohiyusvyeno dunotsalotsv naniv yvwi anehvi.  Nasgi iyusdi galiheliga nihi gesv nvdigalisdodiha; asesgininonv aquaduliha itsigatanai itsalisdodiyi osdv gesv ugvwali, ano uyo gesv ugvwali nitsigatanavna.
english: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏪᏓᏫᏙᏗ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏂ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi nvwadohiyadv adanehi nigohilvnaquo Sedani uwedawidodi nvdagalisdani ditsalasideni hawiniditlv.  Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv.
english: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎷᏏᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏏᏇᏓ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏋᏅ, ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Dimadi itsulaha tsoginilvwisdanehi, ale Lusiya, ale Tsesani, ale Sosiqueda gohusdi diquvnv, wigetsiyoliga.
english: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏓᏏᏯ, ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᏆᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ayv dasiya, hia goweli aquawelanvhi witsvyoliga Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdigalisdodiha.
english: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ.  ᎢᎳᏍᏓ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎯ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᎲ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏉᏓ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Gaya agisquanigodisgi ale nanivquo tsunanelodi unadatlugv disquanigodisgi, witsiyoliga.  Ilasda, ayeli ehi gaduhv ahv agatiya, witsiyoliga, ale Quoda, idalinvtli.
english: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadosdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᎵᏥᏙᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏕᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino yeliquo ditsalinigohisdodi tsigi nasgiya nigawesgv osdv kanohedv aquatseliga, ale nasgiya Tsisa Galonedv agalitsidonvi, nasgiya gvnigesv igvnelvhi gesv udelidv, nasgi elohi tsudalenvhv nvdagvwadalenvdv adelistanvhi tsigesei,
english: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ^
phonetic: Gohisgini hnaquo gvnigesv igvnelvhi, ale anadolehosgi tsunowelanvhi digvtanvhi nasgiya adanvtesgv alisquadisgi nigesvna ehi Unelanvhi gvnigesv igegvlvhi nigadiyu tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv unohiyudiyi ugvwali^
english: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi uwasvhiyu agatanai tsigi, galvquododi gesesdi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏍᏗᏂ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ,
phonetic: Quola, aquasuyedv aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgiya Unelanvhi udanvtelvi, ale Sosdini iginvtli,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Golinidiyi tsitsadatluga, nasgi itsisgana nigesvna iyetsvnelvhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, etsiyanvdv itsadanvti, ale naniv nigav degesadisv Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi dudov anineisdisgi, nasgi itsulaquo nasgi unatseliga ale ayv igatseliga;
english: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Itsatseli gesesdi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itsalisgolvtanelvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nigohilv tsiyalielitseho Unelanvhi aquatseliga, nihi gesv iyusdi, nvdigalisdodisgo gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv etsinelvhi tsigi.
english: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᎢ^ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏕᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsenvistanvhi tsigi nigav nudalesvi^nigav dideyodi gesv ale nigav adedovhisdi gesvi;
english: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgiya Galonedv atsinohelv gagohiyudi netsvnelvi;
english: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏦᎭᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᏅ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏥᎦᏖᏃᎲ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgi esga nitsohasgvna gesv sudalegi unv gvwagatiya udalisgolvdanedi gesvi; itsigatenohv uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv;
english: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏓᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo tsvdatsalinigohistani ulisquadisdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi gayetsuisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nahiyu iga gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
english: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi nudalidasdvna, nasgi itsiyanvdv tsigi itsaligodiyi nasgi Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
english: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᎭ ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏚᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino idalinvtli itsvtayoseha dudov gvdiha Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi utloyiha itsineisdiyi, ale ditsagalenvdisgi nitsehvna iyulisdodiyi; ukalitsvhiquosgini ditsadudododiyi utloyiquo itsadanvtelidohvi, ale utloyiquo detsugodisgvi.
english: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎩᏃᏁᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏠᎢ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Vginonelvhiyeno igi idalinvtli nihi etsinohesgvi, nasgi Tloi dudatinav getsinohesgvi, nasgi ditsiyosdi gesv itsehvi.
english: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏯᎵᎪᏁᎯ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎠᏉᎳ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏏᏆᏏ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nitsiweha, nasgi itsisiyvwiha gesv hia nitsiwesgvi, ayv Quola tsiyaligonehi; ayvno Aquola; ayvno Siquasi; ayvno Galonedv.
english: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᎢᏯᏥᏛᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ?  ᏉᎳᏍᎪ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏁ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ?  ᎠᎴᏍᎪ ᏉᎳ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏕᏣᏬᏍᏔᏁᎢ?
phonetic: Ilvsgisgo iyatsidvhi Galonedv?  Quolasgo dadahnawasdv agadvne itsisdelvdiyi?  alesgo Quola dudov detsawostanei?
english: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏥᏯᏬᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏟᏍᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏯ ᎤᏅᏒ;
phonetic: Unelanvhi tsiyalielitseha nigalisdodiha nasgi itsehv gilo nitsiyawovna gesv Tlisqua ale Gaya unvsv;
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ, ᏱᎬᏉᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Giloyeno uwasvquo dudov dadawosdiha, yigvquoseha.
english: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏬᎥᎩ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏆᏅᏔ ᏥᏯᏬᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Sdiquena dudatinav degatsiyawovgi; nvwadaleno vtla yiquanvta tsiyawovi.
english: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏅᏎ ᏗᏆᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno vtla yiginvse diquadawosdiyi, aqualitsidodiyisgini osdv kanohedv; vtla alisinahisdi gesv gawonihisdiyi aquvdodiyi, Galonedvyeno utseli tsudahnawadv asequoquo yinvgalisda.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Dadahnawasdvyeno kanohedi gesv alisganedv uniyelvha nasgi na tsuniyohuhisdi tsigi; ayvsgini egisdelvdi tsigi Unelanvhi ulinigvgv igiyelvhi.
english: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎦᏪᎳ, ᏓᏥᏛᏔᏂ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏒ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv igawela, datsidvtani anisinasv anisinasani, ale asequo nvdagatsiyvneli aneyatahi aneyatahvi.
english: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏢ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ?  ᎭᏢ ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ?  ᎭᏢ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏗᏒᎯᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉ ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎡᎶᎯ?
phonetic: Hatlv asinasani?  hatlv digowelisgi?  hatlv gawonisgv adisvhihi ani elohi ehi?  tlasgo Unelanvhi alisganedvquo yinuwanelv asinasanv elohi?
english: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏂᏌᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno asinasaniyu gesv tsinuwanisane elohi anisinasanv anvdisgv Unelanvhi nigvwagatahvna tsigesei, Unelanvhi osi uyelvne alisganedv alitsidodi gesv uwvdodiyi tsusdelvdiyi anohiyuhvsgi.
english: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎭ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ;
phonetic: Anitsusiyeno uyelvdv anitayohiha, Anigoino asinasaniyu gesv uniyoha;
english: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᏃᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Ayvsgini Galonedv dadahnawasdv agadvnvhi otsalitsidohvsga, nasgi Anitsusi tsunodesdisgi, Anigoino alisganedv uniyelvhi;
english: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgini getsiyanvdv tsigi, itsulaquo Anitsusi ale Anigoi, Galonedv Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv ale asinasaniyu gesv uniyelvhi.
english: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏟ ᎾᏏᎾᎯ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏟ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏴᏫ.
