syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏢᏔᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏴᎨᏤᎵᏏ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎲ ᏔᎵ ᎾᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏰᏣᏗᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla gohusdi usdi adagoliyesgi itsatlvtahvhi yigi nanivquo yvwi igvwalisdanedi uwasv; ale Unelanvhi nudalidasdvna, nasgi vtla unelagi yvgetselisi adagoliyesgi itsilutsediyi detsalinigvgv ulosvsdodiyi; nasgisgini adagoliyesgi itsilutsehv tali nadvdesdi nahna gayetsadiwisedi gesvi, nasgi yeli getsadalinehidisdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏣᎵᏘ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, nihi itsvgeyui, itsaliti itsadanvsi Unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanedi gesvi.
english: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏁᎦ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏥᎦᏥᏁᏤᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsinega anigatanai tsigatsinetseho nasgiyai; itsigoliya nitsiwesgvi.
english: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏗᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᏓᏗᏔᏍᎬᎢ?  ᎦᏚ ᏥᏗᎬᎭᎷᏯᏍᎪᎢ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi na galvquododi ulisquidi, nasgi tsidilvquodisgoi, tlasgo nasgi idaligohvsgv yigi Galonedv ugigv idaditasgvi?  Gadu tsidigvhaluyasgoi, tlasgo nasgi idaligohvsgv yigi Galonedv ayelv idalisdayvdisgvi?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎢᎩᏣᏘ ᏥᎩ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ; ᏂᏗᎥᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᏖᏆᎶᏐ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏚ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno igitsati tsigi, saquoquo gadu, ale saquoquo ayelvi; nidivyeno igatequaloso nasgi saquo gadu idalisdayvdisgvi.
english: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏣᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Ditsakanvga Isili nasgi uquedaliquo gesvi; tlasgo nasgi na dilisgolvtanvhi tsanalisdayvdisgo uneladisdisgi yigeso atsilv gelasdiyi alisgolvtanvhi?
english: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the alter?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎦᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎦᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Gadono gadiha?  tsigo unelanvhi ayelvhi gohusdi gadiha?  tsigoge nasgi na alisgolvtanvhi atsilv gelasdanedi unelanvhi ayelvhi gohusdi, gadiha?
english: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᏣᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiasgini nitsiweha, nasgi na tsunadalenvdv yvwi atsilv gelasdodi tsanalisgolvdisgoi, anisgina danalisgolvtanehoi, vtlano Unelanvhi; vtlano yaquaduliha anisgina unatseli gesv itseladisdodiyi.
english: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎨᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ.  ᎥᏝ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏂᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla Getsaditasdi yigi atlisdv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, ale nasquo anisgina unatseli atlisdvi.  Vtla getsalisdayvdi yigi Ugvwiyuhi uwesgilv, ale nasquo anisgina unisgilvi.
english: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏗᎿᎭᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ?  ᎤᏟᏍᎪ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏂᎬᎦ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Edihnalvsdisgesdisgo Ugvwiyuhi?  utlisgo nidegalinigvga esgaquo nasgi?
english: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎥᏇᎵᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎥᏇᎵᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nudalesvquo gohusdi unelagi vqueliselvhi aqualisdayvdiyi, aseno vtla nudalesv gohusdi osiyu iyadadvnehi yigi; nudalesvquo gohusdi unelagi vqueliselvhi aqualisdayvdodiyi, aseno vtla nudalesv gohusdi gvwadasdelvdi yigi.
english: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏳᏲᎮᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏲᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo uwasvquo utseli yuyohesdi, nvwadalesgini utseli uyohesdi.
english: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigav gohusdi aninodisgv ganododiyi, itsigisgesdi, ale tlasdi gohusdi yitsadvdvhvsgesdi adanvdogi gesv yinvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᎭ.
phonetic: Elohiyeno Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, ale nasgi na elohi tsakaliiha.
english: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᏣᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎡᏥᏝᏁᎲ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nunohiyusvna gesv igetsayanisgesdi, ale itsadulisgesdi itsenvsdiyi; nusdvquo gohusdi igvyiditlv etsitlanehv itsalisdayvdisgesdi, ale tlesdi gohusdi yitsadvdvhvsgesdi, adanvdogi gesv yinvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᎨᎴᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎡᎶᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᎭ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gilo hia nitsiwesehesdi, hia nasgi alisgolvtanvhi atsilv digeledi Unelanvhi diyelvhi, tlesdi yitsigisgesdi, nvdigalisdodisgesdi nasgi na unanugowisvhi gesvi, ale adanvdogi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi; elohiyeno Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, ale nasgi na elohi tsakaliiha.
english: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏨᏒ ᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ, ᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩ; ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᎲ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Adanvdogi gesv gadiha, vtla adina tsvsv tsadanvdogi, soisgini udanvdogi; gadoyeno galisdodi ayv iyaquadvnedi agihv nvwadale udanvdo tsuwugododi yinigalisdiha?
english: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎾᏲ ᎥᎩᏃᎮᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno alihelisdi gesv gvdi yigalisdayvhvsga, gadono nayo vginoheha nvdigalisdodi nasgi na ugvwali tsigalieliga?
english: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno itsalisdayvhvsgesdi, ale itsaditasgesdi, ale nigav gohusdi nitsadvnehesdi, Unelanvhi ulvquodisgi gesesdi nigav nitsadvnehvi.
english: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎥᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Tlesdi tsunodesdisgi yinitsalistanesdi nasquo Anitsusi ale tsunadaledv yvwi, ale unadatlugv tsunanelodi Unelavhi utseliga;
english: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᏥᏯᏛᏁᎰᎢ, ᎾᎩᏲᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎩᏙᏗ, ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo ayv, nigav nigadvnehv nanivquo osdv uniyelvdi tsinigatsiyadvnehoi, nagiyohvna tsigeso aquvsvquo aqualisdegidodi, unitsatisgini unalisdelvdodi nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi getsisdelvdiyi.
english: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv sgisdawadegi gesesdi, nasgiya ayv nasquo Galonedv tsisdawadegi tsigi.
english: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏨᏲᎯᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ka, idalinvtli, itsvlvquodiha nasgi ayv nigav tsudalenvdv nitsadvnehv sgiyanvdadisgvi, ale itsisquanigodisgv dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya detsvyohiselvi.
english: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏚᎵ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale aquaduli itsigadovhisdiyi, nasgi naniv anisgaya gesv Galonedv asgoli gesvi; ageyvno gesv asgoli asgaya gesvi; Galonedvno gesv Unelanvhi asgoli gesvi.
english: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ, ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏚᎵ, ᎠᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo anisgaya gesv yadadolisdiha ale yadolehosga, gvwalisduli, adehohisdisgo asgoli gesvi.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ ᏄᎵᏍᏚᎸᎾ, ᎠᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏧᎵᏍᏙᏴᎰᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gilosgini anigeyv gesv yadadolisdiha ale yadolehosga nulisdulvna, adehohisdisgo asgoli gesvi; tsulisdoyvhoquoyeno itsulaha nasgi.
english: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏄᎵᏍᏚᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᏍᏙᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏗᎵᏍᏙᏰᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏙᏰᏗ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏰᏗᏱ, ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏚᎴᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno ageyv nulisdulvna yigi, nasquo atsisdoyesgesdi; iyusgini udehohisdiyu yigi ageyv dilisdoyedi ale alisdoyedi uwvdodiyi ulisdoyediyi, gvwalisdulesdiquo.
english: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᎵᏍᏚᎸᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏄᏬᏍᏗ; ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Asgayasgini udohiyuhi vtla yigvlisdulvsga, nasgi Unelanvhi nasgiya tsigi, ale nasgi galvquodiyu gesv tsunuwosdi; ageyvsgini asgaya galvquodiyu gesv unuwosdi.
english: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎨᏴᎯ ᏴᏧᏓᎴᏁ ᎠᎪᏢᏅ; ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏲᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏁ ᎠᎪᏢᏅ.
phonetic: Asgayayeno vtla ageyvhi yvtsudalene agotlvnv; ageyvsgini asgayohi tsudalene agotlvnv.
english: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏯᎪᏢᎾᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎪᏢᎾᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo asgaya vtla ageyv yagotlvnanelei, ageyvsgini asgaya agotlvnanelei.
english: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᏳᏭᏢᏗ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ageyv galvquodiyu iyuwanehi yuwutlvdi asgoli nasgi getsinvsidv gesv yinvdigalisdodiha.
english: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎨᏴ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏰᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏰᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏄᏩᎾᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv vtla asgaya nigeyv tali nudvdvna yeha, vtla ale ageyv asgaya tali nudvdvna yeha nasgi Ugvwiyuhi nuwananvi.
english: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᏍᎦᏲᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno ageyv asgayohi nvdayudalenvhi tsigi, nasgiya nasquo asgaya ageyv unanugowisvhi; aseno nigadiyu tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi gesv nvdayudalenvhi.
english: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of god.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏧᎪᏓ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁ ᏄᎵᏍᏚᎸᎾ?
phonetic: Ditsugoda itsvsv gesvi; ulilohvsgasgo ageyv Unelanvhi yadadolisdane nulisdulvna?
english: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᏱᏤᏲᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᏯ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏳᏍᏘᏰᎦ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo itsvsv itsigatahv yitseyohvsga, nasgi asduya ganvhidv yustiyega udehohisdiyu gesvi?
english: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏳᏍᏘᏰᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎤᏍᏘᏰᎬᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᏁᎸ ᎤᎦᏢᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Ageyvsgini ganvhidv yustiyega galvquodiyu iyuwanehi gesoi; ustiyegvyeno atsinelv ugatlvdodi.
english: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏗᏒᏌᏘ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ; ^ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᏲᎩᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gilo udisvsati yinvwasdi; ^ayv vtla nasgi iyogadvnedi yogiha, vtla ale nasquo tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Unelanvhi tsutseliga.
english: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎲ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᏦᎯᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏲᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Hiasginino nitsvwesehv vtla yitsvlvquodiha, nasgi detsilawitsohihv vtla osdv iyulisdodi yigesoi, uyoquosgini.
english: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏛᎩᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎦᏛ.
phonetic: Igvyiyiyeno gesv detsilawigi itsadatlugv ilvsgi nitsadadisgv gadvgiha; ale goiyuhvsgaquo igadv.
english: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Aseyeno ilvsgi itsadadisdi nihi nitsadvnvi, nasgi osiyu getsiyelvnvhi gvnigesv iyunalisdodiyi nihi nitsadvnvi.
english: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏢᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Detsilawigiyeno ilvhitlvi, vtla Ugvwiyuhi utseli alisdayvdi yitsalisdayvnihoi.
english: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏗᏴᎲᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎠᎪᏄ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎪᎢ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Itsalisdiyvhvsgvyeno itsisiyvwiha gesv igvyi itsigisgo itsvsv itsatseliga; asiyvwino agonu uyosisgoi, nvwadaleno uyvsdesgoi.
english: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪᏃ ᏱᏗᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏔᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎢᏥᏐᏢᏗᎭ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᏄᏂᎲᎾ?  ᎦᏙ ᏓᏨᏲᏎᎵ?  ᏓᏨᎸᏉᏔᏂᏧ?  ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏛᏁᎲ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏨᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Tlasgono yiditsinelv nahna itsalisdayvdiyi ale itaditasdiyi?  tsigoge itsisotlvdiha tsunanelodi unadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale detsadehohisdiha nunihvna?  gado datsvyoseli?  datsvlvquotanitsu?  hia nitsvdvnehv vtla yitsvlvquodiha.
english: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᏨᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ, ᎦᏚ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhiyeno dagiyohiselvgi nasgi nasquo tsidetsvyohiselvgi, nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nahiyu svnoyi atsilonuelv, gadu ugisei;
english: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ, ᎤᎬᎭᎷᏰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᎦ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᎬᎭᎷᏰᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino ulihelitsv, ugvhaluyei, ale hia nuwesei, Itsigi, itsiga; hia nasgi ayv tsiyelvi, nihi nasgi itsaligvhaluyelvhi tsigi; hia nasgi nitsadvnehesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgvi.
english: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ, ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎩᎬ ᏨᏛᏍᏓᏱᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nudvnele unalisdayvnonv, ulisquidi ugisei, hia nuwesei; Hia nasgi itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, ayv agigigv tsvdvsdayidi; hia nasgi nitsadvnehesdi, iyusdiha nasgi itsaditasgesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgvi.
english: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Iyusdihayeno hia nasgi gadu itsigisgesdi, ale hia nasgi ulisquidi itsaditasgesdi, gvnigesv nitsvnehesdi Ugvwiyuhi uyohusvi, gvni galutsvha.
english: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, gilo niduyugodvna nadvnehesdi agisgesdi hia gadu, ale aditasgesdi hia ulisquidi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, asganvtsehesdi ayelv ale ugigv Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ.
phonetic: Uwasvsgini adagoliyesgesdi yvwi, gilano hnaquo agisgesdi nasgi gadu, ale aditasgesdi nasgi ulisquidi.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno niduyugodvna nadvnehesdi agisgesdi ale aditasgesdi, nasgi agisgesdi ale aditasgesdi tsuwugodanehi uwasv usganvtsvi, nagowatisgvna gesv Ugvwiyuhi ayelvi.
english: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏢᏥᏰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎠᏂᎵᎾᎠ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha unitsata getsadasuya diniwanagala ale tsunitlvtsiyesgi, ale yeli unitsata anilinaa.
english: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏒ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏰᎫᎪᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno igvsv yididadadugodaneha, vtla yidogayegugodasi.
english: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏏᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏕᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Degugodasisgini Ugvwiyuhi igigiliyoisdisgo nasgi elohi unisganvtsv degegugodanehv igatloyasdodiyi nigesvna.
english: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ, ᏕᏣᏓᎦᏘᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi, idalinvtli, iyuno detsilawigesdi itsalisdayvdiyi, detsadagatidisgesdi.
english: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎾ ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏪᏅᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᏭᏃᏒᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyu gilo agona uyosisgesdi, tsuwenvsv alisdayvhvsgesdi; nasgi detsilawigi itsisganvtsv ditsugodanehiquo iyulisdodiyi nigesvna.  Wunosvno osdv nigvnelvha witsilutsvha.
english: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏱᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Nano adanvdo ulisgolvtanvhi ugvwali, idalinvtli, vtla nanigatahvna gesesdi, yitsvyeliseha.
english: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏥᏕᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᎨᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏕᏣᏘᏂᏙᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Itsigataha nasgi nitsigatanavna tsigesvgi, tsidetsisdawadisvgi hia nasgi tsunvgewi unelanvhi diyelvhi nasgiya tsidetsatinidohvgi.
english: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎬᏗ ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ, ᏥᏌ ᎠᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎬᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏴᎬᏛ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᎬᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi itsvnoheheha, nasgi gilo Unelanvhi Udanvdo yigvdi yigawoniha, Tsisa atsisginvdvhi vtla yeli yvgvdv; vtla ale gilo Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi yvgvdv, gvni Galvquodiyu Adanvdo yigvdiha.
english: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Tsudalenvdvsgininonv digalvwisdanedi alisgolvtanvhi, aseno nasgiquo saquo Adanvdo.
english: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Ale tsudalenvdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, aseno nasgiquo saquo Ugvwiyuhi.
english: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎯ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsudalenvdv digvwanilvwisdanedi igegvnedi gesvi, aseno nasgiquo saquo Unelanvhi nigadv nasgi digvwanilvwisdanedi igegvnehi nanivi.
english: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏥᏁᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gvnigesvsgini nigvnehv Adanvdo anisiyvwiha getsineha gohusdi osdv unvdodiyi.
english: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ;
phonetic: Asiyvwiyeno ulisgolvdanelvhi geso Adanvdo asinasdv uwonihisdiyi; nvwadaleno agatanai igagadv uwonihisdiyi nasgiquo Adanvdo ulisgolvdanelvhi gesoi;
english: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᏥᏁᎰ ᏧᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ;
phonetic: Nvwadaleno gohiyudi gesv nasgiquo Adanvdo ulisgolvdanelvhi gesoi; nvwadaleno atsineho tsudanvwodiyi, nasgiquo Adanvdo ulisgolvdanelvhi gesoi;
english: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏧᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏧᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏧᏁᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nvwadaleno usquanigodi tsulvwisdanediyi; nvwadaleno udolehohisdiyi; nvwadaleno didanvdo nunasdv tsugoliyediyi; nvwadaleno ilvsgi iyudalegi tsuwonihisdiyi; nvwadaleno tsunetlvdodiyi tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesvi;
english: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏁᎳᎩᎭ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎡᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nasgi nigadv tsudalenvdv nasgiquo saquo Adanvdo deulvwisdanehoi, dayadoheho naniv tsunanelagiha tsunatseli, hiaquo nusdesdi elisgvi.
english: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Ayelvyeno saquoquo tsigi, ale utsati tsiduwitlewisv, ale nigadv nasgi saquo ayelv duwitlewisv, utsati gesv, saquoquo ayelv tsinigalisdiha; nasgiya nasquo nusdi Galonedv.
english: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏗᏧᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Saquohiyeno Adanvdo iyuwanisadv nidiv tsegawovhi saquo ayelv iyegvnelvhi, nasquo Iditsusi ale digadalenvdv yvwi yigi; nasquo tseginatlai ale tseginatlai nigesvna yigi; ale nidiv saquoquo Adanvdo igaditasdiyi iyegvnelvhi.
english: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎤᏫᏞᏫᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayelvyeno vtla saquoquo uwitlewisv yigi, utsatisgini duwitlewisvi.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏯᏆᏘᏝ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏳᏘᏝ?
phonetic: Iyuno olasideni hia yinuwesv, Ayv uwoyeni nigesvna tsigi vtla ayelv yaquatitla, nasgisgo nvdigalisdodiha vtla ayelv yutitla?
english: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎴᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏴ ᎠᎦᏔ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏯᏆᏘᏝ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏳᏘᏝ?
phonetic: Iyu ale agaleni hia yinuwesv, Ayv agata nigesvna tsigi vtla ayelv yaquatitla; nasgisgo, nvdigalisdodiha vtla ayelv yutitla?
english: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᎦᏔ ᏱᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏛᎪᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏛᎪᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᎣᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Iyuno nigv ayelv agata yigi, hatlv advgododi yigi?  iyuno nigv advgododi yigi, hatlv owewasvisdodiyi yigi?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi duwitlewisv nigadv saquoha gesv nahna ayelv nasgiya osiyu uyelvnvi.
english: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎤᏫᏢ ᏱᎩ, ᎭᏢ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Iyuno nigadv saquoquo uwitlv yigi, hatlv ayelv yigi?
english: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎤᏫᏞᏫᏒ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatisgini deuwitlewisv, aseno saquoquo ayelvi.
english: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏩᏪᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏯᏚᎵᎭ; ᎠᎴᏬ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏗᎬᏩᏪᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏍᏛᏯᏑᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Ale agata vtla hia igvwawesedi yigi uwoyeni, vtla yigvyaduliha; alewo asgoli vtla hia idigvwawesedi yigi tsulasideni, vtla yidisdvyasuliha.
english: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏤᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏛ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla, nasgisgini ayelv tsehi utli idiwanagala tsinvwasdoi, nasgi utli ulisgedv gesoi.
english: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏤᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᏕᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏬᏚᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi ayelv tsehi nasgi esga iyvdv idigalvquodi igiyelvsv, nasgi utli idigalvquodi nidedvnehoi; ale nuwodusvna gesv nigadvnvi nasgi utli uwoduhiyu nigalisdisgoi;
english: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏂᎬᎪᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᏭᏓᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏍᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Uwoduhiyusgini nigadvnvi vtla yunigvgoi; Unelanvhisgini duwudatanidolv ayelvi, utli igai galvquodiyu nuwanelv nasgi nahna esga gesvi;
english: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏧᎦᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahna ayelv ilvhitlv tsugalenvdv nigesvna iyulisdodiyi; nasgi duwitlewisv tsunadasquanigodiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏫᏢ ᏯᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏫᏢ ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏫᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏫᏢ ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyuno saquo uwitlv yagiliyoga, nigadv duwitlv unatloyasdiha anigiliyoga; ale iyu saquo uwitlv galvquotanvhi yigi, nigadv duwitlv unatloyasdiha analiheliga.
english: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nihino nasgi Galonedv ayelvi, ale duwitlewisvi nasgi itsisiyvwiha gesvi.
english: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎤᏪᎧᏅ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏒ, ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ; ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ; ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ, ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ; ᎣᏂᏃ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ, ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi deuwekanv anisiyvwiha nahna tsunanelodi unadatlugvi; igvyi gesv, getsinvsidv; talineno gesv, anadolehosgi; tsoineno gesv, dinadeyohvsgi; onino, usquanigodi tsunilvwisdanehi; hnaquono gegalisgolvdanelvhi tsunadanvwodiyi, analisdelisgi, nunigvwiyusadegi, ilvsgi iyudalegi diniwonisgi.
english: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ?
phonetic: Nigadvsgo getsinvsidv?  nigadvsgo anadolehosgi?  nigadvsgo dinadeyohvsgi?  nigadvsgo usquanigodi tsunilvwisdanehi?
english: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ?  ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏁᏢᏗᎭ?
phonetic: nigadvsgo tsunadanvwodiyi gegalisgolvdanelvhi?  nigadvsgo ilvsgi iyudalegi daniwoniha?  nigadvsgo ananetlvdiha?
english: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utsati adina itsadulisgesdi osani udanedi gesvi; aseno gvnigesv nvdvtsvyvneli utli iyosdv iyadvnediyi.
english: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏬᏂᎭ, ᎾᎩᎲᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏣᏱᏉ ᎤᏃᏴᎵᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏴᎩ ᎤᎭᎸᏂᎯ ᏕᎦᏤᎳᎦ.
phonetic: Nasquo yvwi ale galvladi anehi dinikahnawadidohi tsuniwonihisdi yitsiwoniha, nagihvnano yigi adageyudi gesvi, vtsayiquo unoyvlidv ale unoyvgi uhalvnihi degatselaga.
english: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᎩᎭ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎪᎵᎦ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎩᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᎩᎲᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏓᎸᎢ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎩᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi yagiha aquadolehohisdiyi, ale yigoliga nigadiyu udelidv gesvi, ale nigadiyu agadovhisdi gesvi; ale nigav gohiyudi gesv yagiha, nasgi yeliquo digvgihvsdi yigi dodalvi; adageyudino gesv nagihvna yigi, gohusdiquo nigesvna ayv.
english: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᎾᎥ ᏱᎦᏓᏃᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏰᎸ ᏱᏓᎩᏲᏒ ᎤᎾᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᎩᎲᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏉᏤᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo nigav aginav yigadanoneha, ale nasquo tsiyelv yidagiyosv unagohvsdodiyi, nagihvnano yigi adageyudi gesvi, vtla gohusdi aginequotsehi yigi.
english: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏳᎪᎢ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏢᏆᏍᎪᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᏳᏕᏋᎯᏍᏙᎢ;
phonetic: Adageyudi gesv gvnidiyu, ale udanvtiyu; adageyudi gesv vtla yigvyugoi; adageyudi gesv vtla yatlvquasgoi; vtla utli yudequvhisdoi;
english: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏳᏲᎰᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏳᏔᎳᏬᎯᏌᏙᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏓᎳᏫᏎᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla udehohisdi yinadvnehoi; vtla uwasvquo utseli yuyohoi; vtla yutalawohisadoi; vtla uyo yadalawisehoi;
english: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏯᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla yaliheligo uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi, duyugodvsgini gesv nahna aliheligoi;
english: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ ᎡᎵᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏩᏐᎢ; ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Unelagiquo elisgo nigav gohusdi; gohiyuhvsgo nigav gohusdi; nigavquo gohusdi udugi uwasoi; gvnidiyu geso nigavi.
english: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎵᏛᏔᏂᏉ; ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏙᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ; ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎵᏛᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Adageyudi gesv alidvdisgi nigesvna; adolehohisdisgini gesv dvlidvtaniquo; tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv dodagalosoni; agadovhisdi nasquo gesv dvlidvtani.
english: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ;
phonetic: Igadvquoyeno gesv idigataha, ale igadvquo gesv idadolehosga;
english: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎧᎵᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏛᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏛᎵᏛᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Akaliisgini gesv aliyeilolvha, hnaquo nasgi igadvquo gesv dvlidvtani.
english: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏲᎵ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏬᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎵᎬᎩ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏆᏛᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏓᏋᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsiyoli tsigesvgi ayoli uwonihisdi tsiwonisgvgi, ayoli uwolisdi gesv goligvgi, ayoli udanvtedi gesv gadanvtesgvgi; aquadvnvsgini hnaquo naqualistanv, ayoli tsutseli gesv iyvdv nidaquvnelvgi.
english: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᎪᎸ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᎨᏗᏱ; ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎧᏛ ᏙᏓᏓᏓᎪᎯ; ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏛᏉ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎩᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyeno gesv usgolv idigowadiha adagediyi; nahiyusgini gesesdi degakadv dodadadagohi; gohi gesv igadvquo tsigataha; nahiyusgini gesesdi tsigatahesdi nasgiya nasquo vgigatahvi.
english: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢ; ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎬᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohino gesv aneha gohiyudi gesvi, ale udugi gvdi gesvi, ale adageyudi gesvi, hia nasgi tsoi; wudagonadvdvsgini galvquodi gvsv adageyudi gesvi.
english: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ; ᎠᏗᎾ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adageyudi gesv itsisdawadegesdi; ale itsadulisgesdi adanvdo ulisgolvdodi; adina ho ugvwiyusesdi nasgi getsadolehohisdi gesvi.
english: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏗᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏬᎵᏤᎰᎢ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎬᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎦᎾᎸᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno yigawoniha nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesvi, vtla yvwi yidigawonedisgoi, Unelanvhisgini; vtlayeno gilo yuwolitsehoi; adanvdosgininonv gvdi gawonisgv udelidv ganalvgowisgoi.
english: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏯᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏂᎳᏕᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini yadolehosga yvwi degawonedisgo dalinigohisdisgoi, ale deganiladehoi, ale dagalisdadisgoi.
english: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏯᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ ᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo yigawoniha nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesv, uwasv adalinigohisdisgoi; gilosgini yadolehosga dalinigohisdisgo tsunanelodi unadatlugvi.
english: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᎾ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏱᏗᏥᏬᏂᎭ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎰᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏱᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏯᏁᏢᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᎵᏂ ᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Osiyu yitsiyelvna iyuno nitsiv ilvsgi iyudalegi yiditsiwoniha; aseno hougvwiyuha yitsadolehosga; utliyeno atsilvquodiyu nasgi na adolehosgi, esgaquo nasgi na ilvsgi iyudalegi digawonisgi, iyusgininonv yanetlvdiha, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv tsunalini gohisdiyi.
english: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏱᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏱᏗᏥᏬᏂᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏁᏉᏏ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᎦᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuno, idalinvtli, yiwitsvlutselv ilvsgi iyudalegi yiditsiwoniha, gado usdi yitsvnequosi, iyusgininonv itsvwonedisgv gohusdi yitsvnanugowiseha, ale itsigadovhisdiyi yinitsvyvneha, ale yigadolehosga, ale yidigadeyohvsga.
english: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏳᏃᏴᎦ, ᎠᏤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ ᏂᏚᏃᏴᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏴᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏤᎷᎯᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Nasquoyeno gohusdiquo gvnodv nigesvna, yunoyvga, atseluhisdi ale dikanogisdodi yigi, iyuno tsudalehnai nidunoyvgvna yigi, gado yigalisdoda yvdolehohi nasgi atseluhidv gesv ale nasgi dikanogidv gesvi?
english: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏳᏃᏴᎦ, ᎦᎪ ᏯᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno atseluhisdi gagolisdi nigesvna yunoyvga, gago yadvnvisda dahnawa uwenvsdiyi?
english: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏥᏃᎪ ᏗᎬᏗ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎬᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᏥᏪᏒ ᎢᏥᏬᏂᏒᎢ?  ᎦᏃᎴᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi, iyuno ditsinogo digvdi gagolisdi nitsiwonisgvna yigi, gado yigalisdoda gvdolehohisdi yigi, nitsiwesv itsiwonisvi?  ganolesgvyeno itsiwonedisgi gesesdi.
english: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏱᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏌᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasquo utsati iyudalegi yidaniwoniha elohi, aseno vtla saquo nasgi gohusdi nigadvgvna yigi.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᏅᏆᏓᎴᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigoligvna yigi gadvgv gawonisgvi, nvquadalequo nasgiya yigi aquadanvtesgv nasgi gawonisgi; ale nasgi gawonisgi nvwadalequo nasgiya yigi ayv tsiyadanvtesgvi.
english: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏣᏚᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nihi, nasgi utsati tsitsaduli digalvwisdanedi adanvdo udanedi gesvi, itsiyohesdi ditsadadalinehidediyi nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv ditsalinigohisdodiyi.
english: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gawonisgesdi, adadolisdisgesdi atayohihesdi atsisdelvdiyi unetlvdodiyi.
english: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏗᎭ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ;  ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yigadadolisdi yigvdiha nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesvi, aquadanvdo adadolisdisgoi;  aquadanvdvsgini vtla yigananugowisgo osdv gesvi.
english: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gado howa usdi?  aquadanvdo gvdisgesdi gadadolisdisgesdi, ale gagolisdi gadadolisdisgesdi; ale aquadanvdo gvdisgesdi detsinogisgesdi ale gagolisdi detsinogisgesdi.
english: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᏨ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎲᏔᏅᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᏳᏬᎳ, ᏰᎵ ᎡᎺᏅ ᏯᏛ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎩ?  ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᏱᎩ ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nusdv yigi, hnaquo halihelitsv tsadanvdo hvtanvha, gado yigalisdoda nasgi na nagatanavna uwediyi yuwola, yeli Emenv yadv haliheligi?  nigoligvnayeno yigi niwesgvi.
english: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏪᎭ ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ, ᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno udohiyuhi osiyu niweha haliheligvi, soisgini vtla yulinigohisdiha.
english: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᎬᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ;
phonetic: Tsiyalielitseha Aquanelanvhi, nasgi utli igai digvgiwonihisdi gesv tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv esgaquo nihi nitsivi;
english: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎬᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎯᏍᎩᏉ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏥᏰᏲᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno tsunanelodi unadatlugv utli gvgiyelvdi nahna hisgiquo ikanetsvhi agineisdiyi aquadanvdv aquvdodiyi, nasgi nvwanadale nasquo gatsiyeyodiyi, ano asgohi iyagayvli ikanetsvhi agineisdiyi nvwanadale uniwonihisdi gesv aquvdodiyi.
english: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎠᏓᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏣᏛᎾᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, tlesdi ditsiyoli yigesesdi detsadanvdvi; adasgaisdisgininonv gesv ditsiyoli gesesdi, detsadanvdvsgini ditsadvnaya gesesdi.
english: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᎭᏁᎦᎵ ᏓᎦᏥᏴᏔᏂ ᎦᏓᏥᏬᏁᏔᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyi hia nigvnv gowela, Nvwadale diniwonisgi ale nvwadale tsunihanegali dagatsiyvtani gadatsiwonetani hia nasgi yvwi; aseno asi vtla yigvquadvganehesdi, adiha Yihowa.
english: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ [ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ] ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv gohiyudisgi ayelvha, vtla anohiyuhvsgi unohiyudanehi yigi, asgini anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna; adolehohisdisgini gesv vtla anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna [unohiyudanehi] yigi, anohiyuhvsgisgini.
english: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏱᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ, ᏳᏂᏴᎵᎸᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏚᏂᎸᏃᏘᎭ ᏴᎬᎾᏛ?
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi iyuno tsunanelodi unadatlugv nigadv ilvhitlv yidunilawitsonv, ale nigadv tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi gesv yidaniwoniha, yuniyvlilvno nahnani nanigatanavna, ale anohiyuhvsgini nigesvna, tlasgo dunilvnotiha yvgvnadv?
english: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏯᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ, ᏳᏴᎵᎸᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Iyusgini nigadv yanadolehosga, yuyvlilvno gilo gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna, ale gilo nagatanavna, naniv gvwohiyudanehoi, ale naniv degvwugodanehoi;
english: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏯᎵᏰᏍᏚᎲᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino udelidv usquanigodv unawiyi gvnigesv yinigalisda; nasgino yaliyesduhvga Unelanvhi yadadolisdasi, ale yideganotsalvga Unelanvhi udohiyuhiya itsadasuyvi.
english: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎰᏩ ᎤᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩ, ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ, ᎠᏁᏢᏙᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ.  ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gado howa usdi, idalinvtli?  iyuno detsilawigi, itsisiyvwiha dikanogidv itsadvnvisdoi, dideyodi itsadvnvisdoi, tsudalenvdv digawonihisdi itsadvnvisdoi, gvnigesv igvnedi itsadvnvisdoi, anetlvdodi itsadvnvisdoi.  Nigadv adina detsilvwisdanehv ditsadalinigohisdodiyi ugvwalesdi.
english: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, everyone of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᏂᏔᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏎᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏒᏛ; ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎠᏁᏢᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nvwanadale tsuniwonihisdi gesv yigawoniha, anitali, ale tsoi iyvdv wasdesdi daniwonisegesdi saquo uwesvdv; asiyvwino anetlvdisgesdi.
english: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᏢᏗᏍᎩ ᏁᏙᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏩᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusgini anetlvdisgi nedohvna igesesdi, elawequo uwasesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi; uwasvquo adalinohedisgesdi, ale Unelanvhi alinohedisgesdi.
english: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᏓᏄᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anadolehosgi anitaliha aniwonisgesgi, anisoino danugodisgesdi.
english: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎥ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎴᏅᏛ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎬᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gohusdi yatsinanugowiselv gilo nav uwoli, igvyi ulenvdv elawe gvsgesdi.
english: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏥᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏪᏒᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nitsivyeno yeli getsidolehohisdi saquo uwesvdv; nasgi naniv unadeloquasdiyi, ale naniv unigalisdadisdiyi.
english: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏓᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale anadolehosgi tsunatseli didanvdo danohiyuhvsgo anadolehosgi.
english: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla tsudalenvdv gesv igvnehi yigi, nvwadohiyadvsgini gesvi, nasgiya tsinusdi nigadv dunadatluwadisv unadanvti.
english: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᎡᎳᏪᏉ ᎤᏅᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anigeyv ditsatseli elawequo unvsesdi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi; vtlayeno gegalisgolvdanelvhi yigi nasgi uniwonihisdiyi; unohiyudiyiquosgini, nasgiya nasquo tsinigawe dikahnawadvsdi.
english: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ ᏧᎾᏛᏛᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒᎢ; ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale yunaduli gohusdi unadeloquasdiyi, digvwaniyehi tsunadvdvhvsgesdi dotsunenvsvi; udehohisdiyuyeno anigeyv uniwonihisdiyi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi.
english: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏧᏓᎴᏁ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᏂᎯᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigo nihi itsehv tsudalene kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga?  tsigoge nihiquo itsvsv itsilutselei?
english: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᎯ ᎢᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo adanvtesgv gadoleosgi ale adanvdo udanedi agihi ielisgesdi, nasgi gvnigesv nigvnehesdi nasgi hia tsiwitsvyowelaneha ugvwiyuhi unetsvhi gesvi.
english: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gilo nagatahvna igesesdi, unelagiquo nagatahvna gesesdi.
english: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏅᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli, itsadulisgesdi itsadolehohisdiyi, ale tlesdi yitsinvsdosgesdi gawonihisdiyi tsunadalenvdv tsuniwonihisdi gesvi.
english: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ Ꭰ'ᏱᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigadv detsilvwisdanehv uwoduhi ale osdv a'yilvdv gesesdi.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᏕᏥᏂᏴᎭ;
phonetic: Alewo idalinvtli, gvnigesv nitsvyvneha osdv kanohedv, nasgi tsitsvyalitsidonelvgi, ale nasgi nasquo tsidetsadanilvtsv, ale nasgi ulinigidv tsidetsiniyvha;
english: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏱᏗᏥᏂᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo tsitsalisdelvdodi, iyuno asdaya yiditsiniyv nasgi tsitsvyalitsidonelvgi, iyusgininonv asequoquo yigi itsohiyusvi.
english: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏨᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ;
phonetic: Igvyiyiyeno gesv detsayohiselvgi nasgi nasquo ayv tsvgiyohiselvgi, nasgi Galonedv ayv igisganvtsv igiyohuhiselvi, nasgiya nigvnv gowelihi;
english: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏙᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅᎪᏪᎵᎯ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi atsinisanvi, ale nasgi tsoine iga doulehisanv nasgiya nigvnvgowelihi;
english: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏏᏆᏏ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi Siquasi ugohvi, hnaquono taladu iyanidv.
english: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎯᏍᎩᏧᏈ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ [ᎬᏩᎪᎲᎯ] ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎴᏂᏙ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏚᏂᎵᏅᏨ.
phonetic: Onino hisgitsuqui ulosvsdi iyanidv analinvtli itsulaha gvwagohei; nasgino [gvwagohvhi] utli iyanidv analenido asi gohi gesvi, igadvsgininonv dunilinvtsv.
english: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏥᎻ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ [ᎢᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ.]
phonetic: Onino Tsimi ugohei; hnaquono nigadv getsinvsidv [igvwagohei.]
english: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏆᎸᎲᎾᏉ ᏣᏕᎲᏍᎪ ᏣᏓᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Oniyino nasquo ayv vtsigovgi, nasgiya gilo udediyi nusqualvhvnaquo tsadehvsgo tsadagowatisgoi.
english: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᏴᏉᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno aquasdikani oginvsidv gesvi, nasgi vtla yeli atsinvsidv gayvquosedi yigi, nvdigalisdodiha uyo nigatsiyvnelv tsunanelodi unadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv ayv naquasdv naquasdi; ale nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vginelvhi tsigi, vtla asequoquo yinulistanv; utliyeno igai dagilvwisdanehv esgaquo nasgi na nanivi; vtlasgininonv ayv, Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv digikahnawadidolvhi.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏥᏪᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ.
phonetic: Adina iyuno ayv yigi, ale nasgi na yigi, nasgi notsiweha otsalitsidohvsga, ale nasgi nusdi itsohiyunv.
english: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏯᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?
phonetic: Nasgino iyu Galonedv uyohusvhi deulehisanv yagalitsidohvsga, gadono igadv getsadasuyv hia nianiweha, vtla tsunalehisodi yigi tsuniyohusvhi?
english: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi tsuniyohusvhi, hnaquo Galonedv vtla tsulehisanvhi yigi.
english: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyu ale Galonedv tsulehisanvhi nigesvna yigi, hnaquo otsalitsidohvsgv asequoquo nigalisdiha, ale itsohiyusv nasquo asequoquo nigalisdiha.
english: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎸᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏧᎴᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
phonetic: ale nasquo gvnigesv nigalisdiha gayegogi otsinohesgi gesv Unelanvhi; otsinohelvyeno Unelanvhi nasgi uyohusv deuletanv Galonedv; tsulelanvhi nigesvna tsigi, iyuno howa tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi tsuniyohusvhi.
english: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsuniyohusvhiyeno tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi, hnaquo Galonedv vtla tsulehisanvhi yigi.
english: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎠᏏᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎳ.
phonetic: Iyu ale Galonedv tsulehisanvhi nigvsvna yigi, itsohiyusv asequoquo nigalisdiha; asiquo itsisganvtsv itsadudala.
english: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎸᏉ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo na Galonedv unohiyuhi unilinvtsvhi tsigi gvwaniyotsidolvquo.
english: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏂᏉ ᎢᏕᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏱᎬᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏗᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno aniquo idehv uwasv udugi yigvha Galonedv igisdelvdiyi, naniv yvwi dedigonadvdi uyo nigadvnvi.
english: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᎤᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno Galonedv deulehisanv uyohusvi, ale tsudalenvtanvhi nulistanv nasgi unilinvtsvhi tsigesvgi.
english: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎰᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏤᎭ, ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno yvwi iyuwanisadv tsigi ahohuhisdi gesv tseha, yvwi nasquo iyuwanisadv ayohusv dilehisodi tsigi.
english: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏫᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏥᏓᏂᏲᎱᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏅᏛᎨᎬᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Adawiyeno iyuwanisadv nigadiyu tsidaniyohusga, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv iyuwanisadv nigadiyu dinvnodv nvdvgegvneli.
english: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᏛᎭ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno naniv unatselidvha; Galonedv tsudalenvtanvhi; onino nasgi na Galonedv tsutseli gesv nahiyu galutsvha.
english: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏛᎵᏍᏆᏗ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏛᏔᏃᏅᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo dvlisquadi, nahiyu ugvwiyuhi gesv tsuyohiselvhi gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasgi Agayvligei; nahiyu advtanonvha nigadiyu unigvwiyusadegi gesv ale nigadiyu digeganelodi gesv, ale dunalinigvgvi.
english: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Aseyeno nvwasdesdiquo Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, gvni nigadv gvwasgagi dulasgv hawiniditlv nidegvnelvha.
english: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᎩ ᎠᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayohuhisdi gesv nasgi ulisqualvdi usgagi atsidvdodi gesvi.
english: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ.  ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᎦᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nigadiyuyeno tsudalenvdv dulasgv hawiniditlv igvnelvhi.  Aseno, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyagvnelvhi tsadiha, gvnigesv nigalisdiha nagatloyasdvna gesv nasgi na nigadv tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyuwanelvhi.
english: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎬᏂᏏᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuno nigadiyu tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyagvnelvhi gesesdi, hnaquo nasquo Uwetsi uwasv hawiniditlv nvdvdvneli nasgi na nigadv tsudalenvdv hawiniditlv iyuwanelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi nigav igvnisisgi iyulisdodiyi naniv anehvi.
english: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏛᎾᏛᏁᎵ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏥᏕᎨᎦᏬᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏙᎨᎦᏬᏍᎪᎢ?
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi nusdvna yigi, gado dvnadvneli tsuniyohusvhi tsinvdigalisdodisgo tsidegegawosgoi?  iyuno tsuniyohusvhi ase tsunalehisodi nigesvna igesesdi, gadono tsuniyohusvhi nvdigalisdodisgo dogegawosgoi?
english: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛᎿᎭᏕᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gadono unayehisdi nigadvhnadega nigohilvi?
english: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏣᎩᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᏥᏲᎱᏍᎪ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsineisdiha nasgi na ulihelisdi tsagiha nihi tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi ogatseli tsvdidalehvsga, tsiyohusgo nidugitsvnisvi.
english: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎣᎦᎵᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ?  ᎢᏓᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏑᎾᎴᏉᏰᏃ ᏙᏓᏗᏲᎱᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuno yvwi iyunadvnedi iyaquadvnelvhi yigi, nvgi dininvsadi unisgasedi ogalilvhi yigi Equisa gaduhvi, gado gvginequotsedi osdv gesv, iyuno tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi nigesvna yigi?  idalisdayvhvsgesdi, ale idaditasgesdi; sunalequoyeno dodadiyohusi.
english: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏲ ᏗᎵᏃᎮᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi etsilidastanvgi; nayo dilinohelidasdi gesv ayosdisgo osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏰᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ.
phonetic: Itsiyegi duyugodv itsadvnediyi, ale tlesdi yitsisganvgesdi; igadvyeno vtla yanigataha Unelanvhi; udehohisdiyu itsvnoheha nasgi hia tsinitsiweha.
english: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᎦᏫ, ᎦᏙ ᏓᎨᎬᏁᎵ ᏙᏓᎨᎦᎴᏔᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ?
phonetic: Aseno gilo hia yinvgawi, Gado dagegvneli dodagegaletani tsuniyohusvhi?  ale gado usdesdi udotlvsv diniyelv anilutsvha?
english: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏁᎫ!  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᏍᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᎵᏰᎲᎦ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎪᎯ;
phonetic: Tsanegu!  nasgi tsiwisgoi vtla yvgvliyehvga gvni ugohi;
english: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏙᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏫᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎦᏔᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ, ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi tsiwisgoi, vtla nasgi ayelv udotlvdi gesv yiwisgoi, ugatahaquosgini, utsalesdiquo yigi, ale gohusdiquo usdi nvwadale yigi;
english: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏁᎰ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini aneho ayelv nasgiya osi uyelvnvi, ale nudalesv ugata utseligaya ayelvi.
english: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏠᏱᎭ ᏱᎩ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ; ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ.
phonetic: Nigadv uquedali gesv vtla utloyiha yigi; yvwiyeno uniquedalv sudalegi; nvwadaleno nvgi dininvsadi uniquedalvi, nvwadaleno atsadi, nvwadaleno tsisqua.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo galvladi aneha digotlvnvhi, ale elohi aneha digotlvnvhi; aseno tsuwoduhiyu gesv galvladi anehi nvwadalei, ale tsuwoduhiyu gesv elohi anehi nvwadalei.
english: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏙ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎡᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏅᏩᏓᎴᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎧᎸ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏄᏍᏙ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nvdo iga ehi utselidv uwoduhiyu gesvi, ale uwoduhiyu gesv nvdo svnoyi ehi nvwadalei, ale tsunoduhiyu gesv noquisi nvwadalei; ale noquisi kalv uwoduhiyu gesv nvwadale nusdo noquisi nusdv uwoduhiyu gesvi.
english: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.  ᎠᏲᎩ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo nusdi tsunalehisodi gesv tsuniyohusvhi.  Ayogi awisvhi gesoi; ayogi nigesvna diledodi gesesdi.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Galvquodi nigesvna awisvhi gesoi, galvquodiyu diledodi gesesdi; awanagala awisvhi gesoi, ulinigidv diledodi gesesdi;
english: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᏫᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᏗᎴᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᎡᎭ.
phonetic: Idiwisgo uquedali ayelv awisvhi gesoi, adanvdo udotlvsv diledodi gesesdi.  Uquedali ayelv eha, ale adanvdo udotlvsv eha.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎦᏪᎳ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏓᏫ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎣᏂᏱᏃ ᎠᏓᏫ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᏁᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyano hia nigvnv gawela, igvyiyi yvwi Adawi gvnodv nulistanei; oniyino Adawi adanvdo gvnidv dinehi nulistanei.
english: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏇᏓᎵ ᏥᎩ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla igvyi yigese nasgi na adanvdo tsigi, nasgisgini na aquedali tsigi; onino iyvdv nasgi na adanvdo tsigi.
english: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎦᏓᏉ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Igvyiyi asgaya gadohi nvdayudalenvhi, gadaquo gesei; taline asgaya Ugvwiyuhi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi.
english: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏓᏉ ᎠᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏉ ᎨᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nusdv nasgi na gadaquo agotlvtanvhi tsigi, nasgiya nasquo nunasdi gadaquo gegotlvtanvhi; ale nusdv nasgi na galvladi ehi, nasgiya nasquo nunasdi galvladi anehi.
english: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎦᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Ale gada agotlvtanvhi nusdv nasgiya tsinigasdi, nasgiya nasquo nigasdesdi nusdv galvladi ehi.
english: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nitsiweha idalinvtli, nasgi uquedali gesv ale gigv vtla unatseli igvwalisdodi yigi Unelanvhi utseligohi; vtla ale ayogi gesv utseli igvwalisdodi yigi ayohi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎢᏨᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏓᏗᎵᏅᏥ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ
phonetic: Gvniyuquo, itsvnanugowise udelidv gesvi; vtla nigadv yvdadilinvtsi, nigadiyusgini eginetliyvsdi gesesdi
english: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᏥᏛᎦᏔᎾᏫᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ; ᎠᏤᎷᎩᏰᏃ ᏓᏳᏃᏴᎳᏏ, ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏙᏓᎨᎦᎴᏔᏂ ᎠᏂᏲᎩ ᏁᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏰᎩᏁᏟᏴᏏ.
phonetic: Gilaquo iyvdv, tsidvgatanawisdiquo igohidv, ulisqualvdi atselugi nigalistanvha; atselugiyeno dayunoyvlasi, tsuniyohusvhino dodagegaletani aniyogi negesvna, ayvno dayeginetliyvsi.
english: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏛᏄᏬᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏛᏄᏬᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Hiayeno ayogi gesv ayogi nigesvna dvnuwostani, ale hia nasgi ayohusgi gesv ayohusgi nigesvna dvnuwostani.
english: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏓᎵᏁᎯᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᏐᏅ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hnaquo hia ayogi gesv ayogi nigesvna gesv unuwostanesdi, ale hia nasgi ayohusgi ayohusgi nigesvna gesv unuwostanesdi, hnaquo nulistanesdi hia igawedv gesv tsigowela, Adalinehidisgi gesv ugisonv ayohuhisdi gesvi.
english: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗᎨᏒᎢ?  ᏂᎯ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Nihi ayohuhisdi gesvi, hatlv tsadatsvyasdigesvi?  nihi didanisodiyi gesvi, hatlv tsadasegogisdi gesvi?
english: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏨᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ; ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayohusdi udatsvyasdi gesv, nasgi asgani; asganino ulinigohisdisgi nasgi dikahnawadvsdi.
english: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi tsigineha igadasegogisdiyi, tsvdidalehvsga Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv.
english: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᏰᏥᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, itsvgeyui idalinvtli, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi, gayetsitelvdi nigesvna gesesdi, nigohilv utsati detsilvwisdanehesdi Ugvwiyuhi utseli digalvwisdanedi gesvi, itsigatahayeno nasgi itsalinigvnehv Ugvwiyuhi utseli detsilvwisdanehv asequoquo nigesvna gesvi.
english: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎦᏟᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎦᏥᏁᏤᎸᎢ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nano gatlisodi gesv unadanvti unalisdelvdodi ugvwali, nasgiya tsigatsinetselvi tsunanelodi dunadatlugv Gelesiyi, nasgiya nitsadvnehesdi.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏑᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎡᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎩᎳ ᏫᎦᏟᏐᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Igvyiyi iga sunadodaquasdi gesv itsisiyvwiha itsadanelvsgesdi nasgiya nusdv Unelanvhi itsinequoelvi, nasgino tlesdi witsilutsvha gila wigatlisodi yigesesdi.
english: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏥᎷᏨᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏰᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Witsilutsvno nasgi na osiyu ditsiyelvnvhi, nasgi digatsiyagenvdisdi gesesdi goweli, nasgi aniyegi tsilusilimi nihi itsalisgolvtanvhi.
english: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏲᏤᏅᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Iyu ale duyugodesdi nasquo ayv aquenvsdiyi, nasgi dayotsenvstani.
english: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ, ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ale wvdatsvlutseli, Masidoni ayeli agilosvhi gesesdi; masidoniyeno ayeli agilohisdiyi nigalisdiha.
english: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏆᏕᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᏆᎪᎳᏗᏴ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale wigvquadedi yinigagi, ale nasquo yaquagoladiyv itsehvi, nasgi sgiyatinvsdiyi gaisv ilvhitlv witsigadvi.
english: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎢᏒ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏕᏁᏗᏱ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yaquaduli gohi gesv gaisv itsvgowadvdiyi; aseno udugi aquvha ilvsgi igohidv itsvyadenediyi, iyuno Ugvwiyuhi osiyu yuyelvnv.
english: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏈᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Equisasgini gedohesdi hisgasgohine iga iyasdi.
english: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎥᎩᎳᏅᏓᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎬᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ.
phonetic: Equohiyuyeno vgilanvdadelv ale utsati gohusdi gagvdodi, ale unitsata dinigatilegi.
english: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏫᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾᏉ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ; ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Iyuno Dimadi wigalutsvha, itsagasayasdesdi niganayesgvnaquo itseladidasdiyi; dulvwisdaneyeno Ugvwiyuhi utseli digalvwisdanedi, utloyiquo ayv.
english: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏣᏂᎩᏍᏔᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gilo yuniquatihesdi; nvwadohiyadvquosgini tsetsanigistanvha, nasgi ayv agilutsediyi; tsigatenohayeno uluhisdiyi analinvtli anilutsvha.
english: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏃ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏓ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏚᎸ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᏮᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᎸᎭ.
