phonetic: Ano Aquola iginvtli, utsati tsisdiyeda witsilutsediyi unenvsdodiyi analinvtli; aseno vtla yudulv ase gohi gesv uwenvsdiyi; wvdagalutsi adina udlanvdadelvha.
english: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsiyawisgesdi, ulinigidv detsiniyvsesdi gohiyudi gesvi, itsisgaya gesesdi, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi.
english: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigadv detsilvwisdanehv adageyudi gesv itsvdisgesdi.
english: Let all your things be done with charity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᏒ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Alewo idalinvtli, detsigataha Sdiquena dudatinavi, nasgi igvyi udatanvhi gesv Agaya, ale nasgi dunadayosv tsunisdelvhidasdiyi unadanvti;
english: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏂᎬᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Itsvtayoseha nihi ditsohiyudiyi nasgi iyunasdi, ale naniv itsulaha tsunilvwisdanehi analinigvnehi.
english: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᏍᏗᏇᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏉᏚᏁᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏱᎦ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᏥᎷᎶᏤᎲᎩ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏏᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Galieliga gvgilutselv Sdiquena ale Quoduneda ale Agayiga; nihiyeno tsitsilulotsehvgi anikalisisa nasgi.
english: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏓᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Anigalisdadayeno aquadanvdo, ale nihi ditsadanvdo.  Nasgi iyusdi detsilvquodesdiquo nasgi iyunasdi.
english: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᏏᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎡᏈᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏏᎳ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᎾᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Esiyi wigetsiyoliha.  Equila ale Quisila utsati wigetsiyoliha Ugvwiyuhi tsunanelodi unadayolisdi gesvi, gvwanaligoneha tsunanelodi unadatlugv nasgi aninelvi.
english: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.  ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadv idalinvtli wigetsiyoliha.  Detsadayolisdisgesdi galvquodiyu didadowedovsdi gesvi.
english: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏆᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ayv Quola aquadayolisdi gesv aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi aquowelanvhi.
english: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏄᎨᏳᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nugeyusvna igesesdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi atsisginvdvhi gesesdi.  Ugvwiyuhi dagalutsi.
english: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsikahnawadidohesdi.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ayv aquadageyudi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi, Tsisa Galonedv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi.  Emenv.
english: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᎦᏯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya Unelanvhi udanvtelvi, ale Dimadi iginvtli, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga Golinidiyi tsitsadatlugv, ale nigadv itsadanvti nigvnadv Agaya itsehvi;
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasgi Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, udadolitsati Agayvligei, nasgi Unelanvhi nigav adagalisdadisgi;
english: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎦᏲᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᎦᏲᎬᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi ogigalisdadisgi tsigi nigav tsudalenvdv otsigiliyogvi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi yeli digayotsigalisdadisdi anigiliyogi, gayogvdodi nasgi adagalisdadisgi ogvsv ogigalisdadisdisgv Unelanvhi.
english: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏦᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏔ ᎣᎩᏁᎭ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgiyayeno Galonedv ugiliyotsv utsati tsotsigiliyoga, nasgiya nasquo utsata ogineha adagalisdadisgi Galonedv gesv nvdayudalenvhi.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏲᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ, ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎤᏠᏱ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏲᎦᏓᏅᏔ, ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ.
phonetic: Iyu ale nasquo yotsigiliyoga, itsigalisdadisdi ale itsalisdelvdodi ugvwala, nasgi tsitsiwadveha ditsvnidiyu itsigiliyoisdiyi ayv otsigiliyogv utloyi; iyu ale ugalisdi yogadanvta, itsigalisdadisdi ale itsalisdelvdodi ugvwala.
english: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏴᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udugi itsvyvsv ulinigidiyu, nvdigalisdodiha tsotsigataha, nasgi itsatloyasdisgv agiliyoisdi gesvi, nasgiya nasquo itsatloyasdodi gesesdi ugalisdi gesvi.
english: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏲᎦᏚᎵᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᎵ, ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸ ᎡᏏᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᏙᎦᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎣᎦᎸᏲᎵᎸᎩ ᏦᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Vtlayeno yogaduliha, idalinvli, nitsigatahvnaquo iyulisdodiyi nasgi udeyadodi ogilutselv Esiyi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi gagedv ogilutselvi, ulosvstanvhi nidogalinigvgvi, nasgino nvdagalisdodisgvgi ogalvyolilvgi tsogadvnidisdiyi;
english: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎩᎲᎩ ᏦᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᏚᎪᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎬᏒᏉ ᎣᎦᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Aseno ogihvgi tsogiyohuhisdiyi dudugotanvi, nasgi yigvsvquo ogadalisgasdodiyi nigesvna, Unelanvhisgini otsalisgasdodiyi, nasgi na tsuniyohusvhi dilehisodisgi;
english: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᏦᎫᏓᎴᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏦᏨᎾᏁᎭ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎣᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi na ogudaledv nasgi iyunayehisdi ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale nasgi na asi tsogudaleha; nasgi udugi tsotsvnaneha asiquo ogudalesdiyi;
english: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏙᎵᏨ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏌᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihi nasquo sgisdelisgv itsadadolisdisgv ogisdelvdiyi, nasgi ogidolitsv unitsati iyunvnisadv nvdayulisdodiyi unitsati unalihelitsediyi [Unelanvhi] ayv gesv iyusdi.
english: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏦᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏙᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏃᏨᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᎨᏙᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nvdigalisdodiha tsotsaliheliga, nasgi tsogadanvdogi gohiyudisgvi, notsvdisgvna uquedaliquo ugvwali agadovhisdi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ogisdelisgvi, nutlonasdvna gesv otsvdisgv ogedolv ani elohi gesvi; ale ho ugvwiyuha nihi itsehvi.
english: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Vtlayeno nvwadale gohusdi yitsvyowelaneha, nasgi na uwasv tsitsigataha ale nasquo tsidetsadanilvtsv; ale udugi aquvha gvlisquadisgi ditsadanilvisdiyi gesvi;
english: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵᎦᎾᎨ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo yeliganage disgiyadanilvtsvhi tsigi, nasgi ayv gesv itsvyalielisdisgvi, nasgiya sgiyalielisdodi tsigi, nahiyu Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa utseli iga gesesdi.
english: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgino hia nusdv aquohiyusv aquadanvtelvgi gohi gesv asi nasqualisgvna witsvlutsediyi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi taline osdv itsadanvdadisdiyi;
english: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᏨᎶᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏩᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏗᎦᏂᎩᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏅᏓᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏗᏱ ᏫᏥᎦᏛ ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale witsvloisdanediyi Masidoni wagiluhisdiyi, ale Masidoni diganigisv taline nvdatsvlutsediyi, ale Tsudiyi witsigadv sgiyatinvsdiyi.
english: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ, ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᏅᏛᎵ, ᏥᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎦᏓᏖᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏁᎬ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᎥᎥ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ, ᎥᏝ?
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdv tsaquadanvtelvgi, nvlisaliquosgo agiyelvhi gesei?  ale gohusdi gadanvdvli, tsigo uquedali udanvtedi gadatesgoi, nasgino ayv tsinegv hiaquo yinusdi, vv, vv, ale vtla, vtla?
english: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏄᏙᎯᏳᎭ] ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲ ᎥᎥ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini nudalidasdvna tsigi, nasgi [nudohiyuha] ayv itsvnetsehv vv ale vtla nigesvna gesvi.
english: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏪᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᎥ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎦᏛᏁᎢ, ᎥᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏛᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᎬᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi itsehv itsvyalitsidonelvhi tsigi, nasgi ayv, ale Siliwena, ale Dimadi itsvyalitsidonelvhi tsigi, vv ale vtla udvdiyi vtla yogadvnei, vvsgini uwasv udvdiyi gvnigesv nogvnelvgi.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎥᎥ ᎬᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏲᎬᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nagadvyeno uduistanvi Unelanvhi nasgi na iyuwanisadv, vv gvdvdi, ale udohiyuhiya geso nasgi iyuwanisadv, nasgi Unelanvhi atsilvquododiyi ayv iyogvnediyi.
english: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎶᏁᎥᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgino ayv ale nihi itsulaha digalinigohisdisgi Galonedv edatseliga gesvi, ale igilonevhi, nasgi na Unelanvhi;
english: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na nasquo igiyelvtanvhi tsigi, ale iginelvhi tsigi diginawiyi Adanvdo agatidisdodi gesvi.
english: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎥᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏏ ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ ᏫᏂᏥᎷᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi tsitayoseha agatahi iyulisdodiyi aquadanvdo uwohiyudanediyi, nasgi itsvgeyuvsgv nvdigalisdodisgv asi Golinidiyi winitsilugvna tsigi;
english: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᎮᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎣᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ; ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏕᏥᏙᎦ.
phonetic: Vtla adina itsvyadanvtehehi gesv itsohiyusvi, otsisdelisgiquosgini gesv itsaliheligvi; itsohiyusvyeno nigalisdodi asi tsidetsidoga.
english: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏊᎪᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nusdvgi aquvsv gesv daquugotanvgi, nasgi taline witsvlutsediyi nigesvna uyo gvquadanvti.
english: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎦᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno uyo yitsvyadanvdadistanv, gago osdv yaquadanvdadisda, nasgiquo na uwasv uyo tsiyadanvdadistanvhi?
english: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎤᏲ ᏱᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ; ᏂᏥᎥᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi tsinusdv tsiwitsvyowelanelvgi, tlesdiquo nahna witsilutsvha, uyo yigvquadanvdadistanesdi nasgi na ulihelisdi gvquadanvdadisdodi tsigi, aquelisvgi; nitsivquo itsvyoiyuha nasgi nusdv aqualihelisdisgv nasquo nasgi nihi nitsiv itsalihelisdisgvi.
english: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎦᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatiyeno agiliya gesv, ale ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv witsvyowelanelvgi utsati digatsigasawoihi gesvi; vtla adina uyo unadanvdadisdodi gesesdi yaquelisei, itsigadovhisdiyiquosgini nasgi utsatanvhi itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏰᎵ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgininonv gilo ehisdi tsudanvdadistanvhi gesesdi, vtla ayvquo ehisdi yaquadanvdadistanv; nihisgini nitsiv yeli ehisdi itsadanvdadistanv; nasgi tsilosvsdanediyi nigesvna tsilawisehvi.
english: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ [ᎠᏍᎦᏯ] ᏅᏍᏛᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Aliquo nasgi iyusdi [asgaya] nvsdvdvi nasgi unitsati tsigvwasdvdistanv.
english: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏰᏥᏙᎵᏨᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏰᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛ, ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏰᎸᏒ ᏳᏃᏴᏘᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgino gohi gesv yetsidolitsvquo, ale yetsigalisdadv, yinvsegagi nasgi utsati uyo uyelvsv yunoyvtisda.
english: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏱᏕᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha etsisdayidediyi etsigeyuiyu gesvi.
english: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎲ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia ho ugvwalvgi tsiwitsvyowelanelvgi, nasgi itsvgoliyesgvgi, nasgi nigav tsudalenvdv nitsvwesehv nitsadvnehv ale nitsadvnehvna gesvi.
english: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏰᏥᎥᎡᎸ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎥᎡᎭ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ ᏱᏥᎥᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎥᎡᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏥᎥᎡᎸᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Gilo yetsivelv gohusdi usganvtsv, ayv nasquo tsiveha; iyuyeno ayv gohusdi asganvtsvi yitsivsga, nasgi tsivelvhi nihi gesv nvdayulisdotanvgi tsivelvgi Galonedv agatahvi;
english: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎩᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Asgina igilonuhediyi nigesvna; vtlayeno yigigonelv nasgi adanvtelidohvi.
english: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᏠᎠᏏ ᏗᎩᎷᏨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏂᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᏚᎩᎡᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ,
phonetic: Alewo Tloasi digilutsv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseli aqualitsidonilv, ale galohisdiyi agisdugielv Ugvwiyuhi,
english: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏙᎯ ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎥᎩᏅᏟ ᏂᏥᏩᏛᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᎦᏥᏴᏕᏨᎩᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏆᏂᎩᏒᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏩᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla dohi gvquadanvdadisdi yigese diquadanvdvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi Dadasi vginvtli nitsiwadvhvna gesvi; vgatsiyvdetsvgino nahna Aquanigisvgi Masidoni wagilutsvgi.
english: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏓᎵᏁᎯᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎦᏩᏒᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino alihelitsedi gesesdi Unelanvhi nasgi nigohilv igalihelisdiyi tsinigvneha igadalinehidv ugvwali Galonedv edalisgasdodvi, ale gvnigesv tsinigvneha gawasvgv uwasv atsigadovhisdi gesv ayv igvdisgv nigav degesadisvi.
english: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏗ ᏃᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno uganasdv gawasvgi Unelanvhi uwewasvisdi notsalisdiha Galonedv utseliga, nasgi getsisdelvdi tsigi, ale nasgi tsuniyohuhisdi tsigi.
english: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯᎯ ᏂᏙᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ.  ᎦᎪᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏰᎦᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi sunadalegi gesv adahihi gawasvgi nasgi unihihi nidotsalisdaneha; anisoino adadvnidisgi gawasvgi nasgi unvnidisgi nidotsalisdaneha.  Gagono yeli gayegagenvdisdi hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏣᏰᏃ ᏧᏂᏣᏔᏉ ᏥᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᏱᏃᎦᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᏃᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏦᏨᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Vtsayeno tsunitsataquo tsinunasdi yinogasdi, nasgi aniyosdisgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga; nogatlonasdvnasgini gesv tsotsvdisgoi, Unelanvhisgini tsinigvnisisgo nasgiyai, Unelanvhi agatahv otsineisdi Galonedv.
english: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎣᏣᎴᏂ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎠᏎ ᏫᏗᏨᏃᎮᏗ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎪᏪᎵ ᎣᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏍᎩᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Tsigo taline otsaleni ogvsv otsadalvquodiha?  tsigoge ase widitsvnohedi nogalisdaneha, goweli ogilvquodisgi gilo tsinunalisdanehoi, ale nihi disginvnelvhi sgilvquodisgi?
english: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᏥᎪᏪᎳ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᎯ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏣᏂᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂᎪᎵᏰᎠ.
phonetic: Nihi goweli ogatseliga, tsigowela tsoginawihi, naniv yvwi tsanigataha ale tsanigoliyea.
english: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ, ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᎣᎾᏫᏱ.
phonetic: Gvnigesviyu iyetsvnelvhi nihi Galonedv utseli goweli gesvi, ayv tsogilvwisdanelvhi, gowelanvhi gowelodi gvtanvhi nigesvna, Adanvdosgini Unelanvhi gvnidv utseli gvtanvhi; vtla nvyohi digowelodiyi digowelanvhi yigi, uquedalisgini gesv digowelodiyi onawiyi.
english: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino nusdi yitsalisgasdodv Unelanvhi Galonedv iyuwanisadv.
english: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏲᎦᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᏰᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv ogvsv gesv yeli gayogadanvtedi yigi gohusdi ogvsvquo gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, yeliquosgini igayogadvnedi gesv Unelanvhiyi didalehvsga.
english: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎦᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᏃᎬᏁᎸ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ; ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏓᎯᎰᏉ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo yeli igayogadvnedi tsinogvnelv tsogilvwisdanediyi nahna itse kanohedv datlohisdvi; vtla adina nusdv gowelvi, adanvdosgini dadeyohvsgvi; nusdvyeno gowelv adahihoquo, adanvdosgini adadvnidisgoi.
english: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᎪᏪᎴ ᏣᏰᎶᎴ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎪᎯᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᎧᏃᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎼᏏ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ, ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎲᏍᏗᏉ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuno digalvwisdanedi adahihi gesv ugvwali tsigowele tsayelole nvyohi galvquodiyu tsigesei, nasgi Isili tsuwetsi gohidv digvwanakanodi nigesvna tsigese Mosi ukadvi, tsinvdigalisdodisge digvwalvsadv gesv ukadvi; nasgi ahvsdiquo tsigesei;
english: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ Ꮀ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ?
phonetic: Tlasgo ho yugvwiyusesdi galvquodiyu yigesesdi Adanvdo ugvwali gesv digalvwisdanedi?
english: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎤᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno digalvwisdanedi didadugodanehi gesv gananuwisgi galvquodiyu yigi, ho ugvwiyuha udagonadvdi galvquodiyu adadudalesgi gesv digalvwisdanedi.
english: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎥᏝ ᎰᏩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎬᏩᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nasquo galvquodiyu igvnelvhi tsigese vtla howa galvquodiyu yigesei, nvdigalisdodisge gvwadagonadvdv galvquodiyu gesv soi.
english: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi na ahvdv tsigi galvquodiyu yigesei, utlihiyu wudagonadvdi galvquodiyu nasgi na tsinvwasdiquo.
english: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏦᎬᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎯᏗᏳ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᎭ;
phonetic: Nasgino na tsinusdi udugi tsogvha, utsati ahidiyu gagolisdi otsiwoniha;
english: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏝᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎴ [ᏱᏃᏣᏛᏁᎭ] ᏧᎵᎬᏚᎳᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏫᏗᎬᏩᎾᎧᏃᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Itlano Mosi tsinudvnele [yinotsadvneha] tsuligvdulane nasgi Isili tsuwetsi widigvwanakanodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi wasdv nasgi na ahvdv tsigi.
english: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏓᏂᎪᎵᏯ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎪ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Dunadanvdvsgini tsusganoliyu gesei; gohiyeno iyasdi nvwasdiquo nasgi na aligvdulo ahvdv nigesvna iyuno danigoliya uweti kanohedv datlohisdv gowelvi; Galonedvyeno nigvnisisgo ahvdv nigesoi.
english: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎳᎯᏳᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎼᏏ ᏓᏥᎪᎵᏯ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏚᏭᏢᏙᎢ.
phonetic: Gilahiyuquosgini gohi iga iyasdi iyuno Mosi datsigoliya aligvdulo tsuninawi duwutlvdoi.
english: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᏫᏓᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᎬᏚᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv, Ugvwiyuhiyi widagatahvstanvha, nasgi na aligvdulo iyvdv igvnedi nvdagalistani.
english: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏃ ᏄᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎭ ᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi nasgi na Adanvdo; ilvhitlvno nudvhnadegv Ugvwiyuhi utseli Adanvdo, nahna eha owasv odatseligaya gesvi.
english: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏂᏗᎦᎵᎬᏚᎸᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏓᎧᏂᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎢᏓᏓᏁᏟᏴᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏂᏓᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎲ ᎧᏁᏉᏤᎦ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini nidiv nidigaligvdulvna adagediyi nasgiya dedakanisgv galvquodiyu gesv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, idadanetliyvha nasgiya nusdv nidalisdiha, galvquodiyu gesv igihv kanequotsega, Ugvwiyuhi Udanvdo iyuwanisadv nasgiyai.
english: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏦᎩᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᎩᏙᎵᏨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎩᏯᏪᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi hia digalvwisdanedi tsogiha, nasgiya ogidolitsvi, vtla yidogiyawega;
english: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᎩᏲᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏲᏤᏙᎭ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᏨᏁᎲ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏃᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dogiyosvsgini tsudalenvdv gvsgali udehohisdi gesvi, ale vtla yotsedoha asinasanvisdi gesvi, vtla ale ogatlonasdv yidogilvwisdaneha kanohedv gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, gvnigesvsgini notsvnehv gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, gogilvquododiyi notsvneha naniv yvwi dunadanvdv gvdi Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏍᎦᎵ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Iyusgini osdv kanohedv ogatseli nasquo gvsgali igesesdi, nasgi na getsidvdodi gesv gegvsgalanelv.
english: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ ᏚᎵᏏᎲᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᎤᏘᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna nasgi hia elohi unelanvhi uyelvhi dulisihvsdanelv dunadanvdvi, nasgi tsunilvsadadediyi nigesvna igagadv utisdv galvquodiyu osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga, nasgi Unelanvhi nasgiya tsigi.
english: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏲᏣᏓᏃᎮᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno ogvsv yotsadanoheha otsalitsidohvsgvi, Galonedvsgini Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi; ayvno nihi oginvsidasdi gesv nasgi Tsisa nvdigalisdodisgvi.
english: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏁᏤ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏧᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᏚᎸᏌᏓᏗᎸ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎧᏛ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno nasgi na tsunetse igagati ulisigv tsulvsadadisdiyi, dulvsadadilv tsoginawiyi, nasgi oginediyi igagati agadovhisdodi galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv ukadv tsvdidalehvsga.
english: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏓᏉ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏕᎩᎶᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᏴ.
phonetic: Aseno hia nasgi tsugvwalodi gadaquo digotlvtanvhi degilodi, nasgi utsati ulinigidv gesv Unelanvhi utseli iyulisdodiyi, vtlano ayv.
english: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏕᏯᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏉ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᎩᎸᏍᎦ; ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎦᎵᎲᏲᎵᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Ogadeyadodiha gvwaduwidvquo, aseno vtla yogigilvsga; uwelihisdi ogadanvtawadega, aseno vtla ogalihvyolilvhi yigi;
english: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏃᎬᎾᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎬᏕᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏙᎩᏍᏢᏂᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᎩᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Uyo nogvnadegoi, aseno vtla ogvdetsvhi yigi; dogistlvnistanv, aseno vtla ogidvtanvhi yigi.
english: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏦᏥᏰᎸ ᎣᏥᏱᏙᎰ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nigohilv tsotsiyelv otsiyidoho uyohusv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, nasgi nasquo gvnv Tsisa gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi ayv tsotsiyelvi.
english: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏦᏤᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᏦᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎣᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno tsotseha nigohilvquo tsogiyohusidena Tsisa ogisdvdisgvi, nasgi gvnv nasquo Tsisa gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi ayv ayohusgi ogiquedalvi.
english: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏱᎵᏙᎭ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgino ayohuhisdi gesv ogiyilidoha ayv, nihisgini gvnidv.
english: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏦᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏁᏨ; ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ.
phonetic: Utloyiquo tsogiha adanvdo gohiyudodi gesvi, hia nasgiya tsinigvnv tsigowela, aquohiyunv, ale nasgi iyusdi aginetsv; ayv nasquo otsohiyuhvsga, ale nasgi iyusdi otsinega.
english: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏙᏓᏲᎦᎴᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᏗᎩᏲᏏᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Otsigatahayeno nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa tsuletanvhi, nasquo ayv Tsisa agvdisgv dodayogaletani, ale ayv nihino itsulaha widigiyosihisdi gesesdi.
english: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadiyuyeno tsudalenvdv tseha nihi nvdigalisdodiha; nasgi utsati gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv iyuwanisodiyi Unelanvhi utsati galvquododi iyulisdodiyi unitsati analiheligvi.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎩᏯᏪᎦ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏩᎾᎦᎶᏤᎭ, ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏎᎭ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vtla yidogiyawega; udohiyuhisgininonv gaduiditlv ehi gesv ogiwanagalotseha, hawiniditlvsgini ehi gesv ogalinigohiseha nidadodaquisvi.
english: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏌᎧᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᏞᎦᏉ ᏥᎩ ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎡᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Udasakayeno otsigiliyogv tlegaquo tsigi ogiwadveha utsati ulosvstanvhi iyudagedv alisquadisgi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesvi;
english: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏙᏣᎧᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nidotsakanisgvna gesv nasgi digvgowadvdi tsigi, nasgisgini na digvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi; nasgiyeno digvgowadvdi tsigi digalosohvsgi; nasgisgini na digvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi digalosohvsgi nigesvna.
english: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎣᎩᎵᏦᏛ ᏳᏲᏨ, ᎣᎩᎭ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏬᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ, ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏗᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Otsigatahayeno nasgi iyuno elohi ehi otsinelv ogilitsodv yuyotsv, ogiha adanelv Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi, adanelv tsuwoyi digvtanvhi nigesvna anesgehvhi, ayogi nigesvna galvloi didanelv.
english: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎣᏥᏯᎥ ᎣᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᎦᏄᏬᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Aniyeno otsiyav ogiliyediha, utsati ogaduliha oganuwosdodiyi otsinelv nasgi na galvlo nvdayudalenvhi;
english: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᏱᏙᎦᏄᏩᎥ, ᎥᏝ ᏦᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno howa yidoganuwav, vtla tsogiyelvha yigagesesdi.
english: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏦᏥᏯᎠ ᎣᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ, ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏃᎦᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏦᎩᏄᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᏦᎩᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎩᏐᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno hia ani galitsodv tsotsiyaa ogiliyediha, nigalisdodiha gagedv nogadvhnadegvi; vtla tsoginuwesdiyi ogadulisgv yinvdigalisdodiha; tsoginuwosdiyisgini; nasgi ayohusgi gesv atsigisdiyi gvnidv ugisohvsdiyi.
english: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎢᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏦᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏗᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino na igotlvnvhi hia nasgi ugvwali gesv nasgi Unelanvhi, nasgi nasquo tsoginelv Adanvdo agadidisdodi gesvi.
english: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏥᏁᎸ ᎠᏂ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎲ ᎣᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nigohilv ugalisdi ogadanvtawadegoi, ale otsigataha nasgi nigohilv otsinelv ani tsotsiyelvi, Ugvwiyuhi ehv ogigonelvi;
english: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᎣᏤᏙᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudiyeno gesv otsvdiha otsedohvi, vtlano agowadvdi gesvi.
english: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎦᏲᎩᏰᎸᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎣᎩᎪᏁᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎲ ᏬᎦᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ugalisdi ogadanvtawadegoi, ale utli gayogiyelvdi ayelv ogigoneloisdiyi, ale Ugvwiyuhi ehv woganeladisdiyi.
english: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏱᏬᏥᏁᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏲᎩᎪᏁᎳ, ᏦᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi otsalinigvneha, nasquo nahna yiwotsinela, ale yogigonela, tsogadanilvisdiyi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎩᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏱᎾᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno nidiv igvyiditlv wiginanugoisdi gesesdi Galonedv tsuwugododiyi gasgilvi; nasgi nidiv idisiyvwiha eginediyi nusdv degilvwisdanelv didiyelv gvdi, nasgiya nigadvnelidolvi, osiyu yinagi, ale uyo yinagi.
english: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎦᎾᏰᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏙᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗ ᏴᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsotsigataha ganayeisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, dotsisdiyedi yvwi; ale gvnigesv notsalisdiha Unelanvhi agatahvi; ale udugi aquvha gvnigesv iyaqualisdodiyi nasquo nihi detsadanvdvi.
english: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏲᏥᏂᎳᏗᎭ; ᎢᏨᏁᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎭ ᏧᎾᏬᎯᎵᏴᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏚᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎾᏢᏉᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᏃ ᎠᎾᏢᏉᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno nihi sgilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi yotsiniladiha; itsvnehasgini sgilvquododiyi, nasgi gohusdi yuniha tsunawohiliyvsdanedi, itsvyeliseha, nasgi gaduquo ehi anatlvquododisgi tsigi, dotsunadanvdvno anatlvquododisgi nigesvna.
english: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏃᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯ ᏱᏙᎦᏓᏅᏔ, ᏂᎯᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yidogilvnodiha, Unelanvhiquo nvdigalisdodiha; iyu ale dohi yidogadanvta, nihiquo nvdigalisdodiha.
english: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏙᎦᏘᏁᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏙᏧᎪᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏱᏚᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Galonedvyeno udageyudi gesv dogatinega; hiayeno nusdi dotsugodiha, nasgi, iyuno asiyvwi naniv yiduyohuhiselv, hnaquo nasgi naniv duniyohusvgi;
english: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎾᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏧᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino naniv duyohuhiselei, nasgi na dinvnodv tsigi gohi gesv iyudalenvdv unvsvquo unatseli ugvwali unalenidasdiyi nigesvna, nasgisgini na utseli ugvwali tsuyohuhiselvhi ale tsulehisanvhi tsigi.
english: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusidi gohi gesv iyudalenvdv vtla gilo yotsigataha nasgiya uquedali agatahvi.  Ale nasquo iyu Galonedv otsigadovsvhi yigi uquedali agatahv nasgiyai, aseno gohi gesv iyudalenvdv vtla hnaquo yotsigataha.
english: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏏᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᎠᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ; ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusidi, iyuno gilo Galonedvyi ayaesdi nasgi itse nagvnelv; tsudalenvdv uweti gesv ulosonv; gvniyuquo, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv itse nulistanv.
english: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎡᏗᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏒᎦᎶᏔᏅ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ;
phonetic: Ale nigadiyu tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv, nasgi dohi tsinuwanelv edisgagi gesv Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, ale ayv ogasvgalotanv dohi igvnehi digalvwisdanedi;
english: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎯ ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏂᏓᏰᎸᎾᏁᎲᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏒᎶᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi Unelanvhi dohi nigvnehvgi elohi gvwasgagi gesv Galonedv gvdisgvgi, unisganvtsv unisganvtsvhi nidayelvnanehvna; ale ayv ogasvlotanv kanohedv dohi igvnehi.
english: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏔᏁᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎬᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino ayv oginvsidv Galonedv otsadanetliyvstanelvhi; nasgiyaquo Unelanvhi tsitsisdiyedisgo ayv tsogvdisgoi, Galonedv otsadanetliyvsdaneha, itsvtayoseha Unelanvhi dohi itsvnediyi.
english: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏕᎦᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno asgani nagatahvna tsigesei, nasgi asgana uyelvnv ayv gesv nvtsulisdotanv, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi ayv nidisganvna igiyelvdiyi Unelanvhi degakanisgvi.
english: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏃ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎣᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ayvno tsogilvwisdanehi otsisdelisgi nasquo itsvsdiyediha asequoquo etsinediyi nigesvna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi.
english: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏍᏕᎸᎲ; (ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎪᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎪᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;)
phonetic: Hiayeno nigaweha, gvwadvganelv nahiyu didanilvtsvhi gesvi, ale nahiyu iga gayvdadisdelvdi gesv gvsdelvhv; (gvniyuquo, gohi hnaquo nahiyu didanilvtsvhi gesvi; gvniyuquo, gohi hnaquo nahiyu iga gayvdadisdelvdi gesvi;)
english: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᏕᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gohusdi notsadvnehvna gvwadadodesdodi gesvi, hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv usonv gvwaninohedi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi;
english: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᏨᏁᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏦᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎣᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Nigavsgini nudalesv dogilvwisdanehv gvnigesv notsvneho Unelanvhi gohusdi otsadvnehi gesvi, utsati tsotsvnidiyu gesvi, otsigiliyogvi, oginigvsehvi, ehisdi ogadanvtawadegvi,
english: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᎩᎵᏂᎲᎢ, ᎣᎩᏴᎩᏅᎢ, ᎤᏓᏓᏍᎨᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏖᎸᏅᎢ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎣᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎹᏟ ᎣᏨᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Dogilinihvi, ogiyvginvi, udadasgedv unalitelvnvi, dogilvwisdanehvi, otsiyawisgvi, amatli otsvsgvi,
english: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏃᎦᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏙᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎣᏤᎵᏎᎬᎢ, ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᎨᎲᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎣᎨᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nogadanvgalvna gesvi, agadovhisdi gesvi, gohidoyu unelagi otselisegvi, ogadanvtiyu gesvi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo ogehvi, nutlonasdvna adageyudi ogehvi.
english: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎣᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂᏗᏢ ᎣᎦᏣᏅᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv otsvdisgvi, ulinigidv gesv Unelanvhi utseli otsvdisgvi, duyugodv gesv agatisiditlv ale agasganiditlv ogatsanvdvi,
english: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏃᎩᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ; ᎣᎦᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏃᎦᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ogilvquodiyu gesv ale nogilvquodvna gesvi, uyo oginohesgv ale osdv oginohesgvi; ogatlonasdi tsigeso nasgiyai, aseno nogatlonasdvna gesvi,
english: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏃᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏥᏙᏥᏲᎱᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ ᏦᏨᏃᏛ; ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎣᎩᎸᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: Nogigatahvna nasgiyai, aseno osiyu ogigatahi gesvi; tsidotsiyohusgo nasgiyai, gvniyuquono tsotsvnodv; ogisdvdistanvhi, ogilvhino nigesvna;
english: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏯᏃ ᎣᏣᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ; ᎤᏲ ᏥᏃᎦᏛᎿᎭᏕᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏙᏤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᎩᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Uyo tsogadanvtawadego nasgiya, aseno yano otsaliheligoi; uyo tsinogadvhnadego nasgiya, aseno unitsati dotsenvisdisgoi; gohusdi nogihvna tsigeso nasgiya, aseno nigadiyu tsudalenvdv ogatseliga.
english: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏨᏍᏚᎩᎡᎸ ᏦᏥᎰᎵ, ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏂᏗ, ᏦᎩᎾᏫ ᏕᏨᏯᏛᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Detsvsdugielv tsotsiholi, Itsigolinidi, tsoginawi detsvyadvnohisdanelv.
english: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᏣᏍᏗᎬᏎᎸ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎩᎾᏫ; ᎢᏨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᏚᏍᏗᎬᏒ.
phonetic: Vtla yiditsasdigvselv ayv tsoginawi; itsvsvsgini ditsinawi dusdigvsv.
english: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏍᎩᏯᎫᏴᏓᏁᎲ ^ᏗᏇᏥ ᏥᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ^ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏛᏃᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino utloyiquo sgiyaguyvdanehv ^diquetsi tsigatsiwonedisgo nasgiya itsvwonediha^nasquo nihi ditsadvnohi.
english: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏱᏕᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ; ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏅᏅ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ?
phonetic: Tlesdi niditsadoligvna itsulaha yidetsigilanaladisgesdi nanohiyuhvsgvna; gadoyeno usdi dunadudadv duyugodv gesv ale niduyugodvna gesvi?  ale gado usdi saquo nunvnv igagati ale ulisigi?
english: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏄᏅᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᏯᎵ?  ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏐ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ?
phonetic: Ale gado usdi utloyi nunvnv Galonedv ale Quiliyali?  ale gado usdi itsulaquo unatseliga geso gohiyuhvsgi ale gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna?
english: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏙᎵᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ?  ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gado usdi didoligi nigalisdiha Unelanvhi utseli adanelv ale Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi?  nihiyeno nasgi gvnidv Unelanvhi utseliga uneladisdiyi; nasgiya Unelanvhi hia tsinuwesv, Nasgi na gatsiyaesdi, ale anehv gedohesdi; ale ayv gatsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, ale unvsv diquatseli yvwi gesesdi.
english: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏄᎪ ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏖᎴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏒᏂᎸᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭᎢ; ᎠᏴᏃ ᏙᏓᏨᏯᏓᏂᎸᏥ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi etsinugo itsadasuyv anehvi, ale itsateledv gesesdi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi, ale tlesdi itsasvnilvgi gohusdi gadahai; ayvno dodatsvyadanilvtsi,
english: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏥᏙᏓ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏇᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ.
phonetic: Ale ayv Itsidoda gesesdi, nihino diquetsi gesesdi itsisgaya ale itsigeyv, adiha Ugvwiyuhi winasdvna ulinigidv.
english: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᎦᎸ ᎢᏗᎲᎾ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏇᏓᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎢᏗᏍᏆᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi tsinusdi egiduisdanelvhi tsigi, itsvgeyui, idadanvgalv idihvna nudalesv gadaha gesv igiquedalv, ale igadanvdogihi, idisquadisgesdi duyugodv gesvi, Unelanvhi edinayesgvi.
english: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏃᏨᏁᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᏃᏨᏁᎸ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏲᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Disgiyadanilvgi; vtla gilo utsatini yinotsvnelv, vtla gilo asgana yinotsvnelv, vtla gilo yotsilonuelv.
english: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏨᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎠᎩᏪᏒ, ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏥᏯᎠ, ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏕᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi tsinitsiweha vtla ditsvyugodanediyi yagiyelvha; gayulayeno hia tsiniagiwesv, tsoginawiyi itsiyaa, ogadvnvisdiquo itsulaha diginiyohuhisdiyi, ale itsulaha igadediyi.
english: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᎭ; ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎩᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Utsati itsvyoiyuha; utsati itsvlvquodisgoi; agikalitsvhi ugalisdi gesvi; utsatanvhi ulihelisdi aquadanvtawadego nigav otsigiliyotsidohvi.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏰᏃ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎬᏩᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎬᏩᏚᎾᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎦᏕᏯᏙᏗᎬᎩ; ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎠᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎭᏫᏂᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎣᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Masidoniyeno wogilutsv, vtla ogiquedalv gvwatsawesolvsdodi yigesei, gvwadunadvsgini ogadeyadodigvgi; doyiditlv alidv gesvi, hawinino iditlv otsinayesgvi.
english: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ;
phonetic: Unelanvhisgininonv digalisdadisgi uwelihisdi unadanvtawadegi, ogigalisdadistanvgi Dadasi ulutsvi;
english: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᎷᏨᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᎩᏃᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv ulutsvquo uwasv, ugalisdisgini nasquo udanvdadvi nihi gesv iyusdi, oginonelv nihi utsati itsadulisgvi, uyo itsiyelvsvhi, utsati sgigeyuiyu gesvi; nasgi iyusdi utli igai aqualihelitsvgi.
english: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏫᏨᏅᏁᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏒᎩ; ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏞᎦᏉ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhisgininonv uyo itsvyadanvdadistanvgi goweli witsvnvnelvi, vtla uyo yagiyelvha, uyosgininonv agiyelvsvgi; itsigowatiyeno nasgi goweli uyo itsadanvdadistanvi, aseno tlegaquo.
english: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎨᏥᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓ ᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎢ; ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gohino tsigi galieliga, vtla adina uyo itsadanvdadv yinvdigalisdodiha, nvdigalisdodihasgini digetsinetliyvsdi detsada nvdv iyvdv uyo itsadanvdadvi; uyoyeno itsadanvdadvgi nasgiya Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi tsigi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi gohusdi esga itsvyvnediyi nigesvna.
english: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ ᎥᏓᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎡᎶᎯᏍᏗᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ.
phonetic: Uyoyeno adanvdadisdi Unelanvhi digvwadanilvisdi gesv ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv waliyeilohiha vdadisdelvdiyi wigalugi, nasgi uyo ayelvdi nigesvna; elohisdini ehi uyo adanvdadisdi gesv ayohuhisdi gesv waliyeilohiha.
english: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏣᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏣᏢᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏲᎲᎢ, ᎥᎥ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏑᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᎥᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎥᎥ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ!  ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquoyeno hia nasgi uyo tsitsadanvdadvgi nasgi digvwadanilvisdi gesv Unelanvhi, nigav itsalinigvnedi gesv wuliyeilolv; nigav ditsatlvwisdodi itsiyohvi, vv nigav itsiniquatihvi, vv, nigav itsinayesgvi, vv, nigav utsati itsasulisgvi, vvi, nigav ulinigidv itsadanvdvi, vv, nigav adasdvdisdodi gesvi!  nigav tsudalenvdv gvnigesv nitsvnelv nitsisganvna gesv hia nasgi kanohedi tsigi.
english: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏳᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᎦᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏳᎬᏩᎴᎢ; ᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsinusdi udohiyuhisgininonv witsvyowelanelvgi, aseno vtla utsatini iyudvnelvhi yugvwalei, vtla ale na utsatini iyagadvnelvhi yugvwalei; asgini itsvsquanigodiyu gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesv itsalisdanediyi.
english: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛᎩ; ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎣᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏓᏓᏏ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎡᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi ugalisdi itsadanvdv ayv ogigalisdadvgi; vv, ale utli igai ogalihelisdi nulistanvgi, Dadasi aliheligv iyusdi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nasgi udanvdo nitsiv etsigalisdadelvi.
english: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏯᏢᏈᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎣᎦᏢᏆᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎣᏣᏢᏆᏎᎸᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno tsiyatlvquiselvhi gesesdi, nihi itsvneisdisgvi, vtla yigadeosga; nigadiyusgini tsudalenvdv itsvwonetanvi udohiyuhiya tsigi, nasgiyaquo ogatlvquasvi, nasgi Dadasi otsatlvquaselvi, udohiyuhiya nulistanv.
english: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᏉᏨ, ᎤᏅᏓᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale unawiyi itsigeyuhiyu gesv utsati unequotsv, unvdadv itsohiyuhiyu gesv nitsivi, nasgi itsinayesgi ale ditsinawisgi detsadanilvtsvi.
english: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎨᏨᏲᎢᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi galieliga, getsvyoiyudi gesv nudalesv gohusdi ugvwali.
english: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Alewo idalinvtli, gvnigesv nitsvyvneha, Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udanedi gesv nasgi dunelv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Masidoni anehi;
english: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᏄᏂᎨᏳᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi utsati adagoliyesgi anigiliyogv, utsati analiheligv ale utsati uyo nunadvhnadegv galvquodiyu nuwanelv nunigeyuhnavna gesvi.
english: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎤᎾᎵᎦᏟᏴᎯᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏛ;
phonetic: Gatsiyoiyudanehayeno nasgi nidunalinigvgv iyvdv, vv, ale anilosvsdisgv niganalinigvgvi, unaligatliyvhiquo unvsv unadanvtedv;
english: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎩᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎩᏔᏲᏎᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏅᎯ ᏦᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏖᏆᎶᏗᏱ ᏦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Utsati gogisdiyedisgv gogitayosehvgi nasgi uninvhi tsogadanilvisdiyi, ale ogatequalodiyi tsotsisdelvdiyi tsunanelodi.
english: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ [ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎩ] ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᏅᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎪᎦᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale [nasgi nunadvnelvgi] vtla nasgiya nusdv udugi ogvnvi, igvyisgini unvsv Ugvwiyuhi dunadayohiselvgi, ale ayv degogadayohiselvgi, Unelanvhi osiyu ayelvsgv nvdayulisdotanvgi.
english: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Dadasi otsitayoselvgi, nasgi nusdv ulenvhvi, nasgiya iyudvnediyi usquadisdiyi itsehv utloyi itsadanediyi nitsvnehvi.
english: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏥᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigav tsudalenvdv utsati tsitsiha, nasgi gohiyudi gesvi, ale gawonihisdi gesvi, ale agadovhisdi gesvi, ale nigav tsudalenvdv itsigaliyvi, ale ayv sgigeyuiyu gesvi, hia nasgi adanedi gesv nasquo utsati itsihesdi.
english: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᎵᎦᎵᏴᏅ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla yitsinega nasgi hia ase itsadvnediyi, anisoisgini unaligaliyvnv nvdigalisdodiha, ale agigoliyediyi adageyudi gesv itsihv nutlonasdvna gesvi.
english: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎾᎢᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎿᎭᎢ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsigatahayeno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi uwenaiyu tsigesei, aseno nihi gesv nvdigalisdodisgv uyo iyudvhnadegi nulistanvi, nasgi uwasv uyo iyudvhnadegi gesv iyuwanisodiyi nihi ditsehnai itsalisdodiyi.
english: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏣᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ani nasgi nusdv gadanvtesgv gvnigesv nigvneha; osiyuyeno igetsalisdanedi, nasgi gayula itsalenvdv tsigi, hnaquo sudetiyvdv, vtla itsadvnediyiquo nasgi, nasquosgini osiyu itsiyelvdiyi.
english: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏓ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏚᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo itsisquada nasgi iyadvnedi gesvi, nasgi itsigaliyiyu nigesv itsadulvdiyi, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi itsisquadisgvi, itsvdisgv nasgi nusdv itsihvi.
english: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᎵᏴ ᏧᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno igvyi gesv gilo yagaliyv tsudanvdvi, tsagadanilvtsedi geso nasgiya nusdv uhvi, vtlano nasgiya nuhvna gesvi.
english: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᎪᏗᏱ ᏂᎯᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Vtla adina nvwanadale digetsigodiyi nihino asdaya iyetsvnediyi yigadiha;
english: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭᏍᎩᏂ [ᎢᏥᏗᏱ;] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎲ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏥᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Igvwasdihasgini [itsidiyi;] nasgi gohi gesv utsati itsihv yiditsisdelvdiha uninigvsehvi, nasgino nasquo utsati unihv getsisdelvdiyi itsinigvsehvi, nasgi igvwasdiha itsidiyi.
english: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎤᏭᏖᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏘᏰᎮᎢ; ᎾᏃ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎤᏭᏖᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎷᎶᏤᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Nasgi ugodi uwutedv vtla yutiyehei; nano gayoli uwutedv vtla yululotsehei.
english: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎤᎾᏫᏱ ᏧᎳᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏤᎷᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi, nasgi Dadasi unawiyi tsulanelv nasgi igai ditseluisdiyi.
english: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ ᏥᏬᏁᏔᏅᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno dudanilvtsvgi tsiwonetanvi; aseno utlihiyu nuligaliyvsv nvdayulisdotanvgi, uwasvquo udanvtedv itsiwadvhvsvgi.
english: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏱᏥᏅᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Ale yitsinvli nasgi anegi na idalinvtli, nigvnadv dunadatluwadisv tsunanelodi gvwalvquodiyu tsigi osdv kanohedv tsinvdigalisdodiha;
english: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᏂᎦᎥ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎬᏩᏑᏰᏒᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎨᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ [ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ] ᎢᏣᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Ale vtla nasgiquo yinigav, nasquosgini dunadatluwadisv tsunanelodi gvwasuyesvgi ayv itsulaha ogenvsdiyi ogiyvsdiyi hia nasgi adanedi, nasgi tsidogilvwisdaneha, galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi Ugvwiyuhi uwasv, ale [gvnigesv igvwanediyi] itsaligaliyvsv doditsadanvdvi;
english: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎨᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Hia nasgi otsiyosdodisgvi, gilo gohusdi gogelisediyi hia nasgi utsati ugvwali gohusdi ogvnedi tsinigalisdiha;
english: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎣᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏉ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyi gayehi otsagasayasdisgv osiyu ayelvdi gesvi, vtla Ugvwiyuhiquo agatahvi, yvwisgini nasquo anigatahvi.
english: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏅᎵ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎫᏘᎶᏛ ᎣᏥᎪᎵᏰᏛ ᎣᎦᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎾᎦᎵᏴ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale otsinvli itsulaha anegi otsalinvtli, nasgi uwagutilodv otsigoliyedv ogadolehosvhi utsati agaliyiyu gesvi, aseno gohi gesv utli nagaliyv, nvdigalisdodiha utsati itsohiyusvi.
english: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏓᏏᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Dadasino gesvi, oginaligohi nasgi, ale itsulaha tsoginilvwisdanehi nihi gohusdi itsvyadvnehvi; otsalinvtlino gesv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv gvwaninvsidv nasgi, ale galvquodiyu iyanvnehi Galonedv.
english: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏢᏆᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi anigatahv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, gvnigesv nidetsvnelvha nasgi gohiyudisgi adageyudi gesv itsehvi, ale ogatlvquasv nihi itsvneisdisgvi asequo nigesvna gesvi.
english: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nano unadanvti disdelvdiyi ugvwali, asequoquo yitsvyowelaneha.
english: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎵᏱᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎦᏥᏯᏢᏈᏎᎭ, [ᎦᏥᏃᏁᎭ] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎧᏯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᏅ.
phonetic: Tsigatahayeno digaliyiyu gesv detsadanvdvi, nasgi itsvneisdisgv Masidoni anehi gatsiyatlvquiseha, [gatsinoneha] nasgi Ekaya hnaquo sudetiyvdv gvwadvnvistanvhi gesvi; ale nihi ulinigidv itsadanvdv unitsata unitelvnv.
english: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏥᏅᎵ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏣᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno gatsinvli otsalinvtli, nasgi asequoquo iyulisdodiyi nigesvna otsatlvquisgv itsvneisdisgvi; nasgi itsadvnvistanvhi yigi, nasgiya nagiwesvi.
english: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏎᎦᏨ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ, ᏱᏨᏩᏛᏔᏅᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎾ, ᎠᏴ, (ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ,) ᏲᏣᏕᎰᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᎯ ᎣᎦᏢᏈᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yinvwasegatsv Masidoni anehi yigvgisdawadenv, yitsvwadvtanvno nitsadvnvistanvna, ayv, (vtlayeno nihi yigadiha,) yotsadehohi hia nasgi utsati ogohiyuhi ogatlvquisvi.
english: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᏱᎦᏥᏁᏤᎸ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎨᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏭᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎢᏥᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ase yigatsinetselv analinvtli aquelisvgi igvyi wigetsilutsediyi, ale igvyi wunadvnvisdodiyi itsidi gesv, nasgi gayula kaneistanvhi tsigi, nasgi advnvistanonvhi yigi, nasgiya osiyu itsiyelvhi itsinvhi gesvi, vtlano itsigeyunvhi nasgiyai.
english: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ [ᏄᏍᏗ;] ᎩᎶ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏲᎵ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎪᏗ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiasgini [nusdi;] Gilo gayoli awisgi, nasgi na nasquo gayoli usgudesdi gesesdi; ale gilo ugodi awisgi nasgi na nasquo ugodi usgudesdi gesesdi.
english: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ [ᎠᏂᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ;] ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᏝᏉ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏂᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏁᏘ ᎠᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Naniv gilo nasgiya nusdv anadanvtesgv tsuninawiyi [anihvsgesdi;] vtlasdi tlaquo uniyelvhi, vtla ale ase unidiyi tsinigegvneho iyusdi; Unelanvhiyeno ugeyuha ugalisdi udaneti ahvsgi.
english: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno yeliquo getsinedi utsati nudalesv gohusdi, nasgi nihi nigohilv nitsinigvsehvna gesv nigav tsudalenvdv, osdv gesv utsati digetsilvwisdanedi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎬᏅ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᏚᏗᎦᎴᏯᏍᏔᏅ; ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏚᏁᎸ; ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya hia tsinigvnv tsigowela, Dudigaleyastanv; uyo iyunadvhnadegi dunelv; udanvtiyu gesv nvwasdiquo nigohilvi.
english: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎠᏫᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏚ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏉᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgino na ugata awisgi unehi tsigi, ale gadu alisdayvdodi adanehi tsigi, itsinedi gesesdi ale ugodadisdi gesesdi itsiwisdi gesvi, ale unequosdi gesesdi itsadanvtiyu gesv ugatatanvhi;
english: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏣᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎬᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nudalesv gohusdi itsenvistanvhi gesv, nasgi utsati getsadanedi gesvi, nasgi iyugvnisodiyi agalihelitsediyi Unelanvhi.
english: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏯᏔᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏅᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ;
phonetic: Hiayeno ayatasdi gesv itsinvhi, vtla unadanvti uninigvsehv akaliihi uwasv yigi, nasquosgini utsati unalihelitsedi Unelanvhi nigvneha;
english: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏛᏂᎸᏉᏔᏂ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎨᏳᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ;
phonetic: Anigowadisgvyeno iyusdi nasgi hia unalisdelvdodi gesv Unelanvhi dvnilvquotani nigalisdodisgesdi gvnigesv nitsvnehv itsohiyusv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga, ale nigalisdodisgesdi nitsigeyuhnavna gesv detsinehv nasgi, ale nanivquo;
english: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi anadadolisdisgv getsineisdisgesdi, utsati getsigeyusv nvdigalisdodisgv utsati gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi itsinelvi.
english: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎮᎰᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi alihelitsedi gesesdi nigalisdodiha nasgi udanedi gesv ganohehohvsdi nigesvna tsigi.
english: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏙᎵᏍᏙᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎰ ᎠᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᏂᏨᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯ^
phonetic: Nasgino ayv Quola aquvsv itsvsdiyediha tsineisdiha udolisdosiyu gesv ale udanvtiyu gesv Galonedv, ayv nasgi tsitsvyeladidoho aquadanayesdi tsigehoi, aseno agigonelv nitsvnayesgvna tsigi nihi^
english: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎾᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᏓᎾᏰᏍᏛᎾ ᎦᏥᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏣᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎢᎦᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗ ᏥᎪᎨᎵᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno itsvtayoseha itsvyeladidohv naquadanayesdvna iyaqualisdodiyi nigesvna, nasgiya naquadanayesdvna gatsiyvdanedi tsagiyelvha igadv, nasgi uquedali adanvtesgv danikahnawadi tsigogeliseha.
english: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᏤᏙᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᏟᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏙᏣᏟᏴᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhisgininonv uquedalv utsedoha, aseno vtla uquedali tsutliyvdodi gesv yidotsatliyvdiha;
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎣᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏅᏩ ᎣᏣᎢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏧᏩᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏓᏐᏲᎥᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏓᏐᏴᎢ.)
phonetic: (Ogalisdelvdodiyeno gesv danvwa otsaisv vtla uquedali tsuwadodi yigi, tsulinigidiyusgini Unelanvhi iyuwanisadv, dasoyovdisgv ulinigidv dasoyvi.)
english: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏙᏨᏁᎰ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎵᏌᎳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏎᎪᎩᏍᎪ ᏙᏣᏘᏁᎪ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏃᏨᏁᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Eladi nidotsvneho adanvtedi gesv, ale nudalesv inv igati nasgi adalisaladisgi Unelanvhi utseli agadovhisdi gesv digatilegi, ale dotsisegogisgo dotsatinego nudalesv adanvtedi gesv Galonedv gvwohiyudiyi notsvnehoi;
