english: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏦᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale ogadvnvisdi tsotsisdvdisdodiyi naniv nunohiyusvna gesvi, nahiyu itsohiyusv ukalitsvhi gesesdi.
english: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎦᏚ-ᎢᏗᏢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᎧᏂᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏯᏤᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎡᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎠᏓᏅᏛᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᏣᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Tsigo gaduiditlv nusdv dikanodiyi gohusdi detsakanisgoi?  iyuno gilo uwasvquo adalisgasdodisgesdi Galonedv tsiyatseli ayv ielisgesdi, uwasv gesv taline hia nasgi tsiadanvdvli, nasgi nasgiya Galonedv utseli gesv nasgi, nasgiya nasquo ayv Galonedv otsatseliga.
english: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏯᏆᏢᏈᏍᏔᏅ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎣᎦᏒᎦᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏦᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasquo utli igai yaquatlvquistanv nusdv ogasvgalvi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsoginelv itsalisdelvdodi gesvi, vtlano eladi iyetsvnedodi gesvi, vtla yigagadeosga.
english: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎲ ᎢᏨᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱᏉ ᏣᎩᏰᎸᏐ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi adina itsvyowelanehv itsvsgasdanediyiquo tsagiyelvso yinvwasdesdi.
english: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎪᏪᎵᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳ, ᎠᎾᏗᎭ; ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏲᏪᎳᏗᏙᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ, ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᏃ ᎬᏕᎰᏙᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Degowelisgvyeno digagediyu ale tsulinigidiyu, udohiyu, anadiha; ayelvsgini yoweladidoha awanagalahiyu, gawonisgvno gvdehododiquo.
english: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏰᎵᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏙᏦᏪᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏃᏤᏙᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏃᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎿᎭᏬᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyelisgi hia nasgi nusdesdi adanvtesgesdi, nasgi ayv nasgiya nogasdv otsiwonisgv dotsowelisgvi, nahna winotsedohvna gesvi, nasgiya nasquo nogasdesdi dogilvwisdanehv hnaquo nahna wotsedohesdi.
english: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎦᏲᎦᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏲᎦᏓᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᏓᎾᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏓᎾᏓᏤᎳᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏓᏅᏔ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yeli gayogalitloyasdodi yigi, ale digayogadatlilosdodi yigi nunasdv nasgi unvsv anadalvquodisgi; nasgiyeno unvsv gesv unvsvquo nunasdv danadatlilosdisgv, ale unvsvquo danadatselasdisgv vtla yunadanvta.
english: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏲᏣᏢᏈ ᎠᎦᏲᏥᎶᏒᏍᏓ ᎠᏟᎶᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini vtla yvgayotsatlvqui agayotsilosvsda atlilovi; nasgiyaquosgini wasdv iyvdv atlilov Unelanvhi dogiyohiselvi, nasgi atlilosdi nihi ditsehv wigalugi.
english: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏲᏥᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ ᎣᎦᏟᎶᏒᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏫᎦᏲᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏤᎲ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏬᎩᎷᏨ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Vtlayeno yotsilosvsdiha ogatlilosvlvi, nasgiya nihi ditsehv wigayogiluhisdi nigesvna tsigeso iyusdi; nihiyeno nasquo ditsehv iyvdv wogilutsv otsalitsidohvsgv osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga;
english: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏃᏣᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᏚᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎬᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏁᏉᎡᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸ ᏬᎩᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Notsatlvquisdisgvna atlilov doyiditlv gesvi, nasgi anisoi yvwi dunilvwisdanelvi; udugisgini ogvsvi, nasgi itsohiyusv hnaquo unequotsvhi gesesdi, nihi sginequoediyi sgisdelvdiyi wasdv iyvdv ogatliloelv wogilosvsdodiyi,
english: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏤᎲ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎣᎦᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏅᏩᏓᏕ ᎩᎶ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ogalitsidodiyi osdv kanohedv ditsehv udiditlv, vtlano ogatlvquisdiyi nvdigalisdodisgv nvwadade gilo wasdv iyvdv agatliloelvi, gayula ogadvnvisdanelvhi gesvi.
english: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilosgini atlvquisgesdi Ugvwiyuhi atlvquisdisgesdi.
english: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno nasgi na uwasv adalvquodisgi tsagadanilvisdi yigi, nasgisgini na Ugvwiyuhi ulvquotanvhi.
english: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏲᎯᏉ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᏍᎩᏰᎵᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏰᎵᏏ.
phonetic: Yohiquo usdigidv unelagi gesgiyelisedi yigi aginegu gesvi; ale udohiyuhi unelagi sgiyelisi.
english: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏨᏰᎷᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎬᏩᏓ ᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᎭ; ᏌᏉᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᏣᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏛ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏫᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Detsvyelugayeno Unelanvhi digvwada nilvisdi advyugedi gesv gvdiha; saquoyeno asgaya ditsatsvsdiyi nitsvyvnelv, nasgi ulisinahisdi adv igagadv Galonedv widitsvyohisediyi.
english: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ Ꮎ ᎢᎾᏛ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᎴ ᎢᏫ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᏥᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏓᎪᎸᎾ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᎬᎦ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno tsinayesga, nasgiya na inadv tsulonuhele Iwi asinasanv tsigvdisgei, nasgiya detsadanvdv yidagolvna ditsiyohisdiyi yinigvga nutlonasdvna gesv Galonedv utseliga.
english: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎣᏏᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏤᎵᏒ.
phonetic: Giloyeno itsilutsehi nvwadale Tsisa alitsidohvsgesdi, nasgi na ayv otsalitsidonvhi nigesvna, iyu ale nvwadale adanvdo dotsadanilvtsvha, nasgi na ditsadanilvtsvhi nigesvna, ale nvwadale osdv kanohedv, nasgi na ditsadanilvtsvhi nigesvna, osiyuquo unelagi yitselisv.
english: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏅ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᎦᏥᏲᎠᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadanvtesgvyeno vtla usdi unv esga yigatsiyoasga nunigvwiyusv getsinvsidv gesvi.
english: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏅᏇᏲᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏔᎾᎥᎢ; ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unelagi nvqueyonvna yigi agiwonihisdiyi, aseno vtla nasgi yinusdi tsigatanavi; nigavquosgini nogasdv gvnigesv nogalistanv naniv anigatahv nihi itsehvi.
english: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏥᎾᏆᏓᏛᏁᎸ, ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᏨᎬᏩᎶᏓᏁᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigo tsisganvgi eladi tsinaquadadvnelv, nihi etsisaladodiyi, nasgi niditsvgvwalodanelvna tsigi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga itsvyalitsidonelvi?
english: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏥᎾᏌᏅ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏥᎩᏍᎬᎩ ᎬᏆᎫᏴᎡᎲᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Degatsinasanv nvwanadale tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, tsigisgvgi gvquaguyvehvi, nihi gohusdi itsvyadvnediyi.
english: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᎲᎥᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏆᎫᏱᏍᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ ᎬᎩᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᏨᏐᏈᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nahiyu tsitsvyeladidohvgi ale aquadulvhvvga, vtla gilo yaquaguyisgei; nasgiyeno aginigvsehvi, otsalinvtli Masidoni nvdayunilosvhi gvginehvgi; ale nigavquo aquatlinigvnelv itsvsoquilvdiyi nigesvna, ale asiquo nasgi nigadvnehesdi.
english: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎩᏯᎠ, ᎥᏝ ᎥᎩᏲᎯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎡᎧᏯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya Galonedv utseli gayegogi nigesvna gesv tsagiyaa, vtla vgiyohisdanedi yigesesdi hia nasgi gatlvquisgv Ekaya nigvnadvi.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ?  ᏥᎪ ᏂᏨᎨᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Gadono?  tsigo nitsvgeyusvna gesv iyusdi?  Unelanvhi agataha.
english: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎦᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᎾᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎾᏢᏈᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno nigadvnehv nasgi nigagadvnehesdi, nasgi gatsiyosdodanediyi unadlanvdadediyi nasgi na tsunaduliha unadlanvdadediyi; nasgi nahna anatlvquisgv nasgi ayv nogasdv nasgiya nunasdv gvnigesv yinigalisda.
english: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎾᏤᎸᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi na unatlonasgi getsinvsidv, unadalidasdi tsunilvwisdanehi, Galonedv tsutseli getsinvsidv anatselvsgi.
english: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ; ᏎᏓᏂᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yusquanigodi; Sedaniyeno uwasv dikahnawadidohi igagadv ehi atselvsgoi.
english: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏤᎸᏍᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi vtla utsati usquanigodiyu yigi nasquo nasgi tsunvsidasdi duyugodv gesv getsinvsidasdi yanatselvsga; nasgi ulisqualvdi iyunalisdanedi gesv nasgiya dunilvwisdanelv gesesdi.
english: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎫ ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Taline hia nitsiweha, Tlesdi gilo unegu yaquelisehesdi; iyu adina nasgi nusdesdi, ase aginegu nasgiya disgiyadanilvgi, nasgi ayv usdi aquatlvquisdiyi.
english: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬ ᏥᏁᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏁᎦ, ᎠᎩᏁᎫᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎬᏗᎭ ᏥᎦᏢᏆᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nitsiwesgv tsinegv vtla Ugvwiyuhi iyuwesdi yitsinega, aginegusgini nasgiya tsinega, hia nasgi nitsinayesgvna gesv tsigvdiha tsigatlvquasga.
english: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᏣᏔ ᏣᎾᏢᏈᏍᎦ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsunitsata tsanatlvquisga uquedali gvdodi gesvi, ayv nasquo dagatlvquasi.
english: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏙᏤᎵᏎᎭ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unineguyeno unanelagi dotseliseha osiyu itsiyelvha, nihi itsigatanai gesv iyusdi.
english: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎪ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏥᎾᏢᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏒᎭ ᏱᏂᏨᏁᎸ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ [ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲ] ᏱᏥᎩᎡᎸ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏳᏓᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏕᏣᎧᏛ ᏱᏨᏂᎸ.
phonetic: Unelagiyeno itselisgo iyuno gilo yiditsinatlvnv, iyuno gilo asvha yinitsvnelv, iyuno gilo [gohusdi itsihv] yitsigielv, iyuno gilo uwasv yudalisaladanv, iyuno gilo detsakadv yitsvnilv.
english: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏁᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎪᎪᏎᎲᎢ.  ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ (ᎤᏁᎫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ,) ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Udehohisdi gesv ugvwali tsinega, nasgi tsotsiwanagala gogosehvi.  Nahnasgininonv gilo gvwanayehisdi nigesvna gesv (unegu uneisdi tsinega,) ayv nasquo nitsinayesgvna.
english: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎢᎾᏈᎷ ᎾᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ. ᏥᎪ ᎠᏂᎢᏏᎵ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ.  ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏍᎪ ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ?  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ.
phonetic: Tsigo Inaquilu nasgi?  ayv nasquo. Tsigo Aniisili?  ayv nasquo.  Equahamisgo tsunetlvtanvdv nasgi?  ayv nasquo.
english: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ?  (ᎤᏁᎫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ,) ᎠᏴ ᎤᏟᎢ; ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᎥᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᏗᎦᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏴᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ; ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏃᏉ;
phonetic: Tsigo Galonedv tsunvsidasdi nasgi?  (unegu uneisdi tsinega,) ayv utlii; dagilvwisdanehv utli igai; vgilivnilv utlihiyu igai; digasdudiyi vgiyvtanvi utli igai; agiyohusidena gesv yanoquo;
english: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᎬᏋᏂᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Anitsusi hisgi nigvgilivnilvgi iyusdiha saquo galulogi nvgasgohi igvquvnisdiyi;
english: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᏕᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᏅᏯ ᏂᏕᎬᏋᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᏦᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏥᏳ ᎠᏆᏦᏛ ᎤᏲᏨᎩ; ᎤᎵᏨᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ ᎠᏍᏛᎬ ᎾᏆᏛᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Tsoi iyuwagudi ganasda degvgilivnistanvgi; saquo nvya nidegvquvnistanvgi; tsoi iyuwagudi tsiyu aquatsodv uyotsvgi; ulitsvdaquadv ale udodaquadv asdvgv naquadvnvgi;
english: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏙᎲ ᏯᏃᏉ; ᎡᏉᏂ ᏕᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᎾᎨ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Gedohv yanoquo; equoni degeyv unayehisdiyu gesvi; dinadanasahvsgi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; diquatseli yvwi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; tsunadalenvdv yvwi uninayehisdiyu gesvi; gaduhv unayehisdiyu gesvi; inage gesv unayehisdiyu gesvi; amequohi unayehisdiyu gesvi; unatlonasdi otsalinvtli uninayehisdiyu gesvi;
english: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᏂᏥᎸᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎪᏄ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎢ; ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᎹᏟ ᎬᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏴᏢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dagiyawetsidolv ale ehisdi naqualisdanelvi; yanogiyu nitsilvsgvna gesvi; agonu agiyosisgvi ale agitadegisgvi; yanogiyu amatli gvsgvi; uyvtlv ale agiyelvha gesvi.
english: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏓᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᏣᎩᎷᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nidatloyasdvna tsudalenvdv, nasgi nidugitsvnisv tsagilutseha, nasgi na diquagasayasdodiyi nigadv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.
english: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎶᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᏥᏩᏂᎦᎸᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ?  ᎦᎪ ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏂᏥᎴᏴᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ?
phonetic: Gago awanagaloi, ayvno nitsiwanigalvna gesoi?  gago duwodehihoi, ayvno nitsileyvsgvna gesoi?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ.
phonetic: Iyuno ase aquatlvquisdi gesesdi, tsiwanagaliyu gesv ugvwali dagatlvquasi.
english: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎦᏔᎭ  ᏂᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv utseli Unelanvhi ale udoda, nasgi nigohilv galvquododi tsigi, agataha  nigatsigovsgvna gesvi.
english: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏫᎨᏙᎲ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏎᏕᎩ ᎡᎵᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎯ, ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Demasga wigedohv nugvwiyusedegi Elida ugvwiyuhi uwekanvhi, ayawisgvgi Anidemasga uniduhvi nasgi udulisgv aginiyvdiyi;
english: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏦᎳᏅᏃ ᏓᎬᎩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᏔᎷᏣᎩᎯ ᎬᏆᏦᏗ ᎬᏆᏠᎥᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏐᏳᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᏗᏫᏎᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Atsolanvno dagvginugowisvgi talutsagihi gvquatsodi gvquatlovtanvgi asoyulodi, ale tsiyadiwiselvgi.
english: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ [ᎩᎶ] ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla gvwadasdelvdi yigi udohiyuhi aquatlvquisdiyi; nasgi iyusdi datsineistani [gilo] unelawiselv ale Ugvwiyuhi gvnigesv nuwanelvi.
english: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᏚ ᎾᏕᏘᏴ, (ᎠᏯᎥ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏯᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ;) ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Tsigatahvgi asgaya Galonedv gohiyuhvsgi, hnaquo nigadu nadetiyv, (ayav ayelv vtla yitsigataha, ale ayelv nayavna gesv vtla yitsigataha; Unelanvhi agataha;) nasgi hia agatinawidvhvgi tsoine galvlo digesv wagatinolvgi.
english: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, (ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏯᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎾᏯᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ;)
phonetic: Ale tsigatahi gesvgi nasgi, (ayelv ayav, ale ayelv nayavna gesv vtla yitsigataha; Unelanvhi agataha;)
english: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi na agatinawidvhvgi nvwadohiyadv digesv wagatinolvgi, ale udvganvgi aniwonisgv igawesdi nigesvna, niduyugodvna gesv yvwi nasgi iyuwesdiyi.
english: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎦᏢᏈ; ᎠᏋᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏓᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᏢᏈ, ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgi na tsineisdisgv yigatlvqui; aquvsvsgini gadaneisdisgv vtla yvgagatlvqui, tsiwanagaliyu gesv uwasv.
english: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᏚᎵ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᏃᎲᎵ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎥᎨᎳ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏂᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏃ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yaquaduli aquatlvquisdiyi, vtla aginegu yigagesesdi; udohiyuhiyeno gesv yitsinohvli; aseno unelagi vgela, nvdigalisdodiha gilo aquadanvtesgv utli yiniagilvquodi ano naquasdv agigowatisgvi, ale nusdv aquadvgisgvi.
english: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎥᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎩᏣᏲᎯᎯ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᏋᏂᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino ulosvstanvhi aqualisaladodiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nvdigalisdodisgv utsati vginanugowiselvgi, agitsayohihi vginelvgi agiquedalvi, Sedani unvsidv aquvnihi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi aqualisaladodiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏦᎢ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᎡᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia ugvwali tsoi nitsitayoselvgi Ugvwiyuhi nasgi aquadanvediyi.
english: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎬᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏊᏢᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi, Gvwagatiya aquadadolisdi gesv yeliquo getsalisdelvdodi; aqualinigvgvyeno ukalitsvhi igvnelvhi nahna wanagala gesvi.  Nasgi iyusdi utsati aqualihelitsvhi utli agiyelvha aquatlvquisdiyi tsiwanagaliyu gesvi, nasgi ulinigidiyu gesv Galonedv aquutlvdodiyi.
english: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏴᎩᏐᏢᏛᎢ, ᎠᎩᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᏥᏩᏂᎦᎵᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏐ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi galieliga tsiwanagaliyu gesvi, gayvgisotlvdvi, aginigidv gesvi, uyo nvquvhnadegvi, ehisdi aquadanvtawadegv Galonedv nvdigalisdodisgvi; tsiwanigaliyuyeno tsigeso, nahiyu aqualinigidiyu gesoi.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏁᎫ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᏢᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎯ ᏂᏍᎩᏴᏂᏌᏏ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᏅ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᎦᏥᏲᎠᏍᎦ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Aginegu naqualistanv gatlvquasgvi; nihi nisgiyvnisasi; nihiyeno sgilvquododi gesvgi; vtlayeno sudalegi unv esga yigatsiyoasga nunigvwiyusv getsinvsidv, nasquo ayv gohusdi nigesvna yigi.
english: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya adolehohisdodi vginvsidv gesv digalvwisdanelvhi nigalisdiha itsehvi, gvtanvhi utsati gvnidiyu gesvi, uyelvdvi, usquanigodi degalvwisdanelvi, ale ulinigidv degalvwisdanelvi.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏍᎦ ᏕᏦᎭᏍᎦ ᏗᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏨᏯᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gadono usdi nasgi nahna esga detsohasga disoi tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi, hia uwasv, nasgi ayv aquvsv gagedv nitsvyvnelvna gesvi?  gesgivsiquo adina hia nasgi utsatini nitsvyadvnelvi.
english: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏦᎢᏁ ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏱᏅᎨᏨᏴᎦ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲ ᏱᎩᏲᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏲᎭ; ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᎳᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏁᏥ ᏧᎾᏓᏁᎳᏁᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo, tsoine aquadvnvisdi witsvlutsediyi; vtla ale gagedv yinvgetsvyvga; vtlayeno gohusdi itsihv yigiyoha, nihisgini itsvyoha; diniyoliyeno vtla tsunigayvlige tsunadanelanedi yigi, anigayvligesgini tsunetsi tsunadanelanedi gesoi.
english: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏗᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᏁᏉᎬ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎢ ᎤᎦᏲᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale utsati osiyu agiyelvsesdi aquaguyvhidasdiyi ale aquvsv aquadisvhvsdiyi ditsadanvdo detsisdelisgvi, nasquo kanequogv itsvgeyusvi ugayolohisdiyi yinigvneha sgigeyusvi.
english: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎩ ᏕᏨᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Adina unelagi nasgi nusdesdi, nasgi gagedv nitsvyvnelvna gesvi; aseno tsisinasaniyu gesv, galonuhedv aquvtanvgi detsvniyvhvgi.
english: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎢᏨᎶᏄᎡᏍᎨ ᎦᏥᏴᏗᏍᎨ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏫᎨᏥᎷᏤᎸᎯ?
phonetic: Tsigo itsvlonuesge gatsiyvdisge gilo gatsinvsidv wigetsilutselvhi?
english: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏓᏏ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎥᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ.  ᏥᎪ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᎴᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏲᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨ ᎣᏍᏕᏙᎲᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏌᏉ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏙᏍᏓᎳᏏᏂᏙᎲᎢ?
phonetic: Dadasi tsitayoselvgi, ale anegi vtsinvsvgi idalinvtli.  Tsigo Dadasi itsilonuhelei?  tlasgo utloyiquo adanvdo yosdvdisge osdedohvi?  tlasgo saquo yigese dosdalasinidohvi?
english: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ, ᏥᎪ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᏕᎵ ᎢᏤᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏪᏲᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ [ᎣᏥᏁᎦ.]
phonetic: Alewo, tsigo otsalisdeli itseliha itsigatahvi?  Unelanvhi agatahv otsinega Galonedv tsuweyonvhi nasgiyai; aseno itsvgeyui, nigav nihi itsalinigohisdodi ugvwali [otsinega.]
english: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏍᏛᎾᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᏗᏓᏃᎮᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎠᏤᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Tsinayesgayeno nasgi witsilutsvha nasgi nitsasdvnaquo gesv nusdv aquadulisgv itsvwadvdiyi, ale aquvsv gesv sgigowadvdiyi nasgiya nitsadulisgvna gesvi; ale agiwadvdiyi ditiyosdi gesvi, advyugedi gesvi, atalawohisdi gesvi, adisvsdi gesvi, uyo didanohelidasdi gesvi, adonvdi gesvi, utli atselvdi gesvi, tsudalenvdv igvnedi gesvi;
english: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ [ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ,] ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏥᏍᎪᏂᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏂᏰᎸᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᎾᏂᏏᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale [tsinayesga,] taline witsilutsvha, Aquanelanvhi aquadehohisdodiyi itsigatahvi, ale gatsisgonisdiyi unitsati gayula unisganvtsvhi tsigi, ale uyo nuniyelvnvna tsigi gadaha nunadvnelvi, ale udelidv dunanisinvi, ale unalisotlvistanvi.
english: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏥᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ.  ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohi nasgi tsoine hnaquo tsiwvdatsvlutseli.  Anitali ale tsoi anigatahi digvdodi gesesdi asdayidisdi nigav kanohedi gesvi.
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏫᏥᎦᏔᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᏫᎠᎩᎷᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᎦᎵᏏᏅᏓ;
phonetic: Gayula hia nagiwesv, ale igvyi gayehi hia nitsiweha, taline tsiwitsigataho nasgiyai, ale agigonelv gohi gesv gatsiyowelaneha nasgi na gayula unisganvtsvhi tsigi, ale nigadvquo anisoi, nasgi iyu taline yiwiagilutsv, vtla yvgagalisinvda;
english: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏥᏲᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏋᏗᏍᎬ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Nigalisdodiha tsitsiyoha gohiyudisgi Galonedv ayv aquvdisgv kanegvi, nasgi itsigatahv vtla awanagala yigi, ulinigidiyusgini igvnelvhi itsehvi,
english: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏓᎾᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᏯᎥ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏙᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏴᏓᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhisgininonv awanagalahiyu gesv dadanawasdv agadvnvgi, aseno gvnodv iyagvnelvhi gvtanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv Unelanvhi.  Ayv nasquo nasgi otsiyav tsotsiwanagalahiyu, aseno itsulaha dotsvnesdi nasgi, Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv itsvyvdanehv nihi.
english: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᎪᎵᏯ ᎢᏨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ; ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯ ᏂᏣᏍᏛᎢ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏣᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎡᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Itsadagoliya itsvsv, nasgi itsohiyuhi yigi, ale itsohiyuhi nigesvna yigi; itsadolehohi nitsasdvi.  Tlasgo itsvsv yitsadagataha nasgi Tsisa Galonedv itsiyavi, iyusgininonv etsisonvistanvhi yigi.
english: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏍᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno udugi gvsga nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nasgi ayv ogisonvistanvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎣᎩᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini tsitayoseha nasgi nihi gohusdi usonv ditsilvwisdanediyi nigesvna; vtla ayv osiyu ogiyelvsv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi aquadulisgv yinvdigalisdodiha, nihisgini nasgi na duyugodv gesv itsadvnediyi, unelagi ogisonvistanvhi yinvwasdi.
english: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎦᏲᏣᏡᏓ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏲᏥᏍᏕᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yeli yvgayotsatluda udohiyuhi gesvi, yotsisdelvsgini udohiyuhi gesvi.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏥᏕᏣᎵᏂᎬᎪᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Osiyuyeno ogiyelvha tsotsiwanagala tsigesoi, nihino tsidetsalinigvgoi; hiano nasquo ogaduliha, nasgi nitsigolvna itsalisdodiyi.
english: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎠᏋᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏂᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha hia nasgi tsinusdi tsitsvyowelaneha agigonelvi, nasgi nahiyu tsigatahesdi gvsgaisdagi aquvtanidasdiyi nigesvna, nasgiya igvquadvnedi aqualisgolvdanelv Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi tsunalinigohisdi gesvi, vtlano unidvdodi gesvi.
english: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉ ᎢᏤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino, idalinvtli, nvwadohiyadvquo nitsadvhnadegesdi.  Gohusdi nitsigolvna gesesdi, ugalisdiquo detsadanvtesdi, utloyiquo gesesdi detsadanvdvi, nvwadohiyadvquo itsehesdi; Unelanvhino adageyudi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv adanehi tsigi, itseladidohesdi.
english: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏔᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Detsadayolihesdi itsvdisgesdi galvquodiyu didatawedovsdi gesvi.
english: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Nigadv unadanvti wigetsiyoliha.
english: All the saints salute you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏚᏓᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale udageyudi gesv Unelanvhi, ale udadudadodi gesv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Quola, vginvsidv, yvwi gvginvsidv nigesvna, ale yvwi gvginetselvhi nigesvna, Tsisasgini Galonedv, ale Unelanvhi Agayvlige nasgi tsuletanvhi tsigi uyohusvi nasgi gvginetselvhi;
english: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏦᏤᏙᎭ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ;
phonetic: Ale nigadv idalinvtli tsotsedoha, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi detsadatluwadisv Gelesiyi;
english: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv getseladidohesdi, getsalisgolvdanelvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv,
english: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏥᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsidudayose ayv igisganvtsv tsisdi galisdodisgei, nasgi igudalesdiyi gohi gesv ehv uyoi, nasgiya nusdv adanvtesgv Unelanvhi ale Igidoda;
english: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎦ ᏥᎾᏞᎬ ᎡᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏫᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏥᎬᏫᏳᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Agisquanigosga tsinatlegv etsadanvelv nasgi na itsiyanvdv witsikanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Galonedv, nvwadale osdv kanohedv tsitsigvwiyutanv.
english: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏁᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvwadale nigesvna tsigi; anehasgininonv getsadeyadodisgi, ale uninetliyvsdiyi unadulisgi osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseliga.
english: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏱᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusgini nasquo ayv, ale dikahnawadidohi galvladi nvdayulosvhi, nvwadale osdv kanohedv yitsvyalitsidonelv, nasgi gayula itsvyalitsidonelvhi nigesvna, nasgi atsisgatsvhi gesesdi.
english: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏲᎩᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi gayula iyogiwedv tsigi, utloyiquo hia gohi gesv nitsiweha, Iyuno gilo itsalitsidonehesdi nvwadale osdv kanohedv, nano nasgi gayula ditsadanilvtsvhi tsigi, nasgi atsisgatsvhi gesesdi.
english: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎪ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏆᎵᎢ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎭ?  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᎨ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎩᏲᎭ?  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏏ ᏯᎩᏲᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᏱᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Gohiyeno gesv tsigo yvwi diqualii nidegvneha?  Unelanvhige?  tsigoge osdv uniyelvdi yvwi agiyoha?  iyuyeno osdv uniyelvdi yvwi asi yagiyoha, vtla Galonedv aginvsidohi yigagi.
english: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏣᏆᎵᏥᏙᏅᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno itsvnoneha idalinvtli, nasgi hia osdv kanohedv tsaqualitsidonvgi, vtla yvwi tsudeyonvhi yigi.
english: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎬᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏇᏲᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yvwi digvgiyohiselvhi yigi, vtla ale gilo aqueyonvhi yigi, Tsisa Galonedvsgini gvnigesv iyaquvnelvhi.
english: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏥᏯᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏛᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Itsadvganvyeno nusdv tsuwagutanvsv aqualenidolv Anitsusi tsunatseli dikahnawadvsdi detsigahnawadisvi, nasgi ulosvstanvhi gatsiyadeyadotanv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi Unelanvhi tsutseliga, ale detsidvtanvi.
english: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏉᏤᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᏕᏥᎪᎾᏛᏛᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎢᏗᎦᏲᎦᏛᏅ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᏓᏇᎷᎬᎩ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Ale aginequotsehv Anitsusi tsunatseli dikahnawadvsdi tsigadovsgvi detsigonadvdvgi unitsati idigayogadvnv diquatseli yvwi, utli igai ulinigidv aquadanvdvgi daquelugvgi digigayvlige uninohelvhi.
english: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᏥ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏆᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo osiyu uyelvnv Unelanvhi, nasgi nahiyu etsi aginanugowisv nvdagvwadalenvdv aquadadaletanvhi tsigi, ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv agiyanvtanvhi tsigi,
english: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎩᎳᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏁᎯ ᏱᏗᎦᏥᏯᏁᎶᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi Uwetsi aginanugowisediyi, nasgi ayv galitsidohvsgv gvnigesv itsiyvnediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehvi; gilaquo iyvdv, vtla uniquedali ale gigv uninehi yidigatsiyanelotanei;
english: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏱᏩᎩᎶᏎᎢ, ᏱᎦᏥᏩᏛᎲᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏂ; ᎠᎴᏈᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏕᎹᏍᎦ ᏛᎠᎩᎷᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla ale Tsilusilimi yiwagilosei, yigatsiwadvhvse igvyi getsinvsidv iyunalistanvhi ayv oni; Alequiyisgini wagilosvgi, ale taline Demasga dvagilutsvgi.
english: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏦᎢ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ ᏈᏓ ᎥᏥᏩᏛᎲᏒᎩ, ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᎦᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsoi winudetiyvhv Tsilusilimi aquenvsvgi Quida vtsiwadvhvsvgi, hisgigaduno tsusvhidv ganelv aginvgi.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎪᎡ ᏥᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Anisoisgini getsinvsidv vtla gilo yitsigoe Tsimi uwasv Ugvwiyuhi analinvtli.
english: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsitsvyowelaneha, gvniyuquo, Unelanvhi agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga.
english: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏏᎵᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏏᎵᏏᏱ ᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Onino Siliyi ale Silisiyi wagilosvgi.
english: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ;
phonetic: Ale vtla anigatahi yigese aquakadv nasgitsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Tsudiyi, nasgi Galonedv digvwanelodi;
english: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᏥᏂᎬᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᎧᏃᎮᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏣᏛᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Unadvganvhiquosgininonv gesei hia naniwesgvi, Nasgi na uyo tsinigvhnadegv tsuwagutanvsv, hnaquo alitsidohvsga ikanoheha gohiyudi gesv nasgi ilvhiyu tsadvdisgvgi.
english: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Unilvquotaneno Unelanvhi ayv nvdigalisdodisgei.
english: And they glorified God in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏂᎦᏚ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᎣᏂ, ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎲᎩ ᏆᏂᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᏥᏯᏘᏅᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Hnaquono nigadu winudetiyvhv oni, taline Tsilusilimi aquenvsvgi osdehvgi Quaniqua, ale Dadasi nasquo vtsiyatinvsvgi.
english: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏋᏁᎸᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎩ ᏗᏂᏃᏣᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏯᏎᎦᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏙᏥᏍᏆᎸᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏓᎩᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅ ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale gvnigesv nvquvnelvi nvdayulisdotanvgi aquenvsvgi, ale gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelv osdv kanohedv nasgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi gatsiyalitsidonehvi; anisiyvwihasgini udelidv gvnigesv nigatsiyvnelvgi dininotsali gesvi, yasegagi asequo yidotsisqualvda ale asequo yidagisqualvtanv aquelisvgi.
english: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏓᏓᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎯ, ᎠᎪᎢ ᏂᎨᏒ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno vtla nasquo Dadasi, nasgi osdehi, Agoi nigesv, ase atsiusdesedi yigesei;
english: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏄᏪᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏥᏴᏔᏂᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᎵᎸ ᎤᏂᎨᏛᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏓᏤᎵᎦᏯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎣᎩᎲᎢ, ᏦᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᎢᎪᎬᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale nvdagalisdodisgvgi unatlonasdi analinvtli nuwelisdvna getsiyvtanilvhi, nasgi nvdelidv uniyvlilv unigedvdiyi ogadatseligaya gesv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv ogihvi, tsoginatlai igogvnediyi;
english: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏑᏟᎶᏛ ᎤᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏙᏤᎵᏎᎴᎢ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᏙᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏁᎮᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi vtla sutlilodv unv igohidv unanelagi yidotseliselei eladi nidotsadvnehvi; nasgi osdv kanehedv udohiyuhi gesv igvwasdiha igvwasdiha itseladidasdiyi.
english: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏰᎵ ᏗᏂᏃᏨᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏋᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏉᏗᎭ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏗᏂᏃᏣᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᎩᏁᏉᎡᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Nasginino yeli dininotsvli gesvi, nasgi nunasdvi vtla gohusdi aquvnehi yigi, Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigalvquodiha gilo nusdvi; nasgiyeno dininotsali gesv vtla gohusdi yigvginequoelei;
english: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭰ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ [ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ] ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᎨᏅᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ [ᎤᎾᏛᎪᏗᏱ] ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏈᏓ ᏣᎦᎨᏅᏕᎢ;
phonetic: Asgini iditlv, unigohv nasgi osdv kanohedv nidigetsiusdeselvna [unadvgodiyi] ayv vquagenvdvi, nasgiya digetsinvsdeselvhi [unadvgodiyi] osdv kanohedv Quida tsagagenvdei;
english: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᏈᏓ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎾᏋᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏕᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ;)
phonetic: (Nasgini Quida ulinigidv iyuwanehi atsinvsidv gesv digetsiusdeselvhi unetseliga, nasgi nasquo ayv aqualinigidv naquvnehvgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi detsiyalitsidonehvi;)
english: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏏᏆᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᎫᏍᏙ ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏕᎪᎩᎾᏌᏕᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏙᎦᏚᏓᏛᎢ; ᎠᏴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏬᎩᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ale Tsimi, ale Siquasi, ale Tsani, nasgi diligusdo getsiyelvi, unigohv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi vginelvi, anigatisiditlv degoginasadetanvgi ayv ale Quaniqua gvnigesv igvnehi dogadudadvi; ayv tsunadalenvdv yvwi dinehv woginilohisdiyi ugvwali, unvsvno digetsiusdeselvhi dinehvi;
english: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ [ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ,] ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏍᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏆᎵᎦᎵᏴᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Sudalegisgininonv [unadulisgvgi,] nasgi tsosdanvdadisdiyi uyo iyunadvhnadegi; nasgiya nasquo aqualigaliyvsvgi nasgi iyaquadvnediyi.
english: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎥᏗᎣᎩ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏒᎩ, ᎦᏰᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno Quida Vdiogi wulutsv gvnigesv detsigatilvsvgi, gayeguisdodiyeno gesvgi.
english: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᎻᏱ ᏅᏗᏂᎶᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ, ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᏚᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᏕᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Asiquoyeno gilo iyunasdi Tsimiyi nvdinilosgvna gesvi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi itsulaha analisdayvhvsgvgi; aseno nasgi unilutsv, udanvsvgi dudadaledanelvgi, deganayesgvgi nasgi digetsinvsdeselvhi.
english: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᎵᎪᏁᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎥᎬᏩᏘᎾᏫᏛᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale anisoi Anitsusi unatlonastanvgi nasquo vgvwaligonelvgi; nasgi iyusdi Quaniqua nasquo vgvwatinawidvtanvgi anatlonasdisgvi.
english: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ  ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏥᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᏈᏓ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎯ, ᎯᏧᏏ ᏥᎩ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏰᎭ, ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎮᎲᎢ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᏕᏗᏱ ᏥᏂᏕᎲᏁᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ?
phonetic: Aseno  agigohv niduyugodvna nanadvnehvi, nasgiya duyugodv dadeyohvsgv osdv kanohedv, nigadv anigatahv hia nvtsiweselvgi Quida, iyuno nihi, Hitsusi tsigi, tsunadalenvdv yvwi nunasdv nasgiya yinusdi yeha, Anitsusino nusdv anehv nasgiya nusdvna yigi hehvi, gadono Anitsusi nusdv anehv nasgiya unadediyi tsinidehvneha tsunadalenvdv yvwi?
english: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎢᏗᏧᏏ ᎢᎦᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏕᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Ayv Iditsusi igadenvhi tsigi, anisganano tsunadalenvdv yvwi nunasdv igadenvhi nigesvna tsigi,
english: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏗᎦᏔᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏴᎬᏚᏓᎴᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Tsidigatahasgini nasgi yvwi dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nadvnehv nadudalesdisgvna gesvi, gohiyudisgini gesv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi ayv edoiyunv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi igadudalesdodiyi gohiyudi gesv Galonedv, vtlano dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nidadvnehvi; dikahnawadvsdiyeno nigawesgv nadvnehv vtla gilo uquedali yvgvdudalesda.
english: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᎩᏲᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusgini, igiyohv Galonedv igudalesdiyi, gvnigesv yinulistanv igvsv nasquo idisganahiyu gesvi, Galonedvsgo asgana asdelisgi nigalisdiha?  gvwatlisdi.
english: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᏙᎦᏁᏍᎨᎭ, ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi digiyostanvhi gesv taline yidoganesgeha, agisganvtsvhi gesv gvnigesv yinigvneha.
english: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno dikahnawadvsdi iyuwanisadv agiyohusvhiquo dikahnawadvsdi ahvi, nasgi Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali aqualenidasdiyi.
english: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏙᎩᎾᏛᏅ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᎩᏯᎠ; ᏄᏍᏛᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᎥᎢ, ᎦᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Dadahnawasdv itsulaha Galonedv doginadvnv; aseno ayv gvnodv igi, vtlasgininonv hnaquo ayv yigi, Galonedvsgini gvnodv agiyaa; nusdvno hnaquo galenidohv ani uquedali gevi, galenidoha tsiyalisgasdodv Unelanvhi Uwetsi; nasgi agigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale uwasv tsidudayose ayv agisdelisgvi.
english: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᏗᏎ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏳᏲᏞᏒ.
phonetic: Vtla yitsiyosdise gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi; iyuyeno adudalesdi gesv dikahnawadvsdi yvdidalehvsga, hnaquo galonedv asequoquo yuyotlesv.
english: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎫ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎦᎪ ᎢᏥᎶᎾᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏕᏥᎧᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᏛ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Itsinegu Gelesiyi itsehi, gago itsilonastanv, nasgi itsohiyudiyi nigesvna nitsvnelv udohiyuhi gesvi, nihi detsikanv Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv nagvnelv dadahnawasdv gadv itsehvi.
english: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏍᎩᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎪ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏥᎪᎨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ?
phonetic: Hia nasgi uwasv sginonediyi aquaduliha; Adanvdosgo detsiyohisele nvdigalisdodisge dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nitsadvnehvi, tsigoge nvdigalisdodisge itsohiyuhi itsadvgisgvi?
english: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏁᎫ?  ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᏥᏣᎴᏅᎲ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏍᎪ ᎬᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Nigavquosgo itsinegu?  Adanvdo gvdi tsitsalenvhv, uquedalisgo gvdi itsisquadiha?
english: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᏨ?  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Tsigo nasgi nigav tsudalenvdv asequoquo itsigiliyotsv?  iyuno howa asequoquo yigi.
english: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᏥᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ?  ᏥᎪᎨ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ?
phonetic: Nasgino na Adanvdo itsinehi tsigi, ale usquanigodi tsulvwisdanehi tsigi itsehvi, tsigo dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv nadvnehv nvdigalisdodiha?  tsigoge uwohiyuhi advgisgv nvdigalisdodiha?
english: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏄᏛᏁᎶ ᏣᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya Equahami tsuwohiyune Unelanvhi, ale duyugodv tsinudvnelo tsatsiyelvnanelei.
english: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsigatahesdi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi gesv, nasgi Equahami tsuwetsi gesvi.
english: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᏪᎵᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏗ ᏙᏗᎫᏓᎴᏏᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᏅᏛᏂᏌᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gowelino galvquodi igvyi gayehi tsagowatisge nasgi Unelanvhi gohiyudi gvdi dodigudalesisv tsunadalenvdv yvwi, igvyi gayehi osdv kanohedv gvnigesv nagvnele Equahami, hia natsiweselei, Nihi nvdvnisani nigadv yvwi danewadisv elanigv osdv iyunalisdanedi gesesdi.
english: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎨᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏗ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ.
phonetic: Howano nasgi anohiyuhvsgi gesv osdv nunalisdaneho gegatloyasdisgo osdv nulisdanelv uwohiyuhisdi Equahami.
english: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎬᏪᎳ, ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyadvnediyi analisgasdodisgi, nasgi getsisgatsvhi; hiayeno nigvnv igvwela, Getsisgatsvhi gesesdi naniv gilo nidanikahnawadegvna igesesdi nanadvnehv nigadv tsudalenvdv dikahnawadvsdiyi gowelvi.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno gilo dikahnawadvsdi nadudalesdisgvna gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesviyu; Nasgiyeno duyugodv iyadvnehi gohiyudi gesv udvnidisdesdi.
english: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ, ᎩᎶ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno vtla gohiyudi gesv alisdelvdodi yinigvneha; hiasgini, Gilo yvwi nasgi nadvnehesdi nasgi udvnidisdesdi.
english: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᎫᏴᎲ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏍᎦᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ ᎩᎶ ᏡᎬ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Galonedv igaguyvhv igudalesv dikahnawadvsdi udasgaisdodi gesvi, atsisgatsvhi nulistanv ayv igisdelisgvi; hiayeno nigvnv igowela, Atsisgatsvhi gilo tlugv agadvnvhi.
english: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎦᏛᏁᎸ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi osdv nagadvnelv Equahami nasgi unilutsediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayudalenvhi; nasgi etsinediyi Adanvdo aduisdv gohiyudi gvdodi gesvi.
english: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏁᎦ; ᎾᏍᏉ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᎾᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏴᎬᏲᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏁᏉᏣ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, yvwi unineisdi tsinega; Nasquo yvwiquo kanohedv dunatlohisdv asdayidvhi yigi, vtla gilo yvgvyosda, ale vtla aganequotsa.
english: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ.  ᎥᏝ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ,] ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Equahami ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesv tsudalenvdv getsiduisdanelei.  Vtla hia yinigaweha, ale nihi ditsanetlvtanvhi, ilvsgi tsigeso nasgiyai; saquoquosgini tsigeso nasgiya, [hia nigaweha,] ale nihi tsanetlvtanvhi; nasgi Galonedv tsigi.
english: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏅᎩᏧᏈ ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏫᏄᏕᏘᏴᎲ ᎣᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nasgi nitsiweha, Nasgi kanohedv datlohisdv Galonedv ugvwali nasgi Unelanvhi gayula gvwasdayidvhi tsigesei, dikahnawadvsdi nvgitsuqui tsoasgohi winudetiyvhv oni gananugowisvhi tsigi, vtla gvwayosdodi yigi, nasgi yeli asequo iyuwanediyi aduisdvi.
english: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏴᏗᎬᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏮᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno otseli iyulisdodi gesv dikahnawadvsdi ahv yvdidalehvsga, vtla aduisdv yvdigvdalehvsga; Unelanvhisgini Equahami ulisgolvdanele aduisdisgv uwvtanei.
english: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏃ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ?  ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏫᎫᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ; [ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ] ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏅᎿᎭᏕᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏒᎦᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏁᎴᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Gadono gvdodi dikahnawadvsdi?  asganvisdi gesv nvdigalisdodisge wigudatanvhi gesei, nasgi unetlvtanvhi atsiduisdanelvhi gesv unanugoisdi gesv gvdisgi; [ale nasgi dikahnawadvsdi] dinikahnawadidohi osdv nunvhnadege nasgi tsusvgale ayeli nelenehi.
english: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏗᎴᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᏁᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ.
phonetic: Nasgino ayeli dilenehi tsigeso vtla asiyvwiquo ayeli alenehi yigesoi, Unelanvhisgini asiyvwiquo.
english: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎪᏃ ᏓᏡᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ?  ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdisgono datludiha Unelanvhi duduistanvi?  gvwatlisdi, iyuyeno dikahnawadvsdi yvwi getsinelvhi yigese, nasgi yeli gvnidv gvwadanedi gesvi, udohiyuhiya dikahnawadvsdi ahv adudalesdi gesv yvdidalehvsgei.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno goweli galvquodi gvnigesv nigvneha nigadiyu unisganvtsvhi gesvi, nasgi aduisdv Tsisa Galonedv gohiyudi gesv nvdvdalehvsgi, nasgi getsinediyi anohiyuhvsgi.
english: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᏂᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᎦᏛᏅᎩ, ᎡᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gohiyudisgini gesv asi nigananugogvna tsigesei, dikahnawadvsdi ahv hawiniditlv nigadvnvgi, egisduhvgi gohiyudi gesv oni gvnigesv igvnedi gesv iyasdi.
english: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏁᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi digeyohvsgi gesvgi, Galonedvyi digatinegi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv igadudalesdodiyi.
english: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏨ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Gohiyudisgini gesv tsunanugotsv, vtla hnaquo dideyohvsgi digatinidohi yigi.
english: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nitsivyeno Unelanvhi tsuwetsi nitsalistanv Galonedv Tsisa etsoiyusv nvdigalisdodiha.
english: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᏤᏣᏬᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᎵᎪᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏣᏄᏬᎥ.
phonetic: Nitsivyeno tsetsawovhi tsigi Galonedv etsaligonehvi, nasgi Galonedv etsanuwov.
english: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᎭ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᏂᏥᎥᏰᏃ ᎢᎨᏣᏍᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏥᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeha Atsusi, ale Agoi, vtla atsinatlai, ale natsinatlavna, vtla asgaya, ale ageyv, nitsivyeno igetsasdiha Galonedv Tsisa etsiyavi.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎯ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏘᏴᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale Galonedv tsutseli yigi nihi, hnaquo Equahami unetlvtanvdv nitsalisdiha, ale itsatseliga utiyvhi nasgiya nigvnv aduisdvi.
english: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏰᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏲᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᎴᎿᎭᎣ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎡᎦᏃ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Nasgi utiyedi gesvi, ayoli gesv igohidv, vtla yidunadalehnao atsinatlai, nugvwiyusadegi egano nudalesv gohusdi.
english: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎤᏁᎶᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎬᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏚᏒᏍᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Deunelodosgini digvweyohvsgi ale unadesayasdidegi agayvligei dusvsdv gvdisgi.
english: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏏ ᏗᏗᏲᎵ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎩ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo ayv, asi didiyoli tsigesvgi, tseginatlai gesvgi, igadanuyvdvgi dilenvdodi dideloquasdi elohi ehi gesvi.
english: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎤᏓᏄᏴᏕᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno nahiyu aselvhi gesv akalii usqualvhvi, Unelanvhi tsunvse Uwetsi ageyv unanugowisei, dikahnawadvsdi ahv udanuyvdei,
english: But when the fullness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏚᏴᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᏰᎬᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsuduyvdiyi tsuwudalesdiyi uyelvse nasgi unadanuyvdi dikahnawadvsdi ahvi, nasgi ayv tsuwetsi iyegvnediyi.
english: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏥᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᎤᏪᎷᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏆ, ᎡᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsuwetsi tsinitsalistanv, nasgi nvdigalisdodiha, Unelanvhi tsunvsv Uwetsi Udanvdo ditsadanvdogihi, uweluga hia nigaweha, Aqua, Edoda.
english: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏣᎾᏝᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏪᏥᏉᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏘᏰᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha vtla hnaquo etsanatlai yigi, uwetsiquosgini; ale iyu uwetsi yigi, hnaquo tsugvwalodi Unelanvhi udanedi gesv tsatiyehi, Galonedv iyuwanisanvhi.
english: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏁᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nahiyui, Unelanvhi netsigatahvna tsigesvgi, gohusdi detsikahnawadidohvgi nasgi udohiyuhi unanelanvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᏛᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏣᏨᎭ ᏙᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏣᏚᎵ ᏤᏥᎾᏝ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Aseno gohi tsigi, hnaquo etsigadovsvhi tsigi Unelanvhi, ale yadvnv Unelanvhi itsigadovsvhi tsigi, gado digalisdodiha itsatsvha dotsalisgasdodiha awanagala ale uyo iyudvhnadegi dilenvdodi dideloquasdi, nasgi asi nahna tsitsaduli tsetsinatla taline itsalisdodiyi?
english: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙ ᏓᏙᏓᏇᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏦᎳᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏍᏆᎸᎮᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏕᏘᏴᎮᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Detsisquanigodo dadodaquegvi, ale datsolanegvi, ale dasqualvhegvi, ale dadetiyvhegvi.
english: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎾᏰᎢᏎᎭᏉ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᏛᏁᎸ ᎨᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsvnayeisehaquo, asequoquo gohusdi yigatsiyadvnelv gelisgv iyusdi.
english: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᏂᏣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏆᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎢᏍᎩᏴᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha ayv naquasdv nasgiya itsalisdodiyi; nitsasdvyeno nasgiya naquasdi ayv, vtla gohusdi usonv isgiyvnelvhi yigi;
english: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ;
phonetic: Aseno itsigataha awanagalahiyu gesv agiquedalvi itsvyalitsidonelv osdv kanohedv igvyiyi;
english: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᎵᏲᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏣᏇᎲᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏲᎢᏎᎴᎢ; ᏕᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsigvliyogv nasgi agiquedalv tsaquehvgi, vtla nvlisali yitsiyelvnei, ale vtla yitsiyoiselei; desgiyadanilvtsvgisgini dikahnawadidohi Unelanvhi utseli nasgiyai, ale Galonedv Tsisa nasgiyai.
english: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎩ!  ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭᏰᏃ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᎦᏖᏙᎢᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nigavgi nvwadohiyadv itsadanvdvgi!  itsvyoiyudanehayeno, nasgi iyuno yeli nasgi igvwalisdodi yigesei, itsvsv yiditsadagatedoisei, ale ayv yidisginelei.
english: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᏃ ᏍᎩᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Tsigono sgisgagi nulistanv nigalisdodiha udohiyuhi gesv itsvnonelvi?
english: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎭ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏱᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎨᏣᎵᏍᏚᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utsati getsigeyuha, aseno vtla osdv ugvwali yigi; ale nihi yigetsalisduda, nasgi utsati ditsigeyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi.
english: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᎯᏳᏉ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Osiyusgini nigohilv utsati itsigeyudiyi osdv gesvi, vtlano nahiyuquo itsvyeladidohv uwasv.
english: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏇᏥ ᏗᏣᏍᏗᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏨᏁᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ [ᎢᏗᎬᏤᎵᏛ] ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏙᏢᏅᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Diquetsi ditsasdii, nasgi taline itsvnelitsvhi tsigi [idigvtselidv] itsadediyi, gvni Galonedv adotlvnvha detsadanvdvi,
english: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏆᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏁᎬᎢ; ᎤᏯᏰᏃ ᎢᏨᏴᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Gvquadulvdi nigalisdi gohi gesv itsvyeladidasdiyi, ale aginetliyvsdiyi tsinegvi; uyayeno itsvyvsga.
english: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᏴᏙᏗᏱ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Sginohvsi, nihi itsadulisgi dikahnawadvsdi ahv itsadanuyvdodiyi, tlasgo yitsadvgiha dikahnawadvsdi?
english: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏁᎮᎢ, ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv igowela, nasgi Equahami anitali tsuwetsi anehei, asiyvwi atsinatlai ageyv unanugowisvhi, soino natsinatlavna ageyv unanugowisvhi.
english: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏕᏔᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏕᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nano atsinatlai ageyv unanugowisvhi, uquedali udetanei; nasgiya natsinatlavna ageyv unanugowisvhi aduisdv nasgiya udenei.
english: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ; ᏌᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏌᎾᏱ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏢᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᎦ ᏥᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi datlilosdi; hiayeno nasgi tali kanohedv datlohisdv datlilosdi; saquo gesv Sanayi odalv tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi tsidegananugowisga digetsinatlvdi gesvi, nasgi Hega tsidatlilosdi.
english: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᎦ ᏌᎾᏱ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎡᎴᏈᎠ ᏦᏓᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏕᎨᏥᎾᏝᎠ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi Hega Sanayi odalv datlilosdi, Elequia tsodalv, nasgi Tsilusilimi nasgiya tsigi, nasgi gohi nusdvi, nasgiyeno degetsinatlaa uwasv ale nasgi tsuwetsi.
english: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᎦᏚᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏥ.
phonetic: Tsilusilimisgini galvladi tsvdigaduha nasgi natsinatlavna, nasgi ayv nidiv igitsi.
english: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᎪᏪᎳ, ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᏔᎷᎸᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏔᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎾ; ᎭᎴᏅ ᎮᎷᎲᎦ, ᏂᎯ ᏂᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎾ; ᎾᏰᏃ, ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ ᎤᏟ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏪᎧᎭ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv igowela, Haliheligi talulvvsgi nigesvna, nasgi nitadananugowisgvna; halenv heluhvga, nihi nitinanugowisgvna; nayeno, natsiyehvna utli naniv duwekaha tsuwetsi esgaquo na atsiyehi.
english: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏴ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏏᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino ayv, idalinvtli, aduisdv igadetanvhi nasgiya Esigi tsinusdei.
english: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino nahiyu tsigesei, nasgi uquedali udetanvhi tsadeyadodisge nasgi na Adanvdo udetanvhi, nasgiya nusdi gohi gesvi.
english: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎪᏪᎵ?  ᎯᏄᎪᏩ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ; ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Aseno gado adiha goweli?  Hinugowa atsinatlai ageyv ale nasgi uwetsi; atsinatlaiyeno ageyv uwetsi, vtla uweladisdodi yigesesdi utseli iyulisdodi gesv natsinatlavna ageyv uwetsi.
english: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏴ, ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Nasgino idalinvtli, vtla atsinatlai ageyv tsuwetsi yigi ayv, natsinatlavnasgini.
english: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏕᎩᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎦᎩᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏂᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎡᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᏔᏂ ᎠᏓᎾᏢᎥᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎳᎾᎶ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ulinigidv detsidogesdi nasgi nahna nideginatlavna gesv Galonedv nigaginatlavna nigvnelvi, ale tlesdi taline tsietsigilanaladistani adanatlvvsgi agilanalo.
english: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏕᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎦᏰᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo, ayv Quola hia nitsvweseha, nasgi iyuno yidetsiusdeselv, Galonedv vtla gohusdi yvgayetsalisdelvdoda.
english: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎦᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏚᏓᎸᎥᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale taline igatsiyoiyudaneha naniv nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi, nasgi anadudalvvsga nigadv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyunadvnehohvsdiyi.
english: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᏂᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎩ; ᏕᏥᏲᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedv gohusdi gayetsalisdelvdodi nigesvna nigalisda, nihi dikahnawadvsdi itsadudalesdisgi; detsiyohi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi.
english: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎢᏗᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno Adanvdv iyuwanisadv idigatiyv udugi igvsv igadudalesdodiyi gohiyudi gesvi.
english: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏮᏗᏗᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno Tsisa utseli dikahnawadvsdi gesv ahusdesdi gesv vtla gohusdi gvdodi yigi, ale ahusdesdi nigesvna gesvi; gohiyudisgini gesv nasgi adageyudi gesv tsuwvdidiso dulvwisdanehvi.
