english: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬᎩ; ᎦᎪ ᎢᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Osiyu itsadogiyasgvgi; gago itsiyosdodanele, nasgi digetsikahnawadvsdi nigesvna nulistanv udohiyuhi gesvi?
english: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏗᏰᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi etsisdiyetanvhi tsigi vtla itsiyanvdv udanvtelvhi yigi.
english: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᎸ ᎠᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Usdi agododi nigadv galv agodisgoi.
english: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi tsiyalisgasdodi, nihi itsehv Ugvwali nasgi utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadanvdvi; nasgisgini na itsadeyadodisgi usdvdisdi gesesdi, unelagi gilo gagesesdi.
english: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᏱᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏲ ᏂᎥᏋᎿᎭᏕᎦ?  ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎲᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ayv idalinvtli, iyuno ahusdesdi gesv asi yigalitsidohvsga, gadono asiquo uyo nivquvhnadega?  hnaquo ahvdv nigalisdiha didadodesdisgi gesv dadahnawasdvi.
english: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎨᏥᎧᎲᏒ ᎨᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Osiyu yitsiyelvna nasquo yidigetsikahvsv getsadeyadodisgi tsigi.
english: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎶ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno, idalinvtli, etsiyanvdv itsadatseli itsalisdodiyi; adina tlesdi nasgi itsadatseli gesv yitsvdisgesdi nasgi uquedali udulvhvvsgv itsadvnediyi tsitsilanvdadelo nasgiyai; adageyudisgini itsvdisgv osdv nidetsadadvnehesdi.
english: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏚᎵᏁᏨ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎭ, ᎯᎠᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigavyeno dikahnawadvsdi dulinetsv saquoquo ikanetsvhi akaliiha, hiaquo nasgi, Nav idisdadala higeyusesdi nasgiya tsvsv nitsadageyusvi.
english: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏣᏓᏍᎦᎶᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏣᏓᏯᎣᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏙᏣᏓᏛᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Iyusgini dotsadasgalogesdi ale dotsadayaohvsgesdi, itseyatahesdi tlesdi tsidotsadadvtani.
english: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎢᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏃ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᎨᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nitsiweha, Adanvdogihi itsaisesdi, uquedalino ugvvsgv vtla yinigetsadvnehesdi.
english: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎪ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎾᏓᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Uquedaliyeno udulisgv dagatilego Adanvdo, ale Adanvdo udulisgv dagatilego uquedali; nasgino hia dinadatludisgi nigalisdiha; nasgino nigalisdodiha nusdv itsadulisgv vtla yinvgetsadvga.
english: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎲ ᏱᎨᏣᏚᏓᎸ.
phonetic: Adanvdosgini yiditsatinidoha, vtla dikahnawadvsdi ahv yigetsadudalv.
english: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ^ᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino uquedali nusdv deulvwisdanehv gvnigesviyu; hia nasgi nusdi^Adayonedi gesvi, udelidv dinisidi gesvi, gadaha digalvwisdanedi gesvi, unegutsidv gesvi,
english: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏓᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏗᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏛᏳᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏐᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanedi gesvi, adonvdi gesvi, adadaquisdi gesvi, didiyosdi gesvi, didadvyutsedi gesvi, atalawohisdi gesvi, didasohedi gesvi, tali iyadadisdi gesvi, unadatselidv gesvi,
english: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏓᏂ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ, Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Advyugedi gesvi, didahisdi gesvi, udayvsdesdi gesvi, tsuniyvsdesgi tsunilawiisdi gesvi, ale nasgi iyusdidani; hia nasgi gayula nitsvnoneha, nasgiya nasquo itsvnonelvhi tsigi tsuwagutanvsvi, na nasgi iyanadvnehi vtla unatseli yinvgalisda Unelanvhi utseligohi.
english: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Adanvdosgini gananugowisga, adageyudi gesvi, ulihelisdi, nvwadohiyadv, gvnidiyu gesvi, udanvti gesvi, osdv gesvi, gohiyudi gesvi,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᏓᏂ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎭ.
phonetic: Udanvti gesvi, alisinahisdodi gesvi; nasgi iyusdidani digatilegi dikahnawadvsdi vtla yaha.
english: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎸᎲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino na Galonedv tsutseliga tsigi dadahnawasdv unadvnv uquedali gesv gvwatloyasdi udulvhvdi gesv ale ugvvhisdi gesvi.
english: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎢᏕᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᎦᏘᏂᏒ ᎢᏓᎢᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno Adanvdogihi idehesdi, nasquo Adanvdo degatinisv idaisesdi.
english: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; [ᏞᏍᏗ] ᏱᏗᏓᏓᎿᎭᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏛᏳᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yigadulisgesdi na galvquodiyu gesv gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna tsigi; [tlesdi] yididadahnalvsdisgesdi, ale yididadadvyutsehesdi.
english: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏎᎦᏤᎸ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ, ᏂᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎡᏥᏯᏂᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎮᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏣᎪᎵᏯ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, iyuno gilo yusegatselv yusganvtsv, nihi adanvdo ditsatinidohi etsiyanisodi gesesdi nasgi iyudvnelvhi udadolisdi itsadanvdvi, heyatahesdi tsvsv gesv yinvsegagi nihi nasquo yetsagoliya.
english: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᎵᏅᏫᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᏕᏣᏓᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Detsalinvwisdidegv detsadayvehesdi, nasgino nitsadvnehv itsikaliihesdi Galonedv utseli dikahnawadvsdi.
english: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏤᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎶᏉᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏯᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno gilo yeli gilo utselvsesdi, giloquono nigesvna igesesdi, uwasvquo yadalidasdiha.
english: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᎮᎵᏍᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno naniv gilo anigoliyesgesdi unvsv dunilvwisdanehvi, hnaquono unvsv gesv unihesdi unalihelisdodi, vtlano nvwanadale gesvi.
english: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᎾᎵᏅᏫᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᎠᏂᏰᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno unvsv dunalinvwisdidegv aniyehesdi.
english: For every man shall bear his own burden.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎯ Ꭰ'ᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na kanohedv ageyonvhi a'nehesdi nasgi na uweyohvsgi nudalesv osdv gesvi.
english: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᎶᏄᎡᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitsilidastanesdi; vtla gayetsilonuedi yigi Unelanvhi; nusdvyeno gilo awisgvi, nasgi nasquo nusdesdi gatlisisgesdi.
english: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ ᎠᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na uwasv uquedali awisgesdi, nasgi uquedali unanugowisvhi ayogi gatlisisgesdi; nasgisgini na Adanvdogihi awisgesdi, nasgi Adanvdo unanugowisvhi gvnidv ulisquadisdi nigesvna gatlisisgesdi.
english: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᎩᏯᏪᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ; ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ ᎢᎩᏟᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi yidigiyawegesdi osdv degilvwisdanehvi; nahiyuyeno asqualvhvha igitlisodi gesesdi, iyuno nididiwanagalogvna igesesdi.
english: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎨᎦᏛᏁᏗ ᏗᏜᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏕᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi yeli igegadvnedi didlanvdadisgesdi, naniv osdv nidedadvnehesdi, ho ugvwiyusesdi nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi sidanelvhi unadatlugvi.
english: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Itsigowatiha niganvhisv goweli itsvyowelanelvi, aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi.
english: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎦᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏨᏁᎰᎢ; ᏄᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Naniv unadulisgi osdv iyulisdodiyi digegaganvdiyi uquedali gesvi, nasgi ase tsetsiusdesediyi nigetsvnehoi; nunadulisgvna gesv iyusdi getsigiliyoisdodiyi unisdvdisdiyi Galonedv utseli dadahnawasdvi.
english: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎾᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno nasquo unvsv nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi yunisquanigodi dikahnawadvsdi; nihisgini tsetsiusdesediyi unaduliha, nasgi itsiquedalv unatlvquisdiyi.
english: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏛᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ.
phonetic: aseno gvwatlisdi gohusdi aquatlvquisdodiyi uwasvsgininonv dadahnawasdv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga, nasgi tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi elohi dadahnawasdv agadvnvhi tsigi ayv gesv iditlv, ale ayv vquadvnvhi tsigi elohi gesv iditlv.
english: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ-ᏥᏌ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: GalonedvyenoTsisa dinelododi gesv ahusdesdi gesv vtla gohusdi gvdodi yigi, ale ahusdesdi nigesvna gesvi; itsesgini iyagvnelvhi gesvi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᏁᎳᏗᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏭᏁᎳᏗᏓ.
phonetic: Nanivno nasgi hia dikahnawadvsdi dinikahnawadegi, nvwadohiyadv ale udadolisdi gesv wuneladida, ale nasquo Isili Unelanvhi tsutseliga wuneladida.
english: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏆᏕᏯᏙᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᏥᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏐᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏯᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohi iyudalenvdv tlesdi gilo yaquadeyadotanesdi; tsiyelvyeno daginelvha asolehohisdodi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa tsiyatseli gesvi.
english: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv dakahnawadidohesdi ditsadanvdo.  Emenv.
english: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ,
phonetic: Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi, witsvyowelasi itsadanvti Equisa itsehi, ale etsohiyuhvsgi Galonedv Tsisa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itsatseli gesesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏦᏒ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi ale Udoda Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi Galonedv iyuwanisanvhi osdv igadvnelvhi tsigi, iginelvhi nigav osdv gesv adanvdo ugvwali, nasgi tsudalenvdv tsosv ehi ugvwali.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᏑᏰᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏙᏢᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgiya igasuyesv nasgi na agvdisgvi asi elohi nadotlvsgvna gesvi, nasgi nidisganvna igalisdodiyi, ale gohusdi neguisdvna iyulisdodiyi nasgi agatahv adageyudi gesv idvdisgvi;
english: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏑᏰᏐᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎢᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigasuyesoi tsuwetsi igvnediyi agvdisgv Tsisa Galonedv, nasgiya osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
english: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎩᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyuwanisodiyi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nahna igidolitsvhi tsigi nasgi atsigeyui iyuwanisadv;
english: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏧᏈᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyuwanisadv egaguyvdv tsigi ugigv gvtanvhi, egidolitsvhi igisganvtsvi, nasgiya nutsuquisdv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi;
english: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏙᎮᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi utsati iginelvhi tsigi gvdisgv nigav agadohehisdi gesv ale alisinahisdodi gesvi;
english: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iginanugowiselvhi tsigi udelidv udanvtelvhi, nasgiya osiyu uyelvnvi, nasgi uwasv gesv udanvtelvhi gesvi;
english: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎭ ᏧᏪᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi nahiyu aselvhi gesv aliyeilolvha tsuwetlisodiyi saquo itsuwanediyi Galonedv tsuyohisedi galvlohi ale nasquo elohi tseha; nasgi tsuyohisedi,
english: That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎡᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏂᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo tsinvdigalisdodi egalisgolvdanelvhi tsigi igatseli iyulisdodi gesvi, egasuyedv tsigi nasgiya nusdv udanvtelvi, nasgi na tsidulvwisdaneha nigav tsudalenvdv nasgiya uwasv udanvdv duwugotanilvi;
english: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏲᎬᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi ayv igvyiyi otsalisgasdotanvhi Galonedv iyogvnisodiyi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi atsilvquodiyu gesvi;
english: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ [ᏤᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ] ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏅ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi nihi nasquo [tsetsalisgasdotanvgi] hnaquo itsadvganv gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv, nasgi osdv kanohedv itsalisdelvdodi tsigi; nasgi nasquo etsoiyunv, hnaquo itsiyelvtanvgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo nasgi aduistanvhi gesvi,
english: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᏛᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᎫᏴᏛ ᎠᏩᏒᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi agatidisdodi tsigi igatseli iyulisdodi gesvi, gvni igatseliga nidvnelvha aguyvdv awasvhi igatseliga, nasgi galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi atsilvquodiyu gesvi.
english: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo ayv aquadvganv etsoiyusv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale detsigeyusv naniv unadanvti,
english: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏑᎵᎪᎪ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla yitsisuligogo [Unelanvhi] tsiyalielitsehv nihi nvdigalisdodisgvi, nihi itsvneisdisgv gadadolisdisgvi;
english: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa galonedv utseliga, Agayvlige galvquodiyu tsigi, nasgi itsinediyi adanvdo agadovhisdodi ale adananugowisehi, nasgi uwasv etsigadovhisdiyi;
english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎧᏅᎢᎦ ᏤᏣᏗᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgi na itsolisdodi gesv dakanviga tsetsadisdanediyi; nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nusdv udugi gvdi gesv, nasgi udayanvdi gesvi, ale nigav galvquodiyu gesv unadanvti unatseli iyulisdodi gesv nasgi tsunedi tsigi,
english: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎷᏂᎬᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nusdv wudagonadvdv equohiyu gesv ulunigvgv gvnigesv nigvnelv igohiyunvhi tsigi, nasgiya dulvwisdanehv utsatanvhi ulinigidv gesvi,
english: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to usward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏄᏛ'ᏁᎴᎢ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏧᏪᎧᏁᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Galonedv tsinudv'nelei uyohusv tsiduletanei, ale uwasv agatisiditlv tsuwekanei galvladi digesvi,
english: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎨᏅᏴ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏎᏕᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᎾᏙᎠᏗᏒ ᏗᎪᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏂᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Utli galvladiyu esgaquo naniv digeganelodi gesvi, ale ulinigidiyu gesvi, ale gegagenvyv gesvi, ale unigvwiyusedegi gesvi, ale naniv dunadoadisv digovhi tsigi, vtla aniquo uwasv gohi tsigi, nasquosgini nahnani asi uliyeilohisdi tsigi,
english: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nudalesv gohusdi dulasgv hawiniditlv tsiniduwanelv, ale nasgi ugvwiyusadegi tsinagvnelv nudalesv gohusdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv anehvi,
english: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi ayeli tsigi, nasgi ukaliihi, nasgi uwasv nigadiyu nigvnadv akaliihi tsigi.
english: Which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ;^
phonetic: Nihino ditsiyohusvhi tsigesv utsatini nitsadvnelv ale itsisganvtsvi;^
english: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎲ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ] ᎦᏃᎴᏍᎬ ᎡᎯ ᎡᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Nahnani tsuwagutanvsv itsedolvi nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv elohv anehi, nasgiya [udulisgv] ganolesgv ehi egvwiyusadegi, nasgi adanvdo gohi gesv tsidulvwisdane dunadanvdv gohiyudi nigesvna gesv tsuwetsi;
english: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎨᏓᎵᎪᏁᎲᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏕᏅ ᏂᎦᏍᏛ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo tsuwagutanvsv nidiv gedaligonehvgi nahna igiquedalv ugvvsgvi, ale uquedalv ale adanvtedi gesv unadulisgv nidadvnehvgi; ale digadenv nigasdv utalawohisdi gesv tsuwetsi gesvgi, nasgiyaquo anisoi nunasdvi.
english: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏩᏔᏁ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Aseno Unelanvhi uwehnaiyu tsigi udadolisdi gesvi, tsinvdigalisdodisge utsati udageyudi gesv tsuwatane ayv igigeyuhiyu tsinulistanei,
english: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏂᏛᎢ, (ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᏅᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏔᏅ;)
phonetic: Nasgi asganvisdi gesv digiyohusvhi tsigesvgi, igvnidv igatloyastanv Galonedv agvnidvi, (gvwagatiya nvdadolisdi gesv etsisdelvtanv;)
english: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎦᎴᎯᏐᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
phonetic: Ale itsulaha degalehisotanv, ale itsulaha iganvdiyi nigvnelv galvladi digesv Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv;
english: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏭᏩᎫᏗᏗᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi na wuwagudidisv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi nigav uwehnaiyu gesv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi, nigav osdv nigadvnehv Galonedv Tsisa nvdayudalenvhi.
english: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv etsisdelvdotanvhi gohiyudi gesv gvtanvhi; ale nasgi vtla itsvsv gesv nvdayudalenvhi; Unelanvhi ulisgolvtanvhi;
english: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla digalvwisdanedi gesv iyuwanisadv yigi, nasgi gilo utlvquisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎪᏢᏅᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏟ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno ayv igotlvnvhi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv egotlvnvhi osdv digilvwisdanediyi, Unelanvhi nasgi tsinigadvnvisdanetli nahna igedasdiyi.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏦᏎᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏱ ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsanvtesdi nasgi nihi tsuwagutanvsv ditsadalenvdv yvwi uquedali gesvi, nidigetsiusdeselvna getsoselvhi nasgi na digetsiusdeselvhi gegosehi tsigi, nasgi uquedalv digetsiusdeselvhi digoyi digvtanvhi;
english: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᏂᏤᎸᎾᏉ ᎨᏎ ᎢᏏᎵ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏃᏢᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᏁᎳ ᎨᏎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏚᎩ ᏂᏨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏤᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahiyu tsigese Galonedv nitsehvna gesei, nitselvnaquo gese Isili ayeli unotlvsvi, ale itsigonela gese kanohedv datlohisdv aduisdvi, udugi nitsvsvna, ale Unelanvhi nitsehvna gese ani elohi.
english: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏂᎯ, ᎢᏅᎯᏳ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎩ, ᎾᎥ ᏕᏣᏘᏃᎸ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gohisgini tsigi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv, nihi, invhiyu tsinitsadvhnadegvgi, nav detsatinolv gvtanvhi ugigv Galonedv.
english: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎪᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎢᏧᎳ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏐᏴᎢ;
phonetic: Igohisdanehiyeno nasgi, itsula saquoquo igvnelvhi, ale uyostanvhi igadadaledisgi asoyvi;
english: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏛᏔᏅ ᏗᏓᏓᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏬᏢᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Uquedalv gvdisgv udvtanv didadasgagi igvnehi, nasgi yadvnv dikahnawadvsdi ulinetsvi tsudalenvdv iyadvnelidasdi gesvi; nasgi anitali gesv saquo itse yvwi uwotlvdiyi uwasv iyuwanisodiyi, nasgino dohi iyuwanediyi;
english: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎸ ᏓᎾᏓᏍᎦᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyuwanisodiyi itsula saquo ayelv nunadvnv dohiyi iyunvnediyi Unelanvhi, dadahnawasdv uwvdodiyi, nasgi uwvtanv ulv danadasgagvi.
english: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᏤᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏁ ᎢᏥᏃᎯᎮᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ulutsei ale ulitsidone itsinohihele nasgi dohi itsiwadvehi gesvi, nihi inv itsadvhnadegi, ale nasgi na nav iyunadvhnadegi.
english: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏫᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyuwanisadv ayv itsula, saquo Adanvdo gvdi, Agayvlige wigayedilutsedi nulistanv.
english: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏁᏣᏓᎴ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤᏙᎯᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎢᏖᎳ;
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi vtla hnaquo netsadale, ale itsedohiquo yigi, unadanvtisgini itsulaha itsehi, Unelanvhi gadatinav itela;
english: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏝᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎫᏍᏛᏔᏅᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ Ꭰ'ᏅᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Etsanesgehvhi gesv etsitlanvhi getsinvsidv ale anadolehosgi etsigusdvtanvhi, Tsisa Galonedv uwasv nugvwiyusv unvsiyv a'nvhi nvya iyulistanvhi;
english: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᎩ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᏛᏍᎪᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏱ ᎠᏝᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nahnani nigv adanelv osdv didadoligi igvnelvhi, advsgoi galvquodi adanelv nigalisdisgo Ugvwiyuhiyi atlanvhi;
english: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏣᏜᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎡᏥᏝᏅᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnani nasquo nihi tsetsadlastanvhi etsanesgehvhi etsitlanvhi, Unelanvhi uneladisdiyi Adanvdo gvdisgvi.
english: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏴᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ^
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayv Quola tsiyvgi Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgv vgiyvginvhi nihi gesv ditsadalenvdv nvdigalisdodisgvi^
english: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Iyuno howa itsadvganvhi yigi Unelanvhi gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesv ayv vginelvi nahna digilvwisdanediyi nihi osdv itsvyadvnediyi;
english: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎬᏗ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸ,
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv nuwanelv aginanugowiselvgi udelidv gesvi, gayula ilvsgi ikanetsvhi gvdi tsitsvyowelanelv,
english: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ ᏓᏦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᎪᎵᎬ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsigoliyevha datsolisdotani goligv udelidv Galonedv utseliga;
english: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏁᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎭ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsuwegutanvsv vtla gvnigesv igegvnelvhi yigese yvwi tsunetsi, nasgiya gohi gvnigesv tsinigegvneha tsutseli getsilvquodi getsinvsidv ale anadolehosgi Adanvdo gvdi;
english: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ (ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ) ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi (kanohesgi) tsunadalenvdv yvwi utloyiquo unatseli nigegvnehvi, ale nasgiquo ayeli anehi gesvi, ale Galonedv agvdisgv uduistanv Uneladisdisgvi, Osdv Kanohedv gvtanvhi gvnigesv igvnelvhi;
english: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᏴᏋᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏄᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahna ayv digilvwisdanehi ayvquvnelvhi tsigi, nasgiya Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolesdi gesv vqualisgolvdanelvhi tsigi gvwanulvdi nigesvna gesv ulinigidiyu gesv iyuwanisadv.
english: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎠᏆᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Ayv wudagonadvdv aquasdikani tsigi naniv unadanvti gesv, hia nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv vginelv, nasgi ugvwalvgi aqualitsidodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv gvgoliyedi nigesvna uwehnaiyu gesv Galonedv;
english: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏥᏴᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Ale naniv yvwi gvnigesv igatsiyvnediyi nusdv nasgi udelidv gesvi, nasgi didalenisgv elohi nvdagvwadalenvdv gvsgalanvhi tsigi Unelanvhi ehvi, nasgi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv uwotlvnvnvhi tsigi Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi;
english: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎨᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᏟᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Ugvwalvgi nasgi gohi getsilvquodi gesv ale tsunalinigidv gesv galvladiyu degesadisvi, unigadovhisdiyi utsati iyudalegi agadovhisdodi gesv Unelanvhi, gegvdisgv tsunanetlidi unadatlugvi;
english: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏣᎬᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᏓᏅᏖᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgiya nvtsudalenvhvna udanvtelvi, galonedv tsisa ugvwiyuhi igatseli tsagvdisge tsudanvtelei;
english: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyuwanisadv nidinayesgvna ale gayedilutsedi nulistanv tali udvdi edalisgasdodv nvdigalisdodiha nasgi edoiyusvi.
english: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᏗᏥᏩᎾᎦᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏨᎩᎵᏲᏤᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvtayoseha ditsiwanagaloisdiyiquo nigesvna ayv itsvgiliyotsehv iyusdi, nasgi galvquodiyu itsvnehi tsigi.
english: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᏥᏯᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏙᏓ,
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha detsiyaliniquanvneha Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga Tsisa Galonedv Udoda,
english: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᎪᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ,
phonetic: Nasgi digegostanvhi tsigi naniv sidanelvhi gesvi, galvlo ale elohi anehi,
english: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsalisgolvdanediyi, nasgiya uwehnaiyu gesv galvquodiyu gesv uhvi, nasgi utsati ditsalinigohisdodiyi detsadanvdvi Udanvdo uwvdodiyi;
english: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏣᎵᎾᏍᏕᏝᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi Galonedv uneladisdiyi ditsinawiyi gohiyudi gvdodi gesvi; nasgi nihi adageyudi gesv ditsalinasdetladistanvhi ale ditsalisdayidistanvhi gesvi,
english: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏦᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏯᏛᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎭᏫᏂᏴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi nihi ale naniv unadanvti yeliquo getsolisdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi nayadvvi ale niganvhisvi, ale nahawiniyvi, ale nigadvi;
english: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale itsigadovhisdiyi Galonedv udageyudi gesvi, nasgi agadovhisdi gesv tsigalosvsdiha, nasgi etsikaliisdodiyi nasgi nigadv akalii Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fullness of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏗᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎦᏓᏅᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino na yeliquo igvwadvnedi tsigi, utsati ulosvsdi igai iditayohihvi, ale idadanvtesgvi, nasgiya utloyi ulinigidv gesv tsidulvwisdaneha ayv degadanvdvi,
english: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvwalvquododi gesesdi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv, nigohilv degesadisvi, alisquadisgi nigesvna gesvi.  Emenv.
english: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᎩᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha ayv tsiyvgi Ugvwiyuhi agisdvdisgv vgiyvginvhi, itsvtayoseha itsalenidasdiyi nasgiya nusdv adayanvdodi gesv nasgi nihi etsiyanvtanvhi tsigi;
english: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ;
phonetic: Itsvdisgesdi utsati udadolisdi gesvi ale udanvti gesvi, ulitloyasdesdi gvnidiyu gesvi, ale unelagi didadelisedi gesv adageyudi gesv gvdi;
english: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᏴᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Itsatlinigvnehesdi itsisquanigododiyi saquo nidetsvnv detsadanvdvi, nvwadohiyadv detsadaniyvdvi.
english: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉ [ᎡᎭ] ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ;
phonetic: Saquo [eha] ayelvi, ale saquo Adanvdo, nasgiya saquo udugi itsvdiyi etsiyanvdv tsigi, nasgi etsiyanvhv tsvdidalehvsga;
english: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Saquo Ugvwiyuhi, saquo gohiyudi gesvi, saquo didawosdi gesvi;
english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏚᏰᎵᏏᏕᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Saquo naniv Unanelanvhi ale Unidoda, nasgi naniv unatseli ugvwiyuhi, ale nigav degesadisv tsiduyelisidega, ale nihi nitsiv tsitsiyaa.
english: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎡᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nidiv idisiyvwiha eginelv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgiya atlilov Galonedv udanedi gesvi.
english: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏚᎴᏅᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᏚᏴᎩᏁ ᏗᎨᏥᏴᎩᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏁᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha, Nahiyu dulenvgalvladi wulosv, duyvgine digetsiyvginvhi, ale dunele yvwi udanedi gesvi.
english: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎴᏅᎯ ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏠᎠᏒ ᎡᎳᏗᏢ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ ᏂᎦᏛᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Nasgino tsulenvhi tsadiha, gado gadvga, iyuno igvyiyi nasquo tsutloasv eladitlv degesadisv elohi ulutsv nigadvgvna yigi?
english: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏨᏧᏠᎠᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏚᎴᏁᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᏥᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi na tsvtsutloasei nasgiquo nasquo tsidulenei galvladitlv nigav galvloi degesadisv tsiwulutsei, nasgi tsukaliisdiyi nigav nudalesv gohusdi.
english: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᏪᎧᏁᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ, ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Igadvno getsinvsidv duwekanei; igadvno, anadolehosgi; igadvno, analitsidonidohi; igadvno, dinigatiya ale dinadeyohvsgi;
english: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nunigolvna igegvnediyi unadanvti, alitsidodi gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi, Galonedv ayelv unalinigohisdodiyi;
english: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂ ᏂᏗᎥ ᏫᏗᏱᎶᎸᎭ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎲᎢ^ᏗᎦᏛᎾᏯ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ^ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gvni nidiv widiyilolvha saquo iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi Uwetsi edohiyusvi ale edigatahvi^digadvnaya idisgaya igalisdodiyi^akalii atlilov Galonedv nigadv igalisdodiyi;
english: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏗᏲᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎢᎩᏃᎸᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏴ ᎤᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi gohi iyudalenvdv hnaquo didiyoli nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, iginolvtanidasdiyi nigesvna nigavquo dideyodi gesv ganolvtanidohvi, unadalidasdiyu gesv yvwi, anisinasanv anigatiyv unadalonuhediyi;
english: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᎦᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Duyugodvsgini kaneisdi gesv idvdisgv adageyudi gesv tali idvdisgvi, digadvhisdiyi nasgi nigav nudalesv nasgi digadudadewisdiyi nasgi asgoli tsigi, nasgi Galonedv;
english: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏙᎵᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎯᏢᎾᎥ ᏥᏚᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏟᎶᎥ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎧᏁᏉᏍᎪ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gesv tsvdidalehvsga nigv ayelv osdv didoligi tsigi, ale tsidududadewisdi nigav duhitlvnav tsidulisdelvdodi, nasgiya atlilov tsulvwisdanediyi tsudatselidv degesadisvi, kanequosgo ayelvi, adalinigohisdisgo uwasv adageyudi gesvi.
english: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎬᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino hia nitsiweha, ale itsvnetseha Ugvwiyuhi dudov gvdiha, nasgi nihi gohi iyudalenvdv itsehv tlesdi anisoi tsunadalenvdv anehv nasgiya yinusdesdi, nasgi uneguhiyu gesv dunadanvdv anisdawadisvi,
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏃᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏏᎲᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᎾᏞᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unolisdiyi tsunalisihvselvhi, unatledv nahna Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesv alenidasdiyi, nasgi nanigatanavna gesv iyuwanisadv, nvdigalisdodisgv tsuninawi disdayiyu gesvi.
english: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏚᎾᏓᏲᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvwanadolehohisdi nigesvna iyunalistanvhi gesvi dunadayosv unalisotlvisdodiyi, nudalesv gadaha gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi tsugvwalodi unigvvsgv nvtsulisdotanv.
english: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᏰᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
phonetic: Nihisgini vtla nasgi yinusdi yetsadeloquaelv Galonedv,
english: But ye have not so learned Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏪᎲ ᏥᏌ;
phonetic: Iyuno howa etsadvganelvhi gesesdi, ale nasgi itseyonvhi gesesdi, nasgiya nusdv duyugodv uwehv Tsisa;
english: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi nusdv igvyiyi itsalenidolv ugvwali iyvdv itsvnediyi uweti yvwi nasgi tsigi, nasgiya nusdv udalidasdi adulvnvdi gesvi;
english: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎢᏤᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Ale itse itsetsvnediyi nusdv detsadanvdvi;
english: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi itse yvwi itsanuwosdiyi, nasgi Unelanvhi ditlilostanvhi gotlvnvhi tsigi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesvi, ale udohiyusv asganvisdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎠᏥᎪᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᏤᎲ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏣᏓᎳ; ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvnehv atsigodi gesvi, nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv gayegogi nigesvna itsvdisgesdi detsadanetsehv nav itsadala; degadudadewisvyeno.
english: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏔᎳᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᏙ ᏭᏕᎵᏨᎩ ᎨᏥᏔᎳᏬᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Itsitalawosgesdi, ale tlesdi yitsisganvgesdi; tlesdi nvdo wudelitsvgi getsitalawosgi;
english: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎸᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi etsilanvdadelvgi asgina.
english: Neither give place to the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏛᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏳᏃᏍᎩᏎᏍᏗ; ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏎᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unosgidvno gesv tlesdi hnaquo yunosgisesdi; dulvwisdanehesdiquosgini degvdisgesdi tsuwoyeni osdv gesv nadvnehesdi, nasgi gagvwanedi iyulisdodiyi nasgi unigvsehi gesvi.
english: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᏗᏥᎰᎵ, ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᎠ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gohusdi uyo gawonihisdi gesv nvdayunugotsvgi ditsiholi, osdvsgini gesv uwasv nasgi gvwadalinigohisdodi tsigi, nasgi udulvdi gesvi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi gvwagatia udadolisdi gesv unilutsediyi anadvgisgi.
english: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏰᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎡᏧᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi uyo yetsadanvdadisdisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi itsiyelvtanvhi tsigi gvni nahiyu iga etsudalesdi gesv asqualvhvha.
english: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏓᏂᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᎾᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nigav adaniquadisdi gesvi, ale atalawohisdi gesvi, ale kanalvisdi gesvi, ale asdaya gawonihisdi gesvi, ale uhnalvhi gawonihisdi gesvi, iyvdv igvnedi gesesdi itsehvi, ulitloyasdesdi nigav usonv gesvi;
english: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᏕᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ale ditsadageyuhiyu gesesdi, itsadadolisdi ditsinawiyi, detsadanehesdi detsadasganvtsehvi, nasgiya Unelanvhi tsigetsinelv itsisganvtsv Galonedv tsinvdigalisdodiha.
english: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎨᏳᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi etsisdawadegi gesesdi nasgiya iyunadvnedi gesv tsugeyuhi tsuwetsi;
english: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎦᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎴᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale adageyudi gesv gvnigesv nitsvnehesdi itsehvi, nasgiya nasquo Galonedv igigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale tsidegadayohiselvgi, alisgolvdanedi ale atsilv geledi tsinulistanv Unelanvhi uganasdv uwewasvisdi.
english: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏕᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏅ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Edelidvsgini dinisidi gesvi, ale nudalesvquo gadaha gesvi, ale tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, tlesdi kaneisdodi unv yigesesdi itsehvi, nasgi tsunililohvsga unadanvti;
english: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏃᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi ale gohusdi uneilvdi gesvi, ale alisganedv gawonihisdi gesvi, ale gawetlvdi gesvi, nasgi nosvna tsigi; alihelitsediyiquosgini [Unelanvhi] ugvwiyusesdi.
english: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi itsigataha, nasgi gilo udelidv dinisihvsgi, ale agadahai, ale tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi, nasgi Unelanvhi ayelvhi adadolisdanehi gesvi, utseli iyulisdodi nigesvna gesv Galonedv utseligohi ale Unelanvhi utseligohi.
english: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᏔᏅᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo itsilonuhetanvgi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna gawonihisdi gesvi; nasgiyeno hia nvdigalisdodiha unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv unilutseha gohiyudi nigesvna gesv tsuwetsi.
english: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi nihi yitsatloyasdisgesdi unaliwadvehvi.
english: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏤᎲᎩ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᎢᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Ilvhiyuyeno tsigesv ulisigv itsehvgi, gohisgini gesv igagadv itseha Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv; igagadv tsuwetsi unedasdi gesv itsedohesdi;
english: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,)
phonetic: (Adanvdoyeno gananugowisgo nigav osdv gesv ale duyugodv gesv ale gayegogi nigesvna gesvi,)
english: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Itsigoliyesgesdi nasgi osiyu uyelvdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᎵᎪᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏕᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi yiditsaligonehesdi nasgi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ulisigi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, detsigvsgolvvsgesdiquosgini.
english: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Udehohisdiyuyeno kaneisdodiyiquo nasquo nasgi na nanadvnehv udelisvi.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᎬᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᎡ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Nigavsgini tsudalenvdv digvsgolvnvhi tsigeso igagati gvdi gvnigee idigvnelvhi gesoi; nasgiyeno gvnigesv idigvnehi gesv nasgi igagati.
english: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎯᏰᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎯᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎩᏯᏓᏑᏴᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᏓᏣᏁᎵ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha, Hiyegi nihi hilihi, ale talehvga giyadanvsi tsuniyohusvhi giyadasuyvi, Galonedvno datsaneli igagati.
english: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsagasayasdesdi nigav duyugodv itsalenidasdiyi, tlesdi uninegu iyunadvnedi, anigatanaisgini iyunadvnedi,
english: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsudalesgesdi gohi gesv aliyilisvi, nvdigalisdodisgesdi uyoiyu gesv gohi gesvi.
english: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏦᎵᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi nitsoligvna yigesesdi, itsoligisgini gesesdi nusdv udulisgv Nvgvwiyuhi.
english: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi tlesdi gigage aditasdi yiditsiyvsdesdisgesdi nasgi utsati uyoiyu tsigi; Adanvdosgini itsikaliwohi gesesdi.
english: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᎵᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Detsalinohesgesdi detsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi dikanogisdodi, ale galvquododi dikanogisdi, ale adanvdo ugvwali dikanogisdi, detsinogisgesdi doditsadanvdv didalehvsgesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsinogisdisgesdi.
english: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Etsalielitsehesdi nigohilv Unelanvhi ale Agayvligei nvdigalisdodisgesdi nigav gohusdi ugvwali, itsvdisgesdi dudov Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv;
english: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Detsadadohiyuhvsgesdi itsisiyvwiha gesv Unelanvhi etsinayesgvi.
english: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎯ ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigeyv, itsvsv digetsiyehi detsohiyusesdi, Ugvwiyuhi gohiyudi tsigi nasgiyai.
english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asgayayeno nugvwiyusadegi udalii ehvi, nasgiya Galonedv nugvwiyusadegi tsigi tsunanelodi unadatlugv anehvi; ale nasgi Asdelisgi ayelvi.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ [ᏂᎬᏩᏂᏪᏎᎲᎢ.]
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tsunanelodi unadatlugv Galonedv gvwohiyudi tsigi, nasgiya anigeyv digvwaniyehi tsunohiyudi nigav [nigvwaniwesehvi.]
english: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎨᏳᏎ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎᎢ,
phonetic: Itsisgaya, detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii, nasgiya Galonedv nasquo tsugeyuse tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, ale nasgi dasdelisgv uwasv tsidudayosei,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎹ ᏥᎪᏑᎴᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasganvna iyuwanediyi ganvgalisgvi kanohedv gvdisgvi ama tsigosuledisgo nasgiyai.
english: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏪᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᏄᏚᏯᏍᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᏁᎪᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ; ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi uwasv agatahv uwegodiyi digvwalvsadv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nuduyasdvna, ale nudanegoyusvna, ale nigav gohusdi nasgi iyusdi nudadalvna; nasganvnasgini iyulisdodiyi ale gohusdi naguisdvna.
english: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᎭ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᏧᎨᏳᏐ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya anisgaya unvsv diniyelv nidunigeyusv nasgiya yinidunigeyuha tsunadalii.  Gilo udalii tsugeyuso uwasv udageyusoi.
english: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏂᏆᏘᎶ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏇᏓᎸᎢ; ᎨᎶᎰᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Vtlayeno gilo asi ilvhiyu yuniquatilo uwasv uquedalvi; gelohosgini ale asquanigodisgoi, nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi nidadvnehv tsunanelodi unadatlugvi;
english: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏔ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎪᎳ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno nasgi ayelv degadudata, nasgi uquedalv ale nasgi tsugola.
english: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏕᎬᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᏜᏓᏩᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi asgaya degvdegesdi udoda ale utsi, adlawasdisgesdino udalii, nasgino anitali saquoquo gesesdi uniquedalvi.
english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏕᎵᏗᏳ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi utsati udelidiyu; aseno Galonedv ale tsunanelodi unadatlugv gatsineisdiha.
english: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎰᏩ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ; ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏰᎯ.
phonetic: Adina nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv howa detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii nasgiya itsvsv nitsadageyusvi; ageyvno ulvquodiyu gesesdi uyehi.
english: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏚᏳᎪᏗᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli, detsohiyusesdi ditsigayvligei Ugvwiyuhi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi; duyugodiyeno nasgi hia.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Hilvquodesdi tsadoda ale tsatsi, nasgi igvyiyi ulinetsv tsigi tsulitloyasdi aduisdvi,
english: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎨᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi osiyu igetsalisdanedi yigi, ale gohidiyu getsalenidasdi yigi elohi.
english: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎿᎭᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᏥ; ᏕᏣᏛᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏯᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nihi itsigayvligei, tlesdi yiditsihnalvsdisgesdi ditsetsi; detsadvhisdisgesdisgini Ugvwiyuhi utseli dideyodi gesv ale geyadovhisdi gesvi.
english: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ, ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎾᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Etsinvsidasdi, detsohiyusesdi nasgi getsinvsidohi ani uquedali, gesvi, itsinayesgesdi ale detsinawisgesdi, osiyu itsiyelvhi gesesdi ditsinawiyi, Galonedv tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai.
english: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏥᏛᏓᏗᎧᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎪᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla tsidvdadikano iyusdi, yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi; Galonedvsgini tsunvsidasdi iyunadvnedi, Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi nitsadvnehvi, ditsinawiyi tsvdidalehvsgoi;
english: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫᏉ ᏥᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
phonetic: Osiyu itsiyelvhi gohusdi itsadvnehv, Ugvwiyuhi tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai, vtlano yvwiquo tsinidetsadvneho nasgiyai;
english: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Itsigatahv nasgi nigav gohusdi osdv dulvwisdanehv giloi, nasgiya iyusdi unedi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, nasquo atsinatlai yigi, ale natsinatlavna yigi.
english: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏤᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎾᏰᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎡᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏚᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nihi ditsadanvsidohi, nasgiya utloyi nasgi nidetsadvnehesdi, unelagi itselisesdi detsinayedanehvi, tsitsigataha nasgi nihi nasquo Itsinvsidohi galvloi ehvi; vtla ale yidusuyesdi yvwi digvwalvquododi gesvi.
english: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino gesvi, idalinvtli, ditsalinigidiyu gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi etsalisgasdodvi, ale itsalisgasdodv utsatanvhi ulinigidiyu gesvi.
english: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎢᏣᏣᏅᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏣᎴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadv Unelanvhi utseliga alisgasdodo itsatsanvda, nasgi yeli getsaledi iyulisdodiyi asgina asinasanv detsigatilvsdisgvi.
english: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏟᏴᎭ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏄᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno yidigatliyvha uquedali gesv ale gigv, unigvwiyuhisgini, ale tsunalinigidv, ale nunigvwiyusadegi ani elohi ulisigi gesvi, didanvdo uninegutsidv galvlo nunadvhnadegvi.
english: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎵ ᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎨᏣᏟᏴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎨᏣᎴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsagi nigadv ali sgasdodo Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi yeli digetsatliyvdi iyulisdodiyi nahiyu uyoiyu iga gesesdi, nasgino nigadv itsadvnelvhi gesesdi, getsaledi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᏠᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᏣᏍᏚᎶᏕᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi detsidogesdi, detsadatlosdesdi gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, ale duyugodv gesv detsadanetsasdulodesdi;
english: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏕᏂᏃ ᏕᏣᎳᏑᎶᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Ditsalasidenino detsalasulodesdi advnvistanvhi gesv osdv kanohedv nvwadohiyadv adanehi;
english: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎬᏑᎶᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎨᏨᏜᏓᏕᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏥᏍᏟ ᎦᏂ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Aseno nasquo gohiyudi gesv itsaligvsuloda, nasgi itsvdisgv yeliquo digetsvdladedi iyulisdodiyi tsutsistli gani asgina tsutseliga.
english: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎢᏥᎾᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Alisdelvdodino alisdulo itsinagi, ale ayelasdiganvhidv Adanvdo utseliga, nasgi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli tsigi;
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nigohilv itsadadolisdisgesdi nudalesv adadolisdi gesv, ale atayosdi gesv Adanvdo gvdi, ale itsiyawisgesdi nahnani itsvdisgesdi diyaweisdi nigesvna, ale atayosdi gesv getsisdelvdiyi unadanvti nanivi.
english: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏆᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎩᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎣᎵ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏁᎮᏛ;
phonetic: Ale ayv vgisdelvdiyi, nasgi vqualisgolvdanediyi agiwonihisdiyi, agisduisdiyi tsioli nitsisgaihvna, gvnigesv iyaquvnediyi udelidv gesv osdv kanehedv;
english: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ] ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi [osdv kanohedv] tsinvdigalisdodiha ayv vginvsidv vqualvidv tsigi; nasgi iyuwanisodiyi nahnani nitsisgaihvna agineisdiyi, nasgiya iyagiwesdiyi tsiduyugodi.
english: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏆᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᏗᎩᎦ, ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgino itsigadovhisdiyi nasquo ayv naqualisdanelidegv ale naquadvhnadegvi, Digiga, otsigeyui otsalinvtli ale osdv iyadvnehi tsulvwisdanehi Ugvwiyuhi utseli ugvwali, gvnigesv nvdatsvneli nudalesv gohusdi;
english: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏗᏤᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsinvli ditsehvi nasgiquo ugvwali, nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi nogalisdanelidegvi, ale nasgi tsugalisdadisdiyi ditsinawi.
english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏚᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Uwadohiyadv dunikahnawadidohesdi analinvtli, ale adageyudi gesv ulitloyasdesdi gohiyudi gesvi, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv dunikahnawadidohesdi naniv nunatlonasdvna unigeyuhi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.  Emenv.
english: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏫᏙᏍᏙᏪᎳᏏ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏙᏍᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ;
phonetic: Quola ale Dimadi, Tsisa Galonedv gvwaninvsidohi, widosdowelasi naniv unadanvti Galonedv Tsisa gvwohiyuhi nasgi Quiligiyi anehi, dosgatloyasdiha dinigatiya ale aniyadohihi;
english: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtane Unelanvhi igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Aquanelanvhi tsiyalielitseho iyusdiha itsvyanvdadigvi,
english: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Nigohilv nigadadolisdisgv nitsitayohihv nihi nitsiv etsidolisdiyi, ulihelisdi aquadanvdv gadadolisdisgvi,
english: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏖᏆᎶᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ;
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodisgv itsatequalosv osdv kanohedv detsikahnawadisvi, igvyiyi iga nvdagvwadalenvdv gohi iyasti;
english: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏆᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎴᏅᏛ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏰᎵᎢᎶᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Hia nasgi sudalegi gesv naquadlasidvehvna, nasgi na osdv digalvwisdanedi ulenvdv doditsadanvdvi nasgi uyeilvsdiyi gvlisquadisgi Tsisa Galonedv utseli iga aliyeliilolv gvdisgi;
english: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ ᎢᏨᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsiduyugodi nasgi itsvyelisediyi nitsivi, nvdigalisdodisgv aginawiyi itsvsquanigodvi; nasquoyeno vqualvidv gesvi, ale tsisdelisgv ale tsisdayidisgv osdv kanohedv nihi nitsiv itseladisdiha gvwagatiya vgidoligvi.
english: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno aquatseli agatahi nigav itsvgeyusvli Tsisa Galonedv udageyudi gvdisgvi.
english: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏔᏲᎯᎭ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale tsitayohiha gadadolisdisgvi, nasgi adageyudi gesv itsehv asi utli igai unequotsvsdiyi ulitloyasdodiyi agadovhisdi gesv, ale nigav duyugodv golisdi gesvi;
english: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏚᏓᎴᎿᎭᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏓᎿᎭᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎵᏱᎶᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsigowadvdiyi tsudalenvdv dudalehnavi; nasgi nitsatlonasdvna itsalisdodiyi, ale nitsadahnasqualosdisgvna Galonedv utseli iga aliyilolv gvdisgi;
english: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsikalitsvhi iyulisdodiyi duyugodv gesv udalenvhi, nasgi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisodiyi, nasgi ulvquododiyi Unelanvhi ale gvnigesv iyuwanediyi nasgi galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ;
phonetic: Aseno idalinvtli aquaduliha itsigadovhisdiyi nasgi gudalenvdv naqualisdanelvi unequoisdiyiquo nuwanelv osdv kanohedv;
english: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎥᏆᎸᎥᎢ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏂᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᏉ;
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Galonedv agisdvdisgv vqualvvi ugvwiyuhi ganelv nigv gvnigesv nulistanv, ale nigvnadvquo;
english: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎥᏆᎸᎥ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏚᎾᎵᎪᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎾᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale anigodiyu analinvtli Ugvwiyuhi tsunanelodi vqualvv iyuwanisadv dunaligosv dunadanvdvi, utli igai naninayesgvna nunalistanv kanohedv nanisgaihvna uninohediyi.
english: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ, ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igadv udohiyuhi advyugedi gesv ale adisvsdi gesv unadulisgv nvdigalisdodiha analitsidohvsga Galonedv aninoheha, igadvno nasquo osiyu uniyelvsvi.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᎾᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏄᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏯᏅᏗᎭ, ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi sunadalegi gesv analitsidohvsga Galonedv aninoheha adisvsdiquo gesv unadulisgv nvdigalisdodiha, vtlano nunatlonasdvna gesv yanvdiha, uninequosdiyi uniyelvha tsigiliyogv vqualvidv gesvi.
english: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
author: Cherokee New Testament
