syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Anisoisgini gvgigeyuhiyu gesv nvdigalisdodiha, anigatahayeno vginetselvhi gesv agisdelvdiyi osdv kanohedv.
english: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨᏃ?  ᎤᏁᎳᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᎭ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gadogeno?  Unelagi, nigavquo nanadvnehvi, nasquo asequoquo yinanadvneha, ale udohiyuhi yuniyelvha, Galonedv atsinoheha; ale nahnani galieliga, vv, ale ase galieligesdi.
english: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᎩᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Tsigatahayeno hia nasgi vgisdelvdiyi wuliyeilohisdi gesvi nihi itsadadolisdisgv nvdagalisdotani, ale Tsisa Galonedv Udanvdo vginehvi;
english: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏄᏍᏙᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᎸ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya utsati aquadulisgv ale udugi aquvsvi, nasgi nigav gohusdi aquadehohisdiyi nigesvna, nigavquosgini nitsisgaihvna gesvi, tsinusdoquo, nasgiya nasquo gohi, Galonedv tsilvquododi gesesdi tsiyelv gvdi, nasquo gvnodv gesv ale agiyohuhisdi gesvi.
english: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏰᏃ ᏯᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎦᎶᏅᏛ ᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ, ᏯᎩᏲᎱᏒᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗ.
phonetic: Asiyeno yaqualenidolv Galonvdv tsilvquododi, yagiyohusvno ayv aginequotsedi.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏯᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᎪᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyusgininonv uquedalv yaqualenidolv, hia nasgi aginanugowisdi dagilvwisdagohvi; ale vtla yitsigataha nasgi iyusdi aquasuyesdiyi.
english: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏤᎲ ᏩᏆᏕᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Taliyeno iyudalegi gesv asdayiyu naqualisdaneha, nvdigalisdodi aquadulisgv aquanigisdiyi, ale Galonedv tsehv waquadediyi; nasgi wudagonadvdv utli osiyu tsigi;
english: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏟ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᎯ.
phonetic: Usdalvsgininonv aqualenidasdiyi utli osiyu itsalisdanedi nihi.
english: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏣᏉᎯᏳᎭ, ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsinusdi tsaquohiyuha, tsigataha aqualenidasdiyi ale nitsiv itsvyeladidasdiyi, nasgi itsinequotsediyi ale itsalihelisdiyi itsohiyusvi.
english: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi utsati unequotsvsdiyi itsaliheligv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv, ayv nvdigalisdodisgv, nasgi taline witsvlutsedi gesv iyusdi.
english: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏫᏨᎪᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᎩᎪᏁᎸᏉ, ᏱᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgiya adina Galonedv utseli osdv kanohedv tsulilohvsga nitsadvnelidohesdi; nasgi iyuno yiwitsvlutselv ale yiwitsvgov, ale yagigonelvquo, yigadvgvga nitsadvhnadegvi, ulinigidv detsidogv saquo adanvdogihi, saquo adanvtedi gvdi, atequalohi itsatlinigvnediyi itsisdelvdiyi gohiyudi gesv osdv kanohedv.
english: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tlesdi gohusdi anadvnehv getsatludisgi yitsisgasdanehesdi; nasgi gvnigesv iyunvnehi getsidvdodi gesvi, nihisgini gvnigesv itsvnehi etsisdelvdi gesvi, ale nasgi Unelanvhi itsisdelvdi gesvi.
english: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏤᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nihiyeno etsinelvhi Galonedv gesv iyusdi, vtla etsoiyudiyiquo uwasv, nasquosgini etsigilitsediyi;
english: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏍᎩᎪᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎠᏇᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya adisvsdi gesv itsehv nasgi ayv tsisgigoelvgi, ale gohi tsitsadvgiha aquehvi.
english: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏄᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎬᏖᏆᎶᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏓᏘᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno Galonedvyi ugalisdi nvdagvwadaledi gesesdi, iyuno adageyudi gesv adanuwohisdisgi gvwadanedi gesesdi, iyuno gvtequalodi gesesdi Adanvdo vdatinedi gesvi, iyuno adadolisdi gesv ale udanvti gesv ehesdi,
english: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏣ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Itsikalitsa galieligvi, utloyi iyulisdodiyi itsadanvtesgvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadageyusvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi detsadanvdvi, utloyiquo iyulisdodiyi ditsadanvdo.
english: Fulfill ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ; ᎡᎳᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏕᏨᏅ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎤᏟ ᏂᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gohusdi yitsadvnehesdi adisvsdi gesv ale asequo atlvquisdi gesv gvdi; eladiquosgini nidetsvnv detsadanvdv itsisiyvwiha utli nidetsilvquodesdi anisoi esgaquo itsvsv.
english: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏳᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏂᎥᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo uwasvquo utseli yugasayasdesdi, nanivsgini anisoi nasquo unatseliga.
english: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏓᏅᏖ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ;
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdesdi detsadanvtesdi, nasgiya nasquo tsudanvte Galonedv Tsisa;
english: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎦ ᏰᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏄᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi tsagatlilostanvhi gesvi, vtla gadanasahvsga yelisge Unelanvhi nasgiya nusdv nudvnvi.
english: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno natsilvquodvna nudadvnele uwasv, ale atsinvsidasdi nusdv nasgiya nudadvnelei, ale yvwi nunasdv nasgiya nulistanei;
english: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale yvwi nasgiya nusdv gesei, uwasv natsilvquodvna nudadvnelei, ale uwohiyuhisdv nulistane ayohuhisdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi dadahnawasdv ayohuhisdodi gesvi.
english: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎸ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᎾᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo Unelanvhi utsati galvladiyu usaladanv, ale unelv tsudosdodi gesvi, nasgi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo nigav tsunadosdodi gesvi,
english: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᏆᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᎠᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi Tsisa dudov nigadiyu tsunaliniquanediyi nasquo galvloi anehi, ale elohi anehi, ale elohi hawiniditlv anehi;
english: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎦᏃᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigadiyu diganoga gvnigesv iyunvnedi gesesdi nasgi Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi gesvi, galvquodiyu iyuwanehi gesesdi Unelanvhi Agayvligei.
english: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᏥᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎪᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎦᏔᎲᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎾᏫᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvgeyui, nigohilvquo tsitsohiyuhvsgoi, vtla ayv tsigatahvquo iyusdi, gohisgini gesv agigonelvi utli igai ditsilvwisdasi etsisdelvdiyi gesvi, itsinayesgv ale detsinawisgvi;
english: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏚᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno osiyu uyelvdi gesv deulvwisdaneha detsadanvdvi nasgi itsadulvdiyi ale nasquo ditsilvwisdanediyi.
english: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏣᏗᏒᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nigadiyu tsudalenvdv detsilvwisdanehv gohusdi niditsadadelisehvna ale tsitsadisvhihvna gesesdi;
english: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᎾᏓᏥᏃᏍᏆᏗᏰᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎲ ᏕᏥᎸᏌᏓᏗᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏗᏣᏘᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi netsilawisehvna ale nitsatlonasdvna gesesdi, Unelanvhi tsuwetsi, gayetsuisdodi nigesvna, itsadasuyv unadatsinosquadiyedv ale unagolvdv yvwi anehvi, nasgi nahna anehv detsilvsadadiha elohi iga ditsatisdanehi nasgiyai;
english: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎩᏍᏆᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsinanugowisgesdi kanohedv gvnidv adanehi; nasgi iyuwanisodiyi aqualihelisdiyi Galonedv utseli iga gesesdi, nasgi asequo digisqualvtanvhi nigesvna gesvi, ale asequo digilvwisdanelvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᏯᏆᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᎸ ᎢᏤᎶᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᎪᏁᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vv, ale iyu yaquadalisgolvtanv nahna atsilv itselohvi ale detsilvwisdanehv gohiyudi itsvdisgvi, galieliga, ale itsvyaligoneha itsaliheligvi.
english: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎪᎲᏏ ᎠᏴ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo winigalisdoda nihi itsaliheligi, ale sgiyaligohvsi ayv galieligvi.
english: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎴᎰᏒᎭ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno udugi aquvha Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa iyuwanisodiyi Dimadi tsinvsdiyi ditsehv nigohilvna, nasgi ayv nasquo osdv agigalisdadisdiyi gadolehosvha nitsadvhnadegvi.
english: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏲᎩᎾᎵᎪᎭ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏩᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno gilo yoginaligoha utloyi udanvtawadegi, nasgi ase gvwagasayasdodi gesv nitsadvhnadegvi.
english: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno unvsvquo unatseli gesv uniyohoi, vtlano Tsisa Galonedv utseli gesvi.
english: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎵᏱᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno etsigataha nusdv nasgi atsigoliyevi, nasgi gilo uwetsi udoda tsasdelisgo nasgiya agisdelvhidolv osdv kanohedv uliyilvsdiyi dagilvwisdanehvi.
english: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ ᎦᏙᎴᎣᏒᏉ ᎢᏯᏉᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi udugi aquvha nasgi tsinvsdiyi igvwenvdv gadoleosvquo iyaquolisdanedi gesvi.
english: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno tsiyalisgasdodiha Ugvwiyuhi ulisgolvdodiyi ayv nasquo aquvsv nigohilvna witsvlutsediyi.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏎ ᏱᏥᏅᏒ ᎠᏇᎵᏒ ᎢᏆ'ᎶᏓᏔ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᏙᎩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎣᏍᏗᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏂᎪᎯᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Adina ase yitsinvsv aquelisv Iqua'lodata witsilutsediyi, nasgi aginvtli ale oginatequalohi doginilvwisdanehvi, ale oginaligohi osdiyawisgi, nihisgini etsinvsidv, ale nasgi agisdelvdv agiwadvdiyi aginigohisehvi.
english: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏢᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatiyeno udulisgvgi itsigowadvdiyi nitsivi, ale utsati gagedv udanvtawadegvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi itsadvganv utlvtsvi.
english: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏏᎶᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno utlvgvgi ale alequo nuyohusvgi; aseno Unelanvhi uwedolitsvgi; vtla ale nasgiquo uwasv, ayvsgini nasquo, nasgi ulosilodv uyo aquadanvdadisdiyi nigesvna.
english: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏥᏅᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎡᏥᎪᎥᎭ, ᎨᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi utli tlegiyu tsinvli, nasgi hnaquo taline ietsigovha, getsalihelisdi yigi, ale ayv esga iyvdv uyo yaquadanvtawadega.
english: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏨᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tsetsadanilvgi Ugvwiyuhi dikahnawadegi gesv iyusdi utsati osiyu ayelvdi itsvda; ale nasgi iyunasdi detsilvquodesdi;
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎷᎶᎬ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno utseli digalvwisdanedi gesv nvdagalisdodisgvgi alequo nuyohusvgi, nasquanigodisgvna gvnvi, nasgi usquadisdiyi galulogv aqualisdelvdodi itsinvi.
english: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏯᏪᎢᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎠᏴ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino gesv idalinvtli, itsaliheligi Ugvwiyuhi gesv iyusdi.  Hia nasgi witsvyowelanediyi, udohiyuhi vtla tsuyaweisdi yagiyelvha ayv, nihisgini unayehisdi gesv itsudalesgi.
english: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎵ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ; ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎱᏍᏕᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Detseyadotsehesdi gili, detseyadotsehesdi uyo tsunilvwisdanehi; detseyadotsehesdi dinihusdesgi.
english: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏤᎩᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎡᏓᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno tsegiusdeselvhi, Unelanvhi Adanvdo gvdi edadadolisdanehi tsigi, ale idaliheligi Galonedv Tsisa edalisgasdodv iyusdi, ale uquedali gesv nigalisgasdodvna tsigi.
english: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏳᎭ ᏳᏰᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ [ᎠᎩᎭ;]
phonetic: Nasquosgininonv ayv agiha uquedali gesv gvqualisgasdododi gesvi.  Iyuno gilo yeli yuha yuyelv uquedali gesv gvwalisgasdododi gesvi, ayv utli igai [agiha;]
english: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏁᎵᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎥᎩᎱᏍᏕᏎᎸᎩ, ᎢᏏᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏇᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ, ᏥᏈᎷ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᏅᏛᏆᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏃ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᏥᏆᎵᏏ;
phonetic: Tsuneline iga vgihusdeselvgi, Isili unadatselidv gesv nvdvquadalenvhi, Queni anilasdalv gela, Tsiquilu Aniquilu nvdvquadalenvhi; dikahnawadvsdino detsikahnawadisv Tsiqualisi;
english: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏕᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎦᏴᎩᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvno adanvdadisdi gesv ugvwali, detsigiliyoisdisgvgi tsunanelodi dunadatlugvi; duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ugvwali dikahnawadvsdi detsikahnawadisvi, gayvgilawisedi nigesvna gesvgi.
english: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno nigav nasgi gvqualisdelvdodi agiyelvnvi, nasgi esgaquo iyaquvnehi agiyelvha Galonedv nvdagalisdoda.
english: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏓᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗᏉ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᏣᏴᏁᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Vv, udohiyuhi, ale nigavquo gohusdi esga iyaquvnehi agiyelvha nvdigalisdodiha udagonadvtanvhi gesv tsigadovhisdi gesv Galonedv Tsisa aquatseli Ugvwiyuhi; nasgi tsinvdigalisdodiha nigadiyu tsudalenvdv agiyohuselvhi tsigi, ale uneilvdiquo agiyelvha nasgi, Galonedv nasgi aquatseli itsayvnediyi,
english: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᏯᏁᎶᏛ ᎥᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎾᎩᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi detsiyanelodv vgiwadvdiyi, aquadudalesdodi aquvsv aquatseli nagihvna gesvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi gvwadanedi tsigi, nasgini Galonedv gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, nasgi adudalesdodi gesv Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi tsigi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv gvdodi tsigi.
english: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏇᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsigadovhisdiyi, ale ulinigidiyu gesv nasgi uyohusv dulehisanvi, ale aqueladisdisgv nasgi ugiliyotsidolvi, ale uyohusv nasgiya agiyohuhisdiyi;
english: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏱᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏆᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi gohusdi nvdayuliyilvsdodiyi ayohusv dilehisodi gesv waqualiyeilohisdiyi.
english: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏓᎩᏂᏴᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏳ ᏰᎵ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏓᎩᏂᏴᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Vtlasgininonv gayula tsidaginiyvso nasgiya yagiyelvha, vtla ale agisquadvhi gayula yagiyelvha; tsisdawadegasgini, iyu yeli yigi, nasgi diginiyvdiyi nasgi nasquo ugvwali Galonedv Tsisa tsidaginiyvhvgi.
english: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎠᎩᏂᏴᏛ ᏍᎩᏰᎸᎭ; ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏍᎩᏂ [ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ;] ᎠᏋᎨᏫᏍᎪᎢ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬ ᏫᏗᏥᏂᏱᏍᎪᎢ,
phonetic: Idalinvtli, vtla gayula aginiyvdv sgiyelvha; sudalegisgini [nigadvnehoi;] aquvgewisgoi tsudalenvdv oniditlv nusdidegvi, igvyiditlvno tsudalenvdv nusdidegv widitsiniyisgoi,
english: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎨᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏕᎦᎵᏍᏆᎵᎭ ᎠᏌᏍᏛ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Digedv iditlv degalisqualiha asasdv diginiyvdiyi nasgi unelanvhi galvladi nvdayudalenvhi adayanvdodi gesv Galonedv Tsisa agvdisgvi.
english: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, ayv nidiv igisquadvhi gesvi, nasgi nusdesdi igadanvtesdi; ale iyu gohusdi gesv nvwadale nusdesdi dotsadanvtesdi, Unelanvhi nasgi hia nasquo gvnigesv nvdatsvneli.
english: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏳᎳ ᏫᎦᎵᏱᎶᎸᎢ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏁᎶᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Adina nahna gayula wigaliyilolvi, utloyiquo dikahnawadvsdi deganelodidisesdi, utloyiquo idadanvtesgesdi.
english: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎯ ᏥᏕᏍᎩᏯᎧᎭ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, itsatequalohi sgisdawadegi gesesdi, ale detsagasayasdesdi nasgi iyanadvnehi anedohvi, nasgi ayv sgiyadeloquaehi tsidesgiyakaha.
english: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎫᏘᎶᏛ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᎦᏠᏱᎯ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Unitsatayeno anedoha, nasgi uwagutilodv gatsineistanvhi itsvnonelvhi, ale gohi gesv nasquo digagatloyihi itsvnoneha, nasgi anisgagi gesv tsudahnawadv Galonedv utseliga;
english: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱᏉ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎾᏢᏈᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi unisquadisdodi gesv adadvdisgi tsigi, Unanelanvhi unisquoliyiquo tsigi, ale unadehohisdisgiquo anatlvquisdisgi tsigi, nasgi elohiquo ehi unagasayasdi tsigi.
english: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏕᎯ; ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᏗᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Ayvyeno galvladi idehi; nahna nasquo nvdayulohisdiyi tsidigatenoha Igisdelisgi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv;
english: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏁᏟᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᏗᎦᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏗᏗᏰᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi diginetliyvedi tsigi nidigalvquodvna didiyelvi, nasgiya itsuwanediyi uwasv galvquodiyu ayelv nusdvi, nasgiya ulinigvgv gvdisgv nigadiyu tsudalenvdv uwasv digvwanelododiyi iyuwanediyi.
english: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏘ, ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎡᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏚᎶᏙᏗ, ᏅᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli itsvgeyui ale utsati itsvyanvti, sgiyalielisdisgi ale aqualisdulododi, nvwasdesdi ulinigidv detsidogesdi Ugvwiyuhi etsalisgasdodvi, itsvgeyui.
english: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏳᎣᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏏᏂᏗᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎢᏧᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tsisdiyediha Yuodiya, ale tsisdiyediha Sinidigi nasgi utloyiquo itsunvnediyi dunadanvdv Ugvwiyuhi danikahnawadisvi.
english: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᎩᎾᏖᏆᎶᎯ, ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸᎯ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎯᏯᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏞᎻᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏥᏕᎪᏪᎳ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
phonetic: Ale gvsdiyediha nasquo nihi nitsatlonasdvna gvginatequalohi, gvgisdelvdiyi na anigeyv gvgisdelvhidolvhi dagilvwisdanelv galitsidonidohv osdv kanohedv, hiyatloyastanvha nasquo Tlemina ale anisoi utloyi tsogilvwisdanehi, nasgi dunadov tsidegowela gvnidv adanehi gowelihi.
english: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ, ᎦᏗᎭ ᏔᎵᏁ.
phonetic: Itsaliheligesdi nigohilv Ugvwiyuhi nvdigalisdodisgesdi; itsaliheligesdi, gadiha taline.
english: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏓᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Itsadanvtiyu gesv nanvi yvwi anigatahesdi; Ugvwiyuhi navniyu dayai.
english: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏁᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Tlesdi gohusdi yitselihisgesdi; nudalesvsgini gohusdi adadolisdodi ale atayosdi gesv gvdi alihelisdi gvwalitloyasdi, gvnigesv netsvnehesdi Unelanvhi nusdv itsadulisgvi;
english: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᎶᏒᏍᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎬᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nvwadohiyadvno Unelanvhi udanedi gesv, nasgi tsigalosvsdiha nigav gvdanvtedi gesvi, tsusquanigododi gesesdi ditsinawi ale ditsadanvdo, Galonedv Tsisa nigvnisisgesdi.
english: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᏰᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino gesvi idalinvtli, nigav gayegogi nigesvna gesvi, nigav galvquododi gesvi, nigav duyugodv gesvi, nigav gadaha nigesvna gesvi, nigav osiyu gvyelvdi gesvi, nigav osiyu aninohesgesdi; iyuno osiyu iyadvnedi yeha, iyuno gohusdi galvquododi gesesdi, nasgi detsadanvtesgesdi.
english: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᎪᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi gudalenvdv sgiyadeloquaelvhi gesvi, ale disgiyadanilvtselvhi gesvi, ale sgiyadvganelvhi gesvi, ale sgigoelvhi gesvi, nitsadvnehesdi; Unelanvhino nvwadohiyadv adanehi ditsikahnawadidasdi gesesdi.
english: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎯ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏤᎯᏲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno Ugvwiyuhi utsati tsiyalielitsvgi, nasgi hnaquo uwohitsvhi sgiyanvdv taline atsehiyogi, nasgi nahna ugvwali nasquo sgiyanvdvgi, aseno vtla yitsadlanvdadehei.
english: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏆᏕᎶᏆᎥᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎣᏏᏳᏉ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla adina aginigvsehv tsineisdisgv yigi, aquadeloquavyeno nigav naqualisdanelidegv osiyuquo agiyelvdiyi.
english: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏱᎾᏆᏛᎿᎭᏕᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎭ; ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬᎢ, ᎥᏇᏲᏅ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᏉᎳᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎩᏲᏏᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏯᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎩᏂᎬᏎᎭ
phonetic: Tsigataha iyaquadvnediyi eladi yinaquadvhnadega, ale tsigataha iyaquadvnediyi utsati yagiha; nigav degesadisvi, ale nigav naqualisdanelidegvi, vqueyonv iyaquadvnediyi nasquo yaquolanv ale nasquo yagiyosiha, nasquo utsati yagiha ale nasquo yaginigvseha
english: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nigavquo igvquadvnedi Galonedv iyuwanisadv nasgi tsaqualinigohisdiha.
english: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᏍᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv osiyu nitsadvnelv tsisginelv aqualisdelvdodi tsigiliyogv iyui.
english: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏒ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏆᏛᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏓᏘᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgino nihi Quiligiyi itsehi, itsigatahesdi nasquo, nasgi osdv kanohedv igvyiyi itsvyalitsidonelv nahiyu Masidoni aquanigisv, vtla ilvhitlv unadatlugv tsunanelodi gohusdi yigvquadvnele nasgi adanedi ale vdatinedi gesv ugvwali, nihi itsvsv.
english: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦᏰᏃ ᏫᎨᏙᎲ ᏌᏉ ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Desilonigayeno wigedohv saquo nitsadanvsvgi aginigvsehv aqualisdelvdodi, ale nasquo talinei.
english: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtla adina aquadulisgv adanedi gesv yinvdigalisdodiha; udatanvhisgini aquaduliha utsati itsalisdelvdodi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎩᎧᎵᏬᎯ, ᏗᏆᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏆ'ᎶᏓᏓ ᎤᏲᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᏅᏒᎯ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno nigavquo agiha ale utsatanvhi; agikaliwohi, diquadanilvtsvhi gesv Iqua'lodada uyolvhi nasgi nvdatsadanvsvhi, utsati uganasdv gawasvgi, atsilv gelasdi digvdanilvisdi, osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi.
english: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Aseno Aquanelanvhi itsinedi gesesdi nigav itsinigvsehvi, nasgiya uwehnaiyu ale galvquodiyu gesvi, Galonedv Tsisa iyuwanisadv.
english: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Hnaquono Unelanvhi ale Igidoda galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Emenv.
english: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.  ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎠᏂ ᏦᏤᏙᎭ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ.
phonetic: Detsiyoliha naniv unadanvti Galonedv Tsisa anohiyuhvsgi.  Otsalinvtli ani tsotsedoha wigetsiyoliha.
english: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏏᏌ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Naniv unadanvti wigetsiyoliha, ho ugvwiyuha nasgi na Sisa dudatinavi.
english: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv utseliga itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ,
phonetic: Quola, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv nasgiya osiyu uyelvnv Unelanvhi, ale Dimadi iginvtli,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎪᎶᏏ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Witsvyowelasi itsadanvti Golosi itsehi ale itsalinvtli Galonedv etsohiyuhvsgi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏙᏓ, ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ,
phonetic: Otsalielitseha Unelanvhi ale Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv Udoda, otsadadolisdisgo nigohilv itsvyanvdadisgoi,
english: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ;
phonetic: Ogadvganvhi gesv Galonedv Tsisa etsoiyusvi, ale detsigeyusv naniv unadanvti;
english: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏱ,
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodiha udugi itsvsv nasgi galvladi tsetsadvnvisdanelvi, nasgi gayula itsadvganvhi tsigi nahna gayegogi nigesvna osdv kanohedvyi,
english: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏂᎷᏤᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsilutselvhi tsigi, nasgiya nigvnadv elohi tsunilutselv; ale tsigananugowisga udatanvhi nasgiya tsinigalisdi nihi itsehvi, nvdagvwadalenvdv itsadvganv nasgi, ale udohiyuhi itsigadovsv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi;
english: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏤᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸ ᎡᎦᏆ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯᏃ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo tsetsadvganelv Egaqua otsigeyui itsulaha oginvsidasdi, nihino tsinvdigalisdodi osdv iyadvnehi Galonedv unvsidasdi.
english: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏲᎲᏁᎸᎯ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo gvnigesv iyohvnelvhi detsadagesv Adanvdo iyuwanisadv.
english: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏲᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎪᎵᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayv nasquo, ogadvganv nvdagvwadalenvdv, vtla yotsiyohisdisgo otsadadolisdisgv ale otsitayohihv nasgi adanvtesgv agadovhisdi gesv itsikaliisdiyi, nasgi nigav agadovhisdi gesv ale adanvdo ugvwali golitsidasdi gesvi;
english: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᏉᎬ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi itsalenidasdiyi nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi dinikahnawadegi iyunadvnedi gesvi, nigav osiyu uyelvdi gesvi, nasgi osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, utsati itsinanugowisgvi, ale kanequogv etsigadovsgv Unelanvhi;
english: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᎵᏂᎪᏍᎬᎢ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Detsalinigosgvi gvtanvhi utsati ulinigidv gesvi, nasgiya nulinigvgv galvquodiyu utseliga, nasgi nigavquo ugvwali ditsvnidiyu itsalisdodiyi, ale gohidiyu unelagi itselisgv itsigiliyogvi, ulitloyasdodiyi alihelisdi gesvi;
english: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎯ;
phonetic: Etsalielitsehv Agayvligei nasgi yeliquo igatloyasdodi igvwalisdodi igvnelvhi tsigi unatseli iyulisdodi gesv unadanvti igagadv anehi;
english: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏗᎩᎧᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Nasgi igudaledv tsigi ulinigidiyu gesv ulisigi, ale nasgi widigikanvhi tsigi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesv ugeyuhi Uwetsi;
english: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏨᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyuwanisadv egaguyvdv tsigi ugigv gvtanvhi, nasgi igisganvtsv egidolitsvi;
english: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏕᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi tsigi nusdv gvgowadvdi nigesvna Unelanvhi, nasgi igvyi udenvhi tsigi nigadiyu geganelanvhi anehvi.
english: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏂᏗᏱ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᎩ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏬᏢᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏙᏢᎾᏁᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nigav gohusdi tsuwotlvnvhi, nasgi galvladi tseha, ale elohi tseha, gvgowadvdi ale gvgowadvdi nigesvna tsigi, iyu unigvwiyuhi tsunidiyi yigi, ale unigvwiyusadegi yigi, ale getsilvquodi yigi, ale tsunalinigidv yigi; nigadiyu nudalesv nasgi duwotlvnei, ale uwasv dudadotlvnanelei;
english: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏁᎰᎢ ᎣᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏂᏏᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏤᎭ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi igvyi nehoi oni nigav tsudalenvdv, ale nasgi nigvnisiha nigav gohusdi tseha;
english: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ Ꭰ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏧᎴᎯᏌᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi usgoli a ayelv gesvi, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi; nasgi didalenvdisgi, tsudalenvtanvhi uyohusv tsulehisanvhi, nasgi nigadiyu nunadalesv igvyi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Osiyuyeno ayelvnvhi gese nasgi uwehi iyulisdodiyi nigav akaliihi gesvi;
english: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fullness dwell;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏙᎯᏱ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎤᎩᎬ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏨᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi agvdisgv uwasv dohiyi iyunvnediyi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, ugigv dadahnawasdv utsvnvhi uwohiyustanv; nasgi agvdisgvi, iyuno elohi anehi yigi, ale galvladi anehi yigi.
english: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏁᏣᏓᎴᏉ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸ,
phonetic: Nihino ilvhiyu netsadalequo tsigesei, ale etsisgagi tsigese doditsadanvdvi nasgi uyo detsilvwisdanehvi aseno gohi hnaquo itsohisdanelv,
english: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎬᎢ, ᏧᎬᏩᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᏧᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏥᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Uwvtanv ayelv uquedali gesv ayohusgvi, tsugvwale gvnigesv itsvnediyi nitsisganvna ale gohusdi netsuisdvna ale gayetsilawisedi nigesvna nasgi agatahvi;
english: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏉ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎦᏰᏨᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᏅᏋᏁᎸ;
phonetic: Iyuno yinvwasdidiquo itsohiyusvi, gagusdvnvhi ale asdayidvhi gesvi, ale iyvdv igayetsvnedi nigesvna yigi udugi itsvsv osdv kanohedvyi, nasgi itsadvganvhi tsigi, naniv geganelanvhi gesv gegalitsidonelvhi tsigi galvlo hawiniditlv nunadvnvi; nasgi nahna ayv Quola gohusdi Gadvnehi tsinvquvnelv;
english: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᎩᎵᏲᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏥᎧᎵᏏᏏ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏃᏒᎢ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Ayv nasgi gohi gesv tsigalieliga itsvgiliyotsehvi, ale tsitsikalisisi asi unosvi galonedv ugiliyotsv nasgiya agiquedalv tsigiliyogvi, nasgi ayelv tsinvdigalisdodiha, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv tsigi;
english: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏅᏋᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏁᏤᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏨᎩᏁᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Nahna ayv digilvwisdanehi nvquvnelv nasgiya Unelanvhi udanetsedi gesvi, nasgi ayv tsvginelv nihi itsalisdelvdodi, nasgi akalii aqualitsidodiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga;
english: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎡᏘ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi udelidv gvsgalanvhi tsigesvgi eti tsigesv ale unadanetliyvsvsv nvdagvwadalenvdv, aseno gohi tsigi gvnigesv tsinigegvnelv unadanvti tsutseliga;
english: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎤᏓᏅᏘ] ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ [ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ;] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎨᏨᏗ ᏥᏂᎬᏁ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi [udanvti] Unelanvhi udulisge gvnigesv itsuwanediyi nigav galvquodiyu gesv hia nasgi udelidv gesv tsunadalenvdv yvwi anehv [gvnigesv tsinuwanelv;] nasgi Galonedv tsigi nihi itsiyai, nasgi udugi getsvdi tsinigvne galvquodiyu digesv witsinanugoisdiyi.
english: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏃᏨᏁᎭ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏙᏤᏯᏔᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏙᏤᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏦᏨᏗᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏦᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi na gvnigesv tsinotsvneha, naniv tsidotseyatahvsga, ale naniv tsidotseyohvsga tsotsvdiha nigav alisinahisdodi gesvi, nasgi naniv gvnigesv itsotsvnediyi nunigolvna Galonedv Tsisa dunanelodvi;
english: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᏥᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo ugvwali tsidagilvwisdaneha, tsigatlinigvneha nasgiya tsulvwisdanedi gesvi, nasgi ulinigidiyu tsidulvwisdaneha diquadanvdvi.
english: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏆᎧᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Aquaduliyeno itsigadovhisdiyi nigav tsigiliyogv gatlinigvnehv nihi gesv iyusdi, ale nasgi na Leodisiya anehi, ale nanivquo unigohvhi nigesvna aquakadv ani uquedali gesvi;
english: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏂᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsuninawi ugalisdi digvwadanvdadisdi iyulisdodiyi dunadudadewisdv adageyudi gesvi, ale wuniyilohisdiyi nigav galvquodiyu gesv nudlasidvsvna gohiyudi gesv nasgi golisdi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, unigadovhisdiyi udelidv gesv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi Agayvlige utseliga, ale Galonedv utseliga;
english: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᏩᏍᎦᎳ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsidusquanigodi tsiduwasgala nigav utsati tsugvwalodi alisinahisdodi gesv ale agadovhisdi gesvi.
english: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᏪᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏥᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ.
phonetic: Ale hia nasgi nitsiweha nasgi gilo itsilonuhediyi nigesvna nasgi uwoduhi gawonihisdi gesv gvdi.
english: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎪᏁᎸᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎦᏂᎭ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Agigonelvsgininonv agiquedalv gesvi, aseno aquadanvdo gesv itsvyeladidoha, galieliga ale degaganiha osiyu nitsadvnehv, ale ulinigidiyu gesv etsoiyusv Galonedv.
english: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏤᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasgiya tsetsadanilvtsvhi gesv Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi, nasgiya nusdesdi etsisdawadisvi;
english: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏥᎿᎭᏍᏕᏜᏓᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ [ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ] ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nahna ditsihnasdedladvhi ale nahna etsanesgehvhi, ale ulinigidv iyetsvnelvhi itsohiyusvi, nasgiya etseyonvi, nasgi utsati gesesdi [itsohiyusvi] ulitloyasdesdi alihelitsedi gesv Unelanvhi.
english: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎾᏌᏂ, ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi tlesdi gilo tsitsinasani, asinasdv gawonihisdi gesv gvdi ale atlonuhedi gvdi, nasgiya yvwi danadeyohvsgvi, nasgiya elohi dilenvdodi dadeyohvsgvi, vtlano nasgiya Galonedv dadeyohvsgvi;
english: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᎠᏯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno [Galonedv] ayelvi ayaa nigadv akalii Unelanvhi.
english: For in him dwelleth all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale etsikalilvhi nasgi iyuwanisanvhi nasgi nugvwiyusadegi tsigi naniv nunigvwiyusadegi, ale digeganelodi gesvi;
english: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ ᏤᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo iyuwanisanvhi tsetsiusdeselvhi tsigi, ahusdesdi gvtanvhi nasgi gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwatanvhi nigesvna, nasgi iyvdv nitsvnehv ayeli nasgi uquedali gesv usganvistanvi itsvdisgv Galonedv utseli ahusdesdi gesvi;
english: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏂᏌᏅ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏕᏣᎴᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎦᎴᏔᏅᎢ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Etsinisanv nasgi atsinisanv didawosdi gesv gvtanvhi, nasgi nasquo gvtanvhi detsaletanv nasgi dagaletanvi nvtsulisdotanv itsohiyusv Unelanvhi dulvwisdanelvi, nasgi tsuletanvhi tsigi uyohusvi.
english: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏂᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏚᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏕᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎦᏰᏥᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Nihino ditsiyohusvhi nigesv utsatini nitsadvnelv itsadudalvi ale nidetsiusdeselvna gesv itsiquedalvi, ditsvnodv nitsvnelv nasgi gvnodv nagvnelvi, gayetsinelv nigadiyu utsatini nitsadvnelvi,
english: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᏪᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎲᏒᎩ, ᎤᏤᎵ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᏪᏯᎸᏅᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏚᏪᎭᏔᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Ayosdisgv gowelv dikahnawadvsdi igatludisgi, nasgi igiyosdodanehi tsigesvgi, ale uhvsvgi, utseli dadahnawasdv uweyalvnvgi yvwi duwehatanvgi;
english: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎾᏌᏅᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎢ, ᏓᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎨᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ] ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Dunasanvno nunigvwiyusadegi ale digeganelodi gesvi, gvnigesv dunanugowisei, dadalinehidegei nasgi [dadahnawasdv] gvdisgvi.
english: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᏅᏙ ᎠᏢᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi gilo yiditsugodanehesdi alisdayvdi ugvwali, ale aditasdi, ale galvquodi iga, ale itse nvdo atlvnegvi, ale dunadodaquasgv iga;
english: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi udawadisdodvquo gesvgi nasgi na tsudalenvdv uliyilohisdi gesvi; adawadisdodisgisgini Galonedv gesvgi.
english: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏥᏥᎷᏄᎮᎵ ᏥᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎵ ᎠᏌᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏌᎳᏁᎲ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎠᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo tsitsilunuheli tsitsiyosdodaneli asasdv etsinediyi udulisgv udadolisdi iyulisdodiyi, ale dinikahnawadidohi tsunadadolisdanediyi, nasgi ulisalanehv ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi, asequoquo adequvhisdisgv gvdisgv uquedali udanvtedi gesvi;
english: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏂᏴᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ, ᎾᎿᎭᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ ᏚᎯᏞᏫᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏩᏚᎾ ᏚᏪᏙᎸᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏙᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏚᏓᏕᏫᏐᎢ ᎠᏛᏍᎪᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏉᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale niduniyvsvna gesv Asgoli, nahna tsvdidalehvsga nigv ayelvi duhitlewisvi ale tsuwaduna duwedolvi ulisdelvdodoi, ale dududadewisoi advsgoi nasgiya Unelanvhi unequosgvi.
english: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᏤᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏙᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, iyuno Galonedv uyohusv ditsiyohusvhi gesesdi elohi ehi alenvdodi dideloquasdi ugvwali, gadono elohi tsitseho nasgiya dotsanelodi dikahnawadvsdi,
english: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏅᎯ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏒᏂᎸᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏗᎤᏅ ᏣᎬᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏱᏙᎸᎩ;
phonetic: Yvwi uninetsvhi ale tsunadeyonvhi?  nasgi tlesdi tsasvnilvgi; tlesdi usdiunv tsagvgi; tlesdi tsayidolvgi;
english: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏛᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᎲᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ;)
phonetic: (Nigadvyeno nasgi unalidvdodi gohusdi dehvdisgv iyui;)
english: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏤᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᏩᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎥᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsudalenvdv udohiyuhi alisinahisdodi gesv datselv, nasgi nahna owasv odanvtedv Unelanvhi adadolisdanedi gesvi, ale odadolisdi gesvi, ale nogasayasdvna gesv vyelvi, vtlano nasgi agalvquodisgvi, uquedali unigvsehv vwadvehvi.
english: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎰᏩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᎴᏅ ᏗᏣᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Iyuno howa Galonedv dulenv ditsalenvhi gesesdi, itsiyohesdi nasgi galvladi ehi gesvi, nahna Galonedv uwolv Unelanvhi agatisiditlv.
english: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsagasayasdesdi nasgi na galvladi ehi gesvi, vtlesdino elohi ehi gesvi.
english: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ, ᏕᏨᏅᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏪᎲ ᏚᏩᏍᎦᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ditsiyohusvhiyeno, detsvnvno galonedv wehv duwasgalv Unelanvhi.
english: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Galonedv galutsv iyui, nasgi gvnidv iginehi tsigi, hnaquo nasquo nihi itsinanugoisdi gesesdi nasgi itsehesdi galvquodiyu gesv itsanuwosdesdi.
english: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᏕᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏰᎸᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi detsihihesdi ditsiyelv detsadudadewisv ani elohi; nasgi udelidv dinisidi gesvi, gadaha gesvi, agvvhisdi gesvi, uyo adulvnvdi gesvi, ale tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi ayelvhi adadolisdanedi tsigi;
english: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv unilutseha unohiyuhisdv nigesvna yvwi.
english: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏤᏙᎲᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᏥᏤᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Nahna nasquo nihi ilvhiyu tsitsedohvgi, nahiyu nasgi nitsadvnehv tsitsehvgi.
english: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎭ; ᎠᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᎾᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏂᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Aseno gohi gesv nihi nasquo hia nigadv iyvdv nidetsvneha; atalawohisdi gesvi, kanalvisdi gesvi, adaniquadisdi gesvi, asotlvisdodi gesvi, uneilvdi gawonihisdi gesv ditsiholi nvdayunugotsvhi.
english: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏥᎪᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏴᏛᏰᏃ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Tlesdi yiditsadatsigonehesdi, iyvdvyeno iyetsvnelvhi uweti yvwi dulvwisdanehv gvwalitloyasdi;
english: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale itse yvwi itsanuwostanvhi, nasgi itse igvnelvhi tsigi nasgi agadovhisdi gesv ugvwali, nasgiya nusdv nasgi uwotlvnvhi gesvi;
english: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎪᎢ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏧᏏ, ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᏏᏗᏱ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnani vtla gilo Agoi yigi, ale Atsusi, atsiusdeselvhi ale atsiusdeselvhi nigesvna, nvwadale yvwi, Sidiyi ehi, atsinatlai ale natsinatlavna; Galonedvsgini nigav gohusdi nigalisda, ale nigadiyu diyai.
english: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏓ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, nasgiya iyunadvnedi Unelanvhi tsusuyedv gesvi, unadanvti ale getsigeyui, itsanuwosda uwedolisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi, ale adadolisdi gesvi, ale udadolisdi gesvi, udanvti gesvi, gohidiyu unelagi didadelisedi gesvi;
english: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏍᎦᏅᏤᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎾᏓᏕᎵᏎᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelagi detsadadelisehesdi, ale digetsadanehesdi detsadasganvtsehvi, iyuno gilo gohusdi yidanadadeliseha; nasgiya Galonedv gagetsinelv itsisganvtsvi, nasgiya nasquo nihi nasgi nitsadvnehesdi.
english: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᏓᏛᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Ale ho ugvwiyusesdi itsanuwosdesdi adageyudi gesvi, nasgi digudadvsgi tsigi nigalulogvna.
english: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏗᏢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadohiyadv Unelanvhi utseli ugvwiyusadegesdi ditsinawiyi, nahna iditlv nasquo etsiyanvdv tsigi nasgi saquo ayelv itsalisdodiyi; ale ulihelisdiyu itsadanvtesdi.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏕᏣᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Kanohedv Galonedv utseli utsati itsiyaesdi gananugowisgesdi nigav alisinahisdodi gesvi; detsadadeyohvsgesdi ale detsadawonedisgesdi detsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi dikanogisdodi, ale galvquododi dikanogisdi, ale adanvdo ugvwali dikanogisdi, detsinogisgesdi, ditsinawiyi didalehvsgesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsinogisgesdi etsalielitsehesdi.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᏙᎥ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nigav nitsadvnelidohvi, itsiwonisgv ale detsilvwisdanehv yigi, nigav Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa gadov itsvdisgesdi, etsalielitsehesdi Unelanvhi nasgi Agayvligei, nasgi nvdigalisdodisgesdi.
english: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigeyv, detsohiyusesdi itsvsv digetsiyehi nasgi itsvdvnediyi tsiduyugodi ugvwiyuhi detsigahnawadisvi.
english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ, ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsisgaya, detsigeyusesdi ditsadalii, ale tlesdi yiditsiniquatihesdi.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎲᎢ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli, detsohiyusesdi ditsigayvlii nigav nigetsiwesehvi; osiyuyeno uyelvdi Ugvwiyuhi nasgi hia.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᎿᎭᎸᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᏱᏩᎾᎵᎲᏲᎵᎵᎦᏉᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Itsigayvligei, tlesdi yiditsihnalvsdisgesdi ditsetsi, yiwanalihvyoliligaquoyeno.
english: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᎨᏥᏪᏎᎲ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᏥᏛᏓᏗᎧᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ, ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ:
phonetic: Etsinvsidasdi, detsohiyusesdi nigav nigetsiwesehv getsinvsidohi ani uquedali gesvi; vtla tsidvdadikano nasgiyai, yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi, osiyusgini itsiyelvhi gesesdi ditsinawiyi, etsinayesgesdi Unelanvhi:
english: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎰ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nigav gohusdi itsadvnehvi, ditsinawiyi osiyu itsiyelvhi detsilvwisdanehesdi Ugvwiyuhi tsinetsadvneho nasgiyai, vtlano yvwi tsinidetsadvnehoi;
english: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Itsanvtesdi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi itsinedi gesv etsaguyvdanedi itsatseli iyulisdodi gesvi; Ugvwiyuhiyeno galonedv gohusdi etsadvneha.
english: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilosgini utsatini iyadvnehi atsisdvdisdodi gesesdi nasgi utsatini nudvnelvi; vtlano gilo atsilvquododi yigesesdi.
english: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏕᏥᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsadanvsidohi, detsinehesdi ditsinvsidasdi duyugodv ale yeliquo gesvi; itsanvtesdi nihi nasquo Itsinvsidohi galvladi tsehvi.
english: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᎫᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Itsadadolisdisgv gvwagudidisesdi, ale nahna itsiyawisgesdi ulitloyasdesdi alihelisdi gesvi;
english: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᏍᏚᎩᎡᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᎦᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱ, ᎣᎩᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Alewo itsadadolisdisgesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi, nasgi Unelanvhi ogisdugiediyi galohisdiyi nahna ogalitsidodiyi, oginohediyi udelidv Galonedv utseliga, nasgi nasquo tsinvdigalisdodiha vqualvidv tsigi;
english: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏯᎩᏪᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv iyaquvnediyi, nasgiya tsiduyugodi iyagiwesdiyi.
english: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏁᎸ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎢᏧᏓᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsalisinahisdi itsedohesdi anigatahv nasgi na anelv nigesvna, itsudalesgesdi gohi gesv aliyilisvi.
english: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎲ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Itsalinohesgv nigohilv udanvti gesv ulitloyasdesdi, ama ulotsidv gesesdi, nasgi itsigadovhisdiyi itsiwesdiyi detsinetsehv naniv yvwi.
english: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏆᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᏗᎩᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Nigadv naquadvhnadegv Digiga gvnigesv nvdatsvneli, nasgi otsigeyui otsalinvtli, ale osdv iyadvnehi tsulvwisdanehi, ale utloyi atsinvsidasdi Ugvwiyuhi utseliga;
english: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏅᎵ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsinvli witsilutsediyi, nasgi nitsadvhnadegv udolehohisdiyi ugvwali, ale ditsigalisdadediyi ditsinawi ugvwali;
english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏁᏅᏍᏓ ᎣᏂᏏᎹ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎨᏨᏁᎵ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ ᎠᏂ.
phonetic: Anenvsda Onisima, osdv iyadvnehi ale otsigeyui otsalinvtli nasgi itsehv ehi tsigi, nasgi gvnigesv nvdagetsvneli nigadv nigalistanidohv ani.
english: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏗᏴᎩ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎹᎦ ᏆᏂᏆ ᎤᏙ ᎤᏪᏥ, (ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏫᏥᎷᏤᎸᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ;)
phonetic: Elisdaga itsulaha osdiyvgi, witsiyoliha, ale Maga Quaniqua udo uwetsi, (nasgi ugvwali itsadvganvhi tsigi; iyuno witsilutselvha detsadanilvtsvha;)
english: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏓ ᏣᎪᏎᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Ale Tsisa, nasgi Tsasda tsagosehoi; nasgi digetsiusdeselvhi tsigi.  Nasgi unvsv itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali, nasgi gvgigalisdadisgvgi.
english: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎦᏆ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎵᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎴᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Egaqua nasgi itsehv ehi tsigi, Galonedv unvsidohi, witsiyoliga, nigohilv alinigvneha adadolisdisgv nasgi nihi itsalediyi nitsigolvna ale akalii nigav Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏕᎵᎯᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏂᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎭᏱᎳᏆᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno tsiyoiyudaneha nasgi utsati itsadelihisdanehv nihi ale Leodisiya anehi, ale Hayilaquali anehi.
english: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎷᎦ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᎾᎦᏘ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹ.
phonetic: Luga atsigeyuhi aganagati witsiyoliga, ale Dima.
english: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎻᏆ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏁᎸ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᎦ.
phonetic: Detsiyolilvha idalinvtli Leodisiya anehi, ale Nimiqua, ale tsunanelodi nasgi ganelv tsunadatluga.
english: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ, ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎸᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎭ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi hia goweli itsigoliyevha, Leodisiya tsunanelodi unadatlugv nasquo unigoliyediyi nitsvnelvha; ale nasquo nihi itsigoliyevha Leodisiya nvdayulohisdi tsigi.
english: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏆ ᎯᎠ ᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ, ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏤᏣᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale Agiqua hia netsiweselvha, Tsagasayasdesdi digalvwisdanedi gesv Ugvwiyuhi ugvwali tsetsayohiselvhi, nasgi tsakaliisdiyi.
english: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfill it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎬᏗᎭ ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎥᏆᎸᎥᎢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ayv Quola aquvsv aquoyeni gvdiha witsvyoliha.  Itsanvtesdi vqualvvi.  Gvwagatiya adadolisdi gesv itseladidohesdi.  Emenv.
english: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Quola ale Sayila ale Dimadi witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Desiloniga nasgi etsohiyuhvsgi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv getseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Otsalielitseho Unelanvhi nigohilv nihi nitsiv nvdigalisdodisgoi, itsvneisdisgo otsadadolisdisgvi;
english: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏃᎬᎨᏫᏍᎬᎾ ᎣᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎡᏨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ;
phonetic: Nogvgewisgvna otsanvdadisgo detsilvwisdanehv itsohiyusv nvdayudalenvhi, ale itsalinigvnehv adageyudi gesv nvdayudalenvhi, ale ditsvnidiyu gesv udugi etsvsv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, Unelanvhi agatahv nasgi Igidoda;
english: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsotsigataha, idalinvtli Unelanvhi itsigeyuhi, etsasuyedv gesvi.
english: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᎧᏁᏨᎯᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᏃᎦᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Osdvyeno kanohedv ogatseliga vtla kanetsvhiquo gesv yitsiluhisdanelei, ulinigidiyusgini gesv nasquo tali udvdvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo, ale utsati nudlasidvsvna gesvi; nasgiya tsitsigataha nogasdv itsvyeladidolv nihi tsinvdagalisdodisgvgi.
english: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ [ᎡᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ,] ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏅᏓᏩᏓᎴᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Ale ayv sgisdawadegi nitsalistanvgi, ale Ugvwiyuhi [etsisdawadegi,] detsadanilvtsv kanohedv utsati itsigiliyogvi, ulitloyasdv ulihelisdi gesv galvquodiyu Adanvdo nvdawadalenvhi;
english: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsunatlilosdodi nitsalistanvgi naniv anohiyuhvsgi Masidoni anehi ale Egaya anehi.
english: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎵᏒᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎦᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᏭᎷᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏒ ᏚᏰᎵᏒ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno itsehv udalenvgi unoyvlisvgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga, vtla Masidoniquo ale Egaya uwasv yiwulutsei, nasquosgini nigav degesadisv Unelanvhi etsoiyusv duyelisv; nasgi iyusdi vtla ase gohusdi ogadvdi yigi.
english: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏒᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎬᏁᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ ᏕᏥᏲᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ, ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Unvsvyeno gvnigesv nigogvneha nusdv witsvlutselvi, ale nitsadvnelv Unelanvhi iditlv itsagatahvstanv detsiyosv Unelanvhi diyelvhi, ditsikahnawadvsdiyi gvnodv ale udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi tsigi;
english: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏕᎤᎴᏔᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎫᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale etsigatidisdiyi nasgi Uwetsi galvladi nvdayulohisdiyi, nasgi uyohusv tsideuletanei, nasgi Tsisa, nasgi tsigudalesv utalawohisdi uluhisdi tsigi.
english: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvsvyeno itsigataha, idalinvtli, nusdv witsvlutselvi, nasgi asequoquo nigesvna gesvi.
english: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏃᎩᎩᎵᏲᏦᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎩᏐᏢᏃᎢ ᏈᎵᎩᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᏃᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏛᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
