phonetic: Nasquosgini igvyi nogigiliyotsoi ale nigogisotlvnoi Quiligiyi, nasgi tsitsigataha, notsisgaihvna Oganelanvhi otsalisgasdodv itsvnohehelvgi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, tali udvdvgi utsati atlinigvnedi gesvi.
english: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏄᎮᏛ;
phonetic: Itsvwonetanvyeno vtla adalenasdisgi yigesei, vtla ale gadahai, vtla ale atlonuhedv;
english: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏧᏰᎸᏅ ᎣᎦᎨᏅᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏥᏁᎦ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini yeliquo tsuyelvnv ogagenvdisdiyi osdv kanohedv, nasgiya otsinega; vtla yvwiquo osiyu uniyelvdi, Unelanvhisgini nasgi digoliyesgi tsigi diginawi.
english: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎠᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᏲᏧᏢᏗᏍᎨ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ;
phonetic: Vtla ale otsiwonisgv ilvhiyu asequo adalvquododi gesv yotsvdisgei, nasgi tsitsigataha, vtla ale gohusdi yotsvdisge yotsutlvdisge tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesvi; Unelanvhi agatahi;
english: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎪᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏲᎩᏲᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏂᎯ ᏱᏨᏲᏎᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ; ᏰᎵᏉ ᎡᎦᏃ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏗᎦᏲᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yvwi gogilvquododiyi yogiyohei, vtla nihi yitsvyosehei, vtla ale nvwanadalei; yeliquo egano gagedv idigayotsvnedi gesvgi, Galonedv oginvsidv gesv iyusdi.
english: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏘᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏓᏍᏓᎢ ᏥᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Ogadanvtiyusgini gesvgi itsvyeladidohvi, nasgiya tsudasdai tsidasquanigodisgo tsuwetsi;
english: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᎦᏝᏴᏉ ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᎬᏒ ᏙᏨᏅᎢ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatino itsvgeyusv iyusdi, ogatlayvquo ditsvyohisediyi vtla osdv kanohedv uwasv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasquosgini ogvsv dotsvnvi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi itsvgeyuiyu gesvi.
english: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏅᏔᏉᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎸᎢ; ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗᏰᏃ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏃᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏲᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ, ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Itsanvtaquoyeno, idalinvtli, dogilvwisdanelv ale dogiyawetsidolvi; digvwagitsvdiyeno dogilvwisdanehv nogadulisgvna gesv iyusdi asiyvwi nitsadvnv gagedv iyotsvyvnediyi, itsvyalitsidonelvgi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎫᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎨᏙᎸ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎸ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ;
phonetic: Nihi itsigatahi nitsalisdiha, ale nasquo Unelanvhi, nigav nasganvna gesv ale duyugodv gesv, ale gaguhisdodi nigesvna gesv ogedolv itsvyeladidolv nihi itsohiyuhi;
english: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏰᏯᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎰ ᏧᏪᏥ,
phonetic: Nasgi tsitsigataha itsisiyvwiha nitsvweselv itsvwonetanv, ale itsvgalisdadv, ale itsvyeyatanvi, nasgiya agayvlige tsinidegaweseho tsuwetsi,
english: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᏙᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏤᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏫᏥᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nihi itsedohv Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi itselisdiyi, nasgi itsiyanvdv tsigi witsiluhisdiyi utseligohi ale utseli galvquodiyu digesvi.
english: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏃᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha notsiyohisdisgvna otsalielitseha Unelanvhi, nasgi iyuno detsadanilvtsv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, nasgi ayv sgiyadvganelvhi, vtla yvwiquo unatseli kanohedv iyusdi yiditsadanilvtsei, Unelanvhisgini utseli kanohedv, udohiyuhiya tsigi, nasgiya detsadanilvtsvgi, nasgi nasquo utsati tsidulvwisdaneha detsadanvdv nihi nasgi itsohiyunvhi.
english: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏕᏥᎩᎵᏲᏤᎸᎩ ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᎩᎵᏲᏤᎴ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ;
phonetic: Nihiyeno, idalinvtli, ditsisdawadegi nitsalistanvgi tsunanelodi dunadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga Tsudiyi anehi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa gvwohiyuhvsgi tsigi; nihiyeno nasquo utloyi detsigiliyotselvgi ditsatseliga yvwi, nasgiya nasgi tsidunigiliyotsele Anitsusi;
english: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏧᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎪᎦᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏂᎦᏘᎴᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo tsunilvgi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale anadolehosgi unvsv tsunatseliga, ale ayv gogadeyadotanvgi; ale vtla osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi yinanadvneha, ale naniv yvwi danigatilega;
english: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎩᏅᏍᏓᏕᎰᎢ ᏦᏥᏬᏁᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏂᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ.
phonetic: Goginvsdadehoi tsotsiwonedodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi, nasgi gagetsisdelvdi iyulisdodiyi, unikaliisdiyi nigohilv unisganvtsvi; utalawohisdisgini gesv wasdv iyvdv unilutselv.
english: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᎦ ᎣᎦᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅ ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎣᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎩ ᏕᏣᎧᏛ ᏦᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎣᎬᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini idalinvtli, tlega ogadadaletanv tsotsiyelvi, vtlano tsoginawiyi, utli igai ogatlinigvnelvgi detsakadv tsogigowadvdiyi, utsati adulvdi ogvtanvgi.
english: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏒᎩ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏆᏚᎸᎲᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎣᎩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ogadulisgvgi witsvlutsediyi, ale ayv, Quola, ho ugvwiyusvgi, saquo ale taline aquadulvhvgi; aseno Sedani ogiyosdodanehvgi.
english: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᎬᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎣᎦᎵᎮᎵᏍᏙᏗ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ?
phonetic: Gadoyeno udugi ogvha, ale gado osdv yigadanvdadiha, ale gado usdi alisdulo ogalihelisdodi?  Tlasgo nihi yigesesdi agatahv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nahiyu galutsvha?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏍᎩᏴᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno galvquodiyu isgiyvnehi ale sgiyalihelisdisgi.
english: For ye are our glory and joy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᎩᏰᎸᏅᎩ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᎩᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏗᏂᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi hnaquo utli igohidv gayogadvnidisdi nigesvna nulistanv, osiyu ogiyelvnvgi ogvsv ogikahiyasdiyi Ediniyi;
english: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏅᏒᎩ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎧᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
phonetic: Ale otsinvsvgi Dimadi, otsalinvtli, ale Unelanvhi gohusdi advnehi, ale ayv itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi osdv kanohedv Galonedv utseli ugvwali, nasgi ditsalinigohisdodiyi, ale ditsikalisdadisdiyi itsohiyusv ugvwali;
english: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gilo atsitelvdiyi nigesvna hia nasgi agiliyoisdi gesv iyuwanisadv; itsvsvyeno itsigataha nasgi igalisdanediyi eginetselvhi gesvi.
english: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᏂᏨᏃᏁᎶ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno tsitsvyeladidohvgi, nitsvnonelo igigiliyoisdi gesvi; nasgiya tsinulistanv, ale nasgi tsitsigataha.
english: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎬᏆᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᏗᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏓᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏳᏂᎪᎵᏰᎥ, ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᏃ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ, ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi, hnaquo utli igohidv gvquadvnidisdi nigesvna nulistanv, aquadanvsvgi aquadolehohisdiyi nusdv itsohiyusvi, gohusdi yvdiulisdotanv adagoliyesgi yunigoliyev, dogilvwisdanelvno asequo yinulistanidolv, aquelisvgi.
english: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏤᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏛᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo Dimadi ogilutselvhi tsigi, ditsehv nvdayulosvhi, ale osdv ayelvdi oginohehelvhi tsigi, itsohiyusv ale adageyudi gesv itsehv ugvwali, ale nigohilv osiyu sgiyanvdvi, utsati itsadulisgv sgigowadvdiyi, nasgiya nasquo ayv ogadulisgv itsvgowadvdiyi;
english: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᎸ ᎤᎧᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏓᏛᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎢ, ᏂᎯ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, itsvyadanvtelv ukalisdi ogadanvdadvgi nigav otsigiliyogv ale uwelihisdi ogadanvtawadegvi, nihi itsohiyusv nvdayulisdotanvgi.
english: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏰᏃ ᏥᎩ ᏦᏨᏃᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyeno tsigi tsotsvnodv, iyuno ulinigidv detsidogesdi Ugvwiyuhi detsanelodvi.
english: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᎪᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏲᏣᎫᏴᏓᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ilagoyeno igai alihelisdi yotsaguyvdasi Unelanvhi nihi gesv iyusdi, nvdigalisdodisgv nigav osdv adanvdadisdi gesv nasgi otsadanvdadisgv nihi gesv ugvwali ogatseli Unelanvhi agatahvi;
english: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏲᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᎧᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎧᎵᏏᏐᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎷᎶᏥᏙᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Digvwagitsvdi utsati otsadadolisdisgv otsitayohihv, nasgi digayogigowadvdi iyulisdodiyi detsakadvi, ale ogikalisisodiyi nasgi galulotsidohv itsohiyusvi.
english: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎣᎦᏘᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Unalanvhino uwasv nasgi Igidoda, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ogatinvsdi gesesdi ditsehvi.
english: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisodi gesesdi itsinequotsediyi ale utsati iyulisdodiyi detsadageyusvi, ale naniv detsigeyusvi, nasgiya ayv nihi itsvgeyusvi;
english: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsulinigohisdodiyi ditsinawi, nasgi gayetsuisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi duyugodv nitsadvnelv Unelanvhi agatahvi, nasgi Igidoda, nahiyu galutsvha igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv anehesdi nigadiyu unadanvti tsutseliga.
english: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎧᏁᏉᏥᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo, idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha, ale itsvsdiyediha, Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa nvdigalisdodiha, nasgi na sgiyadvganelvhi tsigi itsadvnediyi itsedasdiyi nasgi osiyu gvwayelvdi gesv Unelanvhi, nasgi nitsadvnehv kanequotsisesdiquo.
english: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏨᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigatahayeno nusdv detsvyohiselv dikahnawadvsdi Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa osiyu uyelvnvhi gesvi.
english: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᏗᏣᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi nusdi Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi, ditsadanvgalvdv itsalisdodiyi, nasgi ditsiyohisdiyi udelidv dinisidi gesvi;
english: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi nitsiv itsisiyvwiha yitsigataha itsadvnediyi itsisquanigododiyi itsiyelvi udanvgalvdv gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi;
english: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏃ ᎢᏤᎳᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ;
phonetic: Vtlano itselayohisdi gesvi, nasgiya nanadvnehv tsunadalenvdv yvwi Unelanvhi nanigatahvna tsigi;
english: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᏞᏤᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᏨᏃᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi gilo ulosvsdanediyi ale ulonuhediyi nigesvna analinvtli tsinigavquo gohusdi ugvwali; Ugvwiyuhiyeno ditletsehi hia nasgi nagav tsudalenvdv, nasgi gayula itsvnonelvhi ale itsvyoiyudanelvhi tsigi.
english: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏯᏅᎲ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigiyanvhv gadaha igalisdodiyi igadanvgalvdvsgini igalisdodiyi.
english: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏂᏉᏘᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo adaniquotihi, vtla yvwi yiganiquatiha, Unelanvhisgini, nasgi nasquo utseli Galvquodiyu Adanvdo iginelvhi tsigi.
english: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭰ-ᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᎾᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ; ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏤᏲᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Asgini analinvtli tsunadageyudi gesv ugvwali vtla udulvdi yinitsalisdaneha witsvyowelanediyi; itsvsvyeno Unelanvhi itseyonvhi igi ditsadageyudiyi.
english: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏕᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎹᏏᏙᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎢᎦᎢ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno nasgi nitsadvneha naniv detsigeyuha analinvtli Masidoni anehi; aseno itsvsdiyediha, idalinvtli, itsinequoisdiyi utlihiyu igai;
english: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏒ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Ale itsatlinigvnediyi nvwadohiyadv itsadediyi, ale itsvsv itsatseli digalvwisdanedi ditsilvwisdanediyi, ale itsvsv ditsoyeni ditsvdodiyi gohusdi itsadvnediyi, nasgiya nitsvweselvi;
english: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏ ᎬᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏥᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi osi gvyelvdi getsidasdi yigi anigatahv nasgi anela nigesvna, ale gohusdi nitsinigvsehvna yigi.
english: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎥᎾᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏄᏅᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno, idalinvtli, vtla nanigatavnaquo gesesdi yitsvyeliseha nasgi na unilinvtsvhi ugvwali, nasgi uyo itsadanvdadisdiyi nigesvna nasgi nvwanadale udugi nunvsvna nasgiya nunasdvi.
english: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏱᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yidohiyuhvsga Tsisa uyohusvi, ale dulehisanvi, nasgiya nasquo nasgi na Tsisa unalisgasdotanvhi unilinvtsvhi Unelanvhi tsutinohisdi gesesdi tsisa galutsvha.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎨᏗᎪᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nitsvweseha otsvdiha Ugvwiyuhi unetsvi, nasgi ayv didvnodv ale idalenidohi Ugvwiyuhi galutsv iyui vtla yidogedigonv nasgi na unilinvtsvhi.
english: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏛᏠᎠᏏᎵ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ;  ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏙᏛᎾᎴᏂ;
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhiyeno uwasv dvtloasili galvladi nvdayulosvhi ulitloyasdesdi unelugvi, ale nugvwiyusv dikahnawadidohi kanegvi, ale atselugi Unelanvhi utseliga unoyvgvi;  tsuniyohusvhino Galonedv unalisgadotanvhi igvyi dodvnaleni;
english: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᏫᏕᏓᏠᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᏕᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono ayv didvnodv ale idalenidohi nasgi itsulaha egatinawidvdi gesesdi ulogilvi, widedatloisdiyi Ugvwiyuhi galvloi; nasgino nigohilv Ugvwiyuhi itsulaha widehesdi.
english: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏪᏎᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi detsadagalisdadisdisgesdi hia nasgi tsidetsadawesehvi.
english: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nahiyusgini gesvi ale nahiyu degesadisvi, idalinvtli, vtla udulvdi yinitsalisdaneha itsvyowelanediyi.
english: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏥᎦᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎦᎷᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvsvyeno osiyu itsigata nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utseli iga uliyeilohisdi gesv nasgiya ganosgisgi svnoyi tsigalugoi.
english: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏄᏰᎶᎢᏍᏔᏅᏛ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᏧᎷᏤᎰ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎾᏗᏫᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno nvwadohiyadv ale nunayehisdvna anadisgesdi, hnaquo nuyeloistanvdv adadvdisgi unilutsedi gesesdi, nasgiya agiliya tsulutseho ageyv ganelidv; ale vtla unadiwisedi yigesesdi.
english: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏱᏤᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏣᏢᏔᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏧᏢᏔᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini, idalinvtli, vtla ulisigv yitseha, nasgi na nahiyu iga getsatlvtasdi iyulisdodiyi nasgiya ganosgisgi tsutlvtasgoi.
english: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥᎢ ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎥᏝ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎢᏕᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nitsivi igagati tsuwetsi, ale iga tsuwetsi; vtla svnoyi ale ulisigv idehi yigi.
english: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᎵᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ; ᎢᏗᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎩᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yidilihesdi, nasgiya anisoi nanadvnehvi; idiyawisgesdisgini ale nidigiyvsdesgvna gesesdi.
english: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎵᎯᏰᏃ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᏓᏂᎵᎰᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ, ᏒᏃᏱ ᏚᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Anilihiyeno, svnoyi danilihoi; ale nasgi na tsuniyvsdesgi, svnoyi duniyvsdesgoi.
english: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏕᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏂᏗᎩᏴᏍᏕᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏁᏣᏍᏚᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏁᏥᏍᏚᎶᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏚᎶᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayvsgini iga idehi tsigi nidigiyvsdesgvna gesesdi, adanetsasdulo gohiyudi gesv ale adageyudi gesv idadanetsisdulodisgesdi, egisdelvdiyino gesv udugi igvsv igalisdulodesdi.
english: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla yigasuyesv utalawohisdi gesv igilutsediyi; alisdelvdodisgini igiwadvdiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv;
english: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏱᏗᎵᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏗᎵᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏫᎦᏕᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsigiyohuhiselei, nasgi nasquo yidiliha ale nidilihvna yigi, nasgi itsulaha wigadediyi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏕᏣᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, detsadagalisdadisgesdi, ale detsadalinigohisdisgesdi, nasgiya tsinitsadvneha.
english: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ;
phonetic: Ale itsvtayoseha, idalinvtli, nasgi ditsigatahi iyulisdodiyi nasgi na tsunilvwisdanehi itsehvi, ale digetsanelodi tsigi Ugvwiyuhi detsanelodvi, ale tsigetsanvdadisdiha;
english: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎬᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale utsati ditsilvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi adageyudi gvdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi dunilvwisdanehvi.  Ale dohiyi nitsvnesdi itsvsv itsehvi.
english: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏕᏤᏯᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ, ᏕᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ [ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᎨᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ.]
phonetic: Ale itsvtayoseha, idalinvtli, detseyatahvsgesdi nasgi na nunanelvna, detsigalisdadisgesdi diwanagala tsunadanvti, detsiniyvsesdi diniwanagalai, ditsvnidiyu gesesdi naniv [utsatini nigetsadvnehvi.]
english: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏳᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏱᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏛᏗᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo uyo nagvnelv yutlegesdi uyo yinadadvnehesdi; itsisdawadegesdisgini nigohilv nasgi osdv gesvi, nasquo itsvsv gohusdi detsadadvdisgv, ale nanivquo.
english: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Itsaliheligesdi nigohilvi;
english: Rejoice evermore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nitsiyohisdisgvna itsadadolisdisgesdi;
english: Pray without ceasing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏕᎬ ᎡᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᎮᏍᏗ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ;] ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎮᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigavquo nitsalisdanelidegv etsalielitsehesdi [Unelanvhi;] hiayeno nasgi Unelanvhi itsadanvtehehv Tsisa Galonedv detsanelodv iyusdi.
english: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏴᏝᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Adanvdo adaweligisgv tlesdi yvtladisgesdi.
english: Quench not the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi asequo yitsiyelvsgesdi adolehohisdi gesvi.
english: Despise not prophesyings.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nudalesv gohusdi itsigoliyesgesdi; asdaya detsiniyvsesdi nasgi na osdv gesvi.
english: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ.
phonetic: Itsadanvehesdi nigav nudalesv uyoi.
english: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᏥᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏤᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᏚᏚᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎷᏨ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhino uwasv nvwadohiyadv adanehi nigalulogvna itsinvgalvdi gesesdi; ale nigv itsadanvtediyi ale ditsadanvdo ale ditsiyelvi tsetsisquanigodanedi gesesdi, niduduhisdvna itsalisdodiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv galutsv iyui.
english: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᏯᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏥᏅᏛᏛᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Nudalidasdvna nasgi na itsayanvdv, nasquo nasgi ase tsinvdvdvneli.
english: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli sgiyanvdadisgesdi itsadadolisdisgvi.
english: Brethren, pray for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nigadv analinvtli galvquodiyu didadowedovsdi detsiyolisdisgesdi.
english: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Itsvnetseha Ugvwiyuhi itsvneisdaneha, hia nasgi goweli getsigoliyediyi naniv unadanvti analinvtli.
english: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏉᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏱᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏣᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Quola, ale Sayila, ale Dimadi, witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi itsadatlugv Desiloniga itsehi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsanelodvi.
english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᎦᏚᏓᎳ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏣᏛᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎧᏁᏉᎦ;
phonetic: Ogadudala nigohilv otsalielitsediyi Unelanvhi nihi idalinvtli ugvwali, tsiduyugodi nasgi iyogadvnediyi, nvdigalisdodiha itsohiyusv utsati tsadvsga, ale detsadageyusv nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv utsati tsikanequoga;
english: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎬᏒ ᎣᏣᏢᏈᏍᎦ ᎢᏨᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayv ogvsv otsatlvquisga itsvneisdisgv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisv Unelanvhi tsutseliga, nasgi ditsvnidiyu gesv ale itsohiyu gesv nigav udeyadodi ale agiliya itsilutsehvi;
english: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏭᎪᏛᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎢᏤᎯ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏥᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv igvnehi tsigi Unelanvhi duyugodv tsuwugodvdi tsuwugododi gesvi, nasgi yeli Unelanvhi utseligohi itsehi etselisediyi, nasgi nasquo ugvwali tsitsigiliyoga.
english: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodiha duyugodvi Unelanvhi tsuguyvdanediyi agiliyoisdi gesv nasgi na getsigiliyoisdisgi;
english: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏃ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ,
phonetic: Nihino etsigiliyoisdisgi, atsawesolvsdodi gesv egaguyvdanediyi, nahiyu Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa galvlo nvdayudalenvhi gvnigesv nagvnelvha anehesdi tsunalinigidv tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi,
english: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Atsilv adaweligisgi unuwosdesdi dagiliyoisdisgesdi nasgi na nigvwagatahvna Unelanvhi, ale nunohiyusvna osdv kanohedv igatseli ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
english: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi getsisdvdisdodi gesesdi gegvdanedi winasdvna adadvdisgi ugvwiyuhi agatahv nvdayudalenvhi, ale galvquodiyu ulinigidiyu gesvi,
english: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᎩᏃᎮᎸ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyu tsutseli unadanvti gvwalvquododiyi ugvwali galutsvha, ale usquanigodi tsudanvdadisdodiyi naniv nasgi na gvwohiyuhvsgi nahiyu iga gesesdi, nvdigalisdodisgesdi gohiyunvhi gesv oginohelv itsehvi.
english: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo nigohilv otsadadolisdisgo itsvyanvdadisgo, nasgi Oganelanvhi udayanvdi gesv itsiyanvtanvhi iyulisdodiyi, ale usquadisdiyi nigadv osdv uyelvdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi udanvtiyu gesvi, ale gohiyudi gesv tsulvwisdanedi gvtanvhi ulinigidv gesvi;
english: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᏓᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyuwanisodiyi dudov igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Dalonedv galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi nihi itsvnisadv, ale nihi galvquodiyu iyetsvnediyi nasgi iyuwanisadv, nasgiya nusdv gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Iganelanvhi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏪᏓᏓᏟᏌᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
phonetic: Nasgino, idalinvtli, itsvtayoseha uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale nasgi wedadatlisanedi gesv ugvwali,
english: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎩᏉ ᏤᏥᏖᎸᎾᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏬᏂᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏓᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏕᏅ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tlegiquo tsetsitelvnadiyi nigesvna detsadanvdvi, ale itsadeyatanediyi nigesvna, nasquo adanvdo gvdi, ale gawonisvhi, ale goweli gowelanvhi gvdi ayv ogadanvsidv tsigeso iyusdi; nasgi Galonedv utseli iga usqualvhidenv tsigeso nasgiyai.
english: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ [ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ] ᎬᏂ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᏂᏑᎵᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ;
phonetic: Ase tlesdi gilo yitsilidastanesdi; vtlayeno [nahiyu iga uliyeilohisdi yigi] gvni igvyi anisuligogesdi, ale nasgi na asgaya asgana tsulvwisdanehi gvnigesv nagvnelvha, nasgi advdisgi uwetsi;
english: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎦᏘᎴᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᏥᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏬᎳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsidagatilega ale galvladitlv tsinadadvneha nigav Unelanvhi gegosedi tsigi, ale gegadadolisdanehi tsigi; nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi nasgiya uwola Unelanvhi utseli adanelvi, uwasv gvnigesv nadadvneha Unelanvhi gesvi.
english: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏣᏅᏔ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎸᎢ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yitsanvta, nasgi asi tsitsvyeladidohvgi nasgi hia itsvnohehelvi?
english: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohino tsigi idigataha iyusdi ayosdodisgv gvnigesv iyagvnediyi nahiyu gvnigesv iyagvnedi gesvi.
english: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏥᎧᎲᏒᎭ.
phonetic: Udelidvyeno asgana gayula dulvwisdaneha; gohisgini gesv ayosdodisgi tsigi uyosdodanehesdi gvni atsikahvsvha.
english: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏰᎬᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏨᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏛᏛᏔᏂ ᏓᎬᏔᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎲ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ;
phonetic: Nahiyuno nasgi na asgana gvnigesv nvdayegvneli, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsvdvdvtani adanvdo aholi nvdayudalenvhi gvdi, ale tsvdvdvtani dagvtani gvnigesv nagvnehv nahiyu galutsvha;
english: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi na uluhisdi gesv nasgiya Sedani tsulvwisdanedi dulvwisdanehesdi gvdisgesdi utsati ulinigidv gesvi, ale usquanigodi ale gayegogi uyelvdvi,
english: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale gvdisgesdi utsati udalidasdi niduyugodvna gesv anehv nasgi getsidvdodi gesvi; nvdigalisdodisgv nidunadanilvtsvna gesv duyugodv ageyudi gesvi, nasgi gagetsisdelvdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi udanvsdi gesesdi unilutsediyi ulinigidv unilonuhesgi nasgi iyuwanisodi unohiyudiyi gayegogi gesvi;
english: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: nasgi digvwanadugodanedi iyulisdodiyi naniv nasgi na nanohiyuhvsgvna duyugodv gesvi, niduyugodvnasgini gesv anohiyuhvsgi.
english: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᎳ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏑᏰᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno ogadudala nigohilv otsalielitsediyi Unelanvhi nihi gesv ugvwali, idalinvtli Ugvwiyuhi itsigeyuhi, nvdigalisdodiha Unelanvhi tsudalenvhv nvdagvwadalenvdv itsasuyesv etsisdelvdiyi gvdodiyi Adanvdo itsinvgalisgvi, ale itsohiyusv udohiyuhi gesvi;
english: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏕᏲᎧᏅ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏥᏯᏅᏔᏅ, ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nahna tsideyokanv osdv kanohedv ogatseli tsitsiyanvtanv, itsiwadvdiyi galvquodiyu gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
english: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎡᏤᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᏒᎯᏉ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, ulinigidv detsidogesdi, ale detsiniyvsesdi dideyodi gesv nasgi nusdv etseyonvi, nasquo gawonisvhiquo yigi, ale witsvyowelanelvhi yigi.
english: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏓᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv uwasv, ale Unelanvhi, nasgi Igidoda, nasgi igigeyuhiyu tsigesvgi, ale tsiginelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna adagalisdadisgi, ale osdv udugi gvdi gesv nvdayudalenvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi ditsigalisdadedi gesesdi ditsinawi, ale ditsalinigohisdodi gesesdi nigav osdv gesv itsiwonihisdiyi ale ditsilvwisdanediyi.
english: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino gesvi, idalinvtli, itsadadolisdisgesdi ayv sgiyanvdadisgesdi, nasgi kanohedv Ugvwiyuhi utseliga uyelihisdiyi, ale galvquodiyu iyulisdodiyi, nasgiya tsinusdi nihi itsehvi;
english: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏣᏚᏓᎳᎡᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi tsotsadudalaediyi uniyo ale anisgana anisgaya; vtlayeno naniv gohiyudi gesv yuneha.
english: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᏓᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᎵᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎵ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhisgini nudalidasdvna, nasgi tsvdatsalinigohistani, ale tsvlitsiyosdodaneli uyo itsadvnediyi.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale otsalisgasdodi Ugvwiyuhi nihi gesv ugvwali, nasgi nitsadvnehvi, ale ase nasgi itsadvnedi gesv nusdv itsvnetsehvi.
english: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏎᎮᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi tsusehedi gesesdi ditsinawi etsigeyui iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi, ale ditsvnidiyu iyulisdodiyi Galonedv nasgiyai.
english: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎣᏨᏗᎭ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏓᎴᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎪᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸᎯ,
phonetic: Hnaquono itsvnetseha, idalinvtli, otsvdiha dudov igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi ditsadadaledanediyi naniv analinvtli utsatini iyanadvnelidohi, ale nidanikahnawadegvna dideyodi gesv ayv digogadanilvtselvhi,
english: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏱᏃᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎮ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Iyusvyeno itsigataha itsadvnediyi sgisdawadvsdiyi; vtlayeno utsatini yinotsadvnelidohe itsvyeladidohvi;
english: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏲᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᎮᎢ; ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏙᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎲᎩ ᎬᏩᎩᏨᏗ, ᏃᎦᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᏲᏨᏴᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo asequo yotsalisdayvnanehei; dogilvwisdanehvgisgini ale dogiyawetsidohvgi gvwagitsvdi, nogadulisgvna gesv iyusdi ayv asiyvwi nitsadvnv gagedv iyotsvyvnediyi;
english: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏃᎩᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ [ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ] ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᏗᏣᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏃᏣᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla nogihvna gesv [nvwadale iyogadvnediyi] yinvdigalisdodisgei, ditsatlilosdodisgini notsadadvnehv ayv sgisdawadvsdiyi nvdagalisdodisgvgi.
english: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏥᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎲᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno tsitsvyeladidohvgi, hia nasgi nusdvgi itsvnetselvgi, nasgi iyuno gilo nudulisgvna yigi, tsulvwisdanediyi nasquo ulisdayvdiyi nigesvna gesvi.
english: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏣᏛᎩᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎯ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Otsadvgihayeno nasgi gilo getsadasuyv utsatini nanadvnelidohvi, gohusdi nanadvnehvna, aseno anadvnelidohi igi.
english: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏙᏥᏁᏤᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᏙᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯᏉ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyunasdi gesvi, dotsinetseha ale dotsisdiyediha dotsineisdaneha igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi dohiquo tsunilvwisdanediyi, ale unvsv unatseli alisdayvdi unalisdayvdodiyi.
english: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏪᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini, idalinvtli, tlesdi yiditsiyawegesdi osdv detsilvwisdanehvi.
english: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏂ ᎣᏦᏪᎵᏍᎬᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nigohiyuhvsgvna igesesdi otsiwonisgv ani otsowelisgvi, gvnigesv netsvnelvha nasgi, ale tlesdi itsulaha itsedolvgi, nasgi gvwadehohisdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᎦᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏰᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎡᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Adina tlesdi etsisgagi iyusdi yetsadanvtesgesdi, etsigvsgolvvsgesdisgini itsadanvtli nasgiyai.
english: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏪᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhino nvwadohiyadv uwehi uwasv ase itsinedi gesesdi nvwadohiyadv nigohilvi.  Ugvwiyuhi nitsiv detsikahnadidohesdi.
english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏆᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏁᎰ ᎪᏪᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ayv Quola aquadayolisdi gesv aquvsv aquoyeni aquvtanvhi aquowelanvhi, nasgi digolisdodi tsigi nigadv goweli; nasgiya nigvneho gowelisgoi.
english: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎬᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ,
phonetic: Ayv Quola Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv gvginetselvhi Unelanvhi igisdelisgi ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv nasgi udugi gvdi gesv igatseliga,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏘᎹᏗ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏊᏥ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: wigvyowelasi Timadi aquvsv aquatseli aquutsi gohiyudi gesv iyuwanisadv; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale udadolitsadv gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsakahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga.
english: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᏥᎬᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ ᏣᏗᎩᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏈᏌ, ᎹᏏᏙᏁ ᏥᏩᎩᎶᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᏅᏍᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ,
phonetic: Nano tsigvtayoselvgi tsadigiyasdiyi Equisa, Masidone tsiwagilosvgi, nasgi tinvsdadediyi gilo danadeyohvsgv utsatini iyuniwesdiyi nigesvna,
english: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏉ ᏥᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᎭ ᎥᏲᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏛᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ, [ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎸᎭ.]
phonetic: Ale unadvdasdodiyi nigesvna asequo gawonihisdi gesv ale winasdvna kanohedi gesv unadanetliyvsvsvi, nasgi gawonihisdiquo tsiwaliyilohiha vyono unelanvhi dineladodi gesv udvhisdiyi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga, [nasgi hnadvnelvha.]
english: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᎾᏫ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdi adageyudi gesv ugvwala nasgi gadaha nigesvna onawi nvdayudalenvhi, ale osdv digugododi gesv ale nutlonasdvna gohiyudi gesvi;
english: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎩᎶ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏭᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏔᏅ;
phonetic: Nasgi nahna gilo unagolvdv tsigi, nulisalodvna gawonihisdi gesv wunagatahvstanv;
english: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏃᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏃᎵᎬᎾ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unadulisgvgi dikahnawadvsdi dinosisisgi iyunalisdodiyi, aseno nanoligvna nusdv aniwonisgv, ale nusdv anisdayidisgvi.
english: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ,
phonetic: Aseno idigataha dikahnawadvsdi osiyu gesv, iyuno gilo udohiyuhiya yidakahnawadega,
english: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏂᏆᏘᎯ, ᏧᏂᏙᏓ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏥ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ, ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎯᎯ,
phonetic: Hia nasquo yagataha, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi udanvti yvwi agotlvnanelvhi nigesvna gesvi, dikahnawadvsdisgini nidunanelodvna, ale nunohiyusvna, unelanvhi nidunanelodvna, ale anisganai, anigadahai, ale osdv gesv aniniquatihi, tsunidoda dinihihi ale tsunitsi dinihihi, yvwi dinihihi,
english: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ, ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᎾᏎᎵᏛᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Uninegutsidv, anisgaya dinanisihvsgi, yvwi dininosgisgi, aniyegogi, gayegogi anaselidvsgi, ale nasquo nigav gohusdi nasgi digatilegi osdv dideyodi gesvi;
english: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nusdv galvquodiyu osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi nvwadohiyadv ehi utseliga; nasgi ayv vquasvgalotanvhi tsigi.
english: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏣᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏣᏇᎵᏎᎸ, ᏣᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ale tsiyalielitseha Galonedv Tsisa Ugvwiyuhi igatseli tsaqualinigohistanv, yeliquo igvwadvnedi tsaqueliselv, tsaginetselv digilvwisdanediyi alitsidodi gesvi,
english: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏂᏐᏢᏗ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏉᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏆᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ayv nasgi ilvhiyu tsisotlvdisgi tsigesvgi, ale uyo idigvnehi, ale diganisotlvdi; aseno vgidolitsvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi nitsigatahnavna gesvi, ale naquohiyusvna gesv nasgi naquadvnelvi.
english: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏥᏲᎢᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga utsatanvhi equohiyu gesvgi, ulitloyasdvgi Galonedv Tsisa tsiyoiyudi gesv ale tsigeyui, iyulisdodi gesvi.
english: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ, ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᎸ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎩᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya hia nasgi igawedv, ale wasdv tsudanilvisdiyu, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa elohi ulutsvi, dusdelvhilv anisganai, ayv nasgi nagigvwiyusv tsisganai.
english: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎥᎩᏙᎵᏨᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎩᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏂ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏫᏚᎷᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgi hia nvdayulisdotanvgi vgidolitsvgi; nasgi ayv gesv nagigvwiyusv Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv iyuwanediyi wasdv gvnidiyu gesvi, nasgi tsunatlilosdodi iyulisdodiyi oni gvwohiyunvhi gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna widulugi.
english: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ka, Ugvwiyuhi alisquadisgi nigesvna gesv ehi, ayohusgi nigesvna, agowadvdi nigesvna, uwasvhi agatahnai Unelanvhi, galvquodiyu gesesdi ale galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi; Emenv.
english: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᏕᎬᏲᎯᏏ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏗᎹᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏣᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᎲᏗᏍᎬ ᏯᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hia nasgi digalvwisdanedi gesv nihi degvyohisi, aquetsi Dimadi, nasgiya nuniwesv unadolehosv nihi getsanohesgvi, nasgino nihi nasgina dehvdisgv yaliga osdv alisdi gesvi;
english: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest wage a good warfare;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏂᏲᏥᏙᎸ;
phonetic: Detsaniyvsv gohiyudi gesvi, ale osdv digugododi gesvi, nasgi gilo iyvdv iyunvnetanvhi tsigi, nasgi gohiyudi gesv gvwaniyotsidolv;
english: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎭᎻᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎵᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎦᏥᏲᏒ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nunadvnelv Haminiya ale Eligi, nasgi degatsiyosv Sedani detsiyohiselv unadeloquasdiyi unisotlvdodiyi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏗᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ,
phonetic: Nasgino tsinega igvyiyiquo gesvi, atayosdi gesvi, adadolisdodi gesvi, dinvdadisdi gesvi, ale alihelisdi gesv digalvwisdanediyi, nasgi naniv yvwi ugvwali,
english: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᎦᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᏕᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unigvwiyuhi ale naniv ayeli tsunilvwisdanehi ugvwali, nasgi nvwadohiyadv ale nunayehisdvna igalenidasdiyi, dedikahnawadisv duyugodv gesv ale galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᏓᎧᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia osiyu ale tsudanilvisdiyu dakanv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi,
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi osiyu uyelvdi tsigi naniv yvwi getsisdelvdiyi, ale uniluhisdiyi agadovhisdi gesv duyugodv gesvi.
english: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᏗᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏗᎴᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Saquoquoyeno eha Unelanvhi, ale saquo digohisdisgi ayeli dilenehi Unelanvhi ale yvwi, nasgi na yvwi Tsisa Galonedv;
english: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏓᏲᏎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏥᏚᎫᏴᎮ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi tsidudayose uwasv tsiduguyvhe nanivi, gvnigesv igvnedi aselvhi gesv nahiyui,
english: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎦᏥᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎬᏗᏍᎬᎾ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏥᏁᎦ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia ayv vginetselvhi galitsidohvsgi ale vginvsidv, tsunadalenvdv yvwi digatsiyeyohvsgi galonuhedv ale gayegogi nigvdisgvna; udohiyuhiya tsinega Galonedv agatahvi, vtla yigatsigovsga.
english: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏱ, ᏧᏂᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ ᏄᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgino aquaduliha anisgaya nigav degesadisv unadadolisdoyi, tsunisaladodiyi digadaha nigesvna tsunoyeni nunitalawosgvna ale nunadlasidvehvna.
english: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏓᎾᏣᎤᏍᎬ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏓᎾᏄᏬᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏓᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎥᏝᏍᏗᏃ ᏓᏂᏍᏕᏲᎲ ᏚᏂᏍᏘᏰᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏱᏓᎾᏣᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Ale nasgiya nasquo anigeyv danatsausgv utlvquodi nigesvna dananuwosgesdi, unadanayehisdi ale unalisinahisdi gesesdi; vtlasdino danisdeyohv dunistiyegvi, ale adelv dalonige, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, ale utsati tsugvwalodi dinuwo yidanatsanvdisgesdi;
english: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎾᏣᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏧᏂᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Osdvsgini digalvwisdanedi gesv danatsanvdisgesdi, nasgi tsunanelodi anigeyv tsunililohvsga.
english: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎡᎳᏪᏱ ᎠᏕᎶᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale ageyv elaweyi adeloquasgesdi utsati uwohiyuhiyu gesesdi.
english: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏱᏥᏰᎵᏎ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Vtlasgini unelagi yitsiyelise ageyv tsudeyodiyi ale udalinehidediyi asgaya, elaweyiquosgini uwadiyi.
english: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏫᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎠᎪᏢᏁᎢ, ᎩᎳᏃ ᎢᏫ.
phonetic: Adawiyeno igvyi agotlvnei, gilano Iwi.
english: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏫ ᏯᏥᎶᏄᎡᎴᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎶᏄᎡᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno Adawi yatsilonuelei, ageyvsgini atsilonuelv usganvtsei.
english: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏕᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv atsisdelvdi igesesdi diniyoli degananugowisgvi, iyuno danikahnawadisesdi gohiyudi gesv, ale adageyudi gesvi, ale duyugodv gesvi, ale alisinahisdodi gesvi.
english: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᏝᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya igawedv; Iyuno gilo udutlasgesdi atsigatidisdi iyulisdodiyi, osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv udulisgesdi.
english: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎨᏯᏔᎯ, ᎤᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᏧᏓᏓᏂᎸᏣᏘ, ᏗᎬᏩᏕᏲᏗ;
phonetic: Atsigatidisdi adina ase gohusdi nasganvna gesesdi, saquoquo adayehesdi, geyatahi, ulisinahisdi, osdv tsulvwisdanehi, tsudadanilvtsati, digvwadeyodi;
english: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏗᏓᏛᏂᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ, ᏧᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᏧᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gigageaditasdi uganasisgi nigesvna, didadvnihi nigesvna, tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi nigesvna, udanvtisgini, tsutiyosati nigesvna, adelv tsugeyuhi nigesvna.
english: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Uwasv dudatihnav osdv dikahnawadidohi, tsuwetsi gvwohiyuhiyu ale gvwalvquodiyu igvnehi.
english: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ?
phonetic: Iyuyeno gilo nagatahvna yigi uwasv dudatihnav osdv tsukahnawadidasdiyi, gado yigalisdoda yidagasayasda tsunanelohi unadatlugv Unelanvhi utseliga?
english: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎳᎢ ᎤᎵᎪᏃᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏢᏉᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎵᏌᎳᏙᏓ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏚᏚᎪᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏚᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale vtlesdi gilai uligononvhi yigesesdi, atlvquododiyeno gesv yalisaladoda nasgino usganvtsvhi gesv yidudugodasi nasgiya asgina dudugodanelvi.
english: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏅᎫᏛᎢ, ᎤᏐᏅᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏌᏛ ᏳᏪᎯ.
phonetic: Alewo osiyu gvwanohesgi yigi iyvdv unvgudvi, usonvyeno atsinohesgi yinvgalisda, ale asgina usadv yuwehi.
english: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo aniyadohihi getsilvquodi gesesdi, vtlesdi tsudalenvdv iyaniwesgi yigesesdi, ale vtlesdi yigageaditasdi uniganasisgi yigesesdi, tlesdi tsugvwalodi unigvvsgi yigesesdi;
english: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᏂᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Duniniyvsesdisgini udelidv gohiyudi gesvi anvdisgesdi gadaha nigesvna digugododi gesvi.
english: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏗᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎩᎳ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎨᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia igvyi digoliyevhi gesesdi, gila dunilvwisdanehesdi aniyadohihv gohusdi gageguisdodi nigesvna gesesdi.
english: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasquono tsunadalii getsilvquodi gesesdi, usonv anadanohelidohi nigesvna, aneyatahisgini gesesdi, yeligaya iyanadvnehi nigav gohusdi.
english: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᏌᏉᎭ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ayadohihi saquoha adayehesdi, osdv dikahnawadidohi tsuwetsi ale uwasv dudatihnavi.
english: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᏂᏩᏛᏗᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᎦᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᎾᏰᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno osdv tsunilvwisdanehi gesv aniyadohihvi, aniwadvdiha osdv gegadanvtediyi, ale utsati nunayehisdvna adanvdadisdiyi gohiyudi gesv Galonedv Tsisa.
english: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgi hia tsudalenvdv wigvyowelasi, ale udugi aquvha nigohilvnaquo wigvlutsediyi;
english: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᏉᎯᏤᎵᏙᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏥᎩ, ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏱᏙ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgininonv aquohitselidolvha nasgi tsadolehohisdiyi itsadvnediyi ditsalvwisdanediyi Unelanvhi utseli adanelvi, nasgi tsunanelodi unadatlugv gvnidv Unelanvhi utseli tsigi, gagusdvdi ale ulisdayido tsigi duyuhidv gesvi.
english: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏬᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᎮᎢ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎪᎢᏳᏁᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏓᎦᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nudlasidvsvna usquanigodiyu udelidv unelanvhi dinelodi gesvi; Unelanvhi gvnigesv nagvnele uwodali gesvi, nutlonasdvna gvnigesv nuwanele Adanvdo, dinikahnawadidohi gvwagohei, tsunadalenvdv yvwi gegalitsidonele nasgi atsinohesgei, ani elohi agoiyunei, galvquodiyu digesv widagadanilvtsei.
english: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏓᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ,
phonetic: Aseno Adanvdo kanegv gvnigesviyu nigvneha ulisqualvdi gesesdi gilo tsuniyohisdiyi gohiyudi gesvi, danadvdasdanehesdi unatlonasdi didanvdo, ale danadeyohvsgi anisgina,
english: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Unatlonasdv gayegogi aniwonisgesdi, dunadanvdv digaleyvtanvhi talugisgi udilegi gvtanvhi;
english: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏅᏍᏙᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏁᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏗᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯᏉ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uninvsdosgesdi ditsvsdiyi, aninegesdi gohusdi iyusdi alisdayvdi diyohisdiyi nasgi Unelanvhi uwotlvnvhi tsigi ulihelitsvhiquo tsunadanilvisdiyi anohiyuhvsgi ale unigadovsvhi tsigi duyugodvi.
english: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎢᏎᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏛᏓᏂᎸᎦ;
phonetic: Nigavyeno gohusdi Unelanvhi uwetlvnvhi gesv osiyu, ale vtla gohusdi ayoisedi yigi, iyuno ulihelisdi odanvdv yidvdanilvga;
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏓᎭᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gadahayeno nigesvna igvnelvhi gvtanvhi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale adadolisdodi gesvi.
english: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ, ᎰᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎡᏤᎳᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᏣᏂᏴᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Iyuno analinvtli hia nasgi yigiyanvdadistanv, hosdv gesesdi etsanvsidasdi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga, etselastanvhi gesesdi kanohedv gohiyudi gesv tsikanoheha, ale osdv dideyodi gesvi, nasgi gayula ditsaniyvdv tsigi.
english: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏲᎢᏎᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Detsayoisehesdisgini gawetlvdi gesv gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna ale anigayvlige uninohelvdi tsigi; ale tsalvwisdanehesdi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesvi.
english: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎸᎢᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏅ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayelviyeno ugvwali digalvwisdanedi gesv usdigiyu adasdeliha; Unelanvhisgini dinelododi gesv nigav gohusdi ugvwali gvwadasdelvdi, nasgiyeno aduisdi atsinediyi gvnv gohi tsigi, ale nasgi uliyilohisdi gesvi.
english: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᏍᏛ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya igawedv, ale wasdv tsudanilvisdiyu;
english: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎩᏐᏢᏗᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎡᏓᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyusdi degilvwisdaneha ale gayegisotlvdiha nvdigalisdodi edalisgasdodv gvnidv Unelanvhi, nasgi Disdelisgi tsigi naniv yvwi, nasgi ho ugvwiyuha nasgi na anohiyuhvsgi.
english: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdesdi hinegesdi ale dehadeyohvsgesdi.
english: These things command and teach.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᏐᏅᏤᎴᏏᏗ ᎯᏫᏂᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎨᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ, ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᎡᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo yusonvtselesidi hiwiniyu gesvi; gagetsadeloquaedisgini gesesdi anohiyuhvsgi, hiwonisgvi ale nitsadvhnadegvi, ale tsadageyuei, ale tsadanvtediyi, ale tsohiyusvi, ale gadaha nigesvna gesvi.
english: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᏯᏍᏘ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏕᎯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Witsilutsvha iyasti detsalvwisdanehesdi goweli dehigoliyesgvi, ale dehiwonedisgvi, ale dehadeyohvsgvi.
english: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏤᎵᏒᎩ ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏣᏏᏔᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi unelagi tselisvgi etsanelvhi nasgi tsitsaha, nasgi etsanelvhi tsigi anvdisgv unadolehosv ale degetsasitadv digeganelodi.
english: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏣᏁᏉᏤᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi dehadanvtesgesdi, nasgiquo detsalvwisdanehesdi, nasgino tsanequotsehv gvnigesv nunalisdanehesdi nigadv.
english: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲ ᏨᏒ ᏔᏓᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏙᏘᏍᏕᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Tsadagasayasdesdi tsvsv ale nusdv dehadeyohvsgii, nasgi dehisdawadisesdi; nasgiyeno hnadvnehv tsvsv tadasdelvhi ale nasquo nasgi na getsadvdasdanehi dotisdelvhi.
english: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏂᏫᏅᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ,
phonetic: Udvsonvhi tlesdi yigvsgolvnesdi, hisdiyedisgesdisgini agayvlige nasgiyai, aniwinvno itsadanvtli nasgiyai,
english: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎦᏴᎵᎨᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᏣᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏃ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏤᏣᏙ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ.
phonetic: Anagayvligeno anigeyv ditsatsi nasgiyai, aniwinvgeno anigeyv tsetsado nasgiyai, usonv nudasuyvna.
english: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Dehilvquodesdi tsunosulotsvhi, iyuno udohiyusv tsunosulotsvhi yigi.
english: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎵᏏ ᏯᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᏙᏧᏁᏅᏒ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gilo uwosulotsvhi tsuwetsi ale tsulisi yaneha, nasgi anadeloquasgesdi tsunilvquododiyi dotsunenvsv anehi, ale tsunaguyvediyi tsunigayvligei; nasgiyeno osiyu, ale tsudanilvisdiyu Unelanvhi agatahvi.
english: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏐ ᎠᏔᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏚᎵᏏᏂᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na udohiyuhi uwosulotsvhi tsigesoi, ale uwasvhiyu tsigesoi, Unelanvhi alisgasdodisgoi, ale dakahnawadiso atayosdi gesv ale adadolisdodi gesv nidulisinisv ale nidugitsvnisvi.
english: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏁᎸᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na nunelvna ehi uyohusvhi geso asiquo alenidohvi.
english: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏁᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎨᎫᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nusdesdi hinegesdi, nasgi gageguisdodi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏓᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏱᎸ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ Ꮎ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Iyusginino gilo nidadvnvisdanehvna igesesdi uwasv tsutseliga, ale nasgi ho ugvwiyuha uwasv dudatihnavi, nasgi udayilv gohiyudi gesvi, ale utli uyoiyu esgaquo na nuwohiyusvna.
english: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏬᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎠᎦᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏛᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Uwosulotsvhi agasesdi gesesdi iyuno sudalasgohi iyudetiyvdv gesesdi, ale ulosvsdesdi, saquoquo asgaya unaneladvhi gesesdi.
english: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
author: Cherokee New Testament
