syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏏ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᏛᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏧᏬᏑᎴᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno osdv atsinohesgi gesesdi osi deulvwisdanehvi, iyuno diniyoli tsudvhistanvhi gesesdi, iyuno anedohi tsusquanigotanvhi gesesdi, iyuno unadanvti tsunalasideni tsuwosulelvhi gesesdi, iyuno tsusdelvdv gesesdi anigiliyogi, iyuno usdawadvdv gesesdi nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏌᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎩᏲᎢᏎᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎠᏁᎲ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎠᏁᎳ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ,
phonetic: Aniwinvgesanisgini tsunosulotsvhi giyoisehesdi; iyuyeno nunanelvna nigalisda anehv, Galonedvno unelagi anela, hnaquo unadulisgo tsunatsvsdiyi,
english: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏕᎤᏂᏲᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Tsunadugodanelvhi gesoi nvdigalisdodisgo deuniyosv igvyiyi unohiyunvi.
english: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎪ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏁᏙᎵᏙᎰ ᏓᏓᏁᎳᏗᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏄᎸᏗᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏂᏱᏙᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᎳᏗᏌᏘ, ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo anadeloquasgo unadanulvdi iyunalisdodiyi, anedolidoho dadaneladisvi; vtla ale unadanulvdiquo uwasv yigesoi, nasquosgini kanohedv aniyidohi gesoi ale uniniladisati, aninohesgi nasgi niduyugodvna gesv uninohediyi.
english: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᏫᏅᎨᏌᏂ ᏧᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ, ᏧᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᎳᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎬᏩᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi aquaduliha aniwinvgesani tsunatsvsdiyi, diniyoli tsuninanugowisdiyi, tsunisquanigododiyi daninelvi, ale gvwanatludisgi tsunilanvdadediyi nigesvna gesv usonv gvwaninohediyi.
english: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᎪᎸᏒ ᏎᏓᏂ ᎤᎾᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ.
phonetic: Gayulayeno igadv unagolvsv Sedani unasdawadenv.
english: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏚᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᏗᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏱᏚᏂᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo gohiyuhvsgi asgaya ale ageyv duwekahesdi tsunosulotsvhi, unvsvquo dinisdelisgesdi, tlesdino tsunanelodi unadatlugv yidunidanelesdi, nasgi digvwanisdelvdi yigi udohiyusv tsunosulotsvhi gesvi.
english: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Ale digeganelodi tsigi osdv tsunilvwisdanehi tali iyuwagudi detsilvquodesdi, ale nasgi ho ugvwiyusesdi kanohedv ale dideyodi gesv tsunilvwisdanehi.
english: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏲᏴᏑᎳᏁᏍᏗ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎦᏔᏙᎥᏗᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigadvha galvquodi goweli; Tlesdi yiyoyvsulanesdi waga agatadovdisgi; ale, Gohusdi advnehi agaguyvedi geso dulvwisdanelvi.
english: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏛᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tsaganelodi gohusdi atsilawisehvi tlesdi yitsadvdasdisgesdi gvni anitali ale anitsoi uninohedv gesesdi.
english: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎩ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nano anisganvgi dehigvsgolvvsgesdi nigadv anigatahvi, nasgi anisoi nasquo uninayesdiyi.
english: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᏂᏚᎪᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎩᎶ ᏂᏯᎵᎪᏁᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi, ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv ale gegasuyedv dinikahnawadidohi anigatahvi, hia nasgi tsagasayasdodiyi igvyi gayehi nidugodisgvna, ale detsalvwisdanehv gilo niyaligonehvna.
english: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᏘᏯᏏᏔᏕᏍᏗ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏖᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎬᎢ.  ᏣᏓᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi ulisdi yitiyasitadesdi giloi, ale tlesdi yateladisgesdi gilo anisganvgvi.  Tsadagasayasdesdi higadaha nigesvna gesesdi.
english: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᎹᏉ ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎭᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎭᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏦᎸᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏃᏉ ᏣᏢᏥᏰᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquo tlesdi amaquo yaditasgesdi, usdisgini gigageaditasdi haditasgesdi, gohusdi halisdisgv iyusdi tsolvhisdiyi ale yanoquo tsatlvtsiyesgvi.
english: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏅᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎨᏐ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏫᎦᎷᎪ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᎨᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo anisganvgv gvnigesv geso igvwenvdv, igvyi wigalugo digugododiyi gesvi, gilono ugesdawadegoi.
english: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎨᏐ ᎢᎬᏪᏅᏛ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎ Ꮭ ᎦᎬᏍᎦᎶᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo gilo osdv dunilvwisdanehv gvnigesv geso igvwenvdv; gilono nasgi na hia nusdvna yigi, ase tla gagvsgalodi yigesoi.
english: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏂᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏐᏢᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Naniv digetsinatlai nasgi digetsigilanala tsigi utsati tsunilvquodiyu gesesdi digvwaninatlai, nasgi dudov Unelanvhi ale utseli dideyodi gesv asotlvhi iyulisdodiyi nigesvna.
english: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᏂᏂᏆᏘᎴᏍᏗ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏓᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎦᏛᏁᎸᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nano anohiyuhvsgi digvwaninatlai gesv tlesdi yiduniniquatilesdi yinvdigalisdodisgesdi analinvtli gesvi, gohusdisgini danadvnehesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi anohiyuhvsgi ale getsigeyui gesvi, unatloyasdisgi osdv nagadvnelvi.  Nasgi hia nusdesdi dehadeyohvsgesdi, ale dehinetsehesdi.
english: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏ ᎾᏰᎸᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏬᏂᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏂᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ;
phonetic: Iyuno gilo utsatini nigawesgesdi dadeyohvsgesdi, ale osi nayelvsgvna igesesdi osdv uwonisv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, ale dideyodi gesv nasgi Unelanvhi dinilododi gesv tsidadeyohvsga;
english: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ, ᎤᎵᏰᏔᏁᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᎠᎵᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᏕᎵᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi na utlvquodi, gohusdi nagatahvna, uliyetanehi gawonihisdi gesv, ale tsutiyosati alinohesgvi, nahna tsvdidalehvsga advyugedi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesvi, ale asotlvisdodi gesvi, ale gohusdi didadelisedi gesvi,
english: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎪᏏᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎤᏂᏂᎩᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale gvsgaisdagi uniwonihisdi gesv yvwi ugosidv tsunadanvti, uninigidv duyugodvi, genvisdi gesv Unelanvhi dinelododi itsulaha anelisgi.  Nasgi iyunasdi dehadanvehesdi.
english: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhisgini dinelododi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv adanvdadisdi gesv, nasgi utsati genvisdi.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎩᏲᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏳᎢᏳ Ꮭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎨᏗᏄᎪᏩ.
phonetic: Tlayeno gohusdi yigiyole ani elohi, ale gvnigeyuiyu tla gohusdi yvgedinugowa.
english: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᎩᎭ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏄᏬ ᏱᏗᎩᎾᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno yigiha alisdayvdi ale diganuwo yidiginaa, nasgi yeliquo igiyelvsesdi.
english: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏌᏛ ᏫᏓᏂᏅᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᏂᏃᏴᏘᏍᏗᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unadulisgisgini tsigi unenvisdiyi, udalenasdiyi ale asadv widaninvgoi, ale utsati iyudalegi ulisganisdv ale uyo iyadadvnehi agvvhisdi gesvi; nasgi tsiduninoyvtisdiha yvwi nahna agiliyoisdi gesv ale ayohuhisdi gesvi.
english: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏕᎸᏰᏃ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏘᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adelvyeno digeyudi gesv nahna didalehvsga nudalesv uyoi, nasgi gilo unigvvsgvi unatlesv gohiyudi gesvi, ale unvsv dunadatistanv utsati uyo adanvdadisdi gesvi.
english: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini hisgaya Unelanvhi utseliga nasgi hia dehadanvehesdi, ale dehisdawadisesdi duyugodv gesvi, ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesvi, ale gohiyudi gesvi, ale adageyudi gesvi, ale gvnidiyu gesvi, ale udanvtiyu gesvi.
english: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎭᎵᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏘᏂᏴ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏣᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎠᏂᏚᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv hvdisgesdi osdv alisdi gesv halihesdi.  Nalisquadisgvna gvnidv gesv tiniyv, nahna nasquo etsayanvdv tsigi, ale tsanonvhi tsigi osdv kanohedi gesv unitsati anigatahi anidutahvi.
english: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏂᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏆᏂᏗ ᏆᎴᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi, nasgi digvnidisgi tsigi nigav nunadalesvi, ale agatahv Tsisa Galonedv nasgi Quanidi Qualedi agatahv unonvhi tsigi osdv kanohedv gesvi,
english: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏤᎵᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Nasgi tsasquanigododiyi dikahnawadvsdi, nudadalvna ale gohusdi gayetselisedi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv gananugotsilv gvdisgi,
english: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏨᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsvgananugowisi nahiyu tsunanugowisedi gesvi, nasgi nvwadohiyadv udanvti ale uwasvhi ulinigidv gesvi, Ugvwiyuhi Unigvwiyuhi anehvi, ale Ugvwiyusadegi Nunigvwiyusadegi anehvi;
english: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎯ, ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi uwasvhi ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesv uhi, igagadv ehi gesvi, nasgi igagadv nahna gilo gvwaluhisdi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi gilo ugohvgi nigesvna, ale gvwagowadvdi nigesvna gesvi; nasgi atsilvquodiyu gesesdi ale ulinigidi gesv winasdvna gesesdi.  Emenv.
english: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏱᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎩᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Ginetsehesdi tsunehnai tsigi ani elohi nasgi unatlvquodi yiquo nigesvna, ale unalisgasdododiyi nigesvna udalidasdi genvisdi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini gvnidv analisgasdodisgesdi nasgi utsati iginehi tsigi nagav nudalesv osdv igalisdanedi.
english: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᏂᏯᏙᎯᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Ale osdv nanadvnehesdi, ale unehnaiyu gesesdi osdv nanadvnehvi, ale anigaliyesdi unadanediyi, aniyadohihi gesesdi unihvi,
english: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᏓᏁᎸᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏂᏴᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Anadanelvsgesdi unvsv unatseliga osdv gagusdvdi asi nasqualisgvna nahiyu usqualvdi tsigi, nasgi nalisquadisgvna gvnidv digvwaniniyvdi iyulisdodiyi.
english: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎹᏗ, ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᎨᏅᏴ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ;
phonetic: Dimadi, tsasquanigodesdi nasgi tsetsagenvyv, iyvdv nvnehesdi gawetlvdi gesv ale asequoquo gawonihisdi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesv agadovhisdi niduyugodvna tsidudov;
english: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎧᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi gilo anisdawadisv unatlesv gohiyudi gesvi.  [Unelanvhi] udadolisdi gesv detsakawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
english: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎡᎩᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ;
phonetic: Ayv Quola aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv nvtsulisdotanv Unelanvhi osi uyelvnvi, nasgiya aduisdv gvnidv eginediyi, nasgi Galonedv Tsisa tsvdidalehvsga;
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎬᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Wigvyowelasi Dimadi gvgeyui aquetsi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale udadolitsadv gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsakahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Galonedv Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
english: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᏥᏯᏁᎶᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᏥᎬᏗᎭ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ, ᏂᏥᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎬᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Tsiyalielitse Unelanvhi, nasgi tsidetsiyanelodi, nasgiya digigayvlige nunadvnelvi, tsigvdiha gadaha nigesvna aquadanvdo, nitsiyohisdisgvna, iga ale svnoyi gvyanvdadisgv gadadolisdisgvi,
english: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎸᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎩᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi utsati aquadulisgv gvgowadvdiyi, ale ganvdadisgv detsatloyilvi nasgino agikaliisdiyi ulihelisdi gesvi,
english: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏅᏓᏓ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏣᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᏯᎥ ᏣᎵᏏ ᎶᏏ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏥ ᏳᏂᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno ganvdada utlonasdi nigesvna gohiyudi gesv tsitsayaa, nasgi igvyi tsuyav tsalisi Losi ale tsatsi Yunisi, ale nudlasidvsvna agiyelvha nihi nasquo tsayavi.
english: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᏣᏖᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎩ ᏣᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏣᏯᎠ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏯᏏᏔᏛ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gvyanvdadisdiha tsatelvdiyi Unelanvgi tsanelvhi gesvi, nasgi tsitsayaa, nasgi degvyasitadv tsinvdigalisdodiha.
english: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏍᎦᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla yiginelv adanvdo udasgasdi, ulinigidvsgini ale adageyudi gesv ale osdv adanvtedi gesvi.
english: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᏆᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏴᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi yadehosgesdi hinohesgv ugvwiyuhi igatseliga, ale tlesdi yisquadehosgesdi ayv tsiyvgi nasgi utseliga, tseladisdisgesdisgini agiliyogv osdv kanohedv, tsasdelisgesdi ulinigidi gesv Unelanvhi,
english: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi igisdelvdv tsigi, ale igiyanvdv tsigi uwatanvhi galvquodi adayanvdi gesvi, vtla ayv degilvwisdanehv yinvtsulisdotanv, uwasvsgini udanvtelvi ale gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nvtsulisdotanv, nasgi iginelvhi tsigi nvtsudalenvhvna, Tsisa Galonedv gesv iyusdi,
english: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Gohino gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi nasgi unanugotsilv Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi uyostanvhi tsigi ayohuhisdi gesv, ale unanugowisvhi tsigi gvnidv ale ayohuhisdi nigesvna gesv, osdv kanohedv gvtanvhi,
english: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᎩᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏥᏰᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi ayv vginetselvhi galitsidohvsgi ale vginvsidv ale digatsiyeyohvsgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
english: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏕᎣᏍᎦ; ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᏯᎨᏅᏴ ᎬᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo nvdigalisdodiha hia nasgi tsudalenvdv tsigiliyoga; aseno vtla yigadeosga; tsigatahayeno nasgi tsitsiyalisgasdotanv, ale ulinigidiyu aquohiyuha yeliquo gvwasquanigododi gesv nasgi tsitsiyagenvyv gvni nahiyu iga asqualvhvha.
english: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Detsaniyvsesdi nasgi ditsatlilostanvhi osdv kanohedv nasgi squadvganelvhi tsigi, hvdisgesdi gohiyudi gesv ale adageyudi gesv nasgi Galonedv Tsisa nvdayudalenvhi.
english: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏤᏣᎨᏅᏴ ᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ, ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ.
phonetic: Nasgi na osdv tsetsagenvyv tsasquanigodesdi, tsasdelisgesdi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo nasgi tsigiyaa.
english: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎬᏋᏕᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏯ ᏆᏤᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎭᎹᏥᏂ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi higataha, nigadv Esiyi anehi gvquvdetsvi, nasgi unadasuya Quatsela ale Hamatsini.
english: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎿᎭᎥ ᎣᏁᏏᏉᎳ, ᏯᏃᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏉᏕᎰᎯᏎᎮ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ;
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi tsunedi gesesdi udadolisdi gesv dudatihnav Onesiquola, yanoyeno agigalisdadisgvgi, ale vtla yaquodehohisehe aquatseli tsudadesvdv;
english: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎶᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Lomisgini uwedolv ulinigidv agiyolvgi, ale agiwadvhvgi.
english: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ.  ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi unedi gesesdi uwadvdiyi udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi nahiyu iga.  Ale nigav agisdelvhidolv Equisa osiyu higataha.
english: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏇᏥ ᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi aquetsi tsalinigohisdisgesdi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayulisgolvtanvhi.
english: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏍᏆᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᎨᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ Ꮎ ᏭᏅᎫᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi squadvganelvhi tsigi unitsati anigatahvi, nasgi dehagenvdisgesdi anosdv anisgaya nasgi yeli digvwaneyodi gesv nasquo na wunvgudvi.
english: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎲᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi hvnidiyu gesesdi higiliyogvi, nasgiya osdv ayawisgi Tsisa Galonedv utseliga.
english: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᏤᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏅ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏯᏚᏓᎸᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎪ ᎠᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Gilo dahnawa tsegoi vtla gvnv ulisdelvdodi deulvwisdanehv yadudalvdisgoi, udulisgo asgayegvsda osdv uyelvdi tsulvwisdanediyi.
english: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏍᏚᎸᏍᎪᎢ ᎬᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale gilo udasegogisdiyi tsatlinigvnehoi, vtla yatsisdulvsgoi gvni dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv iyudvnelvhi tsigesoi.
english: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎶᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Digalogisgi tsidulvwisdanehoi igvyi uweladisdodi geso unanugowisvhi.
english: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏛᎵ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏫᏣᎲᏏ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Hadanvdadvli hia tsinitsiweha; Ugvwiyuhino witsahvsi tsagadovhisdiyi nigav tsudalenvdv.
english: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ,
phonetic: Tsanvtesdi Tsisa Galonedv, Dewi uwetsi, uyohusv dulehisanvi, nasgiya nigawesgv osdv kanohedv aquatseliga,
english: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ ᎥᏆᎸᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎤᏲ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahna tsitsigiliyoga vqualvsdiyi iyvdv, uyo tsulvwisdanehi nasgiyai; Unelanvhisgini utseliga kanohedv vtla galvlvhi yigi.
english: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎲᎢ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi unelagi geliha nigadv tsudalenvdv naqualisdanelidohvi gegasuyedv nvdigalisdodiha, ale uniwadvdiyi alisdelvdodi nasgi Tsisa Galonedv nvdayulisgolvtanvhi, ale alisquadisgi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesvi.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᏛᏁᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya igawedv, Iyuyeno itsulaha digiyohusvhi gesesdi, ase nasquo itsulaha dedvnesdi;
english: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏕᏛᏂᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᎩᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏒᏓᏓᏱᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᏓᏱᎵ.
phonetic: Iyuno dedvniesdi ase nasgi itsulaha igigvwiyusadegesdi; iyuno isvdadayilvha nasquo ase dagadayili.
english: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏁᏙᎢᏳᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏴᎬᏓᏓᏱᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuno nedoiyunvna igesesdi ase nvwasdiquo gagohiyudi gesvi; vtla uwasv yvgvdadayiga.
english: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏯ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎤᎾᏗᏒᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎬᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi dehanvdadisdisgesdi, ulinigidvya dehinetsehesdi Ugvwiyuhi agatahvi, unadisvsdiyi nigesvna gesv daniwonisgvi, gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna tsigi, danigatahvsgvquosgini gvwanadvdasdanehi.
english: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏣᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏘᏯᏙᎮᎯ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
phonetic: Hatlinigvnehesdi gvnigesv itsvnediyi osiyu tsayelvsv Unelanvhi, ditsalvwisdanehi gesesdi getsadehohisdi nigesvna gesvi, osdv tiyadohehi gayegogi nigesvna kanohedv.
english: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏴᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᏪᏢᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Iyvdvsgini nvnehesdi gawetlvdi gesv ale nulisalodvna gawonihisdi gesvi, nasgiyeno aninequosgesdi Unelanvhi dinelododi nigesvna gesvi,
english: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎪᏏᏛ ᏣᏓᏰᏍᎪᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎭᎻᏂᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏆᎵᏓ,
phonetic: Ale aniwonisgv adayesgesdi nasgiya ugosidv tsadayesgoi; nasgi nunasdi Haminiya ale Qualida,
english: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏞᏒ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᎾᏂᏪᎠ, ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎤᎶ ᏐᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᎷᏆᏗᏁᎭ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi duyugodv gesv unatlesv, hia tsinaniwea, ayohusv dilehisodi gesv gayula ulo sonv; ale daniluquadineha igadv unohiyusvi.
english: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏂᎬᏅ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ, ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
phonetic: Asesgininonv gagusdvdi Unelanvhi utseliga ulinigidiyu nigvnv; hiayeno nigvnv gowelvi, Ugvwiyuhi dagataha nasgi tsutseliga; ale hia, Gilo kaneisdisgesdi Galonedv dudov nasgi adanvehesdi asgani.
english: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏆ ᏣᏓᏁᎶ ᎾᎿᎭᏓᎰ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏕᎸᏉ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᎤᏁᎬ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Aseno equa tsadanelo nahna daho ditelido vtla adelvquo dalonige ale adelvunegv uwasv digotlvtanvhi yigesoi, nasquosgini ada ale gada digotlvtanvhi; ale igadv digalvquodi igadvno digalvquodi nigesvna.
english: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᎳ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo udanvgalvdv yigi hia nasgi gesvi, nasgi na atelido galvquodi gesesdi, galvquotanvhi, ale yisdv igvnelvhi gohusdi uwadodiyi ganela; ale advnvistanvhi nagav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv ugvwali.
english: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎩᎳ ᏗᎾᏛᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏣᎵᎪᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale dehadanvehesdi gila dinadvsgi unadulvnvdi gesvi; hisdawadegesdino duyugodv gesv, ale gohiyudi gesv, ale adageyudi gesv, ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, itsaligosesdi nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi anadadolisdanehi unawi gadaha nigesvna anvdisgi.
english: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎵᏌᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏅᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏚᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎯᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dehadanvehesdisgini nulisalodvna ale nvgatahvna duwonihisdi gesvi, higatahayeno ditiyosdi gesv waliyeilohihvi.
english: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᏧᎨᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᏗᎬᏩᏕᏲᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhiyeno unvsidasdi vtla tsutiyosdi yigi, tsugeyuhisgini yigi nanivi, digvwadeyodi yigi, gvnidiyu yigi,
english: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ ᏕᎨᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏚᎩ ᏳᏩᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Udanvti gvdisgv yigi degeyohvsgv gvwatludisgi; udugi yuwaha Unelanvhi tsunediyi tsuninetliyvsdiyi dunadanvdvi, ale tsunadanilvisdiyi udohiyuhi gesvi;
english: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏐᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏌᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎫᏴᎩᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Ale unadanvtisodiyi unvsv unadudalesdiyi asgina usadvi, nasgi guyvginvhi tsigi uwasvquo adanvtesgv itsuwanelvhi.
english: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆ ᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nasquo higatahesdi, ulisqua lvdi gesesdi ase udeyadodi uliyeilohisdi gesesdi.
english: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ, ᎠᎾᏢᏆᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ, ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏗᏂᎳᏏᏘᏍᎩ, ᏄᎾᎵᎮᎵᏣᏛᎾ, ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭᎢ,
phonetic: Yvwiyeno unvsv unadalvquodiyu gesesdi, adelv unigvvsgi, anatlvquasgi, unatlvquodi, Unelanvhi gvwanisotlvdi, tsunigayvlige dinilasitisgi, nunalihelitsadvna, anigadahai,
english: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏅᎾ ᏂᏚᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ, ᏄᏃᎯᏍᏘᏒᎾ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᎵᏙᎯ, ᏄᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ, ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᎯ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ,
phonetic: Gohusdi tsunvna nidunigeyusvna, nunohistisvna, usonv anadanohelidohi, nunalisinahisdvna, unihnalvhi, anisgagi osdv,
english: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ, ᎤᏂᎫᏏᏯ, ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏌᎳᏗ, ᎤᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᏄᏂᎨᏳᏒᎾ,
phonetic: Anadalonuhesgi, unigusiya, unadalisaladi, unigeyuhi yisdv unadanvdadisdisgi Unelanvhino nunigeyusvna,
english: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏗᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᎯ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi dinelododi ditselidv unihi, aseno anadayihi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesvi.  Nasgi iyunasdi dehadanvehesdi.
english: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏥᏓᏂᏴᎵᏙᎰ ᏓᏓᏁᎸᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏓᎾᏘᎾᏫᏗᏍᎪ ᏄᎾᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᏚᎾᏘᏂᏒ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia iyunasdi tsidaniyvlidoho dadanelvi ale tsidanatinawidisgo nunadanvdvna anigeyv unikalitsvhi asganai, dunatinisv tsudalenvdv adulvdi gesvi,
english: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏩᏂᏰᎢᎶᎯᎰ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigohilv anadeloquasgoi, aseno vtla ilvhiyu yiwaniyeilohiho duyugodv agadovhisdi gesvi.
english: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏤᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏈ ᏣᎾᏡᏗᏍᎨ ᎼᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏡᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏲᏨᎯ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏲᎢᏎᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Ale nasgiya Tseni ale Tsvqui tsanatludisge Mosi nasgiya nasquo hia anatludi duyugodv gesvi; anisgaya uyotsvhi dunadanvdvi, ale getsiyoisedv nasgi gohiyudi gesv ugvwali.
english: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᏅᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥᎾᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏄᏍᏕ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla utli iyvdv gvwanenvsdi yigi, nanigatahnavnayeno gesv gvnigesv nvdayunalisdaneli nanivi, nasgiya nasquo tsinusde nasgi.
english: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏆᏕᏲᏅᎢ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᏄᏍᏛ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏆᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎨᎵᏍᎬ ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Nihisgini osiyu tsagadovsv nusdv daquadeyonvi, nusdv aqualenidolvi, nusdv daquegotanv diquadanvdvi, aquohiyusvi, gvnidiyu gesvi, aquadageyuhiyu gesvi, unelagi gelisgv tsigiliyogvi,
english: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎩᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎸᎢ ᎥᏘᎣᎩ, ᎢᎪᏂᏯ, ᎵᏍᏗ-ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏅᏋᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏯᏓᎴᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Uyo nvquvnelidolvi, agigiliyotsidolvi Vtiogi, Igoniya, Lisdinigav uyo nvquvnelidolvi; aseno nasgi nigadv nahna Ugvwiyuhi ayadalesvgi.
english: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo naniv unadulisgi Unelanvhi dinelododi gesv unisdawadvsdiyi Galonedv Tsisa anohiyuhvsgi iyunadvnedi nasgi ase uyo igegvnedi.
english: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏓᏂᎶᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎶᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Uniyosgini yvwi ale unatlonasdi aninequogesdi uniyo gesvi, danilonasdisgesdi ale getsilonasdisgesdi.
english: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏕᎶᏆᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏅᎢ; ᎯᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nihisgini detsaniyvsesdi nusdv tsadeloquavi ale tsohiyunvi; higatahayeno nasgi hiyadeloquaelvhi gesvi,
english: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎦᏔᎭ ᏣᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏕᎯᎦᏔᎲ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎯᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ, ᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎬᏩᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ, ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎯᏲᎢᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗ.
phonetic: Ale higataha tsasdi gesv nvdagvwadalenvdv dehigatahv digalvquodi goweli, nasgi yeli higatahnaiyu igvwanedi, tsalisdelvdodi gesv wigvwaliyilohisdi, Galonedv Tsisa hiyoiyusv iyuwanisodi.
english: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏓᏕᏲᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᎪᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎤᏓᏕᏲᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nigav goweli Unelanvhi udanvtelvhi digowelanvhi, ale osiyu udadeyodiyi, udagvsgolvdiyi, udagodiyi duyugodvi, udadeyodiyi osdv gesvi,
english: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏓᏁᎵᏌᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi asgaya Unelanvhi utseliga usquadisdiyi, udanelisadv iyulisdodiyi nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏁᏤᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gvnetseha Unelanvhi agatahvi ale agatahv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv, nasgi tsuwugodanedi tsigi dinvnodv ale tsuniyohusvhi nahiyu gananugotsilvha ale Ugvwiyuhi hnaquo nigalistanvha,
english: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᏣᎵᏁᏅᏕᏍᏗᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏍᏗᏰᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Halitsidohvsgesdi kanohedv, tsalinenvdesdiquo yeli gesesdi ale yeli nigesvna gesesdi, dehigvsgolvvsgesdi, dehisgagesdi, dehisdiyedisgesdi hvdisgesdi utsati gvnidv gesv ale dideyodi gesvi.
english: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏚᏂᏲᏕᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏂᎴᏂ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒ ᏓᏂᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Dvsqualvhiyeno hnaquo nahiyu vtla yunadulisgesdi unadvdasdodiyi osdv dideyodi gesvi; duniyodesgvsgini dinileni anvdisgesdi unvsvquo unadulvnvdi gesv danisdawadisv danitlisisgesdi dinadeyohvsgi;
english: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎴᏂᏃ ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᏎᏉᏃ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏩᎾᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dinilenino danigatahvsgesdi anadvgisgv duyugodvi, asequono gawonihisdi gesv iditlv wanagatahvsdisgesdi.
english: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎮᏯᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᎲᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎯᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏰᎵᎦᏯ ᎯᏍᏆᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini heyatahiyu gesesdi nigav nitsadvhnadegvi, hvnidiyu gesesdi higiliyogvi, detsalvwisdanehesdi alitsidonidohi tsulvwisdanedi gesvi; yeligaya hisquadisgesdi ditsalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᎦᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquoyeno gadalisgolvdiha, ale nahiyu aquenvsdi gesv usqualvhidi.
english: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎵᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏛ ᎦᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Aqualilv osdv alisdi gesvi, agisquadv gadogiyasgvi, agisquanigotanv gohiyudi gesvi,
english: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏨᏆᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏗᏅᏁᏗ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎠᏋᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎣᏂᏰᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono tsvquadanelanelv alisdulo duyugodv iyunadvnelvhi gegaguyvdanedi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi nasganvna digugodisgi adinvnedi nahiyu iga, vtla ale ayvquo aquvsv, nasquosgini naniv unanugoisdi gesv osiyu oniyelvhi.
english: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hatlinigvnelvha nigohilvnaquo tsaluhisdiyi ani gedohvi.
english: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎹᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᏕᏨ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏏᎶᏂᎦ ᏭᎶᏒ; ᏞᏏᏂ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᏭᎶᏒ, ᏓᏓᏏ ᏕᎵᎺᏏᏱ ᏭᎶᏒ;
phonetic: Dimayeno aquvdetsv, nvdigalisdodiha utli uyelvnv gohi gesvi, ale Desiloniga wulosv; Tlesini Gelesiyi wulosv, Dadasi Delimesiyi wulosv;
english: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎷᎦ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᏍᏕᏙᎭ; ᎹᎦ ᏘᏯᏗᏁᏒᎭ, ᎬᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Luga uwasv osdedoha; Maga tiyadinesvha, gvgisdelvhidasdiyeno dagilvwisdanehvi.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏈᏌ ᏥᏅᏒ
phonetic: Ditsigasgini Equisa tsinvsv
english: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏌᎴᎾ ᏠᏯ ᏨᏛᎩᏂᏴᎩ ᎦᏆ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ ᏖᏒ ᏘᏁᏒᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏙᏘᏁᏒᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎦ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Gasalena Tloya tsvdvginiyvgi Gaqua ganelvi tesv tinesvha, ale goweli dotinesvha nasgi ho ugvwiyusesdi ganega digowelodi.
english: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎵᎩ ᎥᏣᏱ ᎪᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏘ ᏃᏒᎾ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎩ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Eligi vtsayi gotlvnvvsgi uloti nosvna naquvnelvgi.  Ugvwiyuhi uguyvedi gesesdi nasgiya deulvwisdanelvi.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᏰᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᏡᏔᏅ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquo nihi nasgi hiyeyadotsehesdi, ulinigidiyuyeno utlutanv otsiwonisgvi.
english: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎩᏬᏂᏒ ᎦᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎥ ᏱᎦᏙᎨᎢ, ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏆᏕᏨᎩ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏚᏚᎪᏔᏁᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Igvyiyi agiwonisv galisdelisgv vtla gilo nav yigadogei, nanivquosgini gvquadetsvgi; tlesdi unisganvtsv yidudugotanesdi;
english: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏛᎯᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᎴᏒᎩ ᏢᏓᏥ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏥᎳᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhisgininonv nav gadogvgi ale aqualinigohistanvgi; nasgi ayv gesv agisquadisdiyi ayelvsvgi alitsidodi gesvi, ale naniv tsunadalenvdv yvwi unadvhidiyi; ale vgilesvgi tlvdatsi aholi tsilavi.
english: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏛᏇᏓᎴᏏ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏛᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale Ugvwiyuhi ase dvquedalesi nigav uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi; ale dvgisquanigotani galvladi ehi ugvwiyuhi digesv wigalugi.  Nasgi galvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi, Emenv.
english: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏈᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏈᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏁᏏᏉᎳ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Giyolilvha Quisga ale Equila, ale Onesiquola dudatinavi.
english: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᏍᏓ ᎪᎴᏂᏗ ᏓᏳᏗᎩᏴᎩ, ᏠᏆᎹᏍᎩᏂ ᎹᎵᏓ ᏓᏥᏯᎧᎯᏴᎩ ᎤᏢᎩ.
phonetic: Ilasda Golenidi dayudigiyvgi, Tloquamasgini Malida datsiyakahiyvgi utlvgi.
english: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎠᏂ ᏣᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎪᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᏳᏇᎳ ᏫᏣᏲᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏇᏗᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎳᎾᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏠᏗᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Hatlinigvnelvha ani tsaluhisdiyi asiquo gola nigesvna.  Yuquela witsayoliga, ale nasquo Quedini, ale lanasi, ale Tlodiya, ale naniv analinvtli.
english: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏩᏓᏅᏙ.  ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏣᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv dakahnawadidohesdi wadanvdo.  Udadolisdi gesv detsakahnawadidohesdi.  Emenv.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏑᏰᏛ, ᎠᎴ [ᎾᏍᎩᏯ] ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎩ,
phonetic: Ayv, Quola, Unelanvhi aginvsidohi, ale Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv, nasgiya unohiyusv Unelanvhi tsusuyedv, ale [nasgiya] didanilvisdi gesv duyugodv gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv nasgiya tsigi,
english: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎵᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏞᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏏ ᎾᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎡᎶᎯ;
phonetic: Tsulitloyasdi udugi gvdi gesv gvnidv alisquadisgi nigesvna awadvdiyi, nasgi Unelanvhi tlewatsigodi nigesvna tsuduistane asi nadalenisgvna tsigese elohi;
english: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏮᏔᏁ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏆᎨᏅᏛᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Aseno nahiyu aselvhi gesv gvnigesv nuwanele utseli kanohedv uwvtane alitsidodi gesvi, nasgi ayv vquagenvdvhi tsigi, nasgiya unetsv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi;
english: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏏ, ᏓᏓᏏ, ᎠᏇᏥᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᏕᏣᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Wigvyowelasi, Dadasi, aquetsiyai, nasgiya naniv anohiyuhvsgi unohiyusvi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv, ale udadolitsadvi, ale nvwadohiyadv, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale Ugvwiyuhi tsisa galonedv Igisdelisgi, detsakahnawadidohesdi.
english: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏟᏗᏱ ᏨᏓᎬᏯᎧᎯᏴᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏃᏒᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏘᎪᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᎦᏚᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏁᏤᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Hia nvdagalisdodisgvgi Tlidiyi tsvdagvyakahiyvgi, nasgi osdv itsvnelidasdiyi nasgi tsudalenvdv unosvnvi, ale tigodiyi digeganelodi degaduwadisvi, nasgiya itsadvnediyi gvnetselvi;
english: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᎧᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᏂᎨᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᏄᎾᏁᎸᎾ ᎤᎾᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏁᎶᏛᎾ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo gohusdi naguisdvna gesesdi, saquo adayehesdi, anohiyuhvsgi duwekahesdi tsuwetsi, nigetsilawisehvna nunanelvna unalenidolvi, ale nidunadanelodvna.
english: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᎫᎢᏍᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᏣᏘ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏓᏛᏂᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Atsigatidisdiyeno gohusdi naguisdvna yigi, nasgiya osdv iyuwahnadegi Unelanvhi utseliga; vtla uwasv adanvtesgv utli uyelvhi, vtla uhnalvtsati, vtla gigageaditasdi uganasisgi, vtla adadvnihi, vtla tsugvwalodi ugvvsgi.
english: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ, ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎤᎵᏏᎾᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Udasquanigododiyisgini osiyu uyelvhi, osdv gesv ugeyuhi, uyvsdesgi nigesvna, duyugodv iyadvnehi, nasganvna, ulisinasdi;
english: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏧᏂᏴᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎨᏲᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏬᏁᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎯᏳᎾᏁᏗ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Asdaya tsuniyvhi nudalidasdvna kanohedv nasgiya ageyonvi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi yeliquo digvwawonedodi osdv dideyodi gesv gvdisgvi; ale gvwanadohiyunanedi igvwanedi dinigatilegi gesvi.
english: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏁᎶᏛᎾ, ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ, ᎨᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Unitsatayeno nidunadanelodvna, asequoquo aniwonisgi, ale unatlonasdi, geugvwiyuha nasgi na digetsiusdeselvhi;
english: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᎠᏎ ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᏁᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏗᏂᎦᏔᎲᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏥᎩ ᏧᎾᏕᏲᏗᏱ, ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi diniholi ase digetsisdunedi, nasgi naniv sidanelvhi anehi dinigatahvsgi, nasgi tsidanadeyohvsga niduyugodvna tsigi tsunadeyodiyi, tsugvwalodi gadaha unigvvsgv iyusdi.
english: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏟᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏧᏍᎦᏃᎸ ᏧᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱ.
phonetic: Gilo iyusdi unvsvquo anehv ehi, adolehosgi unvsvquo unatseliga, hia nuwesei, Tlidiyi anehi aniyegogi geso nigohilvi, uniyo inage anehi, tsusganolv tsunisquoliyi.
english: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are always liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎪᎯᏳᎭ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎸ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Hia nasgi igawedv tsigi ugohiyuha.  Nasgi iyusdi asdaya dehigvsgolvnvha, nasgi ugolv nigesvna iyulisdodiyi unohiyusvi;
english: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎪᎸᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Nunagasayasdvnaquo iyulisdodiyi Anitsusi uninohelvdi gesvi, ale yvwiquo nasgi duyugodv gesv dinigolvsgi uninetsvhi.
english: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎡᎸᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi na unadanvgalvdv gesvi, nigadiyu tsudalenvdv unadanvgalvelvhi gesoi; nasgisgini na gadaha iyunalistanvhi ale nunohiyusvna, vtla gohusdi unadanvgalvelvhi yigesoi; nasquosgini dunadanvdv ale tsunugododiyi gadaha idigvnelvhi.
english: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏱᎭ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏂᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Gvnigesv nanvneha anigatahiyu gesv Unelanvhi; aseno dunilvwisdanehv igvwadayiha, nvdigalisdodiha uniniquatisdiyu gesvi, ale unohiyuhisdv nigesvna gesvi; ale nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv getsisonvistanvhi.
english: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nihisgini hinohesgesdi nasgi osdv dideyodi gesv ulilohvsgi;
english: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ, ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ, ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsunadvsonvhi tsuniyvsdesgi nigesvna iyunalisdodiyi, getsilvquodi, unalisinahisdi, nugolvna gesv unohiyusvi, ale unadageyusvi, ale dinvnidiyu gesvi.
english: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏏᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Anigeyv nasquo anigayvligei, nasgi dunilvwisdanehv duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv ulilohvsgi yigi, usonv anadanohesgi nigesvna, gigageaditasdi uniganasisgi nigesvna, osdv gesv dinadeyohvsgi;
english: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏲᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᏫᎾᎨᏌᏂ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏁᏥ,
phonetic: Nasgi digvwaneyodi yigi aniwinagesani anigeyv unalisinahisdi iyulisdodiyi, tsunigeyuhi iyulisdodiyi digvwaniyehi, tsunigeyuhi iyulisdodiyi tsunetsi,
english: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ, ᏚᏁᏅᏒᏉ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ, ᎠᏃᏍᏛ, ᏧᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Unalisinahisdi iyunalisdodiyi, aneyatahi, dunenvsvquo anedohi, anosdv, tsunohiyuhi unvsv digvwaniyehi, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli gagvwanisotlvdodiyi nigesvna.
english: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏫᏅ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Aniwinv nasquo dehinetsehesdi unalisinahisdi iyunalisdodiyi.
english: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᏰᏣᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏕᏂᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ, ᎬᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ,
phonetic: Nigav tsudalenvdv gesv gvnigesv nvnehesdi digayetsatlilosdodi gesv osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi; didenidi gesv ugvwali uyo nudasuyvna, gvlvquodiyu, nutlonasdvna,
english: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᎪᏁᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᎲᏅ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎶᏃᎮᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiwonisgv osdv yigi nasgi gvgonelohisdi nigesvna; nasgi na tsatludisgi gvwadehohisdi yigi nuhvnv gesv iyusdi gohusdi usonv lonohediyi.
english: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏕᎯᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏅᏏᏙᎯ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᏔᎵᏁᏉ ᏅᏗᏂᏁᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Getsinvsidasdi dehinetsehesdi tsunohiyudiyi unvsv digvwaninvsidohi, nigavquo nanadvnehv osdv uniyelvdi tsunilvwisdanediyi; talinequo nvdininegvna.
english: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎬᎾ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏚᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Naninosgisgvna, gvnigesvsgini nanvnehesdi nigav osdv nudalidasdvna gesvi; nasgi unoduisdodiyi nigavquo nanadvnehv nasgi dideyonvhi gesv Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi utseliga.
english: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎸ,
phonetic: Gvwagatiyayeno udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi nasgi adasdelisgi naniv yvwi uninanugotselv,
english: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎨᏲᎲᏍᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏓᏱᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Igeyohvsga, nasgi idadayihv Unelanvhi dinelododi nigesvna gesvi ale elohi ehi adulvnvdi gesvi, igalisinahisdi ale duyugodvi, ale Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv yidalenidoha ani elohi gesvi;
english: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏄᏛᏁᏍᏗ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;
phonetic: Yidigatiya osdv udugi gvdi gesvi, nasgi galvquodiyu nudvnesdi gananugotsilv galvquodi Unelanvhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv;
english: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏕᎦᏓᎵᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᎢᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi ayv tsidegadaliyohiselei, nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi igaguyvdiyi igudalesdiyi nigav asganvisdi gesvi, ale tsunvgalvdiyi uwasv tsutseli itsuwanediyi unadatselidv yvwi, ulinigidv unadanvti osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
english: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎯᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎯᎬᏍᎪᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᏒᎦᎸᎢ.  ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdesdi hinohesgesdi, ale dehiwonedisgesdi, ale dehigvsgolvvsgesdi hvdisgesdi nigav tsasvgalvi.  Hvdisgesdi Tlesdi gilo esga yitsayelvsesdi.
english: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎭᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏃᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Dehanvdadisdisgesdi tsunohiyudi gesv nunigvwiyusadegi ale digeganelodi gesvi, unohiyuhisdv iyulisdodi gesvi, nigohilvquo unadvnvisdi iyulisdodi gesv nigavquo osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.
english: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏧᎾᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo usonv uninohediyi nigesvna, tsunatiyosati nigesvna iyunalisdodiyi, unadanvtisgini iyunalisdodiyi, gvnigesv iyunvnediyi nanivquo anigatahv utsati unadanvtiyu gesvi.
english: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᎫ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏂᎪᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎢᎩᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏓᏛᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎢᏕᎲᎩ, ᎢᎩᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏓᏂᏆᏘᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Igvsvyeno nasquo ilvhiyu tsigesv iginegu gesvgi, nigohiyusvna, igilidastanvhi, gohusdi dedadvnehvgi tsudalenvdv adulvnvdi gesv ale osdv adadanvdadisdisgi gesvi, uyo gesv ale advyugedi idehvgi, iginiquatisdi, ale didadaniquatihi gesvgi.
english: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎨᏳᏒ ᎤᎦᏄᎪᏨ,
phonetic: Aseno hnaquo Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi udanvtiyu gesv ale yvwi dugeyusv uganugotsv,
english: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ ᎤᏮᏔᏅᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏕᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏙᏑᎴᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Vtla duyugodv digalvwisdanedi gesv gvdi ayv nasgi degilvwisdanelvi, nasgiyasgini udadolitsatiyu gesv igisdelvhvgi uwvtanvgi taline adedi gesv ugvwali adosulediyi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanetliyvsdi gesvi;
english: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᏥᎩᏐᏅᏰᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ;
phonetic: Nasgi utsuquisdi tsigisonvyeli, Tsisa Galonedv Igisdelisgi iyuwanisadv;
english: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv digadudalestanvhi gesvi, nasgi nasgiya ulisquadisdi nigesvna gvnidv igatseli iyulisdodiyi nasgiya udugi igvsvi.
english: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᏣᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiya igawedv; ale nasgi hia tsudalenvdv aquaduliha tsasdayidisdiyi, nasgi na Unelanvhi unohiyunvhi unagasayasdodiyi nigohilvquo osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi.  Hia nasgi osiyu ale gvwanalisdelvdodi yvwi.
english: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏘᏲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏕᎭᏓᏅᏒᎮᏍᏗ, ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ulisganisdvsgini kanohelvdi gesv ale unadanetliyvsvsvi, ale ditiyosdi gesvi, ale adisvsdi gesv dikahnawadvsdi ugvwali dehadanvsvhesdi, gvwanadasdelvdiyeno nigesvna ale asequoquo nasgi.
english: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏯᎨᏯᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏲᎢᏎᎸᎭ;
phonetic: Gilo digalenvdisgi saquo ale tali iyageyatanvhi gesesdi etsiyoiselvha;
english: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigatahesdi nasgi na yinusdi gilo ugolvdv gesvi, ale usganvtsvi, uwasvquo dadadugodanehvi.
english: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏘᎹ ᏥᏅᏒᎭ ᏫᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎦ, ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎾᎪᏆᎵ ᏍᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ; ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᏓᏇᎪᏔᏅ ᎠᏆᎪᎳᏗᏴᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuno Atima tsinvsvha witsalutsediyi, ale Digiga, hatlinigvnelvha Nagoquali sgilutsediyi; nahnayeno daquegotanv aquagoladiyvdiyi.
english: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎾ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏉᎳ ᎭᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸᎭ ᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsina dikahnawadvsdi digosisisgi ale Aquola hatlinigvnelvha Gisdelvdiyi anaisvi, nasgi gohusdi nuninigvsehvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏩᎾᏕᎶᏆ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo digatseliga wanadeloqua nigohilv osdv tsunilvwisdanediyi nasgi udulvdi nigalisdisgv gohusdi gvtanidasdi, nasgi aninequosgi iyunalisdodiyi.
english: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏂ ᏃᎦᏛᏅᎢ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎦ.  ᏕᎯᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nigadv ani nogadvnvi wigetsayoliga.  Dehiyolilvha nasgi na gegigeyuhi gohiyudi gesv nvdigalisdodisgvi.  Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ, ᏉᎳ, ᏥᏴᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ, ᏫᏍᏛᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏆᎵᎹᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏍᏛᎨᏳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ,
phonetic: Ayv, Quola, tsiyvgi Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgvi, ale Dimadi iginvtli, wisdvyowelasi Qualimani utsati isdvgeyui, ale utloyi digilvwisdanehi,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏍᏛᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏈᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏆ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏗᏩᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗᎤᎾᏓᏈᎬ ᎯᏁᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Ale isdvgeyui Aquiya, ale Agiqua, itsulaha idiwawisgi, ale tsunanelodiunadaquigv hinelvi;
english: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Igidoda ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Tsiyalielitseho Aquanelanvhi gvneisdisgo nigohilv gadadolisdisgvi,
english: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏛᎩᏍᎬ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏥᏕᎯᎨᏳᎭ;
phonetic: Gadvgisgv tsadageyusv ale tsohiyusvi, nasgi tsigeyuha Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa, ale naniv unadanvti tsidehigeyuha;
english: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na tsohiyusv tseladisdisgvi nasgi yinigvnisv gvnigesv yinigalisda nigav osdv gesv itsiyavi Tsisa Galonedv nvdigalisdodisgvi.
english: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎣᎨᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏛᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏕᎯᎦᎵᏍᏓᏕᎲᎢ, ᎥᎩᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Utsatiyeno ulihelisdi ogeha ale ugalisdi adanvdadisdi gesv tsadageyusv iyusdi, dvdigalisdodiha unadanvti tsuninawi dehigalisdadehvi, vginvtli.
english: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎩᎭ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏁᏤᎲ ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Udohiyuhisgininonv utsati agiha Galonedv aginelvi, nasgi gvnetsehv tsiduyugodi itsadvnediyi;
english: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏍᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᏥᏰᎸᏍᎦ ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏙᏗᏱ, ᏉᎳ ᎤᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎢᏯᏆᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno sgigeyuhiyu gesv nvdigalisdodiha utli tsiyelvsga gvsdiyedodiyi, Quola udvsonvhi iyaquasdi tsigi, ale gohi gesv ayvgi, Tsisa Galonedv agisdvdisgvi.
english: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎣᏂᏏᎹ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Gvsdiyediha aquetsi Onisima ugvwali nasgi vqualvidv gesv aquadenelvhi tsigi.
english: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ ᏂᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Nasgi tsuwagutanvsv nitsasdelisgvna tsigesvgi, gohisgini tsigi tsasdelisgi, ale ayv agisdelisgi;
english: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎥᏥᏅᎵ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏕᎯᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi taline vtsinvli; nasgi iyusdi nihi dehiyadanilvtsvha, nasgi aquvsv aginawi tsigi.
english: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᏥᏯᎧᎯᏯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂ ᎨᏙᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi aquadulisgvgi tsiyakahiyasdiyi ani gedohvi, nasgi nihi sgisdelvhidasdi gesv agisdelvhidasdiyi vqualvidv gesv osdv kanohedv agisdvdisgvi;
english: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏣᏰᎸᏅᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏆᏚᎸᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏍᏆᏛᏁᎲ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nihi osiyu nitsayelvnvna vtla yaquadulvhe gohusdi aquadvnediyi; nasgi osdv nisquadvnehv osiyu tsayelvnv gvnigesv iyulisdodiyi, vtlano nasgi ase itsadvnediyi nitsalisdanehvi.
english: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏞᎦ ᏳᏓᏅᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏘᏯᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyusdi yigi tlega yudanvsv nasgi tiyadanilvisdi nigohilv udediyi.
english: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎣᏅᏟ ᎠᎨᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎯᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᏍᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Vtla hnaquo atsinvsidasdi nasgiyai, utlisgini galvquodiyu esgaquo atsinvsidasdi, onvtli ageyuhi nasgiyai, ayv ho ugvwiyuha tsigeyui, nihisgini nigav utlihiyu higeyui, nasgi na uquedali gesv ale Ugvwiyuhi desdanelodvi?
english: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᎩᎾᏖᏉᎶᎯ ᏍᏇᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏕᎯᏯᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏕᏍᏆᏓᏂᎸᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno oginatequolohi squelisehesdi, dehiyadanilvtsvha ayv tsidesquadanilvgo nasgiyai.
english: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏚᎨᏍᏕ, ᎠᏴᏉ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏗ ᏅᏁᎸᎭ;
phonetic: Iyuno utsatini nitsadvnelesdi, ale hidugesde, ayvquo aquaguyvdi nvnelvha;
english: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏉᎳ ᎠᏋᏒ ᎠᏉᏰᏃ ᎬᏓ ᎪᏪᎸᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ; ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏨᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏚᎦ ᏗᏍᏆᏓᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏱᎬᏲᏎᎭ.
phonetic: Ayv Quola aquvsv aquoyeno gvda gowelvga, ayv dagaguyvhi; vtlasgininonv tsvsv gesv nasquo gvduga disquadayohisediyi yigvyoseha.
english: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᎮᏍᏗ ᏍᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏓ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎯᎦᎵᏍᏓᏓᏉ ᎠᎩᎾᏫ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᎾᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Vv, dinadanvtli, ulihesdi squadanvdadisda Ugvwiyuhi iyuwanisadv; higalisdadaquo aginawi Ugvwiyuhi denanelodvi.
english: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᏫᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏣᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏁᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Tsohiyusv aqualisgasdodv wigvyowelanelvgi, tsigatahvgi nasquo tsalosvsdodiyi gesv hnadvnehv nusdv gvnetsehvi.
english: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏍᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎭ ᏍᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ; ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo squadvnvisdanelvha sgisquanigododiyi; udugiyeno aquvha itsadadolisdisgv iyuwanisodiyi taline witsvlutsediyi.
english: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎦ ᎡᎦᏉ, ᏗᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏍᏗᏴᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎣᎩᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Wigetsayoliga Egaquo, ditsulaha osdiyvgi Galonedv Tsisa oginisdvdisgvi;
english: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎹᎦ, ᎡᎵᏍᏓᎦ, ᏗᎹ, ᎷᎦ, ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ
phonetic: Maga, Elisdaga, Dima, Luga, itsulaha tsogilvwisdanehi
english: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏏ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonesi tali udvdegesdi detsadanvdvi.  Emenv
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ, ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏕᎧᏁᏤᎮ ᏗᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Unelanvhi, nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesv, iyvdvhaquo ale tsudalenvdv gvtanvhi tsidekanetsehe digigayvlige anadolehosgi degvdisgvi,
english: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ ᎢᎩᏁᏤᎸ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎧᏅ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᏬᏢᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Gohi ulisqualvdi degesadisv iginetselv Uwetsi uwvtanv, nasgi uwekanv utseli iyulisdodiyi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv, nasgi nasquo gvdisgv elohi duwotlvnei;
english: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏕᎬᎩ ᏥᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏛᏔᏅ ᎤᏅᎦᎸᎭ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎤᏪᏁᎢ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi digalvsadadisgi tsigesvgi utseli galvquodiyu gesvi, ale nasgiya ditlilostanvhi tsigesvgi nasgi nusdvi, ale nigadiyu tsudalenvdv tsidusquanigodidegvgi tsigvdisgvgi ulinigidiyu kanegvi, nahiyu uwasv udadvtanv unvgalvha igisganvtsvi, uwenei agatisiditlv Galvquodiyu gesv galvladi.
english: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏁᎯᏯᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᏩᏛᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi igai utli iyudalinehiyadv nagvnele esga dinikahnawadidohi, nasgi utiyasdanedi gesv utli igalvquodi tsudosdodi tsuwadvtanv.
english: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎪ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎶᎢ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏂᎯ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏍᏆᏕᎲᏏ?  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ; ᎠᏴ ᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏯᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Dinikahnawadohiyeno gesv gago ilvhiyu hia nuweseloi, Aquetsi nihi gohi iga squadehvsi?  Ale nasquo hia; ayv Tsigayvlige gesesdi, nasgino na Ayatsi gesesdi?
english: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏫᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo, nahiyu igvyi udenelvhi elohi unanugowisv hia nuwesei; Ale naniv dinikahnawadidohi unelanvhi tsutseli wigvwadadolisdasi.
english: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏥᏂᏕᎬᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Dinikahnawadidohino hia nidegaweseha, Nasgi dinikahnawadidohi tsutseli unole tsinidegvneha, ale atsilv adawelagisgi tsunvsidasdi tsinigvneha.
english: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎭ, ᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ, ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ; ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎠᏛᏁᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏨᏗᎭ ᎾᎿᎭᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Uwetsisgini hia nigaweseha, Tsatseli gasgilv, Tsanelanvhi, nigohilv ale nigohilv nigvwasdiquo; adolanvsdi duyugodv advnedodi nasgi adolanvsdi gohusdi tsvdiha nahna tsagvwiyuhi gesvi.
english: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᏣᏰᎸᏅ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏣᏂᏆᏘᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏣᎶᏁᏔᏅ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏣᎵᎪᎯ.
