phonetic: Osiyu tsayelvnv duyugodv gesvi; ale tsaniquatilv uyo gesvi, nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi, nasgi nihi Tsanelanvhi utli igai tsalonetanv atlonedi osdv adadanvdadisdisgi, esgaquo nasgi na itsaligohi.
english: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ, ᎾᏍᏉ [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ] ᏂᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥ ᏣᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᏦᏢᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Ale, nasquo [hia nigaweha] Nihi, Tsagvwiyuhi, didalenisgv elohi gagusdav tsanei; ale galvloi ditsoyeni tsotlvtanei;
english: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏛᎾᎵᏛᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏣᏛᏁᏍᏗᏉ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᏁᏔᏥ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
phonetic: Dvnalidvtani nasgi; nihisgini netsadvnesdiquo; ale nasgi nigadv dayunetatsi anuwo nasgiyai;
english: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏃᎯ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏙᏘᏇᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏁᏣᏍᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏕᏘᏱᎶᏍᎬ ᎥᏝ ᏭᏍᏘᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale utanohi anuwo nasgiya dotiquenvhi, ale diganetliyvdv gesesdi; nihisgini netsasdiquo, ale detsadetiyilosgv vtla wustitsihisdi yigi.
english: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎶᎢ, ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏦᎴᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎨᏤᏍᎦᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ?
phonetic: Gadoge usdi dinikahnawadidohi gesv hia nuweseloi, Tsigatisiditlv tsolesdi gvni getsesgagi gasgilo ditsalasidiyi nigatsiyvnelvha?
english: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Tlasgo nasgi na nigadv didanvdo getsinvsidasdi yigi, getsinvsidv tsunisdelvhidasdiyi nasgi na alisdelvdodi gesv unatseli iyulisdodi tsigi?
english: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᏛᎦᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏗᎬᏍᎦᎶᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi utli igai igagasayasdodi yinigalisda nusdv igadvganvi, nasgi ilvhiyu digvsgaloisdiyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi.
english: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏥᏍᏛᏗᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno kanohedv dinikahnawadidohi gvnigesv iyunvnelvhi gesv ulinigidiyu yigi, ale nudalesv asganvtsvhi gesv ale nunohiyusvna gesv duyugodv getsisdvditanvhi yigi;
english: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏱᏓᏚᏓᎳᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᏧᎴᏅᎲ ᏧᏃᎮᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᎩᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ;
phonetic: Gado yigalisdoda yidadudalagi, iyuno nigagasayastanvna yigi nasgi igalvquodi alisdelvdodi; nasgi igvyi tsulenvhv tsunohele Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi ayv tsigegisdayidelvgi nasgi na gvwadvganelvhi;
english: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᎲᎩ, ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi nasquo degohiyudanehvgi, degvdisgvgi uyelvdv ale usquanigodi, ale usquanigodi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo udanedi gesv nasgiya uwasv osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
english: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏱᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏗᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Dinikahnawadidohiyeno vtla nunigvwiyusadegi yiniduwanelv nasgi nahna elohi uliyeilohisdi tsigesvgi, nasgi tsidineisdiha.
english: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎤᏁᏤ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᏙ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏯᎦᏔᏂᎯᎰᎢ?
phonetic: Asiyvwisgini ilvhitlv unetse, hia nuwesei, Gado yvwi nasgi tsiyadanvtesgoi?  ale yvwi uwetsi, nasgi tsiyagatanihihoi?
english: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᏂᎩᏴᏁᎸ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᏚᎶᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏂᏴᏁᎸ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏦᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Usdigidvquoyeno esga niyvnelv nigiyvnelv dinikahnawadidohi; digvwalvsada ale galvquodiyu gesv hisdulotanv, ale ugvwiyusadegi niyvnelv gohusdi tsotlvnvnvhi gesvi.
english: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᎸ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏃᎯᏰ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏱᎾᎬᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Nudalesv gohusdi tsulasideni hawiniditlv nidetsvnelv.  Nasgiyeno nigadv hawiniditlv tsinuwanelei, vtla gohusdi yunohiye nasgi hawiniditlv nuwanelvna gesvi.  Aseno gohi gesv vtla yidigowatiha nigadv hawiniditlv yinagvnelv.
english: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎶᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏲᎱᏎᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tsisasgini edigowatiha nasgi usdigidv esga iyagvnelvhi dinikahnawadidohi gesv nigegvnelvi, nasgi uyohuhisdiyi, digvwalvsadv ale galvquodiyu gesv atsisdelotanv; nasgi nvdayulisdodiyi gvwagatiya Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesv gvdisgv naniv yvwi tsuyohusediyi.
english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏓᏘᏃᎯᎲ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏗᏩᏛᎡᎯ, ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Aseyeno nasgi iyudvnedi gesei, nasgi na nudalesv gohusdi agotlvnanelvhi, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv nudalesv gohusdi gotlvnvhi tsigi, nasgi digvwalvsadv digesv widatinohihv unitsati tsuwetsi, nasgi unalisdelvdodi diwadvehi, nigalulogvna iyagvnediyi agiliyogvi.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏅᎦᎵᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏠᏱᏉ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏳᏰᎸᎭ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏧᏬᏎᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Itsulayeno nasgi na diganvgalisgi gesv ale nasgi getsinvgalisgi gesv unitloyiquo; nasgi iyusdi vtla udehohisdi yuyelvha otsalinvtli tsuwosediyi;
english: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ; ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏙᏓᎬᏃᎩᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Hia tsinuwesei, Detsadov gvnigesv nvdagatsiyvneli otsalinvtli; tsunanelodi unadatlugv ayeli dodagvnogistani.
english: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏂ.  ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᎩᎧᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale talinei, Nasgi datsiyalisgasdotani.  Alewo, Gvniyuquo ayv ale nasgi na diniyoli Unelanvhi digikanelvhi gesvi.
english: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏠᏯᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎠᏎᏉᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi diniyoli uniquedali ale gigv uninehi tsigi, uwasv nasquo nasgi utloyastane ugisei; nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv iyuwanisodiyi asequoquo iyuwanediyi nasgi na ayohuhisdi gesv ulinigvgv uhi, nasgi asgina tsigi.
english: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᏅᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᏲᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏕᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsuwudalesdiyi nasgi na ayohuhisdi gesv aninayesgv tsinvdigalisdisge danvnv igohidv tsunadayosvhi tsigesv degetsinatlavi.
english: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᏚᏬᏯᏁᏎᎢ, ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏬᏯᏁᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno vtla dinikahnawadidohi yiduwoyanesei, Equahamisgini unetlvtanvdv gesv duwoyanesei.
english: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏄᏛᏅᏅ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎵᏍᏛᎾ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏴᏫ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi duyugodvgi nigav nudvnvnv analinvtli nasgiya nunasdv iyulisdodiyi, nasgi udadolisdi ale nudalisdvna nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi iyulisdodiyi Unelanvhi utseli ugvwali, nasgi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi iyulisdodiyi unisganvtsv yvwi;
english: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎢ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno uwasv ugiliyotsvhi tsigi, nasgi atsigoliyesgvi yeliquo digvwasdelvdi nulistanv nasgi na getsigoliyesgi.
english: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏓᏘᏯᏅᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏓᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi etsilvquodi idalinvtli, itsatloyasdisgi galvladi ugvwali vdatiyanvdi gesvi, etsadanvdvli Galonedv Tsisa Atsinvsidv ale nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi nasgi tsedanelodi tsigi.
english: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎼᏏ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nulidastanvna gesv nasgi na unetselvhi, nasgiya nasquo Mosi nudalidasdvna tsigese nigav dudatinavi.
english: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᏎ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎼᏏ, ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi asgaya utli atsilvquodiyu atsiyelvse esgaquo Mosi, giloyeno adanelv unesgehvhi utli atsilvquodiyu geso esgaquo adanelvi.
english: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᏓᏓᏁᎸ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nigavyeno dadanelv gilo tsuwotlvnvhi gesoi; nasgi na nigav tsudalenvdv uwotlvnvhi gesv Unelanvhi.
english: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale mosi udohiyuhi nudalidasdvna gesvgi nigav dudatinavi atsinvsidasdi nasgiyai, nasgi gohiyudisgi iyulisdodiyi nasgi na tsudalenvdv gvnigesv igvnedi tsigesei.
english: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎦᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ ᎢᏖᎳ ᏥᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᏗᎩᏂᏴᎭ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedvsgini aganvgi nasgiya nudalidasdvna gesvgi uwasv dudatinavi; nasgi na dudatinav itela tsigi, iyuno ulinigidv yidiginiyvha gvlisquadisgi nasgi na igalisgasdodv ale idatlvquisdodisgv udugi gvdi gesvi.
english: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, Galvquodiyu Adanvdo hia tsinigaweha, Gohi iga iyuno kanegv itsadvgodiyi itsadulisgesdi,
english: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Tlesdi yiditsisdayodisgesdi ditsinawi, nasgiya nunadvnelv tsigvginalvstanvgi, nahiyu iga tsigvgigoliyevgi inagei;
english: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᏆᎦᏘᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Nahiyu ditsigayvlige tsigvgigoliyesgvgi, ale tsigvquagatisgvgi, anigowatisgvgisgininonv dagilvwisdanehv nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv.
english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏥᏂᏉᏘᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏚᎴᎾᎯᎭ ᏧᏂᎾᏫ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ ᏓᎩᏅᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gatsiniquotilvgi nasgi na yvwi, ale hia nagiwesvgi, Nigohilv dulenahiha tsuninawi; ale vtla unigadovsvhi yigi daginvnvi.
english: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nvdayulisdotanvgi aquaselitanvgi agitalawosgv, Nasgi uniyvsdiyu nigesvna gesv aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi.
english: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎾᏫ ᏳᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi, idalinvtli, tlesdiquo nihi gilo uwohiyuhisdv nigesvna unawi yuyaesdi, nasgi adanvehi gvnidv Unelanvhi.
english: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏂᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎨᏥᏍᏓᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Detsadawonidisgesdisgini nidugitsvnisvi, asiquo Gohi iga gagosedi tsigi; nasgi nihi gilo getsisdayohisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi udalidasdi asgani iyuwanisadv.
english: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᏰᏃ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ;
phonetic: Degadudadewisvyeno Galonedv, iyuno yinvwasdiquo deginiyvsv ulinigidv gvlisquadisgi igvyiyi igalisgasdotanvi;
english: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Hiayeno igawedv igi, Gohi iga iyuno itsadulisgesdi kanegv itsadvgodiyi, tlesdi yiditsisdayodisgesdi ditsinawi, nasgiya nunadvnelv nahiyu tsigvginalvstanvgi.
english: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ, ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏗᏅᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ?
phonetic: Gagoyeno hnaquo unadvganv, unihnalvstanei; tlasgo nigadv Itsiquiyi nidodayudinvstanvhi Yisi, nasgi yinunadvnelei?
english: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᏂᏆᏘᎴᎢ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏥᏚᏅᏤᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gago nvgasgohi tsudetiyvdv duniquatilei?  tlasgo nasgi na unisganvtsvhi tsigesei, nasgi na diniyelv inage tsidunvtsei?
english: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎪ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏴᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ?
phonetic: Ale gago dunetsele aselidvsgv nasgi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna gesv utseli atsaweyvlvsdodiyi?  tlasgo nasgi yigese na nunohiyusvna tsigesei?
english: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsinusdi idigowatiha nasgi wigvwaniyvsdi nigesvna gesv nvdigalisdodisgv nunohiyunvna gesvi.
english: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎢᏗᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏒᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᏂᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏦᎭᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayv idinayesgesdi nasgi svgiduisdanelv wigiyvsdiyi tsigi utseli atsawesolvsdodiyi, nasgi gvnigesv yinvgalisda nihi gilo esga itsohasvi.
english: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏥᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᎥᏝ ᏅᏂᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno osdv kanohedv egalitsidonelvgi, nasgiyaquo tsigegalitsidonelvgi nasgi; aseno nasgi na kanohedv unadvganv vtla nvnisdelvhei nvdigalisdodisge gohiyudi gesv nudasuyvna gesv anadvgisgvi.
english: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏴᎯᎭ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏪᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏍᏆᏛᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᎤ ᎤᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᎤᏛ.
phonetic: Ayvyeno igohiyunvhi gesv idiyvhiha atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi; nasgiya nuwesvi, Nasgiya aquaselitanv agitalawosgvi, nasgi uniyvsdiyi nigesvna gesv aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi gesvi; asquadvhisgininonv gesvgi degalvwisdanelv elohi tsudotlvu udagvwadaleudv.
english: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎸᎯᏢᏰᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏯᏪᏐᎴ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ilvhitlvyeno galiquogine iga uneistanv hia nuwesv, Ale Unelanvhi galiquogine iga uyawesole uyohistane nigadv dulvwisdanehvi.
english: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᏴᎭ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ani taline hia nigaweha, Vtla yvgvniyvha aquatseli atsawesolvsdodiyi.
english: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏄᏂᏴᎸᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino gilo ase nahna wuniyvsdi tsigi, ale nasgi na igvyi gegalitsidonelvhi gesv nanuniyvlvna tsigesei, nvdigalisdodisgv nunohiyusvna gesvi.
english: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏑᏰᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎤᏬᎯᏨᎯ ᎣᏂ ᏕᏫ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏔᏁᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo iga asuyeha, hia nigaweha uwohitsvhi oni Dewi agvdisgvi, Gohi iga, nasgiya hia igawedv tsigi, Gohi iga, iyuno kanegv itsadvgodiyi itsadulisgesdi, tlesdi yiditsisdayotanesdi ditsinawi.
english: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏦᏑᏩ ᏱᏚᏁᎴ ᎤᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎥᏝ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎣᏂ ᏱᎬᏩᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno Tsosuwa yidunele unatsawesolvsdodiyi, vtla [Unelanvhi] oni yigvwaneistane nvwadale iga.
english: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᎾᏘᏰᎭ ᎤᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi asiquo unatiyeha unatsawesolvsdodiyi gesv Unelanvhi tsutseliga yvwi.
english: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏴᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎤᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏐ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na uyvlvhi tsigeso utsawesolvsdodiyi, nasquo uyohistanvhi geso dulvwisdanehv, nasgiya Unelanvhi nudvnelv uyohistanvi.
english: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎦᏅᎢᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idatlinigvnehesdi wigiyvsdiyi, yinvsegagiyeno gilo nasgi tsudeloquaelvhi gesv nasgiya nuwohiyusvna gesv yvganvisda.
english: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏃᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᏂᎪᏍᏓᏴ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᏗᏢ ᏗᎬᎦᏘ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏴ, ᏕᎦᏘᎭ ᏔᎵ ᏂᎦᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏫᏢᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏛᏪᏙᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Kanohedvyeno Unelanvhi utseliga gvnodv, ale ulinigidiyu ale utlihiyu nigosdayv esgaquo ayelasdiganvhidv itsuladitlv digvgati digosdayv, degatiha tali nigadiha adanvtediyi ale adanvdo, ale duwitlvi ale dusdvwedogvi, ale digvwugododi igi nusdv adanvtesgv ale nusdv udulisgv unawi.
english: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏍᎦᎳᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏰᎸᎭᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏞᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᏗᎧᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏰᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gohusdi anelanvhi gesv agvsgalanelvhi yigi; nigadiyuquosgini uyelvhai, ale tsutledv nasgi dodikanv nasgi na gvnigesv iyedvnedi tsigi nigadvnelvi.
english: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏗᎪᏩᏗᎭ ᎢᎩᎧᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏭᎶᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsidigowadiha igikahv atsilvquodi nugvwiyusv Atsilvgelohi, nasgi galvlo wulosvhi tsigi, nasgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi, asdaya deginiyvsesdi dedanelodvi.
english: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎩᎧᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎩᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎩᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎲᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi yigikaha nasgi gegidolisdi nigesvna gesv degiwanigalvi, nigavquosgini atsigoliyehvgi ayv nasgiyai, aseno nasganvna gesvgi.
english: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎢᏗᎷᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎩᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎩᏂᎬᏎᎲ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nidisgaihvna idilugi nahna gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv gasgilvi, nasgi egidolisdiyi, ale igiwadvdiyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nasgi nahiyu iginigvsehv igalisdelvdodi.
english: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎨᎪᏣᎴᏛ, ᏴᏫ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ] ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
phonetic: Nanivyeno nugvwiyusv atsilvanelohi gesv yvwi anehv gegotsaledv, yvwi osdv iyunalisdanedi getsinetsehoi, nasgi [tsunilvwisdanediyi] Unelanvhi utseligohi ugvwali, nasgi digvwanalisgolvdodi iyulisdodiyi adanedi gesv ale atsilvgelasdodi nasgi asgani ugvwali;
english: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᏗᎬᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᎴᎾᎸᎯ; ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᎵᏚᏫᏍᏛᎩ ᎠᏩᏂᎦᎳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi yeli digvwedolisdi nanigatanavna, ale nasgi na unalenalvhi; uwasvyeno nasquo duliduwisdvgi awanigala gesvi.
english: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏎ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi iyusdi, nasgi yvwi unalisdelvdodi alisgolvdisgv nasquo uwasv ulisdelvdodi ase ulisgolvdodi gesoi, asgani ugvwali gesvi.
english: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ [ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ] ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᏯᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏯᏅᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᎵᏂ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo hia nasgi galvquodi [digalvwisdanedi] uwasvquo udanvtedv yagisgoi, gvni Unelanvhi uyanvdv yigi nasgiya Elini atsiyanvhvi.
english: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏳᎩᏎ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏪᏎᎸᎯ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏂᎯ, ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏍᏆᏕᎲᏏ, [ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᏅᎮᎢ.]
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo Galonedv vtla uwasv hia galvquodi digalvwisdanedi yugise nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi nagvnelvi; hiasgini iyuweselvhi, Aquetsi nihi, gohi iga squadehvsi, [nasgi uyanvhei.]
english: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎮᎶᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasquo ilvhitlv hia nigaweha, Atsilvhelohi nihi nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
english: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎸ, ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸ, ᎠᏍᏓᏴ ᏓᏠᏱᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏌᏬᎢᎲ ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎬᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏛᎦᏁᎴ ᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ;
phonetic: Nasgi na nahiyu uquedali gesv ulenidolv, udadolisdanelv ale utayoselv, asdayv datloyihv, ale dagasawoihv gvwatloyasdi nasgi na utayoselv nasgi yeliquo gvwasdelvdi gvwudalesdi gesv ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale agadvganele ganayesgv ugvwali;
english: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏕᎶᏆᎡ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Uwetsisgininonv gesei aseno uwohiyuhisda iyulisdodiyi udeloquae ugiliyotsv ugadovhistanei;
english: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ;
phonetic: Ale nugolvna nagvnelv, nasgi awatisgi nulistane winasdvna unalisdelvdodi gesv naniv gvwohiyuhvsgi;
english: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏬᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi Meligisidegi nasgiya uwoseha Unelanvhi.
english: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏲᎦᏛᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏦᏍᏗᏳ ᏗᎪᏏᏐᏗᏱ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏥᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi na otsinohesgv utsati gohusdi gayogadvdi, ale utsosdiyu digosisodiyi, nvdigalisdodisgv ditsisganoliyu gesv itsadvgodiyi.
english: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎨᏣᏕᏲᏗ ᎡᏤᎵᏎᎸᎢ, ᎤᏚᎸᏗᏉ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᎩᎶ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏤᏲᏗᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
phonetic: Nahiyuyeno yeliquo digetsadeyodi etseliselvi, udulvdiquo nitsalisdaneha gilo taline itseyodiyi nusdv igvyiyi dideloquasdi gesv Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv; ale unvdi unadulisgi nasgiya nitsalistanv, vtlano uyvsdi alisdayvdi.
english: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏅᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno gilo unvdi analisdayvdisgi vtla unigadovsvhi yigeso kanohedv adudalesdodi gesvi; diniyoliquoyeno.
english: For every one that useth milk is unskillful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏴᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏧᎾᏛᎾᏯ ᎤᏁᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᎩᏌᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Uyvsdisgini alisdayvdi tsunadvnaya unelisdayvdodi gesoi, nasgi na unigisahv iyusdi gvwanadolehohisdi geso osdv gesv nusdvi, ale nusdv uyo gesvi.
english: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎯᏯᏍᎬ ᎠᎴᏅᏙᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎦᎷᎶᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏗᏰᎢᎶᎦ; ᏔᎵᏁ ᎦᎫᏍᏛᏗ ᏂᏗᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᏓᎯᎯᏉ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idihiyasgv alenvdodi Galonedv utseli dideyodi gesvi, nigalulogvna gesv iyvdv widiyeiloga; taline gagusdvdi nidihvsgvna ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdv ugvwali, adahihiquo digalvwisdanedi tsigi, ale Unelanvhi gohiyudi gesvi,
english: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Didawosdi gesv dideyonvhi ugvwali, ale didasitadisdi gesv ugvwali, ale tsuniyohusvhi tsunalehisodi gesv ugvwali, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna digugododi gesv ugvwali.
english: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nvdadadvneli iyuno Unelanvhi yigalisgolvdanelv.
english: And this will we do, if God permit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᎦᏗᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎨᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Gvwatlisdiyeno nasgi na ilvhiyu iga gegadisdanelvhi gesvi, ale unanelotanvhi gesv galvloi nvdayudalenvhi adanedi gesvi, ale Galvquodiyu Adanvdo gegatloyastanv getsinelvhi.
english: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Ale unanelotanvhi tsigi osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale ulinigidv gesv ulisqualvdi gesvi,
english: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏤ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏭᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᏅᏒᏰᏃ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᎾᏓᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᏕᎰᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsuniyosvhi gesvi, gvwatlisdi taline itse igegvnediyi ganetliyvsdi gesv dunadanvdv wuniluhisdiyi; unvsvyeno taline unadadvnelvhi igi Unelanvhi Uwetsi, ale gvnigesv gvwadehohistanvhi igi.
english: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎯᏰᏃ ᏣᏗᏔᏍᎪ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏃ ᎤᎦᎿᎭᏂᎯᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᎠᏛᏒᎥᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎨᏥᎶᎦᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gadohiyeno tsaditasgo ama yano ugahnanihihvi, ale tsigananugowisgo advsvvsgi gohusdi unvdodi nasgi na gadohi getsiloganelvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi osdv nadvnehoi.
english: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏄᎦᎸ ᎠᏛᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏗᏅᏗᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥᏂᏳ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na tsisdunigisdi ale kanugalv advsgvi adinvdiquo, ale asgaisdiyi gesv navniyu nusdidegoi, nasgi ulisqualvdi gesv agohvsdodi tsigi.
english: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ, ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏅᏟᎯᏳ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏴᎾᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏃᏥᏪᎭ.
phonetic: Aseno, nihi gesv itsvgeyui, nvtlihiyu osdv udugi itsvyvnaneha, ale alisdelvdodi gesv ugvwali tali udvdidegvi, hiasgininonv notsiweha.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᎨᏳᏒ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno vtla niduyugodvna igvwadvnedi yigi nasgi uwagewisdiyi detsilvwisdanelv ale gvnigesv nitsvnelv itsigeyusv deudovi.  Nasgi detsisdelvhidolv unadanvti, ale asiquo detsisdelisgvi.
english: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᏱᎶᎸᎭ;
phonetic: Ale ogaduliha nitsiv itsisiyvwiha gesv gvlisquadisgi nasgiya igai itsatlinigvnediyi gvni utsati nudlasidvsvna udugi gvdi gesv witsiyilolvha;
english: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏗᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏄᏅᏁᎸ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi itsadanulvdiquo yigesesdi, ditsisdawadegisgini gesesdi nasgi na unohiyusv ale dinvnidiyu gesv anvdisgv unatseli nunvnelv aduistanvi.
english: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏒᎲ ᎬᏩᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏎᎵᏙᏔᏁᎢ,
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno Equahami uduisdanelv, nasgi gilo nvwadale utli iyatsilvquodi svhv gvwaselidodi nigesvna gesei, uwasv ehv uselidotanei,
english: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏅᏓᎬᏯᏛᏁᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᎬᏁᏉᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nuwesei, Udohiyuhiya utsati osdv nvdagvyadvneli, ale utsati dagvnequoi.
english: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᎦᏘᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Howano gohidiyu ugatidv atsinele aduistanvhi gesvi.
english: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎲ ᎨᎦᏎᎵᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ (ᎪᎱᏍᏗ) ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏲᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎾᏗᏒᎯᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno udohiyuhi utli iyatsilvquodi ehv gegaselidodisgoi; ale aselitanvhi gesv (gohusdi) asdayidisdodi ayohisdisgi geso anadisvhihvi.
english: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi udulisgv utli igai gvnigesv itsuwanediyi getsiduisdanelvhi nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesv nusdv adanvtesgvi, aselidvsgv usdayistanei.
english: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᏄᎵᏁᏨ ᏕᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᏥᎪᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏲᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎦᏗᏍᎦᎶᏗᏱ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᎩᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᎩᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎡᎩᏩᏌᏓᏁᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi tali nulinetsv dedvdisgv nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesvi, nahna gvwatsigodi nigesvna tsigeha Unelanvhi, ayv igiyolvhi tsigi igadisgalodiyi, ulinigidv igigalisdadisgi gegiwadvdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi diginiyvdiyi udugi gvdi egiwasadanehvi;
english: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎡᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏗᏏᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏩᏴᎯᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ;
phonetic: Nasgi udugi gvdi gesv nasgiya adanvdo ganahisdodi tsigi, esga nigalisdisgvna ale gvdisiyvsdi nigesvna, ale nasgi tsiwayvhiha nasgi ayedoladv udiditlv;
english: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏌ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎩ ᏫᎩᏴᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏥᎧᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nahna Tsisa igvyi egi wigiyvselvhi tsigi, nasgi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi nigohilv atsikanvhi tsigi, Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
english: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎹᏓᎩᏏᏕᎩ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏎᏓᎽ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏩᏍᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏥᏚᏠᏎ ᏧᏨᏏᏗᏒ ᏫᏚᎰᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏁᏤᎴᎢ;
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi Madagisidegi, Ugvwiyuhi Sedamu, atsilvgelohi gesei Unelanvhi wasdv galvladi ehi utseliga, nasgi Equahami tsidutlose tsutsvsidisv widuhonvhi unigvwiyuhi, ale osdv tsunetselei;
english: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏧᏁᎸᏁᎢ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ [ᏚᏙᎥ] ᎠᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏎᎳᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi nasquo Equahami nigadv tsugvwalodi ayehv asgohine gotsaledv tsunelvnei; igvyiyi gesv [dudov] anetlvtanvhi gesv Ugvwiyuhi duyugodv iyadvnehi gadvga, onino nasquo Selani ugvwiyuhi agoseha, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi nvwadohiyadv udulisgi tsigadvga.
english: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ ᎾᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᎤᎾᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᏚᎩᏨᏁᎬ ᏅᎫᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎲ ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi utseda ale utsi nanehvna tsigese, unanetlvtanvhi aninigidv tsigese, dugitsvnegv nvgudalenvhvna tsigese, ale ehv wusditsihisdi nigesvna tsigesei, Unelanvhisgini Nawetsi nasgiya tsinagvnelei, atsilvgelohi tseha nigohilvi.
english: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵᎾᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎤᏓᏬᏅᏛ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎤᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Etsadanvdvlinadi nigav atsilvquodiyu gesv hia nasgi asgaya, nasgi agayvlige Equahami uwasv asgohine gotsaledv udawonvdv ayehv unelvi.
english: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎵᏫ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎨᎦᏒᎦᎸᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏧᏂᏂᏢᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale udohiyuhi Liwi tsuwetsi atsilvgelasdi digalvwisdanedi gesv getsinedi gesvi gegasvgalvdisge asgohine gotsaledv tsuninitlvdiyi yvwi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi analinvtli gesvi, nasquo Equahami ayeli nvdayunadalenvhi gesvi.
english: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎵᏫ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᏅᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎴ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᎨᏅᏯ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na unanetlvtanvdv gesv Liwi anilasdalv nvtsudalenvhvna tsigi, asgohine gotsaledv dudanilvtsele Equahami, ale osdv unetsele aduistanvhi gesv tsagagenvya.
english: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎰ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nudlasidvsvna esga iyatsilvquodi gesv osdv unetseho utli iyatsilvquodi.
english: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎢᎨᏥᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎩᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎭ ᎠᎪᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ani yvwi diniyohusgi tsigi asgohine gotsaledv igetsinehoi; nahnasgini ugisei nasgi na eha agoselvhi tsigi.
english: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠᏉ ᏱᎾᎩᏪᏒ, ᎵᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᏗᏓᏂᎸᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁ ᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎤᎫᏴᎮ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᎫᏴᎲ.
phonetic: Ale hiaquo yinagiwesv, Liwi nasquo asgohine gotsaledv didanilvgi tsigi, asgohine gotsaledv uguyvhe nahiyu Equahami uguyvhv.
english: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏯᎡᎢ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎹᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏥᏚᏠᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Asiquoyeno udoda ayelv ayaei nahiyu Maligisidegi tsidutlosgei.
english: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎵᏫ ᏥᎨᎦᏒᎦᎶᏕ, ᏅᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, (ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏖ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨ) ᎦᏙᏃ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎹᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎡᎳᏂᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏰᎪᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno atsilvgelasdi gesv Aniliwi tsigegasvgalode, nvsganvna igvwadadvnedi yigesei, (atsilvgelasdiyeno gesv ale dikahnawadvsdi dunadudate yvwi ganadanilvtsv) gadono asi udulvdi nigalisdisge nvwadale atsilvgelohi unanugoisdiyi Maligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai, Elanino nasgiya gayegosedi nigesvna gesvi?
english: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Atsilvgelasdiyeno gesv udanetliyvdv gesvi, ase nasquo ganetliyvdv nigalisdiha dikahnawadvsdi.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎨᎳ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ] ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na hia nasgi ugvwali atsineistanvhi gesv utsatini anilasdalv gela gesvgi, nasgi [anilasdalv] udalenvhi vtla gilo atsilvgelasdiyi yidulvwisdanehei.
english: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏓ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎼᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Gvnigesviyuyeno nigalisdiha nasgi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsuda anilasdalv tsudalenvhvi; nasgi anilasdalv Mosi vtla yiduneistane atsilvgelasdi gesv ugvwali.
english: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᎦ,
phonetic: Ale asi utli gvnigesv nigalisdiha, iyuno Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiya nvwadale atsilvgelohi yigananugoga,
english: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi atsigigelohi nagvnelv dikahnawadvsdi uquedali ugvwali nasgiya nagvnelvna gesvi, gvnidvsgini alisquadisgi nigesvna ulinigvgv nasgiyai.
english: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᎮᎶᎯ ᎨᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nigaweha kanegvi, Atsilvhelohi geha nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.
english: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᏩᏂᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhiyeno iyvdv igvnelvhi nigalisdiha igvyiyi ulinetsvhi dikahnawadvsdi, awanigalahiyu gesv ale gvwadasdelvdi nigesvna gesv iyusdi.
english: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ; ᎤᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏝᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴᏔᏂᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏰᏗᎷᏤᏗ ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno vtla galulogi nigesvna igvnehi yigese gohusdi; utlisgini itlasdv udugi gvdi gesv ayvtanilvhi tsigi, nasgi idvdisgv nav gayedilutsedi tsinigalisdiha Unelanvhi galulogi nigesvna nigvneha.
english: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ,]
phonetic: Ale nasgi aselitanvhi gesv gvtanvhi tsigi [Galonedv atsilvgelohi iyagvnelvhi tsigi,]
english: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎮ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎬᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏎᎸᎯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏎᎵᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏁᏟᏴᎾ ᏂᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎮᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.)
phonetic: (Nasgiyeno na atsilvanelohi nigegvnehe aselitanvhi nigesvna; hiasgini na aselitanvhi gesv agvdanelei, hia nasgi iyuweselvhi, Ugvwiyuhi uselitanv ale vtla aganetliyvna nihi atsilvhelohi nigohilvi Meligisidegi nusdv nasgiyai.)
english: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᏫᎬᏁᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya iyvdv ulosvsdi tali advdisgi wigvnele Tsisa kanohedv datlohisdvi.
english: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎪᎯᏛ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi na hia atsilvanelohi unitsadvgi, vtlayeno gohidv gvwanadedi yigese ayohuhisdi gesv iyusdi.
english: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ [ᎠᏍᎦᏯ] ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏤᎭ ᎤᎶᏏᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiasgini [asgaya] alisquadisgi nigesvna tseha ulosihvsdi nigesvna atsilvgelohi gesvi.
english: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎬᏩᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎷᏤᎲᎢ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᏧᎵᏍᏗᏰᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nigohilv yeliquo nasquo digvwasdelvdi nasgi na uwasv gvwaluhisdanehi Unelanvhi anilutsehvi, winasdvnayeno eha tsulisdiyedanediyi.
english: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᎩᎵᎶᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎤᏲ ᎢᎬᏩᏓᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏄᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ, ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᎦᏓᏓᎴᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyusdi atsilvgelohi igililohvsgi gesvgi, nasgi nasganvna, uyo igvwadadvnedi nigesvna, asgana nudanvgalvna, anisgana anehv agadadaletanvhi, ale galvlo udiditlv iyvdv atsisaladanvhi;
english: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎤᏪᎳᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎢᏉᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi na udulvdi nulisdanehvna nidugitsvnisv atsilvuwelasdiyi, nasgi nanadvnehv nunigvwiyusadegi atsilvanelohi, igvyi unvsv unisganvtsv aguyvdodi, iquono yvwi unisganvtsv aguyvdodi; nasgiyeno hia saquo nudvnelei, nahiyu uwasv udalisgolvtanv.
english: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏄᏅᏁᎰᎢ; ᎧᏁᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏎᎵᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏁᏨ ᎣᏂ ᏧᎵᏁᏤᎢ, ᎤᏪᏥ [ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ] ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎦᎷᎶᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno yvwi diniwanagala nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi nunvnehoi; kanetsvhisgini aselitanvhi asdayidistanvhi gesvi, nasgi dikahnawadvsdi ulinetsv oni tsulinetsei, uwetsi [atsilvgelohi] nuwanele nasgi nigohilv galulogi nigesvna tsigi.
english: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏗᏃᎮᎭ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᎧᎭ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᏪᏅ;
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsidinoheha, hia nasgi ho nugvwiyusv nigalisdiha; nasgi nusdi igikaha nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi, nasgi agatisiditlv Galvquodiyu gasgilv galvloi uwenv;
english: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Tsulvwisdanehi galvquodiyu digesvi ale udohiyuhi digalitsodvi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi ulitsotanvhi gesvi, vtlano yvwi.
english: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎸᎯ ᎨᏐ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nanivyeno nunigvwiyusv atsilvanelohi getsinetselvhi geso tsunalisgolvdodiyi adanedi gesv ale atsilvdigelasdodi gesvi; nasgi iyusdi hia nasgi asgaya nasquo ase gohusdi uyohisdi gese ulisgolvdodi.
english: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᏰᎮᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᎠᏁᎭᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno elohi yigayehei, vtla atsilvgelohi yigagesei, ianehayeno atsilvanelohi adanedi gesv analisgolvdisgi dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv nasgiyai;
english: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎼᏏ ᏧᏁᏤᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗ ᏨᏗᎪᏢᏂᏎᎢ; ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎭ ᏧᏛᏁᎢ, ᏕᎰᏢᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᎣᏓᎸ ᏅᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahna tsidunilvwisdaneha ditlilostanvhi ale udawadisdodv galvladi ehi galitsodvi, nasgiya [Unelanvhi] Mosi tsunetsele nahiyu galitsododi tsvdigotlvnisei; hagasayastanvha tsudvnei, Dehotlvsgv nigadv tsudalenvdv nasgiya ditlilosdodi ahv nasgi tsetsananugowiselv odalv nvnelvha.
english: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᏓᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏧᎵᏍᏓᏱᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsinusdi gohi gesv utli igalvquodi digalvwisdanedi gesv uwadvhv, nvdigalisdodiha ayeli alehvsgi gesv utli iyosdv kanohedv datlohisdv ugvwalvi, nasgi utli iyosdv daduisdv tsulisdayisdi.
english: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎦᎫᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏔᏲᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv gaguhisdodi nigesvna yigesei, vtla nvwadale kanohedv ditlohisdodiyi yigvwanitayolei.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏛᏍᏆᎸᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Esgayeno uyelvnv hia niduweselei, Gvniyuquo, dvsqualvhi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi, nasgi itse kanohedv digatsiyatloisdanediyi Isili sidanelvhi gesv ale Tsuda sidanelvhi gesvi.
english: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᏂᏲᏯᏁᏒ ᎦᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏁ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᏥᏯᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Vtla nasgiya kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelv tsunigayvligei, nahiyu ganiyoyanesv gatsinugowisdiyi Itsiquiyi gada ahvi; vtlayeno yunisquanigotane kanohedv degatsiyatloisdanelvi, ale ayv vtla yigatsiyagasayastanei, adiha Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏓᏓᏥᎳᏂ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏙᏓᎪᏪᎳᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎦᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi nusdesdi kanohedv dodagatsiyatloisdaneli Isili sidanelvhi gesv nahiyu galosonvha adiha Ugvwiyuhi; dunadanvdv dadatsilani diquatseli dikahnawadvsdi, ale tsuninawiyi dodagowelani; Ale ayv Gatsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, unvsvno diquatseli yvwi gesesdi;
english: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏧᎾᏓᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎨᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᎦᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎯᎦᏙᎥᎯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎾᏂᎥᏉᏰᏃ ᎬᎩᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎡᎲ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎲ ᏫᎬᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vtla ale gilo asiyvwi gesv nav itsunadali, ale dinadanvtli gesv yigeyohvsgesdi, hia yinigawesgesdi, Higadovhi Ugvwiyuhi; nanivquoyeno gvgigatahiyu gesesdi, usdikani ehv nvdagvwadalenvdv, utli iyatsilvquodi ehv wigvsdi.
english: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᏥᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Dagatsiyadolitsiyeno utsatini nunadvnelvi, unisganvtsvno ale uyo nunadvnelidolv vtla hnaquo aquanvdadisdi yigesesdi.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏤ ᏥᎪᏎᎭ, ᏐᎢ ᎤᏪᏘ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.  ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏘ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏔᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ, ᎤᏲᏥᏕᏅ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino saquo itse tsigoseha, soi uweti nigvneha.  Gohusdiyeno uweti igvnelvhi ale uwetatsvhi tsigeso, uyotsidenv gesoi.
english: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Alewo udohiyuhi igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv dikahnawadvsdi degotlvsvgi unelanvhi utseli digalvwisdanedi ugvwali, ale elohi ehi galvquodiyu galitsodvi.
english: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏦᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎤᏃᏢᏁᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏃᏎᎮᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏓᏓᎯᏛᎢ, ᏥᎦᎧᎮ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎪᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏍᎩᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏣᏝᎮ ᎠᎦᏙᏗ ᎦᏚ;
phonetic: Galitsododiyeno unotlvnei, galvquodiyu gesv tsanosehei, nahna igvyiyi dadahidvi, tsigakahe atsvsdodi gagodiyi, ale gasgiloi, ale nahna tsatlahe agadodi gadu;
english: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᏗᏗᏢ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏣᏃᏎᎮᎢ;
phonetic: Talineno ayedoladv udiditlv hia nasgi galitsodvi utli igalvquodi tsanosehei;
english: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏣᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏥᏰ ᎦᏁᏌᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎶᏗᏱ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎫᏢᏔᏃᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏥᎦᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏖᎵᏙ ᎹᎾ ᏥᎦᎶᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏂ ᎤᏙᎳᏅᏍᏙᏗ ᏣᏥᎸᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏯᏖᏅ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᎪᏪᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi nahna tsahe gohusdi gvdodi adelvdalonige gotlvtanvhi gawasvgi atsilvgelasdi galodi, ale nahna tsitsiye ganesai dikahnawadvsdi digalodiyi adelvdalonige gutlvtanonvhi tsigesei, nahnani tsigale adelvdalonige gotlvtanvhi atelido mana tsigalodei, ale Elani udolanvsdodi tsatsilvsgei, ale nvya diyatenv nahna tsigowele kanohedv datlohisdvi.
english: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ [ᎦᏁᏌᎢ] ᏥᏴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᎩᎷᏫ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏄᏢᏕ ᎦᏁᏌᎢ ᎫᏢᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎦᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Ale [ganesai] tsiyv galvladitlv anigiluwi galvquodiyu iyanvnehi, nasgi tsunutlvde ganesai gutlvdi; nasgi ugvwali vtla gohi gesv nigadv ganeisdodi yigi.
english: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎰᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎮ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏓᏓᎯᏢ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᏫᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi osdv igvnehonvhi gesei, atsilvanelohi nigohilv waniyvhihe igvyiyi dadahitlv galitsodvi, widunilvwisdanehe [Unelanvhi] utseli ugvwali.
english: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏌᏉ ᏫᎾᏴᎯᎮ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏂᎦᏁᏤᎲᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Talinesgini wigalitsodv nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi uwasv saquo winayvhihe nidadetiyvhisvi, vtla ale gigv niganetsehvna yigesei, nasgi uwasv usganvtsv aguyvdodi, ale unitsati yvwi unisganvtsv aguyvdodi.
english: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᎦᏅᏅ ᎠᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᏂᎬᏩᏍᏕ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi Galvquodiyu Adanvdo hia nusde gvnigesv nigvnehei, nasgi na utli igalvquodi digesv wiganvnv asi gvnigesv igvnelvhi nigesvna gesvi, asiquo tsinigvwasde igvyiyi galitsodvi;
english: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯᏉ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᏥᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: nasgi galitsodv ditlilostanvhiquo tsigese nahiyu gesvi, nahnani tsidanalisgolvdisge adanedi gesv ale nasquo atsilvgelasdodi, nasgi na iyudvnelvhi yeli nasganvna igvwanedi nigesvna tsigese adanvdo ugvwali gesvi;
english: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏑᎴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi dilisdayvdiyiquo gesv ale aditasdiyiquo gesv ale digosulediyi gesvi, ale dikahnawadvsdi uquedaliquo gesv tsugvwalei, nasgi iyunadvnedi tsinigegvnele udanetliyvsdi gesv uliyeilohisdi gesv igohidv.
english: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎷᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎷᎶᏥᏙᎲᎾ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏮᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏯᏛᏅ, ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Galonedvsgini ulutsvhi tsigi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi iyulistanvhi tsulvwisdanediyi osdv gesv ugvwali uliyeilohisdi tsigesvgi, nasgi gvdisgv itli igalvquodi ale nigalulotsidohvna galitsodvi, gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwvtanvhi nigesvna uwotlvnvhi, nasgi yadvnv, anelanvhi nigesvna gesvi,
english: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏌᏉ ᏄᏴᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᎡᎸ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yvwi dinihanulvhi ale waga anigina unigigv gvdisgvi, uwasvsgini ugigv gvdisgvi, saquo nuyvle galvquodiyu digesvi, hnaquo nasgi winasdvna aguyvdodi igiwadvelv.
english: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏩᎦ ᏧᎾᎪᏅᏍᏓᎵ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎩᏏ ᎤᎪᏅᎯ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏕᎨᏥᏆᏲᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno waga tsunagonvsdali unigigv, ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv, ale waga agisi ugonvhi gosdu degetsiquayovsgv anigadaha, nanisganvna igvwanvnedi yigi nasgi uniquedalv ugvwali gesvi.
english: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᎪ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎬ, ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏙᏓᏥᏅᎦᎸᎡᎵ ᏙᏓᏥᎧᎲᏏ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎬᏂᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏤᏣᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏨᏁᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ [ᎠᏍᎦᎾ,] ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Ilago iyvdv igai utlihiyu Galonedv ugigv, ditsadanvdo dodatsinvgalveli dodatsikahvsi adahihi detsilvwisdanehvi, gvnidvno Unelanvhi tsetsanelododiyi nvdatsvneli nasgi winasdvna ehi Adanvdo gvdisgv nudanvgalvna [asgana,] Galonedv uwasv udalisgolvtanvhi tsigi Unelanvhi udalisgolvdanelvhi tsigi?
english: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎬᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏓᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎾᏘᏯᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ayeli alehvsgi nigalisdiha itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, nasgi uyohusvhi gesv gvdisgv digvwudalesdi iyudasdodiyi igvyiyi kanohedv datlohisdv uniyostanvi, nasgi getsiyanvdv tsigi unatseli iyulisdodiyi aduisdv winasdvna unatiyasdanedi gesvi;
english: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Kanohedvyeno ditlohistanvhi tsigesoi, ase ahisdi geso asdayidisgi kanohedv datlohisdvi.
english: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏏᏉ ᏥᎬᏃᎢ.
phonetic: Kanohedvyeno datlohisdv asdayiyu geso alisgolvdodi gesv alvhi tsigesoi; vtla ale asdayidvhi yigeso alisgolvdodi asiquo tsigvnoi.
english: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏛᎯ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎩᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi igvyiyi kanohedv ditlohistanvhi gesv vtla asdayidvhi yigese gigv gvtanvna nigesvna yigi.
english: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎼᏏᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᏚᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᏩᎦ ᎠᏂᎩᎾ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎤᏁᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏅ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏐᏈ, ᏚᏍᏚᏞᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Mosiyeno nigadv dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv dunanugowiselv yvwi nasgiya nigvnv dikahnawadvsdi, waga anigina unigigv ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv unegisei, ale ama ale uwanv gigagei, ale disoqui, dusdutleno goweli ale naniv yvwi.
english: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎬ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏥᏁᏤ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hia niwesgei, hia nasgi gigv, kanohedv datlohisdv asdayidisgi nasgi Unelanvhi tsitsinetse ditsikahnawadvsdiyi.
english: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏍᏚᏟᏍᏔᏁ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo gigv dusdutlistane galitsodvi, ale nigadv gohusdi digvtanidasdi dunilvwisdanehvi.
english: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎩᎬ ᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎠᏨᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏴᏓᏗᏙᎵᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nigavquo iyusdi dikahnawadvsdi nigvnv gigv ganvgalvdodi gesvgi; ale gigv atsvnvhi nigesvna yigi, asganvtsv vtla yvgayvdadidoligi.
english: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᏍᏗᏓᏅ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏤᎯ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ (ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ,) ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏤᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏲᎪ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏗᎦᏅᎦᎸᏙᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi udulvdi nigalisdisgvgi hia nasgi nigadv nusdidanv galvladi tsehi ditlilostanvhi gesv diganvgalvdodiyi hia nasgi (dilisgolvdodi,) galvladisgini tsehi gesv nayogo utli idigalvquodi dilisgolvtanvhi diganvgalvdodi.
english: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏭᏴᎸ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏕᎨᏒᎢ ᎩᎶ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏧᏮᏔᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ (ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ) ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒ ᏭᏴᎸ, ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Galonedvyeno vtla yiwuyvlv galvquodiyu degesvi gilo tsuwoyeni tsuwvtanvhi tsuwotlvnvhi gesvi, nasgi udohiyuhi (galvquodiyu gesv) ditlilostanvhi gesvi; galvladisgini nigesv wuyvlv, gohi gesv Unelanvhi agatahv gvnigesv igadvnediyi;
english: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛᎭᏉ ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎮᎬ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎬᏗ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏥᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏩᏴᎯᎮᎢ;
phonetic: Ale vtla udulvdi nigalisdisgv iyusdi iyvdvhaquo udalisgolvdodiyi, nasgiya nidadetiyvhegv, gohusdi unigigv gvdi nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi tsinadvnehe galvquodiyu gesv tsiwayvhihei;
english: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏕᎢ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏎ ᎢᏳᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ;  ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᏌᏉ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi yinusdei hnaquo utsati ase iyugiliyotsvhi yinigalisdisge elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv;  gohisgini gesv uwasv adalisgolvdisgv asgani gesv ahvsgvi saquo gvnigesv nudadvnelv ulisqualvdi degesadisvi.
english: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᎦᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏴᏫ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏧᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎣᏂᏃ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ale tsugagotanvhi tsigi yvwi saquo itsuniyohisdiyi, onino digugododi iga gesvi;
english: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎬᏩᎦᏖᏃᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏙᏛᎠᏛᏁᎵ ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎾᏰᎲᎾ
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo Galonedv saquo iyagalisgolvtanvhi ugisdiyi unitsati gesv unisganvtsvi; nasgino na gvwagatenohi gesv taline gvnigesv nidodvadvneli tsusdelvdiyi, asgani aguyvdodi nayehvna
english: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏩᏗᏍᏙᏛ ᏧᏪᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏓᏅᏗᏍᎬ, ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏥᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᎷᎩ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadvsdiyeno osdv uliyeilohisdi gesv udawadisdodv tsuwehvgi, ale akalii ditlilostanvhi nigesvna tsigesvgi, vtla yeliga, nasgi didasgolvdodi danvdisgv, nidadetiyvhisv nigohilv tsidanalisgolvdisgei nahna anilugi nunigolvna igvwanvnedi yigesei.
english: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏍᏔᏁ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎠᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉ ᏱᏄᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᎮ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏰᎸᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno yeliquo yigesei, tla yigvwaniyohistane tsunalisgolvdisgvi; analisgolvdisgiyeno gesv saquo yinunadanvgalvhe vtla hnaquo anisgana yigvwaniyelvsei.
english: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏗᏏᏐᏗᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini na danalisgolvdisgvi, nidadetiyvhisv unanvdadisisodiquo nigalisdisgo unisganvtsvi.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏩᎦ ᏧᎾᎪᏅᏍᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎲᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno waga tsunagonvsdali ale awi dinihanulvhi unigigv yeli gvwanihvsdi yigese asgani gesvi.
english: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ (ᎦᎶᏁᏛ) ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩᏂ ᏍᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi (Galonedv) elohi unanugotsilv, hia nuwesei, Atsilvgelasdodi ale ilisgolvdodi gesv vtla yeli yiditsayelvnei, ayelvsgini squadvnvisdanelv.
english: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Tsunosdv atsilvdigelasdodi ale dilisgolvdodi asgani aguyvdodi vtla osiyu yiditsayelvnei;
english: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎷᎩ, [ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎳ ᎥᎩᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ,] [ᏥᎷᎩ] ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ Ᏹ, ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hnaquono hia nagiwesvgi, Gvniyuquo tsilugi, [gowelihi gowela vginohesgvi,] [tsilugi] nusdv tsadulisgv iyaquadvnedi yi, Tsanelanvhi.
english: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏳᎳ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏗᏣᏰᎸᏁᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ;
phonetic: Gayula hia iyuwedv tsigi, Atsilvgelasdodi ale alisgolvdodi, ale tsunosdi atsilvdigelasdodi, ale dilisgolvdodi asgani aguyvdodi, vtla yeli yiditsayelvnei, vtla ale osiyu yiditsayelvnei; nasgi dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnv dilisgolvtanvhi tsigesei;
english: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏥᎷᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎢᎬᏱᏱ [ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ] ᎠᏲᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ [ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅ] ᎤᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquo hia nuwesei, Gvniyuquo, tsilugi nusdv tsadulisgv iyaquadvnediyi Tsanelanvhi.  Igvyiyi [uneistanv] ayosdiha, nasgi taline [uneistanv] usdayidisdiyi.
english: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ] ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎡᎩᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: [Unelanvhiyeno] osiyu uyelvdi eginvgalvdiyi Tsisa Galonedv ayelv saquo iyalisgolvtanvhi gesv iyuwanisadv.
english: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᏓᏂᏙᎨ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᏗᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale naniv atsilvanelohi danidoge dunilvwisdanehe nidadodaquisvi, ale nigohilv utloyiquo atsilvdigelasdodi tsunalisgolvdisgei, nasgi asgani gesv ilvhiyu yeli gvwahvsdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᎪᏙᏗ, ᎤᏪᏁ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎦᏗᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸᎢ;
phonetic: Hiasgini asgaya saquo iyulisgolvtanvhi gese atsilvgelasdodi asgani agugododi, uwene ulisquadisdi nigesvna agadisiditlv Unelanvhi uwolvi;
english: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎬᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ale hnaquo nigohilv agatiya gvni gvwasgagi tsulasidiyi gasgilo nigegvnelvha.
english: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏮᏔᏅ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏄᏂᎪᎸᎾ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Saquoyeno iyulisgolvtanvhi gesv uwvtanv ulisquadisdi nigesvna nunigolvna niduwanelv nasgi na nanisganvna igegvnelvhi.
english: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ; ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏂᎨᏐᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nasquo Galvquodi Adanvdo ogohiyudanehi; gayulayeno hia nasgi iyuwedv nigesoi,
english: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎶᏐᏅᎭ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᏗᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏙᏓᏥᎳᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᏙᏓᎪᏪᎳᏂ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nusdesdi kanohedv dodagatsiyatloisdaneli nahiyu galosonvha adiha Ugvwiyuhi; Diquatseli dikahnawadvsdi tsuninawiyi dodatsilani, ale dunadanvdv dodagowelani.
english: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale unisganvtsv ale uyo nunadvnelidolv vtla hnaquo aquanvdadisdi yigesesdi.
english: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nasgi asganvtsvhi gesv gayvdadinelvhi yigi, vtla hnaquo asgani aguyvdodi alisgolvdodi yinigalisdiha.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᏫᎨᎩᏴᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᎤ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎸᏉᏗᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, idalinvtli, nidinayesgvna wigegiyvsdi tsinulistau utli igalvquodigesv Tsisa ugigv iyuwanisanvhi.
english: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᏤ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᏅᏅ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏍᏓᏱᏕᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏰᏙᎳᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏥᎦᏛᎦ;
phonetic: Nasgi na itse ale gvnidv adanehi ganvnv gvtanvhi, nasgi igisdayidelvhi tsigi ayedoladv ulosvi, nasgi uquedalv tsigadvga;
english: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ [ᏥᎩᎧᎭ] ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ;
phonetic: Ale [tsigikaha] nugvwiyusadegi atsilvgelohi Unelanvhi utseli adanelv ugasayasdidegi;
english: And having an high priest over the house of God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᏅ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏤᎩᏍᏚᏞᎸᎯ ᏤᎩᏅᎦᎸᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏰᎸ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎹ ᏤᎪᏑᎴᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nav idilugesdi idvdisgesdi nutlonasdvnv diginawi, ale ulinigidv gohiyudi gesvi, ale diginawi tsegisdutlelvhi tseginvgalvhi uyo adanvtedi gesvi, ale didiyelv gadaha nigesvna ama tsegosuledanelvhi.
english: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒ ᏂᎦᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ; ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Asdaya deginiyvsesdi gvnigesv nigvnelv udugi igvsv nigadlasidvehvna; nudalidasdvnayeno nasgi na uduistanvhi gesvi.
english: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᏓᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏓᏂᎳᏕᏗᏱ ᏗᎩᏄᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ale dedadadanvtesgesdi, adageyudi gesv ale yisdv digalvwisdanedi gesv digadaniladediyi diginuwisdanediyi;
english: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᏱᏗᏑᎵᎪᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏓᏟᏌᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ; ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ; ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏥᏥᎪᏩᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏒ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ.
phonetic: Tlesdiquo yidisuligogesdi idadatlisanidohvi, igadv nasgi iyunadvnedi tsigi; detsadawonedisgesdisgini; ale ho ugvwiyusesdi, nasgi nitsadvnehesdi tsitsigowadi usqualvhidisv nahiyu iga.
