english: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏛ ᏱᏗᏍᎦᏅᎬ ᏚᏳᎳ ᎨᎩᎦᏁᎥᏒᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏯᎵᏃᎯᏯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ,
phonetic: Iyuyeno igvsv igadulvdv yidisganvgv duyula gegiganevsvhi duyugodv gesvi, vtla nvwadale yalinohiya atsilvgelasdi asgani aguyvdodi,
english: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎦᏖᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏛᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Unayehisdiquosgini odanvdv agatenasdiyi digugododi iga gesvi, ale utalawohisdi gesv atsilv nasgiya, nasgi unidvdodi tsigi gvwasgagi.
english: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨ ᎦᏰᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏔᎵᎭ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Gilo Mosi utseli dikahnawadvsdi iyvdv iyuwanetanvhi tsigese ayohusge gayetsidolisdi nigesvna anitaliha anigatahi uninohelvhi gvtanvhi;
english: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎳᏍᏓᎡᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎩᎬᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Tlasgo utli igai yinidogvwayugodi atsisdvdisdodiyi gilo Unelanvhi Uwetsi ulasdaelvhi, ale nasgi na gigvkanohedv ditlohisdotanvhi nasgi udanvgalotanvhi gesv gadaha uyelvnvhi, ale gagvwasotlvtanvhi gvwagatiya adadoligi Adanvdo.
english: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏞᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᏱᎰᏩ.  ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁᎢ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Edigatahayeno nasgi na hia iyuwedv tsigi, Atleisdi gesv ayv aquatseliga, ayv dagaguyvhi, adiha Yihowa.  Ale talinei, Yihowa dodagugodaneli tsutseli yvwi.
english: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏬᏰᏂ ᏫᏗᎩᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unayehisdiyu gvnidv Unelanvhi tsuwoyeni widiginvisdiyi.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏂᏕᏣᏗᏍᏓᏁᎶᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᎸᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Aseno itsanvdada tsuwagutanvsvi, nasgi nahiyu iga nidetsadisdaneloi, utsati itsatlinigvnelv detsigatilvsv agiliyoisdi gesvi;
english: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ ᏕᏣᎵᎪᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigayetsisotlvdvi, ale tsetsigiliyoisdisgvi; ilvhiyuno detsaligonelv nasgi igegvnelvhi.
english: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏆᎸᎢᏛᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏍᎩᏯᏙᎵᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᎥᏣᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᎡᏥᏬᏅᎲ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏫᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ.
phonetic: Vqualvidvyeno gesv iyusdi vsgiyadolitsvgi, ale ulihelisdiquo vtsadanvdvgi etsiwonvhv tsugvwalodi itsihvi, itsigatahvgiyeno galvladi witsisquanigodv utli iyosdv ale ayogi nigesvna tsugvwalodi.
english: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏨᏁᏔᏅᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tlesdi iyvdv itsvnetanvgi itsohiyusvi, nasgi utsati udaguyvedi tsigi.
english: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎸᏗᏳ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏏᏳ ᎤᏴᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsvnidiyu itsalisdodiyi udulvdiyu nitsalisdaneha; nasgi hnaquo Unelanvhi usiyu uyvlvdi gesv itsadvnelvhi gesesdi, itsatseli igvwalisdodi yigi nusdv aduisdvi.
english: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏙᎯᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquoyeno nigohilvnaquo, nasgi uluhisdi tsigi dagalutsi, ale vtla yvdvdohidi.
english: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏃ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏗᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᎠᏨᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Unadanvtino gohiyudi gesv unadvnidisdesdi; gilosgini iyusdi iatsvsgesdi aquadanvdo vtla osiyu yuyelvsesdi nasgi.
english: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎾᏨᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ [ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ] ᎢᏖᎳ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏥᏩᏂᎷᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎢᏖᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᏓᏂᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Aseno vtla anatsvsgi tsigi [unadatlugv] itela yigi, nasgi getsidvdodi gesv iyvdv tsiwaniluga, nasgisgini na unadatlugv itela, nasgi unohiyusv tsidanisdelvdi tsunadanvdo.
english: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᏩᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudino gesv hia nusdi gadvgvi, ulinigidv gohiyudiyi agowadvdiyi gesv nusdv udugi owasvi, ale nudlasidvsvna iyudalisdanediyi ehv nasgi na asi agohvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno anvdisgv eti unadenvhi osdv getsinohediyi uniwadvhvgi.
english: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏙᎵᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏚᏙᏢᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv idvdisgv idoliga Unelanvhi kanegv gvtanvhi gesv elohi dudotlvnvi, nasgino tsudalenvdv agowadvdi tsigi vtla nasgi na gvnigesv iyulistanvhi gesv digotlvtanvhi yigi.
english: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎨᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏩᏛᏔᏁ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎤᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏩᏁᎴ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎬᏗᎭ ᎧᏁᎦ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Equili utli iyosdv ulisgolvdanele Unelanvhi atsilvgelasdodi gesv esgaquo Geni, nasgi nudvnelv uwadvtane gohiyudisgi udaudiyu gesvi, Unelanvhi gvnigesv nuwanele dudanilvtselv ulisgolvtanvhi gesvi; nasgino nudvnelv gvdiha kanega nasquo uyohusvhi tsigi.
english: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎾᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏘᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ; ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎾᎦᏘᎾᏫᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Gahiyudi gesv gvdisgv Inagi agatinawidvhe nasgi ayohuhisdi gesv ugowadvdiyi nigesvna; ale vtla yatsiwadvhei, Unelanvhiyeno utinawidvhei; asiquoyeno nagatinawidisgvna gese Unelanvhi osiyu uyelvdi gesv dulvwisdanehv gvnigesv nagvnelei.
english: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏛᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᎷᏤᎭ ᎠᏎ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᏴᎡᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎬᏩᏲᎯ.
phonetic: Gohiyudisgini gesv nidvdisgvna yigi gvwatlisdi osdv uyelvdi [Unelanvhi] digilvwisdanediyi; giloyeno Unelanvhi yigalutseha ase yigohiyuhvsga ehvi, ale nasgi diguyvehi gesv ulinigidv gvwayohi.
english: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏃᏯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏯᏔᏅ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎾᏰᏎᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᏥᏳ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᎤᏮᏔᏁ ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Noya, Unelanvhi uweyatanv uneisdanelv tsudalenvdv asi ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi, unayesei, udvnvistane tsiyu unalisdelvdodi dudatinavi; nasgi nudvnelv uwvtane duwugodanele elohi, ale utseli nulistane nasgi duyugodv gesv gohiyudi gesv tsvdidalehvsga.
english: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎣᏂ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏤᎢ ᎾᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎢᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Equahami nahiyu atsiyanvhv ilvhitlv uwenvsdiyi nasgi nahna oni iyvdv utseliga iyagvnedi gesvi, tsuwohiyunei; ale tsunugotsei nagatahv nahna aisvi.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᎯᏉ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏙᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᏕᎦᎵᏦᏛᏉ ᎠᏁᎮ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv edohiquo iyusdi uwedole nahna atsiduisdanelv gadohi, nvwanadale unatseligohi nasgiya, degalitsodvquo anehe itsulaha Esigi ale Tsegaqui, nasgi unatloyasdisgi tsigese utloyi aduistanvhi gesvi.
english: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏖᏃᎮᏰᏃ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏗᎦᎫᏍᏓᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Agatenoheyeno gaduhvi digagusdai, nasgi Unelanvhi unesgehvi ale uwotlvnvhi tsigi.
english: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏎᎵ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏧᎵᏂᎪᏎ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏁᎵᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎵ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏧᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎶᏐᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏰᎸᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv nasquo gvdisgv Seli uwasv tsulinigose yeliquo gvwaneliisdi tsinulistanei, ale ayoli tsunanugowise hnaquo tsudananugowisdiyi ulosonelvhi tsigesei, nvdigalisdodisge nudalidasdvna uyelvnv nasgi na uduistanvhi gesvi.
english: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏃᏈᏏ ᎦᎸᎶ ᏣᏂᎧᎳ ᏥᏄᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏳ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎦᎳᎨᏴ ᎬᏎᎰᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏳᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino asiyvwi gesv tsunadalenei ale nasgi uyohusvhiquo nasgiya gesvi, noquisi galvlo tsanikala tsinunitsuquisdi iyunitsuquisdi, ale noyu amequohi utsati tsigalageyv gvsehohvsdi nigesvna tsigi iyunitsuquisdi.
english: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎬᏩᏃᎯᏳᎯ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏎᎢ, ᏂᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏨᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏅᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᏓᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎲᏍᎨ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏙᎯᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nigadv gvwanohiyuhi duniyohusei, nidunadanilvtsvna nasgi na getsiduisdanelvhi gesvi, invsgini widanigowatisgei ale nunadlasidvehvna gesei, ale duniniyvhei, ale aninohvsge nvwanadalequo ale anedohiquo gesv ani elohi.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎾᏅᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᏲᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia iyaniwesgi, gvnigesviyu nanvneho unatseligohi uniyohvi.
english: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏳᎾᏅᏖ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏂᏄᎪᏨᎢ ᏳᏫᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᎴᏉ ᎥᎤᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno yunanvte nahna tsuninugotsvi yuwidlanvdadelequo vunatsvsdiyi;
english: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᏲᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏕᎰᏍᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᏗᏱ; ᏚᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᏰᏃ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gohisgini utli iyosdv unatseligohi uniyoha, nasgi galvloi disquanigodvi; nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi vtla yadehosga nasgi Unelanvhi agosediyi; dudvnvisdanelvyeno gaduhvi.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Equahami, nahiyu atsigoliyev Esigi ulisgolvtanei; ale nasgi na atsiduisdanelvhi gesv uwasvhiyu uwetsi ulisgolvtanei.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏥᏪᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏏᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi na hia iyatsiweselvhi tsigesei, Nasgi Esigi dudov getsiyanvdisgesdi tsanetlvtanvhi gesvi;
english: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎦ ᏧᎴᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏱᎩ; ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Unetanvhi yeliquo nulinigvga tsuledodiyi elisgei, nasquo uyohusvhi yigi; nahna nasquo tsidudanilvtse ditlilostanvhi nasgiyai.
english: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᏤᎦᏈ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏐ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏏ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Esigi osdv tsidunetsele Tsegaqui ale Iso gohusdi asi uliyeilohisdi gesv ugvwali.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᎦᏈ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏚᏁᏤᎴ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏦᏩ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᎪᎵ [ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏕᎢ.]
phonetic: Tsegaqui gohiyudi gesv gvdisgvi, hnaquo ayohusgei osdv dunetsele itsula Tsowa tsuwetsi; ale udadolistane udolanvsdiyi usgoli [ulisdelvdei.]
english: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏦᏩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᎢ, ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᏤ ᏧᎪᎳ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Tsowa hnaquo ayohusgei, uneistane Isili tsuwetsi unadanvsdiyi; ale tsunetse tsugola ugvwali.
english: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎼᏏ ᏧᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏅ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᎦᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏰᏃ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᏂᏍᎦᎢᎮ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv anvdisgv Mosi tsugayvlige nahiyu udenv tsoi iyanvdo tsigvwasgalvnei, anigowatisgeyeno uwoduhiyu gesv ayoli; vtla ale yanisgaihe ugvwiyuhi unetsvi.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎼᏏ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏔᏅ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏲᎢᏎᎴᏉ ᏇᎵᏲ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎪᏎᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Mosi hnaquo utanv nulistanv uyoiselequo Queliyo uwetsi ageyv, uwetsi agosediyi;
english: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏑᏰᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏰᎸᏁ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎲ ᎤᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏞᎦ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Usuyeha utli uyelvne Unelanvhi tsutseli yvwi anigiliyotsidohv utloyasdodiyi, ano asgani tlega osdv udadanvdadisdodi gesvi;
english: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᎵᏍᎨ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᏃ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ; ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏫᏓᎧᏂᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Utli galvquodiyu elisge gayetsisotlvdodiyi Galonedv gesv iyusdi, ano tsugvwalodi asquanigodv Itsiquiyi; agaguyvediyeno gesv iyvdv widakanisgei.
english: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᎨᏎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ; ᎬᏂᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏰᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Itsiquiyi udanvsei, nasgaihvna gese ugvwiyuhi utalawosgvi; gvnidiyusgini gesv nasgiyaquo tsagowatisgo nasgi na gayetsigowadvdi nigesvna gesvi.
english: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᏟᏍᏗᏱ [ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ,] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᏗᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv unetse kanohiyegi dilisdayvdiyi unisquanigododiyi, ale gigv unisdutlisdiyi [galohisdiyi,] nasgi igvyi unadenvhi didvdisgi gohusdi unvnediyi nigesvna.
english: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎺᏉᎯᎩᎦᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᏂᎶᏎ ᎤᎧᏲᏛᎯ ᏣᏂᎶᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎢᏥᏈᏱᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎬᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv anvdisgv amequohigigagesdvyi ayeli unilose ukayodvhi tsanilosgo nasgiyai; Itsiquiyino anehi unanelotanv nasgi iyunadvnediyi dunigvtsei.
english: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏐᏴ ᏤᎵᎪ ᏚᏪᏒᏙᎠᏎᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏂᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv anvdisgv dasoyv Tseligo duwesvdoasei, hnaquo galiquogi tsusvhidv nidunaduwistanei.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏛᏔᏁ ᎨᏥᏛᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏥᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᏛᏂᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Gohiyudi gesv gvdisgv Lehawi unegutsidv vtla yatsidvtane getsidvtanv nasgi na nunohiyusvna tsigesei, nasgi dohiyi tsidudanilvtse iyusdi unigadvnidohi.
english: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏏ ᏓᎦᏛᏂ?  ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎬᎩᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏱᎦᏥᏃᎮᎸ ᎩᏗᏯᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏇᎴᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎻᏏᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᏈᏓ; ᏕᏫ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale gado asi dagadvni?  vtlayeno gvgisquadisdi yigi yigatsinohelv Gidiyani, ale Quelegi, ale Samisini, ale Tsequida; Dewi nasquo, ale Sami, ale anadolehosgi.
english: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᏥᏓᎾᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᎾᏅᏁᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᏅ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏥᏓᏂᏍᏚᎲᏍᎨᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi gohiyudi gesv anvdisgv ayeli degotlvsv tsidanadalinehidehei, duyugodv tsidunilvwisdanehei, unatseli tsinanvnehe nusdv getsiduisdalvi, tlvdatsi uninodenv diniholi tsidanisduhvsgei,
english: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᏣᏅᏜᏓᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏣᎾᏗᏫᏎᎮᎢ, ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎮᎢ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏂᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᎾᎵᎲᎢ, ᏥᏓᏂᎨᎯᏙᎮ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Atsilv usgasedi tsanvdladisgei, ayelasdiganvhidv tsanadiwisehei, diniwanagala gesv tsunalinigidv tsinigegvnehei, nanisgaihvna ninanalisdisge danalihvi, tsidanigehidohe nvwanadale aniyawisgi.
english: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏂᏙᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎮᎢ; ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᎨᏥᎩᎸᏍᎨᎢ, ᏂᏓᎾᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾ ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏍᎬᎢ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Anigeyv digvwaniyohuhiselvhi dinvnodv taline nidogetsiyohisehei; igadvno tsigetsigilvsgei, nidanadanilvgvna gegudalesgvi; nvdigalisdodisge utli iyosdv uniwadvdiyi unadulisgv dilehisodi gesvi;
english: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨ ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᎵᎥᏂᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᎢᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᏥᏍᏚᎲᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Igadvno getsigoliyesge gagetsisotlvdisgv ale degetsilivnihvi, ale nasquo degegalvihv ale degetsisduhvsgvi;
english: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏯ ᏕᎨᎬᏂᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ, ᏗᎦᏄᏙᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏕᎨᏥᎦᎵᏍᎨᎢ, ᏕᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ; ᎠᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᏧᏂᏁᎦᎸᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ; ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎮᎢ.
phonetic: Nvya degegvnisdisgei, diganudogi gvdi degetsigalisgei, degetsigoliyesgei, ayelasdiganvhidv degetsiisdisgei; awi uninodena ale awi dinihanulvhi tsuninegalvnvhi tsunanuwai anedohei; uninigvsehi gesei, anigiliyotsidohei.
english: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: [ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ;] ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏍᏓᎦᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᏔᎴᏒᎢ.
phonetic: [Nasgi hia vtla elohi gvwanadedi yigesei;] inage anedohei, ale dodalvi, ale dusdagalvi, ale gadohi datalesvi.
english: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᏚᎾᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi nigadv hia osdv getsinohesgi tsigese unohiyusv iyuwanisadv, vtla nusdv getsiduisdanelv yidunadanilvtsei;
english: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏂᎷᎶᏤᎲᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi Unelanvhi igadvnvisdanelvhi gesv iyusdi gohusdi utli iyosdv, nasgi nunilulotsehvna igegvnediyi nigesvna ayv nigatloyasdisgvna.
english: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᏕᎨᎦᏚᏫᏍᏗ, ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏛᏁᏓ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎯᏛ ᎨᎦᏢᏔᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏙᎩᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎩᏯᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏁᎬᏁᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgino iyunitsuquisdi anigatahi tsidegegaduwisdi, iyvdv nidvneda nudalesv gagedv igvnehi, ale asgani ahidv gegatlvtasdi tsigi, ale didvnidiyu gesesdi idadogiyasgesdi adogiyasdi igvyiditlv negvnelvi,
english: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏕᏓᎦᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏤᎢ, ᎤᎵᏌᎵᏉ ᎤᏰᎸᏎ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Widedaganisgesdi Tsisa nasgi iyuwanisadv, ale asquadisgi tsigi igohiyusvi.  Nasgi ulihelisdi gesv igvyiditlv nagvnelv iyusdi gvnidiyu dadahnawasdv ugiliyotsei, ulisaliquo uyelvse udehohisdi gesvi, ale agatisiditlv uwenv Unelanvhi uwesgilvi.
english: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵᏉᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏚᏪᎵᏎᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏯᏪᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᎾᎦᎶᏨᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Etsadanvdvliquosgini na nasgi igai gagvwasotlvdv anisgana unelagi duweliselvi, nasgino tlesdi ditsiyawetsvgi ale tlesdi tsuwanagalotsvgi detsadanvdvi.
english: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎢᏥᎩᎬ ᎤᏨᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏗᏣᏟᏴᎲ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏕᏣᏟᏴᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla asi itsigigv utsvisdiyi iyvdv yiditsatliyvhv asgani detsatliyvehvi.
english: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎡᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏥᎨᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᏇᏥ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏅᎵᏌᎵ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏩᎾ ᎯᏳᏏᎦᎶᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᎬᏍᎪᎸᎢᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Ale itsvgewisvhi igi etsiwonedisgv diniyoli tsigetsiwonedisgo nasgiyai, hia tsinigaweha, Aquetsi tlesdi nvlisali yitsayelvsesdi Ugvwiyuhi tsagiliyoisdisgvi, ale tlesdi wana hiyusigalogesdi tsagvsgolvisgesdi,
english: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎵᎥᏂᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na Ugvwiyuhi ugeyuhi agiliyoisdisgoi, ale degalivniho naniv tsuwetsi nasgi tsudanilvtsvhi gesvi.
english: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎲ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎦᎪᏰᏃ ᎡᎭ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏄᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ?
phonetic: Iyuno etsigiliyoisdisgesdi, nasgiya tsuwetsi nidadvnehv nitsadvneha Unelanvhi; gagoyeno eha ayoli nasgi udoda nugiliyoisdisgvna?
english: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏁᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏴᏛᏉ ᎢᏣᏕᏂᏙᎸᎯ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏕᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Iyusgini ilvhiyu netsigiliyoisdisgvna yigi, nasgi nigadiyu diniyoli nasgi igegvnedi tsigi, hnaquo iyvdvquo itsadenidolvhi, vtlano osdv itsadenvhi yigi.
english: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎩᏙᏓ ᏕᎨᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎨᏗᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ; ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏟ ᏱᏂᏙᎬᏩᏳᎪᏗ ᏤᏓᏓᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏗᎦᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Alewo, uquedali gesv Digidoda degehvgi, nasgi tsigegigiliyoisdisgvgi; ale gedilvquodiyu tsigesvgi; tlasgo utli yinidogvwayugodi tsedadayohisediyi digadanvdo tsuwotlvnvhi tsigi, ale igadvnidisdiyi?
english: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏞᎦ ᎨᎩᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲᎩ; [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ] ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na udohiyuhi tlega gegigiliyoisdisgvgi unvsv anadanvtesgv nanadvnehvgi; [unelanvhisgini] osdv igalisdanedi ugvwalv, nasgi itsatloyasdisgi iyulisdodiyi uwasv asgana nigesvna gesvi.
english: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏲᏉᏍᎩᏂ; ᎣᏂᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nigavquo agiliyoisdi gesv gohi gesv vtla osdv odanvdadisdisgi yigi, uyoquosgini; onisgininonv iyvdv nvwadohiyadv adanvdadisdi gesv gananugowisgo duyugodv gesv unanugowisvhi, nasgi iyunalisdanelvhi.
english: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏌᎳᏛᎦ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᏧᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏂᎨᏂ ᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ditsisaladvga ditsoyeni eladi itsulistanvhi tsigi, ale ditsinigeni diwanagalai;
english: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎾᏕᏍᎩ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏕᎦᏅᏅ ᎢᏥᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏲᎤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᎪᎸᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ; ᎧᏅᏬᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Vnadesgi nitsvga deganvnv itsilohisdiyi, nasgino ayouli gesv tlesdi yunigolvstanesdi; kanvwodiquosgini gesesdi.
english: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᏂᎩᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎩ;
phonetic: Nvwadohiyadv detsikahnawadisesdi nanivquo gohusdi detsadadvdisgvi, ale nasganvna gesvi, kanigidv yigi nasgi, vtla gilo yeli Ugvwiyuhi gvwagowadvdi yigi;
english: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎤᏬᎭᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬ ᎢᏣᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ;
phonetic: Itseyatahiyu gesesdi nasgino tlesdi gilo esga uwohasvgi Unelanvhi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesvi; tlesdi uyvsdi uhnasdetlv gananugogv itsadeyadotanvgi, ale nasgi iyuwanisadv unitsati gadaha iyunalistanvgi;
english: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᏣᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏴᏫ, ᎢᏐ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏍᎩ ᏌᏉᏉ ᎢᏯᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᏥᏚᎬᏩᎶᏔᏁ ᏧᎾᏗᏅᏎ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo udelidv dinisihvsgi yitsadasuyesdi, ale asgana yvwi, Iso nasgiyai, usgi saquoquo iyalisdayvdi tsidugvwalotane tsunadinvse igvyi ehi gesvi.
english: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎣᏂ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏣᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ [ᎤᏙᏓ] ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎬᏩᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ, ᎤᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ ᎤᏲᎴᎢ.
phonetic: Itsigatahayeno oni iyvdv osdv iyagadvnediyi tsudulisge tsatsisonvistanei; vtlayeno [udoda] udanvdv gvwanetliyvsdi gesv yuwadvhei, ulisinahisdiyusgininonv ale digvgasawoihi uyolei.
english: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎬᏒᏂᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏥᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎬᎿᎭᎨ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏳ ᎰᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Vtlayeno odalv gvsvnisdi gesv yitsilutsv, ale nasgi tsadaweligisgei, vtla ale gvhnage ulogilvi, ale ulisigiyu hosv ale ganolvvsgvi,
english: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎤᏃᏴᎬᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏔᏲᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᏂᏪᏎᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale atselugi unoyvgvi, ale kanegv unoyvgvi; nasgino unadvganvhi unitayole taline nasgi igeniwesediyi nigesvna.
english: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎾᏜᏓᎢᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏳᏃᏟᏍᏔ ᎣᏓᎸᎢ ᎠᏎ ᏅᏯ ᏣᎬᏂᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᎶᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno osiyu yuniyelvne nusdv ulinetsvi, Nasgi ganadlaiquo nasquo yunotlista odalvi ase nvya tsagvnisdodi gesvi, ale atsiyosdiquo gesv digvwalosvhi.
english: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎼᏏ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᎾᏰᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᎭ.
phonetic: Ale unigohv utsati unayehisdiyu gesv nasgi iyusdi Mosi hia nuwesei, Utsati tsinayesga ale aginawiha.
english: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏯᏂᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎢᏥᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏎᎰᎲᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Sayanisgini odalv itsilutsv, ale gvnidv Unelanvhi utseli gaduhvi, nasgi Tsilusilimi galvladi ehi, ale digvsehohvsdi nigesvna getsinvsidasdi tsunadatlugvi,
english: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏚᎾᏙᎥ] ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏥᏕᎪᏪᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎯ [ᎡᎲᎢ,] ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ [ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,]
phonetic: Ale nahna nigadiyu unadatlisahvi, ale igvyi unadenvhi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nasgi [dunadov] galvladi tsidegowela, ale nahna Unelanvhi nigadiyu Digugodanehi [ehvi,] ale nahna tsunadanvdo unadanvti yvwi nanisganvna igegvnelvhi [anehvi,]
english: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏌ [ᎡᎲᎢ] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎩᎬ ᎠᏍᏚᏢᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏲᏍᏛ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᏈᎵ [ᎤᎩᎬ.]
phonetic: Ale nahna Tsisa [ehvi] nasgi ayeli alehvsgi itse kanohedv datlohisdvi, ale nahna gigv asdutlvhi gesvi, nasgi utli iyosdv atayohihi tsigi esgaquo Equili [ugigv.]
english: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗᏉ ᎡᏥᏲᎢᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎧᏁᎦ.  ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏄᎾᏓᏗᏫᏎᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎤᏟᎯᏳ ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏓᏗᏫᏎᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏱᏁᏓᏛᏁᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᎧᏁᎦ;
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi tlesdiquo etsiyoiselvgi nasgi na tsikanega.  Iyuyeno nunadadiwiselvna yigi nasgi na uniyoisedv elohi unetsvhi, utlihiyu gvwatlisdi igadadiwisediyi iyuno iyvdv yinedadvnelv galvladi tsvdikanega;
english: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏖᎸᏁᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒ, ᎠᏏ ᏌᏉ ᏅᏓᏥᏖᎸᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎡᎶᎯᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎦᎸᎶᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ.
phonetic: Nasgi na kanegv nahiyu elohi utelvnei; aseno gohi gesv uduistanv, hia nuwesv, Asi saquo nvdatsitelvni vtla elohiquo uwasv, galvloisgini nasquo.
english: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ ᎠᏏ ᏌᏉᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏗᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏖᎸᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎬᏤᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia tsinigaweha Asi saquoi, nasgi iyvdv idigvnedi gesv nasgi ditelvnvhi gesv gadvga, nasgi digotlvnvhiquo nasgiyai, nasgino na tsudalenvdv digvtselvdi nigesvna gesv nahnaquo disquanigododi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᏗᎨᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᎬᏗᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasgi ayv digadanilvtsvhi tsigi ugvwiyuhi utseligohi gesv nasgi gvtelvdi nigesvna, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv igihesdi, nasgi idvdisgv Unelanvhi osdv uyelvdi digegilvwisdanedi yigi, galvquodiyu gesv, ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv tali igvdidegvi.
english: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Iganelanvhiyeno atsilv adagohvsdisgi.
english: For our God is a consuming fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗᏎᏍᏗᏉ.
phonetic: Analinvtli digeyudi gesv nvwasdidisesdiquo.
english: Let brotherly love continue.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᎨᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏗᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ; ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitsvgewisgesdi niditsadagatahvna ditsisquanigododiyi; giloyeno nasgi nanadvnehv galvladi anehi getsinvsidasdi tsunisquanigotanvhi igi.
english: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᎣᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏲ ᎢᎨᎬᎾᏕᎩ, ᎢᏨᏒᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎢᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Detsanvdadisgesdi digegalvidv gesvi, nasgiya itsulaha tsidetsalvoi; ale nasgi na uyo igegvnadegi, itsvsvyeno nasquo ayelv itseha.
english: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏨᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏤᎲ ᎦᎳᏫᏎᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎤᏕᎵᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Ditsvsdi gesv nanivquo anehv galvquodiyu gesesdi ale danatsehv galawisedi nigesvna gesesdi; udelidvsgini dinanisihvsgi ale dinadayonehi Unelanvhi dodagugodaneli.
english: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎵᏠᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎢᏥᏰᎵᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏴᎦᎬᏰᎵᏏ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏴᎦᎬᏴᏕᎩ.
phonetic: Detsilvwisdanehv tlesdi tsugvwalodi agvvhisdi gesv yulitloyasdesdi; ale yeliquo itsiyelisesdi nusdv gohusdi itsihvi; hiayeno iyuwedv igi, Vtla ilvhiyu unelagi yvgagvyelisi, vtla ale yvgagvyvdegi.
english: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎨᎩᏪᏍᏗ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᎦᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᏴᏫ ᎢᎦᎬᏋᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nidinayesgvna hia igegiwesdi, Ugvwiyuhi agisdelisgi, ale vtla yvgatsisgaya yvwi igagvquvnedi gesvi.
english: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎯᏌᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ,
phonetic: Detsanvdadisgesdi nasgi na getsagasayasdidegi, nasgi na Unelanvhi utseli kanohedv getsinanugowiselvhi; nasgi nusdv unohiyusv itsisdawadisesdi, osdv itsadanvtehisadv gesesdi nusdv wuliyeilolv dunilvwisdanelvi,
english: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏒᎯ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Tsisa Galonedv nvwasdiquo usvhi tsinusdv, ale gohi iga, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
english: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎫᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᎵᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᏗ ᎣᎾᏫ; ᎥᏝᏃ ᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᎥᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gudalenvdv ale nitsigatahvna dideyodi gesv yiditsatinidohesdi; osiyuyeno gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv yulisdayidisdi onawi; vtlano nusdvquo vlisdayvhvsgvi, nasgi gohusdi unalisdelvdodi wuliyeilolvhi nigesvna gesv nasgi iyusdi unagasayastanvhi gesvi.
english: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᏢᎭ, ᎾᎿᎭᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Atsilvgelasdiyi igotlvha, nahna vtla yiduyugodi unalisdayvdiyi galitsodvquo gohusdi anadvnehi tsigi.
english: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏥᏫᎦᏁᏨᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᎾᎪᎲᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Alewo nvgi dininvsadi unigigv galvquodiyu digesv tsiwiganetsvsdisge nugvwiyusv atsilvgelohi asgani aguyvdodi, nasgi diniyelv galitsodv doyiditlv danagohvsdisgei.
english: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ [ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ] ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi Tsisa nasquo, nasgi, nanisganvna itsuwanediyi yvwi uwasv ugigv gvdisgvi, galohisdiyi [Tsilusilimi] doyiditlv ugiliyotsei.
english: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᎾ ᏪᏗᎷᏥ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idena wedilutsi galitsodv doyiditlv, igatloyasdisgesdi gayetsisotlvdisgvi;
english: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩᏚᎭ, ᎢᎩᏲᎭᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏴᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aniyeno vtla ayogi nigesvna yigiduha, igiyohasgini nasgi iyusdi uliyvilohisdi gesvi.
english: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎩᎭᎦᎸ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎢᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏛᏁᎲ ᎡᏓᎵᎡᎵᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi iyuwanisadv nigohilv Unelanvhi galvquododi gesv idalisgolvdisgesdi, nasgi degihagalv tsunanugowisvhi idalisgolvdisgesdi, nasgi deudov gvnigesv nidvnehv edalielitsehvi.
english: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏫᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Osdvsgini ditsilvwisdanediyi ale itsadanediyi tlesdi itsvgewisvgi; nasgiyeno iyusdi dilisgolvdodi gesv osiyu uyelvha Unelanvhi.
english: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉ; ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᏚᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏲᏉ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Detsohiyusesdi nasgi na getsagasayasdidegi, ale detsadayosgesdiquo; ditsadanvdoyeno dunagasayasdidega, nasgiya iyunadvnedi tsigi nasgi na gvnigesv iyunvnedi tsigeso nunadvnelidolvi; nasgi analiheligv gvnigesv igvwanvnedi yigi, vtlano uyoquo dunadanvdvi; nasgiyeno vtla getsalisdelvdodi yigi.
english: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎣᎪᎯᏳᎭᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏙᎬᏅ ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲ ᏱᏍᏛ ᎢᏲᎦᏛᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsadadolisdisgv ayv sgineisdisgesdi; ogohiyuhayeno osiyu nidogvnv tsogadanvdo, ale ogaduliha nigavquo notsadvnelidohv yisdv iyogadvnediyi.
english: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦᎾᎨ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏮᏆᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiasgininonv itsadvnediyi utli igai itsvsdiyediha, nasgi tleganage ditsehv taline wvquatinohisdiyi.
english: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᏗᏃ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᎸᎯ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎩᎬ, ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ,
phonetic: Unelanvdino nvwadohiyadv adanehi, nasgi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa uyohusv taline tsuletanvhi tsigi, nasgi na atsilvquodi Awidigatiya iyagvnelvhi, gvtanvhi gigv, ayogi nigesvna kanohedv datlohisdv asdayidisgi,
english: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏨᏁᎲ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.  ᎠᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nitsigolvna itsvnedi gesesdi, nigav osdv digalvwisdanedi gesv nasgi digetsilvwisdanedi osiyu uyelvdi iyulisdodiyi, nasgi osdv uyelvdi gesv itsadvnediyi nitsvnehv Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv; nasgi atsilvquododi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.  Amenv.
english: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏓ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
phonetic: Ale itsvsdiyediha, idalinvtli, udanvti ditsadanilvisdiyi itsvwonedisgvi; ilvsgiquoyeno ikanetsvhi itsvwoneda ani gowelihi.
english: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎹᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏁᎳᏛᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ ᎢᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏕᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsanvtesdi nasgi Dimadi idalinvtli uneladvi; iyuno nigohilvna igalutsvha itsvgowadvdi igesesdi nasgi osdehesdi.
english: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.  ᎢᏓᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Detsiyolilvha nigadv getsagasayasdidegi, ale nigadv unadanvti.  Idali anehi wigetsiyoliga.
english: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv detsikahnawadidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎻ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏩᏅᏏᏛ, ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏂᏥᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Tsimi, Unelanvhi ale Tsisa Galonedv gvwanvsidv, witsiyoliga taladu nitsilasdalv itsadigaleyotsvhi tsigi.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏩᏛᎡᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, utsati ulihelisdiyu itsiyelvsesdi, iyuno tsudalenvdv itsigoliyesgi itsaliwadvehesdi.
english: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᏂᏨᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi itsigatahesdi, itsohiyusv agoliyedi gesv itsvnidiyu nitsvnehvi.
english: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏃᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ.
phonetic: Adina itsvnidiyu gesv ukalitsvhi tsulvwisdanedi gesv dulvwisdanehesdi; nasgino nihi itsikalitsvhi ale itsinosdv gesesdi, gohusdi nitsigolvna.
english: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎬᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏔᏲᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏄᎵᏏᏅᏛᎾ ᏗᏁᎯᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏍᎦᎬᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎠᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo nihi itsehv agadovhisdi gesv unigvgesdi, Unelanvhi atayosehesdi, nasgi naniv nulisinvdvna dinehitsigi, ale nidasgagvna tsigi; ale ase atsinedi gesesdi.
english: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ; ᎤᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎯᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎰ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎨᎯᏙᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Adina uwohiyuhiyu gesesdi atayohihesdi, gohusdi nudlasidvehvna; Udlasidvehiyeno nasgiquo amequohi dalisdilanegv unole tsunolvtanidoho ale tsugehidohoi.
english: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏛᎩᏁᎵ, ᏰᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi nasgi asgaya, Ugvwiyuhi gohusdi dvgineli, yelisgesdi.
english: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏓᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏌᏘ ᎨᏐᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Asgaya tali iyudai udanvdvi unetliyvsati gesoi nigav dulvwisdanehvi.
english: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᏩᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏓᏅᎢ,
phonetic: Itsadanvtli gesv uyo iyudvhnadegi waliheligi atsisaladanvi,
english: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎢ; ᎧᏃᏍᎦᏰᏃ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᏥᎦᎶᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ.
phonetic: Uwehnaisgini eladi nagvnelvi; kanosgayeno utsilvsv tsigalosgo nasgiya dagalosoni.
english: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎵᎧᎸᎩᏉᏰᏃ ᏅᏙ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏴᏗᏍᎪ ᎧᏃᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᎦᏙᎠᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏚᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᎠᏲᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢ ᏓᎬᏴᏏ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Likalvgiquoyeno nvdo udilegi, hnaquo gvyvdisgo kanosga, ale utsilvsv gadoasgoi, ale uwoduhiyu gesv udotlvsv ayogoi.  Nasgiya nasquo uwehnai dagvyvsi dulvwisdanehvi.
english: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏧᏱᎵᏙᎰ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯᏰᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎠᏥᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na asgaya ugoliyesgi tsuyilidoho gvnidiyu tsigesoi, atsigoliyevhiyeno gesesdi gvnidv alisdulo atsinvnedi gesesdi, nasgi Ugvwiyuhi tsuduisdanelvhi tsigi gvwageyuhi.
english: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎩᎪᎵᏰᎭ ᎤᏛᏅᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎦᏰᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎠᎬᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi gilo iyuno atsigoliyesgesdi, Unelanvhi agigoliyeha udvnvgi; Unelanvhiyeno vtla gayetsigoliyedi yigi uyo agvdanehvi, vtla ale uwasv gilo yagoliyesgoi.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᏘᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏌᏛᎥᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini atsigoliyesgoi iyuno uwasv udulisgv tsutinehi ale tsusadvvsgoi.
english: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏙᏢᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ; ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏃ ᎠᏍᏆᏓ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Hnaquono adulvdi gesv adotlvna asgani gananugowisgoi; asganino asquada hnaquo ayohuhisdi gesv gananugowisgoi.
english: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏂᎵᏓᏍᏓᏅᎩ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ;
phonetic: Tlesdi inilidasdanvgi, itsvgeyui idadanvtli;
english: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎣᏌᏂ ᎠᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᎠᏏᎯᎭ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎤᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᏴᎳᏛᏫ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nigav osdv adanedi gesvi, ale nigav osani adanedi gesv galvladi didalehvsga ale atloasihiha didalehvsga Agayvligesdvyi igagati uwehi, nasgi gvwadanetliyvsdi nigesvna gesvi, ale gvwagatahvsdi gesv nudayvladvwi gesvi.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏛ ᎢᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎡᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Uwasv udanvtedv iginanugowisv uwatanv kanohedv gayegogi nigesvna, nasgi ayv igvyi eganelanvhi nasgiya igalisdodiyi nasgi geganelanvhi gesvi.
english: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎾᏂᎥ ᎣᏏᏄᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ, ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsvgeyui idalinvtli, naniv osinuliyu gesesdi na udvgodiyi, usganoliyu gesesdi unineisdiyi, usganoliyu unitalawohisdiyi.
english: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Yvwiyeno utalawosgvi vtla yigananugowisgo duyugodv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏅᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏱᏝᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvnehesdi nigav gadaha gesvi ale ulosvstanvhi uyo gesvi, ale udadolisdi itsvtanvha detsadanilvtsvha kanohedv gvyitlanvhi, nasgi yeliquo digvwasdelvdi tsigi ditsadanvdogi.
english: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗᏃ ᎢᏣᏛᎩᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᏒ ᏱᏣᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseno kanohedv nigawesgv itsadvnehi gesesdi, tlesdino itsadvgisgiquo uwasv yigesesdi, itsvsv yitsadalidasdisgesdi.
english: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏓᏤᎸ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ ᎠᏓᎨᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno gilo advgisgiquo yigi iyadvnehino nigesvna yigi kanohedv nigawesgvi, nasgi asgaya datselv tsagowatisgo nusdv uwasv ukadvi adagediyi;
english: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎪᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Uwasvyeno adagowatisgoi, ale adanvsgoi, gilaquono iyvdv uwagewisgo nusdvi.
english: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᎧᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏯᎢᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ, ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini osdv agoliyesgesdi akalilvhi dikahnawadvsdi gvdakahvsgi tsigi, ale gayaisesdi, nasgi asgaya osdv udanvdadisdi gesesdi dulvwisdanehvi, nasgiyeno uwagewisati nigesvna advgisgi, tsulvwisdanehisgini digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ, ᏂᎦᎾᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏃᎪᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏫ ᎦᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏧᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏎᏉᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo itsehv yudasuya tsunelodi yinvwasdi, niganahisdisgvnano yigi ganogoi, uwasvquosgini unawi galidasdisgi yigi, nasgi asgaya tsunelodi gesv asequoi.
english: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᏁᎶᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ, ᏗᏩᏛᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏂᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᎾᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏄᏚᏯᏍᏛᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏄᎾᏍᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Osdv dinelododi gesv ale gadaha nigesvna agatahv Unelanvhi Agayvligei, hia nusdi, Diwadvhidasdiyi tsunadaniyadv ale tsunosulotsvhi uyo nunadvnadegvi, ale ulisquanigododiyi uwasv nuduyasdvna iyulisdodiyi elohi anehi nunasdv iyulisdodiyi nigesvna.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎡᏦᏳᏒ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏳᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, etsoyusv Galvquodiyu Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv, tlesdi tali yudvdesdi didalvquododi gesvi.
english: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏳᏴᎵᎸ ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎥᎢ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎤᎵᏰᏑᏍᏙᎩ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏳᏴᎵᎸ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎾᏕᎩ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ;
phonetic: Iyuyeno gilo asgaya yuyvlilv detsilawivi adelv dalonige uliyesusdogi tsuwoduhi tsunuwai, nasquono yuyvlilv uyo iyudvnadegi digadaha tsunuwai;
english: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏰᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᏃ ᏧᏬᏚᎯ ᏧᏄᏩᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸ, ᎠᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎲᎦ, ᎤᏲᏃ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏁᏥᏪᏎᎸ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾ ᎯᏙᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎲᎦ ᎯᏆᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏍᎩᎸ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ;
phonetic: Yetsilvquotanvno tsuwoduhi tsunuwai, ale hia yinetsiweselv, Ani osdv gesv hihvga, uyono iyudvhnadegi hia yinetsiweselv, Nahna na hidogesdi, ale ani hihvga hiqualasidiyi agisgilv hawiniditlv;
english: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏗᏧᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ?
phonetic: Tlesdi hnaquo detsadanvdv yiditsadalvquodiha, ale tlasgo ditsugodisgi uyo itsadanvtesgi yinitsalistanv?
english: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᏚᏑᏰᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎤᏁᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏙᎵᎦ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᎨᏳᎯ?
phonetic: Itsadvgvga itsvgeyui idalinvtli, Tlasgo Unelanvhi yidusuyesv uyo iyunadvhnadegi elohi anehi, unehnaiyu gohiyudi gesvi, ale unadoliga utseligohi nasgi tsuduisdanelvhi tsigi gvwageyuhi?
english: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏰᏥᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ.  ᏝᏍᎪ ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏂᎨᏨᎿᎭᏕᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏱᏗᎨᏣᏘᏃᎯᎰ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Nihisgini vtla yetsigasayastanv uyo iyudvhnadegi.  Tlasgo tsunehnai uyo yinigetsvhnadegoi, ale yidigetsatinohiho digugododiyi?
english: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᏯᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᏤᏦᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ?
phonetic: Tlasgo yanisotlvisdisgo galvquodiyu deudov nasgi nihi tsetsostanvhi tsigi?
english: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏥᎧᎵᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ, "ᏨᏒ ᏥᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᎭ ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ," ᏣᏗᎭ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuno itsikaliihesdi galvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi nasgiya nigvnv gowelvi, "Tsvsv tsinitsadageyuha nigeyusesdi nav idisdadala," tsadiha, osiyu yinitsadvga.
english: If ye fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ ᏙᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏉ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᏧᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyusginino dotsadalvquodisgesdiquo, itsisganvgesdi, ale dikanawadvsdi detsugodanehesdi itsisganvtsvhi gesvi.
english: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ, ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏉᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏲᏍᏗᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏲᏍᏔᏃᎢ.
phonetic: Giloyeno nigadv dikahnawadvsdi yidakahnawadega, sudalegiquono gohusdi yayosdiha, nigadv duyostanoi.
english: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, "ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ," ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎢᎩ, "ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏓᎸᎩ;" ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏱᏣᏓᎸ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Hiayeno iyuwedv tsigi, "Tlesdi tsadayonelvgi," nasquo hia iyuwedv igi, "Tlesdi tsadalvgi;" nasgino iyuno nitsadayonelvna yigi, aseno yitsadalv, Hnaquo dikahnawadvsdi hiyosdisgi nulistanv.
english: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᎧᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᎬᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Itsinegvi ale detsilvwisdanehvi nasgiya gesesdi nusdv unineisdi gesv ale tsunilvwisdanedi gesv nasgi na digegugodanedi tsigi dikahnawadvsdi gvdakahvsgi gegvdanedi tsigi.
english: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏥᏙᎵᎬᎾᏰᏃ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᏙᎵᏨᎯ; ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎵᏁᏗᏕᎭ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Natsidoligvnayeno tsagugodanedi gesesdi nudadolitsvhi; adadolisdino gesv adalinedideha digugododi gesvi.
english: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᎬᏙᏗ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᎭ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᏱᎩ?  ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᏍᎪ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏳᏍᏕᎸ?
phonetic: Gado gvdodi, idalinvtli, iyuno gilo aquohiyuha yadiha, nidulvwisdanehvnano yigi?  Uwohiyusvsgo yeliquo yusdelv?
english: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏂᎬᎦ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Iyuno gilo iginvtli ale igido tsuniyelvha yigi, ale yuninigvga nidugitsvnisv alisdayvdi gesvi,
english: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏥᏤᎾ, ᎢᏥᎦᎾᏬᏒᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏦᎸᏒᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏂᏗᏥᏁᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᏙ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ?
phonetic: Gilono nihi itsadatlugv hia yiniduweselv; Nvwadohiyadv tsitsena, itsiganawosvhi ale ditsolvsvhi gesesdi; niditsinehvnano igesesdi ayelv ulisdelvdodi gesvi; gado gvdodi nasgi?
english: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo gohiyudi gesvi, iyuno tali nudvdvna igesesdi digalvwisdanedi gesvi, uliwotsvhi, uwasvquo gesv iyusdi.
english: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏱᏅᎦᏫ, ᏂᎯ ᏦᎯᏳᎭ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ; ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏍᏋᏂᏏ ᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏅᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Udohiyuhi gilo hia yinvgawi, Nihi tsohiyuha, ayvno dagilvwisdaneha; gvnigesv nisquvnisi tsohiyusv detsalvwisdanehv nvdisgvna gesvi, ayvno gvnigesv nvdagvyvneli aquohiyusv dagilvwisdanehv gvdisgvi.
english: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎰᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎭ.  ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎾᏫᎭ.
phonetic: Nihi hohiyuhvsga asiyvwi ehv Unelanvhi.  Osiyu hnadvneha.  Anisgina nasquo anohiyuhvsga, ale duninawiha.
english: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ ᏣᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎯᏍᎦᏯ, ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Tsadulisgono tsagadovhisdiyi, nitsadanvdvna hisgaya, gohiyudi gesv uliwotsvhi gesv digalvwisdanedi gesv tali nudvdvna yigi?
english: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎢᎩᏙᏓ ᏳᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏁ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᏏᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Tlasgo Equahami igidoda yududalestane dulvwisdanehvi, ulisgolvtanv uwetsi Esigi atsilv gelasdiyi?
english: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏩᏔᏅ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Higowatiha gohiyudi gesv usdelvhv dulvwisdanelvi, nasgino dulvwisdanelv uwatanv gohiyudi gesv ukalilvi.
english: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᏪᎸᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁᎢ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ; "ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᎸᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸᎩ."  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎠᎪᏎᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Gowelvno udohiyunei hia tsinigaweha; "Equahami uwohiyunvgi Unelvnvhi, nasgino duyugodv digalvwisdanedi gesv utloyi atsiyelvnanelvgi."  Nasgino Unelanvhi Unalii agosehvgi.
english: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ.
phonetic: Nasgino itsigowatiha yvwi deulvwisdanehv adudalesdisgvi, vtlano gohiyudiquo gesv uwasv.
english: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏳᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᏓᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ?
phonetic: Ale nasquo Lehawi unegutsidv tlasgo deulvwisdanehv yududalestanei dudanilvtsv nasgi na nvdagetsinvsidv ale dunvwistanv utsatini iditlv wunilohisdiyi?
english: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏓᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Ayelvyeno adanvdo nuwehvna yigi udawotsvhi tsigesoi, nasgiyaquo gohiyudi gesv tali nudvdvna yigi digalvwisdanedi gesv nasquo uliwotsvhi gesoi.
english: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Idalinvtli tlesdi itsitsati ditsadeyohvsgi yigesesdi, itsigatahayeno utli igai igisdvdisdi gesvi;
english: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᏂᏗᎥ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎪᎸᎾ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎬᏪᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatiyeno iyudalegi nidiv idisganvgoi.  Iyuno gilo gawonisgv nasganvgvna tsigesoi, nasgi nugolvna geso asgaya, yeliquo nasquo gvwenahisdodi nigv ayelvi.
english: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏕᏗᎭᎾᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎨᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏕᏗᎪᎸᏏᏙᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo dedihanaladisgo soquili gegohiyudiyi, ale nigv diniyelv dedigolvsidohoi.
english: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏳᏧᏛᎾ ᏤᏉᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏕᎦᏂᏙᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏂᎦᏔᎲᏏᏙᎰ ᎠᏅᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏚᎸ ᎦᏌᏛᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo nasquo tsiyutsudvna tsequohiyusgininonv ale usgasedi unole deganidohoi, aseno danigatahvsidoho anvtisgo usdigiyu gasadvsdi nahnaquo iditlv udulv gasadvsgi.
english: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏳ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏄᏣᏔ ᎠᏓ ᏓᏥᏍᏢᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo ganoga usdigiyu, aseno equohiyu gawonisgoi.  Gvniyuquo usdi atsilv nutsata ada datsistlvsgoi.
english: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏃᎦ ᎤᏓᏑᏴ ᎢᎦᏙᏢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ ᏂᎬ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏍᏢᏍᎩ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎠᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏥᏍᏝᏫᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ganoga atsilv nasgiyai ale elohi akalii niduyugodvna gesv nasgiya.  Nasgiya nusdi ganoga udasuyv igadotlvsvi, nasgi gadaha igvnehi nigv ayelvi, ale atsistlvsgi aisv anelanvhi gesvi, ale tsvsginoi udayudalenvhi atsitsistlawisdisgi.
english: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎾᏏᏂᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏗᏓᏅᏘᏐᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᏅᏘᏐᏔᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nunadalesvyeno inage anehi ale aninohilidohi ale anadanasinidohi ale amequohi anehi, didanvtisododi ale tsudanvtisotanvhi yvwi.
english: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏃᎦᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏰᎵ ᏴᎬᏓᏅᏘᏐᏓ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎬᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎠᏓᎯᎯ ᏅᏬᏘ.
phonetic: Ganogasgini vtla gilo yeli yvgvdanvtisoda, nasgi uyoi gvsegogisdi nigesvna, akalii adahihi nvwoti.
english: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ ᏕᏗᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᎪᏢᏅᎯ
phonetic: Nasgi idvdisgoi edilvquodisgo Unelanvhi Agayvligei, ale nasgi idvdisgoi dedisginvdisgo yvwi nasgi Unelanvhi nusdv igegvnelvhi gegotlvnvhi
english: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎪ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi saquo aholi diganugogo galvquododi gesv ale asginvdisdi gesvi.  Idalinvtli, vtla osiyu yigi nasgi tsinusdi.
english: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎪ ᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᏗ?
phonetic: Tsigo saquo ganugogv diganugogo uganasdv ama ale uyvsdi?
english: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᏥᎪ ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏡᎬ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏯᎾᏓᏛᎦ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏡᎬ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎪ ᏖᎸᎳᏗᎯ ᏒᎦᎳ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏓᏛᎦ?  ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᏌᏉ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏴᏛᎦᏄᎪᎢ ~ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᎠᎴ ~ᎠᎹ ᎤᎶᏥᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Idalinvtli, tsigo svgataiyusdi tlugv yeliquo yanadadvga oliwa tlugv anadadvsgi, ale tsigo telvladihi svgalaiyusdi yanadadvga?  Nasquosgini vtla yeli saquo ganugogv yvdvganugoi ~ama ulotsidv ale ~ama ulotsidv nigesvna.
english: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᏂᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gago nihi nitsadvnvi udasuya asinasani ale agatanii?  Nasgi wigananugowa deulvwisdanehvi wigvdoda osiyu nadvnehvi, ale wigvdoda asinasaniyu gesv tali udvdesdi udanvti gesvi.
english: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏢᏆᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏤᎪᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏱᏥᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyusgini itsisquanigodesdi doditsadanvdvi advyugedi ale adisvsdi gesvi, tlesdi yitsatlvquasgesdi ale tlesdi yitsatsegovsgesdi udohiyusv yitsiyosgesdi.
english: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏊᏓᎸᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi asinasaniyu gesv vtla galvladi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, elohiquosgini ehi ale uquudalvquo ehi ale asgina iyusdi.
english: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎰ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nahnayeno advyugedi ale adisvsdi anehvi, nahna eho tsudalenvdv ale nigav uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎧᎵᏬᎯ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎸᏉᏛᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Galvladisgini nvdayudalenvhi tsigi asinasaniyu gesv igvyiyi gadaha nigesvna gesoi, hnaquono gohisdisgi, ale udanvti, ale uwohiyuhisdv, ale akaliwohi adadolisdi gesvi ale osdv digalvwisdanedi gesvi, ale nudalvquodvna, ale utlonasdi nigesvna.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Anohisdisgini anohisdisgvi aniwisgo duyugodv unanugowisdi gesvi.
english: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎭᏢ ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏤᎲᎴ?  ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏥᏰᎸ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏥᏓᎵᎭ ᎾᎿᎭᏴᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ?
phonetic: Hatlv didalehvsga dahnawa ale dilisdi gesv nihi itsehvle?  Tlasgo nasgi adulvdi gesv ditsiyelv hawini tsidaliha nahna yvdidalehvsga?
english: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏚᎵᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏕᏣᏓᎯᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ; ᏕᏣᎵᎰᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎢᏤᎪᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igaduligoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi; detsadahihoi ale itselihisgo itsiwadvdiyi aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi; detsalihoi ale dahnawa itsegoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgo nvdigalisdodisgo nitsitayohihvna gesvi.
english: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎰᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏥᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ, ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Itsitayohihoi, aseno vtla yitsiwatisgoi, nvdigalisdodisgo niduyugodvna gesv itsitayohihvi, itsadulisgv nasgi itsvdodiyi osdv itsadanvdadisdisgi itsiwadvdiyi.
english: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᏓᏲᏁᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ?  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᎵᎢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏯᏓᏅᏖᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsadayonehi itsisgaya ale itsigeyv, tlasgo yitsigataha elohi unalii gesvi Unelanvhi asgagi gesvi?  Nasgino iyusdi iyuno gilo elohi unalii iyulisdodiyi yadanvteha nasgi Unelanvhi asgagi gesoi.
english: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏉᏍᎪ ᏂᎦᏪ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪ ᎪᏪᎵ; ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᎦᏘ.
phonetic: Asequosgo nigawe itsiyelvha hia tsinigawe goweli; Adanvdo tsigiyaa udulisgv advyugedi gesv wagati.
english: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏁᎰᎢ-ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno utli igai gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv danehoiNasgi iyusdi hia nigaweha; Unelanvhi unatlvquodi datludisgoi, unadadolisdisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv danehoi.
english: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏤᏣᎴᏲᎯᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᏤᏣᏟᏴᏏ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏣᏓᏅᎡᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi tsetsaleyohisi Unelanvhi; Tsetsatliyvsi asgina, ale ase datsadanveli.
english: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎥ ᎡᏥᎷᏥᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎾᎥ ᏓᏥᎷᏤᎵ.  ᏗᏦᏑᎵ ᏗᏦᏰᏂ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏅᎦᎸ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏧᏓᎢ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Nav etsilutsisi Unelanvhi nasgino nihi nav datsilutseli.  Ditsosuli ditsoyeni itsisganai, ale ditsinvgalv ditsinawi tali itsudai ditsadanvti.
english: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏴᎳ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎦ; ᎢᏥᏰᏣᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏴᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏩᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Uyo itsadanvdada ale ditsiyvla ale ditsatloyiga; itsiyetsasgvi ayvlisdi gesv wadanetliyvsda, ale itsaliheligv uyo adanvdadisdi gesv wadanetliyvsda.
english: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏥᏌᎳᏓᏂ.
phonetic: Itsadadolisdi gesesdi Yihowa dodikanisgvi, nasgino datsisaladani.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ; ᎤᏐᏅ ᏥᎧᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏘᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᎦᎩ ᏚᎪᏓᏁᎯᏍᎩᏂ.
phonetic: Tlesdi usonv yiditsadanohesgesdi idadanvtli; usonv tsikanohesgo tsikaneisdisgo dinadanvtli ale tsidegugodaneho dinadanvtli, Nasgi usonv kanohesgo kaneisdisgo dikahnawadvsdi ale degugodaneho dikahnawadvsdi; iyuno dikahnawadvsdi yidugodaneha vtla dikahnawadvsdi tikahnawadegi yigagi dugodanehisgini.
english: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏓᎯᏍᏗ; ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏥᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ?
phonetic: Asiyvwi eha dikahnawadvsdi gotlvsgi yeliquo gvwadasdelvdi ale gvwadahisdi; gago nihi nvwadale tsidehiyugodaneha?
english: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏥᏪᏍᎩ; ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ ᏓᏲᏤᏏ ᎨᎯ ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛᏃ ᏬᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏬᏥᏃᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Ka hia itsiwesgi; Gohi iga ale sunalei dayotsesi gehi digaduhvi, sudetiyvdvno wotsehesdi ale wotsinodisgesdi ale woginequotsehesdi;
english: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏃ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏑᎾᎴᎢ; ᏕᏨᏅᏰᏃ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ?  ᎤᎬᎭᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦ ᏥᎦᎾᏄᎪᎪᎢ ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏣᎵᏛᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nitsigatahvnano iyulisdodi gesv sunalei; Detsvnvyeno gado usdi?  Ugvhadvquo nasgiyai nasgi tlega tsigananugogoi hnaquono tsalidvdisgoi.
english: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏳᎬᏫᏳᎭ ᏱᏂᏥᏪᎭ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎣᏏ ᏳᏰᎸᏅ, ᏙᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠᏉ.
phonetic: Nasgino iyusdi hia Yugvwiyuha yinitsiweha; Iyuno Ugvwiyuhi osi yuyelvnv, dotsvnesdi ale hia notsadvnehesdi ale hiaquo.
english: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎢᏣᏢᏆᏍᎬᎢ; ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᏉ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gohisgini gesv itsaliheliga itsatlvquasgvi; nigadv nasgi iyusdi alihelisdi gesv uyoquo gesoi.
english: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏣᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi gilo tsagatahoi osdv iyadvnedi gesvi, nasgino nadvnehvna tsigesoi, nasgi nahna asganvgoi.
