english: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ ᏂᎯ ᏗᏤᎿᎭᎢ ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏥᏴᎳ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ka nihi ditsehnai ditsatloyiga ale ditsiyvla winigalisdoda itsigiliyoisdi itsilutsedi tsigi.
english: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ ᎤᎪᏒ; ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏃ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎦᏂᏯᎥ;
phonetic: Tsugvwalodi itsihvi ugosv; ditsanuwono tsisgoyv ganiyav;
english: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᏤᎵ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏕᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏚᏯᏍᏜᏓᏛ, ᏚᏯᏍᏜᏓᏛᏃ ᎢᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏰᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏥᎦᏰᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎢᏥᏟᏌᏅ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
phonetic: Ditsatseli dalonige adelv ale unegv adelv duyasdladv, duyasdladvno itsinohesgi gesesdi, ale uweyesdi gesesdi itsiquedalv atsilv tsigayesgo nasgiyai.  Itsitlisanv tsugvwalodi ulisqualvdi iga gesv ugvwali.
english: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎠᏠᏱᎭ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᏕᏥᎶᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎾᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᏚᎵᎠᏴᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎠᏁᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo atloyiha gegaguyvdanedi tsunilvwisdanehi unisgudesvhi detsilogesvi, nasgi ditsinahisdanelvhi tsigi, unalisdvno nasgi unisgudesvhi duliayvlv Ugvwiyuhi dahnawa anegi unatseliga.
english: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏁᎸᎾ; ᏕᏤᎶᎸ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏥᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏗᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ.
phonetic: Utlvquodi itsehvgi elohi ale nitsanelvna; detselolv ditsinawi, nasgiya tsinanadvneho dihisdiyi gesv iga asqualv.
english: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏅᎾ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏣᏞᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Degugodanelv ale etsilv nasginvna, vtlano yitsatletseha.
english: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎬᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᎶᎨᏛ ᎠᎦᏘᏲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏐ ᎠᎦᏘᏲᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᎦᎾᏏ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂᏱ ᎤᎦᏃᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli ditsvnidiyu gesesdi gvni Ugvwiyuhi galutsvha.  Gvniyuquo ulogedv agatiyo galvquodi elohi unanugowisvhi, ale gvnidiyu geso agatiyoi, gvni uganasi igvyiyi ale oniyi uganodi gesvi.
english: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏓ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗ.
phonetic: Nihi nasquo ditsvnidiyu gesesdi; ditsalinigohisda ditsinawi, Ugvwiyuhiyeno uluhisdiyi usqualvhidi.
english: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏍᎦᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏕᏧᎪᏓᏏᏰᏃ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.  ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏙᎦ.
phonetic: Idadanvtli tlesdi yiditsadasgagesdi yidetsugodasiyeno itsisganvtsvi.  Gvniyuquo Digugodisgi galohisdiyi gadoga.
english: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏕᎤᏙᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Idadanvtli adolehohisdodi agiliyoisdi gesv ale gvnidiyu gesvi, anadolehosgi Ugvwiyuhi deudosdv unineistanvhi tsigi, ditsikahnawadvsdi gesesdi.
english: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏐ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.  ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏦᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎪᎲ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏭᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo osiyu iyunalisdanedi igiyelvso dinvnidiyu tsigesoi.  Itsadvganv gvnidiyu gesv Tsoqui, ale itsigohv nusdv wuyeilohisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi Ugvwiyuhi utsati udanvtiyu gesv ale udadolitsatiyu gesvi.
english: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏛᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎠᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎠᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᏣᏤᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᎥ ᎢᏣᏛᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᎥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏣᏛᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏤᏧᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno idadanvtli, wudagonadvdvi, tlesdi yitsaselidvsgesdi yitsineisdisgesdi galvloi, ale elohi, ale tlesdi nudalesvquo aselidodi gesvi; ale tlesdi nudalesvquo aselidodi gesvi; itsatselisgini vv itsadvdi gesv vv gesesdi, ale itsatseli vtla itsadvdi gesv vtla gesesdi; nasgino tlesdi tsetsugodanelvgi itsisganvtsvi.
english: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏕᎧᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo itsehv udasuyesdi agiliyogesdi, adadolisdisgesdi; Gilo ugalisdi udanvtesdi dekanogisgesdi.
english: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎤᏢᎨᏍᏗ, ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎦᏗᎶᏗ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ, ᎬᏩᎶᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᏙᎥᎢ;
phonetic: Gilo itsehv udasuyesdi utlvgesdi, widayanisgesdi digegadilodi tsunanelodi unadatlugvi, nasgino anadadolisdisgesdi anitayohihesdi atsisdelvdiyi, gvwalonedisgesdi atlonedi anvdisgesdi Ugvwiyuhi dudovi;
english: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᏃᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᏳᏍᏕᎸᎯ ᎤᏢᎩ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᏙᏓᏳᎴᏔᏂ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏚᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏥᏂᎯᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gohiyuhino adanolisdodi gesv dayusdelvhi utlvgi, Ugvwiyuhino dodayuletani; iyu ale usdunvtsvhi gesesdi nasgi tsatsinihisedi gesesdi.
english: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏕᏣᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏂᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏗᏣᏗᏫᏍᏗᏱ.  ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏰᎸᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏓᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Gvnigesv nidetsadadvnehesdi itsisganvtsvdi, ale detsadadolisdanehesdi, initayohihesdi ditsadiwisdiyi.  Udohiyuhiya uyelvhi udadolisdodi gesv udanvti utsati adasdelisgoi.
english: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎳᏯ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏔᏲᎸᎩ ᎤᎦᏃᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎰᏩᏃ ᏄᏚᎾᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏦᎢ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏑᏓᎵᏃ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Ilaya yvwiquo gesvgi ayv nigalisdanehv nasgiya igvwalisdanedi gesvgi; ale ulinigidv udanvdvgi udadolistanvgi utayolvgi uganodiyi nigesvna; howano nudunanvna gesvgi gadohi tsoi tsudetiyvdv sudalino iyanvdo igohidv.
english: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎦᎸᎶᎢᏃ ᎤᎦᏃᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎪᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Alewo udadolistanvgi, galvloino uganodanelvgi, godohino unanugowisvgi unanugowisdi gesvi.
english: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎠᏞᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎤᎦᏔᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Idalinvtli, iyuno gilo nihi nitsadvnv atlesgesdi duyosgesdi duyugodv gesvi, gilono iugatahvsgesdi,
english: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎬ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏍᎦᎸᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi agatahesdi, nasgi asgana agatahvsgi nahna ulidastanvhi aisvi, nasgi asdelisgv gudalesgv adanvdo ayohuhisdi gesvi, ale utsati iyudalegi asdunvtsvhi gesv gvsgalvsgvi.
english: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏈᏓ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏣᏗᎦᎴᏲᏨᎯ ᏋᏗᏱ ᎢᏤᏙᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎨᎴᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏆᏙᏏ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏏᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏈᏗᏂᏱ;
phonetic: Ayv Quida Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidv witsvyowelasi itsadigaleyotsvhi Quvdiyi itsedohi ale Gelesiyi ale Gequadosi ale Esiyi ale Quidiniyi;
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏚᏟᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎦᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Etsasuyedv nasgiya nagataho Unelanvhi Agayvligei, gvtanvhi udanvgalvdi gesv Adanvdo, nasgi nahna tsvdidalehvsga gohiyudi gesv ale asdutlisdi gesv ugigv Tsisa Galonedv; Gawagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv utsati itsatseli gesesdi.
english: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ;^
phonetic: Galvquododi gesesdi Unelanvhi nasgi Ugayvlige Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga, nasgi utsati udadolitsatiyu gesv tsinvdigalisdodi taline tsiginanugowisv udugi gvdi gesv tsiginelv gvnidv igigowadvdiyi nvdayudalenvhi uyohusv dulehisanv Tsisa Galonedv;^
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏦᏒ ᎡᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎯ,
phonetic: Tsiginelv igatseli iyulisdodi tsugvwalodi ayogi nigesvna, ale gadaha nigesvna, ale asgolvgi nigesvna, tsosv etsisquanigodanelvhi nihi,
english: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᏤᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi gohiyudi gesv itsvdisgv Unelanvhi ulinigidiyu gesv gvdi tsetsisquanigodi etsisdelvdi gesv gvdisgi, nasgi etsisdelvdi gesv tsadvnvisdi gvnigesv igvnediyi ulisqualvdi gesesdi.
english: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᏞᎦ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏩᏛᎡᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi nahna utsati tsitsaliheliga, gohisgininonv tlega, iyuno osiyu gesesdi, ehisdi itsadanvtawadega udigalisdodiha tsudalenvdv itsigoliyesgi itsaliwadvehvi,
english: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᎥᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᏱᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ ᎢᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsohiyusv agoliyedi gesv utli galvquodiyu esgaquo adelv dalonige agoliyedi gesv nasgi ayogi tsigi, nasquo atsilv gvtanvhi agoliyevhi yigi, yiwaliyeiloga galvquododi gesvi, ale osdv ayelvdi gesvi, ale galvquodiyu gesvi, Tsisa Galonedv gananugotsilv iyui.
english: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ [ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎡᏥᎪᎥᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎡᏥᎨᏳᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏁᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᎡᏣᎵᎮᎵᎦ ᎢᏨᏗᎭ ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎮᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgi [Tsisa Galonedv] etsigovhi nigesvna ietsigeyuha; ale nasgi gohi gesv netsigowatisgvna, aseno etsohiyuhvsgvi etsaliheliga itsvdiha alihelisdi gesv ganohedi nigesvna ale galvquotanvhi;
english: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale etsalisgolvdaneha itsohiyusv nusdv ugvwalvi, nasgi ditsadanvdo disdelvdi gesvi.
english: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎣᏂᎨᏛᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏲᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi na alisdelvdodi gesv anadolehosgi osdv onigedvnvhi ale uniyolvhi, nasgi unadolehosvhi unineistanvhi nihi etsidolisdi gesvi;
english: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏲᎲᎩ ᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎦᏰᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎮ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏂ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Uniyohvgi iyu gesvi, ale iyulistanidasdi gesv gadvgvi Adanvdo Galonedv utseliga nasgi uniyavi, igvyi gayehi gvnigesv tsinigvnehe ugiliyoisdiyi Galonedv ale galvquodiyu gesv oni unanugoisdiyi.
english: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᎨᎩᏃᎮᎮᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏥᏂᎨᏨᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏰᏥᏅᏏᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv igegvnelvhi tsigesei unvsvquo nanalisdelisgvna gesvi, ayvsgini gegisdelisgvi geginohehelv nasgi gohi gvnigesv tsinigetsvneha nasgi osdv kanohedv getsalitsidonelvhi tsigi, anvdisgv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo galvladi nvdayetsinvsidv; nasgi dinikahnawadidohi tsunaduliha unigoliyediyi.
english: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᏠᎦ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎢᏣᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᏲᎮᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi ditsitloga detsadanvdvi, itsalisinahisdiyu gesesdi, ale gvlisquadisgi udugi itsvsesdi etsinediyi gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv nihi etsiyohedi tsigi nahiyu Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv nagvnelvha.
english: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏂᏣᏍᏛ ᏥᏣᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Itsohiyuhisdv gesesdi, tlesdi ilvhiyu tsinitsasdv tsitsadulvnvvsgv nahiyu nitsigatahnavna tsigesvgi;
english: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini itsiyanvdv asganahi nigesvna tsigi, nasgiya nasquo nihi itsisganahi nigesvna gesesdi nigav nitsadvhnadegvi.
english: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎳ, "ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᏥᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᎩ."
phonetic: Hiayeno nigvnv gowela, "Itsisgana nigesvna gesesdi, ayvyeno tsisgana nigesvna igi."
english: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ [ᎠᏂ] ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale etsadadolisdanehesdi Agayvligei, nasgi nidigalvquodisgvna tsidegugodaneha naniv anisiyvwiha nusdv dunilvwisdanehvi, nigohilv [ani] itsalenidohvi itseyatahi gesesdi itsehvi.
english: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎠᏕᎸ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏯᏛᏅ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ, ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎡᎫᏓᎴᏒᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎸᎢ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Itsigatahayeno gohusdi ayogi, adelv unegv yadvnv ale adelv dalonige, etsaguyvtanvhi nigesvna gesvi, egudalesvi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna itsalenidolvi ditsigayvlige digetsiyohiselvhi gesvi,
english: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎬ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎩᎬ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏫ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎪᎸᏫ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ;
phonetic: Galvquodiyusgini gigv etsaguyvtanvhi gesvi, ugigv Galonedv nasgiya awiagina gohusdi nugolvwi ale nudadalvna;
english: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏥᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏙᏢᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ,
phonetic: Nasgi udohiyuhi natsigatahoi asi elohi nadotlvsgvna tsigesei; aseno gvnigesv nagvnele gohi ulisqualvdi degesadisvi nihi itsalisdelvdodi,
english: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᏤᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ ᏥᏚᎴᏔᏁᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nihi nasgi iyuwanisadv tsetsohiyuhvsga Unelanvhi nasgi uyohusv tsiduletanei ale tsunele galvquodiyu gesvi; nasgi itsohiyusv ale udugi itsvsv Unelanvhi iditlv iyulisdodiyi.
english: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏗᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏕᏥᎧᎾᏩᏛᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ, [ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ] ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᏨᏔᏅ, ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᏥᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏥᎾᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgino ditsinvgalvdv tsigi ditsadanvdo detsikanawadvsv duyugodv tsinvtsulisdotanv, [Galvquodiyu] Adanvdo tsitsvtanv, nutlonasdvna adageyudi gesv itsvdodiyi ditsigeyuhiyu iyulisdodiyi itsalinvtli, ulinigidv detsadageyusesdi itsvdisgesdi gadaha nigesvna itsinawi.
english: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏕᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎢᏣᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏲᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎧᏃᎥᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Taline itsadenvhi gesvi, vtla ayogi ugata itsadetanvhi yigi, ayogisgini nigesvna, kanovdv Unelanvhi utlili iyuwanisadv nasgi gvnodv tsigi ale nigohilv ehi tsigi.
english: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎧᏃᏍᎦᏉ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᎤᏥᎸᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.  ᎧᏁᏍᎦ ᎧᏴᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥᎸᏒᎢ ᎦᏙᎠᏍᎪᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎭ.
phonetic: Nigavyeno uquedali gesv kanosgaquo nasgiyai, ale nigav udalvquododi gesv yvwi, kanesga utsilvsv nasgiyai.  Kanesga kayvsgoi, ale utsilvsvi gadoasgoi, kanohedvsgini Ugvwiyuhi utseliga nigohilv eha.
english: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎡᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎲᎢ ᏤᏣᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia kanohedv nasgi osdv kanohedv etsalitsidonehvi tsetsalitsidoneha.
english: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏓᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyvdv nitsvga nudalesv uyo gesvi ale nudalesv galonuhedv ale utlonasdi gesv advyugedi ale nudalesv uyo didanohedi gesvi,
english: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎩᎳᎢ ᎤᎾᏕᏃᏅᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᎤᏅᏗ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᏫ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏛᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Nasgiya gilai unadenonvhi diniyoli unvdi tsunadulisgoi itsadulisgesdi galonuhedv nudasuyvwi kanohedv, nasgi ditsadvhisdodiyi;
english: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno itsadolehosesdi Ugvwiyuhi udanvtiyu gesvi.
english: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎷᏤᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ,
phonetic: Nasgi etsilutsehvi, nasgi gvnodv nvya uniyoiselvhisgininonv udohiyuhi yvwi, aseno Unelanvhi usuyedv ale galvquodiyu,
english: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏨᏃᏛ ᏅᏯ ᎡᏣᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎢᏤᎶᎯ, ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᎠᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nihi nasquo ditsvnodv nvya etsanesgehvhi adanvdo adanelv iyetsvnelvhi, etsilvquotanvhi atsilvitselohi, etsalisgolvdanediyi atsilvgelasdi adanvdo ugvwali yeliquo digvadanilvisdi gesv Unelanvhi, Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv.
english: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ-ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏥᎲᎦ ᏌᏯᏂ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏑᏰᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nasquo hia nigvnv gowelihiGvniyuquo tsihvga Sayani nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nvya asuyedv, galvquodi, ale gilo nasgi gohiyuhvsgesdi vtla udehohisdi yigesesdi.
english: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏂᏰᎸᎠ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ "ᏅᏯ ᏗᎾᏁᏍᎨᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏎᎸᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎤᏅᏏᏴ ᎠᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ;"
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi etsoiyuhvsgi tsigi galvquodiyu eniyelva; nasgisgini na nanohiyuhvsgvna, nasgi na "nvya dinanesgesgi uniyoiselvhi nugvwiyusv unvsiyv adi nunalisdanelv;"
english: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ "ᏅᏯ ᎠᏓᎿᎭᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᏗᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ," ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏚᏂᎾᏍᏆᎶᏍᏗᎭ, ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᏕᎨᏥᎧᏁᎢ.
phonetic: Ale "nvya adahnasqualosdisgi ale nvya didadodesdisgi," nasgi na kanohedv tsiduninasqualosdiha, nanohiyuhvsgvna gesv iyusdi, nasgi iyunalisdanediyi nasquo tsidegetsikanei.
english: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎢᏥᏠᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎢᏤᎶᎯ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᏗᏣᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎵᏏᎬᏫᏥᏯᏅᏛ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎦᎸᏌᏛ ᏫᏥᎧᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nihisgini etsasuyedv itsitloyi gesvi, itsigvwiyuhi atsilvitselohi, etsilvquotanvhi itsadatselidv gesvi, utsati ditsagvwalanvhi yvwi, nasgi gvnigesv itsvnediyi atsilvquodiyu gesv nasgi tsulisigvwitsiyanvdv, usquanigodiyuno iga galvsadv witsikanvhi;
english: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᎩ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi ilvhiyu tsigesv itsadatselidv nigesvna gesei, gohisgini tsigi itsadatselidv Unelanvhi tsutseli nitsalistanv; nasgi vtla etsidolitsvhi yigesei, gohisgini tsigi etsidolitsvhi.
english: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎨᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᎦ, ᏗᏥᏲᎯ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎤᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏥᏓᏁᏓᎿᎭᏫᏯ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, itsvtayoseha, nasgiya nigetsigatahvna ale anedohi iyunadvnedi nitsadvga, ditsiyohi uquedalv ugvvhisdi gesvi, nasgi adanvdo tsidanedahnawiya.
english: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏦᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏯᏂᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏩᏛᎯᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ale itsalenidohv osdv gesesdi anehv tsunadalenvdv yvna, nasgi getsatludisgv uyo tsunilvwisdanehi tsigetsoseha, nasgi osdv detsilvwisdanehv anigowatisgv yinvdagalisdoda yanilvquoda Unelanvhi nahiyu iga dawadvhilvha.
english: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ^ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi nvdigalisdodisgesdi, detsohiyusesdi naniv yvwi digeganelodi gesvi^nasquo ugvwiyuhi nugvwiyusv gesesdi,
english: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo analisdelisgiquo gesesdi nasgi nidodayunvsidv Ugvwiyuhi getsigiliyoisdodiyi uyo tsunilvwisdanehi, ale getsilvquododiyi osdv tsunilvwisdanehi.
english: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎡᎳᏪ ᏗᏨᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia osiyu uyelvdi Unelanvhi, nasgi osiyu detsilvwisdanehv elawe ditsvdiyi nanigatahnavna ale uninegu yvwi.
english: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏧᏢᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nidigetsinatlavna iyunadvnedi nitsadvnehesdi, vtlasdi adina nidetsinatlavna gesv yitsvdisgesdi yitsutlvvsgesdi uyo digalvwisdanedi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini tsunvsidasdi iyunadvnedi nitsadvnehesdi.
english: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ; ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏆᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Detsilvquodesdi nanivi; detsigeyusesdi analinvtlvi; Unelanvhi etsinayesgesdi; ugvwiyuhi etsilvquoquasdi.
english: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏤᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᎶᏘ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏅᏒ ᏱᏗᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎾᎸᏣᏘ.
phonetic: Tsetsinatlai, detsohiyusesdi digetsinatlai uloti ganayehisdi itsvdisgesdi; vtlesdi anosdv ale unadanvti unvsv yiditsohiyusesdi, nasquosgini uninalvtsati.
english: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia galvquodiyu, iyuno gilo Unelanvhi tsudanvdv ulvquodiyu gesv yinvdigalisdodiha gvnidiyu yigi agiliyogvi, niduyugodvna atsigiliyoisdisgvi.
english: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎨᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ ᎢᏥᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎡᏥᎵᎥᏂᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Gadogeno galvquododi nigalisdiha, iyuno utsatini nitsadvnelv itsisdvdisgesdi etsilivnihesdi itsvnidiyu gesesdi; iyusgini osdv nitsadvnehesdi ale itsigiliyogesdi itsvnidiyu gesesdi, nasgi osdv ayeli gesv Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi.
english: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ; ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᏤᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎯᏰᎴ ᏗᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno itsalisdanediyi etsiyanvdv; Galonedvyeno nasquo igigiliyotselei, ale igihiyele digikahnawadvsdi, nasgi uwedolv ditsikahnawadvsdiyi.
english: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏤᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᏯᏥᏩᏛᎡᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ;
phonetic: Nasgi vtla yusganvtsei, vtla ale galonuhedv yatsiwadvele aholi;
english: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏔᏅ, ᎥᏝ ᏳᏞᏤ ᏱᎬᏩᏓᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ; ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏁᏤᎢ; ᏚᏓᏲᎯᏎᎴᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi gayetsisotlvtanv, vtla yutletse yigvwadasotlvtanei; ugiliyotsvno vtla yunetsei; dudayohiselequosgini nasgi duyugodv digugodanehi.
english: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᏎ ᎢᏗᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏰᎸ ᏡᎬ ᏧᎩᎵᏲᏤᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏗᏢ, ᏗᏛᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎵᎥᏂᎸᎢ ᎢᏣᏗᏫᏍᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi uwasv gesv ugise idisganahiyu gesv uwasv ayelv tlugv tsugiliyotsei, nasgi ayv digiyohusvhi gesv asganvisdi gesv iditlv, didvnodv iyulisdodiyi duyugodv iditlv gesvi; nasgi atsilivnilvi itsadiwisdiha.
english: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏫ ᎤᎾᎴᏲᎥᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎᎢ; ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏨᏒ ᎡᏥᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ.
phonetic: Nihiyeno awi unaleyovhi nasgiya gesei; gohisgini gesv itsatsvsv etsilutselv Awidigatiya ale ditsadanvdo Digatiya.
english: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ ᏗᏦᎯᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏂᏓᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏥᏎᎪᎩᏍᏓ [ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ] ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎢᏥᎨᏴ,
phonetic: Nasquono nihi itsigeyv ditsohiyuhiyu gesesdi digetsiyehi, nasgi iyuno gilo kanohedv nidanikahnawadegvna yigi, nasgi nasquo kanohedv gvdi nigesvna yigetsisegogisda [anigowatisgv] nusdv itsalenidohv itsigeyv,
english: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale anigowadisgv uyo nudasuyvna itsalenidohv ulitloyasdv ganayehisdi gesvi.
english: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᏣᏅᏍᎬ ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎦᏚᎢᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏣᏅᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎠᏍᏕᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏣᏅᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏛᏄᏬᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Ale detsatsanvsgv vtlasdi gaduiquo ehi atsanvdi gesv yigesesdi, nasgi osdiyegv asdeyasdi gesvi ale adelvdalonige atsanvdodi, ale dinuwo dvnuwosgvi,
english: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏕᎵᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎡᎯ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Udelisvsgini odanvdv ehi yvwi gesesdi, nasgi ayogi nigesvna tsigi, nasgi udadolisdi ale udanvti adanvdo, nasgi Unelanvhi dodikanisgv utsati tsugvwalodi tsigi.
english: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᎡᏘ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏓᎾᏣᏅᏍᎨᎢ, ᏚᏃᎯᏳᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ,
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nasquo nanadvnehe eti anosdv anigeyv Unelanvhi anadasgasdodisgi danatsanvsgei, dunohiyuha digvwaniyehi,
english: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏎᎵ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ, ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ ᏥᎪᏎᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏥᏂᏣᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏱᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiya Seli igohiyuhvsge Equahami, sginatlai tsigosehei, nasgi tsuwetsi tsinitsalisdiha, iyuno osdv yiditsilvwisdaneha, ale gohusdi nitsisgaihvna yigi.
english: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ ᎢᏣᏁᎳᏛᎭ ᏗᏣᏓᎵᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᎣᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nihi nasquo itsisgaya itsaneladvha ditsadalii nasgiya iyadvnedi gesv itsigatahvi, ale detsilvquodesdi nasgiya digalvquododi tsigi diniwanagalai, ale digalvquododi tsigi atequalohi otseli gesv gvwagadiya gvnidv etsinelvi; nasgino tlesdi itsadadolisdisgv gohusdi ayosdodisgi yigesesdi.
english: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ ᎨᏒᎢ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏌᏉᏉ ᏂᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ; ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏢᎢ; ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏣᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Ulisqualvdino gesvi nigadiyu saquoquo nidetsvnesdi detsadanvdvi; detsadadoligesdi; detsadageyusesdi itsalinvtlvi; itsadadolitsadiyu gesesdi; itsadadolisdi gesesdi;
english: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏁᏨᏁᎲ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏱᏂᏣᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏔᏅ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏣᏓᏐᏢᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛᏉᏍᏗᏂ ᎨᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᏤᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Tlesdi uyo netsvnehv yitsatlegesdi uyo yinitsadadvnehesdi, ale gayetsisotlvtanv tlesdi yitsatlegesdi yigetsadasotlvdisgesdi, osdvquosdini getsinetsehesdi; itsigatahayeno nasgi itsadvnediyi etsiyanvdv gesvi, nasgi itsatseli iyulisdodiyi osdv etsinetsediyi.
english: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: "ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎤᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏩᏲᏍᏙᏓᏏ ᎦᏃᎪᎢ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏚᎭᏁᎦᎸ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ;
phonetic: "Giloyeno gvnv ugeyusesdi, ale osdv iga tsugowadvdiyi udulisgesdi, wayosdodasi ganogoi uyo gesvi, duhanegalv galonuhedv uneisdiyi nigesvna;
english: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎣᏍᏛᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Adanvehesdi uyo gesvi osdvno dulvwisdanehesdi; nvwadohiyadv gesv uyohesdi ale nasgi dakahnawadegesdi.
english: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᎰᏩᏰᏃ ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎴᏂ ᏚᏛᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎤᎧᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᏡᏔᏅ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ."
phonetic: Yihowayeno digadoli dakahnawadido unadanvti, ale digaleni dudvdasdi anadadolisdisgvi, ukadvsgini Yihowa detlutanv uyo tsunilvwisdanehi."
english: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏅ ᏱᏂᏨᎦ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᏱᎩ?
phonetic: Gagono nasgi osinv yinitsvga iyuno osdv gesv itsisdawadegi yigi?
english: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏕᏯᏔᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Iyu ale duyugodv gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi itsigiliyogesdi, nvwadohiyadvquo gesesdi.  Ale tlesdi yitsisgaihesdi uninayehisdiyu gesvi, ale tlesdi yitsadeyatanehesdi;
english: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.  ᎠᎴ ᏯᏃᏉ ᎢᏨᏛᏅᎢᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎨᏣᏛᏛᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᏨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏗᏥᏃᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Etsilvquodisgesdisgini Yihowa Unelanvhi doditsadanvdvi.  Ale yanoquo itsvdvnvisdesdi naniv gilo getsadvdvhvsgi udugi itsvsv ugvwali, ditsinonediyi udanvti ale unayehisdi gesv itsvdodiyi.
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏥᎨᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎨᏦᏎᎭ, ᏯᎾᏕᎰᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale itsisquanigodesdi osdv digugododi gesvi, nasgi usonv tsigetsinoheha uyo tsunilvwisdanehi tsigetsoseha, yanadehohi nasgi gayegogi getsinohesgi osdv itsalenidohv Galonedv detsikahnawadisvi anineisdisgi.
english: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏲ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utliyeno osiyu, nasgi yinusdi Unelanvhi adanvtesgvi, nasgi itsigiliyoisdiyi osdv detsilvwisdanehvi, ano uyo detsilvwisdanehv itsigiliyoisdiyi.
english: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏌᏉ ᏄᎩᎵᏲᏤ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏛᏕᎢ, ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᏚᎩᎵᏲᏤᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏫᏗᎦᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏥᎴᎢ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏩᏂᏕᎢ.
phonetic: Galonedvyeno nasquo saquo nugiliyotse asganvisdi gesv usdvdei, asgana nigesvna anisgana dugiliyotselei, nasgi Unelanvhiyi widigatinohisdiyi; atsilei uquedali gesvi, aseno Adanvdo uwanidei.
english: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ [ᎠᏓᏅᏙ] ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎤᏪᏅᏎ ᏫᏚᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᏣᏂᏯᎠ,
phonetic: Nasgi nasquo [adanvdo] uwatane uwenvse widulitsidonele didanvdo didasdudiyi tsaniyaa,
english: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎦᏘᏰᎢ, ᏃᏯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏤᎥᎢ, ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏥᏳ, ᎾᎿᎭᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎳᏉ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏥᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᎮᎢ, ᎠᎹ ᏥᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏔᏁᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi ilvhiyu nunohiyusvna tsigesei, nahiyu Unelanvhi gvnidiyu gesv tsagatiyei, Noya nahiyu tsevi, tsadvnvisdisge tsiyu, nahna ilvsgi nasgi tsunelaquo iyanidv tsigetsisdelvhei, ama tsigetsisdelvtanei;
english: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎾᎬᏁᎲ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎧᏁᏤᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏚᎴᎯᏌᏅ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ,
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo didawosdi gesv gohi gesv igisdeliha; vtla iyvdv nagvnehv ayelv gadaha gesvi, kanetsedisgini Unelanvhi gvdodi osdv adanvtedi gesv igisdeliha nvdigalisdodiha dulehisanv Tsisa Galonedv,
english: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏭᎶᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏭᏬᎳ, ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi galvladi wulosv Unelanvhi uwolv agatisiditlv wuwola, dinikahnawadidohino ale digeganelodi ale nunigvwiyusv digvwanelodi nulistanv.
english: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎩᎵᏲᏤᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᏂᏨᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᏚᏲᏐ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Galonedvno uquedali gesv igigiliyotselvhi tsigi, nihi nasquo nasgi iyusdi adanvdo itsalisgasdododi nitsvga; nasgiyeno na uquedali gesv ugiliyotsvhi tsigesoi duyoso asganvisdi gesvi,
english: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎤᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi hnaquo udediyi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi nigohilv uquedalv igohidv ulenidasdi gesvi, nasgi yvwi unadulvdi gesvi, Unelanvhiquosgini osiyu uyelvdi gesvi.
english: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏰᎵᏉᏰᏃ ᏱᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎢᎦᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᏕᏙᎲ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎬᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎾᏩᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎾᏗᏔᏍᎬ ᎨᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Yeliquoyeno yigiyelvha gayula igalenidolv degilvwisdanelv osiyu uniyelvdi gesv nanigatanavna, nahiyu tsidedohv udelidv dinisidi gesvi, ale adulvdi gesvi, ale gigageaditasdi gvdayvsdesdisgi gesvi, ale alisganawasdi gesvi, ale danaditasgv geladidasdi gesvi, ale niduyugodvna unelanvhi diyelvhi didadolisdanedi gesvi;
english: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ, ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏣᎢᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎢᏒ ᏩᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi usquanigodiyu uniyelvha, nahna nitsaisvna gesv anaisv wanigadv ulosvstanvhi uyo iyadvnelidasdi digesvi, nasgi usonv getsinohesgvi;
english: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᎢ ᏧᎵᏁᏃᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Nasgi gvnigesv iyunvnedi gesesdi agatahv nasgi ugvwalei tsulinenodi tsuwugodanediyi dinvnodv ale tsuniyohusvhi.
english: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎴᎢ, ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏛᏙᎩᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno iyusdi osdv kanohedv tsuniyohusvhi nasquo gegalitsidonelei, digegugodanediyi uquedali gesv nasgiya yvwi tsunugododi gesvi, Unelanvhisgini tsuwugododi gesv dinvnodv iyulisdodiyi tsunadadvdogihi gesvi.
english: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎬ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᏓᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nudalesvsgini gohusdi ulisquadidi, nasgi iyusdi itsalisinahisdi gesesdi, ale itsiyawisgv itsadadodasdisgesdi.
english: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎫᏢᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᏯᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ho ugvwiyusesdi ulinigidv detsadageyusesdi; adageyudiyeno gesv dagutlvni utsati iyasganvisdi gesvi.
english: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏣᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏗᏣᏓᏕᎵᏎᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Ditsadasquanigodiyu gesesdi gohusdi niditsadadelisehvna.
english: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᏥᎥᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏕᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎠᏃᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nitsivno etsinelvhi tsigi, nasgi detsadanehesdi nasgiya iyunadvnedi anosdv getsigatidisdi tsudalenvdv Unelanvhi gvwagadiya udanedi gesvi.
english: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo gawonisgesdi, nasgiya Unelanvhi nuwesv gawonisgesdi.  Iyuno gilo dayadohehesdi, nasgi yeli igvwadvnedi gesv ulisgolvdanehv Unelanvhi nasgi nadvnehesdi; nasgino Unelanvhi nigav detsilvwisdanehv atsilvquodiyu igvwalisdodi yigi Tsisa Galonedv gesv yinvdigalisdodiha; nasgi utseliga galvquodiyu gesv ale ugvwiyuhi gesv nigohilv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
english: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᎬ ᏥᏥᏱᎵᏕᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏥᎷᏤᎶᎢ;
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, tlesdi usquanigodi yitsiyelvsesdi galigv tsitsiyilideha nasgi itsigoliyedi tsigi, nasgiya gohusdi usquanigodi tsitsilutseloi;
english: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsaliheligesdisgini nvdigalisdodisgesdi Galonedv ugiliyotsv itseladisdisgvi, nasgino utseli galvquodiyu gesv gvnigesv igvnelvhi gesesdi nihi nasquo utsatanvhi getsalihelisdi gesesdi.
english: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏗ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno gayetsisotlvdesdi Galonedv dudov nvdigalisdodisgesdi osiyu itsalisdanedi gesesdi, Adanvdoyeno galvquodiyu Unelanvhi utseliga itseladidoha; nasgi na gesv gagvwasotlvdi, nihisgini gesv atsilvquodiha.
english: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᏳᎩᎵᏲᏤᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎸᎢ ᏳᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏍᎩᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏌᎳᏁᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Adina tlesdi gilo nihi nitsadvnv yugiliyotsesdi yvwi ulvi yusdvdisgesdi, ale unosgisvi, ale uyo dulvwisdanelvi, ale ulisalanehi gesv nvwanadale tsunilvwisdanedi gesvi.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏯᏕᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏫᎦᎸᏉᏓᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ.
phonetic: Iyusgini gilo Galonedv asdawadidohi gesv usdvdisgesdi agiliyogesdi, tlesdi yadehosgesdi, wigalvquodaquosgini Unelanvhi nasgi winigalisdoda.
english: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᏗᏱ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏰᎦᎴᏅᏔᏅ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏭᎾᎵᏱᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Usqualvhvyeno nasgi digugodoti gesv Unelanvhi utseli adanelv udalenvdiyi; iyuno ayv yegalenvtanv gado usdi wunaliyilohisdi gesesdi nasgi na nunohiyusvna osdv kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏎᎦᏨᎯ ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎭᏢ ᏭᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Iyu ale udanvti usegatsvhi atsisdelvdi gesesdi, hatlv wunanugoisdi gesesdi unelanvhi nidunelodvna ale asganai.
english: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎩ, ᏫᏓᏂᏲᎯᏏ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ, ᎣᏍᏛ ᏕᎤᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᏥᏓᏂᏲᎯᏎᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, nasgi na nusdv adanvtesgv Unelanvhi anigiliyogi, widaniyohisi tsusquanigododiyi tsunadanvdo, osdv deunilvwisdanehvi, nasgiya nudalidasdvna Uwotlvnvnvhi tsidaniyohisehoi.
english: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎨᎦᏁᎶᏗ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ ᎦᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏨᏆᏁᎶᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎦᏔᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎵᏲᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏇᏔᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ^
phonetic: Digeganelodi tsigetsadasuya gatsitayoseha, ayv nasquo tsvquanelodi ale tsigatahi Tsisa Galonedv ugiliyotsvi, ale nasquo aquetadisdisgi galvquodiyu gvnigesv igvnedi tsigi^
english: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏤᎶᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ, ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏰᏍᏗ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏂᏥᏰᎸᏒᎾ ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏞᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Detselohesdi unadatlugv Unelanvhi tsutseliga tsigetsadasuya, detsigatiyesdi, vtlesdi osiyu nitsiyelvsvna osiyusgini itsiyelvhi gesesdi, ale vtlesdi tsugvwalodi itsigvvsgv yinvdigalisdodisgesdi, osiyusgini itsiyelvsv nvdigalisdodisgesdi;
english: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᎦᏘᏴ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎦᎨᏣᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale detsigatiyv [Unelanvhi] tsutseliga tlesdi unigvwiyuhi nanadvnehv yinitsadvnehesdi, gagetsadeloquaedisgini gesesdi nasgi unadatlugvi.
english: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᎡᏥᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᎠᏍᎪᎸᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nugvwiyusvno awidigatiya gananugotsilvha etsinvnedi gesesdi galvquodi alisdulo asgolvgi nigesvna.
english: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ ᏕᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ; ᎥᎥ, ᏂᏥᎥᎢ ᏕᏣᏓᏙᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏢᏉᏗ ᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Nihi nasquo itsiwinv detsohiyusesdi tsunadvsonvhi; Vv, nitsivi detsadadohiyusesdi, ale itsanuwosdesdi udadolisdi adanvdadisdi gesvi; Unelanvhiyeno unatlvquodi datludisgoi, unadadolisdisgini gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesv dalisgolvdanehoi.
english: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ ᏂᏣᏛᎾᏕᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎨᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsadadolisdi gesesdi Unelanvhi ulinigidv uwoyeni hawiniditlv nitsadvnadegvi, nasgino getsisaladodi gesesdi aselvhi gesv nahiyui.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi nigadiyu uwelihisdi itsehv tsetsiyohisi, nasgiyeno itsadanvtesgoi.
english: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ, ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎤᏪᎷᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎡᏙᎭ ᏚᏲᎭ ᏧᏪᏰᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Itsalisinahisdi gesesdi, itsiyawisgesdi, itsatludisgiyeno asgina, tlvdatsi unodena uwelugi nasgiya edoha duyoha tsuweyesdi.
english: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏣᏟᏴᏏ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᎢᎲ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi tsetsatliyvsi, ulinigidv gesesdi itsohiyusvi, itsigatahayeno utloyi agiliyoisdi gesv anikaliihv itsalinvtli elohi tsaneha.
english: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏗᎾ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦ ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᏨᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᏥᎪᎸᎾ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᏥᏖᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ.
phonetic: Adina Unelanvhi utsatanvhi udadolitsati nasgi igiyanvdv tsigi utseli ulisquadisdi nigesvna galvquodiyu gesv wigiluhisdiyi, Tsisa Galonedv agvdisgvi, nasgi tlega itsigiliyotsvhi gesesdi, nitsigolvna winitsvga, ale witsalinigohisda, ale itsalinigidv winitsvga, ale gayetsitelvdi nigesvna winitsvga.
english: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi utseli gesesdi galvquodiyu gesv ale ugvwiyuhi gesv nigohilv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
english: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎦᏲᎵ ᏏᎷᏪᏂ ᎤᏅᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎳᏏᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ, ᎢᏒᏔᏲᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏕᏥᏙᎦ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyowelasi gayoli Siluweni unvsdi nasgi galasidvdi nigesvna itsalinvtli gadanvtesgvi, isvtayoseha, ale gvnigesv nitsvyvneha nasgi hia nahna tsidetsidoga udohiyusv Unelanvhi udadolisdi gesvi.
english: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎹᎦ ᎠᏇᏥ.
phonetic: Dadaloni anehi gegasuyedv nihi etsasuyedv gesv nasgiyai wigetsiyoliha, ale nasquo maga aquetsi.
english: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᏨᏔᏅᎭ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎡᏥᏯᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ
phonetic: Detsadayolilvha itsvtanvha adageyudi didadowedovsdi gesvi.  Nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nitsiv Tsisa Galonedv etsiyai.  Emenv
english: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏌᏩᏂ ᏈᏓ, ᎠᎸᎾᏝᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᎩᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏁ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Ayv Sawani Quida, alvnatlai ale aginvsidv Tsisa Galonedv, gatsiyowelasi nasgi na getsinelvhi tsigi oginelv nasgiyai, galvquodiyu gohiyudi gesv nvdayudalenvne udanvtiyu gesv Iganelanvhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv etsinequoedi gesesdi nvdayudalenvhi agadovhisdi gesv Unelanvhi ale Tsisa igatseli Ugvwiyuhi.
english: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎢ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏕᏛᏅ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎩᏯᏅᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏍᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiya utseli ulinigidi gesv uwatanvi iginelvhi tsigi nudalesv gohusdi dedvnv ugvwali ale Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv ugvwali, nvdayudalenvhi agadovhisdi gesv nasgi na igiyanvdv tsigi gvtanvhi galvquodiyu gesv ale duyugodv isdvnedi gesvi.
english: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏓᎪᎾᏛᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏉᎯᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎬ ᎨᏣᏠᏯ ᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ, ᎡᏣᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏲᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Usgi nahna wudagonadvtanvhi equohiyu ale galvquodiyu egiduisdanelvhi tsigi, nasgi hia detsvdisgv getsatloya sdodi yinigalisda Unelanvhi nusdvi, etsadiwiselvhi gesv uyoi elohi tseha adulvdi gesv tsvdidalehvsga.
english: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎢᎶᏟᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi utsati ilotlinigvnehv itsohiyusv tali itsvdisgesdi duyugodv iyadvnedi gesvi; ale duyugodv iyadvnedi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi agadovhisdi gesvi;
english: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏙᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Agadovhisdino gesv tali itsvdisgesdi alisinahisdodi gesvi; alisinahisdodino gesv tali itsvdisgesdi ditsvnidiyu gesvi; ditsvnidiyuno gesv tali itsvdisgesdi Unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesvi;
english: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏢᏃ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏂᎢᏛᏉ ᏗᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unelanvhino ganayehisdi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi analinvtlv digeyudi gesvi; analinvtlvno digeyudi gesv tali itsvdisgesdi igvniidvquo digeyudi gesvi.
english: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎣᏤᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎧᏁᏉᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎬᏂᏌ ᎥᏝ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏃᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᏁᏉᏣᏛᎾ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno nasgi hia tsudalenvdv otseha ale yikanequoga, nasgi yinigvnisa vtla itsisganolv ale nitsinequotsadvna yigagi agadovhisdi gesv Tsisa Galonedv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga.
english: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏄᏪᎲᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏥᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nuwehvnasgini nasgi hia tsudalenvdv nasgi digewiquo ale iyvdv gvwagowadvdi nigesvna, ale uwagewisvhi atsinvgalvdv gesv ilvhiyu usganvtsidolvi.
english: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏑᏰᏒᎢ; ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏙᎨᏥᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi idalinvtli utli igai itsatlinigvnehesdi nudlasidvsvna itsvnediyi etsiyanvhv ale etsasuyesvi; iyuyeno hia nasgi tsudalenvdv yinitsadvneha, vtla ilvhiyu yidogetsinvgi.
english: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno nitsadvnehv utsatanvhi etsinedi gesesdi itsiyvsdiyi ulisquadisdi nigesvna Ugvwiyuhi digesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᏴᏓᎨᎵᏏ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎢᏥᎦᎳᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏣᎵᏂᎪᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi vtla unelagi yvdagelisi nigohilv itsvyanvdadisdodiyi nasgi hia tsudalenvdv, itsigalahasgininonv, ale detsalinigosv nahna duyugodv gesv gohi tsitsadvgiha.
english: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᎥ, ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎨᎵᎭ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏥᏯᎥᎢ, ᎢᏨᏰᏍᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Vv, duyugodi geliha igohidv ani hia galitsodv tsiyavi, itsvyesdvdodiyi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi;
english: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎦᏔᎲ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᎩᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodisgv tsigatahv nigohilvnaquo iyvdv agidiyi gesv aquatseli galitsodvi, nasgiya Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv gvnigesv naquvnelvi.
english: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᎦᏟᏂᎬᏁᎵ ᎠᎩᎶᏐᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎨᏨᎨᏫᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Ale dagatlinigvneli agilosonvhi gesesdi nigohilv getsvgewisdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, nasgi hia tsudalenvdv.
english: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏎᏉ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏲᎩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᏱᎩᎪᎲᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Vtlayeno alisinahistanvhi asequo gawonihisdi gesv yogisdawadvse gvnigesv nitsvyvnelv ulinigidi gesv ale uluhisdi gesv igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv; yigigohvhisgini gesvgi galvquodiyu gesv utseliga.
english: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏚᎸᏌᏛᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏧᎷᏤᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᎦ-ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᎤᎯ, [ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ,] ᎯᎠ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎠᏇᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏥᏰᎸᎢ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno Agayvlige ulisgolvdanelvgi galvquodiyu gesv ale igadulvsadvi, nahiyu kanegv tsulutselv utsati galvquodiyu igadulvsadv nvdayudaleuhi, [hia tsinigawesgvgi,] Hia tsigeyui Aquetsi, nasgi osiyu tsiyelvi tsigi.
english: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᏒᎯ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎣᏤᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia unetsv galvladi nvdayulosvhi ogadvganvgi, nahiyu galvquodi odalv itsulaha otsedohvi.
english: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏄᏜᏓᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎢᎩᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᏂᏣᏛᎦ ᏱᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎦ-ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏨᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎢᎦ ᏓᎦᏙᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎡᎯ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏓᎧᎸᎩ ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ;
phonetic: Ale nasquo utli igai nudlasidvsvna kanohedv adolehosvhi igiha, nasgi osiyu yinitsadvga yitsagasayastanv nasgiya igadulvsadv ulisigv tsvgasayasdisgoi, gvni iga dagadogi, ale sunale ehi noquisi dakalvgi ditsinawiyi;
english: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏁᏢᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Igvyi nasgi hia nitsigadovsesdi nasgi saquo unv adolehosvhi gowelvi uwasv gesv digvnetlvdodi nigesvna gesvi.
english: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒᏰᏃ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏴᏗᏓᎴᏁᎢ; ᎠᏃᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏂᏁᎨ ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗᏱ ᏄᏅᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Unadolehosvyeno ilvhiyu tsigesei vtla yvwiquo adanvtesgv yvdidalenei; anosdvsgini anisgaya Unelanvhi tsutseliga aninege iyuniwesdiyi nunvnehv Galvquodiyu Adanvdo.
english: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏓᏑᏰ ᏴᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᏣᏓᏑᏴᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᎫᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏌᏛ ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏞᎩᏳ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno unatlonasdi anadolehosgi igvwanadasuye yvwi, nasgiya unatlonasdi dinadeyohvsgi getsadasuyvdi tsigi, nasgi udelidv uniyvtanihisdi gesesdi unadatselidv gesv adadvdisgi, nasgi anadayihesdi Ugvwiyuhi unaguyvdv, ale unvsv iyunvnisadv unilutsedi gesesdi tlegiyu unidvdisgi.
english: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᏗ ᏛᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏛᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏛᏅᏂᏌᏂ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏃᎯ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale unitsatesdi dvnisdawadesi nasgi unatseli adadvdisgi; nasgi nvdvnvnisani duyugodv nvnohi unisotlvisdodi gesesdi.
english: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ ᏓᎨᏥᏰᎸᏥ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏘ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᎵᎾᎯᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎸᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Ale tsugvwalodi unigvvsgv iyusdi, ale galonuhedv anvdisgv aniwonisgv ganododi dagetsiyelvtsi; nasgi tsunadugodanedi gesv eti nvdagvwadalenvdv vtla yalinahisdiha, ale unidvdisgi vtla yigalvsga.
english: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ  ᏂᏚᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏗᏂᎧᎾᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ, ᏨᏍᎩᏃᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏫᏚᏓᎢᏅᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏲᏎ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏗᎨᎦᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎨᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎢ,
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno  nidugeyunvna tsigese dinikanawadidohi unisganvtsvhi, tsvsginoquosgini tsiwidudainvsei, ale tsiduyose tsudadesvdv digegalvsdodiyi ulisigv getsisquanigododiyi digegugodanedi gesv iyui,
english: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎨᏳᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎡᏘ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᏃᏯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏁᎳ ᏧᏛᏕᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏗᎧᎾᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎪᏔᏁ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nugeyunvna tsigese eti elohi tsigesei, Noyasgini tsunela tsudvdei gesv nasgi alitsidohvsgi duyugodv dikanawadidohi tsigesei, ale tsidunohugotane elohi anisgana anehvi,
english: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏐᏓᎻᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ ᏕᎦᏚᎲ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ ᏧᎷᏆᏗᏅᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏯᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎤᎾᏕᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Sodamino ale Gomali degaduhv gosdu tsiniduwanelei, ale tsiduwugodanele tsuluquadinvdiyi, ale nasgi uneyatahvsgi tsiniduwanele oni unadedi unelanvhi nidunanelodvna gesvi,
english: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏎᎢ, ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᏄᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏍᏚᎾᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Lodi udanvti tsuwudalesei, udeyatanelv nunalisinahisdvna anehv anisdunai.
english: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: (ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎬ [ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ] ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ,)
phonetic: (Nasgiyeno udanvti asgaya anehv tsehei, agowatisgv ale advgisgv [nusdv dunilvwisdanehvi] udanvti udanvdo nidugitsvnisv udeyadodi udanvte nvdigalisdodisge niduyugodvna dunilvwisdanehvi,)
english: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏰᎢᎵᏙᎲᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲᏃ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ:
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi agataha iyudvnediyi tsuwudalesdiyi unadanvti unigoliyesgi uniyeilidohvi, uniyono tsusquanigododiyi getsigiliyoisdodiyi digugododiyi iga gesesdi:
english: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮀ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ [ᎨᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ] ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ.  ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏗ; ᎥᏝ ᏯᏂᏍᎦᎢᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi ho ugvwiyuha [genigiliyoisdodi gesesdi] uquedali anisdawadegi unigvvsgv gadaha gesvi, ale dinisgagi nunigvwiyusadegi.  Unisgaisdi, unvsv anadanvtesgv unilvquodi; vtla yanisgaiha digvwanisotlvdodiyi getsilvquodi.
english: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏓᏂᎳᏫᏎᎰ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Dinikahnawadidohisgini utli itsunalinigidv tsigi vtla gohusdi usonv yidanilawiseho Ugvwiyuhi agatahvi.
english: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏉ ᏤᎿᎭᎠ ᎨᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᎨᎨᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎪ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏃᎵᎬᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏛᎾᎵᏛᏔᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᏂᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiasgini nasgiya gohusdiquo tsehnaa gegotlvnvhi gegeisdiyi ale getsidvdodiyi, nasgi anisotlvisdigo tsudalenvdv nanoligvna gesvi, ale dvnalidvtani unvsv uniyoiyu gesvi.
english: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏛᏂᏩᏛᎯ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ] ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏥᏰᎸᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ.  ᏥᏚᏓᏓᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏍᏙᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale dvniwadvhi gegaguyvdanedi niduyugodvna dunilvwisdanehvi, nasgiya [gegaguyvdanedi tsigi] osiyu utsiyelvhi iga gesv osdv tsunalisdayvdiyi.  Tsidudadaloi ale gohusdi tsusdoi nasgiyai, osiyu uniyelvha unvsv anadalidasdisgvi, nahiyu itsulaha itsalisdayvhvsgvi.
english: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ ᏧᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎠᏓᏲᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏲᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ:  ᏗᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ ᏂᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᎾ ᎦᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ; ᏧᏂᎾᏫ ᏧᎩᏌᏛ ᎠᎬᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᏥ,
phonetic: Dinigadoli tsukalitsvhi adayonedi gesvi, ale digvwaniyohisdi nigesvna asgani gesvi:  dinilonuhesgi nidunalinigvgvna ganadanvdvi; tsuninawi tsugisadv agvvhisdi digalvwisdanedi gesvi; agiliyoisdi gesv tsuwetsi,
english: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏅᏕᏨ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎴᏲᎥ, ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ ᎤᎶᏒ ᏇᎳᎻ ᏉᏌ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏧᏰᎸᏎ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎫᏴᏗ,
phonetic: Unvdetsv duyugodv ganvnvi, ale unaleyov, unisdawadenv ulosv Quelami Quosa uwetsi, osiyu tsuyelvse niduyugodvna digalvwisdanedi gesv aguyvdi,
english: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏥᎬᏍᎪᎸᏁ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ: ᎤᏩᎨᏫ ᏗᎦᎵᎠᏅᎯᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏔᏁ ᎤᏁᏤᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᏤ ᏄᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Aseno atsigvsgolvne usganvtsvi: uwagewi digalianvhidv yvwi uneisdi uwatane unetsei, usgatse nudanvdvna gesv adolehosgi.
english: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏔᎴᏒ ᎠᎹ-ᏗᏢᏗᏱ ᎠᎹ ᏂᏗᎦᏁᎲᎾ, [ᎠᎴ] ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏔᏂᏙᎰᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᎾᎨ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏥᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi datalesv amaditlvdiyi ama nidiganehvna, [ale] ulogilv unole tsunolvtanidohoi, nasgi na gvnage ulisigv tsigegadvnvisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
english: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏁᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᏂᎶᏄᎮᏍᎪ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, [ᎠᎴ] ᏃᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏗᏳᎯ ᏧᎾᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎴᏂᏙᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Aninegiyeno utsati atlvquasdi gohusdi gvdodi nigesvna aniwonisgvi, danilonuhesgo anvdisgo uquedali adulvdi gesvi, [ale] nolisinahisdvna nidasdi gesvi, nasgi udodiyuhi tsunadiwiselvhi nasgi na asi udalidasdi gesv analenidohi tsigi.
english: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᏂᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᏅᏒᏃ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᎨᏐᎢ:  ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎠᏥᏎᎪᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏎᎪᎩᏛ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Daniduisdaneho digetsinatlai nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, unvsvno uyo gesv digvwaninatlai gesoi:  giloyeno atsisegogi nasgi na usegogidv unatlai nigalisdisgoi.
english: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏗᏫᏎᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏱᎤᏁᏒ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎨᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏟ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno unadiwiselvhi yigi gadaha gesv elohi ehi, anvdisgv agadovhisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv, talineno yiunesv nahnani ale yigetsisegogisv, ulisqualvdi nunalisdanelv utli uyoiyu esgaquo igvyiyi.
english: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏟᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ ᏄᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎦᏅᏅᎢ, ᎠᏃ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎾᎦᏔᎲ ᏱᏚᏂᏲᏍᎦ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Utliyeno osiyu iyunalisdanedi yigesei nunigadovsvna yigese duyugodv ganvnvi, ano unigadovsvhi gesv yanagatahv yiduniyosga galvquodiyu dikahnawadvsdi nasgi digetsiyohiselvhi.
english: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᎩᎵ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎵᎦᏍᏔᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏮᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᏓ; ᏏᏉᏃ ᎠᎪᏑᎴᎥᎯ ᎤᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ ᏝᏬᏚᎯ ᏮᎠᎦᏔᎲᏍᏓ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgiya nunalisdanelv hia udohiyuhi igawedv tsigi, gili uwasv duligastanv taline wvagatahvsda; siquono agosulevhi udawosdiyi tlawoduhi wvagatahvsda.
english: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏕᏨᏰᏍᏓᏁ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Hia nasgi taline goweli hnaquo itsvyowelasi itsvgeyui; nasgi nahna detsvyesdane utlonasdi nigesvna detsadanvdv nasgi itsvyanvdadisdisgvi,
english: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏦᎦᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsanvdadisdiyi kanohedv ilvhiyu uninohedv getsilvquodi anadolehosgi, ale ayv tsogadeyonvhi oginvsidv Ugvwiyuhi ale Disdelisgi.
english: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ,
phonetic: Hia nusdesdi igvyi itsanvtesdi, nasgi ulisquanvdi gesesdi uniluhisdi gesv anisotlvisdisgi unvsv unadulvnvvsgv anisdawadegi,
english: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ?  ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨᏰᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᎵᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᎴᏅᏛ, ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏛᏉ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ.
phonetic: Ale hia iyaniwesgi, Gado ulistanv uluhisdiyi uduistanvi?  Anigayvligeyeno gvwanilinvtsvhi nvdagvwalenvdv, nvwasdiquo nigav gohusdi tsinusdvquo tsudalenvhv uwotlvnvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv.
english: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏛ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎹᏱ ᎦᏚ ᏧᎦᏚᏕᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏭᎯ ᏥᎦᏙᎨᎢ;
phonetic: Hiayeno unvsv unadulvdv nanigatahvna tsigi, nasgi Unelanvhi unetsv nvtsulisdotanv galvlo ilvhiyu tsigesei ale elohi amayi gadu tsugadudei, ale awuhi tsigadogei;
english: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎠᎹᏱᎭ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᎤᏲᏤᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi elohi nahiyu tsigese amayiha tsinulistanei, uyotsei.
english: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎪᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏁᏨ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏭᎾᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎬᏂ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ.
phonetic: aseno galvloi ale elohi gohi tsigi, nasgiquo unetsv nvdigalisdodiha dasquanigodi, atsilvyi wunaliyeilohisdiyi dasquanigodi gvni digugododiyi iga gesesdi ale getsidvdodiyi anisgaya unelanvhi nidunanelodvna.
english: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏑᏓᎴᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎤᏠᏱ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏌᏉ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ.
phonetic: Aseno itsvgeyui, hia nasgi sudalegi tlesdi nitsigatahvnaquo yigesesdi, nasgi saquo iga gesv Ugvwiyuhi dodikanisgv saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv utloyi, saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv saquo iga gesv utloyi.
english: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏍᎦᏃᎵᏳ ᏱᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎦᏃᎳ ᏣᏁᎵᎭ, ᎬᏂᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎦᏘᏴᎢ, ᏄᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏓᏅᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhi vtla usganoliyu yigi nusdv uduistanv iyudvnediyi, nasgi gilo nasganola tsaneliha, gvnidiyusgini ayv igigatiyvi, nudulisgvna gesv gilo uyohuhisdiyi, nigadiyusgini uniluhisdiyi ganetliyvsdi gesv odanvdvi.
