english: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏎ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏥᎦᎷᎪᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᏓᎦᎶᏐᏂ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏃᏴᎨᏍᏗ, ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯᏃ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏛᎪᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎪᏢᏅᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ugvwiyuhisgini utseli iga ase dagalutsi nasgiya ganosgisgi svnoyi tsigalugoi, nahiyu galvloi dagalosoni utsati unoyvgesdi, gotlvtanvhino adaweligisgv dvgoni, ale elohi nahnano gotlvnvnvhi gesv agohvsdodi gesesdi.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏗᏒᎲᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ!
phonetic: Nasgino nigadiyu tsudalenvdv udisvhvsdi tsigi, nigav nitsisganvna yigi itsalenidohvi ale unelanvhi ganayehisdi gesv itsehvi!
english: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏱᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᎭ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎤᏥᏍᏢ ᏨᏛᏗᏒᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᏛᏗᏌᏂ.
phonetic: Yitsigatenoha ale utsati yitsaduliha uluhisdiyi Unelanvhi utseli iga, nahiyu galvlo utsistlv tsvdvdisvni, ale nasgi gotlvtanvhi adaweligisgv dvdisani.
english: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᏗᎦᏖᏃᎭ ᎢᏤ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno nasgiya nusdv uduistanv idigatenoha itse galvloi ale itse elohi nahna ehv duyugodv gesvi.
english: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭ, ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏨᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏥᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏄᏓᏓᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᏤᎵᏎᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi, itsvgeyui, nasgi hia tsudalenvdv tsitsigatenoha, itsatlinigvsi nasgi nvwadohiyadv itsvdanvdv itsiwadvdiyi nudadalvna ale gohusdi netselisehvna.
english: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢ ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᏉᎳ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᏁᎸ ᏥᏦᏪᎳᏁᎸ;
phonetic: Nasgino gvnidiyu gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseliga alisdelvdodi itsiyelvsesdi; nasgiya nasquo edigeyui idalinvtli Quola gvdisgv agadovhisdi gesv atsinelv tsitsowelanelv;
english: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ; ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᏭᎾᏕᎶᏆᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ ᏓᏂᏁᏟᏴᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᏐᎢ ᎪᏪᎵ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo nigadv nasgi tsuwowelanvhi nasgi nidegvneho kaneisdisgo nasgi hia tsudalenvdv; nahna udasuya igadv asdayiyu golisdiyi, nasgi na niwunadeloquavna ale diniwanagala daninetliyvha, nasgiya nasquo disoi goweli nidanvnehvi, unvsvquo unidvdisgi gesvi.
english: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᎦᎾ ᎤᏂᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅ ᏕᏣᏘᏂᏒ ᏗᏥᏅᏨᎩ ᏗᏥᏲᏒᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi nihi itsvgeyui, nasgi gayula tsitsigataha, itseyatahesdi, tlesdi aninagana unilidastanv detsatinisv ditsinvtsvgi ditsiyosvgi ulinigidv nitsadvnvi.
english: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Itsinequogesdisgini gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ugvwali ale etsigadovhisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli ale Igisdelisgi Tsisa Galonedv; nasgi galvquododi gesesdi gohi gesv, ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
english: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ, ᏦᏥᎦᏙᎵ ᏦᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᎦᎧᎿᎭᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎪᏰᏂ ᏦᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᎦᏒᏂᎵᏙᎸᎯ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏂᏛ^
phonetic: Nasgi didalenisgv tsehei, ayv ogadvganvhi, tsotsigadoli tsogvtanvhi ogigohvhi, nasgi tsogakahnanvhi, ale tsogoyeni tsogvtanvhi ogasvnilidolvhi, kanohedv gvnidv^
english: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏛᏰᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎡᎲ ᏤᎮᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏲᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ^
phonetic: Gvnidvyeno gvnigesv nulistanvgi, ale ogigohvgi, ale otsinoheha, ale itsvnanuwiseha nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv, nasgi Agayvligei ehv tsehei, ale gvnigesv iyogvnelvhi tsigi^
english: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎣᎩᎪᎲᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏖᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎣᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi na ogigohvhi ale ogadvganvhi gesv itsvnanuwiseha, nasquo nihi itsateladisdiyi ogadudadewisvi; ale udohiyuhiya ogadudadewisv Agayvligei ale Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hia ale nasgi itsvyowelaneha itsaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
english: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎣᏣᏛᎦᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏨᎾᏄᏫᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi kanohedv otsadvganelvhi tsigi ale tsitsvnanuwiseha nasgi Unelanvhi igagati gesvi, ale usdi unvulisigi nuwehvna gesvi.
english: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎦᏚᏓᏔ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏃ ᏱᏕᏙᎭ, ᏱᏓᏥᎪᎥᏍᎦᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno nasgi dogadudata yidadiha, ulisigvno yidedoha, yidatsigovsgaquo ale vtla yigedisdawadega udohiyuhi gesvi.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᏕᏙᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎦᏛᎢ ᏤᎭ, ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎵᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Igagadvsgini yidedoha, nasgiya nasgi igagadvi tseha, degadudadewisv igvsv gesvi; ale uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv ugigv iginvgaliha nigav igisganvtsvi.
english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏲᎨᎭ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎢᎬᏒ ᏱᏓᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno vtla asgani yogeha yidadiha, igvsv yidadalidasdiha, ale vtla yigegeha udohiyuhi gesvi.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᏃᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno yidinohvsga igisganvtsvi, nudalidasdvna ale udanvtiyu, nasgi iginediyi igisganvtsvi, ale iginvgalvdiyi nigav uyo digalvwisdadi gesvi.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎡᏗᏰᎪᎥᏍᎦᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno vtla yogisganvtsv yidadiha, ediyegovsgaquo, ale kanohedv utseliga vtla yigegeha.
english: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎦ, ᎢᎨᎭ ᏗᎪᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎡᎲᎢ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli diquetsi, hia nasgi itsvyowelaneha, itsisganvisdiyi nigesvna.  Iyuno gilo yasganvga, igeha digohisdanehi Agayvlige ehvi, Tsisa Galonedv nasganvna.
english: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏴᏉ ᎢᎬᏒ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi ayv igisganvtsvi, ale vtla ayvquo igvsv igisganvtsvi, nasquosgini elohi nigvnadvi.
english: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏗᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi idadolehohisdiha edigatahvi, nasgi yidigisquanigodi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi.
english: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᏚᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Gilo tsigataha adisgi, aseno nidusquanigodvna yigi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi gayegogi ale udohiyuhi gesv nuwehvna.
english: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ:  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Gilosgini yusquanigodi nasgi unetsvhi, nasgi udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi ageyudi gesv ukalitsvhi gesoi:  nasgi hia idadolehohisdiha ediyavi.
english: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ [ᏥᏌ] ᏥᏯᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, [ᏥᏌ] ᎤᏪᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏰᏙᎭ.
phonetic: Gilo [Tsisa] tsiyaa yadiha, [Tsisa] uwedolv nasgiya nasquo yedoha.
english: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎥᏝ ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎤᏪᏘᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏥᎲᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏪᏘ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Idadanvtli, vtla itse dikahnawadvsdi yitsvyowelaneha, uwetiquosgini dikahnawadvsdi nasgi tsitsihvgi didalenisgvi; uweti dikahnawadvsdi nasgiquo kanohedv didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsinetsadvgisgoi.
english: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴᏬ, ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎭ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏰᏃ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ, ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎦᎦᏘ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Alewo, itse dikahnawadvsdi itsvyowelaneha, nasgi udohiyuha [Galonedv] gesvi ale nihi gesvi; ulisigvyeno ulosonv, hnaquono duyugodv igagati dulvsadv.
english: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎨᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟᏃ ᏯᏍᎦᎦ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᎭ ᎩᎳᎯᏳ.
phonetic: Gilo igagadv gea yadiha, dinadanvtlino yasgaga, ulisigvquo eha gilahiyu.
english: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏳᏪᎭ.
phonetic: Gilo dinadanvtli yugeyuha igagadv eha, vtla ale gohusdi adadodesdisgi yuweha.
english: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏉ ᎡᏙᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᏩᎦᏛᎢ, ᎤᎵᏏᎬᏰᏃ ᏚᎨᏩᏛ.
phonetic: Dinadanvtlisgini asgagi ulisigvquo eha, ale ulisigvquo edoha, vtla ale yagataha wagadvi, ulisigvyeno dugewadv.
english: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏅᏨᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᏥᏌ ᏕᎤᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyowelaneha ditsiyoli itsisganvtsvyeno etsidolitsv nvtsulisdotanv Tsisa deudovi.
english: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ, ᎡᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvyowelaneha itsigayvligei, etsigadovsvyeno didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tseha.  Itsvyowelaneha itsiwinv, etsisegogisvyeno unegutsidv.  Itsvyowelaneha ditsiyoli, etsigadovsvyeno Agayvligei.
english: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎡᏥᎦᏙᎥᏒᏰᏃ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎭ.  ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏥᏫᏅ, ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏥᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎤᏁᏧᏥᏛ.
phonetic: Itsvyowelasi itsigayvligei, etsigadovsvyeno didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tseha.  Itsvyowelasi itsiwinv, ditsalinigidiyuyeno, ale kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga itsiyaa, ale etsisegogisv unetsutsidv.
english: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᎬᏩᎨᏳᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitsigeyusesdi elohi, ale gohusdi elohi ehi.  Iyuno gilo elohi yugeyuha, vtla yigvwageyuha Agayvligei.
english: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏄᏓᎴᏰᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᏰᎸ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏨᎦᏙᎵ ᎤᏙᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏢᏉᏗ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᏍᏛᏱ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Tsinudaleyeno elohi tseha, ayelv udulvdi tsigi, ale tsvgadoli udolvdi tsigi, ale atlvquodi alenidasdiyi, nasgi vtla Agayvligesdvyi nvdayudalenvhi yigi, elohiquosgini udalenvhi.
english: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏚᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎭ.
phonetic: Ale elohi galosohvsga, ale nasgi nahna adulvdi gesvi, nasgisgini na Unelanvhi adanvtesgv tsulvwisdanehi nigohilv eha.
english: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ, ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯᏃ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ-ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏣᏔ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ-ᎠᎾᏡᏗᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: ditsiyoli, hnaquo ulisqualvdi, itsadvganvhino tsigi uluhisdiyi galonedvatludisgi, ale gohi gesv unitsata galonedvanatludisgi; nasgi iyusdi idigataha ulisqualvdi gesvi.
english: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎨᎦᏙᏣᎳᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎳ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏔ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᏱᏂᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ [ᎤᎾᏙᏣᎴᏒᎩ] ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏁᎳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gegadotsalaelvgi, aseno vtla nahna anela yigesei, iyuyeno nahna aneta yigesei, ase yinigvwanadvnei, aseno [unadotsalesvgi] gvnigesv iyunalisdodiyi nahna nigadv anela nigesvna gesvi.
english: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Nihisgini nasganvna itsilonev, ale itsigatahiyu nigavi.
english: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hia tsitsvyowelasi vtla yinvdagalisdoda nitsigatahvna gesv duyugodvi, itsigatahiyusgini gesvi, ale itsigatahiyu gesv nigav gayegogi kanohedv duyugodv nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏓᏱᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏓᏱᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Gago gayegogi, iyuno nasgi nigesvna yigi na adayihi Tsisa Galonedv gesvi.  Nasgi na galonedvatludisgi, adayihi Agayvligei ale Uwetsi.
english: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ] ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏓᏱᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ; [ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.]
phonetic: Gilo [Unelanvhi] Uwetsi adayihi, nasgi vtla yuweha Agayvligei; [nasgisgini na gohiyuhvsgi uwetsi nasgi uweha nasquo Agayvligei.]
english: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsitsadvgiha nasgi nihi itsiyaesdi.  Iyuno nasgi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsitsadvgiha itsiyaesdi, nihi nasquo etsiyaesdi Uwetsi ale Agayvligei.
english: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Ale hia nasgi igiduisdanelvhi tsigi, nasgi alisquadisgi nigesvna gvnidv.
english: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎦᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎨᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvyowelasi gatsineisdisgv nasgi na getsilidasdisgi.
english: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏥᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᏲᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎢᏥᎶᏁᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏤᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎢᏤᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgisgini Tsisa itsilonetanvhi gesv tsitsiyaa, ale udulvdi nitsalisdanehvna tsigi gilo itseyodiyi, nasgiyeno Tsisa itsilonetanvhi tsitseyohvsga nigavi, ale udohiyusv tsigi, ale gayegogi nigesvna tsigi, nasgiya nusdv itseyohvsgv etsiyaesdi.
english: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: Ꭷ, ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏥᏌ ᎡᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏕᎰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎷᏥᎸᎭ.
phonetic: Ka, ditsiyoli, Tsisa etsiyaesdi, nasgino nahiyu gananugotsilvha nidinayesgvna gesesdi ale nidadehosgvna gesesdi agatahvi nahiyu galutsilvha.
english: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ, ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ [ᎾᏍᏉ] ᎾᏂᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno yitsigataha nasganvna gesv Tsisa, itsigataha [nasquo] naniv duyugodv tsunilvwisdanehi nasgi tsunanugowisvhi gesvi.
english: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏄᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎦᏰᎪᏎᏗ ᏥᎩ.  ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏴ ᏂᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo nusquanigodi adageyudi gesv Agayvlige iginelv, nasgi unelanvhi tsuwetsi gayegosedi tsigi.  Elohi ayv nigigatahvna tsigi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgi nugatahvna tsigesvgi.
english: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏴ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏨᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏂᎦᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᏗᎪᎢ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, hnaquo Unelanvhi tsuwetsi ayv, aseno vtla asi gvnigesv yinigalisdiha igalisdodi gesvi; aseno idigataha nahiyu gananugotsvha nasgiya nusdv nigasdesdi, nasgiyeno nusdv nasgi dayedigoi.
english: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏙ ᎤᏚᎩ ᏧᏩᏐ [ᏥᏌ], ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᎦᎵᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᏥᏌ] ᏄᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono nasgi hia tsinusdo udugi tsuwaso [Tsisa], uwasv adanvgalisgoi, nasgiya [tsisa] nunvgalvna tsigi nasgiya nadadvnehoi.
english: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ ᎠᏲᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo tsasganvgo ayosdisgo nasquo dikahnawadvsdi, asganiyeno ayosdisgi dikahnawadvsdi.
english: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ ᎢᎩᎲᎡᏗᏱ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ; ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ.
phonetic: Ale itsigataha nasgi gvnigesv nagvnelv igihvediyi igisganvtsvi; uwasvsgini vtla yuweha asgani.
english: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏣᏯᎣ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏱ] ᎥᏝ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ; ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo tsayao [Galonedvyi] vtla yasganvgoi; gilo tsasganvgoi vtla ugohvhi yigesoi, vtla ale ugadovsvhi yigesoi.
english: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎶᏄᎮᎴᏍᏗ; ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli tlesdi gilo yitsilonuhelesdi; duyugodv tsulvwisdanehi nasgi nasganvna, nasgiya [Galonedv] nasganvna tsigi.
english: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏰᏃ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎸᎩ, ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asgani tsulvwisdanehi, asgina nvdayudalenvhi gesoi, didalenisgvyeno nvdagvwadalenvdv asgina asganvgoi.  Nasgi iyusdi Unelanvhi Uwetsi gvnigesv nagvnelvgi, uyosdodiyi asgina dulvwisdanelvi.
english: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏱᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎤᏪᎰᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo Unelanvhi udetanvhi tsigeso vtla asgani yidulvwisdanehoi; nasgiyeno utseliga ugata uwehoi, vtla ale yeli gvwasganvisdi yigesoi, nvdigalisdodisgo Unelanvhi udetanvhi gesvi.
english: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏪᏥ; ᎩᎶ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nahna Unelanvhi tsuwetsi gvnigesv nanalisdiha, ale asgina tsuwetsi; gilo duyugodv tsulvwisdanehi nigesvna tsigesoi, vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigesoi; ale dinadanvtli ugeyuhi nigesvna tsigesoi.
english: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏂᎨᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hiayeno nasgi kanohedv tsitsadvgiha didalenisgv nigetsadvgisgoi, nasgi digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi.
english: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᎾ ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏅᏟ ᏧᎴ.  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎢᎤᎴᎢ?  ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏅᏟᏃ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla nasgi gena nudvnelvi, nasgi unegutsidv nvdayudalenvhi tsigesei, ale unvtli tsule.  Gadono iulei?  Nvdigalisdodisgesgini uwasv dulvwisdanehv uyoiyu gesvi, unvtlino dulvwisdanehv osiyu gesvi.
english: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᎩᏳ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Tlesdi yitsisquanigosgesdi, idadanvtli, iyuno elohi igisgagiyu igesesdi.
english: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎩᎶᏒᎢ ᎬᏂᏛᏃ ᏫᎩᎾᏄᎪᏨᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏗᏗᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎭ.
phonetic: Idigataha ayohuhisdi gesv igilosvi gvnidvno wiginanugotsvi, nvdigalisdodiha didigeyuhiyu gesv idadanvtli.  Gilo ugeyuhiyu nigesvna yigi dinadanvtli, ayohuhisdi gesv eha.
english: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎠᏍᎦᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎯᎯ; ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎠᎯᎯ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo dinadanvtli asgagi yigi nasgi yvwi ahihi; itsigatahano yvwi ahihi gvnidv nuwehvna gesvi.
english: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎢᏗᎪ ᏩᏘᎭ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᏕᏛᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏱᏗᏗᏁᎭ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Ani idigo watiha udageyudi gesvi, nvdigalisdodiha gvnv eladi iginelvi, ale nasquo ayv dedvnv eladi yididineha idadanvtli.
english: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏪᎰᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎬᎬᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏚᏁᎰᏉ ᎤᎾᏫ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gilosgini elohi ehi alisdelvdodi gesv tsuwehoi, ale tsagowatisgo dinadanvtli unigvgvi, aseno nasgi tsasdunehoquo unawi, gado yigalisdoda yuweha Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi?
english: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ ᏗᏇᏥ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏁᎬᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᏃᎪᎢᏉ ᏱᏗᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᎦᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ, ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli diquetsi, tlesdi idinegvquo ale didinogoiquo yididvdisgesdi yigadageyusesdi, degilvwisdanehvsgini ale udohiyusvi.
english: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏅᏓᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᏙᎯᏱᏃ ᏂᏙᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia idadolehohisdiha duyugodv nvdagadalenvhi gesvi; dohiyino nidodadvneli diginawi nasgi agatahvi.
english: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuyeno diginawi igisganvtsv yidigugodiha, Unelanvhi utli galvquodiyu esgaquo diginawi, ale agatahiyu nigavi.
english: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᏂᏗᎫᎪᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏔ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ;
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, iyuno diginawi nidigugodanehvna yigi, ugalisdiyu igadanvta unelanvhi edadanvtesgvi;
english: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᏔᏲᎭ ᎢᎩᏁᎰᎢ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏓᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎩᎧᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigav gohusdi iditayoha iginehoi, nvdigalisdodisgo igisquanigodv utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, ale degilvwidanehv nasgi osdv uyelvdi gesv degikanvi.
english: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᎩᏁᏤᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nusdi utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, igohiyudiyi deudov Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv, ale digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi nasgiya iginetselvi.
english: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ], ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎣᎢ [ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ].  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏯᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Gilono nasgi utseliga dikahnawadvsdi asquanigodisgi nasgi ayaoi [Unelanvhiyi], ale nasgi uyaoi [Unelanvhi].  Ale adanvdo iginelvhi gesv nasgi idadolehohisdiha ayv igiyavi.
english: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᏱᏗᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳ ᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, tlesdi naniv didanvdo yiditsohiyuhvsgesdi, detsigoliyesgesdisgini didanvdo, Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi gesv, ale Unelanvhi nvdayu dalenvhi nigesvna gesvi.  Unitsatayeno unatlonasdi anadolehosgi anedoha elohi.
english: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nusdi itsolisdodi Unelanvhi utseli Adanvdo; nasgi adanvdo hia igawesgi, Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilei, nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi.
english: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎴᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ-ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎦᏳᎳ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgino adanvdo hia igawesgi nigesvna, Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilei, vtla Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi yigi.  Nasgisgini hia galonedvatludisgi utseliga adanvdo, nasgi uluhisdiyi itsadvganvhi tsigi, ale hnaquo gayula elohi eha.
english: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏣᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᏥᏎᎪᎩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎤᏟ ᎤᎵᏂᏗᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏥᏯᎢ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Nihi Unelanvhi nvdatsadalenvhi, ditsiyoli, ale detsisegogisv nasgi; nvdigalisdodiha utli ulinidigidiyu gesv itsiyai esgaquo elohi ayai.
english: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᎶᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Elohi nvdayunadalenvhi nasgi, nasgi iyusdi elohi ehi aniwoniha, ale elohi unadvganehoi.
english: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏲᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎯ ᎣᎦᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎦᏛᎦᏁᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏕᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᏯᏌᏛᏁᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Ayv Unelanvhi nvdayogadalenvhi; nasgi na Unelanvhi agatahi ogadvganehoi.  Nano Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi nigesvna vtla yogadvganehoi.  Nasgi nvdigalisdodiha dedigataha duyugodv iyanadvnehi adanvdo, ale duyugodv iyasadvnehi nigesvna didanvdo.
english: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᏕᎦᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏧᏓᎨᏳᏐ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, degadageyusesdi; adageyudiyeno gesv Unelanvhi udayudalenvhi, gilono tsudageyuso Unelanvhi unanugowisvhi gesoi, ale agataho Unelanvhi.
english: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᎨᏳᎯᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎥᏝ ᏯᎦᏔᎰ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏙᎥ.
phonetic: Udageyuhino nigesvna, vtla yagataho Unelanvhi; Unelanvhiyeno udageyudi gesv dudov.
english: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᏕᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎩᏩᏛᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ani hia gvnigesv nulistanvgi Unelanvhi igigeyusvi, Unelanvhiyeno tsunvse uwasvhiyu udenelvhi Uwetsi elohi uluhisdiyi, nasgi iyuwanisodiyi gvnidv igiwadvdiyi.
english: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏍᏨᎢ.
phonetic: Ani hia adageyudi gesvi, vtla Unelanvhi edigeyuiyu nulistanvi, ayvsgini igigeyuhiyu nulistanvi, ale tsunvsv utseliga Uwetsi alisgolvtanvhi aguyvdodi igisgastsvi.
english: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, iyuno Unelanvhi nasgi igai igigeyuhiyu iyulistanvhi yigi, ayv nasquo digadageyuhiyu yigi.
english: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ.  ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ilvhiyu gilo Unelanvhi ugohvhi yigi.  Iyuno digadageyuhiyu yigi, Unelanvhi igiyaa, ale ayv edigeyusv ukalitsvhi gesoi.
english: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᏯᎥᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏯᎥᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi idadolehohisdiha ediyavi ale ayv igiyavi, nasgi nvdigalisdodisgv igalisgolvdanelvhi gesv uwasv utseli Adanvdo.
english: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎣᎩᎪᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏧᏅᏒ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale ayv ogigohv ale otsinoheha Agayvlige tsunvsv Uwetsi elohi Asdelisgi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏪᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎣᏯᎣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo hia igawesgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi oyaoi, ale nasgi Unelanvhiyi ayaoi.
english: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᎦᏙᎥᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏅ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏙᎥ, ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎯ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏯᎣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏯᎣᎢ.
phonetic: Ale ayv igigadovsv ale igohiyunv Unelanvhi igigeyuhiyu gesvi.  Unelanvhi adageyudi gesv dudov, adageyudino gesv ehi Unalanvhi ayaoi, ale Unalanvhi nasgi uyaoi.
english: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎢᎦᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ, ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏗᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏍᏗ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Ani hia igadageyudi gesv ukalitsvhi, nulistanv nasgi nidinayesgvna iyulisdodiyi digugododiyi iga gesesdi, nvdigalisdodiha nasgiya nusdv nasquo nasgi nigasdi ayv ani elohi.
english: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏳᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎤᏪᎭ; ᎩᎶ ᏥᎦᎾᏰᏍᎪᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᏱᎨᏐ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla ganayehisdi gesv yudasuya adageyudi gesvi, ukalitsvhisgini gesv adageyudi ganugowisga ganayehisdi gesvi; ganayehisdiyeno gesv agiliya uweha; gilo tsiganayesgoi vtla ukalitsvhi yigeso adageyudi gesvi.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Edigeyua nasgi nvdigalisdodiha ayv igvyi igigeyuhiyu nulistanvi.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏳᎠ ᏯᏗᎭ, ᏯᏍᎦᎦᏃ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo Unelanvhi tsigeyua yadiha, yasgagano dinadanvtli, gayegogi nasgi, ugeyuhiyeno nigesvna yigi dinadanvtli nasgi ugohvhi, gado yigalisdoda ugeyuhiyu yigi Unelanvhi ugohvhi nigesvna gesvi.
english: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi dikahnawadvsdi iginelvhi, nasgi iyuno gilo ugeyuhiyu gesesdi Unelanvhi, nasquo ugeyuhiyu gesesdi dinadanvtli.
english: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏱᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ ᏥᏌ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎤᏓᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Gilo yigohiyuhvsga Tsisa nasgi Galonedv gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi udetanvhi, gilono yugeyuha udananugowisvhi, nasquo atsinanugowisvhi ugeyuhiyu gesoi.
english: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏗᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi edigeyui tsigesoi, ale tsigisquanigodo utseliga dikahnawadvsdi, nasgi idadolehohisdisgo gedigeyuiyu gesv Unelanvhi tsuwetsi.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ; ᎤᏤᎵᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎨᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno hia nusdi Unelanvhi ageyudi gesvi, nasgi digisquanigododiyi tsutseli dikahnawadvsdi; utselino dikahnawadvsdi vtla gagediyu yigi.
english: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎪ ᎡᎶᎯ.  ᎢᎪᎯᏳᏒᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ.
phonetic: Nigavyeno gohusdi Unelanvhi udetanvhi asegogisgo elohi.  Igohiyusvno nasgi asegogisgi elohi.
english: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎨᏒᎢ?
phonetic: Gago na elohi asegogisgi iyuno nasgi nigesvna yigi nasgi na gohiyuhvsgi Tsisa Unelanvhi Uwetsi gesvi?
english: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎹᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎹᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ.  ᎬᏩᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ ᎦᏱᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi ama ale gigv uluhistanvhi, hia Tsisa Galonedv; vtla amaquo uwasv, amasgini ale gigv.  Gvwatloyasdi ale Adanvdo nasgi kanohesgi, Adanvdoyeno gayigogi nigesvna.
english: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏦᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉᏉ.
phonetic: Anitsoiyeno aninohesgi galvladi; Agayvligei, kanohedv, galvquodiyuno adanvdo; nasgino hia anitsoi gesv saquoquo.
english: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏦᎢᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ, ᎠᎹ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ.
phonetic: Anitsoino aninohesgi elohi, adanvdo, ama, ale gigv, nasgino hia anitsoi gesv utloyi aninoheha.
english: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᏗᏂᏱᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Iyuno yididiniyiha yvwi uninohelvhi, Unelanvhi unohelvhi utli galvquodiyu; hiayeno nasgi Unelanvhi unohelvhi, nasgi uneistanvhi tsigi Uwetsi.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᎭ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏰᎪᏅ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵ ᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏂᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Gohiyuhvsgi Unelanvhi Uwetsi nasgi uwasv gesv uweha gohiyudisgi; Unelanvhi gohiyuhvsgi nigesvna, nasgi Unelanvhi uyegonv, nvdigali sdodiha nigohiyuhvsgvna gesv Unelanvhi unohelvi Uwetsi uneistanvi.
english: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎧᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nasgi nusdi kanohelvhi gesvi, nasgi Unelanvhi iginelv winasdvna gvnidv, ale nasgi hia gvnidv Uwetsi utseliga gesvi.
english: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎤᏪᎭ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏪᎭ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Gilo Unelanvhi Uwetsi uwehi, nasgi gvnidv uweha; Unelanvhino Uwetsi nuwehvna vtla yuweha gvnidv.
english: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᏤᎲᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia nusdi itsvyowelasi itsohiyuhvsgi dudov Unelanvhi uwetsi, itsadolehohisdiyi gvnidv itsehvi gesvi, ale itsohiyudiyi dudov Unelanvhi uwetsi.
english: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎡᏙᎢᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏏ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛᎦᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nusdi edoiyusvi, nasgi iyuno nigav gohusdi editayosi osdv uyelvdi gesvi, igadvganehvi.
english: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏏ ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎰ ᎢᎩᏁᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏗᏔᏲᏎᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Iyuno yidigataha igadvnehvi, nigav gohusdi editayosi idigataho iginehv iyusdi editayoselvi.
english: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎪᎲ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏳᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏎ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎡᎭ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᏱᎦᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo yugohv dinadanvtli yusganvtsv ayohuhisdi nigesvna asganvisdi gesvi, nasgi atayohihesdi ale ase gvnidv dayetsineli ayohuhisdi nigesvna unisganvtsvhi nvdigalisdodisgvi.  Eha asganvisdi ayohuhisdi gesvi, vtla atayohihesdi nasgi atsidolisdiyi yigadiha.
english: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ, ᎡᎭᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Nigav duyugodv nigesvna nasgi asgani, ehano asganvisdi gesv ayohuhisdi nigesvna.
english: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏒᏂᎰᎢ.
phonetic: Idigataha gilo Unelanvhi udetanvhi tsigesoi vtla yasganvgoi, Unelanvhisgini udetanvhi ulisquanigodoi, nasgino na unegutsidv vtla yusvnihoi.
english: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏃᏴᏨ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Idigataha Unelanvhi nvdagadalenvhi gesvi, ale nigvnadv elohi unoyvtsv uyo gesvi.
english: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᎷᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᎢᎪᎵᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏗᏯᎠ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
phonetic: Idigatahano Unelanvhi Uwetsi ulutsvi, ale iginelv igolisdiyi, nasgi edolisdiyi nasgi gayegogi nigesvna tsigi; ale nasgi ediyaa gayegogi nigesvna tsigi, nasgi Uwetsi Tsisa Galonedv.  Nasgi hia udohiyuhiya Unelanvhi, ale winasdvna gvnidv.
english: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏥᏲᎵ, ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ditsiyoli, detseyadotsehesdi Unelanvhi diyelvhi.  Emenv.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᎠᎦᏑᏰᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏋᏒᏉ ᏱᎩ ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Ayv aquadvsonvhi witsiyoliga agasuyedv ageyv ale nasgi tsuwetsi, nasgi gatsigeyui duyugodv gesvi, ale vtla aquvsvquo yigi nasquosgini nigadv unigadovsvhi duyugodv gesvi;
english: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎩᏯᎠ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᏥᎨᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nvdigalisdodiha nasgi duyugodv gesv tsigiyaa, ale nasgi ase tsigeladidohesdi nigohilvi.
english: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏗᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎤᏪᏥ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Gvwagadiya udadolisdi gesvi itseladidohesdi ale udadolisdi gesvi ale nvwadohiyadv gesvi, nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi Unelanvhi Agayvligei ale Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv Agayvlige Uwetsi, duyugodv gesvi ale adageyudi gesvi.
english: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ ᎠᏆᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᏤᏥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatanvhi aqualihelitsvgi aquadolehosv igadv ditsetsi duyugodv gesv anaisvi, nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi iginelv Agayvligei.
english: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎬᏔᏲᏎᎭ ᎯᎨᏴ, ᏗᎦᎵᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎢᏤ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏥᏁᎩᎰᎢ, ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Hnaquono gvtayoseha higeyv, digaligeyuhi iyulisdodiyi; vtla adina itse dikahnawadvsdi tsigvyowelaneho iyusdi yigi, nasgiquosgini tsinegihoi, digadageyuhi iyulisdodiyi.
english: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏥᏁᏣᏛᎩᏍᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi hia nusdi adageyudi gesvi, nasgi igedasdiyi nasgiya dikahnawadvsdi utseliga nigawesgvi.  Nasgi hia dikahnawadvsdi didalenisgv nvdagvwadalenvdv tsinetsadvgisgoi, nasgi ditsikahnawadvsdiyi.
english: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Unitsatayeno utlonasdi anedoha elohi, nasgi anohiyuhvsgi nigesvna Tsisa Galonedv uquedali unanugotsilvi; nasgi hia utlonasdi ale galonedvatludisgi.
english: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᎩᏲᎱᏎᎴᏍᏗ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎢᏗᏩᏛᎲᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎡᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ.
phonetic: Itseyatahesdi tlesdi yigiyohuselesdi degilvwisdanelvi, idiwadvhvquosgini ukalitsvhi egaguyvdanedi.
english: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᏣᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏐ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎢ ᏳᏪᎰᎢ.  ᎾᏑᎵᎪᎬᎾᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᎧᎾᏩᏗᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏕᏲᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᎭ ᎢᏧᎳ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏥ.
phonetic: gilo tsasganvgoi ale nidakahnawadegvna tsigeso galonedv tsudeyonvhi, nasgi vtla unelanvi yuwehoi.  nasuligogvnasgini na dakanawadisv dikahnawadegi galonedv tsudeyonvhi, nasgi duweha itsula agayvlige ale uwetsi.
english: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏥᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏲᎸᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏕᏲᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏕᏥᏁᎸ ᏱᏕᏣᎵᏂᎸᏤᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏰᏥᏲᎵᎴᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Iyuno gilo yitsilutselv ale nuyolvna yigi hia nasgi dideyodi gesvi, tlesdi detsinelv yidetsalinilvtsesdi, ale tlesdi yetsiyolilesdi;
english: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎵᎯ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno na ayolihi uweladisdiha uyo dulvwisdanehvi.
english: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏛᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗ ᎠᎩᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎪᏪᎵᏉ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᏯᎩᏰᎸᏎᎢ, ᎤᏚᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏋᎭ ᎢᏨᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏗᎰᎵ ᏗᎬᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎵᏃᎮᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Utsadvgi iyudalegi itsvyowelanedi agihvgi, aseno vtla goweliquo ale digowelodi digvdodi yagiyelvsei, udugiyeno aquvha itsvwadvhvsdiyi, ale didiholi digvdodiyi igalinohediyi, ale idaliheligv ukaliisdiyi.
english: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏑᏴᏛ ᎡᏣᎸᎢ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Agasuyvdv etsalvi tsuwetsi wigetsayoliha.  Emenv.
english: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎠᎢᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ ᎠᏥᎨᏳᎢ ᎦᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᎨᏳᎢ.
phonetic: Ayv aidvsonvhi witsiyoliga atsigeyui gaya, nasgi ayv tsigeyui.
english: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏣᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏣᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Gvgeyui, utli igai aquaduliha osdv tsanequotsediyi ale nvwadohiyadv tsalenidasdiyi, nasgiya tsadanvdo osdv unequotsehvi.
english: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ, ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᎵᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸ ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎮᏙᎲ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Utsatanvhiyeno aqualihelitsvgi, idadanvtli unilitsv ale uninohelv tsatlonasdi nigesvna gesvi, nasgi hedohv duyugodv gesvi.
english: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᎬ ᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏗᏇᏥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Vtla gohusdi utli igai aqualihelisdi sgiya yigi nigav aqualihelisdigv gadvgvga diquetsi duyugodv gesv anedohvi.
english: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏕᎭᏛᏁᎲ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏁᏙᎯ.
phonetic: Gvgeyui, duyugodv hnadvneha nigav nidehadvnehv unaligohi ale anedohi.
english: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏘᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᎠᎾᎢᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᏅᏔᏛᏁᎵ.
phonetic: Nasgi uninohelvhi tsigi tsadageyuhiyu gesv tsunanelodi unadatlugv anigatahvi; iyuno nasgi yitisdelvhv anaisvi, Unelanvhi gvwasdawadidohi iyunadvnedi, osiyu nvtadvneli.
english: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᏂᏂᏟᏍᎬᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno dudov nvtsulisdotanv anedoha gohusdi nidaninitlisgvna tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
english: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᏗᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi yinvdigalisdodiha yididadanilvga nasgi iyunasdi, nasgi itsulaha degilvwisdanehv yidisdeliha duyugodv gesvi.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ Ꮎ ᎦᏥᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏓᏯᎶᏈ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎴᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᏱᏙᎦᏓᏂᎸᎦ.
phonetic: Tsunanelodi unadatlugv na gatsiyowelanelvgi, aseno dayaloqui igvyi ulediyi udulisgi, vtla yidogadanilvga.
english: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏫᏯᎩᎷᏨ ᏓᎦᏅᏓᏗ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎬᏗ ᏦᎦᏡᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᏰᎵ ᏳᏰᎸᎭ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏂᏓᏓᏂᎸᎬᎾᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏕᎦᏅᏍᏓᏕᎭ ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᏁᏓᏡᎬ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi iyuno wiyagilutsv daganvdadi dulvwisdanehvi, nasgi uyo gawonisgvgvdi tsogatludiha, ale vtla nasgiquo yeli yuyelvha, vtlayeno nidadanilvgvnaquo uwasv yigi anadanvtli, nasquosgini deganvsdadeha digvwanadanilvisdi tsigesvi, ale deganugowisga tsunanelodi unedatlugv.
english: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᎨᏳᎢ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏣᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᎨᏒ ᎯᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎪᎲᎯ ᏱᎩ.
phonetic: Gvgeyui, tlesdi usonv gesv yitsasdawadvsesdi, osdvsgini gesv hisdawadegesdi.  Osdv tsulvwisdanehi nasgi Unelanvhi nvdayudalenvhi; uyosgini tsulvwisdanehi nasgi vtla Unelanvhi ugohvhi yigi.
english: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎻᏟᏯ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏴ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎣᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Dimitliya nanivquo osiyu gvwanoheha, ale nasquo duyugodv gesv osiyu unoheha, ale nasquo ayv otsinoheha, ale itsigataha otsinohesgv duyugodv gesvi.
english: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏣᏗ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏉᏪᎶᏗ ᎠᎩᎲᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᏱᏙᏓᎬᏔᏂ Ꮎ ᏴᏓᎬᏲᏪᎳᏁᎵ;
phonetic: Utsadi iyudalegi aquowelodi agihvgi, aseno vtla digowelodi yidodagvtani na yvdagvyowelaneli;
english: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎠᏋᎭ ᏞᎩᏳ ᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎩᏅᏙᏗᏱ ᎩᎾᎵᏃᎮᏗᏱ.  ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᏂᏣᏛᎢᏕᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎢᎦᎵᎢ ᏫᎨᏣᏲᎵᎭ.  ᎦᎾᏙᎠᏗᏒ ᎩᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᎢᎦᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Aseno udugi aquvha tlegiyu gvgowadvdiyi, ale hnaquo diniholi diginvdodiyi ginalinohediyi.  Nvwadohiyadv nitsadvidegesdi.  Igalii wigetsayoliha.  Ganadoadisv giyolilvha igalii.
english: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏧᏓᏏ, ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᎻ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᏫᏨᏲᎵᎦ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎢᏨᏁᎸᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏴᏎᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎡᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ;
phonetic: Ayv Tsudasi, Tsisa Galonedv aginvsidasdi ale Tsimi tsosdadanvtli, witsvyoliga nihi nitsisganvna itsvnelvhi Unelanvhi Agayvsegei, ale Tsisa Galonedv iyuwanisadv etsisquanigotanvhi, ale etsiyanvdv itsadanvti itsalisdodiyi;
english: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv ale adageyudi gesv etsinequoedi gesesdi.
english: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎠᏆᏟᏂᎬᏁᎸ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏉ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᎦᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᏔᏁᎲ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎢᏣᏗᏒᏎᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏗᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ.
phonetic: Itsvgeyui, iyuno aquatlinigvnelv witsvyowelanediyi nigadiyuquo igatseli igalisdelvdodi ugvwali, udulvdi naqualisdanelvgi witsvyowetanehv itsvsdiyedodiyi, nasgi ulinigidv itsadisvsediyi gohiyudi gesv nasgi gayula digetsiyohiselvhi tsigi unadanvti.
english: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎯ ᎢᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎨᎪᎥᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ, ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᎩ ᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏯᏅᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᏱᎯ ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ.
phonetic: Giloyeno iyunasdi anisgaya udelidv uniyvlvhi igi nasgi ilvhiyu nvdagvwadalenvdv digegovhi tsigi nasgi iyusdi digegugodanediyi; Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna anisgaya, gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Unelanvhi aninetliyvsgi nalisinahisdvna alenidasdi gesv iyanvnehi, ale anadayihi uwasvhiyu Ugvwiyuhi Unelanvhi, ale igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv.
english: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏚᏭᏓᏓᏎ ᏴᏫ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎲ, ᎣᏂ ᏥᏚᏛᏔᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi aquaduliha itsvyanvdadisdodiyi nasgi hia gayula tsitsigataha, nasgi na Ugvwiyuhi tsiduwudadase yvwi Itsiquiyi gada ahv, oni tsidudvtane nasgi na nunohiyunvna.
english: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏄᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏅᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸ ᏧᏅᏕᏤᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᏗᎬᏩᏲᎢᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏕᎨᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎬᎢ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎲ ᎬᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale dinikahnawadidohi nunisquanigotanvna tsigese nunigvwiyusadegi nigegvnelv tsunvdetsequosgini unatseligohi anehvi, tsudadesvdv digvwayoisdi nigesvna degegalvsdi ulisigvi, galvquodiyu digugododiyi iga asqualvhv gvdisgi.
english: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏐᏓᎻ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎹᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎾᎥ ᏥᏕᎦᏚᎮᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮ ᏓᎾᏓᏲᏍᎨ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏗᏂᏏᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᎠᏍᏓᏳᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏓᏕᏯᏔᎲᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴᎢ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎨ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏠᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ.
phonetic: Ale nasquo Sodami ale Gomali, ale nasgi na nav tsidegaduhei, nasgiya nanadvnehe danadayosge udelidv dinisidi gesv tsunilvwisdanediyi, ale anisdawadidohe uquedali asdayudvsdi uquedali nigesvna gesvi, adadeyatahvsgi nigegvnelei anigiliyoge unisdvdisdi gesv gvtlosgi nigesvna atsilvyi.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏒᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgiya nasquo hia anasgidasvvsgi gadaha nanvneha uniquedalvi, dinisgagi nunigvwiyusadegi, ale digvwanisotlvdi getsilvquodi.
english: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏱᎩᎵᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎸ, ᎤᎾᏗᏒᎸ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎼᏏ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎹᏱᎩᎵ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏳᎳᏫᏎᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏫᏣᏍᎦᎩ.
phonetic: Suyigilisgini nugvwiyusadegi dikahnawadidohi asgina unadisvlv, unadisvlv aniwonisgv Mosi ayelvi, mayigili vtla gohusdi usonv yulawiselei, hiaquosgini nuwesei, Ugvwiyuhi witsasgagi.
english: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎲᎾ; ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎾᎦᏔᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗᏉ ᏣᏁᎿᎭᎠ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏲ ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏁᎭ.
phonetic: Hiasgini usonv aninoheha nasgi nanigatahvna; nasgisgini unvsv gesv tsinagataha, nasgiya gagolisdiquo tsanehnaa anigatahvi, nasgi nahna uyo nanadadvneha.
english: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏲ ᏫᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏏ!  ᎨᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏅᏅ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᎨᎮᎾ ᏇᎳᎻ ᎤᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᏛᏔᏅ, ᏚᏂᎦᏘᎸᏒ ᎪᎵ ᏧᎦᏘᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Uyo winunalisdasi!  Genayeno unvnv unisdawadenv, ale gegaguyvdanedi unadulisgv unigvvsgv unigehena Quelami ulidastanv, ale getsidvtanv, dunigatilvsv Goli tsugatilvdv gesvi.
english: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏚᏓᏓᎳ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᏕᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏧᎳᏕᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᎦ ᎾᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ; ᏚᎶᎩᎸ ᎠᎹ ᏂᏚᏁᎲᎾ, ᎤᏃᎴ ᏧᏱᎴᎪᎢ; ᏕᏡᎬ ᏧᎳᏍᏚᏬᎠᏔᎯ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᎾᏓᏓᏁᎲᎾ, ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᏗᏰᎯᏛ ᏗᎧᎾᏍᏕᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi nvyohi dudadala ditsanelodi detsalisdayvhvsgvi, nahiyu itsuladetsalisdayvhvga naninayesgvna analisdayvhvsgoi; dulogilv ama nidunehvna, unole tsuyilegoi; detlugv tsulasduwoatahi, gohusdi nunadadanehvna, tali iyuwagudi uwayvsvhi tsigesoi, diyehidv dikanasdetlvtanvhi tsigesoi.
english: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᎯ ᏗᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎩ; ᏃᏈᏏ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᎤᎾᏞᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎬᎿᎭᎨ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᏥᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Amequohi uhnalvhi dilisdilanegi, unvsv unadehohisdisgi aninanugowisgi; noquisi uninvnv unatledv, nasgi utsati gvhnage ulisigv tsigegadvnvisdanelv ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
english: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᎩ, ᎠᏓᏫ ᎤᏕᏅ ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ ᏪᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᎪ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᏙᎵ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ,
phonetic: Ale Inagi, Adawi udenv galiquogine wehi, nasquo adolehosgv hia nasgi duneistane hia nuwesei, Gvniyuquo, Ugvwiyuhi dagalutsi datinehesdi asgo iyagayvli tsudoli unadanvti,
english: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎬᏍᎪᎸᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᏄᏂᏪᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Tsuwugodanediyi nanivi, ale tsugvsgolvdiyi naniv Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna nvdigalisdodisgv nigav utsatini digalvwisdanedi dunilvwisdanelvi, ale nigav niduyugodvna nuniwesv Unelanvhi nidunanelodvna nasgi gvwatludisgvi.
english: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏌᏘ, ᎤᏁᎵᎯᏍᎩ, ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ; ᏗᏂᎰᎵᏃ ᏓᏅᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪᎢ, ᏴᏫ ᏚᎾᎧᏛ ᏓᏂᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏩᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi unigonelohisati, unelihisgi, unvsv unadulvnvvsgv anisdawadegi; diniholino danvdisgo utsati atlvquisdi aniwonisgoi, yvwi dunakadv danilvquodisgo osdv igvwanalisdanedi udugi unvsv iyusdi.
english: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ, ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏣᏅᏓᏓ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏛ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ;
phonetic: Aseno, itsvgeyui, itsanvdada kanohedv ilvhiyu uninohedv getsinvsidv Ugvwiyuhi igatseli Tsisa Galonedv tsutseliga;
english: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi hia tsinuniwesvgi, ulisqualvdi gesesdi anehesdi anisotlvisdisgi, nasgi unvsv unadulvnvvsgv niduyugodvna anisdawadegi.
english: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ, ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏁᎲᎾ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi na anadadaledisgi tsigi, uquedaliquo anisdawadegi, Adanvdo nunehvna.
english: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᎫᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏓᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎢᏣᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Nihisgini itsvgeyui, utsati galvquodiyu itsohiyusv itsaligusdvdisgvi, Dalvquodiyu Adanvdo gvdi itsadolisdisgvi,
english: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ, ᎢᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhi etsigeyuiyu gesv detsiniyvsesdi, itsigatenohesdi igatseli Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv udadolisdi gesv gvnidv adanehi tsigi.
english: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᏕᏥᏙᏓᎨᏍᏗ, ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Igadvno detsidodagesdi, tsudalenvdv nidetsadvnehesdi;
english: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ ᎨᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏕᏨᏕᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ; ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᎠᏚᏯᏍᏙᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Anisoino getsinayesgi detsisdelisgesdi, detsvdegesdi atsilvyi; itsiniquatihesdi anuwo uquedalv aduyasdotanvhi.
english: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎬᏩᏲᏍᏙᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏥᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏁᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎾ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏓᎧᏅ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ,
phonetic: Hnaquono nasgi na yeliquo gvwayosdododi tsigi ditsinvisdiyi, ale gvnigesv igetsvnedi tsigi utsati ulihelisdi itsadanvdvi gohusdi netsilawisehvna igvyiditlv dakanv galvquodiyu gesvi,
english: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏒᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi uwasvhi agatanai tsigi Unelanvhi Igisdelisgi, galvquododi gesesdi, ale galvquodiyu gesesdi, nugvwiyusadegi gesesdi, ale ulinigidiyu gesesdi, gohi gesv ale ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
english: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏧᎨᏅᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏣᏂ;
phonetic: Tsisa Galonedv unanugowisvhi, nasgi Unelanvhi tsuyohiselvhi, gvnigesv itsuwanediyi tsunvsidasdi tsudalenvdv nigohilvquo iyulistanidasdi gesvi; ale tsugenvdv utseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv iyuwanediyi unvsidasdi Tsani;
english: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏃᎮᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi na tsunohele kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga, ale Tsisa Galonedv unohelvhi, nasgi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv ugohvi.
english: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎪᏪᎸᎢ; ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyulisdanedi agoliyesgi, ale nasgi anadvgisgi kanohedv hia nasgi adolehosvhi, ale anisquanigodisgi nasgi na tsudalenvdv nahna gowelvi; usqualvhidiyeno.
english: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏂᏣᏓᏡᎬ ᎡᏏᏱ; ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎮᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏣᏁᎭ;
phonetic: Ayv Tsani witsvyowelasi ditsanelodi galiquogi nitsadatlugv Esiyi; gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv ale nvwadohiyadv itseladidohesdi nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi nasgi na tseha, ale tsehvgi, ale tsehesdi; ale nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi galiquogi Didanvdo nasgi uwesgilv igvyiditlv tsaneha;
english: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᏲᎱᏒ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.  ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎢᎪᏑᎴᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ,
phonetic: Ale nvdayulisgolvtanvhi Tsisa Galonedv gayegogi nigesvna Kanohesgi, ale didalenvdisgi ayohusv dilehisodi gesvi, ale Ugvwiyuhi elohi anehi unigvwiyuhi unatseliga.  Nasgi igigeyuhi tsigesvgi ale uwasv ugigv igosuletanvhi iginvgalvdv igisganvtsvi,
english: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎢᏕᎶᎯ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Ale igigvwiyuhi ale atsilvidelohi igvnelvhi tsigi Unelanvhi nasgi Udoda tsutseliga; nasgi galvquodiyu ale ulinigidiyu agosehesdi ulisquadisdi nigesvna.  Emenv.
english: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏓᎬᏩᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎬᏪᏘᎸᎯ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏙᏛᎾᏠᏱᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎰᏩᏉ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo dagalutsi ulogilvi, ale nigadiyu dagvwagohi ale nasquo digvwetilvhi; nigadiyuno tsunadalenvdv yvwi elohi anehi dodvnatloyili nasgi gesv nvdigalisdodisgesdi.  Howaquo.  Emenv.
english: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, didalenvdisgi ale asquadisdisgi, adiha Ugvwiyuhi nasgi tseha, ale tsehvgi, ale tsehesdi, winasdvna ulinigidv tsigi.
english: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ, ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᎵᎪ ᏩᏕᎩ ᎢᏗᎩᎵᏲᏥᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎢᏖᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᏴ ᎨᏙᎲᎩ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏆᏗᎹ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎠᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ayv Tsani, idalinvtli nasquo tsigi, ale igaligo wadegi idigiliyotsidohvi, ale Tsisa Galonedv utseligohi itelvi, ale gvnidiyu gesv nasgi utseliga, ayv gedohvgi amayeli Quadima tsidudov, kanohedv Unelanvhi utseliga agisdvdisgvgi, ale Tsisa Galonedv tsinohesgv iyusdi.
english: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᏆᏘᏂᏙᎲᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᏧᏃᏴᎪᎢ,
phonetic: Adanvdo aquatinidohvgi Ugvwiyuhi utseli iga gesvi, aquadvganvgino aquasohadv iditlv asdaya kanegv nasgiya atselugi tsunoyvgoi,
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎰᏪᎸᎦ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏫᎩᏅᎥᏏ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᎡᏏᏱ, ᏫᎩᏅᎥᏏ ᎡᏈᏌ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏑᎹᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏆᎩᎹ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏱᏓᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏗᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏈᎵᏕᎵᏈ, ᎠᎴ ᎴᎣᏗᏏᏯ.
phonetic: Hia nigawesgvgi, ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, igvyiyi gesv ale ulisqualvdi gesvi; Ale nusdv higowatisgv howelvga gowelihi ale wiginvvsi tsunanelodi galiquogi nunadatlugv Esiyi, wiginvvsi Equisa anehi, ale Sumani, ale Quagima, ale Dayidali, ale Sadisi, ale Quilideliqui, ale Leodisiya.
english: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᎦᏔᎲᏒᎩᏃ ᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅᎩ ᎤᏪᎷᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏗᏍᎩ.  ᎠᏆᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᏓᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Aquagatahvsvgino tsigowadvdiyi agiyelvnvgi uwelugi, nasgi aqualinohedisgi.  Aquagatahvsvno dagigohvgi galiquogi ditsvsdodi digagododi adelv dalonige digotlvtanvhi;
english: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᏕᎦᎧᎲ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗ [ᎦᏙᎬᎩ] ᎩᎶᎢ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏄᏩᎥᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ ᏂᏚᎸᎩ, ᎠᏓᏠᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏓᏠᎲᎩ ᏗᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᏧᏳᎪᏗ.
phonetic: Ayelino degakahv galiquogi ditsvsdodi digagododi [gadogvgi] giloi yvwi Uwetsi nasgiyai, unuwavgi tsulasideni nidulvgi, adatlosdino adelv dalonige gotlvtanvhi udatlohvgi diganvdiyi tsuyugodi.
english: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏗᏰᎬ ᎤᏁᎩᏳ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏩᏅ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎥᏃᏥ ᏥᏄᏁᎩᏴ ᏄᏁᎩᏴᎩ; ᏗᎦᏙᎵᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ;
phonetic: Asgoli ale usdiyegv unegiyu gesvgi uwanv nasgiyai, vnotsi tsinunegiyv nunegiyvgi; digadolino atsilv adaweligisgi nasgiya gesvgi;
english: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂᏃ ᏗᎬᏩᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎥᏣᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᎬᏔᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ; ᎧᏁᎬᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎹ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsulasidenino digvwatalugisgi vtsayi nasgiya gesvgi, atsilvyi gvtanvhi osdv igvnelvhi nasgiyai; kanegvno utsati ama tsidusquanoyvgo nasgiya gesvgi.
english: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏚᏒᎦᎸᎩ; ᎠᎰᎵᏃ ᏓᏳᎦᏌᏛᎩ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᏗᏢ ᏗᎪᏍᏓᏯ; ᎤᎧᏛᏃ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ-ᎡᎯ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏣᎦᎵᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Agatisiditlvno uwoyeni galiquogi noquisi dusvgalvgi; aholino dayugasadvgi ayelasdiganvhidv itsuladitlv digosdaya; ukadvno nvdo igaehi ulinigidv tsagalisgo nasgiya gesvgi.
english: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏥᎪᎥᏃ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᏅᏨᎩ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ.  ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢᏃ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᏆᏏᏔᏗᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Tsigovno dulasgv aginvtsvgi agiyohusvhi igagadv.  Agatisiditlvno uwoyeni aquasitadistanvgi, hia nagiweselvgi, Tlesdi yisgaihesdi, ayv nasgi na igvyiyi, ale ulisqualvdi tsigi.
english: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬᎾ, ᎡᎺᏅ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᏁᎠ.
phonetic: Ayv gvnodv agiyohusvhi tsigesvgi; ale gvniyuquo gvnodv gesesdi nalisquadisgvna, Emenv; ale disduisdi tsvsgino ale ayohuhisdi gesv detsinea.
english: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎰᏪᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎪᏩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏗᏕᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏂ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Howelvga nasgi na tsigowadv, ale gohi gesv nusdidegvi, ale oni iyulistanidasdi gesvi.
english: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏥᏕᏣᎪᎲᎩ ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎠᏉᏰᏂ ᏥᏓᏆᏒᎦᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ.  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎨᏥᏛᎦ; ᎾᏃ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏕᏣᎪᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏄᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Nasgi udelidv gesv galiquogi noquisi tsidetsagohvgi tsigatisiditlv aquoyeni tsidaquasvgalvgi, ale galiquogi ditsvsdodi digagododi adelv dalonige digotlvtanvhi.  Nasgi na galiquogi noquisi dinikahnawadidohi galiquogi nunadatlugv tsunanelodi getsidvga; nano galiquogi ditsvsdodi digagododiyi tsidetsagohvgi, nasgi galiquogi nunadatlugv tsunanelodi gadvga.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏈᏌ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏫᏲᏪᎳᏏ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᏂᏪᏏ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏥᏚᏒᎦᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏤᏙᎭ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎦᎧᎲ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏨᏙᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ.
