phonetic: Ale ganasda vgidelvgi adolanvsdi nasgiyai; dikahnawadidohino ulenvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Talehvga, ale hatlilotsa Unelanvhi utseli digalawiisdiyi, ale atsilvgelasdiyi, ale nasgi na anadadolisdisgi tsigi nahnani.
english: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏥᎪᏢᎭ, ᎯᏃᎯᏴᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏟᎶᎥᎩ, ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏰᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏔᎵᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Udlanvdvsgini digalawiisdiyi doyiditlv tsigotlvha, hinohiyvha, ale tlesdi tsatlilovgi, tsunadalenvdvyeno yvwi getsinelvhi nasgi; ale galvquodiyu gaduhv unalasdaedi gesesdi nvgasgohi taligali iyanvdo.
english: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏆᏤᎵᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ ᏓᎦᏥᏁᎵ [ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ] ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ, ᏧᏏᏕᏅ ᏚᎾᏄᏩᎡᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Diquatselino anitali anigatahi dagatsineli [unadolehohisdiyi] ale anadolehosgesdi saquo iyagayvli talitsuqui sudalisgohino tsusvhidv, tsusidenv dunanuwaesdi.
english: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏔᎵ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏕᎦᎧᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi oliwa tali detlugvi, ale tali ditsvsdodi digagododiyi tsidegakaha Unelanvhi elohi uwotlvnvhi nudvnv igvyiditlv.
english: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏙᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏥᎸ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᎦᎩ; ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Iyuno gilo gohusdi dogvnehesdi nasgi, atsilv diniholi diganugogesdi, ale unidvdisgesdi gvwanisgagi; iyu ale gilo gohusdi tsuwanediyi udulisgesdi, nasgi iyagvnedi atsiisdi gesesdi.
english: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎭ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎦᏅᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎾᏙᎡᎰᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎭ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏚᏪᏯᏗᏒ ᎩᎬ ᎢᏧᏅᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥᏉ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎢᎦᎢᏉ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi uniha galvladi unisdudiyi, nasgi uganvdiyi nigesvna anadoehosgv igohidv; ale uniha amayi duweyadisv gigv itsunvnediyi, ale nasgi iyunvnisodiyi nigavquo udeyadodi gesv elohi ulutsediyi igaiquo anelisgvi.
english: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᏨᏗᎦᎾᏄᎪᎦ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ ᏓᏳᎾᏡᏔᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏳᏂᏎᎪᎩᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᏳᏂᎵ.
phonetic: Hnaquono unisquadv nasgi uninohedi gesvi, nvgidiganvsadi nasgi winasdvna atalesv tsvdigananugoga dahnawa nvdagvneli dayunatlutani, ale dayunisegogisi, ale dodayunili.
english: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᏂᏰᎸᎢ ᏕᎦᏁᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎳᏅᏛ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᏐᏓᎻ ᏣᏃᏎᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏥᏈ, ᎾᎿᎭᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎠᏥᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgino tsuniyohusvhi diniyelvi deganesdi degalanvdv edasdiyi equa gaduhvi, nasgi datlilosdv Sodami tsanoseha ale Itsiqui, nahna nasquo Ugvwiyuhi igatseli atsilvi.
english: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎦᏛᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏓᏛᎿᎭᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᏓᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᏂᏰᎸᎢ ᏦᎢ ᎢᎦ ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏁᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏧᏂᏅᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Igadvno nasgi na yvwi, ale gohusdi dinadadvhna gesvi, ale tsudalenvdv diniwonisgi gesvi, ale unadatselidv yvwi danewadisvi, danigowadisgesdi tsuniyohusvhi diniyelvi tsoi iga nvgineno ayeli, vtlano unelagi unelisdi yigesesdi tsuniyohusvhi diniyelv didanisodiyi tsuninvdiyi.
english: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏛᎾᎵᎮᎵᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎾᏓᏁᎸᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Hnano elohi anehi dvnalihelitsi nasgi gesv nvdigasdodisgesdi, ale osdv unadanvtawadegesdi, ale gohusdi danadanelvvsgesdi; hiayeno anitali anadolehosgi gvwanigiliyoistanvgi nasgi na elohi anehi.
english: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎴᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᎲᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏂᎾᏰᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoino iga nvgineno ayeli ulosonv adanvdo gvnidv Adanehi Unelanvhi nvdayulisgolvtanvhi gvwaniyvlvgi, ale dunalenvgi, nasgino gvwanigohvhi utsati uninayesvgi.
english: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏗᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎲᎢ, ᎡᏍᏓᎩᎳᏩ ᎠᏂ ᎢᏍᏗᎷᎩ.  ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ ᏭᏂᎶᏒᎩ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎤᎾᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᎬᏩᏂᎪᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Unadvganvgino asdaya dikanegv galvladi nvdayudalenvhi, hia nuniwesehvi, Esdagilawa ani isdilugi.  Galvladino wunilosvgi ulogilv unalisaladanvgi.  Ale gvwanisgagi gvwanigohvgi.
english: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳᏉᏃ ᎧᎳᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᎢᎦᏛᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏪᏨᎯ ᎤᏲᏨᎩ, ᎦᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᎵᏖᎸᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎢ ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏴᏫ ᏙᎨᏥᎸᎩ; ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯᏃ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nahiyuquono kalawadisv utsati ulitelvnvgi gadohi, asgohino igadvhi gesv gaduhv nasgi saquo iyuwetsvhi uyotsvgi, gadohino alitelvhvsgv iyui galvquogi iyagayvli yvwi dogetsilvgi; unalinohiyvhino unisgalvgi, ale galvladi ehi Unelanvhi unilvquotanvgi.
english: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎤᏲ ᎬᏒ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ.
phonetic: Taline uyo gesv ulosonv; gvniyuquo tsoine uyo gvsv tlegiyu dagalutsi.
english: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏤᎷᎯᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏗᎧᏁᎬᎩ ᎩᎶᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏍᏓ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Galiquogineno gesv dikahnawadidohi utseluhisvgi; ale galvladi iyvdv asdaya dikanegvgi giloi, hia nvdagawesgvgi, Ayeli degotlvwadisv ani elohi, igatseli Ugvwiyuhi, ale nasgi na utseli Galonedv tsunatseli nidegalisda; ale nasgi na nigohilv ale nigohilv ugvwiyuhi gesesdi.
english: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎩᏦᏁᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ, ᏚᎾᎵᏯᏍᏚᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
phonetic: Nvgitsoneno iyanidv tsunadvsonvhi nasgi Unelanvhi nudvnv igvyiditlv degasgilv tsaninvgi, dunaliyasdunvgi, ale unadadolisdanelvgi Unelanvhi,
english: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏒᎵᏤᎭ, ᏂᎯ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏛ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎮᏍᏗ; ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏥᏣᎩᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Hia nuniwesvgi, Itsvyalisvlitseha, nihi Tsagvwiyuhi Tsanelanvhi, Winasdvna tsalinigidv, nihi nasgi tseha, ale nasgi tsehvgi, ale nasgi tsehesdi; nvdigalisdodiha tsitsagisv utsati tsalinigidiyu gesvi, ale tsagvwiyuhi tsinitsalistanv.
english: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏣᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎲ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏗᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏘᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎩ, ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏛᎾ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏂᏛᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Unadatselidvno yvwi danewadisv unihnalvtsvgi, ale nihi nahiyu tsatalawohisdi gesv usqualvhv, ale nahiyu tsuniyohusvhi digegugodanedi gesvi, ale nasgi taguyvedi gesv tinvsidasdi anadolehosgi, ale unadanvti, ale nasgi na detsadov aninayesgi, tsunasdi ale nasquo tsunadvna; ale didvdodiyi nasgi na elohi anidvdisgi gesvi.
english: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏳᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᏁᏌᎢ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎶᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎦᎸᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏁᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏴᏓᏆᎶᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏙᎯ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎤᏁᏐᎠᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Unelanvhino utseli digalawiisdiyi dayunisduisvgi galvladi, ale wagowadvdi gesvgi nahna utseli digalawiisdiyi ganesai dikahnawadvsdi digalodi; ale dunagalvhvgi, ale duninetsvgi, ale duyvdaqualovgi, ale godohi ulitelvnvgi, ale usgasedi unesoasvgi.
english: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᎶᎢᏃ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ; ᎠᎨᏴ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ-ᎡᎯ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏛᎩ, ᏅᏙᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ-ᎡᎯ ᎤᎳᏍᏓᎥᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩᏃ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ ᏔᏔᏚ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Galvloino galvquodi uyelvdv unanugotsvgi; ageyv nvdo igaehi unuwosdvgi, nvdono svnoyiehi ulasdavgi, ulisdulvgino alisdulo tatadu noquisi digotlvtanvhi.
english: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎦᏁᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᏕᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ [ᎠᏲᎵ.]
phonetic: Nasgino ganelidv gesv iyusdi, uwelunvgi ale unanugowisidena gesvgi, ale ehisdi udanvdv udulisgvgi unanugowisdiyi [ayoli.]
english: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏔᏅ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎢᎾᏛ [ᏫᏥᎪᎥᎩ,] ᎦᎸᏉᎩ ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏕᎤᎷᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale usquanigodi unanugotsvgi galvladi; ale gvniyuquo utanv gigage inadv [witsigovgi,] galvquogi dasgudadvgi, ale asgohi deulugvgi, ale galiquogi dulisdulvgi dasgudadvi.
english: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏂᏓᏛᏃ ᏃᏈᏏ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏂᎧᎸ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏗᎦᏛᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏪᏨᎯ ᏕᎤᏎᏒᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏫᏚᏗᏅᏒᎩ; ᎢᎾᏛᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎴᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏄᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏᏕᎾ [ᎠᏲᎵ] ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏃᏅᎯᏉ ᎤᏪᏯᎣᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ganidadvno noquisi galvladi anikalv tsoi idigadvhi gesv nasgi saquo iyuwetsvhi deusesvtanvgi, ale gadohi widudinvsvgi; inadvno igvyiditlv ulenvgi ageyv nudvnvi, nasgi unanugowisidena [ayoli] nasgi udenonvhiquo uweyaohvsdiyi uyelvsvgi.
english: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏃ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎳᏅᏍᏗ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏮᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏴᏫ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᏱ ᏩᏥᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asgayano ayoli unanugowisvgi nasgi adolanvsdi talugisgi gotlvtanvhi uwvdodi gesvgi digvwanelododiyi iyuwanediyi nigadv unadatselidv danewadisv yvwi; nasgi uwetsi Unelanvyi watsinvstanvgi, ale Unalanvhi uwesgilvi.
english: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎤᎵᏘᏒᎩ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᎶᏒᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ.
phonetic: Ageyvno ulitisvgi inage wulosvgi, nahna Unelanvhi udvnvisdanelvi, nasgi agelasdiyi saquo iyagayvli talitsuqui sudalisgohi tsusvhidv.
english: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎿᎭᏩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎹᏱᎩᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᎵᎸᎩ ᏚᏂᎦᏘᎸᏒᎩ ᎢᎾᏛ; ᎢᎾᏛᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᎾᏟᏴᎲᎩ,
phonetic: Dahnawano nulistanvgi galvladi; Mayigili ale nasgi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi dunalilvgi dunigatilvsvgi inadv; inadvno ale nasgi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi dunatliyvhvgi,
english: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏓᏎᎪᎩᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale vtla yunadasegogisei; vtla ale hnaquo ilvhiyu yuniwadvhe galvladi unadediyi.
english: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᏔᏅ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᎪᏎᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᎭ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ [ᎠᏁᎯ;] ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏰᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏰᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏓᎨᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino na utanv inadv atsinugowisvgi, nasgi na agayvli inadv, Asgina tsagoseha, ale Sedani, nasgi tsidegalonuheha nigvnadv elohi [anehi;] nasgi dayetsinugowisvgi elohi dayegadainvsvgi, ale nasgi tsutseli dinikahnawadidohi itsulaha dagetsinugowisvgi.
english: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏗᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ; ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏩᎦᏓᎤᎦ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏄᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏜᏓᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aquadvganvgino asdaya kanegv hia nvdigawesgv galvladi, Hnaquo aliyeiloga alisdelvdodi gesv ale ulinigidv gesvi, ale Iganelanvhi nahna ugvwiyuhi gesvi, ale ulinigidiyu gesv Galonedv nasgi utseliga; idalinvtliyeno gesv unuhisdisgi eladi wagadauga; nasgi tsunuhisdisgv Iganelanvhi agatahvi iga ale svnoyi digvwadlasdi.
english: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏎᎪᎩᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᏅᏁᎲ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏅᏅ ᏂᏚᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvwasegogistanvgi Unodena agina ugigv, ale gvnigesv nanvnehv unohiyusvi, nasgi danvnv nidunilvquodvna gesvi.
english: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᏂᎦ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᏥᏤᎭ.  ᎤᏲᎢᏳ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᏤᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎢᏤᎯ!  ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏠᎠᏎᎵᎦ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ ᎤᏍᏆᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi itsaliheligi niga galvloi gesvi, ale nihi nahna tsitseha.  Uyoiyu itsalisdanedi elohi itsehi, ale amequohi itsehi!  asginayeno itsatloaseliga, utsati utalawosgvi agatahayeno usqualahiyu gesv agalisgolvdanelvi.
english: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎾᏛᏃ ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏣᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎢ, ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Inadvno udolehosv gadohi tsagadainvsvi, udeyadotanvgi ageyv nasgi na asgaya unanugowisvhi.
english: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏓᏥᏕᎸᎩ ᎠᏬᏎᎵ ᎤᏔᏅ ᏗᎧᏃᎨ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏭᏃᎯᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎧᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Ageyvno tali datsidelvgi awoseli utanv dikanoge, nasgi inage wunohilvsdodiyi atsiyelvnanelvgi, nahna utseligohi digesvi, nahna agelasdiyi sudetiyvdv, ale tali tsudetiyvdv, ale ayeli iyudetiyvdv, nasgi atsikahvsdiyi inadv agatahvi.
english: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎾᏛᏃ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ ᎠᎹ ᏥᎦᏃᎱᎩᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎨᏴ ᎤᎨᎮᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏃᎱᎩᏍᎬ ᎤᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Inadvno aholi dayunugowisvgi ama tsiganohugisgo nasgiyai, ageyv ugehegi nasgi ganohugisgv unvsdodiyi uyelvnvgi.
english: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏙᎯᏃ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᎲᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎩᏐᏅᎩ ᎦᏃᎱᎩᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏅᏓᏳᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Gadohino usdelvhvgi ageyv, ale gadohi usduisvgi aholi ale ugisonvgi ganohugisgv nasgi inadv aholi nvdayunugowisvhi.
english: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᏤᎸᎩ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎠᎨᏴ] ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale inadv uhnalvtselvgi ageyv, ale dahnawa itsuwanediyi uyelvnvgi unalinohiyvhi nasgi [ageyv] unetlvtanvhi gesvi, nasgi na anisquanigodisgi dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi tsutseliga, ale unihi Tsisa Galonedv utseli gohiyudisgi.
english: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎺᏉᎯᏃ ᎤᎶᏗ ᏃᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏆᎴᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏓᏳᏚᎩᏒᎩ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩ, ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏚᎷᎬᎩ, ᏚᎷᎬᏃ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ, ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Amequohino ulodi noyuhi gesv vqualetanvgi, ale nvgi diganvsadi tsigovgi amequohi dayudugisvgi, galiquogi, dasgudadvgi ale asgohi dulugvgi, dulugvno asgohi dulisdulvgi, dasgudadvno unelanvhi dudov asotlvisdodi gesv gowelvgi.
english: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏃ ᏅᎩ ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏥᎪᎥᎯ ᏢᏓᏥᏧᎶᎸᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏚᎳᏍᎬᏃ ᏲᏅᏥᏚᎳᏍᎦ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎰᎵᏃ ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏃᏕᏅ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏥᏄᏍᏙ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎢᎾᏛᏃ ᎤᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏗ ᎢᏳᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Hnano nvgi diganvsadi tsigovhi tlvdatsitsulolvdi nasgiya gesvgi, dulasgvno yonvtsidulasga nasgiya gesvgi, aholino tlvdatsi unodenv aholi tsinusdo nasgiya gesvgi, inadvno unelvgi utseli ulinigvgvi ale utseli uwediyi gesvi, ale utsadi iyudvnelidasdiyi ulisgolvdanelvgi.
english: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏃ ᎠᏍᎫᏓᏛ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏣᏥᏐᏅᏃ ᏓᏤᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏥᏐᏅᏅ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ [ᎠᏁᎯ] ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏍᎬᎩ [ᎠᎴ] ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ.
phonetic: Saquono asgudadv agigohvgi gvwayohuhisdi iyvdv tsatsisonvno datselvgi; ale nasgi gvwayohuhisdi iyvdv atsisonvnv udiwasvhi gesvgi; ale nigvnadv elohi [anehi] anisquanigosgvgi [ale] anisdawadisvgi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi.
english: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ-ᏓᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᎤᏁᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᎪ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏗ?  ᎦᎪ ᏰᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᏱᎾᏅᎦ?
phonetic: Ale unadadolisdanelvgi inadv nasgi nvgidaganvsadi ulinigvgv unelvhi gesvi; ale nasgi nvgidiganvsadi unadadolisdanelvgi, hia naniwesgvgi, Gago nvgidiganvsadi nusdv nasgiya nusdi?  gago yeli nasgi dahnawa yinanvga?
english: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏢᏈᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏔᎵᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏅᏙ ᎤᏕᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale aholi atsinelvgi nasgi gvdisgv utsati atlvquisdi gesv gawonisgvgi ale asotlvisdisgvgi; ale agalisgolvdanelvgi nvgasgohi taligali iyanvdo udediyi.
english: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏚᏙᎥ ᎦᎬᏩᏐᏢᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Ale aholi usduisvgi Unelanvhi asotlvisdisgvi, dudov gagvwasotlvdodiyi, ale nasgi utseli galitsodvi, ale nasgi na galvladi anehi.
english: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏓᏂᎳᏍᏓᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi atsinelvgi unadanvti dahnawa iyunvnediyi, ale nasgi tsusegogisdiyi; ale atsinelvgi nasgi iyuwanisodiyi digvwanelododiyi naniv danilasdalawadisvi, ale tsudalenvdv diniwonisgi gesvi, ale unadatselidv yvwi danewadisvi.
english: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏓᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏂᏗᎪᏪᎸᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ [ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ] ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏥᎸᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale naniv elohi danewadisv dagvwadadolisdaneli, nasgi dunadov nidigowelvna gvnidv gowelihi nasgi Unodena agina utseliga, nasgi [Unodena agina] elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwadalenvdv atsilvhi tsigesei.
english: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏩᏛᎬᎦ.
phonetic: Gilo galilugesdi nasgi wadvgvga.
english: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂᏴᎩ ᏓᏘᎾᏫᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏁᏫᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎠᏓᎯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏎ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ [ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.]
phonetic: Gilo aniyvgi datinawidisgesdi nasgi ayvgi agatinewidvdi gesesdi; gilo hayelasdiganvhidv adahisdisgesdi nasgi ase hayelasdiganvhidv gvdi atsiisdi gesesdi.  Ani nasgi dinvnidiyu gesv ale unohiyusv unadanvti [gvnigesv nigalisdiha.]
english: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏥᏗᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏚᎷᎬᎩ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏥᏚᎷᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎾᏛ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale nvgidiganvsadi vtsigovgi gadohi dayunugotsidisvgi; ale tali dulugvgi unodena agina tsidulugo nasgiyai, ale inadv gawonisgv nasgiya gawonisgvgi.
english: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲᎩ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨᎯ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎠᏥᏐᏅᏅ ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎯ.
phonetic: Ale igvyi unanugotsvhi nvgidiganvsadi nasgiya nulinigvgv nulinigvgvgi, ale elohi ale nasgi nahna anehi unadadolisdanediyi nidegvnehvgi igvyi unanugotsvhi nvgidiganvsadi, nasgi gvwayohuhisdi gesv iyvdv atsisonvnv udiwasvhi.
english: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᏥᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏥᎦᏔᎲᎢ,
phonetic: Ale utsati usquanigodi deulvwisdaneha, nasgi atsilv galvladi nvdayulohisdiyi anino elohi uwotsihisdiyi nigvneha yvwi atsigatahvi,
english: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᎭ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ; ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎢᏦᏢᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏥᏐᏅᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏛᏂᏛᎩ.
phonetic: Ale elohi anehi degalonuheha gvdisgv usquanigodi digvwalvwisdanedi gesv agatahv nvgidiganvsadi; hia nidegaweseha nasgi na elohi anehi, nasgi nvgidiganvsadi ditlilostanvhi itsotlvna, nasgi hayelasdiganvhidv gvdi atsisonvnvhi ale tsudvnidvgi.
english: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎲᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎾᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ale uhvgi gvnodv iyuwanediyi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi tsagatlilostanvhi, nasgi gvwawonihisdi iyulisdodiyi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi tsagatlilostanvhi, ale nasgi iyuwanisodiyi digetsiisdiyi naniv nanadadolisdanehvna nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi tsagatlilostanvhi.
english: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᎾ, ᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᏗᎨᎪᏪᎶᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ;
phonetic: Ale nasgi nuwanisanvgi nigadiyu tsunasdiyi ale tsunadvna, tsunehnai ale uyo iyunadvhnadegi, nidigetsinatlavna ale digetsinatlai, digegowelodiyi dinigatisiditlv tsunoyeni, ale dinigvdageni;
english: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏩᎯᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎠᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥᏉ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᎪᏪᎶᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎪᏪᎶᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi gilo gvwawahisdi nigesvna ale gvwanadinvdi nigesvna iyulisdodiyi, nasgi na uwasv agoweli, ale dudovquo nvgidiganvsadi agowelotanvhi, ale dudov igai asesdiyi gesv agowelotanvhi.
english: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎢᏛᏓ.  ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᎵᏣᏘ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏩᏎᎦ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎦᏎᏍᏗᏱ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏎᏗ; ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎳ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᎥ, ᏑᏓᎵᏧᏈ ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ ᏑᏓᎵᎦᎵ.
phonetic: Ani agadovhisdi gesv gohusdi idvda.  Gilo uwolitsati gesesdi wasega igai gesv agasesdiyi nvgidiganvsedi; yvwiyeno usesdi gesv ugvwala; ale nasgi agasesdi gesv hia nigav, Sudalitsuqui sudalasgohi sudaligali.
english: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏫᏓᏆᎧᎾᏅᎩᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏌᏯᏂ ᎣᏓᎸ ᎦᏙᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᎪᏒᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᏓ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎩ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ.
phonetic: Widaquakananvgino, ale gvniyuquo Unodena agina Sayani odalv gadogvgi, ale unaligosvgi asgohitsuqui nvgasgohi nvgigali iyagali iyanidv, nasgi Udoda dudov dunowelvgi dinigvdageni.
english: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎹ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏴᏓᏆᎶᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale aquadvganvgi gilo kanegv galvladi nvdayudalenvhi, ama utsati tsidusquanoyvgo nasgiyai, ale nasgiya ayvdaqualosgi utsati tsusquanoyvgoi; ale dininogisgi dikanogisdodi dininogisdisgv unoyvgv aquadvganvgi.
english: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᏥᏓᏂᏃᎩᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏩᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎨᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale itse tsidaninogisgo nasgiya gesvgi igvyiditlv gasgilvi, ale nvgi iyanidv dinvnodv nunadvnv igvyiditlv, ale tsunadvsonvhi nunadvnvi; vtla ale gilo gvwadeloquasdi yigese nasgi na dikanogisdi na unvsv asgohitsuqui nvgasgohi nvgigali iyagayvli iyanidv, nasgi elohi gegotsaledv gegaguyvdv gesvi.
english: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎢᎬᏩᏅᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ; ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛᏰᏃ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎭ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎡᏙᎲᎢ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎨᎪᏣᎴᏛ ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏛ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᎬᏩᎾᏓᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi na anigeyv gadaha igvwanvnelvhi nigesvna; unadanvgalvdvyeno gesvgi nasgi.  Hia nasgi na Unodena agina tsigvwasdawadidoha nigav edohvi.  Hia nasgi yvwi anehv gegotsaledv gegaguyvdv, igvyi gvwanadadanelvhi iyunalistanvhi tsigi Unelanvhi ale Unodena agina.
english: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi diniholi gesv vtla galonuhedv gvwadvdi yigesei; nanisganvnayeno Unelanvhi uwesgilv igvyiditlv nunadvnvi.
english: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏃᎯᎵᏒᎩ, ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᏧᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎳᏍᏓᎳᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ,
phonetic: Ale nvwadale dikahnawadidohi vtsigovgi galvloi ayeli gesv ganohilisvgi, alisquadisgi nigesvna osdv kanohedv ganehvgi tsulitsidonedi nasgi na na elohi anehi, ale nigadiyu unadatselidv danewadisv yvwi, ale dinilasdalawadisvi, ale tsudalenvdv diniwonisgi gesvi, ale tsunadalenvdv yvwi,
english: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎵᏰᎢᎶᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Hia nigawesgvgi asdaya kanegvgi, Unelanvhi etsinayesgesdi, ale nasgi etsilvquodisgesdi; nahiyuyeno tsuwugododi gesv aliyeiloga; ale etsadadolisdasi nasgi na galvloi uwotlvnvhi, ale elohi, ale amequohi, ale ama deganugogvi.
english: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏩᏗᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᏥᎦᏚᎲᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno dikahnawadidohi alisdawadisvgi, hia nigawesgvgi, Dadaloni ayogi, ayogi, nasgi na equa tsigaduhvgi, nvdagalisdoda nigadiyu unadatselidv yvwi danewadisv unaditasdiyi niduwanelv gigageaditasdi utalawohisdi gesv udasuyi udelidv dunisinidolv iyuwanisadv.
english: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬᎩ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎬᏓᎨᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏬᏰᏂᏉ ᎠᎪᏪᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Tsoineno gesv dikahnawadidohi unisdawadvsvgi, hia nigawesgvgi asdaya kanegvgi, Iyuno gilo nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi adadolisdanehesdi, ale nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi, ale agvdageni ale uwoyeniquo agowelisgesdi,
english: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᎦᎨᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ ᎦᏐᏅᏴᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎿᎭᎸᏒ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᎯ ᎠᏢᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Nasgi uditasdi gesesdi gegageaditasdi Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv udasuyi, nasgi ama nasuyvna gasonvyvhi tsigi, nasgi uhnalvsv awatisgi ulisquidihi atlvhi tsigi; ale nasgi atsilv ale sagonige adawelagisgi atsigiliyoisdodi gesesdi getsilvquodi dinikahnawadidohi anigatahvi, ale unodenaagina agatahvi;
english: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎬᏩᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎢᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎨᎪᏪᎶᏔᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi anigiliyogv dugasvsdv dalehvsga nigohilv ale nigohilvi; ale vtla gvwanatsawesolvsdodi yigi, iga ale svnoyi, nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi anadadolisdanehi ale nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi, ale nanivquo gilo nasgi dudov gegowelotanvhi.
english: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ; ᎠᏁ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ani gvnigesv nigalisdiha dinvnidiyu gesv unadanvti; ane aneha dinisquanigodisgi dikahnawadvsdi Unelanvhi tsutseliga, ale gohiyudi gesv Tsisa utseliga.
english: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᎩᏪᏎᎲᎩ, ᎰᏪᎸᎩ, [ᎯᎠ ᏅᎦ,] ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏚᎾᏁᎶᏛ ᏗᏂᏲᎱᏍᎩ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎠᏗᎭ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏓᏳᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᏏ.
phonetic: Ale aquadvganvgi gilo kanegv galvladi dvdalehvsgvgi hia nvdvgiwesehvgi, Howelvgi, [hia nvga,] Osiyu iyunalisdanedi tsuniyohusvhi nasgi Ugvwiyuhi dunanelodv diniyohusgi gohi iyudalenvdv; Udohiyuhi adiha Adanvdo nasgi gvwanatsawesolvsdodi iyulisdodiyi dunilvwisdanelvi; ale dunilvwisdanelv dayunisdawadesi.
english: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᏓᏆᎧᎾᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎤᎶᎩᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏬᎸᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ.
phonetic: Ale widaquakananvgi, ale gvniyuquo unegv ulogilvgi, ale ulogilv gilo uwolvgi yvwi Uwetsi nasgiyai, ulisdulvgi adelvdalonige gotlvtanvhi alisdulo, ale gosdaya asgudesdi ganehvgi.
english: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏎᎲᎩ ᎤᎶᎩᎸ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎲᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎯᏍᎫᏛᎦ; ᏣᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏍᏆᎸᎯᎦ; ᎡᎶᎯᏰᏃ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎦᏛᎾᏨ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale dikahnawadidohi digalawiisdiyi iyunugotsvgi asdaya uwelugvgi hia nigawesehvgi Ulogilv uwoli, asgudesdi hvda ale hisgudvga; tsasgudesdiyiyeno gesv hnaquo asqualvhiga; elohiyeno asgudesdiyi gesv ugadvnatsv.
english: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎶᎩᎸᏃ ᎤᏬᎵ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏮᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏍᎫᏕᏐᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ulogilvno uwoli asgudesdi utseli uwvtanvgi; ale elohi usgudesonvgi.
english: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᎯᏙᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᏓᏁᎸ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale dikahnawahidohi digalawiisdiyi galvladi tsvdidanelv dayunugotsvgi, nasgi nasquo ganehvgi gosdaya asgudesdi.
english: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎥ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎲᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ ᎢᏳᏩᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᏣᏤᎵ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎲᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎯᏟᏌ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏒᎯ; ᏖᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎤᏅᎾᏏᏌᏛ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale dikahnawadidohi atsilvgelasdiyi nav dayunugotsvgi, nasgi uhvgi adanvtesgvquo iyuwadiyi atsilv; ale asdaya ulisdanelvgi gosdaya asgudesdi ganehi, hia nigawesgvgi, Asgudesdi tsatseli gosdaya hvda, ale hitlisa telvladi elohi udvsvhi; telvladiyeno hnaquo unvnasisadv.
english: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏪᏂᏙᎸᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏛᏒᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏭᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ ᏭᎸᏅᎩ ᎤᏔᏅ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ-ᎦᏨᏩᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino asgudesdi utseli uwenidolvgi elohi, ale uwetlisanvgi telvladi elohi udvsvhi, ale wudainvsvgi wulvnvgi utanv telvladigatsvwasdodiyi Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv utseliga.
english: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏖᎸᎳᏗ-ᎦᏨᏩᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᎤᎾᎳᏍᏓᎡᎸᎩ, ᎩᎬᏃ ᏓᏳᏨᏨᎩ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ-ᎦᏨᏩᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏚᎾᏔᎾᎸ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏚᏂᎶᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎬᎾᏕᏅ.
phonetic: Telvladigatsvwasdodiyi gaduhv doyiditlv unalasdaelvgi, gigvno dayutsvtsvgi telvladigatsvwasdodiyi, ale soquili dunatanalv iyvdv nidunilotsvgi, nasgi talitsuqui iyutlilodv igvnadenv.
english: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ ᎤᏰᎸᏛ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏂᏰᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎤᏕᏔᏙᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏏᏏᎭ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno uyelvdv galvladi agigohvgi, galvquodi ale usquanigodi, nasgi galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi daniyehvgi galiquogi iyudalegi ulisqualvdi udetadodi; nasgiyeno Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv anikalisisiha.
english: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎥᏓᎸ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ [ᎥᎦᏥᎪᎥᎩ] ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᎾᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎸᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏬᏪᎶᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏎᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ ᎥᏓᎸ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ ᏓᏂᏁᎲᎩ
phonetic: Ale agigohvgi vdalv adagedi digvwalvsadv nasgiyai atsilv udasuyi gesvgi; ale nasgi na [vgatsigovgi] nvgidiganvsadi unadalinehidelvhi, ale nasgi na tsagatlilostanvhi, ale utseli tsuwowelododi, ale nasgi dudov igai asesdi gesvi, anidonavgi vdalv adagedi digvwalvsadv nasgiyai, Unelanvhi tsutseli dikanogisdodi daninehvgi
english: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏃᎩᏒᎩ ᎼᏏ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏧᏃᎩᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏛ; ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎢᎭᏛᏁᎵᏙᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale duninogisvgi Mosi Unelanvhi utseli unvsidasdi tsunogidv, ale Unodena agina utseli dikanogisdi, hia naniwesgvgi, Galvquodiyu ale usquanigodiyu ditsalvwisdanedi gesv Tsagvwiyuhi ale Tsanelanvhi Winasdvna tsalinigidv; Osdv ale duyugodv ihadvnelidohi nihi Tsagvwiyuhi unadanvti unatseliga.
english: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎪ ᏂᏣᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎯ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏕᏣᏙᎥᎢ?  ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏨᏒᎯᏳ ᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏛᏂᎷᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏣᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏢ ᏛᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂ; ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᏗᏧᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Gago nitsanayesgvna gesesdi nihi Tsagvwiyuhi, ale nigalvquodisgvna gesesdi detsadovi?  nihiyeno tsvsvhiyu nisganvna, nigadiyuyeno unadatselidv yvwi danewadisv dvnilutsi ale nitsadvnv igvyitlv dvnadadolistani; nihiyeno ditsugododi gesv gvnigesv nulistanv.
english: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏂᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏓᏆᎧᎾᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏗᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ;
phonetic: Onino iyvdv daquakananvgi, ale gvniyuquo digalawiisdiyi dikahnawadvsdi didiyi galitsodv ulisduidv gesvgi galvladi;
english: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏓᏳᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᏓᏂᏰᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ, ᏚᎾᏄᏮᎩ ᏂᏚᏓᏅᎦᎸᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎬ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏁᏥᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏠᎲᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ ᏗᏓᏠᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Galiquogino iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi digalawiisdiyi dayuninugotsvgi, daniyehvgi galiquogi udeyadodi, dunanuwvgi nidudanvgalvna ale tsunegv doledv dinuwo, ale dininetsiyi dunadatlohvgi adelvdalonige digotlvnvhi didatlosdi.
english: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏚᏁᎸᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᏗᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi na nvgi iyanidv gesv dinvnodv galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi dunelvgi galiquogi gugu adelvdalonige digotlvtanvhi, dikalii Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesvi, nasgi nigohilv ale nigohilv tseha.
english: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎩ ᏧᎧᎵᏨᎩ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏫᎬᏩᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏥᏚᎾᏒᎦᎸ ᏱᏚᎵᏍᏆᏛ.
phonetic: Digalawiisdiyino ukalitsvgi tsukalitsvgi tsugasvsdi Unelanvhi atsilvquodiyu gesv ale ulinigidiyu gesv nvdayudalenvhi; vtla ale gilo wigvwayvsdi yigese digalawiisdiyi, gvni nasgi na galiquogi tsudeyadodi gesv galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi tsidunasvgalv yidulisquadv.
english: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏓᎧᏁᎬᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎢᏤᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏫᏂᏐᏅᏯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎫᎫ ᏓᏟᏍᏛᎢ.
phonetic: Aquadvganvgino gilo asdaya dakanegvgi digalawiisdiyi dvdalehvsgi hia nidegawesehvgi galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi, Itsena, ale elohi winisonvya Unelanvhi utalawohisdi gesv gugu datlisdvi.
english: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏪᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᏣᏍᏓᎳᏛᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎨᎪᏪᎶᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
phonetic: Igvyiyino gesv uwenvsvgi, ale gadohi uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; udeyadodino ale ehisdi dunitsasdaladvgi yvwi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi utseli digegowelotanvhi, ale nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi anadadolisdanehi.
english: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎤᎩᎬ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏚᏂᎵᏬᏨᎩ.
phonetic: Talineno gesv dikahnawadidohi amequohi uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; uyohusvhino yvwi ugigv nasgiya nulistanvgi; ale nigadiyu dinvnodv gesv amequohi anehv duniliwotsvgi.
english: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎡᏉᏂ ᏕᎨᏴ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹ ᏕᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎩᎬᏃ ᏂᏚᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Tsoineno gesv dikahnawadidohi equoni degeyv ale ama deganugogv uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; gigvno nidulistanvgi.
english: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎹᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏯ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᏂᏍᎦᎤᎾ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏂᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏤᎮᏍᏗ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏕᏧᎪᏔᏅᎢ.
phonetic: Ale amayi digatiya dikahnawadidohi vtsiyadvganelvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Nisgauna Tsagvwiyuhi, nihi nasgi tseha, ale tsehvgi, ale tsehesdi, nvdigalisdodiha nusdv detsugotanvi.
english: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎤᏂᏨᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬ ᏕᎯᏁᏁᎸ ᎤᎾᏘᏔᏍᏗ; ᏰᎵᎦᏯᏰᏃ ᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Unadanvtiyeno ale anadolehosgi unigigv unitsvnv, ale gigv dehinenelv unatitasdi; yeligayayeno duyugodi nasgi iyunalisdanediyi.
english: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ [ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ] ᎥᏥᏯᏛᎦᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏣᎵᏂᎩᏛ, ᎣᏏᏳ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Nvwadaleno [dikahnawadidohi] vtsiyadvganelvgi atsilvgelasdiyi hia nvdayuwesvgi, Nasgiya nusdesdi, Tsagvwiyuhi Tsanelanvhi Winasdvna tsalinigidv, osiyu ale duyugodv nihi digugododi gesvi.
english: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦ-ᎡᎯ ᎧᎸ ᎤᏪᏐᏴᏅᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏗ ᏧᎴᏴᏙᏗᏱ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Nvgineno gesv dikahnawadidohi nvdo igaehi kalv uwesoyvnvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; ale agalisgolvdanelvgi atsilv gvdi tsuleyvdodiyi yvwi.
english: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏕᎨᏥᎴᏴᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ ᎢᎬᏩᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏂᏁᏟᏴᏎ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale utsati udilegi gesv degetsileyvdotanvgi yvwi, ale Unelanvhi dudov unisotlvistanvgi, nasgi adanvtesgvquo igvwanelidasdi tsigi hia nasgi udeyadodi gesvi; ale vtla yiduninetliyvse dunadanvdv nasgi gvwalvquododiyi.
english: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏪᏗᏱ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏥᎵᎪᎯᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ; ᏓᏂᏃᏓᏛᏃ ᏚᏂᎩᏍᏙᎥᎩ ᏚᏁᎯᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Hisgineno gesv dikahnawadidohi nvgidiganvsadi uwediyi uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi, utsiligohino gesv ukalitsonvgi ulisigi; daninodadvno dunigisdovgi dunehisdanehv iyusdi,
english: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᏚᏁᎯᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏥᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎤᏲ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᏁ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi galvladi ehi unisotlvistanvgi, nvdagalisdodisgvgi dunehisdanehvi ale dunitsisdalvi, ale vtla uyo yuniyelvne nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏓᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎡᏆ ᎡᏉᏂ ᎤᏪᏴ ᏳᏇᏗ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎠᎹᏃ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎬ ᎤᎶᏐᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᏅᏅ ᎨᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Sudalineno gesv dikahnawadidohi equa equoni uweyv Yuquedi uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; amano nahna egv ulosonvgi, nasgi unigvwiyuhi dikalvgv iditlv anehi uninvnv gegadvnvisdanediyi ayelvsvgi.
english: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎦᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏩᎶᏏ ᏗᎾᏤᎵᏛ, ᎢᎾᏛ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏓᏳᏂᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᎰᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ.
phonetic: Ale tsoi iyanidv anigadaha didanvdo gatsigovgi walosi dinatselidv, inadv aholi dayuninugotsvgi, ale nvgidiganvsadi aholi, ale utlonasdi adolehosgi aholi.
english: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾᏰᏃ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᏓᏂᏩᏛᎮᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Anisginayeno tsunadanvdo nasgi, usquanigodi dunilvwisdaneha, elohi anehi unigvwiyuhi ale elanigv daniwadvhega, nasgi tsunitlisodiyi tsunalisdiyi uniyelvha galvquodi iga gesv Unelanvhi utseliga Winasdvna ulinigidv tsigi.
english: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ ᏥᎦᎷᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ.  ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᏬ ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎪᏩᏛᎡᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo, ganosgisgi tsigalugo nasgiya datsilutsi.  Osiyu iyulisdanedi nasgi na ayawisgi, ale tsunuwo disquanigodisgi, nasgi uyelvha uwedasdiyi nigesvna, ale udehohisdi gesv atsigowadvediyi nigesvna.
english: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏪᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᎠᎹᎨᏙᏂ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏂᏈᎷ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏯᎬᏗᎭ.
phonetic: Ale duwetlisanvgi Amagedoni dudov Aniquilu uniwonihisdi gesv yagvdiha.
english: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎦᎳᏅᏛᏉ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᏪᏐᏅᏴᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎠᏰᎲ ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏗᎧᏁᎬ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏓ.
phonetic: Galiquogineno gesv dikahnawadidohi galanvdvquo galvloi uwesonvyvgi gugu ayehv atlisdvi; ale asdaya dikanegv gilo galvladi digalawiisdiyi ale nahna digasgilv dayudalenvgi, hia nvdagawesgvgi, Hnaquo alisquada.
english: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᏃᏴᎳᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏴᏓᏉᎶᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎦᎸᎲᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏖᎸᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎬᏩᎵᏖᎸᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᎾᏕᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᎦᏎᏗ.
phonetic: Hnaquono dusquanoyvlasvgi, ale duyvdaquolovgi, ale dunagalvhvgi; ale gadohi utsati ulitelvnvgi, nasgi igai vtla ilvhiyu yigvwalitelvno yvwi elohi unadenv nvdagvwadalenvdv, nasgi iyulinigidv ale nasgi iyusgasedi.
english: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏦᎢ ᏄᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏚᏂᏚᎲ ᏚᏲᏨᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏁᏗᏱ [ᏓᏓᎶᏂ] ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi equa gaduhv tsoi nudadvgi, ale unadatselidv yvwi danewadisv duniduhv duyotsvgi; ale Dadaloni galvquodi gaduhv anvdadisdi nulistanvgi Unelanvhi nudvnvi, nasgi atsinediyi [Dadaloni] ulisquidi gigageaditasdi atlisdv utsati utalawohisdi gesv uwadvdi.
english: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏚᏪᎧᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nigadv amayeli duwekawadisv unalisvgi, ale dodalv vtla digvwadvdi yigesei.
english: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏆᏃ ᎤᏁᏐᎠᏒᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ, ᏌᏉᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎸᏗ ᏄᏓᎨᏒ ᏄᏓᎨᏒᎩ; ᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏁᏍᏓᎳ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ; ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ.
phonetic: equano unesoasvgi yvwi anehv galvladi nvdayudalenvhi, saquoha gesv talvdi nudagesv nudagesvgi; yvwino unelanvhi unisotlvistanvgi nvdagalisdodisgvgi unesdala unadeyadodisgvi; utsatiyeno unadeyadodisgvgi nasgi.
english: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎫᎫ ᏥᏓᏂᏰᎲᎩ, ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎡᎮᎾ; ᏓᎬᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏣᎫᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎹ ᏚᏪᏴ ᏧᏬᎳ;
phonetic: Asiyvwino nasgi na galiquogi iyanidv gesv dinikahnawadidohi, nasgi galiquogi gugu tsidaniyehvgi, ulutsvgi ale aqualinohetanvgi, hia nagiweselvgi, Ehena; dagvnanugowiseli nusdv tsagugodanedi gesv utsati unegutsidv ageyv, utsati ama duweyv tsuwola;
english: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏩᏛᏛ.
phonetic: Unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi udelidv tsunanisinvhi tsigi, ale elohi danewadisv tsuniyvsdestanvhi tsigi gigageaditasdi udelidv dunisinidolv uwadvdv.
english: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏗ ᎢᎾᎨ ᏩᏆᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ; ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᎥᏥᎪᎲᎩ ᎩᎦᎨ ᏗᎧᏃᏗᏱ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᎩᎸᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏕᎤᎷᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino adanvdo gvdi inage waquatinvstanvgi; ageyvno vtsigohvgi gigage dikanodiyi nvgidiganvsadi ugilvdvgi nasgi ukalitsvhi gesvgi unelanvhi dudov asotlvisdodi gesvi galiquogi dasgudadvgi, ale asgohi deulugvgi.
english: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ ᏗᏕᎭᎷᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᎨ ᏚᏄᏩᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ, ᏅᏯ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏚᏣᏅᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏢᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎠᏰᎲᎩ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎢᎸᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏩᏛᏛ.
phonetic: Ageyvno didehaluge ale digigage dunuwavgi, ale adelvdalonige ale digalvquodi, nvya ale dagvnaiyunasdi dutsanvdvgi, ale adelvdalonige atlvlanvhi ulisquidi ayehvgi akalii uniquatisdi gesv, ale uneilvdi nasgi udelidv dunisinidolv uwadvdv.
english: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎬᏓᎨᏂᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ, [ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎩ] ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎡᏆ, ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᏂᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Agvdagenino dudov gowelvgi, [hia nigvnvgi] UDeLiDv GeSvI, DaDaLoNi EQua, UNiNeGuTsiDv ANiGeYv UNiTsi ALe UNiQuaTiSDi ELoHi EHi.
english: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎨᏴ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎬᏩᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎩ; ᏥᎪᎥᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Ale ageyv vtsigovgi unadanvti unigigv, ale Tsisa gvwanohesgi unigigv uyvsdesdisgvgi; tsigovno utsati asquanigohisdi gesv gvdi agisquanigosvgi.
english: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎦᏙᏃ ᎥᏣᏍᏆᏂᎪᎵ?  ᏓᎬᏃᏁᎵ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎦᏛᎬ ᏅᎩᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎩᎸᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏥᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏥᏚᎷᎦ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino hia nagiweselvgi, Gadono vtsasquanigoli?  Dagvnoneli nusdv gadvgv ageyv, ale nusdv gadvgv nvgidiganvsadi nasgi tsugilvdi, nasgi galiquogi tsidasgudadv ale asgohi tsiduluga.
english: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᎡᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏰᎭ; ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᎴᏂ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏗᏔᎴᏒ ᏓᎦᏄᎪᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᏮᏓᎦᎶᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ ᏂᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅ Ꮎ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏧᏙᏢᏅ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᎴᏅᏛ ᏛᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏏ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᎭ.
phonetic: Nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi tsigovgi, ehvgi, ale vtla yeha; ale dodvleni winasdvna ditalesv daganugotsi, ale atsidvdodiyi wvdagalosi, nasgino na elohi anehi nasgi dunadov nidigowelanv na gvnidv gowelihi elohi tsudotlvnv nvdagvwalenvdv dvnisquanigosi anigohvha nvgidiganvsadi nasgi tsehvgi, ale nehvna tsigi, aseno nasgi tseha.
english: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂ ᎠᎦᏙᎲᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎬᏙᏗ ᎪᎵᏍᏗ.  ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏓᏍᎫᏓᏛ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏙᏓᎸ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏬᎳ.
phonetic: Ani agadohvhisdi gesv adanvdo gvdodi golisdi.  Nasgi na galiquogi dasgudadv galiquogi dodalv gadvga, nahna ageyv tsuwola.
english: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎯᏍᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᎾᎵᏛᏔᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎡᎭ, ᏐᎢᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏏ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᎦ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᎷᏨᎭ ᏝᎦ ᎤᏕᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale galiquogi naniv unigvwiyuhi; hisgi iyanidv unalidvtanv, ale asiyvwi eha, soino vtla asi yigananugoga; ale galutsvha tlaga udedi gesesdi.
english: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏤᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏁᎵᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎨᎳ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏛᏙᏗᏱ ᏮᏓᎦᎶᏏ.
phonetic: Nasgino na nvgidiganvsadi tsehvgi, ale nasgi nehvna tsigi, nasgi tsunelinei, ale nasgi duliquogi iyanidv gesv gela, ale atsidvdodiyi wvdagalosi.
english: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ ᏕᎤᎷᎬ ᏥᏕᏣᎪᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏏ ᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎧᏁᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Asgohino deulugv tsidetsagohvgi, nasgi asgohi unigvwiyuhi gadvga, nasgi unigvwiyuhi iyunalisdodiyi gesv asi getsinelvhi nigesvna gesvi; gegalisgolvdanehasgininonv unigvwiyuhi unineisdi gesv unineisdiyi saquo iyutlilodv nvgidiganvsadi utloyi kanegvi.
english: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᏄᏅᏅ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎾᏒᎦᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬ ᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi saquo nunvnv dunadanvdvi, ale nvgidiganvsadi nusdv unasvgalv ale dunalinigvgv dodvniyohiseli.
english: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᏅᏛᏅᏁᎵ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏙᏛᏎᎪᎩᏏ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ; ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᏜᏓᏩᏍᏗᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᎾᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi dahnawa nvdvnvneli Unodena agina, ale Unodena agina dodvsegogisi nasgi; nasgiyeno unigvwiyuhi anehv Ugvwiyuhi; ale nunigvwiyusv anehv nasgi Nugvwiyusadegi; ale nasgi gvwadlawasdidegi tsigi getsiyanvdv, ale gegasuyedv, ale nunadalidasdvna.
english: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎠᎹ ᏥᏕᏣᎪᎲᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ ᏧᏬᎳ, ᏴᏫ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale hia nagiweselvgi, Ama tsidetsagohvgi, nahna unegutsidv ageyv tsuwola, yvwi gadvga, ale unitsati gesvi, ale unadatselidi yvwi, ale tsudalenvdv diniwonisgi gesvi.
english: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎪᎯ ᏕᎤᎷᎬ ᏥᏕᏣᎪᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᏚᎷᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏩᏂᏆᏘᎵ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏔ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᎭ ᏅᏓᏰᎬᏁᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏇᏓᎸ ᏓᎬᏩᎨᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏗ ᏓᎬᏩᎪᎲᏍᏔᏂ.
phonetic: Ale asgohi deulugv tsidetsagohvgi, nasgi nvgidiganvsadi dulugvi, nasgi dagvwaniquatili unegutsidv ageyv, ale nvta ale uyelvha nvdayegvneli, ale uquedalv dagvwageli, ale atsilv gvdi dagvwagohvstani.
english: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏚᎳᏁᎸ ᎫᏂᎾᏫᏱ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏁᏨ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Unelanvhiyeno dulanelv guninawiyi nusdv adanvtesgv unisquadisdiyi, ale saquo iyunvnediyi dunadanvdvi, ale tsuniyohisediyi nvgidiganvsadi nahna unigvwiyuhi gesvi, gvni Unelanvhi unetsv nasgi iyulistanvhi gesesdi.
english: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfill his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎨᏴᏃ Ꮎ ᏥᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎦᏛᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Ageyvno na tsigowatisgvgi nasgi na equa gaduhv gadvga, nasgi unigvwiyuhi elohi anehv ugvwiyusadegi tsigi.
english: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ, ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgino hia nulistanidolv nvwadale dikahnawadidohi vtsigovgi galvladi dayutloasvgi, utsati ulinigidv gesvgi; nasgino utseli galvquodiyu gesv elohi iga utistanvgi.
english: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎬᏗ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎡᏆ ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎠᏲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏕᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᏗᏓᏅᏙ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale asdaya uwelunvgi ulinigidv kanegv gvdi, hia nigawesgvgi, Dadaloni equa ayogi, ayogi, ale anisgina unadediyi nigalisda, ale naniv anigadaha didanvdo uniyvsdiyi, ale naniv anigadaha ale uniniquatisdi tsisqua unaneladisdiyi.
english: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᏗᏔᎲ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᎾᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎩ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏚᏁᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎡᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Nigadiyuyeno unadatselidv yvwi danewadisv unaditahv gigageaditasdi utalawohisdi gesv udasuyi nasgi udelidv dunisinidolv iyuwanisadv, ale unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi nasgi udelidv dunanisinidolv, ale aninodisgi elohi anehi dunenvistanv nasgi utsati utlvquodi ehvi.
english: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏗᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏂᎯ ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎡᏥᏄᎪᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏥᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale nvwadale gilo dikanegv galvladi aquadvganvgi, hia nvdagawesgvgi, Nihi diquatseliga yvwi etsinugoi, nasgi itsatloyasdodiyi nigesvna nasgi usganvtsidolvi, ale nasgi utseli udeyadodi gesv itsatloyasdodiyi nigesvna.
english: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏥᏙᎸᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᎷᏨ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏅᏓᏛ ᎤᏲᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎵᏙᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Usganvtsidolvyeno galvladi iyvdv wulutsv, ale Unelanvhi unvdadv uyodulvwisdanelidolvi.
english: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎢᏣᎫᏴᎡᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎡᏣᎫᏴᏏ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ; ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ ᎤᎧᎵᎸᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ ᎡᏥᎧᎵᎢᏏ.
phonetic: Etsaguyvsi nasgiya itsaguyvelvi, ale tali iyuwagudi etsaguyvsi nasgiya dulvwisdanelvi; ulisquidi ukalilvhi nasgi tali iyuwagudi etsikaliisi.
english: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏔᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎤᏕᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎡᏥᎥᏏ; ᎤᎾᏫᏱᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎠᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏉᎳ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏉᏑᎶᏨᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎦᏥᎪᏩᏛ.
phonetic: Nasgi nigav uwasv udalvquotanvi ale utlvquodi udenvi, nasgi igai agiliya ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv etsivsi; unawiyiyeno hia nigaweha, agigvwiyuhi aquola, vtla aquosulotsvhi yigi, vtla ale uyo adanvdadisdi gesv yvgatsigowadv.
english: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᏏᏉᏃ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏴᎳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᎪᎲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎬᏗ; ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Nasgi iyusdi udeyadodisgi gesv siquono uluhisdi gesesdi, ayohuhisdi gesv, ale diyvlasdi gesv, ale agolv; ale agagohvsdodi gesesdi atsilv gvdi; ulinigidiyuyeno Ugvwiyuhi Unelanvhi nasgi tsuwugodanehi tsigi.
english: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏔᏂ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ, ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬᎢ,
phonetic: Ale unigvwiyuhi elohi anehi, nasgi udelidv tsunanisinidolvhi gesvi, ale utlvquodi itsulaha unadenvhi, nasgi dagvwasgonili, ale nasgi nvdagalisdotani dodvniyvlasi, hnaquo anigohvha dugasvsdv nasgi agohvsgvi,
english: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏅ ᏗᏂᏙᎾᎡᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᏓᏓᎶᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ!  ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏗᏣᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏣᎷᏥᏏ.
phonetic: Inv dinidonaesdi anisgaihv agiliyogv nvdigalisdodisgvi, hia naniwesgesdi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa Dadaloni, nasgi ulinigidv gaduhvi!  sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv ditsadugodanedi gesv tsalutsisi.
english: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎲᏍᎩᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏙᏛᎾᏠᏱᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏙᏛᏂᏴᎳᏏ ᏓᎬᏩᏍᎪᏂᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏩᎯᏎᎭ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ;
phonetic: Aninotanvhvsgino elohi anehi dodvnatloyili ale dodvniyvlasi dagvwasgonili nasgi; vtlayeno hnaquo gilo yigvwaniwahiseha ganododi;
english: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎦᏃᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸ-ᎤᏁᎬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏅᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏕᎭᎷᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏩᎾᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎩᎦᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎦᎥ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎧᎹᎹ ᏧᏓᏄᏙᏅᎯ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏗᏖᎵᏙ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏓ ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏣᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏓᏫᏍᎦᎨ ᏅᏯ,
phonetic: Nasgi adelvdalonige ganododi gesvi, ale adelvunegv, ale utsati tsugvwalodi nvya, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, ale usidoli doledv, ale didehalugei, ale diwanagei, ale digigagei, ale nagav digalvquodi ada, ale nigav ditelido kamama tsudanudonvhi digotlvtanvhi, ale nigav ditelido utsati tsugvwalodi ada digotlvtanvhi, ale vtsayi, ale talugisgi, ale anidawisgage nvya,
english: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏏᏂᎹᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏠᏁᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏜᏓᎤᎦᎾᏍᏛ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏩᎾᎨ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗ ᎢᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᎴᏍᏗᎤᎦᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ-ᎤᏂᏃᏕᏅ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ-ᏓᏆᎴᎷ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ-ᏗᎦᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ.
phonetic: Ale sinimani, ale digawasvgi, ale atlonedi, ale adla uganasdv gawasvgi, ale gigageaditasdi, ale goi, ale wanage utsalesdi isv, ale utsalesdiugadv, ale ganatlai, ale awiuninodenv, ale soquili, ale tsusdidaqualelu, ale yvwidiganatlai, ale yvwi tsunadanvdo.
english: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᎬᎥᏍᎬᎩ ᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏢᏉᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎨᏣᏓᏅᎡᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏫᏗᎨᏣᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ale udatanvhi nasgi tsadanvdo tsugvvsgvgi tsadanvelv, ale nigav utlvquodi ale digalvquodi tsigesv getsadanvelv, ale vtla hnaquo widigetsawadvdi yigesesdi.
english: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏛ ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏅᎥᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎢᏅ ᏗᏂᏙᎾᎡᏍᏗ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ, ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ,
phonetic: Hia nasgi tsudaledv aninotanvvsgi, nasgi tsuwenvistanvhi, inv dinidonaesdi nvdigalisdodisgesdi agiliyogv anisgaihvi, danatloyihesdi ale daniyvgesdi,
english: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎭᎷᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎦᎨᎢ ᏥᏚᏣᏃᏛᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏅᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᏥᏚᏣᏃᏛᎩ!
phonetic: Ale hia naniwesgesdi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa gaduhv nasgi usidoli doledv, ale dehalugei, ale gigagei tsidutsanodvgi, ale adelvdalonigei, ale utsati tsunagvwalodi nvya, ale dagvnaiyunasdi, tsidutsanodvgi!
english: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎠᏎᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂᏛ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᏥᏳ ᏧᏔᏅ ᏓᏂᏂᏙᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏳ ᏗᏂᏂᏙᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᏂᏃᏔᏂᏙᎯ, ᎢᏅ ᏛᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ,
phonetic: Sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv nasgi igai tsugvwalodi asequo nigalistanidv.  Ale naniv unigvwiyusadegi tsiyu tsutanv daninidohvi, ale naniv tsiyuhi unatsai, ale tsiyu dininidohi, ale nanivquo amequohi aninotanidohi, inv dvnidonavgi,
english: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎦᏙ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ?
phonetic: Ale unelunvgi iyuno unigohv dugasvsdv nasgi agohvsgvi, hia naniwesgvgi, Gado usdi nasgiya gese nasgi hia equa gaduhv nusdvi?
english: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᏂᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᎪᏍᏚ ᏚᏂᏝᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ ᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏴᎬᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏧᏁᎿᎭᎢ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏥᏳ ᏗᏂᏂᏙᎯ, ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏑᏟᎶᏛᏉᏰᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏅᏔ ᎾᎬᏁᎸ.
phonetic: Dinisgolino gosdu dunitlanvgi, ale unelunvgi danatloyihvi, ale daniyvgvi, hia naniwesgvgi, Uyosdvquo, uyosdvquo, nasgi na equa gaduhvi, nahna tsunehnai tsinunalistanvgi nigadv amequohi tsiyu dininidohi, nvdigalisdodisgv utsati uwehnaiyu gesvi, sutlilodvquoyeno igohidv nvta nagvnelv.
english: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᏂᎯ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᏂᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏞᏥ.
phonetic: Itsaliheligi nasgi nulisdanelv iyusdi, nihi galvloi ale nihi itsadanvti ale etsinvsidv, ale itsadolehosgi; Unelanvhiyeno nihi gesv iyusdi nasgi agatletsi.
english: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏃ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏅᏯ ᎤᎩᏒᎩ, ᎤᏔᏅ ᏗᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎺᏉᎯᏃ ᏭᏗᏅᏒᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏓᏓᎶᏂ ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ulinigidvno dikahnawadidohi nvya ugisvgi, utanv disdosgi nvya nasgiyai, amequohino wudinvsvgi, hia nuwesvgi, Nasgiya gvsgaisdagi nasgi na equa gaduhv Dadaloni atsiyosdodi gesesdi, vtla ale hnaquo gvwadvdi yigesesdi.
english: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏦᏔᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏃᎩᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᏤᎷᎯᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏃᏴᎵᏍᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎢᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᏢᏅᎥᏍᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᏣᏩᏛᎡᎴᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏍᏙᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Ale dikanogisdodi dininogisdisgi, ale dininogisgi, ale atsotasdi dininogisdisgi, ale dinitseluhisgi unadanoyvlisdv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi; itla ale gotlvnvvsgi nudalesvquo gohusdi gotlvsgi hnaquo yetsawadvelesdi; ale nvya asdosgi unoyvgv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi;
english: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏗᏣᎸᏌᏓᏕᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎡᏣᏛᎦᏁᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᏗᏣᏤᎵᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᏗᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒ ᎠᏙᏅᏗ ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏕᎯᎶᏄᎮᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale atsvsdodi dulvsadv vtla hnaquo ditsalvsadadedi yigesesdi; ale adesvhvsgi ale atsiyehi aninegv vtla hnaquo etsadvganedi yigesesdi; ditsatseliyeno aninodisgi getsilvquodi gesvgi yvwi elohi danewadisvi; nigadiyuyeno unadatselidv gesv yvwi danewadisv adonvdi detsalvwisdanehv dehilonuhetanvgi.
english: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏩᏛᎡᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi atsiwadvelvgi unigigv anadolehosgi, ale unadanvti, ale nigadv elohi digetsilvhi gesvi.
english: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏂᏁᎬ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏴᏫ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏛᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏥᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ;
phonetic: Nasgino nulistanidolv aquadvganvgi asdaya aninegv unitsati yvwi galvladi iyvdv, hia nvdvniwesgvgi, Yihowa edilvquoda; alisdelvdodi gesvi, ale atsilvquododi gesvi, ale osdv atsiyelvdi gesvi, ale ulinigidv gesvi, utseliga gesesdi Ugvwiyuhi iganelanvhi;
english: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ; ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎠᎨᏴ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏓᏂᏏᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᏂᏲ ᏥᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏞᏨ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏚᏨᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nasgiyeno tsuwugododi gesv duyugodvi ale osdv; nasgiyeno duwugodanelv utsati unegutsidv ageyv, nasgi udelidv danisinidohv uniyo tsiniduwanelv elohi anehi, ale utletsv tsunvsidasdi unigigv dutsvnelvi.
english: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ.  ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale taline Yihowa edilvquoda unadvnvgi.  Ale nasgi utseli tsugasvsdi dalehvsgvgi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.
english: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᏅᎩᏦᏁ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏪᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎡᎺᏅ; ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ.
phonetic: Nasgino na nvgitsone iyanidv tsunadvsonvhi, ale na nvgi iyanidv dinvnodv eladi dunadanvnvgi, ale Unelanvhi unadadolisdanelvgi, nasgi gasgilv uweli, hia naniwesgvgi, Emenv; Yihowa edilvquoda.
english: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏓ ᎣᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎯ ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᏗᏣᏍᏗᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏣᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Ale gilo kanegv gasgilv dayudalenvgi, hia nigawesgvgi, Etsilvquoda Oganelanvhi nihi nitsiv itsinvsidasdi tsigi, ale nihi etsinayesgi tsigi, ditsasdiga ale ditsatanv.
english: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎤᏂᏣᏘ ᏣᏂᏁᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎠᎹ ᏧᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏓᏴᏓᏆᎶᏍᎬ ᏥᏚᏍᏆᏃᏴᎪ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎦ.
phonetic: Ale aquadvganvgi unitsati tsaninego nasgiyai, ale utsati ama tsusquanoyvgo nasgiyai, ale utsati dayvdaqualosgv tsidusquanoyvgo nasgiyai, hia naniwesgvgi, Yihowa edilvquoda; Ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi Winasdvna ulinigidv ugvwiyusadega.
english: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏓᏓᏅᏓᏓ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏓᎵᎮᎵᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ; ᎤᏃᏕᎾᏰᏃ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᏆᎸ, ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏃ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏃᎾ.
