phonetic: Osdv idadanvdada ale idaliheligi, ale nasgi edilvquoda; Unodenayenoagina tsagatsvsdodiyi asqualv, udaliino advnvistanona.
english: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏧᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ, ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏁᎬ; ᎤᏏᏙᎵᏰᏃ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎦᏛᎦ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi agalisgolvdanelvgi usidoli doledv tsunuwosdiyi, digadaha nigesvna ale tsunegv; usidoliyeno doledv duyugodv nunadvnelidolv unadanvti gadvga.
english: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎰᏪᎸᎦ, (ᎯᎠᏅᎦ,) ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᏣᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᏪᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi, Howelvga, (hianvga,) Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi na Unodenaagina tsagatsvsdodiyi tsunalisdayvdiyi gesv uniluhisdiyi getsiyanvdv gesesdi.  Hiano nagiweselvgi, hia nasgi udohiyuhi iyuwedv Unelanvhi.
english: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏚᎳᏍᎬᏃ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏅᎩ ᏓᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵᏒᎩ.  ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎡᎩᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎯ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎪᎯᏳᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ.
phonetic: Dulasgvno aquadanvnvgi datsiyadadolisdanelisvgi.  Hiano nagiweselvgi, Vtlesdi.  Ayvyeno utloyiquo egininvsidasdi, ale ayv nasgi itsalinvtli tsigesv nasgi Tsisa utseli gohiyudisgi unihi; Unelanvhi hiyadadolisdasi; adolehohisdodiyeno gesv adanvdo ale Tsisa gohiyudanediyi utloyiquo.
english: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎬ ᏐᏈᎵ (ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ;) ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎩᎵ, ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ (ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ) ᎠᎪᏎᎲᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᏕᎫᎪᏗᎭ ᎠᎴ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎪᏢᏍᎦ.
phonetic: Agigohvgino galvloi ulisduidv gesvgi, ale gvniyuquo unegv soquili (vtsigovgi;) ale nasgi nahna ugili, Nudalidasdvna Ale Duyugodv (iyadvnehi) agosehvgi, ale duyugodv gvdisgv degugodiha ale dahnawa gotlvsga.
english: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎦᏙᎵ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎠᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏚᎵᏍᏚᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏚᏙᎥ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᎬᏬᎵᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎪᎵᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Digadoli atsilv adaweligisgi nasgiya gesvgi, asgolino utsati dulisdulvgi; ale dudov gowelvgi nasgi gilo gvwolisdi nigesvna uwasvsgininonv goligvgi.
english: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎩᎬᎯ ᎬᏅᎯ ᎠᏄᏬ ᎤᏄᏩᎥᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᎪᏎᎭ ᎠᏥᏯᏂᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gigvhi gvnvhi anuwo unuwavgi; ale Unelanvhi Utseli Kanohedv agoseha atsiyanisgvi.
english: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᏧᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏚᎾᏄᏬᏍᏛᎩ, ᏧᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale aniyawisgi galvladi anehv gvwasdawadvsvgi uninegv soquili tsunagilvdi, tsusidoli doledv dinuwo dunanuwosdvgi, tsunegv ale digadaha nigesvna.
english: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏗᎦᏄᎪᎦ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏩᏂᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᎾᏓᏤᎵᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᎶᏙᏗᏱ ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ; ᎠᎴ ᏖᎸᎳᏗ ᎦᏨᏩᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᎳᏍᏓᎡᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏑᏱ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale aholi diganugoga gosdaya hayelasdiganvhidv, nasgi tsuwanisdodiyi unadatselidv yvwi danewadisvi; ale talugisgi gvdi digvwanelododiyi nvdagvneli; ale telvladi gatsvwasdodiyi alasdaeha nasgi udasuyi usgasedi ale utalawohisdi gesv Winasdvna ulinigidv Unelanvhi utseliga.
english: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏄᏬᎩᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎦᎶᎢ ᏧᏙᏍᏙᏗ ᎪᏪᎸᎩ, (ᎯᎠ ᏂᎬᏅᎩ,) ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ.
phonetic: Ale unuwogihi ale gagaloi tsudosdodi gowelvgi, (hia nigvnvgi,) NuNiGvWiYuSaDeGi ANeHv NuGvWiYuSaDeGi, ALe UNiGvWiYuHi ANeHv UGvWiYuHi.
english: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᎧᎸ ᎬᏙᎬᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎤᏁᏨᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎾᎯᎥ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᎸᎶ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎯᎵᏙᎯ, ᎡᏤᎾ ᎢᏣᏓᏟᏌ ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ;
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino vtsigovgi nvdo igaehi kalv gvdogvgi; ale uwelunvgi asdaya unetsvgi, hia niduweselvgi nahiv tsisqua galvlo ayeli aninohilidohi, Etsena itsadatlisa atsilvquodi Unelanvhi utseli alisdayvdiyi gesvi;
english: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏰᎬᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏔᏅ.
phonetic: Nasgi itsigisdiyi unigvwiyuhi uniquedalvi, ale anisgayegvsda uniquedalvi, ale tsunalinigidv anisgaya uniquedalvi, ale soquili uniquedalvi, ale nasgi na tsunagilvdi, nidigetsinatlavna ale digetsinatlai, nasquo tsunasdi ale tsunatanv.
english: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ, ᎤᎾᏓᏟᏌᏅᎩ ᏓᎿᎭᏩ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏒᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏐᏈᎵᎯ ᎤᎩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi vtsigovgi, ale unigvwiyuhi elohi danewadisvi, ale nasgi tsunatseli aniyawisgi, unadatlisanvgi dahnawa iyunvnediyi uniyelvsvgi nasgi na soquilihi ugili, ale nasgi tsutseli aniyawisgi.
english: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᎩᏃ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᏥᏴᎩᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏠᏯᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏥᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏕᎦᎶᏄᎮᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎤᏓᏰᎸᏙᏗ ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳ ᏗᎬᏅᏃᏛ ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᏗᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
phonetic: Nvginodiganvsadi atsiyvginvgi, ale agatloyastanvgi utlonasdi adolehosgi nasgi agatahv usquanigodi tsidulvwisdanehvgi, nasgi tsidegalonuhedisgvgi nasgi na nvgidiganvsadi utseli udayelvdodi digetsiyelvtanvhi, ale nasgi na tsagatlilostanvhi anadadolisdanehi.  Hia nasgi itsula digvnvnodv widegegadainvsvgi atsilv tsvdalv nahna sagonige adawelagisgi didawelagisgvi.
english: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎾᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯᏃ ᎭᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ ᏐᏈᎵᎯ ᎤᎩᎵ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏕᎨᏥᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎰᎵ ᏨᏓᎦᏄᎪᎬᎩ; ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸ ᏚᏃᎸᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Unalinohiyvhino hayelasdiganvhidv soquilihi ugili utseliga degetsiistanvgi, nasgi aholi tsvdaganugogvgi; nigadvno tsisqua nasgi uniquedalv dunolvhistanvgi.
english: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᎥᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ, ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᎢᏍᏗ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏔᎴᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏓᏕᏒᏛ ᎤᏒᎦᎸᎩ.
phonetic: Dikahnawadidohino vtsigovgi galvladi dayutloasvgi, ganehvgi asduisdi winasdvna atalesvi, ale utsati equa tsudadesvdv usvgalvgi.
english: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩᏃ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᎾᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏎᏓᏂ ᏣᎪᏎᎰᎢ, ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎠᎦᎸᎸᎩ,
phonetic: Uniyvhvgino inadv, nasgi agayvli inadv, nasgi Asgina ale Sedani tsagosehoi, saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv agalvlvgi,
english: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᏗᏔᎴᏒ ᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏰᎸᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᎶᏄᎮᏗ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏳᎶᏐᏅ; ᎣᏂᏃ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᏥᎪᏗ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏞᎦ.
phonetic: Ale winasdvna ditalesv wagadainvsvgi, ale atsisdunvgi, ale uyelvtanvgi asduhvi, nasgi digvwalonuhedi hnaquo nigesvna iyulisdodiyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi danewadisvi, gvni saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv yulosonv; onino hnaquo atsigodi igesesdi tlega.
english: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏓᎩᎪᎲ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᎥᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏙᏥᎪᎥᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᎨ ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏒᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏌ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏛᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᎦᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎨᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᏰᏂ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎠᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎥᎨᏒᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Ale dagigohv degasgilvi, nahnano unanvnvgi ale tsunugododiyi vgegalisgolvdanelvgi; ale dotsigovgi tsunadanvdo dige tsisgudesvhi nasgi Tsisa aninohesgv unisdvdvhi ale kanohedv Unelanvhi utseli aninohesgvi, ale nasgi unadadolisdanelvhi nigesvna nvgidiganvsadi, ale nasgi tsagatlilostanvhi, ale digegowelanvhi nigesvna dinigvdageni, ale tsunoyeni; ale nasgi Galonedv itsulaha anehvgi ale unigvwiyuhi vgesvgi saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv.
english: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏁᎮ ᎬᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᎶᏐᏅ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Anisoisgini tsuniyohusvhi vtla yanehe gvni saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv dulosonv.  Hia nasgi igvyiyi dilehisodi gesvi.
english: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏴᎬᏩᏅᎦ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏥᎸᏍᎩᏂ-ᏗᏁᎶᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ, ᎠᎴ [ᎦᎶᏁᏛ] ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyulisdanedi ale nasganvna nasgi na uweladisdisgi igvyiyi dilehisodi gesvi; nasgi vtla gohusdi yvgvwanvga taline ayohuhisdi gesvi, atsilvsginidinelohi gesesdi Unelanvhi ale Galonedv, ale [Galonedv] itsulaha unigvwiyuhi gesesdi saquo iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv.
english: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎦᎶᏐᏅ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᎧᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎲᎢ;
phonetic: Saquono iyagayvli itsudetiyvdv galosonv, Sedani dvatsikani dvatsinugowisi atsisduhvi;
english: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏛᎡᏙᎵ ᏧᎶᏄᎮᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏚᏓᎠᏗᏒ ᏓᏁᏩᏗᏒᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎺᎪᎦ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏪᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏗᏱ; ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᏃᏳ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎲ ᎾᏂᎥ.
phonetic: Ale dvedoli tsulonuhediyi tsunadalenvdv yvwi nasgi nvgi nidudaadisv danewadisvi elohi tsaneha nasgi Goga ale Megoga, nasgi tsuwetlisodiyi tsunalisdiyi; nanivno noyu amequohi ahv naniv.
english: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏁᏙᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏂᏅ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ; ᎠᏥᎸᏃ ᎤᎯᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᎤᎶᏒᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎰᏅᎩ.
phonetic: Ale nigvnadv elohi unedolvgi, ale dunaduwistanvgi aninv unadanvti, ale osdv ayelvdi gaduhvi; atsilvno Uhilanvhiyi galvladi dvulosvgi ale dunihonvgi.
english: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᎶᏄᎮᎸᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎳᎩᏍᎩ ᎥᏓᎸ ᏩᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎲ ᏅᎩ-ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Asginano nasgi unilonuhelvhi atsilv ale sagonige adawelagisgi vdalv wagadainvsvgi, nahna anehv nvgidiganvsadi ale utlonasdi adolehosgi, ale getsigiliyoisdodi gesesdi nigohilv ale nigohilvi.
english: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎡᏆ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏬᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎧᏛᎢ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎬᏩᎵᎡᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎬᏩᎵᎡᎸᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎸᎯᏢ ᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Ale agigohvgi equa unegv gasgilo, ale nasgi nahna uwoli, nasgi ukadvi elohi ale galvloi gvwalielvgi, vtla ale ilvhitlv gvwalielvgi, vtla ale ilvhitlv gvwadvdi yigese wunilohisdiyi.
english: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎥᎦᏥᎪᎥᎩ, ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏛᎾ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏚᎾᎴᏅᎩ; ᎪᏪᎵᏃ ᏚᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎢᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ; ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ ᏙᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᎬᏅ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale tsuniyohusvhi vgatsigovgi, tsunasdi ale tsunadvna, Unelanvhi uwolv igvyiditlv dunalenvgi; gowelino dunisduisvgi; ale nvwadale goweli unisduisvgi, nasgi gvnidv adanehi tsigi; tsuniyohusvhino dogegugodanelvgi nasgiya nigvnv gowelv gowelihi, nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎺᏉᎯᏃ ᏚᏲᏒᎩ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ; ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏲᏒ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎲᎢ; ᎠᎴ ᏕᎨᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Amequohino duyosvgi tsuniyohusvhi nahna nunadvnvi; ayohuhisdino ale tsvsgino duniyosv tsuniyohusvhi nahna anehvi; ale degegugodanelvgi nigadiyu anisiyvwiha nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸ ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ.  ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Ayohuhisdino gesv ale tsvsgino atsilv tsvdalv widegegadainvsvgi.  Hia nasgi taline ayohuhisdi gesvi.
english: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎩᎶ (ᏚᎾᏙᎥ) ᏂᏗᎪᏪᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᎡᎬᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Nanivno gilo (dunadov) nidigowelvna gesv hia nasgi gvnidv adanehi gowelihi, widegegadaiegvgi atsilv tsvdalvi.
english: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏓᎩᎪᎲᎩᏃ ᎢᏤ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏤ ᎦᏙᎯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏥᎨᏒᎩ ᎤᏂᎶᏐᏅᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎿᎭᏉ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
phonetic: Dagigohvgino itse galvloi ale itse gadohi; igvyiyiyeno galvloi ale igvyiyi gadohi tsigesvgi unilosonvgi; ale vtla hnaquo amequohi yigesei.
english: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏤ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ ᏓᏳᏠᎠᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᎦᎸᎶᎢ, ᎤᏛᏅᎢᏍᏛᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᏣᏙᏚᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎤᏰᎯ.
phonetic: Ale ayv Tsani agigohvgi galvquodiyu gaduhv nasgi itse Tsilusilimi dayutloasvgi Unelanvhiyi galvloi, udvnvisdvgi nasgiya atsiyehi tsadoduisdisgo tsadvnvisdaneho uyehi.
english: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩᏃ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎩᎶ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᎵᏦᏛ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᏛᏕᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎡᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aquadvganvgino asdaya kanegv gilo galvladi dvdalehvsgvgi hia nigawesgvgi, Gvniyuquo Unelanvhi ulitsodv yvwi anehv udasuya, ale Unelanvhi nasgi anehv dvdeni, ale nasgi tsutseli gesesdi yvwi, Unelanvhino uwasv nasgi anehv ehesdi unatseli Unelanvhi gesesdi.
english: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏙᏓᎦᏅᎦᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏂᎦᏌᏬᎢᎲᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏰᎸᏗ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎡᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏰᏃ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏤᎲ ᎤᎶᏐᏅ.
phonetic: Ale Unelanvhi dodaganvgalvhi nigadv danigasawoihvi; vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi ayohuhisdi, ale uyo ayelvdi gesv, ale ditloyasdi gesvi, vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi ehisdi gesvi; igvyiyiyeno tsudalenvdv tsehv ulosonv.
english: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏍᎩᎸᏃ ᎤᏬᎵ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎢᏤ ᏂᎬᏁᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎰᏪᎸᎦ; ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ.
phonetic: Gasgilvno uwoli, hia nuwesvgi, Gvniyuquo nigadiyu tsudalenvdv itse nigvneha.  Ale hia nagiweselvgi, Howelvga; hiayeno nasgi kanohedv gvdlasidvedi nigesvna ale udohiyuhiya.
english: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᏌᎵᏍᏓ.  ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.  ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᏄᎪᎬ ᏓᏥᏁᏁᎵ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Ale hia nagiweselvgi; Nasgi nisalisda.  Ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, igvyiyi gesv ale ulisqualvdi gesvi.  Utadegisgi ama gvnidv adanehi ganugogv datsineneli tsugvwalodi nigesvna.
english: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏯᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏇᏥ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo adasegogisgesdi nigadiyu tsudalenvdv utseli iyulisdodi gesesdi; ale ayv Tsiyanelanvhi gesesdi, uwasvno ayv aquetsi gesesdi.
english: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎡᎾᏍᎩᏂ. ᎠᎴ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎥᏓᎸ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎬ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎠᏓᏪᎵᎩᏍᎩ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ.
phonetic: Unisgaenasgini. ale nunohiyusvna, ale unisgaisdi, ale dinadahihi, ale uninegutsidv, ale dinadonisgi, ale Unelanvhi diyelvhi dinadadolisdanehi, ale nigadiyu aniyegogi, unatseli igegvnedi gesesdi vdalv nahna adaweligisgv atsilv ale sagonige adaweligisgi; nasgi taline ayohuhisdi tsigi.
english: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩᏃ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏓᏂᏰᎲᎩ ᏚᎵᏉᎩ ᎫᎫ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᏗᏟᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ; ᎡᎮᎾ, ᏓᎬᏯᏎᎮᎵᏃ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ.
phonetic: Agilutselvgino asiyvwi nasgi na galiquogi iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi, nasgi tsidaniyehvgi duliquogi gugu galiquogi ulisqualvdi udeyadodi ditlisdi, ale aqualinohetanvgi, hia nuwesvgi; Ehena, dagvyasehelino atsiyehi unodena agina udalii.
english: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏆᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩᏃ ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛ ᎡᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ ᏦᏓᎸᎢ ᏩᏆᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ Ꮎ ᎡᏆ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏍᏗᏗᏒᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ.
phonetic: Aquatinawidvhvgino diquadanvdv equa ale inv igati tsodalvi waquatinvstanvgi, ale aginanugowiselvgi na equa gaduhvi, nasgi galvquodi Tsilusilimi, eladi nvdayusdidisvgi galvladi Unelanvhiyi dvdalehvsgvgi.
english: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎤᏣᏃᏛᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ, ᏅᏯ ᎤᏣᏘ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏣᏍᏆ ᏅᏯ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Galvquodiyu gesv Unelanvhi utseliga utsanodvgi; ale nasgi dulvsadv, nvya utsati tsugvwalodi nasgiya gesvgi, nasgi tsasqua nvya nasgiyai digvwalvsadv gesvgi.
english: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏐᏴᎩᏃ ᎡᏆ ᎢᏅ ᎢᎦᏘ, ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ [ᏓᏂᏙᎬᎩ,] ᏚᎾᏙᎥᏃ ᏕᎪᏪᎸᎩ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎾᏂᎳᏍᏓᎸ ᎢᏏᎵ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Asoyvgino equa inv igati, galohisdiyino taladu degotlvsvgi, ale galohisdiyi taladu iyanidv dinikahnawadidohi [danidogvgi,] dunadovno degowelvgi galohisdiyi, nasgi taladu nanilasdalv Isili tsuwetsi dunadovi.
english: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏅᏙ ᏗᎧᎸᎬ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ [ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ,] ᏧᏴᏢᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏧᎦᎾᏮᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᏭᏕᎵᎬᏃ ᎢᏗᏢ ᏦᎢ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
phonetic: Nvdo dikalvgv iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi [degotlvsvgi,] tsuyvtlvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi; tsuganawvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi; wudeligvno iditlv tsoi galohisdiyi.
english: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏐᏴᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᎩ, ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᏃ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ [ᏕᎪᏪᎸᎩ,] ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᏧᏅᏏᏛ ᏚᎾᏙᎥᎢ.
phonetic: Asoyvno gaduhv taladu degagusdavgi, degagusdavno taladu dunadovi [degowelvgi,] nasgi taladu iyanidv Unodena agina tsunvsidv dunadovi.
english: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏆᎵᏃᎮᏔᏅᎯ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏐᏴ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Nasgino aqualinohetanvhi ganehvgi adelvdalonige atlvtanvhi atlilosdi, gaduhv atlilosdi, ale galohisdiyi ditlilosdi, ale asoyv atlilosdi.
english: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᏅᎩ ᏧᏅᏏᏴ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏯᏛᎥ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.  ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩᏃ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏩᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏟᎶᏍᏗ, ᎯᏍᎩᎦᏚ ᎢᏯᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᏂᎬᎩ.  ᏂᎦᏅᎯᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏯᏛᎲ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛᎢ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎨᏒᎩ.
phonetic: Gaduhvno nvgi tsunvsiyv gesvgi, ganvhisv ale ayadvv utloyiquo gesvgi.  Utlilovgino gaduhv uwatanvgi atlilosdi, hisgigadu iyasgohitsuqui iyutlilodv nigvgi.  Niganvhisv ale nayadvhv ale nigadvi utloyiquo gesvgi.
english: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏴᏃ ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩᎦᎵ ᎢᏯᎩᏳᏍᏈᏛ ᎤᏟᎶᎥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏅᎯᏛ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏟᎶᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Aseyvno utlilovgi asgohitsuqui nvgasgohi nvgigali iyagiyusquidv utlilovgi, nasgi yvwi utlilosdi iganvhidv, nasgi dikahnawadidohi utlilosdi.
english: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏐᏴᏃ ᏣᏍᏆ ᏅᏯ ᎠᏁᏍᎨᏛᎩ; ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏛᎩ, ᏧᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Asoyvno tsasqua nvya anesgedvgi; gaduhvno gohusdi nasuyvna adelv dalonige gotlvdvgi, tsulvsadv adagedi nasgiyai.
english: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏕᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥᏃ ᎠᏐᏴ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ ᏕᎪᏚᎢᏍᏛᎩ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ ᏅᏯ; ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎦᎫᏍᏓᎥ ᏣᏍᏆ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏔᎵᏁᏃ ᏌᏆᏯ, ᏦᎢᏁᏃ ᎦᎵᏏᏙᏂ, ᏅᎩᏁᏃ ᎡᎻᎳ,
phonetic: Degagusdavno asoyv gaduhvi degoduisdvgi nudalesv digalvquodi nvya; igvyiyi gagusdav tsasqua gesvgi, talineno saquaya, tsoineno galisidoni, nvgineno emila,
english: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᏍᎩᏃ ᏌᏙᏂᎩ, ᏑᏓᎵᏁᏃ ᏌᏗᏱ, ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏃ ᎩᏐᎳᏗ, ᏧᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᏇᎵ, ᏐᎣᏁᎵᏁᏃ ᏙᏆᏏ, ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏃ ᏟᏌᏇᏌ, ᏌᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᏤᏏᏂ, ᏔᎳᏚᏏᏁᏃ ᎠᎻᏗᏏ.
phonetic: Hisgino sadonigi, sudalineno sadiyi, galiquogineno gisoladi, tsunelineno queli, soonelineno doquasi, asgohineno tlisaquesa, sadusineno tsesini, taladusineno amidisi.
english: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏔᎳᏚᏃ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᏗᏍᏚᏗ ᏔᎳᏚ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏛᎩ; ᏌᏉ ᎠᏍᏚᏗ ᏌᏉ ᏓᎬᎾᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᏢᏛᎩ ᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎾᏑᏴᎾ ᎠᏕᎸ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎠᏢᏛᎩ, ᏧᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏓᎨᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ.
phonetic: Taladuno degotlvsv disdudi taladu dagvnaiyunasdi degotlvdvgi; saquo asdudi saquo dagvnaiyusdi gotlvdvgi edasdiyi udlanvdv gaduhv gohusdi nasuyvna adelv dalonige atlvdvgi, tsulvsadv adagedi nasgiyai.
english: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏯᎩᎪᎮ ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎩ.
phonetic: Vtla ale yagigohe nahna digalawiisdiyi; ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi Winasdvna ulinigidv ale Unodenaagina nasgi digalawiisdiyi igi.
english: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᏅᏙ-ᎢᎦ-ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ-ᎡᏃᏱ-ᎡᎯ ᎤᎦᎵᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ; ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ-ᎠᎩᎾ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᎩ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ.
phonetic: Gaduhvno vtla yunaduli nvdoigaehi ale nvdoenoyiehi ugalihisdiyi nahnani; galvquodiyuyeno gesv Unelanvhi utseli iga utisdv nahnani, ale Unodenaagina iga atisdisgi igi nahnani.
english: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛᏃ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᎸᏌᏛ ᎠᏁᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᏃ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏴᎯᎭ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ.
phonetic: Tsunadalenvdvno yvwi nasgi getsisdelvdv gesv nasgi dulvsadv anedohesdi; unigvwiyuno elohi anehi nahna aniyvhiha getsilvquodv ale tsunatseli tsudalenvdv digalvquodi.
english: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᎿᎭᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᎥᏝ ᏧᏂᏍᏚᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᎦ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ.
phonetic: Ale galohisdiyi nahna degotlvsv vtla tsunisdudi yigesesdi iga, vtlayeno svnoyi yigesesdi nahnani.
english: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏴ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ.
phonetic: Ale nahna aniyohihesdi tsunadalenvdv ayv unatseli galvquodiyu gesv ale tsadalenvdv digalvquodi.
english: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏎ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏴᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᏓᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏆᏘᏍᏗ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ; ᎤᏅᏒᏍᎩᏂ [ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏙᎥ] ᏗᎪᏪᎵ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎤᏃᏕᎾᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Ale vtla ase nahna uyvsdi yigesesdi gohusdi gadaha, ale uniquatisdi tsulvwisdanehi, ale gayegogi; unvsvsgini [uniyvsdi gesesdi dunadov] digoweli gvnidv adanehi gowelihi Unodenaagina utseliga.
english: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᎤᏁᎬ ᎤᏪᏴ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ, ᏗᎬᏩᎸᏌᏛ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎩ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ.
phonetic: Aginanugowiselvgino unegv uweyv ama gvnidv adanehi, digvwalvsadv gesvgi, dagananugogvgi gasgilv Unelanvhi ale Unodena agina unatseliga.
english: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏰᎵᏃ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏧᎳᏗᏢ ᎤᏪᏴᎢ, ᏡᎬᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏡᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎳᏚ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏓᏦᎳᏂᏒ ᎬᎾᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ; ᎤᎳᏍᏚᏒᏃ ᎤᎾᏅᏬᏗ ᎨᏒᎩ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
phonetic: Ayelino udlanvdv nahna edasdiyi, ale itsuladitlv uweyvi, tlugvgi gvnidv adanehi tlugvi, nasgi taladu iyudalegi adadvsgvgi ale nidatsolanisv gvnasgvgi udatanvhi; ulasdusvno unanvwodi gesvgi tsunadalenvdv yvwi.
english: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏃᏕᎾ ᎠᎩᎾ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏍᎩᎴᏍᏗ; ᏧᏤᎵᏃ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ;
phonetic: Vtla ale hnaquo yehesdi usonvi; Unelanvhisgini utseli ale Unodena agina utseli gasgilo nahna gasgilesdi; tsutselino tsunvsidasdi gvwadadolisdanehesdi;
english: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎤᎧᏛᏃ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᏚᏙᎥᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏂᎬᏓᎨᏂ ᏕᎪᏪᎴᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Ukadvno anigowatisgesdi; dudovno nasgi dinigvdageni degowelesdi.
english: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᎿᎭᏂ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎠᏨᏍᏙᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏙ ᎢᎦᎡᎯ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏘᏍᏛᎢ; ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎦ ᏓᏘᏍᏓᏁᎭ, ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Vtla ale svnoyi yigesesdi nahnani, vtla ale yunaduli atsvsdodi, ale nvdo igaehi iga utisdvi; Ugvwiyuhiyeno Unelanvhi iga datisdaneha, unigvwiyuhino gesesdi ulisquadisdi nigesvna.
english: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ.  ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ ᏧᏅᏎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏧᏩᏁᏗᏱ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi, Hia nasgi kanohedv gvdlasidvedi nigesvna ale udohiyuhiya.  Ugvwiyuhino Unelanvhi getsilvquodi anadolehosgi unatseliga tsunvse utseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv itsuwanediyi tsutseli tsunvsidasdi, nasgi tsudalenvdv nigohilvnaquo iyulisdodi gesvi.
english: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ; ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Gvniyuquo tlegiyu datsilutsi; osiyu iyulisdanedi asquanigodisgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani gowelihi gowelvi.
english: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᏣᏂ ᎠᎩᎪᎲᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ.  ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏅᎩ ᏓᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏂᏒᎩ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎯ.
phonetic: Ale ayv Tsani agigohvgi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv, ale aquadvganvgi.  Aquadvganvno ale agigohv, eladi aquadanvnvgi dagadadolistanisvgi dulasgv nasgi na dikahnawadidohi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv aginanugowiselvhi.
english: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᎥᏞᏍᏗ.  ᎠᏴᏰᏃ ᎤᏠᏱᏉ ᎡᎩᏂᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ; ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎯᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi, Vtlesdi.  Ayvyeno utloyiquo egininvsidasdi, ale ayv nasgi anadolehosgi tsigesv itsalinvtli, ale nasgi anisquanigodisgi kanohedv ani gowelihi gowelvi; unelanvhi hiyadadolisdasi.
english: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ, ᏞᏍᏗ ᏣᏍᏚᏅᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ; ᎤᏍᏆᎸᎯᏗᏰᏃ.
phonetic: Hiano nagiweselvgi, Tlesdi tsasdunvgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani hia gowelihi; usqualvhidiyeno.
english: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎠᏏᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᎾ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
phonetic: Gilo asgana gesesdi, asiquo asgana gesesdi; gilono gadaha gesesdi, asiquo gadaha gesesdi; gilono osiyu iyadvnehi gesesdi, asiquo osiyu iyadvnehi gesesdi; gilono asgana nigesvna gesesdi, asiquo asgana nigesvna gesesdi.
english: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᎫᏴᏗ ᏥᏰᎮᏍᏗ, ᎦᏥᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ale gvniyuquo tlegiyu datsilutsi; ale aquaguyvdi tsiyehesdi, gatsinediyi naniv anisiyvwiha nasgiya nusdv dunilvwisdanelvi.
english: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᎢ.
phonetic: Ayv Eliqua ale Omiga, didalenvdisgi ale asquadisdisgi, ale igvyiyi ale ulisqualvi.
english: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎣᏏᏳ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏡᎬ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎪᏢᏒ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ.
phonetic: Osiyu iyunalisdanedi nasgi na utseli dikahnawadvsdi nigawesgv iyanadvnehi, nasgi gvnidv tlugv unatseli iyulisdodiyi, ale wigvwaniyvsdi iyulisdodiyi galohisdiyi gotlvsv gaduhvi.
english: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏰᏃ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎩᎶ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏙᏂᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏗᏰᎸᎯ ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᏰᎪᎩ ᎠᏃᏢᏍᎩ.
phonetic: Doyiditlvyeno anedoha gilo, ale dinadonisgi, ale uninegutsidv, ale dinadahihi, ale Unelanvhi diyelvhi dinadadolisdanehi, ale nigadiyu osiyu uniyelvhi gayegogi gesv, ale gayegogi anotlvsgi.
english: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏴ ᏥᏌ ᏗᏥᏅᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᏗᏱ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ.  ᎠᏴ ᏕᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏃᏈᏏ ᏧᎦᏙᏴᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎡᎯ.
phonetic: Ayv Tsisa ditsinvsv aquatseli dikahnawadidohi gvnigesv itsvnediyi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv tsunanelodi dunadatluwadisvi.  Ayv Dewi uwetsi ale nasgi unetlvtanvdv gesvi, ale noquisi tsugadoyvisdi ale sunale ehi.
english: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᏰᎯ ᎡᎮᎾ ᎠᎾᏗᎭ.  ᎠᎴ ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎡᎮᎾ ᎠᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ.  ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎩ ᏫᎦᎷᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎹ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
phonetic: Adanvdono ale atsiyehi Ehena anadiha.  Ale advgisgi Ehena adisgesdi.  Ale gilo utadegisgi wigalugi; ale gilo udulisgesdi ganegisgesdi ama gvnidv adanehi tsugvwalodi nigesvna.
english: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎭ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ  ᎢᎧᏁᏉᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏁᏉᎡᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᏥᎪᏪᎳ;
phonetic: Gvnigesvyeno nigatsiyvneha nanivquo gilo anadvgisgi kanohedv adolehosvhi ani gowelihi tsigowela, nasgi iyuno gilo  ikanequosgesdi hia nasgi tsudalenvdv ani gowelihi tsigowela, Unelanvhi ase unequoedi gesesdi udeyadodi gesv ani gowelihi tsigowela;
english: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎢᏳ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎪᏣᎴᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎦᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏳᏬᏣᎳᎡᎵ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎪᏪᎸ ᎠᏂ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ.
phonetic: Iyu ale gilo igotsalesgesdi igadv kanohedv gowelihi hia nasgi adolehosvhi gesvi, Unelanvhi ase dayuwotsalaeli utseli gesv gvnidv adanehi gowelihi, ale galvquodiyu gaduhvi, ale tsudalenvdv gowelv ani gowelihi.
english: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᎬᏁᎯ, ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏓᏥᎷᏥ.  ᎡᎺᏅ; ᎰᏩᏉ; ᏞᎩᏳ ᎯᎷᎩ ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ.
phonetic: Hia nasgi tsudalenvdv gvnigesv igvnehi, hia nigaweha, udohiyuhiya tlegiyu datsilutsi.  Emenv; howaquo; tlegiyu hilugi Tsagvwiyuhi Tsisa.
english: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
author: Cherokee New Testament

syllabary: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ.  ᎡᎺᏅ.
phonetic: Gvwagatiya udadolisdi gesv Ugvwiyuhi Tsisa Galonedv igatseliga itseladidohesdi nitsivi.  Emenv.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
author: Cherokee New Testament
